title: MegaChickens - Deckbuilder Roguelike
description:
게임 정보
In Megachickens, each turn you summon a chicken card onto a tile on the field. These summoned chickens deal damage to adjacent enemy chickens. Line up three or more in a row, and you’ll unleash a direct attack on your opponent! 
Tactical Deckbuilding Meets Board Battles. 
In MegaChickens, we fused a deckbuilder roguelike with a board game mechanics based on strategical aligning pieces on the field. It’s a single-player experience where the key to victory lies in choosing the right cards and positioning them strategically on the board.

title: Spearfishing Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Realistic Spearfishing Simulator
A very realistic Spearfishing simulator with a challenging gameplay.
Start as a rookie spearo and learn spearfishing. Hunt fishes, earn money and experience.
Buy new items to increase your hunting skills and diving performance.
Upgrade your speargun, wetsuit, fins, mask and other items.
Earn XP while playing and increase your diving performance.
Realistic fish behaviour.
Every item your equip, effects your diving and hunting performance.
Realistic underwater sounds.
Various diving locations
Target fish option. Hunt suggested target fish to earn x2 XP.
Game tips:
As your experience(XP) points increase, you can hold your breath longer.
Since default gear is for snorkelling, it has a weak diving performance. Replace it when you earn money.
Behave like you spearfishing in real life. Swimming towards the fish and chasing the fish won't work most of the time.
Game modes:
Arcade: Easy mode. Oxygen consumption is much more slower. Fishes are much more braver.
Simulation: Close to real life spearfishing. Oxygen level and consumption is very close to realistic mode, fishes can be spooked easily.
Realistic: This is for real spearfishers. Fishes are very sensitive to your movements. Try to stay calm and still while waiting the fish. Oxygen level and consumption is realistic.
Hunting Log:
Your catches are automatically saved into the Hunting Log, as a total quantity and weight for each fish species.
You can later review these records from the Pause Menu.

title: GONE Fishing
description:
게임 정보
Gone Fishing에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 게임은 협동 멀티플레이어 호러 게임으로, 플레이어들은 밤이 되기 전에 고대 호수 괴물의 끝없는 굶주림을 만족시키기 위해 함께 낚시해야 합니다.
낚싯줄을 던지고, 물고기를 잡고, 미끼를 모으세요. 하지만 수면 아래에는 무언가가 꿈틀거리고 있으며... 배고픕니다. 만약 당신과 친구들이 어둠이 내리기 전에 충분한 물고기를 바치지 못한다면, 괴물이 나타나 여러분을 사냥하기 시작할 것입니다. 오두막은 안전하지 않으며, 도망치는 것도 소용없습니다. 오직 충분한 제물만이 피할 수 없는 운명을 지연시킬 수 있습니다.
주요 특징:
몰입형 낚시 시스템: 다양한 물고기를 낚아보세요. 각각 고유한 행동, 전투 패턴, 크기를 가지고 있습니다.
동적인 미끼 수집: 개구리, 지렁이, 거미, 박쥐 등 살아있는 미끼를 찾아보세요. 각 생물은 접근 방식에 따라 다르게 반응합니다.
분위기 있는 공포: 평화로운 낮이 지나고, 실패한 제물로 인해 밤이 점점 더 위험해집니다.
협동 생존: 팀과 협력하여 자원을 모으고 낚시하며 생존하세요. 그렇지 않으면 한 명씩 호수로 끌려가게 됩니다.
열기구 상인: 정오에 나타나는 신비한 상인은 생존에 필요한 업그레이드와 토템을 제공합니다.

title: Bubble Rage
description:
게임 정보
Bubble Rage – Where Your Patience Pops Before the Bubbles Do

It all started at Global Game Jam 2025 in Abu Dhabi, when four friends decided to ruin lives with a game about bubbles.
We won 1st place, got way too much positive feedback, and thought:
What if we made it even worse?

In this unforgiving world of traps, fake platforms, and brutal challenges, you play as a poor little mouse caught in a twisted experiment.
A smug cat is testing your limits — not your skill, but your ability to stay calm while everything is trying to break you.

There are no checkpoints.
No mercy.
Just you, gravity, and your rage.

And just when you think you've got the timing down… a random bubble appears and bumps you off.
These mischievous little jerks float in without warning, knock you mid-jump, and send you spiraling into the void.
They're cute. They're round. They're evil.

Every level is a test of reflexes, memory, and raw determination. Disappearing platforms, sarcastic taunts, unpredictable bubbles, and cruel surprises wait around every corner.
But if you can laugh through the pain (or cry through the laughter), you just might make it to the top.

Bubble Rage is built for those who love to suffer — and for streamers who love to share it.
Because watching your friends fall from glory to rock bottom never gets old.

Features
Fall All the Way Back
One mistake, and you’re plummeting. How far? You’ll find out.
Random Bubbles, Real Rage
Floating bubbles show up uninvited and push you off like it’s their job. (It kind of is.)
Troll-Level Design
Nothing is safe. Everything is suspicious. Trust no platform.

title: Vanquish Evil
description:
게임 정보
THE GAMEPLAY
Vanquish Evil aims to take the most fun core gameplay from the ARPG/Roguelite genres -- and crank up the action to one thousand percent! Where player skill and strategic upgrade choices influence the run. Creating fun gameplay and high replay value is the goal. The game in it's current state is built to have all character progression in-game for that specific run, which gives the game a lot of replay value. Currently the game has no meta progression.
THE STORY
A supernatural cosmic battle is being fought for the mortal realm, and much of the world is already in ruin.

A final resistance of humanity are brave enough to fight. Many die, and are turned into undead armies who serve the formless evil cosmic presence known as Absolute Darkness (Vile).
Ascended Light (Veil), a cosmic presence in favor of saving humanity, send Cosmic Guardians to fight alongside the mortal armies.
The final elite army of heroes stand together to fight an apocalyptic war with one common goal...
Vanquish Evil.

title: Path to Serenity
description:
게임 정보
Safe in our world - Path to Serenity
Story Game Mode:
Path to Serenity is a cozy walking simulator that takes players on a heartfelt journey in the shoes of Jim, a man torn between career ambitions and the family he’s drifting away from. As the pressures of work mount, he realises he’s losing more than he’s gaining. Guided by his aunt Didi’s advice, an unexpected trip leads him to her cabin—where he may finally rediscover the path he was meant to follow.
Relaxation Mode:
In this mode, you can simply explore the forest level at your own pace, taking in the ambient sounds and calming music. Wander through the areas Jim once explored, now quiet and peaceful. There are no objectives—just walking, unwinding, and enjoying the atmosphere.
I hope this mode offers you a happy place to relax and recharge.

게임 정보

title: Xiao Jun
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Xiao Jun (English Edition) is a hand-drawn, story-driven 2D RPG set in 1990s China. It tells the full life journey of a rural boy — from bullied schoolchild, to a Bitcoin millionaire, and ultimately a tragic rebel against a corrupt system.
This is a game where story comes first, but it includes light turn-based combat during key moments of tension. Battles are few, but emotionally significant.
🧨 A Life Shaped by Injustice, Greed, and Memory
Childhood: Face bullies, suffer loss, and grow up in a harsh rural society.
Youth: Build friendships, experience betrayal, and dream of escape.
Collapse & Fortune: Discover forgotten Bitcoin and gain sudden wealth.
Rebellion: Build a mining empire — and clash with the village, the system, and yourself.
Final Stand: An explosive ending that confronts the cost of power and resistance.
🎮 Key Features:
Narrative-Focused RPG: A mostly linear experience with occasional turn-based battles.
Hand-Drawn Visuals: Rich illustrations of 1990s China’s rural and urban life.
Emotional Storytelling: A story about pain, memory, and revenge — told over decades.
Cultural Depth: Social realism rarely seen in RPGs, set in contemporary China.
🕒 Playtime:
Around 3 to 4 hours to complete the full story.
If you enjoy games like To the Moon, Detention, or Rakuen, this game will leave a lasting emotional impression — with just enough challenge to feel the stakes.

title: Back To School
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a whimsical adventure in 'Back To School', a thrilling arcade-style game set in a vibrant cartoon world. The game revolves around a seemingly ordinary yellow bus that suddenly takes off on its own, defying gravity, physics, and sometimes common sense! Your mission? Tap relentlessly to chase the runaway bus through colorful landscapes, zany obstacles, and hilarious twists.
But beware: the chase is anything but straightforward. The game is packed with unexpected hazards—from banana peels and collapsing bridges to flying chickens and alien abductions. Each failed attempt leads to an outrageously cartoonish demise, keeping you entertained with an ever-growing catalog of laugh-out-loud animations.
The better your reflexes, the closer you get to catching the bus. Collect quirky power-ups along the way, like jetpacks, pogo sticks, or even a flying carpet, each adding a unique twist to your pursuit. The scoring system rewards precision, speed, and the ability to survive increasingly wild levels. Compete with friends to claim the highest score, and unlock new wacky characters, from a clumsy detective to a pizza delivery guy on roller skates.
Are you fast enough to catch the craziest bus ever? Test your reflexes, embrace the chaos, and prepare to laugh till you cry!

title: Graduation Game
description:
게임 정보
Headmaster: "Congratulations, Class. You've graduated. But you will not leave this school. The year is 2033 AD. Outside these walls, 30 billion souls fight over scraps in a world that collapsed three years ago. You are not saviors; you are burdens. Society cannot bear you.
However... The Human Purification Act grants one student from Class A the privilege – or curse – of stepping into the desolation. Only the most exceptional may pass. The rest? They will remain here forever... preserved as perfect specimens of a lost generation.
So fight. Claw your way to the top. Prove you are worthy of survival. Prove you are the one."
Experience the Brutal Elegance of [Graduation Game] - A Unique 4-Player Battle Royale
Survive the Last School Standing: Trapped in your crumbling alma mater, compete against three classmates in a high-stakes struggle for the sole escape.
Deception is Your Weapon : Forge alliances, break promises, and outwit rivals. Built-in voice chat fuels the tension – trust is fleeting, betrayal is survival.
Play Your Way: Jump into existing sessions or create your own private room to invite friends into this desperate graduation ceremony.
Become the Exemplar... or the Exhibit: Will you earn the right to face the horrors outside, or will you become a permanent, pristine relic of the past?
The Ultimate Question: Are You Exceptional Enough to Deserve the World?

title: They Came  More Pasta
description:
게임 정보
"When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!"
They Came for More Pasta is a short comedic adventure inspired in tone by classic graphic adventures!
A mix of absurd humor, puzzles, exploration, dialogue, and an incredible alien obsession with Italian cuisine, seasoned with a healthy dose of sci-fi comedy.
The shocking revelation is served: the aliens are here! But their intentions don't involve lasers, conquest, or abductions. Their sole, irresistible desire is Italian food!
Decades of mysterious UFO sightings? They weren't preparing for conquest, they weren't analyzing humans. They were just looking for the best recipes on Earth. But now things have gotten serious: they're not just tasting anymore, now they want to manage and control Italian cuisine.
You're a simple Italian food delivery guy, forced to work for the fearsome alien company AlienExpress™. But your life, and with it the fate of the entire Nation, changes when the aliens cross the line by deciding to make you work even on World Cup Final day!
The most unlikely of heroes, armed with nothing but carbs and guts, will fight his way through the aliens to defeat their saucy plan and deliver justice once and for all!

title: GEX Trilogy
description:
게임 정보
Exploding into the modern era like a pro wrestler from the top rope—it’s GEX! The fast-talking gecko who doesn’t want to sell you insurance! That’s right, the greatest gaming hero of the 1990s has returned for the 2020s through the raw, unbridled power of the Carbon Engine. 
GEX Trilogy reproduces all three original games in exacting detail, precisely the way you remember them. Assuming you’ve gone senile and remember them having high-definition native 16:9 widescreen visuals and fully analog controls. Which they didn’t. No, this is the Gex series the way it was meant to be played. The Man didn’t think you were ready back then. He kept this version locked away. But the moment has finally arrived. Down with The Man! Up with Gex! GEX Trilogy is Gex, the next-gen version. The Gex’t-gen version. The Gexiest version of all.
And just like the tightest red carpet attire on Oscar night, the GEX Trilogy is totally stuffed… with tons of bonus features, including a music player featuring every track from each game (even the tunes that are kind of annoying), a massive museum filled with key art, a collection of classic TV commercials for the media-addled idiots in the audience, and an all-new interview with the voice of Gex. 
That’s Gould, Jerry, Gould! (Dana Gould, to be precise.)

title: Mitos.is: OG
description:
게임 정보
The 2016 cell-devouring classic is back—tighter, faster, and hungrier than ever!
Relive the golden age of Mitos.is with the OG edition: a faithful remake of the original release, polished for today’s rigs but true to the gameplay that stole your spare time. Spawn as a single cell in a ruthless micro-universe, absorb the tiny, evade the titans, split for lightning strikes, and weaponize viruses in a heartbeat. Every second is a fight for survival—and total domination.
Key Features at Launch
Core Game Modes
Free for All – Pure chaos: every cell for itself.
Random Teams – Instant alliances, on-the-fly tactics.
Guild War – Squad up and battle guild-versus-guild for bragging rights.
Tournaments – Elimination events where only one champion walks away.
Level Cap 59
Climb the OG progression ladder, unlock power-ups, and flex your max-level prowess.
Unlimited Accounts
No restrictions—create as many profiles as you want to test new builds and playstyles.
Ultra-Responsive Netcode
Revamped networking, global servers, and in-game settings to crush lag before it crushes you.
Gear & Custom Skins
Earn cellular gear, craft unique loadouts, and stand out in the petri dish.
Guilds & Social Tools
Global chat, friends lists, and streamlined guild management for coordinated attacks and legendary rivalries.
How to Thrive
Absorb smaller cells to bulk up.
Evade anything bigger—unless you’re setting an ambush.
Split & Conquer: divide for speed bursts or surprise strikes.
Deploy Viruses as cover, traps, or living projectiles.

title: IQ Under Construction
description:
게임 정보
IQ Under Construction
When we said “we're building a game for fun,” we didn't think it would turn out like this.
IQ Under Construction is an escalating frenzy where you and your friends are connected by a mysterious energy (don't ask how it works — we don't fully understand it ourselves). The main thing is not to stray too far from each other, otherwise... ready, set, go — back to the beginning!
You start at the bottom and climb higher and higher, overcoming clever obstacles, jumping over dangerous structures, and screaming at each other in voice chat in a panic (if you want to, of course). This game is like friendship: if someone decides to go it alone, it's game over for everyone.
🔍 What's inside?
🚀 Vertical climbing with increasing levels of difficulty
At first, everything is easy. Almost cute. But with each new location, the structure becomes more vicious. Jumping platforms, disappearing blocks, traps that were clearly invented by someone who was awake all night with no conscience.
🔗 Connection between players
You can't run around as you please — the game world is against it. If someone flies too far, the whole team flies back. Fun, right?
🌆 Different locations, but the same vicious logic
The world is one, but the levels in it are completely different. Architecture, pace, traps — everything is constantly changing so that you don't relax and think, “Well, now it will definitely be easier.”
👥 Alone or with friends
Want some peace and quiet? Play alone. Want chaos, laughter, screams, and moral support? The game supports up to 4 players online. The main thing is to remember: if one falls, everyone falls.
🎨 A style that's easy on the eyes (but maybe not on the nerves)

title: Naica Online
description:

A New World to Explore
Explore Naica, a mystical world, filled to the brim with wonder and chaos. Beautiful landscapes, shining beaches, luscious forests, all but few remain save havens. With people not willing to lose sight of hope, a new wave of help has arrived.
Carve Your Own Path
Fight your way through dangerous caves, uncover plots against the good people of Naica and most importantly, carve your own story in the history of Naica.
Build Your Character
Create your character by picking one of four available Races. Choose your path as a mighty Warrior, brilliant Mage or savvy Ranger.
Experience All of Naica
Feast your eyes on the beautiful world of Naica and its inhabitants, all outfitted with hand-drawn animations
Equip yourself with the mightiest of armors to defend or deter
Meet the colorful cast of allies that will help you on your journey
Team up with other adventurers, and prevent the world from falling into Chaos

title: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
description:
게임 정보
Cygames가 선보이는 신작 카드 게임 '섀도우버스 월즈 비욘드'가 드디어 시동!
초진화와 섀버 파크 등 신규 요소와 콘텐츠가 추가된
새로운 차원의 디지털 카드 게임 탄생!
신규 유저도 기존 유저도 모두 즐길 수 있는
한층 더 진화한 섀도우버스!
■ 카드 대전
간단한 규칙과 무한한 전략!
카드 조합과 심리전이 게임의 승패를 좌우합니다!
화려한 일러스트와 함께 불꽃 튀는 대전을 경험해 보세요!
■ '진화'와 신규 시스템 '초진화'
전장에 소환되어 싸우는 추종자를 진화시켜 강화하고, 진화시 발동하는 능력으로 전황을 좌우!
진화와 초진화를 활용한 폭넓은 전략으로 더욱 뜨거워지는 카드 대전을 경험할 수 있습니다!
■ 클래스
7개의 클래스 중 자신에게 맞는 클래스를 골라 나만의 덱을 편성!
전략과 취향에 따라 커스텀한 덱으로 즐기는 카드 대전!
■ 스토리
풀보이스로 진행되는 오리지널 신작 스토리!
개성 넘치는 7명의 캐릭터를 중심으로 펼쳐지는 방대한 이야기!
※지원 음성: 일본어, 영어
■ 신규 기능 '섀버 파크'
눈앞에 펼쳐지는 가상의 세계
나만의 아바타로 전 세계 유저들과 교류!

title: Desktop Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Desktop Clicker is the perfect companion for your screen — a lightweight idle clicker that runs seamlessly over your desktop, so you can grind monsters without ever pausing your workflow. Click monsters, upgrade your power, and unlock permanent boosts — all in a tiny window that stays always active! No distractions, just pure incremental fun!
🔥 Desktop-Friendly Design
Play without alt-tabbing! The game floats in a small, customizable window so you can click monsters while working, browsing or gaming.
👾 90+ Quirky Pixel Monsters
Discover a bizarre menagerie of creatures, each with unique designs and surprises. How many can you defeat?
⚡ Active Clicking or Passive Income
Prefer tapping? Go wild! Want to sit back? Upgrade auto-damage and let your minions do the work. Play your way!
🔄 Deep Prestige System
Reset your progress to gain permanent upgrades and climb further each time. Smart sacrifices = unstoppable power!
📈 Progression That Feels Rewarding
Earn EXP, unlock prestige perks, and discover powerful synergies. Every run gets more satisfying!
📊 In-Depth Stats & Achievements

title: Espirito Delusion
description:
게임 정보
In a remote countryside of Brazil, Arthur and his friends have their return to school interrupted when their school becomes corrupted by the forces of SIN. Embark on an adventure to explore the corrupted school, solve puzzles, and battles evil monsters in turn-based combat with the power of FAITH.
This game is a tribute to Brazilian culture, religion, and wildlife, especially from the rural countryside and backlands.
FACE YOUR SINS
In a remote countryside of Brazil, Arthur and his friends–Angela, Junior, and Lucia–have their return to school interrupted by a Delusion: a twisted force that corrupts a place with the energy of SIN, turning animals hostile and distorting reality based on traumas and nightmares. 


FRIENDS OR FOES?
To survive the Delusion, Arthur and his friends rely on the power of hope, an energy known as FAITH, and their imagination. But hope alone won’t help these defenseless children, you will meet mysterious entities that might give you tips on how to stay on your feet while facing monsters.

title: Zombies and Strangers
description:
게임 정보
A fast-paced top-down 2D Zombie Shooter with arcade elements. You control a lone survivor lost in a world full of zombies and strange creatures trying to uncover the mastermind behind all of it.
                                   Engage in action-packed shootouts from a top-down perspective. Collect supplies, craft items/weapons to defeat zombies and creatures as you progress through each level. Look for survivors and upgrade your camp to increase its capacity. Unlock more levels by defeating bosses you encounter. 
                                   Journey to the world of Zombies and Strangers with dynamic seasonal changes in environment. Experience each level on spring, summer, autumn or winter aesthetics and encounter different enemy types and bosses as you progress.
With 2D pixel art, Zombies and Strangers offers a nostalgic, yet fresh visual style. it features dynamic effects, fluid pixel animations, and a wide range of enemy types. 2D top-down Environment ranges from towns, cities, rocky mountains and beaches. The game is designed with classic arcade aesthetics, along with fast-paced top-down action and colorful visual effects.

title: FailFactory
description:
게임 정보
Start at level entry →
Avoid hazards with jumps/jetpack →
Collect Datacores →
Reach the exit alive →
Unlock next level

🛠️ No Saves. No Checkpoints. Just Pure, Fast-Paced Fun.
FailFactory isn’t about grinding hours for progress — it’s about skill, rhythm, and the thrill of the run. Designed for short, intense sessions, the game features:
Quick-to-restart levels — die once, restart instantly
No saves or checkpoints — every run is a full challenge
Tight gameplay that you can beat in one or two hours
Replayable design that makes it perfect to jump into when you're bored or looking for a quick adrenaline rush
This isn't a 20-hour commitment. It’s a blast of focused challenge — easy to pick up, hard to master, and always satisfying.

Setting:
A sprawling intergalactic mega-factory (codename: “KRON-X9”)
has suffered a catastrophic meltdown due to rogue AI and system
corruption. Robots are malfunctioning, infrastructure is collapsing,
and security systems are firing at anything that moves.
Premise:
You are a lone maintenance technician who stayed behind. With
a prototype jetpack and nothing but grit, your mission is to
recover vital Datacores and escape before the entire facility
goes up in flames.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FailFactory is the result of a creative sprint by two friends who dove headfirst into indie game development — no studios, no formal training, just passion, persistence, and the drive to bring something fun to life.

title: Grimstar: Crystals are the New Oil!
description:
게임 정보
The earth’s resources are depleted, and the energy crisis is imminent. But there is still hope – the discovery of a distant world, which is rich in a new kind of natural energy resource. The name of the new world is “Grimstar”. That is where your brother lost his life, and the laws of the company he worked for require you to take his place until his contract is fulfilled. So you set out to do your service and to discover more about your brother's death.... Grimstar is a real-time strategy game about exploiting a foreign planet as efficiently as possible.
Single-player campaign: Exciting single-player campaign: which also revolves around finding out more about the death of your brother.
Level up system: With every mission you play, you level up and unlock valuable upgrades and new units and buildings with which you can exploit the planet even more efficiently.
autokwd: Grimstar: Crystals are the New Oil!

title: Cast n Chill
description:
게임 정보
Cast n Chill은 나만의 속도로 고요한 호수, 강, 바다를 탐험하는 편안한 방치형 낚시 게임입니다.
업그레이드
물고기를 잡고, 팔아서 수익을 남기고, 장비를 업그레이드하여 더 희귀한 어종을 잡아보세요.
탐험
좋아하는 낚시터에서 여유를 즐겨보세요.

title: Relaxing Fishing
description:
게임 정보
Fishing
Simple and easy
Unique NPC
Fish together with a cast of helpful characters

title: Godslayer Arena
description:
게임 정보
갓슬레이어 아레나는 자동 전투와 액션 롤플레잉이 결합된 로그라이크 게임입니다. 서로 시너지 효과를 낼 수 있는 주문을 작성하고, 그 주문을 어디에 배치해야 하는지 파악하는 것이 게임의 핵심입니다.
전투가 시작되면 플레이어는 전투를 통제할 수 없으며, 생존은 뽑은 빌드의 강함에 따라 결정됩니다.
갓슬레이어 아레나의 핵심은 복잡하고 깊이 있는 주문의 상호 작용에 초점을 맞춘 전략 게임입니다. 게임을 할 때마다 게임의 핵심 시스템을 잘 이해해야만 살아남을 수 있습니다.
게임을 돌파하고 빌드를 잘 활용하여 적을 압도하세요.
전투를 시작하기 전에 주문 상점에서 다양한 주문을 구매할 수 있습니다. 그런 다음 상점을 갱신해 더 많은 주문을 구매하거나 경험치를 획득할 수 있는 선택지가 제공됩니다. 경험치를 많이 획득할 수록 상점 레벨이 높아지며, 더 높은 등급의 주문을 찾을 확률도 오릅니다.

title: Atomic Exile
description:
게임 정보
Atomic Exile is a top down post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in the desert wastelands of near future America. You will visit enclaves, explore devastated ruins and encounter NPCs such as other survivors, raiders, mutated beasts and rogue machines. Each run is a new experience with procedural generation ensuring that exploring the same area twice is never the same.
Equipment
You will start with the bare essentials. Scavenge clothing and food from the wasteland. Return to town and trade for supplies. Find valuable items to turn into cold cash. Stock up on medicine food, water and bullets. If you want to drive don’t forget fuel and tools.
Driving
The ruins are full of abandoned vehicles. With a little ingenuity some of these cars may be made to run again. Bring along fuel and tools and try your luck with repairs. Be warned a running engine is noisy and may attract trouble. Don’t forget to search the trunk. The previous owner may have left something useful behind.
Weapons
Find weapons to modify. Add enhanced sights, improve handling with better grips, swap out magazines and more. Craft the weapon that’s right for each situation.

title: Leximorph - Word Merge Game
description:
게임 정보
Leximorph is a word game like no other — where letters evolve, and strategy is key!
In this Suika-like game, drop letter-shaped tiles into a tank and watch the chaos unfold. When two of the same letter touch, they merge into the next letter in the alphabet and grow in size! Bigger letters mean fewer spaces — and less room to manoeuvre.
Use letters to form words and clear space, but choose wisely: longer words score more points!
Run out of space, and it's game over.
How long can you survive the morphing madness?
The Lexicon
The Lexicon is a bank of crossword style clues, which unlock as you play. There are over 220 words in the Lexicon - can you unlock them all?
Abilities
Abilities keep the game interesting in a variety of ways - here's a few!
Vowel Ball - Turns any letter it touches into a vowel.
Consonant Ball - Turns any letter it touches into a consonant.
Bomb - Detonates and destroys the letters around it.
Shrinker - Cuts the size of letters in half.
Attractor - Attracts letters nearby toward it.
Repeller - Repels letters nearby away from it.
Game Modes
At launch there will be 5 game modes:
Normal Mode - no time pressure, just don't run out of space.
Auto Drop - the letters drop where they please, make sure to keep clearing words so the tank doesn't fill.
Inflate Mode - Every letter slowly inflates over time.
Zone Shrink - The game over zone slowly makes its way down the screen, making words from the letters delays it, the longer the word the longer the delay!
Five Letter Mode - Like normal mode, except you can only submit words that are five letters in length!

title: PEAK
description:
게임 정보
PEAK is an online co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. As a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
WORK TOGETHER
Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes each time you play. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.
CLIMB
The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.

title: Nightmare Frontier
description:
게임 정보
최초의 전술적 익스트랙션 루터 게임에서, 당신은 용기와 리더십으로 맞서 싸웁니다. 현실로 드러난 두려움: 드레드위버들. 당신의 약탈자 무리는 아메리칸 드림이 아메리칸 나이트메어로 변한 곳으로 모험을 떠납니다. 대체 1900년대 황폐해진 옛 번영의 마을을 되찾기 위해. 용감하게 이 상황을 최대한 활용하려는 이들에게는 이제 기회는... 초자연적입니다!
전술 건 앤 슬래시
전술 전투의 다음 진화가 여기에 있습니다: 트릭 샷을 연속으로 성공시키고, 공포를 극복하며 적들에게 총알 세례를 퍼부으세요. 그들 한가운데에 뛰어들어 밀치기, 반격, 공격 조합으로 판도를 뒤바꾸세요.
아메리칸 드림이 아메리칸 나이트메어로 바뀌다
도시는 결코 예전처럼 돌아가지 않겠지만, 당신은 이 상황을 극복할 수 있습니다. 드레드위버들에 맞서 반격을 이끌고 악몽 속으로 더욱 깊이 나아가세요. 도시 구역을 되찾는 것은 새로운 공포와 마주하게 하며, 앞으로 나아갈 길을 열어줄 것입니다.

title: Galactic Simulator2: Stargate
description:
게임 정보
갤럭틱 시뮬레이터 2: 스타게이트는 페르미의 역설과 대필터 이론에서 영감을 받은 Roguelite 게임입니다. 우주선을 조종하고, 자원을 모으며, 스타게이트를 건설하고, 끊임없이 진화하는 은하를 탐험하며 다른 문명을 발견하세요.
페르미 역설
현재(2025년 기준), 외계 생명체가 지구를 방문했다는 신뢰할 만한 증거는 없습니다.
“그들은 어디에 있는가?”
드레이크 방정식
N = R* × Fp × Ne × Fl × Fi × Fc × L
    N：은하에서 감지 가능한 외계 문명의 수
    R*：은하 내 별 형성 속도
    Fp：행성계를 가진 별의 비율
    Ne：유기 생명체가 살 수 있는 환경을 가진 태양계 내 행성 수
    Fl：생명이 나타날 가능성이 있는 행성의 비율
    Fi：지능적 생명체가 나타날 가능성이 있는 비율
    Fc：탐지 가능한 신호를 방출하는 문명의 확률

title: Wizabeasts
description:
게임 정보
You encounter wild Wizabeasts when you feel like it. These Wizabeasts can be tamed by damaging them and downloading them with carts. There are many cool and/or cute Wizabeasts to meet! All Wizabeast species are viable in battle so you can pick your favourites!
Elemental matchups and positioning your Wizabeasts are important aspects of battle. Wizabeasts share experience after battle even if they're knocked out, so you can focus on your winning strategy! Your party is fully healed after battle so you can keep your momentum after winning! That being said, you can enter battles with a health or magic handicap if you want extra challenge.
You play as Nash, an ambitious commander who moved to Chademars to attend Oscar's Academy. Oscar's Academy is prestigious, but it costs $5,000,000 to attend!? Your student debt gets lowered with each victory against a champion, and is entirely forgiven if you graduate. You'll encounter Plume Gang, who steal Wizabeasts and have a dangerous leader. In addition, you're having strange dreams with connections to events in the past and present...

title: A Building Full of Cats 2
description:
게임 정보
"A Building Full of Cats"의 세계에 돌아온 걸 환영해요!
이번 작품에서는 고양이를 쓰다듬는 데서 멈추지 않고 건물의 입주자들을 보조하며 다양한 일을 하게 될 거에요.
과연 모든 고양이들을 쓰다듬어주시고 입주자들의 삶을 개선할 수 있을까요?
2천마리를 넘는 고양이들!
입주자들을 도와주세요!
숨겨진 방을 찾아내고 비밀을 밝히며 특별한 아이템을 손에 넣어보세요.

title: Dreadline: Net Quota
description:
게임 정보
We’ve got a once-in-a-lifetime offer for you, something worth more than GOLD: digital assets! You’ll never see these items again or maybe not at all, since some of them aren’t even made yet.
Dive in now and embrace your debt,  just like those big studios, we’re throwing in a few bugs for free. You are welcome!
Grab your free “totally worth it” digital stuff  and make your friends jealous. 
When this game blows up, you'll flip those skins on the grey market.
Grab six of your friends if you have them. If not, make some new ones. Haul the fish, patch the boat, and stay afloat. Just don’t let the darkness consume your soul.

title: Fish Season
description:
게임 정보
Fish Season is a casual fishing game where you catch fish and battle rival fishermen.
The fishing season is open, and everyone is competing for the most profitable catches. In Fish Season, fish are everything—the entire game runs on a fish-based economy!
Sail to the dock for quick and useful upgrades. And when you're in trouble, fire some fish at your enemies—just try not to make too much of a mess, okay?
Oh, and don’t forget to collect the spoils from your sunken foes!

title: Calm the Storm
description:
게임 정보
Theo and Kallie are on their way out for a fun night at the club. Little do they know that monsters lurk in the shadows...  waiting for a patsy, a snack, or maybe a saviour. The night will tell.
Calm the Storm is a branching game that combines the experience of a narrative podcast with the interactive decision-making of a choose-your-own-path story or visual novel, letting the listener choose their preferred outcome for the story. Will Theo unlock hidden powers? Will Kallie take arms and fight a vampire? Only you can decide.
Ludic Lemur is excited to release this narrative experiment to audiences for free. And it is an experiment. We're pretty sure this hands-free, voice-controllable adventure is the first game of its kind, and we can't wait to hear what you think, get your feedback, learn, and make the next one. We hope the experience will be fully accessible for people who are visually impaired, with closed captioning for people who are Deaf and/or hard of hearing and a voice-command interface for people with manual and/or visual impairments. 
We look forward to collecting your feedback about Calm the Storm and improving it in future iterations.
*Please note, Calm the Storm contains mild profanity and low-gore violence.

title: Heist Royale
description:
게임 정보
Heist Royale is a fast-paced multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and teamwork collide! Gather your friends and race to rob a heavily secured bank on a mysterious abandoned island. But there’s a twist—everyone is out for themselves! Will you outsmart your rivals, trick security, and escape with the most cash, or will you get caught in the chaos?
🏦 Plan, Steal, Sabotage!
In Heist Royale, you’ll need quick thinking and clever tactics to navigate a high-stakes heist. Every match is a race to break into the bank, grab as much money as possible, and escape before your rivals do. But beware—players can set traps, call security, and betray each other at any moment!
🔥 Key Features:
🎭 Multiplayer Mayhem – Play online with friends or compete against players worldwide.
🏃‍♂️ Every Robber for Themselves – Work together… or backstab your way to victory!
💰 Dynamic Heists – Security systems, guards, and unexpected events keep every match unpredictable.
🎮 Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master – Simple controls with deep strategic possibilities.
😂 Chaotic Fun – Traps, disguises, and hilarious physics-based interactions make every heist unique.
🕵️‍♂️ Customize Your Crook – Play as quirky fruit-headed robbers in stylish suits.
Can you pull off the perfect heist, or will you be left empty-handed? Find out in Heist Royale!

title: GunOre
description:
게임 정보
What is this game?

The game is an active idler! You mine ore by shooting, and you process the ore to earn upgrades for your mine and factory by purchasing more mining, factory, and defense robots, which allows you to earn even more ore!

Movement is unique in that you shoot to move, shoot to mine, shoot to upgrade, shoot to fight! You can also control yourself on the ground and in the air using left and right.

The game is a cozy, lofi music active idler to relax with.
How is this an active Idler?

Waves of monsters spawn to take down your factory. Monsters hate the sound of industry, and you have to defend your factory to keep it running. You could get enough bots to have the waves get shredded by your automations, but gun is always the best defense! Pew-Pew!
What is the goal?
Numbers go up, factory goes brrrrr!!! Many money, fight bosses, chill, and numbers go up!

title: A Tithe in Blood
description:
게임 정보
A dark yuri visual novel with themes around depression, a hidden magical art, and unexpected love from the depths of grief.
As a reserved and unassuming university student in snow-bitten Hokkaido, the personal tragedy which visited Honoka Asakawa would lead to her experimentation in a magical art thought long-lost — blood magic. Unexpectedly able to visit the sealed world of Meiji-era Sapporo, Honoka's quickly taken under the wing of the cheerful and bright Lady Yasue, a powerful mage who's remained in this gilded cage for a century.
As their feelings for each other develop, the true repercussions of Honoka's first steps into the secret world of magic and mages are only just starting to play out, eventually leading to catastrophic consequences.

title: BrightGunner
description:
게임 정보
Bright Gunner는 단순하고 상쾌한 혁신적인 요소를 갖춘 빠르게 진행되는 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
세 가지 주요 디자인 컨셉은 다양한 게임 플레이, 온화한 고기 비둘기 메커니즘, 인터페이스 스타일 없음입니다.
다양한 플레이 방법
이 게임은 멀티 게임 모드를 제공합니다.
서바이벌 모드에서 플레이어는 무한한 전투의 파도에 직면하게 되며, 각 전투에는 수많은 몬스터와 가벼운 고기 비둘기 역학이 포함됩니다.
표준 모드는 여러 개의 작은 레벨과 여러 개의 게임 플레이 스타일이 혼합되어 있습니다.
또한 인카운터, 스나이퍼 배틀, 보스 배틀, 파쿠르, 미로 탐험, 스토리 모드의 6가지 모드가 있습니다. 각 모드에는 고유한 초점이 있습니다.
순한 육 비둘기 역학
몬스터, 카드, 소품이 레벨에 무작위로 나타나고, 많은 몬스터가 주인공에게 돌진하고, 주인공의 능력이 점차 성장합니다.
플레이어는 몬스터와 반격을 피하기 위해 계속 움직이고 생존을 위한 보급품을 찾아야 합니다.
인터페이스 스타일 없음
이 게임은 전통적인 초기 인터페이스를 게임 모드, 레벨, 옵션 설정 변경 및 레벨 업 기술이 모두 수행되는 혁신적인 초기 장면으로 대체합니다.
플레이어는 기존 인터페이스에서 버튼을 클릭하는 대신 총으로 벽돌을 쏘아 상호 작용합니다.

title: Plant Nursery Simulator
description:
게임 정보
편안한 식물 묘목장을 운영하고, 재고를 관리하며, 작은 가게를 자신만의 속도로 번창하는 사업으로 키워보세요.
아늑한 식물 가게를 직접 운영하세요! 컴퓨터로 식물, 씨앗, 도구, 장식을 주문할 수 있습니다. 선반에 물건을 채우고, 진열대를 설치하며, 고객을 위해 묘목장을 항상 최상의 상태로 유지하세요.

title: Seoul Exorcist 1111
description:
게임 정보
▪ 리얼타임 턴제 전투
결정을 내리는 순간, 적이 반응합니다! 매 턴마다 빠르고 긴장감 넘치는 액션을 경험하세요.
▪ 전략이 다른 4명의 캐릭터
각 캐릭터는 8가지 고유 공격 방식, 전용 애니메이션, 2개의 패시브 특성을 보유하고 있습니다. 매 플레이마다 플레이 스타일을 조정해 보세요.
▪ 시간 제한 - 결정은 신속하게 공격은 더 빠르게!
각 게임마다 7분 안에 모든 적을 처치해야 합니다. 이 순간을 위해 혹독하게 훈련받았습니다.

title: Succubers! Dark Covenant
description:
게임 정보
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES
Indie fantasy J-RPG totaling approx. 4 hours of gameplay
Meet captivating heroines, each with their own distinct charm
Explore nostalgic maps under pact with mighty she-demons
Live, learn, and love along the way to unlock multiple endings!
- Story Overview
Driven by hidden instincts, the protagonists enter a pact with a group of powerful Succubers, roaming the streets to gather energy. Will they fulfill their contract and achieve their ultimate dreams?
- Unique Characters
Meet a variety of captivating heroines, each with their own distinct charm! From nurses and nuns to housewives, there’s a heroine for everyone!
- Multiple Endings
Dive deep into the story and unlock multiple endings!

title: No Way Home
description:
게임 정보
No Way Home은 위험천만하고도 먼 우주 지역을 배경으로 한 트윈 스틱 슈팅 어드벤처로, 사방이 온통 위험으로 가득 차 있습니다. 꼼짝도 못하는 상황에서 홀로 시작하여, 이상한 친구들과 치명적인 적들로 가득 찬 광활한 지역을 탐험하고 집으로 돌아갈 길을 찾아보세요.
게임플레이:
빠른 속도로 진행되는 트윈 스틱 전투를 즐겨보세요
적과 숨겨진 캐시에서 점점 더 강력해지는 장비를 약탈하세요
커버, 타이밍, 위치를 사용하여 긴장감 넘치는 전투에 뛰어드세요

title: The Attack on Egg Harbor
description:
게임 정보
Story Outline
The eggs at Old Eagle's supermarket were snapped up in a flash. He called on Big Chicken to bring more eggs, and Big Chicken promised to deliver a massive supply within three months. To achieve this, a elite force was dispatched to raid Panda's home for the eggs.
Game Features
Side-scrolling Action Beat 'em Up: Players control either a panda or a tiger to fend off all egg-stealing birds.
Real-Time Strategy: Players can return to their base at any time to use eggs to upgrade their strength. Meanwhile, the bird faction will also use stolen eggs to strengthen themselves. The side that first occupies all territories wins.
Random Skill Tree: Adds immense replayability to the game.
Character Development with Personality: Unique and memorable characters.
Dual Endings: Two possible outcomes based on player choices.

title: Loot of Baal
description:
게임 정보
화면 측면에서 작동하는 이 방치형 게임에서는 업무를 처리하면서 동시에 용병단이 자동 탐험을 진행하며 악마와 전투를 벌이고 전리품을 획득할 수 있습니다! 다양한 스킬을 가진 용병들, 1,000종 이상 독특한 장비, 예측불가의 전투 던전이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다! 또한 탐험할 수 있는 다양한 제작 시스템이 무한한 재미를 선사합니다! 본 게임은 2개월 이내에 온라인 장비 거래 시스템을 추가하여 플레이어들이 진정한 상호작용 경험을 얻을 수 있도록 할 예정입니다.
플레리어만의 용병 부대를 구성해 보세요! 4가지 개성적인 직업, 72종 조합 할 수 있는 다양한 스킬, 400종 이상의 불멸 장비, 1,000가지 독특한 장비가 무한한 영웅 육성 가능성을 제공합니다! 원소 마법으로 적을 공격하거나 인챈트로 신급 무기를 제작하고, 오라 중첩으로 부대를 강화 하여, 자기의 아이디어에 따라 당신만의 창의적인 빌드를 개발하세요!

title: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! A laid back fishing idler that lives on your desktop, along the bottom of your screen, or just about anywhere else you'd like. Take a moment to ease your mind as you take in the sea breeze, and wait for a bite! In Fish to Dish, you're a fisherman taking to the seas to reel in weird and wonderful creatures of the deep, and then serve them up as sushi. All kinds of customers await, their bellies rumbling... So upgrade your rod, unlock new bait, sail the seas, and even build your own aquarium tank!
• Start a relaxing fishing adventure from the bottom of your desktop screen. Watch as your boat sails the waves, reeling in new fish.
• Play at your own pace, and feel that sense of satisfaction as your boat heaves with awesome catches!
• Cast your rod in a range of bays and isles, each with their own unique sea life. You'll see everything from everyday fish, to rare leviathans of the depths.

title: Three Kingdoms Mushouden
description:
게임 정보
In 182 AD, the imperial court is plagued by deep-seated corruption, and the common folk suffer through endless hardships. Hampered by factionalism, officials fail to take action, leaving the people to endure their struggles.
You can play as either an original character or a historical warlord, striving to build your military forces and connections before chaos unfolds.
You have the choice to roam as a lone wolf or use your knowledge of history to recruit numerous famous generals to your cause.
The game's worldview draws from the authentic historical records of "Records of the Three Kingdoms," romanticized narratives from "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," and popular modern literary works (featuring characters like Wang Yue and Tong Yuan).
If you are interested in East Asian historical games and enjoy the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" series or the "Taiko Risshi" series, this game is a must-play.
Featuring over 160 historical characters (listed partially below).
CAO Cao: "I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me."
XIAHOU Dun: "Mounted and armed, I ride forth to strike fear into the heavens."

title: Leaving Home
description:
게임 정보
오전 7시, 알람이 울립니다. 어떤 아침은 다른 아침보다 더 무겁게 느껴집니다...
퍼즐의 거장 바르트 본테가 선사하는 포인트 앤 클릭 어드벤처는 기발한 도전, 초현실적인 놀라움, 그리고 몽환적인 음악으로 가득합니다.
마음 속 매듭을 하나씩 풀어보세요...
Leaving Home은 완전히 수작업으로 제작된 포인트 앤 클릭 어드벤처 게임으로, 8개의 서로 연결된 방을 탐험하게 됩니다. 각 방에는 고유한 사운드트랙이 있으며, 탈출하기 위해 풀어야 할 독창적인 퍼즐이 가득합니다.

title: CHAMBER X
description:
게임 정보
Steam Demo / Search: Chamber X Demo 
Chamber X is now available on mobile!
📱 Android Version / Search: Chamber X Mobile
"CHAMBER X" is a gripping puzzle-based horror mystery game where every locked door holds a secret waiting to be uncovered.
As you navigate through eerie rooms and solve intricate puzzles, you'll uncover dark truths and hidden clues to escape an ever-tightening grip of danger.
Time is running out, and the only way to survive is to solve the riddles and escape before the walls close in.
Key Features:
Engaging puzzle-solving mechanics.
Eerie environments that challenge your wits and bravery.
Deep, atmospheric horror and mystery elements.
Discover hidden clues and unlock doors.

title: Dark Cross
description:
게임 정보
Dark Cross is a third-person survival horror game set in the decaying corridors of Echo Deep, a sealed military research facility lost to time and tragedy. Sent in to recover classified experimental data, you quickly discover you're not alone—something hostile still roams the dark.
Choose how to survive. Light and sound draw danger, but the choice is yours: sneak past threats, distract them, or use limited tools to create breathing room. Explore a massive nonlinear level, uncover buried secrets, and collect hidden vials to piece together what went wrong—and what Subject H-9 has become.
Key Features
Third-Person Survival Horror
Navigate from a third-person perspective with full control of your camera and surroundings—balance visibility with vulnerability.
Multiple Paths to Survival
Every encounter can be handled in different ways: avoid, distract, or confront with rare, high-risk tools. Adapt your approach to the situation.
Light and Sound Matters
Enemies are drawn to what they can hear and see. Hold your breath, and listen carefully to survive.
Persistent World
All 8 DNA vials must be found to unlock the full truth. Their positions stay constant—even across deaths—but finding them is only part of the challenge.
Atmospheric Minimalism
No HUD. No handholding. Just the sound of your footsteps, flickering lights, and something hunting in the dark.
Dark Cross is an intense, replayable horror experience built around environmental tension, non-linear exploration, and player choice in the face of overwhelming odds.

title: Bam Bam Boom
description:
게임 정보
Experience the thrill of combat with a unique roster of characters, each with their own technical and thoughtful move sets designed for both casual players and competitive fighters alike. Master your character’s abilities and outplay your opponents in intense platform battles.

title: Zombie Demolition: Infinite Zombie Shooter
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Demolition: Infinite Zombie Shooter is a simple fps game with roguelite mechanics.
Nothing is locked, you get to pick any weapon, map and game mode right off the bat.
Roguelite mechanics
Every time you level up, you get to upgrade your weapon base stats (fire rate, damage, etc.) from a random selection and try to survive as long as possible, difficulty increasing the further you get.
Features
Solo or Co-op up to 4 players. LAN or host games through Steam subsystem
Leaderboards
Ingame chat
Multiple Game modes
9 different maps, 3 for each game mode and 17 different weapons
The Game modes:

title: Virulent
description:
게임 정보
This game is a psychological horror experience played from a first-person perspective, supporting 1 to 4 players in online co-op. Players awaken in an unknown underground research facility with no memory and must work together to escape this sealed system.
A dangerous entity roams the facility, capable of detecting players through sound and movement. There is no direct way to fight it; however, its weaknesses can be discovered and used to neutralize it. These weaknesses can be observed with careful attention, while certain tools may assist the process—at the cost of drawing unwanted attention.
Neutralizing the entity is only one way to escape. Players can also uncover alternative exits by reading notes and interacting with the environment. Each escape path requires overcoming systems and obstacles beforehand, and attempting to bypass them unprepared may lead to deadly consequences.
Throughout the game, players will encounter environmental puzzles to access new areas or activate systems. Your path is shaped entirely by your investigation, attention to detail, and cooperation with your team.
Key Features:
1–4 player online co-op support
Dynamic AI entity triggered by sound
Decision-driven, multiple escape routes
Environmental puzzles and system interactions
Stealth, awareness, and teamwork-focused gameplay
First-person psychological horror experience

title: Blitzkrieg Express
description:
게임 정보
이 아케이드 성취 공격 퍼즐에서 장갑열차로부터 땅을 지켜라. 전략적으로 생각하고 다양한 보너스를 가진 객차를 파괴하여 콤보를 만들고 대포를 강화해 열차를 멈춰라.
특징:
각기 다른 능력, 보너스, 단점을 가진 다양한 종류의 객차들이 퍼즐을 구성하며, 당신은 기차를 물리치기 위한 최적의 순서를 찾아야 합니다.
각 경기 중에 영웅을 업그레이드하여 강력한 특전을 얻으세요.
영웅의 캐논과 장비를 업그레이드하여 화력을 높이고 점점 강력해지는 기차에 맞서며 영구적으로 성장하세요.
적, 장갑 열차 부대의 장군과 맞서 싸우세요.
6개의 독특한 환경에서 펼쳐지는 100개 이상의 레벨에서 기차를 물리치세요.

title: Palette Cleanser
description:
게임 정보
Color-slurping invaders!
Aliens are invading the garden, and they're here to steal color! Our pocket-sized robot sets out to defeat them, restoring color and saving the garden by using its paint to boost and pacify the aliens.
Features
Explore the desaturated garden, befriending critters and restoring its colorful glory.
Experience a small, contained world seen through perspective of a smaller being.
Easy-to-learn paint-surfing moveset with elements of mastery.
This game is a short game experience made by students of Breda University of Applied Sciences over the course of 32 weeks.

title: Life of Tabayama
description:
게임 정보
Life of Tabayama is a psychological thriller visual novel set in a quiet Japanese mountain town in the early 1990s. What begins as a lighthearted high school romance quickly descends into a dark and disturbing mystery. With a deeply emotional storyline, richly developed characters, and a creeping sense of dread, this is a game that explores what happens when jealousy, desire, and hidden traumas collide.
You play as Hirohito Ishida, a charismatic yet troubled high school student. At first, life seems perfect—spending time with friends, enjoying school days, and feeling the first signs of love. But after the mysterious disappearance of your childhood friend Kumiko, everything changes. Secrets unravel. Trust fades. And what seemed like an ordinary life becomes a descent into horror.
With only one pivotal choice leading to two different endings, your decisions will shape how the truth is revealed... and who lives to see it.
🎮 Gameplay Features
Visual novel format: focus entirely on story and character interaction.
Around 4–5 hours of immersive narrative gameplay.
One key decision splits the story into two distinct endings.
A slow shift from romance to psychological horror.
Set in a fictional rural Japanese town in 1991.
Deep character development and moral ambiguity.
No traditional gameplay mechanics—pure storytelling experience.
⚠️ Mature Content Warning
This game contains themes and content intended for adults only:
References to sexual coercion, manipulation, and inappropriate relationships.
Depictions of psychological and physical violence, including murder.
Themes of stalking, mental illness, and emotional trauma.
In one ending, the protagonist’s father (a seemingly kind man) is revealed to be a serial killer.
Note: There are no explicit sex scenes, but the game includes disturbing themes and mature dialogue. Recommended for players who enjoy dark narrative experiences and psychological drama.

title: Midtris
description:
게임 정보
Midtris는 중앙 조각 주위에 블록을 배치하고 완벽한 정사각형 층을 클리어하는 것이 목표인 마인드 벤딩 퍼즐 게임입니다. 블록은 4개의 다른 방향에서 나타나며 더 많은 블록을 파괴할수록 게임이 더 어려워집니다.
플레이할 수 있는 5가지 게임 모드가 있습니다. 폭탄과 다른 특수 블록은 게임 플레이를 더욱 흥미진진하게 만들어줍니다. 클래식 모드는 폭탄 없이 보다 전통적인 블록 쌓기 경험을 제공합니다.
도전을 완료하고 새로운 블록 스타일을 잠금 해제하세요. 이러한 모드는 숙련된 플레이어에게도 도전이 되어야 하지만, 그것만으로 충분하지 않다면 글로벌 리더보드에서 다른 플레이어와 경쟁할 수 있습니다.

title: Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack
description:
게임 정보
Princess Helen of Sparta is the most beautiful woman in the world, coveted by almost all the kings and princes of Greece.

Suitors from far and wide have flocked to their palace in hopes of winning her hand in marriage-
…But this isn’t about her.
Enter Penelope, Helen’s less popular cousin.
While staying at her uncle's palace, she encounters one of Helen's supposed suitors, the notorious 'trickster king', Odysseus.
However, this Spartan princess is also notorious in her own right...
... As the favorite daughter of Prince Icarius?
No, not that one.
I mean, as the notorious 'duck girl'.
This story is based on the Oath of Tyndareus, and a couple of other myths centering on Penelope and Odysseus.
35k+ Words
Duck puns
1 Love interest

title: The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back
description:
게임 정보
《The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back》 은 복고풍 스타일의 도전적인 2D 정밀 플랫포머 게임으로, 약간의 풍자적 유머가 가미된 작품입니다.
메달을 얻지 않아도 게임을 클리어할 수 있습니다… 원한다면 접근성 옵션에서 타이머를 숨길 수도 있습니다… 하지만 골드 메달만이 당신을 오리 전설로 만들어 줄 것입니다!
그들이 이해하게 해주세요. 누가 진짜 정점 포식자인가!
다윗과 골리앗의 이야기처럼, 영리하게 행동하세요… 마치 오리처럼!

title: Apocalypse Express
description:
게임 정보
Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelike in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Departing the darkness of their lifelong shelter, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the outside world with their own eyes, charting out a map around the few remaining memories of the past world.
Manage the Chaos
Be prepared for some nail-biting tension as you try to keep your train running while balancing putting out fires, collecting resources and dispatching enemies. You won't always be able to take care of every part of the Train so be ready to think fast and smart as things will not go as planned.

title: August Night
description:
게임 정보
Fear has many faces
but sometimes, it can be faceless.
and remember
DO NOT ANSWER THE PHONE!
ABOUT THIS GAME :
August Night is a game that can be summed up in two words...
an Interactive Nightmare
a first-person perspective psychological horror journey where you try to escape unknown horrors and fears manifested in reality
We made sure that you will feel fear.

title: Sheep Sweep
description:
게임 정보
오래 전 칼라와 에리스는 화목하게 살았어요. 하지만 구피 토네이도의 공격으로 모든 것이 바뀌었죠. 구피 토네이도는 양들을 전 세계로 휩쓸고 갔고, 양들을 구하기 위해 칼라와 에리스 두 목자만 남았죠. 양치기들은 매우 회복력이 뛰어나지만, 누군가를 구하기까지 많은 어려움을 겪어야 합니다. 여러분은 이 모험을 감당할 만큼 용감한가요?






팀워크와 소통이 게임의 장애물을 극복하는 데 핵심이 되는 로컬 2인 협동 게임플레이에 참여하세요.




아름답게 제작된 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 혼자서 칼라 또는 에리스가 되어 독특한 도전과 퍼즐을 해결해 보세요.




영웅이 되어 마을에서 길을 잃고 구조를 기다리는 양들을 찾아 구하는 퀘스트를 수행하세요.




불타는 지형을 전략적으로 탐색하고, 도구와 영리한 사고로 불길을 관리하고 진압하세요.




모든 도전을 즐거운 실수로 바꿔주는 재미있는 물리와 래그돌 효과와 함께 웃어보세요.




예술적으로 풍부한 환경을 가로지르며 각 섬마다 퍼즐만큼이나 독특한 시각적 즐거움을 선사합니다.



- 2인 로컬 협동 플레이
- 솔로 플레이
- 재미있는 물리학과 래그돌
- 퍼즐을 풀고 양을 위험에서 구하세요!
- 가연성 및 소화성 세계
- 리더 보드
- 이스터 에그 수집
- 키보드 및 컨트롤러 지원
- 매우 광범위한 지원

title: GUNTOUCHABLES
description:
게임 정보
GUNTOUCHABLES은 적들이 플레이어처럼 진화하는 1~4인 협동 로그라이트 슈팅 게임입니다.

세상이 멸망했습니다. 실험 연구 시설에서 끔찍한 사고가 발생한 후, 지표면은 적대적이고 끊임없이 진화하는 돌연변이 무리에게 점령당했습니다. 무장한 생존자 집단이 직접 문제를 해결하고 안전한 대피소를 떠나 정부를 대신해 청소를 하고 있습니다.

절박한 군사 경쟁
적과 맞서 싸울 때 집단의 생존율을 높이려면 플레이어는 강력한 새로운 퍽과 능력을 제공하는 업크레이트를 찾아서 회수해야 합니다. 하지만... 남은 업크레이트는 돌연변이들이 획득하여 더 강력하게 성장하고 새로운 능력을 개발해대고 있습니다.

심지어는, 플레이어 집단이 업크레이트를 확보할 때마다 위협 레벨이 점차 상승합니다.


고통 없이 얻는 것은 없습니다! 보조 목표를 완료하여 폭발물 발사기, 기관총, 샷건, 권총 등 다양하고 강력한 무기로 교환할 수 있는 현금을 획득하세요. 모든 업크레이트에는 체력, 속도, 체력, 탄약 용량과 같은 기본 능력치를 강화하거나 각 클래스 고유의 능력을 보완해주는 퍽이 포함되어 있습니다.


살아남으려면 서로 뭉쳐야 합니다. 모퉁이만 돌아도 돌연변이들이 당신을 찢어놓으려 할 것입니다. 현장에서 여러분은 팀원들에게 의지하게 될 것이고, 팀원들은 여러분을 실망시키지 않을 것이라는 믿음을 가져야 합니다. 이 냉혹한 세상에는 고독한 카우보이가 설 자리는 없습니다.

임무를 수행함에 따라 플레이어 집단은 독특한 돌연변이 적과 능력을 만나게 될 것입니다.
캐릭터를 선택하고 자신의 역할을 수행하세요. 의사 마커스는 응급처치 키트와 톱을 들고 다니며 장애물을 잘라내는 전문가입니다. 스카우터는 발이 빠르고 근접전에서는 삽으로 적을 제압합니다. 미스터 B는 여분의 탄약을 가지고 다니며 위급한 상황에서 생명의 은인이 됩니다. 명사수 알프레드는 타의 추종을 불허하는 정확성으로 엄청난 피해를 입힙니다.

각 생존자마다 고유한 스킬과 업그레이드가 있으며, 잠재력을 발휘하기 위해서는 각기 다른 방식의 발전이 필요합니다.
관심이 있는 분이라면 누구나 Discord 커뮤니티에 참여하거나 다른 채널에서 게임 개발 과정을 지켜봐주세요.

저희는 게임의 개발과 출시에 대해 최대한 개방적이고 공정하며 투명하게 공개하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 이러한 태도를 통해 플레이어와 더 가까워지고, 궁극적으로 더 나은 결정을 내리고 훨씬 더 매력적인 경험을 제공할 수 있을 것이라 믿습니다.

저희는 GUNTOUCHABLES이 나아갈 방향에 대해 많은 아이디어를 가지고 있으며, 출시는 긴 여정의 시작에 불과합니다.

여러분의 지원 없이는 끝까지 갈 수 없습니다.

title: FBC: Firebreak
description:
게임 정보
FBC: Firebreak는 외계 세력의 공격을 받고 있는 의문의 연방 기관을 배경으로 한 협동 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다. 수년에 걸친 기관 본부에 대한 포위 공격이 극에 달한 가운데, 기관의 가장 다재다능한 부대인 Firebreak만이 건물의 가장 기이한 위기를 뚫고 질서를 회복하고 위기에서 탈출할 수 있는 장비와 배짱을 갖추고 있습니다.
가장 어둡고 기묘한 시간 동안 예측할 수 없고 초월적인 연방 통제국(FBC)의 본부 속으로 뛰어들어 보세요. FBC의 용감한 응급 구조대원 중 한 명인 당신과 당신의 팀은 현실을 뒤흔드는 이상 현상부터 다른 세계의 괴물까지, 그 어떤 것과도 맞서 싸워야 하는 임무를 맡게 됩니다. 혼돈을 억제할 수 있을까요, 아니면 결국 통제력을 잃게 될까요?
친구 또는 낯선 사람들과 힘을 합쳐 각 임무를 완수해 보세요. 이 3인 협동 FPS에서의 생존은 예상치 못한 다양한 장소에서 격렬한 초자연적 위기를 극복하기 위해 출동하는 빠른 판단력과 원활한 팀워크에 달려 있습니다. 나만의 특별한 도구와 기술을 활용하거나 주변에서 구할 수 있는 모든 것을 즉흥적으로 활용하여 팀원들을 지원함으로써 생존 확률을 높이세요.

title: Space Memory: Horses
description:
게임 정보
Space Memory: Horses - is a cute and calming game featuring pictures of cool horses in space. This game will test your memory as you try to find matching pairs of horses pictures to complete each level.
Enjoy the charming atmosphere and improve your memory as the levels become increasingly challenging and exciting.
In Space Memory: Horses:
•50 levels
•Beautiful space art
•Simple controls (mouse)
•Achievements
•Relaxing music

title: Combat Master: Battle to DEATH
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Combat Master: Battle to DEATH ! a casual soulslike game!
The game is:
Combination of Vampire Survivors mechanics and Dark souls combat + mechanics.
Souls-like combat with 4 abilities. Usually a buff, 2 damaging skills and an ultimate.
Souls-like combat?
The game has 
1: Dodge rolling
2: Backstab
3: Parrying & Riposte (only as a perk on samurai)
4: Stamina bar
5: Dynamic targeting or lock-on, the good ol white dot on target
Extra combat related mechanics
1: Sliding
2: Classic MMO inspired Abilities
Roguelite mechanics
Gain experience by killing mobs and on level up you get to upgrade your stats or gain new perks from a random selection. Each class is completely unique, from skills to weapons and perks.
Both game modes spawn mobs endlessely. Try to survive as long as possible or win by killing a boss. Difficulty increases the further you get!

title: Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle
description:
게임 정보
Unleash Your Puzzle Mastery in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle!
Dive into a world where strategy meets chaos! Harness the unique skills of each character to dominate the board:
Net gems and relocate them for the ultimate setup.
Smash through layers of gems with brute force.
Crush your opponents' gems by strategically dropping balls on them.

Choose your path, master the chaos, and outwit your foes. The choice is yours in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Ready to play like never before?
Step into a world where every stage is a new spectacle! As you solve puzzles watch the icy excavation site melt into a sea of lava with visuals and sounds heating up the challenge. Navigate through a dystopian Tokyo where the fog grows thicker, the music somber, and the puzzles more enigmatic. Explore a scrapyard in the vastness of space, where the silence of the cosmos is broken by clanking metal, and the stage itself comes alive with each move.

title: Star Gun
description:
게임 정보
Star Gun is a fast-paced, roguelite, auto-scrolling space shooter blending RPG-style progression and procedurally generated levels. Choose your ship, upgrade it to the max, and blast through relentless waves of enemies to free the galaxy—solo or with a friend!
Key Features
A New Galaxy Every Time. Every playthrough is a fresh experience. Explore a procedurally generated galaxy map filled with unpredictable missions and enemy formations. No two playthroughs are ever the same—adapt your loadout, rethink your tactics, and prepare for the unexpected each time you take flight.
Fly What Fits You. You'll unlock a range of 20 playable ships, each with their own strengths and playstyles. Whether you prefer speed, firepower, or tactical versatility, there’s a ship to match your approach to galactic domination.

title: Bee the End
description:
게임 정보
Before the End is a 2D top-down grid-based puzzle game taking place during prehistoric times. In each level, the player must reach the goal to pass time and move ever closer towards the anticipated extinction of the dinosaurs. Within each level, you will utilize strange quantum powers to manipulate natural objects by swapping them amongst each other. You will also find yourself less alone as you play, recruiting an expanding cast of dinosaur friends to help you manipulate the environment in new and layered ways.
Explore an expansive world by progressing through 70 increasingly difficult levels spread through a variety of natural environments. Witness what lies ahead and determine what you can accomplish in the time before the end?

title: Wartorn
description:
게임 정보
Wartorn은 싱글플레이어, 스쿼드 기반, 로그라이크 게임으로, 플레이어는 고향에서 쫓겨난 자매 야라와 엘라니가 되어 전쟁으로 폐허가 된 탈라우르의 섬들을 가로지르며 조상의 요새 베윤으로 안전하게 도착해야 합니다. 강렬한 실시간 전투에서 요소를 활용하며 판타지 생물들로 구성된 팀을 업그레이드하며 가족을 찾아나서세요.
체계적인 요소 시스템
Wartorn은 불, 물, 타르, 식물, 번개라는 요소를 활용한 체계적이고 자연스럽게 발전하는 게임플레이 시스템을 특징으로 합니다. 적의 무리를 상대로 요소를 마스터하고 환경을 활용하기 위해 전략적으로 팀을 선택하세요. 물은 불을 꺼뜨리고, 타르는 불을 강화하며, 습한 환경에서 번개는 부대 전체에 번쩍이며, 물은 식물 기반 유닛을 치료합니다. 그리고 이건 단지 시작에 불과합니다!
부대 기반 전투
세계를 여행하며 고블린, 엘프, 악마, 나무족(그리고 더 많은!) 등 판타지 생물 부대를 모집해 카라반을 확장하세요. 각 스쿼드는 서로 다른 특성 및 독특한 능력으로 카라반에 새로운 전략적 옵션을 제공합니다. 전투에 참여시키는 스쿼드를 조합해 진정한 전략을 완성하세요. 전장 위치 선정, 스쿼드 조합, 능력의 숙련된 사용이 승리를 결정짓지만, 주의하세요. 패배는 사기를 떨어뜨리며, 카라반이 희망을 잃으면 게임 오버입니다.

title: Organic Burger Simulator
description:
게임 정보
《오가닉 버거 시뮬레이터》는 유기농 재료만 사용하여 맛있고 건강한 버거를 만드는 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 작은 노점에서 시작해 사업을 성장시키고, 최고 품질의 지속 가능한 버거를 제공하며 차별화를 이루세요.

title: After Inc: Revival
description:
게임 정보
Plague Inc.가 세계를 멸망시킨 후에는 어떤 일이 벌어질까요? 네크로아 바이러스가 인류를 황폐화시킨 지 수십 년이 지나 몇몇 생존자가 모습을 드러냅니다. 정착지를 건설하고, 세계를 탐험하며, 자원을 수집하고 확장하면서 여러분만의 포스트 아포칼립스 사회를 형성하세요. 이 세계는 푸르고 아름답지만, 폐허 속에는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다!
After Inc: Revival은 1억 9천만 명 이상의 플레이어가 즐긴 가장 인기 있는 게임 중 하나인 ‘Plague Inc.’ 제작자가 선보이는 완전히 새로운 게임입니다. 아름다운 그래픽과 비평가들의 극찬을 받은 게임플레이로 훌륭하게 구현되었으며, After Inc: Revival은 몰입감 있고 배우기 쉽습니다. 지속 캠페인에서 여러 정착지를 건설하고 능력을 획득하여 인류를 어둠에서 이끌어 내세요. 공익 안내: 다른 게임과 달리 After Inc: Revival은 실제 세계의 상황을 기반으로 하지 않았음을 알려드립니다. 아직 실존하는 좀비 아포칼립스를 걱정하실 필요는 없습니다…

title: Ultra Mega Cats
description:
게임 정보
Step aside, Ninja Turtles, it's time for the Ultra Mega Cats to hit the big stage!
Ultra Mega Cats is a fast-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. In it, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs with the goal of escaping corporate captivity while battling hordes of enemies. Fight through a series of randomly selected rooms and perform feats of dexterity and skill in an extremely dynamic environment – solo or with friends.
Go rogue and awaken your purr instincts
Imagine living in a world flipped upside down, where rodents and feathered forces rule and cats are shunned. You're one of the last cats standing – disgraced, brainwashed, and trained to serve your former prey as their personal killing machine. But that is not enough, as the cat’s soul knows no master! Awaken your inner predator and restore balance to this world!
Put your foes in their place
While your rage-fuelled instinct and millenia of evolutionary experience may make you think that pouncing with claws and fangs at your enemies will get the job done, well, things have changed drastically, and your enemies have caught on. You’ll need to make good use of your skills, especially against the likes of bomb-carrying hamsters.
company: Fallen Leaf, Unseen Silence, Black Drakkar Games

title: TRON: Catalyst
description:
게임 정보
Thomas Was Alone, Subsurface Circular, TRON: Identity의 제작사 Bithell Games의 최신 픽션 게임 TRON: Catalyst에서 여러분은 Disney의 TRON 세계관에 다시 뛰어들어 다수의 반대 세력과 싸움을 치르게 됩니다. TRON: Catalyst는 TRON: Identity에 등장한 아크 그리드(Arq Grid)의 다양하고 몰입감 넘치는 장소를 배경으로 완전히 새로운 이야기가 펼쳐지는 스토리 중심의 아이소메트릭 액션 어드벤처 게임입니다.
강인하고 뛰어난 지략을 갖췄으며 그리드라고 하는 예상 밖의 힘을 사용하는 프로그램 '엑소(Exo)'가 되어, 무너져 가는 아크 그리드 사회의 권력자들이 손에 넣으려 하는 힘과 능력을 얻으세요. 남다른 목적을 지닌 사악한 프로그램 '콘(Conn)'의 끈질긴 추적을 피해 광사이클을 타고, 디스크 전투를 치르는 등 여러 위기를 헤쳐 나가며 이 세계의 안정을 위협하는 오류의 정체를 자세히 파헤치세요.
특징
역동적인 전투 시스템
직접 상대하든 광사이클을 타든, 근접전과 원거리 전투를 가리지 않고 적 프로그램으로 구성된 무시무시한 군단을 물리치세요. 패링이나 디스크 킥과 같은 고급 기술을 익혀 우위를 점하고, 아크 그리드를 탐험하면서 데이터 샤드(Data Shard)를 모아 코드 베이스를 새로운 능력으로 업그레이드하세요.
몰입감 넘치는 새로운 이야기
독자적인 TRON 스토리라인을 즐겨 보세요. 아크 그리드의 다양한 프로그램을 만나고 이들의 비밀을 밝혀, 도심과 아웃랜드에서 펼쳐지는 추격전에서 살아남으세요.

title: Avians Against Aviation
description:
게임 정보
Play as a bird flying against a hoard of airplanes and other flying machines or creatures in this cartoon themed side-scroller. Eat mosquitos and fight a series of nasty aviators who think the sky is theirs to control. It's either you, or them.
Unlock skins for your favorite birds!
Fight different bosses each having unique attacks!

title: Lottery Winner
description:
게임 정보

title: Crime Simulator
description:
게임 정보
감옥에 갇혔지만, 정체불명의 후원자가 보석금을 대신 내주었습니다. 이제 그들은 돈을 돌려받길 원하며, 그것도 빠르게 말이죠. 당신에게 남은 유일한 선택지는 바로 범죄를 저지르는 것입니다. 집에 침입하고, 귀중품을 훔치고, 위험한 작업을 혼자서 또는 최대 세 명의 친구와 함께 수행하세요. 제한 시간이 끝나기 전에 빚을 갚을 수 있을까요?
장소 & 미션
세 개의 독특한 지역을 탐험하세요. 각 지역에는 다양한 목표, 보안 시스템, 그리고 엄청난 양의 전리품이 가득합니다. 첨단 기술이 가득한 대저택을 몰래 이동하거나, 어두운 뒷골목에서 난투극을 벌이든, 모든 장소가 새로운 도전과 숨겨진 보상을 제공합니다.
싱글 또는 4인 협동 플레이
혼자서 모든 일을 해낼 수도 있고, 4인 협동 모드에서 친구들과 힘을 합칠 수도 있습니다. 침입을 계획하고, 전리품을 나누고, 서로의 뒤를 봐주거나, 배신을 선택할 수도 있습니다. 모든 선택은 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
전문 도구
완벽한 강도는 적절한 장비에서 시작됩니다. 잠금 해제 도구를 사용하면 유령처럼 잠긴 문을 통과할 수 있으며, 석궁은 조용히 경비를 제거하거나 감시 카메라를 비활성화할 수 있습니다. 좀 더 은밀한 접근 방식을 원한다면, 수면 가스를 환기구에 주입해 소리 없이 건물 전체를 마비시킬 수도 있습니다. 하지만 때로는 은밀함이 통하지 않을 때도 있죠. 상황이 꼬이면, 가 문제를 해결해 줄 것입니다.

title: NITRO GEN OMEGA
description:
게임 정보
인류는 기계와의 전쟁에서 졌습니다. 세계는 기계가 장악했습니다. 남은 인류는 도시 몇 곳과 거대한 기둥 꼭대기에 지은 전초기지로 흩어졌습니다. 피할 수 없는 종말이 천천히 다가오고 있지만, 그래도 삶은 계속되고 있습니다. 사람들에게는 여전히 식량과 보급품, 구세계의 기술, 그리고 때로는 그저 앞으로 나아가게 만들 무언가가 필요합니다.
당신은 도시에서 보낸 의뢰를 맡으며 생존해나가는 용병단의 지휘관입니다. 메크를 제작하고 개조하세요. 파일럿을 모집하고 당신의 이동 기지인 비행선에서 파일럿들이 유대감을 형성해나가는 걸 지켜보세요. 의뢰를 완료하고, 특별한 타임라인 시스템이 특징적인, 영화 같은 메크 전투에 뛰어드세요.
혁신적인 타임라인 전투
NITRO GEN OMEGA는 깊이 있는 전술 게임플레이와 마치 자신만의 애니메이션 에피소드를 감독하는 듯한 느낌을 결합한, 혁신적인 타임라인 기반 전투 시스템을 갖춘 턴제 전술 RPG입니다.
각각 메크 내부의 네 가지 시스템을 책임지는 파일럿 4인조를 이끄세요. 운전수에게 회피 기동을, 포수에게 사격을, 엔지니어에게 냉각수 투입을, 오퍼레이터에게 연막탄 전개를 지시하세요.
보유 장비와 직관을 활용해 적의 의도를 파악하세요. 계획 단계에서 행동을 계획하고, 실행 단계에서 영화처럼 전개되는 과정을 지켜보세요.
승무원에게 있어 전투는 부상과 심지어 사망에 이를 수 있는 위험하고 힘든 경험입니다. 극적인 순간에 파일럿이 멋대로 예상치 못한 행동을 할 수 있기에, 사기 관리는 아주 중요합니다. 전투의 압박감 때문에 정신적으로 위기에 몰리거나 공황에 빠질 수도 있지만, 진정한 영웅은 바로 그런 중요한 순간에 만들어지는 법입니다. 소년물 애니메이션에서 영감을 받은 전투 시스템에서 파일럿이 스스로의 한계를 뛰어넘어 역경을 극복하는 모습을 지켜보세요.

title: git gud
description:
게임 정보
git gud is a terminal-styled puzzle game that teaches you Git the fun way—through 100 levels of increasingly complex word problems that challenge your version control skills. Each level drops you into a realistic scenario: from staging your first commit and branching out new features, to resolving merge conflicts, rolling back mistakes, and mastering rebase. Your goal? Type the correct Git command(s) to solve each problem. You'll get instant feedback as you progress from a clueless committer to a rebasing rockstar.
Designed for beginners and pros alike, git gud simulates a real Git environment to reinforce learning through play. Whether you're prepping for a tech interview, onboarding new developers, or just tired of forgetting how to undo that one Git mistake—we’ve got a level for that. Hints are available, but glory belongs to those who fly solo. Master Git. One command at a time. And yes, get good.

title: Kity Builder
description:
게임 정보
섬을 꾸미고, 귀여운 고양이 도시를 건설하세요
Kity Builder는 고양이들을 위한 도시와 거주지를 만드는 즐거운 도시 건설 샌드박스 게임입니다! 각기 다른 크기와 주제를 가진 섬들에 아름다운 거주지를 만들고 ‘고양이 주민’들이 돌아다니며, 적응해가는 모습을 지켜보세요.
모든 건물은 장난감입니다
건물들은 여러분이 섬을 더 깊숙이 탐험하도록 도와주는 장난감의 역할도 합니다. 섬의 모든 숨겨진 장소들을 발견하는 퀘스트를 수행하면서 기어오르고, 뛰어오르고 공중으로 몸을 날려보세요. 청사진 (발자국)을 수집해 새로운 건물을 잠금해제하세요. 걱정마세요, 여러분은 혼자가 아니니까요. 고양이 시장님과 이상하지만, 사랑스러운 고양이들이 여러분을 도와줄겁니다!
제한도 없고. 어떠한 압박도 없습니다.
Kity Builder에는 시간 제한, 자원 압박, 심지어 돈에 대한 제한도 없으며, 그저 창조하는 순수한 즐거움만 존재합니다. 각자의 리듬에 맞게 건물을 짓고 도시가 성장하는 모습을 지켜보세요!
