title: Vessels of Decay
description:
게임 정보
Civilization has ended, and something else awakens in its place. From the world’s decay, ancient creatures stir, rise, and roam the land.
Vessels of Decay is a post-apocalyptic action-adventure following the story of Freja and Mud. In this retro-inspired tale, you’ll confront creatures of Scandinavian myth and folklore, and explore the ruins of the civilization they inhabit.
Features:

title: An Unfinished Game
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Unfinished Game™ Testing facility! As our new tester, you will have to make your way through a series of unexpected experiments in this first-person adventure. Small puzzles, platforming, meta gameplay and a group of silly NPC awaits you in this unpredictable factory.

The goal? Succesfully finish all tests so that we'll finally be able to release this "Unfinished Game" of ours!

One thing for sure, expect only the unexpected in here!



What you will find:

Simple puzzles
Platforming
Physics based elements
Other testing bot eager to talk with you
Some bugs (voluntary..?)
Collectables
Easter eggs
Unintentional features
And of course, silliness

title: Summit : Steps of Solace
description:
게임 정보
The beloved Playdate platformer is now available on Steam!
Gameplay
Summit : Steps of Solace is an exhilarating mountain climbing precision platformer, where you scale a relentless peak filled with brutal jumps, hazards, and shifting terrain. Master a range of tools to ascend higher, where every fall is a lesson and each hard-earned step gets you closer to the goal.
Average story playthrough is about 1-1.5 hours in length.
Equipped with 2 pickaxes, scale the mountain to reach the top. Avoid physics based environmental hazards as you uncover the story behind our protagonist’s unwavering tenacity to reach the top.

title: Finnigan Fox
description:
게임 정보
Finnigan Fox is a 2D action platformer with fun RPG elements. Inspired by the glorious days of 16-bit platformers, Finnigan Fox presents classic gameplay in beautiful, colorful, hi-res graphics with a difficulty level adapted to modern sensibilities--meaning it’s not so brutally hard! 🤣
A FOX LIKE NO OTHER 
Play as our titular hero, a clever red fox named Finnigan. Run and leap your way across the land on your mission to save the forest. Wield your bladed crossbow to defeat enemies in your path! Cast magic that changes the season to alter the terrain and neutralize some enemies. You’ll need a combination of melee and magic to solve the puzzles in a mystical land filled with strange creatures and challenging landscapes. 
UPGRADES & BOSSES!
Collect treasure and special items along the way (sometimes hidden). Trade them in at the forest shops to upgrade your arrows and increase your physical and magical capacity.  You’ll need those upgrades to prepare yourself to take on screen-sized bosses!
Each boss is a giant enemy with a different behavior and unique vulnerability. Use your nimble movement to avoid their attacks until you can solve the puzzle of how to defeat them!
5 SEASONS!
Switch between seasons to alter the terrain, explore new areas, outfox enemies and uncover amazing secrets.
HERO’S JOURNEY
Help Finnigan Fox uncover the mystery of the 5th season and bring back justice to the forests and its inhabitants.
ACTION PLATFORMER!
Finnigan Fox is an epic adventure with engaging RPG elements, clever puzzles and thrilling platforming.
company: Bonus Level Entertainment, Independent Arts Software

title: Evel Knievel
description:
게임 정보
Relive the thrill of Evel Knievel's legendary jumps like never before! From daring motorcycle stunts to riding a rocket over Snake River Canyon, this is the ultimate tribute to America's greatest daredevil. Play solo or multiplayer with up to four friends! 😃😃😃😃
⭐4.5/5 Touch Arcade - “Evel Knievel is a fun, worthy tribute to the legendary daredevil”
Laugh with friends as you crash hilariously! 😲🤣 Earn trophies, climb the leaderboards, and customize Evel’s gear with iconic outfits and powerful bikes. There's always a new challenge waiting! 🏆
Can you conquer Evel Knievel’s most daring jumps and land safely on the other side? Get ready for the ride of your life!
True Story 🧾
Evel Knievel became the most famous daredevil in history by performing dangerous and amazing motorcycle jumps. Relive the exploits of this American folk hero by stepping into his shoes with the Official Evel Knievel game!
Advance through his spectacular career, starting with a humble 250cc Scrambler, jumping Rattlesnakes and Lions. 🐍🦁  Work your way up to the 750cc Ultimate and insane jumps over 13 London Buses and the Las Vegas Casino Fountain!
🌞 This update of the Official Evel Knievel game adds a new venue, Snake River Canyon, and new vehicle, the Skycycle X-2 rocket🚀, as well as new multiplayer support! Have a laugh-out-loud, fun time with your family and friends!
Simple Controls 🎮
Use a gamepad, keyboard or mouse to control your vehicle:
Motorcycle  
Two buttons (or directional-stick) manage your acceleration on the ground and rotation in the air so you can hit those jumps at the right speed and land at the right angle. Have fun doing wheelies, flips, loops and many other stunts. Negotiate flaming hoops, springboards, cranes and many other exciting obstacles.

title: Anaria
description:
게임 정보
🔪 ANARIA – You wake up. But sleep was never part of it.
You’re trapped inside a house that bends like a fractured mind. Walls shift. Rooms question your sanity. And somewhere, just out of reach — that voice. Always there. Mocking you. Leading you. Slowly unmaking you.
You don’t know where you are.
But a part of you remembers.
ANARIA is a psychological horror game designed to unravel you from the inside. You won’t find answers spelled out — only fragments, broken memories, and places that shouldn’t exist. All haunted by a presence that feels too close. Too familiar.
There are no cutscenes. No tutorials. No safety nets.
Only you, the creaking silence, and whatever waits beyond the next door.
🕯 Candles are your only light. Each room hides a few — and their flicker is all that keeps the dark from breathing.
But the red ones? They're different. If you find a red candle, stop. Something matters there. It’s never just for show.
🚪 Leave doors open behind you, and the paranoia starts to whisper.
The longer they stay open, the more certain you’ll be: something is following you. You’ll feel it. Cold. Silent. Watching.
🎮 Made entirely by one developer over years of work, ANARIA is raw, imperfect, and deeply personal. It doesn’t aim to impress — it aims to disturb. And it delivers.
💀 This isn’t just a horror game.
It’s a spiral.
And once you’re in... there’s no clean way out.

title: Wiped Clean
description:
게임 정보
Let's begin the briefing Agent, I’m only saying this once, so pay attention. 
Your role? Sounds simple on paper. You show up after a hit, and you erase every trace—every drop, every fingerprint, every clue. The scene must look untouched. No evidence. No questions. No loose ends.
You’ll be scrubbing down entire crime scenes. You’ll bag bodies, dispose of trash, and clean up every mess.
As you progress, you'll unlock better tools and upgrade your skills—but don't get cocky. If you can’t handle the basics, none of it will save you. We’re judged on results, not effort.
Here’s the part that gets sticky: You’re deep undercover.
Your mission: Infiltrate the Syndicate, a brutal underground organization led by the infamous hitman Victor Kane—a man responsible for Hundreds of kills, most of which were never supposed to be possible. The Syndicate doesn’t tolerate failure. And they definitely don’t tolerate rats.
Each scene is more than blood and bodies.
You'll find journals, voice recordings, broken phones, newspaper clippings, even symbols and markings. Some of it won’t make sense. Some of it will make too much sense.
The syndicate’s hiding something bigger. Something old. Something that watches from the shadows. I’d tell you more, but I like you alive.

title: Become the Moon
description:
게임 정보
달이 되다 은 Feldspar Games에서 개발한 독특한 덱빌딩 오토배틀러 게임입니다. 망가진 마법과 이상한 존재들로 가득한 혼돈의 세계를 탐험하며 새로운 우주적 경지에 오르세요.
하수인, 주문, 유물을 조합해 고유의 덱을 만드세요. 라운드마다 새로운 카드를 선택해 무기를 강화하고, 강력한 시너지를 구축하고, 하수인에게 이로운 효과를 부여할 수 있습니다. 강력한 유물을 수집해 덱을 증강하고 별을 향해 도약하세요!

title: 100 in 1 Game Collection
description:
게임 정보
마녀 마그라트, 기괴한 물고기 하비, 녹색 소 스테파니와 이들의 사랑스러운 친구들을 만나면서 추억의 레트로 게임의 클래식한 게임 방식에 아케이드 장르를 재창조하는 참신한 아이디어를 조합한 100개의 아케이드 게임을 아우르는 장대한 여정에 뛰어들어 보세요! 싱글 또는 친구들과 멀티플레이어로 진행하면서 가능한 한 높은 점수를 내고, 실력을 향상하면서 모든 별점을 획득하는 데 도전하는 겁니다!
🌟 주요 특징 🌟
• 서로 다른 매력을 자랑하는 100가지 게임으로 즐기는 파란만장한 여정: 추억의 고전 게임 방식에 신선하고 획기적인 난관을 완벽하게 조합한 재미에 푹 빠져보세요!

title: Egnima
description:
게임 정보
Egnima is a solo puzzle game where the player takes control of two interdependent cubes. Each must be used strategically to progress and solve ingenious puzzles. The adventure unfolds in a semi-open world, blending exploration with linear progression, where every challenge demands deep thinking and precise coordination between the two cubes.
The game will take you through a variety of biomes, each introducing unique mechanics and brand-new challenges. You'll have to face blinding snowstorms, slippery ice surfaces that limit your control, and many other obstacles that will put your problem-solving and adaptability to the test.
Will you be able to master these hostile environments and overcome every puzzle to uncover all the secrets of Enigma?

title: Fary's Cabin In The Tangled Woods
description:
게임 정보
=== DEMO ===
The demo is the ENTIRE game, but will be removed after NextFest, Cheers!
=== 

Walk about a small point-cloud world and untangle puzzles by moving nodes around a grid so no two lines cross.
Work through over 60 puzzles with various mechanics. From the simple to the formidable, from seconds to hours without handholding. Each puzzle will reveal more of the world by unlocking new areas and get you closer to reaching the cabin.
autokwd: Fary's Cabin In The Tangled Woods

title: Bonfire Barrage
description:
게임 정보
Bonfire Barrage is a short-form roguelike inspired by Seraphs Last Stand focused on fast runs, variety, and experimentation. Each run takes around 30 minutes to complete, with 5 distinct characters and 22 unique abilities available from the start.
Various Characters: Choose from 5 characters each with unique base abilities to change the pace of combat.
Upgrades & Evolution: Choose from a variety of upgrades during each run, with each one evolving into a more powerful form as you specialize. Choose your upgrades wisely to optimize your chances of survival.

title: Flint
description:
게임 정보
Flint is an adventure style game that tasks you, the "Stone-Born," with defeating the tyrannical Übel as he holds complete control over the world. Discover a brand new world full of fascinating characters, terrifying foes and tactical weapons to use. 
This is a top-down game in which you wake up in a post apocalyptic world and have to discover your place in it while wrestling with powerful monsters every step of the way. 
Using the Hot-Cycle, you can switch between three different tools at a time, allowing for fluid, strategic combat. You'll have to think on your feet during combat, staying still means death. Dodging is a necessity, enabling quick movement on the battlefield to keep you alive. Parrying allows you to negate enemy damage if timed correctly. Fight like you mean it and use the right tools for the job during combat or you could find yourself at a fatal disadvantage against Mechanoids or Tanks.
You can also upgrade your weapons using Platinum Crystals found throughout the world, allowing access to specialized Runes that give each weapon an extra kick, a halberd can be turned into a Crowd Controlling death machine, or a spear can be turned into a fierce projectile launcher.
Looting parts from defeated enemies, you can go to NPCs in Siedlung and craft specialized equipment, like the Battle-breaker and Plasmoid Armor sets to optimize yourself for either speed, or full protection. 
Test your reflexes by fighting twitchy bosses like Rafael, the Crestfallen. Bosses appear at the end of every dungeon and will require your full attention and an understanding of the game to progress. From the mighty beast Halifax, who's a terrifying grappler, to even an epic Hydra with Flame, Shock and Wind projectiles. You're in for the fight of your life here to save the world, it's Dare or Die.
Traverse through mysterious dungeons like the Asylum, which houses puzzles and secrets to keep you on the edge of your seat as you progress step by step, turning on switches, finding keys, using terminal computers and even moving boxes around.
Experience the epic story which will have you uncovering secrets, testing your morality, as you travel upwards towards the Golden Oath, Take part in being a Knight that fights for ultimate global peace and find out if you're truly on the right side of history as you stand on the side of Hamarolf.
With multiple difficulties, including "Stone Born" and "Dare or Die," modifiers called Shards, that change the gameplay around significantly. Test your limits and compare with friends on who can beat the game the fastest and most efficiently.

title: Mine Safety
description:
게임 정보
**마인 세이프티(Mine Safety)**는 당신이 광산 시설의 플랫폼 운영자가 되어 플레이하는 복고풍 아케이드 게임입니다. 당신의 임무는 이동식 구조물을 조작하여 작은 광부들을 출구 엘리베이터까지 — 가능하면 살아 있는 상태로 — 안내하는 것입니다.
광산은 절대 멈추지 않으며, 기계는 항상 작동해야 합니다. 고속 회전 드릴이 사방에서 끊임없이 굴착하고 있어 작은 광부들에게 치명적인 위협이 됩니다. 계약에 따르면, 당신은 일정 수의 산업 재해만을 법적으로 허용받았습니다. 한도를 초과하면? 해고입니다!
보너스를 극대화하려면 빠르게 일하세요 — 하지만 신중하게, 사고가 발생할 때마다 보너스가 줄어듭니다. 이 게임은 반사 신경, 전략, 그리고 높은 점수를 겨루는 게임입니다. 효율적일수록 글로벌 순위, 친구 순위, 개인 순위에서 더 높은 자리를 차지하게 됩니다.
최고의 자리를 차지하세요!

title: Gorilla Smash
description:
게임 정보
고릴라 한 마리가 정말 100명의 인간을 이길 수 있을까?
지금부터 펼쳐질 광경은 물리 기반의 순수한 대혼돈이다.
Gorilla Smash는 미친 듯이 과장된 난투 게임입니다. 당신은 분노한 고릴라가 되어, 순전히 괴력과 파괴적인 펀치, 그리고 고릴라의 본능적인 분노만으로 인간 무리에 맞서 싸웁니다.
혼란스러운 아레나 전투에서 적들의 공격을 피하고, 강력한 일격을 날리며, 압도적인 수적 우위를 이겨내세요.
어떤 적은 맨손으로, 어떤 적은 무기를 들고 옵니다. 하지만 상관없어요—전부 때려눕히면 그만입니다.
💥 특징:
🦍 거대하고 막을 수 없는 고릴라가 되어 플레이
👊 100명의 적이 당신의 앞길을 막는다 – 맨손과 무장 적을 상대하라
🧠 물리 기반의 혼돈과 래그돌 반응으로 폭소 유발
🪓 밈에서 탄생한 폭력 – 잔인하면서도 웃긴
🚀 빠르고 중독성 강한 게임플레이 – 바로 시작하고, 또 다시 도전
💀 자비는 없다. 무기도 없다. 문제도 없다.
이건 은신 게임이 아닙니다. 전략도 필요 없습니다.
이건 순수한 원시적 박살 게임입니다.
과연 100명을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있을까요… 아니면 군중에게 짓밟힐까요?
먼저 때려라. 질문은 없다.

title: Dino Tower Arena
description:
게임 정보
Dino Tower Arena is a action roguelite game where you can build your dinosaur with different abilities and put it into fights against waves of enemy dinos, upgrading it with new abilities, boosting its stats and unlocking new dinosaurs while advancing on the floors of the enormous Dino Tower!

title: Korter 1996
description:
게임 정보
Korter 1996 is an exploration of loneliness in a point and click adventure game. You can organise and decorate your new apartment and go on expeditions to other people's homes to find more items. While exploring different apartments on the block, you get to solve puzzles that will lead you to more information on each of the inhabitants. How you interact with the items in their apartments will move forward their story and through item dialogues you get to know about their lives.
Features
Move around items and organise to your heart's content (or make a mess)
Hear the thoughts of people who have interacted with the items you find
Unlock new locations and uncover their mysteries
Progress at your own pace
Collect stickers
Unlock the catalogue
Fill your apartment with stuff

title: Nova Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to harness your cosmic powers? Embark on an exciting summer adventure and uncover the hidden mystery as you TEXT, DATE, and FIGHT in this turn-based strategy dating sim!
Our heroine, Luce, has returned to her hometown from the big city for the summer to escape her past, but the town of Vermillion is even more than meets the eye. No worries! Nothing like a fantastic summer vacation and some wild parties to forget all your woes right?
…That is, until a mysterious cosmic force suddenly grants Luce magical powers and a sick transformation sequence to boot! With her new powers, Luce and her friends, Will and CJ, are off to fight a strange threat as the ultimate magical girl crew and uncover the mystery of their hometown! (And maybe find love along the way!)

title: Snowbrawll
description:
게임 정보
2~4명의 플레이어가 온라인과 로컬에서 즐기는 에픽 눈싸움!
눈덩이를 키우고 다양한 파워업을 사용해 친구들을 쓰러뜨리세요!
준비됐나요? 브롤할 시간입니다!
재미있는 전투
“눈덩이 날아갑니다아아!”
눈덩이를 던져 친구들을 쓰러뜨리세요.
하지만 놓치면 눈덩이가 없어서 매우 취약해집니다!
풀 차지!
친구들과 정면 대결을 벌이고, 고집 센 염소처럼 머리로 박치기하세요!

title: Cell Command
description:
게임 정보
A turn-based roguelite unlike anything you've played before
Dive into the microscopic world - cure the virus ravaging the planet. In Cell Command, units grow when they move, and attacks shrink them. A "tank" could be a long, winding python that clogs up the battlefield & encircles its prey!
  Mix DNA nucleotides A C G T to discover unique, unicellular combatants
Command cells (get it?) to construct bridges for ranged units to strike from afar, or poke holes to trap hostiles. Gain attack bonuses when your cells form with their long bodies. Dominate with . Make use of , , & more.
tag: 싱글 플레이어,그리드 기반 움직임,턴제 전술,턴제 전투

title: Broken Arrow
description:
게임 정보
대규모로 지휘하는 현대전
Broken Arrow는 대규모 실시간 현대전 전술 게임으로, 복잡한 연합군 전쟁 시뮬레이션과 액션 중심의 실시간 전술 게임플레이를 결합한 작품입니다. 
300개 이상의 현실적인 군사 유닛과 기술이 등장하며, 각각의 전투는 몰입감 넘치는 경험과 무한 반복 플레이가 가능한 게임성을 선사합니다.
시네마틱 싱글 플레이어 캠페인
발트해 지역을 배경으로 한 19개의 정교하게 제작된 미션을 통해, 미국과 러시아 양측의 시점에서 몰입감 있는 서사 중심 캠페인을 경험해 보세요.
세계적 긴장이 고조되는 긴박한 줄거리를 따라가다 보면, 각 미션마다 새로운 전술적 도전과 이야기 전개가 펼쳐집니다. 정예 부대로 주요 거점을 방어하거나, 대규모 연합 공세를 감행하는 등 모든 미션이 현실감 넘치는 전쟁 시나리오 속에서 지휘 능력을 시험하도록 설계되어 있습니다.
흥미로운 게임 모드
싱글 캠페인 외에도, 실제 장소를 바탕으로 제작된 19개의 맵에서 AI를 상대하는 스커미시 모드를 즐길 수 있습니다. 선호하는 전문화와 난이도를 선택하여 도전해 보세요. 출시 시점에서, 스커미시 모드는 AI를 상대로 한 3v3, 4v4, 5v5를 지원합니다. 친구들과 팀을 이루어 전장에서 마주치게 될 전투 집단을 본뜬 다양한 AI 프리셋을 상대로, 자신만의 속도로 게임을 배워보세요. 1v1 및 기타 싱글 플레이 구성, AI 상대 또는 AI와 협동 플레이에 대한 밸런싱은 추후 업데이트에서 지원될 예정입니다.
또는 온라인에 접속해, 박진감 넘치는 5 대 5 멀티플레이어 매치에서 인간 플레이어를 상대로 겨뤄보세요. 리더보드에서 순위를 올려나가면서 진행도를 확인하고 장군으로서의 경험을 쌓아가면서 레벨을 올리고 새로운 메달을 획득하세요.
게임의 미션 제작에 사용된 것과 동일한 도구인 강력한 시나리오 에디터를 활용해 창의력을 발휘해 보세요. 컷신과 대사를 포함한 맞춤형 시나리오를 시각적 스크립팅 시스템으로 제작할 수 있으며, 코딩 지식은 필요 없습니다. 
제작한 콘텐츠는 Steam Workshop을 통해 커뮤니티와 공유하거나, 다른 사용자의 콘텐츠를 다운로드하여 끝없는 사용자 제작 콘텐츠를 경험해 보세요.
나만의 맞춤형 군대
수백 개의 유닛 중 원하는 조합을 선택해 자신만의 독특한 군대 덱을 만들어보세요. 
300개 이상의 유닛과 1,500가지가 넘는 조합으로, 원하는 플레이 스타일에 맞춰 부대를 맞춤 구성할 수 있습니다. 전차와 항공기를 다양한 무기, 장갑, 지원 시스템으로 개조해 전장에서 우위를 점하세요.

title: LAN Party
description:
게임 정보
Experience a LAN party like never before! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the latest FPS cooperatively, competing against each other in an RTS, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier. Fully customize your unique gaming room and gaming setup, select your avatar, and invite your friends to hang out and play games or have a watch party in your virtual space. Welcome to the next era of online gaming, where the excitement, energy, and camaraderie of a LAN party meets the freedom of the virtual world.
Stream Gameplay
Experience the excitement of the game together through seamless in-room gameplay streaming. Open your friend's gameplay stream to cheer them on and broadcast your stream to a virtual screen so you can all watch together.
Watch Content With Friends
Use a shared video screen and have a watch party with your friends. Our streaming infrastructure ensures that videos are always synced between viewers.

title: Nina
description:
게임 정보
NINA is a short, narrative-driven psychological horror game about a girl trapped in a looping version of her own mind.
Each day, Nina wakes up in her room with no memory of what came before.
As her inner voice, you’ll help Nina uncover fragments of her past, comfort her in moments of fear, and guide her through a house filled with distorted memories. But be careful—say too much, and she breaks. Say too little, and she forgets.
Features:
Short duration (30-40 minutes)
Minimal Pixel art style

title: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator
description:
게임 정보


꿈에 그리던 집을 지어보세요! 3D 평면 모델링에서 현장에서 이뤄지는 의사 결정까지, 거침없는 창의성을 발휘하며 프로젝트에 임하는 족족 현실로 구현해 보세요. 당신의 건축 회사를 업계 정상에 올려놓아야 합니다.
심층 시뮬레이션

커리어 모드에서는 자신의 건축 회사를 설립하고 다양한 현대 주택 건축 프로젝트를 시작부터 끝까지 관리하는 책임을 맡게 됩니다. 여기에는 다음과 같이 일련의 주요 단계가 있습니다.
1차1차 설계 확정 – 고객의 요구사항과 지형, 할당된 예산에 당신의 창의적인 아이디어를 더해 벽, 방, 지붕, 문, 창, 발코니 등을 모델링합니다.
2차2차 설계 확정 – 프로젝트의 개성을 가능하면 크게 살리기 위해 바닥, 벽, 지붕을 선택한 다음, 겨울에도 포근한 온도를 유지할 수 있도록 주택의 난방 시스템을 설치합니다.




건설 단계가 완료되면 1인칭 시점으로 집을 탐방해보세요! 태양의 위치를 바꿔서 다양한 조명 아래, 방이 변화하는 모습을 감상하고, 고상하고 소박한 풍경이나 도시의 풍경, 또는 산악 지대의 풍경 속에서 여러분의 창작물을 감상해 보세요.

다양한 소재, 구조, 아이템, 그리고 무엇보다도 혁신적인 건설 도구로 기발한 창의력을 마음껏 펼쳐보세요. 각 방의 형태부터 세부적인 지붕 도면까지, 건물을 정밀하게 설계할 수 있습니다.

고상 가옥, 녹색 에너지, 더욱 친환경적인 벽과 파티션 등. 커리어 모드의 미션을 하나하나 완수해 가며 기술을 개발하고 새로운 전문 분야를 잠금 해제하여 더욱 혁신적인 주택 건축 프로젝트를 수행해 보세요!

고객의 요구사항과 제한된 예산, 물리 법칙에 얽매이고 싶지 않으세요? 아니면, 나만의 개인 맞춤형 미션을 만들고 싶으세요? 그렇다면 자유 모드가 필요합니다! 제약 조건이 있거나 없는 매개변수를 선택하고, 생물 군계와 60가지 지형 유형 중 하나를 선택한 다음, 창의력을 있는 힘껏 발휘해 보세요.

비디오 게임 시뮬레이션에 맞춰 조정한 아키텍처

물론 건축가라는 직업의 몇몇 측면은 단순하게 표현했습니다. 그렇지 않았다면 수년간의 공부 없이는 플레이하기가 불가능했을 것입니다! 이 게임은 일반 대중이 쉽게 접근할 수 있도록 제작되었으며, 플레이어가 시뮬레이션이나 디자인을 사랑하는 팬이거나 건축 작업을 즐기는 팬이라 해도 모두 Architect Life의 도전에 임하고 창의력을 표현하면서 실제로 즐거워하기를 바랍니다.

title: The Legends of Maui
description:
게임 정보
Story
Tales tell of a time in Aotearoa where magic existed next to ones mana. Taniwha ruled the waves, Mountains did battle, gods walked the Earth and Maui the trickster defied all.
Travel through forests, and over rivers, along shores as Maui with the jaw bone of his grandfather.
Fight Taniwha, and other creatures of the land.
Most Importantly slow the Sun, bring fire to man, fish up islands and Defeat the goddess of death.
Oh and don't forget to tell fantail he is not to laugh...
Transformations
Transform into various creatures of Aotearoa to aid you in you fights; Rupe, Kapowai, Kahu, 
Mangopare
Enemies
Fight and experience enemies inspired by Maori mythology Ponaturi, Kurangaituku, Maero and Taniwha.

title: SPiNG
description:
게임 정보
흐름을 즐기는 유쾌한 게임.
SPiNG의 선과 스킬로 가득한 세계를 경험하세요. 뇌를 위한 피젯 스피너같은 게임입니다.
한 손이나 발, 아니면 다른 무엇으로라도 하나의 버튼을 사용해 1000+개의 손수 제작된 레벨을 넘나들며 플레이할 수 있습니다.

title: Ô
description:
게임 정보
A NEW UNDERGRÔUND STAGE
Ô is a new kind of musical roguelike centered on techno. We work in tight collaboration with artists and labels to bring their music to life. Experience the sound in your own way and reach the best score before the end of the mix.
GROOVE TO FIND THE MOVE
Dance with any instrument of the tracks in each level. Compose your own choreography based on bass, drums, melodies or lyrics. You'll encounter other enemy dancers with their own moveset. Move as close to them at the right timing to electrocute the closest ones, flirt with them ! It's a french game after all...
But not too close, you'll get hurt and it will ruin the show.
GEAR UP
Unlock upgrades, customize automated weapons activated by the sounds of the music. You'll earn resources along the way that you can spend to come up with the best strategy. Find out which weapon works best with each kind of sound you hear.

title: Room 808
description:
게임 정보
방으로 가고 싶지만 이 호텔은 뭔가 이상합니다. 복도가 끝없이 이어집니다. 문이 반복됩니다. 조명이 꺼진 느낌입니다. 눈꼬리에서 무언가가 지켜보고 있습니다. 808호실에는 보이는 것과 다른 것이 없습니다. 여러분의 목표는 간단합니다: 방에 도착하는 것입니다. 도전은? 이상 징후를 발견하는 것입니다...
이상 징후는 환경의 미묘하거나 초현실적인 변화로, 무언가 잘못되었다는 신호입니다. 왜곡된 인물부터 변화된 조명이나 소리에 이르기까지 다양합니다. 호텔 복도를 이동하는 동안 경계를 늦추지 말고 이상 징후를 발견하세요.

title: Apocalypse of the Universe
description:
게임 정보
Apocalypse of the Universe
Genre: 2D Platformer Adventure
Story:
In Apocalypse of the Universe, players take on the role of an elven hero on a perilous quest to save his homeland from a demonic invasion.
Once a peaceful world bathed in the eternal glow of the moon, it is now torn apart by portals that unleash endless waves of demons. These gateways connect to dark realms and threaten to spread corruption and decay across every corner of the land.
The hero must defeat powerful bosses who control these portals. Only by destroying them can he seal the gateways, purify the land, and break the curse that shrouds his world in darkness.

Gameplay:
Platforming Adventure: Navigate through challenging levels filled with traps, obstacles, and enemies. Precision and timing are essential to survival.
Combat Mechanics: Wield unique weapons, including a magical bow, and unleash special abilities to defeat demonic foes. Collect power-ups to boost your speed, damage, and durability.
Boss Battles: Each corrupted region is guarded by a mighty boss. Defeating them is key to closing the portals and reclaiming the land.
Character Progression: Gather resources and items to upgrade your hero’s skills and attributes, preparing for greater threats and complex enemies.

title: Module Miner
description:
게임 정보
Take down The Cube one block at a time and collect resources to improve your mining speed, health, and damage. 
Use your experience to buy special items to increase your mining efficiency such as corrosive mites, giant worms, and mining lasers.

title: Merge Maestro
description:
게임 정보
Merge Maestro is a combo-driven puzzle-like rogue-like. Merge Emoji themed Tokens together to create more powerful Tokens to defeat waves of enemies. Craft your set with Hundreds of unique Tokens to create Thousands of powerful and wacky combinations. No two runs are ever the same in this bite sized rogue-like you can take with you anywhere!
Gameplay
Place Tokens on on the board and Merge tokens of the same type to make ones of a higher Level. Higher Level Tokens are Stronger!!
Choose a new Token to add to your set at the end of every wave. There are 100's of Tokens to discover each with unique effects!

title: Scorching Desert
description:
게임 정보
You wake up alone in a mysterious desert & your task is finding out what happened!
To do that you will build A base, craft better Tools & explore a vast desert landscape
consisting of various unique biomes, that come with their own challenges & rewards!
On the Journey through the desert you will encounter many different threats
such as sandstorms, droughts & dangerous enemies,
but as you'll find out there is something way darker & more sinister plagueing the desert!
Find a Place to cool down


It's best to find somewhere chill during a hot day in the desert. The Scorching heat might
make you feel dizzy or disoriented but don't worry you will find an Oasis along your way!
An Oasis is the perfect spot for settling down in the desert, as it does provide the most
essential resource, water. On top of that you might even make new friends as an Oasis
always remains the favourite spot for friendly desert camels eager to join your journey
Explore a mysterious desert landscape



Explore and surive in a vast 64^2km desert landscape composed of various unique and
beautiful biomes, each with their own challenges! You might find yourself walking across the
sand dunes or stopping and taking a good look at the beautiful scenery of a massive canyon.
Maybe you even find one of the old temples or long-forgotten cities of an ancient civilization.

title: After Light Fades
description:
게임 정보
Solve, evolve, and let go.
After Light Fades is a magical sokoban-style puzzle journey about grief, memory, and transformation.
You play as Alice, who, after the loss of her partner Aura, discovers seven artefacts tied to powerful memories. To heal, she must revisit the places they once shared and cast each artefact into an abyss, where each world reflects a stage of Alice’s emotional journey. As you part with each artefact, you also give up the unique mechanic it granted, turning the act of puzzle-solving into a powerful reflection on letting go.
Seven Emotional Puzzle Worlds
Explore seven handcrafted fantasy environments, spanning over 100 puzzles, each reflecting a stage of grief. From shimmering coves to shifting manors, every world features its own emotional tone and puzzle mechanics, each ending in a powerful act of letting go.
Interconnected Sokoban-Inspired Mechanics
Solve spatial puzzles where objects interact in surprising and meaningful ways. Use mirrors, magnets, fire, vines, clones, and elemental systems in deeply layered challenges that evolve far beyond traditional box-pushing.
A Deep Story of Healing and Transformation

title: Inexorable
description:
게임 정보
This game is an innovative twist on classic snake - style games, building its core gameplay around a minimalist 2D cartoon aesthetic. Set against a bright green background, a tiger - shaped snake head leads a body made of red circular segments. Players must dodge black stone obstacles while devouring bright red apples to score points and lengthen the snake.
Core Mechanics & Innovations
It inherits the classic snake loop of “eat → grow → escalate in difficulty”, but redefines the challenge with static black stones. The snake must avoid not only self - collision, but also navigate around rocks—even predicting pathing as its body grows. Each apple eaten boosts the score by 1 and extends the snake; as length increases, demands for precision and spatial strategy skyrocket. Players balance “greedy growth” against “survival,” with reflexes and decision - making tested relentlessly.
Visuals & Experience
The interface is stripped - down: a “Score” at the top tracks progress, and an “Exit” button in the top - right enables quick exits, perfect for short play sessions. Visual design is playful: the tiger - headed snake adds charm, apples stand out clearly, and black stones signal danger unambiguously. The pace ramps up with the snake’s length—starting as relaxed apple - collecting, then devolving into frantic maneuvers to avoid tangling in its own body or hitting obstacles. This creates a satisfying “easy to start, hard to master” thrill.
Controls
Move Up = W
Move Down = S
Move Left = A
Move Right = D

title: Voracious
description:
게임 정보
This is a math addition and subtraction puzzle game. The interface displays addition/subtraction equations with question marks, and number options lie at the bottom. Players mentally calculate the unknowns (sum, addend, minuend, etc.) and tap the correct answer — right choices earn points and advance progress, training basic arithmetic skills.
The core experience: By randomly placing the question mark (as addend, minuend, subtrahend, or sum), the game forces flexible use of addition/subtraction formulas, avoiding rote memorization. Cartoon - styled geometry and bright colors reduce learning stress, suiting young players or basic arithmetic practice.
It’s a math enlightenment game blending fun and educational value.

title: Demonfo
description:
게임 정보
The story takes place in a modern city. After losing her job, a girl from the bottom of the ladder with bad luck, Chung Kwan, tries to find a cleaning job, but she mistakenly enters a cleaning company that is in the business of exorcising ghosts from murderous houses. When she tries to quit her job and is coerced by her boss, she has no choice but to catch ghosts. But as the story develops, the girl realizes that there is a reason for her constant bad luck. She awakens her divine power and sweeps away all the ghosts and demons, and even the boss has to take a beating if she doesn't obey ......

title: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
description:
게임 정보
                Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors는 Vampire Survivors에서 영감을 받은 로그라이크 액션 게임입니다. 당신은 꼭두각시 피노키오가 되어, 뒤틀린 동화 속 꿈 세계를 모험합니다. 100가지가 넘는 "드림 에그"를 수집하고 다양한 전투 스타일을 만들며, 타로 꿈 스테이지를 클리어하고 현실로 돌아가기 위해 싸우세요!
핵심 게임플레이
다양한 재능과 드림 에그 아이템을 조합해, Lancer, Archer, Caster 등 자신만의 스타일을 완성하세요. 터치 한 번으로 짜릿한 전투가 가능! 누구나 쉽게 빠져들 수 있습니다.

title: Tower Wizard
description:
게임 정보
Gather magic and build your wizard tower
Summon spirits to help gather resources
Construct buildings using the resources you gathered

title: Bebshoru Lodbuka
description:
게임 정보
This is a turn-based combat game where you have to fight against the demons of Bebshoru Lodbuka's hell until you reach the deepest caverns where the supreme darkness of Trekim Gogzokk dwells. In each of the 30 levels you will fight a guardian demon until you reach the final fight.
In the fights you use cards that you can buy in the Marketplace and then throw them when you are fighting. These cards can have effects on your enemy and also on yourself.
There are 5 difficulty levels, and you can save your avatar at any time in addition to the current game, so you can start a new game with your previous avatar to not lose the evolution.
To play you have to use the mouse mainly except in the Marketplace where you can optionally use the Enter key on an item for sale to select how many units you want.
When you choose a higher difficulty level you won't be able to win unless you do some better combat strategy, but at easier levels you can relax a bit.
You have about 500 cards to buy and you are given more coins each time you pass a level.
Death is permanent, so don't forget to save the game if you want to play it again.
Both you and your enemy have multiple skills such as Strength, Destruction instinct, Protection, Witchery, Psychic Power, Intelligence and Consciousness, as well as needs that you must satisfy in order not to reduce your energy, such as Hunger, Thirst, Mood and Clothing. You also have a Mental Strength that you must keep high enough so as not to fall asleep, consuming some food, drinking a potion or by means of some spell.
You have a time limit of 2 minutes to play your turn, and then the turn automatically passes to your enemy, although you can pass it before without playing if you wish. You can also pause the game to give you time to work out a better strategy, except on the hardest level called Hell where the timer never stops.

title: Spirit X Strike
description:
게임 정보
Experience a fresh take on this action adventure of  "Spirit X Strike," featuring three intertwined combat systems: Instant Counter, Super Strike, and Spirit Mimicry. Players can swiftly switch between defense and attack, and experience an adrenaline-pumping combat.
Unique Action storing and release system to break the limits of COMBO potential!
Chain together action sequences using the game’s distinctive Spirit Mimicry. This system allows you to freely assemble moves and unleash them at the moment you desire. Even newcomers can easily execute stunning combos and air-juggle confirms.
It’s Strike Time!
autokwd: Spirit X Strike,灵拳 Spirit X Strike

title: Villa No. 1
description:
게임 정보
"Villa No. 1": A suspenseful puzzle game set in a mysterious villa. A grad takes a high-paying job there, uncovering hidden secrets of the enigmatic family and discovering the house's dark past. His soul is tested as he uncovers the truth.
Game Features



The story takes place in a mysterious villa in the suburbs. A fledgling college student came here because he was eager for a high salary. He thought he was just a sleep tester. As he explored the villa in depth, he discovered that he had always been a mysterious employer. There seems to be a huge secret hidden, and what's even weirder is that the neighbor actually told him that this house was a haunted house, and he was faced with a major choice...
You can experience the weird storyline and feel the slight terror
The game contains heavy family issues, as well as young people’s thoughts and decisions


The retro dim painting style reminds people of the feeling of turning on the old-fashioned TV in the afternoon after the rain.
The game delivers a sense of silent suspense through layers of reversals, with very few face-turning kills, but the complexity of human nature can still shock people.

title: GST Wars
description:
게임 정보
🔥 About This Game
Welcome to a special battlefield where only the strongest survive!
In this fast-paced action game, you’ll select a unique character, each infused with their own DNA abilities, and enter an intense multiplayer arena filled with chaos and opportunity.
💥 Fight to win by battling other players, collecting coins, and climbing the leaderboard. Use your coins to unlock powerful new characters — each with different stats, powers, and playstyles. The more you fight, the more you earn. The more you earn, the stronger you become.
Will you rise to the top and become the richest and most feared warrior on the battlefield?
🎮 Key Features
⚔️ Fast-paced multiplayer battles
🧬 DNA-based character system
💰 Earn and collect coins
🛍️ Unlock and buy new characters

title: Hurley The Hyrax
description:
게임 정보
Hurley The Hyrax is an arcade-style game inspired by early 1980s arcade classics. Play as Hurley, a hyrax who's had all his flowers stolen by the diabolical Serval Squad. Bring all the flowers back to your cave before the servals stop you. Lick the servals to stun them before they get you. And watch out for the traveler, bringing you bonuses and power-ups. Play through an endless series of levels to get the high score, and maybe find love along the way...
Features:
Endless levels
4 unique level themes
Normal, Easy, and Turbo modes
Unlockable hats through challenges

title: ScaleBox
description:
게임 정보
The core mechanics of this game revolve around size, weight, and portals—along with their many surprising applications. You can push boxes as long as their total size does not exceed your own, meaning that the larger you are, the more and bigger boxes you can push!
However, each time you move, you move a distance equal to your own size, making precise positioning more challenging. So, what’s the solution?
Maybe you can use something to block your movement?

title: Metro Gravity
description:
게임 정보
Explore the twisting passages and alleys of the Halls, a liminal manifestation of the subconscious of many.

After clicking a shady looking hyperlink and filling out a survey, you find yourself in a non-sensical place where gravity implies no "up" or "down." The unfortunate residents encourage you to find your way out by facing your regrets and getting stronger.

Gain abilities, jam with foes and conquer the Halls!




Walk on walls, use your gravity beam and other abilities you unlock to traverse the Halls how you please.
Solve puzzles! Test your wit with perplexing and disorienting challenges.
Explore a cute low-poly environment with retro-inspired pixel graphics.

title: Starfield Battlegrounds
description:
게임 정보
우리는 외계 생명이 재난이 닥친 그날까지 우리에게서 멀어질 수 없다고 생각했다.인간의 환상은 깨지고 외계인은 친절한 방문객이 아니라 모든 것을 파괴하는 침입자입니다.경고도, 협상도 없이 그들의 첫 공격이 러시아에 닥쳤고, 곧이어 전쟁이 중국으로 번졌고, 그 후 미국도 살아남지 못했다.결국 세계는 공황에 빠졌고, 문명은 붕괴 직전에 이르렀으며, 사람들은 이것이 단지 전쟁이 아니라 인류의 존망에 관한 궁극적인 도전이라는 것을 깨달았다.
외계 함대의 무자비한 침습을 막기 위해 전 세계 각국은 선입견을 버리고 중미 러시아의 손잡고 협력하에 유사 이래 가장 선진적인 우주 지휘부와 작전 플랫폼인'희망호'를 만들었다.이것은 퇴로가 없는 전투이다. 인류 최고의 엘리트 조종사들은 각국 국가가 만든 최고의 작품을 몰고 전장으로 돌진하여 외계 함대와 사투를 벌일 것이다.
이 생사존망의 순간에 우리는 기적이 찾아오기를 기다릴 수 없다.종말이 눈앞에 다가왔지만 인류는 굴복하지 않을 것이다.오늘 우리는 과거의 불일치를 버리고 손잡고 외계 침략자와 맞붙는다.이 전투에서 우리는 직접 자신의 집을 구해야 한다!
높은 자유도 전투기 조종
이 게임은 1 / 3 인칭 시야각을 채택하여 플레이어는 인간 최고의 전투 조종사 중 한 명으로 변신하여 우주 공간에서 치열한 전투를 벌일 것입니다.각 나라에서 제조한 최첨단 우주 전투기를 몰고 360 ° 의 사각지대 없는 공중전을 치른다.

title: Dear Mirror Flower
description:
게임 정보
I am here, in this world...
  A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio.
In this town, strange incidents never cease.
The cause? Beings born from the darkness of the human heart: Demon Spirits.
Join Satoree Mizuki, a girl who can read others’ minds, and uncover the truth behind these supernatural cases.
  Story
...I can’t remember anything.
Through the haze of my fading consciousness, a girl’s voice faintly echoes in my ears.
When I open my eyes, I find her staring at me, her face filled with uncertainty.
According to her, this town is plagued by Demon Spirits, creatures that lurk in the shadows, bringing disaster to those who cross their path.
And one of them... stole my memories.
With the guidance of this girl, I step into a world of exorcism and supernatural battles without a single clue about my identity.
  System
The protagonist, Yuto Kamizuki, is a Kotodama User whose words can shape reality.
Harness the power of Kotodama and exorcise Demon Spirits alongside Satoree Mizuki.
  Credits
Production : KOGADO STUDIO,INC.
Planning : Kawasyonin49
Character Design : Herigaru, Ringopann
Programming : Noguchi Ryukei, Hinata Anan, Funayama Kazuma

title: Stolen Legacy Rise of The Fallen
description:
게임 정보
You lost everything. Now it’s time to take it all back.
In Stolen Legacy: Rise of The Fallen, you start from the bottom after your empire collapses. Your wealth, your name, your influence — all stripped away. Now, it’s time to hustle your way back up.
Complete missions, make smart investments, and get your hands dirty as you rebuild what was once yours. Every move brings you one step closer to restoring your legacy.

💼 Idle Crime Simulation
Click your way through jobs, missions, and criminal deals as your empire grows  even when you're offline.
📈 Live Stock Market
Buy and sell stocks in real-time. Watch the numbers and invest smart to build long-term wealth.
🏦 Bank Interest System
Deposit earnings to grow your money passively  or spend it fast to climb faster.
🎲 Casino Mini-Games
Play blackjack or spin the Lucky Wheel with in-game currency. Take the risk, reap the reward.
🏙️ Business Investments
Buy businesses that generate passive income. The bigger the investment, the bigger the payout.
📊 Character Progression
Upgrade your stats and skills to earn more, click faster, and unlock deeper systems.
🗂️ Missions & Jobs
Do the dirty work. Run street missions, climb the ladder, and unlock higher-paying gigs.
🎯 From Nothing to Everything
Start with nothing no money, no power, no respect. Build it all back, one move at a time, and rise to claim everything they said you’d never have again.

title: Considerable Grandfather
description:
게임 정보
Considerable Grandfather is on the hunt for Creek, his dearest dog & best friend, who went missing during an overnight break-in by the Molemen, a collective of organized humanoid moles, scavenging for equipment to contribute to their unknown device.
Rescue Boggies!
The goal of most stages in a given location is to rescue all of the stray Boggies. Bring them to the Boggie Door to save them & get them on the path back to their homes!
Dig Holes!
Use your trusty iron shovel to dig holes in the dirt to trap enemies, take shortcuts, or reach inaccessible areas! You can't dig through rock though!
Survive.
Now that the Boggies are safe, you must save yourself next. Be careful out there on your way to the Exit Door!

title: Menhera & Troll
description:
게임 정보
스토리
인터넷에 각종 악플과 싸움이 넘쳐흐르는 세상.
천재 심리학자 교수는 자신의 애제자인 '조수군'에게 인터넷세상의 키보드 워리어들의 실체를 조사하고, 그들의 마음을 치유할 수 있는 방법을 연구하라고 지시한다.
교수의 갑작스러운 지시에 조수군은 당황하지만, 연구해 볼만한 가치가 있다고 느끼고 곧 키보드 워리어들을 찾아 나서기 시작한다.
에...? 그런데 내 주변의 키보드 워리어들이 모두 여자들이었다고?
게임 플레이
당신은 심리학과 대학원생으로서, 키보드 워리어들의 실체를 조사하고 그들의 마음을 치유하는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.
대화를 통해 그녀들을 치유해 보세요!
하지만 명심하세요. 치유에 실패할 경우, 그녀들이 키보드 워리어였다는 사실을 다시한 번 깨닫게 될 것 입니다.
게임 특징
랜덤하게 주어지는 수많은 상황들
이 게임은 일직선형 스토리 게임이 아닙니다. 다양한 상황들을 마주하며 모든 캐릭터들의 마음을 치유해보세요! 만약 실패한다면? 그녀들이 키보드 워리어라는 사실을 다시 한 번 깨닫게 될 것 입니다.
스피디한 게임 플레이
그녀들은 당신의 반응을 무제한 기다려줄만한 인내심을 가지고 있지 않습니다.
당신이 여러명을 동시에 상대하더라도 말이죠.
스피디하게 그녀들의 마음을 공략해보세요.
매력적인 캐릭터
결코 평범하지 않은 그녀들!
키보드 워리어들과 관계를 쌓아 그녀들의 숨겨진 이야기들을 발견해나가세요.
그녀들의 마음을 치유하려면, 그녀들의 대화를 주의 깊게 들여보아야 할 것입니다.

title: Ultra-Ultra Doggy Trainer!!
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for... The STEAM debut of the best game of 2025?*
*study only inclusive of games called 'Ultra-Ultra Doggy Trainer!!'
______________________________________________
Ultra-Ultra Doggy Trainer!! It's a special kind of RPG all about adopting your own puppy and training it to greatness!
In a world where cats and dogs once fought a terrible war, the victory of the dogs is celebrated still to this day via seasonal championships. Every season, two contenders will battle for the right to challenge the champion the following season. You are ARLO KATMAN, a promising young trainer who has just adopted a new puppy.
-Create your own puppy through the Design-a-Dog menu!
-Train your dog via a unique turn-based battle system.
-Meet exciting rivals, and make quirky friends! Work a retail job, write a manifesto(???), or play games at the arcade.
-Organise your day and navigate through a time passage system.
-Explore Pastel Town and try to find all 12 Honey Sticks!
-Conquer your opponents and become the CHAMPION OF PASTEL TOWN.
FAQ
Q: "Will Jamie Jameson be my prom date?"
A: He will, but only to get a free dinner out of you.
Q: "What is the unemployment rate of Pastel Town?"
A: 31.818%
Q: "What should I do if I get trapped in a corner while playing?"
A: Press shift to open the menu, close it again, and move in the desired direction while the menu is closing.
Q: "Mac/Linux support?"
A: Uhhhhh... Quick! Look! A flying dog! *runs away*

title: Symphony of the Stars
description:
게임 정보
Symphony of the Stars is a JRPG inspired by the SNES era that sees a lost outsider, Myst, thrown into a war between the gods of the zodiac! Explore and battle your way through puzzle box dungeons as you seek out powerful relics that grant the use of both combat and overworld skills. Delve into themes of duality and personal growth with Myst as he weighs the preservation of his past against the embrace of an uncertain future.
Customize your characters in battle by learning and equipping devastating skills!
Use skills to interact with the world outside of battle!

title: Fingerdance
description:
게임 정보
Fingerdance is a game that simply confuses your fingers.

Place five fingers of any hand comfortably on your keyboard. Your task is to press and release each finger according to the given patterns. It’s a bit like a rhythm game—but there’s no need to keep time with the beat. Take your time!

The faster you complete each pattern, the higher your rank will be. Try aiming for an S-rank on every stage!
Features
Finger-confusing action
Rhythm-ish gameplay
Minimalistic graphics
Time attacks!

title: Dragons Reef
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요 모험가 여러분!
드래곤 리프 세계로의 매력적인 여정을 시작하세요. 8명의 선장 중 한 명으로 플레이하고 드래곤, 해적, 다양한 바다 생물, 그리고 획득할 골드로 가득한 판타지 세계로 자신의 배를 타고 출발하세요. 각 선장은 특정 상황에서 유리한 고유한 기술을 가지고 있습니다. 기술은 다음 레벨로 개발할 수 있습니다. 플레이 스타일과 선택한 레벨에 맞는 선장을 선택하세요. 이 독특한 게임 플레이에서 플레이 방식과 작업 완료 전략을 바꿀 수 있는 24개의 강력한 마법 유물을 획득할 수 있습니다. 한 번에 4개의 유물만 활성화할 수 있으므로 앞으로의 도전에 캐릭터를 신중하게 적응시켜야 합니다. 완벽한 순간에 완벽한 샷을 찍고 해적을 물리칠 수 있도록 배를 배치하세요. 각 라운드는 여러 번, 다양한 방법으로 완료할 수 있는 흥미진진한 모험입니다. 게임 내 이벤트의 높은 무작위성으로 인해 게임 플레이는 매번 약간씩 다르게 보일 것입니다. 배는 8개의 환상적인 대포알을 사용할 수 있으며, 각각은 특별한 속성과 화려한 애니메이션을 가지고 있습니다. 당신 옆에서 날아주고, 해적과 싸우고, 물 속 장애물을 제거하는 데 도움을 줄 황금빛 용과 함께 분위기 있는 땅을 탐험해보세요.
Dragons Reef는 매력적이고 가족 친화적이며 다채로운 액션 게임으로 다음과 같은 특징이 있습니다.
상품 배달에 관한 레크리에이션 모험
해적으로부터 자신을 방어하는 게임 플레이와 용의 알을 보호해야 하는 추가 과제가 있는 화려한 해상 전투
물건을 훔치는 깡패를 쫓는 재미있는 추격전
플레이어가 통제 지점을 점령하고 유지해야 하는 전략적 게임 플레이

title: Backpack Monsters: Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Backpack Monsters is a roguelike game with placing monsters in backpacks. Buy monsters, organize them and fight against dungeon monsters.



Explore a dark dungeon inhabited by 47 different types of monsters. Delve into its depths and encounter a myriad of fearsome creatures, each with its own unique abilities and challenges. From the menacing goblins lurking in the shadows to the powerful Vampires. Will you brave the darkness and emerge victorious, or will you succumb to the horrors that lie within?



Prepare your battlefield! Arrange your monsters to defeat the enemy and become a Backpack Master! You choose who will serve you. Purchase and evolve monsters to vanquish others.


Strategically position your monsters; they come in various sizes, rarities, and strengths. Experiment with different combinations to discover the ideal mix for defeating your enemies. Whether it's unleashing a towering zombie or deploying a nimble, elusive goblin, the key lies in finding the synergy that outmatches your adversaries.


Collect and evolve your monsters to discover optimal combinations and achieve the title of Backpack Master. Once you attain this prestigious title, you'll be prepared for even greater challenges that await you.

title: Chess Hunt
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에서 당신은 끝없는 배고픔을 가진 뱀파이어입니다. 매일 밤 마을로 내려가 가능한 한 많은 체스 말을 모아야 합니다.
게임 플레이:
매 턴마다 보드를 이동하며 체스 말을 모으세요.
카드를 사용하여 완벽한 경로를 계획하세요.
같은 유형의 체스 말을 모아 최고 점수를 기록하세요.
새벽이 되기 전에 충분한 점수를 모으지 못하면 당신의 불멸의 삶은 끝이 납니다.
밤을 살아남으면 새로운 카드나 업그레이드로 덱을 강화할 수 있습니다.
특징:
배우기 쉬움.
이번 데모에서는 53장의 독특한 카드 제공.
무한한 변화를 제공하는 랜덤 업그레이드.
그리고… 아마도 더 많은 깜짝 놀랄 요소가 있을지도!
위시리스트에 추가해 주세요. 감사합니다!

title: The Diary
description:
게임 정보

The Diary is a 2D suspenseful narrative puzzle game that revolves around several distinct "diaries," including a journal full of life but full of doubts, two investigative notebooks written by different people, and the planner's diary, which will all be displayed before you. By solving each page's puzzle, you will turn the pages and gradually gain insight into a heart-stopping missing case. From different perspectives, you will uncover the buried past behind the case.


· Organize scattered chat records and search for clues in the book

· Move the camera to record past images

· Play instruments, catch dolls... and more fun interactions await you to explore!

title: Escape The Quack
description:
게임 정보
The objective is simple: Find the exit and solve puzzles along the way while staying ahead of the duck.
In this whimsical low-poly adventure, players must evade the relentless pursuit of a quirky duck. Each level presents a unique task that players must complete while avoiding capture. Designed for players of all ages, this game combines humor and lightheartedness with thrilling gameplay. The premise of being chased by a duck adds a fun twist, making it suitable for families and casual gamers alike.
Players will encounter various challenges, such as puzzles to solve, items to collect, and obstacles to navigate. Quick thinking and strategic planning are essential as players balance escaping the duck and completing their objectives.
As players advance, they face increasing difficulty levels, making the gameplay more exciting. The duck becomes more cunning, requiring players to adapt their strategies and improve their skills to survive.
Get ready to race against the clock, complete your tasks, and outsmart the duck in this captivating low-poly world!

title: QIMEN Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보
독특한 타워 디펜스 + RPG 듀얼 뷰 게임 플레이:
・3인칭(타워 디펜스) 뷰: 플레이어는 자동 공격을 수행하고, 방어 탑을 건설하며, 몬스터들의 진행 경로를 관찰할 수 있습니다.
・1인칭(RPG) 뷰: 플레이어의 기본 공격력을 증가시키고, 스킬을 시전할 수 있습니다.
다양한 기문 기관:
・경문(景門): 지형을 변경하여 몬스터의 전진 경로를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

・상문(傷門): 몬스터의 출병 기지를 파괴하여 한쪽 길의 몬스터가 전진하는 것을 막을 수 있습니다.

・개문(開門): 방어 탑의 기반을 이동시켜 공동 방어를 돕는 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.
company: Tianjin Wuhua Network Technology Co, Ltd

title: Sickly Days and Summer Traces
description:
게임 정보
《두 사람의 여름 소리》 는 일본 미소녀 게임 브랜드 Sister Position이 선보이는 픽셀 아트 육성형 RPG입니다.
1920x1080의 고해상도 지원, 2025년 여름 글로벌 출시 예정.
원화 및 캐릭터 디자인: 케이코
시나리오: 히가시토
기획・프로듀스: 차타
히로인 미라이 아스미 역에는 인기 성우 아마치 하루가 열연!
스토리
“오빠와 함께라면, 어디든지 내가 원하는 천국이야.”
세상 끝자락의 조용한 시골 마을.
병약한 여동생과, 그녀를 지켜주는 오빠가
소소하지만 따뜻한 나날을 함께 보냅니다.
아침엔 이슬을 줍고,
한낮엔 구름을 세며,
저녁엔 손을 잡고 귀가하고,
밤엔 별빛 아래 조용히 속삭이는 시간들.
말로 하지 않아도 전해지는 마음.
눈에 보이지 않아도 느껴지는 유대.
이것은,
누군가의 곁을 지키고 싶은
작고 조용한 사랑의 이야기입니다.
게임 특징
오빠의 시점에서 여동생과 함께하는 일상을 체험
다양한 장소에서 상호작용 및 이벤트 발생
대화를 나누고, 돌봐주며, 함께 시간을 보내 유대감을 키워가기
잔잔한 여름 속에서, 둘만의 행복을 찾아가는 힐링 스토리
autokwd: Sickly Days and Summer Traces,두 사람의 여름의 소리

title: Sugar & Rolling Stone
description:
게임 정보
"슈가와 롤링스톤"은 레트로 감성의 사이드뷰 퍼즐 게임입니다.
탐험가 롤링스톤을 조작해, 마법의 열쇠를 가진 소녀 슈가가 잠긴 문까지 안전하게 도달할 수 있도록 도와주세요.
여러 오브젝트를 활용해 길을 만들고 퍼즐을 해결하며 모험을 즐겨보세요!
슈가가 목적지에 도달할 수 있도록 도와주세요!
무거운 열쇠를 들고 있는 슈가는 점프할 수 없지만, 다행히도 다양한 방법으로 이동할 수 있습니다.
대포를 사용해 슈가를 멀리 날려보세요!
슈가는 마법의 보호를 받아 안전하게 착지하니 걱정할 필요 없습니다.

title: Infinite Rails
description:
게임 정보
Explore an Infinite World
Dive into a procedurally generated world with endless possibilities. Every region you explore offers unique landscapes, resources, and challenges. From rolling plains to rugged mountains, adapt your rail-building strategy to conquer any terrain. Discover new stations and routes as you expand your network. No two worlds are ever the same, ensuring a fresh experience every time you play.
Lay Tracks
Design and build your dream railway with intuitive track-laying tools. Connect stations across vast distances and create efficient routes to optimize transportation. Strategize your track placement to avoid obstacles and minimize travel times. Experiment with complex track layouts, including junctions, loops, and switches. Watch your rail system come to life as trains follow your carefully constructed network.
Terraform
Take control of the land to suit your railway-building needs. Carve trough terrain, and bridge rivers to create the ultimate routes. Use advanced tools to shape the environment and overcome natural barriers. Turn rugged terrain into a smooth path for your trains to travel. In , the world bends to your vision.

title: Rise of Adou
description:
게임 정보
Rise of Adou
A Multi-Ending Character-Raising Game
Rise of Adou is a multi-ending raising simulation game. You will personally guide and nurture Adou, interact with legendary generals of Shu Han, fight alongside new companions, and lead him toward different fates—rewriting the ending of Shu Han itself.
Studying boosts many of Adou’s attributes, but it also increases stress and darkness. Will you push him hard for excellence, or give him a joyful, carefree childhood? The choice is yours.
The game features two main types of endings: Career Endings and Romantic Endings. Based on Adou’s final attributes, you can unlock different career paths—even the chance to unify the Three Kingdoms. Meanwhile, five characters are romanceable, each offering a unique romantic conclusion.

title: Hexitten
description:
게임 정보
Hexitten is a sci-fi roguelike deck builder with tactical grid based battles. You will build an elite team of heroes to tackle the greatest threats to the galactic alliance. During your campaign, you will travel through the 6 hextants of the galaxy to collect new abilities, modify your ships, recruit additional team members, discover each hero's story and increase their synergy with other heroes, encounter special events, and fight for the future of the alliance.
Game Features
21 Heroes with 16 Guest Characters
186 Ability Cards and 46 Hero/Guest/Boss Ability Cards
Grid Based Tactical Battles

title: Infiniclick
description:
게임 정보
Infiniclick is a relaxing incremental game (or not—it's up to you) where your goal is to pay off an unfair debt to the Fun Corp.
Each program comes with upgrades that will allow you to earn more money with them.

title: Drone:Modern Warfare
description:
게임 정보
"드론: 현대 전쟁"은 드론 전투 작전을 시뮬레이션하는 게임입니다. 현대 군사 및 보안 분야에서 드론은 정찰, 타격 등 여러 임무를 수행하는 중요한 도구가 되었으며, 그 장점은 높은 기동성, 원격 제어, 그리고 낮은 작전 비용에 있습니다. 게임에서는 플레이어가 다양한 유형의 드론을 조종하며, 적 목표를 추적하고 파괴하는 등의 여러 임무를 수행합니다. 정밀한 제어와 전략적 배치를 통해, 플레이어는 현대 전쟁에서 드론의 실제 운용을 경험하고, 시뮬레이션 전투 환경에서 전술 능력을 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 이 게임은 오락성을 제공할 뿐만 아니라, 플레이어가 전투에서 드론의 중요한 역할을 더 잘 이해하는 데에도 도움을 줍니다.

title: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue
description:
게임 정보
Fear the Timeloop - Prologue는 시간 루프 속에서 벌어지는 서바이벌 호러 게임입니다. 본편 이야기의 프롤로그에서 게임의 첫 한 시간을 플레이해 보세요.

당신은 심한 출혈을 겪고 있는 상태로 낯선 장소에서 깨어나는 제임스 쿠퍼 보안관의 역할을 맡습니다. 만약 그가 빨리 치료하지 않으면, 15분 안에 출혈로 죽게 되고 사이클이 다시 시작됩니다.

하지만 심각한 상처에도 불구하고, 제임스는 훨씬 더 큰 위협인 혈에 굶주린 괴물들과 맞서야 합니다. 그가 탈출하려는 건물은 외부로 나가려는 누구든지 죽일 준비가 된 미지의 인물들에 의해 둘러싸여 있습니다.

title: Maze Lovers Memorial
description:
게임 정보
Maze Lovers Memorial: Where your forever, is forever ingrained
In this cozy, physics-based puzzle game, you guide a marble through over 80 mazes, each one nestled within an atmospheric cemetery. title: Satori | 悟り
description:
게임 정보
Playing Satori | 悟り, the player loses himself in a dream world to take an inner journey of meditation.

title: Cold Bed on Route
description:
게임 정보
This universe may be cold, but it is still three degrees warmer than absolute zero.
Cold Bed on Route is an equation-style rogue-lite adventure game.
Have you heard of The Cold Equations, the seminal 1950s sci-fi novella by Tom Godwin?
A spaceship flying at the edge of its weight limit, carrying cargo vital to saving many lives. An unexpected stowaway slips aboard.
If the stowaway stays, the ship will be too heavy to stay on course. The rescue mission will fail.
If the stowaway is ejected into space, they will, of course, die.
And yet—when the equation is clear, when the lives at stake are many—there’s only one logical outcome: sacrifice the one, save the many.
This is the central dilemma of The Cold Equations, and the foundation of the "equation story" genre it inspired.
Cold Bed on Route takes inspiration from that story and follows the same essential structure.
The setting is a spacecraft adrift in the cold vacuum of space. More seed than ship, it’s a Final Emergency Boat (FEB): ultra-small, ultra-light, and built for last-resort missions.
And of course, as any equation story demands—there is a stowaway.
In The Cold Equations, the stowaway was a fragile girl, sneaking aboard to see her brother.
But in Cold Bed on Route, the “girl” is something else entirely. She is a Doggy, an artificial human with beastlike ears to mark her as non-human. She has flesh, bones, and blood—but she is far stronger and far more intelligent than any ordinary person.
Work with her to search for and jettison any unnecessary items. Then compensate for the excess weight caused by bringing her aboard—a weight that is, well, a little more than it seems... quite a bit more, actually. Uh, how to put it... it’s, you know, really heavy.
And finally, prove that the universe hasn’t gone completely cold. Not yet.
Now then, pilot—it's your turn.

title: Cats Visiting Historical Times
description:
게임 정보
귀여운 시간 여행 퀘스트에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
장난스러운 차원문이 갑자기 열리며, 호기심 많은 고양이와 당황한 주인은 역사 속으로 빨려 들어갔습니다! 이제 고대 문명을 탐험하고, 숨은 고양이를 찾으며, 집으로 돌아갈 단서를 모아야 합니다.
전설적인 시대 탐험:
메소포타미아, 고대 이집트, 고대 그리스, 로마 제국, 바이킹 시대, 중세, 해적의 황금기—각 시대가 몰입감 넘치는 비주얼과 재미있는 역사적 디테일로 재현되었습니다.
다양한 고양이 찾기:
친근한 고양이 – 발견되면 기쁜 고양이들, 자신의 시대에 관한 재미있는 사실을 알려줍니다.
수줍은 고양이 – 변장의 달인, 교묘하게 숨어 있지만 발자국, 넘어진 물건, 꼬리 흔들림을 단서로 남깁니다.
역사학자 고양이 – 희귀하고 현명한 특별한 고양이들, 시대에 관한 흥미로운 지식을 공유하며 '고양이 백과사전' 항목을 해금합니다.
두 가지 재미난 게임 모드:
스토리 모드 – 각 시대를 탐험하며 비밀을 풀고 독특한 역사적 캐릭터들을 만나는 여유로운 모험.
아케이드 모드 – 빠른 속도의 도전! 제한 시간 안에 모든 숨은 고양이를 찾아 랭킹을 올려보세요.
수집, 학습, 해금:
시간을 초월한 귀여운 고양이들로 '고양이 컬렉션'을 완성하세요.
숨겨진 유물을 발견하고 보너스 미니게임을 해금하세요 (이집트 상형문자 해독이나 바이킹 선박 조종 등!).
고양이 호루라기나 시간 나침반으로 도구를 업그레이드해 수줍은 고양이를 더 쉽게 찾아보세요.
재미와 학습의 완벽한 조화:
매력적인 아트 스타일, 유머러스한 대화, 역사를 재미있게 풀어낸 『고양이와 떠나는 역사 여행』은 고양이 애호가, 역사 덕후, 모든 연령대의 게이머를 위한 즐거운 모험입니다. 이 시간 여행자들을 집으로 돌려보낼 수 있을까요… 아니면 역사 속에 영원히 갇히게 될까요?

title: Easy Bubbles
description:
게임 정보
Easy Bubbles에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 여기는 궁극의 방치형 아쿠아리움 성역, 평온한 게임 플레이와 깊이 있는 전략적 선택이 만나는 곳입니다. 수작업으로 정교하게 그려진 선명한 2D 만화 스타일의 풍부하게 디테일한 수중 세계에 몰입하여, Easy Bubbles가 단순한 방치형 게임을 넘어 나만의 아쿠아 휴식처인 이유를 경험해 보세요.

새로운 종 발견
Easy Bubbles에서 여는 모든 물고기 팩은 당신의 수조에 뜻밖의 놀라움을 선사합니다. 게임에는 일곱 가지 테마별 물고기 팩이 있으며, 총 58종의 물고기 중 어떤 종이 나올지는 예측할 수 없습니다. 각 종은 두 가지 생애 단계, 치어와 성어로 등장하며, 네 가지 비주얼 버전(노멀, 컬러풀, 골든 및 레인보우)으로 제공됩니다.


더 큰 흥미를 위해, 모든 물고기에는 다음 일곱 가지 레어도 중 하나가 무작위로 할당됩니다:
Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Ancient

방대한 물고기 라이브러리

58종의 물고기 탐험

종당 2단계 성장(치어 & 성어)

단계당 4가지 비주얼 버전(노멀, 컬러풀, 골든, 레인보우)






치어가 성어로 성장하는 과정을 실시간으로 지켜보세요. 수조 관리와 먹이 주기를 직접 수행해 성장을 가속화하거나, Auto-AFK 모드를 활성화해 자리를 비워도 수조가 자동으로 발전하도록 할 수 있습니다.

할지, 할지 결정하세요. 선택과 타이밍이 를 좌우합니다.


다른 작업을 하는 동안에도 Easy Bubbles를 백그라운드로 실행해 두세요. 백그라운드 모드를 켜면 공부, 업무, 웹 서핑 중에도 물고기들이 성장하고 수익을 창출합니다. 부드러운 시각 효과와 편안한 환경음이 어우러진 당신의 완벽한 데스크톱 동반자가 되어줍니다.


가장 희귀한 개체를 노리는 수집가를 위해, 부스터 팩은 스페셜 버전과 초희귀 컬러를 빠르게 얻을 수 있는 지름길을 제공합니다. 패키지를 열 때마다 Common 치어가 나올지, Ancient 레인보우 성어가 나올지 미니 이벤트를 경험해 보세요.


당신만의 이상적인 수조를 다음 요소로 꾸며보세요:

과 배경

조절 가능한 주·야간

산호 아치, 해조 밭, 난파선 잔해 등의

편안한 환경음악 또는 바다 자연 소리


각 물고기에 어울리는 이름을 붙이고, 게임 내에서 바로 커뮤니티 갤러리에 공유하세요. 팁을 나누고, 서로의 수조를 감상하며, 고유한 컬렉션을 함께 축하해 보세요.



Easy Bubbles는 편안한 ‘핸즈오프’ 플레이와 깊이 있는 컬렉션 메커니즘을 결합합니다. 긴 하루를 정리하며 휴식을 취하든, 물고기 도감을 완성하기 위한 목표를 세우든, 수면 아래에서는 끝없는 즐거움이 당신을 기다립니다. 지금 바로 다이빙해 꿈의 아쿠아리움을 만들어 보세요!
