description:
게임 정보
Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping.
Key Features:
Movement mechanics inspired by the full suite of Source Engine movement gamemodes like Surf and BHop. Enhancements have been made to key aspects of movement to be more welcoming for new players while not compromising on the depth of high-level play.
Consistent, fully deterministic gameplay where specific inputs consistently return the same results, allowing for pure tests of skill where the player is in full control of their character at all times.
Five official maps with level design inspired by Team Fortress 2's community-made jump maps.
Visuals inspired by the early 3D PC games of the late 90s and early 2000s, designed to never infringe on the readability of the environments.
A full replay system which saves your best times on maps to watch back or race against as a ghost.
More features to come over the course of Early Access. Visit my YouTube channel to keep up with development through my devlog series.
NOTE:
This game is hard. While the mechanics of rocket jumping and advanced movement mechanics are tutorialized, it is highly recommended that you at minimum have an understanding of first-person movement mechanics and controls before playing.

title: CritterGarden
description:
게임 정보
Breed, feed, and collect cute Critters in this cozy, relaxing farm sim that is easy to pick up and play for all ages. Critters have complex emotional needs that must be balanced to keep them alive and happy. Critters need to eat, and each species has a unique diet. Discover new Critters by evolving the ones that are present in your garden to complete your Critter Phylogeny! Every Critter’s ancestry can be traced on the grand tree of life – who knows what kinds of great beasts might descend from your humble Slimes?
Get creative! Create distinctive gardens with biome-specific needs and features, including traditional farms, cactus gardens, forests of fruit trees, and more! Unlock research upgrades to enhance the efficiency of your gardening, such as faster tools, quicker Critter breeding, and earning more currency. Paying attention to the specific evolution requirements of Critters and growing conditions of plants will help you check off every task in your journal to achieve 100% completion in growing your collection of life!

title: Bushido Kensei The Last Warrior
description:
게임 정보
Busido Kensei The Last Warrior is a Rogue-Like action RPG with a twist. With Melee Combat you try and survive the demon hordes trying to take over the world. As the last warrior left it is up to you to protect the last remaining bastion of hope!
Are you up to the challenge?
Melee Combat!
Unlike most Roguelike games we have a full on Melee combat system!
Melee: Using your katana slice through your enemies with a Light Attack or a Heavy Attack.
Dash Attack: Dash into battle with a Dash Attack and slice through them.
Dodge Roll: Roll out of harms way!
Level Up!
After every level gained select either a active or a passive skill to make you strong and let you fight for longer!
Find and Equip Better Gear!
Find Rare or even Legendary gear while you fight of the hordes or destroy those evil bosses!
Boss Fights!
Fight strong bosses that will drop gear!
Upgrade Your Stats
If you still struggle to stay alive, use the upgrade stats menu and make your warrior stronger!
For The Future!
With more Heroes, Skills, Enemies, Maps and Modes to come in the future.

title: Two the Top
description:
게임 정보
Two the Top is a cooperative precision platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along and work together as you brave the heights on your journey to the top!
Simple-to-learn controls. (Left, Right, Jump, Yoyo)
Journey through many different environments with their own unique challenges!
Watch your step, a fall could lose you a lot of progress!
Take a break at any time, the game will remember exactly where you last left off and will put you back on track when you return!
Invite a friend along to join for free using the friend pass! Only ONE player needs to own the game to unlock the full experience!
(If both players are using the friend pass, you'll only have access to the demo portion of the game.)
A journey for two;
Bounce off your partner's head to boost high up into the air, and let down your yoyo to let them climb up after you!

title: Parcel Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Inspect and process parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Receive and sort deliveries, examine labels for mistakes, and automate to maximise warehouse efficiency. Upgrade and expand your warehouse to build your parcel empire!
Examine parcel labels for weight, destination, cargo type and more.
Key-in or scan barcodes, and dissect parcels for contraband.
Approve or deny parcels against ever-changing criteria.
Automate label inspections using advanced processing and detection machines.
Increase warehouse throughput using conveyor belts and storage systems.
Build complex systems to maximise warehouse efficiency.

title: Handstand Hank
description:
게임 정보
핸드스탠드 핑크는 당신의 인내심을 시험하는 고통스러운 경험입니다. 장애물 산을 올라갈 때 뛰고, 넘어지고, 분노하며 점점 더 어려운 도전들을 극복하세요.
도전에 대비하세요:
4개의 잔인한 어려운 구역 - 각각이 새로운 독특한 도전을 소개합니다.
두 가지 게임 방식 - 체크포인트가 있는 이지 모드 또는 넘어질 때마다 비용이 드는 하드 모드.
顶点に到達した者を待つ比類のない勝利。

title: Mushroom Musume
description:
게임 정보

Once upon a time, there was a lonesome Recluse, plagued with the desire to raise a child. Wandering nearby, the strange Witch of the Woods couldn't help but overhear this wish, and with a twisted humor gifted them a pot of dirt. Help guide the Recluse through the maze of fungal parenthood, then discover how many types of person (mushroom?) your Daughter can become!

When one Daughter falls, start over and discover new corners of the world... and a treasure trove of secrets and unlockables!


Raising a child is hard, raising a mushroom is no easier. Any little thing you do can change your Daughter's path in life - will she grow into a pretty little Fly Agaric or an uncanny and indomitable Cordyceps? A parent's role is key, so take it seriously... or perhaps you'd rather relax. There's always next time, after all!



The world of Mushroom Musume is fun and unusual, full of whimsical moments and unexpected dark corners. Discover shocking new outcomes and twists in familiar events by playing again as a different Daughter. Choose alternate paths, and gain a more complete picture of this odd world. Perhaps even spend time in a tale-within-a-tale and see the world through (slightly less) fungal-colored glasses...



Each Daughter grown earns you Spores, which you can then spend between runs to buy permanent upgrades. Cultivate your personal garden and gain improvements for future daughters, or maybe receive a rare item from the local summoning circle instead. Featuring exclusive music, unlockable mushroom girls, in-universe notes, and more!



You can find almost any color in fungi, and that's true of your Daughter too. Collect memories of Daughters past, colors, music, and more in your own personal Mushroom Almanac. With tons of treats to discover, foraging for everything could take years!



We offer an extensive demo of Mushroom Musume and welcome you to try it for yourself. The demo allows you to experience a wide slice of the game without any of the planned meta-progression elements, featuring...

title: Redbeard's Recoil
description:
게임 정보
Redbeard's Recoil is a tile-based puzzle adventure. Shooting your cannon carries you three tiles backwards—it's the only way to move.
Existential dialectic
Along the way, you'll engage in philosophical dialogue with a nihilistic seagull named Gulliver. This charmingly existential gull disapproves of some of your main driving forces—namely, the collection of coins as a reason to press on. However, Redbeard has plenty to say in response to Gulliver's persistent flurry of despair. Can Redbeard teach Gulliver to strive for some greater purpose, or will the bird retain his conception of the world as transparently meaningless?
Tiled tribulations
Making progress when all motion is backwards is a strange endeavor. Redbeard emerges into a world of various objects, in their assorted configurations of blocking and allowing, danger and safety. At times he treads near Gulliver's amorality, in encounters with creatures reduced to mere stepping stones for self-advancement. In the end, Redbeard will have faced down dozens of challenges across three distinct areas, grappling not only with the world around him but also with his own existence.
Personal note from the developer
I'm a solo indie game dev, and this is my first release. For years, my hobbies have included programming, art, 3d modeling, music composition, and of course playing and thinking about games. It's been so nice to finally have a place to put all of that together. I hope you like it.

title: Legends: Saint George
description:
게임 정보
성 조지와 용의 전설을 독특한 인터랙티브 경험으로 탐험하세요.
Legends: Saint George에서 당신의 선택이 전설의 기사 성 조지와 그 먼 왕국의 운명을 결정합니다.
공주를 구할까요? 용을 물리칠까요? 아니면 돈키호테나 잔 다르크와 같은 전설적인 캐릭터들과 만나 힘을 합칠까요?
주요 특징:
🌟 분기형 스토리라인: 다양한 선택지가 서로 다른 결말로 이어집니다.
🛡️ 성 조지의 전설에서 영감을 받은 독특한 재해석.
🤹 예상치 못한 만남: 다양한 문화권의 전설적인 캐릭터들.
🎨 세심하게 제작된 비주얼로 영웅과 배경이 생생하게 살아납니다.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 모든 연령층에게 적합: 젊은이와 노인 모두에게 재미있는 방식으로 위대한 신화를 경험할 수 있습니다.
✨ “Legends: Folklore Stories” 컬렉션의 일부: 전 세계의 인기 전설을 주제로 한 시리즈의 첫 번째 모험.
Die by Anything와 Kittengumi의 제작진이 선사하는 이 새로운 인터랙티브 어드벤처는 Guarida Games의 독특한 스타일로 클래식 이야기를 재해석합니다.

title: Metawork - Antique Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Welcome to Antique Shop Simulator, a deep and immersive tycoon experience where you build your legacy as a master antique dealer. From humble beginnings in a small, dusty shop to owning a high-end showroom filled with rare treasures, every decision you make shapes your journey.
Run Your Own Antique Shop
Start with a modest storefront and work your way up by buying and selling second-hand items, rare collectibles, and valuable antiques. You’ll need a good eye for quality and a sharper mind for business. Track item conditions, research their histories, and make calculated decisions—will you sell it now or invest in repairs for greater profits later?
Restore Forgotten Treasures
Some antiques come in poor condition, but hidden beneath the dust may lie a gem. Use your workshop to clean, repair, and restore furniture, old electronics, vintage decorations, and more. Improve their value and attract collectors willing to pay top dollar.
Explore and Expand
Unlock new areas on the map—from estate sales in the countryside to secret warehouse auctions in the city. These locations offer new types of goods, rare items, and valuable opportunities. As your business grows, invest in a larger shop, hire staff, and optimize your operations to handle the booming demand.
Dynamic Customer Interactions
Every day, different customers will walk through your door: collectors, tourists, bargain hunters, and eccentric treasure seekers. Read their behavior, negotiate skillfully, and tailor your offers. Some may even bring you special requests or high-stakes offers that can make or break your reputation.
Build Your Reputation
Word spreads fast in the antique world. Deliver quality service, make smart deals, and handle special requests to build your shop's reputation. A respected name means more customers, better offers, and exclusive deals.

title: Electronic Market Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"전자 시장 시뮬레이터"는 전자 시장 운영에 대한 모든 세부 사항을 갖춘 냉철한 1인칭 시뮬레이션입니다.
매장 관리
매장을 아름답고 효율적으로 디자인하세요. 제품이 진열될 위치를 결정하고, 진열대를 관리하며, 고객 만족도를 높여 완벽한 쇼핑 경험을 제공하세요.
공급품

title: Super Cursor
description:
게임 정보
Well hello there beautiful! The name's Miss Wolfy and I'll be guiding you throughout this adventure (＾ *)✿
Super Cursor is a challenging precision platformer where you control your very own mouse cursor, who is brought to life and given his own personality! Move through the world as you dodge obstacles and enemies who are stopping you from reaching your beloved princess.
Be careful though, as anything you touch will kill you instantly, making you start all over again! (WOW FUN!)
Don't you worry, as only the tip of your cursor will cause damage to you!
Absolutely no mistakes are allowed, can you make it to the end and free the princess and myself, or will we be together forever and ever? (ʘ‿ʘ)ﾉ✿
Features:
Dodge obstacles, enemies, and projectiles thrown your way
Defeat difficult bosses that will enrage you!
Original soundtracks, characters, and world!
Online Co-op because two heads are better than one, right?
Bring personality to your very own cursor!

title: Gut Eater
description:
게임 정보
🐾 Gut Eater – 당신의 유일한 임무는 고양이를 돌보는 것... 하지만 평범한 고양이는 아닙니다. 심리적 공포 체험이 시작됩니다.
📦 수상한 소포. 그 안에는 당신을 응시하고 시험하며 기다리는 생명체가 있습니다. 단순한 반려동물이 아닙니다. 그것은 위협입니다.
🍖 먹이를 주세요. 놀아 주세요. 만지세요. 살아남으세요. 하지만 게임을 할수록, 그 존재는 당신의 정신... 그리고 현실 속으로 파고듭니다.
🔹 😨 억압적인 게임 플레이: 당신이 망설일 때도, 두려워할 때도, 그것은 알고 있습니다.
🔹 🧠 화면을 넘는 공포: 당신의 악몽이 현실이 된다면?
🔹 👁️ 끊임없는 불쾌감: 당신이 게임을 하는 걸까요, 아니면 게임 속에 있는 걸까요?
🚪 당신은 그와 함께 갇혀 있습니다. 그리고 그는 배가 고픕니다. 🤮🍽️🫀

title: OAsys - Speedbots Tournament
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to OAsys!
A new extreme sport is taking the valley by storm, and what better way to promote it than with a tournament? You play as The Pilot and their army of speedbots—built to run, crash, and start all over again in a frenetic time-trial race! All thanks to our sponsors, of course.


Competition Above All!
Take the top spot on the leaderboard! Other contenders want the #1 rank, but you’re more relentless. Replay the level as many times as needed to secure the highest score—so don’t hold back. Show your robot fury to the competition and dominate the leaderboard!
Master Speedbot!
This exceptionally dangerous sport is practiced only by robots designed for this purpose. Very few make it to the finish line, as countless obstacles stand in their way. Will you be the first champion of this Speedbot Tournament?

A Breathtaking Valley!
The races take place in a sprawling landscape, blending natural and industrial settings with a solarpunk-inspired art direction. You’ll die often—but what a stunning valley to behold as you do!
Game Features
- Race through 10 levels with increasing difficulty.
- Improve your mastery of the character and the environment!
- Use gameplay elements to optimize your path and get the best time!
 - Survive obstacles during your run!

title: ULTRA CORE DIVE
description:
게임 정보
AN UNKNOWN THREAT!
Unknown threat has unearthed from an abandoned planet and millions of bug-like creatures have begun an all out assault on the entire solar system. The situation seemed desperate until a mysterious drill shuttle began charging towards the planet. A new hope perhaps? Descent into the depths of the planet, rescue the trapped soldiers, destroy the source of the threat and don't get consumed by the noise!
EMBRACE THE CHAOS!
ULTRA CORE DIVE is a dark and chaotic arcade twinstick shooter inspired by the masters of the genre. The game features a dark retro inspired pseudo-1bit aesthetic with tons of action on screen. The gameplay is familiar fast-paced twinstick shooter action with a small learning curve, complimented with a tough-as-nails difficulty.
Shoot and dodge your way through 5 Zones, featuring 50 handcrafted Arenas filled with waves-and-waves of enemies and hazards! Fight huge and brutal BOSSES that fill the screen with bullets!
Power up and equip powerful weapons and abilities with a semi-randomized upgrade system! Be the arcade master and rack up score multipliers and bonuses!
Don't get consumed by the noise!
FLASHING WARNING!
The game features frequently flashing on screen effects that photosensitive and/or epileptic may find discomforting!
Viewer discretion is adviced!

title: My Last 20
description:
게임 정보
EMBARK THE "MY LAST 20" MISSION
THE COMPANY urgently seeks brave astronauts to enlist on the "My Last 20" mission.
Your objective: extract as many Space Tokens as possible from the Chaos Zone and survive for a ONLY 20 seconds. This mission posses life insurace in case of death. Are you that brave astronaut?
GAMEPLAY
Main Missions: Hardcore challenge where you have to survive for 20 seconds, but won't be easy task, the Chaos Zone will have no mercy. Move at hyper-speed to avoid being hit by asteroids, cows, tentacles and other space stuff. There are 3 different difficulties for these missions.

title: Blenzzle
description:
게임 정보
Blenzzle is a relaxing game to be played at your own pace. There are no points or timers and the levels can have more than one solution.
Slide the pieces to separate the colors from each other, forming color groups and blending the pieces that need their halves.

title: Sounds of Her Love 2
description:
게임 정보
A sequel to Sounds of Her Love, a sweet romance story between two students set in an international school in Tokyo.
One year has passed since the events of Sounds of Her Love, and your relationship with Ceri has deepened. You have now become a couple and, with your encouragement, Ceri has begun to emerge from her shell.
Leopards don't change their spots that easily, however, and though Ceri has been attempting to overcome her innate shyness, she still has a tendency to doubt herself.
Wanting to boost Ceri's confidence, you encourage her to perform in the school's graduation ceremony with the members of the music club. This will be one of the greatest challenges the timid Ceri has had to face, but you are sure that she will be able to overcome it.
You will be there with her, after all, to reassure her... and you want everybody to know just how far Ceri has come.
A cute and sweet kinetic novel (no choices or branches) focusing on a single love interest - your shy girlfriend Ceri!
An easily digestible and compelling story (around 40k words / 2-3 hours playtime).
Precious character artwork and detailed backgrounds.
High quality, English voice acting for all major characters.
Original soundtrack. 
Bonus features including guest artwork by a variety of talented artists and a mini-game quiz.

title: ABYSSAL BLADE
description:
게임 정보
ABYSSAL BLADE is a 2D pixel-art boss rush featuring difficult raid mechanics from high-level MMO raids like FFXIV Savage, WoW Mythic, and Lost Ark Legion raids.
ONLY ONE LIFE
You awaken in the void, burdened by grief. At last, you find the strength to rise. But the path ahead won’t be easy: you only have 1 HP. Take up your blade and break free from the abyss.
JOURNEY TO DEFEAT GRIEF
Challenge five unique bosses, each embodying one of Kübler-Ross’s stages of grief: Denial, Anger, Bargain, Depression, and Acceptance. Each encounter explores a different emotional struggle, expressed through distinctive mechanics and various gimmicks.

title: Ice Cream Typer
description:
게임 정보
    Ice Cream Typer is a high-speed typing challenge where the only way forward is faster fingers.
Inspired by the infamous fitness test and arcade classics, this mode throws you into an endless typing gauntlet. Complete ridiculous words and phrases under pressure—each round gives you less time, and one slip-up could be the end. It’s goofy, intense, and surprisingly addictive.
How It Works:
A phrase appears on screen.
You type it. Quickly and correctly.
The next round starts… with even less time.
Repeat until you break—or beat your high score.
Key Features:
Pacer Test Mode with Increasing Difficulty: The timer gets shorter every round. Stay sharp or get dropped.
Speed & Accuracy-Based Scoring: Points and combos scale with how fast (and clean) you type.
Goofy Word Prompts: The cat did what?
Cheerful, Upbeat Vibes: Lighthearted music and satisfying sound effects keep the energy high.
Simple & Focused: Just your keyboard, a timer, and a screen full of sweetness.

title: Mini Game Hero
description:
게임 정보
위기에 빠진 세상을 구하세요.
하지만 용사가 이상한 걸?
악당을 물리치는 방법은?
용사의 방식은 무려 "미니 게임"!
모든 몬스터들과의 싸움은 미니 게임으로 결정된다!
다양하고 수많은 미니게임으로 몬스터들을 무찌르고 이 세상을 구하세요!
당신이 사용해야 하는 키가 너무 많아요! 무려 4키!
위! 아래! 왼쪽! 오른쪽! 이걸로 모든걸로 해결합니다!
수비 , 공격 , 이벤트 턴을 거치는 전투를 통해 몬스터를 무찌르세요!
4개의 스테이지를 정복하고 마왕성까지 가보세요!

title: Only Jump On Pogo
description:
게임 정보
🦘 점프하세요. 올라가세요. 이해하세요.
모든 것이 이상하게 변해버린 세상에 빠져보세요. 폐허가 된 도시, 뒤틀린 현실, 그리고 단 하나의 탈출 방법: 포고스틱으로 하늘을 향해 점프!
🚀 목표는 단 하나: 위로 올라가기
이 게임은 수직으로 진행되는 모험입니다. 조작을 하나하나 익히고, 리듬을 찾고, 점점 더 높이 올라가세요. 그 끝에는 구름 너머 숨겨진 무언가가 기다리고 있습니다.
처음엔 쉬워 보일 수 있습니다. 하지만 곧… 정말 어렵습니다.
🧠 실수 한 번이면 아래로 추락. 다시 일어나 도전하세요
한 번의 실수로 많은 고도를 잃을 수 있습니다. 조급하면 다시 바닥으로. 하지만 포기하지 마세요. 이 게임은 속도를 겨루는 것이 아니라, 집중력, 인내, 그리고 점프 컨트롤 능력을 시험합니다.
추락은 여정의 일부입니다.
🎮 함께 플레이하세요
최대 4인 멀티플레이어 지원! 혼자 도전하거나 친구들과 경쟁하며 누가 먼저 꼭대기에 도달할 수 있을지 겨뤄보세요.
중간에 쉬는 구역이 있으며, 진행 상황이 저장되어 다음에 이어서 플레이할 수 있습니다.
🎧 몰입감 있는 사운드 경험
완전한 몰입을 위해:
키보드와 마우스 사용 권장
음악을 끄지 마세요
대사와 효과음을 유지하세요
이 게임의 분위기는 여러분과 함께하며, 때로는 방해물이 될 수도 있습니다.
⏱ 당신의 실력은?
플레이 시간은 여러분이 포고 점프 기술을 얼마나 숙련되게 익혔는지에 따라 달라집니다. 진정한 마스터는 30분 이내에 클리어합니다. 나머지는… 조금 더 걸릴 수도 있습니다.
👤 1인 개발자가 만든 작품

title: Clocking In to Fight a Lich in Another Realm
description:
게임 정보
It's finally time to start your new job at The Company! Time to clock in and see what's on the other side of The Company's newly developed portal technology. Fight undead, defeat bosses, and prevent the invasion of a lich's undead army.
Clocking In to Fight a Lich in Another Realm is a boomer shooter where you must battle an undead army in a fantasy world with the equipment your company provided you. Race for the best times on the leaderboards, spend your paycheck on silly doodads, and stop the undead army!
autokwd: Clocking In to Fight a Lich in Another Realm

title: Empire Game
description:
게임 정보
이런 종류의 게임을 좋아하는 더 많은 친구들이 체험판에 참여하여 게임에 대한 피드백을 주셨으면 좋겠습니다. 여러분의 응원은 팀에게 가장 큰 힘이 됩니다! 감사합니다!
"Empire Game" 관련 소통을 위한 Discord 그룹:



게임에서 플레이어는 상황에 따라 자원을 유연하게 할당하여 이익을 극대화할 수 있어야 합니다. 게임 초반, 중반, 후반의 자원 관리 및 소비 전략이 플레이어의 승패를 결정합니다. 종족과 병력 유형을 합리적으로 조합하고 최적의 발전 경로를 개발하며 각 자원의 가치를 최대한 활용해야 합니다.



이 게임에는 약 10개의 독특한 종족이 등장하며, 각 종족은 8종류의 병사와 풍부한 중립 병사를 갖추고 있습니다. 플레이어는 종족의 특성과 병사 유형에 따라 가장 강력한 전술을 구성하여 강력한 전투 진형을 만들 수 있습니다.



영웅 시스템은 매우 심도 있어 플레이어가 다양한 영웅을 선택하고 재능과 기술을 강화할 수 있습니다. 신중한 영웅 훈련과 장비 매칭은 전투에서 큰 역할을 하며 플레이어가 승리를 거둘 수 있도록 도와줍니다.



게임 맵은 무작위이며, 지형과 환경 변화에 따라 확장, 방어, 외교 전략을 신중하게 고려해야 합니다. 합리적인 의사 결정은 플레이어가 복잡한 상황에서 우위를 점하고 승리를 거두는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.



흥미진진한 전투와 재미있는 분위기가 완벽하게 어우러져 있습니다! 이 게임은 한 화면에 최대 500~600명의 전투 유닛을 지원하여 강력하고 웅장한 전장을 연출합니다. 이 게임은 한 화면에 최대 500~600명의 전투 유닛을 지원하여 박진감 넘치는 웅장한 전장을 연출합니다. 캐릭터의 과장되고 유쾌한 액션 디자인은 치열한 전투에 경쾌하고 재치 있는 재미를 불어넣습니다. 유쾌한 장면과 빠른 속도감으로 전투의 스릴을 웃음과 함께 즐길 수 있습니다!

title: Nitro Battle Racing
description:
게임 정보


Overtake and blast away your opponents in Nitro Battle Racing! In this arcade action racer, you will compete in exhilarating races either against AI, or your friends in up to 4-player split-screen multiplayer.

Race in a wide variety of environments! From dry deserts to neon lit cyberspace, and even all the way to mars, there is no telling where your racing career will take you.

Collect random powerups with race defining abilities such as the Rocket Booster which has enough power to pull you to the front of the pack.

Pick your favorite vehicle out of 12 unique karts each boasting their own unique stats to fit your preferred racing playstyle. Choose your favorite drift ability and play your way, whether you prefer to play aggressively with the Gatling Gun, defensively with your own Repair Tool, or simply want to zoom past your opponents with the Drift Boost. Whatever you choose just make sure you leave your opponents in the dust!



Up To 4-Player Local Split-Screen races
12 Unique Karts and 3 Unique Drift Abilities
9+ Random Powerups
6 Unlockable Stages
3 Difficulty Options for AI



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

title: Whispers From The Rift
description:
게임 정보
Whispers from the Rift is a psychologically immersive, choice-driven sci-fi action/horror experience. Guide a fractured man, Robert Jenkins, through a parallel but vastly different world shaped by mind control, otherworldly entities, and morally complex decisions that challenge the nature of free will.
December 21st, 2028: Robert Jenkins is tasked to lead an international mission to infiltrate an illegal Japanese weapon facility. Every step of the way, his fate is in your hands. Supplant his thoughts, direct his actions, and dictate his words. Though initially unaware of your presence in his mind, your commands carry weight while his life and sanity hang in the balance.
Whispers from the Rift is a standalone prequel set fourteen years before the events of CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered (also available here on Steam). *Prior knowledge of the Consortium universe is NOT required*
Robert Jenkins: The man you will be inhabiting and the leader of a covert Global Senate mission in the mountains of Japan. With a background in the Canadian military, he has worked for the Senate since the end of the Wars. Despite feeling out of his depth, Jenkins is inexplicably drawn to this mission.
Colin Wheats: The mission’s recruiter, Wheats is an American-born Senate operative with long-standing connections to the Guardian Church. His record from the Wars is well documented, though he has been out of action for the last five years.
Eliska Soltz: Former Israeli Special Forces, Soltz was trained primarily in reconnaissance and infiltration. Unlike the others, she has no prior allegiance to the Senate and makes little effort to hide her distrust of everything.
Jiang Shi: The most important and mysterious of all. Jiang is a Chinese national who was exiled from her homeland under mysterious circumstances when she was barely twenty years old. Jiang has intimate knowledge of the weapon facility and intends to disable it once and for all.
Philip Lancaster: The mission's wild card. Spy by nature, his true nationality is unknown, and the vast majority of information on his work has been redacted or buried. With his happy-go-lucky personality, Lancaster has said that life is like a video game meant to be played until all its secrets and achievements are discovered.

title: Cosmic Miners
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling space adventure in Cosmic Miners, a single-player sci-fi game that blends mining, exploration, and strategic upgrades into a rich galactic experience. Take on the role of a daring miner, navigating asteroid belts and planetary orbits to extract valuable resources, build your fleet, and rise to prominence in a universe full of opportunity—and danger.

Traverse diverse asteroid fields, each brimming with rare ores and challenges. With upgradable ship modules, adapt your mining systems to extract resources efficiently. Upgrade to advanced tiers to access high-value materials locked behind tougher asteroids.
Choose your alliances carefully as you interact with seven unique factions: Pirates, Drifters, Harvesters, Capitalists, Technocrats, Leviathans, and Proxies. Each faction offers exclusive missions, rewards, and opportunities to shape your reputation and future in the galaxy. Will you stay loyal to your starting faction, the resourceful Harvesters, or climb the ranks to join the enigmatic Leviathans or join Pirates to cause the chaos?

Dock at vibrant stations like The Oasis, the Black Market, and Council Station to sell resources, upgrade your ship, recruit crew members, and take on new quests. Each station is a hub of activity, offering its own role in the galactic economy and its secrets.

title: 100 Italy Cats
description:
게임 정보
🐾 100마리 고양이 시리즈 게임에 오신 것을 환영합니다 🐈
고양이로 가득한 세상에서 가장 귀여운 모험에 참여하세요! 게임 전역에 숨겨진 100마리의 귀여운 고양이를 찾으면서 특별한 테마의 손으로 그린 매력적인 일러스트를 탐험하세요.
이 아늑하고 매력적인 숨은 그림 찾기 게임에서 집중력과 관찰력을 테스트하세요.
각 고양이는 이전 것보다 더 매력적이며, 발견할 때마다 웃음을 자아냅니다.
🐈🕵️‍♂️ 모든 고양이를 찾을 수 있나요? 🕵️‍♂️🐈
주요 기능
🎮 1 레벨
🐈 100 숨겨진 고양이
🎵 멋진 사운드트랙
🎨 고해상도 일러스트
🌗 밝기 설정
💾 진행 저장
🔍 확대
😺 실제 고양이 소리!
💥 콤보 카운터!
💡 팁
🌐 텍스트 없음

title: PathSketch
description:
게임 정보
✔ 레벨 구조를 관찰하여 최적의 경로를 찾고, 갇히지 않도록 주의.
게임 특징
깔끔한 그래픽 스타일
풍부한 레벨과 점진적인 난이도
두뇌 퍼즐을 좋아하는 플레이어에게 적합

title: HAL Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Something is wrong aboard the HIS 01 Echo.
Your shift is over. The return shuttle awaits you in Compartment 9. All you need to do is walk there… but the corridor keeps sending you back to the beginning.
A loop with no end.
At first glance, everything seems familiar — but look closer. With each cycle, something changes: a missing object, a wall in a different spot, equipment moved across the hall. The anomalies aren’t tiny — but they won’t always stand out. Spotting them is the only way forward.
HAL Protocol is a first-person narrative experience focused on observation, memory, and intuition. No enemies. No jumpscares. Just you, the ship, and a looping mystery to unravel.
There is no time limit. Take your time, explore at your pace, and move forward only when you're sure. If something’s off, turn back. If everything looks right, proceed. Choose wrong, and the loop resets.
Can you break the cycle? Or will you remain trapped in the quiet heart of the ship?

title: Urban Disc Golf
description:
게임 정보
Toss. Aim. Score — Urban Style.
Welcome to Urban Disc Golf, an arcade-inspired disc golf game where the concrete jungle becomes your playground. Whether you're curving a disc through alleyways or banking a trick shot off a rooftop, every course is packed with stylish scenery and sneaky targets.
Navigate city parks, plazas, and rooftops in this low-poly 3D world — all while unlocking bonus achievements for hitting signs, bins, and hidden targets in your path.

🥏 Arcade-style disc golf set in an urban world
🎯 Hit the basket... or go for bonus trick shot targets
🎨 Stylized low-poly 3D visuals with a colorful city vibe
🌆 Multiple levels inspired by real city layouts
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly gameplay for all ages
🎮 Simple to play, challenging to master
🧘‍♂️ Relaxing single-player experience — no timers, no stress

title: Hollow Jump
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대해서
살기 팍팍한 세상 속에서, 사람들은 언젠가 도달할 거대한 무언가를 꿈꿉니다.
누군가는 말합니다. 정상의 끝엔 부가 있을 거라고.
누군가는 말합니다. 이상향이 존재한다고.
하지만, 그 끝에 무엇이 있는지는 아무도 모릅니다.
《HollowJump》는 끝없이 위를 향해 오르며, 그 물음에 조용히 다가가는 여정입니다.
계속해서 떨어지고, 다시 오르며,
때론 무의미하게 느껴지는 반복 속에서도,
당신은 점점 더 위로 나아갑니다.
무엇이 기다릴지 모르는 그 끝을 향해—
그저 한 걸음 더, 위로.

title: NOVEMS
description:
게임 정보
Arrange your ideal 9 cards on a page of the magic book!
NOVEMS is an auto-battler deckbuilder where you collect 9 cards to create your own unique build.
Choose, arrange, and entrust—
the cards do the fighting.
You are their master.
In a world where mighty sorcerers clash, forge your ultimate deck.
The key to victory lies in the 3x3 grid of 9 cards you arrange before the battle begins.
Out of countless possibilities, what will you discard, and what will you keep?
Your choices will decide your fate.

title: The Last Dig
description:
게임 정보
생존을 위한 건설
생존 확률을 높이기 위해 발판, 배관, 조명을 설치하세요.
적재적소에 맞는 도구 사용
깊은 곳을 탐험할 때는 장비를 잘 활용하세요. 하지만 주의하세요—위험할 수도 있습니다.

title: Ship
description:
게임 정보
3년의 수련 끝에 이제 나는 3초 만에 주문을 확인하고 10초 안에 분류와 포장을 완료할 수 있게 되었다! 회사 역사상 가장 빠른 포장 기록도 갱신! 그리고 이제, 더 많아지는 주문에 맞서기 위해—바로 너! 내 직속 제자로서 회사에 합류해라!
여기선 모든 주문이 소중합니다! 물건에 맞는 상자를 고르고, 카테고리에 맞게 포장하세요. 배송 중 파손이라도 생기면... 컴플레인과 감봉이 기다리고 있습니다! (예: 전임 분류원은 유리 제품에 ‘취급주의’ 스티커도 안 붙였다고요!)

title: Rentlord
description:
게임 정보
자본의 루프 레코드
로그라이크 요소가 결합된 이 부동산 시뮬레이터에서, 당신은 무작위로 생성된 도시 미로에서 부동산 제국을 구축하게 됩니다. 건물을 사들이고, 현실적인 세금 문제를 뚫고 나가세요. 매 판이 자본 재편의 판타지이며, 부동산 플러그인을 활용해 임대 수익을 폭발시키는 것이 당신의 임무입니다. 비즈니스의 귀재가 되어보세요!
시장 조사
구매 가능한 다양한 부동산을 살펴보세요. 각각의 건물은 고유한 장점과 전략적 가능성을 지니고 있으며, 조합 방식에 따라 수익 구조도 크게 달라집니다. 기억하세요. 비즈니스에서 고정관념은 독입니다. 리스크를 감수해야 진정한 부동산 큰손이 될 수 있습니다!

title: Outrider Mako
description:
게임 정보
In Outrider Mako, explore the Mayoi World—a fantastical world where gods reside—find items requested by said gods, and deliver them in nicely wrapped packages in 2D top-down action gameplay.
Collect Seal Stamps to Return Home
Mako falls into the Mayoi World and finds herself at the Bumon Delivery Center, which a strange monster named Mozu claims is a package delivery service. Mako ends up becoming an outrider for the delivery center. She will need to collect seal stamps from the gods of the Mayoi World in the apprentice notes given to her by Mozu to fill it with spirit energy and return to her own world.

title: Not Monday Cafe
description:
게임 정보
Cozy idle cafe management that keeps you company while you work. Grow fresh ingredients, cook, and serve delicious food to adorable animal customers. Build your dream cafe that sits at the bottom of your screen.
Grow Fresh Ingredients
Plant and harvest crops from your little farm to create the freshest meals.
Build your dream cafe
Design, decorate, and customize your perfect cafe to match your unique style.

title: Epimythos: The Forgotten Legends
description:
게임 정보
Finally, a Greek Mythology quiz game that’s both fun and meaningful.
Epimythos: The Forgotten Legends offers three distinct modes to test your knowledge, learn the stories, and dive deep into mythic symbolism — with hand-drawn illustrations, contextual backstories, and hundreds of curated questions. No ads. No in-app purchases. No gacha. Just a complete mythology quiz experience.
Why Greek Mythology?
Greek mythology lies at the root of Western civilization. Its gods, heroes, and monsters have shaped literature, language, and architecture for thousands of years.
Discovery Mode
Start here if you want to explore, learn, or refresh your memory. Each of the 370 questions (at launch) is paired with a contextual introduction and a backstory after each answer — perfect for mythology buffs and newcomers alike.
Choose up to 100 questions per round from the following categories:
Heroes and Legends: The greats like Heracles, Perseus, Bellerophon and more.
Iliad and Odyssey: The Homeric epics in quiz form.
Argonauts: The mysterious adventures of Jason and his epic crew, plus mighty Medea.
Olympians and Titans: All questions involving the Olympians and their predecessors.

title: MPPP - Multidimensional Paper Plane Project
description:
게임 정보
Survive the skies across shifting dimensions!

MPPP – Multidimensional Paper Plane Project is a simple yet challenging game where you try to survive as long as possible in an ever-changing world. Each world in different dimension introduces new mechanics, keeping you on your toes.
Collect coins and complete feats to increase your score.
Survive through ever-changing dimensions, shifting every few seconds.
Explore 7 unique dimensions, each with its own mechanics inspired by classic and popular mini-games.
Discover a secret 8th dimension—only the luckiest players will find it.
Compete for the highest score on the global leaderboard.

title: Mod Mage Mike
description:
게임 정보
Mod Mage Mike is a game where you harness the power of a node editor to solve logic puzzles, craft futuristic spells, and create your own thrilling adventures.
By chaining nodes together with different properties, you can control the movement and behavior of spell projectiles. For instance, adjusting their speed, direction, bounce, or splitting them into multiple projectiles.
Logic puzzles
Program spell-shooting towers to aim at detectors. When hit, these detectors will light up, triggering events such as opening bridges or doors to progress through levels. It's definitely not always as straightforward as it sounds.
Combat
The levels also contain weapons imbued with strange elemental spells. These prove useful for combating laser-shooting enemies or overcoming specific puzzles. However, be cautious—some enemies and contraptions also possess the ability to wield magic against you.

title: Keep It Running: Together
description:
게임 정보
Fulfill the quotas before the time runs out. Shovel coal into the Boilers, fix any machines that break down and get those boxes filled up with cursed children's toys!
Each new shift brings new obstacles: from the toys springing to life and terrifying Clockwork Demons disrupting the machinery to the monstrous Competitors intending to snatch you away to their mines. And... The ever watchful Boss whom you must never anger too much...
Ever raced a 6-ton steam powered lorry? Experience the thrill and stress of controlling this massive vehicle as you race to deliver the boxes to the various locations within the nearby town before the night ends. Fire up the boiler, slam the throttle but... don't lose your boxes!
But you are not the only one roaming the streets as each new delivery brings new obstacles. Things go bump in the night in this cursed town and once again you will have to deal with the monsters residing within.
Do well and be rewarded with new outfits, new challenges and new Achievements! Show your production prowess with that fancy hat.
Making it to the end of the most difficult shifts and deliveries rewards you with a Custom mode in which you can tweak the upcoming shift or delivery entirely to your liking. Do fun challenges, or torment your friends!
Play alone or with a team of up to 4 people,
Proximity voice chat,

title: Duck Duck Goose
description:
게임 정보
🦆 A stupidly fun hide-and-seek game.
Somewhere in every level… there’s a duck.
You’ll hear it quack every few minutes, but finding it? That’s up to you.
Explore bizarre maps, uncover weird secrets, and maybe — just maybe — survive whatever else is out there.
What starts as a silly game of “Where’s the duck?” quickly becomes something… stranger.
🔍 Features:
5+ handcrafted levels that get bigger, weirder, and more difficult
A rubber duck that quacks every few minutes to give you a hint — or lure you in
Hidden scares and disturbing surprises across the maps (don’t say we didn’t warn you)
A mix of comedy and horror — just enough to make you laugh and look over your shoulder
No combat, no time limits — just you, your wits, and a duck that refuses to sit still
company: Humza Shakoor, Vejay Fongchoy, TheGoodMen GamingStudio LLC

title: Loki's Revenge
description:
게임 정보
After eons of being imprisoned by the Asgardian gods for his crimes and trickery, Loki has broken free and unleashed his army of loyal monsters to bring about Ragnarok in order to terrorize the realms and take revenge against the Norse gods. Fight back as one of your favorite gods to defeat Loki, his army, and avoid Ragnarok!
Defeat Loki's Loyal Army
Draugrs, ogres, wolves, and the Jotnar - they all fight for Loki and must be stopped! Defeat wave after wave of large hordes of monsters and bosses. Some monsters will chase you down relentlessly; others will try to shoot you with arrows and other projectiles. Learn how they attack and avoid getting hit!
Master each god's unique ability

title: Run the Rings
description:
게임 정보
Take command of your destiny in Run the Rings, a strategic PvP spaceship management auto battler where careful planning is the key to galactic supremacy. Design and deploy your spaceship, then test your creation against other players in asynchronous battles through distant star systems.
In Run the Rings, the action begins before the battle. Craft your spaceship with precision, choosing from a vast array of modules, including weapons, shields, and support systems. Position your components strategically to maximize effectiveness, anticipate enemy strategies, and counter their strengths. Once your ship is ready, it’s time to set it loose in the galaxy! Battles are resolved automatically, so your preparation and ingenuity determine the outcome.
Choose your role in this bustling galaxy: be a cunning space pirate raiding trade routes, a savvy merchant trader running valuable cargo through the ring systems, or a fearless bounty hunter taking down high-value targets. Each role offers unique rewards and challenges, letting you shape your adventure to match your playstyle.
Features:
Asynchronous Auto Battler: Battles play out automatically, letting you focus on strategy and ship design. Compete against other players even while offline!
Custom Ship Design: Build your perfect spacecraft by equipping weapons, defenses, and advanced tech modules. Every layout decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

title: Rough Souls: Adventures
description:
게임 정보
🎒 Adventure Mode – Explore, Interact, Progress
In Adventure Mode, you freely roam a handcrafted world filled with interactive elements and hidden areas. You can:
Pick up, throw, and eat items
Jump and climb across the environment
Tame and ride animals like the Saiga Antelope
Navigate ships and reach new locations
Talk to NPCs to receive quests
Key locations include:
A quest-giving NPC near the start
A parkour section with falling barrels
A port area where you can buy your own ship after earning gold
A mini-challenge zone with taming and exploration opportunities
💀 Souls Mode – One Boss, Classic Challenge
There is one Souls-style boss encounter in the game, accessible early on via a quest from an NPC. This mode features:
A single, challenging boss
Emphasis on dodging, learning patterns, and punishing mistakes
A standalone experience inspired by soulslike mechanics
⚔️ Rough Mode – Precision Combat Arena
Accessible from the port area, Rough Mode is a directional 1v1 combat arena where you fight powerful mini-bosses using a custom mouse-driven parry and attack system.
Change attack and parry direction with your mouse
Fight enemies with unique abilities
Earn gold by defeating Rough bosses
Buy your ship after winning and collecting enough gold

title: Extreme Delivery
description:
게임 정보
왜 당신의 패키지가 항상 늦게 도착하는지 그 이유는 바로 이것입니다! 아이템을 최대한 빠르게 배달하여 일을 잘 마치세요. 떨어지는 물체, 폭발, 거대한 해머를 피하면서 진행하세요. 그러나 아이템을 잃으면 고객이 불만을 가질 수 있으니 주의하세요!
Delivery Bro는 당신의 패키지를 배달하려고 애쓰고 있으며, 그가 그것을 얼마나 힘들게 하는지에 대해 당신은 아마 신경 쓰지 않을 것입니다. 아마도 그를 때리고 싶을 것입니다. 부끄러운 일이네요.
Delivery Bro의 제어를 맡고, 세상의 무게를 어깨에 지고 매일의 싸움을 직접 경험하세요.
패키지를 배달하는 것이 쉽다고 생각하시나요?
당신이 해야 할 일은 그것들을 등을 지고 운반하는 것뿐, 하지만 세상은 당신이 겪고 있는 고난에 대해 신경 쓰지 않습니다!
장애물
다양한 장애물들이 성공적인 작업을 더욱 달콤하게 만듭니다.

title: Growmancer
description:
게임 정보
Play as the Growmancer, a wizard traveling worlds with his canine companion to transform wastelands into fertile grounds and battle destructive wildfires. Upgrade both via a skill tree. Challenge yourself or just relax.
Play as the Growmancer, a mysterious sorcerer dedicated to greening barren worlds.
Progress through an expansive skill tree to unlock potent abilities.
Summon steadfast allies to assist in nurturing these new worlds.
...And defend vibrant ecosystems from destructive wildfires!

title: The Pixotron 49
description:
게임 정보
Render increasingly complex pixel art by wiring together visual logic nodes to split, shift, and merge pixels.
Features
Around 3-5 hours of gameplay
Three chapters, each introducing new mechanics and ideas
Meet a cast of quirky (and not-so-quirky) characters with ever more complex image requests
A classically inspired synth soundtrack
Multiple color styles to personalize your experience

title: Gales of Nayeli
description:
게임 정보
Gales of Nayeli is a grid-based Strategy RPG coming to PC in 2025. In this enthralling SRPG adventure, you will meet and customize your party from a cast of over 35 varied and unique characters.
Inspired by classic SRPGs and JRPGs, Gales of Nayeli features an interactive campaign where your choices have lasting consequences throughout the entire game.

title: Questwood
description:
게임 정보
전투하고, 약탈하고, 절차적으로 생성된 숲을 탐험하세요! 혼자서도, 친구들과 함께 화면 분할로 즐길 수 있어요! 궁수, 폭탄병, 스파르탄, 마법사—4가지 개성 넘치는 클래스 중에서 선택하세요! 고유한 능력을 가진 강력한 무기를 발견하고, 최강의 강화 카드 덱을 만들어보세요. 과연 당신은 이 숲을 살아남고 저주받은 나무를 쓰러뜨릴 수 있을까요?
궁수 폭탄병 스파르탄 마법사 중에서 플레이 스타일을 선택하세요
각 클래스는 고유한 아이템과 능력을 제공합니다. 궁수는 화살을 쏘고, 그랩플링 훅으로 간격을 넘을 수 있습니다. 폭파 전문가는 폭발물로 혼란을 일으킵니다. 스파르탄은 근접 전투를 지배하고, 마법사는 강력한 마법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 각 클래스에는 고유한 전리품이 있으며, 찾은 무기마다 특별한 능력을 부여합니다!
매번 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다
절차적으로 생성된 레벨은 각각 고유한 도전과 보상으로 가득 차 있습니다. 매번 새로운 전리품과 놀라움이 기다리고 있습니다. 이 게임은 영구 사망을 포함하므로 주의가 필요합니다. 수집한 모디파이어 카드는 계속 보유되므로, 최고의 덱을 만들거나 재미있고 미친 덱을 만들 수 있습니다. 각 레벨의 끝에는 미니 보스가 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 레벨을 클리어하고 최종 보스를 물리쳐 게임을 클리어하세요. 그 후, 무한 모드에서 하이스코어에 도전할 수 있습니다!

title: Sparganator
description:
게임 정보
Game story:
Third person sci-fi shooter with 8 maps. Player mission is to kill different enemies and find hidden orange flower which is captured by enemy army. Every level has 1 hidden orange flower, finding it finish level and gives steam achievements. Player need battle against several different enemies like melee cyborg, cyborg with weapons, Shooting turrets and flying robots. So can you be the hero of the universe and find captured flowers and save world
Features::
- 8 different maps
- Melee fight
- Weapons: Rifle, pistol,shotgun and throwing grenades
- Collect more ammos and health pick-ups
- Several enemies: Cyborg with melee fight and knifes, Flying enemies with weapons, Turrets with weapons. Cyborg with weapons
- Steam Achievements

title: DECON Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to DECON Protocol!
GAME DESCRIPTION
Dive into sci-fi alien worlds where you deconstruct aliens into parts to upgrade your base. 
Attempt to wipe out the Aliens plaguing each planet and build your base and DECON Unit to produce higher outputs, more damage, more gains, and JUST MORE.
DECON Protocol offers a challenge to see what heights you can reach.
KEY FEATURES
Several Overlapping Systems.
Deconstruct aliens to gather their pieces and parts in order to upgrade a multitude of systems including: Employee Training, DECON upgrades, DECON Overclocking, Gene Splicing, Studies that grant buffs, Missions, Geode Mines, Toxic Waste trading, and much more.

title: Into the M.A.W.
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Into the M.A.W. is a 2-4 person co-op space combat campaign. Gather your crew, assign their roles, and work together to complete perilous missions within a mysterious time loop.
Prepare to enter the M.A.W., your ship’s Miniaturized Aperture Wormhole, to escape a mysterious time loop. As your team embarks on intergalactic missions, rely on learned strategies from previous missions to manage increasingly dangerous threats to your ship and crew. As you complete different objectives, activate the M.A.W. to transport you to your next destination… or reset time to try for a different outcome. Can your crew survive long enough to uncover the secrets of the M.A.W.?
2-4 Person Co-Op
Built from the ground up for co-op play, collaboration isn’t just encouraged - it’s essential to your crew’s survival. Choose from one of four roles and embark on new missions with your friends where every choice counts.
The Captain leads the crew by making strategic and story decisions, scanning for intel, and interacting with other vessels.
The Pilot maneuvers through dangers, utilizing cloaking to outsmart enemies and time travel to restart the mission.
The Gunner commands the ship’s impressive arsenal, from color-dependent lasers to an array of different missile types.
The Engineer manages power distribution, repairs, and shields to keep the ship in one piece amid enemy assaults.

title: Aeternum Grand Plaza
description:
게임 정보
매력적인 Aeternum Grand Plaza 호텔을 발견하고 주변을 주의 깊게 관찰하며 올바른 길을 선택해 출구를 찾아보세요.
Aeternum Grand Plaza는 다양한 시나리오를 갖춘 호텔을 배경으로 하는 이상 현상 탐색 게임으로, "The Exit 8"에서 영감을 받았습니다. 이 게임에서 플레이어는 호텔의 여러 층을 지나며 출구를 찾으려고 노력해야 합니다. 이 과정에서 지나가는 복도의 세부 사항을 살피고, 올바르지 않은 복도를 나타낼 수 있는 이상한 요소를 찾아야 합니다.
절차는 간단합니다. 복도에 이상 현상이 없으면 플레이어는 계속해서 앞으로 나아가며 층을 통과해야 합니다. 그러나 복도에 이상한 요소가 있으면 뒤돌아 다른 층을 통해 출구에 도달하려고 시도해야 합니다.
특징
수수께끼 같은 모험: 이 신비한 호텔의 다양한 복도를 탐험하고 출구를 찾아보세요.
시각적 도전: 50개 이상의 이상 현상을 찾기 위해 세세한 부분까지 관찰하고 분석하세요.
절차적 생성 환경: 호텔의 각 층은 절차적으로 생성되어 다양한 가능성을 제공합니다.
다양한 게임 모드: 클래식 모드 외에도 세 가지 더 복잡한 모드에서 호텔 탈출 능력을 시험해보세요.
소규모 팀 개발: 두 사람이 정성을 다해 개발한 개인 프로젝트입니다.
플레이 시간

title: Struggle
description:
게임 정보
No Up. No Down. No turning back.
You're trapped in a zero-gravity simulation, armed with only a hatchet, a chain, and a fire extinguisher. Your goal? Traverse floating debris, recover lost audio logs, and escape alive.
Every move counts. One wrong impulse could send you drifting into the void… forcing you to restart the level from scratch.
This title combines first-person platforming with a fragmented narrative told through scattered recordings from your lost crew.
Unique physics-based mechanics: push, grab, and launch yourself in zero gravity.
Minimalist visuals with a realistic space atmosphere.
Challenging level design: each stage tests your skill and patience.
Environmental storytelling: uncover what happened to your ship and your crew.

title: Dream of Change: Poker
description:
게임 정보
Dreams of Changed: Poker is a more traditional take on a Texas Hold'em rules poker game, remininscent of classics like Poker Night with a transformation twist, playing against a variety of colourful characters each with their own quirks and playstyles. A mysterious matron has invited yourself, and a bunch of others through dreams to a mysterious game, as an ancient being's fascination with a more modern form of wagering, controls the fates of everyone brought there.
'Winner takes all' being very literal here, as the winner will be able to keep everyone to their form's desire, a focus on transformation as every character has a unique ending. Manage to make it through yourself, and have an oppurtunity to take on Tycha's trial, at a chance to know her intentions...
Features:-
Relaxing, simple poker gameplay with not too much twists to adapt to, whether to chill out to, or just learn for fun. Beginners to some experience recommended.
Games as fast or slow as you want! Play aggressive for faster experiences, or slowly bluff and grind out your opponents chip by chip! Losers that lose their stack with become part of the game itself changed into the very cards you play with!
8 Original Characters to play with, each with their own pattern and style of gaming, as well as a unique 'boss' to encounter! Each character having their own ending cards if they're the victor.
Support to add additional characters within the local files, help in a text file.
Different stages, tables and card skins to earn via levelling up. Each stage with their own music tracks and vibe.
A challenge mode after showing at least every opponent their place. Take on everyone in a knockout tournament and gain the interest of the mysterious dealer herself!

title: Gas Station Story
description:
게임 정보
You are the Clerk, the team leader at 8-Fifteen location #97433213. Your job is to run a small station just outside of Divinity City, a megacity with all sorts of strange inhabitants. One night, when everything seems to be going as it should, a mysterious update appears on your computer - causing trouble for you and your coworker, Sam (as if your work days weren't hard enough).
As the week goes on and the Update Virus “upgrades” your system, you’ll make decisions that steer the course of the story and affect both Sam and yourself. If you’re lucky, you’ll both make it out with your lives… and maybe a deeper relationship than you were expecting. Gain insight into your customers' personal lives (and how the Update Virus has affected them) through conversations, and treat them with kindness or rudeness to influence how they feel about you. If you're not careful, some people might not come back - including Sam!
Gas Station Story features a variety of different gameplay mechanics that you will experience during the narrative. These can be broken down into the Overworld, the Point-of-Sale, the Dialogue, and the Mini-Games.
OVERWORLD

title: NEDRA
description:
게임 정보
In the frozen wastelands of Antarctica, an abandoned Soviet station hides an ancient, otherworldly presence. When an SOS signal draws an expedition to a mysterious crater, disaster strikes, leaving you stranded during the six-month polar night. The fight for survival begins as you take refuge in the station, where you must uncover its terrifying secrets while battling deadly temperatures and heat-sensitive creatures—before the cold consumes you.
Survival Horror Meets Stealth Action
Survive the relentless cold and evade the Frostwalkers, terrifying creatures that sense body heat. To avoid detection, you must lower your body temperature dangerously close to hypothermia—but the deeper the cold, the closer you are to death. Regain warmth with iodine-alcohol mixtures, but beware: warmth makes you visible to the creatures.
Search for supplies and navigate labyrinthine stations to unravel the truth behind the Antarctic station and its ominous past. Every corner holds danger, but the only way forward is through the unknown.

title: The Stick Figure Game
description:
게임 정보
The objective is simple - capture the opponent's flag.  The task is a bit more challenging!
Each turn, a "roll" will determine if you are going to get new units added to play, to move existing units, fire on the enemy, dig to avoid enemy fire and unearth bonuses, conduct reconnaissance, OR if you will get to choose your single action for the turn.  Your odds for each action will change dynamically throughout the game, based on your circumstances.
You control the pace of the game with the settings.  You can allow for pauses and notifications so you can track every move and decision, or you can choose to jump immediately to your next decision, so there is no waiting.  There are multiple pacing and notifications settings so that whether you play against the computer, or against your friend, you can create a vibe that feels right to you.

title: Vesnith Tapes
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
A psychological horror game where a police officer investigates a cold case in a decaying house, uncovering a strange tape recorder that reveals a terrible secret.
Story
In 2011, an old unsolved case leads you to an abandoned house in a desolate and desolate suburb. No signs of life, no answers.
Inside, you find old VHS tapes, forgotten and covered in dust. At first, the tapes seem like meaningless relics of the past. However, as you play them, things start to get strange.
These tapes are more than just recordings. As you watch them, you realize that there is something there that should never have been seen.
Key Feature
VHS gameplay style
VHS style gameplay, with graphics that look like they were recorded on an old cassette tape. The typical VHS visual effects, such as noise, glitches, and dull colors, will provide a unique and terrifying experience.

title: TowerDefense BlobSmash
description:
게임 정보
Smash those Blobs!
Show your strategy skills and defend your Fuel Refinery against the hordes of Blobs threatening your chances of survival on Planet Snaxeka! Build Turrets, fuel your Spaceship and escape the underworld of Snaxeka! Are you ready to face the challenge? Blow ‘em up!
What you get
TowerDefense BlobSmash is an amazing strategy and TowerDefense game that leverages multiple mechanics to put your strategy skills to the test.
Build the right turrets and defend your Fuel Refinery against different waves of Blobs!
Manage your money and fuel resources: Will you find the right balance?
Explosions, toxic clouds and Turret-Upgrades: Use abilities to supplement your strategy!
Play the game in a casual setting: Relax and take breaks by playing TD BlobSmash!
Develop strategies for 16+ Levels!
Play the endless mode and achieve the highest score possible!
Speedrun the game and compare your results with the community!
Be prepared for upcoming Updates!

title: All You Have to Do Is Click the Button
description:
게임 정보
Hi there! Oliver Gumthrow here!
I'm looking for anyone and everyone capable enough to use a monitor and a mouse! If this sounds like you then you are 100% qualified to be our new expert tech person at Gumthrow Industries!
This very important button needs to be clicked, and you'll be paid for it! That's right money in your pocket, and a secure and stable job! Earn pay raises, customize your workspace, and upgrade your work experience.
While clicking the button do not get distracted, if you take too long to click the button you'll be terminated and replaced immediately.
After a quick sign up, take your seat, hand on mouse and click the button!
autokwd: All You Have to Do Is Click the Button

title: A Game About Mining Rocks
description:
게임 정보
Hi everyone!
I'm Lloid, a solo developer, and this game was a little passion project I built in my spare time.
You're alone in an abandoned mine, armed with nothing but a pickaxe.

Mine through rocks, uncover rare minerals, sell what you find, and upgrade your gear... if you survive.
The deeper you go, the darker it gets.
Strange things dwell below the surface—and they don't like visitors.
Mine. Progress. Fight. Discover what's buried in the dark.
No timer. No mercy. Just you, your headlamp, and the unknown.

title: April Grove
description:
게임 정보
April Grove
Take a load off, enjoy the scenery, chop a tree or two; the world of April Grove is yours to explore and savor.
It’s a peaceful world without a danger in sight. All that stands between you and greatness is your efforts and optimization. Gather logs, trade them for gold and purchase food, upgrades or even donate to the local wishing well.

title: Wordatro!
description:
게임 정보
It all started on a rainy afternoon, trapped in an endless word game session with his grandma. That’s when he wondered: how to make it even more engaging and replayable for everyone?
So he took the original word-game challenge, sprinkled in some roguelite mechanics, added a cozy art direction and strategic choices, and boom! Wordatro! was born — your next favorite word game addiction.
Now sit back, relax, and prepare to spell your way to victory!
Wordatro is an easy-to-get-into roguelite word game that challenges both your linguistic and strategic thinking. Build words using a limited pool of letters, with each letter carrying a unique point value. Your goal? Create high-scoring words, trigger powerful combo multipliers, and unlock strategic bonuses to progress through 10 intense levels.
Strategy

title: Icetwine
description:
게임 정보
Icetwine is an immersive Ice Age builder where every drag-and-drop matters. Combine simple materials to craft advanced tools, machines, and structures that will help you create a thriving village amidst a frozen wilderness.
Experiment with basic resources like wood, stone, and iron to discover new items. For instance, merging a log of wood with a cluster of rocks might yield a Primitive Axe, kickstarting your journey toward more sophisticated constructions.
Design and expand your Ice Age settlement by constructing shelters, workshops, and farms. Grow food, cultivate vital resources, and even raise prehistoric creatures like dodos and mighty mammoths to support your burgeoning community.

title: NO LOGIC INC.
description:
게임 정보
So basically, you work for a super-secret bureau hunting anomalies. What’s an anomaly? Well, it’s when:
✅ A vending machine spits bricks (it’s having a rough day)
✅ Meat whispers stuff to you (maybe it loves you, who knows)
✅ Benches run around the park (don’t even ask why)
Your job - press buttons, freak out, and maybe lose your mind. Or not.
Also here:
Dancing Bobrito Bandito to funk beats
The Crocodilo Bomber plane
Psychedelic discos
And lots more stuff your therapist told you to avoid.

title: Beat Bulwark
description:
게임 정보
In Beat Bulwark, the world is connected to pulse - which has begun to fade.
Journey to the heart of the world to restore it by ending the corruption in this
short, difficult, rhythm-based action platformer.
Jump and fight to the beat through challenging handcrafted levels
Most actions are locked to the beat of the music, which shifts based on
your performance
Visual and haptic cues (controller recommended) help to find the flow
and keep it
Enemies and the environment also move to the beat, so planning your
course of action is key!
Gain new, exciting abilities as you progress toward the heart
Replay previous levels to attempt to improve your fastest time
Reach the heart and renew the pulse!

title: Finding Cool Sticks
description:
게임 정보
It's time to find some cool sticks!
Discover lots of different sticks that all have unique shapes. Name and choose what weapons the sticks can be.
Pretend the sticks are different weapons like swords, pistols, rifles, daggers, bazookas and magic wands.
Each stick has different stats for the weapons you choose. Some do more gun damage while others can reach further.
Solve different puzzles found in the forest.
Find a dungeon deep in the forest that hosts evil monsters and try to fight your way through (using stick weapons) to face the dungeon boss.
There's also ducks but you can't attack them although they will quack and look at you.

title: Cheems Bonk
description:
게임 정보
Cheems Bonk is a casual single-player zone-denial arcade game. Swing your baseball-bat left and right to defeat an endless spawn of Evil Cheems. If Evil Cheems reaches you three times, you lose and Evil Cheems prevails. 
Features:
Cheems
Infinite Waves
Score Tracker
Planned Features:
Weapons Shop - Use Score Points to purchase in-game weapons upgrades and skins.
Cosmetic Shop - Use Score Points to purchase in-game cosmetics for Cheems and Evil Cheems. 
Controller Support and Keymapping

title: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape
description:
게임 정보
Lil' Snot: Moon Escape is a difficult, minimalist, precision-platformer. Sling yourself through 5 levels with unique mechanics each to test your capabilities.
Try to beat my fastest finish time of 2:39!
The lil' snot has always wanted to see what's outside of his moon prison, it's up to you to help the lil' snot escape!
Enjoy an atmospheric moon-ish soundtrack and the silence of the character in space.
By holding down Mouse Button Left and dragging down and aiming like a bow, let go and the lil' snot will be shot like an arrow!
Use A and D to move and get the placement you want.
Each stage has varying platforming mechanics:
Sticky walls, repulsion walls, invisible platforms, teleporting platforms, portals, and more!
Playtime: 30 Minutes - 3 Hours (varies based on skill and experience)

title: Vespia: Shield of Aberration
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Vespia: Shield of Aberration is a tower-defense game where you combine spells to modify the effects of your projectiles. In this game, it is not the tower that defines its magic power, but how you choose to apply modifications to it. Create a shotgun wizard by combining multi-casts, create shots that explode into a burst of black holes, and absolutely break the game with your insane combinations!
In Vespia, you will be tasked with protecting the city for 20 days before a powerful prime anomaly appears. During this time you will earn experience, upgrade your characters and unlock new spells - slack off and the increasing amount and types of enemies will be bound to overrun you.
Between each day, you will have the option to unlock special modifier effects which add a little bit of interest to your run; however, the more powerful the benefits, the more powerful the consequences.
Features
Your journey cannot be completed alone, each new student joining your party will bring something new to the table with unique abilities, spells and upgrade trees.
Each new character that you unlock has:
A unique skill tree for that character.
An upgradable ability card active while you are using that character.
Character-specific cards to enhance your deck.

title: Snackroach
description:
게임 정보
미니 골프에서 영감을 받은 가벼운 퍼즐 게임입니다. 제한된 수의 클릭/탭으로 각 레벨을 탐색하여 바퀴벌레를 푸드 게이트로 안내하세요. 여기에는 몇 가지 논리가 필요하며 때로는 순간을 포착하기 위한 빠른 조치가 필요합니다. 몇 가지 놀라움을 기대하세요!

전체
쉬운 플레이: 클릭/탭만 하면 바퀴벌레가 해당 위치로 이동합니다.
69레벨.
난이도가 점점 높아지고 있습니다.
즐거운 캐릭터 애니메이션.
모자 선택.

레벨 기능
영리한 퍼즐.
빠른 반사신경이 필요합니다.
독특한 장애물.
적을 능가하세요.
낙석.
2개의 비밀 방.

원산지
2009년에 저는 형의 게임 사이트를 위해 "Clickroach"라는 게임을 개발했습니다. 상당한 인기를 얻었기 때문에 나에게는 큰 성공이었습니다. 현재 게임은 원래 개념을 재검토합니다. 바퀴벌레와 아이디어 사이에는 유사점이 있습니다. 둘 다 결코 죽지 않습니다. 즐기다!

title: Metahorror Therapy Session
description:
게임 정보
Dr. Montgomery's latest patient, Noel, is as mysterious as he is prone to obfuscating. 
But there's something odd about these sessions with him. Something left unsaid.
It's almost as if... they cannot escape this room.
|| A visual novel about an endless therapy session - developed, directed, produced and written by a psychologist! ||
GAMEPLAY FEATURES:
- 50k words of content, including many optional and hidden dialogue that only the keenest of players will unlock.
- Choose how to respond to the patient's revelations and lies, what questions to ask, and when to keep quiet

title: Fenced In
description: 게임 정보

title: Neanderthallica
description:
게임 정보
Forget fire and remake the Stone Age with a sci-fi shock and amazing weather powers!
Neanderthallica challenges you to master the elements, hone your crafting skills, and delve into a world overflowing with charm and clever design. Claim your place as the ultimate Neanderthal and rewrite history!
Command the Elements
Manipulate weather conditions not just for combat, but to reshape the environment, solve puzzles, and reveal new pathways essential for exploration.
Craft & Customize
Discover and forge over 150 gear and weapon combinations, empowering you to overcome specific obstacles, defeat challenging enemies, and access previously unreachable zones.
A Humorous Sci-Fi Twist on Prehistory

title: Grocery Store Tycoon
description:
게임 정보

Grocery Store Tycoon에서는 사용자가 1인칭 시점에서 주인이 되어 플레이할 수 있으며, 자유로운 카메라 이동으로 상점을 관리할 수도 있습니다.


가장 빠른 계산원의 속도에 도전하거나 단순히 급여를 지불하고 싶지 않다면 직접 계산대를 운영해보세요. 긴 대기 시간과 불만 고객을 피하려면 최대한 빠르게 스와이프하세요.


한 번에 한 케이스씩 창고에서 선반으로 운반하거나 카트를 사용하여 대량으로 운반하세요.


계산대, 선반, 냉장고, 냉동고, 농산물 선반, 쇼핑 카트 보관소, 쇼핑 바구니 스탠드, 물류 장비 및 장식품과 같은 배치 가능한 물품을 구매하세요.


고객 통계, 상품의 공급과 수요, 가격 조정, 배치 가능한 물품의 상태 확인, 직원 관리를 통해 상점을 관리할 수 있는 인터랙티브 UI.


경험치를 통해 아이템 유형, 배치 가능한 물품, 관리 도구, 직원 고용 능력, 상점 확장 및 다른 상점 구매 기회를 잠금 해제하세요. 이는 수동적으로, 일하며 또는 보너스 목표를 완료하면서 얻을 수 있습니다.


배치 가능한 물품을 유지 관리하고, 카트와 바구니를 반환하며, 상점을 깨끗하게 유지하여 상점을 최대한으로 운영하세요.


직원을 관리하여 그들이 행복할 수 있도록 하세요, 그렇지 않으면 그들이 그만둘 수 있습니다! 직원이 원하는 업무에 배치하고, 원하는 급여를 제공하며, 과로시키지 않는 것이 직원의 행복에 기여합니다. 믿을 수 없는 직원은 연락을 취하고 당신의 행복에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.


고객을 만족시켜 좋은 리뷰를 받고 상점이 좋은 평판을 유지하도록 하세요. 그들이 찾는 상품을 갖추고, 가능한 한 짧은 시간 안에 상점에서 머물게 하며, 카리스마 있는 직원이 계산대 뒤에 있는 것이 고객의 만족에 기여합니다.
[/img>

title: Find or be Found
description:
게임 정보
Summary
Find or Be Found is an asymmetric co-op horror game. Go on heists as a pair of burglars looking for the most valuable items in haunted houses. Locate the specific item to earn money and progress, but have a look out during your search because you're not alone.
Play as either the hacker or the robber. Only the hacker knows what to steal and where to find it, and only the robber inside the house can grab it. Communication is key.
Hacker
As the hacker, you are the only one who knows what the item looks like, where it is, and when the monster is nearby. You must guide the robber using maps and cameras.
Describe the item
Check your cameras
Manage resources
Robber
As the robber, locate your way around the house, bring back the item described, and hide when the monster comes. Be fast and discrete, and don't make any mistakes.
Locate and steal the items
Hide from the monster
Communicate your location

title: Shuffle Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Final Fantasy Tactics 나 Slay the Spire와 같은 고전 명작에 영감을 받은 Shuffle Tactics 는 전술 덱빌딩 장르를 새로운 레벨로 끌어올립니다.
로그라이트 전략 RPG인 Shuffle Tactics에서 아스테리아 왕국을 황혼의 저주의 타락으로부터 지켜내십시오. 최고의 덱을 구성해 강력한 힘을 지닌 유물을 획득하고 도움을 받을 최고의 사이드킥을 골라 사악한 왕 오그마를 쓰러뜨릴 퀘스트에 나서십시오.
턴 기반 전략 배틀에서 최고의 콤보를 구사하십시오. 하지만 여행 내내 걸림돌이 될 저주는 조심해야 합니다!

title: Nanostorm
description:
게임 정보
They left you for dead. Now, unleash the Nanostorm.
About the game
Nanostorm is an incremental 2D arcade shoot'em'up game where you get stronger with every death. In the game, defeated enemies drop Nano-Essence, which you can spend in a massive skill tree on new abilities and powerful perks.
A hostile alien world
Stranded and alone after crash-landing on a deadly alien world, you discover that death isn't the end – it's the fuel for your rebirth.
Dive into Nanostorm, a fast-paced, horizontal incremental shoot'em'up. Obliterate endless waves of vicious pixel-art monsters and harvest the vital nano essence they bleed. Pour this essence into a vast skill tree, unlocking game-changing perks that transform you into an unstoppable force.
You start weak, but soon you will evolve into the storm. Gather enough strength to finally activate your ship's emergency warp core and escape this forsaken planet!

title: To the Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
투 더 킹덤은 매끄러운 비디오 게임 메커니즘과 놀랍고 예술적인 비주얼을 결합하여 풍부하고 몰입감 넘치는 전략 보드 게임 경험을 제공하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 친구, 가족 또는 전 세계의 낯선 사람과 함께 플레이하든, 이 게임의 역동성을 마스터하는 데 도전하세요.
배우기는 쉽지만 마스터하기는 어렵습니다.
“투 더 킹덤"은 배우기는 쉽지만 마스터하는 데는 시간이 걸립니다. 상대를 이기기 위해서는 강인하고 조직적이며 때로는 무자비해야 합니다. 전략의 세세한 부분까지 이해해야 승리할 수 있습니다.
땅을 차지하세요
땅은 비옥하고 풍요로우며 점령하기 위해 기다리고 있습니다. 가장 유리한 영토를 점령하여 적의 진출을 막고 전략적으로 영토를 확장하세요. 적의 전략적 연결을 방해하고 혼란을 일으켜 자신의 위치를 높이세요. 하지만 상황은 언제든 바뀔 수 있으므로 너무 편안하게 생각하지 마세요.
깊이 있는 전략 경험
다른 훌륭한 전략 게임과 마찬가지로, “투 더 킹덤”은 신중한 계획에 대한 보상을 제공합니다. 처음부터 끝까지 모든 움직임이 결과를 좌우합니다. 매 경기마다 새로운 맵, 적, 자원이 제공되므로 모든 게임이 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 승리의 열쇠는 상대를 읽고 그들의 전술에 적응하는 데 있습니다.
멀티플레이어 전투
전 세계의 전략 애호가들과 경쟁하세요. 승리의 달콤한 기쁨을 맛보든 패배로부터 배우든, 진정한 리더답게 상대를 존중하는 것이 가장 중요합니다.
숨막히는 비주얼과 사운드
“투 더 킹덤"은 전략 외에도 오감의 향연을 선사합니다. 왕국의 통치자가 되기 위한 여정을 더욱 돋보이게 하는 아름다운 비주얼과 음악, 전반적인 예술적 경험을 즐겨보세요.

title: Dark Mine
description:
게임 정보


Your first night on the job should have been uneventful, just another shift deep in the tunnels of an isolated gold mine. But when disaster strikes and the mine collapses, your reality changes instantly. The crew is gone. Something is down here with you. And the only thing standing between you and the dark is the green glow of your night vision lens.
Dark Mine is a first-person survival horror game set in a pitch-black labyrinth of rock, debris, and unseen terror. Using only a handheld night vision camera, you must navigate narrow tunnels, avoid the creature that stalks the dark, and find your way to the surface.
A Retro Nightmare
Inspired by the lo-fi tension of classic horror, Dark Mine blends PSX-style visuals with a claustrophobic setting and relentless atmosphere. The mine may be abandoned, but it is far from empty. Every flicker of movement and every distant sound may be the last thing you hear.

title: Night Shift
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations on your new job! You’ve been selected for the Night Shift at the finest pizza establishment this side of the void. Your duties are simple: sweep up, hand out pizzas, rearrange the chairs, and keep an eye on—well, never mind that part.
It’s just three nights. Just you, the pizza, and whatever that was in the corner of your eye. If you survive, you get paid. If you don’t… hey, you won’t be hungry anymore.
Inspired by the golden age of lo-fi horror, Night Shift blends first-person survival mechanics with PS1-era visuals, atmospheric tension, and a dash of pizza grease. Tasks are randomly assigned each night, so stay sharp. Or don’t. It’s your funeral.

title: Warning
description:
게임 정보


You are a night guard assigned to a long-abandoned psychiatric facility buried beneath the main asylum. For years, rumors have swirled: missing persons, unexplained noises, flickering lights, and the presence of something no one dares to name. Tonight, it’s your turn to keep watch.
Armed with nothing but a bank of static-filled security cameras, your job is to observe and report. But as the night drags on, things begin to shift, literally. Hallways change, figures appear where none should be, and the feeling of being watched becomes impossible to ignore.
Watch Carefully
Each camera reveals a room. What seems normal one minute might be different the next. Chairs move. Doors open. Shadows stretch too far. These aren’t just glitches, they’re warnings. Identifying and reporting each anomaly is your only line of defense. Miss too many, and you may find the threat is no longer confined to the screen.

title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
description:
게임 정보
독특한 협력 플레이 경험을 제공한 How 2 Escape가 더욱 향상된 게임플레이와 새로운 도전적인 퍼즐로 돌아왔습니다!
최신 시리즈 **"How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine"**에서 당신과 파트너는 실종된 잠수함을 찾아 세계 대전을 막아야 합니다.
세계를 구하라
아군 군사 기지가 적군에게 점령되었고, 정부는 이를 되찾기 위해 어뢰를 발사하라는 명령을 내렸습니다. 하지만 이는 수많은 아군 희생을 초래할 수도 있는 위험한 결정이었습니다.
추후 내부 논의와 적군과의 협상 끝에 정부는 공격 취소를 결정했지만, 문제가 발생했습니다.
어뢰를 실은 **잠수함 "The Triumphant"**은 통신 범위를 벗어나 있어 취소 명령이 제대로 전달되었는지 확인할 방법이 없습니다.
전쟁을 막기 위해, 정부는 최고의 전문가 두 명, **장교 "오리"와 "르로이"**에게 "The Triumphant"을 찾아내라는 임무를 맡깁니다. 그러나 이들이 마주한 현실은 예상과 달랐습니다. 최근 결정으로 인해 잠수함 내부에서는 도덕적 갈등이 점점 커지고 있었던 것입니다.

title: Burger Witch
description:
게임 정보
The Ritual Begins!
Deep within a spooky dungeon, witches have set aside their cauldrons in favor of sizzling grills and toasted buns. The world craves the finest enchanted burgers, and only you and your coven can deliver! But beware—meeting the quota is no easy feat. With orders piling up, ingredients flying, and time slipping away, teamwork is the only spell that will save you.
Burger Witch blends cooperative chaos with a whimsical witchcraft twist. Take orders, assemble burgers with style, and serve mystical customers before time runs out. Earn gold to upgrade your tools, expand your kitchen, and prepare for even greater challenges. But remember—witches cook with magic, not madness, so don’t throw food (unless absolutely necessary)!
Are you ready to don your witch hat and master the mystical art of burger-making?
Magical Kitchen Madness – Work in a haunted dungeon-turned-burger-joint, where every round brings new challenges.

title: Nanomon Virtual Pet
description:
게임 정보
나노몬은 데스크톱 최고의 펫입니다!
사이버 공간의 데이터에서 태어난 나노몬들에게는 좋은 집이 필요합니다. 그들에게 집을 마련해 줄 기회를 드리죠! 날아다니는 고양이, 생각할 줄 아는 수박, 픽셀 드래곤에서 무기를 가진 나뭇잎까지, 모든 나노몬에겐 각자의 개성이 있습니다. 오늘 새 친구를 찾아보세요!
모든 나노몬에겐 삶의 목표가 있고, 당신만이 그것을 이뤄줄 수 있습니다. 완전한 모습으로 성장시키고 싶다면 최강의 나노몬이 되도록 도와줘야 합니다. 스타가 되거나, 나노스케이프 최고의 요리사가 되거나, 그 목표가 뭔지는 아무도 모릅니다.
지금껏 없었던 최고가 되고 싶다면 나노몬을 강력한 전사로 키우세요! 친구들과 온라인으로 겨루고, 최고의 나노몬과 함께 결투하고, 승자의 자질이 있는지 확인하세요!
하지만 일이 바쁘고 휴식이 필요하다면, 화면 밑의 친구들과 그저 노닥거릴 수도 있습니다. 던전을 탐험하고, 낚시를 즐기고, 또는 절친 나노몬과 공놀이를 해보세요. 휴식이 필요할 땐 나노몬이 언제나 함께해줍니다.
나노스케이프는 화면 한 켠의 작은 창 안에 있는 거대한 우주입니다. 당신의 나노몬은 모험을 사랑하죠! 새로운 지역을 탐사하고, 새 장신구를 찾고, 새로운 식사를 하고... 각자 할 일을 하죠. 모든 나노몬은 호기심과 궁금한 것이 많으니, 꼭 함께 모험해 보세요!

title: Maiden
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 영구적인 죽음이 있는 제한된 공간에서 펼쳐지며 매 순간 긴장을 늦출 수 없습니다. 이 역동적인 세계에서, 당신은 끊임없이 움직이고, 잠긴 방의 열쇠를 찾고, 탈출할 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 생존하려면, 플레이어는 다양한 효과가 있는 포션—피해를 주는 포션부터 버프까지—을 사용해야 하지만, 그들의 수급은 제한적이며, 모든 결정은 치명적일 수 있습니다. 각 방은 새로운 도전을 제시하며, 영구적인 죽음은 모든 움직임을 신중하게 생각하게 만듭니다. 이 게임은 당신의 민첩성, 전략 및 예측할 수 없는 상황에 적응하는 능력을 진정으로 테스트할 것입니다.
각각의 모험은 열쇠와 포션을 숨기고 있는 절차적으로 생성된 상자 덕분에 독특합니다. 다음 문 뒤에 무엇이 기다리고 있는지 알 수 없습니다. 열고 있는 모든 상자가 생명을 구할 기회일 수도 있고, 더 큰 위험을 감수하게 만들 수도 있습니다.
열쇠는 진행의 중요한 부분으로, 다음 방으로 가는 문을 열 수 있게 해줍니다. 열쇠에는 여러 가지 유형이 있으며, 각각 고유한 테마를 가지고 있습니다. 피 묻은 열쇠는 희생이나 전투를 요구하고, 돌 열쇠는 힘을 상징하며, 얼음 열쇠는 극복해야 하는 함정에 얼어붙어 있고, 아크열쇠는 드물며 특별한 물건에 접근할 수 있게 해줍니다.

title: Quantum Witch
description:
게임 정보
It's a straightforwardly lovely day in Hus.
It's always a lovely day in Hus. That's not suspicious at all! The bovey is grazing in the field, the faer are roaming around town causing chaos, the shadies are out preaching (they're not a cult!), and a giant stone portal to another dimension has appeared in the woods.
I hope nothing goes hideously wrong and results in an adventure.
So what is it?
Narrative and choice driven adventure. Imagine choose your own adventure meets point and click meets platformer. Yes, you've got it! It's that. Not an action platformer: a  story PLOTformer - you're here for the narrative!
Choices matter. Convince a character to wear something? They'll wear it for the rest of the game. Save a character? They'll be there as part of your story.
Hand crafted retro resolution pixel art in a cute style that definitely doesn't unexpectedly turn creepy. Well, it probably won't. Maybe. Actually, it might.
Not a cult.
Play through multiple times, using your knowledge of past choices to unlock new endings and new secrets!
This is the journey of Ren, a twenty-something shepardess who gets thrown into a multiversal conflict while on a fetch quest to find her lost flock. She'll have the fates of her friends in her hands, and YOU will have to help her make the difficult choices.

title: Snakes and Ladders Championship
description:
게임 정보
3D 뱀과 사다리는 역동적인 3D 환경을 배경으로 한 클래식 보드 게임의 시각적으로 향상된 디지털 버전입니다. 플레이어는 움직이는 뱀과 사다리로 가득한 3D 보드를 따라 이동합니다. 이 게임은 여러 AI 상대와 경쟁하는 싱글 플레이어 모드를 지원합니다.

- 움직이는 뱀: 플레이어가 뱀 위에 착지하면 뱀이 미끄러지듯 움직이며 움직입니다.

title: Polar Shift
description:

Polar Shift is a puzzle-based game where you must decode a foreign language, escape from a violent alien, and help allies with their requests, all while exploring a unique and daunting prison. Explore the gym, cafeteria, and even the notorious "pit" as you adventure inside the gated jail, all while formulating a plan to escape.

title: H.A.D.E.S Zero
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
H.A.D.E.S Zero is a narrative, fixed-camera survival horror that pays homage to the classics of the 1990s genre. Set deep within the H.A.D.E.S Charon research complex, the game puts you in the shoes of Nick Smith, a security agent who must survive the remains of a scientific facility collapsed after a biotechnological incident.
Facing aberrant enemies, scarce resources, and the vestiges of a corporate conspiracy, the player must navigate an environment where horror resides not only in the physical, but also in the ethical and existential. As you progress, you will discover classified documents and files that reveal the secrets behind the H.A.D.E.S(Human Advanced and Development Experimental Systems) project, the origin of the "Proto Alphas" (P.A), and the true price of altering the limits of human evolution. ________________________________________
Key Features
• Cinematic fixed cameras
• Game design focused on survival, with limited resources, meticulous exploration, and strategic confrontations.
• Deep and fragmented narrative, told through archives, notes, and logs that invite interpretation.
• Unique creatures such as the Proto-Alphas (PAs), human-insect hybrids.
• Oppressive atmosphere
________________________________________
H.A.D.E.S Zero is the first installment in the H.A.D.E.S narrative universe, a saga that explores the limits of science, human identity, and fear as a reflection of forbidden knowledge.

총알 지옥 스타일로 평화를 위해 싸우세요!
최첨단 엑소-메크로 무장하고 전 세계의 평화, 정의, 희망을 위해 싸우는 엘리트 파일럿, 엑스-칼리버 나이트를 만나보세요! 엑소-테크 그룹은 인류를 위한 고급 무기와 방어 시설 개발에 헌신해 왔지만, AI 드론이 오작동을 일으키면서 인간을 공격하기 시작했습니다. 이제 당신이 엑스-칼리버 나이트를 조종하여 수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 질서를 회복해야 합니다!
