title: WEGO World War II: Stalingrad
description:
게임 정보
WEGO World War II: Stalingrad is the flagship of Brian Kelly's operational level, ground-centric, WEGOWW2 game system. Built on the framework of Desert War 1940-42, this hex-based wargame captures the drama of the epic German offensive to capture the industrial city of Stalingrad in the Summer of '42. It consists of a series of historical scenarios and campaigns that allow the players to explore the ebb and flow of the actual combat operations. It’s playable by both sides using hotseat, versus the AI, or Play By Email.
WEGO World War II
In many board and computer wargames, one side will move its units and resolve combat, followed by the other side repeating the process.  This game mechanic is known as IGOUGO ("I GO YOU GO"). WEGO World War II is different.  WEGO by its nature is about the player's ability to plan for and manage chaos; to find solutions to perceived challenges and accomplish the mission with the tools at hand.  Despite the fog of war...against a thinking opponent who must problem-solve and plan under the same conditions-- Every decision you make must be carefully considered. Learn to think three moves ahead to outsmart your opponent!
WEGO World War II: Stalingrad 1942 comes with three campaigns
Each campaign consists of three to six linked scenarios. The game uses stylized maps of the Russian steppes over which a hexagonal grid system has been superimposed. This grid is employed to help regulate land unit placement, movement, and combat. Air, Naval, and Ground Assets are off-map capabilities that can be brought into play when the owning player sees fit.
Ground units range in size from company to regiment/brigade level and are represented on the game map using counters with stylized or NATO icons to display unit types.
Air assets 
Represent air groups that can conduct counter-air, interdiction, air re-supply, bombardment, and ground support missions.  Air reconnaissance assets can collect information about enemy location, unit types and strengths.
Naval Assets
Represent the Soviet Volga River Flotilla.  These assets can conduct bombardment and ground support missions.

title: I Know This Place..?
description:
게임 정보

Chapter I in STEAM here if you have not yet touched this unusual world.

“I Know This Place..?” Chapter II – this is a vibe mystical TRANS-MEDIA adventure with deep meaning in our strange game world, where you will see unusual plot twists, amazing locations and quirky characters.
And all of this can be influenced by you personally, because the plot of the chapters develops taking into account the votes of the players.
In addition to the chapters of the game, our universe will be revealed in short films (watch in the game main menu), old audio recordings and comics. And thanks to the introduction of ARG - games in alternative reality - we connect the world of the game and the real one.
What did scientist Vladimir Mashkov do and where is he? What's wrong with his apartment and the house in general. Such questions will torment you after visiting his strange apartment in Chapter I.
In Chapter II we will leave Vladimir's apartment in search of answers, encountering even more questions along the way. We are starting to move away from complete linearity, and are also introducing more opportunities for our players and viewers to add items and (attention) entire story locations to the game!

title: ThrowDown
description:
게임 정보
ThrowDown 
A familiar yet unique tower defense game with randomly-generated maps, reactive mobs, and designed for replayability. 
Overview
ThrowDown takes the classic tower defense gameplay and pairs it with modern features that ensure every playthrough is a fresh challenge. Deploy your defenses strategically as you face endless new maps, diverse enemy waves, and intelligent mobs that will test your tactics.
Key Features
Endless Variety with Random Generation
Every game of ThrowDown presents a new battlefield to master. Maps are procedurally generated, creating unique defensive scenarios that require adaptation and creative thinking. From the layout of the paths to the strategic positions available for your towers, no two games will ever be the same.
Dynamic Wave Composition
Face the unexpected with randomly-generated enemy waves. Each playthrough brings different combinations of mobs, testing your ability to adapt your defenses on the fly. The wave generation system ensures a balanced yet unpredictable variety that keeps you engaged without feeling unfair.
Reactive Mobs - A New Challenge
ThrowDown revolutionizes tower defense with intelligent, reactive mobs. These enemies don't just follow predetermined paths - they analyze your defenses and adapt accordingly:
Mobs actively seek the most efficient route through your defenses
Enemy strength varies based on tower placement, creating a dynamic difficulty system
Witness enemies evolve their tactics as they encounter your defensive strategies
Strategic Tower Defense
Choose from a diverse arsenal of towers, each with unique capabilities:

title: magical capture
description:

Magical Capture Online
Step into the magical mayhem of Frogs vs Ducks!
Magical Capture Online is a quick, clever board game for anyone who loves outsmarting friends (or total strangers) in tense, fast-paced duels. Control a quirky army of magical frogs or feisty ducks in an original strategy game where every move could turn the tide!
What’s Magical Capture Online All About?
Think checkers, but with wizards… and animals… and spells. The rules are easy to learn, but once you hop in, you’ll discover there’s a surprising amount of depth (and a lot of room for mischief).
Play online with instant matchmaking or jump into a private game with a friend. You’ll climb the global rankings as you win—just don’t get too cocky, because every match is a fresh challenge!

Hop In, Play Now: Find a match against someone worldwide in seconds—or share your IP and challenge a friend to a private duel.
Tricky, Tense Strategy: Outsmart your opponent as you move, trap, and transform your pieces. Surprise them with magical moves and unexpected plays!
Rank Up! Every win boosts your MMR (Matchmaking Rating). Lose, and—well, it stings, but you’ll bounce back. 🏆
Play Your Way: Whether you want to take things seriously or just goof off with friends, the choice is yours.
No two matches are the same: Between magical traps and piece transformations, every game brings a new surprise.

title: ToHeart
description:
게임 정보
The late-’90s landmark visual novel from AQUAPLUS is back and fully remastered!

3D scenes and animations!
Updated art in full HD, with modern Windows support!
Your choice of classic or all-new voiceovers!
English & Chinese in addition to Japanese!



Discover the “heartful love comedy” that has captivated Japanese hearts for over a decade!
STORY
Spring is almost here!

Strolling down a street paved with pastel tiles, the sun warms my back as pigeons flock by the roadside. Amid this everyday scenery, it’s another ordinary morning, with just a soft whisper of spring on the wind.

“It’s a little warmer again today, huh?” Akari pipes up as she turns her eyes to me, her bangs swaying gently in the breeze. “I guess winter’s over.”

“I guess it is,” I answer offhandedly, and Akari giggles. I don’t know why.

ToHeart is a “heartful,” heartfelt, and comedic multiple-ending visual novel.
The protagonist is an utterly ordinary young man, but his friends Akari, Masashi, and Shiho make every day a happy one.

As winter turns to spring and March turns to April, the wind also carries a whisper of love.

title: Three Legions: Erosion of the Abyss
description:
게임 정보
심연에 침식된 공간에서 당신은 깨어납니다. 빛을 지키며 나아가세요. 심연 속 괴물들을 쓰러뜨리세요! 빛을 통해 심연에서 벗어난 주민들은 당신을 도울 것입니다.
Three Legions: Erosion of the Abyss 는 로그라이크와 변형 체스, 보스 배틀 중심으로 제작된 턴제 전략 RPG입니다.
세 가지 종족의 다양한 주민들과 그들이 가진 시너지 효과, 그리고 당신이 가진 권능을 조합하여 심연 속 괴물들을 쓰러뜨리세요! 심연 속에서 다양한 만남을 갖고, 신전에서 침식되지 않은 주민이나 유물을 회수하거나, 사라지지 않은 빛을 되찾으세요. 때로는 휴식을 취하는 것도 좋은 방법입니다.
고유한 권능과 유물, 무기를 지닌 4가지 캐릭터
3가지 종족으로 이루어진 72종의 다양한 주민
15가지의 시너지 조합
여러 등급으로 나뉜 60종 이상의 다양한 유물
캐릭터가 지닌 여러 권능, 경험치를 통한 권능 습득 시스템
각 캐릭터의 고유한 무기와 무기의 진화
45가지의 다양한 이벤트
40종 이상의 다양한 적
기본 난이도를 클리어할 시 해금되는 난이도 스케일링 시스템
autokwd: Three Legions: Erosion of the Abyss

title: LongStory 2
description:
게임 정보
The friendliest dating sim on the planet is back and ready to cuddle! A long-awaited sequel to the award-winning visual novel LongStory, our new season picks up where the first ended — the summer before high school begins.
When Turkeyhawk goes missing from a Welcome Home party for Marcel, it’s up to you to find your feathered friend before the school year begins.
It seems like everyone has a theory to share, is busy birdwatching online, or will happily feed the rumor mill. But does the person who left the turkey suit sitting in your closet even want to be found? And if they aren’t Turkey anymore, are they even your friend?
It’s a mess, socially speaking, but don’t worry, there’s still plenty of time for dates and flirtations, even if your romantic escapades keep colliding with quirky detective adventures.
Dive back into life with the most hilarious and heartwarming group of friends you’ll ever encounter in a game.
Episode 1: Welcome Back!

title: Streets of Fear
description:
게임 정보
Streets of Fear is a gritty side scrolling beat 'em up where you play as Phobia, an unhinged force of chaos that stalks the city’s corrupt streets. In this twisted urban battlefield, the cops aren’t protectors, they’re the ones watching their backs. Every alley echoes with dread as Phobia barrels through with relentless fury, leaving fear and broken batons in his wake. In a world where justice is a joke, Streets of Fear lets you become the nightmare they never saw coming.
Feel free to contact me at fearofstreets@gmail.com with any questions!

title: Shambles: Sons of Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
STORY
21세기말, 세계는 대전쟁에 휩싸였고, 인류 문명은 종말을 맞이했다. 그중 일부는 전쟁의 참화를 피해 거대한 벙커에 몸을 숨겼다. 그렇게 수백 년이 흘렀다. 500년 동안 굳게 닫혀 있던 벙커의 문이 마침내 열리고, 세상과 단절된 채 살아온 벙커의 사람들은 완전히 변해버린 세상과 마주하게 된다. 벙커는 생존을 위해 탐험가들을 지상으로 보내기로 결정했다. 바로 당신이 이 벙커의 탐험가다.
바깥세상, 대륙은 혼돈 속에 있다. 여러 세력들이 패권을 두고 다투고 있으며, 벙커의 탐험대는 그 폭풍 속에 던져진다. 탐험대의 모든 선택은 나비효과가 되어 세상을 평화롭게 할 수도, 더 큰 혼란, 파멸로 이끌 수도 있다.
끝없는 시련과 선택의 기로가 당신을 기다린다. 이 세계의 운명은 오직 당신의 선택에 달려 있다.
GAMEPLAY
샴블즈는 텍스트 RPG, 덱빌딩, 로그라이크가 결합된 게임입니다. 벙커의 탐험가가 되어 광대한 세계를 탐험하고, 수많은 이야기와 조우하십시오. 주어진 상황 속에서 어떤 행동을 할지 선택해 가며 임무를 완수하십시오.
autokwd: Shambles: Sons of Apocalypse,샴블즈: 종말의 후손들

title: Bullets & Brains
description:
게임 정보

불릿 & 브레인에서는 아포칼립스 이후의 망가진 세상에 빠져들게 됩니다. 시시각각으로 위험 또는 전투 상황에 빠지는 상황이 펼쳐집니다. 마지막 생존자로서 무수한 좀비와 싸워나가면서 황량한 거리, 버려진 건물, 더러운 골목, 숲, 하수도, 심지어는 설산을 헤쳐 나가야 합니다.



그래도 강력한 이점을 지니고 있으니 두려워하지는 마세요. 뇌와 에너지를 모아서 계속해서 레벨을 올리세요! 해당 아이템으로 캐릭터의 능력치를 올려 파괴적인 공격을 퍼붓고 전투에서 승리의 흐름을 가져갈 수 있습니다.


불릿 & 브레인은 플레이할 수 있는 다양한 캐릭터를 제공합니다. 각각의 캐릭터는 고유한 모습, 스탯, 시작 무기를 지닙니다.




혼자 싸우는 게 두려운가요? 다른 생존자와 힘을 합치고 무슨 수를 써서라도 살아남으세요! 많을수록 더 좋지 않겠어요? 코옵 모드에서는 좀비 떼와 싸우면서 더 큰 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.



게임은 마우스와 키보드, 게임패드를 지원하여 플레이어가 선호하는 방식으로 플레이할 수 있게 됩니다. 사거리 안으로 조준하면서 정확도를 체감하거나 더욱 역동적이고 빠른 플레이를 경험하세요.


아포칼립스 이후의 혼란스러운 상황에서 뇌에 굶주린 좀비 떼를 상대할 준비가 됐나요? 불릿 & 브레인에서 무기를 들고, 마음을 굳게 먹으며, 생존을 위한 궁극의 전투로 떠나보세요. 인류의 운명이 플레이어의 손에 달려 있습니다.




● 고유의 시작 무기를 지닌 다양한 캐릭터
● 분위기 있는 장소와 숨겨진 비밀로 가득 찬 아포칼립스 이후의 배경
● 뇌에 굶주린 좀비 떼와 끊임없이 싸우는 강렬한 톱다운 3D 슈터 전투
● 코옵 모드
● 마우스 및 키보드, 게임패드 지원
● 원하는 대로 쓸 수 있는 다양한 무기가 포함된 만족스러운 총격전

title: Ant Guardians
description:
게임 정보
내 맘대로 골라 소환하는 유닛 디펜스 게임!
오염된 크리스탈을 봉인하는 동안, 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들의 침공을 막아야 합니다!
자원을 모아 동료 유닛을 소환하여 점점 강해지는 적들을 물리치세요.
벽을 소환하여 입구를 막거나, 튼튼한 유닛을 앞세워 적들을 막을 수도 있습니다.
아이템을 강화하여 유닛을 더욱 강력하게 만들어보세요.

title: Sling-A-Thing
description:
게임 정보
"Sling-A-Thing"는 마음을 엉망으로 만드는 코미디 액션 퍼즐 게임입니다. 극도로 다양한 만화 캐릭터와 물건으로 변신하여 출구를 찾아 나가세요.
특징:
특이하고 놀라운, 만족스러운 게임 플레이
각 레벨은 특이한 도전과 만족스러운 해결책으로 당신을 놀라게 할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. 각 퍼즐에 포함된 유머와 창의성은 모든 순간을 즐겁게 만듭니다.

수작으로 만든 레벨 200개 이상
200개 이상의 독특한 레벨이 준비되어 있어 항상 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 각 레벨에는 다양한 장애물과 퍼즐이 있어 당신의 지혜와 반사 신경을 시험합니다.

20가지 이상 다른 것으로 변신
"Sling-A-Thing"의 가장 흥미로운 기능 중 하나는 20가지 이상의 다양한 캐릭터와 물건으로 변신할 수 있다는 것입니다. 기괴한 생물부터 일상적인 물건까지, 각 변신은 퍼즐을 해결하는 데 도움이되는 독특한 능력을 제공합니다. 심장과 유령, 모루와 태양, 거북이와 똥, 조합은 무한합니다!

독특한 변신 메커니즘
변신 메커니즘은 정말로 독창적이며 상상할 수 있습니다. 어떤 변신을 언

title: Operation Ninurta - Eris Portal
description:
게임 정보
Operation Ninurta – 에리스 포탈
Operation Ninurta – 에리스 포탈은 근미래를 배경으로 한 3인칭 전술 슈팅 게임으로, 로그라이크 요소를 포함하고 있습니다. 지구의 병사들은 공간 포탈을 통해 외딴 임무에 파견됩니다. 그리고 이제, 당신이 다음 차례입니다… 목적지는 태양계 끝자락에 위치한 어두운 왜행성 에리스. 그곳에는 외계 생명체의 흔적과 기존 물리 법칙을 거스르는 구조물이 존재합니다.
작전의 기원
이번 작전은 **LEAP (고급 포탈 연구소)**에 의해 시작되었습니다. 고대 유물에서 고대 포탈의 좌표가 발견되었고, 이 좌표들은 천체 사이에 숨겨져 있었습니다. 그러나 현재의 기술로는 40시간마다 단 한 명의 병사만이 포탈을 통과할 수 있습니다. 이러한 제한으로 인해, 낯선 지역에서 홀로 작전을 수행할 수 있는 특수 정예 부대가 창설되었습니다.

title: Skyline Urban Story
description:
게임 정보
"Skyline Urban Story" is a city - simulation game focusing on manageability. It refers to real-world economic laws and allows you to create a charming city with "self-sustaining vitality". In the game, relying on various systems, there are intricate interdependent relationships between regions. The development of one plot may be the opportunity for the city's explosive growth, and the disappearance of one plot may also lead to a major recession in the city. Whether to move forward or backward, mayors need to make good use of various game mechanisms to make the city grow from a small village to a megacity step by step.
 Demand System
Jobs generate population demand, population generates commercial demand, and commerce generates industrial demand. This is the basic demand chain for the operation of a city. With the improvement of the education level, commerce and industry can also generate office demand, enabling the city to complete industrial upgrading and increase urban revenue.
 Industry System
The attractiveness of a modern city lies in a large number of job opportunities at its core. As the mayor, you can attract investment at different levels for the city according to its different development stages. By introducing new industries, you can provide new job opportunities for the city, thus stimulating a new round of demand explosion in the city.
autokwd: Skyline Urban Story,天际都市物语

title: Boxville 2
description:
게임 정보
Triomatica Games의 Boxville 2는 상자 도시에서 사는 캔에 대한 모험 게임의 다음 부분입니다.
두 캔 친구는 시장으로부터 도시의 축하 행사를 위해 불꽃놀이를 준비하라는 중요한 임무를 받았습니다. 하지만 실수로 불꽃놀이가 제대로 터지지 않아 도시에 혼란이 생겼습니다. 더 나쁜 것은 친구 중 한 명이 실종되었다는 것입니다. 이제 주인공인 빨간 캔은 Boxville의 여러 지역과 비밀 장소를 탐험해야 하며 심지어 도시 밖으로 여행을 떠나 모든 것을 고치고 친구를 찾아야 합니다.

title: Ankhway: The Interplanetary Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Ankhway it's a 2D Indie Adventure and Sci-fi videogame with an epic, original and intriguing story that incorporates systems like jumping to avoid traps such as spikes, shooting, ''MP3 Player'' Item to listen to the soundtrack completely free in-game... Among many other mechanics and game systems! Combining the adventure (Exploration, puzzle-solving etc) with action and science fiction.
NEO-RETRO MODERN PIXEL ART STYLE GRAPHICS
Features gorgeous, colorful hand-drawn pixel art by awesome artists like Rinober, KR or NeonPixel

title: Tsan-shadow ninja
description:
게임 정보
Are you looking for an interesting retro-style game combined with something new? You've come to the right place! A game created by a one-man team from a player for players!
Embark on a dangerous journey as a shinobi towards revenge, which will turn into a journey towards intrigue that threatens the entire world - it turns out that the shadow is not only an ally of a true ninja, but also a space that hides something darker.
Fight exciting duels,
hide in the shadows for stealth kills,
sneak like a shinobi!
In this 2D game in a pixel and cartoon style, you will use stealth and combat mechanics depending on the need.

title: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
description:
게임 정보
완벽한 불멸의 기계를 어떻게 파괴할 것인가?

Nightdive Studios에서 제작한 System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster는 FPS/RPG 장르의 클래식 게임을 현대적으로 리마스터하였으며 크로스 플레이 코옵 멀티플레이, 모드(Mod) 지원 등을 제공합니다.
2114년, 초광속 함선인 Von Braun의 냉동 수면에서 깨어난 당신은 자신이 누구인지, 어디에 있는지 기억하지 못한 상태로 뭔가 크게 잘못된 상황에 놓여 있음을 알게 됩니다. 하이브리드 돌연변이와 치명적인 로봇이 복도를 배회하고, 남은 승무원의 절규가 차가운 배 선체에 울려 퍼지고 있습니다. 인류를 말살하려는 변이 AI인 SHODAN을 저지하는 것은 모두 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
버려진 함선 Von Braun의 복도를 깊이 파고들며 풍부한 서사와 환경에 몰입해 보세요. 함선의 각 층을 탐험하며 Von Braun과 승무원에게 닥쳐온 끔찍한 운명을 밝혀내세요.

title: Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
description:
게임 정보

Dive deep through the neon-hued brash and bawdy '80s inspired classic 2D action-platformer with your favorite BADASS Kraut, Klaus Lee! Dust off your jetpack, grab your dynamite, and prepare your laser eyes to dive deep into Klaus' first challenging adventure!


You remember Klaus Lee, right?! No? Well, you should! He almost became a cop in Beverly Hills but then applied to be a private investigator in Hawaii and got bored waiting to find out if he got it. Moving back to Cali, he worked as an unknown stuntman while running a squad of troubleshooters that kept getting beaten to the clients by A much more successful Team. One time he barely missed his job interview at a New York startup and some dude named Zeddemore got the job as an exterminator of spirits.
Did you know that Klaus trained Maverick how to both fly his jet and play killer beach volleyball? This is only a glimpse of everything he experienced living life to the max. Klaus was a really busy guy!



This is the first chapter of the famous action hero Klaus Lee. He was the role model for Colt Seavers, he made Chuck Norris walk as a toddler and prepared some water for Bruce Lee. He dated all Charlie's Angels at the same time in the same restaurant at different tables and he taught Steve McQueen how to drive a car. We are honored to work with him.



Strap on your experimental jetpack and fly through caves, dodge nasty insects, temple traps, and other hazards. But beware: fuel is not an infinite resource.



The unknown creators of the secret temples build puzzles to keep intruders out of their sacred caves. Are you smart enough to solve them?



Riddles aren't the only thing keeping unwanted visitors away, you have to prove your skills against cursed walls, chasing spirits, moving stones, and other threads.



Create, play and share your own levels with other players in the Steam Workshop. Jump in the level editor and discover the countless possibilities.


- Classic platforming action with attitude
- Over 100 levels created by our cruel level designers
- Build your own levels with the comfortable level editor
- Share your level creations cross-platform with the world
- Discover a potentially endless number of user-generated levels

title: DarkRanger
description:
게임 정보
"Dark Ranger" is a light Rogue RPG. Veterans who have retired from the human battlefield have regained their glory in the secondary battlefield against monsters. In the Kingdom of Mist, there is a special trial. If a knight who has reached the age of 40 has not conquered a city and has not been awarded a knighthood, he will be judged as a "frail person". The past will be erased and he will no longer have the right to continue serving. The fate of the faint-hearted people is not good. The long-lasting war has caused the family industry to decline. Some people have become postmen because they are familiar with the kingdom's transportation fortresses after years of wandering. But most people are discouraged and live in the simple taverns in the town.
However, a new threat is approaching in recent years. The monsters in the dungeon are becoming more and more active at night, and the nobles are worried that these monsters will rush to their manors sooner or later. So they began to recruit adventurers. The regular troops have no time to take care of these unimportant secondary battlefields, so the skilled swordsmen and the unhonored ones are the best candidates. You are such an unhonored one. Before going on a mission, the town sheriff will arrange a brief combat training for you. Forget your years of experience fighting humans, the battlefield here is completely different. The time in the dungeon does not pass evenly, it is controlled by the big clock of the dark church in the center of the earth. When the big clock swings to the east, human time freezes, and when it swings to the west, the monsters' time freezes. To win the battle in the swing of the clock back and forth.

title: Bird Game
description:
게임 정보
Bird Game is an abstract, exploration-based RPG with unique, stylized visuals, bizarre puzzles, and turn-based combat.
After an large-scale invasion of purple-eyed crows, you are tasked with seeking out the Renown Wrestling Fish, who decades ago defeated the leader of the same strange beasts. Discover the absurd events unfolding in the Kafkaesque world of Bird Game.

title: Frog Jump
description:
게임 정보
🐸 점프하고, 올라가서, 정상에 도달하세요! 🏰
개구리로서, 당신의 운명이 위로 부르고 있습니다!
Frog Jump는 당신의 기술을 시험하는 도전적이면서도 재미있는 플랫폼 어드벤처입니다.
💋 공주를 너무 오래 기다리게 하지 마세요! 👑👸
🍕 혼자서 또는 최대 8명의 친구와 함께 플레이하세요! 🐸🐸🐸🐸🐸🐸🐸🐸
누가 왕실의 키스를 가장 먼저 받을까요?
🐸💥 친구들의 정상으로 가는 길을 방해하세요!
개구리의 능력을 사용하세요:

title: Hexbound
description:
게임 정보
아늑하고 편안한 경험. 육각형 기반 보드에 도형을 배치하며 만족스러운 퍼즐을 풀고 복잡한 이미지 도전을 해결하세요. 타이머도, 압박도 없습니다—그저 나만의 속도로 퍼즐을 즐길 수 있습니다.
🟡 직관적이고 몰입감 있는 게임플레이
다양한 보드 레이아웃에 도형을 배치하고 패턴을 완성하며 이미지 기반 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 각 보드는 새로운 도전을 제공하여 흥미롭고 보람찬 경험을 선사합니다.
🌟 다양한 보드 & 도전 과제
다양한 보드 형태와 독창적인 퍼즐이 준비되어 있어, 매번 새로운 도전을 경험할 수 있습니다. 조각을 맞추거나 이미지를 완성하는 모든 과정이 편안하면서도 몰입감을 제공합니다.

title: Hunter Roulette
description:
게임 정보
[Hunter Roulette] – Multiplayer Strategy & Deadly Bets in a Cyberpunk Wasteland
Post-Apocalyptic Cyberpunk: A Feast for the Eyes, a Jolt to the Heart
After the cataclysm, the irradiated surface lies silent. Survivors cling to life beneath, packed into a steel-forged city where scarcity rules and profit is the only truth. For the cyber-modified masses, electricity and neon are the new sun, and guns and chips their gospel. Welcome to Hunter Roulette—a brutal game where every shot could be your last.
Hunter Roulette reimagines cyberpunk through the lens of ruin: Colossal machine husks hang broken overhead, data pulses like veins across steel walls, and holographic dealers shout countdowns at betting tables. Each shot tears the air, setting off a dazzling chain of destruction. This is wasteland art—a visual symphony of brutal precision.
Core Gameplay: Life-or-Death Mind Games
[Basic Rules: Odds, Guts, and Wits]
Built on Classic Russian Roulette—Only Crazier:
Bullet Gamble: Guns are randomly loaded with live rounds and blanks. Shoot yourself or your opponent. If you survive a self-shot with a blank, you shoot again.

title: Hannah VCR
description:
게임 정보
Hannah VCR is a narrative puzzle game where you manipulate a VHS tape to change Hannah's destiny.
Each colored square on the tape represents a part of the scene. You decide the order, and Hannah moves forward alone, facing a world broken by memories, abandonment... and the search for a lost doll.
Available in two versions:
VR: Control the tape with your own hands in an immersive environment that simulates a forgotten room.
Traditional: Use your controller on console or PC to solve each level from a classic and challenging perspective.
With a retro aesthetic, immersive music, and an emotionally charged design, Hannah VCR is a thrilling experience filled with mystery and the things that never fully heal.
Rewind. Change the order. Maybe this time, you'll manage to save her.

title: La Galerie des Toilettes
description:
게임 정보
당신은 티켓을 받고, 인간의 화장실에 대한 애정으로 헌정된 최고의 예술 컬렉션이 있는 박물관에 자유롭게 들어갑니다.
게임플레이
컬렉션의 각 작품을 탐험하고 깊이 생각할 시간을 가지세요. 잘난 척하는 예술 설명을 읽고, 작품과 직접 상호작용해보세요. 이 여정은 영혼을 정의하는 여정이며, 삶에서 무엇보다 화장실 유머를 당당히 최우선으로 둡니다.
상호작용과 비밀
예술에 가까이 다가가세요. 만져보세요. 쓰다듬어보세요. 상호작용이 장려되며, 각 작품에 대해 더 많이 배우고 박물관의 비밀 구역 등을 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
다중 엔딩
박물관을 여행하는 동안 예술 작품을 어떻게 감상하느냐에 따라 결말이 달라집니다.
아트 스타일
거친 PS1 스타일의 비주얼은 게임의 실험적인 특성과 어우러져 독특하게 으스스하고 분위기 있는 경험을 만들어냅니다.

title: Ruffy and the Riverside
description:
게임 정보
러피와 함께 리버사이드의 혼돈을 막고 사악한 그롤에 맞서 세계핵을 지키는 여정을 떠나세요. 모험을 즐기다 보면 시니컬한 꿀벌 핍, 모험가 두더지 에들러 경, 현명한 거북이 실리야와 함께 환상적인 세상을 발견하게 됩니다. 고유한 이야기와 대사를 지닌 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들, 매 순간 예측할 수 없는 전개가 러피를 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Princess Pomu and the 5 Moons
description:
게임 정보
Take the role of Pomulus Vongoat VII, a cute goat princess who wants to become an artist, however, she wants to escape the lands of Illeh to look for her mother.
The plan was disrupted by an invasion of mutated humans called Q-mans, killing everyone and capturing the royal family. Pomu accidentally gets demonic powers thanks to an ancient spirit sealed in a chest, and now, realizing she has lost everything, Pomu takes the opportunity to try and restore her life...
in a violent manner.
Simple but satifying combo system and weapons. Punch your enemies or take their weapons, but be careful, not every enemy can be beaten the same way!
6 unique weapons and tons of abilities to be unlocked to help you in your violent journey.

title: About an Elf
description:
게임 정보
Search for a magical land that once was but is now lost. What will you find when you get there? Treasures of gold? Lost knowledge? Endless supplies of gummy bears? Whatever the case, Princess Dam and her incorrigible apprentice, Roland the BraveCat, will face all dangers in their quest for friendship and belonging in a world oppressed by the King of Terrors and his army of evil monsters!
Key Features:
About five-hour-long, story-driven adventure remastered in 4K.

title: Quantum Resonance
description:
게임 정보
Quantum Resonance is a first-person horror game focused on stealth and survival. You play as a maintenance engineer recently hired to work in an underground quantum physics lab. Your job: keep all systems and machinery in working order. A simple routine… until everything goes wrong.
After several tests with a new experimental machine, the systems fail, the lights go out, and a series of explosions rocks the containment chamber. Something has entered our world—something inhuman and beyond comprehension.
The lab has turned into a dark underground prison filled with real nightmares. Alone and without help, you’ll have to rely on stealth to avoid the creatures and use the monorail to escape the facility.

title: Out of Sight
description:
게임 정보
Experience thrilling stealth-action.
Use advanced gadgets to outwit the alien invaders and save the surviving members of your crew.

title: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship
description:
게임 정보
신비로운 세계에서 마지막 함선을 지휘하고, 끊임없이 몰려오는 좀비의 파도에 맞서세요. 터렛을 건설하고, 선원을 이끌고, 함선을 업그레이드하며, 탐험하고 자원을 수집하고 강력한 유물을 발견하세요.
좀비 떼
평범한 좀비부터 변이체, 치명적인 위협까지 다양한 무리에 맞서 싸우세요. 오래 살아남을수록 좀비는 더 강하고 많아집니다. 하지만 전리품과 유물도 그만큼 강력하고 풍부해집니다.
터렛!
자원을 모아 다양한 강력한 터렛을 건설하세요. 업그레이드 경로를 선택하고 효과를 조합해 나만의 좀비 킬링 머신을 만드세요.
company: Zing Games Inc, 紫英互娱

title: EscapeTheBrainrots
description:
게임 정보
🔥 ABOUT THIS GAME
👉 JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER
Join our Discord server to follow game updates, meet other players, suggest ideas, and be part of the Brainrot-hunting community.
Most of the weird ideas behind the game actually come from that server it’s the brain hub of the operation. Get in, and become an official anti-Brainrot unit.
🧠 GAMEPLAY
Escape the Brainrots is a local co-op horror game for up to 4 players, mixing chaos, absurd humor, and twisted mechanics.
You play as an AI deployed to Earth to neutralize the Italian Brainrots unstable beings born from human stupidity. Every map features a new Brainrot with its own gameplay:
Sahur chases you... then stops to quiz you mid-sprint.

title: I Hate Robots
description:
게임 정보
I Hate Robots – a dark action-shooter in a sci-fi setting.
You are a scientist-researcher sent to a planet inhabited by robots. Your mission is to collect samples of living machines for study, but upon arrival, you find neither your colleagues nor the samples. Now, you must venture into dangerous portals to locate the necessary materials while facing hostile machines that will do everything to destroy you.
Key Features:
Diverse levels with unique objectives: survival, exploration, and scientific artifact retrieval.
An arsenal of 6 weapons for eliminating enemies, each with distinct features and firing modes.
Dozens of robot types and their modifications—from small reconnaissance drones to turrets and kamikaze spiders.
Dark atmospheric sci-fi environments, filled with tension and mystery.
Challenging gameplay—limited resources, constant pressure, and the need for vigilance.
Are you ready to step into the unknown?
Every move could be your last. Will you manage to collect the samples and survive among machines that despise the living?

title: Project Silverfish
description:
게임 정보
Project Silverfish is an immersive sim, FPS where you rely on your own wits and diverse sets of tools and weapons to survive!
Venture deep into a hostile and mysterious exclusion zone to hunt powerful artifacts, fight horrifying creatures and descend deeper into lost, cold-war era dungeons!
Solve complex mysteries, tracing the paths of other explorers, and digging up terrible secrets once lost to time. 
Work to uncover the dark secrets of your people's origins, and humanity's extinction...
Choose between 6 distinct pre-made classes or customize your own Inheritor of humanity's ruin!
With a variety of perk rolls and game rules, you can create a unique experience each time you play!

title: Far Fishing
description:
게임 정보
Far Fishing is a short and relaxing fishing game. Set off on a journey to the edge of the world, catching a variety of fish and upgrading your boat along the way.
Catch Fish
The core fishing mechanic is simple and easy to learn.
Chase fish with your small boat and try to keep them inside the circle.
Locations
Explore a variety of unique places — from coral reefs and active volcanoes to dense jungles!

title: Ball Travel
description:
게임 정보
In the game you need to help the ball save his girlfriend. Go on a round-the-world trip. Move, jumo, overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. Collect as many stars as possible.
After purchasing you will receive:
- An exciting adventure: Travel through colorful worlds filled with dangers and surprises in order to save your beloved.
- Exciting gameplay: Dynamic and exciting gameplay based on physics. You will find many challenges that require precision, reaction and strategic thinking.
- 15 unique levels: Diverse and carefully designed levels, each of which offers new mechanics, obstacles and puzzles.
- High-quality visual design: Pleasant graphics and stylish design that create an atmosphere of adventure.
- A great way to pass the time: An exciting way to escape from everyday worries and have an interesting time.
- Satisfaction from passing difficult sections and completing each level.
- unforgettable impressions: Vivid emotions and memories that will remain after completing the game.

title: Beyond the Pitch
description:
게임 정보
It looks like an ordinary football field... but something's buried beneath.
Start digging. What you find might change everything.
Beyond the Pitch is a minimalist digging game about going deeper—underground and into the unknown. No instructions. No map. Just you, the soil… and a growing feeling that this place hides more than it shows.
🕳️ What lies beneath:
Dig. Upgrade. Keep going.
Each layer hides something new.
Clues, tools, secrets, mysteries.
Not everything needs an explanation.

title: Vagabond Starship
description:
게임 정보

The crew of the starship Spearhead have been heading back to Artovya to deliver a unicorn to the king. After a harrowing battle with space pirates, their rutabaga supply is running dangerously low, and they need to find more if they're ever going to make it home.

Sir Typhil of Creulor and his fearless crew of elves, dwarves, aliens, and robots set out on a search across various unknown worlds, meeting zealots, rogues, reporters, and more as they seek out the ever-elusive rutabaga.


A riveting space adventure in which you choose your landing party. With 5 crew members to choose from, your decision changes your experience at each location and the puzzle solutions there
Freely travel between three distinct alien planets
Traditional adventure game puzzles as well other more unique types of puzzles
Fully voiced by professional (and awesome) voice actors
3rd person point and click gameplay
Retro arcade sections for the action elements

While a stand-alone game in its own right, this game continues the over-arching story from the previous four games in the series:

title: Sera Dion: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
HIT, TAKE, SURVIVE!
핵앤슬래쉬 로그라이크 게임 Sera Dion: Survivor를 플레이하세요.
수 천 마리의 몬스터를 죽여 다양한 스킬 조합을 직접 구성하고 강력한 보스를 물리치기 위한 생존의 사투를 펼칩니다.
혼자 혹은 친구들과 함께 플레이하며 긴장감 넘치는 경험을 위해 도전하세요.

title: Vtuber Survivor
description:
게임 정보
Vtuber Survivors is a roguelike survival game for the Chinese Vtubers with gameplay heavily inspired by Vampire Survivors and Holocure. Accumulate wealth, search and strengthen you favorite Vtuber, collect various weapons and items, and fight with enemies to help Vtuber protect a good live streaming environment!
Starting Tips
You may grep your stating gift in Vtuber search character page.
Regardless of whether you clear the stage or not, the coins you earn will belong to you and assist you in your next adventure.
We welcome valuable feedback from personal creator and will make every effort to incorporate feasible suggestions.

title: Stack Attack
description:
게임 정보
Stack Attack is a trip down nostalgia avenue.
Taking the form of a fully Twitch integrated (Required) app, your chat can start and join games.  Using different, pre-defined throw techniques, they attempt to flip Caps over from knocking down the stack of Caps contributed to by everyone in the current game.  For the sake of the in game "economy" you can define how many are contributed by players and by the game itself.
This encourages chat engagement and participation.  More people involved means better algorithm response!

The game also fully supports custom coin graphics.  Personalize it to your stream, your interests, the game you're currently playing, whatever you can think of!

To use, simply create a new element in your preferred streaming application.  Ensure it has transparency enabled.  Target Stack Attack and let it run in the background.  Then, in game, be sure to link your Twitch account!  Once that is done, you can click "Launch" on the main menu.  Once in, Stack Attack can be left running in the background, or minimized.  In chat, anyone can, then, type !throw to start or join a game.  Once in, each player will contribute the specified number of Caps to the stack.  If they choose !throw 1,2, or 3, it will change the angle which they throw from.  The game will, then, rotate throws, one player at a time, until the stack is left with a defined minimum left unflipped.  After each throw, any unflipped Caps  are re-stacked and the round continues.

Players can use !stats to check their total cap amount and top three cap amounts (The game tracks total and duplicate caps per player)
!leaderboard will show the top three players and their total cap amounts

title: Triumvirate
description:
게임 정보
Disclaimer: Please note that Triumvirate does NOT have public matchmaking nor does it have single-player. Please DO NOT buy the game if you don't have enough players to form a session. The minimum player count to start a game is 3.
The Triumvirate has been tasked with the management of a grand new city. People flock from all over for the promise of a glorious utopia. Immigration is at a record-breaking high, expansion at an all-time speed. The unrelenting force of growth will cause the inevitable collapse of the city. 
Triumvirate is better described as a city-administration game than a city-builder. How long can you and your friends keep the city afloat?
Dynamic Player Count
3 to 6 players manage one or two government departments each, depending on the size of the lobby. Each department has unique starting bonuses. Try them all out!

title: Ninjas on Trampolines
description:
게임 정보
What if ninjas fought in a trampoline park, but with paint? Ninjas on Trampolines is a two-to-four player platform fighter where players are ninjas that splatter their opponents on the battlefield. Use trampolines to fight for aerial superiority. Having the most paint on the battlefield will make you victorious, but be careful because your opponents can paint over what you have already. The person with the most paint at the end of a match is declared the winner.


Trampolines:
Trampolines are an essential aspect of this game, hence the name. Using them allows you to get higher on maps and outmaneuver your opponents. They are completely physics-based; the higher your velocity, the higher you bounce off them.

Standstill Jump:
While standing on a trampoline with no vertical velocity, you can press and hold the jump button to bounce off it.



Using Momentum:
If you are airborne, you can fall onto a trampoline to keep your momentum. Fast falling onto a trampoline will increase your bounce height.





The goal of the game is to have the most amount of your paint on the background by the end of a match. This can be achieved by attacking opponents, using items, interacting with game mode objects, and spraying tags onto the background.


Attacking opponents will splatter paint of your color on the stage. The more velocity you have, the more paint will be splattered. Players of higher velocity will have priority when attacking at the same time.










Using tags is a passive way to add your color to the background.





All game modes have a different way of painting the background.


A standard free for all game mode. No special game mode items will spawn.




Hold onto the spray crown to splatter a streak of color into the background as you move. The player with the crown loses it when they are splattered by another ninja.




Attack the paintball to change it to your color. As the ball bounces around the map, it leaves a trail of color.





Items are a part of every game mode and are an additional way to add or erase paint.


When the paintbomb makes contact with a wall or another player, it will explode into the color of the player who threw it. Hitting another ninja will splatter them.




When the shuriken makes contact with a wall, it will slowly spray paint onto the wall around it.




The mop erases ALL paint in the area around it.

title: Shield Hero
description:
게임 정보
Wrenched from your world, you face a hostile arena. Your only defense? A mysterious, ever-evolving shield.

Shield Hero is an action-packed, strategic arena combat game that flips the script on traditional shooters. Here, your shield is not just for defense—it's your ultimate weapon. Trapped in a strange, unforgiving world with no memory of your past, you must survive relentless waves of enemies, unlock the dormant power of your shield, and fight for a chance to find your way home.

Do you have what it takes to master the shield and conquer the arena?
Unique Shield-Based Combat
Forget endless ammo and generic weapons. In Shield Hero, combat is a dance of timing, precision, and strategy.
Defend and Offend: Block, parry, and redirect enemy attacks with your versatile shield.
Strategic Positioning: Master the art of shield placement to defend against overwhelming odds and ricochet attacks back at your foes.
Unleash Devastating Power: Your shield is a weapon. Charge it up to release powerful energy bursts, project destructive beams, and more.
Evolve and Conquer
Survival rewards the persistent. Vanquish your enemies to unlock a deep and rewarding progression system.
Deep Ability System: Discover and upgrade a vast array of shield abilities. Expand its size, fire projectile bursts, or overcharge it for explosive power.
Powerful Synergies: Combine abilities to create game-changing synergies and develop your own unique combat style.
Endless Replayability: With the New Game+ system, the challenge never ends. Face tougher, faster enemies and push your skills to the absolute limit.
Game Features
Multiple Thrilling Game Modes: Test your mettle in Standard, Hard, Turbo, and the intense Boss Rush mode.
Local Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with a friend and face the arena together. Utilize the unique "Echo Clone" mechanic to create an AI ally and dominate your foes.

title: BIT DANCER
description:
게임 정보
BIT DANCER is a simple and casual rhythm game featuring retro original game music and cute pixel art. All you need are the arrow keys and a mouse. It runs in a small window, making it perfect for quick, one-handed play during breaks. Tap along to nostalgic sounds with intuitive controls! Includes 10 songs at launch, with more to come in future updates.

title: Jumper's Doom
description:
게임 정보
Jumper’s Doom is a challenging 2D game in a retro style, set in a dark, black-and-white world. Controlling the Jumpers, you must avoid deadly obstacles and collect the Lotus Flower to save the world and restore its lost colors.
You'll face numerous traps, fast-paced gameplay, and a steadily increasing level of difficulty. Unlock new characters, each with a unique look, and fight for survival in a grim, pixelated world – solo or in local co-op on a shared screen.
The game supports displays with a resolution of:
1280×720, 1366×768, 1280×800, 1600×900, 1920×1080, 2560×1440, and 3840×2160.
Minimalist visuals, a dark atmosphere, and intense action – Jumper’s Doom will put your reflexes to the test.

title: Collapse Of The Midnight Sun
description:
게임 정보
"Collapse Of The Midnight Sun" is a cozy indie game with metroidvania and time loop mechanics that is less than one hour long and developed from scratch by a single developer. You'll be exploring an island that used to be a mountain before the city next to it flooded. The human made fusion reaction that lights up the sky as if it was the sun, has started to collapse. You only have a couple of minutes before it does and time resets. During these couple of minutes, you'll explore the island and memorize its locations like the abandoned train station and tools like the lantern. Memorizing these will be crucial for solving the puzzles ahead, before the next collapse and the resulting time loop.

title: Bambas!
description:
게임 정보
Remember when the streets were your playground, where every curb, puddle, or sidewalk became part of an epic mission? Bambas! brings that magic back, offering a sandbox game that lets you relive those carefree adventures with its innovative control system.

Explore a vibrant Mediterranean coastal city bursting with detail, where creativity knows no bounds and exploration is your ticket to endless fun. Use the controller’s sticks and triggers to move each sneaker independently, mimicking the motion of your own feet. Walking forward isn’t enough—navigate crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps as you tackle hundreds of challenges and unlock a treasure trove of customisable sneakers.

Bambas! isn’t just a game—it’s a celebration of urban culture. Break stereotypes with its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, where every corner hides tales waiting to be uncovered. Discover hidden spots packed with secrets and meet characters who’ll take you on unexpected journeys. Lace up and step up—because in this game, every stride is an adventure of its own.

title: WARRIORS
description:
게임 정보
WARRIORS는 멀티플레이어와 AI 봇이 포함된 싱글플레이어 모두를 위해 설계된 슈팅 게임입니다. 얼리 액세스를 구매한 플레이어는 모든 무기 스킨과 캐릭터를 즉시 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이후에는 경험치를 얻어 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.
현재 게임에서 제공되는 8가지 모드는 다음과 같습니다:
정복
목표를 점령하여 시간 경과에 따라 점수를 얻으세요. 더 많은 목표를 점령할수록 점수를 더 빨리 얻을 수 있습니다.
러시
목표를 파괴하거나 방어하세요. 공격팀의 병력이 소진되면 방어팀이 승리합니다.
킬 컨펌

title: Monkey King: Five Elements Survival
description:
게임 정보
Introduction
Taishang Laojun threw the monkey king in his alchemy furnace in hope that it will kill the indestructible monkey. The monkey has to keep moving, but everytime he moves, the space in the furnace becomes less accessible. Use arrow keys to move the monkey and help him survive longer as less and less space are available.
Game Machanics
There are five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth.
Metal counters wood, wood counters earth, earth counters water, water counters fire, and fire counters metal.
Everytime you move, The block at your previous location will get destroyed, and depending on the direction you are moving to, all blocks will try to move in the same direction and destroy at most 1 adjacent block in that direction if its element is being countered. In addition, every game (level) the monkey will be assigned with an element. If you step on a block that counters your element or there is no direction you can move, the game is over.
Game Modes
The game has two modes with the same machanics but different win conditions, which totally change how you play.
Puzzle Mode
In this mode, you'll be solving pre-designed puzzle mazes. There are one or more exits to each maze, and the mazes might look easy at first, but things get tricky as every time you move blocks get pushed around and destroyed. You are gonna need to learn how to ultilze the block movement and element countering mechanic in your favor, in order to reach the goal.
Survival Mode
In this mode, you need to survive as many steps as you can on the randomly generated board, while every move you make, fewer blocks become available. There is no exit, so death is certain, but the time is not, all you can do is help the monkey king live longer.

description:

Steven Spielberg once said, "I think the real indicator [that games have become a storytelling art form] will be when somebody confesses that they cried at level 17." Well your move, Steve!

Spritz the Happy Onion is a zesty, delicious throwback to momentum-based platformers of old, complete with run button. Except in this game, you can die as many times as you like. Though dying does lose you an expensive egg, which are important because...

A MONSTER HAS APPEARED IN THE SKY TO DEVOUR THE MOON. And only our little layered lancealot possesses a recipe for a cake that might ruin it's appetite.

Spritz can also hop off of background elements, (a feature so satisfying and natural and fun I'm not sure why I haven't seen it anywhere before,) and don magic hats to give him extra abilities like flight and invincibility.

title: The Long Fall Home
description:
게임 정보
The Long Fall Home
The year is 1969. The world is watching as Apollo 11 prepares to make history. But behind the scenes, NASA launches a secret initiative: four brave blue-collar volunteers are selected to join the mission, not to walk on the Moon, but to be cryogenically frozen in a lunar research hub. The plan? Wake them up in 1975 when the next crew arrives and study the long-term effects of lunar exposure on the human body.
That mission never happens.
NASA loses its funding. The world moves on. The volunteers? Forgotten. Until the hub’s power fails in 2025, and they thaw out naturally, confused, dazed, and completely alone.
But the Moon isn’t the same. And neither is space.
As they leave the surface, they’re met with a cosmic fever dream, massive yellow submarines floating aimlessly, whales soaring through the void, asteroids being mined by unknown forces, alien ships locked in battle, and everyday objects blown up to absurd proportions, like they just drifted out of a deranged thrift store.
Is this the future? A hallucination? Or are they still frozen, trapped in a bizarre dream?
With only each other and their wits, the four survivors must navigate an interstellar obstacle course of gravity-defying puzzles, physics-based platforming, and mind-bending hazards, all while piecing together what really happened during their 56-year sleep.
Will they find a way home? Or will they be lost in the madness of deep space forever?
🌌 1-4 Player Co-op – Play solo or with friends as you stumble through the unknown, working together to solve puzzles and overcome bizarre challenges.
🚀 Surreal Space Exploration – Traverse a world where logic takes a backseat, and the impossible is just another Tuesday.
🧩 Physics-Based Puzzles – Manipulate objects, master momentum, and solve obstacles using teamwork and ingenuity.
🎭 A Mind-Bending Mystery – Unravel the truth behind your fate while questioning what’s real and what’s the ramblings of a cryo-frozen brain.
You went to sleep in 1969.
You woke up in chaos.
Now, you just need to get home.
Will you make The Long Fall Home?

After the Collapse, humankind has been forced to live underground. It’s estimated that only 1% of the world population has survived. Under the old city of Barcelona stands ANTRO. A dirty and dark hole divided into geographical strata where the inhabitants of the lowest levels fight for survival doing forced labor, while the ones in the highest levels rule over the new underground world.
The government has become a totalitarian system, handing over the power to a corporation based on technological overproduction and the automation of sectors known as La Cúpula. Freedom of speech has been censored. Art and music, forbidden. And a rebellion seems to be coming to life inside the den in which they’re living.
Dive into ANTRO to the rhythm of Hip Hop, Drill, R&B and electronic music. Play as Nittch and move freely around the city overcoming the obstacles that ANTRO will put in your way, be it resolving puzzles or doing *parkour*. But keep this in mind: when the story requires it, get ready to run in full speed, because the pursuits in ANTRO are an everyday occurrence and both you and the scenario will move in synchrony with the music. Remember: the enemy is always lurking.

Can you outsmart the spirits and find your way out?

Take flight. Break towers. Reclaim your gold. The goblins are coming - and nothing is safe...



Fast paced gameplay requiring rapid decision making
Intense layout of enemy towers that foster intense combat
Economy based deployment and upgrade system

title: Idle Universe Creator
description:
게임 정보
In this game, you will be aiming to create a universe with the same mass as our own. This can be achieved in many ways. From creating the universe from just 1 element, to creating it out of an equal amount of all the elements.
You will start off with just 1 Electron, 1 Proton and 1 Neutron. From there you must increase your rate of production of these Sub-Atomic Particles.
Once you have enough to create Elements, you can open the Periodic Table and choose which atom to create. The Atomic Mass of this atom will contribute to your score.
Because the Universe is made up of a super large number of atoms (that I will not spoil here), you will be able to buy in bulk. But this system works slightly different. Here, each button you press multiplies how many you can buy. So pressing 5 twice will allow you to buy in bulks of 25.
You will also be able to upgrade all the Elements and Sub-Atomic Particles to increase their mass.
However, this may seem a bit slow after a while, so Prestiging will give you an opportunity to reset and start over. This time though, you will have a multiplier for your Rate of production for your Sub-Atomic Particles. This will massively speed up your progress.
Your time and score will also be submitted to leaderboards so you can compare who has the current highest mass and who managed to create the universe in the quickest time.
There will also be many achievements along the way. From creating a molecule of water, to recreating the Universe as close as possible.

An homage to 80s-era side-scrolling shooters!!
Evolving weapons and perks system!!
Challenging platformer levels!!
Beautiful sprite animations and background art!!
Unique robot bosses and sub-bosses!!
No disappearing/reappearing blocks!!

Some X number of years in the near-future. The world has enjoyed 100 years of peace due to a benevolent and fair world government known as the Peacekeepers. However, there are those who are not happy with this peace. The shifty Dr. Kraven decides to hold the PeaceOut Conference, where the world's greatest minds build robots to benefit mankind. Dr. Grey answers the call and invents Blasten, an ultra battle bot with a strong sense of right and wrong.

The conference goes well until the battle robots start going crazy! Dr. Kraven reveals he has taken control of all robots and plans to take over the world!

It's up to Blasten to fight his way through hazardous levels, crazed battle robots, and defeat the evil Dr. Kraven to restore forever peace!

title: Mantra

Corrupted AI code caused thousands of industrial robots to turn into human-killing murder machines. As the former lead developer for Tenso Corp, you feel it's your duty to right the wrongs that brought chaos to the world.
Mantra is a sci-fi FPS inspired by the likes of Doom, TitanFall and Halo taking you through an expansive world where robots have gone corrupt and are seeking to take over the planet. Throughout Mantra, you'll encounter a healthy mix of action-packed combat, swift traversal spaces and puzzles you'll have to complete in order to progress.

Wall run through both dense and open environments to maneuver around your enemies and keep the advantage. Master your movement abilities and keep your foes on their toes.

title: Touching Grass Simulator

Have you touched grass today?
In Touching Grass Simulator, embark on the ultimate quest to reclaim nature, one blade of grass at a time. This quirky and satisfying incremental game lets you grow, manage, and nurture a sprawling field of grass, transforming a barren plot into a lush paradise.
Whether you're planting seeds, upgrading your tools, or automating the process, there's always something to do. Perfect for fans of relaxing, incremental games—or anyone who could use a virtual break from the chaos of daily life.
Will you master the art of grass cultivation and become the ultimate Grass Tycoon? Or will you simply enjoy the chill vibes of watching grass grow?

Grow Grass, Literally: Plant seeds, watch grass grow, and keep expanding your green empire.
Incremental Gameplay: Start small and progress into managing an endless field of grass with upgrades, tools, and automation.

Why Play Touching Grass Simulator?
Need a break? Touch grass—virtually!
Love incremental games? You’ll enjoy the steady flow of upgrades and satisfying growth loops.
Searching for something funny, yet relaxing? This game offers a perfect mix of humor and chill gameplay.
Get ready to touch grass in the most satisfying way possible.
Touching Grass Simulator—it’s more fun than it has any right to be! 🌱

title: Freegglers
description:

Freegglers are lively orange creatures who enjoy life full of freedom. In fact, there was a time when everything was quite normal and Freegglers lived a happy life. Until one day...



From the depths of darkest and most rotting, stinky hole in the ground, you can imagine, emerged a bunch of Evil Freaks whose goal was to enslave all Freegglers and destroy freedom, beauty, harmony and joyful life.

Pull off ridiculous stunts, break records (and bones), and unlock customization items to make your ragdoll as stylish as their wipeouts. Dive into nonsensical simulations and capture your finest (or most catastrophic) moments with the photo mode.
🎯 Absurd challenges in crazy levels
Dodge avalanches of giant balls, outrun rogue self-driving cars, fire cannons... Every level brings a brand-new, unpredictable, and absolutely hilarious challenge.
🤣 Physics has never been this fun (or painful)
Get crushed, run over, blown up, or zapped by lasers. Just laugh it off—grace was never part of the plan.
📸 Photo Mode and Slow Motion
Want to immortalize that epic jump-turned-disaster? Snap the perfect shot or slow it all down for maximum drama. Because every faceplant deserves a close-up.

title: Neural Edge
description:
게임 정보
From the developer: Dear friends, this game is not a hate piece against neural networks. Rather, it is a multifaceted reflection on the new reality.
🐙 Simple gameplay keeps the focus on the story. Can you uncover every ending?
🐙 Almost everything here is sculpted from clay. What could be more human than that...?
🐙 A short story filled with big questions. Is a human truly better than a neural network? Find your own answer.

title: Superstore Rush
description:
게임 정보
Superstore Rush, the ultimate store management game that lets you build, expand, and thrive in your very own bustling superstore! Developed by Shantek, this engaging game combines strategy, resource management, and fast-paced problem-solving to deliver a fun and rewarding experience.
Whether you’re restocking shelves, upgrading departments, or managing your growing customer base, Superstore Rush offers endless excitement and opportunities to grow your dream store. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the ultimate store manager?
Best of all, Superstore Rush is free to play and new content is added regularly!
Start small with basic shelves and work your way up to unlocking an array of departments, including groceries, fridges, freezers, deli cabinets, electronics, clothing, and even a mini-restaurant! Expand your store and serve waves of eager customers to maximize sales and profits.
But running a superstore isn’t just about stocking shelves. You'll face dynamic challenges such as spills, power outages, machine maintenance, unruly customers, and more. Keep your store running smoothly by solving problems quickly and efficiently. Every decision you make shapes your store's success.
Have feedback or suggestions for the game? Jump on the community Discord to share!

title: La Salamanca
description:
게임 정보
개요
La Salamanca에서 당신은 산티아고 델 에스테로를 여행하는 동안 친구들이 모두 미스터리하게 실종된 후 아르헨티나 출신의 청년이 되어 그들을 찾아야 합니다. 모임 장소: "El Portal"이라는 낡고 어두운 아파트 단지, "아늑한" 장소, 실제로는 겉보기와는 다릅니다...
아르헨티나의 지역 전설에서 영감을 받은 이 게임에서 플레이어는 지옥에서 나온 이 장소로 더 깊이 들어가야 합니다. 괴물들을 피해 뛰고 숨어다니며 결국 동료들에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지, 그리고 이 장소가 무엇을 숨기고 있는지 밝혀내야 합니다.
특징
아르헨티나 북부의 전설에서 영감을 받은 심리적 공포 게임입니다.
긴장감 넘치는 분위기가 게임 내내 가장 용감한 사람들도 긴장하게 만들 것입니다.
각 장과 레벨마다 다른 방식으로 플레이할 수 있는 에피소드 구조입니다.
스토리를 진행하고 몬스터를 피하며 뇌를 날카롭게 만들 수 있는 여러 가지 퍼즐이 있습니다.

title: Turn Based Boxing: Tactics
description:
게임 정보
폭력적인 지하 복싱의 세계에 발을 들여보세요. 이 턴제 시뮬레이션(선택 가능한 자동 전투)에서, 당신은 복싱 챔피언의 명단을 모집하고, 훈련하며, 관리하며 궁극의 복싱 왕조를 구축하기 위해 노력하게 됩니다.
자신만의 체육관을 만드세요:
다양한 기술과 스타일을 가진 복서 팀을 구성하세요. 각 복서는 체육관에 현금을 벌어다 주는 데 기여합니다. 현금을 사용하여 복서를 훈련시키세요.
복서를 모집하거나 창조하세요:
전 세계를 탐색하여 체육관에 합류할 가장 재능 있는 복서를 찾아보세요. 노련한 베테랑부터 유망한 신예까지, 모든 복서는 독특한 강점, 약점, 그리고 개성을 가지고 있습니다. 계약을 협상하고, 시너지를 관리하며, 복서들과의 관계를 구축하여 그들의 잠재력을 최대한 발휘하게 하세요.
수십 가지 특전 / 무한한 복서 빌드:
특전은 복서의 성능을 게임의 다양한 측면에서 향상시키는 특별한 능력 또는 보너스입니다. 이는 스태미너와 파워 증가에서부터 방어 기동 향상이나 링에서의 전술적 이점까지 다양합니다. 매니저로서 당신은 각 복서의 강점, 약점, 전투 스타일, 그리고 체육관의 전반적인 목표와 시너지가 맞도록 투자할 특전을 신중히 선택해야 합니다.

title: Cupig's Key Collectathon
description:
게임 정보
Cupig's Key Collectathon 의 열쇠 수집 대회는 열쇠를 모아 보물 상자를 여는 간단한 게임입니다.
.
주요 목표는 점점 더 어려워지는 레벨을 최대한 빨리 통과하는 최단 경로를 찾는 것입니다. 넘어지면 죽지만 타이머는 계속 작동하므로 정확하게 맞춰야 합니다!
100개의 레벨!
점점 더 어려워지는 100개의 레벨을 통해 하늘 섬에서 심해까지 다양한 세계를 방문하세요.
빨리!
자신의 기록을 깨고 가장 빠른 돼지가 되어 모든 열쇠와 보물을 수집하세요!

title: E-Sports Hockey League
description:
게임 정보
E-Sports Hockey League is on a mission to create the ultimate online multiplayer hockey experience.  Get ready for fast-paced arcade hockey renewed with modern gaming tech. Team up with your friends and compete in online matches, tournaments, and leagues.  Customize your franchise and compete for promotion to the big show and win the big prize.  It Doesn't matter how, just win.  Create your own fantasy team and join a league with your friends or random players.  ESHL is a game for hockey players by hockey players.

title: Dyebreaker
description:
게임 정보
Blast the puck to push your paint in Dyebreaker, the 4-player arcade air hockey-like! Score goals to paint the arena the color of your team. Win the round to add a layer of detail to your team's screen print poster. First finished poster wins!
Arcade precision meets physical chaos: blast your body through the air and slam the puck, or hook and throw it with a satisfying slingshot fling
Compete across a huge variety of interactive arenas, randomly selected each match
Pick from 10 colorful characters across 5 playable teams with a signature graphic design style unique to each
Swap team colors at any time, reskinning not just your character but the entire game
Hone your skills against CPU players before taking the fight to IRL friends in local multiplayer
Grow from rookie to veteran with tight controls that are easy to understand but rewarding to master
The Arcade Comes Home
Dyebreaker is approachable yet rewarding, lighthearted yet competitive. It's tailor-made for IRL contests between friends and strangers.
The original Dyebreaker arcade cabinet can be found at Wonderville in Brooklyn, NY. This new release adds loads of fresh content to be shared across arcade and PC, as well as some new "home edition" features like achievements, customizable settings, and a gamepad lobby for assigning players (or CPUs) to teams and slots.

title: Zombolion
description:
게임 정보
Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where you are the last sheriff standing in the entire county, fighting to defend a top-secret research bunker and uncover the truth behind a deadly virus — using the finest scientific and diplomatic methods humanity has to offer.
Methods like: machine gun bursts, grenades, automated turrets, gear upgrades, and plenty of tactics that would make any international committee lose their minds.
There’s no time for talking things through — just bullets, explosions, and pure survival instinct.
Key Features:
🔫 Brutal firepower: Machine guns, grenades, turrets, upgrades — all the “scientific” tools you’ll need to tear through the undead.
🧱 Bunker defense: Fortify your bunker, build up your defenses, and hold out against endless zombie waves.

title: Little Oceania
description:
게임 정보



Place your little buildings, earn a bit of cash, expand your island, repeat! Position and rotate your buildings optimally so they make the most amount of cash per day. Make enough, and your little island will start to grow. Your session ends when you run out of space to build. It's like Tetris, but cuter!




As you plop down buildings, roads, rivers, castle walls and more, you'll start to witness your kingdom growing before your eyes. Strategize hard to grow your kingdom as large as possible and top the leaderboards, or just sit back and enjoy a chill experience creating a fun little world.




As you expand, you'll discover new buildings with unique effects. Roads that multiply the income of their surroundings, but must always be connected in long segments? Rivers that triple the income of their surroundings, but can only be built downwards? Lighthouses that raise columns from the sea, allowing you to build in those final crucial positions so you can squeak out one more island expansion?




Keep your session completely stress-free in creative mode. Nothing to manage, just complete freedom to build however you feel.


























If you got this far, thank you for reading <3 Check out these links:

title: Devastablance. Mountain Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
Devastablance: Mountain Brotherhood is a game set in a post—apocalyptic world where you will find many quests, puzzles and unique mechanics. During the adventure, you will have to face various obstacles, strong opponents and ambiguous choices. Dynamic storytelling and a variety of gameplay will not let you get bored! Travel, defend, fight and strive to achieve your goals! Save humanity and your people! Remember: the fate of this world depends on you!
BACKGROUND
The nuclear war that split time into before and after was the result of a conflict between Humans and Magicians. There were no conquered and conquered, the sky was covered with the ashes of war for centuries. When people came to the surface again and saw the rays of the sun, they were overtaken by new threats. People were divided into factions, and each had its own philosophy. You are the head of a faction of "Scavengers" - people who are trying in vain to bring back balance to this world, which everyone has long forgotten about. You have a high position among the people, a small army and influence, but this is not enough to prevent the death of mankind. The strongest faction, a huge Horde consisting of magicians and their necromancer brothers, wants to conquer new lands. Everyone will have to unite in the face of a common threat. Go a long way, overcoming many obstacles, making new allies and completing the history of this world! Don't let humanity down, it's you who can change everything!
・Many different locations.
・Many different game modes.
・Lots of interactive characters.

title: Wild in the West
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for a rootin' tootin' robot showdown! Wild in the West delivers thrilling third-person action with a unique Wild West twist.
Follow the journey of a mysterious gunslinger who arrives in the frontier town of Red Creek. Skilled but unwelcome, he faces suspicion and rumours about his past. But when ruthless robots invade, the townspeople must turn to the outsider they rejected.
Blast robots across the dusty town, upgrade your firepower and outsmart the relentless invaders. Uncover their secrets and face a mighty boss as you fight to save Red Creek. Can you earn your redemption in a town that never trusted you?
Experience thrilling shootouts, dynamic movement, and a clash of Wild West grit and sci-fi technology. Master your arsenal, outmanoeuvre your enemies, and unravel the mystery behind the invasion!

title: Star Scum
description:
게임 정보
Star Scum fuses deckbuilding roguelikes with a nailbiting, chess-like tactical strategy game where every move matters.
In Star Scum, building your deck is just the beginning! When you play cards in battle, they become tactical units and ship equipment like weapons and shields that you must command every turn across two battling ships.
The tiles of your ship define your stats, like health, amount of moves per turn and how much power you can generate. Customize your ship and buy new ones as you travel into The Vortex!

title: Private Mining Company
description:
게임 정보
Far in the future, you work as an independent military contractor for various deep space mining companies.
Raise your army to defend mining outposts against alien bugs!
Train your soldiers and purchase upgrades across various missions.

title: Level Down
description:
게임 정보
Controls
WASD / Arrow Keys – Move
Space – Jump
Z – Interact
Gameplay
Your goal is simple: reach the green arrow to ascend to the next level. But in Level Down, every move matters. One wrong step could send you plummeting—One wrong step could send you plummeting—not just one floor, but multiple levels down, undoing your progress in an instant. As you climb higher, the challenge ramps up with new mechanics, unpredictable tiles, and heart-pounding obstacles.
Each level is a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled obstacle course that pushes your reflexes and decision-making to the limit.. Will you take the risky path for a faster climb, or play it safe and steady? With so many unique levels, the game keeps you on your toes with increasingly complex challenges.
Key Features
100 Hand-selected Procedurally Generated Levels: Each level is uniquely designed to test your skills, with no two floors feeling the same.
Diverse Tile Mechanics: Tiles behave in wild and unpredictable ways—some crumble, some slide, and some even bounce you in unexpected directions.
Checkpoint Levels: Every 5 floors, take a breather at checkpoint levels. Interact with NPCs for hints, lore, or just a quick break.
Original Pixel Art & Music: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, retro-inspired world with original pixel art and a soundtrack composed by Blake Hudson.
Unique Mechanics
The heart of Level Down lies in its variety of tiles and level mechanics. Each floor introduces new challenges that keep you on your toes. Here’s what you’ll encounter as you climb:
Crumbling Tiles: Step on them, and they’ll fall beneath your feet. Timing is everything!
Slippery Tiles: Slide across these icy surfaces—can you recover before you fall?

title: Bullet Blasters
description:
게임 정보
Bullet Blasters의 혼돈의 세계로 내려가라. 매 플레이마다 다르고, 적들은 예측 불가능하며, 오직 가장 강한 전사들만 살아남는다. 지옥의 타워 기지의 깊은 곳에서부터 신성한 천국의 문까지, 불, 바람, 번개, 독, 얼음의 힘을 다루며 싸워라.
빠른 템포의 전투, 원소 무기, 그리고 프로시저럴 생성 전장에서 어떤 플레이도 똑같지 않다. 혼자 싸우든, 최대 4명의 친구와 함께 로컬 협동 플레이를 하든, Bullet Blasters는 네 반사신경, 전략, 그리고 원소 제어 능력을 시험할 것이다.
30개 이상의 잔인한 레벨을 정복하고 정상에 도달할 자신이 있는가?

🔥 끝없는 가능성, 무한한 재미
프로시저럴 생성은 각 레벨이 새롭고, 도전적이며, 예측 불가능하도록 보장한다. 어떤 플레이도 똑같지 않아, 액션을 신선하고 흥미롭게 유지시킨다!
⚡ 원소 마스터
불, 바람, 번개, 독, 얼음의 힘을 해방시켜라. 각각의 원소는 적을 멋지게 파괴할 수 있는 독특한 효과를 가지고 있다. 원소들을 조합해 파괴적인 결과를 만들어내라!
💀 한 생. 한 발. 한 번의 기회.
각 플레이는 생사가 걸린 전투—원소 무기와 능력을 사용하고, 프로시저럴 생성 혼돈에 적응하며, 끊임없이 변화하는 타워에서 살아남기 위해 싸워라!
🤝 함께 팀을 이루어 폭파하라!
혼자 생존하거나 최대 4명의 플레이어와 함께 로컬 협동 플레이를 즐겨라. 전략, 팀워크, 그리고 순수한 탄환 혼돈이 네가 정상에 오를 수 있을지 결정할 것이다!

title: Arcane Trigger
description:
게임 정보
From the Creators of "Demon King’s End" comes their latest masterpiece! A gunslinger with magic at your fingertips!
After years of hard work, the young mage finally saved up enough to build a beautiful house deep in the woods. But what she didn’t realize was that her new home was right next to a rift between the Shadow Realm and the Mortal Realm…
As night falls, monstrous shadowspawn creatures pour through the rift, destroying everything in their path. Armed with her Arcane Rifle, the mage is ready to pull the trigger and unleash a storm of fury on these rude invaders!
Mix & Match for Max Damage!
Think twice before pulling the trigger! Repositioning your bullets to create the ultimate buff combo!
Craft New Bullets!

title: Cry Pic.
description:
게임 정보
Overview:
This is an action shooter game where the main focus is fighting large enemies (bosses).
Dodge the dizzying amount of enemy bullets while dealing damage to the enemy
Destroy the enemy.
Features:
5 stages, boss battles only
2 difficulty levels
I don't think it's easy to clear, so I've narrowed it down to a low difficulty level.
First try the easier level, and then try the harder level.
Appearance:
2D pixel art, 3D background, chiptune
Danmaku, multi-jointed

title: Wasteland Punk
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Wasteland Punk — the ultimate RPG of survival in a world shattered by catastrophe! Face a gripping story full of twists, fierce enemies, and intense turn-based combat. Unleash your tactical brilliance with weapons forged or scavenged from the ruins of civilization.

title: What's a King to a God
description:
게임 정보
Slay God. Stay God. Stop the Chaos.

What's a King to a God is an irreverent rogue-lite management sim where you play as a begrudging hero who has just overthrown God and must assume the role themselves. It is now up to you to maintain order in the world and thwart the forces of Chaos without getting overthrown yourself. You'll laugh, you'll cry, and you'll die in this choice-focused story that combines the gameplay of Plague Inc. and Reigns, using our unique narrative-based combat system. With a god's eye view of the map, you'll manipulate heroes, monsters, and locations to keep the realm at peace while building enough resources to stop the cycle of Chaos - of gods rising and being overthrown - once and for all.

Please note that current screenshots do not represent final look.
autokwd: What's a King to a God

title: Atomic Raid
description:
게임 정보
아토믹 레이드는 3D 아케이드 슈팅 게임으로, 2~3개 장소마다 놀랍도록 역동적이고 변화하는 게임플레이를 즐길 수 있습니다.
내러티브
인류의 기술적 도약은 외부에서 눈에 띄지 않았습니다. 도시 한가운데서 포털이 열리고 무자비한 생명체 무리가 인류를 파괴하려는 단 한 가지 목적만을 위해 쏟아져 들어왔습니다.
침략을 막기 위해 사람들은 핵무기를 사용하여 자신의 도시에 미사일을 발사해야 했습니다.
모두는 이것으로 충분할 것이라고 생각했지만 포털이 손상되면 외계인의 남은 자들은 인류를 파괴 할 목적으로 바이오 매스와 금속으로 새로운 '병사'를 만드는 이동식 실험실을 건설하여 적응할 수있었습니다.
특징
놀랍도록 높은 역동성
당신이 본 모든 것이 어딘가에 숨어 있습니다...
영웅과 무기에 다양한 버프/디버프가 있습니다.
모든 보너스는 모든 것을 바꾸므로 신중하게 선택해야 합니다.

title: Passer
description:
게임 정보
The operation of this game is very unique. It is recommended to watch the How-to- play video at the top of the page before trying it.
This is a minesweeper game from a third-person perspective.
Marking all mines is the task of each level.
Minefields may be covered by obstacles and can be cleared by blasting.
In the levels, you will encounter guards who prevent your action.
You have a wealth of skills to fight them,
Hand-to-hand combat is your basic skill.

title: Saga of Guardians
description:
게임 정보
About Saga of Guardians
Saga of Guardians is a unique collectible card game and auto battler.
Build YOUR deck, place your cards strategically and climb the ranks in the PVP Arena.
Build the most powerful deck
Collect over 150 unique cards, from 3 unique factions and discover the most powerful synergies to overcome your opponents.
Place your cards strategically
Assemble and power up your team, predict your opponents move and defeat their Guardian.
Battle phase auto resolves

title: The Flower Inspector
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to your night shift.
It's time to return that favor. For one night, you must inspect flowers and decide where you'll ship them to. There's a long shift ahead and some of your choices may haunt you.
If you feel you're being watched, turn off the lights and hide.
Inspect Specimens
You can use a variety of tools to inspect flowers that arrive at the office, including a camera with IR/UV lenses and a microscope.
Compare the data you collect with the flower entry at HERBAWiki™ to determine if a flower can be considered anomalous.
Choices and Consequences
You'll find yourself in the middle of a situation with many conflicts of interest. Depending on what you choose, you will make some people unhappy. Decide your route and survive through the consequences.
Dealing with the Unknown
Depending on what foes you make along the way, your reality can certainly be altered. The game may not be the same every time.

title: Shadows Over Harken
description:
게임 정보
Step into the medieval fantasy world of Shadows over Harken, where a dark necromancer threatens to corrupt the peaceful village of Harken and its surrounding lands. Join a unique team of heroes—Relic, a strong warrior; Alessia, a gifted cleric blessed with power; Hiligon, a powerful paladin; Klean, an agile fighter from another plane; and Neville, a unique and special bard. Experience an immersive visual novel that combines deep storytelling with combat mechanics, where your choices shape the story and the fate of the land. Engage in battles, explore a richly detailed world, and uncover hidden secrets while enjoying captivating artwork and an epic soundtrack. Can you lead your team to victory and stop the necromancer before it’s too late? History based in an original roleplaying campaing.

title: 7821 Akuji
description:
게임 정보
7821 Akugi is a short, liminal horror experience where you pilot a makeshift submarine inside a liquid filled asteroid, searching for a lost science crew.
Story:

Door controls are dead and I hear nothing outside. I hope someone gets this door open soon. My head is starting to ache…  . Hope this isn't my last log.
Emergency Log Entry 01
I’m pretty sure I blacked out from the lack of oxygen. Barely awake when some Enforcers dragged me to the bridge and gave me two choices: accept a brain wipe for the last few weeks and return to Galene, or pilot some… submersible they made to find a lost science crew?
I know what those brain wipes did to other people, I ain’t gonna risk it. Plus Riley was assigned to the science crew - and if I succeeded in this task I was promised a 3rd class citizenship. Easy choice. 
Back in my room now. They left an o2 canister. At least I can breathe.
Emergency log entry 02
I can hear them coming for me. If I can't find you Riley. Know that… I might be in love with you. 
Press any key to continue.
Gameplay:
Navigate your submersible that is barely water tight through tight corridors with only a single light to guide your way.The hacked-together submersible only has a tiny porthole for you to navigate.Choose two routes: Be a good corporate employee and get the job done. Or choose an alternative path...Pick up items, keycards and solve puzzles in order to progress and reach the lost submarine!

title: Crimson Quest
description:
게임 정보
흔히 RTS 장르는 플레이어가 형성한 모든 기지와 유닛을 다방면으로 조작하며 멀티태스킹을 요구하는 반면, '크림슨 퀘스트'는 하나의 플레이어 캐릭터만을 움직이고 자체 생산 기지가 되어, 다양한 특성을 지닌 유닛(몬스터)과 전투 타워를 생성할 수 있습니다. 이로써 작은 악마에게 막대한 생산 능력을 부여하고, 실시간으로 이루어지는 로그라이크 방식의 진행과 탐험의 재미, 소소한 액션까지! 기존의 RTS 요소와 완벽한 결합을 이루어낸 새롭고 독특한 장르의 게임입니다.
탐험을 해보세요.
탐험을 통해 다양한 오브젝트를 찾아내고, 필드에 어떤 야생 몬스터들이 서식하고 있는지 위치를 미리 파악해 보세요. 당신은 지도를 펼쳐 원하는 지역을 표시할 수 있으며, 둘러보기 기능을 해금하였다면 이를 이용해 먼 곳을 내다볼 수도 있습니다! 적의 세력보다 더 빠르게 성장하고 싶다면 동선을 낭비하지 않고 계획적으로 움직여야 합니다.
자원을 채취하여 몬스터와 타워를 생성하세요.
일꾼 몬스터를 이용하여 필드 곳곳에 위치한 에너지 광상을 채광하거나, 가까이가면 드러나는 다양한 보물 상자를 열고 자원을 습득할 수 있어요! 몬스터들은 상위 등급으로 올라갈수록 더 많은 광석이 필요하고, 타워는 종류마다 요구하는 자원의 양이 다릅니다. 또한, 넘쳐나는 자원을 여행 중인 자원 수집가에게 다른 자원으로 교환할 수도 있으니, 그가 어디에 있는지 찾아보는 것도 좋습니다.

title: Gamebook H. P. Lovecraft: The Haunter of the Dark
description:
게임 정보
I have seen the dark universe yawning
Where the black planets roll without aim,
Where they roll in their horror unheeded,
Without knowledge or lustre or name.

Nemesis



Beyond Games and Audiobooks

Robert Blake, the main human character of The Haunter Of The Dark, died under unexplained circumstances.
Do you have the nerve to play his role as written down by the master Lovecraft?

is an audio-active horror where less is more.
You'll see less, hear (fear) more.
Images will appear and disappear similar to the flashes of a night storm.
Music and sounds will indicate you the right direction in the darkness.
Use sound orientation and explore the winding streets of the haunted settlement to find and then escape the cursed temple.
Well, adventurer, you have a small chance called... hope.


In detail:

+ Steam Achievements.
+ Two audio-active modes: Story and Explore.
enhance your listening experience with various intuitive actions. Know when to open doors, chests or sometimes even dodge a certain death…
Let the music guide you through the dark, learn to move effortlessly without the help of your sight. We strongly recommend the use of headphones to find the right direction.
+ Cosmology & horror ambience.
+ 3D audio environment experience.
+ Intuitive controls.



Curtain-up!
autokwd: Gamebook H. P. Lovecraft: The Haunter of the Dark

description:

Twin-Stick Party Shooter
Up to 8 players in local multiplayer (controller required)

Attention! Behold Buhei! The wonder granted to humanity! Experience how believed boundaries fade away and the exquisite combination of game mechanics transcends the human mind.
Multiplayer
In this game, up to 8 players can compete against each other in friendly or less friendly rivalry at the same time. Buhei is THE party game! Gather your friends! Gather your enemies! Marvel together at the explosion of action on your screen.
Diverse Weapons
Watch out! Witness the symphony of firepower. A fantastic arsenal that gives you the opportunity to wreak havoc on your opponents. An inexhaustible selection awaits you. From high-speed projectiles to sophisticated traps that can outsmart even the cleverest opponents.

title: Battle of Rebels
description:
게임 정보
이 싱글 플레이어 또는 멀티 플레이어 크로스 플랫폼 1인칭 및 3인칭 슈팅 게임에서 좀비 무리에 맞서 싸우세요.

스토리
외계인들은 인간의 DNA를 부패시켜 좀비로 만드는 인간 복제 기계를 도심 지역에 설치했습니다. 기계를 비활성화해야 하지만 작업이 쉽지 않습니다. 먼저 기계가 설치된 영역을 좀비로부터 제거해야 합니다. 해당 지역이 정리되면 외계인 보스가 도착합니다.

Access Key를 얻으려면 BOSS를 죽여야 합니다. BOSS가 죽으면 컴퓨터를 비활성화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 액세스 키를 받게 됩니다.

행운을 빌어요!

게임 소개
Battle of Rebels는 여러분의 강점을 활용하여 승리를 향한 자신만의 길을 개척하면서 더 많은 일을 하고 더 많은 사람이 될 수 있는 자유를 제공합니다. 보급품을 모으고 상대를 물리치세요.



싱글 플레이어에서는 외계인이 지구를 침공한 후 바이러스가 지구에 퍼지고 국가는 이를 방어하기 위해 고군분투합니다. 침략을 막기 위해 전 세계에서 연합군이 결성되었지만 허사였습니다. 외계인은 훨씬 더 발전했습니다. 최첨단 기술을 통해 인간 복제가 가능해졌습니다!

우리는 더 이상 우리가 누구와 싸우고 있는지 알지 못합니다! 인간?

외계인들이 모든 방어선을 침투했고, 우리 군대는 패배했습니다. 인간 외계인이 우리를 둘러싸고 있습니다. 우리는 그들을 외계인이라고 부릅니다.

일부 인간은 감염되어 워킹 데드가 된 후 혼란을 일으킬 것입니다.
