title: Deep Copy
description:
게임 정보
Deep Copy is a top down point-and-click literary adventure set in a hand-painted science fiction world. Awakened with no memory, you must solve puzzles and navigate a branching story to piece together the dense, interconnected mystery at the heart of the lab.
A SIREN SOUNDS, AND YOU AWAKEN
A klaxon alarm screams through a laboratory and your eyes creak open. Who are you? Where are you? Your head rings, and you do not know. One thing is certain: the Scientist is still inside the building, and he is coming. Explore the hand-painted laboratory, solve environmental puzzles, and debate with the myriad voices inside your head as you try to escape and save your soul.

TOP DOWN, LITERARY, CRPG INSPIRED
Deep Copy is a top down point-and-click literary adventure set in a world of dark science fiction. You are...well, you're not sure. You're an amnesiac, awakened among a creche of life support tanks in an abandoned laboratory. Someone, or something, has left behind a dense and interconnected web of mystery in the ruins of the laboratory, and you're at the center of it.

Inspired by literary classics like Disco Elysium and Planescape Torment, Deep Copy is a unique blend of the interactivity and puzzles of point-and-click adventure games with the deep, reactive story and beautiful writing of big CRPGs.

Explore a laboratory overflowing with puzzles and meticulous, hand-placed secrets. There is more than meets the eye. Use and debate with the two factions of your mind, Divination and Intelligence, as they guide you to damnation or salvation. Interact with a cast of strange characters through branching dialogues and make real choices that affect everything around you as you try to escape...by any means.

title: Zombolion
description:
게임 정보
Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where you are the last sheriff standing in the entire county, fighting to defend a top-secret research bunker and uncover the truth behind a deadly virus — using the finest scientific and diplomatic methods humanity has to offer.
Methods like: machine gun bursts, grenades, automated turrets, gear upgrades, and plenty of tactics that would make any international committee lose their minds.
There’s no time for talking things through — just bullets, explosions, and pure survival instinct.
Key Features:
🔫 Brutal firepower: Machine guns, grenades, turrets, upgrades — all the “scientific” tools you’ll need to tear through the undead.
🧱 Bunker defense: Fortify your bunker, build up your defenses, and hold out against endless zombie waves.

title: LANIAKEA
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Laniakea, a vast and immersive MMORPG experience that will transport you to a breathtaking world of wonder and adventure.

In this expansive open world, you'll embark on a thrilling journey across sprawling landscapes, bustling cities, and ancient ruins, as you explore the secrets of a richly detailed universe.

Explore a Vast Open World

Discover a vast, open world filled with hidden secrets, mysterious landscapes, and ancient ruins waiting to be uncovered. From the snow-capped peaks of the Frozen Spires to the scorching dunes of the Golden Wastes, every region is meticulously crafted to provide a unique and unforgettable experience.

Choose Your Path

Create your own legend by selecting from a diverse range of playable weapons, each with its unique abilities, playstyles, and progression paths. Will you wield the fury of the elements as a Stormcaller, or master the art of stealth as a Shadowdancer? The choice is yours.

Unleash Your Power

Unleash devastating combat abilities, summon powerful allies, and harness the power of ancient magic to dominate the battlefield. With a deep crafting system and extensive character customization options, you'll be able to tailor your experience to suit your playstyle.

Join a Thriving Community

Join a vibrant community of players, collaborate with friends to conquer challenging group content, and participate in regular events and updates that will keep the game fresh and exciting for years to come.

Key Features

Explore a vast, open world with diverse regions, each with its unique landscape, architecture, and secrets
Choose from a range of playable weapons, each with its unique abilities and playstyles
Develop your character through a deep crafting system and extensive customization options
Engage in action-packed combat with a variety of abilities, summons, and magic
Join a thriving community with regular events and updates
Get Ready for the Adventure of a Lifetime

Embark on an unforgettable journey in Laniakea, where the boundaries between reality and fantasy blur, and the fate of the world rests in your hands.

title: Backpack Rogue

Your Inventory
Every decision about which item to put in your backpack and exactly how it synergizes with the rest can be crucial. Your survival depends on your ability to balance risk and reward by strategically planning your actions

Uncover high drama in this whodunnit set in a small-town community theater! Gather clues by investigating the sets, casts and backstage crews of 10 theatrical productions, using their stories to piece together each deadly crime.



Explore the theater for clues
The game features 10 levels -- each focused on a deadly incident that occurs during a performance.

Solve mysteries
Gather clues and observe each scenario to deduce what happened.




Infer the story from clues and environments, then fill in the blanks to progress.

title: Soulglass
description:
게임 정보
Your contract is to protect unknown souls, each embodied in a Soulglass. Keep the sands of this giant mystical hourglass flowing while fending off afflictions that threaten both you and your charge.
FEATURES
Exciting abilities that allow you to play with movement and physics.
Tons of strategic variety based on your ability choices.
Diverse levels with colorful environments and obstacles.
OVERCOME ADVERSITY
Afflictions create physical challenges for you, while the soul you protect carries even heavier burdens. Their story is shaped by the Soulglass’s traits and active afflictions.
MAINTAIN BALANCE
Master your abilities to navigate the Soulglass and remove afflictions that attach to its surface. Keep the sand flowing in order to complete your contract while avoiding total imbalance where any chamber of the Soulglass becomes completely empty.
GAIN POWER
Completing contracts grants opportunities to upgrade your abilities. Plan wisely, as future challenges will test you in three key areas:
Control over objects and the Soulglass itself
Speed and precision in navigating the map
Strength against afflictions and obstacles

title: Prison Escape io
description:
게임 정보
감옥에서 탈출하세요—함께!🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ 경비원을 따돌리고 대탈출을 할 수 있다고 생각하세요? 친구와 팀을 이루거나 이 가슴 뛰는 멀티플레이어 모험에서 경쟁하세요! 함정이 가득한 환기구, 비밀 터널, 경비가 있는 복도를 함께 탐험하거나 서로를 앞지르기 위해 경쟁하세요. 길을 따라 동전을 모아 세련된 의상을 잠금 해제하고 성과를 높이세요. 상황이 어려울 때 파워업이 구세주가 될 테니 주의하세요. 여러분과 여러분의 팀은 너무 늦기 전에 탈출할 수 있을까요?
멀티플레이어의 즐거움을 위해 디자인된 게임 모드
👮 Prison Break: 친구와 힘을 합쳐 탈출 계획을 조정하거나 누가 먼저 탈출할 수 있는지 경쟁하세요. 자랑할 권리도 있습니다!
🔍 Glass Bridge: 신뢰와 타이밍의 시험! 팀과 협력하여 올바른 유리 패널을 선택하거나, 유리 패널을 남겨두고 혼자 결승선까지 경주하세요.
🌈 오브비 레인보우: 다채롭고 협력적인 수직 여행 - 친구를 돕거나 누가 더 빨리 오르는지 경쟁하세요.
재미를 계속 유지하기 위한 기능
🎭 기발하고 독특한 캐릭터 라인업에서 선택하고 감옥 탈출 팀에 완벽하게 맞는 캐릭터를 찾으세요.
⚡ 파워업으로 게임플레이를 강화하여 친구보다 빠르게 달리고 우위를 점하세요.
🎁 함께 재미를 공유할 수 있는 흥미진진한 일일 보상을 받으세요.
🎮 여러 게임 모드에 뛰어들어 그룹의 참여를 유지하세요.
🌍 친구와 함께 새로운 장소를 발견하고 탐험하세요. 각 장소는 이전 장소보다 더 스릴 넘칩니다.

title: Sneaky Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Sneaky Pirates에서 항해를 시작하세요! 망망대해에서 펼쳐지는 속임수와 전략, 액션의 온라인 먼티플레이어 소셜 추리 게임! 최대 4명의 플레이어가 여러 척의 배들 사이에서 변장하고 몰래 숨어 다니며 상대를 사냥하고 훔치는 치열한 두뇌 싸움을 즐길 수 있습니다.
훔쳐서 승리하기 – 게임이 끝날 때 가장 많은 골드를 획득한 해적이 승리합니다. 동점일 경우, 먼저 훔친 해적이 승리합니다!
군중 속에 숨기 – AI가 조종하는 함선들 사이에 섞여 조심스럽게 다음 행동을 계획하세요.

title: Beat Dodger
description:
게임 정보
Beat Dodger is a Rhythm game that combines flying through obstacles, and tapping to the beat while jamming to tunes! Anyone can do it! All you have to do is follow 2 simple steps:
Obstacles fly towards you, when the obstacles reach about the size of the white ring, just Hit the Beat. Be careful though! Too early or too late, and it will count as a missed beat.

title: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino
description:
게임 정보
Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino is a 2D atmospheric visual novel, blending absurdity, paranoia, and mild unease into everyday life.
You play as Glorbofrutodrila — a creature who moves into a new home with his pregnant wife, hoping for peace and a fresh start. But soon, cracks begin to show — both in the walls and in reality. Neighbors whisper, the floor creaks, and one early morning phone call might change everything.
The game features:
Branching dialogue and meaningful decisions
Memorable characters reacting to your choices
Hand-drawn art in a unique visual style
Subtle ambient music and immersive sound design
A story where nothing is accidental
This is not a horror game. It's a tale of suspicion, strange timing, and the feeling that you're not in full control.
autokwd: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino

description:
게임 정보
You have been selected to work in the Media Regulation Branch, the front lines in the fight for truth and national purity. Report to Office Building Number: 171 Room: 152 by the end of the day. Your duty? Safeguard NewMerican values, ensure only that trustworthy information reaches the public.

As stated in your employ handbook section C page 14 under the 5th stanza of the 3rd paragraph you are to be filtering out and stamping all information the public is allowed to see. You are the final check to ensure NewMerica stays the perfect safe haven for all.  
2025 is a dystopian 2D puzzle game where you take on the role of a NewMerican media censor officer within a surveillance heavy, authoritarian society. Through the manipulation of text, redaction of sensitive content, and strategic bans of documents, you must maintain the truth of NewMerica, the world's most perfect country.

title: Velocity Riders
description:
게임 정보
아드레날린이 솟구치는 3D 바이크 레이싱 모험을 준비하세요! 초현실적인 그래픽과 매끄러운 조작으로 아름다운 환경을 누비세요. 교통 체증을 헤치고 나가든, 램프를 질주하든, 모든 레이스가 실감 나게 느껴집니다.
특징:
현실적인 3D 그래픽과 역동적인 환경
플레이어가 선택할 수 있는 다양한 바이크
점점 더 어려워지는 스마트 AI 상대
다양한 트랙: 도시, 사막, 숲 등

title: Souper Hero
description:
게임 정보
Souper Hero is a dungeon crawler roguelike fueled by the power of soup. Explore a procedurally generated world filled with friends and foes, collect ingredients, and make yourself stronger by cooking delicious soups! 
Cooking: Every ingredient has a flavor and enemies drop ingredients that augment your attack. Combine up to five ingredients in a soup and you get a completely unique weapon to play with. Though be careful, your new weapon has limited uses, so use it wisely. Some special drops have unique effects to explore, so be on the lookout!
The Dungeon: Explore a lush fantasy world full of strange (yet delicious) creatures. Find clans of local wildlife to loot and learn to traverse different biomes. Every playthrough is unique, since all content is procedurally generated. Be careful not to get lost!
The Hub: After a hard day of work (or losing all of your health) take a break at the hub. Here, you can interact with shopkeepers, cook freely, and prepare for your next traversal into the dungeon.

title: Lo-Fi Golf
description:
게임 정보
LoFi Golf is a chill, third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music.
Your goal is to complete five maps using the limited number of shots available. Choose your preferred difficulty level, explore atmospheric maps, and build your strategy to succeed!
Improve your skills in Training Mode.
Once you complete a map, progress to the next one.

title: Lucha Throwdown
description:
게임 정보
Lucha Throwdown
The Lore of the Mask Lives On…  
Step into the ring and onto the battlefield in Lucha Throwdown — a high-octane Card Battler, where legendary Luchadores clash to defend Earth from an ancient evil!
The cursed El Abysmo mask has been unearthed, unleashing a dark force upon the world. Now, a coalition of Lucha legends must rise. Play as iconic Luchador champions Dr. Wagner Jr., L.A. Park, Tinieblas, Keyra, each bringing their signature style, spirit, and power to the fight.
- Build your deck. Train with Champions. Battle their Jefes.
- Outplay opponents with fast-paced card combat that captures the intensity of real lucha libre action.

title: Poltergeist @ Button Mash
description:
게임 정보
This is a cooking sim for people who have struggled with mental health issues and/or worked in a kitchen (ha ha, redundant).  
Gameplay
The gameplay is your basic singleplayer cooking game. Orders come in from annoying, unseen customers, and it's your job to make them - perfectly, otherwise the annoying, unseen chef will yell at you - in a timely manner.
Features
As you progress through the seven stations of the kitchen (Bar, Dodger Night, Oven, Fryer, Saute, Salads, Code Red) you will unlock new characters with unique abilities, get paid for each dish you make correctly, and shop for things you don’t need. Do drugs (or, preferably, don’t) to manage your mental health and affect gameplay elements. If you make it far enough, you'll get to unlock the recipes from the actual restaurant.
Life Lessons
Get stressed, make money, buy stuff, do drugs. Learn something hopefully. Repeat.
The only enemy is your ego - conquer it or die trying.

title: Dumpster Baby
description:
게임 정보
Dumpster Baby
When friends are near, you're never far from home.
Dumpster Baby is an isometric narrative exploration game about being queer and homeless, and the unique experiences that arise from that intersection of identity and life situation. Explore the community park, public library, and the local Market's parking lot as you meet new people and learn their stories. See first-hand the importance of queer community during hard times.
Go out there and explore.
You play as Bandit, an optimistic racoon meeting new friends as he tries to find roommates. You're crashing on Betty's couch, a queer mentor who appreciates your company but can't house you forever. Time to go out and learn that you are not alone in your journey, and there are more people in similar situations to yours than you may think.
Scamper around to find items
Craft trinkets
Trade goods
Find furniture to keep while you wait to get your own apartment
Help out your friends, new and old
A community at your doorstep.
Connect with other queer homeless people in your area and foster friendships by helping each other out as you are able. Find items that you need to live, and find items that make life worth living.
Gift items to your friends
Keep track of their desires and hopes in your journal
Make a community in your new apartment together
A touching narrative.
Dumpster Baby tackles the real life issues that are at the intersection of being queer and homeless, but reminds players that there is always hope. We are stronger together, and if we cannot find queer joy, we shall create it.
Estimated play time: 2 hours
Our Story:
company: Josef Arnold, Sam Bowsher, Tommy Bozzelli, ,

title: Tilebound
description:
게임 정보
Tilebound is a captivating blend of strategy, puzzle-solving, and magical combat, where every tile you place shapes your destiny. You are a novice Tile Wizard, bound to an ancient spellbook, seeking freedom by mastering the art of building powerful tile chains and unleashing elemental spells.
Key Features:
Strategic Tile Placement
Begin your journey with a single enchanted tile and unlock new ones as you progress through the levels. Each tile carries unique elemental properties—allowing you to create intricate chains that trigger devastating spells.
Dynamic Spellcasting System
Align your tiles to match rune shapes hidden within each level. The longer your chain and the more precise your patterns, the more powerful your spells become, rewarding you with rare tiles and magical artifacts.
Evolving Challenges
Face an array of progressively complex levels, each introducing new mechanics and environmental hazards. Every level tests your mastery of the spellbook.
Freedom Through Mastery
Every chain you build brings you closer to unlocking the full potential of your spellbook. Can you master the art of tile magic and break free from the book's bindings?
Are you ready to place your first tile and begin the journey to freedom?

title: One Hard Game Please!
description:

One Hard Game Please
Are you ready to test your limits in one of the most challenging rage games out there? One Hard Game Please takes inspiration from the classic "The World's Hardest Game" but cranks the difficulty up to an entirely new level. With movement that’s as tricky to master as the levels themselves, this game is designed to push even the most skilled players to their breaking point.
Core Gameplay
Precision Movement: Once you start moving, there's no stopping! Navigate tight spaces and deadly obstacles while bouncing off walls in this fast-paced, reflex-intensive experience.
Instant Death: Touch anything dangerous, and it’s game over. Respawn at the start of the level and try again—no checkpoints, no mercy.
Retro Pixel Art: Clean, minimalist visuals that keep the focus on the action.
What to Expect
10 Brutal Levels in the Demo: A taste of the chaos to come. Can you conquer these meticulously crafted levels?
100 Levels Planned for Full Release: Each level more devilishly difficult than the last. Perfect your skills and prove your mastery.
Who Is This Game For?
If you crave a real challenge and thrive on skill-based games that test your patience and precision, One Hard Game Please is for you. Whether you're a fan of rage games, looking to push your limits, or just want to prove that you're the best, this game will give you exactly what you’re asking for—and more.
Can you beat the demo? Prove it.

title: Compass of Destiny: Survivors

Endless Waves of Enemies:
Players face more challenging and diverse enemies with each wave.
Dynamic and Infinite Maps:
Various maps set in different locations offer players different strategies. From rural areas to historic streets, the game is played in a variety of areas.
Equipment and Power-ups:
Players can earn new equipment, upgrade existing abilities and gain unique powers between waves.
Content Unlocked Over Time:
Players can unlock new enemies, equipment and abilities as they reach certain levels.
Point System:
The time you survive, the number of enemies you kill, and the level you reach determine your score. This increases competition and encourages players to perform better.
Strategy Advice:
Manage your stamina and limited power carefully. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, so making the right investments in power-ups is critical.
Make good use of the map's features to gain an advantage in tight spaces or scatter enemies in wide areas.
Survivors mode offers gamers a fast-paced, exciting and highly replayable experience.

Each time you play, the world is reborn, offering a fresh experience. Various options to customize any new game are available. Options such as starting with any available upgrades or any amount of gold. Various modes all the way from permadeath to invincible exist with many more in-between.

Combine mathematical concepts to create an arsenal of unique spells. Experiment with:
Geometric patterns for your shields and projectiles
Algebraic equations to create perfectly placed elemental attacks
Vector arithmetic to warp the 3rd dimension with your movement

Plan your moves, strategize your actions, and execute perfectly timed maneuvers to solve challenging puzzles and achieve success. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun challenge or a puzzle enthusiast seeking your next obsession, Record Rewind Repeat offers an experience you won't forget.
Can you master time and logic to conquer all 50 levels?

Enemies are chess pieces with different movement patterns: so, when disguised as one of them, Alice will move with the corresponding scheme. Abilities like resizing, invisibility, and teleporting will help you complete the puzzles.

Chess-based puzzles of increasing complexity.
Stealth sections based on disguises.
Special abilities and effects to discover.
Cute and appealing graphic style.

메뚜기를 잡고 모든 메뚜기를 모아보자!
메뚜기 컬렉션은 본격 메뚜기 잡기 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 어떤 메뚜기가 나올 지 두근거리며 할 수 있는 수집 장르의 게임입니다.
필드에 메뚜기가 있고, 마우스와 키보드만을 이용해 당신은 이 메뚜기를 잡고 스팀 인벤토리에 메뚜기를 쌓을 수 있습니다.
각 메뚜기는 희귀도가 있으며, 플레이어는 메뚜기를 잡을 때마다 다음 확률에 따라 아이템을 획득합니다.
Common : 90%
Rare : 4.5%
Epic : 0.49%
Legendary : 0.01%
모든 메뚜기를 모으고 공식 디스코드에서 자랑해보세요!
autokwd: Grasshopper Collection,나는 메뚜기의 종류를 100가지 이상 알고 있다.

title: Nightmare Owl
description:
게임 정보
나이트메어 올"에서, 벗어날 수 없는 악몽에 갇힌 크리시의 잊혀지지 않는 1인칭 공포 세계로 들어가세요. 그녀는 가족의 오래된 농장에서 사탄의 책을 발견한 후, 악마들이 끊임없이 그녀를 사냥하는 무서운 꿈의 풍경에 갇히게 됩니다. 살아남을 수 있는 유일한 희망은 이 어둡고 뒤틀린 세계에서 탈출할 수 있는 열쇠를 쥐고 있는 신비한 안내자인 애매한 올빼미를 찾는 것입니다. 농장의 으스스한 잔해를 탐색하면서, 그림자 속에 도사리고 있는 악마의 세력을 따돌리고 달아나야 합니다. 길을 밝혀줄 손전등만 있으면, 수수께끼를 발견하고, 숨겨진 단서를 찾고, 밤을 살아남는 데 필요한 모든 수단을 사용할 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 한 걸음 한 걸음 나아갈수록 위험에 더 가까워지고, 오직 올빼미만이 자유로 가는 길을 보여줄 수 있습니다. 두려움에 맞서 악몽의 손아귀를 끊을 용기가 있을까요? 아니면 영원히 어둠 속에 갇히게 될까요?
근접 무기 찾기
--------
무기를 사용하여 물건을 부수거나 악마로부터 자신을 보호하세요. 조심하세요, 악마들은 매우 빠르게 공격합니다!
빨리 손전등을 찾으세요!
---------
대부분의 시간 동안 어둠 속에 있기 때문에 손전등이 필요합니다! 손전등은 일반적으로 악몽 속으로 들어갈 때 가까이에 있습니다.

title: Kimochii Classroom
description:
게임 정보
Hi hi~! This is Akemi signing on!
Welcome to my new game, Kimochii Classroom! An atmospheric, slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story.

Filled to the brim with personality, Kimochii Classroom offers a loveable cast of characters and a meticulously crafted soundscape to bring the world to life!
You will follow Simon, a second year high school student, and his day-to-day life with his friends, coworkers, and little sister. Everyday Simon goes to school, works at his secret part-time job, and studies at home with his best friend Anna. Everything seems normal until Simon comes across a strange object that belongs to his classmate, Felicia. He doesn't know it yet, but he's stumbled into something much more complicated than he realizes.
Get to know the characters!
Annabelle - Annabelle, or 'Anna,' is Simon's best friend, and a classmate of his in class 201. Her outgoing and cheeky personality keeps Simon on his toes, and makes every day enjoyable! Anna is also super close with Chiko, so much so that many people think they're sisters!
Chiko - Chiko is Simon's little sister! She may be small, but she packs enough energy for everyone around her! On top of her already immaculate cooking skills, Chiko is practicing hard everyday to become an amazing singer and guitar player at her school's light music club!
Felicia - Felicia is another member of class 201 with Simon. She's known for her stunning looks and perfect grades, but Felicia is also known for being the heiress to the Arison corporation, a massive company with lots of influence!
Mayuka - 'Mayu' is a bartender and Simon's coworker at the 'Tumultuous Tap,' a local bar establishment Simon works at part time. Mayu is excellent at being professional, but often likes to show off her more playful and teasing side, like when Simon is around!
Support the game on Kickstarter!

title: Necroflora
description:
게임 정보
Necroflora is a strategy roguelike in which you manage a terrifying hydra plant, select strange mutations to wreck havoc on the land.
Bring the chaos
Create your own plant using an array of flowers with different powers and see how it evolves. Feed on the remains of your foes to grow more branches and seek out mana crystals to unlock powerful mutations. The 4 kings have multiple armies all across the lands, only a potent catastrophe could topple their power. Will your hydra grow enough to fill that role?
Mutate, Adapt, Overcome
Using all the tools at your disposal, bio-engineer your very own plant horror. Make it grow, freeze foes, create toxic clouds or even bring back the dead. Everything required for a good time.
5 Plants, offering different starting points and different strategies
10 Flowers, each with their own abilities
30 Mutations to unlock and pick from to increase your hazardousness
10 Foes aiming to get the honor of dealing the final blow to the mighty hydra
10 Biomes to explore and revitalize
4 Kings to topple
Open new horizons
Jump into the minimalist world of Necroflora and watch your hydra grow, offering laid back and relatively short but satisfying play sessions.
Analyze your run and all you and hydra accomplished with a full stats page at the end of each session
Destructible environments, break the means of production
Restore nature and color to the land with various plants in 64 colors

title: Pokettohiro
description:
게임 정보
A group of brave heroes must gather the fragments of the Magic Crystal to face the evil Black Knight and thus prevent the destruction of the kingdom.
Be prepared to discover a huge open world to explore, with secrets and surprises in every corner. Embark on hidden dungeons, forge bonds with villagers and help them solve their problems, discover useful items to progress in your adventure, release imprisoned heroes, and unite them to your cause.
Will these little heroes be able to restore peace to the kingdom?
Features:
Six distinct playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles.
A vast and diverse world, teeming with challenges and secrets to uncover.
Hidden dungeons featuring epic boss battles that will test your skills.
Engaging side quests to assist the villagers and deepen your adventure.
A multitude of collectibles hidden throughout the map, rewarding keen explorers.

title: SkyTaxi
description:
게임 정보
SkyTaxi is a high-energy 2.5D flying taxi game set in a futuristic, cyberpunk world. Players navigate 2D movement within a fully 3D environment, transporting passengers, meeting daily objectives for their boss, and overcoming increasingly complex challenges as they progress.
Core Gameplay
Players take control of a futuristic taxi, navigating a maze of flying bases, dodging obstacles, and keeping an eye on the fuel gauge while racing against the clock. Using impulse-based flight controls, players must skillfully balance gravity to land smoothly and avoid crashes. The core gameplay challenges players to prioritize picking up passengers while managing fuel for maximum efficiency. Additionally, each level features a special box that can be carried and released by the taxi, helping players by destroying drones, stunning robots, and blocking street cleaners, making it easier to pick up passengers from their bases.

title: Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0
description:
게임 정보
Step into the captivating world of Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0, where science and adventure collide! This immersive VR experience lets you explore a vibrant insect science museum filled with live insects and reptiles in stunning macro detail. Shrink to their scale and discover the intricate beauty of their world like never before.
The experience also includes a special room showcasing the legendary Dan Capps Exhibit, one of the world's most extensive insect collections, with over 100 meticulously curated display cases. In this immersive exhibit, experience video recordings of Dan Capps himself, as he pops up throughout the room to guide you through the fascinating world of entomology. Whether you’re marveling at the intricacy of insect anatomy or learning about the rare species Dan has collected, this experience brings the hidden wonders of nature right to your fingertips.
Perfect for science enthusiasts and curious explorers, this immersive experience offers an unforgettable introduction to the rich biodiversity of our planet’s insects and reptiles—all from the comfort of your own space.

title: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater
description:
게임 정보
Murder at the Birch Tree Theater: A Musical Theater Murder Mystery

Uncover high drama in this whodunnit set in a small-town community theater! Gather clues by investigating the sets, casts and backstage crews of 10 theatrical productions, using their stories to piece together each deadly crime.



Explore the theater for clues
The game features 10 levels -- each focused on a deadly incident that occurs during a performance.

Solve mysteries
Gather clues and observe each scenario to deduce what happened.




Infer the story from clues and environments, then fill in the blanks to progress.
autokwd: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater

title: Sneaky Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Sneaky Pirates에서 항해를 시작하세요! 망망대해에서 펼쳐지는 속임수와 전략, 액션의 온라인 먼티플레이어 소셜 추리 게임! 최대 4명의 플레이어가 여러 척의 배들 사이에서 변장하고 몰래 숨어 다니며 상대를 사냥하고 훔치는 치열한 두뇌 싸움을 즐길 수 있습니다.
훔쳐서 승리하기 – 게임이 끝날 때 가장 많은 골드를 획득한 해적이 승리합니다. 동점일 경우, 먼저 훔친 해적이 승리합니다!
군중 속에 숨기 – AI가 조종하는 함선들 사이에 섞여 조심스럽게 다음 행동을 계획하세요.

title: Tapeheads
description:
게임 정보
Tapeheads is a retro-futuristic computer simulation game set in an world where technology took a different path. You receive a replica of the 1983 Sonnenlicht Troika computer system from your uncle. Using the Symbolic79 programming language, solve puzzles sent by your uncle and his friends. Take breaks with included mini-games.

Key Features:
Symbolic79 programming language: Custom language with extensive documentation and examples.
Interpreter with debugging and REPL: Debug and test your code seamlessly with an interactive interpreter and REPL.
Editor with file revisioning: Manage your projects with built-in file revisioning.
Mini-games with logic puzzles: Enjoy engaging mini-games.
Atmospheric sound and graphics: Immerse yourself in a detailed retro-futuristic system.

Artwork from the In-Game Magazine

title: Domovoy
description:
게임 정보
In the game "Domovoy" you will have to dive into a seemingly ordinary apartment, but the further you go, the more HE reveals his essence. This horror game is a first-person walking simulator with a tense atmosphere, explore the apartment, find answers and move on. Are you ready to meet HIM?
Domovoy is not only a guardian of the hearth, but also a vengeful spirit. If ignored or disrespected, it can turn against the owners.

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: Datbyel's Nebula
description:
게임 정보
소개
닻별의 성운은 가벼운 퍼즐과 전투가 포함된 스토리 위주의 게임입니다.
총 두 개의 챕터로 이루어져 있으며, 2챕터는 1챕터를 출시한 후에 개발할 예정입니다.
시놉시스
1992년 9월의 어느 날...
대기업 코넥 에너지를 퇴사한 엘리는 우연히 신비로운 세계 '닻별'에 떨어집니다.
닻별에서 엘리는 기억을 잃은 안치타와 만나고 그와 동행하며 돌아가기 위한 여정을 시작합니다.
엘리는 이 여정 속에서 진정으로 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 깨달을 수 있을까요?

title: My Café Manager Simulator
description:
게임 정보
내면의 기업가 정신을 발휘하세요! 리노베이션, 제품 선택, 고객 서비스, 야외 분위기 사이의 균형을 맞추어 궁극적인 카페 경험을 구축하고 고객이 다시 찾게 만드세요.
다양한 제품을 주문하여 선반을 채우고 고객을 만족시킵니다. 고급 커피 원두, 맛있는 페이스트리 또는 수공예 간식 등, 올바른 재고는 경쟁에서 차별화될 것입니다.

title: Dark Symphony
description:
게임 정보
In the dead of night, amidst the ominous whispers of the forest, a nightmare awakens. Welcome to Dark Symphony, a spine-chilling first-person horror experience that plunges you into a haunting tale of obsession, madness, and survival.



Story
You are John, a man who wakes from a restless sleep beside his wife in your secluded cabin deep in the woods. Your peaceful night is shattered by the eerie mumblings of an unnamed man outside, searching desperately for his lost vinyl records. He scattered these six records in his drunken stupor, each containing a movement from Percy Grainger's "Lincolnshire Posy," throughout the forest clearing. The man, driven to the brink of madness by his obsession with this music, will stop at nothing to retrieve them.

The stakes are terrifyingly high. The strange man is temporarily distracted as the records play, giving you precious moments to locate and place the remaining records on one of the six gramophones scattered around the clearing. But beware: if he catches you, he will chase you down and end your life. Should the current gramophone finish playing before you find the next record, the man will storm into your cabin and kill your sleeping wife, ending your desperate quest in horror and failure.











Can you unravel the mystery of the strange man and his cursed records? Will you save your wife and escape the forest alive? The gramophones are waiting, and the night is closing in. Prepare yourself for a journey into darkness, where every decision could be your last.

title: MEGARACER QUANTUMRUSH
description:
게임 정보
MegaRacer QuantumRush - 궁극의 VR 오픈 월드 레이싱 경험
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 VR 레이싱 게임의 새로운 기준을 제시하는 몰입형 오픈 월드 카트 레이싱 게임입니다. 거대한 미래 도시 Mega City를 배경으로, 귀여운 애니메이션 스타일의 캐릭터와 독창적인 카트를 운전하며 다양한 모드를 즐길 수 있습니다. 이 게임은 모든 연령대의 플레이어가 몰입하고 즐길 수 있도록 설계되었으며, 초보자부터 숙련자까지 만족시킬 다채로운 콘텐츠를 제공합니다.
다양한 게임 모드
MegaRacer QuantumRush는 단순히 레이싱을 넘어선 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 다음과 같은 다양한 게임 모드를 통해 끊임없이 새로운 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다:
스트리트 레이싱: Mega City의 도심을 질주하며 빠른 속도와 민첩성을 요구하는 레이스를 즐기세요.
장애물 레이싱: 전략적인 플레이가 필요한 이 모드에서는 복잡한 장애물을 극복하며 우승을 노립니다.
왕관 쟁탈전: 정해진 시간 안에 왕관을 쟁취하고, 끝까지 방어해 승리하세요.
축구 모드: 레이싱과 축구가 결합된 독창적인 모드로, 카트를 이용해 공을 몰고 골을 넣으며 팀워크를 발휘하세요.
Mega City를 탐험하며 10여 종 이상의 색다른 모드와 특별한 이벤트를 발견하고 도전해 보세요.
VR에 최적화된 몰입감과 편안함

title: Blow Out
description:
게임 정보
👾Aliens are attacking!! 👾
🔫But all our weapons are useless! 🔫
🌬 So it's up to Mr. Blow (no relation) to BLOW 🌬 them 🌬 away 🌬

Blow Out is a "Non violent" arcade game where you can't kill your enemies, you can only blow them back
It's very fun. Trust me.

There is a demo coming soon so please Wishlist so you can see it

title: Welcome to Neokyo City
description:
게임 정보
In a city governed by drones and powered by neon gas, hope soars through the rooftops in the form of a rogue human. Jump across rooftops, hack powerboxes, and avoid the ever present drones that oppress the citizens of Neokyo City in this open-world 2D platformer.

title: Elemental Seasons
description:
게임 정보
Elemental Seasons is a brutal exploration and survival game set in a seasonal themed world. Explore each biome, defeat every boss to earn the chance to escape this world!
EXPLORE THE SEASONAL BIOMES
Immerse yourself in a breathtaking new world divided into four unique biomes inspired by the beauty of each seasons. Explore the valley of autumn, the thick woods of summer, the rebirth in spring and the death of winter. Each biome offers its own unique challenges, secrets, and stunning visuals.
DEFEAT ELEMENTAL TITANS
Prepare for epic battles against 4 elemental titans, each embodying the power of nature. Face the fury of Fire, the uncontrollable wrath of Water, the raging tempest of Air, and the crushing strength of Earth. Each fight is a test of skill and survival against the elements themselves.
BRUTAL YET FAIR COMBAT
Face challenging combat where enemies wield elemental strengths, but you can counter them by consuming specific foods or rely solely on your skill to parry every strike. Every enemy attack can be parried with precision, negating all damage. Be a parry master or stack the odds in your favor, the choice is yours.
KEY FEATURES:
The world consists of 4 biomes each with its unique enemies and resources.
Parry based combat where the player can afford to not eat anything and still win boss fights.
Rewarding food system that gives an edge to players who need it.
Epic boss fights that will satisfy the player's fantasies of being able to control different elements.

title: Batter Up
description:
게임 정보
Batter Up is a rogue-lite arena shooter where you bounce a baseball around the map to kill the undead. The game features 3 biomes and a variety of enemies to battle through. With over 50+ items to choose from for your builds, you can create chaotic and downright overpowered synergies to mow through enemies.

Features
50 unique upgrade items
3 biomes to collect unique items in
3 unique bosses to fight
Multiple map variations
30 minute runs
1-2 minute waves

title: Party Madness
description:
게임 정보
Party Madness is a 2-4 player online party game. Compete with your friends in wacky mini-games, collect points, and claim victory!
UNIQUE MINIGAMES!
Every mini-game in Party Madness is pure chaos! One moment you're escaping an angry octopus in the ocean, the next you're in the middle of a bank heist dodging lasers — and just when you think it’s over, you’re driving through a desert with meteors raining down on you. Dodge, laugh, and grab the cash!
EVERY GAME IS A NEW CHALLENGE!

title: Clean Stack
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
Clean Stack is a little puzzle game that involves stacking odd-sized objects with fun physics without making anything touch the ground. There are lots of different objects, which creates some bizarre situations. You'll also need to use potions on the objects to get through the levels, which makes the game even more challenging!

About Clean Stack
Clean Stack is a extended version of a game made in the GMTK 2024 gamejam. The game is way longer with a bunch of new mechanics. The game has been designed to provide a pleasant, relaxing experience while retaining some challenge. In addition, there is more bananas.
Key Features:
its literally FREE
65 levels
Around 3-4 hours of gameplay
A ton of fun and weird achievements
25+ differents items to play with
6 potions to make chaotic situations
A silly blue monster to annoy guide you though the game
An hard difficulty gamemode
Bananas
And all the passion of a person in their creation
Bananas

title: Adhvan Chakra
description:
게임 정보
Command powerful aerial units known as Vaahans, and lead your squadron of airborne warriors to victory with innovative macro-based controls.
Command and manage a wide variety of unique Vaahans, each with distinct abilities and tactics, to outsmart relentless enemy factions.
Turn the tide of battle by strategically altering the attack, defense, and speed of your units and even your opponents. With fully simulated physics, every unit and object react dynamically. Manipulate enemy mass and speed to outmaneuver and overpower them.
The enemy is relentless. Gather every resource you can and extract before it's too late.
Outsmart your foes through in-depth research and analysis. Encounter a vast array of enemies, each with unique traits to study. Challenge powerful bosses at any time; but victory demands matching their firepower.
Discover the Gorger system: a revolutionary RPG elemental interaction mechanic where a unit's composition defines its resistances and vulnerabilities. Study your opponents' physical traits, analyze their constitution, and exploit their weaknesses to gain the upper hand.

title: Orbcraft Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Orbcraft Survivors는 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 시간 생존 게임입니다. 오브를 제작하고 강력한 특성을 부여해 점점 강해지세요.
같은 오브를 합성하여 더 강력한 형태로 강화하고, 특성을 적용해 효과를 극대화하세요. 다양한 조합을 실험해 압도적인 마법을 발동시키고, 몰아치는 적의 물결 속에서 살아남으세요.
각 캐릭터는 최대 6개 이상의 오브를 장착할 수 있으며, 각각 고유한 스킬을 보유하고 있습니다. 오브를 합성하여 더욱 강력하게 만들고, 3레벨 오브를 해방하여 전장을 지배하세요.
50개 이상의 특성이 다양한 등급으로 존재하며, 전투마다 새로운 조합과 전략이 펼쳐집니다. 강력한 시너지를 발견하고, 운과 전략을 시험하며, 매번 새로운 경험을 만들어보세요!

title: Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade
description:
게임 정보
Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade is a fast-paced slalom 'em up fantasy roguelite, featuring beloved household name Gob Johnson himself.
Avoid obstacles, smash into enemies, collect marmalade boons and do sick tricks.
A Radical Roguelite
Start at the top of the highest peak and race to the the deepest depths to catch the sickest air.
Each run down the Great Mountain is different. Choose your path.
Unlock all Gob's friends
Unlock and play as a bunch of different characters, who all have unique powers.
Collect powerful marmalade boons
Collect Enchanted Marmalade to choose from a ton of boons.
Journey through the Radicallion on your quest
The world of Radicallion has many biomes to explore as you descend it's peak. Race down the mountain, skid through the mines, cause havoc in the city and much more.

title: Old Hero
description:
게임 정보
Old Hero is a short (15h or so) JRPG with early 90s graphics and gameplay but with modern storytelling and quality-of-life features.
STORY
The story begins with Rufus training his swordplay on the local beach. He daydreams to himself about his trip to the local abandoned tower that the villages call Icehenge due to its magical ice walls. His brother and sister agreed to take him there for the first time to see the bats and ghosts.
Imogen is eavesdropping as Rufus talks to himself and invites herself along, not that Rufus is having any of it. They argue a little but agree to go back to the village together.
The day after, a strange coincidence at the castle means Imogen takes Edmund's place to go to Icehenge. But a strange hooded figure is waiting there and when the group return, the local castle has been raided. The party travel to the king but encounter setback after setback that eventually sends them a long, long way from home.

title: Star Freight
description:
게임 정보
Can you deliver the goods? Board your old but still trusted spaceship and get ready to haul cargo. But fuel is expensive, so make sure to choose the optimal route!

Star Freight is a space-themed puzzle game, featuring:

- a selection of 100 puzzles of increasing difficulty
- unique packing and route choice challenges

title: Desktop Cat
description:
게임 정보
In this version, you can experience the following features:
- A black cat that freely roams and interacts with your mouse.
- Real-time weather updates displayed on your desktop.
- Pinball minigame where you can collect score and win items.
- Up to 20 collectible digital paintings to decorate your desktop.
- Summon idle friends to appear and hang out on your screen.
This version is designed to give you a glimpse of the final product's interactive features and visual style. It runs independently as a desktop overlay, providing a playful and artistic companion to your daily workspace.

title: Prison Escape io
description:
게임 정보
감옥에서 탈출하세요—함께!🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ 경비원을 따돌리고 대탈출을 할 수 있다고 생각하세요? 친구와 팀을 이루거나 이 가슴 뛰는 멀티플레이어 모험에서 경쟁하세요! 함정이 가득한 환기구, 비밀 터널, 경비가 있는 복도를 함께 탐험하거나 서로를 앞지르기 위해 경쟁하세요. 길을 따라 동전을 모아 세련된 의상을 잠금 해제하고 성과를 높이세요. 상황이 어려울 때 파워업이 구세주가 될 테니 주의하세요. 여러분과 여러분의 팀은 너무 늦기 전에 탈출할 수 있을까요?
멀티플레이어의 즐거움을 위해 디자인된 게임 모드
👮 Prison Break: 친구와 힘을 합쳐 탈출 계획을 조정하거나 누가 먼저 탈출할 수 있는지 경쟁하세요. 자랑할 권리도 있습니다!
🔍 Glass Bridge: 신뢰와 타이밍의 시험! 팀과 협력하여 올바른 유리 패널을 선택하거나, 유리 패널을 남겨두고 혼자 결승선까지 경주하세요.
🌈 오브비 레인보우: 다채롭고 협력적인 수직 여행 - 친구를 돕거나 누가 더 빨리 오르는지 경쟁하세요.
재미를 계속 유지하기 위한 기능
🎭 기발하고 독특한 캐릭터 라인업에서 선택하고 감옥 탈출 팀에 완벽하게 맞는 캐릭터를 찾으세요.
⚡ 파워업으로 게임플레이를 강화하여 친구보다 빠르게 달리고 우위를 점하세요.
🎁 함께 재미를 공유할 수 있는 흥미진진한 일일 보상을 받으세요.
🎮 여러 게임 모드에 뛰어들어 그룹의 참여를 유지하세요.
🌍 친구와 함께 새로운 장소를 발견하고 탐험하세요. 각 장소는 이전 장소보다 더 스릴 넘칩니다.

title: Super Bouncy Gumball Party
description:
게임 정보
Destroy the Bricks - Defend the Blocks - Collect the Gems
Run, jump and bounce the Super Bouncy Gumball to break the Bricks in each stage, but be warned; Every hit increases the speed and the Blocks you stand on can be damaged and destroyed as well.  
• The Goodies
Make use of Power-Ups like the classic Double Jump, the fun Low Gravity or the game changing Super Bubble to reach the Bonus Stage and set the Hi Score.  
• The Baddies
Fight different types of enemies, including Slimes, Zombies, Exploding Bombs, Aliens, Wizards and more.
• The Heroes
Unlock a cast of silly characters to play as, such as a cute Kitty, a grumpy Vampire or an acrobatic Ninja.  
• The Universe
Each of the 8 Worlds introduces a new gameplay mechanic like Bouncy Pads, Bumpers and Portals. 
• The Buddies
Play the entire game, locally with a friend.  Any saved game can be played Co-Op or Solo mode.

title: Anomaly 13
description:
게임 정보
WARNING:
There is a risk of seizures related to photosensitivity. Some people may experience seizures triggered by flashing lights and flickering images, which are common in video games. Even those who have never had such seizures before might be unaware of their condition. We recommend a reasonable restriction on the audience for the game.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game in the walking simulator genre with puzzle elements. As a prospective buyer, Cooper Evans, you will explore a mysterious house and try to uncover its secrets.
Explore the house's surroundings.
Pay attention to changes in the environment.
Solve puzzles and complete assigned tasks.
Overview:
The Anti-Anomaly Organization (AAO) has identified a unique anomaly, designated as "13." To study it in detail, AAO agents have installed hidden cameras in a mysterious house that is soon to be auctioned.
The protagonist, eager to purchase the house at a bargain price, decides to make it their new home. As you move in with your belongings, you remain unaware of the strange events awaiting you.
Anomaly 13 is a horror game that emphasizes shifts in time and space.

title: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2
description:
게임 정보
동화탑방어는 3D 만화풍의 탑방어게임으로서 게임에는 많은 관문이 있는데 매 관문마다 게임을 시작할 때 소량의 자원을 주어 몬스터를 처치하면 더욱 많은 자원을 얻을수 있다.
게임에서 각 몬스터의 생명치와 이동 속도가 다릅니다. 몬스터가 에너지 보호막을 가지고 있을 때 생명치가 높아집니다.
호박포탑은 보호막에 대한 피해가 비교적 높고, 나머지 포탑은 보호막에 대한 피해가 비교적 낮다.
게임에는 한 무리의 몬스터에게 데미지를 입힐 수 있는 폭발 마법이 있으며, 고혈량 몬스터에 대한 데미지는 백분율 데미지이다.
피쳐:
6 가지 승급 가능한 방어포탑
마법 1개
포탑과 마법을 승급할 수 있는 스킬 트리
16종 몬스터(일반 몬스터 8종 + 보호막이 있는 일반 몬스터 8종)
25개 관문
autokwd: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2

title: Tiled Tower
description:
게임 정보
¡Clear levels! ¡Climb the tower!
In this puzzle game you will have to clear different levels by using your wits.
Walk on the tiles to advance, but be careful!
If you break a tile... you will fall.
You will have to step on every tile, shattering them, and finally step on the exit tile. But avoid stepping on any shattered tile, or it will break.
Several mechanincs will add complexity to the puzzles, such as:
Obstacles
Reinforced tiles
Teleporters
Reinforcer tiles
Etc.

title: Pirate Game!
description:
게임 정보
Journey to the 17th century Caribbean and take the wheel of a ship as Captain George Somers, James Riskinner or Joseph Bannister, three historical figures  during the "Golden Age of Piracy".

title: The Unrested
description:
게임 정보
버려진 기숙학교… 조용한 복도를 울리는 발자국 소리… 그리고 과거에서 돌아온 복수의 영혼…
몇 년 전, 기숙학교에서 일어난 비극적인 사건이 당신의 소중한 친구를 앗아갔습니다. 그러나 이 이야기는 죽음으로 끝나지 않았습니다. 이제, 당신은 편지를 통해 그 어두운 과거로 다시 호출되었습니다. 이 버려진 학교의 폐허 속에서, 당신의 친구의 불안한 영혼이 기다리고 있습니다.
버려진 방을 탐험하고, 숨겨진 열쇠를 찾고, 치명적인 위험의 손아귀에서 탈출하려고 노력하세요. 하지만 조심하세요… 그들은 당신의 모든 움직임을 지켜보고 있으며, 이번에는 당신을 무서워하게 만드는 것만으로 끝나지 않을 것입니다.

title: Jewel Match Solitaire Fantasy - Collector's Edition
description:
게임 정보
Experience a fresh new take on solitaire — in an epic adventure, where magic and strategy intertwine. Embark on a solitaire adventure to restore majestic castles to their dazzling glory, as you traverse over 1,000 spellbinding levels. Play timeless classic solitaire variants like Klondike and Spider, alongside wondrous new creations such as Lady Beth, Spire, and San Martino.
Help a cast of fantasy characters to overcome magical obstacles such as mischievous frogs, mystical barriers, and fiery blazes. Your quest will take you on a journey that includes Supersize, Challenge, Sliding and Match-2 levels.
Unlock powerful upgrades to enhance your journey, and choose from a variety of beautifully designed card decks. Tailor your adventure to your style with four unique modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed. Explore every level for hidden treasures and strive to achieve the legendary "Perfect" score.
autokwd: Jewel Match Solitaire Fantasy - Collector's Edition

title: Tilebound
description:
게임 정보
Tilebound is a captivating blend of strategy, puzzle-solving, and magical combat, where every tile you place shapes your destiny. You are a novice Tile Wizard, bound to an ancient spellbook, seeking freedom by mastering the art of building powerful tile chains and unleashing elemental spells.
Key Features:
Strategic Tile Placement
Begin your journey with a single enchanted tile and unlock new ones as you progress through the levels. Each tile carries unique elemental properties—allowing you to create intricate chains that trigger devastating spells.
Dynamic Spellcasting System
Align your tiles to match rune shapes hidden within each level. The longer your chain and the more precise your patterns, the more powerful your spells become, rewarding you with rare tiles and magical artifacts.
Evolving Challenges
Face an array of progressively complex levels, each introducing new mechanics and environmental hazards. Every level tests your mastery of the spellbook.
Freedom Through Mastery
Every chain you build brings you closer to unlocking the full potential of your spellbook. Can you master the art of tile magic and break free from the book's bindings?
Are you ready to place your first tile and begin the journey to freedom?

title: One Hard Game Please!
description:
게임 정보
One Hard Game Please
Are you ready to test your limits in one of the most challenging rage games out there? One Hard Game Please takes inspiration from the classic "The World's Hardest Game" but cranks the difficulty up to an entirely new level. With movement that’s as tricky to master as the levels themselves, this game is designed to push even the most skilled players to their breaking point.
Core Gameplay
Precision Movement: Once you start moving, there's no stopping! Navigate tight spaces and deadly obstacles while bouncing off walls in this fast-paced, reflex-intensive experience.
Instant Death: Touch anything dangerous, and it’s game over. Respawn at the start of the level and try again—no checkpoints, no mercy.
Retro Pixel Art: Clean, minimalist visuals that keep the focus on the action.
What to Expect
10 Brutal Levels in the Demo: A taste of the chaos to come. Can you conquer these meticulously crafted levels?
100 Levels Planned for Full Release: Each level more devilishly difficult than the last. Perfect your skills and prove your mastery.
Who Is This Game For?
If you crave a real challenge and thrive on skill-based games that test your patience and precision, One Hard Game Please is for you. Whether you're a fan of rage games, looking to push your limits, or just want to prove that you're the best, this game will give you exactly what you’re asking for—and more.
Can you beat the demo? Prove it.

title: Compass of Destiny: Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Compass of Destiny: Survivors
Using assets from Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, Survivors mode is a special game mode that heavily features action and survival elements. Set in the mystical atmosphere of Istanbul, players must survive against ever-increasing waves of enemies.
Key Features of the mode:
Endless Waves of Enemies:
Players face more challenging and diverse enemies with each wave.
Dynamic and Infinite Maps:
Various maps set in different locations offer players different strategies. From rural areas to historic streets, the game is played in a variety of areas.
Equipment and Power-ups:
Players can earn new equipment, upgrade existing abilities and gain unique powers between waves.
Content Unlocked Over Time:
Players can unlock new enemies, equipment and abilities as they reach certain levels.
Point System:
The time you survive, the number of enemies you kill, and the level you reach determine your score. This increases competition and encourages players to perform better.
Strategy Advice:
Manage your stamina and limited power carefully. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, so making the right investments in power-ups is critical.
Make good use of the map's features to gain an advantage in tight spaces or scatter enemies in wide areas.
Survivors mode offers gamers a fast-paced, exciting and highly replayable experience.

title: The Squirrel & Sea
description:
게임 정보
"다람쥐와 바다" 는 수중 2.5D 마우스 전용 고난이도 게임입니다.
노를 저어 바닷속 세계를 탐험하세요.
카약을 젓는 느낌을 상상해 보세요.
해파리, 물고기, 바다표범 등 다양한 해양 생물을 만나게 될 것입니다.
플레이 시간: 8시간 이상 ~ 무한대.
마지막 승자는 무료 버블 스킨을 받을 수 있습니다.
진행도를 여러 번 잃을 수도 있습니다.
게임의 스토리와 배경은 진행하면서 점차 드러납니다.
절대 포기하지 마세요!

title: Murder Inc
description:
게임 정보
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.
You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.
Features:
Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

title: Record Rewind Repeat
description:
게임 정보
"A clever take on the time-loop mechanic that will have you feeling brilliant one moment and clumsy the next." - Indie Game Buzz Editor

Record Rewind Repeat is a mind-bending puzzle-platformer that tests your timing, logic, and reflexes. Navigate 50 meticulously crafted levels where every move matters. Use a unique time-recording mechanic to create duplicates of yourself and work together across time to overcome intricate puzzles and platforming challenges.
Key Features:
Innovative Time Manipulation Gameplay: Record your actions, rewind to the past, and collaborate with your time-duplicates to solve puzzles.
50 Handcrafted Levels: Each level introduces new mechanics and challenges, testing your logic, timing, and platforming precision.
Simple to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls make it accessible to all players, while the puzzles grow in complexity to keep you engaged.
Minimalistic 3D Art Style: A clean, distraction-free visual aesthetic that highlights the puzzles and gameplay.
For All Ages: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves puzzles and platformers.
Plan your moves, strategize your actions, and execute perfectly timed maneuvers to solve challenging puzzles and achieve success. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun challenge or a puzzle enthusiast seeking your next obsession, Record Rewind Repeat offers an experience you won't forget.
Can you master time and logic to conquer all 50 levels?
Wishlist now and start your time-manipulating journey!

title: Go To Sleep
description:
게임 정보
Was that door always open? Or is something peeking out from inside the closet? Is that breathing yours or is that just the demon under the bed waiting for you to close your eyes?
Go To Sleep is a short first-person point-and-click survival horror game where you play as a young teen trapped in a dream-turned-nightmare. Stuck in his bedroom, you must survive until morning keeping a relentless demon at bay with your only source of support being a tiny stuffed companion.
Will you make it until the morning?

title: Agora
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Agora: The Future of Digital Board Gaming
Step into Agora, a social-driven board game platform that connects players and independent studios in immersive 3D environments. Discover unique games, meet new friends, and enjoy seamless digital gameplay.
Key Features:
🎲 Play Unique Board Games – Explore a curated selection of independent titles with built-in rule enforcement for smooth gameplay.
🌍 Immersive 3D Environments – Play in stunning, game-specific settings that enhance every match.
🗣️ Social-First Gaming – Join voice channels, meet new friends, and recreate the magic of in-person board game nights.
🛒 Support Independent Studios – Discover and support innovative board game creators.
🎭 Express Yourself – Customize your avatar with unique skins and accessories.
🔥 Free – Play for free alone or with some friends!
Why Choose Agora?
Unlike other platforms, Agora prioritizes quality with immersive 3D environments, automated rules, and strong social features. Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer, Agora is the ultimate destination for digital board gaming.
🚀 Join the Beta Today and Be Part of the Future of Board Gaming!

title: Arachnoid
description:
게임 정보
Arachnoid is an intense survival horror game where moving into an abandoned home turns into a nightmare. Clean the house by picking up trash, move boxes inside to unpack, and drive your car to complete various tasks. At first, it's just an old house with a few creaks and shadows. But as the days pass, you realize you're not alone - something is watching, crawling, waiting. The house is infested with giant, intelligent spiders, and they are not in a hurry to reveal themselves. Run from the giant spiders, until you find a way to fight them. Finding a shotgun, you are able to find and carry ammo to fight against these monsters.
Uncover the dark mystery behind the infestation while solving puzzles and completing quests to survive. But as the horror escalates, so does the fight. After finding a shotgun with limited ammo, you'll have to decide when to run, when to hide, and when to face the nightmare head-on. The spiders aren't just lurking in the corners - they scale wall crawl across ceilings, and hunt in groups.
With a slow-burning atmosphere that builds into heart-pounding terror, Arachnoid will test your nerves. Will you make it through, or will the spiders claim their next victim?

title: The Music at the end of the World
description:
게임 정보
Shape the Story with Your Choices:
As a new ice age slowly pushes the world toward extinction, witness the experiences of the Narrator, one of the few remaining survivors. In this choice-driven game, you will determine the fate of the character telling the story and how it all ends. In a world on the brink of destruction, where loneliness has become a form of madness, decide what the Narrator will do under conditions no sane person could endure.
You can keep your body warm, but can you protect your mind from the cold?
Experience the winter that brought the apocalypse and the solitude of an abandoned world. The journey of the Narrator, seemingly impossible yet somehow real, is in your hands. Shape the course of the story with your choices. While doing so, try to preserve both the Narrator’s sanity and your own.
autokwd: The Music at the end of the World

title: Food Truck Monopoly
description:
게임 정보
Food Truck Monopoly is a simulation game where you step into the shoes of a food truck worker on a mission to manage a business. Navigate bustling city streets, take orders from demanding customers, cook up delicious meals under pressure, and keep your food truck rolling. Balance speed, accuracy, and $ management to stay ahead of the competition and survive as long as possible. Upgrade your truck, explore new neighborhood, and serve mouthwatering dishes to dominate the food truck scene!

title: Spell Magic
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure in various procedurally generated open worlds, where magic and mathematics collide. In Spell Magic, you'll craft and master powerful spells using the fundamental forces of arithmetic, geometry, and algebra.
As a skilled mathemagician, you'll explore a vast, ever-changing realm, teeming with fearsome monsters and challenging puzzles. Your quest is to unravel the secrets of the mystical arts, harnessing the power of numbers to bend reality to your will.
Explore Procedurally Generated Worlds
Each time you play, the world is reborn, offering a fresh experience. Various options to customize any new game are available. Options such as starting with any available upgrades or any amount of gold. Various modes all the way from permadeath to invincible exist with many more in-between.
Craft Your Spells
Combine mathematical concepts to create an arsenal of unique spells. Experiment with:
Geometric patterns for your shields and projectiles
Algebraic equations to create perfectly placed elemental attacks
Vector arithmetic to warp the 3rd dimension with your movement

title: Touhou Volleyball Danmaku
description:
게임 정보
The latest sensation to hit Gensokyo, Volleyball! But this isn't an ordinary game of volleyball.
The skies are your court as you will pick a team of two of your favorite Touhou characters. They will not only attempt to keep the ball in play but also avoid the bullets coming your way, all while dishing out your own attacks!
Story
One day in Gensokyo, everyone woke up to find their powers absent, including our resident incident solvers, Reimu and Marisa. But when Sakuya suddenly appears before them, a great revelation is made. A strange orb has appeared in Gensokyo with the power to take away abilities and grant them as it sees fit. Our heroines are on another case, going from place to place, challenging their friends in this new sport that has taken Gensokyo by storm.

title: Polytopia Island
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Polytopia, an immersive survival adventure where every decision shapes your journey. Spawn on a desolate beach and explore a world filled with diverse biomes, including scorching deserts, frozen winterlands, and lush forests. Gather essential resources like iron, lead, gold, and silver to craft tools, build shelters, and thrive in this open-world sandbox.
Embark on thrilling quests, such as uncovering secrets hidden in abandoned housing developments, battling zombie hordes, and unlocking blueprints for advanced crafting stations. Whether you choose to survive alone or collaborate with friends, Polytopia offers endless possibilities and challenges in a vibrant, ever-evolving environment.
Are you ready to carve out your path and conquer the wilds of Polytopia?

title: ZeroFactory

특징
이 게임은 현실 세계 장면을 스캔하여 완전히 개발되었으며, 상세하고 사실적인 비주얼을 제공합니다.

문화적 배경
2022년부터 2024년까지 예술가 푸샤오웨는 현장 조사 중에 여러 구포우(Gupo Wu) 유적지를 발견했으며, 대부분은 붕괴 또는 철거 위험에 처해 있었습니다. 2023년, 푸샤오웨는 올드미디어의 팡정과 쉬슈셴과 협력하여 3D 기술을 사용해 기록이 드문 독신 여성들의 집단 공간을 보존했습니다. 조사 결과를 바탕으로 자가머리(Self-comb Women) 여성들의 삶의 서사를 엮어 게임을 통해 역사적 기록에서 주변화된 여성 공동체를 더 많은 사람들에게 소개하고자 합니다. 이 게임의 모든 공간 장면은 주강 삼각주 지역 구포우의 현장 스캔을 기반으로 하고 있습니다.
자수녀: 중국 봉건 시대에 주강 삼각주 지역에서 평생 결혼하지 않기로 선택한 여성들.
구포우: 자수녀들이 공동으로 건설한 건축물로, 요양, 예배, 일상 생활의 공간으로 기능하며 독특한 여성 커뮤니티를 형성했습니다.
플레이 시간
약 45~60분.
주의: 이 게임은 공포 게임이 아닙니다.

Arcade gameplay: play through three different levels with unique challenges and enemies, fighting off 60 waves of enemies. Play in arcade mode to go for the highscore.
Turn-based and real-time: with a hybrid real-time and turn-based combat system, you can plan your moves to execute glorious attacks while still feeling fast-paced and frantic.
Unique weapons: Master 6 unique weapons to take down HackerGuy and his minions. Ambush your enemies, dodge their attacks, and choose the best tool for the job as you switch weapons frantically in this arcade game.
Cartoon story: 4 unique animated cutscenes that will remind you of your favorite cartoons.
and much more!

title: Warrior Duels
description:
게임 정보
Warrior Duels is an immersive online trading card game that pits two legendary warriors from distinct historical factions against each other in a duel of skill, strength, and strategy.  Choose from preconstructed decks or build your own, play against opponents from around the world, or challenge the AI.
Warrior Duels is completely free with built-in tutorials to teach the game mechanics.  Simple to learn, challenging to master!
Choose from 7 different warriors, each with unique abilities
Build custom decks with powerful attacks, defenses, and tactical cards
Outmaneuver your opponent with skillful card combinations
Make attacks concealed, unblockable, or undodgeable to avoid defenses
Used tactical cards that favor your faction's skills
Seven different factions offer unique gameplay each having different strengths.  Barbarians are attack focused with little regard for defenses.  The Ninja relies on concealment and sneak attacks, the Samurai uses lightning quick attacks and defenses.

title: Konpira Fune Fune
description:
게임 정보
전통적인 일본 파티 게임에서 영감을 받은 빠른 템포의 턴제 대결에 뛰어들어 리듬을 완벽하게 마스터해 보세요.
                           상대를 선택하고 정교한 타이밍으로 앞서나가며, 액티브와 패시브 업그레이드를 통해 강력한 시너지를 구축하세요. 승리를 위해서는 단순한 실력뿐만 아니라 자원을 신중하게 관리해야 더 어려운 도전에 도달할 수 있습니다.

빠른 속도의 리듬 기반 전투로 전략과 즉각적인 반응을 융합합니다.
모든 선택이 중요합니다. 전투를 현명하게 골라 포인트를 획득하고, 업그레이드에 투자하면서도 진행을 위한 자금을 아껴야 합니다.
무작위로 등장하는 적과 점차 어려워지는 난이도로 인해 무한한 재플레이가 가능합니다.

                         전략적 업그레이드 & 깊이 있는 콤보
다양한 업그레이드를 조합해 플레이 방식을 자유롭게 설계하세요:
액티브 & 패시브 능력 – 반응 속도를 높이고, 적을 교란하며, 리듬 기반 전략을 극대화하세요.

title: Bunny Ball
description:
게임 정보
귀엽고 아늑한 액션! 버니볼과 다른 동물들을 모아보세요! Pinball과 Breakout이 혼합된 게임에서 아이들이 음식을 얻을 수 있도록 도와주세요!
50개 이상의 레벨에서 즐기는 캐주얼한 재미
선택할 수 있는 많은 동물

차분한 분위기와 음악을 즐기세요

title: Escape From kiss
description:
게임 정보
잠에서 깨어나 보니 기묘한 마을에 갇혀 있습니다.
광적인 구애자가 뒤에서 당신과 키스하려고 접근하고 있어요!
마을에 있는 모든 오두막이 첫 번째 오두막과 완전히 동일한지 판단해 탈출 열쇠를 얻어야 합니다.
company: CE JIN_策今, MI YU Studio_谜予网络游戏工作室

title: Dreamrealms Resurgence
description:
게임 정보
Seek solace in your pastoral hometown — until eerie dreams corrupt the villagers. Cultivate your homestead to harvest prosperity, then against the encroaching nightmare!
Features
Tend Crops, Chop Lumber, Reel in Fish — Stock Your Inventory & Forge Your Adventure!

title: Square Brothers
description:
게임 정보
Two bandit brothers, One epic heist!
 Two sly siblings, one crazy platforming heist- ready to steal everything that shines?
 Team up with two green-skinned burglar brothers on a quest for glittering gold. Switch between the tall, lanky thief to reach elevated platforms, and his short, stocky accomplice to slip under narrow gaps. Only by using their unique shapes together can you collect every shiny treasure, snag the key, and escape to the exit.

title: Shadows of the Blade
description:
게임 정보
Description
A classic platformer that focuses on a simple but dynamic combat system and puzzle solving.
Gameplay Core
Here you will not only have to run forward and defeat enemies, but sometimes you will also have to hide in the shadows, hack systems and solve puzzles.
Early Access
The game will be gradually updated, adding new levels and mechanics. I will try to balance different parts of the gameplay so that the game does not slide into only action or constant puzzles.

title: Darkest Descent
description:
게임 정보
You are a lost soul wandering through the ruins of a long forgotten society. You and up to seven other friends are tasked with protecting Jane, a young woman trapped in a perpetual cycle of death and rebirth. Use powerful spells and weapons to fight your way through the stronghold to uncover ancient knowledge and meet a powerful deity held deep within its chambers.
Gather a team of 8 souls controlling one vessel and face unknowable dangers in this cooperative turn-based dungeon crawler. Collect unique skill and spell cards that will aid you and your team in combat. Each card provides a unique benefit, granting useful buffs to one of your friends, weakening an enemy, mending your teammates wounds and damaging monsters that block your path.
Coordination and cooperation is important for success, maybe you have a party member that specializes entirely on damage, maybe they could use a little bit of healing every now and then! You may even a whole team of casters that needs a quick boost to their spells, or you could all focus on making one party member a powerhouse capable of annihilating anything in their path!

title: Project 2025 Text Based Story Board
description:
게임 정보
Overview:
Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is an AI-powered interactive story creation platform that enables users to craft unique narratives using their own AI service APIs. This tool does not include any built-in API keys - users must provide their own valid AI service credentials.
【Core Features】
- Trilingual Support: Full compatibility with Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English
- Dynamic Story Engine: Generates organic narrative branching
【System Requirements】
• Valid AI service API key (e.g., DeepSeek/Local LLM)
• Stable internet connection
• Basic text processing capability
Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is a narrative tool that transforms your AI service API into a powerful storytelling engine.
[Important Notice]
This tool does not include any built-in API services. Users must provide their own valid AI service credentials to access all features.

title: ARVIS Knock Out!
description:
게임 정보
The fight is coming to your hands!
After boxing with you in VR with ARVIS Punch, and ARVIS Punch 2, our fighters are waiting to reach a bigger audience by removing the need of a headset.
Experience a new and dynamic fight experience with our third-person perspective, and brand new animations that really PUNCH.
Test your skills with all of our classic VR fighters like Mariano, or even Ultratumba; and get ready to face new challengers!
Select your fighter and opponent carefully, as their speed, strength or reflexes can be the difference between a nice fight and a straight Knock Out!
Still finding our fighters too weak? Jump into multiplayer mode, where you will be able to prove your worth online and locally.
So don't waste any time, get into ARVIS Knock Out! Select your fighter, hit the ring, and get that Knock Out!

title: The Love Between Litchis and Elms
description:
게임 정보
Youth is a chapter of poetry that can never be revisited but will always remain sealed in the depths of memory.
With dreams and hopes for the future, you step into an international high school filled with stories. Here, you meet three boys with distinct personalities: the aloof and profound senior, the gentle and wise scholar, and the sunny and passionate childhood friend.
Amid encounters and farewells with them, you experience the thrill of love, the trials of friendship, and the warmth of family.
Youth is also an old music box, spinning as it plays that familiar song.
Are you ready?
Game Features：
1.A Fresh and Artistic High School Romance Story
You will experience a poetic high school life, vividly recreating the details of youth with a nostalgic touch.
2.Exquisite Visuals
Beautiful and colorful CG illustrations, each like a movie screenshot; the art style blends Japanese freshness with realism, capturing the beauty of campus moments.
3.Rich Bonus Content and Special Interactions
Features 9 regular bonus stories and 11 special bonus collections, including sweet interactions for New Year, Valentine's Day, and other festivals.
Game Rules：
1.Diverse and Charming Love Interests
You will decide your love interest through choices: the cool and profound senior, the gentle and wise academic genius, or the sunny and passionate childhood friend. Additionally, there are hidden romanceable characters.
2.Immersive Experience with a Main Storyline and Emotional Side Stories
Combines a main storyline with emotional side routes. The timing of emotional side story unlocks depends on your relationship development, offering a highly immersive romantic experience.
3.Fun "Heart-Matching Compatibility Test"
See which love interest matches you best based on your choices!
autokwd: The Love Between Litchis and Elms

title: GleanBound
description:
게임 정보
GleanBound: is first-person horror semi-realistic maze runner that mixes adrenaline-fueled chase mechanics with creepy events and terrifying creatures. Collect soul stones and stay ahead of what’s hunting you — but remember, every corner could be your last. Run and uncover the dark secret that put you there.
The world may not be fully real, but it feels disturbingly close.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 The corn maze breathes with eerie atmosphere — rustling leaves, distant footsteps, flickers in the dark. 
The basement reeks of decay — rotting wood, rusted tools, and walls clawed bare through torn, moldy wallpaper. Dust chokes the air, light barely reaches the corners.
You’re not here to hide — you’re here to run.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 　　　 You need to collect soul stones while something else chases you. Every second counts. One wrong turn, one missed step, and it’s over. You’ll either adapt to the tempo — or get swallowed by it.

title: Beat Dodger
description:
게임 정보
Beat Dodger is a Rhythm game that combines flying through obstacles, and tapping to the beat while jamming to tunes! Anyone can do it! All you have to do is follow 2 simple steps:
Obstacles fly towards you, when the obstacles reach about the size of the white ring, just Hit the Beat. Be careful though! Too early or too late, and it will count as a missed beat.

title: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino
description:
게임 정보
Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino is a 2D atmospheric visual novel, blending absurdity, paranoia, and mild unease into everyday life.
You play as Glorbofrutodrila — a creature who moves into a new home with his pregnant wife, hoping for peace and a fresh start. But soon, cracks begin to show — both in the walls and in reality. Neighbors whisper, the floor creaks, and one early morning phone call might change everything.
The game features:
Branching dialogue and meaningful decisions
Memorable characters reacting to your choices
Hand-drawn art in a unique visual style
Subtle ambient music and immersive sound design
A story where nothing is accidental
This is not a horror game. It's a tale of suspicion, strange timing, and the feeling that you're not in full control.
autokwd: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino

description:
게임 정보
You have been selected to work in the Media Regulation Branch, the front lines in the fight for truth and national purity. Report to Office Building Number: 171 Room: 152 by the end of the day. Your duty? Safeguard NewMerican values, ensure only that trustworthy information reaches the public.

As stated in your employ handbook section C page 14 under the 5th stanza of the 3rd paragraph you are to be filtering out and stamping all information the public is allowed to see. You are the final check to ensure NewMerica stays the perfect safe haven for all.  
2025 is a dystopian 2D puzzle game where you take on the role of a NewMerican media censor officer within a surveillance heavy, authoritarian society. Through the manipulation of text, redaction of sensitive content, and strategic bans of documents, you must maintain the truth of NewMerica, the world's most perfect country.

title: Velocity Riders
description:
게임 정보
아드레날린이 솟구치는 3D 바이크 레이싱 모험을 준비하세요! 초현실적인 그래픽과 매끄러운 조작으로 아름다운 환경을 누비세요. 교통 체증을 헤치고 나가든, 램프를 질주하든, 모든 레이스가 실감 나게 느껴집니다.
특징:
현실적인 3D 그래픽과 역동적인 환경
플레이어가 선택할 수 있는 다양한 바이크
점점 더 어려워지는 스마트 AI 상대
다양한 트랙: 도시, 사막, 숲 등
열렬하게 경쟁하고, 자유롭게 달리세요. 도로는 당신의 것입니다!
company: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

title: Souper Hero
description:
게임 정보
Souper Hero is a dungeon crawler roguelike fueled by the power of soup. Explore a procedurally generated world filled with friends and foes, collect ingredients, and make yourself stronger by cooking delicious soups! 
Cooking: Every ingredient has a flavor and enemies drop ingredients that augment your attack. Combine up to five ingredients in a soup and you get a completely unique weapon to play with. Though be careful, your new weapon has limited uses, so use it wisely. Some special drops have unique effects to explore, so be on the lookout!
The Dungeon: Explore a lush fantasy world full of strange (yet delicious) creatures. Find clans of local wildlife to loot and learn to traverse different biomes. Every playthrough is unique, since all content is procedurally generated. Be careful not to get lost!
The Hub: After a hard day of work (or losing all of your health) take a break at the hub. Here, you can interact with shopkeepers, cook freely, and prepare for your next traversal into the dungeon.

title: obakeyashiki
description:
게임 정보
"Obakeyashiki" is a first-person exploration adventure game where you search for an exit from a maze-like haunted house.
◆ Story
―― "Welcome to the haunted house."
You visit a mansion that has been turned entirely into a haunted house by its owner, who built it to entertain visitors.
―― "I've prepared five exits."
Once you step inside, you can't leave until you find one of the exits.
Of the five possible exits, one has a guided path prepared for it.
To find the others, you’ll need to leave the main path and explore the maze-like house on your own.
No combat. No game over.
◆ Controls
WASD — Move
Left Click — Interact
Tab — Inventory
Esc — Settings

title: AHAPIKA – Heroic Agency
description:
게임 정보
What would make a great hero like Achilles harvest olives for an ordinary market woman? What would drive the great Greek heroes to become ordinary couriers? The desire for fame and adventure, of course!
Ahapika is the most heroic agency in Greece, and only the most valorous and glorious are accepted. Follow the path of its origin from the very beginning! You will have to fulfill the requests and orders of both ordinary mortals and the great Olympian gods. But be careful - sometimes an innocent request to deliver a package can lead to fatal consequences. Fight with beasts and monsters, argue with gods and titans, gather the best heroes to help.
An exciting story:

title: Alice in Disguise
description:
게임 정보
In Wonderland, the evil Red Queen has captured Alice’s friends and she is the only one who can save them!
Will Alice be able to sneak into the Royal Castle and free them all?
Gameplay
Alice in Disguise is a stealth game with chess-based puzzles where you must complete a series of levels without getting caught by enemies. Levels are set on chessboards where Alice must disguise herself and act like the castle guards to go unnoticed.
Enemies are chess pieces with different movement patterns: so, when disguised as one of them, Alice will move with the corresponding scheme. Abilities like resizing, invisibility, and teleporting will help you complete the puzzles.
Features
Chess-based puzzles of increasing complexity.
Stealth sections based on disguises.
Special abilities and effects to discover.
Cute and appealing graphic style.
Try to rescue all of Alice's friends and defeat the evil Queen to save Wonderland!
