title: Feral Echoes
description:
게임 정보
Feral Echoes는 모든 발걸음이 중요한 생존 모험입니다. 게임은 생존, 탐험, 마법 및 전투 요소를 결합합니다. 야생 땅을 탐험하고, 피난처를 짓고, 괴물과 싸우고, 퍼즐을 풀며 독특한 이야기를 만드세요. LAN, P2P, Steam을 지원하는 멀티플레이어 모드에서 이를 모두 즐길 수 있습니다.
생존하고, 건설하고, 싸우세요!
멀티플레이어 모드: LAN, P2P 또는 Steam을 통해 친구들과 함께 플레이하세요. 함께 세상을 탐험하고, 피난처를 만들고, 자원을 모으고, 적과 싸우세요.
생존 시스템: 체력, 배고픔, 갈증, 산소, 마나를 관리하세요. 이 혹독한 세상에서 살아남기 위해 캐릭터의 상태를 잘 살펴보세요.
마법과 전투 기술: 강력한 마법 능력과 전투 스타일을 해제하세요. 한손검에서 불 마법, 폭탄까지. 기술과 진행 시스템을 통해 캐릭터를 발전시켜보세요.
건설 시스템: 방어 구조물을 짓고, 함정을 만들며, 모듈식 시스템으로 기지를 강화하세요. 파괴하고 복구하며 외부의 위협으로부터 창작물을 지키세요.
동물 세계: 사냥하고, 동물을 기르고, 생태계를 만드세요. 낚시하고, 식물을 기르고, 정착지를 발전시키세요.
혼자 또는 친구와 함께 플레이: 지속적으로 업데이트되는 메커니즘, 동적인 전투 및 독특한 분위기는 솔로 플레이어와 팀 모두에게 잊을 수 없는 모험을 제공합니다.
주요 특징:
멀티플레이어 및 네트워크 상호작용: LAN, P2P 및 Steam 완벽 지원. 저장 및 로드 시스템을 통해 플레이어는 중단 없이 모험을 계속할 수 있습니다.
직관적인 조작 및 캐릭터 커스터마이징: 외모와 캐릭터 성장에 대한 다양한 커스터마이징 옵션. 독특한 전투 스타일과 마법에서 영감을 얻으세요.
다양한 전투 및 무기: 원거리 총기에서 마법, 즉석 도구까지 다양한 무기로 싸워보세요.
퀘스트 및 이벤트 시스템: 고급 퀘스트, 대화 및 일지 시스템으로 세상에 생명을 불어넣으세요. 독특한 선택과 이벤트로 이야기를 전개해보세요.
유연한 건설 및 파괴 시스템: 모듈식 시스템을 사용하여 피난처, 기지 및 함정을 만드세요. 잠금 장치 및 기계 시스템으로 당신의 영역을 방어하세요.
동물 및 농업: 동물을 길들이고, 식물을 기르고, 안정적인 생태계를 만드세요.
Feral Echoes는 신비와 위험이 가득한 세상에서 탐험, 생존, 창조력을 발휘할 수 있는 무한한 가능성을 제공합니다. 생존을 위해 싸우고, 이 서사적인 모험에서 독특한 세상을 만들어 가세요!

title: Bound in Time
description:
게임 정보
Bound in Time is a two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two flashy heroes with a number of abilities, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures and monsters. As levels are explored and cleared, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on harder enemies and bosses!

Join together in a local coop where one of you will play as Lux the high fire power cyborg and Hikari the highly mobile Samurai. You will have a number of cooperative actions to help you through such as medkits to heal each other, revive the other in their time of need and use your abilities to kill and stun enemies when your partner needs it.

Take on hordes of creatures which different features such as spitting acid and holding the player down.

3 levels to complete, take on waves of the horde in the old ruins, fight through a burning village on the fire plant and make it to the castle to take on Egon the evil Knight and save time from falling under his control.

title: Virsamals Companion Console
description:
게임 정보
Virsamals Companion Console is a retro game console for your desktop. You and your chosen companion go on idle adventures, and every hour, you will encounter another friendly Virsamal!
Idle
Every day, go on up to 5 adventures. You can idle the entire time, or change location every hour to look for new exotic critters. Being active will also increase the amount affection your Virsamal gains.
Evolve
With enough affection, most Virsamals can evolve in one of two ways! Evolution is location dependent, so Virsamals that have been more places will have more options. Evolved Virsamals don't show up on adventures, so evolution is key to discovering new creatures. 
Collect
There are over 100 creatures to collect, through expedition encounters and evolution. But the rarest of all can only be found on Fabled adventures. Fabled adventures appear infrequently after spending time in a single area, but are no guarantee of seeing a Fabled Virsamal. Patience and a bit of luck will be required!
Trade
Virsamal records are stored using the Steam Inventory, so you can trade with your friends or players worldwide to fill out your collection.
Game will require a connection to Steam servers.

title: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One
description:
게임 정보
시간에 잊힌 세계, 신비로운 산 꼭대기에 고대 동굴이 숨겨져 있으며, 탐험가들의 도전을 기다리고 있습니다. 운명으로 묶인 두 명의 모험가는 동굴 깊숙이 발을 들여놓으며, 역사 속에 묻힌 비밀을 밝혀냅니다. 그 안에서 기이한 식물, 신비로운 생물, 그리고 그들의 지혜와 협력을 시험하는 신비로운 힘과 마주하게 됩니다. 깊이 들어갈수록 동굴이 단순한 장소가 아니라는 것을 깨닫게 됩니다. 동굴은 살아 숨 쉬고 변화하며, 마치 그들의 존재를 인식하는 듯합니다. 과연 어떤 비밀이 숨겨져 있을까요? 어떤 시험이 기다리고 있을까요? 오직 신뢰와 협력을 통해서만 동굴의 신비를 풀고 살아남을 수 있습니다.
Together in Forgotten Lands는 두 명의 플레이어가 협력하여 네 개의 독특한 생태계를 탐험하는 협동 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임입니다. 빛을 활용한 퍼즐, 복잡한 미로, 플랫폼 챌린지, 그리고 음악 기반의 수수께끼 등 다양한 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 모든 퍼즐은 협력을 필요로 하며, 모든 장애물은 완벽한 조율을 요구합니다. 그리고 한 걸음씩 나아갈 때마다 잊혀진 과거의 조각들이 드러납니다. 당신은 이 동굴의 손아귀에서 벗어날 수 있을까요?
기능 목록
2인 협력 플레이: 두 명의 플레이어를 위해 특별히 설계되었습니다. 함께 협력하여 난해한 퍼즐을 풀고 끊임없이 변화하는 동굴을 탐험하세요.
다양한 생태계: 각기 다른 분위기, 메커니즘, 그리고 독특한 생물들이 존재하는 네 개의 놀라운 생태계를 탐험하세요.
몰입감 있는 퍼즐: 빛 조작, 공간 퍼즐, 리듬 기반 메커니즘 및 플랫폼 도전과제 등 다양한 퍼즐이 기다리고 있습니다.
살아있는 세계: 동굴은 여러분의 존재에 반응하며 변형되고, 진행할수록 새로운 길이 열립니다.
autokwd: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One

title: Jump or Smash
description:
게임 정보
In a pixelated world full of obstacles and impossible platforms, you take control of a little slime whose only mission is to reach the top. Every jump counts, every mistake has consequences. There is no room to give up: only skill, patience and determination. Can you lead the slime to glory without falling into despair?

title: 浮华工造 千机百炼 Ornate Machina: The Thousand Trials
description:
게임 정보
Ingenious Mechanisms & Brain-Burning Challenges
Ornate Machina: The Thousand Trials is a box-pushing puzzle game with rich and varied mechanics. Beyond classic Sokoban-style gameplay, you'll face five distinct types of contraptions. Observe carefully, learn how each works, roll carts up steep slopes, and even use sound to locate hidden platforms—only through exploration and clever thinking will you find the way forward!
Rich and Varied Level Design
The game features 4 chapters and 20 hand-crafted levels (with more to come!). To complete each chapter, you must understand the mechanics it introduces. Want to achieve the fewest steps? That will take deep thought and flexible strategy.
A Unique Visual Style
A fresh blend of traditional Chinese aesthetics and pixel art delivers a visually novel experience. Lighthearted characters, layered level design, and a distinct soundtrack combine to create a uniquely artistic atmosphere.
If you manage to beat a level in fewer steps—share your brilliance with us!
Features
Chinese-style puzzle adventure with diverse contraptions
4 uniquely themed chapters with 20 handcrafted levels (more in future updates!)
Pixel art inspired by traditional Chinese visuals
5 types of clever and varied mechanisms to master
autokwd: 浮华工造 千机百炼 Ornate Machina: The Thousand Trials

title: The Last Heroine
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of a lone warrior as she scours mysterious, hostile ruins in search of the one she must slay: the Guardian of the Ruins. Take on powerful enemies. Learn and master combat mechanics such as dodging, parrying and different types of attack. Explore and collect various weapons and shields in labyrinthine ruins, lost in the middle of the sky. Survive, and find the final arena where your final enemy lies: an absolutely fearsome Boss.

title: Weed Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Weed Store Simulator allows you to manage a legal cannabis store while secretly producing illegal substances and stepping into the underground world. As you leverage the advantages of legal trade to grow your business, you’ll also form dangerous connections in the criminal world and carry out covert operations. Balancing between mafias, gangs, and secret markets, you’ll strive to make big money both legally and illegally. Success here depends on strategy and taking risks. To succeed in both your store and the dark world, you'll need to be smart and courageous!
Grow your own cannabis plants, sort them by quality, dry them, package them, or turn them into ready-to-sell joints. Every step is on you, every gram under your control.
But sticking to green won’t be enough. For those who want more, the rules of the game change. Behind closed doors, things get bigger: with the production of white powder and blue crystals, a high-risk, high-reward game begins. Everything’s sterile, everything’s systematic. If you know what you’re doing, the business is yours to run.

title: My Dear Can't Speak
description:
게임 정보
Main Story
After years of relentless effort, the protagonist finally achieves their lifelong dream. However, upon realizing this dream, they are overcome with a deep sense of emptiness and numbness. One day, while drowning their sorrows in alcohol, they come across a mysterious girl at the train station...
Gameplay
As the president of a software company, the protagonist is responsible for managing and operating the business. From software development plans to various employee affairs, every aspect is personally overseen by the protagonist.
Players are not only responsible for advancing the game's main storyline but can also freely explore various management and interactive gameplay elements to create a unique gaming experience.
Players take on the role of a company founder, responsible for operating and developing a software development company. By researching new software, recruiting and training employees, and optimizing budget management, they can help the company grow and enhance its market competitiveness. Players must allocate resources wisely, formulate development strategies, and ensure the company's steady progress.
The game features a shop where players can purchase various items. Using these items strategically can effectively advance the game.
Additionally, the game incorporates heartwarming interactions between the protagonist and his daughter. Players can arrange time to spend with her and participate in her growth journey. Different choices will influence the depth of their father-daughter relationship and may even alter the course of the story.
Players must find a balance between career and family, managing their company while maintaining a strong bond with their daughter, ultimately leading to different game endings.
Main Characters
autokwd: My Dear Can't Speak,私の娘は話すことができません

title: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater
description:
게임 정보
Murder at the Birch Tree Theater: A Musical Theater Murder Mystery

Uncover high drama in this whodunnit set in a small-town community theater! Gather clues by investigating the sets, casts and backstage crews of 10 theatrical productions, using their stories to piece together each deadly crime.



Explore the theater for clues
The game features 10 levels -- each focused on a deadly incident that occurs during a performance.

Solve mysteries
Gather clues and observe each scenario to deduce what happened.




Infer the story from clues and environments, then fill in the blanks to progress.
autokwd: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater

title: Sneaky Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Sneaky Pirates에서 항해를 시작하세요! 망망대해에서 펼쳐지는 속임수와 전략, 액션의 온라인 먼티플레이어 소셜 추리 게임! 최대 4명의 플레이어가 여러 척의 배들 사이에서 변장하고 몰래 숨어 다니며 상대를 사냥하고 훔치는 치열한 두뇌 싸움을 즐길 수 있습니다.
훔쳐서 승리하기 – 게임이 끝날 때 가장 많은 골드를 획득한 해적이 승리합니다. 동점일 경우, 먼저 훔친 해적이 승리합니다!
군중 속에 숨기 – AI가 조종하는 함선들 사이에 섞여 조심스럽게 다음 행동을 계획하세요.

title: Orbcraft Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Orbcraft Survivors는 로그라이트 요소가 가미된 시간 생존 게임입니다. 오브를 제작하고 강력한 특성을 부여해 점점 강해지세요.
같은 오브를 합성하여 더 강력한 형태로 강화하고, 특성을 적용해 효과를 극대화하세요. 다양한 조합을 실험해 압도적인 마법을 발동시키고, 몰아치는 적의 물결 속에서 살아남으세요.
각 캐릭터는 최대 6개 이상의 오브를 장착할 수 있으며, 각각 고유한 스킬을 보유하고 있습니다. 오브를 합성하여 더욱 강력하게 만들고, 3레벨 오브를 해방하여 전장을 지배하세요.
50개 이상의 특성이 다양한 등급으로 존재하며, 전투마다 새로운 조합과 전략이 펼쳐집니다. 강력한 시너지를 발견하고, 운과 전략을 시험하며, 매번 새로운 경험을 만들어보세요!

title: Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade
description:
게임 정보
Gob Johnson's Downhill Marmalade is a fast-paced slalom 'em up fantasy roguelite, featuring beloved household name Gob Johnson himself.
Avoid obstacles, smash into enemies, collect marmalade boons and do sick tricks.
A Radical Roguelite
Start at the top of the highest peak and race to the the deepest depths to catch the sickest air.
Each run down the Great Mountain is different. Choose your path.
Unlock all Gob's friends
Unlock and play as a bunch of different characters, who all have unique powers.
Collect powerful marmalade boons
Collect Enchanted Marmalade to choose from a ton of boons.
Journey through the Radicallion on your quest
The world of Radicallion has many biomes to explore as you descend it's peak. Race down the mountain, skid through the mines, cause havoc in the city and much more.

title: Darkest Descent
description:
게임 정보
You are a lost soul wandering through the ruins of a long forgotten society. You and up to seven other friends are tasked with protecting Jane, a young woman trapped in a perpetual cycle of death and rebirth. Use powerful spells and weapons to fight your way through the stronghold to uncover ancient knowledge and meet a powerful deity held deep within its chambers.
Gather a team of 8 souls controlling one vessel and face unknowable dangers in this cooperative turn-based dungeon crawler. Collect unique skill and spell cards that will aid you and your team in combat. Each card provides a unique benefit, granting useful buffs to one of your friends, weakening an enemy, mending your teammates wounds and damaging monsters that block your path.
Coordination and cooperation is important for success, maybe you have a party member that specializes entirely on damage, maybe they could use a little bit of healing every now and then! You may even a whole team of casters that needs a quick boost to their spells, or you could all focus on making one party member a powerhouse capable of annihilating anything in their path!

title: Colony 19
description:
게임 정보
Having finally escaped your white room, you find yourself in an overwhelming and unfamiliar world hidden from you all your life. Piece together the true reality kept from you and people like you whilst locked away.
This game is a VR climber game where you must physically climb out of the concrete and metal hell that towered over your head all your life. Explore a monolithic environment and ascend through an unforgiving megastructure that is COLONY 19.
company: Zane Shan, Liza Gitelman, Riley Fink, , , , , , , , , , ,

title: The Love Between Litchis and Elms
description:
게임 정보
Youth is a chapter of poetry that can never be revisited but will always remain sealed in the depths of memory.
With dreams and hopes for the future, you step into an international high school filled with stories. Here, you meet three boys with distinct personalities: the aloof and profound senior, the gentle and wise scholar, and the sunny and passionate childhood friend.
Amid encounters and farewells with them, you experience the thrill of love, the trials of friendship, and the warmth of family.
Youth is also an old music box, spinning as it plays that familiar song.
Are you ready?
Game Features：
1.A Fresh and Artistic High School Romance Story
You will experience a poetic high school life, vividly recreating the details of youth with a nostalgic touch.
2.Exquisite Visuals
Beautiful and colorful CG illustrations, each like a movie screenshot; the art style blends Japanese freshness with realism, capturing the beauty of campus moments.
3.Rich Bonus Content and Special Interactions
Features 9 regular bonus stories and 11 special bonus collections, including sweet interactions for New Year, Valentine's Day, and other festivals.
Game Rules：
1.Diverse and Charming Love Interests
You will decide your love interest through choices: the cool and profound senior, the gentle and wise academic genius, or the sunny and passionate childhood friend. Additionally, there are hidden romanceable characters.
2.Immersive Experience with a Main Storyline and Emotional Side Stories
Combines a main storyline with emotional side routes. The timing of emotional side story unlocks depends on your relationship development, offering a highly immersive romantic experience.
3.Fun "Heart-Matching Compatibility Test"
See which love interest matches you best based on your choices!
autokwd: The Love Between Litchis and Elms

title: GleanBound
description:
게임 정보
GleanBound: is first-person horror semi-realistic maze runner that mixes adrenaline-fueled chase mechanics with creepy events and terrifying creatures. Collect soul stones and stay ahead of what’s hunting you — but remember, every corner could be your last. Run and uncover the dark secret that put you there.
The world may not be fully real, but it feels disturbingly close.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 The corn maze breathes with eerie atmosphere — rustling leaves, distant footsteps, flickers in the dark. 
The basement reeks of decay — rotting wood, rusted tools, and walls clawed bare through torn, moldy wallpaper. Dust chokes the air, light barely reaches the corners.
You’re not here to hide — you’re here to run.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 　　　 You need to collect soul stones while something else chases you. Every second counts. One wrong turn, one missed step, and it’s over. You’ll either adapt to the tempo — or get swallowed by it.

title: Project 2025 Text Based Story Board
description:
게임 정보
Overview:
Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is an AI-powered interactive story creation platform that enables users to craft unique narratives using their own AI service APIs. This tool does not include any built-in API keys - users must provide their own valid AI service credentials.
【Core Features】
- Trilingual Support: Full compatibility with Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English
- Dynamic Story Engine: Generates organic narrative branching
【System Requirements】
• Valid AI service API key (e.g., DeepSeek/Local LLM)
• Stable internet connection
• Basic text processing capability
Project 2025 Text Based Story Board is a narrative tool that transforms your AI service API into a powerful storytelling engine.
[Important Notice]
This tool does not include any built-in API services. Users must provide their own valid AI service credentials to access all features.

title: ARVIS Knock Out!
description:
게임 정보
The fight is coming to your hands!
After boxing with you in VR with ARVIS Punch, and ARVIS Punch 2, our fighters are waiting to reach a bigger audience by removing the need of a headset.
Experience a new and dynamic fight experience with our third-person perspective, and brand new animations that really PUNCH.
Test your skills with all of our classic VR fighters like Mariano, or even Ultratumba; and get ready to face new challengers!
Select your fighter and opponent carefully, as their speed, strength or reflexes can be the difference between a nice fight and a straight Knock Out!
Still finding our fighters too weak? Jump into multiplayer mode, where you will be able to prove your worth online and locally.
So don't waste any time, get into ARVIS Knock Out! Select your fighter, hit the ring, and get that Knock Out!

title: My Chibi Friend
description:
게임 정보
My Chibi Friend는 당신의 데스크톱에 사는 사랑스러운 친구입니다. 이 작은 친구는 다음과 같은 행동을 해요:
걷고, 먹고, 자고, 청소해요.
표정을 바꾸고 당신과 대화해요.
데스크톱 경험에 활기와 재미를 더해줘요.
모든 작업에 당신과 함께
귀여운 데스크톱 친구는 바쁜 업무 중에도 항상 곁에 있어요.
이제 당신의 화면은 이 친구의 집이에요
SNS를 하거나 드라마, 영화를 볼 때도, 이 친구는 데스크톱을 청소하고 밥을 먹으며 조용히 당신을 기다려요!

title: Cats Hidden in Chang'an
description:
게임 정보
Cats Hidden in Chang'an is a cute hidden object game set in the Tang Dynasty city of Chang'an. There are 100 cats waiting for you to discover in the hand-painted backgrounds. Found a cat? Click it!
Features
1 level, 100 cats
❔ Secrets
⏰ Timer mode with leaderboards
⚙️ Actual game settings, haha

title: Akane's Way: Hiragana
description:
게임 정보
Begin your journey to Japanese literacy at Kazamori Shrine, where language flows like the wind.
Akane's Way: Hiragana is a meditative Japanese language learning experience where you'll master hiragana through a deeply immersive narrative adventure.
As you study under the gentle guidance of Akane, the shrine's caretaker, you'll not only learn a new writing system but discover the cultural and historical significance the writing system.
A Serene Learning Environment
Nestled between mountains and valley, Kazamori Shrine offers a tranquil backdrop for your studies. Listen to the wind through maple trees, and find your own learning rhythm in this thoughtfully crafted world.
Progressive Hiragana Mastery
Begin with simple vowels and advance through consonant groups at your own pace. Akane's adaptive spaced repetition system tracks your progress with each character, focusing your practice where you need it most.
Personalized Feedback Styles
Choose from five unique feedback modes to match your learning style:
Stillness: Minimal audio for a distraction free experience
Harmony: Musical notes form melodies as you advance
Encouragement: Receive gentle praise from Akane
Distance: Ambient music creates a focused atmosphere
Echo: Hear each character's sound reinforced through repetition
A Living Story
Develop a meaningful connection with Akane as you earn her trust through consistent study. Unlock deeper conversations about Japanese culture, Shinto practices, her personal history, and the significance of language as your friendship grows.
Multi Sensory Learning
Visual chalk drawings, native pronunciation audio, and mnemonic stories combine to create powerful memory anchors for each character. Switch between multiple choice or typing input, and visual or audio only modes to challenge yourself.

title: Sweet Girls Collection
description:
게임 정보
Experience a sweet-sweet daily life with beautiful girls inspired by desserts!
Sweet Girls Collection is a visual novel with no in-game choices—simply enjoy reading the story. Choose a Sweet to pursue to start, then fully enjoy each of their individual storylines.

title: Graveyard Visit
description:
게임 정보
《The Lingering》 시리즈의 두 번째 에피소드. 《The Lingering: Graveyard Visit》에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
《The Lingering》는 인도네시아의 실제 공포 사건과 도시 전설에서 영감을 받은 에피소드 형식의 분위기 중심 호러 시리즈입니다. 각 에피소드는 ‘잔류하는 존재’와 마주친 사람들의 불안한 이야기를 전합니다.

title: Familiar Stranger
description:
게임 정보
Be cautious about what your child watches late at night—certain shows may feature unsettling content or frightening imagery that can cause distress, leaving lingering effects on their imagination. These terrifying images might even bleed into your child’s dreams, giving life to their worst fears. The Familiar Stranger is a gripping 3D psychological horror game that takes you on an intense journey through the fragmented recollections of a child's troubled mind.
In this immersive experience, you will step into the shoes of a young child, forced to navigate through a world of twisted memories and unsettling visions. The game challenges you to uncover dark secrets hidden deep within the child's past, revealing the deep-rooted fears that have shaped their reality. As you delve into their mind, you’ll discover that not everything is as it seems—each memory holds a clue, a piece of the puzzle, but also a terrifying secret that might just haunt you forever.
But there’s more to fear than just the unsettling memories. The Familiar Stranger is an ever-present entity, always watching from the shadows, drawing closer as you uncover more of the child's hidden past. It’s a figure that feels both eerily familiar and undeniably threatening, a silent observer waiting for the right moment to strike.
As you explore, you’ll need to be quick, clever, and stealthy. The Stranger is relentless, lurking in the darkness, always one step behind. Can you outwit it, or will you be caught in a never-ending game of cat and mouse? The game forces you to face your fears head-on, testing your ability to survive in a world where memory and nightmare blur into one.
The Familiar Stranger isn’t just a game—it’s a psychological thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat, forcing you to confront the haunting question: how much of your own past is locked away, and what happens when those memories come back to life? Prepare for an unforgettable experience that will challenge both your courage and your mind.

title: Need For Scream
description:
게임 정보
PLOT
You are a student who has come to Russia on a study exchange program. Alongside your studies, you have a hobby — you run a blog about life in Russia for your American followers. One day, you hear rumors about a cursed village not far from where you live, and decide to travel there to shoot content for your channel.
According to legend, a terrible tragedy took place in the village not so long ago. A young boy came to spend the holidays with his grandfather. After some time, the grandfather fell ill and asked his grandson to make him an herbal brew. Unable to find sage at home, the boy went into the forest and mistakenly picked foxglove — a plant that looks very similar to sage. But unlike sage, foxglove is poisonous, known for its toxic properties and especially dangerous to the heart. Because of this, the grandfather died, and the boy remained locked in the house with the body for several days until his parents arrived in the village.
After they left, strange things began happening. A ringing silence settled over the village, and those who disturbed it would wake up the next day without their tongue. They say the grandfather hated noise even after death. When his grandson was taken from him, he began wandering the village, cursing anyone who made a sound — determined to plunge the place into absolute silence.
The village quickly became abandoned and remains deserted to this day.
GAMEPLAY
This is a classic walking simulator with lots of jumpscares. You'll solve light puzzles, explore the village, and uncover the stories of its former residents.
A unique feature of the game is the use of your microphone. The ghost of the grandfather will attack you, and the only way to fend him off is to scream into your mic as loudly as possible.
The village is plunged into complete darkness. Your flashlight is your only companion — but it must be manually charged to light your path.
Sometimes, your camera will come in handy, with a built-in night vision mode.
It may seem like the village is completely dead — just eerie crows around — but wait... is that a cat? Where did it come from? Is it leading you somewhere? Is it trying to help, or is it luring you into a trap?
You’ll have to find out for yourself.
GAME FEATURES
