description:
게임 정보
In a city governed by drones and powered by neon gas, hope soars through the rooftops in the form of a rogue human. Jump across rooftops, hack powerboxes, and avoid the ever present drones that oppress the citizens of Neokyo City in this open-world 2D platformer.

title: Tapeheads
description:
게임 정보
Tapeheads is a retro-futuristic computer simulation game set in an world where technology took a different path. You receive a replica of the 1983 Sonnenlicht Troika computer system from your uncle. Using the Symbolic79 programming language, solve puzzles sent by your uncle and his friends. Take breaks with included mini-games.

Key Features:
Symbolic79 programming language: Custom language with extensive documentation and examples.
Interpreter with debugging and REPL: Debug and test your code seamlessly with an interactive interpreter and REPL.
Editor with file revisioning: Manage your projects with built-in file revisioning.
Mini-games with logic puzzles: Enjoy engaging mini-games.
Atmospheric sound and graphics: Immerse yourself in a detailed retro-futuristic system.

Artwork from the In-Game Magazine

title: Domovoy
description:
게임 정보
In the game "Domovoy" you will have to dive into a seemingly ordinary apartment, but the further you go, the more HE reveals his essence. This horror game is a first-person walking simulator with a tense atmosphere, explore the apartment, find answers and move on. Are you ready to meet HIM?
Domovoy is not only a guardian of the hearth, but also a vengeful spirit. If ignored or disrespected, it can turn against the owners.

title: Water Maid
description:
게임 정보
Fill Up Your Pot and Make it Back. Safely

Watermaids are all about heading out and bringing back fresh water for the villagers. Navigate treacherous terrain and evade enemies to find a springwater well.



Fill up your trusty pot and return to the village before the sun sets. Be careful though, you're not as agile as you were before filling up.

Take Down Vicious Beasts and Explore the Island



Escape, Escort, and Strike Back. Outmaneuver cunning enemies and uncover the secrets of Nada Village Island. Investigate the disappearance of your predecessor and keep the villagers safe from the calamity that is to befall the island.

title: T.D.Z. 4 Heart of Pripyat
description:
게임 정보
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!

title: Datbyel's Nebula
description:
게임 정보
소개
닻별의 성운은 가벼운 퍼즐과 전투가 포함된 스토리 위주의 게임입니다.
총 두 개의 챕터로 이루어져 있으며, 2챕터는 1챕터를 출시한 후에 개발할 예정입니다.
시놉시스
1992년 9월의 어느 날...
대기업 코넥 에너지를 퇴사한 엘리는 우연히 신비로운 세계 '닻별'에 떨어집니다.
닻별에서 엘리는 기억을 잃은 안치타와 만나고 그와 동행하며 돌아가기 위한 여정을 시작합니다.
엘리는 이 여정 속에서 진정으로 자신이 원하는 것이 무엇인지 깨달을 수 있을까요?

title: Catolonizer
description:
게임 정보
식민지 고양이: 위기의 한가운데에서 에 오신 것을 환영합니다 – 최대 15명이 함께하는 짜릿한 온라인 소셜 디덕션 게임! 임무를 수행하고 비밀을 밝혀내며, 누구를 믿을 수 있을지 판단하면서 협력하거나 속이세요.
게임 방법: 이노센트라면 임무를 완료하고 킬러를 밝히는 것이 목표입니다. 플레이 중 코인을 모아 상인을 방문하고 생존에 도움이 되는 파워업을 구매하세요. 킬러라면 들키지 않고 모두를 제거하는 것이 임무입니다! 하지만 조심하세요 – 일부 플레이어는 게임의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 특별한 능력을 가지고 있습니다.
주요 특징:
멀티플레이 혼돈: 최대 15명의 플레이어와 함께 속임수와 생존의 치열한 게임을 즐기세요.
역할 기반 능력: 파워업과 고유 능력을 통해 자신의 역할을 강화하세요.
소셜 디덕션 게임플레이: 토론하고 전략을 세우며 투표를 통해 누가 믿을 수 있는지 판단하세요.
다이내믹한 매치: 매 게임은 당신과 친구들의 선택에 따라 달라집니다.
상대를 속이고 팀을 승리로 이끌 수 있을까요? 지금 식민지 고양이 커뮤니티에 참여해 확인해보세요!

title: My ranch
description:
게임 정보
This is a farming simulator game!

Here, you need to manage your resources to expand your ranch, raise farm livestock such as chickens, cows, and sheep, and grow a large selection of crops! You can sell your produce for gold to purchase resources and gadgets that will improve your ranch.

As you oversee your ranch, you will also have to take care of yourself, and stay healthy and alive. The game utilizes a dynamic season/weather system, which can interfere with the behavior of certain animals, and the growth of certain crops. There is also a combat system that allows the player to hunt wild animals, and fend off dangerous beasts that might assault your ranch at midnight and eat your livestock (which is also why NOT leaving them wandering outside your ranch at night is a good idea). Lastly, there will also be cute critters who will not-so-cutely eat your crops.

The game allows for multiplayer gameplay, collaborate with your friends to manage the ranch together, hunt or fish for a homemade delicious meal, snuggle with your family cat(s) and dog(s), and much more!

title: Backpack Rogue
description:
게임 정보
Your Inventory
Every decision about which item to put in your backpack and exactly how it synergizes with the rest can be crucial. Your survival depends on your ability to balance risk and reward by strategically planning your actions
Game Features
A unique backpack system that allows the player to collect and combine items to create powerful sets
Dynamic bullet hell gameplay that will dilute thoughtful backpacking sessions
You create your own build that interests you the most

title: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater
description:
게임 정보
Murder at the Birch Tree Theater: A Musical Theater Murder Mystery

Uncover high drama in this whodunnit set in a small-town community theater! Gather clues by investigating the sets, casts and backstage crews of 10 theatrical productions, using their stories to piece together each deadly crime.



Explore the theater for clues
The game features 10 levels -- each focused on a deadly incident that occurs during a performance.

Solve mysteries
Gather clues and observe each scenario to deduce what happened.




Infer the story from clues and environments, then fill in the blanks to progress.
autokwd: Murder at the Birch Tree Theater

title: Sneaky Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Sneaky Pirates에서 항해를 시작하세요! 망망대해에서 펼쳐지는 속임수와 전략, 액션의 온라인 먼티플레이어 소셜 추리 게임! 최대 4명의 플레이어가 여러 척의 배들 사이에서 변장하고 몰래 숨어 다니며 상대를 사냥하고 훔치는 치열한 두뇌 싸움을 즐길 수 있습니다.
훔쳐서 승리하기 – 게임이 끝날 때 가장 많은 골드를 획득한 해적이 승리합니다. 동점일 경우, 먼저 훔친 해적이 승리합니다!
군중 속에 숨기 – AI가 조종하는 함선들 사이에 섞여 조심스럽게 다음 행동을 계획하세요.

title: Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0
description:
게임 정보
Step into the captivating world of Tony's Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0, where science and adventure collide! This immersive VR experience lets you explore a vibrant insect science museum filled with live insects and reptiles in stunning macro detail. Shrink to their scale and discover the intricate beauty of their world like never before.
The experience also includes a special room showcasing the legendary Dan Capps Exhibit, one of the world's most extensive insect collections, with over 100 meticulously curated display cases. In this immersive exhibit, experience video recordings of Dan Capps himself, as he pops up throughout the room to guide you through the fascinating world of entomology. Whether you’re marveling at the intricacy of insect anatomy or learning about the rare species Dan has collected, this experience brings the hidden wonders of nature right to your fingertips.
Perfect for science enthusiasts and curious explorers, this immersive experience offers an unforgettable introduction to the rich biodiversity of our planet’s insects and reptiles—all from the comfort of your own space.

title: Beat Dodger
description:
게임 정보
Beat Dodger is a Rhythm game that combines flying through obstacles, and tapping to the beat while jamming to tunes! Anyone can do it! All you have to do is follow 2 simple steps:
Obstacles fly towards you, when the obstacles reach about the size of the white ring, just Hit the Beat. Be careful though! Too early or too late, and it will count as a missed beat.

title: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino
description:
게임 정보
Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino is a 2D atmospheric visual novel, blending absurdity, paranoia, and mild unease into everyday life.
You play as Glorbofrutodrila — a creature who moves into a new home with his pregnant wife, hoping for peace and a fresh start. But soon, cracks begin to show — both in the walls and in reality. Neighbors whisper, the floor creaks, and one early morning phone call might change everything.
The game features:
Branching dialogue and meaningful decisions
Memorable characters reacting to your choices
Hand-drawn art in a unique visual style
Subtle ambient music and immersive sound design
A story where nothing is accidental
This is not a horror game. It's a tale of suspicion, strange timing, and the feeling that you're not in full control.
autokwd: Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino

description:
게임 정보
You have been selected to work in the Media Regulation Branch, the front lines in the fight for truth and national purity. Report to Office Building Number: 171 Room: 152 by the end of the day. Your duty? Safeguard NewMerican values, ensure only that trustworthy information reaches the public.

As stated in your employ handbook section C page 14 under the 5th stanza of the 3rd paragraph you are to be filtering out and stamping all information the public is allowed to see. You are the final check to ensure NewMerica stays the perfect safe haven for all.  
2025 is a dystopian 2D puzzle game where you take on the role of a NewMerican media censor officer within a surveillance heavy, authoritarian society. Through the manipulation of text, redaction of sensitive content, and strategic bans of documents, you must maintain the truth of NewMerica, the world's most perfect country.

title: Velocity Riders
description:
게임 정보
아드레날린이 솟구치는 3D 바이크 레이싱 모험을 준비하세요! 초현실적인 그래픽과 매끄러운 조작으로 아름다운 환경을 누비세요. 교통 체증을 헤치고 나가든, 램프를 질주하든, 모든 레이스가 실감 나게 느껴집니다.
특징:
현실적인 3D 그래픽과 역동적인 환경
플레이어가 선택할 수 있는 다양한 바이크
점점 더 어려워지는 스마트 AI 상대
다양한 트랙: 도시, 사막, 숲 등
열렬하게 경쟁하고, 자유롭게 달리세요. 도로는 당신의 것입니다!
company: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

title: Souper Hero
description:
게임 정보
Souper Hero is a dungeon crawler roguelike fueled by the power of soup. Explore a procedurally generated world filled with friends and foes, collect ingredients, and make yourself stronger by cooking delicious soups! 
Cooking: Every ingredient has a flavor and enemies drop ingredients that augment your attack. Combine up to five ingredients in a soup and you get a completely unique weapon to play with. Though be careful, your new weapon has limited uses, so use it wisely. Some special drops have unique effects to explore, so be on the lookout!
The Dungeon: Explore a lush fantasy world full of strange (yet delicious) creatures. Find clans of local wildlife to loot and learn to traverse different biomes. Every playthrough is unique, since all content is procedurally generated. Be careful not to get lost!
The Hub: After a hard day of work (or losing all of your health) take a break at the hub. Here, you can interact with shopkeepers, cook freely, and prepare for your next traversal into the dungeon.

title: Lo-Fi Golf
description:
게임 정보
LoFi Golf is a chill, third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music.
Your goal is to complete five maps using the limited number of shots available. Choose your preferred difficulty level, explore atmospheric maps, and build your strategy to succeed!
Improve your skills in Training Mode.
Once you complete a map, progress to the next one.

title: Lucha Throwdown
description:
게임 정보
Lucha Throwdown
The Lore of the Mask Lives On…  
Step into the ring and onto the battlefield in Lucha Throwdown — a high-octane Card Battler, where legendary Luchadores clash to defend Earth from an ancient evil!
The cursed El Abysmo mask has been unearthed, unleashing a dark force upon the world. Now, a coalition of Lucha legends must rise. Play as iconic Luchador champions Dr. Wagner Jr., L.A. Park, Tinieblas, Keyra, each bringing their signature style, spirit, and power to the fight.
- Build your deck. Train with Champions. Battle their Jefes.
- Outplay opponents with fast-paced card combat that captures the intensity of real lucha libre action.
- Battle online, cross-platform, in thrilling multiplayer or embark on your solo journey to glory.
The Ultimate Showdown of Strategy & Strength
Each match is a full-on simulation of high-flying wrestling action, where signature moves, devastating combos, and tactical mastery decide the victor. Customize your stable, collect powerful decks, and unleash the fiercest finishing moves.
- Created by the award-winning developer behind classic THQ wrestling games
- Art by Demente Studios, Mexico’s animation powerhouse
- Immersive audio by Guadalajara’s Kapara Sound
- Narrative crafted by the director of Neverwinter Nights
Lucha Throwdown isn’t just a game — it’s a legacy.
Are you ready to wear the mask and defend the Earth?

title: Colony 19
description:
게임 정보
Having finally escaped your white room, you find yourself in an overwhelming and unfamiliar world hidden from you all your life. Piece together the true reality kept from you and people like you whilst locked away.
This game is a VR climber game where you must physically climb out of the concrete and metal hell that towered over your head all your life. Explore a monolithic environment and ascend through an unforgiving megastructure that is COLONY 19.
company: Zane Shan, Liza Gitelman, Riley Fink, , , , , , , , , , ,

title: SpeedCoins
description:
게임 정보
                                                                 SpeedCoins is a frantic 2D platformer that combines action, exploration, and time control. Run, jump, and fight through worlds full of danger, hidden messages, and strange creatures. Master time to your advantage... and make sure you're faster than the coins if you want to survive!
You’ll shape your own destiny, change your skin along the way, but never lose sight of your goal. This is SpeedCoins!
Explore.
Discover the messages from someone special as you journey through unknown worlds. Explore the moon, the desert, and even the depths of hell!
Fight.
Dodge, shoot, and use your powers to battle anything that stands in your way.

title: Heart Idler
description:
게임 정보
💖 Heart Idler
Heart Idler is a clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate collection of hearts?
🖱️ Click to Generate Hearts
Start with zero hearts and click hearts that fly out to get more hearts.

title: Rattus Velocitas
description:
게임 정보
"Psst, wanna join the Rat Race?"
This is Rattus VELOCITAS, an arcade racing game where Fancy Rats riding futuristic ion-engine powered hoverbikes race on procedurally generated race courses! Collect items to give yourself an advantage or take out the competition!
7 different Fancy Rat colours and patterns you can choose from aside from the default Lab Rat colour, including Black-Eyed White, Agouti Hooded, and more!
5 different procedurally generated environment types.
6 Different items, including two types of Missiles, a Shield, a piece of Cheese, a Portable Dash Ring and a Bomb.
Race in a random environment, choose your favourite environment to race in or even enter a previous run's "track seed" if you'd like to experience a specific seed's race course again.
This game can be played in Splitscreen with up to 4 players on one PC!*
*Please note multiple game controllers, including Xbox 360, Xbox One, Dualshock 4(R) or DualSense(R) controllers are required for Splitscreen multiplayer mode. Performance depending on the machine hardware configuration may be reduced in Splitscreen.

title: One Hard Game Please!
description:
게임 정보
One Hard Game Please
Are you ready to test your limits in one of the most challenging rage games out there? One Hard Game Please takes inspiration from the classic "The World's Hardest Game" but cranks the difficulty up to an entirely new level. With movement that’s as tricky to master as the levels themselves, this game is designed to push even the most skilled players to their breaking point.
Core Gameplay
Precision Movement: Once you start moving, there's no stopping! Navigate tight spaces and deadly obstacles while bouncing off walls in this fast-paced, reflex-intensive experience.
Instant Death: Touch anything dangerous, and it’s game over. Respawn at the start of the level and try again—no checkpoints, no mercy.
Retro Pixel Art: Clean, minimalist visuals that keep the focus on the action.
What to Expect
10 Brutal Levels in the Demo: A taste of the chaos to come. Can you conquer these meticulously crafted levels?
100 Levels Planned for Full Release: Each level more devilishly difficult than the last. Perfect your skills and prove your mastery.
Who Is This Game For?
If you crave a real challenge and thrive on skill-based games that test your patience and precision, One Hard Game Please is for you. Whether you're a fan of rage games, looking to push your limits, or just want to prove that you're the best, this game will give you exactly what you’re asking for—and more.
Can you beat the demo? Prove it.

title: Compass of Destiny: Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Compass of Destiny: Survivors
Using assets from Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, Survivors mode is a special game mode that heavily features action and survival elements. Set in the mystical atmosphere of Istanbul, players must survive against ever-increasing waves of enemies.
Key Features of the mode:
Endless Waves of Enemies:
Players face more challenging and diverse enemies with each wave.
Dynamic and Infinite Maps:
Various maps set in different locations offer players different strategies. From rural areas to historic streets, the game is played in a variety of areas.
Equipment and Power-ups:
Players can earn new equipment, upgrade existing abilities and gain unique powers between waves.
Content Unlocked Over Time:
Players can unlock new enemies, equipment and abilities as they reach certain levels.
Point System:
The time you survive, the number of enemies you kill, and the level you reach determine your score. This increases competition and encourages players to perform better.
Strategy Advice:
Manage your stamina and limited power carefully. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, so making the right investments in power-ups is critical.
Make good use of the map's features to gain an advantage in tight spaces or scatter enemies in wide areas.
Survivors mode offers gamers a fast-paced, exciting and highly replayable experience.

title: The Unrested
description:
게임 정보
버려진 기숙학교… 조용한 복도를 울리는 발자국 소리… 그리고 과거에서 돌아온 복수의 영혼…
몇 년 전, 기숙학교에서 일어난 비극적인 사건이 당신의 소중한 친구를 앗아갔습니다. 그러나 이 이야기는 죽음으로 끝나지 않았습니다. 이제, 당신은 편지를 통해 그 어두운 과거로 다시 호출되었습니다. 이 버려진 학교의 폐허 속에서, 당신의 친구의 불안한 영혼이 기다리고 있습니다.
버려진 방을 탐험하고, 숨겨진 열쇠를 찾고, 치명적인 위험의 손아귀에서 탈출하려고 노력하세요. 하지만 조심하세요… 그들은 당신의 모든 움직임을 지켜보고 있으며, 이번에는 당신을 무서워하게 만드는 것만으로 끝나지 않을 것입니다.

title: Spell Magic
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure in various procedurally generated open worlds, where magic and mathematics collide. In Spell Magic, you'll craft and master powerful spells using the fundamental forces of arithmetic, geometry, and algebra.
As a skilled mathemagician, you'll explore a vast, ever-changing realm, teeming with fearsome monsters and challenging puzzles. Your quest is to unravel the secrets of the mystical arts, harnessing the power of numbers to bend reality to your will.
Explore Procedurally Generated Worlds
Each time you play, the world is reborn, offering a fresh experience. Various options to customize any new game are available. Options such as starting with any available upgrades or any amount of gold. Various modes all the way from permadeath to invincible exist with many more in-between.
Craft Your Spells
Combine mathematical concepts to create an arsenal of unique spells. Experiment with:
Geometric patterns for your shields and projectiles
Algebraic equations to create perfectly placed elemental attacks
Vector arithmetic to warp the 3rd dimension with your movement

title: Touhou Volleyball Danmaku
description:
게임 정보
The latest sensation to hit Gensokyo, Volleyball! But this isn't an ordinary game of volleyball.
The skies are your court as you will pick a team of two of your favorite Touhou characters. They will not only attempt to keep the ball in play but also avoid the bullets coming your way, all while dishing out your own attacks!
Story
One day in Gensokyo, everyone woke up to find their powers absent, including our resident incident solvers, Reimu and Marisa. But when Sakuya suddenly appears before them, a great revelation is made. A strange orb has appeared in Gensokyo with the power to take away abilities and grant them as it sees fit. Our heroines are on another case, going from place to place, challenging their friends in this new sport that has taken Gensokyo by storm.

title: Soul Sight
description:
게임 정보
Find the differences in 30 moving artworks. There are no timers, no lives, just differences!
Features
15 abstract LCL artworks
15 artworks provided Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington
An original "Last Child Left" soundtrack, with lo-fi ambience and chilled beats.
In-game assistance, to help with the tougher differences!
Adjustable speed, to suit your style of play
Adjustable color palettes to fit moods or help find differences
Ambient soundtrack choices, such as, sea, rain, and garden, to help with your relaxation needs!

title: Kingdom Defense: Deliverance
description:
게임 정보
이 몰입감 넘치는 2D 게임에서 끊임없는 오크와 악당의 파도로부터 성을 지켜내세요. 독특한 방어 유닛과 전략적인 게임 플레이를 활용하여 요새를 보호하고 승리를 쟁취하세요. 왕국을 지키면서 장대한 전투와 스릴 넘치는 판타지 모험을 경험하세요.
주요 특징
역동적인 전투 메커니즘: 몰입감 넘치는 전투 메커니즘으로 전략적인 실시간 게임 플레이를 즐기세요.
독특한 방어 유닛: 다양한 영웅, 전사, 신비로운 생명체를 지휘하여 방어를 강화하세요.
강력한 능력: 영웅에게 특별한 능력을 장착하고 파괴적인 힘을 발휘하여 오크의 침략을 막아내세요.
도전적인 레벨: 각각 고유한 적과 장애물이 있는 일련의 도전적인 레벨에서 전투를 벌이세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 전략적인 기술과 결단력을 시험하는 강력한 보스와 대결하세요.
게임플레이
침략군을 격퇴하기 위한 전술을 계획하고 실행하면서 전략적인 방어의 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요. 각 레벨마다 새로운 도전과 적들이 등장하므로 전략을 조정하고 개선해야 합니다. 자원을 수집하고 유닛을 업그레이드하고 난공불락의 요새를 건설하여 공세를 막아내세요.
전투에 참여하기
킹덤 디펜스를 다운로드하세요: 지금 다운로드하여 오크의 침략으로부터 왕국을 지키기 위한 장대한 여정을 시작하세요. 영웅이 되어 군대를 승리로 이끄세요!

title: The Squirrel & Sea
description:
게임 정보
"다람쥐와 바다" 는 수중 2.5D 마우스 전용 고난이도 게임입니다.
노를 저어 바닷속 세계를 탐험하세요.
카약을 젓는 느낌을 상상해 보세요.
해파리, 물고기, 바다표범 등 다양한 해양 생물을 만나게 될 것입니다.
플레이 시간: 8시간 이상 ~ 무한대.
마지막 승자는 무료 버블 스킨을 받을 수 있습니다.
진행도를 여러 번 잃을 수도 있습니다.
게임의 스토리와 배경은 진행하면서 점차 드러납니다.
절대 포기하지 마세요!

title: Murder Inc
description:
게임 정보
In a grim world of chaos, where reality feels like a thin layer over madness, welcome to Murder Inc — a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time and style are your ultimate weapons.
You are a mysterious operative, an antihero walking the fine line between life and death. Your targets are the criminals who rule the city from the labyrinth of filthy streets. But there’s a catch: every shot, strike, or step you take sets time in motion. The faster you move, the faster the world collapses around you.
Features:
Time dynamics: Time only moves when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.
Brutal style: Every kill is a mix of speed, fury, and tactical precision.
Adrenaline vibe: Stylish pixel visuals paired with a retro-wave soundtrack that keeps your heart racing.

title: Record Rewind Repeat
description:
게임 정보
"A clever take on the time-loop mechanic that will have you feeling brilliant one moment and clumsy the next." - Indie Game Buzz Editor

Record Rewind Repeat is a mind-bending puzzle-platformer that tests your timing, logic, and reflexes. Navigate 50 meticulously crafted levels where every move matters. Use a unique time-recording mechanic to create duplicates of yourself and work together across time to overcome intricate puzzles and platforming challenges.
Key Features:
Innovative Time Manipulation Gameplay: Record your actions, rewind to the past, and collaborate with your time-duplicates to solve puzzles.
50 Handcrafted Levels: Each level introduces new mechanics and challenges, testing your logic, timing, and platforming precision.
Simple to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls make it accessible to all players, while the puzzles grow in complexity to keep you engaged.
Minimalistic 3D Art Style: A clean, distraction-free visual aesthetic that highlights the puzzles and gameplay.
For All Ages: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves puzzles and platformers.
Plan your moves, strategize your actions, and execute perfectly timed maneuvers to solve challenging puzzles and achieve success. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun challenge or a puzzle enthusiast seeking your next obsession, Record Rewind Repeat offers an experience you won't forget.
Can you master time and logic to conquer all 50 levels?
Wishlist now and start your time-manipulating journey!

title: Go To Sleep
description:
게임 정보
Was that door always open? Or is something peeking out from inside the closet? Is that breathing yours or is that just the demon under the bed waiting for you to close your eyes?
Go To Sleep is a short first-person point-and-click survival horror game where you play as a young teen trapped in a dream-turned-nightmare. Stuck in his bedroom, you must survive until morning keeping a relentless demon at bay with your only source of support being a tiny stuffed companion.
Will you make it until the morning?

title: Embroideryvania
description:
게임 정보
Explore a one-of-a-kind embroidered metroidvania world in split-screen, local couch co-op, with a companion. This gem is perfect for players who’d like to introduce someone who doesn't play video games to the hobby. You play as a snail visiting a plant park, identifying plants you’ve never seen before. Customize your shell by finding unique designs in the world. Uncover mysteries and get safely lost in this peaceful world, as there are no enemies or combat to worry about. Only you, your companion, and the surrounding environment.

title: Hop On It
description:
게임 정보
Your goal is to reach the top.With nothing but a pogo stick, you start climbing. The journey isn’t easy. You’ll bounce across tricky obstacles, fight for control, and maybe lose your cool along the way. Play solo or team up with friends for some chaotic fun. Can you conquer the challenge, or will the forest get the best of you?

title: Untitled Hand Game: Titled Edition
description:
게임 정보
Hands on sticks... You're one of them. Things to hand out... There's a lot of them.
Embark on a short journey no hand on a stick has been on until now and never again. Rummage through things, avoid being slapped, and hand stuff out to other hands before they lose their patience.
RUMMAGE THROUGH STUFF
Stick your hand in various piles to find what the greedy hands are wanting. You'll need to be quick or they'll become impatient and just leave without even waving goodbye.
KEEP THE STUFF
Put your hand in danger to keep your stuff from falling on the floor, being slapped, or stolen by aliens in tiny UFOs.

title: Now I'm Home
description:
게임 정보
Do you love cats? How about a bit of chaos, strategy, and cuteness all mixed together?
Then you’re in the right place. Run your own little cat business, team up with uniquely talented feline friends, grow your production — and make some money along the way. It may look adorable on the surface… but beneath it lies a system that rewards smart decisions.
Key Features
✔ Thematic Neighborhoods – Explore levels inspired by cities like Istanbul, Rome, New York, and Beijing. Each region highlights its own unique cat breeds.
✔ Limited Space, Endless Possibilities – Make the most of a compact game board. Every tile matters.
✔ Cycle-Breaking Spirits – Special spirits can turn the tide of a match — but triggering them takes skill.
✔ Cat Collection – Dozens of cats inspired by breeds from around the world, each with unique passive abilities.
✔ Shops, Treats & More – Personalize your system with special items that boost your production.
✔ Gold & Rent System – Optimize your income and don’t forget to pay your rent... or you’ll be out on the street!
✔ Synergy & Interaction – The way your cats interact can make or break your economy.

title: Staroot
description:
게임 정보
게임 특징
■ 씨앗을 심어 키우고, 뿌리를 지키며 다가오는 적들을 막으세요
■ 카드를 사용해 불리한 상황을 역전 시켜보세요
■ 각각의 다른 특징을 가진 식물들을 만나보세요

title: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas
description:
게임 정보
《물감 공방》은 전략적 설계와 자동화 운영이 절묘하게 어우러진 공장 건설 게임입니다. 순수한 원색을 추출하는 것에서 시작하여 정교한 색상 조합을 통해 새로운 색을 창조하고, 개성 넘치는 캔버스를 제작하며, 다양한 흥미로운 도전을 해결해 나갑니다.
흑, 백, 적, 녹, 청을 기본 색상으로 삼아, 이를 조화롭게 섞어 나만의 환상적인 색조를 만들어 보세요. 혼합한 색상을 체계적으로 저장하고, 이를 적재적소에 활용하여 다양한 목표를 달성하세요. 세밀한 계획과 창의력을 발휘하여 도전적인 과제를 하나씩 정복해 보세요!
autokwd: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas,물감 공방

title: Banpo's Bridge Wondrous Worlds
description:
게임 정보
Banpo's Bridge Wondrous Worlds is a reimagining of the classic Japanese puzzle genre, Hashiwokakero, or hashi. Explore and experience a tranquil vastness while connecting islands of imaginative worlds with bridges, and play through an extensive catalog of increasingly difficult puzzles.
Features
An in-depth tutorial for learning how to play hashi
Play through 5 unlockable worlds
Over 200+ puzzles

title: Polytopia Island
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Polytopia, an immersive survival adventure where every decision shapes your journey. Spawn on a desolate beach and explore a world filled with diverse biomes, including scorching deserts, frozen winterlands, and lush forests. Gather essential resources like iron, lead, gold, and silver to craft tools, build shelters, and thrive in this open-world sandbox.
Embark on thrilling quests, such as uncovering secrets hidden in abandoned housing developments, battling zombie hordes, and unlocking blueprints for advanced crafting stations. Whether you choose to survive alone or collaborate with friends, Polytopia offers endless possibilities and challenges in a vibrant, ever-evolving environment.
Are you ready to carve out your path and conquer the wilds of Polytopia?

title: ZeroFactory
description:
게임 정보
Zero Factory는 마법과 기술이 결합된 독특한 생존 게임으로, 개방적이고 부패한, 그리고 끊임없이 진화하는 세계에서 생존과 인간의 창의력의 본질을 탐험하세요.
🌍 석기시대에서 여정을 시작하고, 기술을 발전시키며 거대한 자동화 공장을 건설하여 자원 생성과 관리의 궁극적 도전에 도전하세요.
캐릭터 커스터마이징 🔧

title: Ruby Journey
description:
게임 정보
You arrive with just one gold, and you want their ruby.
Trade, do quests, manage your resources wisely to get richer!
Talk to locals and grow friendships, all while discovering their lore...
Befriend
You've officially come to help the village to recover from its recent hardships.
(And officiously, to obtain their ruby.)
Accomplish the locals' quests to gain their trust.
Trade
The more you help a local though quests, the more trades he propose.

title: Escape The MonStalkers!
description:
게임 정보
무서운 생물들이 당신의 악몽을 괴롭히기 시작했습니다. 의사는 이 환영들의 원인을 알아내기 위해 마음속에 숨겨진 기억의 조각들을 찾으라고 합니다.

title: Harem Of Three Thousand
description:
게임 정보
Step into the imperial palace—a place of splendor, yet also a living hell.
You were born as an unremarkable illegitimate daughter, but upon entering the palace, you unexpectedly captured the favor of a cunning emperor. What seemed like a blessing from above soon revealed itself to be shrouded in mystery.
As jealousy brews and conspiracies arise, you find yourself the target of countless schemes. Initially wishing to simply stay out of harm’s way, you accidentally uncover secrets buried deep within the palace. As you delve further, the truth of the past slowly unravels.
A capricious emperor, a mysterious empress, and concubines with vastly different personalities—each harbors their own motives.
In the treacherous depths of the palace, where hearts are fickle and betrayal lurks behind every smile, can you navigate through the countless crises and survive until the end?
Game Features：
1.High degree of freedom in court life:
Experience ultimate freedom—rise to become Empress of the realm or explore countless romantic possibilities. Every choice you make shapes your destiny in the palace.
2.Multi-line plot and character strategy:
From the unpredictable and cunning Emperor, to the serene court musician; from the devoted yet tragic prince, to the rebellious and untamed royal, and even the fiery foreign prince. There’s even a secret female character waiting for you!
Game Rules：
1.Palace Development
Interact with characters through map exploration, chatting, playing chess, and probing conversations to increase affection and attribute points.
2.Intrigue and Assassination System in the Deep Palace
Build your influence, win over ministers and concubines, train maids and assassins, and secretly eliminate your enemies.
3.Experience the Joy of Raising Children
Design courses, arrange exams, correct the prince’s personality, and enjoy the process of raising royal heirs!
4.Luxurious Outfits and Customization
A large selection of exquisite outfits to choose from, with different costumes boosting different attributes, allowing you to craft your unique palace style!

title: Conlutus
description:
게임 정보
Conlutus is a short arcade adventure game featuring one large level. Collect coins and stars as you progress and manage you're oxygen levels to survive and beat you're previous high score. . 
You are a diver exploring a deep cave system trying to find your way out. You hog all the oxygen and try to make it out. The game loop is collecting coins in this one large map and unlocking doors to get the most amount of coins.

title: Of Sense and Soul
description:
게임 정보
In 1875 London, an editorialist and a gentleman have an unusual first meeting through a misconstrued personal ad. Their paths intertwine as they struggle against their own regrets and ways, and they must decide which to follow: their hearts, or the status quo.
Of Sense and Soul is a story lost to time, centred on two men navigating the smog-covered streets of Victorian London: Hugo Brooks, a reserved editorialist who never adventures far outside the written word, or Seamus Charkham, a confirmed bachelor who would sooner move forward blindfolded than look to the past.
Both are set in their ways, and both are in desperate need of a change, though loath to admit it. Despite wanting to believe they’re satisfied with continuing on as they have been, they find that sometimes, things can change for the better — and that the marks we leave on the lives of those around us are so much greater than we realise.

title: Play Together: Party Games
description:
게임 정보
Play Together: Party Games는 로컬 또는 원격으로 즐길 수 있는 재미있고 매력적인 파티 게임 모음입니다.
최대 8명이 함께 즐기는 협동 및 경쟁 게임
액션, 턴제, 다양한 미니게임이 준비되어 있어 모두를 위한 콘텐츠가 있습니다!
휴대폰을 컨트롤러로 사용하세요
태블릿, PC 또는 TV를 메인 화면으로 사용하면, 손님은 휴대폰으로 무료로 참가할 수 있어요.
Play Together 컨트롤러 앱은 브라우저, iOS 및 Android에서 무료 제공됩니다. 별도 다운로드 필요 없음!

title: Farlands Journey
description:
게임 정보
GAMEPLAY
A great adventure awaits you!
Embark on a journey to distant lands with a mission to save a magical academy and return the stolen heart of magic. Explore various locations, look for secrets, collect jewels and defeat enemies. Along the way, you will encounter challenges, puzzles and bosses.

Find or take from enemies various hats with different effects. Find or buy various magic wands with different types of attacks and summoning animal allies. Collect all the pieces of the puzzle and fight the final boss - the thief of the heart of magic.

title: Your Stepsister
description:
게임 정보
Meet Your Stepsister, an interactive Virtual desktop companion with a tsundere twist! She’s not just a cute anime girl sitting on your screen—she reacts to your actions, remembers past interactions, and has a personality all her own. Whether she’s teasing you, giving you quests, or demanding attention, she’ll make sure you never feel alone at your desk.
Features:
Interactive Desktop Companion – She lives right on your screen, constantly moving, reacting, and even commenting on your activities as you go about your day. She’s more than just an icon—she’s an engaging, dynamic character that interacts with you in real-time, adding a layer of personality and charm to your desktop experience.
Dynamic Mood System – Her personality evolves based on how you treat her, shifting between a variety of moods such as Happy, Annoyed, Playful, or even Sad. The way you interact with her directly influences her reactions, creating a truly personalized experience where your actions shape her behavior.

title: AI PAINTER: Painting Simulator
description:
게임 정보
붓으로 고전을 밝히고, AI로 기적을 창조하세요!
"AI PAINTER: Painting Simulator"에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 그림의 즐거움과 카드 전략을 교묘하게 결합한 창의적인 세계입니다! 여기서 당신은 상상력 넘치는 화가가 되어, 간단한 낙서와 AI의 마법을 통해 예술 거장들의 걸작을 재현하고, 독특한 스타일의 예술 카드를 수집하게 됩니다.
【AI 그림 시작하기】
이미지 1: 서버 상태 클로즈업]
1. 그림 인터페이스에 들어가면 Unity가 자동으로 로컬 AI 서비스를 시작합니다
2. 모니터 아이콘이 파란색이 될 때까지 몇 초 기다리세요. 이는 AI 서비스가 준비되었음을 나타냅니다
3. 파란색 아이콘을 클릭하여 AI 서비스에 연결하세요 - 연결이 성공하면 녹색이 됩니다
4. 이제 창작을 시작할 수 있습니다!
【핵심 게임플레이】
마법의 붓, AI의 기적:

title: Equate 8
description:
게임 정보
Equate 8 is an innovative and addicting new math puzzle game by the creator of The Devil's Calculator. Rearrange numbers in a 3x3 grid to solve eight equations (3 across, 3 down, and 2 diagonal) in the fewest moves possible. Challenges involve a variety of operators and difficulty levels. The game tallies your moves -- go for the gold!
Solving the grid in fewer moves will gain a silver or gold medal, but a bronze is awarded regardless, so don't stress. The daily puzzle gives players a free way to play and unlock content. Acquire “streaks” tokens by playing regularly. Exchange medals and streaks for Challenges, packs of themed puzzles.

title: RIFT WAR Tower defense
description:
게임 정보
An eldritch inspired 2D pixel art tower defense game.
This is a game about managing limited resource to spawn units and cast spells to destroy the enemy rift portal.
Take control of the battlefield with unique runic spells.
Spawn eldritch-inspired units to destroy the enemy rift portal.
This is a small game made as a hobby. Still, I hope that you will enjoy the game regardless! Feel free to leave comments so that I can use your feedback to create better games in the future!

title: Lots of Cats on an Adventure
description:
게임 정보
‘모험 속에 고양이가 가득해(Lots of Cats on an Adventure)’는 만화 속에 숨어있는 고양이를 찾는 게임이다냥!
 평화롭던 어느 날, 집사들이 외계인들에게 납치됐다!
이대로 지켜보고 있을 수만은 없던 한 고양이, 함께 집사들을 구할 동료를 모으러 떠나는데….
멋지고 다양한 핸드드로잉 풍경 곳곳에 숨어있는 고양이를 찾으며, 고양이 친구들의 좌충우돌 모험기를 함께하자냥!
2000+의 고양이와 특별한 물건을 찾아보세요!
파트 1 (무료): 메인 삽화 5+1개, 카툰 에피소드 5화, 고양이 750+마리, 물건 250개
파트 2 (DLC): 메인 삽화 5+1개, 카툰 에피소드 5화, 고양이 750+마리, 물건 250개
주요 특징
카툰 에피소드들과 메인 삽화들이 모두 이어지며 이야기가 진행됩니다.
1분에 한 번씩 힌트를 사용할 수 있습니다.
고양이가 없는 곳을 클릭해도 패널티가 없습니다. 마음껏 찾아보세요.
오리지널 사운드트랙을 사용하며, 각 에피소드별로 개성 있는 곡들이 준비되어 있습니다. 아울러, 기본 BGM 세트 이외에 다른 BGM 세트도 준비되어 있어, 취향에 따라 선택하여 들을 수 있습니다.
autokwd: Lots of Cats on an Adventure,모험 속에 고양이가 가득해

title: MareDare
description:
게임 정보
Play as the berry loving mare, Merry Berry, and help her complete the ultimate 6-level dare! Collect berries, avoid nasty spikes, traverse tricky levels, use portals and unlock the ending! All of this and more in MareDare! The ultimate mare game by Rakan Haddad Software!

title: Boat Together
description:
게임 정보
Paddle through the water with your friends!
Are you ready for a fun-filled journey on kayaks or boats? In this game, where you can play with up to 8 friends, you'll need to paddle well—because controlling your boat won’t be so easy!
Explore the islands!
Explore and discover islands with new biomes as you navigate through dangerous paths. Remember, each new biome offers a unique experience, and reaching the next island will always be more challenging!

title: Castle Crumble
description:
게임 정보
모험을 떠나 강력한 왕국을 정복하세요!
*Castle Crumble*에서 당신의 목표는 분명합니다—성은 반드시 무너져야 합니다. 완전히 시뮬레이션된 물리 환경에서 거대한 요새를 먼지로 만드는 꿈을 실현하세요. 파괴가 편안할 수도 있을까요? *Castle Crumble*에서는 가능합니다!
주요 특징:
다양한 도구를 활용하여 여러 가지 방식으로 성을 무너뜨리세요. 더 강력한 화력을 원한다면 부스터를 장착하고 진정한 파괴력을 unleashed하세요!

title: Everstrife
description:
게임 정보
A fast-paced bullet hell game infused with roguelike and card mechanics.
Featuring a vast array of heroes, spells, and relics, the game allows endless combinations through synthesis, ensuring a fresh experience with every playthrough.
30 spells that can be freely combined to create over 2,000 unique variants
7 expansive maps and 6 heroes with distinct skills
50 relics to synergize with heroes and spells, enabling thousands of strategic builds
Rapid progression to challenge relentless enemy hordes and formidable bosses
Fuse spells, unlimited creation:
Unique card and spellcasting mechanics:

title: HARVEST
description:
게임 정보
You are a contractor hired to perform routine maintenance in an abandoned hospital. What was supposed to be a simple job quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival. As you navigate the dark hallways, restoring power and unlocking doors, you uncover disturbing secrets hidden within the facility and its mysterious operations.
Rich lore: Stories unfold through files, computer logs, old notes, and environmental storytelling, helping the player piece together this sinister mystery.
Frightening combat: The player is trapped inside a building with dangerous criminals who will eliminate anyone that threatens their operation.
Immersive graphics and soundscape: Carefully crafted to imerse you in this dark abandoned environment

title: Sunset Sprout
description:
게임 정보



On a spread of islands on the Pacific Ocean, you get yourself one, and you aim to be a farmer! It is a long way from home, but the corporate life is just not for you, not after what happened, not after all the years you lost in that life!
However, you were only able to get an island in ruin, and you barely had enough cash to buy some seeds and see where you could take it from there!
Are you up to the challenge? let's find out!
34+ different plants & trees
35+ main quests
Farm expansions
Seasons
Day night cycle
Weather Effects
40+ Crafting recipes
10+ Buildings
5+ different animals
...

title: 60 Below
description:
게임 정보
60 Below is a single player survival horror game where you are tasked with repairing and maintaining the equipment in an underground facility to bring it back online and make sure you survive the new ice age. But be careful, as something wants to claim the facility for itself.
Key features:
Repair and Restore - Restore power to the facility and bring it back to life. Keep all systems operational to make survival easier and to kick out any unwanted guests.
Explore - Explore the frozen remnants of an underground facility and look for anything that can aid you in your journey.
Survive - Survive the cold by staying in heated rooms or by supplementing your body using questionable chemicals. Furthermore, the environment is not the only thing that is trying to kill you, so be careful as there is something that does not want you in his new home.

title: Heat incremental
description:
게임 정보
From the creator of reactor idle, factory idle and city idle!

Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET, Yes, really.

You’ll start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but soon begin to research less clean methods to produce even more heat. Who knows—you might
actually succeed in overheating the planet.

Managing excessive heat, however, is not an easy task. Be prepared for challenges and, yes, explosions. MANY EXPLOSIONS. In your defense, explosions also help heat up the planet. Explosions cause financial losses and can bankrupt you though...

This game introduces new features gradually. At first, you’ll see only the basics to help you get started, but as you progress, more advanced technologies and mechanics will
unlock. It is a long journey with plenty to explore.

Disclaimer: This game is HARD.
It is also a form of a puzzle game, requiring you to figure out efficient strategies to improve your setup and boost your income.
Keep in mind that perfection isn’t the goal—you’ll need to focus on specific areas and make trade-offs.

Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Chronicles of Veldoria
description:
게임 정보
A dark force is corrupting the land. Elemental creatures are losing control. You must master the art of battle, forge the most powerful weapons, and recruit legendary allies to halt Ogre Muk’s reign of terror. Will you rise as a hero, or let it fall into darkness?
Chronicles of Veldoria is a tactical RPG that redefines classic turn-based combat with its Press Turn battle system. Learn to exploit enemy weaknesses, merge with elemental spirits, and upgrade powerful skills to dominate the battlefield. Every attack matters.
                                                          Two childhood friends. A world in chaos. A tyrant rising.
Choose between Alex, the charismatic warrior, or Elizabeth, the kind-hearted mage, and embark on a quest across six vast regions, each guarded by corrupted elemental bosses under the influence of the dark tyrant, Ogre Muk.
Once you’ve chosen, you’ll battle these legendary creatures and uncover ancient secrets to strike a decisive blow against Muk’s sinister plans. You won’t be alone, however. You’ll encounter brave heroes who will join your cause against tyranny and many citizens worldwide looking to lend a hand.
                                                              Key Features

title: Exo Exploits
description:
게임 정보
은하 무역 연합(GTF)의 운영자로서, 당신은 기업 제국을 확장하기 위해 먼 행성으로 파견됩니다. 당신의 임무는 간단합니다: 공장을 건설하고, 자원을 착취하며, 수익을 창출하는 것. 그러나 탐욕으로 가득 찬 은하에서, 연합의 요구를 충족시키기 위해 어디까지 나아갈 수 있겠습니까?
산업 제국을 구축하고 확장하세요
효율성과 이익을 극대화하기 위해 미래지향적인 공장 단지를 설계하고 관리하세요. 자원 채굴, 생산, 물류를 조화롭게 운영하며 행성 밖 제국을 성장시키세요.
우주 함대를 제작하고 지휘하세요
무역, 연구, 방어를 위한 특화된 우주선을 제작하세요. 함대를 구성하여 수익성 높은 무역로를 확보하고 경쟁자를 물리치며 은하 곳곳에서 새로운 기회를 열어보세요.
계약을 완료하고 연방에 영향을 미치세요
GTF에서 자원 수집부터 함대 구축까지 다양한 계약을 수락하세요. 모든 결정이 냉혹한 연방 관리들과의 평판에 영향을 미칩니다. 성공은 보상을, 실패는 대가를 가져옵니다.
네온과 결합된 레트로-퓨처리스틱 미학을 정복하세요
Exo Exploits의 생생하고 신스웨이브에서 영감을 받은 비주얼에 빠져보세요. 빛나는 공장 바닥부터 박동하는 우주 풍경까지, 레트로-퓨처리스틱한 분위기가 모든 순간을 잊을 수 없게 만듭니다.

title: Car Factory Empire
description:
게임 정보
카 팩토리 엠파이어는 자동차 회사를 만들고 관리하는 게임입니다. 시장에서 성공을 거두려면 자동차를 이끌고 경주에 참여하고, 자동차를 개발하고 제작하고, 새로운 기술을 연구하고, 시장을 차지하기 위해 경쟁하고, 새로운 공장과 생산 시설을 차지해서 구매해야 합니다.
이 게임의 배경은 20세기 초, 자동차 시대가 시작되던 때입니다. 자동차 회사를 아예 처음부터 만들어야 합니다. 최초의 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 법을 배우고, 다른 제조업체와 시장에서 경쟁하기 위해 정기적으로 개선하고 개량합니다. 공장의 모든 생산 공정을 관리하고, 생산을 규제하고, 구매자를 찾고, 연구를 관리하고, 자동차를 설계해야 합니다. 100개가 넘는 자동차 기술과 10개가 넘는 다양한 차체 덕분에 자동차를 만드는 과정은 흥미진진하고 다면적입니다. 또한 생산에 필요한 자원을 추출하고, 원자재 공장을 점령하고 통제해야 하며, 다른 제조업체와 시장 점유율을 위해 경쟁하고, 직접 만든 자동차로 경주에 참여하고, 다양한 대회에 참여해야 합니다. 이 게임은 제작 시뮬레이터, 글로벌 전략 및 역동적인 레이싱의 요소를 갖추고 있습니다. 이 모든 것이 당신에게 진짜 자동차 재벌이 된 듯한 기분을 느낄 수 있는 기회를 줄 것입니다! 비싸고 빠른 차를 생산할 것인가, 아니면 싸고 대량 생산할 것인가? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!
카 팩토리 엠파이어에서 플레이어는 자신만의 자동차 회사를 만듭니다. 플레이어는 회사 이름을 정하고, 어떤 종류의 자동차를 생산할지 결정해야 합니다. 다음 모델 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다: 고급형, 저가형, 스포츠형. 어떤 종류의 자동차 공장과 그 자동차가 어떤 종류일지는 플레이어가 결정해야 합니다.  생산된 자동차는 품질, 신뢰성, 속도, 가격 등의 특성으로 구성된 특별한 등급에 따라 평가됩니다. 이러한 특징을 바탕으로 게임을 하면서 자동차 구매자를 찾게 됩니다. 하지만 가장 중요한 것은 자동차를 생산하고 판매하는 것입니다! 최초의 자동차는 다소 원시적일 수 있지만, 판매에서 수익을 냄으로써 플레이어는 자동차 설계에 새로운 기술을 개발하고 구현하여 자동차를 더 좋게 만들 수 있을 것입니다. 과학 건물에서 플레이어는 자동차의 새로운 차체와 유닛을 연구하고, 공장의 생산 건물을 개선할 수 있습니다. 관리 건물에서 플레이어는 공장 직원을 관리하고 생산 공정을 제어할 수 있습니다.
새로운 기계를 생산하고 연구하려면 플레이어는 자원과 원자재가 필요하며, 이는 세계 지도에 있는 자원 광산과 건물을 점령하여 획득하고 축적해야 합니다. 컴퓨터 상대는 이러한 건물을 차지하기 위해 플레이어와 경쟁합니다. 게임의 목표: 지도 상에서 가장 큰 도시를 장악하고 영향력을 행사하여 자동차 시장에서 핵심적인 점유율을 차지하는 것입니다. 자동차 생산에 들어간 노력을 보여주기 위해, 플레이어는 직접 자동차를 조종하고, AI와의 경주에서 만들어진 자동차를 평가할 수 있습니다. 플레이어가 자동차 디자인에 구현한 모든 기술은 자동차의 핸들링, 무게, 속도, 제동, 주행 거리 등에 많은 영향을 미칩니다!
Car Factory Empire에서는 회사가 파산하거나 타겟 고객이 없는 열악한 자동차를 생산할 경우 플레이어가 손해를 볼 수도 있습니다. 하지만 어떤 기계공장이 될지, 어떻게 승리를 쟁취할지는 플레이어의 결정에 달려있습니다! 귀하의 자동차는 대중화되어 대량 생산될 수 있고, 반대로 고급스럽고 명성 있는 모델을 소량 생산하여 성공을 거두고 경주에서 명성을 얻을 수도 있습니다! 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: Headshot Roulette
description:
게임 정보
Headshot Roulette is a crazy, adrenaline-pumping roulette simulator for daredevils with a shotgun. Blanks or a fatal shot? Luck decides fate, and the result is a spectacular brain-blowing!
The game is up to 4 players at one table. Challenge the cunning AI or play with friends live. Atmospheric room, flickering lamp light, ominous shadows - the tension increases with each move!
Unique items
Use all methods to change the outcome of the round.
Voice chat and gestures
Discuss a plan of action or try to intimidate your opponents.

title: CATACOMB
description:
게임 정보
CATACOMBS - is a single-player first-person indie horror game. The game is set from a unique body camera like perspective and the average play time is 1 hour.
What are the Catacombs?
Under the populous streets of Paris exists kilometers of long lost tunnels and rooms—where millions were buried.
You are one of the many urban explorers who find themselves lost in this underground world. Can you find your way out alive as an undead monster hunts you down?
Gameplay
You will have to explore many different tunnels and regions as you find your way out. Lurking around corners is a monster who chases you with chainsaws or his bare hands.
The map is carefully designed so that you quickly find areas of interest rather than being lost in long tunnels.
The game creates an immersive atmosphere with a unique body cam like perspective, beautiful 3D graphics and high quality 3D sound.
Warning: This game contains gore.

title: Diecast Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
멀티플레이어
멀티플레이어 다이캐스트 상점 시뮬레이터를 사용하면 다이캐스트 모델 상점을 관리할 수 있습니다. 세밀하고 사실적인 세계에서 진열대를 구성하고, 고객을 돕고, 상점을 확장하세요. 디스코드에 가입하여 다른 플레이어와 소통하고 다이캐스트 상점 경험을 공유하세요!
나만의 다이캐스트 상점 건설
처음부터 최고의 다이캐스트 제국을 건설하세요. 번화한 도시에서 창의력과 전략으로 꿈의 다이캐스트 상점을 디자인하고, 관리하고, 성장시켜 성공으로 이끄세요.
매니저
진열대에 다이캐스트 모델을 배치하고, 미적 감각과 효율성을 위해 매장 레이아웃을 최적화하고, 매력적인 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
커스터마이징
매장 구석구석을 커스터마이즈하고 장식하여 매력적이고 개인화된 쇼핑 환경을 조성하세요.
새 라이선스 잠금 해제
인기 브랜드의 라이선스를 구매하여 다양한 다이캐스트 모델을 구비하세요. 새로운 브랜드를 도입할 때마다 매장에 다양성을 더하고 더 많은 고객을 유치하세요.
희귀 아이템 찾기
희귀한 자동차를 찾아 컬렉션에 추가하세요. 독점 아이템을 제공하여 다이캐스트 애호가와 수집가를 유치하세요.
고객과 거래
고객과 교류하여 다이캐스트 모델을 거래하세요. 공정하고 흥미로운 거래를 통해 관계를 구축하고 충성도 높은 고객층을 확보하세요.
성장
매장의 물리적 공간을 확장하고 인테리어를 업그레이드하며 고객의 요구에 맞게 지속적으로 적응하세요.
온라인 주문
스쿠터로 온라인 주문을 처리하고 배송하여 적시에 정확한 배송을 보장합니다.
특징
다이캐스트 거래 시스템
청소 기계공
NPC 상호작용
랜덤 이벤트
광고 시스템

title: Escape from Chancellor's Chambers
description:
게임 정보
Escape from Chancellor's Chambers is a puzzle game with platforming elements where you play as a Wizard trying to escape from the many chambers below the chancellor's castle.

Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and find spells to help aid you in your escape. You may meet some interesting characters along the way!


There are several spells that can help the player progress past challenges that were previously impossible.

There is an in-depth story that will try to pull in the player and teach them about the world and the characters inside it, including what roles they play.

title: Prison Escape Simulator
description:
게임 정보
감옥 탈출 시뮬레이터 는 싱글 플레이어 탈출 및 생존 게임입니다.
달리고, 죽이고, 숨고, 올바른 길을 찾고, 섬에서 탈출하세요
게임의 스토리
죄수는 처형될 것이다. 그의 유일한 치료법은 감옥에서 탈출하는 것입니다.
모든 것이 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 생존하고 탈출하세요.
당신은 죄수를 구할 수 있습니까?
생존을 테마로 한 탈출 게임은 숨을 멎게 할 것입니다. 무한한 플레이로 액션 어드벤처를 경험하세요. 신비한 섬을 탐험하세요. 그리고 탈출 경로를 찾으십시오.
신나는 트랙
내리막길을 즐겨보세요. 당신의 재능을 보여주세요.
미로에서 탈출
미로에서 탈출할 방법을 찾으세요.

title: Invisible Wall
description:
게임 정보
A horror story that could happen to anyone.
Strangers who might show up at your door.
Choices you’ll have to make.
A truth that’s hard to accept.
This short psychological visual novel is more about perception than traditional storytelling. Every choice shapes your destination. Every detail is intentional.
Story
A young couple moves into a new apartment after their wedding - but the husband leaves on a business trip right away, leaving his wife alone. Not the best honeymoon, to say the least.
But that’s not the only problem that has fallen on their shoulders - a strange woman has started to visit the apartment.
Loneliness, confusion, and anxiety—this is how the story begins. Your decisions will shape what happens next.
But some things are beyond your control.

title: Urban Project
description:
게임 정보
Build Beautiful and Charming Cities in This Game
In this game, you won’t have to deal with complex tasks like micromanagement or resource tracking. Just relax and build your own city, increasing profits and completing quests.
You'll find a wide variety of buildings, each with unique behavior. The income from many structures depends on their location and neighbors, so you'll need to decide where to place your buildings for maximum benefit.
Here are just a few:
Field
Mine
Office
Amusement Park
And over 30 more!
If you ever feel that a building is placed in a way that hinders your plans, you can always demolish it.
Quests

title: TypInc.
description:
게임 정보
Typinc. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game.
Complete typing jobs presented to you to unlock perks which affects the score you make.
                        Features:
Typing stats such as Best Typing Speed, Average of Last 10 and Accuracy. 
Roguelike Deckbuilding
Unlock different perks for different affects

title: Whisper of Y'Ryando
description:
게임 정보
《옐란도의 속삭임: 크툴루 선집》에서는, 크툴루의 그림자가 짙게 드리운 세계에 발을 들여놓게 됩니다. 클락 라프크래프트의 절망적인 운명감이 느껴지는 이 게임은, 조각난 이야기 방식으로 펼쳐지며, 격동의 즈비다 시를 배경으로 합니다. 정치적 혼란과 혁명의 물결이 충돌하는 가운데, 숨겨진 위험과 비밀이 곳곳에 존재하며, 이성의 한계를 계속해서 시험하게 됩니다.
주사위를 던져 얻은 단서들을 통해 혼란스러운 세계 속에서 진실을 향해 나아가세요. 모호한 중얼거림, 고대 건축물의 숨겨진 기호 속에서 수백 개의 단서를 수집하게 됩니다. 이 단서들은 꿈과 환상처럼 보이지만, 하나하나가 퍼즐을 푸는 중요한 열쇠가 될 수 있습니다.
수집한 단서들을 결합해 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내세요. 《옐란도》의 비밀이 조금씩 드러날 때, 마치 어둠 속에서 형언할 수 없는 존재의 실체가 조금씩 드러나는 것처럼 느껴질 것입니다.
autokwd: Whisper of Y'Ryando,옐란도의 속삭임: 크툴루 선집

title: Mall Simulator 2025
description:
게임 정보
몰 시뮬레이터는 여러분이 직접 운영하는 다양한 상점이 있는 대형 쇼핑몰의 재벌이 되는 경험을 할 수 있는 편안한 1인칭 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
디자인은 중요합니다! 최고의 쇼핑몰 디자인을 만들고 상점을 관리하세요. 베스트셀러 상점을 전시하고 고객을 위한 완벽한 쇼핑몰을 만드세요.

제로에서 히어로로! 가장 유명한 브랜드의 새로운 매장을 열고 귀하의 쇼핑몰에서 그들의 제품을 판매하세요. 식료품점에서 보석점으로 매장을 확장하세요.

title: Gigantes Ex Machina
description:
게임 정보
게임 특징
『기간테스 엑스 마키나』는 로그라이트 메카닉 액션 슈팅 게임입니다.
많은 이들에게 친숙한 탑다운 시점과 레벨업을 통한 무작위 강화 및 업그레이드 시스템을 채택하여 플레이어가 보다 빠르게 적응하고 쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다.
화려한 폭발과 상쾌한 타격감 그리고 현실감 넘치는 사운드가 당신의 눈과 귀를 즐겁게 할 것입니다!

title: Tiny Devils
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Devils는 1-4명의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있는 빠른 멀티플레이어 파티 게임입니다. 벌과 자석 같은 특수 능력을 사용해 라이벌을 방해하며 미친 듯한 장애물 코스를 질주하세요. 왕관을 차지하고 결승선까지 달려가세요—가장 먼저 도착하는 사람이 이기지만, 혼돈은 피할 수 없습니다!
재미있는 반전이 가득한 혼돈의 경주
상대를 능가하는 창의적인 파워업:
비 스트라이크
플레이어를 쫓아다니는 벌을 내보내어 맞은 상대가 왕관을 떨어뜨리게 만드세요.
마그넷 매드니스
강력한 자력으로 라이벌의 왕관이나 가까운 아이템을 빼앗으세요.

title: Maze Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
You are a green alien of an unnamed species, embarking on a dangerous journey to reach the summit of the northern mountains — a rite of passage in your culture.
Armed with nothing but your wits, you must avoid threats lurking in every corner. Fortunately, mysterious power-ups and ancient devices are scattered throughout the land to aid you.
I like to describe the game as a new take on the maze genre — you are unarmed, and survival depends entirely on navigation, power-ups, and timing.
Each level consists of five areas, with the fifth area being a boss fight. Levels are accessed through a central world map, and new levels unlock as you complete previous ones.

title: A Deep World
description:
게임 정보
Deep World is a 2D stealth adventure game set in an alien underwater realm. Guide a fragile little creature as it explores, hides, and outmaneuver procedural animated monstrous predators on it quest to rescue a lost friend. Can you navigate the depths and make it back home alive?
Features:
Dynamic Underwater World
Explore a mysterious, alien ocean teeming with life and danger, brought to life with stunning 2D art and procedural animations.
Immersive Stealth Gameplay
Outsmart procedural animated predators by sneaking, hiding, and using your wits to survive.
A cinematic emotional journey
Embark on a heartfelt adventure to reunite with your lost companion and find your way back home.
About the development
Deep World was originally created as project in a game design graduate class at USC Games, in collaboration with students from Berklee School of Music. Later finished and polished for this full release by Jose Striedinger.

title: Decodence
description:
게임 정보
Decodence is an ultra fast paced first person movement shooter set in a Deco-Punk universe. It brings a highly advanced, open ended movement system together with hard to learn, skill based combat mechanics.
The grungy atmosphere takes inspiration from games such as Bioshock, Dishonored, Wolfenstein, and the movie Metropolis.
The game mechanics take inspiration from games such as Titanfall and Rust.
The physics based movement system takes an open ended approach, allowing players to bend its rules, which allows for the discovery and utilization of endless movement tech. This will create interesting, unique and dynamic gameplay.
Movement mechanics will be difficult to master leaving a broad skill gap in gunplay and combat. We will accommodate learning curve issues with a fair skill-based matchmaking system. Weapons will have various levels of skill required to use them proficiently and every weapon will have their own unique characteristics.
Each gun will have a unique, dedicated recoil pattern, rather than a randomized recoil pattern meaning players will be able to learn and eventually predict where their shots will hit. These patterns will vary in difficulty and will be the main determining factor in how difficult a weapon is to use. Although some recoil patterns will be able to be learned fairly quickly, every pattern will be difficult to completely master and players with better mastery of recoil patterns will have an easier time putting shots on target.

title: Flicker
description:
게임 정보
타일 기반 퍼즐 게임에서 초, 성냥, 연료 사이를 뛰어다니며 목표는 단순합니다: 불꽃이 꺼지기 전에 모든 초를 밝히세요.
기본적인 레벨은 메커니즘의 핵심 개념을 분해하여 가르칩니다. 직관적인 UI와 시각적 단서는 올바른 결론을 도출하는 데 도움을 줍니다.
힌트는 단계적으로 제공되며, 해결 방법을 얼마나 노출할지는 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다.

title: TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
최고의 TCG 멀티플레이어 카드 상점 시뮬레이터에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
상점 관리: 나만의 지역 게임 상점을 관리하세요. 최신 부스터 팩으로 진열대를 채우고 나만의 가격을 설정하세요.
카드 수집: 팩을 개봉하여 희귀하고 강력한 카드를 수집하세요. 컬렉션을 구축하고 다른 사람들과 거래하세요.
게임 호스트: 흥미진진한 토너먼트와 이벤트를 조직하고 주최하여 많은 사람들을 끌어모으고 활기찬 커뮤니티를 만들어 보세요.
상품 주문: 최신 상품과 독점 아이템을 주문하여 재고를 최신 상태로 유지하세요.
비즈니스 확장: 직원을 고용하고, 상점을 업그레이드하고, 공간을 확장하여 상점을 성장시키세요.
친구와 함께 플레이하세요: 친구 및 다른 플레이어와 연결하여 최고의 카드 상점을 만들기 위해 거래하고, 경쟁하고, 협력하세요.
최고의 카드 상점 거물이 될 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Oh
description:
게임 정보
Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience.
Key Features
Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects.
Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield.
Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests - every detail enhances the atmosphere.
Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face!
About the Development Team
Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.

title: Frick It
description:
게임 정보
스토리 중심의 협동 호러 생존 어드벤처입니다.
세상은 종말을 맞이했지만, 벙커의 인공지능은 인간의 의식을 지닌 로봇 생산을 멈추지 않습니다. 거대한 자기 폭풍이 뒤를 쫓는 가운데, 고철 차량을 타고 버려진 구역을 탐험하고, 크리스탈을 채굴하며, 귀중한 부품을 수집하고, 자판기에서 아이템을 구매해 앞으로 나아가세요.
여정을 따라가며 실패한 다른 로봇들의 이야기를 발견하고, 황폐한 땅을 배회하는 끔찍한 괴물들과 맞서 싸우게 됩니다.
아침은 비교적 안전하지만, 밤에는 항상 등을 조심하세요.
당신 옆의 동료는 친구가 아니라 위장한 미믹 로봇일 수도 있습니다.
비마저도 무자비한 이 세계에서 모든 행동은 선택이며, 모든 지연은 위협이 됩니다.
이 게임은 제가 혼자 개발한 첫 번째 작품입니다. 여러분의 피드백과 의견은 제게 큰 힘이 됩니다. 버그 수정과 개선을 계속할 예정이니, 꼭 리뷰를 남겨주세요. 즐겁게 플레이하시길 바랍니다!

title: Puppet: Hide And Seek
description:
게임 정보
Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer.
THE GAME:
Hide And Seek - is a multiplayer horror game in (7 vs 1) mode,
where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer, and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape the killer.

CAN YOU BE SAVED??
Multi-user features
Take advantage of our in-game positional voice chat. Invite friends or find other players using the server browser.
hide and seek
Hide in closets, walls, bushes, houses, but remember the main thing is your life is at stake.
Teleports
Find hidden places and discover new places where you can hide.
Killer
The Killer sees where you are talking, so you need to talk as little as possible.
Items
Pick up keys, bits, open locked doors and destroy the killer while there is a chance.
The goal of the Survivors in each game is to try not to get caught by the Killer and escape from the scene of the murders - it sounds easier than it really is.

title: No Retreat! The Russian Front
description:
게임 정보
NO RETREAT
 This game is a Strategic game on the Eastern Front of World War II.
It is a digital port from the famous and eponym boardgame, No retreat!, designed by Carl Paradis, which retells the story of the titanic struggle between the invading armies of Nazi Germany versus Communist Russia during WW2 at a player-friendly and manageable level of scope and difficulty. With only 70 Army/Front sized counters for the whole campaign, and with very low stacking, it’s a quick-playing yet realistic affair that favours the strategic and offensive-minded player.
 The moderate complexity of the game, the light number of armies and the contained size of the map allows easier onboarding, fast play and fun experience.
 In a skillfully blended collation of classic hex-based wargaming and modern card-driven simulations, No Retreat: The Russian Front stays truly story-centric, providing the proper feel of sweeping maneuvers, exploitation and encirclements across the vast steppes and forests of Russia.

title: KilaFlow
description:
게임 정보
KilaFlow is a fast paced precision 3D platformer where you play as a cute and mischievous Antivirus trying to fix the mistakes of it's creator and save all data from a mysterious virus!

A new blast from the past!
In KilaFlow, you play as a digital simulation of a Toy Robot named "Kila", the mascot of the "KilaFlow" Antivirus. It's creator, Connor D. Rive, has made Kila in hopes that it can cure and fend off any and all viruses that plague their life. Kila must find the nine keys of each program to gain access to the source of the virus and bring it back to the side of cute and friendly, by any means Kila (or YOU) feels like!



Walk, Run, Jump, Bounce, Spin, Charge, or FLOW your way to the end and save as much data it takes along the way! You may be an Antivirus, but when was the last time one of those ever REALLY fixed the problem, huh? Save all the corrupted data, or don't! Beat the best time, or take as much time as you need! As long as you reach the Golden Brackets, collect the key, and beat the virus, it doesn't matter how much you help as long as you're having fun!

With , each having , KilaFlow will present you with new challenge after challenge, obstacle after obstacle, huggable data critters after huggable data critters! Whether you're a speedrunner, completionist, or just here for casual platforming fun, there are many ways to play and enjoy this series of digital obstacle courses! Beat the best times of levels to get better keys and unlock secrets, save or ignore every data to receive awards or face stronger foes, and you can do it all without taking a tick of damage! The real challenge starts when you chose to perfect your runs and do every challenge the game has to offer. Though, if that's not your thing, just getting to the end is fine too! Play as much or as little as you choose!

From an to a with some questionable characters, Kila cleans it all! Chill out to the beats from a friendly dolphin in a Vaporwave Cove, or run across train cars in a Dinosaur ridden offline Desert. Be careful what you click when journeying through literal Ad Space, and don't trust every wise Gorilla offering to send emails for you in the big city. Who knows what Antivirus Adventures you might find yourself in!

KilaFlow is a small, simple, and fun little platformer I began developing to keep my spirits up, and I'd like to share that fun with you all as well! It has since succeeded it's Kickstarter with the support of it's community, and I intend to keep developing it with the players needs first! Thank you very much!

title: I will purify you
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 특별한 방법으로 괴이를 정화 시킬 수 있는 초능력을 가진 주인공 '제임스'가 되어 세계 각지의 초자연적인 현상을 해결해 나가세요.
 
 픽셀 그래픽의 귀여운 괴이들과 세계 각지에서 초자연적인 현상을 일으키는 강력하고 아름다운 그녀들을 만나보세요.

 I.P.U는 당신에게 계속해서 몰려오는 부하 괴이들과 일정 시간마다 등장하는 강력한 보스를 물리쳐야 하는 2D 픽셀 그래픽의 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

title: Orbital Challenge
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, and teleport your way through 10 challenging levels in this fast-paced physics platformer! Compete for the fastest time on global leaderboards!

title: Night of the Slayers
description:
게임 정보
정화의 밤의 기사들
헌터는 전투의 최강자로서 게임 맵에서 날카로운 중도끼를 장비하며, 근접 공격에 뛰어난 능력 외에도 원거리 투척도끼를 보유하고 있습니다. 멀리서도 사냥에 참여할 수 있습니다.

title: Coreless
description:
게임 정보
"Coreless" is a third-person, single-player action roguelike game that brings a unique twist to meta-progression with its versatile talent and power system. Choose from a diverse range of avatars, enhance them with talent points, and research and arm them with unique powers. Each adventure promises challenging endeavors and distinctive experiences.

title: Moonlight Traveler
description:
게임 정보
전투에 집중하는 액션 게임으로 심연에서 돌아온 소녀가 자신의 비밀과 구원을 탐구하며 반복되는 전투에 빠진다.
서로 다른 전투 방식의 적에게 도전하여 당신의 능력을 능숙하게 사용하고, 속성을 강화하며, 룬을 배합하여 적을 이기고 승리합니다.
신기의 선택은 매우 중요하다. 모든 신기는 유일무이한 성능을 가지고 있다.
부적 잠금 해제, 적절한 전투 스타일을 자유롭게 조합
여러 가지 흥미진진한 보스들이 도전을 기다리고 있습니다.
독특한 게임 진행 방식
근접, 원거리 및 신기의 조합, 다양한 공격 방식

title: Case 32
description:
게임 정보
간단한 설명
작은 지방 마을에서 일련의 신비한 살인 사건이 일어납니다.
쿠퍼 형사는 진실을 얻기 위해 신비의 얽힌 차가운 사건을 풀어냅니다.

게임에 대한 설명
이상한 사건이 쿠퍼 형사의 손에 넘어갑니다. 첫눈에
한 남자가 미쳐 아내를 죽이고 자살 한 것처럼 모든 것이 사소한 것처럼 보입니다. 우리가 범죄 현장에 도착했을 때,쿠퍼
이 경우 그렇게 간단하지 않습니다. 탐정과 관련된 신비한 이야기
스스로 자신을 발견하면 놀라운 것을 믿을 것입니다. 차가운 이야기,아니
이것은 당신을 무관심하게 만들지 않을 것입니다.

title: Oceanhorn: Chronos Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
화이트 시티가 가이아의 얼굴에서 씻겨 나간지 오랜 시간이 지났습니다. 한때 웅장했던 아카디아 왕국은 미지의 바다에 수백 개의 섬으로 흩어졌습니다.

네 명의 모험가들이 세계를 이전의 영광으로 복원하기 위한 여정을 시작했습니다. 소문과 예언을 따라 그들은 신화 속의 지하 단지인 크로노스 던전으로 들어가는 길을 찾았습니다.
깊은 곳 어딘가에 역사를 바꿀 수 있을 만큼 강력한 물체인 패러다임 모래시계가 숨겨진 있습니다. 바닥 층으로 가는 길과 크로노스 던전 안에서 기다리고 있는 도전을 알아낼 수 있겠습니까?

모든 연령대를 위한 던전 크롤러

오션혼: 크로노스 던전은 16비트 아케이드 클래식에서 영감을 받아 4명의 플레이어가 소파에서 협동하는 던전 크롤러입니다. 친구들과 나란히 싸우거나 혼자서 네 명의 영웅을 모두 통제하세요. 크로노스 던전의 밑바닥까지 가시겠습니까?

title: Overwork Empire
description:
게임 정보
This is a business simulation + tower defense + card game.
Cards are divided into construction cards, trap cards, employment cards, skill cards, and beverage cards.
In the preparation stage before work, players can use construction cards to expand the site and build facilities, and use employment cards to hire employees according to project requirements. Trap cards can also be used to arrange office supplies on the employees' path. Facilities are divided into R&D department, food department and power generation department. Players need to allocate talent resources to various departments to keep the company running
During the work stage, players use skill cards to make the escaped employees lose their will to resist and return to their workstations to continue working overtime. Or flip the card to become a beverage card to increase the energy of employees. Using skill cards or beverage cards will consume a fixed number of action points. After refreshing the card every 7 seconds, the action points will also be restored to the maximum value.
Players can develop multiple projects. When there is a shortage of manpower and funds in the early stage, develop outsourced projects to accumulate funds. When the conditions are met, you can develop self-developed projects. Unlike outsourced projects, self-developed projects can continue to generate income for a certain period of time after completion, and have the opportunity to be nominated for a series of awards such as the best game of the month.
When the player achieves the first award-winning achievement, he will be involved in a plagiarism lawsuit . From then on, the plagiarism function is unlocked, but the price is that every time you plagiarize, you will be sued.
If the player does not have enough funds due to misoperation, he can borrow money from the bank. Before repaying the loan, he cannot borrow again.
News events will occur every week in the game, which are divided into 4 sections: social livelihood, financial consulting, industry express and company development. The occurrence of events will pose challenges to the development of the company.
Players can use resources to unlock new company systems to reduce the pressure of dealing with challenges.
The game has multiple endings, including 1 good ending and 2 bad endings.

title: One Shot All Kill
description:
게임 정보
극소량의 탄알로 모든 타겟을 파괴한다! 
이 게임의 핵심 요소입니다.
※ 어떤 방식으로 모든 타겟을 파괴할 것인가?
"도탄 사격"을 통해 모든 타겟을 파괴합니다.
※ 이 게임은 단순한 도탄 사격 게임인가?
이 게임이 다른 게임과의 차별점은 "플레이어가 직접 도탄 각도를 만드는" 것에 있습니다.
탄알을 반사시키는 장벽을 이동·회전시켜 도탄 각도를 직접 설계하고, 다른 장벽과의 연계를 통해 단 한 발의 탄알로도 다양한 경로를 만들어내어 최대한 많은 타겟들을 섬멸할 수 있습니다.
※ 탄알 한 발로 도탄 경로를 많이 만들기만 하면 정답일까?
아닙니다! 맵 곳곳에 플레이어에게 도움이 되거나 방해가 되는 다양한 구조물이 있습니다.
플레이어는 탄알 한 발 한 발 발사하면서 맵의 구조물들을 전략적으로 활용하거나 방해가 되는 것은 파훼하며, 모든 타겟들을 섬멸해야 합니다.
※ 플레이어에게 높은 피로도를 주는 것이 아닐까?
플레이어가 전략을 강구하면서 쌓여온 스트레스를 타격감 있는 액션과 강력한 폭발 이펙트를 장식하여 통쾌함을 선사하는 것! 이 게임의 핵심 재미입니다!

title: Votica
description:
게임 정보
The People of Velkarya Are Ready... Are You?
Inspired by real life... but made more logical.
The citizens of Velkarya are heading to the polls, and you're on your way to becoming the next president in this complex modern nation.
Votica is a turn-based election simulation game designed for political strategy enthusiasts. Filled with single-player scenarios and competitive multiplayer action, the game is shaped by clever moves, public opinion polls, and media battles.
Run for Office with Your Own Character
Velkarya will decide. Are you ready?
At the start of the game, create your own politician—your background, strengths, and weaknesses will shape your campaign journey. Once your character is ready, the 12-round election marathon begins.
Plan Your Actions, Win the Vote
Promise, forget, promise again: the golden rule of politics.
Each round, make strategic choices with limited campaign points:
Media & Promotion: Appear on TV shows, dominate social media.
Public Relations: Fire up crowds at rallies, meet voters at local markets.
Polling & Strategy: Analyze Velkarya’s complex demographics, identify your target audience.
Negative Campaigning: Expose your opponents’ weaknesses.
Policy & Public Image: Expand your voter base with popular policy proposals.
Every game is different, as Velkarya’s demographics—including political leanings, age distribution, media habits, education level, and economic status—are reshuffled each time. This means new challenges with every election.
Serious Satire
Lies, promises, and a bit of strategy: the road to presidency!

title: Car Dealer Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
🚘 Ready to build and grow the car dealership of your dreams?
Car Dealer Life Simulator puts you in the driver’s seat of your own auto empire.
Start from nothing, buy used cars, inspect, repair, clean, and flip them for profit.
Negotiate with customers, take financial risks, expand your dealership, and rise to the top of the car trade world!

🏪 Start and manage your own car dealership business
🚗 Realistic used car system – mileage, engine condition, tire wear, age, and more
🧰 Add value through repairs, maintenance, and professional cleaning
💬 Negotiate with NPC customers and respond to dynamic offers
💸 Dynamic economy with price trends, seasonal events, and a changing market

💰 Borrow from the mafia – fast cash with serious risk
📉 Avoid bankruptcy through smart decision-making and spending control
🎮 Level up your character and unlock new trading abilities
🌍 Open new branches and expand your reach in the auto trade scene

title: Corrupted Souls
description:
게임 정보
Corrupted Souls is a dark action RPG that plunges you into a dying world consumed by betrayal, vengeance, and ancient horrors.
You are a silent warrior, cast into the abyss by the very kingdom you swore to protect. Now, surrounded by twisted monsters and cursed landscapes, your only way forward is through the blade.
Features:
Brutal Combat – Master dodges, parries, and strikes in skill-based battles.
The 'Burn' System – Embrace the demonic flame as you absorb damage and unleash your true form.
Deep Customization – Develop your stats and enhance your armor’s spirit to unlock unique resistances and abilities.
Lore-Rich Exploration – Discover the truth of your exile through ancient tombstones and lost relics.
Four Catastrophes – Conquer the elemental monsters chosen by the elders: Forest, Frost, Fire, and Lightning.
Steam Achievements & Cloud Save Support – Track your progress and play across devices.
Will you rise from the ashes, or be devoured by the world that betrayed you?

title: ReDrop
description:
게임 정보
디스클레이머
쉽게 빡치는 편이라면, 이 게임은 그냥 넘기세요.
그리고 막혔다면… 음, skill issue입니다. 걱정 마세요. 게임이 문제인 게 아니라, 확실히 당신 문제예요.
Git gud 하면, 승리는 달콤할 겁니다.
그게 싫다면, 분노로 가득한 여정을 준비하세요!
당신은 죽을 겁니다. 아주 많이, 엄청 많이 죽을 거예요. 즐기세요!
이 게임은 뭐야?
ReDrop은 픽셀 아트로 만들어진 2D 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다.
특이하게도, 죽어야만 앞으로 나아갈 수 있습니다.
무슨 뜻이냐고요? 죽을 때마다 플랫폼이 생성되고, 그걸 이용해 길을 뚫어야 합니다.
쉬워 보이죠? 그냥 계속 죽으면 결국 끝까지 갈 수 있을 것 같죠?
하지만 문제는… 당신이 만든 플랫폼 때문에 오히려 막힐 수 있다는 겁니다.
쉬운 점프도 불가능해지고, 방금 만든 플랫폼에 머리를 부딪치고, 운 나쁘게 길 전체를 막아버릴 수도 있어요.
자, 이제 게임 속으로 드롭할 준비 되셨나요?

title: DarkBlood -ReVerse
description:
게임 정보
Features of this game
.
DarkBlood2 is an RPG with simple controls.
Each of the nearly 20 warriors has their own goals in life, and some of them are emotionally scarred. You can change characters by talking with them, raising their intimacy level, and completing the quests assigned to you.
Some events can only occur with certain characters, so experience each life as you change protagonists.
How to proceed with the game
.
The goal is to reclaim the Holy Grail of Souls, which governs life and death in the world.
Gather information and explore the dungeon in search of the whereabouts of the Holy Grail.
Exploring a dungeon is a simple choice of going forward, going back, or choosing a fork in the road, but the structure changes each time due to automatic generation, so you can enjoy conquering it over and over again.
As time passes, the atmosphere of the town changes, and the NPCs that appear also change. By using special abilities, you can rewind time, so even if you fail in negotiation, you can start over.

title: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
description:

데스크톱 애완동물이란 무엇인가요?
고대에는 데스크탑 주위를 움직이는 작은 캐릭터를 보여주는 일종의 컴퓨터 소프트웨어가 있었습니다. 그들은 재미있게 성가신 일이었고 매우 인기가 있었습니다. 이 프로젝트는 현대적인 게임 로직을 캐릭터에 접목하고 뛰어난 시각적 요소와 물리학 기반의 상호작용성을 결합하여 해당 장르를 현대적으로 재해석하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
데모의 기능(곧 제공 예정)
Elly: 판단하는 눈으로 당신을 쳐다보는 괴팍한 펑크/고스 소녀
흔들림 물리학: 머리카락, 옷감, 가슴 및 엉덩이에 대한 풍부한 시뮬레이션

워크숍 지원
더 많은 성우 캐릭터
더 복잡한 동작

title: ZPF
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by classic horizontal shooters like Lords of Thunder, Elemental Master, and the Thunderforce series, ZPF is a passion project from the designer and developer of Super XYX and Tänzer.



Players will dodge and weave through intense bullet patterns, unleashing a barrage of firepower upon hordes of unique and challenging enemies.



Choose your hero - from the teleporting trickster to the laser-wielding warrior! Each character boasts a distinct playstyle with unique shots and melee attacks.



Brace yourself for epic encounters with mid and end-stage bosses, each demanding a different strategy to defeat.



Upgrade your arsenal and gain valuable tips between levels at each of the world’s in-game shops.



Finish every stage and discover a treasure trove of hidden secrets.

title: DodgeKill
description:
게임 정보
DodgeKill is not your typical game. Here, there's no character to control—your cursor is the one taking all the action!
Minimalist yet dynamic
A game visually simple, some geometric shapes, a few colors, and that's all.
But if we combine all this, we get a game with varied enemies and complex challenges!
Easy to learn, hard to master
Is it playable with only the mouse ? Absolutely! 
You just need to move the cursor. But make no mistake, even if the controls are simple, the game remains no less complicated! 
(Controllers and touchscreens are also compatible 🙂)
Gameplay
A unique gameplay playable entirely with the mouse
Various level filled with surprises, for increasingly difficult challenges
A tough difficulty that tests your nerves and will give you great satisfaction with each victory
Simple and intuitive controls, accessible to all players
Challenges available to increase the difficulty even more
 Ready to take on the challenge ?

title: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror game, where each episode tells the story of someone who came face to face with something unexplainable.
This is not a story about saving the world. It’s about those who tried to keep their sanity.
A Whisper of Loneliness — Episode One
You are Alex, a 22-year-old electrician sent to a remote island with a lighthouse. A group of geologists had been working there, preparing to reopen the old, sealed mines.
Then, suddenly — all communication stopped.
You arrive alone. Greeted by fog, a storm, the distant lighthouse... and silence. No people. Empty homes. Scattered notes.
And something watching you through the mist.
All you have are your tools, a kerosene lamp, and the growing sense that you're not alone here.

title: Death Ring: Second Impact
description:
