title: Console Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Console Shop Simulator" is a relaxing first-person simulation that brings every detail of running a store to life.
Store Management
Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Decide where CDs and consoles will be displayed, manage your shelves, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers.
Product Supply
Order stock using the in-game computer. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage area, and place them on the appropriate shelves for your products.
Trade
Trade with incoming customers, buy products from them and give other products in return!
License
Buy licenses to access new products, buy and sell. Get rewards by showing your loyalty to license companies!
Employees
Hire employees and pay their salaries so the store can run itself
Customization
Paint your store the way you want, shape your shelves. Decorate the store with LEDs!
Profit
Hunt for discounted items and buy them to save even more!
Online Sale
Listen to online orders and grow your business in the virtual space!

title: Checkmate Madness
description:
게임 정보
기물로 화신하나, 결코 주인에게 조종받는 병졸이 아니다.각 수사관은 독특한 초능력을 지니고 있다. 검술가, 마물사냥꾼, 사기꾼... 칼날을 휘두르며 한 치의 틈새에서 공포를 베어넘길 것인가? 총화를 장악하고 사냥의 시간을 선포할 것인가? 혹은 속삭이는 주문으로 기묘한 술법으로 전장을 지배할 것인가? 각기 다른 직업이 당신에게 독특한 생존 방식을 부여한다.
고대 신의 계약은 은총이자 동시에 저주다.자유롭게 조합하는 [계약]과 습득한 [스킬]로 천변만화의 전술을 구축하라. 광기의 심연에 침잠할 것인가, 이성의 방어선을 굳건히 지키며 체스판을 장악해 최후의 승리를 쟁취할 것인가? 당신의 선택이 모든 것을 결정할 것이다.
죽음은 종착점이 아닌 진실로 통하는 계단이다.매번 좌절은 소중한 계시가 되어 순환적 탐색 속에서 인식과 체스 실력을 재구성하게 할 것이다. 운명의 족쇄를 찢어버리고 층층이 쌓인 광기 속에 감춰진 우주의 궁극적 진실을 엿볼 수 있을 때까지, 이 순환은 계속될 것이다.
고대 신의 그림자가 체스판을 뒤덮고, 옛 규칙은 이미 붕괴했다.용기를 칼로, 지혜를 방패로 삼아 심연을 응시할 때, 이 붕괴된 체스판에서 생기를 찾을 수 있다. 이성과 광기의 잔혹한 격돌을 목격하라——매번 선택은 얇은 얼음 위를 걷는 듯하고, 매번 수를 두는 것은 영혼을 떨리게 하여 비길 데 없는 자극과 도전을 선사할 것이다.
이는 단순한 게임이 아닌, 고대 신과의 대결이자 이성과 광기의 시험장이다.
당신은 이 위험천만한 체스판에 발을 들여놓을 준비가 되었는가?

title: Love Cult
description:
게임 정보
Upon receiving visions of doomsday fast approaching, Meridian is left with one mission before time runs out: to reverse the world’s fate by summoning love through the forbidden art of divine matchmaking.
Skilled in an arcana of her own, Meridian’s answer lies in the heart of the mystical Lapis cards, as she consults the cosmos to inspire new love connections across the city, which has been overtaken by astral gods peddling their own twisted notions of love to their believers.
With the astrals’ targets set on her, Meridian must ensure that those who believe in her magic will be guaranteed an everlasting love, no matter the otherworldly obstacles awaiting. For as she sees it, a true love as foretold by the stars is simply the only way to stop the doomsday clock... and the key to a most amorous salvation.
8+ Hours of Gameplay where you play as Meridian, leading your followers to save the world from doomsday with the power of love!

title: All-Front Assault
description:
게임 정보
This is a game where players manipulate and command a commander from a customized perspective, controlling an entire team to combat alien creatures.
During battles, players can switch to any soldier at any time to serve as the commander, or they can independently control a squad or command all soldiers.
Killing enemies in battle earns reinforcement points, which can be used to summon turrets, fighter planes, or battleships for support. Powerful turrets and aerial forces can quickly alter the dynamics of the battlefield.
Players can also call for reinforcements, having transport planes deliver squads to the battlefield. This allows one's forces to overwhelm the enemy with numerical superiority.
In the game, players can form a legion comprising five squads. They can choose from a variety of soldier classes, with different combinations of soldiers yielding better results.
tag: 턴제 전술,전술 RPG,타워 디펜스,트레이딩 카드 게임

title: Billionaire in the Oil Boom
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1960, and the world is on the brink of an energy revolution. The discovery of vast oil reserves in the Middle East is changing the global economic landscape, creating unprecedented wealth and opportunity. Nations rise, corporations battle for dominance, and fortunes are made overnight. Will you seize the moment and build a financial empire, or will you be left behind as others strike it rich?
Money is never enough
In this era of rapid transformation, money is more than just a currency: it’s power. Take control of financial markets and wield a variety of investment tools to build your fortune. Trade in:
Stocks – Invest in emerging oil giants before they take over the world.
Bonds & State Bonds – Secure lucrative government contracts and finance infrastructure projects
Commodities – Buy and sell crude oil, gold, wheat and other valuable resources driving the global economy.
Real Estate – Capitalize on booming Middle Eastern cities as wealth floods the region.
Take Over Corporations – Control Industries
Investing isn’t just about buying and selling assets—you can take control of entire companies! Acquire businesses, set corporate strategies, and dictate their future. Will you build a financial empire through innovation, or will you crush your competition through hostile takeovers? Your leadership and decision-making skills will determine your success.
High-Stakes Special Operations – Shape the Market
To dominate the industry, you must play the game at the highest level. Execute powerful financial moves, including:
Mergers & Acquisitions – Absorb competitors and control global supply chains.
Private and Public Stock Offerings – Raise capital without losing control of your empire.
One well-timed move can shift the balance of power—but one mistake can cost you everything.
Exploit Global Tax Systems & Political Instability
The Middle East oil boom isn’t just about business—it’s about navigating the complex political and economic landscape. With multiple nations vying for control, you must .

title: WonderLang Korean
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering Korean transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.
WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.
More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!
WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, A1 level and A2 level learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.

title: 迷雾岛屿：9号万能试剂
description:
게임 정보
"Thank you for reading. A demo in English will be soon."
Story
You play as an amnesiac, piecing together fragmented memories to uncover the dark secrets both within yourself and hidden on the island.
One day, you notice that two of your regularly scheduled pills are missing. That night, your dreams overflow with bizarre visions—the man who usually visits you on schedule transforms into a killer intent on ending your life.
At the same time, your therapist at the hospital has been replaced by a new doctor: gentle, caring… and unnervingly similar in appearance to your “boyfriend.”
################################################################
In this fragile emotional web, will you choose Courage or Trust?
################################################################
Key Features
Two Parallel Routes
Each of the two male leads has an independent storyline.
Multiple Endings
Your choices affect two hidden stats—Courage and Trust—and determine which of the 8 possible endings you’ll reach.
Playtime
Approximately 5 hours of main-story content.
################################################################

title: Cleaning Simulator
description:
게임 정보
청소? 지루하다고 말했어? 그런 말 하지 마!
Cleaning Simulator는 너에게 대걸레, 진공 청소기, 스폰지를 들고 재미있는 청소 모험을 시작할 것을 초대한다. 더러워진 바닥, 산더미처럼 쌓인 설거지, 날아다니는 파리, 먼지 쌓인 카펫, 어지러운 방... 모두 너를 기다리고 있다! 하지만 걱정하지 마, 올바른 도구만 있으면 이 혼란은 순식간에 깨끗해질 거야.
편안하게 게임을 즐기거나 모든 미션을 완료하고 청소 마스터 타이틀을 얻을 수도 있다 – 게임은 네가 원하는 대로 진행할 수 있도록 해준다. 대걸레로 바닥을 닦고, 스폰지로 표면을 청소하고, 설거지를 식기 세척기에 넣고, 쓰레기를 주워 분리 배출하고, 파리를 약으로 처리하고, 카펫을 청소하고, 어지럽혀진 물건을 정리하고, 필요하면 고압 세척기로 고질적인 오염을 제거해!
청소하면서 환경이 어떻게 변하는지를 보는 것은 정말 즐거운 일이다. 특히 HDR과 레이 트레이싱을 켜면, 깨끗한 표면에 빛이 반사되는 것을 보는 게 정말 멋지다... 실제로 청소를 하고 싶어질 거야.
🧼 무엇을 할 수 있을까?
🧹 대걸레로 바닥 닦기 – 대걸레로 바닥의 오염물질과 얼룩을 닦아내자.
🧽 스폰지로 청소하기 – 벽, 테이블, 조리대 등을 스폰지로 깨끗하게 닦자.
🍽️ 식기 세척기 사용하기 – 설거지를 식기 세척기에 넣고, 깨끗하게 세척된 후 원래 자리에 놓자.
🦟 파리 처리하기 – 파리를 약으로 처리해 청결을 유지하자.
🗑️ 쓰레기 주워서 분리 배출하기 – 쓰레기를 모아 분리하고 버리자.
📦 – 어지러진 물건과 박스를 정리하자.
💦 – 고압 세척기로 고질적인 더러움을 없애자.
🧹 – 카펫을 청소기로 청소하고 바닥을 상쾌하게 만들자.

title: ESCAPE FROM TIMOKHA 2: ARMY
description:
게임 정보
Timokha caught up with the plane on the way to the Maldives and showed his secret weapon! What is it?! Maybe a new kind of pie? No! This is a summons to an exciting journey to serve in the ranks of the Pie Federation! Tough quests with polishing the push and painting the grass green await you! Escape as soon as possible, because mom and dad are waiting for you at the resort! This game is an exciting and funny quest that will definitely cheer you up! You have inventory at your disposal, with which you will interact to solve puzzles. A variety of army challenges await you:
1) Shooting at targets
2) Assembling / disassembling a pie shooter
3) Running over obstacles
4) Washing floors for speed
5) Push-ups and pull-ups
And ... Much more! Along the way, the main villain Timokha will pursue you and interfere with your plans! You will also be met by other hostile soldiers of the pie army! This escape will be unforgettable for you!

title: Rumbral
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in a dark, mysterious forest with no memory of who you are or why you're there. Move through a world filled with abandoned structures and puzzles, perhaps left behind by others. Survivors? Explorers? Discover strange magenta liquids that reveal secrets of the past… and maybe of yourself. But be careful: you might not be alone in this desolate place.
Throughout your journey in Rumbral, you'll come across strange magenta puddles that allow you to travel to another reality. Shift between these parallel worlds to influence both and find your way forward.

title: GOAL3
description:
게임 정보
GOAL3 is an arcade soccer game where there are no bans and rules! You will have to play fun and unpredictable matches on unique arenas, where nature itself will be the obstacle to victory.
This Tournament brings together the best national teams in the world - choose any of the 16 teams and fight for the Champions Cup. Or just play friendly matches - that's fun too!
The game features several arenas with unique game mechanics:
STADION - Beware of lightning, it's electrifying and very dangerous!
WINTER PARK - The freezing rain will freeze your hottest attack!
BEACH - Tornadoes are a hoot!

title: Demon of the time
description:
게임 정보
Short Description:
The sinister Demon of Time has broken free, unleashing chaos alongside cultists armed with deadly weapons from the future. As a warrior monk, only you can stop the darkness. Arm yourself, battle enemies in atmospheric ancient Japanese locations, and save the world at any cost!

Story
A thousand years ago, the Demon of Time was sealed within an ancient altar. But now, his followers have broken the seal, unleashing an ancient evil once again. Warping the fabric of history, the demon steals weapons from future eras, equipping his minions with power that should never exist. If he is not stopped, time itself will collapse, merging past, present, and future into a whirlwind of chaos.
To protect the altar, the dark spirit has granted two of his most loyal servants, the ninja Gekko and the samurai Raijin, unimaginable powers. No longer human, they have become monstrous beings, capable of crushing entire armies. Can you fight through hordes of cultists and defeat these two unstoppable warriors, or is the world doomed to descend into madness?


Artifact Hunt
The only hope to seal the Demon of Time once more lies in five sacred artifacts hidden near the spirit’s temple. These relics hold the power to restore balance, but they are fiercely guarded by fanatical cultists who will stop at nothing. Only you can stand against the darkness—break the cult, recover the artifacts, and stop the growing chaos before it’s too late.



Demon Of The Time is a fast-paced first-person arcade shooter featuring intense and cinematic combat across expansive, meticulously designed locations inspired by ancient Japan.

Your arsenal consists of a wide variety of modern weapons transported to this distorted past—pistols, shotguns, rapid-fire machine guns, devastating rocket launchers, and more.

Throughout the levels, you can discover various abilities to enhance your combat skills: speed boosts, shields, infinite ammo, and more. Use them wisely, and the cultists won’t stand a chance!

On your path to the Demon’s altar, you will face a diverse array of enemies—feral geishas attacking with bare hands, farmers lurking in bamboo forests with shotguns, and demonic samurai wielding supernatural powers. But your greatest challenge awaits: Gekko and Raijin, the altar’s monstrous guardians, armed with devastating abilities and weapons.

Are you ready to challenge time itself? Fight your enemies, gather the artifacts, and seal the Demon of Time before reality collapses!

Key Features:
🎮 Immersive low-poly visuals with a rich ancient Japanese atmosphere.
📖 A gripping storyline about the battle against the ancient Demon of Time.
💥 Fast-paced and cinematic combat.
🔫 A vast arsenal of powerful and diverse weapons.
👹 Various enemy types and unique bosses.
🕵️‍♂️ Hunt for sacred artifacts that influence the game’s ending.
🎯 Additional missions for true combat masters.
🗺️ Six diverse levels to explore.

title: Snowfall's Mystery
description:
게임 정보
The main character, a student-programmer named Elliot, has been struggling with mental disorders for a long time. He dreams of one thing – to create a robot assistant that would warm him in the winter of 1999. One day, he receives a floppy disk with a mysterious messenger from his best and, perhaps, only friend. It seems that this program knows more about him than he does, and every conversation with it reveals new aspects of his inner world.
Help Elliot overcome his mental issues and confront his inner demons. Become part of a philosophical journey through the lens of technology and the human psyche.
Key Features:
Psychological Narrative – A multitude of secrets hidden in the story that make you reflect on the hero's psyche and the world around him.
Interactivity – Instead of just reading text, the game incorporates interactive elements to enrich the experience.
Stylistic Design – Minimalistic design using only two colors creates an atmosphere of mystery and tension.
Atmosphere – A tense, enigmatic atmosphere that enhances the sense of uncertainty and intrigue.
Two Endings – The game offers two different conclusions based on the choices you make.
Philosophical and Moral Dilemmas – The game presents choices that challenge you on issues of morality, responsibility, and the nature of humanity.

title: Rage Room: Catharsis
description:
게임 정보
Rage Room Catharsis: The Most Enjoyable Way to Release Stress
Ever felt tense at the end of a long day? Rage Room Catharsis is designed precisely for those moments!
Psychological research shows that physical expression in a safe and controlled environment can lower stress levels, support mental balance, and promote emotional relief. The ancient practice of catharsis now meets the immersive power of virtual reality.
How Does It Work?
While playing, your body naturally:
• Reduces stress hormone levels
• Releases endorphins (your “happy hormones”)
• Relieves muscle tension
• Calms your mind
So, when you put on your VR headset, you’re not just playing—you’re rebalancing your nervous system.
Why Rage Room Catharsis?
🧨 Smash the Unsmasheable
Shatter expensive vases, giant TVs, and office chairs—do the impossible in VR, safely and guilt-free.
🔨 Choose Your Weapon
Sledgehammer, baseball bat, handgun, laser sword—whatever fits your stress relief style.
⚡ Slow Motion Mode
Feel every hit in cinematic slow motion. Watch debris fly and tension melt away.
🌍 Diverse Environments
Not just a room! Explore metro stations, space bases, industrial labs, and more to match your mood.

title: Night Crew
description:
게임 정보
"Explore Twilight Palms Mall, a pure-blooded American retail paradise! Frequented by happy customers, cannibals, spiritual beings, and our lovely mall staff."
With proximity voice chat, physics based movement and up to 5 other friends, complete your shift as a member of the Night Crew!
Oh god. It Knows.
You are hunted. Run or hide from nocturnal monstrosities that track with you not only with sight, but sound and smell too. That pie you pinched from the bakery, may mean you end up in the next batch.
The Job
Management have a couple of boxes they want ticking. Luckily, they have several suckers 𝚝𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚎𝚍 𝚊𝚜𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚜 to sort them out. Fix cabling, clean up trash, 𐌄𐋄Ꝋ𐌐𐌂𐌉𐌔𐌄 𐌔Ꝋ𐌌𐌄 𐌔𐌓𐌉𐌐𐌉𐌕𐌔... Whatever it takes to keep the suits happy.
And If you or one of your companions meets an unfortunate end... well... someone will have to clean that mess up...
Many ways to die.
Served in soup. Neck snapped. Lost in madness. Crew members are exposed to a myriad of horrifying entities in the faint glow of neon light. Maybe it's time to break out that torch, and a can of bear spray.
Shareholder Satisfaction
Keep management happy and your head above water - or you may lose it.
The executives want one thing: year on year growth. Just keep the freaks under the rug.
𝙽𝚘𝚝𝚑𝚒𝚗𝚐 𝚒𝚜 𝚜𝚙𝚘𝚘𝚔𝚒𝚎𝚛 𝚝𝚑𝚊𝚗 𝚊 𝚍𝚒𝚙 𝚒𝚗 𝚜𝚑𝚊𝚛𝚎 𝚙𝚛𝚒𝚌𝚎𝚜!
The Crew
Pick your unique crew member, each with powerful and upgradable traits that allow you to make a huge impact. Each misfit plays differently, and different combinations will give you endless ways to complete your tasks!
Features

title: A Deep World
description:
게임 정보
Deep World is a 2D stealth adventure game set in an alien underwater realm. Guide a fragile little creature as it explores, hides, and outmaneuver procedural animated monstrous predators on it quest to rescue a lost friend. Can you navigate the depths and make it back home alive?
Features:
Dynamic Underwater World
Explore a mysterious, alien ocean teeming with life and danger, brought to life with stunning 2D art and procedural animations.
Immersive Stealth Gameplay
Outsmart procedural animated predators by sneaking, hiding, and using your wits to survive.
A cinematic emotional journey
Embark on a heartfelt adventure to reunite with your lost companion and find your way back home.
About the development
Deep World was originally created as project in a game design graduate class at USC Games, in collaboration with students from Berklee School of Music. Later finished and polished for this full release by Jose Striedinger.

title: Decodence
description:
게임 정보
Decodence is an ultra fast paced first person movement shooter set in a Deco-Punk universe. It brings a highly advanced, open ended movement system together with hard to learn, skill based combat mechanics.
The grungy atmosphere takes inspiration from games such as Bioshock, Dishonored, Wolfenstein, and the movie Metropolis.
The game mechanics take inspiration from games such as Titanfall and Rust.
The physics based movement system takes an open ended approach, allowing players to bend its rules, which allows for the discovery and utilization of endless movement tech. This will create interesting, unique and dynamic gameplay.
Movement mechanics will be difficult to master leaving a broad skill gap in gunplay and combat. We will accommodate learning curve issues with a fair skill-based matchmaking system. Weapons will have various levels of skill required to use them proficiently and every weapon will have their own unique characteristics.
Each gun will have a unique, dedicated recoil pattern, rather than a randomized recoil pattern meaning players will be able to learn and eventually predict where their shots will hit. These patterns will vary in difficulty and will be the main determining factor in how difficult a weapon is to use. Although some recoil patterns will be able to be learned fairly quickly, every pattern will be difficult to completely master and players with better mastery of recoil patterns will have an easier time putting shots on target.

title: Flicker
description:
게임 정보
타일 기반 퍼즐 게임에서 초, 성냥, 연료 사이를 뛰어다니며 목표는 단순합니다: 불꽃이 꺼지기 전에 모든 초를 밝히세요.
기본적인 레벨은 메커니즘의 핵심 개념을 분해하여 가르칩니다. 직관적인 UI와 시각적 단서는 올바른 결론을 도출하는 데 도움을 줍니다.
힌트는 단계적으로 제공되며, 해결 방법을 얼마나 노출할지는 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다.

title: TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
최고의 TCG 멀티플레이어 카드 상점 시뮬레이터에 오신 것을 환영합니다!
상점 관리: 나만의 지역 게임 상점을 관리하세요. 최신 부스터 팩으로 진열대를 채우고 나만의 가격을 설정하세요.
카드 수집: 팩을 개봉하여 희귀하고 강력한 카드를 수집하세요. 컬렉션을 구축하고 다른 사람들과 거래하세요.
게임 호스트: 흥미진진한 토너먼트와 이벤트를 조직하고 주최하여 많은 사람들을 끌어모으고 활기찬 커뮤니티를 만들어 보세요.
상품 주문: 최신 상품과 독점 아이템을 주문하여 재고를 최신 상태로 유지하세요.
비즈니스 확장: 직원을 고용하고, 상점을 업그레이드하고, 공간을 확장하여 상점을 성장시키세요.
친구와 함께 플레이하세요: 친구 및 다른 플레이어와 연결하여 최고의 카드 상점을 만들기 위해 거래하고, 경쟁하고, 협력하세요.
최고의 카드 상점 거물이 될 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Oh
description:
게임 정보
Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience.
Key Features
Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects.
Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield.
Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests - every detail enhances the atmosphere.
Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face!
About the Development Team
Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.

title: Frick It
description:
게임 정보
스토리 중심의 협동 호러 생존 어드벤처입니다.
세상은 종말을 맞이했지만, 벙커의 인공지능은 인간의 의식을 지닌 로봇 생산을 멈추지 않습니다. 거대한 자기 폭풍이 뒤를 쫓는 가운데, 고철 차량을 타고 버려진 구역을 탐험하고, 크리스탈을 채굴하며, 귀중한 부품을 수집하고, 자판기에서 아이템을 구매해 앞으로 나아가세요.
여정을 따라가며 실패한 다른 로봇들의 이야기를 발견하고, 황폐한 땅을 배회하는 끔찍한 괴물들과 맞서 싸우게 됩니다.
아침은 비교적 안전하지만, 밤에는 항상 등을 조심하세요.
당신 옆의 동료는 친구가 아니라 위장한 미믹 로봇일 수도 있습니다.
비마저도 무자비한 이 세계에서 모든 행동은 선택이며, 모든 지연은 위협이 됩니다.
이 게임은 제가 혼자 개발한 첫 번째 작품입니다. 여러분의 피드백과 의견은 제게 큰 힘이 됩니다. 버그 수정과 개선을 계속할 예정이니, 꼭 리뷰를 남겨주세요. 즐겁게 플레이하시길 바랍니다!

title: Of Sense and Soul
description:
게임 정보
In 1875 London, an editorialist and a gentleman have an unusual first meeting through a misconstrued personal ad. Their paths intertwine as they struggle against their own regrets and ways, and they must decide which to follow: their hearts, or the status quo.
Of Sense and Soul is a story lost to time, centred on two men navigating the smog-covered streets of Victorian London: Hugo Brooks, a reserved editorialist who never adventures far outside the written word, or Seamus Charkham, a confirmed bachelor who would sooner move forward blindfolded than look to the past.
Both are set in their ways, and both are in desperate need of a change, though loath to admit it. Despite wanting to believe they’re satisfied with continuing on as they have been, they find that sometimes, things can change for the better — and that the marks we leave on the lives of those around us are so much greater than we realise.

title: Bygone Dreams
description:
게임 정보
PC 게임 기술 콘퍼런스 'REBOOT Develop 2017'에서 "영상 체험상" 수상!
2021년도 WN Dev 콘테스트 우승작!
꿈과 환상이 뒤섞인 "Bygone Dreams: 지나간 꿈"의 세계로 여러분을 초대합니다.
스토리
여러분은 힘을 잃어버린 여신과 '악몽'이 세상을 먹어 치울 때 눈을 뜨게 됩니다.
'와'라는 이름을 지닌 여러분의 눈앞에 펼쳐진 것은 이 세계의 어머니인 여신이 지키던 꿈의 대지, '루메'. 하지만 지금 루메는 세계를 먹어 치우는 악몽의 위협에 놓여 있습니다.
사라져 가는 여신의 마지막 말에 따라, 여러분은 세상을 구하기 위해 오래전 이 대지를 지키던 수호자를 찾는 여행을 시작합니다......
슬라브 신화와 중세 보스니아 전승을 기반으로 Prime Time Studio가 그려낸 "Bygone Dreams"의 독특한 세계를 꼭 경험해 보세요.

title: Maze Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
You are a green alien of an unnamed species, embarking on a dangerous journey to reach the summit of the northern mountains — a rite of passage in your culture.
Armed with nothing but your wits, you must avoid threats lurking in every corner. Fortunately, mysterious power-ups and ancient devices are scattered throughout the land to aid you.
I like to describe the game as a new take on the maze genre — you are unarmed, and survival depends entirely on navigation, power-ups, and timing.
Each level consists of five areas, with the fifth area being a boss fight. Levels are accessed through a central world map, and new levels unlock as you complete previous ones.

As a personal initiative, I’ve decided to donate 25% of my earnings from this game to humanitarian relief efforts in Gaza, via the Danish Red Cross (Røde Kors Danmark). Read more here:

title: Puppet: Hide And Seek
description:
게임 정보
Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer.
THE GAME:
Hide And Seek - is a multiplayer horror game in (7 vs 1) mode,
where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer, and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape the killer.

CAN YOU BE SAVED??
Multi-user features
Take advantage of our in-game positional voice chat. Invite friends or find other players using the server browser.
hide and seek
Hide in closets, walls, bushes, houses, but remember the main thing is your life is at stake.
Teleports
Find hidden places and discover new places where you can hide.
Killer
The Killer sees where you are talking, so you need to talk as little as possible.
Items
Pick up keys, bits, open locked doors and destroy the killer while there is a chance.
The goal of the Survivors in each game is to try not to get caught by the Killer and escape from the scene of the murders - it sounds easier than it really is.

title: No Retreat! The Russian Front
description:
게임 정보
NO RETREAT
 This game is a Strategic game on the Eastern Front of World War II.
It is a digital port from the famous and eponym boardgame, No retreat!, designed by Carl Paradis, which retells the story of the titanic struggle between the invading armies of Nazi Germany versus Communist Russia during WW2 at a player-friendly and manageable level of scope and difficulty. With only 70 Army/Front sized counters for the whole campaign, and with very low stacking, it’s a quick-playing yet realistic affair that favours the strategic and offensive-minded player.
 The moderate complexity of the game, the light number of armies and the contained size of the map allows easier onboarding, fast play and fun experience.
 In a skillfully blended collation of classic hex-based wargaming and modern card-driven simulations, No Retreat: The Russian Front stays truly story-centric, providing the proper feel of sweeping maneuvers, exploitation and encirclements across the vast steppes and forests of Russia.

title: KilaFlow
description:
게임 정보
KilaFlow is a fast paced precision 3D platformer where you play as a cute and mischievous Antivirus trying to fix the mistakes of it's creator and save all data from a mysterious virus!

A new blast from the past!
In KilaFlow, you play as a digital simulation of a Toy Robot named "Kila", the mascot of the "KilaFlow" Antivirus. It's creator, Connor D. Rive, has made Kila in hopes that it can cure and fend off any and all viruses that plague their life. Kila must find the nine keys of each program to gain access to the source of the virus and bring it back to the side of cute and friendly, by any means Kila (or YOU) feels like!



Walk, Run, Jump, Bounce, Spin, Charge, or FLOW your way to the end and save as much data it takes along the way! You may be an Antivirus, but when was the last time one of those ever REALLY fixed the problem, huh? Save all the corrupted data, or don't! Beat the best time, or take as much time as you need! As long as you reach the Golden Brackets, collect the key, and beat the virus, it doesn't matter how much you help as long as you're having fun!

With , each having , KilaFlow will present you with new challenge after challenge, obstacle after obstacle, huggable data critters after huggable data critters! Whether you're a speedrunner, completionist, or just here for casual platforming fun, there are many ways to play and enjoy this series of digital obstacle courses! Beat the best times of levels to get better keys and unlock secrets, save or ignore every data to receive awards or face stronger foes, and you can do it all without taking a tick of damage! The real challenge starts when you chose to perfect your runs and do every challenge the game has to offer. Though, if that's not your thing, just getting to the end is fine too! Play as much or as little as you choose!

From an to a with some questionable characters, Kila cleans it all! Chill out to the beats from a friendly dolphin in a Vaporwave Cove, or run across train cars in a Dinosaur ridden offline Desert. Be careful what you click when journeying through literal Ad Space, and don't trust every wise Gorilla offering to send emails for you in the big city. Who knows what Antivirus Adventures you might find yourself in!

KilaFlow is a small, simple, and fun little platformer I began developing to keep my spirits up, and I'd like to share that fun with you all as well! It has since succeeded it's Kickstarter with the support of it's community, and I intend to keep developing it with the players needs first! Thank you very much!

title: I will purify you
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 특별한 방법으로 괴이를 정화 시킬 수 있는 초능력을 가진 주인공 '제임스'가 되어 세계 각지의 초자연적인 현상을 해결해 나가세요.
 
 픽셀 그래픽의 귀여운 괴이들과 세계 각지에서 초자연적인 현상을 일으키는 강력하고 아름다운 그녀들을 만나보세요.

 I.P.U는 당신에게 계속해서 몰려오는 부하 괴이들과 일정 시간마다 등장하는 강력한 보스를 물리쳐야 하는 2D 픽셀 그래픽의 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

title: Date or Destiny : Kiss or Miss
description:
게임 정보
평범한 러브 스토리를 넘어 **"Date or Destiny: Kiss or Miss"**에서 카안을 조종하세요. 아버지에게 쫓겨난 청년 카안은 목적 없이 삶을 떠돕니다. 낯선 이들과 놀라움으로 가득한 도시에서 그의 운명을 당신이 결정해야 합니다.
새로운 사람들을 만나고, 말을 신중히 선택하며, 누구를 믿고, 누구를 멀리할지, 마음을 따를지 머리를 따를지 결정하세요. 모든 선택은 다른 결과를 낳고, 매 순간이 전환점입니다.
autokwd: Date or Destiny : Kiss or Miss

title: Ominous Stew
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Ominous Stew, the chaotic 1vs1 cooking battle game that pits legendary chefs against each other in fast-paced culinary duels! Dive into the chaos in Story Mode or challenge friends in Versus Mode.
In Ominous Stew, it's restaurant vs. restaurant in thrilling 3-7 minute rounds. Move swiftly between customers to cook and serve dishes, aiming to outscore your opponent and claim culinary supremacy.
Experience the freedom of cooking without recipes! Combine a variety of ingredients based on your customers' nutritional needs. Create unique dishes to earn points and prove your problem solving skills.

title: Blood Rush
description:
게임 정보
BLOOD RUSH는 ULTRAKILL과 Hades 같은 장르의 거장들에게서 영감을 받은 강렬한 로그라이트 FPS입니다.
절차적으로 생성되는 지옥에 뛰어들어, 독창적인 무기를 손에 넣고 새로운 능력을 개방하며 강력한 시너지를 만들어내세요. 자유를 향한 길을 가로막는 모든 도전에 맞서 싸우십시오.

속도와 정밀함
지옥은 가혹한 곳입니다. 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들 사이에서 생존하려면, 기동성이 가장 강력한 무기가 될 것입니다. 멀찍이 회피하며 안전한 전투를 펼칠 수도 있고, 과감하게 적을 압박하는 공격적인 플레이도 가능합니다. 하지만 어떤 전략을 선택하든, 정교한 헤드샷 한 방이 승패를 가를 것입니다.

우상과 유물
지옥의 심연을 탐험하며 유물과 우상의 힘을 이용해 보세요. 강력한 업그레이드와 독특한 능력을 부여받아 더욱 강해질 수 있습니다. 탐험 중 발견한 시너지와 기회를 활용해, 전투 스타일을 유동적으로 변화시키세요.

title: Orbital Challenge
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, and teleport your way through 10 challenging levels in this fast-paced physics platformer! Compete for the fastest time on global leaderboards!

title: Night of the Slayers
description:
게임 정보
정화의 밤의 기사들
헌터는 전투의 최강자로서 게임 맵에서 날카로운 중도끼를 장비하며, 근접 공격에 뛰어난 능력 외에도 원거리 투척도끼를 보유하고 있습니다. 멀리서도 사냥에 참여할 수 있습니다.

title: Coreless
description:
게임 정보
"Coreless" is a third-person, single-player action roguelike game that brings a unique twist to meta-progression with its versatile talent and power system. Choose from a diverse range of avatars, enhance them with talent points, and research and arm them with unique powers. Each adventure promises challenging endeavors and distinctive experiences.
tag: 액션 로그라이크,핵 앤 슬래시,던전 크롤러,액션 RPG

title: Moonlight Traveler
description:
게임 정보
전투에 집중하는 액션 게임으로 심연에서 돌아온 소녀가 자신의 비밀과 구원을 탐구하며 반복되는 전투에 빠진다.
서로 다른 전투 방식의 적에게 도전하여 당신의 능력을 능숙하게 사용하고, 속성을 강화하며, 룬을 배합하여 적을 이기고 승리합니다.
신기의 선택은 매우 중요하다. 모든 신기는 유일무이한 성능을 가지고 있다.
부적 잠금 해제, 적절한 전투 스타일을 자유롭게 조합
여러 가지 흥미진진한 보스들이 도전을 기다리고 있습니다.
독특한 게임 진행 방식
근접, 원거리 및 신기의 조합, 다양한 공격 방식

title: Case 32
description:
게임 정보
간단한 설명
작은 지방 마을에서 일련의 신비한 살인 사건이 일어납니다.
쿠퍼 형사는 진실을 얻기 위해 신비의 얽힌 차가운 사건을 풀어냅니다.

게임에 대한 설명
이상한 사건이 쿠퍼 형사의 손에 넘어갑니다. 첫눈에
한 남자가 미쳐 아내를 죽이고 자살 한 것처럼 모든 것이 사소한 것처럼 보입니다. 우리가 범죄 현장에 도착했을 때,쿠퍼
이 경우 그렇게 간단하지 않습니다. 탐정과 관련된 신비한 이야기
스스로 자신을 발견하면 놀라운 것을 믿을 것입니다. 차가운 이야기,아니
이것은 당신을 무관심하게 만들지 않을 것입니다.

title: Rogue Paper Scissors
description:
게임 정보
The childhood game that ended friendships is back—and this time, your life depends on it.
Rogue Paper Scissors is an extraction deckbuilding roguelite that transforms the simple three-choice game into a deep tactical roguelike where every decision could be your last. Build your deck from nothing, merge cards into devastating hybrids, and face the ultimate question: extract your rewards safely, or risk everything for greater power?
🎯 Core Features:
Slot-Based RPS Combat

Three simultaneous battles decide each round. Predict your enemy's moves, counter their strategy, and watch your carefully laid plans crumble when they pull out a Shifting Scissor that swaps positions at the last second.
Trait System That Matters
Sneaky cards deal bonus damage on wins
Fixed cards stay in your hand between rounds
Homing cards return after victory
Shifting cards swap positions before reveals
Healing cards restore HP when they win
Hybrid Fusion Mechanics

Merge different card types to create game-breaking hybrids like:
Glass Guillotine: Deals double damage but shatters if it doesn't kill
Mirage Blade: Always draws but steals the enemy's traits
Eclipse Edge: Heals on wins, becomes fatigued on losses
The Extraction Gamble
Every few floors, face the ultimate decision: extract your loot and keep it forever, or push deeper for better rewards. Die without extracting? You lose almost everything. The tension is real.
Status Effects & Combos
Apply Bleed for persistent damage, Silence enemy traits, or build Shield to absorb hits. Master three-card combos for devastating effects that can turn impossible fights into crushing victories.

title: Peter's Apostles
description:
게임 정보
Delve into a Cyberpunk world, or better said, into its cyber space, to protect servers from the malicious hackers that threaten it.
Place towers, or in this case Arms, at the different nodes of the companies' network to provide them with protection against the malwares that hackers created and that aim to infect the server.
With an incredible variety of Arms, inspired by various office supplies, which will not only be your means of attack but also your defense against the different malwares, viruses, trojans, and other malicious programs or messages that hackers have placed on the network.
In addition, follows the adventures of a pair of orphaned siblings trying to carve out a place for themselves in the world of future cybersecurity. Join them during the years it takes to become one of the best cybersecurity companies, see how they work for various companies and meet a variety of characters while you learn more about the past of these brothers.

title: Travel with dinosaurs
description:
게임 정보
이것은 탐색류 VR 가상 관광 게임이다. 첫 번째 빛 카드: 우주에 서서 우주를 몰입하고 체험할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 블랙홀 지식도 알 수 있다. 두 번째 관문: 배를 타고 공룡 시대에 가서 각종 공룡을 참관하고 그들의 습성을 알 수 있다. 또한 당신의 오른손으로 공룡을 만지고 공룡과 상호작용할 수 있다.물론 티라노사우루스를 조심해라. 그것은 고기를 먹는 것이다. 너를 보면 계속 너를 미행하고, 큰 입으로 너를 물어뜯을 것이다. 너의 오른손 핏줄이 0으로 보일 때, 매우 희한하다. 너는 처음부터 다시 시작해야 한다.즐겁게 놀고 지식도 배우세요.
autokwd: Travel with dinosaurs,恐龙과 함께 여행

title: Touhou Volleyball
description:
게임 정보
Touhou Volleyball에 오신 것을 환영합니다 — 동방 프로젝트의 인기 캐릭터들이 배구 코트에서 대결을 펼치는 빠르고 캐주얼한 스포츠 게임!
이 캐주얼 배구 게임에서는 환상향의 주민들이 고공 점프와 박력 있는 스파이크로 가득한 1대1 난투를 벌입니다. 오랜 동방 팬이든, 가볍게 즐길 수 있는 파티 게임을 찾는 분이든, Touhou Volleyball은 매 경기마다 매력과 도전을 선사합니다.

title: Brainrot Royale
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME TO BRAINROT ROYALE
Step into Brainrot Royale, the ultimate chaotic battle where your imagination collides with the unpredictable power of AI. Ever wondered who would win in a wild showdown between your favorite meme-fueled Italian characters? Time to find out. Pick your fighter and prove what you’re made of! Matches are up to 16 players at once!
YOUR GOAL
Rack up the highest score and crush the competition! Each match is a fast-paced, point-based free-for-all where eliminations are key. Master your character’s unique abilities, outsmart your rivals, and climb the scoreboard to claim victory!
FEATURES
Brainrot Characters
Play as the famous Italian Brainrot characters and duke it out between each other. Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Sahur, Bombardiro Crocodilo... you name it!
Iconic Locations
Battle across chaotic, meme-inspired maps like the mysterious Boscolini Fungolini or the sunny shores of Playa Nabolini. If they look familiar… it’s because they are. Just be warned: this is high-risk tourism, folks!

title: KrvVR
description:
게임 정보
KrvVR puts you into a fast-paced VR martial arts arena where survival demands every punch and dodge. Crush enemies with your fists, wield unique weapons and unleash abilities. Your real-world moves fuel progress, making every bout a true physical challenge. Your progress resets everyday to encourage daily exercise.
Fast-Paced Combat
Face a flood of monsters and dodge obstacles in a responsive combat system. Time your strikes and actions with precision as enemies get faster and increase in numbers, pushing your reflexes to the max.
Wield swords, bows, staffs or spells like fireballs and tornadoes. Slice foes with a sword, freeze them with ice or whip up a whirlwind and more! Each tool helps you sustain on the battlefield.
Staying alive in KrvVR is no joke. Grab rare food drops to heal up mid-fight, but stay sharp. Enemies hit hard and missing a pickup or a failure to strike could be a game over.
New stages apart from unique visuals, come with new abilities, enemies and consumables. Everyday climb your way to the final stage where everything is available to use in an endless mode.
Everyday your progress resets, encouraging daily exercise and effort to climb your way back. KrvVR tracks your punches and dodges, estimating calorie burn based on height and speed. The more you move and the harder you strike, the quicker you unlock new arenas and challenges. It's a workout that feels like a brawl.
Enemies swarm in bigger waves and move faster. Hazards and obstacles keep you guessing, forcing you to sharpen your skills and strategy to survive each round.

title: Let's Paint Toast
description:
게임 정보
Let’s Paint Toast is a fast-paced, color-based puzzle game where precision and quick thinking are the keys to mastering chaos.
Paint slices of toast using red, yellow, and blue—then deliver them to the matching colored blocks. Mix colors to create green, purple, and orange toast as the difficulty ramps, demanding sharp hand-eye coordination and strategic decision-making as you aim for the leaderboard.
Play solo to test your reflexes, or team up with a friend in couch co-op or via Remote Play Together and climb the co-op leaderboard. Looking for competition? Challenge your friend head-to-head in the Versus mode.
Features:
Fast-paced puzzle gameplay with a color-matching and mixing twist
Solo and local co-op play (Remote Play Together supported)
1v1 Versus mode for competitive fun
Global leaderboards for solo and co-op scores

title: Skulker
description:
게임 정보
Game Description:
Skulker is a casual fishing game that combines elements of fishing exploration and prop collection.
As a player, you will take on the role of an intergalactic hunter "skulker" who doesn't want to work, but only wants to fish, enjoying a comfortable fishing time on an alien planet, meeting various alien civilization characters, and learning about their preferences and stories.
In the game, players can match the rich fishing equipment, combining different genres of equipment matching effects in order to facilitate the decision-making of the current need to explore the attributes. Eventually, you can smoothly collect the rich fishing objects on the planet and fulfill the commission requests sent to you by different characters.
Game Features:
An exploration experience in the form of dice rolls, where points are used to make decisions about fishing spots and trigger a variety of special events.
Dozens of fishing techniques that operate differently, with each game distinctly different.

title: Radiant: Guardians of Light
description: 게임 정보

title: Rekindled Trails
description:
게임 정보
Enter a unique and fantastic world!
On your journey, you’ll explore a world as beautiful as it is mysterious. Light your path with the help of the Flame and uncover diverse biomes and villages along the way. Venture into shadowy mines, enchanted forests, desolate deserts and uncover new mysteries at every step.
Fish, pull and mine!
During your journey, you’ll gather resources to aid your quest. Equip your fishing rod, pickaxe, and gloves to collect fish, minerals, and roots. All essential to progress and unlock new biomes and locations!
Sell your goods

title: Primordialis
description:
게임 정보
Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.
================================== Grow ==================================
Use the simple but flexible creature creation system to become anything you want.
Draw your creature using a wide variety of cell types which each have a unique function.
Combine different cells to construct your own weapons, defenses, and mobility.
Decorate your creature with custom coloring.
================================= Survive =================================
Overcome enemies and environmental hazards to grow larger and advance.

title: Atuel
description:
게임 정보
Atuel is an award-winning surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina.

Perspective is fluid and interconnected as you shapeshift to become different animals and elements that form part of Atuel’s ecosystem.

Real-life interviews about the past, present, and future of the Atuel weave together to form a historic narrative about people’s intimate relationship to the land they live on and the effects of the global climate crisis.

A beautiful audiovisual experience focused on contemplative exploration.
Shapeshift to become different animals and elements of Atuel’s ecoystem.
Stunning surrealist landscapes based on the real-world topography of the Atuel River Valley.
Real-life interviews with historians, biologists, geologists, and more.
A historic narrative woven together from many different, interconnected perspectives.
An atmospheric, ambient soundtrack produced by musicians Makunouchi Bento.
An impactful half-hour game available in many different languages.

title: Love Sphere
description:
게임 정보
INTRODUCTION
This work is a Adventure told from a first-person perspective.
The theme of this title is "Morality and freedom".
STORY
The main character is a dull middle-aged man.
While watching the daily news, he found an ad looking for someone to set up a venue for a magic show.
He accepts the job and heads to the setup site, where he meets a shady magician...
POINT
This is a visual novel in which you progress through the story by reading the text.
Choose a topic from the options and enjoy a conversation with the characters.
The title's play time is about 30 minutes.
*Please read the guidelines on the official website regarding streaming the play video of this work.

title: Mini Star Quest
description:
게임 정보
사냥의 시간!
미니 스타 퀘스트는 턴제 액션 게임입니다. 티켓을 모아 퀘스터들을 모집하고 여러개의 강력한 파티들을 편성하여 거대한 적들을 화끈하게 사냥해보세요!
특징
자신만의 파티들을 완성해보세요! 한 퀘스트에 최대 3개의 파티를 동시에 데려갈 수 있습니다
하나의 파티로 단기 퀘스트를 도전하거나, 또는 최대 3개의 파티로 장기전을 도전해보세요!
퀘스트를 완료하고 티켓을 모아 귀여운 퀘스터들을 모집해보세요!
귀엽고 컬러풀하며 화려하기까지한 턴제 액션에 푹 빠져보세요!

title: Maze In Your Mind
description:
게임 정보
You can't play any game until your mind plays it first
You can't solve any maze until your mind solves it first
Maze In Your Mind is a game about a three-layer maze connected by static portals where the player must find the right portal to unlock the final portal.
The right portal is signaled by visual cues and audio rhythms.
Avoid enemies and explore the maze, but not the maze you see, but the maze you don't see, the maze in your mind.
If one mind is not enough then play in BattleMind mode where you can play together with another mind in the same device.
Key Features :
30 levels (minds) with 3 mazes each connected by static portals.
Each level (mind) has between 2 and 7 short repeating musical rhythms as audio signals.
10 levels (minds) in BattleMind mode.
Play against the computer, against your friend, team up with your friend against the computer or free for all in BattleMind mode.
Play a 7-second game in the lose box or win box.
If you want to see your physical self, look in the mirror.
If you want to see your non-physical self, look at the boundary (wall).

title: Nippon Dojo
description:
게임 정보
Want to learn how to read your favorite Japanese Manga?
Or have a trip to Japan planned and want to impress your friends!?
Journey into an immersive playful world with two friendly Japanese Shiba Pups as they guide you on your way to Japanese Hiragana and Katakana Proficiency!
1. Study the specific Japanese character group sheet you want to focus on
2. Chose your preferred mini game (Pop It!) or (Fetch It!)
3. Master and Win!
The more you play, the faster you learn Hiragana and Katakana!
See you at the Dojo!
And remember. NEVER BE GAME OVER™

title: Network Nodes
description:
게임 정보
NETWORK NODES
Connect to a neon puzzle that will power your brain to its full potential!
Immerse yourself in the captivating cyberspace world of Network Nodes — a minimalist yet infinitely deep puzzle game where each solution opens new possibilities. Connect glowing nodes, create perfect networks, and watch your creations come alive in dazzling neon light!
INTUITIVE MECHANICS, BOTTOMLESS DEPTH
In Network Nodes, simple rules hide boundless complexity. Each node requires a specific number of connections — no more, no less. Draw lines between nodes, maintaining color compatibility and avoiding intersections. Elegant in its simplicity, yet requires mastery to perfect.
FEATURES:
Neon Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a hypnotizing cyberpunk world with pulsating nodes and glowing lines against the cosmic void
Over 40 Unique Puzzles: From tutorials to challenges that truly test your logical thinking abilities
Progressive Difficulty: Gradually learn new mechanics — colored nodes, universal connections, dynamic activation, and much more
Relaxing Experience: No timers, no penalties — just you and the puzzle in a meditative flow
Minimalist Design: Clean and elegant interface where nothing distracts you from solving puzzles

title: All Whispering Tome
description:
게임 정보
All Whispering Tome is a captivating reading game where you explore a vast library of untold tales. Within its weathered pages lie stories whispered through time and space, both prophecies of futures yet to unfold and echoes of forgotten pasts.

As the reader, you embark on a captivating odyssey of discovery, where each turn of the page unlocks a new narrative tapestry. As you decipher these stories, the narratives evolve, even the words may or may not shift before your eyes. All the hints are hidden within the ever-evolving nature of these stories.

Lose yourself in these mesmerizing tales and uncover the stories beyond the stories in the All Whispering Tome.
Gameplay
Read the books and look for anything unusual. The definition of unusual may vary from story to story. Also be careful to notice any changes in the stories you've already read. The All Whispering Tome may or may not change shape and content before your eyes in any moment. You must read carefully to uncover the stories beyond the stories.

title: Powerfall
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Introducing Powerfall, a futuristic dystopian 3D platformer set hundreds of years on from the modern day, in a time where energy is now the most valuable resource... and yet, 99% of humanity do not have a single watt of it, which only you can change by ascending the skyscraper and freeing the ultimate energy source, returning it back to the people. 
Story
You see, the very top of the elite stole the energy from the people and encased at the top of their corporation's skyscraper, forbidding anyone to use it unless they pay an extortionate fee. You are part of a rebel group, tasked with infiltrating the skyscraper, climbing to the top and freeing the ultimate energy source, dispersing it back across the city.

title: Hidden Cats & Pandas
description:
게임 정보
고양이와 팬더가 사는 나무집 마을에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
고양이와 팬더는 이곳에서 놀고, 기어오르고, 숨바꼭질을 좋아합니다.
숨은 고양이와 팬더는 숨은 그림 찾기 게임입니다. 플레이어는 맵 곳곳에 숨겨진 고양이와 팬더를 모두 찾아야 합니다.
300마리의 동물을 찾아야 합니다. 새끼 고양이, 팬더, 숨겨진 별까지!
company: Sons of Welder, FM Simple Games Studio

title: Flame Land
description:
게임 정보
A short, cute, colorful 2D platformer inspired by the energy and exploration of Kirby's Adventure. The round structure borrows ideas from Star Fox 64 - you pick your path through a series of levels in pursuit of a high score. The levels themselves meanwhile blend the sprawling nature of Sonic 1's levels with the room-structure of Kirby's Adventure's levels.


Run through SHORT, SNAPPY levels.


Build a team of four characters to take on the evil king.


your path through the game.


each level with its many paths, looking for around every turn.

title: Branch Collector
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to your cabin in the woods.
It seems you have been hit with a bit of bad weather this evening and you aren't sure your fire will make it through the night. Luckily there's plenty of firewood outside, if you can stand the cold...
Challenging the Cold
In this cozy collector game, your goal is to survive as long as possible by keeping warm. Collect branches to keep your fire lit, collect items to increase your survival chances, and choose between many upgrades and shop items to create the best chances of survival your own way.
Upgrading your Survival Kit
Between each play-through, the branches you collect in total can be spent on chosen upgrades. These include the addition of items to the drop tables, choosing survival items for each run, changing how the cold affects you and more. There are many ways to play, but which will give you the best chances?
Surviving the Storm
As you play, you may notice not everything is within your control. The weather, item locations, and even your ability to find more firewood play a big part in your ability to survive. You will need to be able to adapt to the challenges at hand to set your high score.
The cold always wins...

title: PULLBACK RACERS
description:
게임 정보
PULLBACK RACERS
Racing without gas, steering, or brakes! Pull back and launch your toy cars into fast-paced tracks with friends. After each race, everyone builds ramps, bombs, traps, and more -to screw over your friends (and often yourself). Watch harmless tracks evolve into chaotic deathtraps. Buy 1, get 1 free!
Toyful Features:
🫂 Up-to 4 player multiplayer support!
🎶 Enjoy a banger OST (from cool people who previously dropped many bangers: HASTE, ROUNDS, Stick Fight, POST VOID, TABS, and more...)
🛣️ 25+ unique Track pieces to race through!
💣 10+ game-changer items to spawn!
🔧 5+ weird modifiers to add to the chaos, create your own game modes! 
🎒 6 different AAA quality (!) skins to customize your cars!
⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴
We're TENSTACK! A small collective of game makers creating lots of creative and 'digestible' games. A digestible game respects its players' money and time, is designed around a single idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. We want you to be able to finish our games in just a couple of sessions—without ever making you feel stuffed, so to say.

title: Space Mechanics: repair | hiring | crafting
description:
게임 정보
Space Mechanics is a simulation game.
character management: w - forward, s - backward, a - left, d - right, q - turn left, e - turn right, space - up, c - down. If you hold your LB next to any object, it will follow the cursor.
repairing: The spaceships that need to be repaired will arrive to you. Using the default welding and spare parts from the in-game store, you will be able to fix them, and you will be paid for it. In total, there are 13 types of spaceships in the game, in order for the gate to open and the spaceship to fly in, you need to press the button near the gate. after the ship has flown in, you need to close the gate and inspect the spacecraft for problems and replace parts or use welding, depending on the situation. After you have fixed everything, you need to click on the same button, but if you have not fixed all the problems, then the button will not work.

hiring: You can hire spaceships for the money you earn, they will mine minerals, there are 12 spaceships that can be hired: 2 to find ore, 1 cheap miner, 1 ordinary miner, 1 upgraded miner, 3 ordinary defenders, 3 upgraded defenders and 1 superluminal spaceship. There can be a total of 6 squads in the game, 5 ships each, for each squad you need to hire 1 spaceship to find ore, miners and defenders, but you can use a superluminal spaceship as defenders, 1 superluminal spaceship = 2 upgraded defenders = 4 regular defenders. The more units are formed, the greater the chance to find the best ore. The ores will be spawned in a box called "ores".

crafting: You can create alloys, melting furnaces, and higher-level crafters in a regular crafter that you can buy. inside the crafter, instructions will be given on what resources are needed for crafting, after you put the necessary ingots in the right places, you need to close the hatch of the crafter and wait about 15 seconds, after that the item will appear in the crafter, if it is an improved crafter or an improved melting furnace, then it will appear in the room. There are 3 types of crafters, 1 uranium factory and 3 types of melting furnaces in the game. There are 5 types of ores in the game: iron, silver, gold, titanium and uranium. If any of these metals are melted down, its value will increase, and if an alloy is made from the melted ingots, the value will become even greater.

title: Rise To Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
폭발하고, 부스트하고, 상승하세요! Rise To Mayhem에서 여러분은 지구에서 솟아오른 미스터리한 외계 타워를 오르도록 파견된 엘리트 제트팩 병사가 됩니다. 강력한 무기, 빠른 반사 신경, 그리고 혼돈에 대한 갈망으로 무장한 여러분은 적 무리와 싸우고, 치명적인 함정을 피하고, 거대한 보스를 물리치고, 강력한 업그레이드를 모아 더욱 높이 올라가야 합니다. 여러분의 임무는 최대한 오래 살아남고, 최대한 높이 올라가, 압도당하기 전에 최고 점수를 달성하는 것입니다. 격렬한 픽셀 아트 액션, 만족스러운 파워업, 그리고 끝없는 반복 플레이를 통해 Rise to Mayhem은 아케이드 슈팅 게임과 로그라이트 팬들에게 레트로풍의 아드레날린 넘치는 경험을 선사합니다.

title: Drakula's Ascension
description:
게임 정보
"Drakula's Ascension" is a challenging, yet simple platformer with a retro gothic horror theme where you have to overcome failure in order to ascend back to the surface. All to live a life of your dreams, one that you once lived. Face demons in hell, the caves beneath the surface, the church of your village, the castle that belongs to you, and the ones inside your head telling you to give up. You're immortal, you have no reason to stop going, your only punishment from failing is that you have to take steps that you took before.
Gameplay:
Compose yourself for the troubles that await!
Ascend from the bottom floor and clear the enemies that block your path! Be careful though, as one mistake can turn you into your worst enemy, as you have to rise again.
Double jump, duck, and attack at any time!
An old school platforming feel, where you can truly test the limits of such simple and familiar controls
Develop your patience!
Take your time with each jump and track the enemies' patterns. They may seem overwhelming at first, but each enemy is quite simple to conquer once you've learned how to best them.
- The higher you climb, the more you have to lose
- Progress and loss thereof is auto-saved
- Challenging, simple, and addictive gameplay
- See which of your friends can ascend and conquer their enemies
- Hours of learning to master yourself await you
Supports Mouse, Keyboard, and controller
Starting Tips:
Check the control settings to learn the controls or figure out what works best for you
You can duck, double jump, and attack during both!
You can slice through and destroy projectiles

title: Capsoul
description:
게임 정보
A fateful showdown is coming—get ready to examine your skills as the crafty, pint-sized Capsy locks horns with the ruthless power of Thornark.
You are Capsy — a charming yet slightly cheeky capsule with a moustache and a stylish shower cap. Sounds weird? It does! But hey, don’t judge a capsule by its cap. This is a hardcore platformer filled entirely with action, where every jump or shot could be your last.
Each level grants you just 3 lives and a couple of extra attempts before you’re unceremoniously booted back to the main menu. Yep, you heard that right: if you slip up, prepare to feel the burning butt.
Worried about going in unarmed? Relax. There's an arsenal of weapons ready to match every playstyle and taste. Just a heads-up—handle them with care, because while they can blast away the foes, they’re just as likely to put an untimely end to your journey.
But wait, there’s more than just guns. You’ve also got a suite of cool abilities: a trusty hook, a bullet jump, circle shooting, and a few surprises waiting to be discovered. Sounds awesome? Then it’s time to check them out!
Complete levels, collect rare items, and get set for moments when you’ll become something more than just a capsule with a moustache. Capsoul isn’t for the faint of heart—it's built for gamers who crave a challenge, have a good aim, and don’t mind clashing with the same boss a dozen times over.
So, are you brave enough to dive in and show the world what you’re made of?

title: clicko
description:
게임 정보
Tired of endless clicks with no purpose? Dive into a game where every tap matters, and strategic placement is key to victory!
In clicko, your screen is your canvas, and every click is a strategic decision. Start by clicking anywhere to place your first square. Click again, and a new challenge emerges: place another square, but avoid overlapping any previous ones and ensure they don't collide. It's a test of spatial awareness and quick thinking!
Core Gameplay & Features
Strategic Placement: Master the art of precise clicking to fill the screen without collisions.
Dynamic Market: Visit the in-game market to gain an edge.
Clear the Board: Purchase boosters to remove existing squares and make room for more.
Visibility Boost: Instantly reveal all placed squares to plan your next move.
Time Manipulation: Buy extra time to think, or briefly slow down the clock when things get hectic.
Catch the Effects: Keep an eye out for special pop-up effects that appear during gameplay – catch them for unique advantages! Avoid clicking harmful effects though.
High Score Chase: Earn points with every successful placement. The higher your score, the more powerful boosters you can unlock from the market.
clicko
clicko offers a deceptively simple yet deeply engaging experience. It’s perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing puzzles, quick reflexes, and the satisfaction of mastering a unique mechanic. Each session presents a fresh challenge, pushing you to refine your strategy and achieve higher scores. Also, it's good to get frustrated sometimes, isn't it?
Are you ready to transform mindless clicks into a thrilling challenge?

title: Tradie Tapper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Tradie Tapper
The Aussie-built idle game where you tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom.
Start from a bare dirt lot and build your empire one job site at a time. Hire sparkies, plumbers, roofers and more, each tradie adding to your passive income machine. Upgrade their gear, smash milestones, and take on brutally scaled rebirth contracts as you climb the ranks.
Whether you're smashing tinnies or topping leaderboards, one thing’s for sure: the grind never stops.
Features
Tap to earn coins and upgrade your tradie crew
Hire Electricians, Builders, Apprentices, and more
20+ unique backgrounds from trailer parks to disaster zones
Rebirth system with randomized mutators and scaling challenge
Skill tree integration for long-term progression
Steam leaderboards and achievement tracking
Offline support with anti-cheat protections
Built with pixel charm, Aussie humour, and a relentless pace
Aussie-made. Meme-fueled. Built for the grind.
Join us in Early Access and help shape the future of Tradie Tapper, one contract at a time.

title: Rusty Flesh
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Flesh is a sci-fi horror puzzle platformer for the Game Boy Color where you switch gravity instead of jumping (guess you could call it a VVVVVV-like!). Explore the different areas of a derelict spaceship putting together all the pieces of its lovecraftian mistery, and enjoy its retro-futuristic aesthetics.

In the near future, Earth has become a wasteland, unfit for any kind of life. Nations fell, and big tech corporations seized power. They had been getting ready for this. They built massive spaceships where a few chosen ones would travel for hundreds of years, looking for a new home. The Grampus was one of those ships... but something went wrong.
Features
Explore a derelict spaceship: Something's wrong in this spaceship, and it's up to you to discover what happened. Explore the ship and find clues in a non-linear narrative.
Solve gravity-based puzzles: Combine your gravity switch with other mechanics to progress through Rusty Flesh's series of puzzles.
Fight undead abominations: The former crew members have been turned into undead monsters, and they are after you.
8-bit retro gaming fun: Get back to the glorious days of 8-bit handheld gaming! Rusty Flesh actually runs on a Game Boy Color, with all its limitations.

Note: The description, screenshots and trailer you see depict a game that is still in development. All content is subject to change as development continues.

title: Leviathan
description:
게임 정보
Leviathan is a multiplayer extraction shooter set in a sci-fi universe where humanity has been abducted by a gargantuan, interstellar beast and changed over the course of several millennia. Ultimately, the abducted were deposited to new planets and evolved into three factions of ideologically distinct lifeforms. A short time ago, a second set of abduction events occurred – but now... fate has brought them together to the surface of the bountiful world of Domusalus... where only ONE FACTION will remain.
Fight for control of Domusalus as one of these factions:
• Terran – Strength is paramount, and a chance to demonstrate their might to the weaker factions will surely ensure dominance. Furthermore, Domusalus is rich in resources of which their home planet is greatly lacking. After living in such hostile environments, the Terran have no intentions of sharing – and the other factions are simply in the way.
• Faunian – They believe in the preservation of all life… but should any being show disregard to this most sacred ideal, they will work to destroy the aberration at all costs. In seeing the other factions taking advantage of the planet’s resources, the Faunian look quickly to protect it, even if it means total destruction of the opposition.
• Angel – With their golden metallic bodies, the Angel have all but discarded their humanity. In doing so, however, they have become virtually immortal and look to transform all other lifeforms in the same way. Believing that this is the only way for advancement, any who resist are looked at as lesser beings that require immediate extermination.
Key Features
• Three playable factions – each with a mysterious shared history!
• Hundreds of items - weapons, ammo, armor, grenades, restoratives and more!
• Explore the “Aurelian Wilds” - a HUGE map offering unique areas, enemies, loot and extractions!
• High risk/High reward - fight against (and loot!) both AI and Player opponents!
• Play solo or in teams of three – take the loot for yourself OR work together to enhance survivability!
• Capture outposts – make your mark to boost your faction's domination over the planet!

title: Dungeon Fight Tactics
description:
게임 정보
다양한 전략과 창의력이 가득한 오토 배틀러 세계로 뛰어들어 보세요. 팀을 신중하게 구성하고 매번 다른 무작위로 생성되는 던전에 그들을 보내세요.
전투는 자동으로 진행되며, 여러분의 역할은 전투에 들어가기 전에 팀을 최대한 준비시키는 것입니다.
강력한 아이템과 마법서를 사용해 캐릭터를 자유롭게 커스터마이징하세요. 캐릭터, 아이템, 스킬을 조합해 나만의 스타일로 팀을 만들어 보세요.
100명이 넘는 개성 있는 캐릭터와 100개 이상의 아이템 및 스킬이 존재해 무한한 조합이 가능합니다.
다양한 조합을 실험하고, 강력한 시너지를 찾아내며, 매번 새로운 도전에 적응하세요.
당신만의 방식으로 팀을 구성하고 던전을 정복하세요!

title: Geometry raid
description:
게임 정보
《Geometry Raid》is a rogue-lite space slash shooter game, the game combines classic barrage shooting and sword slash game elements. By driving a two-part ship,you can shoot and swing tail to crush the enemy . The game focuses on hardcore physics simulation and maximizing the melee slash experience.
Features
Hardcore 2D sword melee slash simulation and the multiple genres built around it

Hardcore physics collision simulation: The movement of players, enemies, and bullets is simulated by the Godot physics engine to create a realistic sense of impact

Hardcore damage calculation: Inspired by the damage system of riding and slashing, which I incorporated into my game, in-game damage is determined by factors such as quality and relative speed. This means that the faster the relative velocity between objects, the higher the damage caused


Geometry Madness is a game in continuous development, and I will be updating it constantly to expand the depth and content of the game.

title: Goblin Adventure: Free from Lore
description:
게임 정보
Goblin Adventure: Free from Lore is a short post-ironic RPG about portals, mushrooms, and rejecting narrative authority.
🧌 You're a goblin. You don’t know what’s happening — and maybe that’s your power.
🧙‍♂️ The Dark Mage believes in order, truth, and citations.
🧠 The gnome wants freedom, fungi, and less existential stress.
🎮 **Features:**
- Short, weird RPG (10–15 min)
- Post-ironic dialogue and boss fights with meaning itself
- No lore. No map. No grinding.
- Possibly pie.
Add it to your wishlist. The goblin union demands it.

title: Tile Tides
description:
게임 정보
Match all split animals with their corresponding half in this ocean themed relaxing puzzle game. Includes over 3500 variations and nine difficulties. Pick your theme between warm sandy beaches, icebergs or volcano islands as well as your four favorite sea creatures.

title: ZURD HUNT
description:
게임 정보
RETRO-STYLE ARCADE SHOOT 'EM UP
In the year 2,000,000,009, a team of bounty hunters infiltrate a massive facility swarming with hostile AI. Can they find Zurd?
NO CASUAL GAMING
Blast through each sector without getting hit.
Collect power-ups to enhance attack.
Accrue spree points to earn temporary shield.
Accrue kill points to buy stuff.
Get good.

title: Pinballers
description:
게임 정보
"Did someone ask for an incremental roguelike game where you make your own pinball machines? No? Ok just me then"
Pinballers is a game where you take a simple pinball machine with one component and score points by interacting with that component. Hitting that component will give you monies to spend in the upgrade shop, where you can add flips, buy more of that component, and more!
When you hit certain scores on the machine, you can add a shiny new component and upgrade that (Wooow)
With 4 machines and counting, combinations of 6+ components on each machine, loads of different pinball textures available, this is a dream for anyone wanting a new take on the pinball nostalgia of the past.
Key Features:
PINBALLS
FLIPPY THINGS
BUMPY THINGS
THINGS TO ROLL OVER
PROMO CODES (MORE PINBALL SKINS)
Less Key Features:
4+ Machines
6+ Components
8+ Pinball Skins
A developer who wants your input to make the game better (Please?)
Have an idea? Join the DragonkidGames discord and have your say
Audio Credits:
As I am not good at making sound effects, I 'borrowed' some. Here's what I used:
Electric Sound Effects Library by Little Robot Sound Factory
Thwack Sounds by AntumDeluge
Level up, power up, Coin get by wobbleboxx

title: Survival: Hold Your Self
description:
게임 정보
Enter a challenging survival world full of dangers, discoveries, and decisions.
In this single-player survival game, your survival is the focus. Gather resources, build your own base, and craft equipment to face the elements.
Explore different biomes – from scorching deserts to icy snowscapes – each region presents new challenges. The right clothing is crucial: a straw hat will protect you from the sun, while a winter jacket is vital in the cold.
Find abandoned locations, loot valuable items, and face dangerous creatures. Firearms like pistols are rare but can be purchased from merchants for resources or currency.
In addition to surviving, you can also build your own small farm: Buy animals from a merchant and breed animals to provide for yourself in the long term.
You're on your own – how long can you survive?

title: I had a Friend
description:
게임 정보
I Had a Friend is a first-person, single-player psychological horror game set in the unsettling atmosphere of an abandoned family house. You play as Richard, a foreign tech university student living in Germany. One night, as you drift off to sleep at your computer, your phone suddenly rings.
A message from your mother, Hannah, lights up the screen. She informs you that your father, Tom, has been in a serious accident and is now hospitalized. With no one else to care for the family cat, Felix, Hannah asks you to return home immediately.
Upon arriving at the empty house, with only Felix as your companion, you begin to feel a growing unease. Strange, unexplained noises echo through the halls, objects shift as if moved by it self, and Felix’s behavior grows increasingly erratic with each passing night.
What was supposed to be a simple visit quickly spirals into something far more unsettling. As the night unfolds, you must uncover the truth behind the strange happenings in the house, as reality begins to distort around you. What’s really going on in the shadows, and who — or what — is behind it all?

title: BloodRush: Undying Wish
tag: 앞서 해보기,핵 앤 슬래시,빠른 진행,다크 판타지

title: The Echo Paradox
description:
게임 정보
The Echo Paradox is a psychological horror game where you explore alternate universes each with different haunting entities.
A TALE OF HUMANITY'S DARKEST DISCOVERY
Humanity stands on the brink of an unsettling revelation – the multiverse is real, but eerily devoid of life. As a daring volunteer for the Phaselink research group, you embark on a chilling journey, venturing into unknown parallel universes in a desperate quest to find any remnants of human existence.
HOW WILL YOU SURVIVE?
Brace yourself for a descent into terror. The further you explore, the more the fabric of reality warps around you. Each universe is a twisted reflection of our own, haunted by entities that defy explanation.

title: Bling: Fortune Memories
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure of exploration and survival in Bling: Fortune Memories, a platformer and strategy game set in a mysterious abandoned temple. Play as a young adventurer searching for his lost brother, who vanished while trying to collect the temple’s legendary gems.
Key Features:
Strategic exploration: Move on a 2D grid through an environment filled with traps, enemies, and hidden secrets.
Invisibility power: Use the Medallion’s power to temporarily become invisible and evade deadly dangers.
Puzzles and challenges: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that will test your wits and reflexes.
Minimalist art style: A simple, geometric visual style that enhances the strategic gameplay.
Collection-based progression: Find and gather gems to unlock new levels and advance the story.
Can you overcome the temple’s challenges and rescue your brother before it’s too late?

title: Neon Shift
description:
게임 정보
Neon Shift is a speedrun-focused, side-scrolling platformer with a twist! Run, jump and slide your way through levels as fast as possible, then shift into a phantom that can uncover new routes with a dash and chase yourself down to secure a spot on the leaderboard. Alongside a set of core levels to play through, Neon Shift features a level editor that allows players to design and upload their own levels for others to try out and compete in.
Neon Shift's gameplay is all about momentum - the player gradually builds speed as they run and jump, making mistakes costly when going for the fastest times. In order to achieve the perfect run, players will need to familiarise themselves with the obstacles in their path and link jumps and slides together in precise sequences to avoid collisions, all while running at breakneck speed. Reaching the finish line quickly is only half of the challenge though; the player must then immediately chase themselves down as a phantom if they hope to log the time. This can be a tricky task, particularly if they were fast on the first go round, but thankfully the phantom has a new trick up their sleeve - the phase dash. This can be used to surge forward a short distance and pass straight through certain obstacles, revealing new routes if the player knows where to look. Dashing through obstacles also resets the ability's cooldown, allowing the player to clear large stretches of level very quickly and catch up to their target before they run out of road.

title: Trytka
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a world where the old world burned and what’s left wants you gone.
In TRYTKA you awaken in a post-apocalyptic wilderness, armed with nothing but your will to survive. Scavenge resources, craft tools, build your base  and prepare for the nightly wave of killer robots determined to wipe you out.
Cut trees, collect scrap, set traps, and upgrade your defenses. Every day is a race against time  and every night is a battle. Explore abandoned buildings, discover scattered locations, and try to stay one step ahead of the metal horde.
Can you survive the storm? Or will your fire be extinguished?

title: Breach : 83
description:
게임 정보
Watch the feeds. Spot the intrusions. Hold the line.
Vast, unknowable entities have become irresistibly drawn to the noise and chaos of humanity—like a storm collapsing upon a flickering candle. Their efforts to enter our world have fractured reality, creating BREACHES—unnatural rifts where the fabric of existence wears thin.
Monitor surveillance feeds across key locations. Detect and report Breaches. Let too many Breaches slip by, and it's Game Over—not just for you, but for all of us.
BE EVER VIGILANT. GOOD LUCK.
FEATURES:
Surveillance Horror Gameplay
Spot subtle (and not-so-subtle) changes in up to 5 live camera feeds per level. Miss too many and face the consequences.
Sabotage and Disruption
The Breaches aren't the only threat. Stay sharp—unknown forces are actively working to sabotage your watch. Expect planted explosives, booby traps, and camera interference designed to shatter your focus. These hazards demand immediate attention—hesitation only results in failure

title: Culinary Wizard
description:
게임 정보
Embrace cooking techniques like never before
After being fired from a previous job as a line cook, a young chef is hungry for new work. One morning a mysterious job offer appears that beckons you towards a mysterious, magical restaurant.
Culinary Wizard is a traditional 2D action-platformer made in a cozy 32-bit pixel art style. Bring ingredients to life and travel between unique worlds, battling hunger one customer at a time. Refine your palette and master the techniques of the culinary arts to deliver tasty meals to happy customers, no matter the request.
Game Features
Traditional side-scroller action in a retro pixel art style, with a dash of modern zest.
Level up with powerful skills and abilities! Smash your way to victory with a mighty tenderizer, throw in a dash of salt when in a pinch, or slice foes to pieces with a cutting edge chefs knife. Take your skills to new heights with your trusty spatula, or roll through the competition with a wooden rolling pin.
Become an interdimensional chef and travel between distant worlds to cook for quirky customers with absurd appetites that are almost as bad as their jokes.
Spice up your fashion sense with over 15 wacky costumes to wear! Choose your favorite cooking styles to make your culinary journey unique.
A vast selection of sweet and savory food-based enemies all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animations.
Hand crafted environments with seamless parallax, giving that sense of depth to a flat world.
A handful of sound effects custom made for each enemy that gives them some extra flavor.
20 trophies to earn and display proudly in your bedroom as you advance through your cooking career.
Flexible keyboard/controller inputs that let you rebind buttons to anything you want to best fit your gaming playstyle.
Hungry for more? Complete Culinary Wizard to unlock recipes from the secret menu; a chef's greatest challenge!

title: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme
description:
게임 정보
R.A.C.E is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of steel monsters and epic battles! Survival racing simulator! Welcome to a unique game where the management, pumping and control of the car at the highest level! Real steel rage in survival races! Get engaged in 3D ultimate race battles, fire rockets and use the protective shield to counter the attack from the enemy. Nitro Boost is mandatory! Collect turbo while you hit that gas pedal and leave all other race cars behind. You decide the rules on the track while you drift, drag, bump, collide, fire and overtake to finish first!

FAST ACTION RACING IN 3D
Monster trucks, roaring engines, smoking tires, damaging collisions, and above all Speed! R.A.C.E. - Rocket Arena Car Extreme - is full of epic explosions, destruction and effects. Press nitro - get even more adrenaline, and let your enemies breathe dust. The change of day and night, the neon signs and tricks will never let you get bored. If you like to play with beautiful graphics and no brakes, then this is your race car game of choice! You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness.

THE ULTIMATE RACE BATTLE EXPERIENCE
Your Monster Truck, your arena, your rules! Participate in Arena battles and get straight in to the real action. Burn out your enemies in the derby arena and race them into fire traps, huge morgensterns, chainsaws and other destructive obstacles. This race game is like a real action movie!
