                Grow and upgrade your farm while taking care of your everyday activities.
Appreciate the different plants

title: A game about cards
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요. 전 슈퍼리타입니다 . 카드 게임을 좋아하죠.
그래서 모든 것이 카드인 게임을 만들었어요.
카드를 결합해서 새로운 카드를 만들 수 있어요 ( +  = ).
저장 파일도 카드랍니다 .
카드를 찾으세요:
라운드가 시작될 때마다 덱에서 몬스터와 열쇠가 뒤섞입니다.
모든 열쇠를 찾으면 상점으로 이동하여 더 좋은 카드를 구매할 수 있습니다.
카드 레시피를 많이 알고 더 좋은 콤보를 만들어 내면 생존율이 높아집니다.
특징 :
수많은 특별 카드
전설적인 무기 제작
엄청난 콤보

title: Dawn Apart
description:
게임 정보
외계 지형을 번성하는 공업 단지로 탈바꿈시키세요. 뭐든지 부술 수 있는 세상에서 자원을 채집하고, 정교한 생산 라인을 설계하고, 효율성을 극대화하세요. 모든 공장, 모든 공정, 모든 전초 기지가 당신의 선택과 도전에 따라 변화합니다.

네, 컨베이어 벨트도 있습니다. 그것도 엄청 많이요.

title: Project:M
description:
게임 정보
About:
Project:M is a chapter based indie horror game, and all chapters are FREE 
Story:
Explore the disappearance of two kids that went missing while exploring an abandoned building in the middle of the woods. no one has any clues of what has happed to the two kids. you (a detective) were sent into the building to find out what has happened and where the kids have went.
Gameplay:
Explore the wearhouse,Find keys,unlock doors, escape monsters, and solve puzzles. But beware something lurks in the shadows
Mature Content:
This game contans the following:
Blood, violence, flashing lights

title: Warspace 2
description:
게임 정보
Warspace 2 is a 1-4 player CO-OP space shooter with RPG elements, open-world and procedurally-generated galaxy. You can trade, craft, and fight your way through a universe, either solo or with friends.
1-4 PLAYER CO-OP
Join forces with up to three friends to explore and battle through a vast universe teeming with challenges. You can also play in a single-player offline mode, network connection is not required to play.
HIGH-TECH EQUIPMENT AND SHIPS
Equip your spaceship with the latest technology. From laser cannons to shield generators, ensure you have the best gear to face the dangers of space and conquer your enemies.

title: Word Play
description:
게임 정보
Word Play is a brain-busting spelling game about making words, getting upgrades, and scoring big.
Try to spell the biggest and best words you can. 
Drag and drop letters, click on tiles, or simply type with the keyboard.
Score enough points to clear the round and pick an upgrade.
Modifiers change the fundamental rules of the game.
Upgrades let you modify your tiles.
Gifts add new tiles to your letter bag.

title: Kaizen: A Factory Story
description:
게임 정보
때는 1986년, 인디애나 사우스 벤드에서 나고 자란 데이비드 스기모토는 가족의 연줄 덕분에 일본에 있는 마츠자와 공업에서 생애 첫 일자리를 얻습니다.

일본은 호황이고, 당신처럼 젊고 똑똑하고 야심 찬 사업가가 필요한 실정입니다. 80년대 여느 중견처럼 제트기를 타고 세계를 여행할 일만 남았겠죠?

…그렇겠죠?

분명히 국제 영업팀 일자리를 제안받았는데, 새로운 직장에 출근해 보니 반짝반짝한 사무실이 아니라 도쿄 외곽의 낡은 마츠자와사 공장입니다. 곧바로 자동 생산 라인 설계 업무에 투입된 당신! 공장 자동화라는 신세계에 던져진 신참으로서 살아남을 수 있을까요?

title: Galactic Conquest
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey with Galactic Conquest Universe, the pioneering real-time strategy game that redefines the genre with real-time voxel deformation. Experience battlefields that transform dynamically as explosions and environmental interactions reshape the terrain, creating ever-evolving tactical challenges.
Choose from six distinct factions, each offering unique units and structures, allowing for a multitude of strategic approaches. Manage a robust in-game economy with a comprehensive currency system and marketplace, enabling resource trading and economic strategies that can turn the tide of war.
Developed in Unity, Galactic Conquest Universe features a charming low-poly aesthetic, delivering a visually appealing experience that complements its innovative gameplay.
Prepare for a strategy game like no other, where the battlefield is as dynamic as your tactics. Command your forces, adapt to the ever-changing terrain, and lead your faction to victory in Galactic Conquest Universe.
Add to your wishlist today and be among the first to experience the future of real-time strategy.

title: Dr Voss’ Escape Room
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is a fun and relaxing multiplayer puzzle game where you and up to 4 friends work together to solve a variety of challenging puzzles. Set in the mysterious lab of Dr. Alaric Voss, you'll uncover hidden clues, piece together the story, and unlock the secrets behind his quest for the immortality potion.
This is a game for those who enjoy taking their time to think things through and solving clever puzzles with friends in a chill, pressure-free environment.
Key Features
Play Together: Team up with friends to solve puzzles designed for collaboration and communication.
Challenging Puzzles: From balancing scales to deciphering hidden messages, every puzzle will test your problem-solving skills.
Relaxed Gameplay: No rush, no stress, just a fun, shared experience of unraveling the mysteries of Dr. Voss’ lab.
Progression Tracking: Watch your progress unfold as you solve puzzles and get closer to escape the room with the immortality potion.
What to Expect
Explore and Discover: Use tools like UV flashlights to reveal hidden messages and clues.
Solve Together: Work as a team to unlock doors, crack codes, and piece together the story.
Create the Ultimate Potion: Follow the clues to blend potions in the correct order, leading to the lab’s final secret.
Around 1 Hour of Gameplay: Enjoy a focused and engaging escape room experience that can be completed in about an hour, perfect for a fun session with friends.
Why You’ll Love It
Dr. Voss' Escape Room is perfect for groups of friends looking for a relaxed but rewarding experience. It’s not just about solving puzzles, it’s about working together, thinking creatively, and enjoying the journey.
So grab your friends and see if you have what it takes to escape Dr. Voss’ lab!

title: Tring!
description:
게임 정보
Tring! is a score-attack game where you fly a triangle shaped spaceship and bounce your shot balls off walls. Every third bounce off your ball counts towards one point and destroying a golden square is another!

title: Therapy Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Therapy Simulator에서 치료사의 자리에 앉아 인간 감정과 기이한 성격들이 얽힌 복잡한 세계를 탐험해보세요!
이 내러티브 중심 게임에서 당신은 다양한 환자들을 상담하는 치료사가 됩니다. 각 상담 세션마다 고유한 이야기가 펼쳐지며, 대화를 이끌고, 더 깊은 진실을 밝혀내거나, 때로는 세션을 유쾌하게 엉망으로 만들 수도 있는 선택지를 제공합니다. 진행하면서 아늑한 사무실을 꾸미고, 일정을 관리하며, 심지어 치료실 밖에서도 환자들의 삶에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.
주요 특징:

title: Sunfluffs
description:
게임 정보
exist in the world as a queer little animal.
Cleru comes from a beautiful archipelago of clouds, and travels down to the surface to find cool stuff and help out their friends. Explore the world, meet other sunfluffs and moonfloofs, and just exist for a while.
a relaxing game of exploration and discovery.
Cleru can pull fruit out of any container, as long as nobody can prove the fruit wasn't just there to begin with. Toss berries at grumpy critters to cheer them up! Jump around vibrant environments, wear lots of colorful clothing, and try your best to help out the mysterious Lightbearer.
take pictures of cute critters!

title: Color Fear
description:
게임 정보
오늘 컬러 펀 컬러링 쇼에서는 시청자들이 집에 누가 침입했는지 알아내는 것을 도와주기를 바랍니다. 침입하는 각 새로운 침입자는 서로 다른 능력을 가지고 있으며 당신을 쫓아낼 것입니다! 쇼가 알고 싶어하는 것은 그들이 당신에게 보여주는 색깔이 무엇인지입니다!
이유를 알아보세요 피치는 매일 밤 당신에게 그의 뒤틀린 게임을 시킵니다. 컬러 펀 컬러링 쇼의 미스터리 스릴러와 그것이 생겨난 이유를 파헤쳐 보세요.
밤의 상점: 매일 밤이 끝나면 밤의 상점을 이용하여 컬러 펀 컬러링 쇼에 대항할 수 있는 업그레이드나 능력을 구매하세요!
밤의 상점에서 구매할 수 있는 업그레이드:
침입자의 위치를 찾는 데 도움이 되는 장난감 로봇
캐스트 멤버 중 가장 싫어하는 사람을 제거하는 암살자
손전등 및 이동 업그레이드
밤 건너뛰기 카드

title: Punk Juice
description:
게임 정보


Join a band with two crass, potty-mouthed punks, Ricki and Max. What else do you have going on Tuesday nights? Curate your style, endure the trials and tribulations of public transit, and play dead-end gigs! Go on mediocre dates, thrift with your besties, buy overpriced coffee, and complain about the cost of rent in this Seattle-inspired grungy city. Punk Juice invites you to recreate your life… Only worse!
WHAT KIND OF PUNK ARE YOU?

Fully customize your character from their hair to their socks! Your punk reflects whatever inner rebel lies within you. Stay up to date with the latest fashions, shop for "new" clothes at the thrift store, and befriend new styles from your friends.
PLAY DEAD-END GIGS

Unravel an overarching narrative where every decision you make decides your fate. Play rhythm mini games to make a name for yourself in the music scene, be it rivals, friends, or new connections. Go on adventures with your bandmates to build your friendships and unlock extra pieces of the story.

Check out every nook and cranny that makes up the unique neighborhoods in Punk Juice. You'll find new places, quests, and friends in every hot spot.

Who knows what relationships blossom on your adventure? Will you make new friends, keep it casual, or flirt with the enemy...

title: Computer Manufacturer
description:
게임 정보
기업의 키잡이로서 상업의 파도 속에서 전설적인 장을 쓸 것입니다
무에서 회사를 창립하고 점진적으로 사업 영역을 확장하는 모든 단계에서 정확한 의사결정이 필요합니다.
과학적인 인재 계획을 수립하고, 완벽한 채용 시스템으로 업계 엘리트를 유치해 팀 역량을 강화하세요.
시장 기회를 신중히 평가하고, 잠재력 있는 제품을 생산·판매하여 시장 점유율을 차지하세요.
자체 개발 장비 돌파인가, 구매를 통한 원가 절감인가
맞춤형 수요를 충족하고 독특한 경쟁 우위를 구축하기 위해 생산 장비 자체 개발에 자금과 인력을 투자하세요.
아니면 성숙한 표준화 하드웨어를 구매해 규모의 경제로 원가를 낮추고 신속한 생산 능력 확장을 실현하세요.
전주기 전략적 의사결정과 가치 균형
정교한 재무 관리로 운영 비용을 엄격히 통제하세요.
예리한 시장 통찰력을 활용해 제품 가격을 책정하고 수익성과 가성비 사이의 균형을 잡으세요.
치열한 경쟁 시: 높은 가성비로 시장 점유율을 선점해 사용자 기반을 축적할지, 아니면 고품질 제품·서비스로 고수익을 얻기 위해 고급 시장에 집중할지.
이 중대한 결정들은 장단점을 저울질하고 결단을 내려야 하며, 회사를 상업의 거친 파도 속에서 안정적으로 이끌어 영광을 이루게 할 것입니다.

title: Dynastopia
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a thrilling 3D local multiplayer board game where strategy and wit go hand in hand. In Dynastopia, your goal is simple: be the last player standing. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal of weapons from city shops or unleash the ultimate game-changer—the God Eye, a secret weapon that wipes out all competition.
Robberies

Strategize your approach by balancing between lethal weaponry and banking heists. Rob banks to give you money to purchase weapons in order to stay ahead, but remember, your salary increases the more you play it clean. The less bank robberies, or weapons you own, the more money the salary gives you. Robbing banks though, comes with high risk but high reward. Based on what robbery Card you pick up, you'll be required to roll between a range of numbers. If you win, you take the money. If you lose you go to jail and lose half your money.
Gun Shops & weapons

The Gun shops are the main tools you will use to best your friends/Enemies. They offer a wide variety of weapons that come with their own set of ammo, lives they take, and range(board squares) they cover. Buy your weapons wisely based on your enemies' positions, the weapons they possess, and your lives.
Hospitals & other squares
The Hospitals heal you by giving a spare life, the police stops arrest you if you posses weapons, the traps take lives and the mystery cards present you with a random set of events either good or bad.

Whether you choose to build your empire through crime or skillful gameplay, every decision shapes your path to victory.
Prepare for intense battles, cunning strategies, and a fight to the finish in Dynastopia
Note From Dev
Hello everyone! I'm glad you checked my page out. If you ever think of buying my game please keep in mind that while I am super excited about developing this game, I am also just a solo developer, a teenager, and a human being. Which means i'll be prone to mistakes, which would inevitably show up in the game as bugs.

With that said, please always still feel free to contact me or let me know if you have any problems or issues, or encounter any bugs within the game.
Thank you, and I hope you have fun!

title: Race Jam
description:
게임 정보
Race Jam은 레이싱 게임 팬과 고전 게임 향수를 불러일으키는 팬에게 적합합니다.
코너를 드리프트하고, 터보 패드를 치고, 지름길을 이용해 트랙 주위를 더욱 빠르게 돌며 경쟁자들을 먼지 속에서 몰아내세요.
언제든지 니트로 부스트를 충전하여 차량을 오버드라이브로 전환할 수 있습니다. 하지만 충전 부스팅은 위험합니다. 부스트할 때마다 체력이 감소하기 때문입니다.
다른 레이서와 부딪혀 체력바를 낮추세요. 상대의 체력이 0으로 줄어들면 잠시 레이스에서 탈락하게 됩니다.
상대나 환경과의 충돌은 체력 바를 줄일 수 있습니다. 수리 버튼을 눌러 체력 바를 재충전하세요. 타이밍이 중요합니다. 차량을 수리하면 가속도가 상당히 감소하기 때문입니다.
흥미진진한 액션을 수행하여 화재 미터를 채우세요. 가득 차면 차량에 불이 붙고 가속도와 최고 속도가 향상됩니다. 리더를 잡기 위한 마지막 추진을 하는 데 필요한 X-Factor일 뿐입니다!

title: Terrierble Logic
description:
게임 정보
Do you like dogs?
Of course you do, because you are a cool person. Next question.
Do you like puzzles?
And I mean puzzles that involve more than just finding hidden objects, swapping gems, or pushing blocks around. Puzzles where you might need to pull out a piece of paper and think a bit. Maybe for a while, you feel a bit stupid because you aren't getting it, but then you have a 'Eureka' moment and suddenly feel really smart. If so, then you have come to the right place.
Oh, one more thing we should mention: there may or may not be some bad puns and silly jokes as well, for which we apologize in advance. We know logic is a very serious business, and we tried to keep a serious tone, but the dogs made us do it. We hope you understand. 
Terrierble logic is a game that involves taking the clues you are given and arranging the elements into the boxes together so that each clue is correct. All you need to solve the puzzles is contained in the clues, with only basic numeric literacy required. Sounds easy, right? Sure, it can be, but it can also get tricky when you need to remember a few different things. But don't worry, you've got this. Just read carefully and play around with everything on the screen, and you'll figure it out like the genius that you are. 
What exactly does the game offer?
Over 75 puzzles of increasing difficulty.
Over 200 unique animated characters to bring the game to life.
Sound effects and a unique soundtrack to gently annoy you as you think about the puzzles. (Don't worry you can turn it off)
A simple point and click interface that anyone can use.
Recurring characters and story to tie puzzles together.
A 'simple English' mode that simplifies the language to help non-native speakers.
Some secrets and little extra jokes to discover.
Controller support so you can sit on your couch and still use your brain.

title: PUMP IT UP RISE
description:
게임 정보
집에서 즐기는 아케이드 리듬게임의 재미!
PUMP IT UP은 25년 동안 전 세계 아케이드 시장에서 사랑받아온 댄스 리듬게임입니다.
5개의 라인으로 구성된 노트에 맞춰 플레이하며 음악을 즐기는 전통적인 스타일의 리듬게임을 제공합니다.
PUMP IT UP만의 듣고, 보고, 누르는 몰입감 있는 플레이를 경험할 수 있습니다.
게임 특징
"베토벤 바이러스", "터키 행진곡", "캐논 D" 등 펌프 잇 업에서만 만나볼 수 있는 유명 곡들을 수록!
약 200곡의 오리지널 곡 제공 - 정식 출시 후에도 업데이트 및 DLC로 신곡이 지속적으로 추가됩니다.
게임 패드 완벽 대응 - 독특한 채보의 재미를 누구나 쉽게 느낄 수 있도록 구현했습니다.
Steam Deck 완벽 호환 - 개발 초기부터 최적화를 염두에 두고 설계되어, 언제 어디서든 손안에서 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.
초보부터 고수까지 아우르는 난이도 구성 - 누구나 쉽게 시작할 수 있으며 숙련자에게는 도전적인 고난이도 트랙도 제공됩니다.
전용 컨트롤러 제공 예정 - 아케이드의 손맛을 100% 살릴 수 있는 전용 컨트롤러 지원을 준비 중입니다.

title: EDENS ZERO
description:
게임 정보
왕도 스페이스 판타지 만화 속 세계로 뛰어들자!
마시마 히로 작가의 작품, 스페이스 판타지 만화/애니메이션 "EDENS ZERO"를 원작으로 만들어진 액션 RPG 등장!
원작을 생생하게 체험할 뿐만 아니라, 광활한 필드를 무대로 펼쳐지는 게임 오리지널 스토리의 수많은 퀘스트까지 즐길 수 있는 풍성한 볼륨의 게임!
박력 넘치는 액션 배틀!
콤보와 필살기를 구사해 배틀에 도전하자!
오의로 끝을 내자!
오의 게이지가 쌓이면 주위의 모든 적에게 큰 피해를 주는 "오의"를 발동할 수 있다!

title: Find Cats 4 女神与猫
description:
게임 정보
"모든 연령대의 고양이를 좋아하는 사람들이 즐길 수 있는 귀여운 게임!여러 지도와 지능적으로 숨어 있는 털복숭이를 찾을 수 있는 기회가 있습니다!"
400 마리의 고양이 [9%는 숨겨진 고양이]

title: Trans Theft Horso
description:
게임 정보
Adric Belfonté never wanted to go west, but a small task, picking up their brother's hormones, turns into a wild and western fantasy of crime and adventure!
Explore the bewaffling and dangerous west! Defy the admirals, ride the animals, fight the haters, seek the missing, and discover why the medicine routes dried up. The West is full of friends and enemies, of lobsters and monsters, and the two great gee-gees: horses and gender gladness!
A feverish LGBTQ fantasy adventure, in full colour! Go west, young enby! Have fun, and beware!

title: Bearzerk
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Bearzerk
Bearzerk is a survivorlike teddy apocalypse where plush meets pandemonium. Strap in for a bullet-riddled, stuffing-soaked descent into madness. Pick your weird teddy. Gear up. Unleash chaos.
Features (Early Access)
15+ Playable Teddies (and counting): From possessed plushes to axe-wielding samurais and chicken-mounted maniacs, each bear brings unique perks, quirks, and synergy madness.
20+ Weapons & 70+ Armor Items/Perks: Launch toast. Brand enemies with infernal irons. Spin like a blender. It's your build. It's your funeral.

title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
description:
게임 정보
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.
Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.
Join Hanna's adventure through Eriksholm on her quest to find her brother and uncover the mystery behind his disappearance. Venture into stunning landscapes in a gripping story where every second counts as Hanna strives to reunite her family.

title: Saloon Simulator
description:
게임 정보
남북전쟁 이후 19세기 미국. 모래 언덕, 뜨거운 태양, 질주하는 말 - 얼음 위에 테킬라를 한 잔 손에 들고 이 모든 것을 느껴보세요. 와일드 웨스트의 중심부에 있는 오래된 술집을 재건하고 그 과정에서 주류 사업의 선구자가 되어보세요.
위아래로 - 복원, 매칭, 건설
모든 것이 뜻대로 되지는 않았고, 속임수를 쓰기도 했지만 걱정하지 마세요! 망가진 내부를 새로 단장하고 손상된 가구를 수리하면 동경하던 낙원이 그 어느 때보다 가까워집니다. 가장 필요한 장비를 구입하고, 술을 비축하고, 원하는 대로 술집 디자인을 시작하세요. 돈은 하늘에서 내려온 만나가 아니라는 점을 기억하세요. 신중하지 못한 구매는 여기서 반드시 권장되는 것은 아닙니다!
이제 여기서 규칙은 여러분이 정하세요!

title: Becoming Saint
description:
게임 정보
추종자들의 뜨거운 신앙심을 활용해 가능한 많은 도시 국가를 정복하고 개종시키며 신부의 길을 닦아 나가세요. 성공을 향한 길에는 수많은 장애물이 있지만, 인내심만 있다면 당신도 생전에 신부가 될 수 있습니다!
추종자들을 이끌고 소규모 전투에 투입해, 각 지역을 개종시키기에 가장 전략적인 부대를 선택해보세요.
당신의 교리에 따라 최대 16종의 다양한 부대를 해금하고 모집하세요.
부대마다 강점과 약점이 있으며, 특정 적에게 효과적인 특수 능력과 다른 부대들과의 시너지를 가지고 있습니다.
지형을 활용해 우위를 점하고 빈틈없는 전략으로 적을 상대하세요.
신부의 능력으로 아군을 축복하고 적에게 저주를 내리세요.
언제든 부대를 직접 조종해 그들의 잠재력을 최대한으로 끌어내세요.

title: Lost in Prayer
description:
게임 정보
Anything that kills you becomes playable for your next runs.
Will you be tempted to die on purpose in a successful run to unlock the enemy you face? Dying is more bittersweet when the boss that took you down becomes the instrument of your revenge.
With dozens of playable characters, you’ll find your favorite playstyle. Play to its strengths, go beyond Hell or above Heaven, and discover why you’re stuck in the Purgatory.
Lost In Prayer's characters have:
Specific equipment slots: Not every loot will be useful for your character. Sadly, our big turtle-like guy, the Godly Terapin, can’t fit any chest armor on him.
Unique skill sets to unlock: You can play the same character in different ways thanks to a wide skill tree.

title: Nightmare Shift
description:
게임 정보
사람들은 벽에 귀가 있다고 말하지만, 벽에 눈이 있다면 어떨까요? 당신이 하는 모든 일을 지켜보고, 기다리고, 보는 눈이 있다면요.
외딴 모텔에서 야간 근무를 하고, 불안한 손님을 상대하고, 섬뜩한 사건을 해결해 보세요. 엠마의 불안한 아파트 생활을 경험하고, 감시당하고 있다는 불안감을 느끼고, 현실과 악몽의 경계가 흐려지면서 무엇이 진짜인지 의문을 품어보세요.
엠마의 세계
평범한 밤이 비범한 미스터리로 밝혀지는 엠마의 삶 속으로 들어가 보세요. 엠마의 두려움과 고군분투, 현실과 악몽 사이의 모호한 경계를 경험해 보세요.
불안한 일상

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition
description:
게임 정보
수많은 팬을 보유한 스트롱홀드 크루세이더의 확장된 결정판에서 성지 탈환을 위한 전설적인 십자군 원정으로 시간 여행을 떠나보세요! 새로운 게임플레이 콘텐츠와 소스 아트워크, 음악, 다시 돌아온 성우, 작곡가, 오리지널 게임의 베테랑 개발자가 참여하여 충실하게 재구성한 업그레이드된 비주얼로 역사적인 사막 전투를 펼치세요.
사막을 정복하세요
스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판은 플레이 가능한 8개의 새로운 병력, 맞서야 하는 4명의 새로운 AI 영주, 추가 캠페인으로 오리지널 게임을 확장합니다. 홀로 새로운 역사적 캠페인 2개와 '시간의 모래' 전초전 트레일 4개를 플레이하거나, 친구와 팀을 이루어 완전히 새로운 협동 트레일을 나아가세요!
또는 더 넓은 맵, 커스텀 옵션, 편의성 개선과 같은 플레이어 요청 기능을 갖춘 전초전 모드에 뛰어들어 보세요. 처음 보는 캐릭터, 병사, 캠페인 등으로 완성된 이 결정판은 오리지널 프리렌더링 아이소메트릭으로 표현된 새로운 그래픽으로 게임을 리마스터하며, 여러분의 패기를 시험합니다!
힘을 발휘하여 20명의 까다로운 AI 영주에게 맞서든, 친구와 함께 새로운 협동 트레일을 진군하든, 그저 자신이 만들어 낸 장엄한 사막 성채에 감탄하든, 스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판에서는 베테랑 플레이어와 신규 플레이어 모두가 실시간 전략 클래식을 다시 방문하여 원하는 방식대로 플레이할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition,Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition 스트롱홀드 크루세이더: 결정판

title: Spell Wizard
description:
게임 정보
In Spell Wizard, you’ll battle hordes of enemies by typing the words associated with them to unleash spells. Precision and speed are your weapons in this fast-paced Typing game with Roguelite elements.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Typing Combat: Face off against waves of enemies, using your keyboard to strike them down with precision.
Roguelite Progression: Collect gems to enhance your abilities and unlock new upgrades between runs.
Short but Intense: Each run is a test of skill and survival, perfect for quick gaming sessions.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
description:
게임 정보
The Fate of The Forgotten Realms is in Your Hands
Return to the city of Neverwinter in Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition.

A dark force sweeps over Faerûn, ravaging everything in its path as though searching for something – something that you now find in your possession. As the Shard-Bearer, only you can stop the King of Shadows and his army from desecrating the land you call home. Will you save Faerûn, or fall victim to the temptation of absolute power?

When your actions dictate the fate of the Realms, there are no small choices.

Includes All Expansions:
Mask of the Betrayer: Cursed with an insatiable hunger only quelled by devouring spirits, the Shard-Bearer must travel to the Shadow Realm to unearth the cause of this dark affliction.

title: Your Personal Chill Apartment
description:
게임 정보
Create your own cozy rooms in Your Personal Chill Apartment, listen to relaxing tracks in our built-in music player, and stay motivated by completing real-life tasks to earn in-game coins for upgrading your space!
Decorate with Furniture
Choose your favorite furniture from our huge catalog of decor items. Move, rotate, and stack objects however you like – it's all up to your creativity!
Recolor Objects
Don’t like the default colors we picked? No problem! You can repaint any object to any color you love. We also added a palette feature where you can save your favorite colors for quick access.

title: Deodar
description:
게임 정보
There is something amiss upon the Great Tree. Cedar, armed with a magical lute and bell, climbs the Tree to investigate...
Explore the world from Cedar's minuscule perspective. Sooth the creatures of the Tree and heal the blight. Find hidden power-ups, overcome environmental obstacles, and restore peace to the world through the power of music.
This is a short game (an experienced player can complete a play-through in about 20 minutes), but there is more than meets the eye. With three different endings and an unlockable bonus mode, and mutually exclusive achievements, prepare to explore the world of Deodar more than once. Allow yourself to get lost in its ambient soundscapes and pixel art charm.
This is a retro-inspired game. This means that, like the games of old, the player is expected to explore and figure things out. This adds in a layer of difficulty which is not always present in modern games.

title: Star Rift Saga
description:
게임 정보
On a distant planet, rifts in space are opening — threatening to release planet-devouring monsters into the galaxy. Close the rifts and save the galaxy in this modern Metroidvania-like with tight platforming, fast-paced combat, and deep RPG progression.
COMBAT: Engage in fast, fluid battles against a wide variety of enemies and bosses across multiple distinct biomes. Use precision platforming, invincible dashes, flight, and more. Switch between customizable weapons on the fly and use every skill at your disposal.
EXPLORATION: Discover a vast, interconnected alien world packed with hidden paths, alternate routes and mysterious rifts. Be on the lookout for Vitality Sparks, Power Sparks, and other upgrades. As your abilities evolve, so does the world around you.

title: Observer Protocol: The Station - Second Shift
description:
게임 정보
You are not the hero. You don’t explore. You don’t fight. You watch.
Your assignment continues—this time in a deeper, colder section of the station. The rooms are different, the silence heavier. The anomalies haven’t stopped. If anything, they’ve grown bolder.
Welcome to Second Shift, the next entry in the Observer Protocol series. A minimalist surveillance horror experience where your only weapon is observation—and failure means letting it in.
Flip between new camera feeds, scanning for increasingly strange and disturbing changes. Every mistake invites something closer. Every shift chips away at your certainty.
What’s hiding in the quiet? What’s learning from your gaze?
Key Features:
A new suite of eerie environments to monitor—each with its own unsettling behavior
Deeper anomaly mechanics: some may react to how long you watch
Same no-combat, no-jump-scare philosophy—just dread and deduction
Standalone experience, but part of the larger Observer Protocol storyline
autokwd: Observer Protocol: The Station - Second Shift
tag: 공포,심리적 공포,숨은 그림 및 물체,쌍방향 소설

title: Atomic Owl
description:
게임 정보
An avian story of a bird and a chatty blade unfurls its feathers! A feathery roguelite for the SNES era makes its debut!
Take up arms against the evil Crow sorcerer who brainwashed your troupe.
You must save them all.
Hidalgo Bladewing and his companions return to their favorite ramen spot following a perilous mission, only to be confronted by the vengeful void crow, Omega Wing. Two years later, Hidalgo must rescue his fallen companions from the clutches of this ruthless old foe—with the help of a chaotic, brash-talking sword.

title: Heroes For Hire
description:
게임 정보
Heroes For Hire is a business tycoon game focused around building a dungeon raiding guild from the bottom up with the GuildOS system.
Managing a guild isn't going to be as easy as it sounds, though. When running any business, you already have to worry about your employees, your customers, your finances and your living quarters. Just imagine what can go wrong when you start bringing dungeons, fantasy and magic into the picture, too!
Think you have what it takes to run the number one guild in the county? If so, you can compete in tournaments and competitions with rival guilds to determine who really is Raiders Digest's top guild of the week!
Employees are the life blood of any business. After all, how are you going to raid dungeons when you don't have any dungeon raiders on the payroll?

title: Gorilla Vs 100 Men
description:
게임 정보
고릴라 한 마리가 100명의 남자를 이길 수 있을까?
멈출 수 없는 고릴라가 되어 인터넷에서 가장 혼돈스러운 질문에 답해보세요. 빠른 속도의 래그돌 물리 기반 아케이드 격투 게임에서 끊임없이 몰려오는 남자들을 주먹으로 상대하세요.
끝없이 몰려오는 적들을 부수고, 때리고, 짓밟으며 혼돈과 광기의 물리 엔진 속에서 싸우세요. 고전적인 100명 도전 모드에 도전하거나 무제한 모드에서 얼마나 오래 버틸 수 있는지 확인해 보세요. 웨이브도, 휴식도 없습니다 — 오직 당신과 순수한 근육, 그리고 불운한 인간들뿐입니다.
간단하고 중독성 강한 게임 플레이로 쉽게 익히고 계속 즐길 수 있습니다. 짧은 시간 동안 빠르게 즐기거나 높은 점수를 노리며 끊임없는 혼돈 속으로 빠져보세요.
주요 특징:
웃긴 격투 게임에서 고릴라로 플레이
끊임없이 몰려오는 적들을 강력하게 때리기
100명 도전 모드와 무제한 생존 모드
즉각적인 액션, 군더더기 없는 아케이드 재미
래그돌 물리로 예측 불가능한 전투 경험
웃긴 방귀 공격으로 적들을 뒤로 날려버리기
가슴을 두드려 강력한 충격파 발산
짧고 강렬한 재플레이 가능성
고릴라 한 마리가 100명을 이길 수 있을까요? 직접 확인해보세요.

title: Sector Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Sector Unknown is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2, Knights of the Old Republic, Fallout: New Vegas, as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3, Encased, Colony Ship, Trudograd, and Pathfinder: Kingmaker.
Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. While combat is a viable approach, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically.
Story
In Sector Unknown, your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories.
In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful mega-corporation that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now erased from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and abandoned planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all.

title: Store Keeper
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Store Keeper — a game where you take on the role of a large wholesale warehouse manager!
Your task is to establish a seamless logistics operation: from receiving goods from suppliers to delivering them to retail stores. Smart inventory management, precise calculations, and efficient space organization will help you build a warehouse that runs like clockwork.
Key Features:
🔹 Receiving and Inspecting Shipments

Monitor incoming goods, check invoices, and identify supplier errors. Decide how to handle defective or surplus products. Every decision impacts your reputation and profits.
🔹 Optimizing Warehouse Space

Arrange products strategically to speed up shipments and minimize losses. Upgrade warehouse facilities and organize storage areas for maximum efficiency.

title: Synthwave Burnout VR
description:
게임 정보
Synthwave Burnout VR is an explosive arcade racing game in VR, inspired by the aesthetics of the ’80s and synthwave style. Strap on your headset, rev your engine, and blaze through neon-soaked tracks where every move, turn, and crash feels like you’re in the heart of a glowing retro-futuristic storm.

Style
In VR, the neon-soaked aesthetics of the ’80s feel more vivid than ever. Dark tracks, pulsating horizons, flickering stars, and hypnotic lights surround you from all sides. Every flash, reflection, and shadow comes to life in immersive virtual reality. A powerful electronic soundtrack and rich spatial audio complete the experience, pulling you deeper into the retro-futuristic world.


Take control of 6 unique vehicles using your VR controllers — steer the wheel, hit the gas, dodge obstacles, and smash into rivals. Each of the 6 levels offers fresh sensations, visual tricks, and unique challenges. Swerve, evade, and ram with real physical movement and full concentration. Don’t just watch the race — become part of it.

●      
● Full VR immersion with in-game camera, intuitive controls, and a realistic sense of speed
● 6 vibrant levels with unique visual effects
● Atmospheric synthwave soundtracks and spatial audio
● 6 unique vehicles with detailed VR interiors and distinct handling systems
● Fast-paced races packed with rival competitors
● Extra challenges and objectives on every level
● Spectacular crashes and a detailed damage system

title: Gaucho and the Grassland
description:
게임 정보
라틴 카우보이
라틴 카우보이 가우초가 되어 자신의 땅을 가꾸는 놀라운 경험을 즐겨보세요.
농장 동물 키우기
농업이 없는 경우: 이곳에서는 동물을 보호할 완벽한 장소를 짓는 것부터 토지에 더 많은 자원을 확보할 수 있도록 사육하는 것까지 동물을 돌보는 데 중점을 둡니다.

title: Knock On The Window
description:
게임 정보
Knock On The Window
노크 온 더 윈도우는 서스펜스와 예상치 못한 반전으로 가득한 미스터리한 이야기에 빠져들게 하는 VHS 미학의 분위기 있는 호러 게임입니다.
스토리
마틴은 직장에서 긴급한 임무를 맡게 되었습니다. 하지만 이를 위해 그는 상사의 집으로 가야만 했습니다. 그래서 마틴은 광활한 해바라기 밭 한가운데서 혼자 집에 있는 자신을 발견했습니다. 창문을 두드리기 전까지는 모든 것이 잘 진행되고 있었습니다....

title: HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT
description:
게임 정보
「헌터X헌터」최초의 본격 대전 격투 게임이 등장!
「헌터X헌터」최초의 본격 대전 격투 게임이 등장!

title: Bring You Home
description:
게임 정보
BRING YOU HOME(브링 유 홈)은 납치된 외계의 애완동물을 구하기 위해 온갖 종류의 세계를 탐험하는 작은 외계인 영웅 Polo(폴로)의 이야기를 풀어내고 있습니다.

BRING YOU HOME(브링 유 홈)은 귀엽고 접근성이 뛰어나고 시각적이며 가족 친화적인 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임입니다. 영웅을 조정하는 것이 아니고, 레벨 그 자체를 조정합니다! 어떻게요? Polo(폴로)에게 올바른 경로를 보여주려면 모든 레벨을 변경하고 재정렬하세요!

이 혁신적인 메커닉으로 실패조차도 재미있을 수 있는 게임입니다! 가여운 Polo(폴로)는 치명적이지만 즐거운 숙명을 발견하고 시간을 거슬러 올라가 레벨을 되돌립니다.

마법의 캐릭터, 기괴한 놀라움, 수많은 불안정한 위험으로 가득한 세계로 모험을 떠나 잃어버린 애완동물의 납치범을 붙잡습니다. 이 미스터리의 진상을 밝혀내고 싶으세요?

창의적 게임
주위 환경을 제어할 수 있는 놀라운 게임 메커닉을 경험해보세요!

누구도 예상하지 못하는 게임
수십 가지 레벨을 오가며 우주에서 이 세계 저 세계로 이동합니다. 다음에 무슨 일이 일어날지 절대 알 수 없습니다!

익살스러운 게임
모든 레벨에서 익살스러운 함정 발견 - 놓치지 않는 것이 좋을 거예요!

사랑스러운 게임
사랑스러운 애완동물과 함께 찍은 향수 어린 사진을 찾고 수집하세요! 오, 달콤한 추억...

title: Worship
description:
게임 정보


당신의 어두운 부분을 받아들이세요. 이제 광신자의 옷을 입고 천천히 세상을 장악해 나갈 차례입니다. 나의 피로 그린 의식을 치러 적들과 장애물을 극복해 내세요. 신의 무시무시한 행위를 자행해 더욱 강력한 마법으로 보상받으세요. 교리 주입 명령에 따를 신봉자들을 영입하세요. 당신을 위해 무엇이라도 할 준비가 된 장기말이 될 것입니다. 신을 위해 더욱 강력한 의식을 치르기 위해 신봉자들에게 명해 스스로를 바치도록 하세요! 세계의 종말을 이끌어 내세요. 아니면 그 와중에 목숨을 바치게 될 수도요?




예배로 인해 세상이 더욱 과감하고 불경해지며 테마와 톤이 강렬해집니다. 우스울 정도로 무시무시한 피의 의식부터, 악하기 그지없는 동시에 활기 가득한 희생까지. 흑백의 잉크 스케치 스타일로 개성 넘치는 세상에 빠져 보세요. 이따금 생기 넘치는 색채와 손으로 그린 애니메이션도 만날 수 있습니다. 귀여우면서 개성 강한 아트와 그를 잘 살린 블랙 유머까지, 악행을 저지르는 데 이만큼 쾌감을 느끼기도 쉽지 않으실 겁니다. 음울하지만 귀엽고 웃기면서 무시무시한 세상이 여러분을 기다립니다.




그런 말이 있죠. "사이비 종교 창설은 우정에 좋다." 선택한 신과 당신을 섬기는 신봉자들의 교단을 확장해 나가며 커뮤니티를 받아들이세요. 최대 3명의 협정 동료를 온라인으로 초대하여, 으스스한 목표를 향해 함께 전진하세요. 혼돈을 100% 보장해 드립니다!




어드벤처 RPG, 로그라이크 장르를 슬쩍 비튼 게임에서 광활하고 생동감 넘치는 세상을 모험하세요. 비밀을 파헤치고, 네 가지 다채로운 세력과, 또 당신의 교단과 상호작용하세요. 그리고 신을 위해 믿음과 헌신을 바치는 거죠. 신봉자, 의식, 힘을 충분히 모아 마지막 과제에 도전하세요. 바로 당신의 신을 필멸자들의 땅으로 소환하는 겁니다.

title: Medievaly: Battle Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Dark Ages, now in color! Medievaly is a real-time strategy game for everyone feeling a little bit Medievaly - or just wanting their own colorful kingdom to enjoy (while fending off relentless attacks from encroaching enemies). 
Come for the Middle Ages, stay for dynamic battle simulations where everything can happen, RTS mechanics, and a whole lot of tactical gameplay!
Real-Time Strategy Meets Simulated Battles: Every kingdom needs a base and yours is no exception! Set up defenses, expand infrastructure, then send out your men-at-arms to valiantly die under your banner in unpredictable, occasionally chaotic battles! Once they win, due to your tactical genius, use the gold harvested and won in battle to rally even more warriors to your banner!

title: Robot Anomaly
description:
게임 정보
You work at the CSP Robotics company. The night is quiet and your shift is about to end. But the robots have a different plan for tonight.
Inspect anomalous robots
Each floor may host an anomaly. Inspect every robot for rogue behavior or hardware modifications.
Leave the building
Immerse in a liminal atmosphere. The rooms seem to repeat with no end. You will feel alone and surrounded at the same time.
Scares, but not jumpscares
There may be some sudden movement, a shape could run out of sight. But nothing will jump to your face.
But don't lower your guard. Some robots may resort to violence.
Play Time
30-90 minutes
Fail on the first 8 floors and progress will reset

title: Gangsters Way
description:
게임 정보
Story
Street gangster John Brown dared to cross paths with mafia boss Victor "Fang" Lorenzo. Instead of an immediate sentence, Lorenzo offers John a chance to prove his worth. Can he earn respect with his fists, or will his name be lost forever in the criminal chronicles?
John Brown is a lone street thug for whom the law has always been just a meaningless word. Thus, he wasn't afraid to challenge Victor "Fang" Lorenzo—a ruthless and influential mafia boss. For his audacity, John finds himself tied up in the luxurious hall of the mafia's residence, face to face with a man who decides fates with a snap of his fingers.
Many stories would end at this point, but Lorenzo, recognizing John's exceptional combat skills, offers him an alternative path: if he can defeat all of the mafia's top fighters, he'll earn a chance to become part of the family; if not, he'll die like the rest. Can John take on numerous elite thugs alone, or is he destined to feed the worms in a grave? The outcome depends solely on you!

Gameplay
Gangsters Way delivers hardcore melee combat reminiscent of street brawls. You'll face numerous opponents alone, requiring you to utilize the full arsenal of a street fighter. Combine attacks into powerful chains, deftly dodge incoming strikes, and execute deadly special moves to take down enemies one by one. This isn't just a fight—it's a fighter's journey, and if you want to see it through, you'll have to prove you're not just skilled... You're the best!

title: VertiGhoul
description:
게임 정보
Death is inevitable. 
Dash your way through the different hellishly difficult areas, while assisting Death with getting his subjects under control.
You're going to die. A lot.
Working as a subject of Death, it's inevitable. Learn and master the mechanics of the ghoulish dash to overcome the difficulty and die less.
Experience Hell
Death will need your help in all areas of Hell, so you'll see everything from the Tree Tops to the Barracks, and with true skill, maybe even Ascension.
Complete Death's List
Death works in his mysterious ways, and for some reason he needs you to fulfil very specific requirements for each level, awarding you with game-altering sigils.
Alter the Rules
Death's Sigils will change the game's fundamental rules, creating a completely new challenge to dive into.

title: Chained Backrooms
description:
게임 정보
1-4인용 협동 호러 액션 게임으로, 플레이어가 서로 사슬에 묶여 백스테이지를 함께 탐험해야 하는 독특한 협동 게임 체인드 백룸에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
게임 특징:

title: Shadow of the Matrix
description:
게임 정보
Shadow of the Matrix is an exhilarating third-person shooter set in a futuristic space environment. Engage in combat against a mysterious enemy systematically disabling the spaceship's vital systems. Can the protagonist save the crew, or will the mission end in disaster? The fate of the voyage rests in your hands.

Story
In the distant future, Earth has been annihilated by a devastating nuclear war. The few survivors escaped aboard the spaceship "Ark," with passengers placed in biostasis, while a small crew managed operations through robotic avatars connected directly to their nervous systems. The journey proceeded smoothly until the Ark neared its destination—a planet resembling Earth—when critical systems began to fail, endangering all aboard. Only the security officer and a technician codenamed Neurohex awaken. Together, they must confront the threat and save the passengers.

Gameplay

title: W.A.N.T.E.D
description:
게임 정보
W.A.N.T.E.D - WANTED - WNTD - A Open-World Experience Action Adventure Game with a WorldWide inspired ambience.
Trailer and GamePlay Videos Coming Soon
Visit Virtual Digital W.A.N.T.E.D Cities: Miami, New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Deserts, Country Sides, Tropical Islands, Japan, Australia
In Online Multiplayer to Play with everyone around the World
Step into the chaotic and thrilling world of W.A.N.T.E.D Online, an immersive multiplayer online game inspired by the fast-paced, action-packed style of the GTA series. In this dynamic open-world environment, players are free to carve their own path, whether they want to build an empire, wreak havoc, or live the life of a law-abiding citizen.
Key Features:
Expansive Open World: Explore a massive, detailed city filled with bustling streets, gritty alleyways, and countless hidden secrets. Every corner of the city offers new opportunities—and dangers.
Action-Packed Gameplay: Engage in high-stakes heists, explosive shootouts, daring car chases, and intense battles for control of the streets.
Customizable Characters and Vehicles: Build your identity in the game by customizing your character’s look, wardrobe, and vehicles. Stand out from the crowd or blend in to avoid detection.
Diverse Roles: Choose your path as a cunning criminal, a relentless cop, or a rogue entrepreneur. Whether you’re robbing banks, enforcing the law, or running shady businesses, the choice is yours.
Player-Driven Economy: Invest, trade, and build your fortune through various industries. Create alliances or rivalries to dominate the city’s economy.
Real-Time Multiplayer: Form crews with friends or compete against other players in real-time for dominance of the city’s lucrative hotspots.
Dynamic Events: Experience regularly updated missions, heists, and challenges that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

title: Neon Abyss 2
description:
게임 정보
Neon Abyss 2와 함께 아름답게 픽셀화된 혼란스러운 어비스에 더 깊이 빠져보세요! 이 사이버 신화 로그라이크에서 액션은 더 빠르고 위험은 더 높으며 가능성은 무한합니다. 폭발적인 런 앤 건 게임플레이, 다양한 전투 스타일, 무한한 아이템 시너지를 갖춘 Neon Abyss 2는 매번 입장할 때마다 극적이고 스릴 넘치는 경험을 선사합니다.
Neon Abyss 2가 신나는 온라인 4인 협동 플레이를 선보입니다. 협동 플레이에서 여러분과 최대 3명의 친구가 로그라이크 혼돈 속으로 함께 뛰어들 수 있습니다. 각자의 고유한 시너지와 콤보를 결합하여 강력한 파괴력을 만들어내세요. 빌드를 조정하고 팀으로서 어비스를 정복하세요. 같은 맵 내의 다른 방을 탐험하여 효율성을 극대화하고 숨겨진 비밀과 보물을 발견하세요.

title: TBH: Task Bar Hero
description:
게임 정보
🎮 Key Features:
Taskbar Integration
Minimal UI design allows the game to coexist naturally with your desktop, staying active like any background application.
Fully Automated Gameplay
Your character continues the adventure automatically—no clicks or repetitive actions required.
Random Reward Box System
Reward boxes appear at regular intervals, with a tiny chance to obtain legendary items that could redefine your journey.
Non-Intrusive Design
Never interferes with your important tasks. You only need to step in when you want to collect rewards or level up your character.
Lightweight
Consumes minimal system resources, truly stays with you all day.

title: DREADZONE
description:
게임 정보
DREADZONE
The year is 2030, and humanity is on the brink of collapse. A devastating virus, Zeno-29, has swept across the globe, transforming the infected into horrifying mutants and leaving society in ruins. To contain the outbreak, governments have created thousands of isolated zones—quarantined wastelands where the infected are sent to live out their final days.
You are one of the infected. Sent to a remote, desolate zone filled with abandoned factories, crumbling houses, underground hideouts, and wild, untamed terrain, survival is your only option. Supplies are scarce, danger lurks around every corner, and the virus is slowly taking hold of you.
Survive
Gather resources, hunt wildlife, scavenge abandoned ruins, trade with survivors, and complete missions. Construct shelters to protect yourself from the elements and hostile threats. Craft weapons, tools, and essential supplies. Smelt ore, cook food, and prepare for the dangers ahead to stay alive in the unforgiving quarantine zone.
Explore the Zone
Venture into the heart of the quarantine zone, where danger lurks at every corner. Infiltrate abandoned bunkers, forsaken factories, abandoned houses, and many other areas the world has left behind. Navigate a deadly world filled with relentless zombies, terrifying mutants, wild animals, and ruthless soldiers who will shoot on sight.
Your Path
Survival is a choice. Some will focus solely on living out their remaining days, prioritizing basic needs and safety. Align yourself with the last remaining scientists, working toward a cure for the virus or embrace your infection, joining the mutant hordes to wage war against the oppressive government forces.

title: A Tale of Brothers
description:
게임 정보
PRESENTATION
This is a classic 2D old-school RPG in the style of the retro Super NES and Genesis RPGs such as Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
After the cataclysms not much was left of the Ruskin Lands, once a prosperous and peaceful Kingdom. Now, those who struggle to survive in a destroyed and decayed land, do so in the hopes of one day ascending to the Winged City. The capital of the Winged Ones, a group of people of very specialized high technology, the only ones able to live a good quality life, free of diseases and hunger, after the cataclysms.
Caldwell and Caldwyn, two former soldiers in the army of the Ruskin Kingdom, fight together to survive in what used to be their hometown. One day, while exploring the ruins of an ancient shrine, they find what could be the cure of their world, now full of disease, hunger and suffering. This cure comes in the form of a woman.
While pursuing answers to find out more about her, they will also find out a lot about themselves and their brotherhood.
FEATURES
Touching storyline about the meaning and depth of brotherhood
5 playable characters
A vast world to explore, with forests, caves, mountains, ruins, shrines and more
Optional dungeons to explore
Optional bosses to fight
Autosave function
Mouse support
15 to 20 hours of gameplay

title: Imaginytes
description:
게임 정보
Imaginytes is a captivating blend of roguelite, tower defense, and deckbuilding set in a vibrant fantasy dreamworld. Explore a realm where imagination comes to life and time adds an exciting twist to every decision.
Face the dark forces of nightmares in beautiful, procedurally generated maps, ensuring no two battles are ever the same!
Summon Imaginytes onto the hex grid battlefield to create mazes for the enemies. With more than 150 different Imaginytes to collect, each with their own strengths and abilities, you will not run out of options anytime soon.

title: PyramidValley: Reborn
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of ancient Egypt with PyramidValley: Reborn, a compelling management game that invites you to build and develop your own pharaonic city. Play as iconic figures such as Cleopatra, and construct legendary monuments like majestic pyramids, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, and the Great Sphinx.
Collect and manage various resources to ensure your city's prosperity, while taking on strategic challenges that will test your managerial skills. With meticulous graphics and an immersive atmosphere, PyramidValley: Reborn offers a rewarding gaming experience for all history enthusiasts and management game fans.
Furthermore, the Reborn project aims to revive the game by allowing players to relive the PyramidValley experience independently, thus ensuring the continuity of this Egyptian adventure.
