title: Let Them Trade
description:
게임 정보
『무역의 길』은 경영 시뮬레이션 건설 게임입니다. 보드 게임 스타일을 기반으로 클래식 보드 게임의 전략성과 재미를 계승하며, 체스판 같은 배치 공간에서 플레이어들의 전략적 판단력을 발휘할 수 있습니다. 언리얼 엔진으로 제작된 이 게임은 몰입감 넘치는 비주얼로 가상과 현실의 경계를 허물며, 마치 눈앞에 펼쳐진 보드 게임 왕국 같은 경험을 선사합니다.
게임 속에서 당신은 왕의 신분으로 도시 건설과 번영을 책임집니다. 지속적으로 물자 공급을 안정화하고 시민 요구를 정밀하게 충족시켜 만족도를 높이세요! 도시 간 자동 무역 시스템이 운영되며, 각 도시는 예산과 고유 자원을 보유합니다. 이로부터 세금을 징수하며 부의 성장이 가져다주는 성취감은 즐기세요!
탐험 여정에 나서 자연이 숨긴 귀중한 자원을 발견하세요. 도시 건설을 위한 전략적 요충지를 신중히 판단해야 합니다. 다양한 자원이 풍부한 이 신비로운 세계에서 안목을 발휘해 가장 잠재력 있는 자원을 선택하고, 경제 발전의 토대를 마련하여 상업 제국을 확장해 보세요!

title: FIND ALL 8: The road to the Maya
description:
게임 정보
In this game you'll explore colorful city streets on the eve of the Day of the Dead, unique jungle landscapes and ancient temples of a lost civilization. You'll even get a chance to look inside one of the pyramids. All along the way you will have to find all the hidden objects, so that the black-and-white world will be painted in color and come to life. You decide what items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family
Game features:
- Option to choose the item you want to search for
- Increasing level of difficulty
- There is a hint
- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings
- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell
- Coloring levels
- 2.5D effect
- Possibility to break the piñata

Artist: Anikeyra
autokwd: FIND ALL 8: The road to the Maya

title: ByteRogue
description:
게임 정보
Infiltrate, loot, cast, and escape in this fast turn-based magical heist roguelike!
You are a cunning wizard-thief breaking into a small warehouse to steal valuable gems. Though abandoned, the warehouse’s security robots remain active and are eager to eliminate any intruders. Use your magical powers to outsmart the robots, collect as much treasure as you can, and escape before you’re taken down!
Key Features
Challenging turn-based tactical gameplay focused on enemy parity, clever positioning and board manipulation.
Diverse spells that let you dash great distances, swap places with objects, phase through obstacles, and more.
Simple controls—just directional input and two buttons, making it easy to pick up and play.
No inventory management or excessive menuing—just straight forward action.
Fast-paced with rapid-fire turns.
Coffee-break friendly runs—each one takes just about 10 minutes.
8 different game modes, offering plenty of variety and challenge.

title: Fragile Packages: Handle with Care
description:
게임 정보
Leap from package to package in this 'build-your-own' platformer challenge with a daily anomaly challenge. How high will you go? And what will you uncover in the clouds? Collect and open packages to earn cash, then upgrade your stats and items to climb even higher.
Every step takes you higher, but it's not just about reaching the top—it's about the journey that gets you there. Complete challenges to access better upgrades or explore the city.
Ascend beyond the darkness and into the clouds by building your own pathway through the sky.
Explore the city to collect packages and bring them back to the courtyard to continue your ascent.
Encounter the 'Things'—they may hinder your progress in unexpected ways.
Daily Anomaly Challenge—find the gateway to the daily anomaly challenge and spot the the difference to make it up the building and gain more upgrades.
Speed Challenge—race through the checkpoints in this non-stop auto runner to explore more of the city.

title: Monster: Titan's Playground
description:
게임 정보
Devastate a fully-destructible city in VR as a giant monster. Battle mechs using your various breath, ranged, and melee weapons—including fire breath, gravity cannon, and lock-on missile pods.

Experience what it's like to look down upon a city—and then crush it. Tear chunks out of buildings and toss them at your mechanical foes. Catch missiles out of the air and hurl them back at the mech that fired them. Even throw mechs into other mechs!



Feel the rage of a monster that's been mutated and experimented on by mad scientists—and enjoy the arsenal of pointlessly destructive weapons they've given you.

title: NWO - Anarchy Collapsed
description:
게임 정보
🌍 세계 정복
미션은 명확합니다—적이 도착하기 전에 195개 국가를 정복하고 통합하세요. 영향력을 확장하고, 전략적 영토를 점령하며, 전쟁 또는 외교를 활용하여 세계를 지배하세요.
💰 초당 수입 – 건설 및 확장
자금이 곧 힘입니다. 초당 수입이 증가합니다—공장, 기업, 무역로를 업그레이드하여 재산을 증대하고 영향력을 확장하세요. 더 많은 국가를 지배할수록 더 많은 자원을 확보할 수 있습니다.

title: MAVRIX by Matt Jones
description:
게임 정보
무한한 MTB(산악 자전거) 기회의 거대한 오픈 월드, MAVRIX에 뛰어드세요.
순수한 창의력의 공간입니다. 다운힐 레이스 트랙, 거대한 슬로프스타일 라인, 다양한 바이크 파크가 100제곱킬로미터에 걸쳐 펼쳐집니다! 레이스를 펼칠 준비를 하거나, 자신만의 라인을 정의할 스타일과 창의력을 발휘하세요.
친구들과 함께 라이딩하고, 숨겨진 도전을 발견하고, 함께 거대한 점프를 뛰어보세요. 기차처럼 줄지어 질주하세요!
글로벌 랭킹: 최고가 되고 싶으세요? 랭킹은 거짓말을 하지 않습니다. 희귀 아이템을 잠금 해제하고 실제 상품을 놓고 경쟁하세요.
실제와 같은 물리 엔진 및 컨트롤: 듀얼 스틱 컨트롤, 좌우 브레이크 레버, 독립 서스펜션을 사용합니다. 우리의 물리 엔진은 그립의 균형을 맞추고, 트릭을 성공시키고, 자신만의 독특한 방식으로 라이딩할 수 있도록 자전거와 당신을 연결합니다.
스폰서십 시스템은 프로 라이더의 삶을 당신의 손에 쥐여줍니다. 계약을 체결하고 수집하여 자신만의 MTB 경력을 관리하세요.
실제 브랜드: 커스터마이징이 핵심입니다. 실제 MTB 브랜드의 자전거, 의류, 부품을 잠금 해제하여 꿈의 세팅을 만드세요.
산에서 만나요!

title: Total Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Descend into Total Chaos, a gripping terrormare that blurs the line between reality and madness.
Once a bustling haven for coal miners, Fort Oasis is now a crumbling wasteland, its eerie silence broken only by a cryptic radio transmission beckoning you toward the island’s heart—the forsaken mines. But as you delve deeper into the island’s desolation, the path forward becomes twisted and uncertain, unraveling unsettling truths hidden in the encroaching darkness.
Scavenge for scraps and craft makeshift weapons to defend yourself against the horrors that lurk in the shadows. Unearth fragments of forgotten lives scattered across the island and piece together the chilling mystery of Fort Oasis’s demise. Every discovery brings you closer to a truth that threatens to shatter your sanity.

title: Russian Survivors
description:
게임 정보
소련 붕괴 이후의 환경에서 도마뱀 무리와 이탈리아 뇌부패 동물 무리와 싸워보세요.
게임플레이:
이 생존형 게임에서 여러분은 고대 도마뱀 군대와 새롭게 깨어난 이탈리아 뇌부패 동물 무리의 공격을 받는 소련 붕괴 이후의 다양한 장소로 뛰어들게 됩니다. 파티를 구성하고, 적을 처치하고, 무기와 캐릭터를 업그레이드하고, 더 많은 적을 훨씬 효과적으로 처치하세요!
적:
도마뱀은 우리 조상의 가장 오래된 적이지만, 결코 배우지 않고 오늘날까지도 우리 영토를 침범하고 있습니다. 하지만 퉁퉁퉁 사후르, 트랄랄레로 트랄랄라, 봄바르디로 크로코딜로에 대해 들어보신 적 있으신가요? 분명 있으실 겁니다! 이들을 비롯한 수많은 뇌부패 동물들이 도마뱀과 연합하여 러시아 땅을 가득 채웠습니다. 이제 이 감염병의 확산을 끝낼 때입니다!
특징:
두 가지 게임 모드:
대도시를 탐험하고 새로운 플레이 가능 캐릭터와 더욱 강력한 업그레이드를 찾기 위한 비교적 긴 세션이 포함된 탐색 모드
짧은 파도와 수많은 몬스터가 있는 파도 모드에서는 새로운 무기 부품을 잠금 해제하여 무기를 더욱 강력하게 만들거나 완전히 다르게 만들 수 있습니다.
파티 시스템, 혼자 있을 필요는 없고, 마음에 들면 됩니다.
다양한 캐릭터가 각자 고유한 무기를 사용하므로, 약점이 없는 균형 잡힌 파티를 구성하기 위해 합리적으로 조합해보세요.
무기 커스터마이징 시스템
캐릭터 커스터마이징 시스템
다양한 유형의 적과 위협적인 보스

title: Digitalink
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Digitalink is a psychological horror experience where every decision you make brings you closer to unlocking—or unleashing—a terrifying mind.
Trapped in a high-security research facility, you're tasked with mapping the neural responses of a massive, unidentified creature. You’ll analyze its behavior through cryptic logic puzzles, decipher twisted commands, and respond under pressure. Each correct decision reveals another fragment of its brain map... each mistake pushes it closer to aggression.
As tension builds, the creature reacts. Jump scares are not just for shock—they're consequences. The more you understand, the deeper the horror gets.
Key Features:
🧠 Logic-Driven Gameplay: Solve layered logic puzzles under psychological pressure.
👁️‍🗨️ Reactive Horror: The creature responds dynamically to your actions.
🧬 Narrative Unfolding in Real-Time: Discover logs, warnings, and patterns hidden in the interface.
💡 Minimalist Interface, Maximum Dread: The fear comes from what you don't see.
🔁 Replayability: Every session can uncover new fragments of the creature’s mind.
You're not fighting the monster—you're studying it. But how long can you observe something... before it starts observing you?

title: Gloria's House
description:
게임 정보
글로리아의 하우스(Gloria's House)는 간단한 캐주얼 게임으로, 작업이나 공부를 할 때 화면에 계속 띄워 둘 수 있습니다. 뽀모도로 타이머를 완료하여 코인을 획득하고, 다양한 장식품으로 방을 꾸밀 수 있습니다. 게임 내에는 시간을 보낼 수 있는 미니 게임도 있습니다. 강한 목적의식이나 부담 없이 편안하게 즐기며, 하고 싶은 일에 집중해 보세요.

title: The Novice: Animal Kingdom
description:
게임 정보
Mana crystals have been appearing all around the world. The cause: unknown!
The adventurer's guild has been created to manage the situation.
You are playing as a novice adventurer who just enlisted.
Your task is simple. Complete guild quests to restore order and find what is happening.
Gameplay
The guild has entrusted you with a wand capable of unleashing powerful spells.
You are now ready to take on quests.
Stay alive—if you fall, you’ll never unleash your full power.
Features
6 biomes to explore.
6 different type of quests.
7 elements to combine unlocking different way to play.
Dynamic combat against a large variety of enemies.
Are you ready to embrace the journey of The Novice? Find the source of the madness now!

title: No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES
description:
게임 정보
Iris the internet idol has been abducted by aliens?!
Finding herself on board a mysterious UFO and tasked with completing a bizarre escape game, Iris knows there's one person who she can always count on for help: Kaname Date, Psyncer!
As Date, conduct investigations, solve escape game puzzles, and Psync into the dreams of potential suspects to help Iris escape and unravel the mystery behind The Third Eye Game!
 Investigation: Use the special functions in Date's left eye to gather information that will lead to Iris's whereabouts! Familiar and new characters will also appear!
Somnium: Explore the eccentric dream world of potential suspects to uncover clues and secret memories!
Escape: Solve thrilling mysteries while exploring a locked environment. When you find the true answer beyond the surface level of logic, the door to escape will open!
autokwd: No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES

title: Honest Helper
description:
게임 정보
                                  Honest Helper is a top-down, grid-based strategy game where you use time manipulation to defeat all enemies without any casualties. This cute and charming game will challenge your tactical and decision making skills across 30+ levels for hours on end.
                                        Graveyards and Gravesouls!
You embody a powerful being who can control time. They use this power to go back through history and visit graveyards, conjuring the "soul" of those long deceased in hopes of giving them a longer lease at life.

title: Gundroid
description:
게임 정보






Enjoy a modern take on a classic genre. Gundroid is more than just a throwback. This is retro gaming revitalized.





Learn enemy attack patterns and react quickly to stay one step ahead of the invading forces. Shoot, dodge, jump, and counter their every advance.





Power up your experience with weapons tailor-made for every situation. Find your favourite playstyle or experiment with them all.





Battle your way through diverse stages as you protect every part of the hand-drawn, pixel art landscapes of New Port City.





Fuel your fight with the bespoke metal soundtrack. Thrashing guitars and pulsing drums propel you forward through enemy forces. This is the genre as it was always meant to be heard.

title: Pact Between Us
description:
게임 정보
《Pact Between Us》 is our studio's 6th FMV(and the 2nd custom project—the name of the first custom project won’t be mentioned here because the client refused to pay after delivery, a consequence of being too trusting… ah, the woes of youthful inexperience -_-!). I took on this custom project for a simple reason: 《Back 2》incurred significant losses, leaving me unable to fund development for 《Back 3》. So, accepting custom work became a necessary step.
Though custom, this project is quite unique. Unlike traditional FMVs focused primarily on viewing, this one can truly be considered a game. The overall structure draws inspiration from an ancient game (oops, showing my age -_-!), but it fills the framework with live-action content. While it sounds simple, execution was incredibly challenging. I hope you experience a completely new form of interactive entertainment.
The gameplay may feel unfamiliar to FMV fans, as it involves repeated actions to build character stats. Though we’ve minimized this as much as possible, stat-building is like grinding for loot—it’s an inherent part of the process. Through this, players increase their stats, which then influence the final ending based on their accumulated attributes and key story events.
Simultaneously, it may also feel unfamiliar to fans of character sims, because the systems aren’t deep enough. The main reason was scale: exceeding the client’s budget meant certain content couldn’t be developed. But for novelty’s sake, it still offers something fresh.
The game features 10+ endings, ranging from perfect emotional outcomes to more ordinary career conclusions.
Still, raising your sister from childhood, watching her grow step by step, and immersing yourself in her life and emotions… it’s quite a touching experience.
Finally, regarding pursuing FMV —whether debt-ridden projects, custom jobs, or passion projects—here are a few words to those who’ve supported me:
First, heartfelt thanks to everyone who’s backed me since 《Try and love》, through 《Back1》, The 《Undead Realm:Egp》, to 《Back2》. Many of you have reached out via email with moving words of encouragement, pouring out paragraphs of thoughtful feedback and discussion. I truly wanted to credit each of you individually, but since most correspondences use email nicknames or addresses, privacy prevents me from naming you here. Rest assured, I’ve replied to every single one. If any of your emails slipped through, please resend—I’m currently the only one handling all store operations and emails, so the voluminous nature of the work can lead to oversights. Your support remains my greatest motivation; it’s immensely encouraging.
I’d also like to thank all the content creators (UP friends) who consistently show interest in my FMV(listed in no particular order):
木歌总攻大人，友利奈绪大魔王，你是Nana的小可爱吗，帅桃游戏解说，星星星空吖，镜柯君Kim，咖米狸，11的游戏世界，游戏的艾米，Wendy恐游版，左手善良，香菜爱吃香菜， and everyone else supporting my FMV.
I’ve spent countless hours in your live streams, observing gameplay experiences and feedback from viewers—both positive and critical. These insights are noted for gradual refinement in future projects (admittedly, improvements may be slow, or even involve detours... reasons to be discussed around  release).
autokwd: Pact Between Us,我和未来有个约定

title: Noir Lords
description:
게임 정보
Noir Lords – Fast-Paced Card Battles & Strategic Showdowns!
Step into the dark, mysterious world of Noir Lords, where every decision shapes your fate! This fast-paced strategy card game puts you in the middle of an intense battle against a powerful enemy army. As an elite strategist, you’ll build your ultimate deck, outsmart ruthless opponents, and take down bosses in a gripping noir-inspired story.
🔥 Strategic Card Battles – Quick & Intense!
Each battle is a high-stakes showdown where the right move can change everything. Use a variety of powerful attack, defense, and support cards to dominate your enemies. Every turn counts—will you go for an all-out assault or wait for the perfect counter?
🃏 Build & Customize Your Deck!
No two battles are the same! Construct your deck with 45+ unique cards, including:
✔ Attackers – Deal damage and eliminate threats.
✔ Blockers – Shield your key cards from incoming strikes.
✔ Fortify & Heal – Strengthen your defense and keep your forces alive.
✔ Poison & Turn Points – Manipulate the battlefield with clever tactics.
⚡ Fast-Paced Action Meets Deep Strategy!
Forget slow, drawn-out matches—Noir Lords delivers quick yet tactical encounters where you need to think on your feet. Adapt to your enemy’s strategy, manage your resources wisely, and execute game-changing combos!
📖 A Noir-Infused Story Full of Twists!
As the city’s last hope, your mission is clear: stop the Big Boss and his army before they take over everything! But things aren’t always as they seem. Who can you trust? What secrets lurk in the shadows? Unravel the mystery as you progress through intense battles and uncover the truth behind the war!
🎴 Open Card Packs & Expand Your Arsenal!
Collect and unlock new agents and powerful items by opening card packs! Expand your deck with fresh strategies and rare cards that give you an edge in battle. Will you get the ultimate combination to take down the enemy?

title: Apocalyptic Shadow
description:
게임 정보


스토리의 배경은 가상의 포스트 아포칼립스 서유럽을 배경으로 하며, 플레이어는 필요한 장비를 찾기 위해 여러 지역에 들어가게 됩니다. 운영 기지, 상인과 같은 시설, 모딩 워크스테이션, 개인 맞춤화 영역 역할을 하는 버려진 대피소는 이 잔혹한 모험에서 플레이어의 진행 상황을 보여줄 것입니다.

그러나 피난처를 벗어나 황폐한 폐허의 세계에 들어서면 상황은 극도로 위험해진다. 이 게임에는 위험한 생물 군계로 가득 찬 다양한 지역이 포함되어 있습니다. 플레이어는 초기 장비를 받은 후 스스로 의존하여 보급품을 찾고, 도적과 싸우고, 가장 중요한 것은 살아서 보호소로 돌아가야 합니다.

핵 방사능은 지역 좀비, 적, 야생 동물에게 영향을 주어 더욱 사납고 위협적으로 만들 수 있다는 점에 유의해야 합니다.
탐색

관찰과 실험, 반복적인 탐색을 통해 지도의 특징과 메커니즘을 점차 이해하게 됩니다. 하지만 안전한 복귀를 위해 주의해서 진행하세요. 모험을 할 때마다 보물, 새로운 길, 숨겨진 이야기 단서 등 다양한 보상이 주어집니다. 도전에 대비하세요. 황무지는 놀라움을 멈추지 않으며, 여러분의 용기와 호기심으로 인해 각 지도의 독특한 비밀과 보물을 발견하게 될 것입니다.
작업
게임에는 앞으로 나아가도록 안내하는 여러 퀘스트 라인이 있습니다. 다양한 캐릭터와의 대화를 통해 점차 정보를 얻고 이 세계의 비밀을 밝혀내게 됩니다. 각 모험에는 다양한 액세서리와 보상이 제공되므로 지속적으로 힘과 자원을 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 천천히 수수께끼를 풀어가는 과정에서 당신은 계속해서 새로운 비밀과 도전을 발견하고, 호기심과 용기를 유지하며, 이 세상의 진실을 향해 전진하게 될 것입니다.

이 가혹한 종말의 세상에서 생명을 보존하는 것이 가장 중요한 일입니다. 캐릭터가 죽으면 축적된 장비와 자원은 모두 사라집니다. 결국, 살아야만 우리는 다시 시작할 수 있고 더 나은 내일을 찾을 수 있습니다. 이 잔인한 게임의 핵심은 생존을 유지하는 것입니다.

이 세계에는 아직도 좀비들이 거리를 배회하고 있으며, 언제든지 좀비들이 당신을 공격할 수 있으니 가볍게 여겨서는 안됩니다. 하지만 낙심하지 마세요! 탄약이 충분하다면 스릴 넘치는 집 청소에 도전해 보는 것은 어떨까요? 무거운 총기를 사용하여 격렬하게 발사하고 강력한 충격으로 모든 적을 파괴하십시오. 시체산 앞에 서서 폭죽처럼 총알을 뿌리고, 좀비들을 무자비하게 쓰러뜨리고, 지저분한 전장이 승리의 증거가 된다고 상상해보세요! 경계하고, 살아남은 다음, 여러분의 힘을 사용하여 더 안전한 내일을 만들어보세요!
autokwd: Apocalyptic Shadow,末日幽影 Apocalyptic Shadows

title: DISCOPUP
description:
게임 정보
In DISCOPUP, you're a seal eager to party, making your way to the most famous nightclub in the city: DiscoPup. However, tonight, the bouncer is only letting dogs in. How will you make it past him?
Costumes! Find the right accesories and combine them in such a way that will make you look just like any other party dog. Put your fashion sense to the test against DiscoPup's bouncer.

title: LEGION:DEAD METAL
description:
게임 정보
In a world steeped in shadows, two factions have battled for centuries, shaping the fate of humanity from the shadows. On one side stands the Legion, a coalition of warriors dedicated to preserving the light and fighting the darkness. Opposing them are the Watchers, an insidious group whose malevolent influence stretches back to World War II, when they manipulated events and figures like Hitler to destabilize nations and weave themselves into the fabric of power.
Elijah Stone, the central figure in this epic conflict, has been honed into a weapon by the Legion. Trained in advanced military tactics and weaponry, he embodies the hopes of his faction. Yet, unbeknownst to him, a dark counterpart exists on the other side of a veil that separates their world from a twisted reflection of it, where chaos reigns.
The Watchers have seized control of a covert military research facility in international waters, believing it to be the thinnest point of the veil—their key to unleashing dark forces upon the world. Their sinister ritual requires Elijah's blood, which they intend to use to tear open the portal. This momentous event occurs only once every hundred years, making Elijah's capture a critical objective for the Watchers.
As the clock ticks down to the ritual, Elijah is thrust into a solo mission, tasked with infiltrating the heavily guarded facility. He must execute a strategic assault that, while seemingly a mere pinprick in the grand scheme, targets the very heart of the Watchers' plans. Each step brings him closer to the truth about his dark counterpart and the horror that awaits on the other side of the veil.
Elijah's journey is not just about survival; it’s a race against time to thwart an ancient evil from being unleashed. The stakes are high, and the horrors he faces inside the facility will test not only his skills but his very essence. As he delves deeper into enemy territory, he must confront not just the Watchers but the darkness within himself, grappling with the knowledge that the line between good and evil is often blurred. In the end, Elijah must find the strength to overcome both external and internal demons, ensuring that the veil remains intact and the world is shielded from the abyss.

title: Rogumon
description:
게임 정보
“I am one called Exile, and I wish to tell you a story.”
Battle, collect and upgrade dozens of Rogumon in this creature-collecting roguelite. Unique items, moves, and abilities ensure that no two attempts will be the same. Enter the fray alongside your team as you together seek to escape from the eternal prison of Torment.
Key Features
Build your team: Ally yourself with the Rogumon you encounter. Train them, teach them new moves, and find equipment to strengthen them.
Adapt to Torment’s shifting obstacles: No two escape attempts will be the same. You’ll be forced to experiment with – and fight against – different Rogumon on each run. With adaptability, quick thinking, and a little luck, you just might be able to create an unstoppable team.

title: Empire Builder - Europe
description:
게임 정보
Zombie Possum Games Inc, in collaboration with Darwin's Toys Inc, is excited to bring the Empire Builder series of board games to your PC. As fans of these games, we at Zombie Possum Games Inc sought more time in our busy lives to enjoy them. To our surprise, we couldn't find any playable versions online using the services that we love like Steam and Xbox. That changes now. With the release of Empire Builder - Europe and the license to offer all other installments in the franchise, we are partnering with Darwin's Toys to publish the latest versions on Steam, iOS, Xbox, and other platforms.

If you are an avid train gamer in the physical space, we hope you will enjoy our adaption of the board game to the digital game space.

Features to be included in the initial release include the following:
All of the game's resources, cities, demand cards and event cards, fully implemented in the digital game.
A select number of popular house rules. (TBD)
2-6 player multiplayer between Steam friends and those with a ZPG account.
A user interface that is designed to make the game play of the boardgame faster. Our goal is to get 4 player game play down to under an hour or 45 minutes for experienced players.
Tournament rules.
Current tournament approved map coming soon for the physical board game. (published by Darwin's Toys)

2009 map, cards and rules.

Planned features for after release.
iOS support
Xbox and controller support.
Additional languages.

This is the first in a series of Empire Builder games that we plan to release alongside Darwin's Toys' re-release of the physical board games. As avid players ourselves, this is a passion project; one we hope allows us to be able to play with our friends when getting together in person is less than ideal.

title: Hop to It!
description:
게임 정보
Your home has been sucked into the sky for some reason, ascend a tower of broken cityscape to get back. Watch out for the various obstacles that stand before you, and try not fall...
'Hop to it!' is a Foddian-style 3D platformer where you play as a sentient pogo-stick, get to the top to return to your beloved home that may or may not be a garden shed.
Features
Groundbreaking sentient pogo stick physics
Serene city views as you plumet to the ground
Helpful tips to let you know what you could improve on
Challenging but rewarding movement
Several areas with unique challenges
Checkpoint mode for practice
Hop (and fall) through various environments

title: Boxing Machine VR
description:
게임 정보
기어와 증기로 가득한 체육관에서 로봇들을 박살내라! 스파링 모드에서 자유롭게 싸우거나 리듬 모드에서 박자에 맞춰 주먹을 날려 왕좌를 차지하라!
게임 특징:
두 가지 모드:
리듬 모드: 박자에 맞춰 주먹과 방어를 조율하며, 박진감 넘치는 음악 리듬에 맞춰 부드럽고 역동적인 전투를 즐기세요.
스파링 모드: 자유롭게 링 위에서 싸우며, 제한 없는 펀치, 회피, 콤보로 기계 적들을 압도하세요.

title: Caller of the Crows
description:
게임 정보
불태워라. 살아남아라. 까마귀를 불러라.
당신은 '까마귀의 부름자'입니다. 화염방사기를 들고 옥수수밭에 착륙했습니다. 그러나 그곳에는 오래된 농장 도구보다 훨씬 더 무서운 것이 지키고 있습니다. 허수아비들입니다. 그들은 단지 서 있는 인형이 아닙니다. 지켜보고, 쫓아오며, 절대 멈추지 않습니다. 밭을 되찾고, 까마귀들이 달콤한 옥수수를 즐길 수 있도록 하세요.
🌽 클래식 모드 – 원초적인 악몽
미로에서 모든 허수아비 소품을 찾아 불태우세요. 하나를 태울 때마다, 주 허수아비가 깨어나 사냥을 시작합니다. 그가 당신을 찾기 전에 임무를 완수할 수 있을까요?
⚔️ 반격 모드 – 이번에는 무력하지 않다
까마귀들을 구출하면, 그들은 귀청이 터질 듯한 울음소리로 허수아비를 기절시켜줍니다. 기절했을 때 빠르게 공격하지 않으면, 회복 후 대가를 치르게 될 것입니다.

title: We Have To Let You Go
description:
게임 정보
We Have To Let You Go is a puzzle RPG game about getting fired (literally) by your totalitarian dictator boss and going on a journey to stop his new business prospects to take over the world.
Features

6 sprawling chapters with plenty of secrets to uncover.
Classic Dragon Quest inspired battles with puzzle elements.
Over 20 unique abilities that offer constant creativity in battle.
Challenging boss fights that require skill and strategy to overcome.
A vital dodge mechanic that adds a risk and reward factor to combat.
A large cast of delightful characters to meet on your journey.
A cute and colorful pixel art style.
Several collectables and optional side quests.
An ever-changing soundtrack that develops throughout the adventure.

We Have To Let You Go will release in 2025
autokwd: We Have To Let You Go

title: Pip My Dice
description:
게임 정보
About the game
Pip My Dice is a roguelike deck builder inspired by Balatro and the Yahtzee game. Customize different dice and use them together with powerful relics to break high scores and climb the leaderboard. 
Collect powerful relics to create synergies with your dice and upgrade your combination slots. Take your time and make wise decisions about what you buy in the shop and how you use it. Don't be greedy, you never know if you are going to roll what you are expecting... Unless you customize your dice so much that all faces are the same!
Enjoy endless replayability with the guarantee that every run will be different from the previous one, and save your favorite seeds to replay and share those you like the most.
Customize all faces of your dice individually to make the most of your relics and create game-breaking combos! Rig the odds by modifying the value of the dice faces, and make sure that there is no room for chance. Hold on to precious consumables to get you out of trouble.

게임 정보
모든 순간이 중요하며 빛과 그림자 사이의 경계가 시계 바늘만큼 얇은 세계로 들어가 보세요. 24는 2D 픽셀 RPG에 당신을 빠져들게 합니다. 전투, 논리 퍼즐, 퀘스트, 매료적인 비선형 플롯의 세계로. 당신의 선택은 여정의 근간을 바꿉니다.

알수 없는 전쟁으로 찢겨진 땅에서 이상한 생물과 악한 힘이 존재에 회색 그림자를 덮어씌웠습니다. 소멸된 삶, 노예 된 사람들, 생동감 넘치는 색채가 사라진 세계 - 그 결과는 명확합니다.

당신의 임무는 심오합니다: 이 세계에 색채를 되찾거나 그림자의 매혹적인 부름에 굴복하십시오. 24는 어둠의 중심에 던져진 이야기를 풀어가는 인간의 강인함의 이야기를 짜봅니다.

플레이어로서, Anna와 Alex의 운명을 통제하십시오. 각각 독특한 기술과 다양한 줄거리를 가지고 있습니다. 서술은 복잡한 비선형으로, 각 결정이 울림을 일으킵니다. 선택은 다중 엔딩을 위한 촉매이며, 결과가 가득 찬 개방적인 세계를 형성합니다.

전투에 참여하고 복잡한 논리 퍼즐을 해결하며 알려지지 않은 이야기를 밝히는 퀘스트에 착수하십시오. 주의하세요 - 목숨을 잃는 것은 게임 오버를 의미하며 24의 교활한 길에서 주의를 기울이도록 장려합니다.

24는 게임뿐만이 아니라, 무자비한 폭풍에 갇힌 마음과 영혼을 품은 여정입니다. 희망의 불빛이 되어 색채를 되찾을 것이냐, 아니면 어둠에 안기를 택할 것인가. 선택은 당신의 것이며, 시간은 흘러갑니다.

title: Warped
description:
게임 정보
Survive at spaceship captured by unknown life forms. Permadeath, crafting weapons, repairing machinery, spacewalks, talking with ship's AI, zero gravity... Resolve mystery of ancient cursed spaceship, and finally, find a way to return home.

title: Horror Night with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
description:
게임 정보
Horror Night with TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR
Your car broke down. Middle of the forest. No signal. You spot a creepy mansion up the hill. You knock. No answer. Just as you turn to leave—CREAK—the door opens by itself.
- You step in.
- Bad idea.
Now you’re trapped. No windows open. No doors unlock. But something is inside. And it’s not happy.
From the shadows, you hear it:
- “TUNG. TUNG. TUNG. SAHUR.”
He’s coming. He’s got games. And you’re the main player.
Meet Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a drum-beating nightmare with a twisted sense of fun. He doesn't want to kill you right away—he wants to play. If you want to survive, you’ll need to solve every cursed puzzle, dodge every jumpscare, and outsmart his chaotic friends, including the one and only Tralalero Tralala, who might be your only hope… if he stops spinning in circles for five seconds.
FEATURES:
- Explore a Haunted Mansion full of traps, cursed hallways, and too many basements.
- Solve Deadly Puzzles before the next round of TUNG TUNG begins.
- Snap Creepy Photos to reveal secrets (and maybe unlock a screaming ghost or two).
- Use a Pistol to slow Tung Tung down when he gets too close for comfort.
Survive Brainrot Mayhem featuring a cast of cursed icons like Brr Brr Patapim, Ghoulberto Spaghatini, and the flying menace known only as Auntie Boom Boom.
There’s only one rule in this mansion: Play the game, or the game plays you.
And remember…
TUNG.
TUNG.
TUNG. SAHUR.
You knocked. Now you’re stuck.
autokwd: Horror Night with Tung Tung Tung Sahur

title: Fire Boy
description:
게임 정보
The hero is not just a character in the game; he's your companion on this journey, breaking the fourth wall and bringing a new dimension to your gaming experience.
Its comedic personality allows for funny interactions, especially when failing or succeeding in unexpected ways. It has unique lines for different situations, such as losing a life or gaining a new ability, but these dialogues may vary depending on the player's actions.
These lines will make you laugh out loud and moments that will warm your heart, this game promises to be a memorable adventure from start to finish. Put your skills to the test. Join the Fire Boy on his epic mission and "Step into the Heat of Adventure. Destiny Calls!"

title: Look At Me
description:
게임 정보
**《Look At Me》**는 1인칭 공포 게임으로, 당신의 목표는 유령이 나오는 집에서 탈출하는 것입니다. 이를 위해 퍼즐을 풀고 이 오싹한 장소의 비밀을 밝혀내야 합니다. 하지만 쉽지 않을 것입니다—이동하는 물체, 깜빡이는 불빛, 그리고 이곳에서 생을 마감한 소녀의 유령 등 여러 초자연 현상이 당신의 길을 가로막을 것입니다.
게임 특징:
최대 4명까지 협동 플레이 모드
키보드, 마우스 또는 컨트롤러를 지원하는 1인칭 시점
두려움과 긴장감을 조성하는 어두운 분위기
독특하고 무서운 메커니즘을 가진 유령 소녀
정신 건강 시스템
다양한 점프 스케어 및 다른 무서운 서프라이즈
인벤토리 시스템과 손전등이나 노트와 같은 상호작용 가능한 아이템으로 몰입감을 강화
어두운 분위기를 느껴보세요

게임의 분위기는 압도적으로 강렬하며, 플레이어를 공포의 중심으로 몰입하게 합니다. 유령이 있는 방, 깜빡이는 불빛, 어둠 속에서 들려오는 속삭임은 불안감을 조성하며, 한 걸음 한 걸음이 도전이 됩니다. 게임 중에 누군가가 지켜보는 느낌이 들며, 게임의 분위기에 압도되어 두려움을 견디는 능력이 시험됩니다.
모든 코너에 위험이 도사리고 있다

이 게임에서 안전은 착각일 뿐이며—위험은 모든 코너에 도사리고 있습니다. 모든 소리, 삐걱거림, 속삭임 또는 예상치 못한 소음은 다가오는 위협을 의미할 수 있습니다. 겉보기에는 빈 방도 보이지 않는 위험이 숨어 있을 수 있으며, 유령 소녀는 가장 예기치 못한 순간에 나타납니다. 생존하려면 항상 경계해야 하며, 깜짝 놀랄 준비가 되어 있고 즉각적인 결정을 내릴 준비가 되어 있어야 합니다. 이 게임에서 공포는 당신의 끊임없는 동반자입니다.

자유로 가는 길은 결코 쉽지 않습니다—유령이 있는 집에서 탈출하려면 일련의 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하고 깊숙이 감춰진 비밀을 밝혀야 합니다. 이 도전을 해결하려면 논리적 사고와 여정 중에 찾은 단서를 연결하는 능력이 필요합니다. 퍼즐은 게임 세계와 연결되어 있으며, 유령이 나오는 집의 과거와 비극적인 사건과 관련이 있어 이야기에 깊이를 더합니다. 퍼즐을 풀 때마다 이 장소의 신비로운 역사를 점차 알게 되지만, 동시에 최종 진실—그리고 그에 따른 위험도 다가옵니다.

title: Relicbound
description:
게임 정보
Relicbound is a thrilling third-person shooter and story-driven action-adventure game. Step into the shoes of Jackson, a skilled archaeologist kidnapped by a sinister organization bent on discovering an ancient relic capable of controlling time itself. Driven by high stakes, Jackson must navigate a dangerous journey through dense jungles, intricate cave systems, and awe-inspiring ancient temple ruins, as well as enemy-infested outposts.
With a dynamic weather system and powered by Unreal Engine 5's cutting-edge Lumen lighting, Relicbound offers stunningly lifelike environments that captivate and immerse you in its world. Every moment is crafted with meticulous detail to bring the story to life. Discover the secrets of the past and face off against relentless foes in an epic adventure where every choice could change the course of time.
Prepare to be captivated by the mystery, action, and breathtaking visuals of Relicbound.
KEY FEATURES
Thrilling Story-Driven Adventure
Embark on an epic journey as Jackson, a skilled archaeologist, racing against a sinister organization named Eclipse to uncover an ancient relic with the power to control time.
Gameplay Mechanics
Enjoy engaging gameplay mechanics, including seamless ledge climbing, exhilarating rope swings, and fluid parkour, allowing for dynamic and strategic traversal across diverse and challenging environments.
High-Octane Third-Person Shooter Gameplay
Engage in intense combat with dynamic enemy AI, utilizing a variety of weapons and tactics as you infiltrate enemy outposts and survive relentless foes.
Dynamic Weather System
Experience ever-changing environments with realistic weather effects that enhance immersion.
Time-Bending Mechanics
Harness the power of the ancient relic to manipulate time, solving intricate puzzles and gaining a tactical edge in combat in late game.

title: Irbet Tong
description:
게임 정보
One day, your mom sent you to the store to buy jam for tea.
You walk along a road that winds through a slowly collapsing Sakha village, where houses sink into the ground and the land loses its grip.
In Yakutia, the degradation of permafrost is especially visible in places like Sylan, Usun-Kyuyol, Zyryanka, Churapcha, and Yukechi — and many others. Soon it will reach the boy’s home too — a child of the Sakha people, whose house sits right in the heart of a thermokarst zone. It’s one of the consequences of industrialization and widespread deforestation, heating the planet and unraveling the balance.
Thermokarst, Sylan Village
Troubled by what he sees, the boy begins to wonder what part he can play in healing his homeland, where families are being displaced and entire homes stand empty as the ground sinks and floods roll in. His path is a slow walk, filled with quiet reflections, brief encounters with ichchi (local spirits), and glimpses into Sakha cosmology — a way of seeing and understanding the world.
This is a slice-of-life exploration game with short interactive episodes.
You’ll live one evening before summer break through the boy’s eyes — choosing dialogue options, exploring secret paths, uncovering quiet, hidden stories. There’s no world to save here — just a small tale about the mystery of ordinary things, and the strangeness of life in Orto Doidu.
Features:

title: Radial Fusion
description:
게임 정보
2D Retro Style Orbital Space Arcade Shooter Game
Defend the solar system from total destruction due to uncontrolled Radial Fusion that is triggered by enemy mines and weapons.
Game Levels 1-6:
The game is won by destroying all Descending Enemy Fusion Weapons (Blue).  The game is lost when uncontrolled Radial Fusion is triggered by either Stable Orbital Enemy Mines (Red) or Descending Enemy Fusion Weapons (Blue).  There are 6 levels of increasing difficulty.  The bonus level is enabled after passing level 3.  Player initials, high score, total Player Ships damaged and game time are all saved at the end of a level.
Bonus Level:
Play until the Player Ship is destroyed.  Use the Player Ship beam weapons to discharge the Low and High Orbit Enemy ships before they fire their weapon.  Firing on a noncharging enemy ship will result in a feedback beam pulse that will reduce your score.  The enemy weapons will charge faster and faster over time as the bonus round continues.  Player initials, high score, Enemy Low and High Orbit Charge Speed (CSL) and CSH) for the bonus round is saved.
Game Level 1-6 Characters:
Descending Enemy Fusion Weapons (Blue)
These weapons descend towards the star.
They will detonate if they reach the star and trigger runaway Radial Fusion.
Avoid collisions with the Player Ship or ship damage will occur.
Stable Orbital Enemy Mines (Red)

title: FUMES
description:
게임 정보


FUMES는 차량 전투 장르의 황금기에서 영감을 받은 싱글플레이어 게임입니다. 간단하고 빠르게 진행되는 강렬한 게임플레이. 차에 올라타서 무기를 장착하고 뒤틀린 폐기물을 순항하세요.

헛소리는 없습니다. 오직 당신과 당신의 차, 그리고 순수한 재미. 옛날처럼!
특징
커스터마이징 가능한 자동차를 운전하세요. 무기를 장착하세요.
오래된 랠리 게임에서 영감을 얻은 운전 물리학을 경험하십시오.
적의 파도를 만나십시오. 파괴의 추격전에 참여하십시오.

자동차를 커스터마이즈하세요. 전투 스타일에 맞는 무장을 선택하세요. 스티커를 붙이세요.
보스를 물리치고 새로운 자동차와 부품을 획득하세요.
로딩 화면이 없습니다. 빠른 이동도 없습니다. 그냥 차를 이용하세요.

전투가 끝나면 속도를 늦추고 라이딩을 하며 FUMES를 흡입하세요.
사막에서 길을 잃으세요. 끝없이 펼쳐진 환경을 돌아다니세요.
기타 사운드가 가득한 오리지널 사운드트랙을 들어보세요.



FUMES를 위시리스트에 올려주세요. 이렇게 하면 4명으로 구성된 소규모 팀이 만들고 있는 이 게임을 더 많은 사람들이 발견할 수 있도록 최선의 방법으로 개발을 지원할 수 있습니다.



황무지를 돌아다니며 고철을 모으고, 도전 과제를 해결하고, 아수라장이 되어보세요...

...또는 디스코드 서버에 가입하여 저희와 같은 다른 여행자들과 함께 어울리세요. 이 뒤틀린 세상을 만드는 데 참여하세요!

title: END: Awakening
description:
게임 정보
END: Awakening is a narrative-based action-survival game in which you and up to three friends must gather resources, craft weapons and tools, and upgrade your cabin into the ultimate anti-zombie fortress! Venture out into the wilds ruled by brutal Rustler scavengers, or the undead-infested Whitestone City to collect food, water, and medical supplies. Solve puzzles and carefully choose between sneaking and fighting to defeat both human and undead enemies in order to advance the plot and begin to unravel Hecate’s twisted plan.
FEATURES
Deep Storyline Rooted in Greek Mythology: The Witch-Goddess Hecate has imprisoned all of Olympus in order to unleash her undead wrath upon the world! The enigmatic Hexa corporation manipulates the disaster! Strike out and unearth the mystery!
Survive the Apocalypse Side By Side: Join up to three friends on your adventure! Forage together, craft together, explore together, and fight together!
Intense Loot-Driven Gameplay: Explore for food and water, medicine and ammunition, as well as powerful weapons and vehicles! Scavenge for resources and materials to upgrade your survival-tools and improve your shelter, fortifying it against all attackers!
Face the Apocalypse Your Way: Every encounter tests your skills, reflexes, and decision-making. Will you fight your enemies directly? Will you sneak past them? Will you set traps and ambushes to turn things to your favor before making your move? The choice is yours– as are the consequences.

title: Wrist Catcher-寸关
description:
게임 정보
Pulse and Pretense: A Village of Veiled Truths
You are an apprentice of a traditional Chinese medicine herbalist in South Village. Every day, villagers and outsiders pass in front of you. Your task is deceptively simple: diagnose and take the pulses of villagers, and check the road guide documents of outsiders.
This is a suspense game that combines traditional Chinese medicine pulse diagnosis with Chinese horror. Through hand-drawn line drawing and meticulous brushwork, you will immerse yourself in a mysterious and enigmatic village. Examine the pulse, ask about the symptoms and verify the identity to expose the hidden "false people" from the diagnostic details. As plague spreads, even reality begins to rot...
Game Features:
The hand-drawn style is paired with a text that is terrifying to think about, and the writing style is inspired by Lu Xun and Howard Phillips Lovecraft.
By observing the pulse, symptoms and conversations, you can determine whether the villagers are normal or have been replaced by "something".
From daily pulse diagnosis to joint fight against the epidemic, the secrets behind the village have gradually come to light...
Can you hold the last line of defense of the village?

title: Putt in Parks
description:
게임 정보
Step onto the lush greens & unwind in the relaxing world of Putt in Parks, the ultimate chilled minigolf experience set in stunning, stylized landscapes. Leave your worries behind as you explore whimsical courses designed to be as much about the journey as the scorecard.
KEY FEATURES:
Charming Courses: Wander through sun-dappled forests, serene lakesides, cozy village parks, and magical twilight gardens, each lovingly crafted to inspire peace and wonder.
Gentle Gameplay: Enjoy the simple pleasures of minigolf with intuitive controls, forgiving physics, and no timers. This is a game for those who want to take things at their own pace.
Walking Simulator Vibes: Roam the courses on foot, discovering hidden nooks, tranquil sights, and secret shortcuts. Soak in the ambiance, listen to the birds, and let your mind drift.
Replay & Relax: Play a single hole, complete a full course, or just stroll around for the scenery. Perfect for a relaxing session after a busy day.

title: SUBROUTINE
description:
게임 정보
로봇 평가 루틴
고객들은 우리의 휴머노이드 로봇을 기업의 인력으로 추가하는 것을 기대하고 있습니다. 귀하의 임무는 그들이 배치될 준비가 되었는지 확인하는 것입니다.
기계적 완전성을 점검하고, 적절한 펌웨어와 훈련 모듈을 로드하며, 행동을 평가하세요.
기계적이거나 행동적인 이상은 반드시 보고하고 격리해야 합니다.
기능
휴머노이드 공장 루틴: 하드웨어 검사, 칩 설치, 행동 모니터링, 이상 보고.
은신 게임플레이: 시설을 탐험하고 위협적인 로봇으로부터 발견되지 않도록 숨을 장소를 활용하세요.
스토리: 서버 로그에 숨겨진 전송 데이터를 탐색하며, 시설 뒤에 숨겨진 음모를 밝혀내세요.
예측 불가한 AI: 로봇에게 속지 마세요. 방심하면 기습당할 수 있습니다.

title: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game
description:
게임 정보
환영합니다, 호빗 친구! 그림으로 그린 듯 아름답고 평온한 공간! 크리에이티브 스튜디오 Wētā Workshop이 빚어낸 샤이어를 소개합니다! 샤이어에서 아늑하기 그지없는 호빗의 삶을 살아보세요. 가운데땅에서의 전원생활을 발견하고, 처소를 꾸미고, 즐거움을 나누세요. Tales of the Shire: 반지의 제왕™ 게임에서는 친절한 호빗과 익숙한 얼굴들도 만나볼 수 있답니다.

강변마을에 도착하면 나만의 호빗을 구축하게 됩니다. 강변마을은 아직 호빗골에서 정식 독립 마을로 인정받지 못한 상태인데요, 여러분은 이 조용한 마을에 생기가 넘치도록 도와줘야 합니다. 나만의 호빗 집을 꾸미면서 편안함을 만끽하고, 정원을 가꾸고, 맑은 연못에서 생선을 낚고, 야생의 과일과 약초를 채집하고, 마을 주민과 거래를 해보세요. 직접 만든 요리를 동네 호빗과 함께 즐기고 관계를 발전시키는 건 어떨까요?
볼거리는 물론, 먹을 것도 풍부합니다. 아름다운 숲과 호수, 초원에서 환상적인 나날을 영위해 보세요.
주요 특징

환영합니다, 호빗 친구 – 많은 사랑을 받은 J.R.R 톨킨의 책에서 튀어나온 듯한 호빗을 플레이해 보세요! 개성 있는 외형으로 꾸미고 멋들어진 호빗 복장을 입힐 수 있습니다. 샤이어에는 꾸미기 요소 역시 무궁무진합니다. 나만의 호빗 집을 꾸미세요. 자유로운 배치 시스템으로 가구를 원하는 대로 놓아, 취향에 맞게 아늑한 공간을 만들어 나갈 수 있습니다. 강변마을의 평온한 집에 적응하면서 매일매일 새로운 경이를 발견하고, 절실했던 휴식을 누리세요.

호빗의 하루는 음식으로 완성된다고 해도 과언이 아닙니다. 낚시, 원예, 채집을 통해 식량 저장고를 노동의 결실로 가득 채워보세요. 그때그때 계절에 맞는 제철 농작물과 꽃도 수확할 수 있습니다. 식사 시간에는 부엌의 온기를 느끼면서 조리법을 골라 요리 실력을 선보일 수도 있죠. 두 번째 아침 식사를 즐기거나, 동료 호빗과 함께 만찬을 나누세요. 초대 손님과 식사를 즐기면 새로운 관계가 형성됩니다.
autokwd: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings Game,Tales of the Shire: 반지의 제왕 게임

title: The Shaman's Ark
description:
게임 정보
Game Features
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world inspired by the aesthetics of nomadic Asian cultures. Explore the vast and enigmatic world of the Ark, once again standing on the edge of the Abyss.
Fight in rhythmic battles using the power of the shamanic drum. Let ancient melodies help you crush your enemies!
Defeat gigantic bosses.
Acquire abilities that will unlock new paths.
Meet various characters along your journey, each with their own story and goals.
Seek out and wear bones for your shamanic necklace to gain the powers hidden within.
Discover places of Power to restore and enhance your abilities.

title: Void Protocol
description:
게임 정보
⌛CORE MECHANICS
Imprint System: Use a "Chronocamera" (Imprint Sphere) to record/rewind objects' states (position, switches, motion) and crack mind-bending puzzles!
Mechanic Analogy: Think of it as a temporal camera:
Snapshot (Imprint): Target objects (doors, lasers, machinery) to save their current state (position, rotation, activation, etc.).
Review (Rewind): Reload "temporal snapshots" to undo mistakes or forge new paths.
Dynamic State Chains: Manipulate multi-object synergies (e.g., "1-switch controls 2 gates") and predict chain reactions.
Negation Rules: Rewinding a "recorded ON state" after disabling its controller triggers logic inversion.
🌀KEY FEATURES

🔮Minimalist Sci-Fi Aesthetics: Cyberpunk neon glows and industrial textures—zero visual clutter.
⚙️Pure Mechanic-Driven Design: "No tutorials. No compromises." Progress from single-object puzzles to temporal matrixes with escalating complexity.
🏆Speedrun & Strategy: Chase "Zero Imprint" achievements and claim the SSS Chronoarchitect title.

title: MY FATHER LIED
description:
게임 정보
“My Father Lied” is a first person point and click mystery game
that tells the story of Huda, who finds herself following an unfathomable secret
regarding her father’s 20 years disappearance.

The game is made entirely by using images, both 360 degree images and conventional 2D images, making it look graphically good on low spec devices.

KEY FEATURES

Solve the puzzles


Explore what is hidden


Learn what happened


Find out what secrets your father hid from you

title: Undead: Rise of the Betrayed King
description:
게임 정보
Undead: Rise of the Betrayed King - is an exhilarating role-playing game where you take to the skies in the form of a mighty dragon, the last guardian of balance in the world. Awakened evil threatens to destroy everything in its path, and only you, possessing the ability to transform into a human, can stand against this malevolence.

As a dragon, you employ your unique abilities to explore grand landscapes, unravel the secrets, and combat curses cast by the awakened evil. When the hour of battle arrives, you transform into a powerful warrior, utilizing ancient spells and magical artifacts.

Undead: Rise of the Betrayed King not only offers an epic adventure but also presents moral dilemmas that impact the storyline. Choose wisely, for your decisions determine not only your fate but also the fate of the entire world. Exciting quests, captivating battles, and astonishing discoveries await you in this world of magic and peril.
autokwd: Undead: Rise of the Betrayed King

title: For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation
description:
게임 정보
PS1 명작에서 영감을 받은 역동적인 전투에 참여하세요.
근접 공격, 원거리 공격, 마법을 사용하거나 은신으로 적을 제압하세요. 적들은 각기 다른 방식으로 반응하므로 전투마다 전략이 필요합니다. 복잡한 퍼즐을 풀고, 숨겨진 경로를 찾아 강력한 보스를 물리쳐 새로운 능력과 유물을 획득하세요. 힘과 지략으로 이 가혹한 세계에서 당신만의 길을 개척하세요.
서사 중심의 RPG:
복잡한 캐릭터와 도덕적 딜레마, 여러 갈래의 선택이 있는 깊이 있는 스토리를 경험하세요.
선택이 중요한 대화:
대화 중 내리는 결정이 퀘스트, 관계, 게임의 결과에 영향을 미칩니다.
2D와 3D의 융합:
2D 픽셀 아트 캐릭터와 3D 환경이 조화를 이루는 독특한 비주얼 스타일을 탐험하세요.
autokwd: For Evelyn II - Shards of Creation

title: hololive Holo's Hanafuda
description:

Embark on an unforgettable journey through breathtaking fantasy worlds where every corner is a canvas for your wildest adventures. Kick back and fish or grow something delicious. Discover new recipes and make something unique. Stumble upon endless hidden secrets. Amass a collection, or befriend every creature.

title: ChipWits

Program a robot to solve logic puzzles in ChipWits, an open-ended programming game for beginners and experts alike! Inspired by the 1980s original, ChipWits combines the best of puzzle games, automation, and programming to introduce a new generation of players to a classic gaming experience.
Take control of a humble robot, ChipWit Model CW-03.24, and learn the ropes of automating its activities. Place chips to instruct your ChipWit’s movement across the factory floor, building on skills learned in previous areas to solve increasingly complex puzzles to help Professor Chip open his first factory. Order these chips to find a solution to each floor, then press play to watch your ChipWit accomplish its goal!
ChipWits is designed to mimic programming, with no prior experience required. Each puzzle has multiple solutions and can be resolved in unique and clever ways. Experiment with different chip combinations to achieve your goal, and see how your performance compares to the global leaderboard!

• Maximize your score
• Minimize the number of chips used
• Minimize the number of cycles (steps) it takes for your program to run

음식을 찾아 마을을 돌아다니다가 음식을 숨겨둔 심술궂은 노인을 우연히 만납니다. 그러나 당신은 곧 그 노인이 아내를 잃은 후 가족과 친구들과 연락이 끊긴 재능 있는 예술가라는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당신의 도움으로 그는 사랑하는 사람들과 다시 연결되고 다시 한 번 행복을 찾을 수 있습니다.

이 게임은 탐험을 유도하는 오픈 월드 환경을 특징으로 하며 숨겨진 구석구석을 발견할 수 있습니다. 마을은 퍼즐을 풀고 퀘스트를 완료하는 등 흥미로운 캐릭터와 유쾌한 미니 게임으로 가득 차 있습니다. 캐릭터와의 상호 작용을 통해 노인과 예술과 삶에 대한 열정을 재발견하기 위한 그의 여정에 더 가까이 다가갈 수 있습니다.

또한 게임의 놀라운 그래픽과 몰입형 사운드 디자인은 플레이어를 생명과 디테일로 가득 찬 고요하고 평화로운 해안 마을로 안내합니다. 세상은 형형색색의 동식물로 활기차고 사운드트랙은 게임의 분위기를 완벽하게 포착하여 플레이어를 경험에 몰입시킵니다.

전반적으로 우리 게임은 모든 연령대의 플레이어에게 완벽한 유쾌하고 따뜻한 경험입니다. 털복숭이 영웅과 함께 우정과 자기 발견의 여정에 동참하고 노인이 다시 한 번 삶의 기쁨을 찾도록 도와주세요.

Kardashev is a game about energy. It is a first-person, space set, open world, factory building game. The primary goal is to ascend the Kardashev Scale.
Everything in this game starts with the Miner. You place the Miner on asteroids, and use this block to mine raw ores. These raw ores can be used directly in production, but mostly they are processed into Ingots via the Refiner.
After you have assembled all the raw materials you need, you use the Fabricator to process these into either intermediate products, or other blocks that can be placed in the world. Intermediate products may be used in other Fabricator recipes, and so the complexity of your factory will quickly increase!
Logistics features heavily in this game, and so you will be using Transporters and Inserters to move items around your factory and to fulfil varying and complex recipes.

title: Another Head
description:
게임 정보
It is with great pleasure that I present to you Another Head! The first game by Looting Dreams, created by Eric Sorrentino (yours truly). You’ll be transported to a small town in Colorado, Havenbrook, where you’ll control Tom as he faces one of the most intriguing events of late: there’s a new neighbor in town.
It’s hard to pin Another Head to a single genre. The story can take wildly different directions and tones depending on your choices.
No missions, live the story as the protagonist
Don’t expect senseless quests or triggers! The story progresses according to your decisions, whether you like it or not.
Feeling lost? Don’t worry—you can always consult the thoughts swirling around in Tom’s mind. Draw inspiration from his needs and ideas to navigate the game and make important decisions.
Meaningful dialogues
Interactions with people are key, so never miss a chance to chat with your neighbors. The choices you make during dialogues will always have weight. Think carefully about what to say, or you might regret it.
Multiple endings
Through different choices and actions, you can unlock up to 10 unique endings. If you manage to find them all, you can participate in the ultimate poll to decide which ending becomes the definitive one—good or bad!
A race against time
Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!
A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers
What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.
Developed in Italy, with love
I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.
