게임 정보

Dive into serenity with Desktop Aquarium, the ultimate desktop idle aquarium game that lives on your taskbar! Manage your own peaceful underwater world while you work or browse. Feed your fish, upgrade your tank, and collect rare species—all without leaving your desktop.

Cast your line with the built-in fishing system to discover exotic fish from hidden depths. Each catch can be added to your tank. Whether you're a casual clicker or a collector at heart, Desktop Aquarium brings relaxation, charm, and a splash of joy to your everyday routine.

Let your aquarium grow while you go about your day—and reel in something extraordinary.

title: Dice With The Universe
description:
게임 정보
Play dice with the Universe. Wield the fundamental forces of physics to control the Universe... and to shape what the next iteration of reality will be. A strategic rogue-like dice-battler with deckbuilding elements where you balance your skills against your luck.
Take the role of a Universal Concept who shapes the very fabric of reality with the power of one of the fundamental forces of physics-- weak, strong, electromagnetic and gravity. Each power provides a distinct and unique playstyle, moveset and dice with special abilities.
Each run crosses the lifespan of the entire Universe, from the Big Bang up until the Big Crunch when the Universe collapses back in on itself, ready to be born again. Your victory or defeat determines your position during the next iteration of the Universe (the next run); when the rules of physics are written during the first Plank epoch, your performance in the previous run will influence reality itself to be favorable to your chosen force. Earn powerful Universal Laws that give you significant bonuses, unique abilities, and change the very rules of the game itself.
Face off against the other fundamental forces in a series of dice-based battles. Your moveset determines the dice outcomes that earn you points (such as straights, of-a-kinds, specific sums, etc). After each roll a decision must be made: will you stay safe and keep the points you have earned-- or roll your remaining dice for more points, but risk not gaining more, and instead losing everything collected so far.
As the four forces struggle eternally as the Universe itself is born and reborn-- could a fifth, previously unknown force arise, looking to permanently break this cycle for it's own malevolent benefit?

title: 2Deez
description:
게임 정보
A simple fighting game distilling the core essence of 3D fighting games! And yet, it's 2D...?
Distilling the essence of 3D fighting games, 2Deez is the perfect starting point, or grinding point, for someone who really wants to understand 3D fighting games as a subgenre.  
Features
A story mode with 10 chapters, featuring characters such as a cursed rat, a cotton candy monster, and a cabal of evil wizards
Make your own custom palette... with HATS!!!1!!1
Arcade Mode
Offline Play with Bots
Offline Versus Mode for local play
Online lobby play with Rollback Netcode, chat, and spectators
Replays to watch the games you've played, with replay takeover
In-Game command list with frame data
An in-depth training mode with hitbox viewer, frame data display, a macro editor, and ability to save training macros to json files
If you dig deep, and are willing to work with json files, the ability to make and fight against your own bots

title: Marty's Funducational Tour!
description:
게임 정보
Hello…
My name is Marty. I am a Robot with a Humanology Doctorate from Robot University. I have created a rural American town as my next research project, and I am ecstatic to show off my town to an actual Human. Be prepared to learn all about Humans, such as why you must be quiet in Libraries (because noise can upset the books and jumble the letters), why streets were invented (because the word "roads" was copyrighted by Ancient Romans), or why every town HAD to have a Bowling Alley in it (I am still looking into this).
 This FUNducational journey has over 20+ buildings to explore and many unique and true facts about human culture that may leave you astonished! Some have claimed that my knowledge is false or that I make incorrect assumptions. While this is most likely not true, I am open to any feedback on my project, and since you are a human, I will accept most corrections you give, although I am the expert here.

Thank you,
Marty
What To Expect From This Game:
Witty-ish repartee with Marty The Robot
A Town the size of 1632x1294 pixels with quite a few inconsistencies
Buildings to investigate and find any deviations from the norm(Marty has misplaced quite a few objects...)
Unique and interesting facts from Marty The Robot
An Original Score made by a poorly trained musician - me :)

title: Dwarven Village: Dark Siege TD
description:
게임 정보
  Dwarfs are base trops 
 Ranged & Non-Ranged
 Magical & Non-Magical
Ranged Damage
Great Damage
No Magical Damage

title: Saunageddon
description:
게임 정보
Investigate the FInnish top-secret project to end all life by proving to the Finns that you are no german spy, but a real local!
Featuring 12 Sauna levels, meticulously crafted on real cottages and public saunas. Physics based Löyly throwing mechanics, and locals to meet!
And indie passion project by one aspiring Finnish game developer. Consider this game a medicine against the high paced and confusing information age. Relax, throw löyly, enjoy. And save the world.

title: Butterfly X
description:
게임 정보
A free Butterfly X game featuring characters from all versions of the Butterfly series of puzzle games. You can choose any level to pass through. But it will be great if you pass them all, helping the caterpillar to fulfill its mission.
As usual, the caterpillar can't jump on its own. It can fly from place to place like a butterfly, bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes.
We hope you will enjoy it and have fun!
Features
- Collect all the flowers to advance to the next level.
- Kill bees and bounce off objects to advance to the end of the level.
- Use pipes along the way to overcome obstacles in the level.
- Moving objects help to pass the level.
- There are several paths, find the right one.
- Beware of the blue bird, it pecks to death.
- The levels are very different, be alert.

title: RogueCraft
description:
게임 정보
몬스터들의 무리에 의해 황폐해진 왕국에서, 오직 당신만이 마법의 탑으로 이루어진 난공불락의 요새를 건설할 수 있습니다.
새로운 퍼크와 아이템을 획득하고, 진화 및 장비를 실험하여 매 플레이마다 더욱 혼돈스러운 경험을 만들어 보세요.
30번의 공포스러운 웨이브를 극복하고, 절망 속에서도 영웅적인 활약이 가능함을 증명해 보십시오.
특징:
38가지 독특한 탑 – 공격, 파밍, 버프, 디버프에 특화.
22명의 캐릭터 – 각자 고유의 시작 탑과 특별한 능력 보유.
18종의 일반 몬스터와 12명의 보스 – 각각 독자적인 메커니즘 보유.
37종의 아이템 – 전투의 결과를 극적으로 바꿀 수 있음.
6가지 다양한 맵 – 각각 고유의 환경과 조건을 제공.
최대 30분 이내의 빠른 게임 진행 – 긴박한 전투로 전략을 시험.
병합(Merge) 메커니즘 – 동일한 탑을 결합해 업그레이드.
다양한 플레이 스타일 – 전면 공격부터 치밀한 방어까지 자유롭게 선택.
40가지 업적 – 플레이어의 실력을 시험.
메타 진행 – 플레이 사이에 새로운 탑, 캐릭터, 기능을 해제.

title: Descendance
description:
게임 정보
Descendance is a top down 2D pixelated RPG where players and friends can find various caverns and dungeons to gather increasingly better loot.
Help the village, fish, fight, and complete quests as you discover mysterious groups and decide what path you choose to take.
Host servers amongst your friends to explore the game together, or play alone if you prefer.
enjoy parry based combat with a wide variety of magic, melee, and various projectiles to fight with.

title: Bomb Bowling X
description:
게임 정보
Bomb Bowling X is a casual retro game where you need to help a cute cat in a superhero cape win at Bomb Bowling.
It has only a few bomb charges, as well as bowling balls, basketballs and your skill and ingenuity.
The goal of the game is to complete levels by knocking pins off the screen. This can be done by exploding bombs that set various objects in motion (bowling balls, pins, basketballs, canes, balloons)
The player's task is to build a logical sequence of their interactions Armed with the laws of physics and your own ingenuity, bring down the full power of your "striking" skill on the pins!

title: StandOff
description:
게임 정보
STANDOFF is a stylized third-person action RPG where you battle waves of enemies, collect loot, and build the perfect gear setup. Explore a vibrant fantasy world, fight through dynamic encounters, and unlock powerful abilities as you level up.
Dodge, block, strike, and survive—then face off against tougher enemies and bosses in fast, responsive combat. Whether you're grinding for gear or jumping into a quick fight, STANDOFF keeps the action moving.

title: Swifty
description:
게임 정보
⚡ Swifty – Precision. Speed. Survival.
Race through challenging levels where speed is everything. Swifty tests your reflexes, timing, and precision in a fast-paced 2D platformer designed for players who love a challenge. Dodge deadly traps, pull off flawless jumps, and perfect your runs. Show that annoying frog who is the real "Swifty" here.
💥 Key Features:
Fast-paced gameplay that rewards precision and speed
Tight, responsive controls for smooth movement
Challenging levels with deadly obstacles
Minimalist art style focused on gameplay clarity

title: RTS Chess
description:
게임 정보
메커니즘
모든 조각은 이동 및 이동 옵션에 대해 별도의 쿨타임을 가지며, 조각을 조합하여 새로운 조각을 만들 수도 있습니다.
지도
체스 테마를 좀 더 재미있게 만들기 위해, 지도는 각각의 고유한 유형(생태계)을 가진 헥사곤으로 구성되어 있습니다.
건물
조각과 그들의 이동을 강화, 생산 또는 변경하는 건물을 지으세요.

title: COLD BOOT
description:
게임 정보
한 방, 한 명
모든 타격이 중요한 치열한 액션을 경험하세요. 적의 총알과 당신의 카타나는 즉시 죽입니다. 죽을 때마다 한 번의 반복(iteration)이 소모되며 마지막 체크포인트로 돌아갑니다. 죽음은 당신의 실력을 연마할 뿐이지만, 너무 자주 죽지 않도록 주의하세요!
반복 회복 메커니즘:
마지막으로 쓰러진 지점에 도달하면 반복을 회복할 수 있습니다. 이 신선하고 영리한 메커니즘은 죽음의 아픔을 덜어주면서도 긴장감을 더합니다—새로운 경로를 찾아 적을 처치할 것인가, 아니면 손실을 보충할 것인가? 매 순간 예측 불가능한 선택이 이어집니다.
업데이트와 스킬:
적을 베어 충전량을 채우고, 이를 사용해 시간 감속 같은 강력한 스킬을 활용하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 이동, 공격, 충전 관리 등에 영향을 미치는 무작위로 제공되는 다양한 업그레이드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 업그레이드들을 자유롭게 조합해 나만의 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들어 보세요.

title: ToDo LisT
description:
게임 정보
할 일 목록의 중요한 과제
반복되고 지루한 삶에서 벗어나려고 합니다. 일상적인 할 일을 완료하는 동안, 그들은 점점 인생의 진실을 발견하게 됩니다.
어느 날, TV 프로그램에서 신비로운 오웰 선생님이 그들에게 미래를 바꿀 수 있는 정보를 전했습니다. 당신은 이러한 기회를 잡을 수 있을까요?
다양한 결말
매일의 할 일 작업에서, 당신의 선택은 다양한 결과를 가져올 수 있습니다. 좋든 나쁘든.
특별한 퍼즐 풀이 경험
일상적인 과제는 간단하고 지루할 수 있지만, 단서는 이미 당신의 일상의 모든 구석에 숨겨져 있습니다. 이러한 퍼즐을 풀면, 할 일 목록 뒤에 더 큰 음모가 숨어 있을지도 모릅니다.

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅
17개의 작고 큰 던전과 10개의 룬
200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)
20명의 동방 캐릭터 신앙
...언제든 늘어날수도있습니다.

title: Safety Check YOSHI!
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a game where you identify dangers and near-miss situations in various locations.
You have recently been appointed as the Chairperson of the Safety and Health Committee at your workplace.
As the new chairperson, it is your responsibility to learn about various near-miss incidents and potential hazards.
As part of your training, you will enter a virtual world created with digital twin technology, which closely replicates the real world.
In this simulation, avatars will engage in dangerous behaviors, and your mission is to identify and point out those hazards.
Contents
Collect manuals that describe the safety rules for each location.
When you find an avatar engaging in dangerous behavior or breaking the rules, confront them by presenting the manual.
Once the avatar is in a safe state, confirm it with a cheerful "Safety Check! (Yoshi!)"
Your work isn’t done until you return safely.
There is also a time limit, so try to complete your tasks efficiently and reach the goal.
※ The images shown are from a development version and may be subject to change.

title: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
description:
게임 정보
Four couples, four yuri stories

Want to read yuri? Here's not only 1, but 4 yuri stories featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.

Developed by Team ANPIM: Your quick fix for short, cheesy, and fluffy yuri kinetic novels.

Total length: ~112,000 words
My Dream Is To Be a Model, Not a Maid!

Tanaka Akane is a stubborn and hot-headed 24 year old still chasing her lifetime dream of being a model, but after countless amounts of interviews, she still hasn't landed a permanent modeling job at an agency yet. To make matters worse, she accidentally spills coffee on a rich CEO's daughter and now this stranger demands Akane to be her maid to pay off the damages. How will Akane fare as a maid for this snobby and impossible rich girl? Will she even be able to last a day?

Length: ~28,000 words
There’s No Way I’d Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right?

Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her?

Length: ~30,000 words
The Moon That Fell for the Star

Tsukimiya Minami is just an ordinary convenience store worker trying to make ends meet—another day, another dollar. But things takes an unexpected turn during a late-night shift when she encounters a mysterious stranger in need of help. Against her better judgment, Minami offers her a place to stay. Little does she know, her new and annoying (yet surprisingly captivating) roommate is more than meets the eye (and ear) with a plate full of troubles. Yet, Minami can’t seem to resist lending a hand. As Minami gains a new temporary roommate, she soon also ends up gaining something else unexpectedly…

Length: ~28,000 words

When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else! How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for?

Length: ~26,000 words

Content warning:
Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.
autokwd: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM

title: USB-BOT
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an electrifying 2D platform puzzle adventure in USB-BOT, where a small, disconnected USB sets out on a quest to reunite with the device it was once a part of. With its wire tail torn away, USB-BOT must navigate a world that suddenly feels immense and full of danger. As you traverse 2D environments filled with challenging puzzles and dynamic platforming elements, your mission is to help this determined little USB find its way back home.
Grab, move, and use items in creative ways to conquer puzzles and platforming challenges. Grab metal objects and place them cleverly to complete circuits, power devices, and unlock new paths.

title: Liar Luna
description:
게임 정보
Play as Luna, a girl caught in a fight between armed insurgents and spies. Help her navigate her way to saving her friend. Explore a laboratory dedicated to the production of new materials. Acquire and use gadgets. Enjoy a lighthearted and chaotic story of a girl out of her depth in an espionage mission.
A visual novel game where you select branching choices and navigate an espionage mission. Select from a variety of choices and unlock new means and methods of completing the mission through the finding and use of various spy gadgets or experimental chemical substances. Play as a teenager thrown into a situation way out of her depth.

title: The Dance of Maple Leaves
description:
게임 정보
 단풍잎의 춤   RPG 즉시제 전투 양성 게임, 게이머는 망천 대륙에서 탐색을 진행할 것이며, 게임 중 레벨 장비 재료는 게이머가 몬스터에게서 획득해야 한다.
게임 방법 1: 초대형 주성 개방식 탐험 지도, 5대 던전 소지도, 던전 수령, 야외 BOSS, 야외 보물창고 등.
게임 2: 장비 속성 업그레이드 시스템, 모든 기초 속성은 최고 10 포인트 업그레이드 가능, 장비 감정 시스템, 모든 장비는 감정 가능, 등급은 우수, 우수, 우수, 서사시, 전설, 각 등급은 다른 추가 단어 속성에 대응, 최고 6 단어 속성을 얻을 수 있습니다.
게임 방법 3: 퀘스트 시스템, 유저를 안내, 유저를 선도, 더욱 좋은 돈과 아이템을 획득할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: The Dance of Maple Leaves,단풍잎의 춤

title: Happy Surprise Garden
description:
게임 정보
Dangers lurking everywhere
The seemingly peaceful and beautiful natural scenery may be ambushed by brutal alien creatures. Animals with cute appearance may have been infected and may suddenly attack when approached. You need to be ready with weapons to repel them at any time.
Strengthen skills
Collect resources during exploration and adventure. Once you have enough resources, you can synthesize weapons on the crafting table. Each weapon has different characteristics and skills. Whether in single-player or multiplayer mode, you can experience a full sense of freshness.

title: microFISHER
description:
게임 정보
          microFISHER is a cozy and relaxing fishing game where your ultimate goal is to collect every fish specimen. To achieve this, you must explore and discover various lakes, each home to a unique fish that your team is aiming for. The fishing system is simple yet engaging, featuring a timing-based mechanic. A bar spins around a circle, and you must carefully time your catch by hitting the bar when it turns blue. While easy to learn, this mechanic can become a fun and rewarding challenge as you chase after bigger fish.
                      To become the best fisherman, you will need to venture across different islands in search of essential upgrades. The toolbox upgrade allows you to cast your fishing line farther, giving you access to bigger and much-wanted fish. Meanwhile, finding bucket upgrades increases the number of fish that you can carry, allowing for longer and more productive fishing sessions.

title: DEATH BURGER
description:
게임 정보
A first-person horror adventure where you must escape while being pursued by a mysterious giant hamburger.
Explore a creepy facility and stand your ground against the approaching menace!
[Key Features]
• Fight with fries...
Slice your enemies with a glowing French fry! It's the only way to fight back.
Read your enemy’s moves, guard when needed, and strike during openings.
The game features a lock-on system, so even players not confident with camera control can fight comfortably.
• May the M.O.R.S.E. be with you
M.O.R.S.E. (Move Or Rotate Spatial Elements) is an ability that lets you move or levitate objects in the environment.
Use it to clear paths, solve puzzles, and aid your exploration.
• Story
What exactly is that giant hamburger?
As you push deeper into the facility, you'll gradually uncover its identity and purpose.
Don’t miss the shocking finale!
• Volume
The game is designed for about 1 to 2 hours of playtime.
The story is self-contained with no branching paths.
[Streaming and Video Policy]
We welcome gameplay videos and streaming. Please follow these two simple rules:
Include the name of this game in your video title.
Add a link to the game’s Steam store page in the description.

title: Patient Zero Pandemiс Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Can you destroy humanity?
Patient Zero Pandemic Simulator is an intense virus simulator with strategic elements, where your goal is to create a deadly disease and bring it to a global catastrophe. Starting with "patient zero," you must adapt the virus, evolving it to overcome all the barriers humanity puts in place to survive.
DETAILED WORLD
Immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic world where every infection is influenced by a variety of factors, from climate and transportation to healthcare and population density.
15 TYPES OF DISEASES
Infect the world by choosing from 15 disease types, each with unique mutations and developmental possibilities.
LARGE INFECTION MAP

title: 180 Seconds: A Firefighter's Call
description:
게임 정보
The alarm blares. Your heart races. In 180 seconds, lives will be changed forever - including yours. 
As a firefighter in this thrilling simulation arcade game, you're thrust into burning buildings with nothing but your wits, your equipment, and a ticking clock. Each environment - from maze-like office complexes to sprawling schools - is a puzzle of flame and smoke, waiting to be solved. But unlike traditional puzzles, the stakes here are life and death.
Your primary tool is a firehose with three tactical modes, each offering a different balance of power and precision. Will you use the focused stream to cut through to a specific hotspot, or switch to the wide spray to control a larger area? Every choice matters when the clock is ticking down from 180.
But "180 Seconds" isn't just about fighting fires. It's about the people caught in them. The game uses advanced AI to generate unique characters for each playthrough, complete with their own voices and backstories. The child you save in one run might be replaced by an elderly couple in the next, ensuring that no two games feel the same.
This unpredictability extends to the fires themselves. Using a proprietary system developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game simulates fires that react realistically to their environment and your actions. Manage oxygen levels carefully, or risk turning a smoldering room into a raging inferno with one wrong move.
Between missions, you'll return to the firehouse. Here, the game slows down, allowing you to explore, interact with fellow firefighters, and even care for the station's pet. But don't get too comfortable - the alarm can sound at any moment, catapulting you back into the action.
As you play, you'll find yourself improving. Response times that once seemed impossible become achievable. Rooms that were death traps become navigable. You'll start climbing the Steam Leaderboards, competing with firefighters around the world. But more importantly, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the real-life heroes who do this work every day.

title: Nia: Jewel Hunter
description:
게임 정보
Begin a thrilling journey through time with Nia, a brave young girl who finds herself transported to an ancient world filled with mysteries and dangers.
In this captivating platformer, you’ll venture into a past where myths and legends intertwine, guiding Nia on her quest to return home.
Trapped in this hostile world, Nia must navigate her way back by overcoming numerous trials, solving ancient puzzles, and dodging dangers at every turn. Explore mysterious ruins, uncover hidden artifacts, and tackle intricate mechanisms that can either be your salvation or doom.
Collect ancient artifacts, activate portals, and find the exit on each level to help Nia return to the modern world. Your wit, agility, and keen observation will be the keys to success in this remarkable adventure.
Key Features:
Atmospheric World: Explore a setting inspired by the ancient civilizations of Egypt and Greece.
Engaging Puzzles: Solve challenges rooted in myths and legends.
Exciting Levels: Conquer unique obstacles and trials.
Vibrant Graphics and Enchanting Music: Immerse yourself in the ancient world.

title: Odin's Defense
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a quest to defeat Fenrir. Travel distant lands, flanked by your allies, and take your rightful place by Odin's side!

Odin’s Defense is a twist on the traditional Tower Defense genre: instead of upgrades, equip your towers with powerful items to create unique effects each round. Immerse yourself in the story and make choices that will shape the outcome of your campaign.
Hand select the towers you will bring into battle. Get tactical, pick your favourites and charge into battle.
The Spindlewood, Dunes Eternal and the Boolevard of Broken Bones await the arrival of the Bifrost! Journey across forests, graveyards, deserts and more on your quest to defeat Fenrir.

title: Unhandled Exception
description:
게임 정보
Unhandled Exception (working title) is a 2D action/adventure, platformer, sidescrolling shooter, top down adventure, puzzle... well I couldn't choose a genre, so am just throwing everything at the wall to see what sticks. The truth is I wanted to try my hand at multiple 2D genre's for two reasons; to push myself to learn different game types, and to build each level around what's best to push the story along.

This game is heavily story driven and I 'borrowed' a lot from the movies and games I grew up with in the 80's and 90's. I look forward to providing more updates as I develop more of my game.

title: Glow Cubes
description:
게임 정보
To start, select a puzzle cube from the menu or shelf, as shown in the trailer. From there, you can press scramble to begin a timed solve, or play around with moves starting from the solved state. This is useful for practicing and experimenting with algorithms.

Key Features:

Solved cubies glow and are counted on the laptop, highlighting your progress as you solve!



Save your cube state! You can continue later, or revert back if you mess up an algorithm. Each puzzle gets its own save, so you can have multiple puzzles going at once.



Curate your cube collection! When you solve a cube, it appears as unscrambled on your shelf, and a new bonus cube may be unlocked. Mouse wheel over a cube to rotate it horizontally, or right click to match its angle to the cube in play. Click and drag to swap cubes around. You can even drag a display cube to the cube in play to instantly switch puzzles!



Right click and drag rotates the puzzle on two axes, which covers most movement, but leaves the same two faces (blue and green, red and orange, or yellow and white) on top and bottom. Click the icon cube on the right to change which two faces are on top and bottom. This system prevents gimbal lock that hinders the movement in other puzzle cube games.



Sometimes, the colored faces of cubies will be hidden. So, the inner faces are marked, and you can right click to see a ghost of the cubie extracted from the puzzle.

title: The Qubit Factory
description:
게임 정보
// New Employee Onboarding: Quantum Computing //
Below are classical bits, which all regular computers operate on. Boooooring!
                  Much more exciting are quantum bits (or qubits for short), which are not limited to simple {0,1} states. 
                  Qubits are so hot right now! They are the building blocks of newfangled quantum computers. As newly-minted employees of The Qubit Factory you will have the privilege of processing qubits in our state-of-the-art production lines. By harnessing the power of quantum entanglement and superpositions you will help up deliver exciting new computational products to our valued customers! 
// ---------------------------------------------------- //
The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game about building logic circuits to solve computational tasks, inspired by classic titles from developer Zachtronics. Based on authentic representations of quantum bits and components, The Qubit Factory features puzzles based on key concepts and algorithms from the field of quantum computing.
Open-Ended Puzzles - Factory employees are encouraged to design their own unique solutions to given tasks. Bonuses will be awarded to those meeting strict efficiency criteria. Convoluted and/or poorly-optimized solutions will be frowned upon.
Faithful Physics - Designed and programmed by a real (semi-successful) research scientist in the field of quantum computing: key concepts and algorithms from quantum computing are conveyed accurately, allowing players to build genuine knowledge about quantum computing!
Accessible- Core concepts are built slowly, with players encouraged to build foundational understanding in classical computing before progressing to quantum analogues. No prior computer/physics knowledge is assumed!

title: Neither dead nor alive
description:
게임 정보
Neither Dead or Alive
Will You Break Free or Succumb to Darkness?
In Neither Dead or Alive, you awaken as a skeleton brought back to life by a young, overzealous necromancer. But something went wrong—you retained your will, your mind, and your burning desire for freedom. Trapped within the ominous castle of your creator, your journey to escape begins.
Along the way, you’ll encounter cryptic puzzles, treacherous traps, and a cast of otherworldly characters. Some, like mischievous demon, may aid your quest—or try to steal your soul. Others might tempt you with the ultimate choice: give up and embrace the dark power of the necromancer. Will you forge your own path to freedom, or let the castle claim you forever?
Key Features:
A Unique Undead Perspective: Play as a skeleton with free will, fighting to break free from a necromancer’s control.
Interactive Puzzles and Riddles Solving: Solve devious puzzles scattered throughout the castle to uncover hidden paths and secrets.
Morally Gray Choices: Will you resist the necromancer's pull, strike a deal with the demons, or surrender to the darkness?
Memorable Characters: Interact with a cast of quirky and sinister characters, each with their own agendas.
Why Play?
Neither Dead or Alive is a darkly charming mix of puzzle-solving, storytelling, humor, and moral dilemmas. With a hauntingly atmospheric setting, unique undead protagonist, and a story where every choice matters, this is a game for players who crave more than just another escape adventure.
Your Fate Awaits
Will you defy the necromancer, outwit the demon, and break free? Or will you succumb to the shadows within the castle walls? The choice is yours in Neither Dead or Alive.

title: Quarter Lie
description:
게임 정보
A swindler exorcist loans a ticket for a long sea voyage, hoping to earn a living off of rich passengers. Everything goes smoothly until he discovers that the ship is actually haunted, and he can’t lie his way out anymore.
Forced to choose between your own well-being and the safety of the ship and its passengers, find a way to get the best outcome for everyone.
Features:
— A complex, intertwined narrative system
— 9 characters to con or befriend
— A hard limit on the amount of lies you can tell
— About 2 hours of playtime

title: LootMage
description:
게임 정보
LootMage(루트메이지)는 중세 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 마법 탄막 슈팅 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다.
플레이어는 이 세계의 모험가로서 끊임없이 변하는 던전에서 적들과 맞서 싸우며
보물을 수집하고 생존해야 합니다.
끊임없이 쏟아지는 적들의 공격을 회피하며 마법을 활용해 스릴있는 전투를 경험하세요.
패배한다면 모든 아이템을 잃지만, 지금까지 쌓아온 기술과 경험은 새로운 도전에 큰 힘이 됩니다.
과연 당신은 던전의 끝에 다다를 수 있을까요?

title: SPACESHEEP
description:
게임 정보
Your spaceship may be busted, but that’s not stopping you! Travel through bizarre alien planets, each with its own dangers, weird creatures, and strange landscapes. Who knows what secrets (or trouble) you’ll find?
Lost in space? Bring a buddy along! Play solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op and work together to solve challenges, escape enemies, and (hopefully) not get lost in space forever.

title: Dungeon Grid
description:
게임 정보
Build the Weirdest, Deadliest Spellcaster Ever
You’re a wizard with a problem: monsters keep trying to turn you into a stain on the dungeon floor. The solution? Stick magic parts onto yourself until they become the stain.
Fight Hordes. Try Not to Die. Repeat.
Battle waves of enemies who probably deserve it. Outsmart them with clever positioning, overpower them with absurd builds, or just panic and attach every part you find.
Think Fast.
Just having a good Synergy isn't enough. You'll have to execute on it if you want to succeed.
Strategic Mayhem in Every Run
Every Playthrough and Synergy provides a new way of playing the game, creating unique situations and new game-breaking Combinations.

title: Novaxandria Volume 01
description:
게임 정보
This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series, taking you back to the very beginning of the story.
Synopsis:
Novaxandria is a vast cosmopolis full of enigma and mystery. Its atmosphere varies dramatically from one district to another, each with its own unique character. In the very north of its territory there’s the Starfall Home, an orphanage where our protagonists were raised.
Young Iris, our main protagonist, finds out that bullying is happening in the orphanage. As she stands up to fight against the bullies, she makes a group of friends, and together they uncover the darker secrets lurking within Starfall Home. They resolve to fight back against the injustice and give all the kids a better life.
Features:
1 - Visual Novel
This game features a straightforward linear storyline, told in the form of visual novel. There are rich dialogues, manga clips and CGs to get you immersed in the story.
2 - 2D Turn-based Strategy Game
This game includes a 2D turn-based trategy game that’s inspired by chess and classic SRPGs. You will control different ally units (or ‘chess pieces’) to defeat your enemies. Different chess pieces have different movement patterns, weapons and skills that enrich the gameplay.

title: Silence Forest
description:
게임 정보
Silent Forest is a card-based roguelike game that marries simple controls with deep, varied gameplay. Its clean hand-drawn visuals and perfectly matched sound effects draw players into a vibrant fantasy world where storybook charm conceals genuine people and tales.
Venturing into the wilderness is the shared destiny of every saturated civilization. In the new millennium, when booming populations outgrew urban space, the government of Min City issued a provocative call: “Advance into the forest; our tomorrow lies within.” After the latest global crisis was averted, late-developing nations entered a golden era. One frontier town of fewer than ten thousand residents, empowered by the newly laid railway, swelled into a million-strong megacity within just three decades. Yet overcrowded streets, polluted rivers, and the bones of the homeless soon revealed the limits of that progress; expansion outward seemed the only path forward.

title: Striatum
description:
게임 정보
oh Noooo...
you overslept for the Party didn't You?
why are you Always doing things like that?
how Are you going to get ready in Time?
What are you looking for?
-----
Explore your apartment as you desperately try to get ready for a party. Navigate multiple rooms, and distractions in your preparation quest. Collect over 100 unique items to discover the ultimate inventory for party preparedness. Chat with your friends along the way on your new and smart phone. Discover unique events and interactions, complete quests, and discover the countless secrets of Striatum.
-----
Features
A retro first-person point-and-click PC adventure game with a colorful and surreal mid-90s low-poly 3D style.
Race the clock to prepare yourself for a party. Navigate competing distractions to be as prepared as possible.
A lovingly handcrafted open-apartment environment full of interactions and hundreds of unique items to collect.
Branching pathways and dialogue, multiple ending scenarios, and secrets to unlock encourage multiple playthroughs to discover everything.
An in-game smart phone interface. Have branching conversations with your friends to influence your relationship with them, keep track of important tasks, and find out all of the other amazing things technology can do for you!

title: Mini Painter
description:
게임 정보
Mini Painter is a cozy desktop idle game about finding balance between work and rest.
Immerse yourself in a meditative world where a tiny artist paints miniature figures, decorates his home, and learns to take care of himself.

Upgrade the room, collect geeky items, and keep your little painter inspired.
The more inspiration he has, the better his miniatures will turn out.
Each painted figure brings you closer to the final goal: the opus magnum that's been gathering dust on the shelf, waiting for its moment.
Features:
Unhurried progress: take your time creating the perfect geeky room.
Work and rest balance: don't overwork your artist, or he'll burn out. But don't let him relax too much either, or he'll lose his motivation.

title: Remembering Emily
description:
게임 정보
Remembering Emily is a short visual novel in which Thomas, the protagonist, relives his memories of Emily—memories that led him to her tragic end… although they might not be as clear as they first appear.
Fragmented Memories
Throughout the different chapters of Remembering Emily, Thomas will try to piece together what really happened. Each memory represents a possible path… and each path reveals a different truth.
The player’s choices are crucial in this story, as they lead to unique situations and two completely different—but complementary—endings.
If you want to uncover what truly happened with Emily, you’ll need to reach both endings. Only then will you understand 100% of the story.
Characters
While Remembering Emily features more characters than those shown here, this is a brief overview of the key figures in this tale of mystery and emotion:

title: Butterfly X
description:
게임 정보
A free Butterfly X game featuring characters from all versions of the Butterfly series of puzzle games. You can choose any level to pass through. But it will be great if you pass them all, helping the caterpillar to fulfill its mission.
As usual, the caterpillar can't jump on its own. It can fly from place to place like a butterfly, bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes.
We hope you will enjoy it and have fun!
Features
- Collect all the flowers to advance to the next level.
- Kill bees and bounce off objects to advance to the end of the level.

- Moving objects help to pass the level.

title: RogueCraft
description:
게임 정보
몬스터들의 무리에 의해 황폐해진 왕국에서, 오직 당신만이 마법의 탑으로 이루어진 난공불락의 요새를 건설할 수 있습니다.
새로운 퍼크와 아이템을 획득하고, 진화 및 장비를 실험하여 매 플레이마다 더욱 혼돈스러운 경험을 만들어 보세요.
30번의 공포스러운 웨이브를 극복하고, 절망 속에서도 영웅적인 활약이 가능함을 증명해 보십시오.
특징:
38가지 독특한 탑 – 공격, 파밍, 버프, 디버프에 특화.
22명의 캐릭터 – 각자 고유의 시작 탑과 특별한 능력 보유.
18종의 일반 몬스터와 12명의 보스 – 각각 독자적인 메커니즘 보유.
37종의 아이템 – 전투의 결과를 극적으로 바꿀 수 있음.
6가지 다양한 맵 – 각각 고유의 환경과 조건을 제공.
최대 30분 이내의 빠른 게임 진행 – 긴박한 전투로 전략을 시험.
병합(Merge) 메커니즘 – 동일한 탑을 결합해 업그레이드.
다양한 플레이 스타일 – 전면 공격부터 치밀한 방어까지 자유롭게 선택.
40가지 업적 – 플레이어의 실력을 시험.
메타 진행 – 플레이 사이에 새로운 탑, 캐릭터, 기능을 해제.

title: Descendance
description:
게임 정보
Descendance is a top down 2D pixelated RPG where players and friends can find various caverns and dungeons to gather increasingly better loot.
Help the village, fish, fight, and complete quests as you discover mysterious groups and decide what path you choose to take.
Host servers amongst your friends to explore the game together, or play alone if you prefer.
enjoy parry based combat with a wide variety of magic, melee, and various projectiles to fight with.

title: Twisted Gallery 异馆
description:
게임 정보
Twisted Gallery에 오신 것을 환영합니다 — 침묵 속에서 현실이 뒤틀리는 공간.
당신은 혼자 현대 미술관에 있습니다. 하얀 벽, 검은 바닥, 정교하게 배치된 전시물들. 모든 것이 질서 있어 보이지만 왠지 모르게 불안감을 줍니다.
당신의 임무는 단순합니다: 관찰하고 올바른 선택을 하세요.
불안을 무릅쓰고 더 깊이 들어가면, 무언가 다른 것이 보일지도 모릅니다.
당신은 변화들을 알아챌 수 있을까요? 아니면 영원히 익숙함 속에 갇히게 될까요?
주요 특징
『The Exit 8』에서 영감을 받은 심리 공포 게임
1인칭 몰입형 탐험 경험
모든 이상 현상을 다 보기 전까지는 반복되지 않음
이스터에그처럼 숨어 있는 특이한 이상 현상
자동 저장 기능 및 언제든지 일시정지 가능
스트리밍 및 영상 제작 안내
게임 이름과 발매 플랫폼만 명시하시면 자유롭게 방송하거나 영상을 업로드하실 수 있습니다. 개발자에게 따로 연락하실 필요는 없습니다.
가능하시다면, 콘텐츠 내에 Steam 상점 페이지 링크를 포함해 주시면 진심으로 감사하겠습니다!

title: Saunageddon
description:
게임 정보
Investigate the FInnish top-secret project to end all life by proving to the Finns that you are no german spy, but a real local!
Featuring 12 Sauna levels, meticulously crafted on real cottages and public saunas. Physics based Löyly throwing mechanics, and locals to meet!
And indie passion project by one aspiring Finnish game developer. Consider this game a medicine against the high paced and confusing information age. Relax, throw löyly, enjoy. And save the world.

title: Solitaire Zero 21
description:
게임 정보
Card game fit for all the family! The aim of the game is to clear the playing area of all cards whilst keeping your deck score between 0 and 21. If you hit 0 or below, or hit 21 or above, it is game over.
Gameplay
The player selects one of the top cards showing an addition or subtraction sum. This adds that card to their pile, applying the maths operation to their current score. The objective of the game is to stay within the range 1 - 20. If the sum falls to zero or hits 21, the game is over.
Only the top items of each pile are visible, so the player needs to operate some strategic thinking in order to ensure they don’t “go bust”.
Additional “wild” cards sometimes appear which has the ability for the player to alter their current score to help them (e.g. ‘MIN’ reduces their score to 1, ‘MAX’ increases their score to 20).
When a player clears all the cards successfully without hitting 0 or 21 they win some diamonds.
If a player fails, they can use their diamonds to try again where they left off.
Player Control
The game is controlled using either the Mouse or a DualSense / Xbox controller, to select the available cards with the thumb sticks to move a highlight around the screen, using A/X and B/O to select/deselect items as needed.
Progression & Challenge
The player works their way through the campaign, starting with Level 1. The difficulty increases as they progress.
A player can also collect the diamonds to customise the pack theme.
The game also features a Daily Challenge. In this game, all cards are laid on the table, with the player briefly able to see what they’re playing with. Then the cards turn over, and the player must select them one by one.
Achievements
The game features Steam Achievements as the user progresses through the game.

title: RTS Chess
description:
게임 정보
메커니즘
모든 조각은 이동 및 이동 옵션에 대해 별도의 쿨타임을 가지며, 조각을 조합하여 새로운 조각을 만들 수도 있습니다.
지도
체스 테마를 좀 더 재미있게 만들기 위해, 지도는 각각의 고유한 유형(생태계)을 가진 헥사곤으로 구성되어 있습니다.
건물
조각과 그들의 이동을 강화, 생산 또는 변경하는 건물을 지으세요.

title: Quarter Lie
description:
게임 정보
A swindler exorcist loans a ticket for a long sea voyage, hoping to earn a living off of rich passengers. Everything goes smoothly until he discovers that the ship is actually haunted, and he can’t lie his way out anymore.
Forced to choose between your own well-being and the safety of the ship and its passengers, find a way to get the best outcome for everyone.
Features:

title: COLD BOOT
description:
게임 정보
한 방, 한 명
모든 타격이 중요한 치열한 액션을 경험하세요. 적의 총알과 당신의 카타나는 즉시 죽입니다. 죽을 때마다 한 번의 반복(iteration)이 소모되며 마지막 체크포인트로 돌아갑니다. 죽음은 당신의 실력을 연마할 뿐이지만, 너무 자주 죽지 않도록 주의하세요!
반복 회복 메커니즘:
마지막으로 쓰러진 지점에 도달하면 반복을 회복할 수 있습니다. 이 신선하고 영리한 메커니즘은 죽음의 아픔을 덜어주면서도 긴장감을 더합니다—새로운 경로를 찾아 적을 처치할 것인가, 아니면 손실을 보충할 것인가? 매 순간 예측 불가능한 선택이 이어집니다.
업데이트와 스킬:
적을 베어 충전량을 채우고, 이를 사용해 시간 감속 같은 강력한 스킬을 활용하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 이동, 공격, 충전 관리 등에 영향을 미치는 무작위로 제공되는 다양한 업그레이드를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 업그레이드들을 자유롭게 조합해 나만의 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들어 보세요.

title: ToDo LisT
description:
게임 정보
할 일 목록의 중요한 과제
반복되고 지루한 삶에서 벗어나려고 합니다. 일상적인 할 일을 완료하는 동안, 그들은 점점 인생의 진실을 발견하게 됩니다.
어느 날, TV 프로그램에서 신비로운 오웰 선생님이 그들에게 미래를 바꿀 수 있는 정보를 전했습니다. 당신은 이러한 기회를 잡을 수 있을까요?
다양한 결말
매일의 할 일 작업에서, 당신의 선택은 다양한 결과를 가져올 수 있습니다. 좋든 나쁘든.
특별한 퍼즐 풀이 경험
일상적인 과제는 간단하고 지루할 수 있지만, 단서는 이미 당신의 일상의 모든 구석에 숨겨져 있습니다. 이러한 퍼즐을 풀면, 할 일 목록 뒤에 더 큰 음모가 숨어 있을지도 모릅니다.

title: Touhou Crawl
description:
게임 정보
던전화된 환상향을 돌파하자!

이 게임은 던전 크롤 -스톤수프-의 큰 영향을 받은 동방 2차 창작 팬게임 로그라이크입니다.
이 게임은 제가 아주 오래전에 만들어졌던 프로젝트로 로컬라이징 지원, 편의성 추가, 추가 컨텐츠, 밸런싱등의 개선을 통해 스팀 무료 게임으로 제공될 예정입니다.
게임 특징
12개의 종족, 20개의 직업, 혹은 9명의 유니크한 동방 캐릭터 스타팅
17개의 작고 큰 던전과 10개의 룬
200종이 넘는 몬스터 (그 중 약 80명의 동방 캐릭터 네임드)
20명의 동방 캐릭터 신앙
...언제든 늘어날수도있습니다.

title: Safety Check YOSHI!
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is a game where you identify dangers and near-miss situations in various locations.
You have recently been appointed as the Chairperson of the Safety and Health Committee at your workplace.
As the new chairperson, it is your responsibility to learn about various near-miss incidents and potential hazards.
As part of your training, you will enter a virtual world created with digital twin technology, which closely replicates the real world.
In this simulation, avatars will engage in dangerous behaviors, and your mission is to identify and point out those hazards.
Contents
Collect manuals that describe the safety rules for each location.
When you find an avatar engaging in dangerous behavior or breaking the rules, confront them by presenting the manual.
Once the avatar is in a safe state, confirm it with a cheerful "Safety Check! (Yoshi!)"
Your work isn’t done until you return safely.
There is also a time limit, so try to complete your tasks efficiently and reach the goal.
※ The images shown are from a development version and may be subject to change.

title: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
description:
게임 정보
Four couples, four yuri stories

Want to read yuri? Here's not only 1, but 4 yuri stories featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.

Developed by Team ANPIM: Your quick fix for short, cheesy, and fluffy yuri kinetic novels.

Total length: ~112,000 words
My Dream Is To Be a Model, Not a Maid!

Tanaka Akane is a stubborn and hot-headed 24 year old still chasing her lifetime dream of being a model, but after countless amounts of interviews, she still hasn't landed a permanent modeling job at an agency yet. To make matters worse, she accidentally spills coffee on a rich CEO's daughter and now this stranger demands Akane to be her maid to pay off the damages. How will Akane fare as a maid for this snobby and impossible rich girl? Will she even be able to last a day?

Length: ~28,000 words
There’s No Way I’d Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right?

Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her?

Length: ~30,000 words
The Moon That Fell for the Star

Tsukimiya Minami is just an ordinary convenience store worker trying to make ends meet—another day, another dollar. But things takes an unexpected turn during a late-night shift when she encounters a mysterious stranger in need of help. Against her better judgment, Minami offers her a place to stay. Little does she know, her new and annoying (yet surprisingly captivating) roommate is more than meets the eye (and ear) with a plate full of troubles. Yet, Minami can’t seem to resist lending a hand. As Minami gains a new temporary roommate, she soon also ends up gaining something else unexpectedly…

Length: ~28,000 words

When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else! How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for?

Length: ~26,000 words

Content warning:
Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.

title: USB-BOT
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an electrifying 2D platform puzzle adventure in USB-BOT, where a small, disconnected USB sets out on a quest to reunite with the device it was once a part of. With its wire tail torn away, USB-BOT must navigate a world that suddenly feels immense and full of danger. As you traverse 2D environments filled with challenging puzzles and dynamic platforming elements, your mission is to help this determined little USB find its way back home.
Grab, move, and use items in creative ways to conquer puzzles and platforming challenges. Grab metal objects and place them cleverly to complete circuits, power devices, and unlock new paths.

title: Bomb Bowling X
description:
게임 정보
Bomb Bowling X is a casual retro game where you need to help a cute cat in a superhero cape win at Bomb Bowling.
It has only a few bomb charges, as well as bowling balls, basketballs and your skill and ingenuity.
The goal of the game is to complete levels by knocking pins off the screen. This can be done by exploding bombs that set various objects in motion (bowling balls, pins, basketballs, canes, balloons)
The player's task is to build a logical sequence of their interactions Armed with the laws of physics and your own ingenuity, bring down the full power of your "striking" skill on the pins!

title: StandOff
description:
게임 정보
STANDOFF is a stylized third-person action RPG where you battle waves of enemies, collect loot, and build the perfect gear setup. Explore a vibrant fantasy world, fight through dynamic encounters, and unlock powerful abilities as you level up.
Dodge, block, strike, and survive—then face off against tougher enemies and bosses in fast, responsive combat. Whether you're grinding for gear or jumping into a quick fight, STANDOFF keeps the action moving.

title: Swifty
description:
게임 정보
⚡ Swifty – Precision. Speed. Survival.
Race through challenging levels where speed is everything. Swifty tests your reflexes, timing, and precision in a fast-paced 2D platformer designed for players who love a challenge. Dodge deadly traps, pull off flawless jumps, and perfect your runs. Show that annoying frog who is the real "Swifty" here.
💥 Key Features:
Fast-paced gameplay that rewards precision and speed
Tight, responsive controls for smooth movement
Challenging levels with deadly obstacles
Minimalist art style focused on gameplay clarity

title: SPACESHEEP
description:
게임 정보
Your spaceship may be busted, but that’s not stopping you! Travel through bizarre alien planets, each with its own dangers, weird creatures, and strange landscapes. Who knows what secrets (or trouble) you’ll find?
Lost in space? Bring a buddy along! Play solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op and work together to solve challenges, escape enemies, and (hopefully) not get lost in space forever.

title: Arcane Assembly
description:
게임 정보
Rebuild the Magic. Rewrite Time.

In the shattered remains of the Chrono-Circle, magic is fading from the world. As the last living Spellwright, your task is clear: Reignite the Arcane Forge. Automate the forgotten spellwork. Unravel time itself.

Deep below the ruins lies the Arcane Assembly, a massive tower of ancient machinery that once powered the ley lines of the world. You’ll start by manually channeling raw mana, then automate your growing spell empire with conduits, scroll writers, and relic amplifiers. Master the art of arcane automation and restore the flow of magic before it's lost forever.
Key Features
Master Arcane Automation: Progress from simple manual spellcasting to designing vast, complex networks of mystical infrastructure. Unlock conduits, rune engines, and scroll presses to produce spells passively and grow your power exponentially.
Discover Ancient Relics: Unearth dozens of powerful relics that permanently alter the way you play. A single relic can change your entire strategy, offering unique bonuses and game-changing rules that persist across timelines.
Collapse Time: Perform a "Timeline Collapse," the ultimate prestige system. Reset your progress to earn Chrono Knowledge, unlocking deeper secrets, permanent upgrades, and new paths to power that accelerate your journey.
Deep Lore, Light Touch: Uncover a rich narrative woven through ancient ruins and the descriptions of forgotten spells and relics. Hints of forgotten empires and spellwright rivalries await those who look closely.
A Constantly Evolving World: Never play the same game twice! New spells, relics, and global events are generated and introduced every week, ensuring the challenge is always fresh and there is always something new to craft.
Seamless Cross-Platform Play: Start your game on your PC and continue on the go. Your progress is synced between the Steam, Web, and Mobile versions of the game.

With regular, procedurally generated updates that deliver fresh content, Arcane Assembly is a game that evolves constantly. We are dedicated to providing an experience that always has something new for both new and veteran players to discover, master, and automate. Join our Discord to become part of the development journey!

title: Geargrid Tile Match
description:
게임 정보
Step into the clockwork chambers of Geargrid, where every match you make turns the cogs of a grand steampunk engine. This tile-matching puzzle adventure fuses vintage machinery aesthetics with addictive gameplay. Sort, stack, and solve intricate puzzles across handcrafted mechanical stages—each one more challenging than the last.
🔩 Features:
Match 3 identical tiles to clear the grid and keep the gears turning
Stunning steampunk visuals with brass, copper, and gear-laced detail
Increasing difficulty and layered puzzle design for true tacticians
Fluid animations and polished UI in a vintage industrial theme
Casual yet deeply satisfying gameplay loop

title: JackKnife
description:
게임 정보
Carver gets betrayed by his organization which leads to his death, but the need for revenge won't let him die tonight. In the afterlife, with radio contact from a friend, they try to get Carver back to the land of the living. You'll have to manage your way back with an extensive arsenal of weapons and explosives, tight gunplay, and light puzzle solving skills. But with fierce AI and wide variety of enemies around every corner will you survive this suspense filled night before you 'JackKnife' or get derailed?Features: Goal oriented AI, Full screen support, Save/load function, Upgrade system, Graphics/performance options, Full voice acting, and Story.

title: Royal Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Take to the stars in Royal Odyssey, a top-down space shooter inspired by the classic Shoot-Em-Up(Shmup) genre. Pilot Prince Zayven’s ship through a relentless asteroid storm as he races to return home and save his kingdom from a sudden threat. With quick reflexes, strategic upgrades and fast-paced action...can you overcome the dangers of space and complete Zayven's heroic journey before it's too late?

title: Shrooms! Tower Defence
description:
게임 정보
Shrooms Tower Defence is a fungally fresh take on tower defence, with procedurally generated maps and free-roam paths for the greedy lumberjacks to take to harvest your trees! Make careful use of your ten special Shrooms with various attack-patterns and abilities to protect your island!
FEATURES
Procedurally generated island maps mean you will never face the same challenge twice! Forests, rivers and other features create endless new experiences. 
Say goodbye to grids and lanes! Lumberjacks follow free-roam paths to harvest your trees, laying down infrastructure such as bridges and roads as they go to allow future enemies easier access. Protect your forest from every angle and strategy with careful placement and reaction!
Different types of lumberjacks present unique threats. Some are fast and weak, others are bulky and slow. Some have special abilities, like flight or devastating flamethrowers– and the powerful boss-lumberjacks are the most dangerous of all!
A variety of different Shroom-types with different elemental powers and special abilities that are strong or weak against different enemy-types. Will you use fire? Poison? Explosions? Ink to slow your enemies down? Knowledge is everything!
Each Shroom has its own system of upgrades–multiple tiers and options to choose from. Increase a Shroom’s attack power or unlock new abilities to add to its arsenal. Will you distribute your upgrade-points evenly across your army? Or will you pour all your efforts into a few unstoppable fungi?

title: BACKFIRE
description:
게임 정보
Nine deadly weapons with one thing in common– they all fire backward. Mastering each weapon's quirks is the key to combat. Jet around with the flamethrower, master the kick of the shotgun, kill at a distance with the sniper rifle. Whatever you choose, fire with purpose, or die.

title: Geometry Shooter Pro
description:
게임 정보
【클래식 슈팅의 새로운 차원】
움직이는 포탑에서 총알을 발사해 화면 가득 퍼지는 원, 삼각형, 사각형을 깨뜨리세요! 기하 도형은 맞을수록 점점 커지며, 완전히 파괴하려면 여러 번 정밀하게 명중시켜야 합니다. 타이밍과 정확도가 고득점을 위한 유일한 열쇠입니다!
【세 가지 강화 요소로 진화된 쾌감】
▶ 3라이프 시스템: 이제는 단 한 번의 실수로 끝나지 않아요! 여유 있는 리트라이 메커니즘으로 더욱 과감한 플레이와 콤보에 집중할 수 있습니다.
▶ 멀티 배틀 모드: 실시간 PVP 대전을 통해 탄막으로 상대를 압도하거나, 협력 모드로 함께 더블 스코어를 노려보세요!
▶ 전략 아이템: 무작위로 등장하는 보너스 볼에는 서프라이즈가 숨어 있습니다! 전략적으로 활용해 게임의 판도를 뒤집어보세요!
'딩!' 탄환 장전 소리가 울립니다—
당신은, 자신의 한계를 갱신할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Steve's Warehouse
description:
게임 정보
Steve is a busy alien and they must collect and sort out human fruits, animals, storage or even planets. To do so, Steve will combine the same objects to create better objects, make more points, and make more money!
Discover the ultimate physics deck-builder: Suika meets Roguelike
Steve's Warehouse is inspired by the Watermelon game (Suika game) and rogue-like deckbuilding games (such as great games like Peglin, Luck be a Landlord or Balatro). Physics will do its thing, creating both the most satisfying and the most funnily frustrating situations
Experiment with object families and their strange effects
Strange effects include animals that eat fruits, strange letters that rotate, and sports balls that create objects when they touch a wall. Each of the 8 families works singularly around physics or other objects!
Spice things up with passives
With more than 40 unique passives, discover various combinations to have a crazier effect:
Transform every object into a car, make every object rotate, win points when using a bomb or TNT...
Survive bosses and Challenges
Each arena has a boss with a special effect to give you one last challenge before finishing the game. Additionally, discover 7 unique challenges changing the game rules entirely!

title: Inkborn
description:
게임 정보
Inkborn은 카드를 연결하여 강력한 콤보를 만드는 것이 적을 처치하는 핵심인 로그라이크 덱빌더 게임입니다. 각 플레이마다 다른 세계의 생명체들과 맞서 싸울 수 있는 새로운 방식을 제공하는 비선형적인 종이접기 세계를 탐험할 수 있습니다. 마을에서 준비를 하면, 시간이 지남에 따라 마을을 확장하고, 새로운 카드와 능력을 잠금 해제하고, 깊이 있는 스킬 트리를 통해 나만의 플레이 스타일을 맞춤 설정할 수 있습니다. 잉크와 종이로 이루어진 세계 뒤에 숨겨진 역사를 밝혀낼 준비를 해보세요.
주요 특징
콤보
카드 비용 아래에 있는 다양한 기호(글리프)로 표시되는 카드 유형에 따라 특정 순서로 카드를 플레이하면 특수 효과가 발동합니다. 이제 카드를 뽑을 때마다 강력한 콤보를 펼칠 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다.
스킬 트리

title: Novaxandria Volume 01
description:
게임 정보
This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series, taking you back to the very beginning of the story.
Synopsis:
Novaxandria is a vast cosmopolis full of enigma and mystery. Its atmosphere varies dramatically from one district to another, each with its own unique character. In the very north of its territory there’s the Starfall Home, an orphanage where our protagonists were raised.
Young Iris, our main protagonist, finds out that bullying is happening in the orphanage. As she stands up to fight against the bullies, she makes a group of friends, and together they uncover the darker secrets lurking within Starfall Home. They resolve to fight back against the injustice and give all the kids a better life.
Features:
1 - Visual Novel
This game features a straightforward linear storyline, told in the form of visual novel. There are rich dialogues, manga clips and CGs to get you immersed in the story.
2 - 2D Turn-based Strategy Game
This game includes a 2D turn-based trategy game that’s inspired by chess and classic SRPGs. You will control different ally units (or ‘chess pieces’) to defeat your enemies. Different chess pieces have different movement patterns, weapons and skills that enrich the gameplay.

title: Silence Forest
description:
게임 정보
Silent Forest is a card-based roguelike game that marries simple controls with deep, varied gameplay. Its clean hand-drawn visuals and perfectly matched sound effects draw players into a vibrant fantasy world where storybook charm conceals genuine people and tales.
Venturing into the wilderness is the shared destiny of every saturated civilization. In the new millennium, when booming populations outgrew urban space, the government of Min City issued a provocative call: “Advance into the forest; our tomorrow lies within.” After the latest global crisis was averted, late-developing nations entered a golden era. One frontier town of fewer than ten thousand residents, empowered by the newly laid railway, swelled into a million-strong megacity within just three decades. Yet overcrowded streets, polluted rivers, and the bones of the homeless soon revealed the limits of that progress; expansion outward seemed the only path forward.

title: Pale Coins
description:
게임 정보
Explore the open world of Grenmark in Pale Coins, an old-school Fantasy Action-RPG with souls-like elements. Pale Coins features challenging gameplay and unique boss fights, tons of rare loot to find, dungeons to conquer, quests to complete, and stories to uncover.




Explore a gorgeous handcrafted fantasy world, starting with nothing but an old weapon. Journey across forests, ruins, mountains, and caverns as you encounter new characters on your search for the Champion’s Coin.




Prepare for battle as you encounter a variety of monsters while exploring beyond the safe borders of the capital and the villages. Amongst them are formidable boss fights that will require skilled gameplay to combat their unique movesets and abilities.




Unearth a broad arsenal of melee, ranged, and magic weapons with their own stats and skills, as well as a plethora of armor sets allowing you to transform your character.



Uncover powerful skills granted by rare pieces of equipment, and are found throughout the vibrant world of Grenmark. While worn, these rare pieces of equipment allow you to cast special magic spells, utilize new movement abilities, summon minions, and much more. It’s up to you to find, utilize, and master all the many skills available.

title: Street Drive Rush
description:
게임 정보
🏁 Street Drive Rush
Master the streets in a high-speed, urban driving experience packed with challenge and variety.
In Street Drive Rush, you’ll take on the city in three distinct driving modes: Time Trial, Parkour, and Drift. Choose your path, push your limits, and prove your skills behind the wheel.
🚗 Game Features
Three Unique Modes
Time Trial – Race against the clock and beat checkpoint challenges.
Parkour – Navigate wild stunt courses where your car must jump, land, and climb across urban obstacles.
Drift – Rack up points by mastering corners and controlling your slide.
Speed Capture System
Speed zones across the city measure your velocity — go too fast, get caught, and earn bragging rights.
Collect Diamonds
Hunt for hidden diamonds scattered across each map to unlock rewards and perfect your routes.
Mission-Based Gameplay
Each mode features carefully crafted missions that increase in difficulty and demand true driving precision.
Stylized Urban Environment
A sleek, colorful city filled with highways, rooftops, ramps, and tight turns — all optimized for smooth performance.
🎮 Perfect For Fans Of:
Drift and stunt-based driving games
Arcade-style racing with bite-sized missions
Challenge runs and high-score chasing
Fast-paced, casual driving fun with replay value
Are you ready to own the streets?

title: City Taxi Mission
description:
게임 정보
Drive, earn, and dominate the city streets in City Taxi Mission — a mission-based taxi driving game with endless fun!
Hop into your yellow cab, pick up passengers, and drop them at their destinations across a bustling 3D city. Every successful fare earns you money to upgrade your fleet and unlock new taxis. Whether you're cruising through downtown traffic or weaving past buses and bikes, each mission challenges your reflexes, timing, and road sense.
🚕 City Taxi Mission blends fast-paced arcade driving with the satisfaction of casual progression. Perfect for fans of urban driving games, taxi sims, and short-session gameplay.
🕹️ Key Features:
🚖 Drive and Deliver – Pick up and drop off passengers across an open city environment
🎯 Mission-Based Gameplay – Complete multiple passenger drop missions in each run
💰 Earn and Upgrade – Unlock new taxis with the money you earn
🛞 Smooth Driving Experience – Designed for casual players and driving enthusiasts alike
🌆 3D Urban Environment – Explore traffic-filled city roads with buses, bikes, and pedestrians
🔓 Achievement System – Unlock Steam achievements as you rise through the game
🎮 Singleplayer – Fully offline, no internet required
Ready to rule the roads?
Start your engine and take on the challenge in City Taxi Mission — where every ride counts!

title: The Rainbox
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the RAINBOX, A colorfully monochrome world for you to solve puzzles in!
You play as the adorable white cube named Reynold, and you must solve puzzles to progress. You have the ability to push blocks, and you must use that to get all of the blocks on their goals. Seems simple, right? 
Well, it is, at first.
It's not as simple as just pushing the blocks on the goal. Each individual block has a completely different mechanic. Sometimes you have to PULL the block onto the goal, other times you have to SCARE it onto the goal, and other times still the block will just kill you.

title: Filiy Eclipse
description:
게임 정보
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an escape pod.
He has no memory, doesn't know where he is, and can't even remember his own name.
He arrives at a shopping street but there is no one there. Only a robot.
The robot speaks to him.
"You have temporarily lost your memory. If you want to regain your memory quickly,
you should go to the museum and look around at various things."
With nowhere to go, he decides to head to the museum.
● Obtain a secretary hidden somewhere and learn and strengthen command skills.
   It can also be learned at a dojo.

title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan
description:
게임 정보
Story
In “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan,” you play as Maria Ramirez, an American working in Japan as an English teacher. It’s a rewarding, fun job, and you’re beloved by students and coworkers alike–until suddenly, one day you lose your job. You work for a dispatch English teaching company, and they lost their contract with your school, just one month before the end of the school year.
Out of nowhere, you must change the course of your life. You have a loving girlfriend to support you and other friends facing this alongside you, but ultimately you must make an extremely tough choice about your future.
This game is based on the real-life experiences of English teachers throughout Japan, on issues that tens of thousands of people endure every single year, and is designed to provide an up-close viewpoint of what the dispatch contract system does to the individuals impacted.
Features
Live through real-life shock – You’re an English teacher in Japan, and suddenly, your life is turned upside-down. Experience the chaos of a last-second life meteor.
Make tough choices – End your relationship? Risk it all? There are no easy answers to how to face your future.
Exploration of underdiscussed issues – Tens of thousands of English teachers in Japan face the same problems every single year, and “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan” sheds light on these solvable issues to a mainstream audience.
A myriad of social issues – Job loss, foreign work visas, cross-country moves, same-sex marriage, adult loneliness–this game covers many different factors in a short time span.
Brisk story – Across all endings, the story runs about 6,000 words long, so a full playthrough should take thirty minutes or less.
About Yuri Kissaten
Yuri Kissaten is a game studio that makes narrative-focused games about girls loving girls, founded in 2024 by Fruz and Beatrice Baker. We create experiences with strong stories and memorable characters. All Yuri Kissaten projects focus primarily on LGBTQ+ characters and their relationships, romantic and otherwise. We hope you enjoy our games!

title: Cryptid Engine
description:
게임 정보
Move slowly. Look closely. In this world, the silence speaks, and what hides in the stillness is watching you too.
Realism
There are no puzzles, jump scares, or goals.. there's only you... and your camera. Only the most patient are able to hunt down the ethereal beings of the other world(s).
Unlock Maps
Inspired by old computer hunting games... players can earn points upon successfully capturing a creature on camera. And spend those points on more dangerous maps.
Custom Level Support
All levels are "assembled" using the in-house game engine created in Raylib.
Experienced players are able to:
Use any model they want for the "creature_model" and the "env_model"
Assign an unlock price for their maps (maximum: 1000 pts)
Adjust the behavior of creatures.
Change the texture/sound/model for almost any visual asset used in a map.
The game uses morph keys for variety. No advanced knowledge of modeling topics required!

title: Yogoe Hunter
description:
게임 정보
착귀갑사
선택으로 운명을 개척하는, 동양 신화 기반의 로그라이크 텍스트 어드벤처
서양에 몬스터가 있다면, 동양에는 '요괴'가 있습니다.
요괴는 고대 한국과 일본에서 전해 내려오는 신비롭고 괴이한 존재들로,
사람을 돕기도, 해치기도 하며 전설과 역사 속에 함께 등장합니다.
『착귀갑사』는 218종의 요괴를 도감처럼 정리하고,
그들과 마주하며 선택을 이어가는 로그라이크 텍스트 어드벤처 게임입니다.
배경은 중세 한국과 일본. 전통 문화와 전설을 체험할 수 있는 특별한 세계로 여러분을 초대합니다.
누구나 쉽게, 하지만 깊이 있는 선택형 이야기
게임의 방식은 단순합니다.
텍스트를 읽고, 선택지를 고르는 것만으로 플레이가 진행됩니다.
복잡한 조작 없이도 94개의 다양한 엔딩과 수백 개의 분기를 통해
매번 새로운 이야기를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.
한국과 일본 전통 설화를 바탕으로 한 세계관
게임 내 모든 스토리는 한국과 일본의 전래동화, 민속설화, 역사적 전승을 기반으로 구성되었습니다.
플레이어는 닌자, 무사, 방랑자, 무당, 황제 등
다양한 정체성을 선택하며 중세 동아시아의 전통 문화와 신화적 상상력을 체험하게 됩니다.
20만 자 이상의 방대한 텍스트
이 게임에는 약 소설 3~4권 분량에 해당하는 200,000자 이상의 이야기가 담겨 있습니다.
텍스트 기반 게임으로는 드물게, 극도로 풍부하고 밀도 있는 서사를 즐길 수 있으며
매번 다른 루트와 새로운 결말을 통해 깊은 몰입감을 제공합니다.
로그라이크 방식의 성장과 반복
매 회차마다 스탯과 아이템이 무작위로 변화
다양한 빌드 조합 가능
영물과 함께 성장
윤회를 거듭할수록 강해지는 시스템
초반엔 어려울 수 있지만, 반복을 통해 점차 강해지고
새로운 분기를 해금하며 점점 넓은 세계를 경험할 수 있습니다.

title: GAT RAT
description:
게임 정보
Ultimate 2D Shooter
A rat with an assault rifle? How about a rat with TWENTY guns — including shotguns, energy weapons, grenade launchers, an overpowered harpoon gun, and more.
Epic Spells and Perks
Guns not enough? That’s fair. That’s why GAT RAT can also wield elemental spells and game-changing perks that completely transform your playstyle into something wild and overpowered.

title: Y2ROLL
description:
게임 정보
Y2ROLL is an N64-style minimalistic physics-based arcade-style marble rolling game that will take you back to the turn of the millennium.
Features
Minimalistic gameplay that is easy to pick up, with a very high skill ceiling and constant opportunities for skill expression
Return to the 32bit console era
Vibrant N64-style graphics and art direction
Soundtrack inspired by atmospheric/intelligent DnB music
Easy to pick up
Every level simply asks you to reach the goal
Every level can be played with a single analogue stick or WASD keys
Hard to master
Later levels will test the movement mastery of even genre veterans
Replay levels to try and earn elusive gold medal times

title: The King's Legend
description:
게임 정보
The King's Legend
A gritty, medieval fantasy turn-based strategy game where every move is a matter of sacrifice.
Sit at the war table as a king locked in a deadly duel against a rival monarch. Across a hex-based battlefield, command an evolving army of Soldiers, Knights, Wizards, and powerful Legends. With each turn, you must make brutal decisions—sacrifice your own to strengthen the rest, upgrade your forces, and regenerate lost pieces to outwit your opponent.
Played for millennia, this ancient game is more than tradition—your kingdom’s fate hangs in the balance. Challenge your friends in intense 1v1 battles where cleverness trumps brute force.
Think carefully, strike boldly—only the smartest king will rise to legend.

A Duel Demands Two. The King's Legend is a head-to-head experience—built for rivalry, not solitude. Whether side by side or connected through Steam Remote Play, a challenger is required. No friend at the ready? Seek one out. A true duel waits for no one.

title: Mechanoid
description:
게임 정보
Blast your way through 18 levels of platform mayhem in a quest to save mankind from the grip of a totalitarian  regime. Every level is a playground of possibilities, where quick thinking and quicker reflexes are the keys to survival.
As you progress, you'll find opportunities to enhance your crucial systems. Weapon upgrades pack more punch against tougher enemies. Shield improvements give you better protection when things get hectic. Battery enhancements let you push deeper into hostile territory. And perhaps most crucial of all, life support upgrades keep you alive in increasingly dangerous environments.

title: Reflex Unit : Strike Ops
description:
게임 정보
리플렉스 유닛: 스트라이크 옵스
파국적인 사건들로 파괴된 근미래 세계에서, 강력한 기업들이 통제권을 장악하고 문명의 잔재를 자신들의 사유지로 만들었습니다. 그 중에서도 네오테크가 최고의 자리에 올라 자원을 착취하고 무자비한 효율성으로 인구를 억압하고 있습니다. 하지만 희망은 사라지지 않았습니다. 리플렉스 유닛, 전직 요원들과 전문가들로 구성된 작지만 정예화된 팀이 자유를 위해 싸우기 위해 잿더미 속에서 일어섰습니다.

특징:
전술 헬리콥터 전투: 각각 고유한 게임플레이 역학을 제공하는 여러 특수 헬리콥터를 조종하세요.
스토리 기반 캠페인: 사악한 네오테크 기업과 그들의 세계 지배 계획 뒤에 숨겨진 미스터리를 밝혀내세요.
다양한 임무: 포로를 구출하고, 자원을 모으며, 적 기지를 공격하고, 네오테크의 요새를 타격하세요.
전략적 게임플레이: 도전적인 임무를 극복하기 위해 속도, 화력, 연료 및 적재 용량의 균형을 맞추세요.
멀티플레이어: PVP 및 협동 게임 모드.

리플렉스 유닛의 리더로서, 다양한 임무를 수행하며 개조된 헬리콥터를 조종하게 됩니다. 적 영토를 정찰하고, 과감한 구출 작전을 수행하며, 90년대 클래식 게임 데저트 스트라이크에 대한 오마주로 강력한 화력을 퍼부으세요.


네오테크의 사악한 작전을 방해하기 위해 고위험 임무에 참여하세요. 그들의 끔찍한 드론 프로그램 뒤에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견하고 그들의 궁극적인 무기 배치를 막기 위해 시간과 경주하세요. 몇 년 전 네오테크에 의해 붙잡힌 당신의 형제 클라이브에게 무슨 일이 일어났는지 그 미스터리를 밝혀내세요.


배신, 동맹, 개인적인 복수로 가득한 흥미진진한 이야기를 경험하세요. 위험은 높고, 긴급함은 현실입니다. 당신의 전략적 결정과 전투 능력이 인류의 운명을 결정할 것입니다.

title: Soviet Tide Arising!
description:
게임 정보
Take to the skies over the western front in this fantasy alternate timeline WW1 casual run and gun style sim-shooter. Fly as a heroic pilot of the Allied Empires as you take on nefarious Soviet forces.
Supports Touch / Mouse / XBOX controller
Fly 44 allied missions against the Greater Soviet Union
Attack Soviet airships, bombers, ground forces, and aces
Infiltrate Soviet territory to complete clandestine reconnaissance and attacks
Earn endurance missions, medals, and increase your rank as you complete the story missions

title: Chinese Chess Way
description:
게임 정보
"Yidao VR Chinese Chess" is a virtual reality tabletop chess game set against the backdrop of ancient Chinese wars. It adopts the classic Chinese chess gameplay rules of horses moving the sun, elephants moving the fields, chariots moving in straight lines, and cannons climbing over mountains. Players will be placed in a virtual ancient battlefield and compete in chess skills with virtual ancient generals in a war-ridden environment. The game supports retaking moves. As long as you defeat the opposing coach (general), you will win.
When players pick up the pieces, a yellow light spot will appear to indicate where they can place a piece. The position for capturing a piece is particularly displayed as a double sword. Even players who are not familiar with the rules of moving can easily experience the classic strategic charm of Chinese chess.
autokwd: Chinese Chess Way,弈道VR中国象棋

title: Zombie Jazz
description:
게임 정보
A mysterious and deadly gas has spread across the surface of the planet, blanketing cities, forests, and oceans in a toxic shroud. With its arrival came something far worse — the dead have begun to rise. Once-lifeless bodies now roam the earth, driven by an unnatural hunger, attacking the living without mercy. No one knows where the gas came from, or why it causes the dead to reanimate, but what’s clear is that it’s changing everything.
Those still alive can only survive brief exposure to the gas before it takes hold of them as well. Scattered across the ruins of civilization are strange puzzles. Solving them appears to delay the effects of the gas, granting precious seconds for the player to find a way to safety.
No one knows who placed the puzzles or why. All we do know is bullets kill the zombies, and they love to dance to Jazz music. Whatever the truth, one thing is certain: the only way to survive is to keep moving, keep thinking, and keep solving. Your mind is your last weapon. Every puzzle solved is one more breath, one more heartbeat… one more chance to live.
Customize the game to suit you:
The game gives you the opportunity to customoize your experience by making the levels larger or smaller depending on how much challenge you wish to face.
The main weapon in the game is fully customizable, with various mods and damage types, allowing you to make weapons like a fully automatic incendiary rocket launcher, a sniper rifle, or an electro shotgun.
Play how you want:
The game is fully playable as either a mouse and keyboard first person shooter or in SteamVR virtual reality.
Game features:
Customizable levels
Huge hoards of zombies to kill
Drill zombies!

title: Rebound Rush
description:
게임 정보
Rebound Rush
Rebound Rush is a fast paced sport game where you duel your friends in a life size pinball arena. Conquer the crowd and terrain by avoiding and using obstacles to your advantage and score in your oponnent's nest!
Be careful though, the commentator might hinder you by moving the net or throwing items to make the match more spicy! Watch out for boomboxes and use them to keep your opponent on the edge!

Heads up! Rebound Rush is a two-player-only experience—whether you're battling it out in couch PvP or via Steam Remote Play, you'll need a friend to duel (after all, what's life without a few broken friendships over video games?). No buddy nearby? Go outside and make one—we believe in you. Good luck!
