description: 게임 정보

title: Mix It! RELOADED
description:
게임 정보
Overview:
Embark on a captivating space adventure with Mix It!, an innovative game that seamlessly blends entertainment with education. As an Astropilot undergoing the rigorous training program, players will delve into the mysteries of the universe, exploring the fascinating physical properties of light in an engaging and interactive way.
Key Features:
Astropilot Training Program:
Immerse yourself in the role of an Astropilot and undergo a comprehensive training program designed to teach you about the physics of light.
Navigate through stunning space environments and tackle challenges that require an understanding of light properties to progress.
Educational Exploration:
Learn and apply concepts related to reflection, refraction, and color theory as you traverse the universe. Mix It! seamlessly integrates educational elements into the gameplay for an enriching experience.
Award-Winning Design:
Proud recipient of prestigious awards, including Game Jam Plus' Best Sound Design, Best Game about Color (sponsored by Anjo Tintas), and Best Game of Costa Rica. Additionally, Mix It! received a nomination at the VIT awards 2023.
Immersive Visuals:
Marvel at the breathtaking visuals of space, enhanced by vibrant colors and mesmerizing light effects. Mix It! leverages cutting-edge graphics to create an immersive and visually stunning gaming experience.
Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics:
Engage in dynamic gameplay that combines exploration, and skill-based challenges. Each level presents new and exciting opportunities to apply your knowledge of light physics.
Community and Recognition:
Follow @t3ampo on social media, and join a growing community of players passionate about science, space, and gaming. Share your experiences, participate in discussions, and stay updated on the latest news through community channels. (Instagram, Twitch, and X)

title: Sudoku Mania
description:
게임 정보
The concept of the game is to fill a grid with the numbers 1-9 ensuring no repetition across rows or columns.
Players move to the empty cells in the grid and choose a number to go in that cell.
If players get stuck on a particular puzzle, a Hint system is available to get them back on track.
Play continues until the board is filled.
The Pencil icon allows the player to make pencil marks in the square to make notes and narrow down their choices. This isn’t counted as their answer.
The Eraser icon allows the player to rub out a previous answer if they later realise it’s not correct.
The Undo icon allows the player to undo one or more moves. This doesn’t roll back the game timer.
Difficulty
The game is available in four difficulty levels:
- Easy
- Medium
- Hard
- Extreme
In Beginner mode, players can make an unlimited amount of mistakes, compared to the normal mode where only a handful of errors can be made before its GAME OVER!
Challenges
The game will contain a Daily Challenge function where players can battle against other players all over the world to get the fastest time.
Progression
The game consists of a set number of levels in each difficulty level - completing all will win the game.
Leaderboards
The game also includes leaderboards to allow players to rank amongst their friends and the world. Leaderboards will be progression and time based.

title: White Room Protocol
description:
게임 정보
화이트 룸 프로토콜이란?
제시는 자신의 트라우마를 잊기 위해 자원했습니다. 그가 약해서가 아니라, 기억이 더 강했기 때문입니다.
White Room Protocol에서는 실험적인 기억 삭제 프로그램을 받는 피험자의 정신 세계에 들어갑니다. 살균된 흰 방에서 시작해, 제시의 가장 끔찍한 기억 — 그의 어린 시절 집 — 으로 안내됩니다. 그곳에서 끔찍한 일이 벌어졌습니다.
이것은 단순한 공포 게임이 아닙니다. 당신이 한때 안전하다고 생각했던 장소로의 심리적 추락입니다.
주요 특징
몰입감 있는 심리적 공포
손전등 기반의 탐험과 동적 조명
소름끼치는 사운드 디자인과 환경 서사
이야기와 연결된 가벼운 퍼즐
현실감 있는 1인칭 상호작용
당신은 과거를 지울 준비가 되었습니까 — 아니면 과거가 당신을 지울까요?

title: Graphic Tower Defense
description:
게임 정보


이 게임은 빛, 어둠, 불, 천둥, 얼음, 바람의 여섯 가지 기본 속성을 제공합니다. 플레이어는 이 속성들을 자유롭게 조합하여 방어 타워에 고유한 능력을 부여할 수 있습니다. 적절한 속성 조합을 통해 강력한 속성 결합 효과를 활성화하고, 궁극의 방어 시스템을 구축하여 각 타워가 최대의 위력을 발휘하도록 하세요!



최대 4명이 온라인에서 함께 협력하고, 팀원과 함께 방어 진형을 계획하고, 적의 맹렬한 공격에 맞서기 위해 협력할 수 있습니다. 자신만의 원소 매칭 전략을 조합하고, 서로의 장점을 보완하며, 몰려드는 적들을 물리치고, 팀워크의 즐거움을 경험하세요!



싱글 플레이어 캠페인에서는 각 레벨마다 독특한 적과 새로운 방어 타워가 등장합니다. 도전 과제를 완료하면 더욱 강력한 타워 디펜스 유닛을 점진적으로 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다. 캠페인 모드는 게임 운영에 익숙해지는 데 도움이 될 뿐만 아니라 원소 매칭의 핵심을 깊이 있게 익히고 더욱 어려운 전투에 대비할 수 있도록 도와줍니다!

title: Idle Guy: Life Simulator games
description:
게임 정보
Idle Guy: Life Simulator 게임은 모든 것이 가능한 모바일 애플리케이션, 생활 시뮬레이션 게임입니다! 실제 생활 시뮬레이터! 실제 비즈니스 시뮬레이터에서의 모험이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 생활 시뮬레이터의 세계에서 Rich Inc. 캠페인을 구축하세요! 모든 것이 가능한 무위도식의 생활 시뮬레이터!
거리의 가난한 남자에서 진정한 백만장자가 되세요! 진정한 오피스 타이쿤이 되세요! 부유하고 한가로운 생활에 합당함을 증명하세요! 억만장자의 부유하고 한가로운 생활을 선택하세요! 모든 것이 여러분의 손에 있습니다! 자신의 사업을 구축하세요. 자신의 비즈니스 제국을 만드세요! 비즈니스 세계의 황제가 되세요! 부유한 무위도식 오피스 타이쿤, Mr. Billion이 되세요! 이 게임은 거대한 비즈니스 제국의 오피스 거물과 억만장자의 부유한 생활을 시뮬레이션합니다!
집도 돈도 없는 실직자로서의 경력을 시작하세요. 우리 게임의 모바일 실제 생활 시뮬레이터에서 실제로 무위도식하고 부유한 생활을!
돈을 버는 첫 번째 방법을 찾고, 일자리를 얻고, 공부하고, 기업 사다리를 올라가고, 주식 시장에서 거래하고, 카지노에서 돈을 따고, 자동차와 집, 비행기를 사고, 필요한 모든 것을 하지만, 캐릭터가 노환으로 사망하기 전에 세계은행의 수장이 되세요.
생활 시뮬레이션:
😎 - 돈, 직업, 집이 없는 가난한 남자로서의 생활을 시작하고 개선하세요!
🌭 - 음식을 위한 돈을 찾으세요.
👕 - 옷을 사고 기숙사의 첫 방을 구입하세요.
🎓 - 대학에 등록하고 더 많이 벌기 위해 발전하세요.
💪 - 주식 시장에서 거래하세요.
🏢 - 회사 사다리를 올라가세요.
😍 - 여자친구를 찾아 가상 가족을 만드세요.
🏥 - 병원에 가는 것을 잊지 마세요, 캐릭터를 치료하고 휴양지로 데려가세요.
🎉 - 볼링을 하거나 당구를 치거나 콘서트에 참석하여 행복을 증가시키세요.
💲 - 자신의 사업을 시작하고 첫 백만을 벌어보세요.
💯 - 모든 도전을 극복하고 노환으로 죽지 않으면 세계은행의 수장이 되세요.
리얼 아이들 오피스 타이쿤은 게임처럼 돈을 관리합니다! 당신이 그 자격이 있다는 것을 증명하세요! 게으른 억만장자, 가난한 사람, 부자, 비즈니스 황제, 돈의 보스, 현금 마스터 - 우리 게임에서 당신이 될 사람을 선택하세요!
자신만의 성공 이야기를 만드세요! 선택하세요! 좋거나 나쁘거나? 가난한 남자나 부유한 남자? 은행을 털거나 비즈니스 제국을 만들까요? 선택하세요! 모험을 좋아하나요? 실제 생활 시뮬레이터를 좋아하나요? 자본가 거물이 되는 것을 좋아하나요? 우리 게임에서 모든 것이 가능합니다! 우리 비즈니스 무위도식 가족에 가입하세요!

title: Playomoji
description:
게임 정보
달리고, 점프하고, 구르세요.
이것은 파쿠르 게임입니다. 하지만 단순한 장애물 게임이 아닙니다. 친구들을 트롤하고, 넘어뜨리고, 앞서가세요.
최대 16인 온라인 멀티플레이.
친구들과 함께 하거나, 혼자 온라인 로비에 참여할 수 있어요. 언제나 혼돈과 경쟁이 가득합니다.
다양한 맵에서 플레이.
각 맵은 고유한 디자인과 장애물을 가지고 있어요. 게임의 흐름이 계속 바뀝니다.
다양한 꾸미기 아이템.
옷과 스타일로 캐릭터를 꾸며보세요. 게임을 통해 더 많은 아이템을 잠금 해제할 수 있어요.
간단한 규칙, 큰 재미.
목표는 명확합니다: 가장 빠르게 도달하거나 가장 웃기게 플레이하세요. 어떻게 즐길지는 당신에게 달렸어요.

title: Avalone's Adventurers: My Parents were Assassinated so I've Started an Adventuring Party to Avoid a Political Marriage
description:
게임 정보
마리안 아발론은 부모님의 모험 사업을 물려받았지만, 작은 문제가 있습니다... 모험에는 적합하지 않습니다!
모든 파티원 지원서를 정리하고, 최고의 인재를 영입하여 수익성 있는 퀘스트에 배정해야 할 때입니다. 마리안은 더글러스 나이트그레이브 공작의 아들과의 약혼을 취소하려면 금화를 엄청나게 벌어야 합니다!
어드벤처 오버타임
아발론의 모험은 끝이 없습니다! 매 플레이마다 새로운 경험을 선사하며, 플레이어에게 다양한 신규 멤버, 퀘스트, 그리고 이벤트를 선사합니다.
문서 정리
매일매일 서류가 쌓여만 갑니다. 하루가 끝나기 전에 모든 서류를 처리하는 것은 불가능해 보입니다.
오래된 보고서는 폐기하고, 유용한 문서는 보관하고, 책상 위에 비슷한 페이지들을 쌓아두면 모든 서류 작업을 정리하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
지원자 고용
아발론의 모험가들은 숙련된 모험가 파티 없이는 운영될 수 없습니다!
비용과 기술 요건을 충족하는 다양한 계층의 사람들을 충분히 고용하세요.
퀘스트 수락
모험 파티는 퀘스트를 받지 않는다면 사업이 될 수 없습니다.
마감일이 다가오면 최대한의 수익을 올리거나, 최소한 파티원들에게 충분한 골드를 지급하기 위해 가능한 가장 대담한 퀘스트를 수행해야 합니다!
골드 비축
마리안은 더글러스 나이트그레이브 공작의 아들과의 약혼을 취소하려면 엄청난 양의 골드가 필요합니다.
너무 늦기 전에 용을 당황하게 할 만큼 충분한 금화를 테이블에 쌓을 수 있을까요!?
약혼 취소
마리안은 부모님이 자신이 공작을 좋아하지 않고 그의 아들도 별로 좋아하지 않는다는 것을 알면서도 왜 나이트그레이브 공작의 아들과 약혼을 하게 되었는지 결코 알 수 없었습니다! 하지만 공작은 부모님의 서명이 있는 서류를 가지고 있었고, 약혼을 취소하려면 선불된 결혼 비용을 환불해 달라고 요구했습니다.
autokwd: Avalone's Adventurers: My Parents were Assassinated so I've Started an Adventuring Party to Avoid a Political Marriage

title: Courier Bay
description:
게임 정보
Courier Bay
Welcome to Courier Bay – a delivery simulator full of charm, heart, and a whole lot of cargo!
Step into the shoes of Leo, a new recruit at Bay Express, as you navigate a vibrant city filled with unique neighborhoods, unforgettable characters, and stories tucked between packages and delivery notes.
In this stylized low-poly game with a cozy atmosphere, you’ll face the daily grind of a delivery worker on the rise. Each day brings new routes, quirky clients, and choices that shape your journey toward becoming a partner at Bay Express—if you can survive the daily hustle.
Explore districts like Crystal Bay, with its lakeside mansions, or brave the industrial maze of Rustpoint. Uncover local dramas, urban mysteries, and unexpected friendships with residents like Seu Arlindo, the wise grocer full of sayings, and Elias Ramos, a former fisherman turned contemplative pier clerk.
Courier Bay is more than just delivering packages — it’s about meeting people, understanding places, and growing through the ordinary.
Key Features:
📦 Narrative delivery simulation with evolving daily missions.
🚚 Multiple vehicles, including trucks, vans, and jeeps, each with unique physics.
🏙️ A rich and varied city with over 100 buildings, including rural, industrial, and urban areas.
👥 NPCs with unique personalities and custom-crafted dialogue interactions.
🗺️ Top-down interactive map with free navigation between districts and landmarks.
It’s your first day on the job. The city is waiting.
Courier Bay — where every package has a story.

title: God Fishing
description:
게임 정보
Overview
God Fishing is an experimental idle fishing game with aspects of horror and a running narrative. You solve puzzles to find the right combinations of location and bait to find certain catches. After throwing your hook, you will have to wait for a varying amount of time. Catching a fish will reveal some dialogue which will help you understand the wider narrative.
Features part 1
7 different fish to catch
A minimalist pixel art style
A wide narrative
A small crafting system
Vibes
part 2
Will be released somewhere in the future as a free update to the current game

title: Conchiglia
description:
게임 정보
해변에서 조개 찾기
해변에서 휴가를 보내고 조개를 찾으러 갔는데 해변에 물건이 가득합니다.
개체와 상호 작용
해변 파라솔과 갑판 의자를 닫고, 선실 문을 열고, 조개를 가릴 수 있는 물체의 시야를 확보하는 데 필요한 모든 조치를 취하고, 일반적으로 해변의 모든 물건과 상호작용하세요.
조개를 찾아 해변을 탐험하세요

title: Hungry Meem
description:
게임 정보
어느 날, 여러분은 세계수 아래에 사는 먹성 좋은 생명체, ""밈""의 이야기를 담은 그림책을 발견합니다. 하지만 그 이야기는 너무나도 슬픈 결말로 끝나고 말았죠…
하지만 여러분에게는 그림책에 관여하여 ""밈""을 ""도와줄"" 능력이 있습니다. ""밈""과 함께 힘을 합쳐, 이야기의 결말을 해피 엔딩으로 이끌어 주세요!
밈을 도와주세요!
세계수 아래에 살며 살짝 먹성이 좋은 매력적인 생명체 ""밈"".
어느 날, 어떤 재료도 맛있게 조리할 수 있는 ""기적의 냄비""가 망가지면서, 밈은 멸망할 위기에 처하게 되고 말았습니다!
살아남은 밈을 ""도와주며"", 이번에야말로 밈이 사는 세상을 전보다 더욱 풍요롭게 만들어 가요!
밈의 생태
밈은 먹고, 놀고, 자는 것을 아주 많이 좋아하는 생명체입니다.
다양한 경험을 쌓아가다 보면 새로운 스킬을 배우거나, 외형이 변하기도 합니다. 교배를 통해 태어나는 밈의 종류도 무한하죠. 종족을 번영시키며 마음에 드는 밈을 찾아보세요!

title: Re:END
description:
게임 정보
Re:END is a laid-back, top-down, solo mode RPG, like the great MMOs of the good old days. Re:END is easy to operate, and has a deep system, including leveling up, reincarnation, pets, equipment upgrades, arenas, materials, and more.
Experience an RPG with all the elements that made the good old days (late 2000s) MMORPGs.
▼Leveling up and reincarnation
What would an MMO be without leveling up? Nothing beats the feeling of overcoming adversity, discovering new and better ways to earn experience points, and getting stronger with every level.
Allocate status points every time you level up, recalibrate, and reincarnate. Get stronger and develop your character to be who you are.
▼Collecting materials and upgrading weapons
Collect materials by defeating powerful monsters or fishing to improve your equipment. Fight more powerful monsters, face new challenges, and prepare for the next power spike.
▼Pets
All enemies, including bosses, can become your allies (some arena monsters cannot join). When you defeat an enemy, there is a small 0.3% chance that it will become your ally. The probability may be low, but the sense of accomplishment when it happens is exceptional!

title: Nia: Jewel Hunter
description:
게임 정보
Begin a thrilling journey through time with Nia, a brave young girl who finds herself transported to an ancient world filled with mysteries and dangers.
In this captivating platformer, you’ll venture into a past where myths and legends intertwine, guiding Nia on her quest to return home.
Trapped in this hostile world, Nia must navigate her way back by overcoming numerous trials, solving ancient puzzles, and dodging dangers at every turn. Explore mysterious ruins, uncover hidden artifacts, and tackle intricate mechanisms that can either be your salvation or doom.
Collect ancient artifacts, activate portals, and find the exit on each level to help Nia return to the modern world. Your wit, agility, and keen observation will be the keys to success in this remarkable adventure.
Key Features:
Atmospheric World: Explore a setting inspired by the ancient civilizations of Egypt and Greece.
Engaging Puzzles: Solve challenges rooted in myths and legends.
Exciting Levels: Conquer unique obstacles and trials.
Vibrant Graphics and Enchanting Music: Immerse yourself in the ancient world.

title: The Qubit Factory
description:
게임 정보
// New Employee Onboarding: Quantum Computing //
Below are classical bits, which all regular computers operate on. Boooooring!
                  Much more exciting are quantum bits (or qubits for short), which are not limited to simple {0,1} states. 
                  Qubits are so hot right now! They are the building blocks of newfangled quantum computers. As newly-minted employees of The Qubit Factory you will have the privilege of processing qubits in our state-of-the-art production lines. By harnessing the power of quantum entanglement and superpositions you will help up deliver exciting new computational products to our valued customers! 
// ---------------------------------------------------- //
The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game about building logic circuits to solve computational tasks, inspired by classic titles from developer Zachtronics. Based on authentic representations of quantum bits and components, The Qubit Factory features puzzles based on key concepts and algorithms from the field of quantum computing.
Open-Ended Puzzles - Factory employees are encouraged to design their own unique solutions to given tasks. Bonuses will be awarded to those meeting strict efficiency criteria. Convoluted and/or poorly-optimized solutions will be frowned upon.
Faithful Physics - Designed and programmed by a real (semi-successful) research scientist in the field of quantum computing: key concepts and algorithms from quantum computing are conveyed accurately, allowing players to build genuine knowledge about quantum computing!
Accessible- Core concepts are built slowly, with players encouraged to build foundational understanding in classical computing before progressing to quantum analogues. No prior computer/physics knowledge is assumed!

title: Quarter Lie
description:
게임 정보
A swindler exorcist loans a ticket for a long sea voyage, hoping to earn a living off of rich passengers. Everything goes smoothly until he discovers that the ship is actually haunted, and he can’t lie his way out anymore.
Forced to choose between your own well-being and the safety of the ship and its passengers, find a way to get the best outcome for everyone.
Features:
— A complex, intertwined narrative system
— 9 characters to con or befriend
— A hard limit on the amount of lies you can tell
— About 2 hours of playtime

title: EndSeeker
description:
게임 정보
You play Coal, a little black cat who wait his judgment at the Purgatory. He hears his dad's voice which beg to leave the place with him.
On your way, there are Guardians. Shapeless creatures which monitors this place. If they find you, you restart to your tomb where you wait your judgment.
This is an infiltration game with roguelite mechanic because each time the game launch, the placement of room changed.

title: Neither dead nor alive
description:
게임 정보
Neither Dead or Alive
Will You Break Free or Succumb to Darkness?
In Neither Dead or Alive, you awaken as a skeleton brought back to life by a young, overzealous necromancer. But something went wrong—you retained your will, your mind, and your burning desire for freedom. Trapped within the ominous castle of your creator, your journey to escape begins.
Along the way, you’ll encounter cryptic puzzles, treacherous traps, and a cast of otherworldly characters. Some, like mischievous demon, may aid your quest—or try to steal your soul. Others might tempt you with the ultimate choice: give up and embrace the dark power of the necromancer. Will you forge your own path to freedom, or let the castle claim you forever?
Key Features:
A Unique Undead Perspective: Play as a skeleton with free will, fighting to break free from a necromancer’s control.
Interactive Puzzles and Riddles Solving: Solve devious puzzles scattered throughout the castle to uncover hidden paths and secrets.
Morally Gray Choices: Will you resist the necromancer's pull, strike a deal with the demons, or surrender to the darkness?
Memorable Characters: Interact with a cast of quirky and sinister characters, each with their own agendas.
Why Play?
Neither Dead or Alive is a darkly charming mix of puzzle-solving, storytelling, humor, and moral dilemmas. With a hauntingly atmospheric setting, unique undead protagonist, and a story where every choice matters, this is a game for players who crave more than just another escape adventure.
Your Fate Awaits
Will you defy the necromancer, outwit the demon, and break free? Or will you succumb to the shadows within the castle walls? The choice is yours in Neither Dead or Alive.

title: 180 Seconds: A Firefighter's Call
description:
게임 정보
The alarm blares. Your heart races. In 180 seconds, lives will be changed forever - including yours. 
As a firefighter in this thrilling simulation arcade game, you're thrust into burning buildings with nothing but your wits, your equipment, and a ticking clock. Each environment - from maze-like office complexes to sprawling schools - is a puzzle of flame and smoke, waiting to be solved. But unlike traditional puzzles, the stakes here are life and death.
Your primary tool is a firehose with three tactical modes, each offering a different balance of power and precision. Will you use the focused stream to cut through to a specific hotspot, or switch to the wide spray to control a larger area? Every choice matters when the clock is ticking down from 180.
But "180 Seconds" isn't just about fighting fires. It's about the people caught in them. The game uses advanced AI to generate unique characters for each playthrough, complete with their own voices and backstories. The child you save in one run might be replaced by an elderly couple in the next, ensuring that no two games feel the same.
This unpredictability extends to the fires themselves. Using a proprietary system developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game simulates fires that react realistically to their environment and your actions. Manage oxygen levels carefully, or risk turning a smoldering room into a raging inferno with one wrong move.
Between missions, you'll return to the firehouse. Here, the game slows down, allowing you to explore, interact with fellow firefighters, and even care for the station's pet. But don't get too comfortable - the alarm can sound at any moment, catapulting you back into the action.
As you play, you'll find yourself improving. Response times that once seemed impossible become achievable. Rooms that were death traps become navigable. You'll start climbing the Steam Leaderboards, competing with firefighters around the world. But more importantly, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the real-life heroes who do this work every day.

title: Another Head
description:
게임 정보
It is with great pleasure that I present to you Another Head! The first game by Looting Dreams, created by Eric Sorrentino (yours truly). You’ll be transported to a small town in Colorado, Havenbrook, where you’ll control Tom as he faces one of the most intriguing events of late: there’s a new neighbor in town.
It’s hard to pin Another Head to a single genre. The story can take wildly different directions and tones depending on your choices.
No missions, live the story as the protagonist
Don’t expect senseless quests or triggers! The story progresses according to your decisions, whether you like it or not.
Feeling lost? Don’t worry—you can always consult the thoughts swirling around in Tom’s mind. Draw inspiration from his needs and ideas to navigate the game and make important decisions.
Meaningful dialogues
Interactions with people are key, so never miss a chance to chat with your neighbors. The choices you make during dialogues will always have weight. Think carefully about what to say, or you might regret it.
Multiple endings
Through different choices and actions, you can unlock up to 10 unique endings. If you manage to find them all, you can participate in the ultimate poll to decide which ending becomes the definitive one—good or bad!
A race against time
Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!
A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers
What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.
Developed in Italy, with love
I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.

title: Dungeon Grid
description:
게임 정보
Build the Weirdest, Deadliest Spellcaster Ever
You’re a wizard with a problem: monsters keep trying to turn you into a stain on the dungeon floor. The solution? Stick magic parts onto yourself until they become the stain.
Fight Hordes. Try Not to Die. Repeat.
Battle waves of enemies who probably deserve it. Outsmart them with clever positioning, overpower them with absurd builds, or just panic and attach every part you find.
Think Fast.
Just having a good Synergy isn't enough. You'll have to execute on it if you want to succeed.
Strategic Mayhem in Every Run
Every Playthrough and Synergy provides a new way of playing the game, creating unique situations and new game-breaking Combinations.

title: The Dance of Maple Leaves
description:
게임 정보
 단풍잎의 춤   RPG 즉시제 전투 양성 게임, 게이머는 망천 대륙에서 탐색을 진행할 것이며, 게임 중 레벨 장비 재료는 게이머가 몬스터에게서 획득해야 한다.
게임 방법 1: 초대형 주성 개방식 탐험 지도, 5대 던전 소지도, 던전 수령, 야외 BOSS, 야외 보물창고 등.
게임 2: 장비 속성 업그레이드 시스템, 모든 기초 속성은 최고 10 포인트 업그레이드 가능, 장비 감정 시스템, 모든 장비는 감정 가능, 등급은 우수, 우수, 우수, 서사시, 전설, 각 등급은 다른 추가 단어 속성에 대응, 최고 6 단어 속성을 얻을 수 있습니다.
게임 방법 3: 퀘스트 시스템, 유저를 안내, 유저를 선도, 더욱 좋은 돈과 아이템을 획득할 수 있습니다.
autokwd: The Dance of Maple Leaves,단풍잎의 춤

title: Happy Surprise Garden
description:
게임 정보
Dangers lurking everywhere
The seemingly peaceful and beautiful natural scenery may be ambushed by brutal alien creatures. Animals with cute appearance may have been infected and may suddenly attack when approached. You need to be ready with weapons to repel them at any time.
Strengthen skills
Collect resources during exploration and adventure. Once you have enough resources, you can synthesize weapons on the crafting table. Each weapon has different characteristics and skills. Whether in single-player or multiplayer mode, you can experience a full sense of freshness.

title: microFISHER
description:
게임 정보
          microFISHER is a cozy and relaxing fishing game where your ultimate goal is to collect every fish specimen. To achieve this, you must explore and discover various lakes, each home to a unique fish that your team is aiming for. The fishing system is simple yet engaging, featuring a timing-based mechanic. A bar spins around a circle, and you must carefully time your catch by hitting the bar when it turns blue. While easy to learn, this mechanic can become a fun and rewarding challenge as you chase after bigger fish.
                      To become the best fisherman, you will need to venture across different islands in search of essential upgrades. The toolbox upgrade allows you to cast your fishing line farther, giving you access to bigger and much-wanted fish. Meanwhile, finding bucket upgrades increases the number of fish that you can carry, allowing for longer and more productive fishing sessions.

title: Patient Zero Pandemiс Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Can you destroy humanity?

title: Solitaire Zero 21
description:
게임 정보
Card game fit for all the family! The aim of the game is to clear the playing area of all cards whilst keeping your deck score between 0 and 21. If you hit 0 or below, or hit 21 or above, it is game over.
Gameplay
The player selects one of the top cards showing an addition or subtraction sum. This adds that card to their pile, applying the maths operation to their current score. The objective of the game is to stay within the range 1 - 20. If the sum falls to zero or hits 21, the game is over.
Only the top items of each pile are visible, so the player needs to operate some strategic thinking in order to ensure they don’t “go bust”.
Additional “wild” cards sometimes appear which has the ability for the player to alter their current score to help them (e.g. ‘MIN’ reduces their score to 1, ‘MAX’ increases their score to 20).
When a player clears all the cards successfully without hitting 0 or 21 they win some diamonds.
If a player fails, they can use their diamonds to try again where they left off.
Player Control
The game is controlled using either the Mouse or a DualSense / Xbox controller, to select the available cards with the thumb sticks to move a highlight around the screen, using A/X and B/O to select/deselect items as needed.
Progression & Challenge
The player works their way through the campaign, starting with Level 1. The difficulty increases as they progress.
A player can also collect the diamonds to customise the pack theme.
The game also features a Daily Challenge. In this game, all cards are laid on the table, with the player briefly able to see what they’re playing with. Then the cards turn over, and the player must select them one by one.
Achievements
The game features Steam Achievements as the user progresses through the game.

The Demons Told Me to Make This Game is a Time Loop game and a cosmic horror narrative adventure about demons, monsters, evil cults, bloody rituals, and Elder Gods.

기지를 짓고 강화하세요. 벽, 함정, 자동 방어 시스템을 설치하세요. 발전기와 외계 연료 전지를 사용해 시스템에 전력을 공급하세요. 매일 밤 또는 무작위 이벤트 때 포식자들이 공격합니다. 그들은 방어를 시험하고 약점을 파악하며 시간이 지날수록 강해집니다.

주요 게임 메커니즘:

기지 건설: 구조적 안정성과 업그레이드 단계를 가진 모듈식 건설 시스템.

방어 및 전투: 함정, 터렛, 무기를 배치하여 포식자 무리를 방어.

제작 시스템: 자원을 모아 도구, 무기, 탄약, 방어구, 업그레이드를 만듦.

에너지 및 시스템: 방어 시설, 문, 조명을 작동시키기 위한 에너지 관리.

적 AI: 벨로시랩터는 스토킹, 매복, 협동 공격을 함. 일부는 진화하거나 돌연변이.

생존 루프: 식사, 치료, 장비 유지 관리. 매일 요새를 강화하고 밤을 준비.

게임 정보
Donut Shop Simulator에서는 단순한 계산원 역할을 넘어, 나만의 가게를 운영하는 모든 세부 사항을 체험할 수 있습니다. 주문을 받을 때 고객의 니즈를 즉각적으로 파악하고, 현금 또는 신용카드 거래를 통해 재정을 능숙하게 관리하세요. 상품 진열대 정리, 재고 부족 파악, 그리고 배송이 제때 정확하게 이루어지도록 하는 등 모든 단계에서 전략적 결정을 내려야 합니다.
올바른 제품 조합을 선택하고 이윤을 극대화하여 가장 수익성 있는 방식으로 주문을 승인하세요. 고객의 요청에 신속하게 대응하여 만족도를 높이고, 작은 가게를 지역 내 가장 인기 있는 디저트 명소로 탈바꿈시키세요. 게임의 깊이 있는 시뮬레이션은 경영 능력을 향상시킬 기회를 제공할 뿐만 아니라, 빠른 사고, 계획 수립 및 전략 구상 능력을 시험합니다.
가게 간판부터 인테리어, 심지어 배송 트럭까지 모든 세부 사항을 자유롭게 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다. 원하는 색상, 스타일, 문구를 사용해 가게를 독특하게 만들어보세요. 모든 디테일이 가게의 이야기와 정신을 반영하도록 정성스럽게 디자인되었습니다.
즐겁고 몰입감 있는 이 시뮬레이션 경험을 통해, 당신이 직접 자신의 사업을 운영할 준비를 하세요!
도넛을 직접 만들어 보세요
계산원 고용

title: Recharge
description:
게임 정보
Recharge는 아케이드의 재미와 시뮬레이션에 영감을 받은 조작감을 결합한 진정한 심-케이드 RC 레이싱 게임입니다. 사실적인 물리 엔진, 인상적인 그래픽, 그리고 다양한 커스터마이징 옵션을 통해 전에 없던 RC 레이싱 경험을 제공합니다. 전문 RC 서킷부터 해변, 놀이공원, 스케이트파크 등 현실 세계에서 영감을 받은 다양한 트랙에서 혼자 또는 친구들과 함께 레이싱을 즐겨보세요. RC 스타일 컨트롤러와 게임패드를 포함한 폭넓은 컨트롤러 지원으로, Recharge는 생생하고 몰입감 있는 RC 레이싱을 선사합니다.

title: Regista: Reign Your Football Club
description:
게임 정보
권력의 게임
당신의 사무실은 UEFA챔피언스리그보다도 더 치열합니다. 팬들의 찬사와 야유, 이사진의 날카로운 시선, 네 가지 주요 지표는 언제 터질지 모르는 시한폭탄과 같습니다. 조금만 실수해도 모든 것이 무너질 수 있습니다. 이 소용돌이 속에서 당신이 팀을 정상으로 이끌 수 있을지, 아니면 경쟁자들에게 철저히 무너질지… 그 모든 건 당신의 선택에 달려 있습니다!
무명에서 명문으로
이름조차 생소한 하위 리그 팀에서 시작해, 세계를 호령하는 명문 클럽으로 성장하는 여정. 그 과정에서 마주할 시련과 도전은 오직 당신만이 감당할 수 있습니다. 때로는 단기 이익을 포기하는 용기가 더 멀리 나아가는 원동력이 됩니다.
카드의 귀재
당신 앞에는 수많은 모험과 미지의 선택이 기다리고 있습니다. 하지만 다채로운 카드들이 든든한 무기가 되어줄 것입니다. 전략적인 카드 구성과 타이밍, 그리고 올바른 판단을 통해 주도권을 쥐어라. 모험을 감행할지, 장기적인 안목으로 안정적인 길을 택할지… 모든 결정은 당신의 몫입니다.
autokwd: Regista: Reign Your Football Club,축구장의 대부

title: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants
description:
게임 정보
"The Maze Survivor:First Entrants" is the prologue to "The Maze Survivor:The 9th Entrants"
It is a limited space survival game that uniquely combines the characteristics of survival, horror, puzzle solving and maze adventure games.
You will play the role of the first batch of entrants into the maze. Compared with the ninth batch of entrants, you have fewer clues and more pressure to survive.
You will wake up in a wild jungle without any clues. Through the gaps in the leaves, they could see that they were surrounded by high walls. The walls open at dawn and close at night.
You must try your best to collect enough supplies and establish their own stronghold in this relatively safe forest. When you are fully prepared, enter the maze full of unknown dangers, collect more important materials, solve complex puzzles, make marks, and try to extend your footprint as far as possible.
autokwd: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants,언캐니 미궁: 9번째 참가자
company: 崔资坦独立游戏工作室

title: Trade Rivals - Goblin Age
description:
게임 정보

전설적인 중세 상인의 역할을 맡아보세요!
Trade Rivals - Goblin Age에서 고블린, 마법사, 엘프, 인간이 사는 생동감 넘치는 세계에서 중세 상점을 운영하게 됩니다. 목표는 무엇일까요? 가격 전략을 완벽히 익히고 희귀 상품을 확보하며 경쟁자를 능가하여 시장을 장악하는 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요—경쟁자들은 공정하게 게임하지 않을 것입니다. 당신의 상점을 저주하거나 눈앞에서 거래를 가로챌 수도 있습니다!
autokwd: Trade Rivals - Goblin Age,무역 라이벌 - 고블린 시대

title: Auridia
description:
게임 정보
Auridia is a metroidvania about platforming, secrets, and lore.
You’ll like Auridia if…
You love fluid movement, like swinging from a grappling hook or bouncing off of spikes
You like platforming where you need to chain together moves
You look for secrets in every corner
You're intrigued by what's out-of-reach, and look forward to revisiting areas
You like reading about ancient societies, strange gods, and the pursuit of the unknown
You might not like Auridia if…
You’re looking for combat — there is almost none
You want a longer game — Auridia can be completed in 3-6 hours
You like cutscenes and exposition — Auridia's story is told through artifacts, and you will need to piece together their meaning
You prefer a clear objective at all times. You may get lost in Auridia, and you will need to explore, read through your journal, and look at your map to find the way forward.
Explore a branching world

title: 我在地府打麻将 - Demonic Mahjong
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to join our game discord community:
Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!
autokwd: 我在地府打麻将 - Demonic Mahjong

title: FISHTOPIA
description:
게임 정보
픽셀 아트로 구현된 FISHTOPIA 세계에서는 오프라인 상태에서도 계속 성장하는 신비한 생물들을 쉽게 키울 수 있습니다. 각양각색의 심해 생물들을 만나며 컬렉션 도감을 하나씩 채워가세요. 다양한 스타일의 장식품을 마음대로 조합하여 나만의 화려한 수중 세계를 만들 수 있습니다. 자세히 살펴보면, 심해에 숨겨진 비밀을 발견할지도 모릅니다.
정교한 픽셀 아트
현대적 감각의 레트로 CRT 픽셀 아트로 구현된 독특한 미학
여러 테마의 배경과 장식품을 자유롭게 조합 가능
동적 배경화면 지원: FISHTOPIA 가 언제나 함께합니다

title: Secret Paws - Cozy Offices
description:
게임 정보
Secret Paws - Cozy Offices는 3D 숨은그림찾기 게임으로, 아늑한 사무실에 숨겨진 고양이를 찾는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.

서랍과 캐비닛을 열고 물건을 움직여 가장 예상치 못한 숨겨진 장소를 발견하세요. 사무실의 모든 구석에는 놀라움과 도전이 가득하며, 세밀하게 설계된 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다.
특징
혁신적인 3D 숨은그림찾기: 클래식 탐험 메커니즘과 아이소메트릭 3D 환경을 결합한 혁신적인 게임. 🚀
거의 500마리의 숨겨진 고양이: 모든 색상, 크기 및 성격의 고양이를 찾아보세요. 😺
비밀 고양이: 독특한 숨겨진 장소에서 특별한 고양이를 발견하세요. 💡
세부적인 상호작용: 가구를 열고, 물건을 움직이고, 환경과 상호작용하세요. 😻

title: Log Away
description:
게임 정보
Immerse into Log Away, a cozy sandbox-building game. Build, furnish, and decorate your dream cabin in breathtaking landscapes, from coastal shores to mountain peaks, surrounded by wildlife and beloved pets. Enjoy peaceful solitude to rekindle your inner self.
Unleash your creativity with boundless freedom. Design your cabin and its surroundings with over 500 items, from rustic furniture to charming decor, without time or resource limits. Choose your interests, like fishing or painting, to unlock:
items tailored to your interests, such as special bookcases, chairs, or garden decorations
travel bags with surprise items, which when unpacked, add personal touches to your dream cabin

title: Tree Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Oh Roots and Branches! Your Kingdom needs help!
Welcome to Tree Kingdoms, a bite sized 4x strategy game and a surprisingly deep battle for survival. You are the Great Tree Spirit of a cosy woodland kingdom, but winter is coming and resources are scarce. You must secure the forest from rivals before the frost sets in. Can you outwit your foes and prove yourself a strategic master?

Strategic Turn-based action!


Explore the map, claim territory and upgrade your cities! Build an Empire that can stand up to your rivals and see your treelings through the harsh winter. Will you fortify or will you focus on conquest?

Race against the seasons to secure your victory in this Bite Sized 4x!
Winter freezes the map over time, pushing your strategic thinking and forcing you to adapt. Upgrading your cities and gathering new units might be your path to salvation, sometimes surviving is better than fighting. Your Treelings will rely on you to make the right choice. Do you build tall and gather resources? Or do you walk the path of the warlord? It’s all up to you.
The Clock is ticking...

title: ReCharge RC: High Voltage
description:
게임 정보
Customize your vehicle, Create your very own race tracks, Share them online and race your friends best times with global online leaderboards. Created by an RC enthusiast, for RC enthusiasts! High speeds, huge jumps, big drifts, ReCharge RC: High Voltage is a racing game unlike anything youve ever played before!
From the creator of the hit indie racer played by millions: ReCharge RC! With a community-driven development approach, get involved and lets make the best RC game ever!
Featuring:
A fun and rewarding sim-cade handling model
that blurs the line between arcade and simulation. Inspired by real life RC but tuned to be an absolute blast to pick up and play. Noobs, racing game fans, RC enthusiasts, and pro racers alike will enjoy the intuitive arcade handling with just enough sim based elements to make those coming from real life RC feel right at home and provide intense competition. With accurately modeled suspension geometry and vehicle mechanics like air control and a detailed damage engine that allows for broken steering links and shocks leading to floppy a-arms, scratched up bodies, parts flying off and more, ReCharge RC brings all the fun of real life RC to your screen!

title: CrafTAE
description:
게임 정보
Stack cards 🃏 to collect food, craft equipment, build structures and defeat the dungeon ⚔️ in this village builder roguelite. Discover new cards, gather new resources and craft new recipes every run! Combine, survive and thrive!
Features ⭐
• 🃏 300+ cards to discover
• 🌳 10 biomes to unlock & explore
• 👿 9 dungeons & 3 difficulties to defeat
• ⚔️ 50+ enemies to fight
Explore biomes 🌳
Biome cards are the main source of resources each run. To start a new run you need to select which biomes you want to use. Explore them to find unique resources and customize your build the way you want!
Craft new resources 🔨
Use your cards to craft all kinds of new resources, equipment and structures to help you settle your people.

title: Radio Ghosts
description:
게임 정보
Radio Ghosts is a narrative game about geometry tests, vampire baristas, and camping with your mom. It was created for and playable on the original Nintendo Game Boy, but through super-spooky frequencies is brought here to modern gaming machines.
Features:
High-quality pixel graphics that only an original 160 x 144 resolution can provide
Genuine simulated four-way D-pad movement
Highly efficient single-button interaction using the Z key
(Seriously, though, the game also supports common controllers)
Four shades of green
Genuinely awesome original four-channel Game Boy soundtrack
All the snark from a fifteen-year-old girl that you can handle
Gameplay:
Meet interesting people and irritate them, including:
Your mom
A radio ghost
A vampire barista
A haughty wizardess
A touchy goblin
A cold and calculating cat
Paul
Top-down super-fun non-Euclidean cartographic action
Petty theft
Marine biology
Crushing reality
The experience:
60-90 minutes of playtime
Controls: arrow keys + Z key to interact; Xbox and PS4 / PS5 controllers also supported

title: Mall Simulator 2025: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
프롤로그를 통해 Mall Simulator 2025의 엔트리 레벨 콘텐츠와 기능을 체험해 보실 수 있습니다. 위시리스트에 추가하는 것을 잊지 마시고 정식 버전이 출시되면 저희를 팔로우하세요.
몰 시뮬레이터는 여러분이 직접 운영하는 다양한 상점이 있는 대형 쇼핑몰의 재벌이 되는 경험을 할 수 있는 편안한 1인칭 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
디자인은 중요합니다! 최고의 쇼핑몰 디자인을 만들고 상점을 관리하세요. 베스트셀러 상점을 전시하고 고객을 위한 완벽한 쇼핑몰을 만드세요.

title: The Hatchling
description:
게임 정보
The Hatchling
Locked in a dystopian lab, a strange egg stirs. Its temperature, humidity, and nutrients must be maintained with precision. Its integrity is fragile. And you must not fail.
The Overseer watches—cold, unwavering, and silent in its judgment. You are but one of many caretakers before you, each evaluated, each replaced. Failure is not an option.
A Game of Dread and Precision
This low-bit horror simulation demands absolute efficiency:
✔ Regulate temperature, humidity, and nutrients—maintain the egg’s delicate balance.
✔ Acquire and ration lab supplies through the Supply Shaft—resources are limited.
✔ Combat system malfunctions—power surges, failing dispensers, will test you.
✔ Endure the Overseer’s relentless judgment—its criteria are unknown, its patience is not infinite.
✔ Uncover the hidden purpose of the lab—and your own existence.
A Test Hard to Pass
As you carry out your task, something deeper stirs within the facility. The unseen presence behind the Overseer grows aware of you. A voice—distorted, ancient—seeps into the system. Is it watching through the Overseer? Or has it always been there?

title: Circular Fallacy
description:
게임 정보
This is a puzzle game that seamlessly blends 2D card mechanics with 3D scene transitions, offering a unique perspective-shifting gameplay experience. In this game, you will gather clues from immersive 3D environments and apply them to solve puzzles on a 2D card table. Meanwhile, your actions on the card table can also influence changes in the 3D world. Uncover related clues and piece together the unfolding story.

title: Dungeon Weiqi
description:
게임 정보
Dungeon Weiqi is a pixel-art roguelike card game primarily inspired by the ancient game of Weiqi.
Weiqi Style Card Combat
Deploy cards using Crystals that regenerate automatically each turn.
Once placed on the chessboard, cards autonomously attack adjacent enemies at round's end.
Try to occupy advantageous positions and surround the enemy to create more advantages!
Your Lord enters battle as a card. Will you use the lord's powerful abilities to charge forward, or protect them in the rear and seek victory? The choice is yours!
Diverse Factions & Card Types
Players can choose from multiple factions. You can collect unique cards, and form the most suitable deck to fight!
There are three types of cards for both the enemy and us: Warrior Cards | Skill Cards | Structure Cards.
Master their synergies to overturn desperate situations!
Enemies also possess unique cards and combat styles. Be careful to deal with them and familiarize yourself with their combat styles and weaknesses. Then victory is yours!
Explore the Map Freely
Avoiding strong enemies or engaging in direct combat? The decision is entirely yours! You can freely plan your path, choose the order of battle with enemies, or even completely ignore them (if you are willing to give up the treasure they are guarding).
Be careful with your supplies. Every step further will cost your food. If the food runs out, you will be at a huge disadvantage and even lose the entire game! Plan your path carefully to avoid the worst-case situation.

title: INVERTA
description:
게임 정보
Inverta is a thrilling 2.5D puzzle-platformer where you defy gravity in a haunting post-apocalyptic world! Take control of gravity itself—flip between surfaces, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets of a war-torn land. With innovative mechanics, atmospheric storytelling, and challenging gameplay, Inverta offers a unique adventure for fans of indie games, physics-based puzzles, and immersive platformers. Can you escape the ruins of a shattered world? Master gravity, conquer obstacles, and unravel the mystery!
company: Rahul Vyas, Sushil Joshi, Aditya Chaki

title: The Horde Wants You Dead
description:
게임 정보
THE HORDE WANTS YOU DEAD is a chaotic shoot'em up where you and your squad must survive against hundreds and thousands of angry and fearless enemies.
Keep your bullets flying, throw grenades at large groups, roll away from danger. Learn and adapt to different enemies. Use all the tools at your disposal to match their quickly overwhelming numbers.

title: Bow Course - Archery Golf
description:
게임 정보
Nock your arrow and challenge your friends in archery golf!
Master realistic arrow physics and challenge your friends for a round in beautiful and challenging 9 target courses. Gain a competitive edge with skillful usage of different arrows, avoid obstacles and utilize shortcuts. The player with the least amount of shots wins!
Main Features
Play solo or challenge your friends in multiplayer
Realistic bow handling & arrow physics
Versatile courses - Each 9 target course offers several routes and shortcuts that players can tactically use with different arrows
Fun and challenging gameplay — Easy to pick up but offers depth to master
Practice at the shooting range in the main hub area
Customizable difficulty - choose starting point, wind conditions & more
Play comfortably with teleport, smooth locomotion and other settings

title: Paddle Paddle Paddle
description:
게임 정보
Swing your paddles and overcome the loooooong parcour. In "Paddle Paddle Paddle" you have to paddle (who would have expected...), avoid obstacles and just don't fall into the lava... At the end of the hard and rocky path an incredible prize awaits you (maybe).

You can play the game alone or with a friend. Here you either control both paddles or share control with your game partner. Frustration and mistakes are inevitable here!

Features:
-> Physics-based paddling like in real life (I think)
-> High frustration factor when falling down (friendships could suffer)
-> Local and Online Coop is possible
-> Speedrun timer in the game
-> One giant level with different biomes
-> Input Rebinding option in the Settings
-> Checkpoints can be activated in the Settings
-> Different Paddle-Type (Realistic or Arcade) in the Settings
Information about the development:
My name is Mateo and I am the 22 year old solo developer of the game. The idea for "Paddle Paddle Paddle" came to me while I was taking a shower and I wanted to mix an only-up like parkour with a physics-based paddle boat mechanic. The whole video game was a little experiment and will be developed and released within a month. I hope you still have fun (and hopefully not too much frustration) with the game.

title: Demon Hunt
description:
게임 정보


"Demon Hunt는 3D 탑다운 중간 속도의 자동 슈터로 로그라이트 요소를 포함한 게임입니다.
포스트 아포칼립스의 사이언스 픽션 판타지 세계를 배경으로, 생존을 위해 끊임없는 악마의 무리와 강렬한 보스 전투에 맞서 싸우게 됩니다."

-적을 처치하고 경험치를 모아 레벨 업하며 스킬 포인트를 얻으세요.
-스킬 포인트를 사용하여 무기를 업그레이드하거나 새로운 무기와 유물을 획득하세요.
-독특한 능력 분기를 통해 무기를 진화시키고 더 강력한 형태를 잠금 해제하세요.
-매 5분마다 보스 전투에 참여하고 30분 경과 후 최종 악마 보스를 처치하여 승리하세요.
-사냥 후 기지에서 자원을 사용해 오브를 잠금 해제하여 영구적인 능력을 얻으세요.
-죽은 적에게서 아이템을 약탈하고 장착하여 영구적인 스탯 업그레이드를 얻으세요.
-기지에서 아이템을 재활용, 구매 및 제작하세요.
-새로운 메카 클래스를 잠금 해제하고, 그들의 재능 트리를 통해 발전시키며 다양한 빌드를 시도해 보세요.

title: Cloudtop Chaos
description:
게임 정보
In this wholesome community-focused bonanza, you’re tasked with restoring color to the sky island of Cloudtopia! The first and only order of business will be to drum up as much chaos as you can!
You’ll achieve this by generating magic from the joyful variety of infinitely-replayable puzzle games.
Luckily, as always, you'll have a squad of loyal friends to help spice things up!

title: Super Loco World - Cozy Train Automation
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Super Loco World! As the freshly-minted transport tycoon around these parts, you’ll need to build up a rail network, manage train traffic, and keep the goods flowing to meet the growing demands of an ever-evolving world!
Embrace automation🚦
Your trains need more than just a route from you! Control their speeds carefully, manage rail junctions, and eventually automate the process using some very handy rail signals, including: 
Signposts to direct trains carrying different goods in different directions. 
Logic-based stop signs to help you manage congested areas. 
Traffic lights to control the flow of trains into stations.
autokwd: Super Loco World - Cozy Train Automation

title: Night Lotus
description:
게임 정보
A multiplayer first-person game with elements of social deduction (inspired by the board game "Mafia"). Here, you must uncover who among you is the secret killer.
Goal:
Win depending on your role by fulfilling your victory conditions.
Gameplay
Before the game begins, each player is randomly assigned one of three roles:
Monk – Peaceful and unwilling to harm anyone, but in desperate situations is ready to use force for the greater good—provided they have something to fight back with. A large-caliber revolver should do the trick.
Magistrate – Their goal is to secretly protect the monks. Fortunately, they have the means to do so. Just make sure no one finds out what's hidden under your cloak, or the protector might become the next victim.
Lotus – A secret killer disguised as a monk. Their words can deceive you, leading to decisions that may cost you dearly.
Game Process
Monks, accompanied by the Magistrate, must collect Buddha Statues to win. Of course, finding them won’t be easy—teamwork is essential. And trust me, the Lotus won’t let that happen without a fight.
Along the way, you may find potions that increase your chances of victory. Drinking them may restore your health, help you survive an attack, let you see items through obstacles, or even reveal the identity of the person in front of you.
In this game, no one can be trusted. Victory comes through cunning, teamwork, or cold steel!

title: Diner Bros 2
description:
게임 정보
정신없이 바쁜 주방 액션
요리 실력을 시험해 볼 준비가 되셨나요? 빠르고 재밌고 정신없는 Diner Bros 2에서 북적거리는 레스토랑을 열어보세요. 주문을 처리하고, 맛있는 음식을 만들고, 최대한 빨리 서빙하여 배고픈 손님들을 만족시켜 주세요!
손님을 파악하세요
Diner Bros 2에는 쏟아지는 주문만 있는 것이 아니랍니다. 특별한 손님들 때문에 긴장의 끈을 놓을 수가 없어요! 고유한 특성과 요구 사항을 가지고 있는 캐릭터들은멀티태스킹능력을한계까지밀어붙이죠.
점유 금지! 청소년은 하루 종일 앉아 있어도 괜찮다고 생각해요!
잠시도 가만히 있지 않는 조거는 음식이 빨리 나오길 원해요. 아주 빨리요!
음식만 먹고 몰래 도망칠 기회를 노리는 불량 청소년을 조심하세요!
어린이는 닭 다리만 먹어요. 골치 아프죠!
이게 다가 아니랍니다. 주문의 흐름을 유지하는 건 당신에게 달려 있죠!
레스토랑을 업그레이드하세요
새 주방기기를 구매하세요. 식당이 커지면서 늘어나는 수요를 충족하려면 더 좋은 도구가 필요해요.
주방 배치를 최적화하세요. 돈을 버는 데 있어서 가장 중요한 것은 효율성이죠. 주방이 원활하게 돌아가도록 배치되었는지 확인하세요. 그냥 놔둬도 상관없고요!
레스토랑을 확장하세요. 음식 평론가를 감동시키고 탐나는 3스타 상을 받을 자신 있으신가요?
직원이 더 필요한가요? 친구를 고용하세요!
Diner Bros 2에서는 혼자서 모든 일을 감당하지 않아도 된답니다. 종업원을 고용하여 부담을 덜거나, 4인 로컬 협동 캠페인에서 친구를 혼돈 속으로 초대하세요!

title: Elestrals Clash!
description:
게임 정보
Elestrals Clash! reimagines the strategic battles of the Elestrals Trading Card Game (TCG) in a dynamic digital format, offering a cross-platform experience accessible on both desktop and mobile. Whether you’re a seasoned Caster or new to the adventure, this immersive, lore-rich game offers everything you need to compete for supremacy in the mythical world of Elestrals.
Explore a realm where the elemental forces of Earth, Fire, Water, Thunder, Wind, Frost, Solar, and Lunar collide in a battle for dominance. Each Caster will unlock, collect, and strategically deploy their enchanted creatures, known as Elestrals, to rise through the ranks and Ascend to Immortality. With a seamless, fully automated experience, players can now wield their decks anytime, anywhere, whether at home or on the go.
Game Modes and Features
Cross-Platform Gameplay: Enjoy Elestrals Clash! on both desktop and mobile devices with full account synchronization, so you never miss a beat, no matter where you are.
Every Type for Every Player: No matter what element you prefer to Clash with, Casters will immediately have free access to every available card in the game!
Casual Play: Test your skills in both fun and competitive environments.
____________________________________________________
Join the Ascent to Immortality — wishlist Elestrals Clash! on Steam now to unlock new horizons and be part of the future of strategic card gaming. Keep an eye out for updates on special events, content drops, and exclusive in-game rewards as we gear up for the official release!
[Recommended for the following players]
TCG players
Elestrals players
Players who enjoy competitive gameplay

title: Demigoddess!
description:
게임 정보
Demigoddess! is a unique game that focuses on the essentials of turn-based strategy games. It is designed so that each gameplay can be won or lost in approximately 1 hour.
Random map generation system -- The terrain, shape of the continents, type of enemy forces, force placement, and number of resources change every time you start the game.
You can control over 350 types of soldiers and monsters, 20 unique factions, and use over 300 types of equipment items.
Various items and magic can strengthen your soldiers as you like.
You will enjoy playing this game over and over again!
-- Victory Conditions --
The world called "The Continent" is divided into 64 areas, and you will win if you can conquer more than 32 of them.
We have eliminated the cumbersome work that are common in strategy games, such as "finding unpainted areas on the map and filling them in one by one" after the victory is confirmed in the second half, so that you can enjoy the most exciting time when the enemy and friendly forces are in balance for a long time.

title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
description:
게임 정보
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family. Parallel to the worldwide cinema release of GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE, the popular Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda are celebrating their video game debut! Climb into the cockpit with the two heroes of the film GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE and six other colourful characters. Fans of the film and the Europa-Park are looking forward to a reunion!
The races will take you to well-known locations across Europe. Whether it's a Free Race, Point Chase, Time Trial or the Grand Prix - there are plenty of opportunities to put your driving skills to the test! And you'll need skill, because Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is really fast thanks to different boost techniques!
Each character not only has their own vehicle, but also individual strengths and weaknesses. So every race feels different - depending on who you send onto the track.
But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions isn't just fun to play alone: in local multiplayer for up to four people, you can experience exciting races together and create unforgettable moments - because Ed & Edda is all about sharing the fun!
 Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:
 Fast-paced races: On fast tracks, around famous attractions from all over Europe, provide variety!
Fast on the road: Various boost techniques ensure very high speed!
Eight playable characters: including Ed & Edda, the famous Europa-Park mascots!
Many possibilities: Unique racers, clever power-ups and customisable vehicles ensure variety and fun!
Multiplayer: Up to four drivers can race at the same time - perfect for families and friends!
autokwd: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions

title: Stranded In Starlight
description:
게임 정보
While traveling through hyperspace, your ship's drive field suddenly fails. Moments later, a relentless alien force attacks, determined to ensure your journey ends here. Now, Stranded In Starlight, survival is your only option.
Features
Fast gameplay sessions (under 30 minutes)
Many different weapons and utilities
Bosses
Survive hordes of enemies that grow larger and stronger as time passes
Gain experience and upgrade your ship
Between runs you can permanently upgrade your ship and unlock new abilities

title: Kingdom Ascension
description:
게임 정보
중세 시대를 배경으로 한 전략 전쟁 게임입니다. 영주가 되어 처음부터 자신의 영토를 건설하세요. 자원 수집, 건물 건설, 병력 모집, 탐험 및 모험을 통해 영토를 확장하고 조국을 방어하세요.



황량한 기지에서 시작하여 식량과 재료와 같은 핵심 자원을 수집하세요. 자원이 부족한 경우, 병력 훈련, 건물 업그레이드, 기술 연구 및 개발에 자원을 신중하게 배분하여 발전의 기반을 다져야 합니다.

title: Cubic Cosmos
description:
게임 정보
The goddess of vanity has issued you a dangerous challenge. Win, and you rescue your imprisoned companions; lose, and you are stripped of your humanity to become a plaything in her hands. Life and liberty are at stake—will you beat her at her own game?
Cubic Cosmos brings you a unique roguelike deckbuilding experience, where tower-defense gameplay and fast-paced, hard-hitting card battles collide to create unparalleled strategic depth.
Fight Fate With Every Choice
Choose to wage war or explore random events—every step could change your destiny.
200+ cards with dozens of possible strategic combinations.
50+ relics, each one crucial to your deckbuilding strategy.
50+ random events.
Complete runs to unlock various heroes with unique strategic abilities.
Build an Unbeatable Deck
Pair relics with cards to enjoy deep strategic deckbuilding gameplay.
Dozens of Strategic Combinations: Focus on powerful pawns, deadly sorceries, or mysterious relics. Shield your pawns from harm, or let their death strengthen your forces... the possibilities are endless!

title: You Are The Code
description:
게임 정보


버그가 코드를 잠식하는 프로그래밍 퍼즐 게임! 한 가지 문제: 타이핑을 할 수 없습니다. 기존 코드 라인을 탐색하고 실행하여 출력이 목표와 일치하도록 만드세요!
You Are The Code의 각 레벨은 미리 작성된 코드로 구성됩니다. 원하는 출력과 일치시키기 위해 실행할 라인을 선택할 수 있습니다. 라인을 위아래로 이동할 때마다 버그가 진행되어 코드를 지우려고 합니다! 어떤 경우에는 그다지 나쁘지 않을 수도 있습니다...
GMTK 2023 게임 잼 6700개 출품작 중 상위 2%에 선정되었습니다!
특징:
100개 레벨
이해하기 쉬운 사용자 지정 프로그래밍 언어, 사전 프로그래밍 지식 필요 없음
이동 취소
시간 기반 퍼즐 없음, 움직이지 않으면 아무 일도 일어나지 않음

title: Ghost Pub
description:
게임 정보
GhostPub은 로그라이크 기반의 타이쿤 게임입니다.
유령 선술집의 주인이 되어 성공적인 창업을 이루어보세요!

title: Fischer's Fishing Journey
description:
게임 정보


《냐옹이 낚시 일기》에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 귀여운 고양이 피셔를 데스크톱에 배치하고, 그를 최고의 공부 및 업무 파트너로 삼아보세요. 게임을 데스크톱 배경화면으로 설정하면, 피셔가 화면 한쪽에서 조용히 낚시를 즐깁니다. 또는 화면 위에 고정해 하루 종일 함께할 수도 있습니다. 낮과 밤이 바뀌고, 비와 맑음이 교차하는 다채로운 동적 풍경이 몰입감 있는 힐링 분위기를 선사합니다. 바람이 살랑이는 소리, 시냇물이 졸졸 흐르는 부드러운 효과음과 함께라면, 공부와 업무 시간이 더욱 평온하고 여유롭게 느껴질 거예요.
바쁜 일상 속에서 잠시 쉬어가며, 피셔와 함께 여행을 떠나보세요. 행성 곳곳의 다양한 풍경을 탐험하고, 특별한 자연의 아름다움을 감상하며, 여유로운 낚시의 즐거움을 만끽할 수 있습니다.




복잡한 조작 없이, 피셔가 모든 낚시를 대신해 줍니다! 당신은 여유 시간이 날 때마다 낚싯대와 미끼를 확인하고, 물고기가 얼마나 잡혔는지 살펴보기만 하면 됩니다. 낚은 물고기는 판매하여 수익을 얻을 수도 있고, 어항에 넣어 추가적인 보상을 획득할 수도 있습니다. 이렇게 얻은 물고기 코인으로 미끼를 구매하고, 낚싯대를 업그레이드하며, 어항을 확장해 더욱 다양한 물고기와 새로운 낚시터를 개방해 보세요!




낚시 성과는 장소, 시간, 날씨, 사용한 미끼에 따라 달라집니다. 흔히 볼 수 있는 물고기부터 신비로운 희귀 어종까지, 수십 종의 독특한 물고기가 당신의 발견을 기다리고 있습니다!




낚은 물고기를 어항에 넣어 여유롭게 헤엄치는 모습을 감상해 보세요. 물고기는 단순한 관상용이 아니라, 추가적인 보상도 제공합니다! 어항을 업그레이드하고 공간을 확장하여 더욱 다양한 물고기로 가득 채워보세요.




여행을 하다 보면, 개성 넘치는 다양한 친구들을 만나게 됩니다. 그들과 대화를 나누고, 그들의 이야기를 듣고, 오랜 세월 감춰져 있던 이 행성의 비밀을 밝혀보세요. 평온한 풍경 속에 숨겨진 따뜻한 감동과 신비로운 모험이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다!

title: Heroes & Dice
description:
게임 정보
각 영웅은 자신만의 주사위를 굴리고, 선택한 주사위를 제한된 횟수만큼 다시 굴릴 수 있습니다.
선택한 주사위를 캐릭터에게 배정한 후 차례대로 움직임을 실행하세요.
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 얻은 코인을 사용해 새로운 스킬을 구매하세요.
이 스킬을 캐릭터의 주사위에 배정하여 원하는 방향으로 캐릭터를 발전시키고 전략을 세우세요.
특정 레벨에서 동료를 선택하세요.
사용하지 않은 스킬을 에너지 스톤에 쌓고, 스톤이 가득 차면 고유 능력을 사용하세요.
스테이지 끝에서 보스와 대결하세요.
새로운 스테이지와 영웅을 잠금 해제하며 독특한 여정을 이어가세요.
주사위 면의 스킬을 변경하여 캐릭터의 주사위를 업그레이드합니다.
고유한 스킬도 가진 스테이지 최종 보스와 맞서 싸우세요.

title: RotorSim: Helicopter Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Take to the skies above exciting island landscapes in RotorSim, a retro-inspired helicopter simulation inspired by the classic sims of the 1990s. Master accessible yet rewarding flight mechanics as you tackle diverse missions in a hand-crafted world.
As a new pilot for AeroAssist, an organization specializing in aerial support for disaster relief, medical transport, and critical supply delivery, your mission is to bring aid to remote locations. Whether rescuing stranded hikers, delivering vital cargo, or transporting passengers, the places you visit will depend on your skill and adaptability!
Engaging Flight Model
The flight model strikes a balance between realism and accessibility, capturing a sim-cade level of helicopter aerodynamics. Easy to grasp mechanics are balanced with key helicopter dynamics like engine torque, vortex ring state, and RPM management, while keeping the controls intuitive and not requiring expensive peripherals.
3 Different Helicopters
As of the 1.0 release, there are 3 helicopters, each with their own distinct handling characteristics. One is quick and light, one is a strong, slow behemoth, and one is the classic balance between the two. Learning each platform's strengths and weaknesses will be the key to completing the campaign.
30 Mission Campaign
Perform search-and-rescue operations, transport cargo, and ferry passengers while meeting a cast of colorful characters who call the islands home. And if you'd like to practice, mess around, or just chill, choose a free flight mode and go explore the world!
Weather Simulation
Weather is an active part of the simulation, affecting both visibility and helicopter handling. Missions can  include stormy conditions, rain, fog, wind gusts, and turbulence, each requiring precise control and careful attention.
Lightweight
RotorSim is built to run smoothly on lower-end hardware (such as integrated graphics and the Steam Deck) without sacrificing the depth of the simulation.
Future Improvements:

title: MiDiO!
description:
게임 정보
🎨 Customize
Place, rotate, recolor, rescale and arrange freely to design your perfect DIO. Share your creations with friends through the Steam Workshop!
🏃‍♂️ Explore
Step into your Dio! Walk around, jump around and explore your own, your friends’, or the community’s creations from a whole new perspective.

title: Campus Fantasy
description:
게임 정보


이 게임은 언리얼 엔진 5를 사용하여 제작되었으며 많은 차세대 기술을 사용합니다. 예를 들어, Nanite는 모델을 영화 수준의 고정밀로 만들 수 있습니다. Lumen은 자연 환경에 필적하는 빛과 그림자를 제공하여 게임의 낮과 밤의 주기를 사실적이고 섬세하게 만들 수 있습니다. 또한, 이 게임은 1인칭으로 플레이어가 게임을 더욱 몰입감 있게 경험할 수 있습니다.

title: The Pub Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
꿈의 펍을 운영해볼 준비 되셨나요?
The Pub Life는 여러분을 처음부터 자신의 펍을 설립하고 운영하는 경험으로 초대합니다! 오래된 가게를 인수하고 꿈꾸던 공간을 만들기 위해 도전하세요. 고객을 만족시키고 사업을 확장하려면 무엇이든 해야 합니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 훌륭한 펍을 운영하려면 철저한 계획과 결단력 있는 관리가 필요합니다.
가게를 청소하고 시작하세요
펍에 들어서자마자 청소부터 시작하세요. 먼지와 어수선함 속에 갇히지 마세요. 깨끗한 펍은 만족스러운 고객을 의미합니다! 플레이어는 초기 예산을 신중하게 사용하여 첫 번째 재료를 구입하고 간단한 메뉴로 시작할 수 있습니다.
성장하고 레시피를 발견하세요
사업을 확장하려면 레벨을 올리고 더 고급 재료의 잠금을 해제하세요. 새로운 레시피를 배우고, 칵테일 제조 기술을 향상시키며 고객을 놀라게 할 특별한 메뉴를 만드세요. 창의력을 발휘해 고객의 사랑을 받는 펍으로 거듭나세요!
균형 유지
훌륭한 펍 운영은 메뉴에만 국한되지 않습니다. 재고를 균형 있게 유지하고 예산을 계획하며 고객의 요구를 충족시키는 것을 잊지 마세요. 수입을 신중하게 관리하고 비싼 투자에 신중히 접근하세요. 그렇지 않으면 부채의 늪에 빠질 수 있습니다!
사실적인 시뮬레이션
The Pub Life는 실제 펍 운영자가 직면하는 모든 도전과 보상을 시뮬레이션합니다. 세밀한 관리 시스템, 다양한 레시피 옵션 및 재미있는 공간 개발 과정은 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
준비되셨나요? 꿈의 펍을 창조하고, 운영하고, 가장 사랑받는 공간으로 만들어보세요!

title: Star Vortex
description:
게임 정보
Star Vortex는 디아블로 2와 같은 고전으로부터 영감을 받은 탑다운 액션 ARPG 우주 슈터 게임입니다. 인류는 모든 존재들에 맞서 싸우고 있습니다. 갑자기 새로운 위협이 등장해 인류를 공격하기 시작했습니다. 전 지구에 이 새로운 위협을 알려야 하며, 모함을 호위해 이 위기에 대한 소식을 전하는 일은 당신의 손에 달려있습니다.
플레이어는 전투함의 파일럿이 되어 모함이 지구에 무사히 도착할 수 있는 관문의 열쇠를 찾기 위해 우주를 탐험해야 합니다. 우주를 탐험하는 동안, 경험치를 획득해 레벨업을 하고, 전투함을 작은 프리깃에서 거대한 전함으로 업그레이드 할 수 있으며, 또 플레이어의 빌드와 플레이 스타일과 시너지를 낼 수 있는 장비들을 수집할 수 있습니다. 랜덤하게 생성되는 영역을 탐험하며 엘리트 적 및 보스들과 맞서 싸우고, 그 역경을 헤쳐나가며 성장해 나가세요.
플레이어의 스타일에 맞는 궁극의 빌드를 만들고, 최고의 장비를 찾기 위해, 모함에 있는 정거장을 방문해 완벽한 함선을 디자인할 수 있습니다. 작은 프리깃으로 시작해, 경험치를 얻고 레벨업을 함에 따라, 함선의 크기를 키울수 있습니다. 작은 프리깃에서 구축함, 그리고 순양함으로, 궁극적으로는 거대한 전함까지 말이죠.

title: Oxide Room 208
description:
게임 정보
Eight people trapped in an old laboratory find themselves caught up in sinister circumstances as they try to survive their final moments in this action-packed, terrifying body horror game full of gore and madness. Immerse yourself in a nightmare where the boundary between flesh and insanity blurs. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment.
1. Chronology of a massacre. THE STORY
Oxide Room 208 tells the story of eight people who are trapped by the ruthless Doc and forced to be connected to his experiment, Oxide. This dark and twisted place is controlled by Eva, an innocent victim used by Doc in his cruel research to turn her into the host of the experiment. However, Eva's sanity has reached its limit, causing the experiment to spiral out of control and create an organic, hellish environment that transcends reality. Now everyone is trapped in this nightmare filled with grotesque creatures and dangers, inspired by an old motel and the underground laboratory facilities where many atrocities were committed in the name of science. If you want to survive the night, find door 208 and go through it at all costs.

title: Lord O' Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Lord O' Pirates는 위험으로 가득한 바다를 항해하는 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다!
강력한 해적선의 키를 잡고, 무자비한 군함 함대와 해양 괴물, 그리고 그 이름만 들어도 미쳐버릴 것 같은 초자연적 공포와 맞서 싸우세요! 지구 끝 너머, 별들 사이까지 항해하세요!
당신만의 스타일로 플레이하세요: 잔인한 근접 무기로 적과 맞서거나, 멀리서 정확히 조준해 공격하거나, 아니면 느긋하게 지휘관 역할을 하며 부하들이 싸우게 하세요.
퀘스트를 완료하거나 잃어버린 보물을 찾아 새로운 배, 선장, 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하세요!
낯설고 이세계적인 미지의 바다를 넘나드세요.
전설의 보스들을 사냥하고 그들의 저주받은 보물 속에서 부를 쌓으세요!
부하 기반 능력으로 당신만의 저주받은 함대를 만드세요!
대포를 준비하세요 — 우주가 당신을 기다립니다!
참고: 이 게임을 만드는 동안 어떤 마을도 약탈당하지 않았습니다.
그리고 비밀 해우(바다소) 레벨도 없습니다. 제발 그만 편지 보내세요!!!

title: Café Manager
description:
게임 정보
꿈의 카페를 만들어보세요!
벽을 배치하고, 테이블보를 선택하여, 당신의 스타일에 완벽히 맞는 카페를 만들어보세요!
팀을 구성하고 관리하세요!

title: ERA ONE
description:
게임 정보
Era One is a space-themed game developed by Team Complex LTD.
Combining innovation, customization, and epic space battles, Era One offers a unique gaming experience. Players can customize their own ships using assembly modules, construct stations, warships, bases, and even cities in space. The game seamlessly blends real-time strategy (RTS) and base building elements, providing players with the opportunity to engage in intense battles between space fleets.


From the ashes of a shattered universe, a young woman's quest for salvation sparks a journey of intrigue, danger, and discovery. In a future where Earth's resources were depleted, humanity embarked on The Great Colonization, expanding to other planets. The rise of mining corporations led to conflicts and the emergence of space piracy. A wealthy magnate discovered a powerful energy source, leading to the construction of the Navi Mondo, enormous fortified and self-sustaining cities in space, and the formation of the Free Federation of Worlds. Centuries passed, and the population was pushed to abandon planets, living only on the Navi Mondo. However, genetically engineered biominers mutated and posed a threat. With resources nearing exhaustion, the Free Federation planned to migrate using Hyperspace Leap technology. The colonizing ships Victrix and X Gemina encountered a gravitational anomaly, causing a breach. Chaos ensued as resources depleted, wars resumed, and the political system collapsed. Alya De Shars sought to steal a power source to launch a secret ship and start anew. This sets the stage for a story of humanity's struggle, the rise and fall of an empire, and the hope for a fresh beginning beyond the Solar System.
We asked Alberto Selvaggi to read Era One's lore and compose based solely on his inspiration and years of passion for music and piano. The result is a unique and emotionally touching soundtrack that will accompany us throughout the story, adding depth and making everything deeply engaging.


The player can construct their own base using a set of assembly modules, with no limit to shape or size.
Extensive Base Customization: Era One offers a wide range of options for base construction and customization. Players can design and build their bases from scratch, choosing the layout, structures, and aesthetics that suit their playstyle.
Resource Management: Building and maintaining a base requires effective resource management. Players must gather and manage resources such as raw materials, energy sources, and workforce to construct and upgrade their bases. Proper allocation of resources is essential for the growth and sustainability of the base, ensuring its survival in the game world.
Defensive Structures and Strategies: Bases in Era One must be fortified against external threats. Players can construct defensive structures such as turrets, and traps to protect their bases from enemy attacks. Choosing the right defensive strategy, positioning defenses strategically, and upgrading them over time are crucial aspects of base building in the game.
Research and Technological Advancement: As players progress in Era One, they can unlock and research new technologies to enhance their base-building capabilities. Advancements in areas such as construction techniques, resource extraction, and defensive systems provide players with additional options for base expansion and fortification.


Players can build their starships according to their preferences.
Vast Ship Customization Options: Era One offers a wide array of ship customization options, allowing players to design and personalize their vessels. Players can choose from different ship types, sizes, and aesthetics, customizing various aspects such as hull design, paint schemes, and exterior decorations. This level of customization allows players to create unique and visually distinct ships that reflect their individual style.
Modular Ship Components: Ships in Era One are built using modular components, offering players the flexibility to tailor their ships for specific roles and functions. Players can select and install various modules, such as propulsion systems, weapon systems, cargo holds, and utility modules, based on their playstyle and objectives. The modular nature of ship components enables players to experiment with different configurations and optimize their ships for exploration, combat, trading, or other specialized tasks.
Upgradeable Ship Systems: As players progress in the game, they can acquire new technologies and upgrade ship systems to enhance their performance. Upgradable systems can include engines for increased speed, shields for improved defense, weapons for enhanced firepower, and scanners for better exploration capabilities.

title: cultivation of the strong
description:
게임 정보
'강자의 자기 수양'은 세계 빅맵 개발과 3인칭 생존 사격, 로그라이크의 결합이다.
마음속에 여자가 없으면 칼을 빼는 것은 자연히 신이 난다.진정한 강자가 되려면 여자들의 시험을 통과해야 한다!
제국의 가장 위대한 영웅, 도전을 받아들일 준비가 되셨습니까?
* 게임의 특징
독특한 오픈 월드 맵
3인칭 사격에 Roguelike, 전통 놀이를 뛰어넘어 더욱 재미있는 경험을 선사합니다
autokwd: cultivation of the strong,강자의 자기 수양

title: Hunters Inc
description:
게임 정보
**헌터스 Inc.**는 1~4명이 협동 플레이할 수 있는 근접 FPS 게임으로, 오크 사냥꾼들과 함께 거대한 몬스터를 처치하고, 치명적인 식물과 동물로 가득 찬 절차적으로 생성된 환경을 탐험하는 게임입니다.
1~4인 협동 플레이
오크 함께 강하다! 전투팀으로 협력하여 목표를 추적하고, 치명적인 야수와 위험, 귀중한 자원으로 가득한 야생 세계를 헤쳐나가며 목표를 물리치세요.
거대 몬스터 사냥
환경을 파괴할 만큼 강력한 다양한 생물을 추적하고 처치하세요. 각 몬스터는 독특한 전투 도전을 제공하며, 처치 후에는 희귀 제작 재료를 얻을 수 있습니다.
4가지 독특한 클래스
버서커로 적 무리를 학살하거나, 트래커로 목표를 찾고, 대장장이로 자원을 채취하고 전쟁 기계를 만들거나, 샤먼으로 보호 토템과 주문으로 팀을 지원하세요.

title: Tower Networking Inc.
description:
게임 정보
Tower Networking Inc is a blend of simulation and economic-strategy with rogue-like elements. Physically connect your clients to your networks by patching cables into switches, routers and data risers. Run an internet service provider in a tower that keeps building random floors. Each new floor comes with unique residences and/or offices that naturally has a variety of different needs.
As the network operator, you are tasked to provide connectivity and various IT related services to the residents in the tower on a limited budget. Your board of directors have a strict policy where you must never go over-budget or face termination from your role. Additionally, some of your clients have service level agreements (SLA) and you must ensure their internet connection (and the services they need) stays up. If any of them files a complaint, then its game-over!.
Your goal is to ensure your internet service provider runs as long as possible.
Key Features:
RUN AN INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDER: Provide internet services to residences and offices in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower.
CABLE MANAGEMENT SIMULATION: Spaghetti ahoy! Link up switches and routers with various types (and lengths) of network cables.

title: Night Club Simulator
description:
게임 정보
낡고 버려진 장소를 인수하여 국가에서 가장 인기 있는 나이트클럽으로 탈바꿈하세요. 이 모험에서 플레이어는 공간의 모든 구석을 리모델링하고 업그레이드하며 확장하여 나이트라이프의 정점에 도달합니다. 그러나 그것은 쉽지 않을 것입니다. 문제 많은 고객을 관리하면서 클럽의 명성을 유지해야 합니다. 이 게임은 단순한 나이트클럽 시뮬레이터가 아니라 전략, 창의성, 혼란의 여정을 친구들과 함께 경험하는 것입니다.
장소 디자인부터 고객 관계까지, 우리는 당신을 나이트라이프의 혼돈과 흥분 속으로 빠져들게 하는 역동적인 분위기를 제공합니다. 당신만의 클럽 스타일과 분위기를 만들고, 장소를 맞춤 설정하며 나이트라이프 장면에 당신의 흔적을 남기세요. 모던한 디자인으로 클럽을 장식하거나 향수를 불러일으키는 요소를 추가하고 싶든, 선택은 전적으로 당신에게 달려 있습니다!
당신이 플레이하게 될 협동 시뮬레이션 장르에서 최고의 그래픽. Unreal Engine 5로 개발되었습니다.
더 몰입감 있는 경험을 제공하는 역동적인 고객 AI 행동과 자발적인 이벤트.

title: Slime Survivors
description:
게임 정보
"Slime Survivors" – Survive the Limitless Monster Onslaught!
As endless hordes of demons swarm like tidal waves, you’ll become a hero of the Slime Kingdom, upgrading diverse weapons to forge instruments of carnage! Dodge through bullet-hell barrages, unleash dazzling ultimate skills to shred enemy waves, and experience an adrenaline-pumping roguelike survival frenzy!
How to Play
All you need to do: Move your character, aim at enemies, evade attacks, collect rewards, power up, and slaughter foes in style!

title: Space Bross
description:
게임 정보
Space Bross is a thrilling blend of action 2.5D roguelite, and Tower Defense genres.
You’re a retired astronaut. You had one job: chill. But then they came for your chicken. Now it’s personal.
Set off on a chaotic journey across deep space in Space Bross, a roguelite tower defense action game where survival means lasers, loot, and a whole lot of clucking vengeance.

title: Night Lotus
description:
게임 정보
A multiplayer first-person game with elements of social deduction (inspired by the board game "Mafia"). Here, you must uncover who among you is the secret killer.
Goal:
Win depending on your role by fulfilling your victory conditions.
Gameplay
Before the game begins, each player is randomly assigned one of three roles:
Monk – Peaceful and unwilling to harm anyone, but in desperate situations is ready to use force for the greater good—provided they have something to fight back with. A large-caliber revolver should do the trick.
Magistrate – Their goal is to secretly protect the monks. Fortunately, they have the means to do so. Just make sure no one finds out what's hidden under your cloak, or the protector might become the next victim.
Lotus – A secret killer disguised as a monk. Their words can deceive you, leading to decisions that may cost you dearly.
Game Process
Monks, accompanied by the Magistrate, must collect Buddha Statues to win. Of course, finding them won’t be easy—teamwork is essential. And trust me, the Lotus won’t let that happen without a fight.
Along the way, you may find potions that increase your chances of victory. Drinking them may restore your health, help you survive an attack, let you see items through obstacles, or even reveal the identity of the person in front of you.
In this game, no one can be trusted. Victory comes through cunning, teamwork, or cold steel!

title: Diner Bros 2
description:
게임 정보
정신없이 바쁜 주방 액션
요리 실력을 시험해 볼 준비가 되셨나요? 빠르고 재밌고 정신없는 Diner Bros 2에서 북적거리는 레스토랑을 열어보세요. 주문을 처리하고, 맛있는 음식을 만들고, 최대한 빨리 서빙하여 배고픈 손님들을 만족시켜 주세요!
손님을 파악하세요
Diner Bros 2에는 쏟아지는 주문만 있는 것이 아니랍니다. 특별한 손님들 때문에 긴장의 끈을 놓을 수가 없어요! 고유한 특성과 요구 사항을 가지고 있는 캐릭터들은멀티태스킹능력을한계까지밀어붙이죠.
점유 금지! 청소년은 하루 종일 앉아 있어도 괜찮다고 생각해요!
잠시도 가만히 있지 않는 조거는 음식이 빨리 나오길 원해요. 아주 빨리요!
음식만 먹고 몰래 도망칠 기회를 노리는 불량 청소년을 조심하세요!
어린이는 닭 다리만 먹어요. 골치 아프죠!
이게 다가 아니랍니다. 주문의 흐름을 유지하는 건 당신에게 달려 있죠!
레스토랑을 업그레이드하세요
새 주방기기를 구매하세요. 식당이 커지면서 늘어나는 수요를 충족하려면 더 좋은 도구가 필요해요.
주방 배치를 최적화하세요. 돈을 버는 데 있어서 가장 중요한 것은 효율성이죠. 주방이 원활하게 돌아가도록 배치되었는지 확인하세요. 그냥 놔둬도 상관없고요!
레스토랑을 확장하세요. 음식 평론가를 감동시키고 탐나는 3스타 상을 받을 자신 있으신가요?
직원이 더 필요한가요? 친구를 고용하세요!
Diner Bros 2에서는 혼자서 모든 일을 감당하지 않아도 된답니다. 종업원을 고용하여 부담을 덜거나, 4인 로컬 협동 캠페인에서 친구를 혼돈 속으로 초대하세요!

title: Elestrals Clash!
description:
게임 정보
Elestrals Clash! reimagines the strategic battles of the Elestrals Trading Card Game (TCG) in a dynamic digital format, offering a cross-platform experience accessible on both desktop and mobile. Whether you’re a seasoned Caster or new to the adventure, this immersive, lore-rich game offers everything you need to compete for supremacy in the mythical world of Elestrals.
Explore a realm where the elemental forces of Earth, Fire, Water, Thunder, Wind, Frost, Solar, and Lunar collide in a battle for dominance. Each Caster will unlock, collect, and strategically deploy their enchanted creatures, known as Elestrals, to rise through the ranks and Ascend to Immortality. With a seamless, fully automated experience, players can now wield their decks anytime, anywhere, whether at home or on the go.
Game Modes and Features
Cross-Platform Gameplay: Enjoy Elestrals Clash! on both desktop and mobile devices with full account synchronization, so you never miss a beat, no matter where you are.
Every Type for Every Player: No matter what element you prefer to Clash with, Casters will immediately have free access to every available card in the game!
Casual Play: Test your skills in both fun and competitive environments.
____________________________________________________
Join the Ascent to Immortality — wishlist Elestrals Clash! on Steam now to unlock new horizons and be part of the future of strategic card gaming. Keep an eye out for updates on special events, content drops, and exclusive in-game rewards as we gear up for the official release!

TCG players
Elestrals players
Players who enjoy competitive gameplay

title: Demigoddess!
description:
게임 정보
Demigoddess! is a unique game that focuses on the essentials of turn-based strategy games. It is designed so that each gameplay can be won or lost in approximately 1 hour.
Random map generation system -- The terrain, shape of the continents, type of enemy forces, force placement, and number of resources change every time you start the game.
You can control over 350 types of soldiers and monsters, 20 unique factions, and use over 300 types of equipment items.
Various items and magic can strengthen your soldiers as you like.
You will enjoy playing this game over and over again!
-- Victory Conditions --
The world called "The Continent" is divided into 64 areas, and you will win if you can conquer more than 32 of them.
We have eliminated the cumbersome work that are common in strategy games, such as "finding unpainted areas on the map and filling them in one by one" after the victory is confirmed in the second half, so that you can enjoy the most exciting time when the enemy and friendly forces are in balance for a long time.

title: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions
description:
게임 정보
Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fast-paced racing game for the whole family. Parallel to the worldwide cinema release of GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE, the popular Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda are celebrating their video game debut! Climb into the cockpit with the two heroes of the film GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE and six other colourful characters. Fans of the film and the Europa-Park are looking forward to a reunion!
The races will take you to well-known locations across Europe. Whether it's a Free Race, Point Chase, Time Trial or the Grand Prix - there are plenty of opportunities to put your driving skills to the test! And you'll need skill, because Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is really fast thanks to different boost techniques!
Each character not only has their own vehicle, but also individual strengths and weaknesses. So every race feels different - depending on who you send onto the track.
But Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions isn't just fun to play alone: in local multiplayer for up to four people, you can experience exciting races together and create unforgettable moments - because Ed & Edda is all about sharing the fun!
 Key features of Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions:
 Fast-paced races: On fast tracks, around famous attractions from all over Europe, provide variety!
Fast on the road: Various boost techniques ensure very high speed!
Eight playable characters: including Ed & Edda, the famous Europa-Park mascots!
Many possibilities: Unique racers, clever power-ups and customisable vehicles ensure variety and fun!
Multiplayer: Up to four drivers can race at the same time - perfect for families and friends!
