title: Stranded In Starlight
description:
게임 정보
While traveling through hyperspace, your ship's drive field suddenly fails. Moments later, a relentless alien force attacks, determined to ensure your journey ends here. Now, Stranded In Starlight, survival is your only option.
Features
Fast gameplay sessions (under 30 minutes)
Many different weapons and utilities
Bosses
Survive hordes of enemies that grow larger and stronger as time passes
Gain experience and upgrade your ship
Between runs you can permanently upgrade your ship and unlock new abilities

title: Kingdom Ascension
description:
게임 정보
중세 시대를 배경으로 한 전략 전쟁 게임입니다. 영주가 되어 처음부터 자신의 영토를 건설하세요. 자원 수집, 건물 건설, 병력 모집, 탐험 및 모험을 통해 영토를 확장하고 조국을 방어하세요.



황량한 기지에서 시작하여 식량과 재료와 같은 핵심 자원을 수집하세요. 자원이 부족한 경우, 병력 훈련, 건물 업그레이드, 기술 연구 및 개발에 자원을 신중하게 배분하여 발전의 기반을 다져야 합니다.

title: Cubic Cosmos
description:
게임 정보
The goddess of vanity has issued you a dangerous challenge. Win, and you rescue your imprisoned companions; lose, and you are stripped of your humanity to become a plaything in her hands. Life and liberty are at stake—will you beat her at her own game?
Cubic Cosmos brings you a unique roguelike deckbuilding experience, where tower-defense gameplay and fast-paced, hard-hitting card battles collide to create unparalleled strategic depth.
Fight Fate With Every Choice
Choose to wage war or explore random events—every step could change your destiny.
200+ cards with dozens of possible strategic combinations.
50+ relics, each one crucial to your deckbuilding strategy.
50+ random events.
Complete runs to unlock various heroes with unique strategic abilities.
Build an Unbeatable Deck
Pair relics with cards to enjoy deep strategic deckbuilding gameplay.
Dozens of Strategic Combinations: Focus on powerful pawns, deadly sorceries, or mysterious relics. Shield your pawns from harm, or let their death strengthen your forces... the possibilities are endless!

title: You Are The Code
description:
게임 정보


버그가 코드를 잠식하는 프로그래밍 퍼즐 게임! 한 가지 문제: 타이핑을 할 수 없습니다. 기존 코드 라인을 탐색하고 실행하여 출력이 목표와 일치하도록 만드세요!
You Are The Code의 각 레벨은 미리 작성된 코드로 구성됩니다. 원하는 출력과 일치시키기 위해 실행할 라인을 선택할 수 있습니다. 라인을 위아래로 이동할 때마다 버그가 진행되어 코드를 지우려고 합니다! 어떤 경우에는 그다지 나쁘지 않을 수도 있습니다...
GMTK 2023 게임 잼 6700개 출품작 중 상위 2%에 선정되었습니다!
특징:
100개 레벨
이해하기 쉬운 사용자 지정 프로그래밍 언어, 사전 프로그래밍 지식 필요 없음
이동 취소
시간 기반 퍼즐 없음, 움직이지 않으면 아무 일도 일어나지 않음

title: Ghost Pub
description:
게임 정보
GhostPub은 로그라이크 기반의 타이쿤 게임입니다.
유령 선술집의 주인이 되어 성공적인 창업을 이루어보세요!

title: Fischer's Fishing Journey
description:
게임 정보


《냐옹이 낚시 일기》에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 귀여운 고양이 피셔를 데스크톱에 배치하고, 그를 최고의 공부 및 업무 파트너로 삼아보세요. 게임을 데스크톱 배경화면으로 설정하면, 피셔가 화면 한쪽에서 조용히 낚시를 즐깁니다. 또는 화면 위에 고정해 하루 종일 함께할 수도 있습니다. 낮과 밤이 바뀌고, 비와 맑음이 교차하는 다채로운 동적 풍경이 몰입감 있는 힐링 분위기를 선사합니다. 바람이 살랑이는 소리, 시냇물이 졸졸 흐르는 부드러운 효과음과 함께라면, 공부와 업무 시간이 더욱 평온하고 여유롭게 느껴질 거예요.
바쁜 일상 속에서 잠시 쉬어가며, 피셔와 함께 여행을 떠나보세요. 행성 곳곳의 다양한 풍경을 탐험하고, 특별한 자연의 아름다움을 감상하며, 여유로운 낚시의 즐거움을 만끽할 수 있습니다.




복잡한 조작 없이, 피셔가 모든 낚시를 대신해 줍니다! 당신은 여유 시간이 날 때마다 낚싯대와 미끼를 확인하고, 물고기가 얼마나 잡혔는지 살펴보기만 하면 됩니다. 낚은 물고기는 판매하여 수익을 얻을 수도 있고, 어항에 넣어 추가적인 보상을 획득할 수도 있습니다. 이렇게 얻은 물고기 코인으로 미끼를 구매하고, 낚싯대를 업그레이드하며, 어항을 확장해 더욱 다양한 물고기와 새로운 낚시터를 개방해 보세요!




낚시 성과는 장소, 시간, 날씨, 사용한 미끼에 따라 달라집니다. 흔히 볼 수 있는 물고기부터 신비로운 희귀 어종까지, 수십 종의 독특한 물고기가 당신의 발견을 기다리고 있습니다!




낚은 물고기를 어항에 넣어 여유롭게 헤엄치는 모습을 감상해 보세요. 물고기는 단순한 관상용이 아니라, 추가적인 보상도 제공합니다! 어항을 업그레이드하고 공간을 확장하여 더욱 다양한 물고기로 가득 채워보세요.




여행을 하다 보면, 개성 넘치는 다양한 친구들을 만나게 됩니다. 그들과 대화를 나누고, 그들의 이야기를 듣고, 오랜 세월 감춰져 있던 이 행성의 비밀을 밝혀보세요. 평온한 풍경 속에 숨겨진 따뜻한 감동과 신비로운 모험이 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다!

title: Heroes & Dice
description:
게임 정보
각 영웅은 자신만의 주사위를 굴리고, 선택한 주사위를 제한된 횟수만큼 다시 굴릴 수 있습니다.
선택한 주사위를 캐릭터에게 배정한 후 차례대로 움직임을 실행하세요.
쓰러뜨린 적에게서 얻은 코인을 사용해 새로운 스킬을 구매하세요.
이 스킬을 캐릭터의 주사위에 배정하여 원하는 방향으로 캐릭터를 발전시키고 전략을 세우세요.
특정 레벨에서 동료를 선택하세요.
사용하지 않은 스킬을 에너지 스톤에 쌓고, 스톤이 가득 차면 고유 능력을 사용하세요.
스테이지 끝에서 보스와 대결하세요.
새로운 스테이지와 영웅을 잠금 해제하며 독특한 여정을 이어가세요.
주사위 면의 스킬을 변경하여 캐릭터의 주사위를 업그레이드합니다.
고유한 스킬도 가진 스테이지 최종 보스와 맞서 싸우세요.

title: RotorSim: Helicopter Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Take to the skies above exciting island landscapes in RotorSim, a retro-inspired helicopter simulation inspired by the classic sims of the 1990s. Master accessible yet rewarding flight mechanics as you tackle diverse missions in a hand-crafted world.
As a new pilot for AeroAssist, an organization specializing in aerial support for disaster relief, medical transport, and critical supply delivery, your mission is to bring aid to remote locations. Whether rescuing stranded hikers, delivering vital cargo, or transporting passengers, the places you visit will depend on your skill and adaptability!
Engaging Flight Model
The flight model strikes a balance between realism and accessibility, capturing a sim-cade level of helicopter aerodynamics. Easy to grasp mechanics are balanced with key helicopter dynamics like engine torque, vortex ring state, and RPM management, while keeping the controls intuitive and not requiring expensive peripherals.
3 Different Helicopters
As of the 1.0 release, there are 3 helicopters, each with their own distinct handling characteristics. One is quick and light, one is a strong, slow behemoth, and one is the classic balance between the two. Learning each platform's strengths and weaknesses will be the key to completing the campaign.
30 Mission Campaign
Perform search-and-rescue operations, transport cargo, and ferry passengers while meeting a cast of colorful characters who call the islands home. And if you'd like to practice, mess around, or just chill, choose a free flight mode and go explore the world!
Weather Simulation
Weather is an active part of the simulation, affecting both visibility and helicopter handling. Missions can  include stormy conditions, rain, fog, wind gusts, and turbulence, each requiring precise control and careful attention.
Lightweight
RotorSim is built to run smoothly on lower-end hardware (such as integrated graphics and the Steam Deck) without sacrificing the depth of the simulation.

title: Campus Fantasy
description:
게임 정보


이 게임은 언리얼 엔진 5를 사용하여 제작되었으며 많은 차세대 기술을 사용합니다. 예를 들어, Nanite는 모델을 영화 수준의 고정밀로 만들 수 있습니다. Lumen은 자연 환경에 필적하는 빛과 그림자를 제공하여 게임의 낮과 밤의 주기를 사실적이고 섬세하게 만들 수 있습니다. 또한, 이 게임은 1인칭으로 플레이어가 게임을 더욱 몰입감 있게 경험할 수 있습니다.

title: The Pub Life Simulator
description:
게임 정보
꿈의 펍을 운영해볼 준비 되셨나요?
The Pub Life는 여러분을 처음부터 자신의 펍을 설립하고 운영하는 경험으로 초대합니다! 오래된 가게를 인수하고 꿈꾸던 공간을 만들기 위해 도전하세요. 고객을 만족시키고 사업을 확장하려면 무엇이든 해야 합니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 훌륭한 펍을 운영하려면 철저한 계획과 결단력 있는 관리가 필요합니다.
가게를 청소하고 시작하세요
펍에 들어서자마자 청소부터 시작하세요. 먼지와 어수선함 속에 갇히지 마세요. 깨끗한 펍은 만족스러운 고객을 의미합니다! 플레이어는 초기 예산을 신중하게 사용하여 첫 번째 재료를 구입하고 간단한 메뉴로 시작할 수 있습니다.
성장하고 레시피를 발견하세요
사업을 확장하려면 레벨을 올리고 더 고급 재료의 잠금을 해제하세요. 새로운 레시피를 배우고, 칵테일 제조 기술을 향상시키며 고객을 놀라게 할 특별한 메뉴를 만드세요. 창의력을 발휘해 고객의 사랑을 받는 펍으로 거듭나세요!
균형 유지
훌륭한 펍 운영은 메뉴에만 국한되지 않습니다. 재고를 균형 있게 유지하고 예산을 계획하며 고객의 요구를 충족시키는 것을 잊지 마세요. 수입을 신중하게 관리하고 비싼 투자에 신중히 접근하세요. 그렇지 않으면 부채의 늪에 빠질 수 있습니다!
사실적인 시뮬레이션
The Pub Life는 실제 펍 운영자가 직면하는 모든 도전과 보상을 시뮬레이션합니다. 세밀한 관리 시스템, 다양한 레시피 옵션 및 재미있는 공간 개발 과정은 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 제공합니다.
준비되셨나요? 꿈의 펍을 창조하고, 운영하고, 가장 사랑받는 공간으로 만들어보세요!

title: Raptorfall: Survival
description:
게임 정보
당신은 외계 행성에 추락했습니다. 우주선이 파괴되었습니다. 위험한 벨로시랩터 같은 포식자들이 땅을 돌아다닙니다. 목표는 단순합니다: 생존하세요.

추락 지점과 주변 생태계를 탐험하며 자원을 모으고, 잃어버린 보급 상자를 찾으며, 부서진 우주선 부품을 회수하세요. 수집한 자원으로 도구, 무기, 방어 시설, 기술을 제작하세요.

기지를 짓고 강화하세요. 벽, 함정, 자동 방어 시스템을 설치하세요. 발전기와 외계 연료 전지를 사용해 시스템에 전력을 공급하세요. 매일 밤 또는 무작위 이벤트 때 포식자들이 공격합니다. 그들은 방어를 시험하고 약점을 파악하며 시간이 지날수록 강해집니다.

주요 게임 메커니즘:

기지 건설: 구조적 안정성과 업그레이드 단계를 가진 모듈식 건설 시스템.

자원 수집: 우주선 잔해와 랜덤 장비가 들어있는 루트 상자가 지도에 흩어져 있음.

방어 및 전투: 함정, 터렛, 무기를 배치하여 포식자 무리를 방어.

제작 시스템: 자원을 모아 도구, 무기, 탄약, 방어구, 업그레이드를 만듦.

에너지 및 시스템: 방어 시설, 문, 조명을 작동시키기 위한 에너지 관리.

적 AI: 벨로시랩터는 스토킹, 매복, 협동 공격을 함. 일부는 진화하거나 돌연변이.

생존 루프: 식사, 치료, 장비 유지 관리. 매일 요새를 강화하고 밤을 준비.

title: Guac & Load
description:
게임 정보
Guac & Load
Guac & Load is a fast-paced restaurant sim where chaos in the kitchen turns into a fight for survival.
👨‍🍳 Start Your Shift
Cook rice, beans, and meats
Make some guac and stock your trays
Build burrito bowls for customers
Run the register and keep the line moving
🧟 But Watch Out...
Some customers can get aggressive, must be the Z-Coli outbreak!
Grab kitchen tools or the guac gun to fight back
Survive furious ex-customers and keep the restaurant alive
🌀 Gameplay Loop
Each shift starts calm—just another day behind the counter. But after a while, everything changes. The pressure builds. The music shifts. The customers? Not so friendly anymore.
✅ Features:
Buying, cooking, chopping different types of food.
Preparing customer's orders. A customer has a specific order that you must fulfill, you get money based on how accurate your order is.
Zombies (infected by Z-Coli) will come and you'll need to fight to survive.

title: Donut Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Donut Shop Simulator에서는 단순한 계산원 역할을 넘어, 나만의 가게를 운영하는 모든 세부 사항을 체험할 수 있습니다. 주문을 받을 때 고객의 니즈를 즉각적으로 파악하고, 현금 또는 신용카드 거래를 통해 재정을 능숙하게 관리하세요. 상품 진열대 정리, 재고 부족 파악, 그리고 배송이 제때 정확하게 이루어지도록 하는 등 모든 단계에서 전략적 결정을 내려야 합니다.
올바른 제품 조합을 선택하고 이윤을 극대화하여 가장 수익성 있는 방식으로 주문을 승인하세요. 고객의 요청에 신속하게 대응하여 만족도를 높이고, 작은 가게를 지역 내 가장 인기 있는 디저트 명소로 탈바꿈시키세요. 게임의 깊이 있는 시뮬레이션은 경영 능력을 향상시킬 기회를 제공할 뿐만 아니라, 빠른 사고, 계획 수립 및 전략 구상 능력을 시험합니다.
가게 간판부터 인테리어, 심지어 배송 트럭까지 모든 세부 사항을 자유롭게 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다. 원하는 색상, 스타일, 문구를 사용해 가게를 독특하게 만들어보세요. 모든 디테일이 가게의 이야기와 정신을 반영하도록 정성스럽게 디자인되었습니다.
즐겁고 몰입감 있는 이 시뮬레이션 경험을 통해, 당신이 직접 자신의 사업을 운영할 준비를 하세요!
도넛을 직접 만들어 보세요
계산원 고용

title: Star Vortex
description:
게임 정보
Star Vortex는 디아블로 2와 같은 고전으로부터 영감을 받은 탑다운 액션 ARPG 우주 슈터 게임입니다. 인류는 모든 존재들에 맞서 싸우고 있습니다. 갑자기 새로운 위협이 등장해 인류를 공격하기 시작했습니다. 전 지구에 이 새로운 위협을 알려야 하며, 모함을 호위해 이 위기에 대한 소식을 전하는 일은 당신의 손에 달려있습니다.
플레이어는 전투함의 파일럿이 되어 모함이 지구에 무사히 도착할 수 있는 관문의 열쇠를 찾기 위해 우주를 탐험해야 합니다. 우주를 탐험하는 동안, 경험치를 획득해 레벨업을 하고, 전투함을 작은 프리깃에서 거대한 전함으로 업그레이드 할 수 있으며, 또 플레이어의 빌드와 플레이 스타일과 시너지를 낼 수 있는 장비들을 수집할 수 있습니다. 랜덤하게 생성되는 영역을 탐험하며 엘리트 적 및 보스들과 맞서 싸우고, 그 역경을 헤쳐나가며 성장해 나가세요.
플레이어의 스타일에 맞는 궁극의 빌드를 만들고, 최고의 장비를 찾기 위해, 모함에 있는 정거장을 방문해 완벽한 함선을 디자인할 수 있습니다. 작은 프리깃으로 시작해, 경험치를 얻고 레벨업을 함에 따라, 함선의 크기를 키울수 있습니다. 작은 프리깃에서 구축함, 그리고 순양함으로, 궁극적으로는 거대한 전함까지 말이죠.

title: Oxide Room 208
description:
게임 정보
Eight people trapped in an old laboratory find themselves caught up in sinister circumstances as they try to survive their final moments in this action-packed, terrifying body horror game full of gore and madness. Immerse yourself in a nightmare where the boundary between flesh and insanity blurs. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment.
1. Chronology of a massacre. THE STORY
Oxide Room 208 tells the story of eight people who are trapped by the ruthless Doc and forced to be connected to his experiment, Oxide. This dark and twisted place is controlled by Eva, an innocent victim used by Doc in his cruel research to turn her into the host of the experiment. However, Eva's sanity has reached its limit, causing the experiment to spiral out of control and create an organic, hellish environment that transcends reality. Now everyone is trapped in this nightmare filled with grotesque creatures and dangers, inspired by an old motel and the underground laboratory facilities where many atrocities were committed in the name of science. If you want to survive the night, find door 208 and go through it at all costs.

title: The Necromancer's Tale
description:
게임 정보
The Necromancer's Tale is a narrative-driven top-down RPG where you play the role of a minor noble in the 18th Century, drawn into the Dark Necromantic Arts as you seek knowledge and revenge. Great power awaits... along with the weird, the morbid, and a gradual descent into madness.
Before you lies a great spellbook, filled with powerful rites of death and reanimation. Can you decipher the pages and master its arcane rituals without losing your mind or being strung up by the townsfolk? Your progress will require great determination, cunning and secrecy.
The Necromancer's Tale is a story-rich game, with 400,000 words of hand-written narrative and lore, in which you converse with 180+ NPC characters, each with their own hand-drawn portrait art (we have not used any generative AI in the game). You will investigate, negotiate, coerce and flatter in order to progress your aims. The game's Trust system means that your choices - even in conversation - really matter. If the townsfolk's trust drops too low, you will find your choices are affected - if it drops further still, you will surely be tried in court and hanged, or lynched by a frenzied mob.
Your character is created in an interactive and fully voiced backstory, defining your gender, early life, skills and career (military, diplomatic, or academic). Narrative options during the main game are affected by these choices.

title: Food Industry
description:
게임 정보
The world has changed... pollution and decades of overproduction have made the planet unstable and altered the climate.
Ever-increasing industrialization has accelerated the arrival of cataclysmic storms. They have spread across the globe like wildfire, destroying everything in their path.
You, like so many others, had no choice but to flee to new lands. Now you will have to adapt and rebuild.
Will you then make the same choices as before? And will you be able to survive the increasingly intense and devastating storms?
In Food Industry, you are in charge of developing a prosperous city where survival depends on food production. You must juggle the construction of infrastructure, resource management and the well-being of citizens while facing environmental and economic challenges.
One person's work: I'm an independent developer and I'm counting on you to be lenient in your criticism. If you have any questions or objections, please feel free to contact me via private message or Discord.
Key Features
✓ Agriculture: sowing and harvesting fields of grains, fruits and vegetables, and raising farm animals for its food resources.
✓ Construction and Management: Create and grow your city by balancing the needs of your citizens while overcoming the challenges of food production.

title: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants
description:
게임 정보
"The Maze Survivor:First Entrants" is the prologue to "The Maze Survivor:The 9th Entrants"
It is a limited space survival game that uniquely combines the characteristics of survival, horror, puzzle solving and maze adventure games.
You will play the role of the first batch of entrants into the maze. Compared with the ninth batch of entrants, you have fewer clues and more pressure to survive.
You will wake up in a wild jungle without any clues. Through the gaps in the leaves, they could see that they were surrounded by high walls. The walls open at dawn and close at night.
You must try your best to collect enough supplies and establish their own stronghold in this relatively safe forest. When you are fully prepared, enter the maze full of unknown dangers, collect more important materials, solve complex puzzles, make marks, and try to extend your footprint as far as possible.

title: Low_Signal
description:
게임 정보
Low_Signal is a classic first-person exploration game. Its structure requires you to unlock abilities in order to discover new areas and progress through the story.
Although you'll be much faster and more agile than in a walking-sim, observation is still essential. 
The adventure will take place in the setting of an abandoned Asian slum. Inspired by the city of Kowloon, the environments can sometimes be gloomy or stressful, and some themes are rather dark. However, horror is not the central genre.
The game offers a complete narrative experience that lasts around 3 to 5 hours.
Investigate and explore
Reading notes and collecting objects are key parts of the gameplay.
A strange Altar is located in the central hub of the slum. Linked to five antennas, it can receive specific objects and notes that you must find and return in pairs. If these items are both related to the same former inhabitant, a lock is overturned. However, you don't yet know what lies behind this mechanism.
Get new abilities - Visit their dreams

title: Grounded 2
description:
게임 정보
When you've been shrunk to the size of an ant, what was once familiar is now a wild, uncharted frontier. Traverse sprawling manmade spaces overgrown with nature with buggies that can fight alongside with you, uncover hidden secrets, and fight to survive in a world much larger than the backyard. The playground may seem familiar, but beneath its bright colors and towering structures lie mysteries hidden in plain sight. Are you ready to uncover them?

title: Boom Gear
description:
게임 정보
Boom Gear is a wild, high-energy demolition derby where crashing and smashing your way to victory is the only rule that matters.
Slip behind the wheel of a rugged car and barrel into opponents in open-ended free play. Dodge obstacles, out manoeuvre rivals, and leave a trail of mayhem in your wake.
Every hit counts—rack up your score with epic takedowns and showcase your mastery of pure, arcade-style carnage. It’s you against the metal jungle—no mercy, just high-octane fun.
Your car, your style, your rules.
In Boom Gear, customization is your ticket to personalizing the destruction. Swap out car bodies for different looks—from brawny bruisers to nimble compacts—and bolt on wheels that suit your demolition style. Throw on a flashy paint job that screams attitude: neon grids, bold camo, or even colour splotches if that’s your vibe.
The combination is up to you—build your signature ride, and bring the pain in style.
Demolition isn’t just about smashing—it’s about building your ultimate ride.
Every time you score big, you’ll earn cash to unlock new car bodies and wheels through a random draw system. No rarities, no tiers—just pure, unpredictable fun as you expand your garage with every victory.

title: MOTTAINAI GHOST
description:
게임 정보
본 작품은 가벼운 놀람 요소는 있지만, 그로테스크한 표현이나 폭력적인 장면은 전혀 포함되어 있지 않습니다.
그럼에도 불구하고 호러 게임 특유의 음울하고 불길한 분위기를 충분히 느낄 수 있습니다.
“호러에 관심은 있지만 너무 무서운 건 싫다”는 분이나 어린이도 안심하고 즐길 수 있는 ‘호러 입문작’으로 추천드립니다.
시놉시스
휴가 렌탈로 큰돈을 벌겠다는 꿈을 품고 낡은 중고 아파트 건물을 구입한 당신.
하지만, 이상한 일이 벌어지기 시작하며 투숙객들이 하나둘씩 사라지기 시작합니다.
이 기묘한 사건의 원인을 밝혀내기 위해 방 하나하나를 철저히 조사하던 당신은, 버려진 음식물과 물건들의 원한에 직면하게 됩니다.
게임 규칙
당신의 목표는 저택에서 탈출하는 것입니다. 하지만 당신 앞을 가로막는 것은 바로 "음식 찌꺼기"입니다.
음식 찌꺼기를 먹으면 위(胃) 레벨이 올라가며, 더 큰 음식 찌꺼기를 먹을 수 있게 됩니다. 위 레벨을 효율적으로 올리는 것이 탈출의 열쇠입니다.
탐색을 돕기 위해 후각과 시각과 같은 오감을 강화하는 아이템이 준비되어 있습니다. 또한, 길을 잃지 않도록 자동 맵핑 기능이 포함되어 있어 쾌적한 플레이가 가능합니다.
과연 당신은 이 가혹한 저택에서 무사히 탈출할 수 있을까요?
게임 특징
일본 문화에 뿌리를 둔 귀신 이야기
"MOTTAINAI(모타이나이)" 정신을 중심으로 일본의 민간 전설을 현대 공포로 재구성한 작품.
일상 속에 숨어있는 공포를 직접 체험해보세요.
탐험 기반 공포 게임
아파트의 모든 방을 조사하며 숨겨진 아이템과 메모를 찾아내고, 이상한 사건의 진실을 밝혀냅니다.
MOTTAINAI GHOST에 잡히면 게임 오버
아파트를 돌아다니는 MOTTAINAI GHOST를 조심하세요.
당신의 행동이 생존 여부를 결정합니다.

title: Clan Duramont
description:
게임 정보
PRESENTATION
This is a classic 2D old-school RPG in the style of the retro Super NES and Genesis RPGs such as Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest.
The Clan Duramont is a Family who has fought the demons in the Avant Kingdom for generations. For the moment they are born, they are raised and trained to face the evil forces that haunt the kingdom.
Lothar, the last of his brothers, and father of Draco, Viktor, Lorena and Victoria, has to face his oldest foe one more time, the demon Pagunga. As fate would have it, said battle will test the Duramont Family, twisting it and breaking it, forcing them to hold the pieces together so they can hope to triumph against Pagunga and his demon legion.
Journey into an adventure of family, courage, betrayal and redemption. Join the Clan Duramont.
FEATURES
15 to 20 hours of gameplay
Multiple party members
A vast world to explore, from snowy locations to deserts, ruins, forests and temples
Mouse Support
Autosave function

title: Orbi Universo II
description:
게임 정보
Orbi Universo II is a deep management-simulation-strategy game that puts you at the forefront of history itself. Through an innovative node-based system, you'll guide your society from the Neolithic era to the Atomic Age, making impactful decisions that ripple through time.
MASTER THE COMPLEXITY OF CIVILIZATION
Harness a unique node system where every aspect of your civilization interacts in meaningful ways
Watch as your decisions create cascading effects across your society
Balance countless interconnected elements: from agriculture and commerce to religion and warfare
Navigate the delicate dance between stability and progress
FORGE YOUR OWN PATH
Shape your civilization's unique cultural and religious traits
Each region has its own local resources and nodes
Adapt to your environment and create truly distinct societies
Challenge historical assumptions and craft your own alternate history
FACE A LIVING WORLD
Engage with rival civilizations across a dynamic world map
Wage wars through tactical battle choices
Forge diplomatic alliances and trade relationships
Secure crucial resources through commerce or conquest
A UNIQUE EXPERIENCE
Abstract visual style that emphasizes clarity and readability
Multiple victory conditions and play styles
Diverse soundtrack inspired by many different cultures, evolving with you
Rich emergent storytelling through systemic interactions
A NEW EVOLUTION

title: Chick Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Chick Clicker
Start with a single chicken and a pocket full of feed. In this 3D style chicken idle game, you hatch, harvest, and hustle your way from humble henhouse to unstoppable chicken empire. Your feathery workforce lays the groundwork—literally—for your rise to farming fame.
Upgrade coops, automate feeding, and discover rare breeds with ridiculous productivity. Whether you’re a hands-on farmer or a laid-back egg tycoon, there’s always a bigger barn on the horizon.
Can you turn a sleepy little farm into the clucking capital of the world?
KEY FEATURES
Build a Chicken Army
Tap, hatch, and collect coins as you grow your farm. The more eggs you gather, the bigger your flock becomes!
Smarter Chickens, Bigger Profits
Level up your chickens and improve key skills like movement speed, hatch rate, and farm production. Every egg counts toward your feathered fortune.
Unlock Automation
Buy upgrades to automate your farm and hatch eggs automatically. Chickens can be upgraded to deal with farm production.
Dev in the Coop
Expect regular updates, new features, and fresh content every 1–2 months. I'm always cluckin' up something new!
Build your farm, grow your flock, and let the chickens do the rest!

title: Death Infection
description:
게임 정보
An open world that can accommodate tens of thousands of people,
with each city allowing up to 10,000 people to log in and interact simultaneously.
No shops, no top-up points; all trading currency and equipment are obtained within the game
Rich survival skills and crafting.
Players can build their own homes in the post-apocalyptic world.
From combat and kendo to ninjutsu, from tailoring and blacksmithing to master craftsmanship, from farming and gathering to culinary expertise.
Up to 200 survival skills can be freely combined, making each character unique.
A metaverse that truly restores virtual characters’ genitalia and sexual interaction functions to players.
Players can engage in various sexual interactions with each other.
No need to install additional mods, and no need to pay to unlock.

title: Earthion
description:
게임 정보
Return to the genesis of 16-bit gaming with Ancient's brand new shoot 'em up, Earthion!
Yuzo Koshiro’s Earthion is a side-scrolling space shooter developed natively for 16-bit systems by legendary Japanese developer Ancient Corporation. 
Guide space fighter pilot Azusa Takanashi, through eight chaotic levels, each with their own unique environment, enemies, and boss fights, to repel the alien invaders and save planet Earth.
Legends of the 16-bit era return
Instrumental in the creation of some of the 16-bit era’s most defining games, Ancient Corporation and Yuzo Koshiro return to their roots after three decades to deliver a generation-defining experience and an unforgettable fight among the stars.

title: Droned
description:
게임 정보
Droned is a small project by a single dev to revive some old school action. Compete in AI league, take on the trials or battle it out in arena with your friends.
The game reward progression by collecting new drones, weapons & utilities that compliments your play style.
GAME MODES
AI LEAGUE
Build your ultimate drone team and take on AI-controlled squads based on real player loadouts. Climb the leaderboard and defend your rank in this solo competitive mode.
TRIALS
A high intense co-op mode—a gauntlet of brutal combat scenarios designed to push your tactical mastery to the edge. Bring your best drone, a trusted ally, and a high-level Codex if you hope to survive. Do you have what it takes to conquer them all?
ARENA
Compete in intense Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes against real players or bots in fast-paced, high-stakes combat. Victory goes to the last drone standing—or the team with the sharpest tactics and deadliest aim.
CUSTOMIZATION AND LOADOUT
Customize your drones with a growing collection of weapons & utilities.

title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
description:
게임 정보
Blasphemous로 호평받은 개발진이 제작한 NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound는, Tecmo(현 KOEI TECMO GAMES)가 만든 NINJA GAIDEN 시리즈의 고전 스토리와 게임플레이를 멋지게 결합했습니다. 고전 스타일과 현대 3D 버전 게임의 깊이와 강렬함이 만나 장대하고 스릴 넘치는 모험을 선사합니다.

title: Knight Jump
description:
게임 정보
(컴퓨터에서 번역)
"나이트 점프" - 3D 플랫포머. "점프 킹"에서 영감을 받았습니다.
어렵지만 공정한 점프
떨어지지 마세요!
최고 점수 달성

title: Tears of Vanfell
description:
게임 정보

Tears of Vanfell is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op.


Explore and climb the procedurally-generated Mountain to find and defeat Bosses, and continue on your journey.

During your adventure, you'll pick up powerful new abilities, weapons and equipment, all of which you'll need to use if you plan on surviving.



Explore the Mountain with a team of up to four players! Or, if you would rather take on the Mountain by yourself, don't worry -- you may also bring another member of your camp to help you out.


Prepare yourself for your next expedition at your campsite. At first, it will be just you and your thoughts... but as you explore, you'll find others willing to help you out -- from other explorers with unique skills, to specialists who can help behind the scenes.



During your adventures, you'll meet many characters and grow to understand them and their motivations. But you may also find yourself caught up in the aftermath of a century-old war...

title: Store Empire
description:
게임 정보
낙원 같은 섬에 위치한 도시에서 상점 제국을 건설하고 비즈니스의 왕이 되세요. Store Empire에서, 당신은 작은 상점을 관리하는 것부터 시작해 다양한 상점을 인수하여 포트폴리오를 확장할 수 있습니다. 도둑으로부터 사업을 보호하고, 고객의 행동을 파악하며, 도시 전역에 광고를 하여 더 많은 소비자를 유치하세요. 도시의 축제나 축구 경기 날과 같은 무작위 이벤트에 대비하고, 고객의 특별한 요구를 충족시키기 위해 상점을 조정하세요. 전략과 계획을 통해 섬에서 가장 큰 상업 제국으로 성장시키세요!
도시는 플레이어에게 완전한 몰입감을 제공하기 위해 설계되었습니다. 상점에 가장 적합한 공급업체를 찾기 위해 다양한 창고와 시설을 탐험하세요. 손님이 없어서 한가한가요? 걱정하지 마세요! 광고 대행사에 들러 광고를 계약해 더 많은 손님을 끌어 모으세요. 재정이 어려워지면 은행에서 대출을 받을 수 있지만, 이자를 잘 관리하세요. 아무도 파산을 원하지 않으니까요.

title: YOOCA: Next Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Yooca: Next Horizon is a social-life RPG set in a vibrant multiplayer open world where your story is shaped by the choices you make, the skills you master, and the quests you take on.
Start as a nobody. Grow into somebody.
Build your Character Traits – Nett Worth, Authority, Influence, and Strength – through meaningful gameplay across diverse activities and social experiences. Whether you're running a café, acing a trivia showdown, performing live music, or completing crafting quests, every action you take leaves its mark on your journey.
Forge your path, shape your destiny, and rise to become a legend in the Youniverse.
🧭 Core Gameplay
Grow Your Character Traits:
Your journey is defined by four key traits –
💰 Nett Worth (earn and accumulate wealth),
🗣️ Influence (social clout and popularity),
🏋️ Strength (fitness and stamina),
👑 Authority (your rank, reputation, and impact).
Level them up through gameplay, choices, and achievements.
Master New Skills:
From cooking and cycling to piano and singing, Yooca: Next Horizon lets you learn and master a wide variety of skills. Improve them over time and unlock unique gameplay advantages, rewards, and new quests.
Choose Your Quests:
Take on story-driven or skill-based quests that range from chill and casual to ambitious and challenging. Explore different professions, meet quirky NPCs, and shape your own narrative.
Craft, Earn, and Upgrade:
Collect resources, craft items, and build your inventory. Trade with others, complete jobs, and grow your empire.
Social Sandbox:
Socialize, party, or collaborate with friends. Customize your avatar and apartment. Express yourself through fashion, emotes, and voice chat.
Play to Progress:
Enjoy a mix of mini-games, time-limited challenges, and daily tasks that reward you with XP, currency, and progress across your skills and traits.

title: Pattern Survivors: Bullet Hell
description:
게임 정보
Pattern Survivors: Bullet Hell (Roguelike)는 당신이 우주 타워를 조종하고 자신만의 공격 패턴을 디자인하여 적들의 물결을 물리치는 역동적인 액션 게임입니다.
🛠️ 플레이 방법 – 3초 만에 액션 시작 — 튜토리얼 없이, 기다림 없이, 바로 플레이!
1️⃣→ 프로브/에미터 추가
[p>전통적인 불릿 헬 슈터와 달리, 여기서는 당신이 직접 공격 패턴을 결정합니다. 에미터/프로브를 배치하고 슬라이더로 패턴을 설정해 독창적인 탄막 시퀀스를 만들어 전장을 지배하세요! 실시간으로 공격 패턴을 수정하며 새로운 적의 물결마다 전략을 조정할 수 있습니다.[/p]
[p>각 웨이브를 물리칠 때마다 경험치를 얻어 레벨업하며, 타워나 에미터를 강화하는 강력한 업그레이드를 선택할 수 있습니다.[/p]

title: Conquer Lands
description:
게임 정보
Build your deck of cards and units, form your army. Use your cards with your army in battle against challenging lords to save and rebuild the kingdom.
Building Unit Deck: Players can create a unit deck as deck of cards. Units can be selected based on their strength, class and type, this adds strategic depth to the gameplay.
Trigger Mechanic: Cards are triggered depending on the power, class and type of units in the army.
Card Upgrade: Cards can be upgraded in two ways. Card Level increases the damage, Position Level allows the card to deal damage to multiple enemies.
Map System: The map consists of 10 regions, each region branching into 3 different paths. Choose the path that suits you best and shape your strategy.
Position Cards: This card allows players to change enemy positions randomly or on request, this provides strategic depth on combat.

title: Panta Rhei - Guardian of Time
description:
게임 정보
Panta Rhei is an adventure rogue-lite where time is your weapon. You take on the role of Phi, a Guardian of Time exiled in the Garden of Past since the Great Cataclysm. Phi spent eons tending to the garden, hiding from the outside world and neglecting their duties as a guardian. Now a chaotic force threatens to tear the flow of time apart, forcing Phi to leave their sanctuary and embark on a journey through the Realm of Time. A journey that requires Phi to face their shadows of the past and embrace their origin as a Guardian of Time to save their home.
TIME IS YOUR WEAPON



Phi's abilities to bend time allow you to manipulate the environment to clear paths or solve clockwork puzzles while exploring. They also allow Phi to revert their own last moves to double their effectiveness in combat or recover from lethal mistakes.
AN EVER-CHANGING REALM



The Realm of Time holds many secrets for you to uncover. Each location has its own challenges, gradually revealing more of the world as Phi solves side quests and cleanses the world. Gather and combine items in the world to craft unique strategies. Tend to the Garden of Past to maximise your chances for future runs.



Panta Rhei explores time as our most valuable resource. For Phi, time is quite literally tied to their life and purpose. But they also experience it as something non-linear, an aspect of their life that they can control and shape to their will.
company: reignite games, Omme Animation, Nordic Scoring

title: Rusty Rangers
description:
게임 정보
[용감한 레인저 팀을 제외하고는 아무도 이전의 세상이 어땠는지 기억하지 못합니다. 이제 혼돈과 예측 불가능성이 모든 곳을 지배하고 있으며, 과거에는 무해했던 생명체가 파괴를 가져오고, 주변 세계는 끊임없이 변화하며 익숙한 환경을 무력화시키고 있습니다.
고전적인 게임플레이와 현대적인 메커니즘의 결합
용감한 레인저 중 한 명을 조종하여 책임감 있는 임무를 수행하세요 - 악당을 찾아 널리 퍼진 광기를 막고 세상에 평화와 정의를 되찾으세요!
여러분은 세상을 구하기 위해 달리고, 점프하고, 쏘는 등 바쁘게 지낼 수 있는 많은 독특한 적들을 만나게 될 것입니다! 레인저마다 전투 스타일과 특수 기술이 다르므로 자신에게 가장 적합한 영웅을 선택할 수 있습니다!
아름다운 픽셀 그래픽
러스티 레인저의 세계는 상세한 세계, 독창적이고 다채로운 캐릭터, 유용한 아이템 및 기괴한 생물로 가득합니다. 각 픽셀은 큰 사랑으로 만들어졌습니다. 러스티 레인저의 아름답고 놀라운 세계를 즐겨보세요!

title: BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE
description:
게임 정보
Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore. Experience the terror with high-quality graphics that bring the eerie environment to life, and envelop yourself in a soundscape of detailed 3D audio that enhances every haunting whisper and distant footstep. The atmosphere is thick with dread, filled with puzzles that challenge the mind and screamers that test your resolve, ensuring a pulse-pounding journey into the unknown.
High-Quality Graphics – Immerse yourself in an environment where every detail is crafted to enhance the horror.
Detailed 3D Audio – Every sound is designed to amplify the suspense and immerse you deeper into the game.
Creepy Atmosphere – The constant, oppressive dread is carefully maintained to keep you on edge.
Challenging Puzzles – Test your wits with intricate puzzles that integrate seamlessly into the narrative.
Effective Screamers – Prepare for heart-stopping moments that are sure to keep the adrenaline pumping.

title: Grim Hollow
description:
게임 정보
Grim Hollow is an immersive open-world survival horror game currently in Early Access, where the dead dominate the land and survival is a constant struggle. Explore a hostile and evolving world filled with threats, mysteries, and opportunities to rebuild amidst the chaos.
This Early Access version offers a preview of the core gameplay systems and is actively being developed with player feedback. While many features are already playable, additional content, polish, and systems will be added over time leading up to the full release.
🔑 Key Features (Early Access Preview)
🧭 Expansive Open World
Explore a growing world made up of distinct biomes—from dense jungles and eerie swamps to crumbling urban ruins. New zones, secrets, and map expansions will be introduced throughout development.
🥫 Survival Mechanics
Scavenge for essentials like food and water, monitor your vitals, and adapt to harsh environmental conditions. Stay alive by managing hunger, thirst, injury, and infection.
🛠️ Crafting System
Salvage resources to craft weapons, tools, and survival gear. Customization and upgrades let you shape your approach to every threat.
🏘️ Village Building
Build, upgrade, and defend your own safe zone. Set traps, reinforce structures, and turn your base into a thriving outpost of humanity.
🧟 AI Enemies (Limited in Demo)
Currently features one zombie type in the demo. The full game will introduce multiple zombie variants and hostile human factions, each with unique behaviors and strategies.
📜 Quests & Narrative
Uncover the mystery behind the outbreak through environmental storytelling, side quests, and main missions. The full storyline will expand over time with deeper lore and branching content.
🌐 Multiplayer Mode (Limited in Demo)
Team up with friends online. Multiplayer is functional in Early Access with a prototype map; the full version will support a complete open-world co-op experience.
🎭 Character Customization
Adjust your character’s appearance, skills, and playstyle to fit your survival strategy.
🎧 Atmospheric World-Building
Experience a hauntingly beautiful world brought to life with stunning visuals, dynamic lighting, and a suspenseful original soundtrack.

title: The Murder Hotel
description:
게임 정보
또 다른 피해자는 내 이름으로 ""그들은 모두 수치심에 휩싸여 서 있었다""고 주장했다.

The Murder Hotel은 거대한 반전이 있는 인터랙티브 Murder Mystery Adventure입니다: 가위를 휘두르는 악마는 살인자이고 당신은 인간 손님 중 한 명을 의심해야 합니다.


그들이 어떻게 그런 짓을 할 수 있었는지에 대한 그럴듯한 이론을 만들어 내야 합니다.
언제든지 저를 가스펑거라고 불러주세요. 저는 악마 같은 호텔리어입니다, 당신을 위한.
아, 벌써 떠나실래요? 얼마나 재미있을까요. 내가 허락하지 않는 한 아무도 이곳을 떠나지 못합니다.
살인사건 4건을 해결하는 건 어때요. 쉽겠죠? 반전이 있어요. 내 손님들을 죽이는 건 바로 접니다. 그리고 조사해서 다른 손님 중 한 명을 범인으로 의심하게 하는 것이 당신의 임무입니다.
라이벌을 물리치고 악마 위원회를 설득해 승소해야 합니다.
한 번이라도 지면 여기서 영원히 머물게 될 거야!
어떻게 나한테 도전해 보겠습니까?
게임에 대하여
악마가 가해자일지는 몰라도 각각의 살인은 인간의 방법으로만 설명할 수 있습니다. 도전할 준비가 되었나요?


왜 살인이 일어나고 있는지, 어떻게 살인을 끝낼 수 있는지 알아보세요.

title: AVTale
description:
게임 정보
AVTale – is an exciting cooperative 2D platformer designed for two players on a single screen (Split Screen) locally and online, where teamwork is the key to escaping a bottomless cave where echoes of ancient mysteries blend with the whispers of shadows. The game features a dark-toned atmosphere where lighting plays a crucial role and offers dynamic battles, challenging puzzles, and a world filled with dangers.
Co-op as the Key to Survival
The game is built to emphasize the importance of player interaction. One player takes on the role of support, using healing, shields, and buffs, while the other focuses on offense, fighting enemies. Only through teamwork can they succeed.

title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
description:
게임 정보
돈만 있으면 다 해결할 수 있어, 이 멍청아! 도시를 건설하고, 모험가를 초대하고 모험가들이 문제를 해결해줄 때까지 임무를 맡겨... 황금이 부족한게 바로 문제란 말이야! 요즘 반려동물님을 모시는데 식비가 얼마나 들어가는지 알아? 괴물들에게 둘러싸인 땅에 도시를 건설하는건 말할것도 없지!
독특한 식민시 건설시뮬레이션 애호가들을 위해 만들어진 , Gold Gold Adventure Gold 는 컬트 오브 더 램, 림월드, 마제스티와 블랙 앤 화이트를 합친 다음 어게인스트 더 스톰을 약간 곁들인 작품입니다.
임무를 부여하세요
모험가들이 공짜로 일하지 않는건 누구나 다 알고 있습니다. 그들의 충성심은 황금에 따라 움직이죠!
황금과 명예를 가지고 모험가들을 고용하고, 그들에게 임무를 부여하세요! 죽이고, 방어하고, 탐험하는겁니다!

title: Escape House
description:
게임 정보
'Escape House' is a short (around 30 minutes), walking simulator game wherein the player is paid to partake in an experimental, real-world video game which is currently in development and not yet accessible to the public. Will you partake, and at what cost?
Mechanically, the game offers little in the way of game play. But what it lacks in that department, it more than makes up for in atmosphere and tone. Be that through its use of music, narration or (perhaps most predominantly) the many twists and turns within its story. All of which make 'Escape House' a game worth sharing with friends. If for no other reason than to witness their reaction.

title: Grist
description:
게임 정보
An ASCII-driven Sci-Fi RPG, GRIST takes place on the Shell World Atropos: A megaplanet consisting of multiple kiliometres-deep layers - worlds within worlds within worlds. From the mountainous terrain and scattered settlements of the surface, to the ancient temples and dark megacities of the interior, send your team ever deeper in search of the life-giving nanoparticle GRIST.
GRIST draws on a heritage of table-top RPGs, gamebooks, and classic CRPGs from the 1980s, resynthesizing them into a glowing terminal-wave aesthetic with driving basslines, exploding ASCII particles, and a healthy dose of existential horror.
Hexcrawl your way down into the depths of the Shell World finding lost civilisations and forgotten technologies
Take advantage of positioning in combat to avoid attacks, gain buffs, and out-manouever your enemy
Equip your team with build-defining cards salvaged from the battlefield or obtained on the black markets
Every game is different - it's a whole new Atropos each time, from locations to missions to story
A persistent meta-game that evolves based on your actions in each run

title: Fate’s Theater
description:
게임 정보
Because it's not a 'fairytale' until a fairy tells it!
Fate's Theater is a card-based storyteller where two mischievous fairies—sparkling Fortune and velvet-dark Misfortune—compete to toy with mortal fates. Enchant your living cards, combine their destinies, and make secret wagers to determine whether your mortals experience delightful serendipity or become unwitting characters in wickedly amusing catastrophes — always in perfect rhyme!

“Where mortal fates take wicked swings,
You choose which fairy pulls the strings!”
FEATURES
Cosmic Tug-of-War — Shift mortal fates between delightful fortune and wicked misfortune.
Freely Combine Cards — Experiment with card combinations to discover 400+ hand-crafted micro-stories.
Dual-Outcome Narratives — Each micro-story concludes differently depending on the winning fairy.
Rhymes & Mischief — Every fate revealed through playful verses, making mischief deliciously poetic.
Simple Rules, Strategic Bets — Easy-to-learn mechanics with secretive wagers to tip fate's scales.
Reactive Ambience — Background hues and music dynamically shift with each fairy's triumph.
Cute Shadow Puppets — Adorable silhouetted characters in charming shadow theater aesthetics.
Quick Duels, Solo or Multiplayer — Short, narrative-rich matches playable alone or with a friend.
Whimsy & Wickedness — Equal parts cute and macabre, balancing playful charm with dark humor.
“Fortune's kiss, Misfortune's curse,
Who gets to write the final verse?”

title: Phantom Necro
description:
게임 정보
팬텀 네크로 | Phantom Necro
죽음을 지배하라, 영혼을 소환하라!
『팬텀 네크로』는 강대한 세력들이 충돌하는 세계에서, 한 네크로맨서가 자신만의 군단을 이끌고 최강의 자리를 향해 나아가는 전략 RPG입니다.
소울을 모아 전설의 팬텀을 소환하고, 전장을 뒤흔들 스쿼드를 구성하세요. 당신의 선택과 전략이 세계의 판도를 바꿉니다.
소환 시스템 | Summoning System
소울을 모아 다양한 팬텀을 소환하고, 당신만의 군대를 구축하세요.
스쿼드 시스템 | Squad System
팬텀을 스쿼드에 배치해 전황을 장악하세요.
전투 | Combat

title: Get Out Of The Woods
description:
게임 정보
가족과 꿈 사이에서 선택을 해본 적이 있나요? 만약 이 둘이 서로 충돌한다면 어떻게 하시겠습니까? 작은 암탉 클로코의 가족을 만나보고, 누구를 믿고 누구를 피해야 할지 직접 결정하세요. 아니면 첫인상이 속일지도 모릅니다.
오래된 비밀을 조사하거나 농장에서 단순히 산책을 즐기세요. 하지만 당신의 모든 선택은 가족의 세심한 주시를 받게 됩니다. 진정으로 소유하지 못하는 찰나의 자유를 느껴보세요.
사람들은 항상 남의 떡이 더 커 보인다고 말하지만, 낯선 숲에서는 자신을 잃지 않는 것이 가장 중요합니다. 작은 새가 할 수 있는 일은 무엇일까요? 포식자를 길들이기? 순수한 생명을 구하기? 범죄를 해결하기? 하지만 기억하세요, 자신의 한계를 뛰어넘을 수는 없습니다.
Get Out Of The Woods는 많은 사람들에게 익숙한 사회적 갈등을 탐구하는 비선형 비주얼 노벨입니다. 이야기 속으로 빠져들고, 선택을 내리며, 캐릭터들과 공감하세요. 주의 깊게 살펴보세요. 비밀은 어디에나 존재하며, 모든 이가 자신만의 비밀을 가지고 있습니다!
게임은 3개의 챕터로 나뉘어 있습니다.
챕터 1
당신의 행동 하나하나가 주인공의 성격을 형성하며, 후속 챕터의 스토리 방향을 결정합니다. 그녀의 삶을 바꿀 첫 번째 갈등을 목격하고 그녀의 전략을 선택하세요: 외교 아니면 강요?
첫 번째 챕터에서 기대할 수 있는 것:
4개의 결말;
전투 시스템;
농장 지도 탐험;
독창적인 사운드트랙과 많은 일러스트.
챕터 2
이전에 내린 모든 결정이 두 번째 챕터에서 독특한 스토리를 만듭니다. 5개의 각기 다른 이야기를 탐험하세요! 클로코는 새로운 도전에 직면합니다: 자유의 대가를 배우고, 배신을 경험하며, 새로운 세계에서 누구를 믿을 수 있을지 결정해야 합니다. 매 순간이 결말에 결정적일 수 있습니다.
챕터 3
마지막 챕터는 긴장감 넘치는 결말로 이끕니다. 여기서 주인공은 자신의 행동 결과와 맞닥뜨리고, 자신의 한계를 넘으려 노력합니다. 이 챕터는 클로코가 조화를 찾고, 정의를 실현하며, 자신의 자리를 찾을 수 있을지 아니면 꿈을 위해 큰 대가를 치르게 될지를 묻습니다.

title: Kungfu2
description:
게임 정보
This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as kungfus with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of kungfus and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!
Each level is only 30 seconds, and ordinary levels quickly kill enemies to accumulate resources, and boss levels!
Multiple character kungfus characteristics
Sword Immortal, God of Wealth, Scholar... Each character has its own characteristics. Switch characters, explore completely different fighting styles, and find your destiny kungfus!
Bond kungfus system
After each level, choose randomly refreshed kungfus and props, activate dozens of bond effects, and each game is a unique growth path!
Sword system + Kongtong School = Blade of Fire!
Sword system + Fist system = High attack speed + True damage = Meat shield nemesis!
The more you fight, the stronger you become, and the more you grow
Killing monsters will drop gold coins and experience, and strengthen your attack, attack speed, critical strike and other attributes in real time! The difficulty of the levels rises step by step. Can your construction defeat the final boss?
Gameplay highlights
Short, flat and fast game: 15 minutes to complete a single game, and you can complete it in a few minutes when you turn on the double speed!
Strategic depth: The kungfus fetters require delicate calculations. Is it mindless shopping? Or operating the economy? In "Kungfu2", every decision is a gamble to live and die.
—— Today, can you rewrite the limits of kungfus within 30 seconds? ——

title: Unprotected
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에서 우리의 주요 목표는 과학자를 찾아 그에게서 정보를 얻는 것입니다. 그러나 우리는 과학자가 발생한 사건으로 인해 사망했을 것으로 의심하고 그가 단서를 남겼기를 바라며 모험을 계속합니다.
당신의 유일한 희망은 그가 자신이 만든 악을 파괴하는 해독제를 남겼다는 것입니다. 이 모험에서 당신은 인류를 구하려고 노력하면서 다양한 퍼즐, 공포 및 액션 요소를 경험하게 될 것입니다.

title: Third Shift
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT
Third Shift is the first ever hybrid, point-and-click, survival horror video game, to take place in a pharmacy.

title: Price of a life
description:
게임 정보
Price of a Life is a unique, single-player experience blending intense bullet-hell gameplay with strategic micromanagement. Set in a hedonistic world, you must compete fiercely to earn the favor of the enigmatic deity, Sacrion.
Survive Sacrion's Trials: Navigate chaotic trials filled with relentless enemies and lethal projectiles. Combine quick reflexes and strategic planning to adapt and survive, proving yourself worthy of Sacrion's attention.
Innovative Gameplay: Control multiple elements simultaneously, blending precision mouse and keyboard controls with tactical decision-making. Balance managing characters, dodging bullet storms, and maintaining order.
Guide Your Team: Lead two brave boys through perilous dangers, with strategic support from a wise monk whose advice might just be your lifeline.
Stunning Art & Original Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-drawn art style complemented by an original soundtrack that brings Sacrion's treacherous world vividly to life.
Challenge Awaits: Face varied and unpredictable obstacles and fierce enemies. Do you have what it takes to conquer the trials, impress Sacrion, and voice your ultimate wish?
Embrace chaos, manage carefully, and discover if the price of a life is one you're willing to pay.

title: DreamBreaker
description:
게임 정보
DreamBreaker is a turn-based card-based building game with rogue.
The Demon Lord is awakening, and you must find the Demon Lord's hiding place and improve yourself as much as you can within a limited time, sealing it again before it fully regains its challenge after challenge, you collect scattered memories and find the truth of this world!
In each game, you can choose different companions and exploration routes to find different skills and items. Experience the ever-changing world of building through different combinations!
Dual-skill cards
Each card can be equipped with 2 skills, and choose 1 of them to cast when played. Think and make choices based on the battle situation
Time-Order
Planned skills will be resolved sequentially during the action phase. Acting before or after the enemy is also part of the strategy!
Hero Team
Choose 1 main attack and 2 support characters for each game. Different fighting styles, and wonderful combinations create wonderful sparks!
Choose Route
The ultimate goal is to defeat the Demon Lord. There are no prescribed game routes, so you can freely choose the map you want to explore, so that every adventure and every build is different!
Boss Fights
Dozens of well-choreographed boss fights. Test your build to be up to the task! And bosses have their own unique loots to enrich your build!
The awakened Demon Lord
The Demon Lord gradually becomes stronger with time. Spend less time facing weaker demon lords, or spend more time becoming stronger yourself!

title: Dragons Reef VR
description:
게임 정보
안녕하세요, 모험가 여러분!
가상 현실에서 드래곤 리프 세계로 신나는 여정을 시작하세요. 8명의 선장 중 한 명을 선택하고 나만의 배를 타고 드래곤, 해적, 다양한 바다 생물, 그리고 골드로 가득한 판타지 세계로 떠나보세요. 각 선장은 고유한 기술을 보유하고 있어 특정 임무에서 유리한 고지를 점할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터의 스킬은 더욱 높은 레벨로 발전시킬 수 있습니다.
드래곤스 리프 VR은 다음과 같은 다채로운 액션 게임입니다.
배를 타고 상품을 배달하는 가상 현실 체험
해적으로부터 자신을 방어하는 화려한 해상 전투
도둑을 쫓는 스릴 넘치는 추격전
상대의 방어막을 무력화하기 위해 점령 지점을 점령하고 사수해야 하는 역동적인 게임 플레이
해적들이 막으려는 동안 아군 함선을 목적지까지 호위하는 모험
해적 구조물을 파괴하는 만족스러운 게임 플레이
최대한 많은 에너지 통을 기지로 가져와야 하는 민첩성과 집중력이 요구되는 게임
해적 역할을 맡을 수 있는 두 개의 특별 레벨
여러 번 플레이할 수 있는 10개의 긴 레벨, 매번 플레이할 때마다 약간씩 다른 게임 플레이
24개의 특별한 유물

title: Schizophrenia
description:
게임 정보
Schizophrenia is a psychological survival horror.

You don't remember anything. You have to survive in the bunker in order to get out of it. Look for and use all the items that come your way.
The bunker can be dangerous. Who knows who might even be there.

FEATURES:

Growing horror
While in this bunker you begin to go crazy. You feel like someone is watching you. Strange sounds are constantly heard.
Something needs to be done to avoid going crazy. Find the pills. Or at least eat right.

Bunker
The bunker is equipped with a water supply system and electricity supply. But the lights begin to flicker. The hike will have to refuel the generator. The water stopped flowing. The water supply system may need to be repaired.

Nightmares and dreams
At night you can dream about a lot of different things. Sometimes these are strange and incomprehensible dreams that look like memories. Sometimes these are terrible nightmares that only make your condition worse. Try to control yourself and at such moments remember something with the help of dreams, find useful information for yourself that you have forgotten.



Could the inhabitants of the bunker be dangerous? What can you generally expect from them? It’s better for me to get around them or better find weapons for protection.
Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

title: Hydro
description:
게임 정보
Realistic simulation of a 1930s-era vintage hydro-electric power station
Interact with vintage machinery and manage your fatigue levels - across day and night shifts
React to varying demands for township power and get rewards (or not)
Order supplies, monitor reserves and maintain oil levels and fuses
Research and apply at least a dozen unique upgrades to enhance the power station
Reputation system - your actions can have long-lasting effects!
House-keeping requirements - wipe-up oil stains, clean windows and graffiti
Contend with multiple auditors who will occasionally visit and check your performance
Almost endlessly-varied game play and multiple game-ending events
WELCOME TO HYDRO!
Get-to-grips with vintage machinery from yesteryear! 
The local township has directed old No. 101 Hydro-electric Power Station be pressed back into duty and you're the sole custodian for the job!
Keep your wits: not only generating power quietly, without blowing fuses or starting fires, but also managing and maintaining your power station's supply levels (e.g. gear oil, fuses, battery acid) to keep it running smoothly.
You'll also need to manage your fatigue levels and work efficiently to stay profitable and keep your funding levels in the green - or risk shutdown by the township's council.
WHEN THE RIVER IS WILD...
Generate power day and night so long as the river is flowing fast.  Your main goal in Hydro is to generate electricity for the Township whilst dealing with obstacles that come your way.
Work both day and night shifts, encounter unique events and township power demands based on the time of day.

title: Wander Stars
description:
게임 정보
Join Ringo, a young martial artist looking for her brother, and Wolfe, a mysterious scoundrel running from his past, as they join forces in an unlikely partnership to collect the pieces of the fabled Wanderstar Map. Across 10 “episodes” of anime-inspired adventure, Ringo and Wolfe will have to work together to find answers, make up for past mistakes, and travel across the universe in search of their goal. And who knows, maybe they’ll learn how to get along at some point!
Trained in the ways of Kiai, a magical form of martial art and also the universe’s most exciting form of televised entertainment, Ringo can combine words to create customized attacks in intense turn-based battles. During her race across the universe you’ll expand Ringo’s vocabulary, equip Pep Up bonuses earned through honorable victories and level up her spirit power. Defeat or befriend a cast of fearsome space pirates, mysterious scoundrels, cute witches, high school delinquents, talking crows, and skilled martial artists on your way to becoming a Kiai master.

title: 9 Souls
description:
게임 정보
9 Souls:
You wake up after a car crash—or at least, you think you do. The world around you feels familiar, yet something is off. Every room seems to repeat, and yet there's always a difference. A flaw. An anomaly.
In each section, you're given three paths. Only one is free of distortion. Choose correctly, and you save a soul. But with every step forward, a growing unease creeps in—something fundamental doesn’t add up. The rooms shift, and your perception grows increasingly unreliable.
What’s really going on here?
The game offers no clear answers—not right away. Maybe never. Only at the end do the pieces begin to form a picture… or do they?
Features:
🔍 Mystery Horror: Pay close attention—tiny details can mean the difference between salvation and madness.
🔀 Three paths—only one right: Spot the anomaly to proceed.
🧩 Exploration with purpose: Each correct choice rescues a lost soul.
Find the right path. Save what can still be saved.
And ask yourself: What if you’re never meant to see the truth?

title: The Last King
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey to ancient Greece in The Last King, an immersive open world survival game. As a courageous warrior, you must navigate a war-ravaged land teeming with enemies, including Persians, barbarians, and untamed wilderness. Forge your own destiny as you build a formidable base, recruit a mighty army, and liberate Greek villages from the clutches of oppression.
Key Features:
Rebuild your kingdom

The great Persian force have destroyed you, your army, your morale and your kingdom. Rebuild your kingdom brick by brick and see the citizens growing once more.
Build resource gathering stations and create jobs in your kingdom.
Battle Against Fierce Foes:
Engage in intense combat against a diverse range of enemies. From relentless Persian forces to brutal barbarian tribes, every encounter is a test of skill and strategy. Command your army with precision, employing a variety of tactics and formations to outmaneuver and overpower your adversaries.

title: The Warrior
description:
게임 정보
The Warrior is an adventure, and platformer game that explores the perspective of multiple protagonists, all intertwined in a single, grand story.
Control multiple characters
Each character wants to be the star of their own adventure. By taking control of each one, you'll discover that the villain and the hero are simply a matter of perspective.
Face challenges
In addition to unique abilities, each character carries their own difficulties and obstacles. Overcoming them will require thinking outside the box.
Explore the world
Dive into a universe full of details and secrets. Explore the environment, meet unique creatures, and decipher ancient runes.
Encounter unique and charismatic characters throughout your journey and understand their motivations and desires.
Terrifying creatures of unimaginable size await you underground. Defeating them won’t be an easy task.
Piece together fragments of the story from each character’s perspective through dialogues and ancient ruins. Can you uncover the truth?

title: Unto the Aurora
description:
게임 정보
THIS GAME CONTAINS MULTIPLE INSTANCES OF FLASHING IMAGES.
1597. North East Scotland. Accused of witchcraft and sentenced to death, with the help of a mysterious entity you escape a brutal fate by setting sail across a harazardous ocean passage towards a reported safe haven.
From Arboreta Games (solo developer of The Black Iris and It Sleeps Below the Haar), Unto the Aurora is a short historical game, with a focus on: atmosphere, exploration and emotion. Players will be responsible for navigating and steering their ship, as well as ensuring they survive the passage without freezing or starving.
Setting
Set at the tale end of the 16th century, during the height of Scotland's witchcraft panics, the world of Unto the Aurora is heavily inspired by: folklore, historical manuscripts and scholarship on the period, whilst adding in elements of fantasy and horror.
Key Features
Realistic Sailing - Experience a physics-based sailing system where wind, waves, currents and buoancy are all simulated to provide a realistic sailing experience
Survive the Crossing - Defend yourself against starvation and cold during your crossing by: warming yourself by your stove, minimising exposure to the elements and fishing.

title: Ikarus Parkour
description:
게임 정보
엘리트들이 왜곡된 오락을 위해 주최하는 치명적인 게임 쇼를 배경으로 한 몰입감 있는 정밀한 3D 플랫포머입니다. 자원해서 참가한 참가자들은 알 수 없는 장소 깊은 지하에 묻힌 850미터 높이의 수직 타워로 이동됩니다.
하드 모드 - 체크포인트 없음, 스피드런 타이머 있음
캐주얼 모드 - 체크포인트 많음, 타이머 없음

title: SCP
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "SCP," an intense open-world survival-craft experience set in a post-apocalyptic realm where the enigmatic SCP entities roam freely. Brace yourself for a relentless struggle for survival as you navigate through a desolate landscape filled with anomalies.
**EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD:** Explore a dynamic world, where each corner holds dangers and resources.

title: Over Engineered
description:
게임 정보
Over Engineered is an idle strategy game that encourages construction of complex machines. Using limited space, money, and power; you must build complex contraptions to bring a ball from its spawn, to its goal. The longer each ball takes, the more money you make in return.
Machine Parts:
Unlock new machine parts to build more complex contraptions. Give each item a whirl and see what new creations you can bring into your game.

title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보


A small accident occurred in the laboratory last month, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a mos? A mos is a bigger version of a mosquito which was accidentally made by humans. They are not ten cm tall, not even 30 cm, but over one meter tall! It seems that these creatures want to reproduce, therefore they are looking for blood. That is the reason why there are many reports of people going missing. At first, we thought mos would become extinct in the first week. But we were wrong. Now they are everywhere and the number of missing people keeps rising.

An emergency signal has been broadcasted. The AAS team received the signal and are here to take action. They said that they have found a way to stop this apocalypse and that there is no need to send more troops. It seems that every member of AAS has a mission. They said that once all missions have been completed, the apocalypse will end once and for all.

This game consists of two game modes: single player and co-op.
On single player mode: grab a weapon, exterminate all mos, and complete the mission!
On co-op mode: pick your weapons and perks, think of a strategy, and survive endless waves of mos.

title: Sands of Hope
description:
게임 정보
A little game about exploring a desert and restoring its water flow... Among other things!
Discover this open world and uncover the secrets of Cydonia's Village. Collect Energy Cores with the help of a loyal companion to restore water to the desert and meet villagers along the way.

title: Idle Adventurer
description:
게임 정보
Become an adventurer and slay your way through infinite stages of enemies in this idle action RPG. Work your way through the hoards of creatures and beasts in order to bring back the glory to your village.
There's over 50 unique monsters with different variants and appearances to match each and every environment in which you will encounter them in. Paired with 25 different bosses and super bosses, you'll have your favorite monster to slay in no time!
Collect different armor and weapon sets in order to gain stat set bonus effects and other lucrative bonuses to help you along your journey.
Can't play the game all day? Then don't worry! Your progress will continue whilst you are offline, and you will come back to a whole host of loot and items when you make your return to vanquish more foes!

title: Sizzle & Stack
description:
게임 정보
서둘러 서빙하세요! 손님들은 기다려주지 않아요! 재료를 빠르게 드래그하고, 센스 있게 조합해 매일매일 새로운 도전을 즐겨보세요. 당신만의 카드덱을 열어 이상적인 주방을 만들고, 장비를 업그레이드하며 최고의 요리로 손님들의 입맛을 사로잡으세요. 진정한 요리왕의 전설이 지금 시작됩니다!
카드를 열고 주방 도구와 재료를 정성스럽게 배치하세요. 전통 레시피를 따를지, 과감하게 새로운 맛을 조합할지 모두 당신의 선택! 오늘의 셰프 스페셜, 당신의 센스에 달려 있습니다.
평범한 칼을 최고급 셰프 나이프로, 작은 작업대를 화려한 주방으로! 더 많은 카드, 더 다채로운 조합, 더 빠른 서빙 속도까지—작은 식당이 미슐랭 3스타의 꿈을 이루는 순간을 함께하세요!

title: Atollo
description:
게임 정보
Set sail into the unknown in Atollo, a vibrant, pixel-art sea adventure where every journey is unique. Explore a shifting archipelago, meet goofy island dwellers, and battle rival ships to collect five magical eggs - your only key to awakening the kraken at the heart of the map.
FEATURES
🗺️ Ever-changing map
Explore a procedurally generated archipelago - no two voyages are the same.
🚢 Fast-paced naval combat
Face off against enemy ships in tight, tactical battles on the open sea.
🌴 Bizarre island encounters
Visit 5 random islands per run and meet one of 24 whimsical characters - from moons with sunglasses to haunted coffee pots.
🥚 The egg hunt begins
Earn magical eggs from the islanders. Collect all five to summon your final challenge.
🐙 Face the kraken
Unlock the center of the map and confront a colossal sea beast in a thrilling endgame battle.
📸 Progress artwork
After each run, view a unique scene featuring the characters you’ve met - and silhouettes for those yet to be found.
A GAME MADE WITH PICO-8
Atollo is a standalone desktop release built entirely in Pico-8, a fantasy console for tiny retro games. Development on Pico-8 is a celebration of creative constraints, compact code, and playful design - and it’s free to play.
ABOUT THE DEVELOPER
Hello ! I'm Alberto and I'm a solo developer with a passion for expressive games :)) Atollo was created from start to finish by me, from the design and code to the art and audio, as a personal challenge and a way to grow as a game maker.
I’m releasing Atollo for free with the goal of sharing something fun, goofy and replayable, while building a portfolio that can help me take the next step into the game development industry.
If you enjoyed the game or have any feedback, I’d love to hear from you! :))

title: Bobbies Evolution
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the chaos of civilisation.
Race wars, political coups, and full-blown riots, it’s all part of the simulation. Citizens aren’t just peaceful little people anymore. They can protest, become radical, or turn your city into ashes overnight. Will you rule with mercy or crush anyone against you?
Power-hungry politicians will fight for control.
They’ll demand new laws, more freedom, or worse, total dominance. Will you bend to their will, or erase them from existence so they never rise again?
Implement laws, taxes, and policies.
You are their leader. Their president. Their god. Keep them happy or face mass unrest. Angry mobs will come for your throne if you ignore their cries.
The Bobbies
Every citizen race is bobbies, they call themself bobbies and you will too. Every little citizen will have their own feelings, and act based on those feelings. they will also learn by making choices, either bad or guilty.
But beware.
If the Bobbies ever realise it’s a simulation… things might get weird. They’ll question everything, including you. Will you guide them with kindness, or show them who’s really in control?
The danger around the corner.
If a pandemic breaks out… everything can spiral. Fear spreads faster than the virus. Citizens will panic, isolate, rebel, or blame you. Will you cure the disease and restore order, or let nature take its course and watch who survives?
Key Features:
▪ God Simulator – Rule with unlimited power. No mana, no cooldowns, only consequences.
▪ Deep Society Simulation – Citizens have emotions, needs, and beliefs. One upset Bobby can trigger a revolution.
▪ Dynamic Politics – Watch kingdoms rise and fall. Support a side or let the world burn.
▪ Racial Conflict – Prejudice and hate can divide your world, or you can fight it with unity and hope.
▪ Trade & Enchantment – Collect, sell, and enchant Bobbies. Each one brings something new to your society.

title: RnGesus Slayer
description:
게임 정보
《RnGesus Slayer》: 《Slay the Spire》와 슬롯머신이 만났다!
《RnGesus Slayer》는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임으로, 3개의 개별 덱을 가지고 있으며, 카드는 슬롯머신을 돌려서 배치됩니다!
같은 유형의 카드가 맞으면 콤보가 발동하여 강화된 카드로 변합니다.

title: Yokai Tales
description:
게임 정보
세 마리 너구리 형제와 함께 밝고 경쾌하면서도 전략적인 모험을 떠나세요.
"공허"라고 불리는 신비한 힘이 대지를 침식시키며 요괴들을 적으로 변하게 하고 있습니다. 너구리 형제들과 힘을 합쳐 공허를 막고 그 정체를 밝혀내세요.

title: Shattered Soul
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Shattered Soul is a modern game that interprets Beat'em up by adding the fun with a charming narrative based on Metroidvania-styled epic action. Explore a fantastic world that intersects medieval Europe, follow stories of adventure in search of lost soul and bodies.
You become 'Ireth' and venture out looking for her lost memories. She explores the forests, cathedrals, and snowy villages of the border area, and battles enemies by using various techniques against bandits, fanatics, demonized humans and mutant animals. 'Ireth' discovers secrets all over the continent to find her soul with shattered sword 'Bias'.
As you hack-and-slash your way across town - either solo or with a friend in local co-op - you'll gain new skills, chow down on power-ups, wield an assortment of weapons, and unleash an arsenal of combos, throws, and special combat moves for both fighting enemies and platforming challenges
Key Features
Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
Tightly tuned 2D controls. Dodge, dash, and slash your way through over 24 enemies and 6 epic bosses. Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the lost kingdom.
Five large city regions to fight through, complete with shops and side quests.
An expansive world filled with unique dungeons, quests, and secrets.
All in classic hand-painted original 2D drawings.

title: Potato Cop
description:
게임 정보
Potato Cop is an action game with a straightforward and simple playstyle. Armed with just your potato-peeler, melee your way through and take out enemies as you dodge attacks of different types from flying projectiles to blazing flame trails. Prove yourself to be the best cop and clear the enemies faster against the timer.

title: Jar Head Cauldron
description:
게임 정보
Defeat enemies with enchanted weapons crafted using your cauldron featuring “in world crafting” to upgrade items, weapons and keys to help you save all 13 members of your coven. As you progress you will unlock the secrets of the other side. Find and harvest required occulted items to complete the necromantic ritual to save your coven.
Completing The Ritual
Find and save your lost covens jared heads from a cult of black magic users
Gather required body parts from fallen enemies to build your covens new bodies 
Collect and craft the skulls required to initiate the ritual
Proform the ritual and protect your coven as they pass back through to our world
Gameplay Features and Modes
"American Magic" Crafting tree will include 17th century to early 20th century gunpowder weapons
"Occult" Crafting tree will only include primitive gunpowder weapons a focus on melee and magic. 
Features
In depth in world crafting with the use of the cauldron
Fight waves of enemies and crawl dungeons
Action is broken up with crafting, collecting and looting, puzzles and exploration at your own risk.
Occulted crafting tree that must be discovered through trial and error
Controls FPS, Drag and drop items, Craft, Loot

title: Voyagers of Nera
description:
게임 정보
Voyagers of Nera는 고대 유적과 다양한 생태계로 가득한 광활한 바다를 배경으로 한 최대 10명이 즐길 수 있는 협동 생존 제작 게임입니다. Nera는 아름다움과 마법, 그리고 위험이 가득한 마법의 해양 세계입니다. 당신은 이 세계의 오래 전 멸종된 수호자들의 후손인 에코입니다. 당신은 바다를 항해하고, 심해의 괴물들을 물리치고, 영원히 사라지기 전에 영혼들을 깨워야 합니다.
바다로 항해하세요
함께 협력하여 멀리 있는 섬으로 항해하거나 파도를 가르며 서핑하세요. 수면 아래로 잠수하여 희귀한 자원과 숨겨진 보물을 찾으세요. 하지만 심해에 잠복해 있는 것들을 조심하세요...
마법의 해양 세계에서 생존하세요
쓰러진 거상 주위에 형성된 군도나 하늘까지 솟아오른 산호 절벽과 같은 환상적인 생태계로 여행을 떠나세요. 생존하기 위해서는 강력한 해변 기지를 건설하고, 새로운 무기를 제작하고, 파도 위아래에서 괴물들과 싸우면서 강력한 자연의 영혼들을 깨워야 합니다.

title: Heroes Against Time
description:
게임 정보
Build the Perfect Team
Each party member has different abilities, synergies and choices in events
However, draft carefully: because without knowing how to scale your team to victory, you'll end up as a yummy snack for the bigger threats which lurk further within the woods...
Easy to Learn, Hard to Master
Simple mechanics combine into satisfying and deep game design, perfectly scratching that itch of watching numbers grow while your party powers up throughout their adventure.
Play At Your Own Pace
Runs can be as quick and snappy as you wish once you get used to the game (about 10 minutes long for veteran players), the game turn-based nature of the game also lets you choose to take your time and make the perfect decision—or read carefully and savor the writing.

title: One Last Clip
description:
게임 정보
낯선 영화관의 창고에서 정신을 차렸지만, 어떻게 왔는지 기억나지 않습니다. 벽에는 탈출 방법이 적힌 안내판이 있습니다. 지시를 따르지 않으면 영원히 갇히게 됩니다.
당신의 임무는 간단합니다: 결함이 있는 필름을 골라내는 일입니다.
상영관에 들어가 자리를 잡고 영화 클립을 보세요. 본 후 두 출구 중 하나를 선택하세요 - 정상 클립과 결함 클립 각각에 대응하는 출구입니다. 0관에 도달할 때까지 이 과정을 반복하세요. 하지만 잘못 선택하면 처음으로 돌아갑니다.
영화관에서 이상하거나 소름 끼치는 일이 생길 수 있습니다. 신경 쓰지 마세요. 그저 집중을 방해하려는 것뿐입니다.
이 게임은 Exit 8, The Cabin Factory, False Mall과 유사한 분위기의 변칙점 찾기 경험을 제공하지만 독특한 변주가 있습니다. 방을 검사하는 대신, 짧은 영화 클립을 반복해 보며 결함을 찾아내야 합니다. 상영관은 가끔 변화할 수 있지만, 이는 당신의 판단에 영향을 주어선 안 됩니다.
경미한 공포 요소와 영화관에 어울리는 변칙점들이 포함되어 있습니다. 모든 결함 클립을 찾아내어 사이클을 완료하거나 게임 전체를 클리어하세요.

title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
description:
게임 정보
◆내용 설명
"인연"의 칼날로 악귀를 멸하라!
카마도 탄지로의 전투가 가정용 게임으로 다시 막을 올린다―――



【솔로 플레이 모드 -히노카미 혈풍담-: 애니메이션 '귀멸의 칼날' 세 편의 이야기를 체험!】
카마도 탄지로가 걸어온 이야기를 게임으로 체험하자.
TV 애니메이션 '귀멸의 칼날' 에서 '환락의 거리편', '도공 마을편', '합동 강화 훈련편' 의 에피소드를 수록!
탄지로와 동료들의 앞을 가로막는 상현 혈귀들에 맞서 함께 싸우자!



【버서스 모드 -대전-: 주, 집결】
귀살대 최고 계급인 검사 '주' 9명을 포함해 40명 이상의 캐릭터가 참전!
전작에 이어 '합체 오의'와 '장비'라는 신규 요소도 추가!
온라인 대전과 오프라인 대전을 통해 새로운 경지에 도달하자!



◆일반판 구성
-귀멸의 칼날 히노카미 혈풍담2　게임 본편
-플레이어블 캐릭터 조기 해방권 '귀멸 학원·렌고쿠 쿄쥬로', '귀멸 학원·우즈이 텐겐'

◎저장 데이터 연동 특전
동일한 플랫폼의 『귀멸의 칼날 히노카미 혈풍담』 및 『귀멸의 칼날: 도전, 최강의 대원!』의 저장 데이터를 소지한 고객님께서는 아래의 특전이 증정됩니다.
-『귀멸의 칼날 히노카미 혈풍담』 저장 데이터 특전:
플레이어블 캐릭터 조기 해방권 '귀멸 학원·카마도 탄지로', '귀멸 학원·카마도 네즈코', '귀멸 학원·아가츠마 젠이츠', '귀멸 학원·하시비라 이노스케', '귀멸 학원·토미오카 기유', '귀멸 학원·코쵸우 시노부'
-『귀멸의 칼날: 도전, 최강의 대원!』 저장 데이터 특전:
플레이어블 캐릭터 조기 해방권 '히나츠루·마키오·스마'
게임 내 의상 조기 해방권 '히나츠루·마키오·스마【옷(식사 준비)】'

※플레이어블 캐릭터 조기 해방권은 버서스 모드에서 기재된 캐릭터를 처음부터 플레이할 수 있는 특전입니다.
※게임 내 의상은 버서스 모드에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
※"대전" 내 시스템 보이스는 '대전' 모드 내에서 설정할 수 있습니다(예: '시작', '거기까지' 등).
※저장 데이터 연동 특전은 동일한 플랫폼에서만 적용하실 수 있습니다.
※온라인 기능을 이용하기 위해서는 최신 패치가 적용되어 있어야 합니다.
※내용 및 사양은 예고 없이 일부 변경될 수 있습니다.
※다운로드판 특전은 영구 부여되는 특전입니다.
※특전은 추후 별도로 배포될 수도 있습니다.
※한국에서 구매하신 제품은 한국어 자막만 지원됩니다.
한국 외의 지역에서 구매한 제품은 아래의 자막을 지원합니다.
(일본어, 영어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 독일어, 스페인어, 중국어 간체자, 중국어 번체자)
※스토어 내에서 사용 중인 캐릭터 비주얼은 개발회사인 주식회사 사이버 커넥트 2(CyberConnect2)가 게임 내의 3D 모델을 바탕으로 작성한 비주얼입니다.
