title: Autumn Waifu
description:
게임 정보
Autumn Waifu 게임으로 퍼즐과 애니메이션의 미학이 어우러진 매혹적인 세계에 푹 빠져보세요! 퍼즐과 애니메이션 애호가를 위한 특별한 게임으로, 여름 분위기와 매력적인 캐릭터들을 만나볼 수 있습니다.
게임 특징
독특한 퍼즐로 가득한 30개의 레벨
각 레벨은 가을 테마로 제작된 새로운 애니메이션 소녀들의 이미지를 제공합니다. 소녀들의 아름다움과 매력을 하나하나씩 발견해 나가야 합니다. 레벨이 올라갈수록 난이도가 높아지므로, 퍼즐 초보자와 숙련된 퍼즐 애호가 모두에게 흥미로운 게임입니다.
완성된 퍼즐 갤러리
완성된 각 퍼즐은 갤러리에 저장되어 언제든지 진행 상황을 확인할 수 있습니다. 갤러리는 아름다운 일러스트 컬렉션으로 구성되어 계속해서 감상할 수 있습니다.
업적 시스템
성공에 대한 보상을 받으세요! 게임의 모든 레벨 완료 등 다양한 과제를 완료하세요. 업적은 동기 부여를 높이고 성공에 대한 자부심을 느끼게 해 줍니다.
간단하고 직관적인 조작법
이 게임은 사용자 친화적인 인터페이스를 갖추고 있습니다. 퍼즐 조각을 원하는 위치에 끌어다 놓기만 하면 됩니다!
가을 분위기와 애니메이션의 아름다움
화려한 그래픽, 밝은 캐릭터, 그리고 가을 분위기는 게임에서 보내는 시간을 잊지 못하게 만들어 줄 것입니다. 각 애니메이션 소녀는 독특하고 개성이 넘치며, 이는 조립 과정을 더욱 흥미진진하게 만들어 줍니다.
누구를 위한 게임인가요?
Autumn Waifu는 퍼즐, 애니메이션, 그리고 편안한 게임을 좋아하는 모든 사람에게 완벽한 선택입니다. 즐거운 시간을 보내고 싶은 플레이어와 자신의 실력을 시험하고 새로운 경지에 도달하고 싶은 플레이어 모두에게 적합합니다.
Autumn Waifu에서 퍼즐을 수집하고, 업적을 달성하고, 매력적인 애니메이션 일러스트 컬렉션을 만들어 보세요!

title: Ascend
description:
게임 정보
진실을 밝히다
Ascend는 3인칭 어드벤처 퍼즐 게임으로, 한 젊은 여성이 신비로운 산 정상에 올라 그 비밀을 알아내고 자신의 민족의 땅을 조화로운 상태로 회복시켜야 합니다. 퍼즐, 자연의 경이로움, 잃어버린 문명의 잔재, 천체와의 연결 등 이전에 시도했던 모든 사람들이 불가능하다고 판명된 여정을 떠나는 오로라를 기다리고 있습니다.
오로라는 산이 자신이 상상했던 것과는 전혀 다르다는 것을 금세 알아차립니다. 대답하기보다는 질문이 더 많을 것입니다. 명확한 방향보다는 흐릿한 판단이 더 많아집니다. 결국 그녀는 산 안팎의 모든 삶에서 균형이 얼마나 중요한 역할을 하는지 깨닫게 됩니다.
그녀가 단 한 가지 확신하는 것은 자신이 추구하는 것은 산 정상에 있다는 것입니다. 그녀는 반드시 등반해야 합니다.

title: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
description:
게임 정보
원작의 핵심은 그대로, 몰입 체험이 진화를 이룬다.
2004년 발매된 "METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER"를 원작으로 한 리메이크 작품.
원작의 스토리와 세계관은 그대로 유지되었으며, 최신 그래픽과 입체적인 사운드 표현으로 정글에서 펼쳐지는 궁극의 서바이벌 스텔스 액션을 즐길 수 있다.

모든 것의 발단이 된 냉전 하의 위기
냉전의 시대. Naked Snake, 훗날 "Big Boss"로 알려질 그는 과학자 Sokolov의 망명을 돕기 위해 소련으로 향한다. 하지만 Snake의 스승이자 특수 부대의 어머니로 불리던 군인 "The Boss"의 배신으로 임무는 실패, Sokolov는 GRU의 Volgin 대령의 손에 끌려가고 만다.
1주일 후, Snake는 Sokolov의 구출과 더 보스 암살 명령을 받고 또 다시 소련으로 떠난다.
끊임없이 변화하는 "시대(SENSE)"속에서, 전설의 기점이 되는 임무가 결행된다.

오리지널 매력 그대로 진화
스토리, 캐릭터, 보이스, 게임 플레이, 음악 등 원작이 가진 매력은 그대로, 최신 하드웨어에 맞춘 진화를 이룬 리메이크 작품. 세계 구석구석을 다시 만들어 모든 컷 장면에 새로운 생명이 불어넣어졌다.


미려한 그래픽으로 그려지는 세계
Unreal Engene 5를 채용해 광대한 스테이지를 최첨단 기술로 표현. 그 압권적인 그래픽으로 정글, 숲, 늪지대의 무성한 생태계도 고밀도의 디테일로 그려져 있다. 캐릭터도 주름이나 모공, 안구와 홍채와 같은 미세한 디테일을 포함시켜 리얼리티가 넘치는 표정을 구현하고 있다.



전투 피해 묘사가 진화하면서 옷의 찢김, 멍, 탄흔이 실시간으로 Snake의 몸에 표현된다. 옷은 갈아입어 변경을 할 수 있지만, 몸에 난 상처는 계속 남게 된다. 플레이어 개개인의 게임 플레이에 따라 Snake의 모습이 다양하게 변한다.



당시와 같은 플레이 감각으로 즐길 수 있는 오리지널 조작 방법과 더불어 새로운 게임에 익숙해진 세대를 위한 플레이 스타일도 채용. 심플하고 이해하기 쉬운 조작성으로 플레이에 대한 집중력을 높여 극한 환경에서의 짜릿한 서바이벌 체험을 즐길 수 있으며, 당시와 같은 플레이 감각으로 즐길 수 있는 플레이 스타일도 선택이 가능.
※추가 컨텐츠는 인터넷에 접속해 소프트를 업데이트하면 플레이하실 수 있습니다. 각 콘텐츠의 배포 시기에 대해서는 정해지는 대로 안내해 드리겠습니다.

・SNAKE VS MONKEY
이 모드에서는 Snake 역할을 하며, 각 단계에서 도망치는 탈출한 유인원들을 모두 모으자!


・FOX HUNT
게임 본편과 공통의 세계관으로 전개하는 완전 오리지널 온라인 대전 모드입니다. 스텔스 요소나 서바이벌 요소등을 구사한 ""숨바꼭질""에 가까운 전술을 즐기실 수 있습니다.


・Secret Theater
적병이 숨겨둔 8mm 필름을 입수함으로써 해금되는 즐거움 영상입니다. 오리지널 영상 외에도 신작 영상도 수록되어 있습니다.

And more…
autokwd: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER

title: The Knightling
description:
게임 정보
Sir Lionstone, the most powerful knight and protector of the great city of Clesseia, hasn’t returned from his latest quest. As Sir Lionstone’s trusted knightling, it is up to you and the legendary shield he left behind to become the hero the people need and find Lionstone before lurking threats endanger the realm. Explore the many regions and secrets of the lands of Clesseia, fend off bandits and monsters, and uncover the truth of the shield’s unparalleled power and the realm’s illustrious past.

All Heroes Start Small
Play as the Knightling, a knight-in-training whose loyalty and determination sets them off on a grand adventure to find their knight. With solely a shield in hand, you’ll utilize and upgrade your training and arsenal of abilities to overcome obstacles, help citizens and prove that you’re worthy of knighthood.



The Best Offense Is a Good Defense
Left with just Sir Lionstone’s shield, which contains a mysterious element called Callyrium, it is up to the Knightling to harness its power and become the next legendary hero. Leverage the shields natural defensive power to block, parry, and create ideal openings, then leverage big attacks and combos to finish off foes.




Set off on your adventure across multiple regions of Clesseia with the power of your shield to help you along! Traverse and platform to various areas to earn valuable praise used in upgrades, or use the shield’s various movement abilities to make getting around easier. Though probably beneath a legendary shield’s reputation, no one is stopping you from sliding all across the land!

title: Highway Builder
description:
게임 정보


Nowadays, one of the most important tasks in the field of infrastructure planning and construction is to create new highways that will connect people living far away from each other. In Highway Builder you will take control of a construction team that specializes in building highways, freeways or even complex and dangerous mountain roads. Together with your team, you will start your career by repairing local national roads to become popular and take orders all over the world. Your team will experience many adventures while travelling to the four corners of the world.

Highway Builder combines elements of a construction worker simulation and company management. After accepting the tasks, you will decide which machines and tools will be necessary during the construction, select the right professionals to the team and send them to the field. Depending on the mission you will need a completely different set of machines, equipment and specialists! Then, during the construction phase, you will take control over individual members of the construction team to perform specific tasks by yourself. Remember that each client expects high quality from you and allocates a specific budget to complete the work. Prove to him that it is possible to do the job well, fast and to not exceed the budget! After all, you are the professionals.

During the construction phase you will sit at the helm of various construction machines, from excavators and tippers to advanced soil stabilization machines, asphalt milling machines and many others. The Highway Builder offers a huge variety of real machines and tools to work with, and as your business grows, you'll get access to even more equipment to broaden your team's capabilities, allowing you to take on more and more complex tasks. Manage your orders skillfully, take care of your tools and work machines, appreciate your employees, and your company will gain global fame in no time at all!

MAIN FEATURES:
- Manage a construction company, take care of finances and make sure the machines are in good condition
- Choose the right tools and specialists for the job
- Go out into the field and take on the role of the workers
- Use a huge number of real construction machines and tools
- Grow your business to achieve global fame!

title: The Green Room Experiment
description:
게임 정보


The Green Room Experiment : Episode 3


Welcome to the captivating universe of "The Green Room Experiment," where the boundary between reality and illusion blurs. This immersive series delves into the mysteries of parapsychology and dreams. Each episode is a game in itself, you don't need to know the other episodes to play this one.

This exploration/puzzle game immerses you in a deep sleep where the unexpected becomes the norm. Observe, explore, and solve puzzles that will lead you to wake up.

This new chapter takes you into the dream of Zoran Cassidy. Dive into the heart of an enchanting and fantastical world where childhood memories, struggles, and the dreamer's history intertwine. Get ready for a unique gaming experience where the impossible becomes possible.

Are you ready to embark on this new mystery and uncover the secrets hidden in the corners of "The Green Room Experiment"?





A few years after World War II, Soviet scientists began experimenting with human beings to investigate the mysteries of parapsychology. One of these experiments, conducted by Dr. Igor Lumelius, consisted of putting guinea pigs, called butterflies, under hypnosis in order to lock them into a deep sleep. Patients, lost in the maze of their sleep, had to explore every corner of their own dreams in order to find their own way out, and thus be able to wake up. Each of these experiments, all conducted in the same room with dilapidated green walls, were recorded, transcribed and carefully archived.
Only a few years ago, the world learned of the existence of these experiment, and the entire archive was made available to the general public. This series of video games offers you to relive the experiment of the Green Room.



The Green Room Experiment is a first-person game that explores the world of dreams. Unravel the mysteries of this surreal exploration game and immerse yourself in a dreamlike, strange and solitary universe.

title: Aperture Dating Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Aperture Dating Simulator isn't your average fan-made Portal game...
Set in an alternate universe from the series that inspired it, APDS will introduce you to a new Aperture - one that seems a lot more... normal than the original. At first.
Take control of a manufacturing employee thrust out of their element and into maintenance, where you'll meet 8 brand-new personality cores, each with their own special little quirks. From level-headed supervisor Miss Esther to hot-tempered sports fanatic Rob, there's plenty of new "faces" to get to know.
Aperture Dating Simulator is fully voiced by a group of independent voice actors and programmed by a single developer. With 18 endings to discover and more than 30 cutscenes to unlock, there's a lot this little dating sim parody has to offer. Or so we hope.
What do you have to lose? Your dignity? If you're reading this, it's already gone.

title: WhamPunch 超能打
description:
게임 정보
WHAM! Punch enemies to the building and destroy it !
《WhamPunch》 is a first-person superpowered combat game that focuses on high-speed battles, environmental destruction, and uniquely designed levels.
GAME FEATURE
Fight using your fists—charge up your punches to send enemies flying with shockwaves and air pressure, creating exaggerated knockback effects. Smash them into buildings, causing massive explosions and large-scale environmental destruction.
Almost all enemies and NPCs can be punched into the air, and most buildings in the world can be destroyed—from streetlights and water towers to even skyscrapers and mountains.
SUPERPOWER BATTLE

title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance
description:
게임 정보
【디지털 디럭스 에디션 한정 예약 특전】
・최대 3일(72시간) 얼리 액세스

【예약 특전】
・예약 접수 중 10% OFF
・조 무사시 추가 의상 '오리지널 아케이드 의상' (게임 내 아이템)
・추가 부적 '축복' (게임 내 아이템)
※2025년 8월 29일 12:59(KST)까지 예약 구매 한 경우 본 특전이 동봉됩니다.
■게임 설명
히트작 「베어너클 4」의 개발 스튜디오가 선사하는 새로운 닌자 액션 게임. 복수심에 불타는 한 시노비의 서사가 핸드 드로잉 터치의 아트 스타일로 섬세하고 선명하게 그려진다.
■줄거리
시노비의 정점에 이른 닌자 '조 무사시'는 전소된 마을과 돌로 변한 동료들을 눈앞에서 목격하고 복수의 여정에 나선다. 거대한 악에 맞서 동료들의 원수를 갚기 위해서…
■시노비의 기술을 갈고닦아라
검과 쿠나이, 인술, 인법 그리고 조 무사시의 능력을 확장시키는 부적을 자유롭게 사용하여 적을 쓰러뜨려라. 상황에 따라 다양한 기술을 선택하고 자신만의 배틀 스타일로 콤보를 펼치자. 매끄럽고 약동감 있는 애니메이션과 속도감 넘치는 액션이 융합하여 유일무이한 통쾌함을 맛볼 수 있다.

군사 기지부터 작열하는 사막까지, 길을 떠난 조 무사시 앞에 펼쳐지는 각양각색의 스테이지. 수작업으로 밀도 있게 표현된 세계가 그의 여로를 물들인다.
또한, 도중에는 다양한 인술을 구사하여 눈앞의 난관을 극복하고 숨겨진 신규 루트를 발견하는 등, 만족스러운 플랫폼 액션도 즐길 수 있다.



※내용 및 사양은 예고 없이 변경될 수 있습니다.

title: WASTED Bloodline
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready to step into the raw and ruthless world of WASTED Bloodline, the new multiplayer video game that redefines the concept of pure adrenaline?
Developed with the incredible power of Unreal Engine 5.5, the most advanced graphics engine of the moment, the game offers an uncompromising experience and delivers a breathtaking visual spectacle where every detail, from the subtlest shadows to the conflict-ravaged landscapes, comes to life on screen.
WASTED Bloodline is a game that combines the best of competitive multiplayer and offline experiences, making it perfect for every type of player.
The game features multiple modes:
FREE FOR ALL
A competitive multiplayer mode where you can challenge your friends or others from around the world in a no-rules battle where every player fights for themselves.
DEFUSE OPS
The survivors plant explosive charges at key strategic points across the island.
Memento and his squads must move quickly to locate and defuse the bombs before they detonate.
Each round is a race against time where strategy, precision, and cold blood make the difference.
Plant, defend, defuse: every action can change the course of the battle.
NETWORK BREACH
In this game mode, your team must hack critical points across the map to gain control of the territory.
Each breached node brings your team closer to victory, while every lost point puts the entire operation at risk.
Challenge your opponents in a race against time, the team that hacks the most points before the clock runs out will win the match.
TEAM DEATHMATCH
Face off against the opposing team in a blood-soaked showdown where only one simple rule applies: The team that stays standing wins. 
GUN GAME

title: Sprunki Horror from the Loop
description:
게임 정보
Discover dark secrets in a mysterious visual novel mixed with rhythm game parts. Look around creepy places, talk to weird characters, and see scary visions. You must find the truth between bad dreams and real life.
In this game, you'll find:
A surprising story that reveals new sides of familiar characters
Beautiful, mysterious locations to explore
A special mix of visual novel and rhythm gameplay
Let the music guide your fate as you uncover the dark secrets of Sprunki. Every beat brings you closer to the truth, but be careful - the rhythm of your actions may lead to unexpected consequences. Can you find the right tempo to survive the ancient evil that lurks in this strange world?

title: The Tale of Relm
description:
게임 정보
The Tale of Relm is a captivating, story-rich JRPG that combines classic turn-based mechanics with strategic depth, offering players an immersive experience set in a richly detailed, handcrafted world. As you journey through diverse landscapes, you'll uncover hidden secrets and solve intricate puzzles reminiscent of early Zelda games.

At the heart of the game lies a compelling story that unfolds through the experiences of 10 unique playable characters, each with their own backstory, abilities, and strengths. Expressive, hand-drawn character busts bring these characters to life, adding emotional depth and making the dialogue more immersive.

The Tale of Relm's strategic combat system emphasizes careful planning and rewards you for discovering enemy weaknesses and breaking their shields before delivering the final blow. With over 200 unique enemies, each with distinct behaviors and strategies, every fight presents a new challenge. Unlike some traditional JRPGs, there are no random encounters; enemies are visible on the map, allowing you to choose when and how to engage.

As you explore the game’s world, you’ll find yourself drawn into its story through interactions with villagers, exploration of its villages, and the mysteries that lie hidden within its landscapes. Shops offer weapons and armor, each with its own strengths and weaknesses, while random villagers may provide useful tips or hints, further enriching the narrative experience.

The game also offers a flexible skill acquisition system, allowing you to customize your characters by obtaining skills in any order through a job point system. This flexibility enables unique and varied builds, giving you control over how your characters evolve throughout the game.

Strategic boss battles are another highlight, with each boss having a perfect strategy waiting to be uncovered. Success in these battles requires careful observation, tactical thinking, and a deep understanding of the game's mechanics, all within the context of its unfolding story.

Embark on an epic, story-rich journey filled with strategy, exploration, and discovery in The Tale of Relm, where every decision shapes your adventure and the narrative pulls you deeper into its world.

title: The Uncalled
description:
게임 정보
The Uncalled is about a young romantic shepherd who is not called to arms for the war against demons and monsters in the north of the territory, considering that he was unable to fight. However, witless enough, the enemy has already preferred the longer path and flocked around the town in the south, using the caves, lakes, ruins, dungeons under the mountains and swampy areas. Our protagonist is left alone with women, children, and animals to protect against the monsters and with lots of pain of being belittled by men of the locale as well as some young girls including his beloved one.
Game Concept: The Unlikely Hero
Premise:
Our protagonist is a seemingly insignificant character, often overlooked and underestimated. They might be physically frail, socially awkward, or possess a unique weakness that sets them apart from the norm. However, beneath this exterior lies a hidden potential, a spark of courage, and a determination to overcome their limitations.
Gameplay:
Incremental Growth: The character's progression is gradual and satisfying. As they overcome challenges and face adversity, they develop new skills, enhance their abilities, and gradually become a formidable force.
Character Customization: Players can choose from a variety of backstories, weaknesses, and starting attributes, allowing for a personalized experience.
Skill Tree: A deep and engaging skill tree system enables players to tailor their character's growth to their preferred playstyle.
Equipment and Items: A diverse array of equipment and items can be collected and upgraded to enhance the character's abilities and appearance.
Companion System: The protagonist can form bonds with a variety of companions, each with their own unique skills and personalities, providing both emotional support and combat assistance.
Challenging Combat: The combat system should be challenging but rewarding, emphasizing strategic thinking and resource management.
Storyline:
The story can revolve around a quest to save the world from a powerful threat, or a personal journey of self-discovery and redemption. The character's initial weakness can serve as a driving force, motivating them to overcome their limitations and prove themselves worthy of the challenge.

title: Iridio
description:
게임 정보
Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help.
Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.
Gameplay features
Dive into a fully open-world island, offering boundless exploration opportunities.
Dynamic 24-hour day/night cycle and diverse weather conditions such as rain and snow, actively influencing your in-game experience.
Employ your versatile crossbow in various modes, including standard, electric, explosive, and flammable options.
Harness the island's creatures to perform laborious tasks, taking advantage of their abilities for your benefit.
Find essential items, trade them with the tribe, or get them from looting fallen enemies.
Gather resources to craft a variety of objects and weapons crucial for your journey.
Elements like fire and water can be used to unravel puzzles, liberate hostages, and unveil hidden secrets.
Encounter advanced AI that dynamically reacts to your in-game actions, random events, and changing weather conditions.
Immerse yourself in realistic physics and graphics, incorporating the latest Unity High Definition Rendering Pipeline (HDRP).

title: Lost Soul Aside
description:
게임 정보
에디션 포함 항목:
Lost Soul Aside™
당신의 세계를, 여동생을, 영혼을 지키기 위한 싸움.
영웅의 여정
루이자가 사라졌다. 사라졌다고?! 어떻게 이런 일이...
우리에게는 꿈이, 미래가 있었는데. 모든 게 더 나아질 거라 믿었어. 그런데... 이렇게 끝난다고?
아니, 계속 싸워야 해. 남은 우리가 포기할 순 없어.
뜻밖의 동료도 생겼고... 난 점점 강해지고 있어.
그녀를 구할 수 있을까? 그녀의 영혼을 되찾을 수 있을까?
숨 막힐 정도로 스타일리시한 액션 어드벤처 RPG에서 화려한 무기 콤보를 달성하며, 강력한 적들과 거대한 보스를 상대하세요.
진정한 영웅의 여정을 통해 나만의 전투 스타일을 찾고, 퍼즐을 풀며, 놀라운 능력으로 자신을 진화시키세요.
갈등하는 세계

title: 7 Days
description:
게임 정보
                               Step into a world where dreams and reality mix.
                              Play as a boy trapped between waking life and a dream, exploring his memories each day. Each day uncovers a different part of his life, from school and family to love and loss. Your choices influence his journey: will he find hope and awaken, or remain lost in darkness?

title: GCS: Salvage Rat
description:
게임 정보
GCS: Salvage Rat is a gritty, first-person space sim with permadeath and immersive salvage contracts. Explore a procedurally generated universe of hostile factions, dangerous asteroid fields, and derelict stations. Pilot a fully customizable ship, mine valuable resources, fight for control, and descend into abandoned hulks on foot in tense FPS missions. There are no second chances — your legacy is all that remains.
Whether you're hunting bounties, stripping wrecks for data, or trading across star systems, every decision matters in this brutal, single-player sci-fi experience.
Key Features
🔧 Dual Gameplay Modes
Pilot your spacecraft in full first-person, then breach derelict stations or contract sites in immersive FPS missions.
🌌 Massive Procedural Universe
Explore up to potentially 1,000+ hand-seeded star systems, each procedurally generated with dynamic NPCs and salvage contracts.
⚙️ Hardpoint-Based Ship Customization
Equip mining lasers, turrets, armor plating, missile bays, and utility modules to tailor your craft to your playstyle.
💀 True Permadeath
Death is final. But achievements, rank, and exploits live on in the game’s legacy records.
🛠️ Economy & Faction Warfare
Trade across stations, accept high-risk salvage jobs, and navigate a web of procedurally generated NPC factions under seven major alliances.
👨‍🚀 No Waiting. No Matchmaking. Just Play.
GCS: Salvage Rat is designed from the ground up for solo players who want immediate, high-stakes gameplay — with no dependency on others.

title: HamSumo

Play against your friends in VERSUS matches! 1v1, 2v2, or a full on 4-Player Free For All? The choice is yours!
Experience Captain Ham's perilous journey to Planet Sumo in ADVENTURE mode! Play through a full campaign of single-player levels and bonk your way through the story of HamSumo!

title: Wall Jump Stuff
description:
게임 정보
**Coming Soon - Don't Forget To Wishlist!**


Hi, I have been learning how to make games for a few years now, here is my first release!

I really appreciate your feedback and plan to update this game, so let me know what you would like to see or if you spot any bugs!

Thank you for your interest, I hope you enjoy playing Wall Jump Stuff as much as I enjoyed making it! - Paul Chettle, Fizzy Vortex Games


Wall Jump Stuff is a physics based arcade wall jumping game, you'll need to think fast when positioning your character to navigate obstacles and catch gems

Your character is in a constant state of falling so jumping to the opposing wall or on to an obstacle is the only way to advance

I designed this game to be challenging at first, once you pick up the wall jumping mechanic you should be able to clear obstacles more easily and anticipate how to position your character to better catch the falling gems that are used to unlock more characters

The control is a simple 1 click of the mouse and your character jumps in a predictable arc - but make no mistake - this is not an easy game

There are currently 20 obstacles!, some with variations, that are selected at random and repeat as you ascend the cliff. If you fail a particular obstacle you get another chance at the beginning of your next run to tackle that obstacle before the sequence switches back to random!


Features
- Challenging wall jumping game mechanic
- 1 click to jump
- 20 Obstacles
- 22 Characters
- 3 Boats/Ships
- 63 Steam Achievements
- Steam Cloud Save

Notes: currently there is only mouse support for interacting with the menu system

title: Word Rave
description:
게임 정보
ABOUT THIS GAME
Word Rave is an exciting word puzzle game that combines strategy, music, and word popping into an experience suited to your playstyle. Whether you’re a fan of puzzling for big solutions in word games or a someone who wants a more casual, high-energy gameplay, Word Rave has something for you.
In Word Rave, you’ll clear out bad letters on a dynamic 3x3 to 6x6 grid while rotating the board until you can form a set of words like making a big crossword. Once you're happy with the lit-up words, you’ll get to clear them in a satisfying “pop” that rewards you for bigger and more words. If you're especially skilled or lucky, you can even keep popping words utilizing the chain bonus for more lucrative high-scores!
The game has two modes to fit any playstyle:
Rave Mode: Test your speed and skill with a 3-minute timer as you race to form and pop words for the highest score. The clock is ticking, and the challenge escalates as you try to chain combos and avoid bombs that can end your run early. Can you rack up the highest score before time runs out?
Chill Mode: Take your time and play at your own pace in this relaxing yet challenging mode. As the difficulty slowly increases, you’ll need to clear words while avoiding bombs that can explode and end your game. With the option to activate hearts to protect you from bombs and no timer, Chill Mode provides a low-stress environment to strategize and build a high score
Both modes feature high-score tracking, so you can compare your performance with friends and players worldwide. Whether you prefer the rapid pace of Rave or the laid-back challenge of Chill, Word Rave offers hours of fun and rewarding gameplay.
Key Features:
Dynamic Crossword: Rotate the board to until the it lights up with words like a filled-in crossword, then clear them all in a single satisfying pop!
Bombs & Stops: Keep your eye on bombs with a ticking fuse—clear them before they explode! Stops can also fill up your board fast if you don't clear them early
Stars: Use stars as wildcards to complete words, and watch your score skyrocket as you score dozens of words with just a single star!
Game Modes: Choose between Rave Mode for fast-paced action or Chill Mode for a more strategic, relaxing experience
Create & Share: Adjust and save your favorite maps, then show off your high-scores while challenging your friends to beat them using your map settings!

title: Blueman
description:
게임 정보
평범한 가족 휴가, 소박한 미국 호텔, 아내와 또 한 번 다툰 후 찾아온 팽팽한 침묵. 괜찮아요, 위스키 한 잔이면 분위기를 누그러뜨릴 수 있을 거예요 — 딱 한 잔만요, 긴장을 풀기 위해. 그런데 어느새 하루가 다 지나갔습니다. 저녁이 되었네요. 이상하네요… 모두 어디 갔죠?
위험한 곳
이건 정말 미친 짓이에요! 모든 것이 당신을 죽이려 합니다… 얼마나 시간이 흘렀는지조차 기억나지 않습니다 — 몇 시간, 며칠… 아니면 몇 주? 당신은 여전히 출구를 찾고 있어요. 하지만 애초에 출구라는 게 없었다면요?
정말로 도망칠 수 있다고 믿으십니까?
«이곳은 당신의 한계를 시험하며, 오직 가장 강한 자만이 탈출구를 찾을 수 있다.» — 싸구려 리얼리티 쇼의 홍보 문구 같지만, 여긴 관객도 없고 박수도 없습니다. 오직 침묵과 삐걱대는 바닥소리, 그리고 누군가가 지켜보고 있다는 느낌이 전부죠. 진실은 훨씬 단순합니다. 당신은 여기 갇혀 있고, 결국 여기서 죽게 될 겁니다. 문제는 그게 언제 일어날지… 그리고 누가 (혹은 무엇이) 당신을 가장 먼저 찾아낼지입니다.

title: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity
description:
게임 정보
Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity (OMUI) is a game about humankind’s suicidal instincts, interweaving grand geopolitical destruction with personal tragedy. It unfolds as a world-ending nightmare: a playful childhood afternoon quickly descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the sudden death of my Uncle Ramin.
Players should expect a deeply personal and tragic experience designed to place you in the shoes and eyes of a child in my own family as the Islamic revolution came and went, followed by the Iran-Iraq War, scattering us in a hundred different directions and uprooting thousands of people from their ancestral land.
Except, in this reality, the nuclear apocalypse comes in its place - and who but Ramin can stop it? You will take on his impossible quest to save his family as the nightmarish reality collides with hallucinations of his real life.
What features should one expect? 
Explore a 1970s style Tehran apartment in a first-person perspective. 
Play with toys, examine photographs, and understand the relationships of an Iranian family.
Watch the Shah on TV, flip the channels, and try to understand your father and brother's political arguments. 
Listen to the Shah's final speech to the Iranian people.
Run for your life and seek shelter.
Control Ramin as a pilot in his battle against nuclear demons and repressed memories. 
Confront Ramin in his final moments. 
Immerse yourself in the primeval destruction of Iran. 
Find your family in the spirit world and prepare for your journey to the Upper Realm.
Coming to peace with what happened was a long and arduous process. Making this game helped me immensely, but sometimes what was meant to be a way to let go grows into a means to hold on. It is with gratitude to the spirits and to history that I present the complete first edition of Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity in time for the tenth anniversary of a world without Ramin.
It's true that the past is the past, but that doesn't mean we can't change how we feel about it.
For the world to heal, we too must mend.

description:
게임 정보
CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy arcade 3D city destruction game with rogue-like elements where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.
Unleash havoc by swiping at buildings, pouncing on structures, and hurling objects with telekinesis.  As the chaos unfolds, enemies will continuously spawn to capture Bluu and stop her destruction spree.  Once the level is cleared, you can rescue a kitten that supercharges Bluu’s powers, enhancing her abilities with unique effects like summoning lightning storms or turning invisible. Embrace the carnage, adapt your playstyle, and lead Bluu to victory!

title: Unwanted Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Survive. Evolve. Destroy the Unwanted Dungeon.
Unwanted Dungeon is a 2D survivorslike game with the depth of a classic RPG, blending roguelike elements (semi-procedural generation, permadeath) with the strategic progression of a roguelite (inventory and loot management).
Frenzied action inspired by Vampire Survivors meets the tactical depth of the original Diablo 1. Create unique builds, face hordes of monsters, and uncover the secrets of a living, treacherous dungeon.
Key Features
RPG Elements – Skill trees with dual combat modes per class, dialogues with NPCs, deep character personalities and classes, skill points, and a diverse character building system that shifts your combat strategy.
Semi-procedural Dungeons – Randomized rooms in every run, with chests, crypts, quests, and varied objectives (survival, exploration, bosses).
Inventory & Economy – Equip rings, amulets, treasures, runes, scrolls with different rarity levels, trade in NPC shops, and store items between runs.
Roguelike + Roguelite Fusion – Permadeath, unique runs, randomized power-ups, and permanent unlocks and upgrades for future adventures.
Frenzied Combat – Face dozens hundreds of enemies on-screen with a mix of auto and active abilities. Each character build changes how you fight, explore, and replay the game with new gear and strategies.
Story & Characters
Eldoria was a peaceful haven until Eldrin, its most beloved mage, fell into darkness. His tower collapsed, giving rise to a living dungeon filled with monsters and abominations. Now, everyday citizens — driven by rage and a thirst for vengeance — confront the one who once protected them.
Choose your character:
Rebecca, the Explorer – Driven by revenge after losing her wife in the cataclysm. Melee-focused, she can be a swordmaster or a steel-plated tank.
Elias, the Hunter – A wandering merchant who sees the dungeon as a chance to make money. A long-range archer or a trap-based tactician with a unique playstyle.
Aaron, the Scholar – Eldrin's naïve young apprentice with a strong sense of justice. Can be an arcanist with mid-range spells or a complex combo-based summoner.

title: Shifting To The Backrooms
description:
게임 정보
Game Description
"Shifting To The Backrooms" is a mix of psychological horror and drama game where the protagonist, Will, grappling with family tragedies, discovers the method of "shifting" enabling him to enter dream liminal worlds and escape from his grim reality. However, the dream turns into a nightmare from which Will cannot wake up.
The game will feature:
More than 15 liminal spaces
Unique and abstract levels never seen before in Backrooms games
Non-Euclidean spaces, time manipulation, and abstract puzzles
An intriguing story about shifting and parallel universes
About the Game
Unlike most Backrooms co-op adventures, our game focuses on a single-player story campaign.
We understand multiplayer is fun (and we plan to add co-op mode post-launch), but we aim to deliver something fresh:
A deep plot with unexpected twists and complex characters.
No clichéd "yellow corridors" — we’ve reimagined liminal spaces. Their potential is limitless.
Story
The core of the game is Will’s personal journey, not the "spaces." Liminality and Backrooms are just the stage.
Will, a 15-year-old, battles family turmoil tied to his father, mother, sister, and stepfather (all revealed in-game). He seeks peace by "shifting" to safe levels, but dreams morph into an inescapable nightmare. Your task: guide Will to wakefulness. Through dreams, you’ll uncover ways to alter reality and secrets that reshape his family’s fate.
Themes explored:
Shifting, astral projections, transcendental travel
Oneirokinesis (Can thought influence reality through dreams?)
Fear of being trapped in the astral plane, a dream, or an alternate reality
The thin line between sleep and reality

title: LHEA and the Word Spirit
description:
게임 정보
LHEA awakens in the In-Between, a dreamy world between life and death. Mentored by an ancient Word Spirit, help her master an innovative timeline battle system and guide lost souls to their next lives.
Explore the realms, learn knowledge, optimize your Fate Flute and battle entities to seal the realms and restore balance in the In-Between!

title: Vampire's Castle
description:
게임 정보
Vampire’s Castle is a 4-player online co-op horror game that plunges you into the heart of a cursed fortress, where unimaginable treasures await—if you can survive long enough to collect them. Enter alone or team up with up to three others to explore the castle's dark corridors, avoiding the wrath of Vlad, the vampire who guards it.
The castle is alive with danger, and every step you take could be your last. Vlad stalks the halls in two terrifying forms: as a bat, he relies on his acute hearing to hunt you down. Move too loudly, and he’ll be drawn to your location. As a man, he sees everything in his path, ready to end your hunt for treasure if you’re caught. Use your surroundings carefully, as your survival depends on both silence and strategy.
To escape with your bounty, you'll need to learn how to outsmart Vlad. Some paths can be blocked by opening windows that cast light into the corridors, forcing the vampire to retreat. But be cautious—these windows are not everywhere, and the light can only protect you for so long.
The castle’s layout is as dangerous as it is vast, with some areas louder than others. Certain rooms have creaky floors or footstep-heavy corridors where the sound of your movements will echo. Be sure to check your surroundings and make sure Vlad isn’t nearby before entering these riskier zones.
Time is of the essence, and your goal is simple: collect as much treasure as you can before you find a way out. But remember—staying quiet, staying hidden, and using the environment to your advantage are the keys to survival. Will you escape with your loot, or will you become a permanent resident of the castle?

title: Pit of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Pit of Despair is a psychological horror game that places the player in a snowbound cabin, isolated deep within a remote forest. The environment is cold, unwelcoming, and indifferent to your presence. You are stranded, with no immediate means of escape. An unidentified presence resides within the cabin’s walls, or perhaps within your own mind.
Inspired by the atmospheric tension of P.T. Silent Hills and the unsettling monotony of The Exit 8, Pit of Despair delivers a chilling, narrative-driven experience that thrives on psychological tension and environmental storytelling. 
This is a short, intense "walking simulator" designed to be experienced in one sitting, lasting approximately 30 - 45 minutes. 
Pit of Despair is an experience best played with headphones, in the dark, and with no distractions.

title: Station Master RPG
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of the station master at a railway station in rural Japan! You start off with a tiny old station building in the middle of nowhere, but this is soon about to change. Watch the city grow together with your station, upgrade the infrastructure to cope with the ever-increasing demand and design it to your liking! Take care of your passengers and employ staff to cover the station's workload, all while keeping an eye on the finances.
Features available in this Early Access version of the game
Passenger interaction and satisfaction – Don't let them wait in queues!
Construction system that allows for adding and changing floors, walls, wallpapers and roofs
Laying tracks and building new platforms
Typical Japanese station equipment like ticket gates, vending machines, etc.
Staff management and skill progression
Dynamic city development based on the station's ratings
Additional features planned for future releases
More train types (including electrification of the line!)
More station equipment and construction elements
Steam Workshop support for custom objects and trains
Improvement on the RPG factor of the game (player skilling system)
More interactive gameplay (infrastructure maintenance, cleaning, picking up lost items, etc.)
More language support (Japanese & German)
... and much more!
Players are very welcome to join the community and suggest features for the game! Let's build this game together!

title: Beekeeper Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beekeeper Simulator lets you step into the peaceful yet rewarding world of beekeeping. Start small with a single hive, tending to your bees by providing food, cleaning the hives, and keeping them healthy. As your colonies grow, gather different types of honey based on the flowers your bees visit, each with unique flavors and values.
Use your earnings to buy better tools, new hives, and advanced equipment to improve honey production. Explore the environment to find rare flowers, attract special bee species, and optimize your apiary. Expand your beekeeping empire, manage multiple hives, and master the art of honey-making while keeping your bees happy and productive.

title: Cloud Cats` Land
description:
게임 정보
배가 난파된 후, 당신은 지도에 없는 신비로운 섬에 도착하게 됩니다. 그리고 이 신비한 섬에는 구조의 유일한 길이 되는 등대가 서 있습니다.
구름 고양이들은 친근하고 장난기 가득한 존재로, 새로운 손님들을 따뜻하게 맞이합니다. 하지만 등대 관리자는 무슨 일이 있었던 걸까요? 정말로 고양이들이 그의 실종과는 관계가 없는 걸까요?  
각 고양이는 독특하며 당신의 여정에 특별한 마법을 더합니다. 고양이들을 끌어들여 퍼즐을 풀고, 그들이 당신의 잊지 못할 모험에 도움을 줄 수 있도록 하세요.

title: Monkey Fruit Fight!
description:
게임 정보
Monkey Fruit Fight is a fast paced 2D pixel art PvP game SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES!
Featuring pixel art in the style of late 80s / early 90s console and arcade games:
Original synthwave soundtrack by Canttias (Canttias on Spotify) 
Retro vibes & 8-bit / 16-bit nostalgia
Easy-to-learn but difficult-to-master gameplay
Colorful arenas
Smooth and modern player experience
Online and couch play
Cross-platform play
More game modes coming!

title: Season 31
description:
게임 정보
Season 31 is a short narrative experience about loss, degrowth and embracing change.
April 2131.
In the deserted countryside, rally cars are racing endlessly to entertain the public far in the capital. Recruit, film, manage to make the races go as smoothly and spectacularly as possible. Everything should go well, as long as you keep everything under control…

title: Bound Between Desks
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a world where the line between reality and mysticism blurs!
Bound Between Desks is a captivating visual novel that transforms ordinary school life into a mystical adventure filled with secrets and unexpected twists. Your choices will determine not only the protagonist's fate but also unveil the deep mysteries hidden behind the walls of what seems to be an ordinary school.
Key Features
Deep Characters with Hidden Secrets Meet unique characters, each harboring their own mysteries. Build relationships, explore motivations, and remember—every interaction can dramatically alter the course of the story.
Atmosphere of Tense Mysticism The school holds countless mysteries, and the boundary between reality and the supernatural grows ever thinner. Will you uncover the truth, or will your actions lead to even darker revelations?
Every Choice Matters Your decisions have real consequences. The game features over 4 unique endings with multiple variations—each playthrough will reveal new facets of the story.
Stunning Anime-Style Visuals Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world through stylish graphics and thoughtful artistic design. Every scene is crafted for maximum immersion into the school's mysterious atmosphere.
Soul-Stirring Soundtrack Experience an emotionally captivating musical score that perfectly complements every moment of tension, mystery, and revelation. The carefully crafted soundtrack draws you deeper into the story, enhancing every emotional beat and atmospheric scene.

title: Mesorift Survival
description:
게임 정보
— Mesorift Survival —
Mesorift Survival is a classic survival experience featuring a mix of PvP and PvE, set in a dangerous, tropical world.
Explore a vast open-world map made up of three islands – one large main island and two smaller ones – surrounded by dense jungle, untouched wilderness, and an atmosphere that constantly shifts between beauty and danger.
Features:
Classic Survival Start
You begin your journey on the beach – with nothing. Gather wood, stone, and other materials to craft your first tools like an axe and pickaxe.
Dangerous AI Dinosaurs
The islands are far from uninhabited – prehistoric beasts roam the jungles. Sneak, fight, or flee – survival is everything.
PvP and PvE Elements
In addition to AI threats, other players can be just as deadly. Will you form alliances or trust no one?
Resources & Exploration
Venture deeper into the wilderness to discover valuable resources like oil, silver, copper, and more.
Base Building & Crafting
Construct and upgrade your own base. Craft useful tools and powerful weapons to defend yourself and dominate the environment.
Whether solo or with friends – Mesorift Survival challenges you to survive, explore, and conquer in a brutal, untamed world.

title: Ice Cream You Scream
description:
게임 정보
Disclaimer: The base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are available as DLC.
Uncover the chilling secrets of the Coconut Ice Cream Factory in Ice Cream You Scream!
Delve into the unsettling world of Ice Cream You Scream, a terrifying first person horror game where you play as Steve, a former employee returning to the abandoned Coconut Ice Cream Factory. Investigate the factory's mysterious shutdown in 1978 and confront the horrifying truth lurking within its walls.
Solve Puzzles and Unravel the Mystery
Navigate the dilapidated factory, using your wits to solve intricate puzzles that stand between you and the factory's dark secrets. Overcome obstacles and piece together the events that led to its demise in this gripping horror adventure.
Experience the Twisted Lore
Unearth the factory's disturbing past as you uncover its twisted lore. Discover the stories behind both friend and foe, each with their own connection to the chilling events that transpired at the Coconut Ice Cream Factory. Experience the true meaning of survival horror as the past comes to life.
Survive the Haunting Entities
Prepare to encounter terrifying monsters lurking in the shadows. These entities will stop at nothing to prevent you from uncovering the truth. Use stealth, strategy, and your survival instincts to avoid becoming their next victim in this terrifying monster horror experience. This is a true first-person survival game at its core.
Are you brave enough to enter?
Step inside the abandoned factory in Ice Cream You Scream, and prepare yourself for a terrifying experience filled with secrets, puzzles, and unrelenting horror. Can you survive the night and uncover the truth behind the Coconut Ice Cream Factory's gruesome past?

title: Crimson Mansion
description:
게임 정보
An old mansion. A mysterious inheritance. And a past that refuses to stay buried.
You play as Jacob, a man drawn to a sprawling, decaying estate left to him by an uncle he never really knew. But the house is more than just timber and stone—it’s a place heavy with memory, shadow, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Jacob explores its forgotten rooms and dust-covered halls, he begins to piece together a fractured history.
This is a slow-paced, narrative-driven exploration game focused on atmosphere, discovery, and unraveling a psychological mystery at your own pace. There are no jump scares, combat, or timers—just you, the house, and what it chooses to reveal.
💡Features:
Narrative-Driven Exploration
A slow-paced, story-rich experience focused on atmosphere, discovery, and unraveling a personal mystery.
Everything Tells a Story
Jacob will comment on nearly everything you can examine—furniture, photographs, tools, keepsakes—offering insight, speculation, or emotional reaction.
Letters, Notes, and Forgotten Objects
Find scattered documents and items tied to the mansion's former inhabitants. Each clue builds a picture of who they were and what happened here.
Interconnected Clues
Details are rarely isolated—what you find in one room may shed light on events in another. Observant players will piece together a layered, non-linear narrative.
Environmental Puzzles
Solve light puzzles based on logic and observation to unlock new areas or uncover hidden items.
Immersive Ambience
A subtle soundscape of creaks, whispers, and shifting tones sets the mood without cheap scares—just quiet unease.
This is a game for players who enjoy quiet tension, emotional storytelling, and piecing together a mystery through observation and inference. Not all truths want to be found—but once you open the door, you may not be able to close it again.

title: Quality Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Work at a body modification clinic in a cyberpunk tower-city. Play as Jin, a salesperson advising clients on mods. Making little money aside from what you earn on commission, save up enough to afford your sick rabbit's surgery in two weeks. Watch your decisions ripple through the lives of each character you meet.
Clients from all walks of life visit the clinic. As you speak with them and uncover their secrets, you'll have to decide if they should get the mods they seek. Choose between morals and your bottom line, and impact the client’s future as well as your own.
Each decision you make ripples out into the world, changing the lives of your clients and coworkers. Watch the results of your actions play out in a responsive world.

title: Goblin Journal
description:
게임 정보
Read the forgotten journals. Rally the outcast horde. Crack the rune‑box before the world forgets the goblins were ever here.

Puzzle out the field notes of a long‑lost goblin commander, plot a path across shifting battle maps, and watch your carefully loaded squads clash in turn‑based auto‑battles.

Each journal becomes your next roguelite campaign: three escalating parchment maps, dozens of ambushes and intrigues, and a last‑stand finale whose outcome rewrites the legend.

Will your translations redeem the scattered clans—or doom them to fade into myth forever?

FEATURES
Plan, Place, Watch Chaos Unfold – Slot abilities before each turn‑based auto battle, then adapt between rounds as enemy tactics mutate.
Nine Hand‑Authored “Runs” – Every journal shuffles 70+ combat encounters, 30+ narrative events, and fort hubs for hiring, healing, or shopping.
Four Tactical Archetypes – Commander, Shield, Pair, and Bulky each wield 6 skills that steer AI behaviour.
30+ Run‑Changing items – Torch‑lit talismans, poisoned provisions, map‑wide tricks—mix them for brutal synergies or last‑second clutch saves.

title: Yuri's Resolve
description:
게임 정보
Stranded in the relentless orbit of Mars, Yuri’s Resolve is a single-player factory-building odyssey that dares you to rebuild, survive, and forge a path home. As the sole survivor of a catastrophic mission failure, you’ll salvage wreckage and mine minerals from the fractured remains of Phobos, transforming them into intricate manufacturing systems through sheer ingenuity.
At the core of Yuri’s Resolve is a richly detailed system featuring nearly 1,000 chemical formulas, resources, and manufacturing recipes, all rooted in real-world chemistry and physics. Every production chain rewards meticulous planning and creative experimentation as you refine raw materials into advanced components. Build sprawling factories in zero-gravity, mastering unique challenges like realistic thermodynamics, authentic power systems, and innovative logistics—without conveyor belts in space, you’ll rethink industrial design from the ground up.

Pilot your fully interactive space forklift from an immersive cockpit, your vital lifeline in the void. Navigate treacherous debris fields, haul salvage, and assemble your factory piece by piece in a dynamic 3D environment. With intuitive controls, every maneuver—whether aligning a new module or weaving through Phobos’ scattered wreckage—feels precise and rewarding. Spaceflight blends realistic physics with responsive, dynamic gameplay for a thrilling experience. Your forklift isn’t just a tool; it’s your steadfast partner in survival.

title: Lost Lands
description:
게임 정보
당신은 이 ‘잃어버린 땅’에 도착한 첫 번째 사람입니다. 이제 건설하고, 탐험하고, 발견할 시간입니다! 이 신비로운 고대 세계에는 많은 미스터리가 숨겨져 있으며, 당신이 그것을 밝혀낼 주인공입니다.
당신은 외로운 모닥불 하나와 주변에 펼쳐진 미지의 땅들로 시작합니다. 주변 지역을 탐색해 새로운 건설지, 수집할 자원, 탐험할 유적, 연구할 룬스톤 등을 발견하세요…

title: Seclusa
description:
게임 정보
Seclusa에 오신 여러분을 환영합니다!
Seclusa는 캐주얼한 사진 촬영 시뮬레이터와 편안한 휴식 게임의 조합으로 원하는 만큼 느긋하게 혹은 활발하게 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다. 각 구역은 정성스럽게 제작되어 편안하고 몰입감을 주며 해당 지역의 야생동물을 촬영하거나 불가에서 석양을 즐길 수 있습니다.
사진 촬영
카메라를 들고 다양한 동아프리카의 야생동물을 촬영해 요청 받은 사진을 완성해 보세요. 레벨이 오르면 더 많은 동물과 지역이 개방되며 카메라 업그레이드를 통해 내 사진의 분위기를 완전히 바꿀 수도 있습니다. 탐험하면서 다양한 희귀종을 눈여겨보세요!
경험치를 얻고 레벨 업
오늘의 과제를 완료하고 목표를 완료하거나 라디오를 틀고 주변의 자연 환경이 살아 숨쉬는 하루를 구경해 보세요. 레벨이 오르면 크레딧을 획득해 카메라를 개선하거나 오두막에 필요한 물건을 구매하고 카드 컬렉션을 늘리거나 날씨나 시간대를 바꿀 수 있는 능력을 손에 넣을 수도 있습니다.

title: Evolve Lab
description:
게임 정보
Program and improve your creatures’ behavior after each combat!
Customize your creatures using a unique state machine system. After every battle, you can add new actions to the state machine or enhance existing actions and their stats to refine your strategy.
Face enemies created by other players!
Every enemy you encounter was created by another player. When a creature is defeated, it remains in the ocean and becomes an opponent for other players, including yourself! This creates an ever-expanding roster of unique enemies and a dynamic meta that evolves over time.
Defeat is not the end!
Track how your creations perform even after your run ends. In the depth overview, you can watch how they are performing. Build something powerful enough, and your creature might even become an elite enemy for other players to face!

title: Lost Twins 2
description:
게임 정보
Lost Twins 2 is an incredibly cute puzzle adventure that will challenge, entertain and maybe even inspire you. Guide Abi and Ben on their journey to find a way back home across a whimsical polygonal playground crafted with an enormous amount of care. Is the mystical Fenghuang leading them home or steering them down a rabbit hole?
Inspired by Miyazaki, the art style merges soft, painterly backgrounds with simplified, memorable characters and fluid animations. Each frame is crafted meticulously with pride - specific lighting techniques, thoughtful composition, and immense attention to detail mean that every single moment you'll spend playing Lost Twins 2 will be a feast for the eyes. The original musical score is atmospheric, soothing, and thematic to complement the art style.



The puzzles in Lost Twins 2 are painstakingly designed, with elegant solutions that make you feel, momentarily, like a genius. They are hard enough to present a challenge but logical enough that you'll be able to solve them within a few attempts. There is a joy to be discovered in every level in Lost Twins 2.

title: Crafty Crasher
description:
게임 정보
Crafty Crasher에 오신 걸 환영해!
장치와 혼돈이 가득한 궁극의 크래시 놀이터야!
타이밍 맞춰 함정과 장비를 작동시켜 차량을 부수거나 구출하자—그리고 파츠를 이동하거나 너만의 엉뚱한 장치를 만들어서 장면을 혼란으로 가득 채워봐!
파괴할래? 구할래? — 네가 결정해!
완벽한 타이밍! 스위치와 버튼을 딱 맞춰 눌러서 선한 자를 도와주거나… 악한 자를 막아봐!

description:
게임 정보
배가 난파된 후, 당신은 지도에 없는 신비로운 섬에 도착하게 됩니다. 그리고 이 신비한 섬에는 구조의 유일한 길이 되는 등대가 서 있습니다.
구름 고양이들은 친근하고 장난기 가득한 존재로, 새로운 손님들을 따뜻하게 맞이합니다. 하지만 등대 관리자는 무슨 일이 있었던 걸까요? 정말로 고양이들이 그의 실종과는 관계가 없는 걸까요?  
각 고양이는 독특하며 당신의 여정에 특별한 마법을 더합니다. 고양이들을 끌어들여 퍼즐을 풀고, 그들이 당신의 잊지 못할 모험에 도움을 줄 수 있도록 하세요.

title: Station Master RPG
description:
게임 정보
Play the role of the station master at a railway station in rural Japan! You start off with a tiny old station building in the middle of nowhere, but this is soon about to change. Watch the city grow together with your station, upgrade the infrastructure to cope with the ever-increasing demand and design it to your liking! Take care of your passengers and employ staff to cover the station's workload, all while keeping an eye on the finances.
Features available in this Early Access version of the game
Passenger interaction and satisfaction – Don't let them wait in queues!
Construction system that allows for adding and changing floors, walls, wallpapers and roofs
Laying tracks and building new platforms
Typical Japanese station equipment like ticket gates, vending machines, etc.
Staff management and skill progression
Dynamic city development based on the station's ratings
Additional features planned for future releases
More train types (including electrification of the line!)
More station equipment and construction elements
Steam Workshop support for custom objects and trains
Improvement on the RPG factor of the game (player skilling system)
More interactive gameplay (infrastructure maintenance, cleaning, picking up lost items, etc.)
More language support (Japanese & German)
... and much more!
Players are very welcome to join the community and suggest features for the game! Let's build this game together!

title: Beekeeper Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beekeeper Simulator lets you step into the peaceful yet rewarding world of beekeeping. Start small with a single hive, tending to your bees by providing food, cleaning the hives, and keeping them healthy. As your colonies grow, gather different types of honey based on the flowers your bees visit, each with unique flavors and values.
Use your earnings to buy better tools, new hives, and advanced equipment to improve honey production. Explore the environment to find rare flowers, attract special bee species, and optimize your apiary. Expand your beekeeping empire, manage multiple hives, and master the art of honey-making while keeping your bees happy and productive.

title: Underside: The Lift
description:
게임 정보
Underside: The Lift - A single-player horror roguelike with survival elements.
Try to survive in a house where every apartment could be your last.
You find yourself in a familiar yet distorted place,
as if you’ve entered its darker reflection.
As if you’ve stepped into the Underside.
The silence is suffocating. There’s something behind every door.
Unfamiliar sounds echo like whispers in the dark — unsettling and real.
All you have is an old pipe and a lighter.
Try different weapons. Search for notes. Study your enemies.
Each monster has its own weaknesses.
No direct hints. Only observation and experience.
One life. One chance.
Die and start over.
Every run is a new house.
New layout, new monsters, new challenges.
Remember: nothing ever repeats here.
The lift is the only place where you can catch your breath,

title: Tides of Lava
description:
게임 정보
끊임없이 변화하는 환경에서 끊임없는 적의 무리로부터 기지를 보호할 수 있는 능력이 있으신가요? 알아볼 방법은 단 하나뿐입니다.
Tides of Lava는 기존 타워 디펜스 게임에서 볼 수 없었던 몇 가지 독특한 기능을 갖춘 로그라이크 타워 디펜스 게임입니다.
1. 타워 수정: 2.5분마다 같은 유형의 모든 타워에 적용되는 타워 개조를 받게 됩니다. 이 모드를 조합하여 타워를 커스터마이징하세요!
2. 그리드 기반 빌딩 시스템: 그리드 기반 빌딩 시스템의 자유와 유연성을 즐기세요.

title: SillyAhhPVP
description:
게임 정보
Simple fighting game. Each player gets 1 - 5 randomly chosen attacks and fight on a randomly chosen map either 1v1 or with a team (depends on game settings). The goal is to defeat your enemy with the attacks you were given.
Movement
This game features a few movement abilities such as a mid-air dive and a slide. Upon getting hit with an attack, if the blow was hard enough, the player will fall over and cannot use attacks until they stand back up.

title: Season 31
description:
게임 정보
Season 31 is a short narrative experience about loss, degrowth and embracing change.
April 2131.
In the deserted countryside, rally cars are racing endlessly to entertain the public far in the capital. Recruit, film, manage to make the races go as smoothly and spectacularly as possible. Everything should go well, as long as you keep everything under control…

title: Bound Between Desks
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a world where the line between reality and mysticism blurs!
Bound Between Desks is a captivating visual novel that transforms ordinary school life into a mystical adventure filled with secrets and unexpected twists. Your choices will determine not only the protagonist's fate but also unveil the deep mysteries hidden behind the walls of what seems to be an ordinary school.
Key Features
Deep Characters with Hidden Secrets Meet unique characters, each harboring their own mysteries. Build relationships, explore motivations, and remember—every interaction can dramatically alter the course of the story.
Atmosphere of Tense Mysticism The school holds countless mysteries, and the boundary between reality and the supernatural grows ever thinner. Will you uncover the truth, or will your actions lead to even darker revelations?
Every Choice Matters Your decisions have real consequences. The game features over 4 unique endings with multiple variations—each playthrough will reveal new facets of the story.
Stunning Anime-Style Visuals Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world through stylish graphics and thoughtful artistic design. Every scene is crafted for maximum immersion into the school's mysterious atmosphere.
Soul-Stirring Soundtrack Experience an emotionally captivating musical score that perfectly complements every moment of tension, mystery, and revelation. The carefully crafted soundtrack draws you deeper into the story, enhancing every emotional beat and atmospheric scene.

title: Mesorift Survival
description:
게임 정보
— Mesorift Survival —
Mesorift Survival is a classic survival experience featuring a mix of PvP and PvE, set in a dangerous, tropical world.
Explore a vast open-world map made up of three islands – one large main island and two smaller ones – surrounded by dense jungle, untouched wilderness, and an atmosphere that constantly shifts between beauty and danger.
Features:
Classic Survival Start
You begin your journey on the beach – with nothing. Gather wood, stone, and other materials to craft your first tools like an axe and pickaxe.
Dangerous AI Dinosaurs
The islands are far from uninhabited – prehistoric beasts roam the jungles. Sneak, fight, or flee – survival is everything.
PvP and PvE Elements
In addition to AI threats, other players can be just as deadly. Will you form alliances or trust no one?
Resources & Exploration
Venture deeper into the wilderness to discover valuable resources like oil, silver, copper, and more.
Base Building & Crafting
Construct and upgrade your own base. Craft useful tools and powerful weapons to defend yourself and dominate the environment.
Whether solo or with friends – Mesorift Survival challenges you to survive, explore, and conquer in a brutal, untamed world.

title: Ice Cream You Scream
description:
게임 정보
Disclaimer: The base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are available as DLC.
Uncover the chilling secrets of the Coconut Ice Cream Factory in Ice Cream You Scream!
Delve into the unsettling world of Ice Cream You Scream, a terrifying first person horror game where you play as Steve, a former employee returning to the abandoned Coconut Ice Cream Factory. Investigate the factory's mysterious shutdown in 1978 and confront the horrifying truth lurking within its walls.
Solve Puzzles and Unravel the Mystery
Navigate the dilapidated factory, using your wits to solve intricate puzzles that stand between you and the factory's dark secrets. Overcome obstacles and piece together the events that led to its demise in this gripping horror adventure.
Experience the Twisted Lore
Unearth the factory's disturbing past as you uncover its twisted lore. Discover the stories behind both friend and foe, each with their own connection to the chilling events that transpired at the Coconut Ice Cream Factory. Experience the true meaning of survival horror as the past comes to life.
Survive the Haunting Entities
Prepare to encounter terrifying monsters lurking in the shadows. These entities will stop at nothing to prevent you from uncovering the truth. Use stealth, strategy, and your survival instincts to avoid becoming their next victim in this terrifying monster horror experience. This is a true first-person survival game at its core.
Are you brave enough to enter?
Step inside the abandoned factory in Ice Cream You Scream, and prepare yourself for a terrifying experience filled with secrets, puzzles, and unrelenting horror. Can you survive the night and uncover the truth behind the Coconut Ice Cream Factory's gruesome past?

title: Crimson Mansion
description:
게임 정보
An old mansion. A mysterious inheritance. And a past that refuses to stay buried.
You play as Jacob, a man drawn to a sprawling, decaying estate left to him by an uncle he never really knew. But the house is more than just timber and stone—it’s a place heavy with memory, shadow, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Jacob explores its forgotten rooms and dust-covered halls, he begins to piece together a fractured history.
This is a slow-paced, narrative-driven exploration game focused on atmosphere, discovery, and unraveling a psychological mystery at your own pace. There are no jump scares, combat, or timers—just you, the house, and what it chooses to reveal.
💡Features:
Narrative-Driven Exploration
A slow-paced, story-rich experience focused on atmosphere, discovery, and unraveling a personal mystery.
Everything Tells a Story
Jacob will comment on nearly everything you can examine—furniture, photographs, tools, keepsakes—offering insight, speculation, or emotional reaction.
Letters, Notes, and Forgotten Objects
Find scattered documents and items tied to the mansion's former inhabitants. Each clue builds a picture of who they were and what happened here.
Interconnected Clues
Details are rarely isolated—what you find in one room may shed light on events in another. Observant players will piece together a layered, non-linear narrative.
Environmental Puzzles
Solve light puzzles based on logic and observation to unlock new areas or uncover hidden items.
Immersive Ambience
A subtle soundscape of creaks, whispers, and shifting tones sets the mood without cheap scares—just quiet unease.
This is a game for players who enjoy quiet tension, emotional storytelling, and piecing together a mystery through observation and inference. Not all truths want to be found—but once you open the door, you may not be able to close it again.

title: Lil Johnny's Escapade
description:
게임 정보
In the 2D Platformer, Lil’ Johnny’s ESCAPADE, you play as Lil’ Johnny trying to save the earth from an evil oil baron polluting the land.
Save the planet!
Clean up the mess the oil baron, Maverick, has made by taking down his minions with your new energy power! Although it won't be easy…
Traverse the land!
Jump from platform to platform to get to different levels filled with exciting mechanics to keep you on your toes.

title: Biofall: Survival
description:
게임 정보
Story

The year is 2030, the world lies in ruins following the end of World War 3.. and civilization.


We all believed that the apocalypse would be brought on by nuclear weapons.. but its so much worse.



In May of 2025, Rangen Chemical released what was called the “cure". 2 years later after the “cure” was released to the population, people started having horrid reactions, mostly violent, and this was just the beginning. Nations fell as quickly as cities did... You are one of the few that are immune to the cure.


This is ground zero, Ashveil Island, the home of Rangen Chemical. Experiments, Projects, and horrors unknown were made and stored here.




Do you dare risk your life to save the world?


With thousands of items of carefully planned pieces of lore can you find the truth?

Features: Singleplayer, Multiplayer, and server hosting


Interactive world: Everything you see can be manipulated and moved, anything that has some sort of inside or storage will be able to store things (table with a small cabinet on the bottom for example) These things found in world can be scrapped or used as parts to craft other things

title: Interstellar Sentinel 2
description:
게임 정보
Interstellar Sentinel 2 is an action-packed shoot'em up that takes you on a cyberpunk sci-fi journey to PAL Tech world, an Ecumenopolis where the cosmic balance of power is being consumed by Gressle, a cybernitc Weretech line of mercenaries.
An inspired love letter to some of the best side-scrolling games ever made
I grew up playing games like Salamander/Life Force, Gradius, R-Type, Super Aleste, Einhander, Ikaruga, and more. Interstellar Sentinel features tight controls, digital & analog stick (PlayStation & Xbox controllers verified), stylized beautiful art with light anime inspiration, and a rewarding experience that becomes more challenging as your skills grow.

title: Dillo's Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
Step into the role of Dillo, the ingenious armadillo with pinball expertise, in this dynamic 3D physics collectathon! Master mind-bending pinball structures and fast-paced movement as you roll through vibrant, sprawling worlds filled with intricate challenges. With every agile flip, bounce, and roll, unleash your creative strategies to overcome movement puzzles and destroy Rat King's forts. Rally your firefly friends scattered across diverse environments and prove that clever mechanics and bold determination can light up even the darkest corners of the world. Will your pinball prowess and quick wits save the day?
Roll Fast, Think Smart – Save the Fireflies!
In Dillo’s Dilemma, you play as Dillo, a clever armadillo who mastered the art of rolling into a high-speed pinball to navigate the world! Use your shell not just for defense, but for movement, puzzles, and offense!

title: Greed Grid
description:
게임 정보
THE PUZZLES
Greed Grid leads you through numerous hand-crafted puzzles, thoroughly exploring innovative twists of familiar mechanics. Each level presents unique challenges and subverts expectations. Every puzzle is a test of your planing and precision skills.
Calculate every move in advance
The malware you control must frequently charge from the power supply of the corporate servers you're hacking, requiring careful planning.
Find the most efficient solution
Your malware will trip the servers' firewall protection if you stay for too long, asking you to find the optimal solution to each puzzle.
Try the speedrunning mode
Go for both speed and efficiency in Greed Grid's speedrunning ironman mode. You will get a timer on all levels and a score at the end.
THE STORY
In a dystopian world, not too far out in the future, and not too far away from our contemporary reality, the world's leading high-tech manufacturer is set to release a revolutionary new product. One unexpected death, however, shines light on the company's insatiable greed and malevolent practices. Our protagonists will reach their breaking point and attempt to resist their omnipresent overlord.
Greed Grid is a cautionary tale of the dangers of oligarchy, but also of the strength and power each of us possess to fight back.

title: Suizokukan Project
description:
게임 정보
Turn your desktop into an aquarium!
Fish, collect, earn, and decorate your aquarium. Suizokukan Project makes for the perfect companion while you do menial work in your computer.
Buy better gear

title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
description:
게임 정보
Hoard’s LLC is a cozy, story-driven puzzle game where you play as Barry, a mild-mannered minotaur working deep in the depths of a corporate dungeon. When Barry starts to realize his coworkers are being exploited, he sets out to do something truly radical: help them!
What is the most powerful weapon against an evil boss ruling over a dungeon full of monsters?
An ancient sword?
A magic ring?
No!
The most powerful spell of all: Unionizing! 
Create a path through the labyrinth: Navigate a maze of departments—like Loot Logistics and Monster Resources—solving clever puzzles to reconnect isolated coworkers. Rotate tiles to create a path to get Barry to the exit on each level. Avoid spike traps, stone tiles that refuse to budge, and other obstacles.

title: Is This Seat Taken?
description:
게임 정보
Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken?, your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.
Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. A sleepy passenger won’t be happy trying to nap on the bus next to someone listening to loud music. It’s all about reading the room to find the perfect placement!
Nat is an aspiring actor whose world gets turned upside down when they see a shape just like them on the big screen. This discovery sends Nat on a global journey to meet their hero and figure out how to fit in. Experience Nat's heartfelt story as you travel from city to city, each with its own levels, characters, and charm.

title: Me The Gravekeeper
description:
게임 정보
Ready to become a gravekeeper? Experience the cemetery management simulation in Me the Gravekeeper!
🎮You won’t just protect the graves from various obstacles but also take full control of managing your own graveyard.
⛏️Each body that arrives must be given a proper burial and that means digging the grave yourself.
⚰️After digging, you’ll need to carry the corpse to its grave. Or, make your life easier by hiring pallbearers to do the heavy lifting for you
💰 Decorate your graves with lamps, statues, fences, and other ornaments to raise their value and sell them for a higher price.
🌸 Pick flowers growing around your cemetery and sell them at your flower shop for extra income.
👴You’ll be personally trained by Grandpa himself, and of course, you'll become his successor as the gravekeeper.
🧟 Graveyard full? No problem! When a body decomposes, just clean up the plot and put it back on the market. Recycling at its finest!

title: BIG LOOT
description:
게임 정보
BIG LOOT - 교역, 생존, 캐러밴을 주제로 한 로그라이크 어드벤처. 세계를 탐험하고 장비와 경로를 현명하게 선택하세요 - 다음 마을까지의 길은 놀라움으로 가득합니다.
특징:
수집한 자원으로 마차 부품을 제작해 강화하세요. 전리품을 더 담을 상자 추가 또는 안전한 운반을 위한 바퀴 강화.
모든 여정은 독특합니다. 출발 시 선택: 안전(적은 전리품) 또는 위험(풍부한 전리품).

title: Necrosis: Dawn of Dread
description:
게임 정보
What is Necrosis: Dawn of Dread?
Necrosis: Dawn of Dread is a tense, first-person co-op survival horror experience that blends the claustrophobic dread of old-school horror games with modern gameplay mechanics. Team up with up to three friends to scavenge supplies, survive brutal encounters, and solve deadly puzzles in a city overwhelmed by the undead. Every match is a desperate fight to survive—with no second chances.

Key Features
Terrifying Co-op Survival Horror
Experience classic survival horror from a new angle. NDOD drops you into large, unpredictable environments filled with relentless enemies, dwindling resources, and no guarantees. The only way out… is together.
Tactical FPS Combat
Manage limited ammo, choose your shots carefully, and master a variety of weapons. NDOD rewards precision and teamwork—reckless shooting will only get you killed.

title: Isles & Tiles
description:
게임 정보
Raise an island from the sea and build your colony upon it! Isles & Tiles is a turn-based resource management game where you balance expanding your island, growing your colony, and gathering resources against the needs of your settlers and the draw of your cards.
Start with a core deck and unlock new cards, events, trophies, and modifiers as you explore new paths to victory!
Raise an Island – Use the cards you draw to shape the contours of your coastline and build your colony. No two islands will ever be the same, and you can always adjust the terrain to suit your needs.
Manage Your Resources – Start with a small stockpile of basic resources, and build what you require. Need more wood? Raise a forest and place a timberyard, or turn a tile into a mountain and mine it for stone.
Balance Your Needs – The beginning of every colony is easy, but once time starts to pass you'll have to weigh in on the needs and desires of your settlers. What will you choose?
Unlock Legendary Cards – Start with a core deck and unlock over a hundred new and more powerful cards as you play. Collect victory points to unlock new cards or convert your favourite cards into legendary foil versions!

title: Deck of Destiny: Battlege
description:
게임 정보
🏆 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 🏆
Deck of Destiny: Battleforge 는 전략, 액션, 로그라이크 덱 구축의 요소를 결합한 현대적인 로그라이크 덱 빌더입니다. 4명의 전설적인 영웅 중 한 명을 선택하여 고대 땅의 마법을 되찾고 끝없는 전쟁에서 나만의 전설을 쓸 준비를 하세요.
이 전략 게임에서 각 레벨에서 살아남기 위해 영리한 카드 사용과 효과적인 전략 개발에 대한 기술을 테스트하세요. 카드는 공격, 방어, 체력, 버프, 속도의 5가지 유형으로 제공되며 각각 고유한 전략적 이점을 제공합니다. 적의 물결을 물리치고 카드, 귀중한 장비, 골드를 수집하여 캐릭터를 개발하세요. 카드를 강화하고 운과 전략 사이의 섬세한 경계에서 살아남아 운명을 형성하고 전설적인 전사가 되세요!
🌟 고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했습니다
고대 왕국은 한때 마법과 힘으로 가득했으며, 카드의 힘이 곳곳에 퍼졌습니다. 하지만 어느 날, 어둠의 저주가 모든 왕국을 뒤덮어 세계의 마법을 훔쳐 혼란에 빠뜨렸습니다. 그 결과, 파괴와 절망이 온 땅에 퍼졌고, 많은 사람들이 카드의 힘이 다시는 돌아오지 않을 것이라고 두려워했습니다.
🎯 전략과 기회에 기반한 모험
전략적 로그라이크 게임인 Deck of Destiny: Battleforge에서 각 영역에서 카드를 현명하게 사용하고 몬스터 군대에서 살아남으세요. 다음 라운드에서 기회를 높이기 위해 살아남고, 카드를 수집하세요. 전략, 빠른 생각, 뛰어난 카드 플레이가 중요합니다.
🦸 영웅을 선택하고 힘을 발견하세요
궁수, 마법사, 전사 또는 탱크? 각자 독특하고 치명적입니다! 모든 영웅은 고유한 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 캐릭터를 개발하고, 카드를 업그레이드하고, 맵 키를 수집하여 새로운 영역을 잠금 해제하세요.

title: Bloom - a puzzle adventure
description:
게임 정보
Bloom - a puzzle adventure - is a block puzzle about chain reactions and a puppy with a bizarre love for berries. Follow Arya and her dog Bo in an adventure set in vibrant locations and a cute story with witty characters across hundreds of mind-bending block puzzles.
Done saving the world?
Enjoy endless levels created by players like you, or try the ultra-simple level maker to create your own level and share it with your friends! Show off your creativity and become the best creator in the world!

title: Don't Play This
description:
게임 정보
Don't Play This 는 워킹 시뮬레이터 장르의 1인칭 인디 호러 게임입니다.
설명
사람들은 종종 카메라로 영상을 녹화하는데, 이 영상은 그들에게 마지막이 됩니다. 이 순간을 재현하고 기록을 영원히 끊어버린 순간을 경험해야 합니다.
게임 플레이

title: Dino Topia
description:
게임 정보
🦕 Dino Topia's 1st CBT has officially started! 🦖
🔥The wait is over! The Closed Beta Test for Dino Topia is officially live!
Step into a vibrant world of Dinos, strategic battles, and cozy base-building starting today!
🎮 If you’ve secured a spot, head in and start your adventure now!
🦖 Collect, battle, build... and shape the future of Dino Topia with your feedback!
✨ Haven’t joined the CBT yet? It’s not too late!
🔗Join Discord now and fill out the survey for a chance to grab one of the remaining slots!
About the game
"Dino Topia" is a sandbox roguelike game set in a prehistoric world.
Tame and collect a variety of dinosaur companions to help you build, farm, and work together in creating your ultimate home. Take on thrilling battles and face monsters of increasing difficulty with your loyal dinosaur allies by your side.
Sandbox Construction
Gather resources, unlock new technologies, and freely design and expand your home base into a thriving settlement.

title: PIGFACE
description:
게임 정보
“Hello, Exit …”
You’re a terrible person who has done awful things, and now your past has finally caught up to you. As you wake up in an abandoned warehouse covered in your own blood, you hear a phone ring from across the room. 
They’ve drilled a bomb into your head, and now they have a job for you. 
PIGFACE is a kinetic, fast-paced, ultra-violent first-person shooter where you fulfill contracts for those holding you hostage. Use shotguns, rifles, pistols, hammers, landmines, grenades … it doesn’t matter. 
Just Get The Job Done.
IT’S BLACKMAIL…
They know what you’ve done and now they have a job for you. Complete combat sandbox style missions to earn money, expand your loadout, and get closer to whoever’s pulling the strings.
ARMED TO THE TEETH
Purchase anything from hammers to grenade launchers to kevlar vests from the Black Market.
WEAR DIFFERENT FACES
Find and unlock a variety of masks that enhance your ability to kill.

title: Nexus - FPV Carnage
description:
게임 정보
In Nexus, you are a force of nature. Weave through gunfire, master aerial combat, and rain destruction from above in this high-stakes FPV drone roguelike shooter. Pilot advanced combat drones through intense missions where split-second decisions matter. Death sends you back to base - but your tech, skills, and power grow with every run.
Master the Skies
High-speed combat that rewards skill and daring. Start as a rookie, become an ace. Dive through obstacles, chain perfect attack runs, and strike from impossible angles. Go loud with guns blazing or strike with surgical precision. The skies are yours to dominate.

title: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
description:
게임 정보
이 플랫폼 퍼즐 게임은 셀레네의 이야기를 따라갑니다. 그녀는 특별한 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 기계를 작동시키고, 길을 밝히며, 주변 환경의 일부 요소를 미세하게 조정할 수 있는 능력을 지니고 있습니다. 다양한 종류의 꽃빛을 사용하면 물체를 충전하고 플랫폼을 상승시킬 수 있으며, 빛을 활용하는 방식에 따라 변화하는 환경을 탐험할 수 있습니다. 각 도전은 창의력을 요구하며, 우호적이거나 적대적인 생명체와의 만남은 행성계 전체의 운명을 결정짓는 중요한 선택으로 이어집니다.
특징
✨ 빛의 힘을 활용하여 퍼즐을 풀고 장애물을 극복하세요.신비로운 꽃의 빛을 흡수하고 방출하여 길을 밝히고 숨겨진 기계를 작동시킬 수 있습니다. 빛을 사용할 때마다 환경이 변화하며, 어둠과 희망 사이의 섬세한 균형을 형성합니다.
🌿 다양한 존재들과 함께하는 살아있는 세계.여정을 도와줄 수도, 방해할 수도 있는 생명체들을 만나면서, 한 걸음 한 걸음이 새로운 도전이 됩니다. 자연 속 존재들이 퍼즐이자 길잡이가 됩니다.

title: Hotel Tales
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to our hotel, where anyone could be a guest. Ghost? Ancient deity? Character from a famous fairy tale? But the staff here is not so ordinary either.
From now on, you are a new employee of this hotel. A friendly team and interesting tasks to keep you waiting for more. Your job description? Be ready to become a jack of all trades!
tag: 비주얼 노벨,시뮬레이션,다크 판타지,숨은 그림 및 물체

title: Forgotten house
description:
게임 정보
"Pompasaur"와 콜라보레이션 >>> "Gnarled hag"에서 영감을 받은
"Gnarled hag"와 "Granny"에서 영감을 받았습니다. 무서운 할아버지가 살고 있는 낡고 오래된 집에서 탈출해야 하는 소녀가 되어 플레이하세요.
그에게서 숨기기
서랍, 상자, 소파 뒤에 숨어 탈출구를 찾지만 가장 중요한 것은 소음을 내지 않는 것입니다. 그렇지 않으면 그가 당신을 알아 차릴 것입니다. 그가 당신을 잡는 것을 원하지 않습니까?
그에게서 도망쳐
tag: 공포,생존 공포,탐험,숨은 그림 및 물체,분위기 있는

title: E-Shop Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
