title: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
description:
게임 정보
Marisa of Liartop Mountain is an adventure role-playing game where the player's choice and the dice will determine the path.
Reimu ventures through a mysterious book, to find Marisa who has disappeared.
＜Gameplay＞
・A tale of an adventure changes depending on the player's choices.
Inspired by gamebooks, this game is full of unimaginable choices.
Each decision spins a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.
・Future of the battle entrusted to your wits and dice rolls
The adventure progresses with the player's discovery and wit but you may encounter monsters. Win, or lose – it depends on the dice rolls.
You can enjoy both the feel of playing an analog game on a tabletop, and the high tempo and comfortable experience that only a digital game can offer.
The choices after leveling up will affect the progression and playstyle.

title: Tackle  Loss
description:
게임 정보
Tackle for Loss is a 2D top-down action game that puts you in the shoes of a former American football pro. Utilizing his unique set of football skills, you'll navigate a gritty underworld, battling enemies on a desperate mission to save a loved one. Violent combat, a gripping narrative, and dark pixel art combine to create a high-impact experience inspired by the likes of Hotline Miami.
Combat is built around a brutal twist on American football’s four-down rule: you get four tackles - total - to clear each level. No button mashing. Just four perfectly placed tackles between you and the end zone. Sounds impossible? It kind of is.
Football Infused Combat
Killstreak Mechanic
Unlockable Skillpath
Gamepad & Keyboard Support
Gritty Backstory
Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish

title: Legend Battles
description:
게임 정보
                 장비를 착용하고, 날아오르고, 약탈하고, 운전하고, 사격하고, 생존하세요!
LEGEND BATTLES는 400km²에 달하는 광활한 오픈 월드에서 펼쳐지는 차세대 초현실적인 무료 대규모 배틀 로얄 게임입니다. 언리얼 엔진 5.5를 사용하여 놀라운 디테일로 구현된 수백 개의 미래형 대도시에서 숨 막히는 전투를 경험하세요. 모든 건물은 탐험 가능하며, 섬세한 내부 환경은 모든 전투에 깊이와 사실감을 더합니다.
중기관총, 리볼버, 수류탄, 전술 나이프 등 다양한 무기를 선택하세요. 레이싱카, 오프로드 바이크, 오프로드 차량, 커스텀 픽업 트럭 등 파괴 가능한 탈것을 타고 험준한 사막 산맥을 가로지르는 광활한 도로망을 누비며 전장을 누비세요.
LEGEND BATTLES는 단순한 게임이 아닙니다. 완벽한 전투 경험을 선사합니다.
                                               전투 전 나만의 스타일을 완성하세요

title: Empire of Vice : Chicago
description:
게임 정보
Build your criminal empire during Prohibition.
Manage speakeasies, casinos, and territories, corrupt the powerful, and shape your destiny through hundreds of narrative choices.
Chicago, 1925. The city thrives in the shadows. Prohibition has given birth to a new kind of empire—built not on law, but on bribes, bullets, and fear.
In Empire of Vice: Chicago, you play as a gangster from one of several unique backgrounds: an ambitious street thug, an exiled hitman, or a fading mob boss. Where will your story end?
This turn-based strategy and management game plunges you into an underground war where every decision shapes the fate of your criminal empire. Expand your influence by controlling neighborhoods, running speakeasies and casinos, and manipulating a web of smuggling, corruption, and betrayal. But beware—the city remembers, and every action has its price.
A Life of Crime, Told Through Your Choices
Write your rise—or fall—through hundreds of branching narrative events that capture the decadence, violence, and moral tension of true gangster life.
Turn-Based Criminal Strategy
Plan your every move: takeovers, resource management, protection, vendettas… every choice matters. Think ahead—or pay the price.
Choose Your Gangster
Pick from multiple origin stories—rookie thug, fallen boss, fugitive assassin… each with their own strengths and burdens.
Manage Your Illegal Empire
Speakeasies, casinos, smuggling networks—develop and protect your growing organization.
Corruption & Influence
Bribe officials, manipulate the police, eliminate rivals through fear or cunning.
Vengeance, Conflict & Betrayal
Wage war, orchestrate hits, or turn enemies against one another in a ruthless battle for power.
Dynamic Narrative Events
Each playthrough brings unique, choice-driven situations that simulate the unpredictable life of a rising criminal.
A Living, Shifting City
Explore a stylized and corrupt version of Chicago where neighborhoods and alliances evolve based on your actions.

title: Legacy of Defense
description:
게임 정보
게임 설명:

판타지 세계의 주인공이 되어 몬스터의 침공을 막아라! 레거시 오브 디펜스
레거시 오브 디펜스는 횡스크롤뷰와 덱빌딩 요소를 결합한 혁신적인 디펜스 게임입니다.

모험을 떠나 동료를 획득하고, 위험한 적으로부터 자신을 방어하세요!
주요 특징:

횡스크롤뷰 액션: 화려한 2D 그래픽과 직관적인 조작으로 눈앞에 펼쳐지는 치열한 전투를 경험하세요. 몰려오는 몬스터를 방어하는 짜릿한 손맛을 느껴보세요.

덱빌딩 전략: 다양한 카드들을 모아 나만의 덱을 구성하세요. 각 카드에는 강력한 스킬이 포함되어 있어 전략적인 플레이가 요구됩니다.

판타지 몬스터: 상상 속에서나 볼 수 있었던 다양한 판타지 몬스터들이 공격해옵니다. 각기 다른 능력을 가진 몬스터들을 상대하세요.


스킬 업그레이드: 전투를 통해 경험치를 획득하고, 주인공의 스킬을 업그레이드하세요. 강력한 스킬을 통해 더욱 효과적으로 몬스터를 소탕할 수 있습니다.

몰려오는 몬스터들을 막아내세요. 카드를 선택해 스킬을 사용하고 적들을 처치하세요. 전략적인 덱빌딩이 승리의 열쇠입니다. 각 스테이지를 클리어하며 점점 강해지는 몬스터들에 맞서 최종 보스를 물리치세요!

당신의 전략과 실력을 시험해보세요. 용감한 영웅이 되어 판타지 세계를 구할 준비가 되셨나요?

title: Witchy Business
description:
게임 정보
냄비와 수저가 날아다니는 마법 시뮬레이터
『물약 가게』에서는 당신만의 마법 상점을 운영하게 됩니다. 마법 꽃을 재배하고, 재료를 수집하며, 물약을 제조해 손님들에게 판매하세요. 뭐라고요, 제조 순서를 외우기 어렵다고요? 걱정 마세요, 우리는 폭발의 예술로 승부합니다! 실패에서도 배울 수 있는 것이 많으니까요!
연금 공식: 폭발과 부의 사이는 한 끗 차이
가장 유명한 꼬마 마법사로서, 수많은 손님들이 당신의 명성을 듣고 찾아옵니다. 그들은 아주 기상천외한 주문을 해올 거예요. 다양한 미니게임을 통해 재료를 수집하고, 갈고, 섞고, 끓여서 마법 아이템을 만들어야 합니다. 제조 속도도 중요하니 주의하세요! 손님들은 참을성이 없거든요! (그렇다고 작업실을 폭발시켜선 안 돼요!)

title: Overage - Child of Chaos
description:
게임 정보
Overage – Child of Chaos is a fast-paced roguelike and horde-style shooter
developed by CopyCat Game Studios. It is a game that delivers an intense and rewarding power trip, where players confront challenging enemies while embracing the chaos. The game cleverly satirizes familiar media tropes, letting players battle through exaggerated clichés with a mix of skill and strategy. Although the combat requires precision and quick thinking, each victory makes players feel like an unstoppable force, with the thrill of overcoming tough obstacles. The chaotic energy, combined with witty humor, creates an epic,
adrenaline-pumping experience that’s both challenging and empowering.

title: Marathon
description:
게임 정보
헤일로와 데스티니의 제작자들로부터
번지의 팀 기반 FPS 익스트랙션 슈터 게임에서 타우 세티 IV의 잃어버린 식민지를 수색하세요. 자신만의 러너를 선택하고, 세 명이 한 팀을 이뤄 경쟁 팀들과 적대적인 보안군을 상대로 무기와 업그레이드를 차지하기 위해 싸워야 합니다. 살아남으면, 전리품은 앞으로 타우 세티 IV에서의 임무를 위해 보관할 수 있습니다. 용감하다면, 그 위에 떠 있는 버려진 MARATHON 호로 여행을 떠날 수도 있습니다.
러너가 되세요
독특한 능력을 가진 사이버네틱 용병들 중에서 선택하세요. 임무 중 수집한 무기, 주입물, 장비로 플레이 스타일을 자유롭게 설정하세요. 모든 경기에서 실험하고, 전략을 세우며, 더 강해져서 돌아올 수 있을 것입니다.

title: SILENT HILL f
description:
게임 정보
미련. 갈등. 후회. 피할 수 없는 선택. 그리고 자신의 죄.
그것과 마주할 수 없는 자들은 짙은 안개 속 세상을 떠돈다……

무시무시한 심상 풍경이 구현된 세계와 크리처가 특징인
공포와 광기의 사이콜로지컬 호러 'SILENT HILL' 시리즈 최신작.

일본을 무대로 한 새로운 "사이콜로지컬 호러"가 시작된다.


옛 시절. 한 지방의 산간에 위치한 쓸쓸한 시골 마을 에비스가오카에 사는 고등학생 시미즈 히나코.
그녀의 일상은 흐릿한 잿빛이기는 해도 사춘기다운 평범한 나날이었다.

그러나 그 평범한 일상은 갑작스럽게 무너진다.
익숙했던 마을은 안개에 둘러싸여 오싹하게 변해 간다.
인기척은 사라지고 대신 안개 속에서 기괴한 무언가가 꿈틀거린다.

변모한 마을을 탐색하고 수수께끼를 풀며 몸을 지키기 위해 싸우고 살아남아라.

마주해야만 하는 선택과 마주하기 위해서.
그리고 죽여야만 하는 자를 죽이기 위해서.

그녀가 택한 것은 아름다운 선택인가?
아니면 소름 끼치는 선택인가?

아름답고도 오싹한 선택에 관한 이야기.

title: ROAD59　A Yakuza’s Last Stand
description:
게임 정보
STORY
A towering metropolis floating in Tokyo Bay—Tenkai Ward.
Here, beings known as Jingi wield inhuman powers and engage in brutal blood-soaked battles for survival.
Despite being born as the heir to Hakurou, Sho Himuro longs for nothing more than an ordinary and peaceful life. Yet, fate binds him to his duty as the new boss, forcing him to shoulder the burden of his family’s future.
As Sho hesitates to fully embrace the path of the yakuza, the conflict in Tenkai Ward intensifies over the legendary Power of Orochi, said to grant its wielder their deepest desire.
Meanwhile, the city’s largest gang, Kurojou, begins to move in the shadows as they seek to absorb the weakened Hakurou following the loss of its former leader.
To protect his family, Sho must navigate a world of betrayal and desire, forced to make impossible choices by his own hands.
Will salvation or ruin await him at the end of this path?
Desire. Betrayal. Mythology. And Honor.
The intertwining lives of modern yakuza unravel in this tale of modern yakuzas.
Jingi—Yakuza Who Transcend Humanity
In Tenkai Ward, those who seek to forge unbreakable bonds with their comrades undergo the Grail of Blood Ritual.
In this ritual, a child receives blood from their parent, and a younger brother from their elder, symbolizing their inauguration. This sacred exchange not only marks them as full-fledged members but also grants them an extraordinary power beyond human limits—the divine force known as Jingi.
To share blood is to forsake the path of a mortal. Once one becomes Jingi, there is no return to normalcy. Their bodies are forever altered and they must server any ties to the world they once knew.
Yet, despite this irreversible fate, they step forward, driven by unwavering resolve and the a desperation for power.
The Stage is Set—Tenkai Ward
National Route 59 cuts through Tokyo Bay. Beyond it lies a world glistening with desire, home to the most renowned skyscrapers in the world: Tenkai Ward.
company: 株式会社ロケットスタジオ

title: NubiaPhobia
description:
게임 정보
Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor. Break the witch's curse on your home as you explore five distinct regions, each hiding a sacred key to unlock the village chest.

title: Jamboy
description:
게임 정보
Jamboy: A Jelly-cious Hero, is a vibrant action-platformer starring an unusual protagonist: a jam-packed hero who, inevitably, seems to have an innate talent for falling into sticky situations.
The game is structured around a series of short stories in episodic format offering a fascinating fusion of genres guaranteed to hold the player's attention. Adding to this ingenious game design is the charming aesthetic of its hand-drawn art, and sly humor, which adds to the fun of the gameplay experience in the style of the classic "Earthworm jim."
Jamboy and Billy find themselves in a frantic escape from a relentless police donut! Reflecting on the succession of unfortunate decisions that have led them into this complicated situation, they are surprisingly engulfed by an unexpected character: Damien! And who is Damien? It turns out he's a huge guy who happened to be right in their path. How unfortunate... that's what happens to them for not keeping their eyes wide open!
After this unusual incident, Jamboy is forced to enter the depths of the giant. A labyrinth of tunnels awaits him, infested by monsters made of food. Although the entrance to this fleshy cavern was unintentional, finding the exit promises to be a test of skill and cunning.

title: Fuel Station Simulator
description:
게임 정보
In this game about a gas station, you are the boss. From Zero to Hero, you are responsible here for either the economic success or downfall.

You start - as it should be - with almost nothing. If you handle it skillfully, you’ll end up with a fully developed gas station, complete with your own employees and plenty to keep you busy.

The following areas await you:
- Fuel Pumps: Refuel the approaching cars and collect payments. Additionally, expand the refueling options by earning more fuel pumps.

- Car Wash: Plenty of dirty cars! Once you’ve created at least one car wash facility, you can serve your customers and clean their vehicles. Later on, you can even add a self-service option!

- Car Repair: Fix vehicles in your own workshop, at least until you have staff for this task.

- Gas Station Shop: Collect payments from customers who have refueled, order goods, stock shelves, and sell them profitably! Of course, this comes after you’ve equipped your shop with a few shelves.

- Refinery: This is where you get the raw material… but will you also get the best conditions?1

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
description:
게임 정보
무한한 세계가 교차하는 차원을 뛰어넘는 레이스 배틀이 시작된다!
소닉이 활약하는 세계와 수많은 작품이 트래블 링으로 연결되어
탄생한 멀티버스.
그곳에는 새로운 모험과 예측불가능한 레이스, 그리고 뜨거운 경쟁이 기다린다.

▼전 세계 플레이어와의 대전 및 협력!
오프라인은 물론, 온라인으로 전 세계 플레이어와 플랫폼의 벽을 넘어 배틀을 펼치자! '월드 매치'에서는 최대 12명과 대전 가능! 팀을 짜서 특수한 룰로 즐기는 '친구 매치', 전 세계의 플레이어와 클리어 타임을 겨루는 '타임 트라이얼' 등도 탑재. 다양한 모드에서 승리를 거머쥐어라!

▼나만의 머신을 제작하자!
레이스의 운명을 크게 좌우하는 신규 시스템 '가젯' 등장! 가젯을 장착하면 레이스 중에 특수한 능력을 발휘할 수 있으며 플레이 스타일, 공략 루트, 전략이 크게 변화한다. 70종 이상의 가젯을 조합하여 독자적인 전략을 세워 보자. 여기에 머신 또한 앞뒤 파츠부터 컬러와 스티커, 텍스처까지 자유롭게 커스텀 가능!

▼한 바퀴 돌 때마다 변화하는 예측 불능의 레이스 체험!
2nd Lap에서는 트래블 링을 통해 이세계로 뛰어들자! 24개의 메인 코스와 15개의 크로스월드가 기다리고 있다.

▼시리즈 사상 최다 캐릭터 등장!
소닉 시리즈에서 23명의 캐릭터가 레이서로 참전! 좋아하는 캐릭터로 레이스를 즐기자.

▼전략의 핵심이 되는 '아이템'도 다수 등장!
거대화하는 머신, 라이벌을 깔아 뭉개며 달리는 '몬스터 트럭' 등 다양한 아이템이 등장!

title: Lobstar: Arcade Version
description:
게임 정보
Punch through the cosmos!
Lobstar: Arcade Version is a shoot-em-up where you cannot shoot bullets. Instead, you can punch those bullets back at foes--or get in the enemy's face and punch them yourself!
Punch Past it All! Punch bullets to deflect them. They will automatically fly at the nearest enemy. You can also defeat most enemies in one punch!
Shine Bright with Star Time: Perform a Lobster Roll to evade an attack with good timing to enable Star Time. You cannot take damage during Star Time, so go crazy!
Lobstars Never Die: Cosmic lobster "The Lobstar" is immortal and cannot die. Getting hit will push it back, but this will not deter it from its destination. While anyone can clear the game, the credits won't roll for just anyone.
Shoot for the Stars: Go for a high score or a fast clear time with the in-game ranking and timer functions! Crazy-quick crustaceans may even catch up with the edge of the universe itself...

title: Consume Me
description:
게임 정보
BEING A TEENAGER SUCKS. So we made a videogame about it.
Hey remember when your parents, your friends, and society at large all conspired to make you feel ugly, lazy, stupid, and unloved despite the brilliant human spirit contained within you? No? Well, allow us to refresh your memory via the timeless medium of a slice-of-life role-playing game!
In Consume Me, you take on the role of Jenny, young, in love, and entering her final year of high school. Make meticulous scheduling decisions to maximize your glow-up! Solve the puzzle game of dieting! Evade distractions as you pursue scholarly success! Do chores to get money from mom at a rate much lower than minimum wage!
company: Jenny Jiao Hsia, AP Thomson, Jie En Lee, ,

title: Touhou Kichouden ~ Mythos of Phantasmagoria 2
description:
게임 정보
A long time ago, King Kourin defeated Vladrouge Scarlet to avenge the death of Queen Marisa’s mother Mima. The Gensokyo Continent was soon under the rule of three kingdoms headed by a different queen. Although Kourin still retained Marisa’s hand in marriage, he wanted each queen’s child to have his blood and strength. He would go on to kickstart three new royal bloodlines by bringing a son and two daughters.
During the first decade of their lives, all three kingdoms lived in prosperity. But then, the wicked vampire sorceress Flandre Scarlet of the Gensokyo Socialite Order shattered that peace. By bringing yourself, your stepsisters, and your childhood friend together, Queen Marisa has ordered you to combine your skill and effort to defeat Flandre and the Order.
In case you’re curious about who’s participating in this adventure:
Kichou Kirisame, the Prince of the Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo. He’s a heroic warrior who can equip all weapons and armor.
Miho Fujiwara, Kichou’s childhood friend. She’s a samurai in training who is quick in movement.
Mirabel Yakumo, the Princess of the Democratic Kingdom of Gensokyo. She has a broad array of healing and defensive spells.
Towa Houraisan, the Princess of the People’s Kingdom of Gensokyo. She can easily bend destructive spells to her will.
This massive role-playing adventure features:
NOTE: Basic reading ability is required to fully enjoy this game.
Four playable characters (characters above) ranging from a fighter, thief, and two magicians.
Watch day turn to night according to your system’s time. Some monsters only come out at night.
Over 100 different pieces of gear to equip, as well as special skills and magic.
Dozens of never-before-seen monsters, including new variants of existing monsters and new species.
company: Drillimation Systems, Studio Emiko, E Enthusiasm

title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian
description:
게임 정보
소중한 것을 되찾기 위해 잃어버린 고향에서 두 사람은 진실을 찾는다……
<<스토리>>
과거에 세 곳의 주 경계선에 존재하며 광산과 교역으로 번영을 이루었던 마을 「할펜」.
그 평화로운 마을에서, 대부분의 주민들이 사라졌다는 수수께끼의 재해가 발생.
마을은 출입금지 지역이 되었고, 왕도에서 파견되는 조사원을 제외하고는 드나들 수 없게 되었다.

세월이 흘러 마을의 출입금지가 해제되고, 부흥 계획이 세워지게 되었다. 이를 계기로 과거에 고향을 떠날 수밖에 없었던 소녀와 소년은 각자 생각하는 바를 가슴에 품으며 귀향한다. 소녀는 실종된 할아버지가 남긴 가게를 되찾기 위해. 소년은 아버지가 남긴 유품을 조사하기 위해. 그리고 공통된 목적인, 마을 사람들이 사라진 원인을 조사하기 위해……

두 사람은 고향 땅에서 만나고 함께 진실을 찾기 위해 걷게 된다. 그들 앞에 상상도 하지 못했던 만남과 진실이 기다리고 있다는 것을 모른 채……
<<필드>>
모험의 무대는 『레슬레리아나의 아틀리에』와 같은 「란타나 대륙」.

본작에서는 캐릭터를 조작하여 필드를 직접 탐색할 수 있습니다.
필드에서는, 시간 경과에 의한 밤낮 변화와 날씨 변화 등에 의해 『레슬레리아나의 아틀리에』에서는 다 표현하지 못했던 경치를 만끽하면서 모험을 즐길 수 있습니다.
전투는 『레슬레리아나의 아틀리에』를 계승한 전략성이 높은 타임라인 커맨드 배틀입니다.
배틀 멤버는 전열과 후열 각각 최대 3명씩 이루어지고, 동료와 함께 힘을 합쳐 전투를 즐길 수 있을 뿐만이 아니라 멀티 액션과 아이템 믹스, 연계 공격 등 새로운 요소를 구사해서 보다 상쾌한 배틀이 전개됩니다.
조합은 소재가 가진 색깔 「기프트 컬러」를 연결하여 아이템을 제작하는 「기프트 컬러 조합」. 동료와 협력해서 조합하면 아이템을 더욱 강화할 수 있습니다. 또한, 최대 3종의 소재로 특성을 부여할 수 있으므로 간단하면서도 세심하게 조합할 수 있습니다.
「조합」으로 제작한 아이템을 자신의 상점에서 판매하여 마을을 발전시킵시다! 다양한 아이템을 판매해서 돈을 벌고, 그 돈으로 출자하면 마을이 발전해 나갑니다. 마을이 발전하면 새로운 조합 레시피를 획득하거나 메인 스토리가 진행됩니다.

title: ReLinked 0.26091975
description:
게임 정보
THE PLANET IS IN DANGER, COMRADES!
Hordes of alien invaders have invaded Earth, destroying everything in their path. The enemy has broken through the surface and is rapidly advancing into the depths—mines, subways, old bunkers, bases, and tunnels. The underground has become a battlefield: dark, cramped, and dangerous.
The military is conducting a series of sweeps—step by step, meter by meter. You are part of this machine. One of the soldiers sent below. The order is simple: clear the sector.
GAME FEATURES
Weapon Customization
You can change the behavior of your weapons with modules. Shoot multiple bullets at once, add effects, pierce through enemies, or make bullets bounce off walls. Experiment and find what works best for you.
Destructible Map
Every block in the level is destructible. Grab a drill and carve your way through, break walls to search for enemies.
Procedural Level Generation
Dungeons are randomly generated. Every playthrough is different—new rooms, routes, and situations that never repeat.

title: True Vikings
description:
게임 정보
소개
당신은 평범한 바이킹 전사로서 북쪽의 혹독한 환경에 위치한 작은 마을에서 여정을 시작합니다. 앞에는 당신을 영광의 정상으로 이끌 수 있는 수많은 도전과 사건이 기다리고 있습니다. 내전과 프리지아와 잉글랜드에 대한 습격을 통해, 당신은 자신의 부족을 이끌고 강력한 야를(Jarl) 혹은 **코눙(Konung)**이 될 수 있습니다. 그러나 선택은 당신의 몫입니다: 정복의 길을 따를 것인지, 과거를 버리고 평화로운 땅을 지킬 것인지를 말이죠.
이 게임은 다양한 이야기를 담고 있습니다:
서사적인 전투, 전사로서의 영광을 얻을 수 있는 기회.
로맨틱한 순간, 전쟁의 혼란 속에서도 마음을 따뜻하게 만들어 줍니다.
세 가지 길 중 하나를 선택하고 당신의 운명을 개척하세요, 16개의 독특한 결말 중 하나를 잠금 해제하며:
바이킹-정복자: 두려움을 주지만 공정한 통치자가 되어, 정복한 땅과 함께 살고 번영하며 약탈을 멈추세요.
바이킹-약탈자: 약탈과 정복의 길을 따르며 모든 것을 굴복시키는 것을 목표로 삼으세요.
수호자: 파괴를 거부하고 앵글로색슨 왕국에 합류해 침략자로부터 그들을 보호하세요.
당신이 내리는 모든 결정은 당신의 운명뿐만 아니라 왕국, 민족, 그리고 시대 전체의 미래를 결정합니다. 당신은 어떤 길을 선택하시겠습니까?

title: LingTian2: Your Destined Prince
description:
게임 정보

링티안2(LingTian2)는 로맨틱하고 달콤한 오토메 비주얼 노벨 게임입니다. 당신은 방 왕국의 평범한 소녀로, 왕자 링티안과의 운명적인 만남은 당신의 따뜻한 마음 덕분입니다. 이제, 당신의 사랑과 로맨스가 펼쳐질 준비가 되었습니다. 이 멋진 왕실 로맨스를 맞이하세요!

▌로맨스 방 왕국의 왕실은 왕자 링티안이 공주를 찾을 수 있도록 "사랑 찾기 이벤트"를 개최합니다. 이 이벤트는 공공의 관심을 돌리고 사회적 긴장을 완화하는 방법으로 사용됩니다. 왕실 시험 후, 당신과 다른 소녀들이 결승에 진출합니다. 그러나 방 궁전에 들어서자마자 왕자는 특별히 당신에게 관심을 가지며 모든 면에서 당신을 보호합니다. 궁전 안에서, 소녀들은 숨겨진 "방 카드"를 찾아 왕자와 데이트할 기회를 얻습니다. 하지만 왕자 링티안은 몰래 당신이 시간 동안 그와 함께 할 수 있도록 힌트를 제공합니다.
왕자를 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 왕자는 당신을 무조건적으로 방어하며 결코 당신을 탓하지 않습니다. 병사들이 당신을 제압하려 할 때, 왕자는 부상을 입었음에도 불구하고 병사들을 엄하게 꾸짖으며 당신에게 해를 끼치지 않도록 합니다.
눈 내리는 날, 왕자는 직접 소녀들을 궁전에 맞이하며 전화기를 선물로 주었습니다. 곧 다른 소녀들은 자신들의 전화기가 왕자와 연락되지 않음을 깨닫고, 오직 당신만이 전화를 걸고 메시지를 보낼 수 있습니다. 당신이 그에게 이 질문을 던지자, 왕자는 깊은 애정을 담아 이렇게 대답합니다: "나는 오직 너만 좋아해. 다른 소녀들에는 관심 없어. 나는 오직 너만 신경 쓰고, 너만 집중해. 너와 함께 있고 싶을 뿐이야."


▌전체 게임 버전
1,000개 이상의 정교한 3D 장면
전 캐릭터 음성 연기 및 효과음
왕자의 심장 박동, 온기, 호흡과 상호작용, 그의 방과 단서 잠금 해제
왕자가 전화, 메시지, 동행, 잠자리에 들게 하는 10개의 상호작용 구간
다양한 선택이 다른 결말로 이어지는 10개의 사이드 스토리라인
재미와 탐험을 위한 3개의 미니게임
사랑에 빠진 느낌을 들게 해주는 10개의 아름다운 테마곡
Ginyan의 소설을 바탕으로 한 10만 단어 이상의 달콤한 로맨틱 이야기

▌방 왕국 소개 방 왕국은 제3차 세계대전 후 지각 운동으로 형성된 사각형의 땅에서 새롭게 창건된 국가입니다. 이 나라는 자유롭고 평등하며 다양한 민족과 언어가 공존하는 나라입니다. 방 왕국의 사람들은 본래 로맨틱하며 사랑에 대한 열정이 강합니다.


▌왕자와 당신
링티안 — 방 왕국의 왕자이자 왕위 계승 4위, 잘생기고 고결하며 성실하고 충성스러운 성격을 가진 왕자입니다. "사랑 찾기 이벤트" 이전에 이미 당신에게 깊이 빠져 있었습니다. 당신이 방 궁전에 입성할 수 있도록 그는 모든 노력을 기울였으며, 무슨 일이 있어도 당신을 무조건 보호합니다. 왕자에게 실수로 물어보았을 때도, 그는 오직 당신이 처벌받을까 걱정하며 자신의 부상은 아랑곳하지 않습니다.
당신 — 친절하고 성실하며 요리에 능한 소녀, 특히 브레이즈드 포크 라이스가 특기입니다. 요리 학원에 다니며 파트타임으로 일하면서 왕실 시험에서 결승에 진출하고 방 궁전에 입성하게 됩니다. 왕자를 만나게 되어 긴장과 부끄러움을 느끼지만, 다른 소녀들이 왕자의 마음을 얻으려 노력할 때, 실수로 왕자를 물게 되어 자신이 탈락할 것이라고 생각합니다. 그러나 곧, 왕자의 호위병이 된 정훈과 재회하게 되며, 정훈은 왕자가 진심으로 당신을 좋아한다고 전합니다.

▌게임 플레이
스토리 시청/선택하기: 영화 같은 스토리 속에서 왕자와의 로맨스를 진행하고 방과 단서를 열어가세요.
미니게임: 왕자에게 연고를 바르거나 단서로 퍼즐을 푸는 재미있는 게임.
일상 상호작용 및 동행: 왕자와의 전화, 메시지, 일기를 통해 소통합니다.
노래와 비디오 리뷰: 로맨틱한 순간을 되새기며 심장을 느껴보세요.


▌환생 시리즈 "방 왕국 왕자 과거와 현재의 꿈 환생 시리즈" — 링티안, 진팅, 비웨이, 리누오 네 명의 왕자가 함께 시간을 초월한 영원한 사랑을 엮어갑니다. 방 왕국 사람들은 환생을 믿으며, 과거 삶을 되돌아보며 링티안과 당신은 사랑이 이 생에만 존재하는 것이 아니라, 수많은 생을 걸쳐 쌓인 것임을 깨닫게 됩니다.
1-링티안: 이번 생의 운명적인 왕자 | 왕자 링티안은 이번 생에서 첫눈에 당신에게 빠졌습니다. 그의 사랑 추구는 당신을 방 궁전에 데려오는 것에 불과하며, 당신을 온전히 보답하고 아끼고 싶어 합니다.
2-진팅: 전생의 헌신적인 왕자 | 방 왕국의 진팅 왕자는 군사학교에 다녔으며, 주방에서 일하는 당신을 항상 보호하고 지켜주었습니다. 그의 열정적이고 헌신적인 로맨스는 당신에 대한 깊은 사랑이었습니다.
3-비웨이: 전생의 왕자 동급생 | 당신은 왕자를 위해 총알을 막았고, 그 덕분에 왕실 고등학교에 다니게 되었습니다. 왕자 비웨이는 당신을 깊이 보호하고, 달콤한 캠퍼스 로맨스를 되돌려줍니다.
4-리누오: 전생의 불면증 왕자 | 리누오 왕자는 당신이 그의 배고픔을 채우고, 그의 곁에 있어야만 잠을 잘 수 있었습니다. 당신의 달콤한 사랑은 그의 불면증을 치유했습니다.
이 사랑은 환생을 넘어, 수많은 생을 거쳐 계속될 것입니다...

▌1000 Princes 시리즈
🌸 "1000 Princes" 오토메 게임 (STEAM 및 Google Play): 왕자님들과 함께하는 당신의 로맨틱한 이야기! 매우 달콤하고 화려한 로맨스 비주얼 노벨 오토메 게임 시리즈.
📕 "1000 Princes" 포토북 전자책 (Google Play): 왕자님의 포토북 (텍스트, 이미지, 사진, 영상 포함).
🥐 "1000 Princes" 테마 송 (YouTube): 왕자님들이 당신을 위한 사랑을 노래하며, 당신만을 위한 사랑의 피아노 멜로디를 연주해요.
🌕 "1000 Princes" Patreon: 공주님 멤버가 되어 벽지와 다양한 디지털 상품을 다운로드하고, 왕자님들의 이름과 사진이 삽입된 독점적인 사랑의 편지를 맞춤 제작하세요.
🌲 "1000 Princes" LINE 스티커: 왕자님들의 사랑으로 매일 채팅을 채워보세요!
💎 "1000 Princes" 공식 웹사이트: 각 왕자님에 대한 종합적인 정보와 업데이트를 확인하세요.
🫐 "1000 Princes" 개발자 브이로그 (Ginyan): YouTube에서 확인하세요.

▌개발자 프로필 Ginyan — 독립적인 오토메 게임 개발자, 전자책 작가, 외국어 학습서 및 로맨틱 소설 전자책 창작자. 판타지에 대한 열정을 가지고 있으며 컴퓨터와 외국어 학습에 대한 강한 욕구를 가지고 있습니다. COVID-19 봉쇄 기간 동안부터 iClone과 CC를 배우기 시작하여 3D 애니메이션을 제작하고, Unity 게임 엔진을 연구하고, AI 기술을 결합하여 소설을 오토메 게임으로 변환시켜 플레이어들이 달콤한 사랑의 세계에 몰입할 수 있도록 했습니다.

title: Sandtable Engine
description:
게임 정보
땡! 크리에이티브 타임 땡!

샌드 엔진은 게임을 즐기거나 다양한 종류의 DIY 게임 아이디어를 만들고 싶을 때 경량급 게임 아이디어 및 게임 플랫폼을 제공합니다!
샌드 엔진은 완전히 모듈식 엔지니어링에 기반한 게임 프로그램 플랫폼입니다. 게임 내 장면과 플레이를 완벽하게 모듈식으로 구현합니다. 플레이할 모듈을 불러옵니다. 또는 자신만의 모듈을 만듭니다.



다중 통합 모듈러 메커니즘

샌드 엔진 게임 본체를 획득하면 모든 엔진 기반 게임 플레이를 잠금 해제하고 지속적으로 업데이트하는 것과 같습니다!
게이머는 다양한 게임 플레이를 경험할 수 있습니다. 게임 플레이를 독립적인 모듈을 지원하는 게임이라고 생각하시면 됩니다. 모든 플레이가 이 모듈을 기반으로 하므로 "하나의" 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.
개발자는 간단한 JavaScript 프로그래밍과 함께 지도 편집기를 통해 자신만의 게임 세계를 만들 수 있습니다. 완전히 독립적인 게임 플레이를 만들 수 있습니다.



엔진 메커니즘 및 특성

플레이어의 경우:
멀티 플레이어 온라인 기본 지원, 싱글 및 멀티 플레이어를 모두 지원하는 게임 모듈러 (SteamP2P, Dedicated Server)
플레이어가 직접 호스트 서버를 구축할 수 있음(Steam 친구 초대)

title: Run TavernQuest
description:
게임 정보
Run TavernQuest is a role-reversing twist on old school text adventure games. You're the command parser and game master, overseeing the game's inner workings for a player named STEVE. Can you guide STEVE away from his poor decisions so he can save the princess?
In this game, you won't be typing. Instead, STEVE is the player and he types commands to you, often very bizarre ones. Your job is to interpret his words and choose how the adventure proceeds. The choices you make can lead him down drastically different paths, but it's ultimately up to STEVE to win the game.
Features
Fully narrated by the very talented Jack Dundon
Control the environment and every NPC as they respond to STEVE's stupid commands
Engage in text-based combat where your goal is to lose every time
Customizable font and grayscale mode for enhanced readability

title: Heart Of Muriet
description:
게임 정보
Heart of Muriet is a voxel fantasy 4X RTS with a unique take. Teaming up with Elves, Dwarfs, and Mages, you’ll need to build and manage settlements while researching powerful magic to overcome the enemy in tense, company-based warfare.
Build and upgrade your bases with up to 40 different buildings and even more upgrades. Choose from 4 magic realms with a great selection of spells and a plethora of research options to boost the might of your heroic wizard and their army. Pick a clever strategy for your army, control your wizard and watch them win epic battles against your enemies.
You can manage troop formations and workers with ease and without any stress. Gone are the days of dragging boxes on the battlefield, instead you control entire formations or all the workers at a specific base with a single click. Give your fighting formations special commands depending on the situation, or use your spellcasters to turn the tide of epic battles.

title: NIA
description:
게임 정보
Drill, smash, leap and slide through this 2d puzzle platformer mashing retro graphics & icepunk aesthetics. Explore dozens of hand crafted worlds in well over 100 different levels.

A young icer-nomad must drill, battle, and puzzle her way towards the discovery of a lifetime - the true cause of The Silver Storm and the last warm day on Earth - to save her family from the growing cold.


A young icer-nomad has just been given her first ice drill and joined her place in the community as an icercadet. Everything is going just as it should and everyone is doing their part - except that hasn’t stopped the frost from growing through the farmbeds and the lights from crackle-popping in the frigid night. Every once in a while, spectral glimpses of the cities of old can be admired through the permafrost asbut the elders only mutter ”the past is the past’. The Silver Storm is now nothing but a story told to keep cadets under their electric blankets at night.

With fantasies of canned ham and the magical foods of The Before time drifting through the new cadet’s mind, a glimpse of a factory lost deep in the ice beneath her makeshift bed is all she needs to make her decision - she’s going down. As she drills, a crack forms, a large crack that swallows her up and slides her into the depths of the ice below.

Lost in the Underice, she must now find her family the food they need while navigating the dangers lurking below her world. If that means she has to solve the mystery of The Silver Storm and end the global ice age, then so be it. People have to eat.



NIA is a lighthearted old-school 2D platformer with a few modern twists.


13 worlds hand crafted to offer the best possible experience.


A complex simplicity reminiscent of the classics, handcrafted levels for fans of platformers old and new.

title: Apple Pie Bueno
description:
게임 정보


Immersive RPG. A narrative-driven role-playing game. Unite the region as a post-nuclear drug-running god... guinea pig for science and scavenge as a peaceful vagrant… or experiment as some third kind of person so indefinable you upset the elderly

Freedom of Exploration. Navigate by landmark as you explore the dilemmas of this rich, open world's factions and inhabitants. Try to help, ignore them outright, or play both sides as you see fit

Unforgettable Encounters. A cast overflowing with unique characters, each with secrets to uncover and problems to solve. Have deep conversations, philosophize on society, investigate, rant, provide therapy, or manipulate

Intricate, Branching Stories. Secrets are devastating in the wrong hands and actions taken at the wrong time can be catastrophic. Numerous endings differ drastically based on player behavior

Imagination Fuel. An ambient, unobtrusive soundtrack provides each location with a unique theme and underscores the lonely spaciousness of the open prairie

New World. Discover dozens of bizarre post-apocalyptic locales as you trek the barren landscape. Piece together the connections that tie this world together

title: Tales of War
description:
게임 정보
Tales of War is a highly dynamic multiplayer voxel medieval experience featuring large scale castle siege maps and many classes to choose from.
Features:

20+ classes
5 classes of each role: Frontline, Ranged, Support and Mobile.


Siege [2-100 players]
Engage in large-scale battles and conquer all flags to win.


Fight in close quarters and defeat each enemy 3 times to win. An Arena server contains 4 arenas (up to 24 players) and 12+ randomly selected map


Make a significant impact on the battlefield by selecting real life Legends with unique abilities.

title: ProtoDungeon: Episode III
description:
게임 정보
ProtoDungeon: Episode III is a short adventure game which draws from Game Boy Color sensibilities. Escape from the Third Nightmare, using nothing but the magic item you find there beneath a shriveled lotus tree. Jump, swim, and dash to unlock your way through a seaside cove, discover what's inside the shipwreck, and maybe get closer to solving the mystery of the nightmare prison by reaching that familiar chapel...

ProtoDungeon is the mini-series prequel to The Waking Cloak. Stay tuned for further announcements!

Note: you don't need to play the first two episodes to enjoy this one!

title: Secrets of Moon Island
description:
게임 정보
Secrets of Moon Island is an Action Adventure RPG with its own, unique approach to Swordplay.
Discover a mysterious island, fight against vicious monsters, and become stronger during your adventures.
The Secrets of Moon Island is a solo developer project (very indie), programmed from scratch in over 6 years of passionate work. The game tells the story of the last descendants of a once wealthy family who are trying to find out what happened to their long lost ancestor. What will they find?
Key Features
Experience Non Target Based Combat.
The game features its own combat system, the "Fencer Mode".
If your sword connects with an enemies body with sufficient speed, or even if they just run into your sword, they will take damage.
To avoid getting hit and taking damage of your own, simply either move out of the way of the enemies hit or move your weapon in the path you think the opponents weapon will take
In most cases enemies do what is known as telegraphing, they pull their weapon back in the direction they are going to try to hit you from. Use this to parry their weapon. If you have successfully parried an enemy, you will have a small time frame to get in a hit of your own.

title: School of Magic: Deck & Slash
description:
게임 정보
마법 학교에 오신 것을 환영합니다
마법 학교에 온 것을 환영하며, 예기치 않게 신비로운 세계로 이동한 자신을 발견하고 속삭이세요. 소용돌이치는 불확실성의 안개 속에서 여러분은 신비한 힘의 비밀이 기다리고 있는 특별한 여정의 문턱에 서 있습니다.
전투
마법학교의 신성한 홀을 여행하며 오크, 스켈레톤, 그리고 다른 세계의 적들과 맞서 치열한 주문 시전 전투를 벌이세요. 주문을 외우고 마법을 사용할 때마다 전투의 기술을 익히고 원소의 원초적인 힘을 활용하는 데 한 걸음씩 다가갈 수 있습니다.

title: SOWA VR
description:
게임 정보
SOWA VR - is a multiplayer virtual reality shooter with a focus on community features. Realistic and simplified recharge features and fast paced combat as part of the core experience.

Features
Community hosted dedicated servers.
Quick-starting lobby system.
Search And Destroy, Deathmatch, King of the arena, and Gun Game game modes.
Bots.
Offline mode.
Practice range.
Proximity voice chat and radio communication.

title: RelicWar
description:
게임 정보
Turn Based Gameplay
Starting each match you will have a deck of cards. These will allow you to boost movement, attack or defense. You can set traps to slow your enemies down or use the same cards in your hand during battles to give you that extra edge.
Unique Hunters
Each Hunter has a different background story, principles and weapon for combat. Outside of the dungeons you will need to upgrade them and provide healing for any lasting injuries at the nearby MediCenter. Some Relics you find can be equipped for your next adventure into the dungeons.

title: Secrets For Taking
description:
게임 정보


You wake up in this new world. There are four zones to explore. Each zone has its own hidden devices within them.
As you explore, you can develop a stronger soul by fighting others. Once beating them, you can choose to let them go free or take their secret, making you vastly stronger.

Discover what happened and who is chasing after you. There will be some hints given in unordinary means, but you will understand.
Depending on your actions and beliefs, you can change everything.

Features

Journey through a new world with its new, beautiful, and mysterious locations!
Enjoy a beautiful story and (hopefully) nice soundtrack!
Have a party where you the player lead Mash with some of his allies.
Other fantastic gameplay mechanics that make the game fun.
Make choices that maybe affect the story?
Level and Currency systems.
A moderately challenging game, that gets harder as it goes on! (definition of a normal game, to be honest)
Some Easter Eggs (Secrets) hidden inside and/or outside the game!
















Go Wishlist Secrets For Taking now! You'll be notified of when the Game is available!
And thank you to everyone who has already wishlisted the game. You have my deepest respect and gratitude!
What are you waiting for? You reached the bottom. Play the game!!

title: Sword of Shadow: Revolution
description:
게임 정보
그림자의 검:혁명은 오픈 월드 롤 플레잉 게임이다. 신들의 우주에서 일어나는 행동과 어떤 실수는 전 세계의 죽음으로 이어질 수 있습니다. 당신은 아케론,반 인간,반 악마,어둠의 진정한 하나님,파괴와 유혈 사태에서 세상을 구할 수있는 유일한 사람으로 재생됩니다,이 세상에서 당신의 작업은 평화의 진정한 인감,만 년 이상 신들의 분노를 억제 칼을 찾는 것입니다.

고유성
무기와 힘의 거대한 다양한 악마로 재생할 수 있습니다.
아케론은 그가 세상의 구원이라고 알려져 그의 개념의 순간부터,어둠의 진정한 하나님,그는 훌륭한 살인자로 훈련되었다,그는 자비와 고통을 알고,그의 목표는 하나님의 진노에서 인류를 저장하는 것입니다.

-개선하고 힘을 각성,숙달에 기술을 연마,어둠의 독특한 기술을 습득,그들을 마스터하는 법을 배워야,그렇지 않으면 그들은 당신을 죽일 것입니다

-사람,신,악마,동물 및 기타 생물과 싸우십시오. 당신의 수준을 높입니다.

열린 판타지 세계 탐험
당신이 더 강해지고,영웅과 그의 행동을 연구하고,이 우주의 새로운 비밀을 배울 수있는 전 세계.
버려진 장소,동굴 및 도시를 탐험하십시오.
광산 금,문자와 통신하고 문제를 해결하는 데 도움이,당신의 직업은 힘입니다.

title: Into the Evernight
description:
게임 정보
Into the Evernight is a retro-styled role-playing game with a heavy emphasis on player choice and branching story paths.
Turn-based, tactical combat.
Engage enemies in tactical, RPG-style combat as you try to stop the spreading darkness.
Branching story paths.
The choices you make and actions you take will lead the storyline down very different routes.
Evolving game difficulty.
Into the Evernight's difficulty is not set by a slider in options, but rather by your in-game choices. An easier path forward always exists, but at what cost...?
Upgradeable skills and items.
Customize your squad with over 60 upgradeable skills. Wield weapons and armor that gain in strength not only as they are reinforced, but also as your characters become accustomed to them.

title: Project Hypnagogia
description:
게임 정보

A mad scientist conducts an experiment on a subject in an abandoned hospital called "hypnagogia," where the subject's true fear is revealed. Watching them flail from side to side, trying to escape from themselves. Not the first or last experiment, not everyone survived, but one Subject #17 was able to distinguish himself from all his predecessors.

Trialee #17 is the unnamed protagonist you will be playing as. Throughout the game you'll have to run, hide, confront and find loopholes. As you immerse yourself in your fears, the environment will begin to change and creepy images will begin to hunt you more often until you die. The level of anxiety shows how much the Test Subject #17 sinks into hypnagogia, pills must be taken to control the anxiety.

The player will stumble upon the lab where all the secrets are, where he will eventually go. And what already awaits there - will scare everyone, a huge scale laboratory, where you can kill a lot of time to study all sorts of materials on all sorts of cases related to the previous subjects. As with the reason for closing the hospital.

In gameplay there are two types of items, basic and story, basic will always be with you, that is, the same light source. Plot ones are those that are needed for further progression, whether it's finding the keys to open the door to need to turn on the generator, and for this you need fuses that are scattered throughout the hospital.

Game Features:
- A critical alarm mark results in death, as does a head-on encounter with scares.
- Changing environments throughout the playthrough.
- A constant sense of dread, images from the subconscious are always haunting Test Subject #17.
- Little elements of parkour, for more effective escape.
- Hide or run, or do it all together, it's up to you.
- You can't confront your fears, only run and hide.

title: SkyCraft
description:
게임 정보
Skycraft is an open-world survival game for 1-10 players, set in infinite procedurally-generated floating islands.
CONSUME ESSENCE

Possess your spirit to consume the essence of the skies. With each essence, enhance your abilities and expand your island. Embrace the essence and let your spirit soar.
MAINTAIN YOUR ISLAND

Don't let your island run out of essence. Keep gathering essence to enhance astral dimension and expand island. Shape your sanctuary into a thriving haven and defend it from threats.
GATHER RESOURCES

Discover rare resources scattered across islands, crafting essential tools and equipment. Each find shapes your destiny amidst the boundless skies.

Constructing a base to shelter you from dangerous creatures and unforgiving weather. Strengthen defenses against aerial predators and storms. Your sanctuary stands as a beacon of safety in the turbulent skies.

Embark on expeditions to explore diverse islands, uncovering their hidden secrets and untold treasures. With each step, unravel the mysteries of these uncharted lands and forge your own path amidst the wonders of the skies.

title: Project Microchip
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Project Microchip is a thrilling multiplayer game that combines survival, strategy, and social deduction. Players are trapped in an isolated, abandoned forest under heavy radiation, where they must join one of two factions: Infected or Survivor. To survive, they need to collect items, complete objectives, follow clues, and make strategic decisions—but trust is a dangerous thing.
Story
A biotech company claimed to have developed a serum that grants immunity to radiation. To test it, seven volunteers were sent into an abandoned, irradiated forest. At first, everything seemed normal, but within days, strange things started happening. Some test subjects began to undergo uncontrollable mutations. Their instincts became feral, their strength grew, and they were no longer fully human. These individuals were soon labeled Infected. The remaining subjects, who resisted the serum's effects, became the Survivors. But now, they face a far greater challenge—staying alive in the forest, avoiding radiation, and escaping the relentless hunt of the Infected. Who is Infected, and who is a Survivor? Paranoia spreads, time is running out, and every second, survival gets harder...
The real threat? Is it the Infected hunting you down? Or the Survivor you trust the most?

title: Fractured Worlds
description:
게임 정보
The world is broken. All that remains are fragments, forming an ever-changing labyrinth of times and places lost. Explore randomly generated zones, uncover lost stories and amass loot & power as you search for what broke the world and a way to fix it in this action RPG.

Utilize a variety of weapons, skills and spells in easy to control beat 'em up style combat.
Find and obtain both randomly generated and unique gear with varied bonuses and modifiers to suit your playstyle in a system designed to minimize "trash" items and focus on interesting decisionmaking.
Seamlessly connect to other players to cooperatively take on the combined contents of both players' dungeons. Or, use shards found in your travels to set up a multiplayer run in a set dungeon with up to 4 total players.
Leave markers for others that are more than just messages; the same nearby enemies, treasures and traps you encountered will appear in their procedurally generated area, allowing players to share particularly rewarding - or punishing - encounters.

title: Deflectorium
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist Deflectorium now. The galaxy needs you.
Gameplay
Actively deflect incoming projectiles back at your enemies or spin them around yourself and throw them back. This can all be done within the deflection zone around your hero. Move freely across the arena in no time. Gravity won't bother you.
Arenas are connected to each other on a hexagonal map where a boss waits patiently at the end, opening the way to other sectors. With a new threat.

Along the way, you find various run upgrades that, to a greater or lesser extent, make the journey easier. And more fun. Resources found are perfect for permanent upgrades.

Features
Bullet perfect game
Instant movement by mouse
Active deflection of enemy bullets
Spin and release
Permanent upgrades
Passive run enhancements
Special skills (curving space and time)
Hexagonal progress map
Boss fights
Classes

title: Warlock's Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Battle your way through hordes of the Warlock's minions in this dungeon crawler! Find better armor and weapons to help you survive, level up to increase your stats, learn new skills to smite your enemies or heal yourself. In the end, will you be able to defeat the evil Warlock and free your people from his tyranny?
***Please Note IF YOU PLAY THE DEMO***
The game is still in ALPHA phase. You may experience bugs, poor quality animations, sounds, VFX, etc. and other issues. Feel free to point things out in the community hub! 
Things we are currently working on:
Animations
Sounds
Visual Effects
Game Balance
Other game mechanics
Adding items
Adding creatures
Lots of other cool stuff!

title: On the Hunt
description:
게임 정보



On the Hunt is a first-person wild animal hunting simulator. A game with a fairly well-developed world of wildlife. Wild animals are very circumspect and careful, hunt down and develop your hunter skill!
Test your new weapon at the shooting range and go hunting for the beast in these beautiful places as soon as possible!

KEY FEATURES:
A large number of picturesque locations for hunting, at different times of the year.
Decide for yourself: to hunt in sports excitement or meditatively walk around the area.
A wide selection of smooth-bore and rifled weapons and cartridges for them.
Hunting animals: elk, wild boar, deer, bear, wolf, fox...
Upgrade system of experience and ammunition.

Hunting in various scenic regions is fun and exciting!
Have a good hunting !!!

title: Mapama Pirates
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in the boundless world of Mapama, an MMO filled with adventure, naval battles, and treasures! Command your own ship and sail through a vast ocean, visiting numerous ports where you can stock up on provisions for your crew, trade goods, and acquire valuable upgrades for your ship.
You begin humbly with a small single-masted sloop, armed with two cannons. However, by skillfully gathering wood, ores, and other resources, you can constantly improve your ship. Rise to command the mighty ketch, or dominate the seas aboard a grand galleon or frigate.


In the world of Mapama, there are numerous professions you can master:
Carpentry
Metalworking
Naval Combat
Navigation
Fishing

title: A Blocc World
description:
게임 정보
A Blocc World. The best kind of world. A world of discovery, adventure and smashing fun.

Wander through peaceful fields, golden sands and towering trees, and dare to dream that you could be the hero this world needs. Stop dreaming. This world needs a hero.

You'll need to train. Smash your way through the ugly beasts trying to ruin your peaceful paradise. Learn from your battles. Unlock new powers to smash even harder. Steal items and equipment from your vanquished foes. Don't worry about the ethical concerns of looting the deceased, it's all for the Quest. Don't stop to clean up after yourself, that will only slow you down. Focus! The Quest!

You'll need help. Make friends on your travels. Help them with their troubles and they might just help you too. But don't get too friendly, they'll distract you from the Quest.

You'll be tested. Some of the ugly beasts pack quite a punch. But they stand in the way of you and the Quest. You know what that means.

title: Amnea28: Two Eternities
description:
게임 정보
∞ "Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 
∞ Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.
∞ 30-50 hours of gameplay
∞ 5 unique routes
∞ 36 different endings and 19 unlockable epilogues
∞ more than 100 CGs and 32 music tracks
∞ the character routes are NOT romantic (the protagonist can't romance anyone); however there are certain romantic subplots in the story
∞ the choices you make shape up the character's mental state, the changes can be observed via a special stress scale. Don't let stress destroy the poor thing's mind, or their not-so-great qualities will manifest. They say "Amnea" puts pressure on its guests, so don't let them lose their minds!

title: Poly TD
description:
게임 정보
소개
