title: Eclipse of Elysium
description:
게임 정보










In Eclipse of Elysium, you step into the shoes of 21-year-old Aria. At first glance, she appears to be a young, unassuming woman who wouldn't harm a fly. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, Aria is a biological weapon, deployed on the most dangerous missions in Eldora. Will you guide Aria to become a guardian angel, protecting the innocent, or a ruthless assassin fulfilling the orders of the powerful and wealthy?



Aria's emotional landscape is turbulent at best. Impulsive, fierce, and often consumed by rage, she embodies the unpredictability of a storm. However, like the calm after a tempest, she can also exhibit kindness and a willingness to aid those around her. The emotional path Aria treads is yours to shape. Will you navigate her through the darkness with a compassionate heart, or will rage be her guide? The choice is yours.



Serving the "Python Network," one of the most critical intelligence services of the Republic, Aria operates in the shadows. She's the one called upon when danger looms, or when tasks demand a leap outside the boundaries of legality. Her hands are the ones that get dirty, fighting battles unseen and undertaking missions that others dare not whisper about.

At the helm of Aria's assignments is Liaison Officer Krall, a member of the Scalekrin—an ancient race of lizard people long oppressed. Krall has climbed the ranks through sheer determination and now stands as a pivotal figure within the Python Network. His loyalty to the organization is unwavering, and he will do whatever it takes to secure his standing, guiding Aria through the network's dark web of intrigue and espionage.



In this shadowed world, every decision, every alliance, and every battle shapes the destiny not only of Aria but also of Eldora itself. What will your choices reveal?





Charon, was once among the most influential figures in Endora. As the chief advisor to the Merchants' Guild, his knowledge, experience, and wisdom were highly valued, and his counsel was eagerly sought after.



However, those who knew him witnessed Charon's gradual descent into madness, a process that began when he started investigating the origins of the mysterious Conflux. This dangerous organism relentlessly spreads across the world, engulfing villages, cities, and even entire kingdoms in its path.

Charon's intent was to halt this threat, leading him to the ruins of ancient civilizations. Yet, as his investigations deepened, he became increasingly reticent and enveloped in secrets. Five years ago, Charon vanished from the public eye. Now, he has reemerged, leading a mysterious order that is working to accelerate the growth of the Conflux.



To be honest, I'm a newcomer in the video game industry. I've been gaming since I commandeered my sister's Super Nintendo at the age of 10. But the dream of developing my own video game only took hold three years ago when I tried out Unreal Engine for the first time and quickly realized the boundless possibilities it offers.



My dream is to create a game that merges the best of two worlds. I'd like to combine the charm and pathos of a JRPG like Xenoblade with the vast freedom of choice found in Western RPGs like Baldur's Gate. The adventure should be easily accessible. There are no complex mechanics preventing you from quickly getting into the game. I also want to avoid grinding that unnecessarily prolongs playtime.

I aim to create a cinematic work that takes players on an emotional journey, presenting them with tough emotional choices and introducing them to charming and complex characters.

title: Seagulls: Crappy Situation
description:
게임 정보
Seagulls: Crappy Situation
바다에 고립되어 분노한 갈매기들에게 둘러싸인 채, 슬링샷과 물 호스만으로 끝없이 밀려오는 파도를 견뎌야 합니다. 이 독특한 로그라이트 게임에서 멀티태스킹과 전략을 테스트하세요. 유머러스한 혼란과 기괴한 갈매기가 기다리고 있습니다!
🚣‍♂️ 갈매기 파도에서 살아남기
갈매기들의 파도에서 당신의 뗏목을 방어하세요. 슬링샷으로 갈매기를 쏴서 떨어뜨리세요, 하지만 조심하세요—이 새들은 끔찍한 엉망을 남깁니다. 실패할수록 더 많이 배웁니다!
👫 로컬 협력
친구를 초대하여 분할 화면에서 협력하여 갈매기들의 혼란을 함께 처리하세요! 팀원과 함께라면 더 카오스하고 훨씬 더 재미있습니다!

title: My Dear Neighbor
description:
게임 정보
The darkest matrix ever created
My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror puzzle game set in a distinct and captivating world. Players will find themselves immersed in a story rich with unique characters and a terrifying atmosphere. This game challenges players with moral decisions and reveals a brutally unforgiving world waiting to be discovered. As players navigate through this virtual realm, they will experience a hand-crafted universe filled with secrets and parallel dimensions to explore and unravel.
In My Dear Neighbor, Edition 404, players are plunged into a bleak and terrifying universe, where they must seek answers within a matrix-like reality. The challenge lies in discerning truth from illusion and facing one's deepest fears. Players must fight to escape a nightmarish world riddled with bugs and harrowing visions in this intense psychological horror experience.
A world unique in its kind

title: Zurarararush!!!
description:
게임 정보
~story~
20xx
A pandemic Breaks Out Due to A Mutated Virus!
The Whole World Is Filled With Fear and Anxiety.
In the midst of this, a device that can directly attack the virus
"ZURA" is developed, and a ray of hope shines on the world!
Can you defeat the virus and save the world――?

~Game Overview~
"Zurarararush!!!" is a twin-stick shooter that is easy and intuitive to play.
The player becomes a doctor wearing a micro-suit,
and wears ZURA (a wig) as a weapon, and defeats the mutated virus inside the body.

ZURA has many types, and by wearing them, you can shoot various bullets.
ZURA can be stacked, so by taking multiple types, your firepower will increase significantly.
ZURA has a limited number of bullets (hair volume), so they will run out eventually.
The point of the strategy is to keep taking ZURA and maintain your firepower.

There Are Currently Two Modes Available.
Arcade Mode Has 100 Levels Plus Some Extras.
Score attack has two types: 3 minutes and infinite.

In arcade mode, there is a simple story where the doctor defeats the virus and becomes a hero, with themes of lovers and parents and children.
You can collect DNA and power up like an RPG, so anyone can aim for the ending.

In score attack, you compete with people around the world for the highest score.
By defeating enemies within a certain time, you can continue your combo and increase your score.
ZURA acquisition is essential for maintaining the combo.

The Play Time Is Expected to Be 10 to 20 Hours.

title: Surfers Code
description:
게임 정보
서핑은 라이프스타일입니다
여행하는 서퍼로서 열대 섬의 차가운 분위기에 빠져보세요.
첫 번째 섬에서는 독특한 캐릭터들과 교류하며 방향을 잡고, 서핑을 배우고, 과거 서퍼들의 역사를 발견하고, 보물을 탐색해 보세요. 편안하고 라이프스타일에 맞춰 첫 번째 서핑 장소를 연결한 후 보트를 타고 다른 섬으로 모험을 떠나보세요. 뱃사공은 "길을 따라 많은 휴식 시간이 있습니다"라고 암시하지만, 당신은 "빠른" 제트 스키에서 우승하면 더 멀리 모험을 하고 외부의 신비를 밝힐 수 있다는 것을 알고 있는 대회 섬에 가는 데 관심이 있습니다. 섬.

외곽섬
서핑만이 이 섬의 매력은 아닙니다. 처음에는 "이 섬들은 신비와 모험으로 가득 차 있다"는 것을 알게 됩니다. 다른 방문객과 대화하고, 여행자의 일기를 읽고, 제트스키를 타고 외곽 섬을 탐험하면서 섬의 비밀과 펼쳐지는 설화를 밝혀보세요. 모험이 발전해감에 따라 상황이 항상 보이는 것만큼 간단하지는 않다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다.


엄청나게 멋진 서핑
간단한 컨트롤과 무한한 가능성을 갖춘 물리 기반 서핑입니다. 버튼 하나로 테일 슬라이드, 컷백, 방송이 가능합니다. 하기는 쉽지만 잘하기는 어려운 시뮬레이션 디자인. 이 지역의 전문 서퍼들은 속도를 조절하고, 파도를 읽고, 속도를 높이고, 테일 슬라이드나 공중으로 달려가야 한다고 말합니다. 이것을 잘하는 법을 배우는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 파도는 당신이 그릴 수 있는 열린 캔버스입니다. 웨이브 점수는 귀하의 능력 진행 상황과 개선 방법을 보여줍니다. 모든 휴식 시간에 콘테스트가 가능합니다.


초보자 휴식에 적합한 시뮬레이션 보드로 시작하세요. 섬 곳곳에 흩어져 있는 더욱 전문화된 보드로 이동하세요. 큰 파도를 위한 빅 웨이브 건, 속도와 큰 공기를 위한 빠른 트윈 핀, 그리고 재미있는 보드 몇 개를 선택하여 화살통을 완성하세요.


섬 전체에서 서핑 브레이크를 찾아보세요. 초보자 휴식 시간부터 시작하세요. 약간의 기술과 연습이 필요한 빠르고 느린 구간으로 쉽게 이륙할 수 있는 정말 재미있는 쉬운 파도입니다. 근처에 있는 다른 리프, 포인트, 비치 브레이크를 이용해 보세요. 모두 고유한 특성을 가지고 있습니다. 군중에서 벗어나 다양한 신비롭고 알려지지 않은 휴식 시간을 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요.


당신은 한 명의 탐험가에게 묶여 있지 않습니다. 다양한 플레이어 중에서 선택하세요. 하지만 각 플레이어가 게임의 물리학에 영향을 미친다는 점을 알아두세요. 특히 서핑에서 플레이어를 바꾸고 게임의 느낌을 바꾸세요.

title: Two Sides
description:
게임 정보
Two Sides is a unique sandbox where you explore the duality of choices. Play as a savior or a sinner, navigating through complex scenarios that challenge your morality. You create your own story. This isn't a game about good vs evil, your choices have consequences and there's no clear path to achieving your objective without any side effects.

Features:

- Simulated sandbox environment with NPCs that respond to your actions.
- Consequences where any character can become a witness to your action.
- Realistic physics & gunplay.
- Infinite replayability through randomized levels.

Every action you take affects how the level can play out. Are you going to shoot an innocent just because they saw you break the law so you don't get caught? Or are you going to shooting someone accidentally just to get to an objective faster?

Two Sides is a top down tactical shooter where you navigate a detailed sandbox full of interactions.

Are you prepared to make tough choices? Will you risk people's lives to conceal your mistakes, or will you take the difficult path to preserve your morality? In Two Sides you can choose how you want to approach things.

title: The Schism
description:
게임 정보
There has been a rift created between realities, and they're calling it "The Schism". The Schism is a sci-fy horror game, where you - a world renown scientist -  must gather useful intel to aid the government's containment plan. Your team will enter compromised locations, and set about your tasks to collect critical information. But beware, your not alone.
Survival
The Schism features immersive survival mechanics. As your fear increases, an ever growing amount of danger follows in your wake, with immersive hallucinations. Stay alive by keeping calm using a variety of special objects.
Replayability
Using unpredictable AI, The Schism ensures that each playthrough is unique. This is not a game you play once and throw away. The Schism can offer endless enjoyment with your friends.
Environments

title: Sigils of Slaughter
description:
게임 정보
Hack and slash and magic your way through an otherworldly uprising certain to raze the world to nihility. Navigate chaotic urban environments, bringing to bear supernatural weapons and dark magic. In addition to top-down shooter mechanics, our novel gesture and sketch-based user interface offers a unique gameplay experience that traditional interfaces do not by enabling the player to express their will through drawings.
Blades of Mayhem
Use butcher knives tethered to magical ropes by drawing slashes:

Magical Traps
Sketch sigils that anchor to nearby enemies and drain their life:

Conjurings and More
Conjure and command allies to help you fight, as well as unique weapons and artifacts to gain an advantage. Use a variety of magical means to survive the onslaught, but if all else fails - use your ever ready shotgun.
Experience engaging gameplay through complementary enemy design. Brawl against bare knuckle fighting brutes, fireball flinging fiends, and trigger-happy troglodytes. Confront mages that shoot lightning, wizards that cast spells, and wretches who steal your magic. Some enemies are fast, others slow. Some have shields and others don't need them. All are savage.

title: Warriors of Thalyrion
description:
게임 정보
Warriors of Thalyrion is a 2D pixelart action game in which you can fight short and fun battles against your friends. As a classic couch game, you play on the same PC as your friend and you share the same game world.
Choose a hero
Before starting the game, you decide on a hero. You can choose between different archetypes and weapons. Do you prefer the sword or the bow? Every character has a weapon for close combat and one for distance fight.
Choose a game mode
PvP: In PvP mode, your teammate is your opponent. Try to achieve the round objectives and score more points than your opponent. Each arena is set up differently and a round is limited in time. With targeted attacks, you can prevent your opponent from collecting points.
Co-op: In the co-op campaign, you play together with your teammate. Complete the round objectives together to reach the next level. A campaign consists of several levels, which are completed with a boss fight.
Solo: You can also play through the campaigns alone. But be aware that it won’t be easy.

title: Cards and Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
카드 & 던전즈는 핵앤슬래시 액션과 카드 플레이를 결합한 액션 가득한 로그라이크 던전 크롤러입니다. 무작위로 생성되는 층을 탐험하며 몬스터와 싸우고, 전리품을 모으고, 카드를 사용해 강력한 효과를 발휘하세요. 과연 깊은 심연에서 살아남을 수 있을까요?
끊임없이 변화하는 층을 돌파하라
절차적으로 생성된 던전에 내려가 점점 강해지는 적들과 싸우고, 역동적인 환경을 탐험하세요. 각 층마다 독특한 레이아웃, 몬스터, 함정이 있어 매번 새로운 경험을 제공합니다.
카드의 힘을 마스터하라
여정을 통해 카드를 모으고 사용해 강력한 효과를 발휘하세요. 카드 덱을 전략적으로 업그레이드하고 조정하여 계속 진화하는 위협에 대응하세요.
영웅을 선택하고 플레이 스타일을 정의하라
각기 다른 무기와 스킬을 가진 다양한 캐릭터 중에서 선택하세요. 근거리 전투를 선호하든, 정밀한 원거리 공격을 선호하든, 당신의 스타일에 맞는 영웅이 준비되어 있습니다. 진행하면서 새로운 캐릭터를 잠금 해제하고, 던전을 공략하는 새로운 방식을 발견하세요.
강력한 적들과 보스에 도전하라
몬스터 무리와 강력한 보스와 대결하세요. 아래로 내려갈수록 적은 점점 더 강력해집니다. 적의 패턴을 파악하고 전술을 조정하여 끊임없는 공격에서 살아남으세요.
전리품을 모으고 업그레이드하라
전투를 통해 보상을 얻고, 골드를 사용해 덱을 강화하며 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하고 영웅을 업그레이드하세요. 전설적인 카드와 강력한 업그레이드를 활용해 자신만의 전략을 세우고 더 깊은 던전을 탐험하세요.
높은 반복 플레이성
절차적으로 생성된 층, 다양한 영웅, 무수한 카드 조합 덕분에 매번 새로운 도전과 놀라움을 경험할 수 있습니다. 깊은 심연의 마지막 층까지 도달해 승리할 수 있을까요?

title: DUCK DUCK
description:
게임 정보
Gather the flock and fluff your feathers for a fly new chatroom sandbox experience!
Soar and Explore a Vibrant Open-World Sandbox
Welcome to Mourning Duck Island, a land of opportunity where you’ll take flight, dive deep, and waddle your way through a mysterious world full of secrets and treasures.
Gather, Trade, and Build
Around these parts, bread is more than just food; it's money! Acquire bread and materials to expand your very own nest, a fully customizable home. Discover and build unique interactables to improve your gathering, enhance exploration, or just have fun!
Glide, Slide, Dive, and Drive
Mourning Duck Island is your playground! With a range of fluid movement mechanics, explore land, air, and sea in whatever way you desire.
A Multiplayer Sandbox Full of Quacky Adventures
Team up with friends in this open-world multiplayer sandbox! Ride pedal-powered boats together, place interactive objects to help with gathering, and explore cooperatively. Whether you're gliding side by side, diving for treasure, or just goofing around, there’s always fun to be had!
Grow Your Flock
Raise and nurture a flock of loyal ducklings to gather materials and uncover hidden treasures. Customize each one to create the ultimate squad of resourceful little hatchlings.
Your Brood, Your Way
Express yourself with unlockable cosmetics for both your duck and ducklings. From stylish feathers to quirky outfits and hats, make your ducks truly stand out in the flock!

title: AYON: Split In Time
description:
게임 정보
AYON: Split in Time

Embark on an epic time-travel adventure in AYON: Split in Time. As Dahx, you’ll traverse multiple eras to reunite with your lost brother, Aidan. Armed with ancient artifacts called Ayons, you’ll navigate a world brimming with mystery, danger, and discovery.
A Vast, Exciting World 🌍
Explore richly detailed environments spanning tropical islands 🏝️, dense forests 🌲, snowy mountains 🏔️, and arid deserts 🏜️. Each era presents unique challenges and hidden secrets. Navigate intricate dungeons and vast landscapes, facing diverse enemies and formidable bosses. Seamless transitions between time periods add depth to your exploration, making each discovery more rewarding.
Master Time Manipulation ⏳
Harness the Ayons’ power to bend time and solve complex puzzles 🧩. Each Ayon possesses unique abilities to help you overcome obstacles and progress. Master these mechanics to gain an edge in combat and uncover your family’s legacy.
Forge Your Own Path 🛡️
Customize Dahx’s abilities to match your playstyle. Enhance combat skills, develop powerful magic, and upgrade equipment to face mounting challenges. Your choices shape Dahx’s journey, ensuring a personalized adventure.
An Epic, Time-Spanning Drama 🎭
Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative across multiple timelines. Unravel the mystery of your parents’ disappearance and the ancient artifacts they discovered. Experience a tale of brotherhood, betrayal, and redemption, woven through a rich tapestry of historical and fantastical elements.
Dynamic Combat and Exploration ⚔️
Engage in fast-paced combat with varied weapons and abilities. Use the environment to your advantage and adapt to each era’s unique conditions. From fierce creature battles to intricate puzzles, the gameplay keeps you constantly engaged.
Immersive Audiovisual Experience 🎶
Lose yourself in a captivating soundscape that adapts to your environment and actions, crafted by a visionary composer. Coupled with stunning visuals and meticulously detailed environments, AYON: Split in Time creates a truly immersive world.
Take a break from the main adventure with fun and nostalgic 2D pixel art minigames. Hunt for ancient gems in hidden caves and enjoy a variety of mini-challenges that add extra layers of excitement to your journey.

Join Dahx on his quest to reunite with Aidan, uncover time travel’s secrets, and save their world from impending doom. AYON: Split in Time offers a unique blend of adventure, puzzle-solving, and action that will captivate players and leave them craving more.

title: Stellar Dawn: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
용감한 전사여, 인터스텔라 도전에 준비하세요
"스타라이트: 생존자"는 알려지지 않은 인터스텔라 황야로 떠나는 생존 게임입니다. 여기에서는 최첨단 고급 기술 무기로 무수한 적과 맞서 싸우는 용감한 전사로 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 각 전투는 긴장과 흥분으로 가득차며, 각 적은 전진하는 길에 큰 장애물이 될 수 있습니다. 손에 든 무기와 전략을 활용하여 강력한 적을 물리치고 생존의 기회를 얻어야 합니다.
미지의 탐험과 귀중한 보물 발굴하기
신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 탐험하고 지표면 아래에 숨겨진 귀중한 보물을 발견하세요. 생존뿐만 아니라 이 미지의 땅에서 가장 귀중한 자원을 발굴하는 것이 여러분의 임무입니다. 이 보물들은 즉각적인 이익을 가져다주는데 그치지 않고 전투 능력과 생존 능력을 향상시키는 강력한 업그레이드를 해제하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 각 발굴은 모험이자 각 발견은 놀라움의 순간입니다. 계속 전진하고, 알려지지 않은 지역을 탐험하며 더 많은 보물을 찾아야 합니다.
인내와 지혜로 진정한 생존자가 되기
위기에 가득한 인터스텔라 황야에서는 인내와 지혜만이 여러분의 생존을 가능하게 합니다. 전례 없는 도전에 직면하고 다양한 어려움을 극복해야 진정한 생존자가 될 수 있습니다. 준비되셨나요? 이 모험 여행을 시작하고 알려지지 않은 도전을 맞이하여 스타라이트에서 가장 용감한 전사가 되어봅시다.

"스타라이트: 생존자"가 여러분의 참여를 기다리고 있습니다. 함께 이 신비로운 인터스텔라 황야를 정복하고 여러분만의 전설을 만들어봅시다!

title: Gravepact
description:
게임 정보
Gravepact is a survival roguelite where the goal is to destroy as many incoming enemies as possible, while collecting experience to spend on attacks, passive items and skills to build your character into a powerful conduit of destruction that lays waste to everything in your way.

Eight strangers find themselves pulled towards a long forgotten graveyard, under the power of an invisible force they are incapable of resisting. Why were they gathered here? Who commands the coven of witches determined to keep them there? What dark secrets are your companions hiding from you, or even from themselves?
Features
Eight characters with branching class upgrades that provide additional skills and improve your primary attack in their own way.
Start from a Gravekeeper shoveling zombies over the head and end with a Wraith Queen that commands angry ghosts to shred her enemies to pieces.
Or begin as a humble Occultist threshing enemies with zig-zagging Eldritch Bolts as he works his way up to becoming an Archmage of unimaginable power.
From magic and archery to summoning and just good old fashioned hacking and slashing, there is a playstyle for everyone.

Bank upgrades
Levelups in Gravepact do not constantly interrupt your gameplay the way they do in most Survivor type games Open up your character screen at any time to spend your level-ups on new weapons, items and upgrades, as well as improve your skills. A + sign on your portrait will let you know if there is something new to be gained.

Forge new weapons, spells and powers
Hate having to get a specific item to upgrade a specific attack into another specific attack? Gravepact does away with narrow limitations. You don't need any specific passive item to upgrade any specific attack. Attacks are upgraded using gems you find during the game and any base attack type can be turned into an ultimate attack type. IE: A base weapon like the Javelin can be turned into any Ultimate weapon like the Knife of Hearts or the Muramasa.

Dig up the past to increase your power
All of the characters have something to contribute beyond their skill in carnage. As you discover more about them and the place you are stuck in together your collective power will grow. Better stats, new and improved starting bonuses, in-run character updates and events, and more.

title: Library of Meialia
description:
게임 정보
Library of Meialia is a 2D pixel art rogue-like adventure where you play as Amlos, a curious young dragon navigating the sprawling, enigmatic Library of Meialia—a place where you don’t quite belong. As you journey through the endless halls, you’ll face off against the library's sentinels and ancient beasts long sealed away. Along the way, forge friendships with diverse characters, uncover hidden secrets, and grow stronger with every battle. Immerse yourself in this meticulously hand-crafted pixel library, where every corner offers both opportunity and peril, all set to a beautifully composed soundtrack.
Soar Through the Library—Until You Can't…
As Amlos, the young dragon, your wings allow you to fly effortlessly through the library, scale walls and explore unknown corridors . But beware—some rooms will ground you, forcing you to tread carefully with your claws.
Knowledge is Power
The Library of Meialia is the ultimate center of magical knowledge. On your quest to master Aethium magic, you’ll discover magic books and pages scattered throughout, each offering new skills to aid your journey. With over 70 skills to unlock, the possibilities are endless. Take your discoveries to the Aethiumeter and use your newfound powers to conquer any obstacle in your path.
Unleash the Sealed Beasts
Each level of the library contains terrifying monsters, sealed away for students to study. But you’ll face them head-on, battling through their varied attack patterns and relentless bullet hells. You'll need to defeat them to prove your worth and advance deeper into the library. But remember—greater dangers lie in wait at each level's end…
No Two Explorations Are Alike
The Library of Meialia is never the same. Thanks to its random map generation, each playthrough in the library offers a fresh experience. New paths, new challenges, and new treasures await every time you step inside. Grab your magic books and prepare for the unexpected!

title: Kombat Hamster
description:
게임 정보
햄스터 메타 농장을 자동화된 햄스터 코인 채굴 기계로 성장시킨 다음, 기술을 개발하고 더 많은 기술 자원을 확보하여 생산량을 늘리고 더 많은 햄스터 코인을 얻으세요! 내려가는 길은 없고 올라가는 길만 있어요!

농장을 개선하고 보상을 받으세요: 더 많은 햄스터! 햄스터가 많을수록 농업 사업이 더 빨리 성장합니다! 그리고 기억하세요: 햄스터는 야행성보다 더 어두컴컴하며, 야생에서는 포식자에게 잡히지 않기 위해 낮 동안 지하에 머물지만 농장에서는 그렇지 않습니다. 그들은 연중무휴 24시간 일하고 있으며 햄스터 동전이 그들이 살아가는 유일한 목적이기 때문에 아무것도 두려워하지 않습니다.

순위를 높이고, 임무를 완수하고, 보상을 받고, 새로운 기술을 잠금 해제하고 광산, 광산, 광산! 올바른 길로 가고 있어요, 햄스터 사령관님!

이것은 단지 시뮬레이션 게임일 뿐이며 플레이하는 동안 실제 암호화폐를 채굴하는 것은 아니라는 점을 명심하세요!

행운을 빌며 달에서 만나요!

title: Day Trader Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Day Trader Tycoon: Make Your Mark in Stocks and Crypto
Day Trader Tycoon is a parody of the stock market where you play as a day trader trying to beat the market. You'll need to quickly react to news and events, leverage insider trading, and participate in several schemes to earn money trading stocks and crypto.

The game is story-based where you interact with a variety of characters and make decisions that impact the outcome, with multiple possible endings.
Gameplay Features

Trading Platform: Fast-paced trading where quick thinking in stocks and crypto can make or break you. Markets change in real-time based on news and world events
Interactive Storytelling: A story that changes based on what you decide to do, with different endings depending on how you play.

The Story

Fresh out of college with your finance degree, you land a job at Obsidian Capital, a small and shady firm. Your new coworkers are smart and well-connected, but they're not always playing by the rules. It's up to you to figure out how to succeed in this tricky environment, balancing making money with doing what's right in both the stock and crypto markets.



The game will be available for Windows, Linux and Mac.

If you like the game, please consider joining the for more frequent updates & discussions!

title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
description:
게임 정보
Key Game Features:
Intelligent, terrifying creatures that stalk your team, learn, and evolve.
A changing, mutating world where the environment itself is your enemy. Each game is unique, with the landscape mutating in different ways.
Cooperative gameplay, where you work with your team to get in, collect scrap, and get out before the environment and creatures grow to monstrous levels.
Cannibalize your friends

title: Moonbane Survivor
description:
게임 정보
수많은 달의 괴물들을 쓰러뜨리고 생존하세요!
Moonbane Survivor는 달에 의해 폐허가 된 도시에서 살아남는 로그라이트 RPG Bullet Hell 게임입니다.
적을 쓰러뜨리고, 전리품을 얻고, 조합하고, 강해지세요. 그리고 이 세상을 구원하세요.
다양한 무기 모듈과 장비의 조합으로 탄막을 헤쳐나가는 스릴을 느낄 수 있습니다!
Features :
수많은 적들을 쓰러뜨리세요.
전리품을 얻고 새로운 장비를 장착하여 강해지세요.
다양한 무기 모듈을 조합하여 당신만의 강력한 무기를 만들어보세요.
스테이지를 공략하고 새로운 무기와 모듈을 언락하세요.

title: Mystic Blaze
description:
게임 정보
Graze through a canvas of supernatural flame and hand drawn pixel art.  
There's wizards
Grind against dense streams of fire to power your offense.
Patterns and bosses inspired by both classic shmups and modern bullet hells.
There's spooky entities too

title: Deadly Trick
description:
게임 정보
'Deadly Trick'은 서브컬처 사회적 추론 게임입니다!
주어진 학급 활동을 완료하여
라스토프 학교에서 벌어지는 데스 게임인 '특별 수업'에서 살아남는 것이 게임의 목표입니다.
친구들을 모아 함께 플레이 하세요!
데들리 트릭은 5~8인의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있습니다!

title: Splat Splat
description:
게임 정보
Splat Splat is a "skill" based top-down shooter 1v1 mayhem game! Splat your friend until they can't splat no more! Then do it again and again to become the ultimate Splatter!
Collect coins to bid for upgrades and gain advantage over your opponent!

title: Does The Moon Dream
description:
게임 정보
The quiet town of Frozen Pines. It was the perfect place to get away, just the two of you. So then why? Why did things go so horribly wrong?
Beware, you're being hunted. Strange and deadly monstrosities hide behind every corner. Armed with only an axe and your wits, face the horrors and find the answers you seek.
FEATURES
Directional, Grid-Based Combat - Brutal grid-based combat with directional attacking and blocking that requires both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.
Choices Matter - Be careful on you route through Frozen Pines, your actions will affect will affect whether characters live or die.
A Love Letter to PS2 Horror - Inspired by the likes of Killer7, King's Field 4, and the Silent Hill series, with a unique retro horror aesthetic.
Chilling Monster Encounters - Explore a variety of eerie locations and eldritch beasts as you search for survivors, uncovering the town's mystery.

title: Cendovia Uprising
description:
게임 정보
Cendovia Uprising is a turn-based battlefield card game. In each battle, you play cards to advance your army across the battlefield. Destroy the enemy's leader before they destroy yours. Tailor your decks to suit your strategy. Navigate challenging terrain as you fight among ten factions to conquer Cendovia.
Conquer the Island and Each Other
Cendovia Uprising offers 3 play modes:
Campaign Mode (PvE): plot your course across Cendovia as you compete in a series of battles to conquer the island.
Scrimmage Mode (PvE): play stand-alone matches against NPCs of your choosing.
Online Mode (PvP): battle against others online in public or private matches or tournaments.
Build the Ultimate Deck
Your deck consists of your leader, starters, and reserves. Every battle begins with only your leader on the battlefield and your starter cards in your hand. In subsequent turns, you draw cards from your reserves. Tailoring your decks to match the terrain and opponent can aid you in combat. You can create many custom decks.

title: Secrets Of Suburbia
description:
게임 정보
The Story
In the quiet town of Covenbrook, a girl has gone missing. Some say she ran away, but rumors online suggest something far worse. The town has seen disappearances before, and people are becoming suspicious. But you are Rowan Parker, and you’re home alone on a Friday night. Who's going to let that stop you from playing video games, browsing the internet, and IMing with your friends all night?
Ok. You can also leave your bedroom and solve the mystery if you want.
Gameplay
Secrets of Suburbia is a story-rich, first-person mystery game that weaves horror and web exploration into it's core. You can investigate at your own pace.
Key Features
Explore the suburbs of 1997. Venture into a variety of locations in and around the town, from pristine homes to forgotten places. Behind locked doors, you’ll discover secrets and truths that have stayed hidden until you decide to look for them.
Explore an internet of 1997. You have unlimited access to a hand-crafted internet of 1997.  Find games, fandoms, secret websites, and people's real online personas at 56kbps*. At least, once you disable that firewall that mom just set up.
Engage in deep, logical deduction. Discovering the truth involves utilizing every resource you have. Find keys and passwords to unlock new areas both online and offline. Infiltrate other people's accounts to figure out what's really going on.

title: CardCraft Champions
description:
게임 정보
A unique roguelike game that blends deep strategic deckbuilding with fast-paced auto-battling.

Craft cards to create a huge variety of combos.
Discover and upgrade game-changing items.
Challenge traditional deckbuilding wisdom: thin decks offer speed but lower health and item proficiency.
Freely buy, sell, and combine cards to forge your perfect deck.
Choose from 5 different classes and 2 art styles: classic fantasy or animal champions.

CardCraft Champions is a fresh strategic challenge.
Will you build a lean, efficient deck, wield the most powerful items, or discover a perfect balance?

Craft cards into unique combinations.


Items can upgrade up to tier 6.


5 classes of characters.

title: Tree of Knowledge
description:
게임 정보
A rogue-lite where instead of battling monsters, you battle trivia questions! On your way to the top you have the chance of discovering various events and artifacts, which may help or hinder your progress. Every time you die you gain XP and level up, which unlocks additional skills to help you on your climb to the top.


FEATURES:

Randomly generated trees of trivia. Every climb will be different



Over 4 000 different quiz questions divided into over a hundred different categories

title: Seeing Red
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in SEEING RED, a single-player, first-person survival horror experience that pulls you into a chilling narrative filled with suspense and mystery. You step into the shoes of Benjamin, an ex-military private detective whose troubled past comes back to haunt him when he returns to his forgotten childhood town.
SEEING RED is a full-featured first-person survival horror game that offers an intense and immersive experience. This product includes:
Full Story Campaign – A gripping, atmospheric narrative following your search for your missing sister, uncovering dark secrets along the way.
Gameplay Features:
First-Person Combat – Use firearms and melee weapons to fight off relentless monsters, but beware—ammo and stamina are limited.
Stealth & Evasion – Hide, run, or find alternative ways to survive against creatures hunting you.
Investigation & Exploration – Search for clues, interact with NPCs, and uncover the town’s dark secrets through dialogue and environmental storytelling.
Decision-Making – Your choices affect how the story unfolds, leading to different outcomes and interactions.
Puzzles & Lore Discovery – Solve cryptic puzzles, piece together hidden lore, and unveil the truth behind the horrors that surround you.
Immersive Horror Experience – Photorealistic visuals, dynamic sound design, and psychological horror elements that heighten tension and fear.

title: Light Night Street
description:
게임 정보
A new type of bullet hell action game is born!
Bounce back the barrage of shouts with your shield and witness the moment bullet hell games go from "difficult" to "exciting"!
Unique and diverse mecha (weapons).
Aim 360 degrees with the right stick.
Block the attacks of powerful enemies with your shield and counterattack when you see an opening.
The entire game takes place in beautiful night-time cities.
The battle begins with memorable soundtracks!

title: Impious
description:
게임 정보
Impious is a dark, turn-based roguelite RPG that immerses you in the oppressive depths of an underground indoctrination center set in a time reminiscent of modern days, yet not quite our present. As one of the "Impious," you are captured for your sins and subjected to the brutal attempts of a medieval sect to cleanse your soul through pain and obedience. Will you reclaim your freedom, or will you succumb to the brainwashing horrors within?
Features
Strategic Turn-based Combat
Engage in tactical battles where every decision counts. Utilize a variety of weapons, equipment, and consumables to gain the upper hand. Adapt your strategy by anticipating enemy moves and exploiting critical hits, dodges, and status effects.
Unique Death Mechanics
Death is not the end. When your character falls, they are returned to their cell, stripped of their gear, and subjected to further indoctrination. Manage your character's "Will" to prevent them from becoming permanently brainwashed.
Challenging Environments
Navigate through rooms filled with enemies and diverse challenges. Success relies on your equipment and stats, with varying outcomes that shape your journey. Gain experience, loot valuable items, and restore your Will through these trials.
Interact With other Characters
Meet and interact with characters you have created in previous runs. Trade items, offer motivation, and collaborate to increase your chances of escape, adding depth to the narrative and strategy.
Immersive Atmosphere
Explore the harsh, angular environments of a brutalist indoctrination center, dominated by concrete and metal. The cold, artificial lighting creates a claustrophobic and oppressive ambiance. Characters wear torturous medieval garb, emphasizing the sect's cruel methods.
Engaging Sound and Music
Experience a haunting soundscape and a unique soundtrack that blends medieval tones with 80s-inspired synth, enhancing the dark and foreboding atmosphere.
Impious offers a relentless challenge for fans of roguelites, dark RPGs, and strategy games. As you delve deeper into the center, each step brings you closer to freedom or eternal indoctrination. Are you prepared to face the horrors within and reclaim your will?

title: Robinson Crusoe : The Lost Tribes
description:
게임 정보
"Stranded. Alone. Survival is your only hope."
After a devastating shipwreck, you awaken as Robinson Crusoe, stranded on a mysterious Caribbean island. The fight for survival begins immediately—battle hunger, thirst, and relentless predators while uncovering the island’s darkest secrets. Scavenge resources, craft essential tools, and build shelters to withstand the harsh wilderness.
But survival is only the beginning. The island is home to ancient ruins, warring tribes, and a terrifying enemy—ruthless cannibals who hunt in the shadows. To endure, you must form an unlikely alliance with Friday, a captive native. Together, you’ll infiltrate enemy camps, raid forbidden lands, and uncover a hidden past that will challenge your very humanity.
Every decision shapes your fate. Will you hold onto your morals, or will the island turn you into a predator?
Key Features:
Survive the Wild
Master Resource Management – Nature is Both Friend and Foe
Every day is a fight for survival. Your stomach growls, supplies run low, and the island gives nothing for free. If you want to live, you must find water, food, and materials to craft tools.

title: Undeance
description:
게임 정보
Step into the high heels of a nightclub hostess and defend your territory in an over-the-top third-person zombie shooter. When the undead crash the party, it is time to grab your weapon and show them who is boss.
Battle through waves of increasingly deadly zombies in a vibrant, neon-lit nightclub setting. Start with a basic pistol, earn score for each kill, and use it to purchase powerful new weapons or unlock fresh areas of the map. Survive round after round, upgrade your loadout, and reclaim your club.
Whether you are fighting solo or partying up with friends in multiplayer, teamwork and firepower are your keys to survival.
Defeating invaders earns youscore, which can be spent on upgrading your arsenal. Invest in powerful weapons to ramp up your firepower, allowing you to eliminate waves of undead more efficiently. The stronger your gear, the better your chances of survival!

title: What remains of my sins
description:
게임 정보
What remains of my sins blends psychological horror and retro aesthetics with procedural generation to create a tense and unpredictable journey. You step into the worn shoes of an aging protagonist whose physical limitations and faltering memory reflect a life steeped in regret. Each time you enter a level, the layout and challenges shift, forcing you to adapt quickly while you search for the key to escape.
Beneath the grim visuals and oppressive atmosphere lies a deeper tale of redemption. As you navigate claustrophobic corridors and grimy, decaying spaces, echoes of the past hint at a lifetime of inflicted harm, abuse, and loss. Uncover the protagonist’s story through subtle environmental clues, confronting both inner demons and horrifying enemies along the way.
Will you break free from the nightmare and atone for your sins, or remain trapped in a cycle of guilt forever?
This demo represents an early vision of the game. Some mechanics or narrative elements may evolve during development.
Procedurally Generated Levels
No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring each run feels fresh and terrifying.
Elderly Protagonist
Movement and actions are intentionally constrained to reflect age and vulnerability, intensifying every tense encounter.
Retro Horror Atmosphere
Dark and morbid pixel-inspired visuals, combined with unsettling sound design, evoke a classic survival horror feel.
Stress-Based Puzzle Solving
Rely on quick thinking and memory retention under duress to uncover crucial keys and pathways to safety.
Themes of Sin and Redemption
Dive into a story marked by past wrongdoing and the quest for absolution, woven seamlessly into the gameplay.

title: Cat at Home
description:
게임 정보
From the moment of waking up from a coma, the life of the cat Orange was completely rewritten. Upon entering this mysterious villa, Orange encounters the bizarre disappearance of the homeowner, "Boss." The animal companions living under the same roof, each with distinct personalities, can all speak and clearly possess wisdom beyond that of ordinary animals.
"Wait, how did I become so smart too?"

title: Inventorix
description:
게임 정보
(우주 요정이 제작한) INVENTORIX 장치를 사용하여 성간 아이템에서 최대한의 가치를 이끌어내고, 외계인을 고용하여 수익을 끌어올리세요. 미스터리한 빚을 갚거나, 운을 믿고 천문학적인 부를 창출해 보세요.
주요 특징(체험판, 더 많은 기능 추가 예정)
은하계 수익: 우주의 돈을 벌어보세요. 짤랑짤랑!
인벤토리 관리: 아이템과 외계인을 묶어서 강력한 콤보를 찾아보세요.
80가지 아이템: 신중하게 선택하세요.
75가지 외계인 특전: 빌드에 제일 큰 지원이 되는 특전은 무엇일까요?
10가지 이상 아이템 클래스: 한 클래스에 집중하거나 클래스를 혼합하여 우주처럼 어마어마한 시너지를 만들어 보세요.
로그라이크: 각 런은 변화무쌍하고 빠르게 전개되며 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
7가지 INVENTORIX 장치: 장치를 잠금 해제하고 장치마다 다른 고유한 전략을 살펴보세요.
7가지 난이도: 점점 어려워지는 도전을 정복하세요.
도감: 새로운 아이템과 외계인을 발견하여 도감을 완성하세요.

title: Climbing Back to the Mothership
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction:
Climbing Back to the Mothership might look like a typical 2D platformer.
But using "seems" to describe the genre feels a bit inaccurate. After thorough research, we found that the surveyor in the game can't actually jump because he's unconscious. He can't jump, and he can't move on his own. The core mechanic of the game revolves around using the grappling hook on the surveyor's arm to move around.
From feet to hands, from jumping to grappling, from nothing to something.
So, Climbing Back to the Mothership is a 2D platform drag-and-pull game.
Thank you for your interest in my game This page's content has been polished by GPT for localization.
The trailer features an older version of the content, but the core remains the same.
We will refine all related content before the game's release. Thank you for your understanding and look forward to it.
Game Features:
Play as a damaged grappling hook.
Climb from the depths all the way back to the mothership.
Friendly little robots help soothe your emotions when you fall back to the start.
Use your starting skills to increase your margin for error.
Hidden safety measures prevent severe falls, if you can find them.
Picturesque landscapes reminiscent of pixel art.
Fragmented storyline scattered across the map.
Many small robots accidentally dropped, each offering you surprises.

title: Territorial Hissing
description:
게임 정보
Something smells funny around here...
Niko wakes up after a long night of partying to discovers that something is stinking up his neighborhood. As he investigates he stumbles upon a story of corruption that sends him down a path with more than he bargained for.
Explore the world and discover all the secrets. Fight your way through the mean critters as you learn all the truths. Snag some cool trinkets to enhance your abilities. And laugh along the way.

title: Small Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield
Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game with procedurally generated campaigns
Choose various options for the campaign including the number of kingdoms and cities, and a campaign map will be generated with a world consisting of several small islands, making each play through unique
Choose to play as one of several kingdoms that each has their own set of islands and cities. The kingdoms all have similar unit types, but each has their own unique flavour, with strengths and weaknesses for you to use strategically
Build up your cities by constructing buildings, gathering resources and training units for your garrison from the world map. Will your cities be economic powerhouses producing loads of resources? Or will they be military training camps designed to get a variety of new units into your armies?

title: Death's Web
description:
게임 정보
"Death's Web" is a challenging "Rogue-lite" platformer where you explore an ever-changing 2D world filled with enemies ready to slay you. Fight, die, learn repeat.
Features:
Collector of Souls: You posess the ability to steal enemies souls after they die. you can secure the souls through soul spheres and use them after death to permanently increase your stats and upgrade spells.
Curses: Numerous curses are waiting to be discovered; they may lead to your demise, but they can be exchanged for blessings to aid your journey. Survive their devastating effects to claim your rewards. Curses can blind you, summon deadly spikes, unleash freezing hail, and much more—each one a unique challenge to overcome!
 Blessings: Some will heal you, others grant powerful new abilities, and some can completely absorb incoming damage. They enhance gameplay with unique effects, making each run more dynamic and engaging!

title: Seagull Kart Racing
description:
게임 정보
Dive beak on to victory!
Seagull Kart Racing is a frenetic and fun racing game in witch you're not bound like a mear mortal by gravity!
Use your wings and your wit to be the first seagull to cross the finish line!

You've just arrived in a new city and a crow from the future tells you that you're the only seagull capable of defeating the racing master, an alien entity that races across the universe destroying civilizations that aren't up to it .

Thus begins your training in time and space to become the fastest seagull of all time!

Main features:

• You can fly! Forget about gravity!
• Use 8 amazing power ups to win!
• Online multiplayer race mode (up to 8 players)
• Controller and keyboard support

Coming soon:
• Single player story mode
• Single player timed races
• Customize your seagull

title: Hellspresso
description:
게임 정보
As a dedicated ghost chef trying to make a living in the afterlife, you decide to open your own restaurant in hell. Day after day and night after night, from one shift to the next, race against the clock to serve more and more hungry customers. Switch to your not-so-secret magic kitchen to prepare more exotic dishes. Start off small, expand your restaurant and your skills, and slowly gain your reputation as the best ghost cooking chief in hell!
Cook dishes and serve hungry customers!
.
.
.
Run, cut meat, fry potatoes, mix delicious smoothies, make coffee, serve customers before they storm out, clean tables, stack dirty plates, wash dishes… You will have a lot on your plate.Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your restaurant. Every second counts, because if you take too long, your customers will be tired of waiting and they will leave angry and hungry!
.
Encountering strange orders with venomous mushrooms or magic plants that you don’t have in your fridge? Time to enter your clandestine kitchen! Discover the mystical counterparts to your regular ingredients and kitchen tools. Watch as a regular steak transforms into rotten meat, and a mushroom becomes a venomous variant with red spots. Sprinkle glowing eyes on your donuts, chop garlic, brew magic potions, and create infusions with foxglove or deadly nightshade. Your cauldron and your alembic will help you to craft enchanting recipes and satisfy every customer. Master the art of juggling between both kitchens to ensure your dishes never burn!
.
.
Discover more than 50 ingredients to cook, each with its magical counterpart hidden in your secret atelier. From familiar carrots, mushrooms, and donuts to exotic items like garlic, blood, or deadly nightshade, a world of exciting ingredients awaits your culinary creativity! You can create more than 100 different recipes from all around the world and even beyond, to offer new dishes and drinks to your demanding customers.
.
Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast. Each day, you can choose which ingredients to put on your fridge and on your cupboard, as well as the counters that will be in your kitchen. With more than 10 different personalities, each customer wants something different, and it’s up to you to optimize your menu accordingly. Discover their favorite recipes to gain their trust and unlock their secrets.
.
Some ingredients and ustensiles have a magical equivalent in your secret kitchen, allowing you to put even more recipes to your menu!
.
When they are done eating, customers take a quick nap. Take advantage of their inattention to absorb a part of their soul! Souls can then be used to improve your restaurant!
.
.
Invest the souls you stole to build up your kitchen with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for unlocking new recipes and increasing your profit. Opt for more storage capacity with a fridge expansion to use more ingredients, or tools like a new blender or more stoves to increase your productivity. You can even invest in an automatic dishwasher! Buy more tables to host more and more hungry customers. Decorate your restaurant with fine taste to increase your customer’s patience… and tips! Take some classes and improve your serving skills to get better tips, or specialize in some recipes and increase your prices. Will you decide to master the art of donuts or to unlock the secrets of smoothies? It’s up to you!

title: Roll The Bones
description:
게임 정보
Let's roll them bones!
In this high-paced, action-packed roguelite you will need to carefully choose a loadout of spell dice to beat each dungeon floor.
Pave your way through 15 unique dungeon floors filled with bloodthirsty enemies!
What's the deal with dice?
Each die has 6 sides and possibly up to 6 different spells. Some are good, some are terrible and some will straight up annihilate the enemies (or even yourself).
Choosing dice that play well against specific dungeon floors is the key to success.

title: Convicted
description:
게임 정보
Convicted is a survival horror multiplayer game set in a top-secret Soviet facility during the 1980s, full of unethical experiments, paranormal activities, and dangerous monsters! An accident happened to free some of the lab's anomalies, which will hunt you down! Play as them or try to escape!
Explore the secret Soviet laboratory, and be sure not to miss any items. They could potentially save your life! After all, you don't really know how to stop the strange, hostile anomalies. Will ordinary firearms be able to stop them? Well, there's only one way to find that out!

title: Nowhere Manor
description:
게임 정보
영혼이 있다는 것을 어떻게 증명할 수 있을까요?

자동화된 하인의 나날을 보내던 무지한 인형 리베르가 의식을 갖게 되고 비운의 저택을 탈출해야 한다는 절박함을 느끼게 됩니다.

괴상한 천사, 변절한 악마, 신성한 야망을 지닌 과학자를 만나보세요. 친구가 될 수도, 적이 될 수도 있지만 모두의 소망은 똑같습니다. 영혼을 찾아 며칠 내로 사라질 노웨어 매너에서 탈출하는 것이죠.

저택의 홀과 방을 거닐어보세요...

Monaramis의 독특하고 몽환적인 아트 스타일을 4K 해상도로 렌더링한 다크 어드벤처
저택이 간직한 기억과 비밀을 밝혀 목표를 방해하는 누구든 가차 없이 희생하는 집단에 대해 알아가세요.
손님의 비밀을 파헤치세요. 탈출하려면 영혼을 만들어내야 합니다. 동맹, 또는 적이 될 손님이 승패를 좌우할 것입니다.
멀티 엔딩: 당신의 선택이 이야기, 그리고 다른 캐릭터의 운명에 영향을 미칩니다.
천사, 악마와 거래하고, 파멸에서 벗어나 자신의 존재를 극복하세요!

title: Essentures
description:
게임 정보
Essentures is inspired by the great games of the 90s and late 80s, but incorporates the improvements and concepts of modern gaming. You will experience a grand adventure through 4 kingdoms wherein you can use mysterious creatures as both allies or weapons! It's entirely up to you how you will travel through this world, defeating the Ancient Gods and discovering the universe's mysteries as you do.
Action RPG + Turn RPG at same time!



Essentures mixes Action and Turn RPG combat systems in a unique system that encapsulates strategic thinking of RPGs and the thrill of real-time combat! To achieve this, the mechanics of both genres were blended in such a way so as to limit the weaknesses of both while exemplifying their strengths. This, mixed with many new mechanics, the reimagining of existing mechanics, a unique battle system, and an epic story creates a unique experience only Essentures can offer!
Over 250 creatures!



In Essentures each creature has an infant stage and an adult stage. The infant stage is shared among members of the same family, each with its own respective color, while each adult stage is unique. There are a grand total of 320 creatures in the game, composed of 250 adult forms and 70 infant forms. Each creature can be transformed into a weapon form optionally in battles to create lots of strategies!

title: Kaisa: Resurrection
description:
게임 정보
KAISA commands you! Wishlist now!
After the sun sets and the clock strikes midnight, your task begins: you must feed your master before the first light of dawn. How hard can it possibly be to survive the night?

What happens during the day?... Well, that's another story.
Gameplay:
Feed your master during the night.
Scheme & Prepare during the day.
Find or order mighty weapons like REGULAR chopsticks or UNIMPRESSIVE kitchen knifes to improve your combat abilities.
Who knew lies could be a currency.
Stuff your master to turn back time.
Beware the noise you make, for that which listens will come..
Not everything is as it seems.
About the Demo
Hello and welcome to Kaisa: Resurrection!
We’re a small, passionate two-man team working hard to bring this game to life. This early demo is just a small taste of what’s to come, though some features are still limited.
We’re aiming for a September release, but to bring our full vision to life, we need your support! If you enjoy the demo, please wishlist the game—and keep an eye out for our upcoming Kickstarter.
Our Vision
Kaisa: Resurrection is a brutal and rewarding experience—a game that’s easy to pick up but demands real skill to master. It’s challenging, bloody, and unforgiving, but every victory is earned.

title: OnOrbit - Virtual Space Lab
description:
게임 정보
Welcome Spacefarer, Join us On Orbit!

Try our sandbox, simulator and strategy PC game on STEAM or EPIC Games store from August 2024.
Its a high fidelity, real world and near future space simulator, featuring real world space engineering.
Gameplay - What's under the hood
We’re going, Together.

Join OnOrbit’s Supranational Space Cooperative (SSC) on its journey to make life multiplanetary. Your personal mission? Develop the skills you need to take humanity out into the solar system. Once your technical and psychological training is complete, use your knowledge to head out to the planets and build, build, build!
Build and repair spacecraft on orbit
Using real world, and near future space hardware, build your own craft from the ground up. Go from the smallest craft, to the craziest design you can think of in sandbox mode.
Operate your craft to complete missions
Use robotic arms, fire thrusters, mate with docking ports, spin reaction wheels, deploy aerials, move solar panels, take camera shorts ... operate any and all of your spacecraft parts to complete your mission, but watch out, they don't all work as expected.
Is it a rare part, or worthless space rust? Bring them back to the station and strip them for IS$ or reverse engineer them for reuse. Be warned though, you may have collected more than you bargained for.
Climb in the rankings and get to build your own space station. Take it to Mars, Venus or beyond. Lucky enough to own your own station? Rent a docking port to other players, sell them power, fuel, air and water and help them get their smaller craft in orbit around other planet
Join one of the space station missions, inspect the SSC Thor, SSC Tunguska, SSC Black Knight or the SSC LaGrange in the full version of the game.

Along with the sandbox, the future roadmap has us building the latest and greatest models from all your favorite space companies. Investigate and explore the ISS, Axiom space station, Artemis Lunar Gateway, Blue Origin's Orbital Reef, CASC's Tianggon sation and the ISS. Refuel and repair Hubble, Chandra, James Webb, Starlink satellites and the other on orbit craft. Fly the Sierra Dreamchaser, the Boeing Starliner, SpaceX's Dragon Then build out your own fleet to head out there.

If you're a modeler or a modder and want to know more, please visit us at our website. We're looking for captains for our existing stations around Earth, Venus and Mars.

title: Merauders - A Voyage of Discovery
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
Summary
A "coming of age" story about a teenager discovering who they are with the help/hindrance of the people they meet along the way. The protagonist must navigate a world of intrigue, puzzles, and quests, determining their place in the world and forging their destiny.
Discover an exciting new world filled with interesting characters, mysterious legends, forgotten islands, hidden coves, and puzzling quests
Find clues and gather treasures as you delve deeper into the story and discover more about the world as you shape your destiny and that of your family
Uncover the rich lore and legends of the realm of Modieva as you meet new people, locate new places, and experience the vast world around you
Genre
Narrative adventure RPG with puzzle elements
Similar Games
To the Moon
Stardew Valley

Setting and art style
Fantasy/Pirate/Nautical theme
2D pixel art characters and environments
Set in the Discordian Tales universe

Main player goal
Self-discovery and achieving true potential, regardless of what society dictates
SYSTEMS
Game currency

title: Ukrainians: Our battle
description:
게임 정보
Ukrainians: Our battle is a visual novel that will give you a wide range of opportunities to explore life in the country during the war. Feel yourself in the role of a volunteer, on whose shoulders a great responsibility fell in one moment. The game is filled with various graphic scenes and deep text stories that will not leave anyone behind. What dynamics does the country live in during the war: economy and business, education and science, sport, tourism, energy, police and other industries. Learn new facts for yourself and immerse yourself in these stories.
Dive into the exciting atmosphere of the game
In this game, you will travel to different locations, interact with people and situations that are based on real events. The war radically changed the life of every Ukrainian, and in this game you will be able to understand the features of the new reality. You are a volunteer and the army and civilians rely on you, but at the same time you also have a family and the need to look out for the well-being of everyone close to you. The game does not have a narrow direction, but on the contrary comprehensively reveals the life of the hero in the conditions of war. Every time you will be faced with a choice that will affect the further development of events both for you and for those around you.
Travel the country
company: Serhii Khramov, Illia Ustenko, Maksym Kanshin,

title: Fractured Worlds
description:
게임 정보
The world is broken. All that remains are fragments, forming an ever-changing labyrinth of times and places lost. Explore randomly generated zones, uncover lost stories and amass loot & power as you search for what broke the world and a way to fix it in this action RPG.

Utilize a variety of weapons, skills and spells in easy to control beat 'em up style combat.
Find and obtain both randomly generated and unique gear with varied bonuses and modifiers to suit your playstyle in a system designed to minimize "trash" items and focus on interesting decisionmaking.
Seamlessly connect to other players to cooperatively take on the combined contents of both players' dungeons. Or, use shards found in your travels to set up a multiplayer run in a set dungeon with up to 4 total players.
Leave markers for others that are more than just messages; the same nearby enemies, treasures and traps you encountered will appear in their procedurally generated area, allowing players to share particularly rewarding - or punishing - encounters.

title: The Little Clandestine
description:
게임 정보
The Little Clandestine is the continuation of the story narrated in Dirty Wars - September 11 by UglyCat Studios, an emotional 2D top-down adventure that invites you to experience the Cold War in South America during the late '70s and '80s through the eyes of Pipo, a Chilean child from a fractured family who enters a clandestine life in a world of struggle and resistance against the military dictatorship in Chile.
                                                                                                                     Pipo
Main Features:
Unique Graphic Style: The game features a graphic style inspired by posters and art from the '70s, with meticulous details that recreate the atmosphere of the time. From poor neighborhoods to the grand avenues of Santiago de Chile, each scene is designed with a retro touch.

title: Deflectorium
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist Deflectorium now. The galaxy needs you.
Gameplay
Actively deflect incoming projectiles back at your enemies or spin them around yourself and throw them back. This can all be done within the deflection zone around your hero. Move freely across the arena in no time. Gravity won't bother you.
Arenas are connected to each other on a hexagonal map where a boss waits patiently at the end, opening the way to other sectors. With a new threat.

Along the way, you find various run upgrades that, to a greater or lesser extent, make the journey easier. And more fun. Resources found are perfect for permanent upgrades.

Features
Bullet perfect game
Instant movement by mouse
Active deflection of enemy bullets
Spin and release
Permanent upgrades
Passive run enhancements
Special skills (curving space and time)
Hexagonal progress map
Boss fights
Classes

title: Inn Keeper
description:
게임 정보
독특한 1인칭 경영 게임 경험에서 풍성한 중세 판타지 세계의 여관 주인이 되어 보세요. 자신만의 규칙에 따라 시설을 관리하고 어떤 경로를 따를지 선택하세요. 고객에 적응하고 번창하는 경제를 달성하세요. 세세한 부분까지 나만의 여관을 건설하고 전 세계로 영향력을 넓혀 보세요.
고객, 판매자 및 고유한 캐릭터와 상호 작용
고객을 적절하게 맞이하고 음식, 음료 및 엔터테인먼트에 대한 고객의 요구를 충족시키고 마땅히 누려야 할 휴식을 제공하세요! 여러분과 여관의 평판을 관리하세요. 순회 상인 및 생산자와 상업 계약을 체결하여 자원 생산에 영향을 줄 수 있는 위험(질병, 기상 조건, 도적 공격 등)에 대처하면서 재고를 지속적으로 보충하세요.


퀘스트를 완료하여 세상을 움직이고, 고객을 돕고, 길드에 가입하여 지원을 받고, 권력의 영역으로 올라가거나 새로운 캐릭터를 만나세요. 강력한 사람들의 도움을 받거나 라이벌을 제거하여 장애물을 설치하여 비즈니스가 성장할 수 있도록 관계를 활용하세요.
캐릭터를 진화시키고 시설을 개발하세요
캐릭터를 생성하고 커스터마이징하세요. 게임 시작 시 다양한 직업별 시작 상황 중에서 선택하여 플레이 스타일을 정하세요. 경험을 쌓고 레벨을 올려 13가지 스킬 유형에서 캐릭터를 성장시키세요. 스킬을 사용하면 더 나은 가격 협상, 더 빠른 요리, 체력 증가, 새로운 아이템 제작, 더 많은 직원 고용 등에 도움이 되는 패시브 또는 액티브 효과를 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다.


건축 자재를 구입하고 망치를 이용해 직접 여관을 건설하세요. 증축을 추가하고, 여관을 확장하고, 지하실을 파고, 나만의 가구를 만들어 보세요. 일상 업무를 도와줄 직원을 고용하세요. 여관 이름, 제공되는 메뉴, 음식 가격, 영업 시간 등 세세한 부분까지 관리할 수 있습니다.
기술을 연마하고 휴식을 취하세요
조용한 시간에는 다양한 기술을 활용해 보세요.


농부가 된 기분이 든다면 텃밭이나 더 큰 규모의 밭에서 과일과 채소를 직접 재배하세요.
독특하고 사실적인 요리 시스템으로 식사와 음료를 준비하세요.
당신의 기술에 따라 품질이 매우 다른 다양한 아이템을 만드십시오.
믿을 수있는 빗자루로 엉망진창을 청소하여 여관을 깨끗하게 유지하십시오. 일부 고객은 그다지 깨끗하지 않다고 말해야합니다.
낚싯대를 사용하거나 덫을 만들어 근처 개울, 강, 호수에서 낚시를하세요.

또한 고객과 머니 게임을 플레이하여 이미 가지고있는 것보다 더 많은 돈을 벌 수 있습니다. 그리고 세계사에 관한 책을 통해 주변 세계에 대해 더 많이 알아보세요.

title: Wildaria
description:
게임 정보
TAME RIDABLE PETS
Tame any animal with the lasso mini-game to gain a companion that you can level-up, ride into battle, and fight along-side! They even have elemental pet abilities...
EXPLORE INFINITE BIOMES
Explore an endless procedural fantasy world, discover the depth of biomes filled with living creatures, villagers, and natural features... to find all the hidden secrets.

title: Odyssey of Dremid'ir
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an Odyssey, through a captivating 2D RPG set in a hand-drawn world ravaged by the absence of its god-like creators. Play as Codrin, an unwitting mage, who journeys through the post-apocalyptic realm of Dremid'ir, mastering volatile magic, confronting unimaginable creatures, and exploring diverse landscapes — from ruined cities to deep caverns.
KEY FEATURES:
Forge an Unlikely Alliance:
Odyssey offers a heavily story and character driven adventure, bringing together unlikely friends, from novice sorcerers, angelic knights, and even dangerous scavengers together on a journey to save the world.
Dynamic and Tactical Combat:
Immerse yourself in fast-paced, seamless combat where enemies roam freely. Combine party members strategically, exploiting their synergies. Outsmart foes who adapt and plan, creating an engaging challenge.

title: Last Dragoon: Awaken
description:
게임 정보
한때는 드래곤과 드래곤 나이트가 세계를 보호했지만 지금은 드래곤이 모두 사라지고 세상은 사악한 생물에 의해 타락하고 해가 지면 균열에서 태어나 모든 것을 파괴하고 삼켜 버립니다. 그리고 당신, 인간 궁수, 당신의 집은 폐허가되었습니다. 당신은 방황하는 길을 떠나야합니다. 모든 것이 무의미하다고 생각했을 때 우연히 죽어가는 아기 드래곤을 발견하고 성공적으로 구하고 키우기로 결정했습니다. 그 이후로 당신은 함께 모험하고, 함께 사냥하고, 함께 놀고, 궁극적으로 서로의 가장 가까운 전투 파트너가 되었습니다. 당신이 성장함에 따라 드래곤이 성장하고 팀이 성장함에 따라 희망에 다시 불을 붙이기 시작합니다...

이것은 다른 게임 플레이 요소도 포함하는 어드벤처 타워 디펜스 게임입니다. 자세한 내용은 다음 기능을 참조하십시오.

특징:
Adventure Survival: 세계 지도를 탐험하고 생존하세요. 다른 적과 맞서 싸우거나 도망치십시오. 다른 세계에서 텔레포트합니다.

드워프 용병 고용 및 소환: 서로 다른 드워프를 고용 및 소환하여 전투를 수행합니다. 드워프는 다양한 유형으로 나뉩니다. 드워프의 유형에 따라 공격 특성과 성장 속성이 다릅니다.

건설 및 타워 방어: 기지의 다양한 방어 시설을 건설하거나 수리합니다. 밤이 되면 기지를 지키십시오.

펫 육성: 어린 드래곤의 성장에 동행하고, 어린 드래곤에게 먹이를 주고, 함께 싸우세요. 드래곤이 성장하면 드래곤의 화염을 뿌리기 위해 장착 및 제어할 수 있습니다.

내장 미니 게임: 3개의 내장 미니 게임이 있으며, 드래곤과 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다.

게임 시스템은 주야간 날씨 시스템과 결합됩니다. 날씨 시스템은 일부 게임 결정에 영향을 미칩니다.

회피 및 활 기술을 기반으로 하는 전투 시스템입니다.

사냥과 채집: 모든 종류의 동물을 사냥하세요. 다양한 컬렉션 요소로 강화하고 업그레이드하세요.

title: Nihongo Quest
description:
게임 정보



Learn Japanese through gaming! Nihongo Quest is a colorful JRPG that will teach you over 1000 Japanese words and characters! Explore the world of Gakushū as you battle, race, and draw your way to victory!


Learn over 1500 words and characters! This game teaches you up to the N5 level of the JLPT! (with hopefully more to come!)
Battle wild characters, students, and evil forces using the Japanese learned in the game!
Play through an engaging story as you learn Japanese!
Write out the characters that you learn to practice handwriting!
Create your own towns using your own vocabulary list!
Race against the clock in various mini-games to reinforce your learning!
Review using an automatically created, personalized review schedule to help you retain what you learn!
Customize your character with character skins!

title: 150 Floors
description:
게임 정보
올라가다!
150 플로어스”는 8명의 다른 마법사로 플레이할 수 있는 로그 라이트, 타일 기반 전략 RPG입니다. 150개의 층에서 수많은 괴짜적인 적들과 전투를 치르고, 당신의 여정을 도와줄 수도 있고 도와주지 않을 수도 있는 다양한 캐릭터들을 만나보세요. 당신이 꼭대기 층에 도달하려고 도전을 한다면 말이죠!
게임플레이
적으로 가득 찬 150층의 타워에서 모험이 펼쳐집니다. 각 마법사의 고유한 마법 기술을 사용하여 적을 공격하고 자신을 방어하세요. 타일로 구성된 각 층은 내구성 한계가 있습니다. 적을 공격하면 그들이 점령한 타일도 공격하는 것이며, 타일이 깨져 적을 이전 층으로 보낼 수 있습니다. 이 논리는 적에게도 적용됩니다. 점령한 타일이 깨지면 이전 층으로 떨어집니다. 바닥에 있는 모든 몬스터를 물리치면 엘리베이터가 바닥에 나타나 다음 층으로 이동합니다.
스토리
2년 전, 먼 땅에서 괴이한 괴물들이 큰 탑 꼭대기에서 태어나 침입을 시작하여 수백만 명의 사람들을 죽이고 영혼을 소멸했습니다. 갑작스러운 괴물들의 침입으로 영향받는 8명의 마법사는 각자의 개인적인 이유로 이 괴물들의 땅을 없애고 싶어 합니다. 그들이 공유하는 유일한 공통점은 150층에 도달하여 정복하는 거고, 그리하면 원하는 소원을 들어준다는데… 그런 전설이 있습니다.

title: Stop the Crawl
description:
게임 정보
DECK BUILDER AUTO BATTLER HYBRID
Choose between 50+ monsters across 10 different factions to create a deck that is able to handle anything the heroes will throw at you.
DEFEND YOUR DUNGEON
Tactically position your units to defend against waves of marauding heroes. As you clear out the floors of the dungeon, you will encounter progressively stronger enemies. Do you have what it takes to stop the crawl?
SYNERGIZE
The key to unlocking your monsters’ potential is knowing how to utilize their faction traits. These traits have significant effects that will change the tide of battle. Figure out which factions work well together to create a board that can beat back the heroes.
ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
You’ll encounter new and more powerful heroes as you progress through your dungeons' many floors. Each floor will introduce a new challenge requiring you to rebuild and rethink your defenses using the monsters in your deck.

title: Lost in Cheese
description:
게임 정보
사랑스러운 정육면체 모양의 고양이가 치즈에 가로막혔어요. 엄청난 양의 치즈가요.
치즈를 밀어서 길을 열고, 커다란 빨간 버튼까지 나아가세요.
치즈로 가득한 각 스테이지를 클리어할 때마다 치즈의 미스터리에 한 걸음 더 다가가게 됩니다.
귀엽고 아늑한 치즈 가득한 세계에 빠져보세요.
여정을 따라가다 보면, 신비로운 치즈의 기원에 대한 단서를 주는 오랜 친구들을 만날 수 있어요.
특징:
100개 이상의 레벨이 있는 아름다운 섬을 탐험하세요.
퍼즐을 마스터하고 새로운 세계를 해금하세요.
최소한의 이동으로 클리어하여 보상을 받으세요.
몰입감 있는 세계에서 두뇌를 자극하는 도전을 즐기세요.

title: Squid Grid
description:
게임 정보
그리드 위의 오징어에 관한 퍼즐 게임입니다.

title: ARCHWIZARD
description:
게임 정보
ARCH WIZARD is a fast paced First Person "Hyper Shooter":
Tight battlefields
A few very distinct enemies
Many tricks in your sleeve
A lot mechanics to master
Blend all your moves, skills and abilities into one personalized flow of magic rage. A calculated ever adapting dance between enemies. Using their attacks and even detached body parts to dig into the depths of combat spell craft.
You are a powerful mage. Lost in the ruins of warp portal network, once connecting the outskirts of the multiverse.
You must fight your way through cosmoses.
First — to get back to your Tower.
Second — to establish dominance on the parallel realms.
To go back from THE OTHER SIDE.
To find the source of Chaos.
To face the End of the World
To become the eternal ARCH WIZARD — an architect, a director, a tailor of your own fait.
Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.

Trailer music contains tracks: Shadows And Dust by Scott Buckley and Creepy Dark Atmosphere by Universfield

title: Primal Fray
description:
게임 정보
Primal Fray는 턴제 전략 로그라이트 게임입니다. 전투는 절차적으로 생성된 육각형 기반의 하늘에 떠있는 섬에서 이루어집니다. 당신은 유닛을 사용하여 적군을 기습하고 처치할 수 있습니다.
강력한 보스를 물리치세요
독특한 메커니즘을 가진 여러 보스가 등장합니다. 당신은 그들을 뛰어넘을 수 있을까요? 아니면 완벽한 팀을 구성하여 보스를 물리칠 수 있을까요? 가능성은 무한하지만, 한 가지 확실한 점은… 쉽지 않을 거라는 것입니다.

title: Joninės
description:
게임 정보
Four friends in early 90's go to celebrate Midsummer's day in an island in a middle of a lake.
Little do they know of what awaits them.
In this story rich horror tale you will have to survive and find your friends.
Game is in Lithuanian language with English subtitles.

title: On the Hunt
description:
게임 정보



On the Hunt is a first-person wild animal hunting simulator. A game with a fairly well-developed world of wildlife. Wild animals are very circumspect and careful, hunt down and develop your hunter skill!
Test your new weapon at the shooting range and go hunting for the beast in these beautiful places as soon as possible!

KEY FEATURES:
A large number of picturesque locations for hunting, at different times of the year.
Decide for yourself: to hunt in sports excitement or meditatively walk around the area.
A wide selection of smooth-bore and rifled weapons and cartridges for them.
Hunting animals: elk, wild boar, deer, bear, wolf, fox...
Upgrade system of experience and ammunition.

Hunting in various scenic regions is fun and exciting!
Have a good hunting !!!

title: Into the Evernight
description:
게임 정보
Into the Evernight is a retro-styled role-playing game with a heavy emphasis on player choice and branching story paths.
Turn-based, tactical combat.
Engage enemies in tactical, RPG-style combat as you try to stop the spreading darkness.
Branching story paths.
The choices you make and actions you take will lead the storyline down very different routes.
Evolving game difficulty.
Into the Evernight's difficulty is not set by a slider in options, but rather by your in-game choices. An easier path forward always exists, but at what cost...?
Upgradeable skills and items.
Customize your squad with over 60 upgradeable skills. Wield weapons and armor that gain in strength not only as they are reinforced, but also as your characters become accustomed to them.

title: Sword of Shadow: Revolution
description:
게임 정보
그림자의 검:혁명은 오픈 월드 롤 플레잉 게임이다. 신들의 우주에서 일어나는 행동과 어떤 실수는 전 세계의 죽음으로 이어질 수 있습니다. 당신은 아케론,반 인간,반 악마,어둠의 진정한 하나님,파괴와 유혈 사태에서 세상을 구할 수있는 유일한 사람으로 재생됩니다,이 세상에서 당신의 작업은 평화의 진정한 인감,만 년 이상 신들의 분노를 억제 칼을 찾는 것입니다.

고유성
무기와 힘의 거대한 다양한 악마로 재생할 수 있습니다.
아케론은 그가 세상의 구원이라고 알려져 그의 개념의 순간부터,어둠의 진정한 하나님,그는 훌륭한 살인자로 훈련되었다,그는 자비와 고통을 알고,그의 목표는 하나님의 진노에서 인류를 저장하는 것입니다.

-개선하고 힘을 각성,숙달에 기술을 연마,어둠의 독특한 기술을 습득,그들을 마스터하는 법을 배워야,그렇지 않으면 그들은 당신을 죽일 것입니다

-사람,신,악마,동물 및 기타 생물과 싸우십시오. 당신의 수준을 높입니다.

열린 판타지 세계 탐험
당신이 더 강해지고,영웅과 그의 행동을 연구하고,이 우주의 새로운 비밀을 배울 수있는 전 세계.
버려진 장소,동굴 및 도시를 탐험하십시오.
광산 금,문자와 통신하고 문제를 해결하는 데 도움이,당신의 직업은 힘입니다.
company: Phantom Studio, Not The Moon Studio

title: Secrets For Taking
description:
게임 정보


You wake up in this new world. There are four zones to explore. Each zone has its own hidden devices within them.
As you explore, you can develop a stronger soul by fighting others. Once beating them, you can choose to let them go free or take their secret, making you vastly stronger.

Discover what happened and who is chasing after you. There will be some hints given in unordinary means, but you will understand.
Depending on your actions and beliefs, you can change everything.

Features

Journey through a new world with its new, beautiful, and mysterious locations!
Enjoy a beautiful story and (hopefully) nice soundtrack!
Have a party where you the player lead Mash with some of his allies.
Other fantastic gameplay mechanics that make the game fun.
Make choices that maybe affect the story?
Level and Currency systems.
A moderately challenging game, that gets harder as it goes on! (definition of a normal game, to be honest)
Some Easter Eggs (Secrets) hidden inside and/or outside the game!
















Go Wishlist Secrets For Taking now! You'll be notified of when the Game is available!
And thank you to everyone who has already wishlisted the game. You have my deepest respect and gratitude!
What are you waiting for? You reached the bottom. Play the game!!

title: Wacambria Island
description:
게임 정보
Explore Wacambria Island’s vast landscape as a treasure hunter, adventurer all while fighting valiantly for the freedom of the local islanders. Search various biomes, caves, ruins and towns while unlocking treasures and solving puzzles in your quest to liberate the island.
Engage in Exciting Combat

Engage in satisfying combat as you save Wacambria Island. Your enemies will strafe, parry and work together to try and stop your valiant efforts. Utilize the variety of weapons and tactics to bring your foes to their knees.
Customize your adventurer

Unlock new cosmetics and armor all throughout Wacambria and its various ruins and caves.
Explore an Ancient World

Discover the secret of Wacambria Island as you explore various locations including ruins, caves, temples and towns. Wacambria Island is packed with secrets, treasure and danger.

Befriend the locals as you rise to the challenge of securing their freedom. The people of Wacambria Island are a friendly bunch. As you adventure through the Island you have the opportunity to engage and help them help you.

Purchase one of many in game homes and decorate them to your hearts extent. Buy materials or use items you find on your adventure to create your own lavish living quarters.

Wacambria Island is a open-world, action RPG set on an island comprised of diverse biomes. Play as an adventurer whos search for treasure lands him in the middle of a drama between the local islanders and an invading army. With the island mostly controlled by the invading army, you will need to work together with the locals to gain back territory. This journey will take you across numerous biomes, caves, ruins and towns while discovering the secrets of an ancient power and a legendary hero. With the odds stacked against the local people, you will be the deciding factor of freedom in Wacambria Island.

title: SeaDogs Of Nassau
description:
게임 정보
Explore Unsettled Seas
Choose a cursed pirate captain to play as that can possess bodies, wield brute force, or charm contacts to build a haven in the Caribbean. Each captain plays radically different, from soul-trading merchants to illiterate werewolves.
Coordinate Brutal Naval Combat
Engage in exhilarating naval battles with a pirate vessel of your own making. Fight dirty or honorably with skills befit of a seafaring corsair.

title: Sophonce
description:
게임 정보
Sophonce is a science fiction action horror first-person shooter that relies on philosophical undertones as the primary focus of the plot.
Features
Wide array of telekinetic abilities and elemental weaponry at your disposal.
Reflex Mode (Slo-Mo).
An impressive arsenal of weapons with each having unique attributes to them. Many different ammo types specific to each weapon such as stasis ammo, pyro ammo, gravity ammo, shock ammo, and rift ammo.
A riveting story that keeps track of your choices/actions that will ultimately determine the ending of the game.
And....more to be disclosed in the future!

title: Quatros Noir
description:
게임 정보


Quatros Noir는 클래식한 공식에서 이전에 본 적이 없는 새로운 차원을 펼칩니다. 플레이어들은 네 개의 상호 연결된 그리드를 탐험해야 하며, 각각이 고유한 블록과 규칙을 가지고 있어 새롭고 중독성 있는 느낌을 얻어 높은 점수를 얻어야 합니다!

Noir를 모티브로 한 주제, 특수 효과 및 부드러운 재즈 사운드트랙으로 Quatros Noir를 경험해보세요. 격렬한 캠페인 모드, 경쟁적인 PvP 모드, 지역 협동 모드를 비롯한 20가지 이상의 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다.



회전 그리드는 네 개의 상호 연결된 그리드를 탐험해야 하는 완전히 새로운 메커니즘입니다. 각각이 고유한 블록과 규칙을 가진 네 개의 그리드를 탐험해야 합니다. 블록 배치에 대한 신중한 고려가 필요하며, 그리드가 상호 연결되어 서로 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.



다양성 가득한 강렬한 싱글 플레이어 경험으로, '젠(Zen)', '모드(Modes)', '하드코어 레벨(Hardcore Levels)' 세 가지 섹션으로 나뉩니다. 각 섹션은 고유한 분위기와 사운드 트랙을 갖추고 있으며, 깊이 들어가면서 변화와 진화합니다

매료적인 캠페인 모드에서 Quatros Noir의 신비를 풀어보세요.

다양한 경쟁 PvP 모드와 팀워크를 시험할 로컬 코옵 모드. PvP에서는 최대 4명의 플레이어와 빠른 경기에서 대결할 수 있습니다. 코옵에서는 당신과 당신의 친구들이 하나의 그리드에서 함께 작업하여 최고의 점수를 달성해야 합니다.



독특한 시각적 효과와 현대적인 분위기가 가미된 클래식한 느낌의 느와르에서 영감을 받은 분위기 있는 세계를 경험해보세요. 몇 가지 부드러운 재즈와 결합하여 Quatros Noir의 분위기에 푹 빠져보세요.

title: INFEROS NUMINE : descent into darkness
description:
게임 정보
In a world where dark magic and betrayal fester like a venomous wound, the kingdom stands on the precipice of chaos.
Step into the shadows of a cursed kingdom where monsters rule and justice is long forgotten. Inferos Numine is a dark action-adventure game where you play as a fallen demon, betrayed by your own kind and left to rot in the depths of the underworld. Now reborn through rage and fire, your only purpose is vengeance.
Fight your way through legions of twisted demons and grotesque monsters as you uncover the truth behind your betrayal. Master brutal combat, harness infernal powers, and carve a bloody path through a decaying world ruled by darkness.
Features:
A gripping dark fantasy story of betrayal, revenge, and redemption
Intense melee and magic combat against monstrous enemies
Unique demonic abilities that evolve with your choices
Atmospheric environments filled with lore and hidden secrets
Epic boss battles that test your skill and willpower
Will you claim revenge... or become the very evil you swore to destroy?

title: Warlock's Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Battle your way through hordes of the Warlock's minions in this dungeon crawler! Find better armor and weapons to help you survive, level up to increase your stats, learn new skills to smite your enemies or heal yourself. In the end, will you be able to defeat the evil Warlock and free your people from his tyranny?
***Please Note IF YOU PLAY THE DEMO***
The game is still in ALPHA phase. You may experience bugs, poor quality animations, sounds, VFX, etc. and other issues. Feel free to point things out in the community hub! 
Things we are currently working on:
Animations
Sounds
Visual Effects
Game Balance
Other game mechanics

title: Mapventure Story
description:
게임 정보
이 액션 로그라이트에서는 매번 플레이할 때마다 자신만의 맵을 만들고, 보스를 향해 바로 갈지 아니면 더 많은 적과 싸워 더 강해질지 결정할 수 있습니다. 다양한 생물군계에서 자원을 모아 마을을 업그레이드하고 사람들을 구출하여 다음 모험을 위한 더 많은 이점을 얻으세요.

여행의 시작
몇 년 전 마지막 유능한 사냥꾼이 끊임없이 변화하는 던전에서 돌아오지 못한 후, 당신은이 역할을 맡기로 결정했습니다. 마을은 거의 비어 있고 무너진 집들로만 구성되어 있지만 몬스터에 맞서 싸울 수 있다면 마을에 다시 새로운 생명을 불어 넣을 수 있습니다.
생물군계
던전은 한 생물군이 다른 생물군을 따라가는 신비한 장소입니다. 예를 들어, 울창한 숲에서 뜨거운 사막으로, 또는 으스스한 묘지에서 수정의 평면으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 각 생물군계는 마을을 확장하는 데 중요한 다양한 재료를 제공합니다. 더 발전할수록 생물 군계와 재료의 선택이 더욱 다양해집니다.
에너지
모험에서 더 강해지려면 필드에 있는 모든 몬스터를 처치한 후 생물 군계의 에너지를 사용할 수 있습니다. 공격, 방어, 특수 에너지가 있으며, 한 종류의 에너지를 충분히 모으면 레벨이 상승하고 해당 에너지와 관련된 세 가지 개선 사항 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 일부 강화 효과는 최대 체력이나 재료 생산량을 증가시키는 패시브 효과인 반면, 다른 강화 효과는 공격이나 동작을 변경합니다.
새로운 지인 및 오래된 지인
던전을 여행하는 동안 때때로 마을로 데려갈 수 있는 다른 사람들을 만나게 됩니다. 그들 중 일부는 이미 길을 잃은 것으로 생각되고 다른 일부는 아직 만나지 못했습니다. 누군가를 도와주면 그들도 분명히 감사를 표하고 자신만의 방식으로 여러분을 지원하고 싶어 할 것입니다.
수년 전 길을 잃은 여행자들의 피난처로 시작된 이곳은 모두가 번영을 위해 무언가를 기여한 작은 공동체의 고향이 되었습니다. 하지만 지금은 거의 아무도 남지 않았고 마을은 길을 잃은 것처럼 보입니다. 다행히도 던전에는 온갖 유용한 기술을 가진 많은 사람들이 방황하고 있으며, 여러분이 그들을 찾아서 구해주기를 기다리고 있습니다. 그들의 도움으로 마을은 다시 번성할 수 있습니다.
