title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
description:
게임 정보
The game includes over 50 different types of growth skills that players can obtain, with over two hundred thousand words of game plot and character dialogues. In addition to over 50 sets of different types of equipment that players can obtain, scattered throughout the universe are several sets of ancient artifacts recording ancient secrets waiting for players to acquire and unlock. One hundred different effects of Fate Seals allow players to gain the blessings of destiny in intense battles...

The story takes place in a remote star domain we call Havendia, where the powers of elements such as gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, and thunder are the source of all energy. There are a total of eight major races here, and the peace that has been maintained for nearly a thousand years seems to have come to an end...
Exciting and Unique 3D Combat Visual Experience

We place great importance on depicting the combat process, drawing inspiration from various literary and artistic works to make "Peerless Destiny" stand out!
Featuring an innovative 3D spatial combat system, battles can extend from the ground to the sky, with unique camera effects presenting grand scenes of a fantastical world. Engage in battles as seen in novels and animations, where you can perform extraordinary feats like soaring through the air and unleashing incredible powers!
Fundamental Combat System

Blocking, dodging, parrying—inspired by the core elements of Souls-like games, we have made modifications to these mechanics. We offer various difficulty modes to cater to a broader range of players. Even against formidable bosses, players can engage in intense back-and-forth battles!
Satisfying Combo System

By interacting precisely with the keys, players can trigger combos and lengthen their duration. A well-executed combo can potentially turn the tide of a battle in an instant!
Environment Interaction Enhances Realism in Combat

Your skills not only serve as weapons to damage enemies but also have environmental impacts, capable of causing destruction in various settings—whether small villages or large cities, you have the power to wreak havoc. If you enjoy, hmm, demolition work, this could be a great choice!

Both NPCs and monsters intelligently respond to attacks by dodging, fleeing, blocking, counterattacking, and more. They offer real-time voice responses expressing disdain, fear, and other emotions towards you. In this world, each creature reacts differently based on its unique personality! Voice conversations between you and characters make the game livelier, ensuring you don't feel like a lonely warrior. Additionally, precise collision detection between creatures and the environment allows interactions such as kicking rocks on the ground or sending enemies flying through impact!

In addition to the normal "Story Mode", there are two modes to choose from: "Revisiting Old Dreams" and "Trial of Heaven"
"Revisiting Old Dreams" mode, you are randomly teleported to a previously defeated boss and immediately engage in battle. Hone your combat skills and earn additional rewards.
"Trial of Heaven" mode, also known as the "Heavenly Trial Grounds", you will face several replicated boss entities! This place is unstable. Anomalies can occur at any time! For example, encountering temporal disturbances that cause fluctuations in the flow of time, or facing imbalances in gravity, and even adverse environments that disrupt the minds of creatures.
Sustaining the "Heavenly Trial Grounds" requires a significant amount of energy, with the activity area continuously shrinking to reduce consumption. So, please eliminate your targets quickly; otherwise, you will have to face a siege by all bosses without any escape routes.
Of course, if you perform well in the trial, you can obtain not just more experience, equipment, and treasures but also Destiny Marks with random effects.

Customize your own exclusive skills and character growth path. Both skills and characters are capable of growth. The choice between specialization or a comprehensive development path is entirely up to you. The unique Thunder Tribulation system requires characters to undergo a Thunder Tribulation test with each growth, giving you a greater sense of ceremony, mission, and achievement!

We offer various ways to earn Lucky Points, which can be used to draw Destiny Marks. These marks provide different types of destiny-enhancing effects, such as invincibility aura or time dilation. This system combines elements of metaphysical concepts like the I Ching and Bagua!

Wielding the sacred artifact of heaven and earth, you guide the cycle of destiny! By unlocking celestial artifacts, you empower yourself with mysterious and endless strength, commanding unknown miracles within the cosmos!

The Celestial Stele leaderboard comprises four types of rankings. You can compete with players globally, showcase your achievements among friends, or contribute to regional competitions! The Celestial Stele was originally a heaven-defying divine object, stealing a glimpse of celestial secrets to create these leaderboards!

Embark on an incredible gaming journey with "Peerless Destiny"! Immerse yourself in a whole new gaming experience, merging captivating storytelling with interactive gameplay.

Discover a narrative fusion of novels, anime, and immersive gameplay. Experience the rebirth of a near-fallen protagonist, whose newfound strength uncovers deeper secrets of this world.

Engage in breathtaking 3D combat offering free-flight, earth-shattering battles. Destroy environments, from forests to entire villages, showcasing the true power of your character. Brace yourself for intense battles that surpass conventional limits.

Traverse a fantastical landscape filled with richly detailed environments. Witness the aftermath of destructive battles, leaving shattered vistas and scattered remnants. Indulge in the realism and engage in strategic gameplay.

Ascend to new heights through electrifying trials after accumulating sufficient experience points. Avoid fluxing time, gravitational imbalance, and cognitive disruptions. Triumph over challenges and unlock "Destiny" bonus effects.

Radiant with the light of wisdom, system sprites descend upon the dazzling starry skies of "Peerless Destiny". They are eager to establish a closer bond with you and explore the realms of fantasy together.
The game offers four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Devil.
Easy and Normal modes provide a satisfying grass-cutting experience where skills automatically target enemies, making gameplay relatively simple.
Hard and Devil modes are somewhat similar to souls-like games, requiring manual targeting of skills and utilizing actions like blocking, dodging, and parrying to avoid damage. Otherwise, death comes easily. The gameplay is slightly more complex.
Believe me, the Devil difficulty level will be the most challenging experience you'd rather not speak about! ^^~

title: Circle Defense
description:

I know you have rich experience in defending the Earth!
CIRCLE is a tower defense game with a light card system, where you will play as a commander defending the Earth: by building/upgrading weapons on a rotating device called "CIRCLE" and using cards to deal with the continuously invading aliens.


Origin of the CIRCLE
One day, the moon was hit and destroyed by unknown creatures, and the debris turned into a circle around the Earth. Due to concerns about the unknown creatures, humans transformed the lunar circle into the CIRCLE device and deployed cosmic-level defense weapons on it.



Under the pressure of alien attacks, the human military technology tree continues to evolve, and its functions are summarized into command cards, waiting for the commander to issue orders.
The energy for the cards comes from the CIRCLE: the faster the Ring rotates, the higher the energy generation rate, but it seems to affect the aiming rhythm for deploying weapons.



- Level-based game: each successful defense against alien attacks will greatly enhance Earth's weapon defense technology, continuously unlocking new weapon types, upgrade items, and new technology cards.
- The combination of different weapon upgrade projects and different cards will create a multitude of possibilities.
- Each type of monster has its own behavior patterns and characteristics, so make sure to respond based on your understanding of them!

title: Burden of Truth
description:
게임 정보
Burden of Truth is the next entry in the Burden of Proof saga, marking the return of this grand courtroom adventure! Experience the missing chapter from the original story which has been restored & fleshed out into a full game. Gather evidence by investigating the crime scene, find contradictions in the courtroom, and confront the truth with everything you have!



One year after his mentor's poisoning, renowned prosecutor Conrad Cross accepts a new case tangled in web of conspiracy. In order to determine the true culprit, Cross and his opponent, Kate Flocking, engage in a battle of wits and piece together the incident by analyzing the available evidence. However, this objective proves difficult to accomplish when it's revealed that a mysterious organization is interfering with the flow of information to the courtroom. Even so, the legal counsel is determined to persevere through these limitations and expel the lies by uncovering contradictions within the witness' statements. To deliver justice, someone must be found guilty.



But as the trial winds down, an unsettling situation unfolds when a mysterious figure informs Cross that his childhood friend, , has been arrested on suspicion of murder. At the same time, the dangerous rebellion group mounts an assault to retrieve the , a database of information that could plunge the world into if it falls into the wrong hands. Knowing that Sarah could never be responsible for the heinous crime she's accused of, Cross must turn his entire mindset around to become the that his friend deserves. As the only person capable of saving Fletcher and preventing the catastrophic consequences of the Zero Data's exposure, Cross must enter a that could very well determine the fate of the world.



continues RobProductions' iconic hybrid-genre experience with third person investigations and challenging logic puzzles that test your knowledge of each case. Explore the crime scene as you survey for traces of the culprit. Collect evidence and make surprising deductions via the new , which highlights more information about about the status of each clue. Hold people accountable by tracking the source of each item added to the court record, or utilize on-hand items to get out of dangerous situations.



Then, make your case in the courtroom by cross-examining witnesses and presenting evidence that favors your argument. As legal counsel, you get to and when to hold back, but be warned; the judge and his counselors grow weary with every faulty step, so be sure to back up your claims with . As you make choices that affect the course of the trial, new discoveries can be made that contradict previous testimony. With logic as your weapon, search for the within the witness' assertions and take the fight to them!



The outcome of the case is in your hands. As such, to deduce the truth and deliver justice for those that have been wrongly accused!

title: BabushCats
description:
게임 정보
BabushCats is a pixel-art, top-down simulation game with elements of combat. Take on the role of a wholesome grandma who runs a shelter for cats living in the neighborhood. Expand and customize your home as the number of your lovely pets grows. At night, prepare to battle your cats' nightmares and stop them from disturbing their sleep! Defeat mysterious nightmare bosses and find your ultimate cat companionship.
Features:
Take care of love-starved kittens! Feed them their favourite food, wash them carefully and watch their trust level rise. Each need comes with its unique interaction.
Upgrade your house! Unlock new rooms with special appliances as cats get more demanding over time.

title: Shadows Of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the heart of terror with Shadows Of Despair, a spine-chilling co-op horror experience for up to four players.
GAMEPLAY
Navigate through eerie, intricately designed maps, each hosting multiple Case Files that blend intense main challenges with three additional objectives.
Encounter a variety of foes with unique personalities and humorous voice lines, making every session a blend of fear and dark comedy.
Work together to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and survive the night in an immersive horror adventure where teamwork is your only hope.
KEY FEATURES
Co-op horror game for up to four players
Intricately designed Case Files with major and minor challenges
Enemies with unique personalities and humorous voice lines
Collaborative puzzle-solving and secret uncovering
Survival-focused gameplay requiring teamwork
Demonic AI adds dark comedy to the terror

title: Cat Girl Survivor
description:
게임 정보
"Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“은 뱀서라이크 게임의 단순한 플레이 방식과 다양한 캐릭터, 장비 아이템, 스킬, 플레이모드가 조합된 슈팅 액션 게임입니다. 자신만의 캐릭터를 선택하고 다양한 장비와 스킬을 습득해 악마로부터 위협받는 고양이 소녀 세계를 구하세요!
주요 특징
다채로운 스킬과 캐스팅 시스템 효과적으로 악마들을 공격하기 위해 다채로운 스킬과 함께 "Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“에서만 볼 수 있는 캐스팅 스킬 시스템을 활 용해 보세요. 캐스팅 스킬은 사용 전 파워를 모으기 위해 몸을 움직일 수 없는 치명적 약점이 존재하지만 그만큼 광범위하고 강력한 데미 지를 적에게 줄 수 있습니다. 캐스팅 스킬과 일반 스킬을 적절히 전략적으로 사용해 악마들을 효과적으로 공격해 보세요!
스킬을 전설 등급으로 레벨업 해 화려하고 시원한 타격감을 즐길 수 있습니다.
다양한 캐릭터 기본 캐릭터 뿐 아니라 각자 다른 스킬과 능력을 지니고 있는 캐릭터들이 있습니다. 아카네, 시로, 코로 등 당신에게 매력있고 플레이 스타 일에 맞는 캐릭터를 선택해 게임을 즐겨보세요!

title: AO: Containment Breach
description:
게임 정보
There's been a Containment Breach within the AO facility on Terra. You're being sent in to establish communications with the other teams inside and to Contain what AOs have broken containment.
AO: Containment Breach is a Procedurally Generated, Level Building, Semi-Auto-Battling, Rogue-lite, Horror hybrid. Fight and Contain AOs as you make your way through the Containment Breach of the Terra AO facility. During "Dives" scavenge for Materials to bring back to the hub to Craft unique Weapons, Upgrades, and Gear. Build Craft unique and interesting strategies to combat hostile entities. Answers to the breach lay deep within the facility...

CONTAIN: Assume all AO containments have been breached. Figure out the Containment Procedures by looking for clues and other means to Re-Contain them.

title: Casual Trucking
description:
게임 정보
Casual Trucking is a laid-back delivery simulator without any time pressure.

It's a small game, a sort of experiment with 3d and chill gameplay. Something that you can play while listening to your favorite podcast.

- Choose a delivery mission, head to the location and pick up the truck and cargo
- Buy different trucks for specific delivery missions
- Purchase real estate and gain passive income

title: Deus Proxy
description:
게임 정보
A New Kind of Auto Battler

Deus Proxy is a roguelike that brings together the most exciting aspects of new-school auto battlers and old-school tabletop gaming. Every game is a completely new adventure with 15 factions, human opponents, and hundreds of heroes, items, traits, and spells!
Asynchronous Multiplayer

In Deus Proxy you play through hand-crafted PvE and one-of-a-kind PvP encounters. Any army that wins a PvP encounter becomes an adversary in other player’s games. You see the enemy armies before picking your cards and designing your own army, which rewards drafting a diverse deck to counter the challenges you might face instead of playing the most "meta" cards.
Comprehensive In-Game Information

Tired of "wiki games" that require you to constantly alt-tab to see what a powerup does? Every spell, item, hero, unit, trait, buff, faction and game mechanic is explained in a searchable in-game compendium. When designing your army, an overlay tool is present to quickly view any stat of every unit on the field. Within seconds you can discover ways to counter your opponent.
Endless Theorycrafting

Every game of Deus Proxy is a possibility to try new strategies and find new synergies! There are no implicit faction bonuses, all bonuses come from items and spells related to that faction. Your plant-based army might focus on empowering ranged units to entangle far-away targets, giving army-wide regeneration bonuses to make your treants walking tanks, or just being immune to the acid rain your mage caused. Because you have 1-3 battles per turn, it is vital to keep your armies adaptable for each new challenge!

Heroes can equip any item that you obtain, and can cast any spell they have the slightest proficiency to cast. A huge variety of builds are possible, and the traits and stats a hero has are only a suggestion of what they're capable of when properly equipped.

title: Enter the Nemesis: Blood Portal
description:
게임 정보
Be prepared to hack, slash, shoot, and torch your way through these bloody levels of platforms. You will be creating part of the platforms yourself by killing your enemies - when an enemy is killed his dead body becomes a platform you can move on. You have to kill enough enemies in order to reveal the hidden blood portals, and pile up the dead bodies of the enemies in order to reach the portal and exit the level and enter the next one. Ultimate goal is to go through all the levels and portals to find your abducted step sister, and try to finish the Nemesis. This game is a bloody action platform adventure.

title: JRoguePG
description:
게임 정보
JRoguePG takes the turn-based battles of a JRPG and combines it with a true Roguelike. From a seasoned JRPG developer, expect a robust and finely-tuned battle system that you will want to dive into again and again with the new classes you unlock, biomes you discover, and randomized equipment you receive during the run.

Evil plagues the world using fear and suffering to gain power. The world's only hope lies within a rift that opens only every decade. This rift allows four heroes to enter and attempt to battle their way to the source of the evil. Upon failure, a portion of the resources and any knowledge gained are left for the next decade's heroes to try again. How many heroes will you sacrifice to the rift in order to defeat Extol?
Unlock 30 classes including Ninja, Elementalist, Paladin, Thaumaturgist, Samurai, Hexblade, Battlemage, Lancer, and more!
Each class unlocks 3 class abilities any other class can equip
25 different biomes each with different themed monsters to learn how to defeat
Expect to use your brain to win battles. There is no mashing A to attack and win or an overpowered ability that kills everything
Randomized equipment chests, enemies, and biomes
How you build your party matters tremendously with class composition and how you equip them
Use resources you gather in the previous run to unlock upgrades like starting with more weapon experience, more frequent rare chests, manipulate the randomized biomes, start with more gold, and more!
PERFECT for the Steam Deck!

title: Dr. Gloom’s Lab
description:
게임 정보
어둠 속으로 내려가다

이전에 경험해보지 못한 등골이 오싹해지는 호러 서바이벌 슈팅 경험에 도전하세요.
잭슨 블레어와 함께 그룸 박사의 실험실 깊숙한 곳으로 모험을 떠나세요.
모든 구석에 숨겨진 비밀을 밝혀내고, 그림자 속에 숨겨진 상상할 수 없는 공포에 맞서 싸우세요.
광기를 해방하다

숨막히는 생생한 그래픽에 몰입하여 소름 돋는 분위기에 생명을 불어넣습니다.
미로 같은 복도를 탐색하며, 기괴한 돌연변이들과 맞서 싸우고, 숨겨진 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내는 과정에서 심장이 쿵쾅거리는 1인칭 액션을 준비하세요.
이 게임은 단일 비전 개발자가 Unreal Engine 5를 사용하여 열정, 창의성, 결단력으로 제작한 작품입니다.

뒤틀린 이야기

매력적인 스토리와 몰입감 있는 게임플레이로, 이 솔로 개발된 걸작은 끝까지 여러분을 사로잡을 것입니다.
제한된 물품만을 가지고 그림자 속에 숨겨진 공포에 맞서고, 진실을 밝혀낼 준비가 되셨습니까?

공포를 체험하고, 광기를 극복하며, 승리를 쟁취하세요.
저의 첫 번째 인디 프로젝트인 이 스릴 넘치는 여정에 함께하며, 모든 비명과 심장이 멎을 듯한 순간이 이 게임에 쏟아 부은 열정과 헌신의 증거가 됩니다.
어둠이 기다리고 있습니다. 이에 맞설 준비가 되셨습니까?

title: Sauna Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Sauna Simulator" is a funny business simulator. Buy premises, equip them with a sauna stove and start earning from it!
You inherit a sauna stove and decide to open your own sauna business. You have a large area at your disposal, divided into rooms, which you can buy and put there any stove from the store.
While your business is small, you will do all the work yourself: please customers, clean the room, put firewood in the sauna stove. However, as your sauna expands, you'll be able to hire employees to take care of all the chores you don't want to do.
Customers leave feedback. If your customers don't like your sauna: poor service, dirty facilities, etc., they will definitely leave a bad review. If, on the other hand, you take complete care of your customers, they will leave you a positive rating. Based on these ratings, you will see the average rating of your sauna.
You should not forget about safety. If your stove is cheap, then it will have a high chance of catching fire. In such cases you will need fire extinguishers, which of course you can buy at the store.

title: Looping Art Museum
description:
게임 정보
Reveal the memories through "Spot the Difference."
Escape from the endless loop in a single-path maze.

This is a single-player adventure game drawn with flickering lights and pixel art.

Game Description
This game is a side-scrolling adventure game.
You can move right or left, but you will always end up returning to the same place.

There is only one way to move forward. Carefully observe the paintings.
You will notice there’s a painting that differs slightly from the one you saw before.

If you feel something is off, take a stop and look at the painting.
If it has changed, congratulations! You have taken a step forward, and now you are ready to look for the next change.

As you discover changes one by one, the path forward will open up.
Now, you are ready for your journey in the looping art museum.

The game is controlled using only the keyboard.

The Character can only move to the left or right.
A key or Left Arrow key: Move left
D key or Right Arrow key: Move right

There are also parts where you will be required to enter text.
Please use the keyboard to input the word.
On a cold day, the protagonist visits the art gallery for the first time in a while.
She got attracted to one specific painting.
As time passes while they are fascinated, people around her disappear.
But when trying to leave, she noticed something strange.
Whether she goes back or forth, the same painting appears in front of her again and again and again...

This is a looping art museum.

Clever "Mr.Cat" talks to you and tells you to play "Spot the Difference" in the museum.
You have to observe the paintings closely and start naming them.
Find the paintings which are changing stealthily.
Can you escape from the loop by repeating "Spot the Difference"?
And what secrets lie hidden in the looping art museum?
Name: Nekko
A mechanical engineer turned indie game developer.
For some reason, I am burning through my savings day and night, devoting myself to game development.
Obsessed with the charm of pixel art, they endlessly tweak the positions of pixels if left alone.

title: What remains of my sins
description:
게임 정보
What remains of my sins blends psychological horror and retro aesthetics with procedural generation to create a tense and unpredictable journey. You step into the worn shoes of an aging protagonist whose physical limitations and faltering memory reflect a life steeped in regret. Each time you enter a level, the layout and challenges shift, forcing you to adapt quickly while you search for the key to escape.
Beneath the grim visuals and oppressive atmosphere lies a deeper tale of redemption. As you navigate claustrophobic corridors and grimy, decaying spaces, echoes of the past hint at a lifetime of inflicted harm, abuse, and loss. Uncover the protagonist’s story through subtle environmental clues, confronting both inner demons and horrifying enemies along the way.
Will you break free from the nightmare and atone for your sins, or remain trapped in a cycle of guilt forever?
This demo represents an early vision of the game. Some mechanics or narrative elements may evolve during development.
Procedurally Generated Levels
No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring each run feels fresh and terrifying.
Elderly Protagonist
Movement and actions are intentionally constrained to reflect age and vulnerability, intensifying every tense encounter.
Retro Horror Atmosphere
Dark and morbid pixel-inspired visuals, combined with unsettling sound design, evoke a classic survival horror feel.
Stress-Based Puzzle Solving
Rely on quick thinking and memory retention under duress to uncover crucial keys and pathways to safety.
Themes of Sin and Redemption
Dive into a story marked by past wrongdoing and the quest for absolution, woven seamlessly into the gameplay.

title: 7Years
description:
게임 정보
7Years is a non-linear, open-world horror game, that offers both a single-player story and 4-player online co-op. After waking up in the middle of the night, you discover that you're wife is missing. Desperate to find her, you try to find help, only to quickly learn that the only person left in your entire mountainside neighborhood is you. No phone service and the main powerline to the neighborhood has been severed. You are alone, or so you think, until you find a modified HAM radio system that is transmitting a repeating message...with your name in it. The person on the other end may be your only hope to find your wife and survive the horrors surrounding you. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and complete their only mission...to find you.

title: Kitesurf Runner
description:
게임 정보
Learn to kitesurf in 2 dimensions. Compete in competitions, travel to new lands, race for the finish line, or just land some tricks.
Learn to kite. Tutorial covers controls for basic riding, loading and popping, jumping, rails, back rolls, board offs, and kite loops.
Kiteboarding is a dangerous sport!  Watch out for jellyfish, drones, sharks, rockets, and crash landings.
Play through amateur, minor league, semi pro, pro, and heracles worlds.
Travel in traditional platformer levels.
Make it to the end but watch out for sharks, jellyfish, and drones!
Collect coins on the way.  Use them at the shop to customize your look.
Compete in competitions.  Bring home a bronze, silver or gold medal!
High score - high score wins - coins give bonus score points.
Best trick -  best trick wins.
Drone Madness - Hit as many drone grinds as you can, don't let the drones hit you!
Upside Down Grind Mode - Hit rails upside down to score!
Carrot Grab - Collect as many carrots as you can.
Race - Checkpoint race.
Trick Race - Checkpoint race.  Landing tricks gives you bonus time!
Customize your characters outfit and kite gear at the store, be sure to collect plenty of coins in travel mode to use at the store!
Collect powerups. -Jump Higher, -Ride Faster, -Spin Faster.
Indie developed.  My first major game.

title: Robinson Crusoe : The Lost Tribes
description:
게임 정보
"Stranded. Alone. Survival is your only hope."
After a devastating shipwreck, you awaken as Robinson Crusoe, stranded on a mysterious Caribbean island. The fight for survival begins immediately—battle hunger, thirst, and relentless predators while uncovering the island’s darkest secrets. Scavenge resources, craft essential tools, and build shelters to withstand the harsh wilderness.
But survival is only the beginning. The island is home to ancient ruins, warring tribes, and a terrifying enemy—ruthless cannibals who hunt in the shadows. To endure, you must form an unlikely alliance with Friday, a captive native. Together, you’ll infiltrate enemy camps, raid forbidden lands, and uncover a hidden past that will challenge your very humanity.
Every decision shapes your fate. Will you hold onto your morals, or will the island turn you into a predator?
Key Features:
Survive the Wild
Master Resource Management – Nature is Both Friend and Foe
Every day is a fight for survival. Your stomach growls, supplies run low, and the island gives nothing for free. If you want to live, you must find water, food, and materials to craft tools.

title: Warplock
description:
게임 정보
Warplock began as a small personal project in my first year at college. Over my time as a student I continued working on it and devoting more and more time to it. With the help of my girlfriend, I have been able to create the game that it is now. Warplock is a top-down action roleplaying game. The goal? To beat each biome. Along the way you will find various upgrades and items you can pick up. You will cast spells and destroy monsters who pray on your demise. When all is said and done, you return back to your home base to restore your health and magic and place the necessary upgrades before returning back to the wilderness.

We at Quackpot Studios hope that you enjoy.

-quack quack.

title: Cat Tree
description:
게임 정보
Cat Tree is a relaxing and captivating indie game where you can collect adorable cats that inhabit a mysterious tree. Starting with just a few cats, you'll watch as your tree grows, revealing new sections with fresh spots for your charming pets.
Discover a variety of cats hiding in each container!
You'll find everything from common to the most unique ones. Collect them all to expand your collection.
Your task is to nurture the cats, watch them grow, and decide which ones to keep in your collection and which to sell for profit. Explore the tree and uncover all its secrets while enjoying the peaceful and soothing atmosphere of the game.

title: Blankspace
description:
게임 정보
⬆️ Maximize Your Score!
Your mission: make as many points as possible by harnessing the power of emojis, each with its own unique effect. But be warned—fall short of the target, and it's game over. Strategize, optimize, and push your limits to stay ahead in this high-stakes challenge!



Jump into Blankspace now and see how far your strategy can take you. Will you unlock the ultimate synergies and rise to the top, or will the challenge push you to your limits? Start playing and find out!

title: Rob Together
description:
게임 정보
The Ultimate Co-op Heist Experience

PLAN YOUR HEIST Every successful heist starts with a solid plan. In Rob Together, teamwork is the key to success. Gather your friends and take on roles like Hacker, Thief, Lookout, and Saboteur. Identify security vulnerabilities, study guard routines, and choose the best approach. Sneak through silently or create diversions to achieve your goals. Every decision will shape the outcome of your heist.


HACK, HIDE, AND STEAL Show off your skills and perfect your timing. Hack cameras and alarms, pick locks to access hidden areas, and collect valuable items while avoiding guards. Work together as a team to complete your objectives and escape without being caught. Every heist will push your team’s abilities to the limit.


ESCAPE WITH THE LOOT Getting in is one thing; getting out is a whole different adventure. After completing your mission, coordinate a stealthy escape. Find hidden routes, avoid patrolling NPCs, and ensure your team gets out safely with the loot. A flawless escape is the most crucial part of the heist.


COLLABORATE IN EVERY MISSION Rob Together delivers the full co-op heist experience. With dynamic environments, complex security systems, and countless strategies, every heist is unique. Play with up to 4 players and face the ultimate test of coordination, communication, and teamwork.

Rob Together isn’t just a game—it’s a challenge that tests your wit, speed, and teamwork. Can you and your crew pull off the perfect heist?

title: Damashi Game
description:
게임 정보
Damashi Game에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
Damashi Game에서는 플레이어들이 퍼즐, 사회적 도전, 장애물 코스에서 서로 경쟁하며 궁극적인 상을 차지하기 위해 서로를 이기고 살아남으려고 노력합니다.
개요:
전략, 심리학, 빠른 사고가 가장 큰 무기가 되는 스릴 넘치는 멀티플레이어 사회적 속임수 경험인 "Damashi Game"의 세계에 발을 들여보세요. 모든 행동이 중요하고 모든 말이 마지막이 될 수 있는 게임에서 플레이어들은 일련의 치열한 도전에서 서로 맞서 싸우며, 기술뿐만 아니라 상대를 속이고 이길 수 있는 능력을 테스트합니다.
"Damaashi Game"에서 승리하는 유일한 방법은 살아남는 것입니다. 그리고 생존을 위해서는 속임수의 기술을 마스터해야 합니다. 고위험의 1대1 결투에서든 적들과 함께 위험한 장애물 코스를 통과할 때든, 당신의 결정 하나하나가 생사의 갈림길이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Blitloop
description:
게임 정보
Blitloop is a fast-paced, retro-styled space arcade shooter. You play as “Blit” on a mission to rescue orb pods and save the galaxy. Take down countless enemy ships and face massive bosses as you zip through a stylish world. And at the same time, rush to rescue the pods scattered across the level before they are captured by the enemy.

Blitloop blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade old-school SHMUPs with the tactical elements of modern hardcore bullet hell shoot 'em ups. Earn power-ups to enhance the ship’s weapons, keep the bombs and missiles fully stocked, and prepare for fluid arcade action, stylish graphics, and an '80s synthwave soundtrack.

Achieve a high score by keeping the score multiplier at its maximum and planning for additional combos.
Story

In the future, the Galactic Federation and the pirates of planet Zirkoid are at war. On planet EX4042, the Galactic Federation is mining a powerful orb that powers all crafts and weapons that are keeping the pirates at bay.

An infiltrator droid from Zirkoid intercepted the information of the whereabouts of EX4042 and sent a fleet of forces to steal pods containing the valuable minerals.

The Federation was taken by surprise and was immediately outnumbered. This can be the end of the prosperous Federation and lead to a new era of darkness where pirates of Zirkoid could destroy countless planetary systems.

But all hope is not lost…

Meet Blit, a space bounty hunter that was tracking down a Kessel smuggler in a nearby solar system. She picked up the distress calls from EX4042 and immediately changed course, making her way to the orb mining planet

With her genetically modified spaceship that can absorb orb minerals to enhance into a range of weaponry, Blit is the Federation’s last hope to stop a galactic destruction.
Game Features

title: Umbra Lumen
description:
게임 정보
You are dead...
So, yeah, sorry to tell you this, but you are, so... Anyway, I just thought you wanted to know. By the way, welcome to "Beyond Life." As for what this place is for… honestly, I have no idea.

Deckbuilding and Puzzle?
I know this sounds kind of weird, but hey, you're already here so you may as well try it. The idea is that your Tarot cards are powerful puzzle pieces that you can use to combat foes. You can build endless combinations with their own sets of mechanics and personalities. But there's a catch: you will need to adapt because the cards you find are pretty unpredictable. Which, now that I think about it, is kind of ironic given the whole "Tarot" thing.

About Beyond Life
To be honest, I think this whole place is a test, some kind of "purgatory." Reincarnation? Oh yeah, I've heard that too. But there are all sorts of wild theories floating around. Some say we’ll be reborn based on how we lived before, part of some endless cycle. Others are convinced this is Valhalla, where we wait for Ragnarok, the final battle. Some think we’re here to be judged, either sent to paradise or punishment. Then there are those who say the way you died determines your fate, and depending on it you need to climb the levels of the underworld. This would be a problem for me, I don't even remeber how I died!
How about you? Maybe you should explore a bit before jumping to any conclusions.

Coming soon!
The game is still in development, but is all steam ahead so it can be launched as soon as possible! I document everything on YouTube and take feedback and ideas on my Discord. So, don’t be shy—hop in and join the journey!

title: Building Friends
description:
게임 정보
Building Friends is a charming narrative adventure where you play as Mable the Shovel! Join a lively cast of construction equipment characters with pun-tastic names as they embark on a mission to build a house from the ground up! With your shovel powers and team spirit, sharpen your skills and construct a home in this unique blend of fun and friendship.

title: GrimmKitchen
description:
게임 정보
Revive the restaurant passed down from your grandmother and aim for a three-star rating!
Enter a fairy tale world where you’ll battle enemies and gather ingredients in action-packed,
while also hiring and training staff to manage your restaurant.
This game offers a blend of restaurant management and fairy tale action!
Fairy Tale Action
Gather Ingredients
Step into a fairy tale world and collect all kinds of ingredients!
Defeat creatures, and you might just find rare, high-quality ingredients.
The more you gather, the more delicious dishes you can serve at your restaurant!
Fairy Tale Skills
Unleash powerful abilities inspired by fairy tale characters in battle!
Use them strategically to turn the tide of the fight in your favor!

title: Ruins of Endoth
description:
게임 정보


Ruins of Endoth is a Third-Person ARPG set in a dark fantasy world with a focus on hack-and-slash, random loot and replayability.

Endoth is a broken world. A world ravaged by war over many centuries. A world where evil reigns and only pockets of survivors remain, huddled in the dark awaiting the arrival of a prophesised hero.

It combines classic ARPG elements such as stats, skills, swordplay, magic and levelling up with a mix of hand-crafted and procedurally generated maps to make every new game a fresh and exciting experience!

Dark fantasy ARPG
Third-Person

title: Whispering Age
description:
게임 정보
Command Manager!
In whispering age you command your units by speaking with your managers, who then try... to fulfill your orders!
Assign Tasks!
Tell your managers to gather resources, construct structures, or defend the village. You'll at times need to calm your managers as civil war can break out!

title: Undeance
description:
게임 정보
Step into the high heels of a nightclub hostess and defend your territory in an over-the-top third-person zombie shooter. When the undead crash the party, it is time to grab your weapon and show them who is boss.
Battle through waves of increasingly deadly zombies in a vibrant, neon-lit nightclub setting. Start with a basic pistol, earn score for each kill, and use it to purchase powerful new weapons or unlock fresh areas of the map. Survive round after round, upgrade your loadout, and reclaim your club.
Whether you are fighting solo or partying up with friends in multiplayer, teamwork and firepower are your keys to survival.
Defeating invaders earns youscore, which can be spent on upgrading your arsenal. Invest in powerful weapons to ramp up your firepower, allowing you to eliminate waves of undead more efficiently. The stronger your gear, the better your chances of survival!

title: Budget Guardian: Health Realm
description:
게임 정보
Budget Guardian: Health Realm combines engaging gameplay with educational elements, making complex financial concepts both accessible and enjoyable.
Welcome to the whimsical world of Hindmarchville, where the villagers have elected a cat as their mayor, leading to some peculiar occurrences. In this casual simulation adventure, you play as Aayto, a dedicated health professional who has come to town to establish a care centre.

title: Chalice of Highland
description:
게임 정보
⚔︎ Guide a young bird on his quest to find the Chalice of Highland ⚔︎
In Chalice of Highland, embark on an epic adventure inspired by Gameboy aesthetics. Explore the world and dive into six challenging dungeons to recover the Chalice of Highland. As a brave bird, you’ll wield a sword to battle enemies and use your unique ability to fly, uncovering secrets along the way.
Key Features :
6 Unique Dungeons: Each dungeon presents its own mechanics and challenges, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
7 Epic Bosses: Face off against formidable bosses guarding each piece of the Chalice of Highland.
7 Dream Sequences: Uncover the hero's backstory through dream sequences that reveal the mysterious past of the Highlands.
Customizable Screen Colors: Choose from different screen color palettes to enhance your retro gaming experience.
Classic or Widescreen: Play in the original Gameboy format or switch to a 16:9 widescreen view for a modern twist.

title: Hollowge
description:
게임 정보
"Buried alive, one shall rise."
Descend into the depths of Hollowforge, a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous horrors born of corporate greed. In this adrenaline-pumping first-person stealth/action game, you'll need more than just firepower to survive—you’ll need to outwit and outmaneuver the abominations lurking in every shadow.
Blending the fast-paced chaos of Doom with the stealth mastery of Thief, Hollowforge delivers a heart-pounding experience where every choice matters. Run, sneak, and shoot your way through a labyrinth of tunnels, making split-second decisions as you unravel the dark secrets of a megacorporation’s failed experiment.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Stealth/Action: Stay sharp. Darkness is your ally, but when the monsters find you, your guns become the final word.
Immersive Underground World: Explore the massive, open-ended complex of Hollowforge—a place steeped in mystery, where every corner hides a secret or a nightmare waiting to strike.
Resource Management: Conserve your scarce ammo and health, or spend your hard-earned credits at vending machines for a fighting chance.
Weapons Arsenal: From pistols to crossbows, take control of a versatile range of weaponry as you adapt to the horrors below.
Dynamic 3D Graphics: Feel the tension build with every flicker of light in this atmospheric world. Every shadow could hide an enemy. Every step could be your last.
Get ready to survive. Will you bring the truth to light—or be swallowed by the darkness?
Are you brave enough to face the horrors of Hollowforge?

title: Enlightening
description:
게임 정보
Enlightening은 블록을 밀어 움직이는 논리 게임으로, 전기를 활용한 독특한 메커니즘을 제공합니다.
로봇 청소기 Flux를 도와 각 레벨의 출구를 작동시키는 에너지 회로를 만들어 탈출하세요.
임무는 간단해 보일 수 있지만, 퍼즐은 공간 인식, 추상적 사고, 그리고 분석적 사고 능력을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다.
준비되셨나요? 에너지를 충전하고 도전하세요!
125개 이상의 정교하게 설계된 레벨과 25개의 튜토리얼이 준비되어 있으며, 명확하고 보람 있는 게임을 위해 체계적으로 구성되어 있습니다.
각 퍼즐은 신선한 반전을 제공하며, 문제 해결 능력을 시험하고 계속해서 몰입하도록 만들죠!

title: THE REVENANTS
description:
게임 정보
                                    The Revenants는 단순한 서바이벌 게임이 아니라, 한 걸음 한 걸음이 치명적인 파괴된 세상에서 생명을 위해 싸우는 이야기입니다. 생존자 그룹을 통제하고 시련과 위협을 헤쳐 나가야 하며 생존을 위해서는 음식, 물, 건강, 에너지와 같은 기본 통계를 추적해야 합니다.
세계에서 자원과 물건을 찾고 필요한 장비를 제작하세요. 또한 적대적인 몹과 싸워서 그룹을 보호해야 합니다. 기술을 개발하고 생존 전략을 개선하며 어떤 위협도 견딜 수 있다는 것을 증명하세요!
                                                  여러분은 위험한 세계에서 생존을 위한 가혹한 현실에 직면하게 됩니다. 캐릭터에 장비와 옷 품목을 장착하고 방어 무기를 선택하세요.

title: Pixel Frontier: Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Pixel Frontier: Tactics is a turn-based strategy game with a difference. Instead of action points and cool-downs, your Heroes will roll dice every turn and spend the values they roll to use their abilities.
Victory in battle will require careful planning, both setting up your Heroes for success in the base with powerful equipment and upgrades; and preparing to defeat dangerous enemies with clever tactics and strategies on the battlefield itself.
Heroes come in 36 unique classes; Knights are experts in defence, using heavy armour and their rigorous martial training in battle, whereas Alchemists brew powerful and dangerous potions, but can have explosive accidents if they lose control of their experimental craft.
Each Hero class has access to 13+ unique abilities, with their own dice costs, effects and strategies. With over 450 abilities in total there is an incredible variety and depth of options to discover and master.
Each Hero will start with a few basic abilities and then unlock more as they increase in level. As they level up, you’ll also upgrade these abilities, changing their effects, costs and more, as well as upgrading your Hero’s dice to fit your new abilities. Each Hero is their own puzzle, and finding the right combinations of dice, abilities and Heroes will be your key to victory.

title: Encounter
description:
게임 정보
As fate would have it, you’ve stumbled upon this game. Might as well give it a try. Who knows what you might encounter… ayyy. Get it? Encounter is the name of the game. When I said, “who knows what you might encounter,” it was a play on words.
So, what’s this Tarot thing about? They represent scenarios where you might have to think on your feet, snack on some magical berries, or even get attacked by a [REDACTED]-eating succubus! Fun! But it's not just fate at play—you’ll need to manage your resources wisely, timing your limited actions perfectly as you navigate a labyrinth of twists and turns, and overcome a host of unpredictable events.
Your adventure kicks off with a single crate. What’s inside? Treasure? Trash? A mildly cursed sandwich? Crack it open and find out! From there, anything goes. You’ll encounter oddballs, outlaws, and outright disasters. Duel the friendly neighborhood postman, accidentally infuriate a small child, or face down ambush after ambush—who’s to say? Will you fight, finesse, or just wing it and pray to the RNG gods? Whatever you do, tread carefully—your journey lasts only as long as you do, and the next tavern might be farther than you expect.

title: Operation Zero
description:
게임 정보
Operation Zero is top-down run-n-gun arcade shooter with a sci-fi comedy edge. A mysterious and threatening artificial intelligence is spreading across New America, and only one hero has the brawn, firepower and ignorance to stop it: TASKILLER, the ultimate bio-engineered super-soldier!
You'll need the help of the GENERAL and some state-of-the-art firepower to blast your way through hordes of AI-deranged droids and drones to reach the nerve center of 8 secret bases, each more dangerous than the last.
Featuring:
Top-down run-n-gun action... fans of the late 80's and 90's arcade classics will feel right at home
Twin-Stick controls by default, but configurable to suit other styles
8 missions to take on, containing 5-7 levels each, spanning forests, secret bases and underground AI nerve centers
Arena Mode: a non-narrative "infinite" way to play - see how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of enemies
Randomly generated levels for extra replayability
Plentiful and stackable weapon powerups to form interesting and deadly combinations. Including but not limited to rapid, bounce, spread, split, explosive...
Personal drone powerups to augment your firepower

title: Sadko
description:
게임 정보
Fight or flee!
Not a moment's peace - evil is coming from everywhere and they have one target - to stop you. Wait, I think they're scared of… The letter “o”?! Go ahead, Sadko the singer!
Point your mouse in the direction of the enemy to perform your attack, apply skills for greater effectiveness, and don't let Sadko's health drop to zero so you don't lose progress.
Oh, is that a rock? I'll take it.
Help build a monument to the letter “O” that will banish evil from this land forever - find resources on the map for construction and save up currency to open new biomes.
Folk tales of ancient Rus
Visit five dangerous locations, on each of these the hero is waiting for new challenges, enemies and bosses inspired by Slavic folk tales - Baba Yaga The Bony-Legged, dangerous Koshchey the Immortal and Mavka, who watches from the depths. In short, be prepared for everything, entering uncharted lands...

title: Ox & Horse Work in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay
In "Ox & Horse Work in Hell" players team up with their friends to take on the roles of Ox-Head and Horse-Face, the guardians of the underworld. Your daily work involves battling evil spirits, punishing them, and collecting Sin Points they drop.
There are many ways to punish these evil spirits:
Beat them down directly with your fists.
Pick up items and smash them.
Tie up fallen ghosts on torture devices and vigorously torment them.
Utilize contraptions to create an assembly line of punishment.
Incidental Encounters at Work
Your work in Hell will also involve interacting with various colleagues and superiors, leading to numerous interesting story snippets.
autokwd: Ox & Horse Work in Hell,地狱里的牛马

title: Malón
description:
게임 정보
In this minimalist strategy game you'll take command of an army fort, tasked with defending it at all costs. To succeed, you'll need to expand your base and train soldiers to stand by your side in defense of the flag.
Animals will be a highly valuable resource, enabling you to grow your economy and expand further.
You’ll also have the option to choose the opposing side, establishing your own indigenous settlement and becoming the leader of your people, guiding them in resistance against the huinca invasion.

title: Swingin'!
description:
게임 정보
Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement. Swingin-kun can't generate speed by himself, so be careful not to waste the speed you gain from falling! You can bounce off the floor, stick to walls, alternate between your two arms to attach yourself to the ceiling and move sideways– with some creativity, you can do all kinds of things! Furthermore, Swingin’! includes a level editor so that you can create and share your own custom stages!

title: Shadow Eagle
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Eagle is a secret organization for peace. It is said that it dates back to the Seljuk Empire and perhaps even before that. Recently, they have been fighting for justice all around the globe.
In a recent robbery that took place in one of London's museums, only the portrait of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror was stolen. Deniz sets out to Dublin to meet with the person who was examining and researching the painting before the robbery. While waiting in a pub for the meeting he learns that there will be an attack on the Limon Company data center.
Deniz and his connection Orla make a plan to stop this attack.
However this is just the beginning. What is the purpose of this attack? Why are they going to Türkiye, all of a sudden? Shadow Eagle faces an international criminal organization.

title: Wizard Hand
description:
게임 정보
Wizard Hand is a magical solitaire roguelike about accumulating the maximum number of magical points by mastering the art of combining enchanted cards, transformations, and a collection of magical items.
The goal of the game is to remove the entire pyramid of cards from the table, while scoring the maximum points. Play a matching card onto the pyramid card to start a combo! The more points you have, the more opportunities you have to expand your magical arsenal and be ready for future challenges!

title: Idlemancer
description:
게임 정보
Features
Realtime PvP: defeat your opponent by reaching the right-side of the screen with your slimes! Don't let them reach your side...
Roguelike Progression: Select Traits as you win rounds, but 3 losses means the run is OVER!
Idle Gaming: 45 bonuses to upgrade with "idle" currency earned over time, even when the game is closed!
Legend Rank: Climb the leaderboard based on W-L ratio!
Social Bragging: See other players run around, and admire their publicly displayed rank... or show off your own!

title: A Day's Work
description:
게임 정보
A Day's Work is a wholesome exploration adventure set in a small open world where you can do things at your own pace. Every workday features a unique map, but always with the same friendly characters, allowing you to explore different solutions to their problems and uncover all the secrets.
Key Features
Friendly characters
Secrets
Harvesting
Crafting
Original soundtrack
Rabbits...

title: Vorozhey
description:
게임 정보
In recent months, an eerie stillness has fallen over the city. Women are vanishing without a trace, only to be found later in the forest — heartless, marked with a burned noose on their bodies. The police are helpless, and the locals dare not speak of it aloud.
You are an artist, once inspired, now cursed. Your dreams have turned into vivid nightmares, visions of things that shouldn’t exist… or perhaps already have. Ancient forces whisper through your mind, growing stronger, closer — as if something is trying to break through, using you as its vessel.
Where does reality end and madness begin? Can you uncover the truth behind the victims before losing yourself? Or are you just a brush in the hand of darkness?
Vorozhey is shrouded in an atmosphere of ominous silence, where reality dissolves into ancient myths and personal nightmares. The creaking floorboards, whispers from the dark, and haunting visions make you question your own sanity.
Psychological horror
Slavic mythology
Uncover the mystery of the city

title: Prop Haunters
description:
게임 정보
Prop Haunters is a fun and fast-paced multiplayer party game where sneaky props and sharp hunters collide in a whimsical, action-packed showdown! Dive into a vibrant world filled with adorable environments, where you can play as a variety of quirky props trying to outwit a team of determined hunters.
As a prop, disguise yourself as everyday objects, blend into the surroundings, and evade detection with clever tactics and quick reflexes. But watch out—Runes give you the chance to fight back! Use special abilities like a flashbang to stun hunters, a speed boost to make a quick escape, or temporary invisibility to hide from sight. Runestones scattered across the map let you power up and take the hunt into your own hands!
As a hunter, your job is to track down those mischievous props before time runs out, using your wits and a keen eye to spot the hidden objects. But don’t get too comfortable—Runes also give hunters a boost based on their play style, such as increased speed for agile hunters or enhanced vision to spot props more easily.
With a focus on teamwork, strategy, and laughs, Prop Haunt brings hours of fun for friends and family alike. Whether you’re hiding or seeking, no two rounds are the same—every game is a new opportunity for chaos and hilarity. So, grab your friends, choose your side, and get ready for the ultimate game of hide and seek in the cutest way possible!
Key Features:
Cute, vibrant graphics that make every round a visual delight.
Multiplayer madness for up to 16 players.
A variety of props to play as, from chairs to teacups, each with its own quirky advantages.
Runes with unique powers, like flashbangs, speed boosts, and temporary invisibility, adding a new layer of strategy to each round.
Boosts for hunters tailored to their play style, helping them track down props with special abilities.
Dynamic environments full of unique hiding spots and surprises.
Fast-paced gameplay that's easy to pick up but hard to master.
Are you ready to haunt the props or hunt the haunters? The power is in your hands!

title: Slime Attack: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
🐾 유니크한 영웅 및 펫 잠금 해제 🐾
퀘스트를 완료하여 각기 다른 플레이 스타일을 가진 강력한 영웅과 함께 싸우는 충실한 펫을 잠금 해제하세요.
⚔ ◆ 6가지의 독특한 무기 타입을 마스터하고 그 이상 ◆ ⚔
중장비: 충격파로 적을 처치하세요.
활: 멀리서 적을 저격하거나 강력한 화살을 발사하세요.
쌍검: 빠른 칼날로 공격적인 전투를 펼치세요.
검과 방패: 공격과 방어의 균형을 맞추세요.
유틸리티 스태프: AoE 피해, 적 제어 및 버프.
소환 스태프: 전투를 돕는 크리처를 소환하세요.

title: Code Quest
description:
게임 정보
Fix the world. Learn to code. Uncover the truth.
In Code Quest, you step into the role of a mysterious character tasked with restoring order to a broken digital world. Journey through diverse locations – from enchanted forests and futuristic cities to a cosmic space station and the heart of a computer itself – solving increasingly complex programming puzzles along the way.
With a unique Scratch-like programming interface, you'll learn fundamental coding concepts such as:
Building sequences of instructions
Loops and logical conditions
Managing variables and data flow
Optimizing algorithms
Every level presents a new challenge that requires creativity and problem-solving skills. As you fix the world, you'll watch it transform before your eyes, uncovering hidden secrets and mastering the art of programming.

Key Features:
Learn through play: No coding experience required!
Scratch-like interface: Intuitive tools to build and test your code step by step.
Diverse worlds: Explore forests, cities, space stations, and the inner workings of a computer.
Engaging story: Discover the mysteries of the broken world and your role within it.
Progressive challenges: Puzzles that grow in complexity as you advance, introducing new programming concepts.

Code Quest is perfect for everyone – from beginners eager to learn the basics of coding to experienced players looking for a unique challenge. Can you repair the digital world and uncover the truth behind its fractured surface?
Add Code Quest to your wishlist today and begin your journey into the world of coding!

title: Tailor Simulator
description:
게임 정보
From Workshop to Empire! Manage your workshop as a master craftsperson, design unique clothes, and fascinate your customers. Show your art by working with various materials from cotton to linen, nylon to polyester. Stay organized, meet your deadlines, and watch your small workshop grow into a tailoring business. From the smallest scissor to the largest shelf, transform every corner of your workshop into a reflection of your art. Prove yourself on this journey to become both a talented craftsperson and a successful entrepreneur!

title: MARKSMAN VR
description:
게임 정보
정밀함. 인내. 완벽함.
MARKSMAN VR은 당신의 정확도, 전략, 그리고 강철 같은 멘탈을 시험하는 몰입감 넘치는 가상현실 저격 게임입니다.
정밀한 사격을 즐기고 완벽한 한 발의 짜릿함을 원하는 플레이어를 위해 설계된 이 게임은, 긴장감 넘치는 미션 속에서 당신의 실력을 증명할 기회를 제공합니다.
🎯 임무 개요
은신 및 전략:
정밀한 계산과 신중한 계획이 핵심인 스텔스 미션에서 고가치 타깃을 제거하세요. 들키지 않고 조용히 적을 처치하는 것이 승리의 열쇠입니다.
속도 및 생존:
치열한 타임어택 미션에서 반사 신경을 시험하세요. 다수의 적을 빠르게 제압하고, 총알이 빗발치는 상황에서 살아남으세요.
🔑 주요 특징
🎯 초현실적인 VR 저격 시스템
소총의 무게, 방아쇠의 압력, 완벽한 명중의 쾌감을 느껴보세요. 손의 자연스러운 떨림과 움직임은 현실성과 도전 욕구를 더욱 자극합니다.
🔧 무기 업그레이드 시스템
게임 플레이를 통해 보상을 획득하고, 게임 내 상점에서 새로운 무기나 업그레이드를 해제하세요. 자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 장비를 구성하고 점점 더 어려운 임무에 도전할 수 있습니다.
🏆 다이내믹 점수 시스템
정확성과 속도를 보상하는 독특한 점수 시스템으로 최고 점수를 노려보세요:
적을 처치하면 기본 점수 획득
헤드샷 시 추가 보너스
빠른 임무 완료 시 보너스 점수 제공
🏙️ 몰입감 있는 환경
버려진 마을부터 외딴 전초기지까지, 각 레벨은 고유하고 분위기 있는 배경을 제공합니다. 환경은 무대이며, 중심은 항상 저격수의 시선에 있습니다.
🎯 훈련이 완벽을 만든다
기지에 위치한 인터랙티브 사격장에서 스킬을 연마하세요. 임무에 대비해 조준 실력을 향상시키고, 모든 도전에 대응할 자신감을 키우세요.
❓ 왜 MARKSMAN VR인가?

title: AI Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter! … or a future where it replaces you!
🔹 Collect Bits – Because AI runs on data, not on hopes and dreams.
🔹 Upgrade Your Algorithms – Go from "Potato Calculator" to "Overlord AI" in just a few clicks.
🔹 Automate Everything – Why click when the machine can do it for you? Efficiency is key!
🔹 Experiment with Upgrades – More power, fewer bugs, and some very mysterious bonuses…
🔹 Reach the Singularity – When AI gets too smart, who's really in control? 👀
Click wisely… your creation might have its own plans! 🧠💾
🚀 Download AI Clicker and become the creator… before your AI beats you to it! 🤯💾

title: Rope Grabber
description:
게임 정보
Picture this: you are a remnant of a civilization on its way out, after years of prosperity. The advancement of old has been replaced with flesh-eating zombos, ready to pounce at a moments notice. Like any other day, however, your pet needs to use the bathroom and get exercise so they don't tear apart all 0f the furniture.
With the actual purchase in the future  you can likely expect (given met time and budget requirements instead of zero):
a twin stick arcade shooter with a unique mechanic and a tight arcade loop at a sawbuck price.
More pet selection
Varied gameplay and enemy ai
More variation to procedural generation
Multiplayer
Pet, player, and enemy animations that don't detract from the style
Working online high-score system WITHIN STEAM RATHER THAN RUNNING THE EXECUTABLE YOU DOWNLOAD WITHIN STEAM OUTSIDE OF STEAM TO GET IT TO WORK.

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!
여유로운 분위기, 끝없는 재미:

title: Bear Brigade: Ocean Attack!
description:
게임 정보
The Ursine Nations have always had a less than stellar relationship with the neighboring Aquatic Kingdom— likely on account of the bears’ favorite delicacy: fish. Despite this, the two societies have enjoyed relative peace, both respecting the treaty that ended their feud all those years ago. However, unrest is churning in the waves and the fish of the Aquatic Kingdom have suddenly decided to invade the bear’s territory! As the leader of the Grizzlies, one of the factions within the Ursine Nations, it is up to you to fend off these intruders.
Rally your troops...
Command the battlefield as a fierce Grizzly warrior and use your resources to deploy a variety of bear units.
Buff Your Army: Place buildings and utilize tower buffs to defend your city. 
Spawn Allies: Spawn Grizzly bears, Panda bears, and Polar bears to utilize their unique abilities to destroy your enemies.
First Person: Fight alongside your troops in first-person mode
Build up your defenses...
Use natural resources to construct and upgrade defensive structures like catapults and crossbows.
Tower Building: Place and enhance towers with ranged attacks or elemental effects.
Environmental Strategy: Block river routes, build on high ground, or funnel enemies into choke points.
First-Person Engineering: Jump into the action to reinforce crumbling defenses in real time.
... and push back the tides of war!

title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: Riftborn
description:
게임 정보
“Riftborn“ 은 인간, 언데드, 괴물 세 진영의 멀티플레이어 슬래셔 아레나로, 인간, 언데드, 괴물이 아레나에서 대결을 펼칩니다. 각기 다른 직업과 능력으로 각 경기는 전략과 액션으로 가득합니다. 저주받은 폐허에서 싸우고 고대 요새의 깊은 곳에서 우위를 점하세요. 각 경기장에는 교활함, 팀워크, 그리고 승리할 수 있는 능력이 필요합니다. 기사의 검을 휘두르든, 마법을 시전하든, 괴물처럼 적을 찢어 죽이든, 한 가지 확실한 것은 혼돈이 지배하고 재미가 멈추지 않는다는 것입니다!
다양한 무기
검, 도끼, 활, 석궁, 단검, 칼, 창, 원하는 마법 등 다양한 방법으로 상대를 죽일 수 있습니다!
게임 모드
Riftborn에는 다양한 플레이 스타일에 맞게 설계된 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다. 플레이어는 혼란스러운 자유 대전(FFA) 모드에서 전투를 벌이고, 팀 데스매치(TDM)에서 동료와 협력하며, 최후의 팀 순위(LTS)에서 자신의 기량을 시험해볼 수 있습니다.

title: Baspetball
description:
게임 정보
😸 A portion of the profit from this game will be allocated to street cat rescue and support initiatives. 😻
The Ultimate Showdown:
Baspetball is a basketball-themed puzzle game with strategic elements, where the player controls a team of cats, each with their own unique abilities and movement styles. The goal is to plan their actions carefully to score baskets without letting the opposing team of dogs steal the ball.
Features:
🐾 50 handcrafted levels.
🎵 Original soundtrack.
🖼️ 5 different scenarios.
🐈 Cute cats.
🐕 Cute dogs.
🏀 Characters with basketball legend numbers.
🧩 Game experience designed for both think and relax.

title: Upwards
description:
게임 정보
On the outskirts of a small village stands a massive tree whose canopy disappears far above the clouds. While grandiose on the outside, its interior houses the humble Mortem Post, which receives and delivers letters from those who have passed on. Deciding to break protocol to lend a helping wing, Rain, a flighty little courier takes a skittish girl by the name of Mila on an adventure through the inner workings of the post office. Together, they search for a letter containing the last words of someone who seemingly never existed.
One part visual novel, one part puzzle adventure! Follow Rain and Mila through the mysterious Mortem Post as they meet with various couriers working throughout the tree and make use of Rain's trusty stamp collection to overcome a myriad of obstacles that stand in their way!
Often during your adventure, you'll need to take advantage of stamps to tie words together in intuitive ways to help Rain and Mila out of various sticky situations. No two puzzles are exactly the same -- from choose-your-own-adventure style outcomes to stealth missions, you'll see just how versatile Rain's stamps can really be!
