title: Ascend the Dome
description:
게임 정보
Is this the hardest and most massive climb-up game ever made?
You find yourself trapped in a massive dome containing various biomes, each filled with unique obstacles and challenges. Your mission is to escape by climbing through the layers of the dome, facing numerous challenges, minigames, and puzzles that will test your precision and skill.
Designed for speedrunners, this is definitely not a cozy game!
Climb, drive, dodge, roll, run, explore, swim, fly, grind... all to reach the top, combining climbing with unique minigames in every biome:
Kart parkour levels.
Backrooms and mazes.
Golf Rollin.
SkyBlock.

title: Coin Devotee
description:
게임 정보
Play a flip coin game with the devil.
You can keep all the coins you flipped in your pocket.
But nothing comes for free; you'll need to pay the debt in return.
Otherwise, some bad things could happen.
Can you fill your pocket full before you run out of luck?
Have bad luck? Worry not.
At the end of the round, the devil is kind enough to provide one item for free.
The item can be used to improve your game.
And if you have more to spare, you can buy them all!
Try to utilize them to build a strategy to maximize your profit.

title: Little Betty: Gold Rush
description:
게임 정보
Step into this captivating 2D pixel art retro platformer and enter a world where speed and precision determine your success. With a total of 60 levels spread across 4 diverse worlds, you'll experience fast-paced single-screen action: collect all the gold coins, master treacherous traps, and overcome dangerous obstacles.
Highlights:
60 Challenging Levels: Each world features 20 unique levels that will test your speedrunner spirit.
Retro Pixel Art: A lovingly crafted aesthetic that reinterprets classic platformer action.
Precise Platforming: React in a flash to traps and obstacles in single-screen level designs.
Steam Achievements: Earn achievements and prove your skills in exciting challenges.
Epic Final Boss: Confront the ultimate enemy in a battle that decides the fate of a family.
Embark on an adventure full of heart, action, and nostalgia—and let yourself be captivated by Little Betty: Gold Rush!

title: DREADCORE : Locked Unit
description:
게임 정보
Hey everyone, i'm a solo developer working on this game called DREADCORE: Locked Unit which is a narrative-driven first-person psychological horror game set in a dystopian cyberpunk world. In this game, players explore a mysterious storage facility where reality and technology intertwine, uncovering dark secrets hidden within forgotten rooms and malfunctioning systems.
The game focuses on atmospheric exploration, environmental storytelling, and puzzle-solving to create a tense and engaging experience. Players will piece together cryptic messages, decipher fragmented logs, and interact with strange devices to unravel a mystery that challenges their perception of reality. As they progress, they must navigate unsettling environments filled with distorted voices, eerie projections, and digital anomalies.
With a strong emphasis on psychological horror, DREADCORE: Locked Unit delivers an experience that blurs the line between the digital and the real, questioning what it means to be human in a world dominated by technology.
An Anthology Series
DREADCORE is an anthology series of narrative-driven psychological horror experiences set in a shared cyberpunk universe. Each episode explores a different mystery and story, connected by the overarching theme of humanity's evolving relationship with technology and the consequences of digital immortality.
Each episode in the series is self-contained, allowing players to jump into different stories without prior knowledge, while recurring themes and subtle connections tie the episodes together for those who delve deeper. The stories explore moral dilemmas, identity, and the psychological toll of a world where technology can blur the line between life and death.
Locked Unit is the first episode in this anthology, introducing players to the dark, atmospheric world of Dreadcore and setting the tone for future episodes. It invites players to question reality, unravel unsettling mysteries, and experience the chilling consequences of humanity's pursuit of digital transcendence.
Key Features
First-Person Exploration: Immerse yourself in a dark, cyberpunk world where every detail tells a story.
Environmental Storytelling: Discover the past through notes, terminals, and interactive objects scattered throughout the environment.
Puzzle-Solving: Solve intricate puzzles involving power grids, security overrides, and cryptic codes to progress.

title: Blitzpoint
description:
게임 정보
Improvise, Adapt, Overcome!
Take command, marine! Watch your forward operating base grow as you prepare for relentless waves of enemies in a thrilling mix of modern military vehicular combat and tower defense.
With BlitzPoint, we’ve streamlined classic strategy mechanics and infused them with action-packed defense gameplay. Build your base during the day, fortify it with turrets, tanks, and artillery, then unleash their firepower at night.
Can you balance your resources to dominate the battlefield? Will you rely on Humvees and Bradleys, bolster your air defenses with Apaches, or trust in precision artillery strikes? It’s going to be a brutal fight, but nothing beats seeing your base stand tall after the final wave.

title: Duck's Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Duck's Hunt is a fast paced hardcore FPS game where you play as a bloodthirsty duck.

No health bars. No reloads. It’s just you and the gun you snatched from the enemy. One hit and you’re out. There are no convenient save points. When you die, you are back to the start of the level. Learn from your mistakes to achieve a flawless victory!
Alright, it's go-time! Grab the keys, jump in and take off for a quick spin around the neighborhood! Just a heads-up though the roads might be a little... unpredictable, shall we say so hold on tight and get ready for a bumpy, but fun ride.

title: Gemmy's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
We would appreciate your feedback and suggestions!
  Simple but not easy! Move! Avoid the traps! Reach the goal!
  How to Play:
Use only your mouse to guide Gemmy across the map to the goal.
Do not touch any traps, objects, or even the walls!
As you progress, the game becomes more challenging, testing not only your control skills but also your ability to strategize and find a way through the traps.
  Features:
Over 20 types of traps, each with unique mechanics.
Move through these traps, timing your movements carefully to avoid hazards—some even challenge you to pass within a time limit or as the path rotates.
You may even find yourself in shifting mazes where the walls constantly change position, making every second count!
Traps interact with each other, creating even more diverse and unexpected challenges.
                                                                    📌 Accessible to players of any language, even though the system interface is currently available only in English.
Steady your hands, move with precision, dodge the obstacles, and rush forward at the perfect moment!

title: Bug Bait
description:
게임 정보
In Bug Bait, you’ll dive into an intense single-player survival tower defense experience like no other! Defend your base from relentless swarms of ravenous bugs using a blend of strategic planning, clever resource management, and quick reflexes. The bugs are cunning, their numbers are overwhelming, and it’s up to you to hold the line.
Build, defend, and survive: can you outlast the swarm?
Key Features
Dynamic Survival Gameplay
Prepare for a challenge as waves of bugs adapt and grow stronger with each encounter. The only way to survive is to stay sharp and think fast.
Tower Defense Meets Resource Management
Balance building powerful defenses with managing limited resources. Every decision matters—will you upgrade your towers, bolster your defenses, or stockpile resources for the next big wave?
Customizable Defenses
Unlock and upgrade a variety of defensive tools, from ballistas to battering rams, each with unique strengths to exploit against the swarm.
Evolving Bug Threats
Face an ever-changing army of bugs, each with its own behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses. Adapt your strategy as new, more dangerous enemies emerge.
Immersive Environments
Defend your base in stunning, handcrafted levels, each with unique terrain and environmental challenges that will test your strategic skills.
Replayability and Progression
Come back again and again to try countless strategies against the swarms and defend what is rightfully yours from the incoming waves!
Updates
We're committed to keeping Bug Bait fresh and exciting with high-quality updates that include new features and general improvements from community feedback!
We’re passionate about making Bug Bait the ultimate survival tower defense game. If you have feedback or ideas for improvement, we want to hear from you!
The swarm is closing in—are you ready to take the bait? Jump into Bug Bait and start your survival adventure today!

title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
description:
게임 정보
Yellowcake is an audio game. This means that the entire world and story are told in sound. To navigate in this game, you will need headphones or some other kind of audio device that allows you to localize sounds. Close your eyes and dive into a world like no other!
Yellowcake is a first-person experience. You play as Vident, a young man with a special gift. He can hear objects, animals and humans - but not just in the ordinary way. Vident can hear people even if they stand perfectly still and hold their breath. And he can hear the rocky walls of the uranium mines, in which he lives and works - and whose secrets he will soon discover. This talent helps him navigate through twisty caves and sneak past guards who try to stop him.
Yes, this game will be suitable for sightless and visually impaired players.

title: Backpack Guardian
description:
게임 정보
You are the last guardian and the last hope of your people, and the dark forces are spreading fast! Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run.
Engage in a fun, fast-paced combat where precision and quick reflexes are key. Master and unleash powerful magic to dominate the battlefield!
Strategically position and rotate items of varying sizes to maximize your limited inventory space. Each item has unique effects and can influence the stats of neighboring items. Choose wisely and carry what you need for success!

title: Collapsed Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Travel to planets
Travel the galaxy in search of planets rich in ores.
Explore and dig into the ground for valuable ores
Terraforms the planet and collects ores.
Sell ores
Remember that the company takes 30% of your earnings but that's the price you pay to return to Earth.
Buy new equipment
Jetpack, radar, sand vacuum, icebreaker, etc. Everything needed to optimize ore extraction.

title: Gimlé Trials
description:
게임 정보
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.
Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.
Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.
Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.
Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.
Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

title: Isoge
description:
게임 정보
Forge Your Dream City in Isoforge
Explore a vast island, design your perfect city, and defend it against relentless invasions! Isoforge combines strategic city-building with dynamic events, giving you endless possibilities to shape your world. Are you ready to build, defend, and thrive?
Build & Expand
Start with only a rocket and expand into a sprawling city. Choose from a wide variety of buildings, each offering unique effects that influence others positively or negatively. Unlock new structures, upgrades and events influencing your city in new ways.
Recruit & Defend
In Isoforge, threats are never far away. Recruit soldiers, unlock new units, and prepare for invasions. Strategize your defenses to protect your city while balancing resources and expansion.
Dynamic Events
Each in-game day brings new surprises! From invasions and upgrades to building unlocks and unexpected challenges, every moment keeps you on your toes. Can you adapt to the ever-changing world of Isoforge?
Unique Interactions
Buildings don’t exist in isolation. Every structure in Isoforge interacts with others, either enhancing their effectiveness or creating obstacles. Master this system to optimize your city and overcome challenges.
Gamemodes
Choose from different gamemodes, challenging you in new ways or giving you an even more relaxing experience.

title: Car Grind
description:
게임 정보
Car Grind is a kinetic game where you use combos of flips, grinds, and wheelies to power your car while you explore each arena. Your car is powered by combos, doing more tricks allows you to extend your reach from each recharge station.
Grind
Jump on rails and grind your car. Keep the balance right or slide off the edge and crash.
Jump & Flip
Turn your car in acrobatic flips! Don't forget to keep the car upright when you land!

title: Astro Busters
description:
게임 정보
Have You Been Waiting for a Modern Take on Classic Asteroid Shooters? 🚀
Your wait might just be over! Astro Busters brings you a fast-paced space shooter with realistic physics, responsive controls, and thrilling arcade action. Take on missions, upgrade your weapons and ships, and battle fierce enemies in deep space solo or in multiplayer!
Q3 2025 – Early Access Launch with 3 levels, new weapons and more at a lower price. 🚀
Dec 2025 – Full Release with multiplayer, AI enemies and more at a higher price.
📱 Also coming on Android!
Want to blast asteroids on the go with touchscreen controls? Try Astro Busters on Google Play when released and experience the action on your phone or tablet.
(Demo is already released! Visit our website for the link)
Background
The idea to create this game came from playing old incredibly fun classics like Asteroids, Gravity force and X-Pilot for endless hours.
Since we couldn't really find a modern version of those games and we really wanted to play such a game both solo and with our friends in multiplayer we decided to develop it ourselves ;-)
We hope that you will like it as much as we do !

title: Blue Mansion

게임 정보
■ Dynamically constructed deck
Obtain cards while exploring the mansion, choose whether to add them to your deck, and build your own powerful deck.

Unlock puzzles one by one as you progress, obtain powerful props, and explore the secrets of the mansion.

You, actually?

title: Broth Bounty
description:
게임 정보
Broth Bounty is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by classic lightgun games, with a chaotic culinary twist! As a shotgun-wielding chef, you must restore order to kitchens across the country, where ingredients have gone rogue. Restaurants are counting on you to tame the madness and cook up the perfect soups for hungry customers. Aim carefully, make every shot count, and avoid hitting the wrong ingredients—your bullets are limited, and the pressure is on! Shooting the wrong ingredients can have dire consequences...
Features
🔥 Wacky, unpredictable ingredients – Shoot rampaging veggies, flying chickens, and more!
👹 Epic boss fights – Face off against monster-sized kitchen abominations.
🗺️ Randomized roguelite maps and levels – No two kitchens are ever the same.
🔫 Upgradeable arsenal & abilities – Enhance your skills and weaponry to survive the culinary chaos.

title: Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start
description:
게임 정보
Sweet Start는 앞으로 출시될 게임의 맛보기가 아닙니다. 나만의 캔디 제국을 건설하는 과정과 분위기를 탐험할 수 있는 독립형 게임입니다.

이 게임은 Candy Shop Simulator에서 여러분을 기다리는 놀라운 모험의 시작일 뿐이라는 점을 기억하세요!
사탕 가게를 열어보세요!
제과 기업가 정신의 세계로 들어서면서 달콤한 모험을 시작해보세요. 나만의 사탕 가게를 열고 맛있는 사탕, 초콜릿, 달콤한 음식의 세계로 뛰어들어보세요.

나만의 페이스트리 만들기
주방에서 창의력을 발휘하고 입맛을 자극할 군침이 도는 페이스트리를 만들어보세요. 맛있는 초콜릿부터 거부할 수 없는 젤리까지 다양한 맛과 디자인을 실험하여 사탕 가게를 돋보이게 하는 시그니처 컬렉션을 만들어보세요.

당신의 달콤한 걸작을 세계에 선보이세요! 열성적인 고객을 위해 사탕 가게를 차리고 달콤한 향기가 분주한 군중을 끌어들이는 모습을 지켜보세요. 판매를 관리하고, 고객과 소통하고, 모든 맛있는 음식이 행복한 고객의 손에 전달되도록 하세요.

사탕 가게의 모든 측면을 관리하여 최고의 사탕 거물이 되십시오. 재고 및 가격 책정부터 마케팅 전략까지 현명한 비즈니스 결정을 내려 수익을 극대화하세요. 매장을 확장하고, 새로운 레시피를 잠금 해제하고, 고객이 더 많은 것을 위해 다시 방문하도록 하는 흥미로운 방법을 찾아보세요.

title: Western Death
description:
게임 정보
In Western Death, you navigate through rooms, slaying creatures, earning experience, and collecting new weapons. With each level-up, you can choose from various cards that grant unique perks and bonuses, enhancing your abilities and playstyle.
Story Introduction:
In Western Death, you play as Jack Wotson, a fearless bounty hunter on a mission to track down the notorious serial killer John Willams, a man with the power to wield magic. Your goal is to stop Willams before his dark sorcery brings ruin to the world.

title: 1234 connect puzzle
description:
게임 정보
-- How to play --
- Connect 3 or more numbers, such as 1, 2, 3, in descending order, then release your finger.
- The connected numbers will rearrange themselves in the order they are linked and merge into a single number greater than the last one connected (for instance, tracing 1, 2, 3 will result in a merged number of 4).
- You can connect circles whether they're touching or slightly apart.
- Additionally, you can connect the numbers in descending order, such as 4, 3, 2, 1.
- Remember to connect the numbers one at a time, following their order.
Examples of Valid and Invalid Moves:
Valid: [1, 2, 3, 4]
Valid: [2, 3, 4]
Valid: [3, 2, 1]
Invalid: [1, 2]
Invalid: [1, 2, 4, 5]
Invalid: [1,2,3,2]
When no more numbers can be connected, the game is over.
-- Feature --
- With no time limit, you can enjoy the game at your own pace.
- Experience gameplay free from flashy distractions.
- Immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of the BGM and the satisfying sound effects when tracing or generating numbers, designed to relax and enchant.
- Challenge players from around the globe in the score rankings.
- It's easy to dive into, but once you start, you'll find it hard to stop.

title: Subjectivation
description:
게임 정보
You can't afford to look away any longer
In Subjectivation, you have to take matters into your own hands.
You tried to avert your eyes and forget what has been done. The perfectly tuned, entropy-draining electromagnetic waves caught up with you anyway. 
Now, your only option is to return to the source of the signal. What you do with this oscillator is up to you, but you simply have to do something. During your journey you’ll rediscover what fate befell the snowy town  - and use that knowledge to shape the future with your own two hands.
You can't afford to look away any longer.
And when you finally turn back, you will
Collect keys, find useful items, and jot down notes to help you solve puzzles that will affect the story’s outcome 
Fight off the town’s inhabitants warped into unrecognizable creatures by the corrupting signal
Manage your body heat by finding the few rare sources of warmth in this wintery town
Explore the town’s exteriors and interiors with your trusty lighter and notebook in hand
Talk to those you've wronged and find out whether you can convince them to find forgiveness in their now-frozen hearts
Shape the town's future with the ways you solve the puzzles and approach the conversations you will be presented with

title: Don't Touch Us
description:
게임 정보
Don't Touch Us
A psychological horror RPG set in the decaying halls of an abandoned hospital, Don't Touch Us plunges players into a chilling mystery filled with puzzles, exploration, and haunting revelations. Experience a gripping story of loss, revenge, and the supernatural, brought to life with realistic graphics and immersive sound design in Unreal Engine 5.
Story
Anya was murdered. Brutally. Her ghost—shattered into two—now roams the ruins of Doctor's hospital, searching for the truth. As one half of Anya’s spirit, you awaken with no memories, drawn to an eerie voice calling your name, the other half of your lost soul. Together, you must uncover the hospital’s darkest secrets, reunite as one, and confront the entity that ended your life.
But the doctor still lingers… and he’s watching.
Gameplay
Linear, story-driven experience – No combat, just pure psychological horror.
Puzzle-solving & exploration – Uncover hidden clues and items to progress.
Environmental effects – Different areas distort vision, warp sound, and twist reality.
Diverse environments – Each level introduces a new tone and visual style, from dark, oppressive halls to unsettling, empty spaces.
Deep RPG elements – Level-based progression tied to uncovering Anya’s past.
Fully voiced characters – Immerse yourself in the chilling narrative.
Features
✔ Unreal Engine 5 visuals – Realistic graphics with ray tracing, and adjustable settings.
✔ Hauntingly immersive atmosphere – Every sound and shadow hides a story.
✔ A compelling mystery – Piece together Anya’s past and seek justice.
✔ Psychological horror meets shocking scares – A constant sense of dread, broken by heart-stopping moments.
Coming Q2 2025
Wishlist now and prepare to enter the nightmare.

title: Continuity
description:
게임 정보
In Continuity you are sent to a planet similar to earth that is plagued with evil and creatures that seek your blood. Your mission is to clear this world of plague and take over this planet to help fix overpopulation on earth.

Explore this vast world full of biomes and structures to get new gear and materials. Find new enemies in every area you go to. At the start of your adventure you land on this unknown planet "Athea 24Z7" sent to be the hero of earth and cleanse this world of evil. Upon loading into a world you must choose your class which will determine the skills you can unlock as well as the weapons and artifacts you can use. Fight off against bosses to unlock new stages of the story and find new enemies to fight.

You will soon realize the truths about your mission and the story of this unknown world. You aren't as alone as you thought you were, hero.

title: Twenty Six
description:
게임 정보
Twenty Six is an action packed bullet hell that you play through the multiverse- and experience how it was made in parallel dimensions!

title: SPACEROCKS
description:
게임 정보
You are an obsolete model of space drone created for one purpose: mining resources. You were meant to be taken out of commission along with the others, but somehow, you've awakened just in time to avoid the culling. You know that there is an entire Universe out there for you to explore, but it won't be so simple: the other drones can sense that you've gone rogue, and will attempt to destroy you on sight. Your new mission: build enormous strength, wealth and infrastructure necessary to overcome the tremendous power of The Corporation, and escape to a remote area of space far from its control.
In order to escape far enough away from the reaches of The Corporation, you will ultimately need to build a Wormhole Machine. To accomplish this, you will need many supporting factories constructing the necessary parts and Generators to power them.

title: TYRONE vs COPS 2
description:
게임 정보
Tyrone was minding his own business, when the cops rolled up with weapons drawn, claiming that they had a warrant for his arrest (again)... It's time to teach those pigs another lesson! This is a rogue-like third person shooter exploring the reality of police brutality in America.
Featuring all new mechanics and a new map, Tyrone is back and blacker than ever!
Features
Play as Tyrone
Hold your gun sideways
Shoot it at cops
Loot their weapons after you kill them
Over a dozen different types of enemy cops, including BOSS COPS
Awaken the latent power of your melanin using kills from your past lives
Over 40 different perks and abilities to improve Tyrone's cop-killing capabilities
Receive assistance from cute Federal Agents

title: Scenes from the Heart - Part 1
description:
게임 정보
In this heartwarming Visual Novel, you will aid two of your new classmates while also getting to know them better. Explore the world of improv theater, tease the group's Tsundere, learn about their backstory, and work together to create your own Visual Novel.
Scenes from the Heart is a classic Visual Novel about a mature but lonely boy (you) who struggles to connect with others due to his superiority complex. His life changes when he befriends Chisaki Namichi, who faces bullying for her unique eye color at elementary school. Together, they later discover Konaka Motomi, a new transferred classmate with her own quirks.
As they bond, Konaka introduces improvisation theater to Chisaki and you. Inspired, Chisaki initiates her long dream of a visual novel development project, involving the player and Konaka. Despite initial conflicts during the process, they succeed and win an award for their demo, as a menacing shadow is watching over them, hinting at challenges ahead...
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The story will be split into two parts:
Part 1 is more like a prologue to introduce the starting point and the main cast.
Part 2 (TBA) will be diving deeper into everyday life and branching the story at a certain point.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: WildAge
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a magical world where you play as two adorable dragons, each with their own unique abilities. One is agile and jumpy, able to leap over gaps and climb high platforms. The other is strong and clever, capable of pushing magical stones to open paths and solve puzzles.

Together, they travel through colorful worlds, collect shimmering magical crystals, and overcome fun yet challenging obstacles. Only by working as a team can the dragons reach the portal that leads them home — to the enchanted Dragon City.

This game encourages logical thinking, coordination, and teamwork, making it a perfect adventure for young players who love magic and exploration!

title: Echoes of Myth
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Myth is a roguelite soulslike set in a broken, ever-changing fantasy world where gods have fallen silent. Choose your class and path, tactically battling enemies and bosses. Collect unique loot, unlock talents, and permanently enhance your character. Die, learn, and rise stronger.
Soulslike Combat
Engage in challenging combat against formidable enemies and bosses. Utilize a mix of melee attacks and spells, relying on well-timed dodges and parries to survive. Choose from different classes, each offering a unique weapon, spells, and talents that fit your playstyle.
Explore a Fragmented Fantasy World
Navigate through a broken, ever-changing realm where gods have fallen silent. Chart your own course through multiple routes filled with secrets and mysteries to uncover. Each path offers new challenges and discoveries in this dynamic world.

title: Cafe Maid - Classic Edition
description:
게임 정보
Summary - Idler Gameplay
In Cafe Maid serve your guests' needs in your own idle café. Your harem of cute anime maid girls earns you money even while you are shaving or watching your favorite movies, and when you come back, you can spend all that to make your cafe the biggest success around the globe. The game scales almost infinitely.

Grow your business through managing cute maid girls, deploying them in your cafe to serve your guests. As your business grows, more girls join. Flirt with them, get to know them deeper through engaging conversations, watch them open up, and change for the better (or worse) because of you.
Key Features
Chill Idle Gameplay
An enjoyable fusion of idle & clicker gameplay, allowing you to wind down a bit. Cafe Maid will not ask much of you, allowing you to focus on the girls and their stories while their business progresses on its own.
Upgrade Your Company
Once reaching a high collective level, sell your company to an investor for profits, and start over with a new girl added to the team. Spend the profit you earned on brand strategies, raising the girl's efficiency while working in the cafe. Through your previous successes your consequent businesses earn more coins, and attract more guests to be entertained.
Tasks and Achievements
An endless rotation of random tasks around the cafe will keep you busy, earning you extra rewards, such as fresh look for the girls and the cafe, gifts to give to the girls and more. In game achievements reward your mileage, allowing you to access great rewards through earned tickets.
Managing
Hire the cutest maids, selecting from a large variety, starting with your tsundere stepsister: a punk singer, an aspiring pie cook, a classic twintailed maid, a seductive fox girl and more. Set the girls up to meet the guests' needs, whether it's preparing and serving cakes and drinks, dancing and singing for them and more.
Flirting
Flirt with any and all of the maid girls of your cafe, earning their friendship and love beyond the role of being their boss. Give them gifts, take them on dates, flatter and tease them; each girl reacts differently, and their true nature reveals itself as you talk to them, but so will they reveal your true nature.

title: Planet Hoarders
description:
게임 정보
You are a replicant engineered by the Corporation for a single purpose: gather valuable bio-species from abandoned facilities across various planets.

Alone or with up to three teammates, you'll land on planet surfaces to explore and locate facility entrances. Inside, navigate dark, procedurally generated networks of rooms and tunnels to collect small creatures you can carry—but beware of monsters that aim to end you. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are essential to evade or confront these threats.

With limited time on each planet, you must act swiftly to meet your KPIs.
Use in-game radio communication to share information and coordinate actions to access restricted areas.

Finally, uncover the unsettling truth behind your mission.

title: Coreward
description:
게임 정보
Coreward is a fast-paced incremental game where you resist waves of enemies by rotating your shields.
FIGHT
Rotate your shields quickly to cover all angles, while you try to pick up the debris left by the enemies you destroy.
UPGRADE
Improve yourself using the debris of the enemies you've destroyed. Widen your shields so they cover more ground, improve your core so it lasts longer, accelerate your debris collection... There's so many ways to get ahead!

title: Dicey Heroes
description:
게임 정보
“Dicey Heroes” is a casual deck-building game that combines Monopoly and roguelike.
Units move by rolling dice, and actions are triggered by the squares they stop on.
As a breakthrough, your army units have only one parameter: a number. This number serves as both attack power and life force; if it reaches 0, the unit dies. Simple, isn't it?
The objective of the game is to strengthen this number and defeat the enemy.
When a unit stops on a square, its effect is activated.
An “attacking square” attacks the enemy, an “adding square” increases the unit's number, and a “multiplying square” doubles the unit's number.
There are various types of squares, and by combining and strengthening them, you can defeat stronger enemies.
In addition, you can use items to strengthen your units and items to change the roll of the dice to whatever you want.
Of course, enemies will also attack you. Pay attention to the number of chains you have left; if it reaches zero, they will attack you.
Select and strengthen your squares to be able to cross with strong enemies.
We invite you to experience a game that blends luck and strategy at a high level!

title: Stalk and Strike
description:
게임 정보
Stalk and Strike is a multiplayer PvP shooter that blends stealth, parkour, and vertical combat. The action takes place on a mysterious alien planet where a scientific expedition has vanished without a trace. You are a volunteer sent to investigate — but something went terribly wrong. Now, only one can survive, and the evacuation ship has room for just one.
Key Features:
 Battle Royale with a twist: A last-player-standing PvP experience with no teams — only one survivor makes it out alive.
 Jetpack traversal: Use your jetpack with an overheat system to move quickly and gain vertical advantage. Time your flights carefully.
 Stealth and realistic lighting: Hide in shadows, ambush your enemies, and adapt to dynamic lighting that affects visibility and tactics.
 Vertical level design: Giant mushrooms, cliffs, and industrial structures create multi-level battlefields. Height is a strategic asset.
 Dynamic weather and day-night cycle: Sandstorms, rainfall, snowfall, and transitions from bright daylight to pitch-black night change every match. Adapt on the fly.
 Light parkour elements: Climb, slide, and maneuver around the terrain. Mobility gives you an edge.
 Win with cunning, not just firepower: Outsmart your opponents. Use the environment and clever tactics to turn the tide.
 Short, intense matches: Each game lasts 10–15 minutes. Every choice matters.
There is no between-match progression — all players start equal. Your survival depends entirely on skill, strategy, and adaptability.
 Coming soon: Additional game modes including Deathmatch and Extraction are planned for future updates.

title: Actuator : Overt Abnormality
description:
게임 정보
"Actuator : Overt Abnormality" is a new action RPG that expands your horizons as you level up.
Synopsis
The protagonist, in search of a certain rare battery, arrives at a peculiar town…
The town seems to be strange, with violent creatures and no sign of people.
The protagonist uses his natural athletic ability to confront the anomaly alone. (all while continuing their search for the battery)
Action
Vaulting Jump
The protagonist is athletic and can jump over places that are slightly taller than she is.
Actuator
The mysterious flashlight that the protagonist always carries in her hand can move any “object” at will from a distance, as long as the conditions are met.

title: Joe and the Lost Pixels
description:
게임 정보
치명적인 함정을 피하고 픽셀 몬스터들과 맞서 싸우는 이 2.5D 레트로 어드벤처에 도전하세요!
『Joe and the Lost Pixels』는 80년대 명작 게임에 대한 플레이 가능한 오마주로, 황금기 시절의 수많은 장치와 마지막 순간의 죽음을 재현했습니다.
용감하지만 약간 서투른 모험가 조를 조종해 디지털 망각에 의해 부패한 세상을 복원할 힘을 가진 전설의 ‘잃어버린 픽셀’을 찾아 나서세요. 하지만 길은 쉽지 않습니다. 뱀, 가시, 사라지는 플랫폼, 해양 몬스터, 비밀 미로 등 위험이 가득합니다.
때때로 무기를 얻을 수 있지만, 방심하지 마세요.
그리고 당연히, 조의 고전적인 임무는 ‘공주를 구하는 것’입니다. 이 이야기가 어떻게 진행되는지 당신도 알겠죠.
특징:
현대적인 물리 효과를 더한 고전 플랫폼 게임, 2.5D 시점의 3D 그래픽
다양한 스테이지: 정글, 사원, 해저 동굴, 요새 등
가벼운 퍼즐과 옛날 스타일의 도전 과제
게임패드와 키보드 지원
즉사와 빠른 재시작: 옛 시절의 감성을 느껴보세요
잊혀진 픽셀의 세상을 구할 준비가 되었나요?

title: Library Simulator
description:
게임 정보
📚 About This Game
In this library management simulation game, you start with nothing but an empty room and a few books. Your goal is to design and manage a fully functional library from the ground up, where every decision—from layout to membership plans—shapes how your space operates and grows.
Place furniture, arrange shelves, and customize the environment to reflect your own vision. Whether you're creating a quiet reading nook, a modern study area, or a sprawling multi-room facility, you're free to build the kind of library you want to run.
As your visitor base grows, you'll register new members, manage book types, and set up personalized subscription systems. Using an in-game computer interface, you'll handle purchases, pricing, and service upgrades to keep your library running efficiently.
The game offers a blend of creative freedom and thoughtful management, giving you the tools to create a unique library experience and the responsibility to keep it functioning smoothly.
🧠 What You’ll Be Doing:
📦 Build & Decorate:
Choose where every shelf, desk, decoration and even lights goes.

title: Project OBSCURE
description:
게임 정보
Project OBSCURE is a physics-based first-person puzzle game where you manipulate objects using the power of light.

Command objects using the power of "Light" and explore the forgotten chambers of an old facility. Harness the Law of Inertia—the first law of motion—and manipulate objects with the help of your flashlight. We aim to bring a fresh perspective to the puzzle genre, a mixture of both lively and realistic mechanics.

As you progress, uncover secrets and prepare yourself for mind-boggling puzzles. Prepare yourself for an atmospheric steampunk experience. May the light guide you...
📰 CUTTING EDGE TECHNOLOGIES FROM QUARK CORP!!!
S-8 GRAVITON is a groundbreaking invention from QUARK CORP. It enlarges when exposed to light and shrinks back to its original size when the lights turn off. SIZE SOMETIMES MATTERS!
While our beloved S-8 GRAVITON changes its size, its weight also changes accordingly. But keep in mind — EXCESS OF ANYTHING IS BAD.

title: Doomclock
description:
게임 정보
Doomclock is a fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with deckbuilding at its core. Dive into brutal, top-down action as you fend off relentless hordes, build a personalized deck, and wield an ever-growing arsenal to stop the Apocalypse in its tracks.
Build Your Deck
Choose from dozens of unique cards to craft your playstyle. Unlock powerful passives, new weapons, and active abilities through achievements and feats of strength. Discover hidden synergies and secret combos that can turn the tide of battle.
No Pauses!
Every moment counts—level-ups, upgrades, and shop interactions happen in real time. There are no pauses. Think fast, adapt on the fly, and survive the chaos. Each run lasts up to 20 intense minutes.
Slaughter Your Enemies
Slay enemies to earn experience and gold for mid-run upgrades and long-term progression. Face off against seven distinct enemy types and four unique bosses. Watch the blood fly—literally—and manage the gore or invest in handy helmet wipers to keep your vision clear.
Can you beat the clock, or will the Apocalypse win?
Features:
Auto-firing
Fast runs (up to 20 minutes, no pauses)
Multiple characters (each with their own skill tree)
Dozens of different cards (passives, weapons and active skills)
Multiple hidden synergies
Earn experience to level up during each run, and collect gold to spend at the shopkeeper or unlock meta progression
Screen gets soaked in gore—clean it or invest in helmet wipers
7 different enemies and 4 unique bosses

title: Meowventure
description:
게임 정보
This is a top-down roguelike deck-building game where you can combine a wide variety of cards to unleash unimaginable attack effects. With a high degree of freedom in deck construction, countless powerful combos await your creativity.
The game is set in a magical forest ruled by a dark lord. You will take on the role of a brave cat hero summoned from the city, fighting to rescue animal companions under the dark lord's control. Build powerful combos, defeat the dark forces, and save the enchanted forest!

title: Cell Servant
description:
게임 정보
First-person psychological horror game. Serve as a cell servant in a dark underground prison holding dangerous prisoners, and explore a mysterious facility with a unique mix of realism and subtle surrealism.

This is a 30-45 minutes horror experience with the story gradually revealed through gameplay.
This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with prison serving routine simulation and conversation mechanics.

title: Saratoga
description:
게임 정보
Saratoga is a solo or two-person turn-based strategy wargame that is Volume I in the Great Battles of the American Revolution wargame series created by designer Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games. The game focuses on the Battle of Saratoga on September 19, 1777 which proved to be the turning point of the American Revolution.
Players can battle human opponents online or play against the game's AI. There are three scenarios that offer opportunities to explore alternate histories, including a British counterattack on the next day.
Saratoga features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. Players alternate their turns with the first player being determined either by the scenario or randomly.  During their turn a player will conduct maneuver for their units and then engage in combat using units with capabilities based on the historical record.  Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, the ability of nearby leaders and the characteristics of the units in the combat.
Saratoga is Volume I of the enormously popular Great Battles of the American Revolution series designed by Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games.
Each side has an historically accurate order of battle that encourages the player to attempt to outdo the generals of history. Saratoga has scenarios that simulate "what-if" situations as well.  What if the British had counter-attacked the next day? What if Benedict Arnold had gotten his way and been free to attack?

title: The joyless joybound
description:
게임 정보
More than two hundred years after a great war, the world has entered an era of peace and development. Television, the internet, music, games, and various other forms of entertainment and technological inventions are rapidly changing people's lives and values. The pursuit of cultivation and immortality, once sought by everyone, has been replaced by a more relaxed, entertainment-first mindset. Consequently, once prominent cultivation sects have declined and gradually faded into the unprecedented tide of this new era. You, as the contemporary successor of the declining "Hehuan Sect," feel compelled to uphold the sect's last vestiges of glory after your master's passing. During your first summer break from university, you return to Xiahe Town, where you grew up, home to your sect and your companions. Making the right choices and responding to the feelings of the young women is the primary condition for inheriting the sect.

title: The Light Switch
description:
게임 정보
The shadow speaks to you. It wants to play a game. You'll have only a few seconds to find it.
Features:
Four different game modes, each using light and shadow in a unique way - think quickly, look intently, don't miss any details. You wouldn't want to make the shadow angry.
Three ways to play: Story Mode, Custom Mode, and Endless Mode each offer a different experience.
Over 100 random events involving light, sound, and the objects in the room mean that every playthrough is different - don't get disoriented when your world gets turned upside down, literally.
Three endings requiring mastery of the game modes tell the story. Why are you haunted by darkness itself?
Game Modes:
The shadow wants to play, but they will keep you on your toes. 
HIDE AND SEEK
The shadow will find somewhere in the room to hide. No peeking until it's done moving.

title: Sunberry Care Center
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Sunberry Care Center
Sunberry Care Center is a psychological, analog horror adventure horror game with multiple endings.
Upon launching the application, you take on the role of a newly hired staff member at Sunberry Care Center, a facility dedicated to the treatment of a rare disease known as Sunberry Syndrome.
Life at Sunberry Care Center is simple. Your job is to complete routine duties involving facility management and patient care.
At Sunberry Care Center, You should...
Keep the blinds open
Keep the lights on
Administer injections to patients
Ignore the patients if they talk to you
At the end of each day, you will earn a wage based on your performance. Save diligently. By the end of the contract you should have enough to start fresh—far away from this wretched facility.

title: Tiny Gunmon
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Gunmon is a cozy-yet-chaotic idle hunting and life-sim hybrid where you raise, evolve, and command adorable gun-wielding creatures known as Gunmons. Whether you're grinding through study sessions or enduring long workdays, your Gunmons are always by your side on your desktop screen—cute, fierce, and just a little bit hungry for battle.Welcome to their tiny playground, where life is as much about shooting preys as it is about fruit snacks and friendship.

Features

Idle Combat Meets Life Sim
Gunmons will stroll around, hunt, and harvest their AI preys even when you're away—but they need your help to thrive. Keep them fed, manage their behavior, and ensure they don’t get too cranky when hungry!

Hunger & Happiness System
Gunmons get hungry over time. Let them forage for fruits from AI preys to keep them active, healthy, and productive. A well-fed Gunmon is a happy (and profitable) Gunmon.

Evolution Through Battle
Watch your Gunmons grow! By hunting AI preys and gaining experience, Gunmons can evolve into stronger forms with new appearances. Merge two max-level Gunmons of the same kind to unlock their evolved version.

Gacha & Collecting
Unlock new Gunmons via a gacha system using in-game currency. Expand your roster, discover rare species, and build the ultimate Gunmon playground.

Customizable Playground
Decorate and upgrade your Gunmons’ playground with facilities and items. From clinics that slow hunger loss to fruit droppers and coin collectors, every addition changes how your tiny playground works.

Built for Desktop Companionship
Tiny Gunmon runs quietly in the background, making it a perfect companion while you work or study. Check in on your Gunmons, collect some coins, and get back to your tasks—with a smile.

title: Vocator
description:
게임 정보
Vocator combines the unpredictability of a roguelike, the strategic planning of a board game, and the tactical depth of an autobattler.
Core Features:
Choose from 8 unique Vocators, each with a powerful ability that shapes your strategy.
Play from a roster of 70 heroes, placing them on the board to boost your army.
Reroll your servants' dice to land them on tiles occupied by heroes.
Collect and equip 86 artifacts that enhance heroes, empower servants, or alter core game rules.
Discover powerful synergies between heroes, artifacts, servants, and abilities to maximize your score.
Master the roguelike gameplay loop, uncovering new strategies and combinations with each run to overcome increasing challenges.
Whether you're a roguelike enthusiast, a fan of tactical autobattlers, or someone who loves strategic board games, Vocator challenges you to think ahead, adapt fast, and master the mechanics.

title: Richard
description:
게임 정보
About this Game:
Welcome to Rose Academy for the Gifted where the best and brightest graduate standing on top of the world! Take on the role of George, a transfer student, in his final year at high school. Help George through the ups and downs of his high school social life as he works to make friends while campaigning against Richard, the most popular kid in school and his roommate. Learn about the other students, understand what they're really trying to say, and earn their trust as fast as possible in order to win the title of Prom king in this Shakespeare inspired social simulation game!
Are you confident you can earn the crown in time?
Features
Converse with students! - Talk to the popular kids in the school to earn their trust and help them trust each other!

title: Duo Heli Combat
description:
게임 정보
Duo Heli Combat는 전략 요소가 가미된 생동감 넘치는 복셀 기반 아케이드 게임으로, 헬리콥터를 조종하며 미션을 완수하고 기지를 점령하며, 혼자서 또는 친구와 분할 화면 모드로 전투를 펼치는 게임입니다!
미션을 완수하세요 - 포로를 구출하고, 호송대를 호위하며, 깃발을 점령하는 등 다양한 임무가 기다립니다!

title: Solitaire of Stygian Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Our world is being slowly consumed by an ancient evil old gods and only you have the knowledge of the dark forces. Some say the knowledge makes you a madman, yet you can see the cards are everywhere - each chaotic aglomeration a sign of chaos infiltrating our reality. The destiny of the world hinges solely upon your shoulders. Walk the streets of randomly generated city, tread the paths of randomly generated labyrinths, solve randomly generated card layouts to bring order to our world. Maybe you will succeed where the mute violist from H. P. Lovecraft's "The Music of Erich Zann" failed...
Solitaire of Stygian Shadows is a solitaire card game where each playthrough is unique. Card layouts are randomly generated, as well as the environment through which you move. The goal of the game is to discover, one by one, numbers of the cypher to open the gates to the den of the ancient evil.
Experienced solitaire players will find themselves comfortable with the rules of the game. The cards have numerical values from 0 to 9, instead of traditional playing card ranks with aces, kings and queens. Gameplay difficulty can be described as relaxed, despite the theme of the game.

title: Odd Dorable
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a short, playful adventure through this cozy and welcoming open world filled with different puzzles to solve. Uncover hidden secrets and help the princess find all her lost candies. Rediscover your inner child as the game evokes a sense of wonder and curiosity.


Little Features:
⏰ Around 30 minutes to 1 hour of playtime!
☁️ Step into a world of pure imagination, lovingly crafted together with my daughter!
🏝️ Explore different playful locations and solve puzzles!
🤪 Meet a small cast of quirky characters!
🎒 Find all six magic candies and help the princess reclaim her magical powers.

This game uses visual storytelling, so no language is needed to play and fully enjoy the experience.

⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴

A digestible game respects its players' money and time, is designed around a single idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. We want you to be able to finish our games in just a short session without ever making you feel stuffed, so to say.

title: FED Chairman
description:
게임 정보
[h1]Take the Chair. Steer the Economy.[/h1]
You control monetary policy for the United States in a single-player
macro-strategy simulator. Raise or cut rates, deploy QE/QT, face surprise
shocks, and watch every decision ripple through housing, jobs, and markets.
Gameplay Loop
Board Briefing – Read daily data, headlines, and staff projections.
Deliberate & Vote – Adjust policy levers live in a simulated FOMC.
Watch the Ripple – Advance time; the dynamic model recalculates 60+
indicators in real time.
React to Events – Oil embargoes, pandemics, debt-ceiling crises.
Score & Persist – Credibility, CPI, GDP, and unemployment feed an
overall grade that unlocks new scenarios.
Game Modes at Launch
Campaign – 4 historical crises: 1929, 1973, 2008, 2020
Mini Missions – 30 missions to achieve
Key Features
20+ monetary tools: Fed Funds target, IOER, swap lines, standing repos, etc.
Fiscal & regulatory tools such as Tariffs and Taxes to control the economy inflation and unemployment.
60-variable macro model with regional heat-map feedback.
Diegetic control-room UI—flick levers, stamp minutes, slide dot plots.
No microtransactions; all modes above included in base purchase.
Languages
English (audio & text)

title: A Flame in the Dark
description:
게임 정보
An eclipse has blocked out the sun and in the perpetual darkness monsters have risen from the shadows.
A small tribe of people have traveled to a ancient dungeon where legend tells of a permanent source of light.
You must make your way through the winding and crumbling ruins, your only weapon a torch. However, when your torch eventually burns out the shadow will take you. Before that happens you must find a way to help those who will come after you.
A Flame in the Dark is played 1 torch at a time. You must explore the dungeon and unlock ways and passages before your torch runs out, so the next torch bearer can get even deeper; and closer to their salvation.
The dungeon is dark and you only have a single torch to light your way. Explore, solve puzzles, and use your time wisely because time is always running out...

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, unfolding through tense silence and detailed sound design that builds a growing sense of unease. Inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete: 200 minutes
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: Eden: Discovery
description:
게임 정보
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
Key Features:
• High-Stakes Extraction
Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.
• In-Game Currency & Tournaments
Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.
• Social Spaces
Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.
• Future Creative Mode
Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.
• Multiple Paths to Victory
Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.
EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.
• Marketplace & Player Economy
Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.
• PvPvE Gameplay
Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

title: The Witch's Realm
description:
게임 정보
Escape and survive in this supernatural puzzle adventure game where light is your only defense!

Play as a female protagonist that is visiting her grandmother's house where you explore eerie locations, solve escape room-style puzzles, and uncover hidden objects while managing your sanity. Navigate between reality and a twisted ghost dimension while you fend off spirits with your flashlight and unravel the dark history of a cursed town. 
Explore The Witch's Realm
Investigate eerie locations, each hiding secrets and deadly threats:
A Haunted House – The last refuge of a good witch… and now a dangerous trap.
An Abandoned Town – Shrouded in mystery, filled with remnants of a lost past.
A Foggy Graveyard – Where restless spirits linger, guarding hidden truths.
A Twisted Swamp – A dark, shifting maze that distorts reality itself.
Classic Escape Room-Style Puzzles
Hidden objects
Number codes
Riddle solving
Mazes
Managing Your Sanity
The longer you stay in the darkness, the lower your sanity gets
Use Safe Zones to increase your sanity 
The lower your sanity, the more frequent and aggressive ghostly encounters become
Flashlight Mechanic 
Light is your defense against the darkness
Shining it on ghosts will temporarily make them flee or stun them
Ghost Dimension
An alternate dimension filled with supernatural power
Cleanse alters & ritual sites where ghosts use to cross over to the main world

title: Rename the History
description:
게임 정보
전후 역사상 가장 어려운 시기에 국가를 이끄세요. 이때 강대국이 될지 강대국이 될지 선택해야 합니다. 서쪽으로 갈지 동쪽으로 갈지? 결정은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 새로운 역사에서 국가를 잃지 않으려고 노력하고, 많은 갈등을 헤쳐 나가며 영향력을 높이세요.
당신의 목표는 21세기 초에 국가 지도자가 되는 것입니다. 국가를 개선해야 하며, 이는 여러 가지 방법으로 가능합니다. 강력한 국가 기관과 경제의 도움으로 강력한 우월성을 달성할 수 있습니다. 또는 강력한 군사 강대국이 되어 이웃을 정복하고 자신을 강대국이라고 선언할 수 있습니다. 두 가지 방법 모두 장단점이 있지만, 어떤 것을 선택할지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
군대
보병과 전차로 구성된 군대를 지휘하세요. 보병은 수비대를 만들고 정복한 국경을 보호하는 데 필요합니다. 전차는 전선을 돌파하는 데 필요합니다. 전선에서 승리하려면 여러 유형의 군대를 결합하세요!
경제와 건설
전장에서만 국가를 개발하는 것이 아닙니다. 돈을 빌리고, 사무실, 막사, 벙커를 건설할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 목표는 귀하의 국가에 최대의 번영을 이루는 것입니다. 다양한 경제 개발 방식을 결합하여 새로운 경제 기적을 위한 레시피를 만드십시오!
동맹과 외교
다른 국가와의 문제는 군사 행동의 형태로만 해결될 수 없습니다. 귀하는 그들과 동맹을 맺고, 군대의 통과를 요청하고, 인도적 지원을 보내는 등의 방법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 외교적 영향력 방법을 사용하여 국경에 편안한 환경을 조성하십시오.
국가 정책
국가 정책으로 국가 문제를 해결하십시오. 향후 60일 동안 국가 개발에 대한 초점을 선택하십시오. 이는 정치적 초점, 경제적 초점 또는 군사적 초점이 될 수 있습니다. 이 메커니즘은 귀하의 국가뿐만 아니라 전체 지역에도 강력한 영향을 미칩니다. 여기에서 강력한 외교 정책을 찾을 수 있습니다.
다양성의 강점
기억하세요. 선택할 수 있는 국가는 50개국 이상입니다. 그리고 각 메커니즘은 국가에 따라 더 중요하거나 덜 중요할 수 있습니다. 또한, 같은 국가에서 플레이하면 게임의 재미를 충분히 느낄 수 없습니다.

title: The Werewolf
description:
게임 정보
The Werewolf is an intense action-survival game where you become a cursed beast, doomed to transform under the full moon. When night falls, your hunger for blood takes over—eliminate enough victims to stave off the curse, or risk being consumed by it.
But the hunt won’t always be easy. As your reign of terror grows, the villagers may begin to fight back, forming a resistance with torches, traps, and weapons to defend themselves. If your killings draw too much attention, the kingdom may even send skilled knights to hunt you down, forcing you into brutal, high-stakes battles.
Amid the chaos, you may uncover the truth behind your curse. Who did this to you—and why? Will you seek revenge, hunting down the one responsible? Or will you succumb to the monster within, becoming the nightmare the world fears? The choice is yours, but the moon always rises again.

title: My Furry Protogen 3 🐾
description:
게임 정보


My Furry Protogen 3 is the final chapter of the saga, continuing the story of protogen scientist Juno and our main hero. They have made their choice, and now they are ready to risk their lives to stop the antagonist, the mysterious protogen that almost killed Juno before. But will they find the required power for that?...

Meet new friends, find old ones, discover the truth about Juno, and stop this mysterious protogen in "My Furry Protogen 3"!
Features:
• About 2 hours of content.
• Cute female protogen!
• HD fully original artworks.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Some personal drama, as usual.

title: The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game
description:
게임 정보
The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game

《The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game》은 차세대 서바이벌 호러 게임의 정점에 빠르게 올라가고 있습니다. Unreal Engine의 힘으로 지원되며, 초현실적인 그래픽으로 꾸며진 이 게임은 위험이 도처에 도사리는 잊을 수 없는 서바이벌 체험을 제공합니다.

Lost in the Darkness: A Tale Unfolds

평온한 삶을 살아가던 안드레아는 전 여자친구로부터의 갑작스러운 전화로 인해 감정의 소용돌이에 휘말리게 됩니다. 예기치 않은 전화는 그녀의 평화로운 존재를 혼란에 빠뜨리고, 이례적인 어둠이 가득한 미지의 장소로 그녀를 끌고 갑니다. 섬뜩한 분위기가 그녀를 깊은 불안으로 채우며 본능에 의존하도록 강요합니다.

A Struggle Amidst the Shadows

에본베일의 어둡고 섬뜩한 경계에서 홀로 갇힌 안드레아는 그림자 사이에서 길을 찾기 위해 싸웁니다. 작은 희망의 빛을 붙잡으며 생존하기 위해 싸워야 합니다. 그녀의 모든 움직임을 위협하는 미지의 적과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 모든 발걸음마다 주변에 숨겨진 위험에 주의하고, 빛을 향해 나아가기 위해 용기를 모아야 합니다.

현실 이상의 경험

《The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game》은 단순한 게임을 넘어 깊은 체험을 제공합니다. 긴장감 넘치는 순간, 감정의 동요, 그리고 어두운 비밀로 가득 찬 이야기로 플레이어를 매료시키고 잊을 수 없는 여정을 제공합니다.

어둠 속에서 생존 전쟁이 시작됩니다

안드레아의 어두운 세계에서의 생존 전쟁은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 그림자와 두려움의 중심에서 안드레아의 생존을 확보하기 위해 용기를 모으고 이 잊을 수 없는 모험에 뛰어들어 보세요.

title: AUTO-CRISIS
description:
게임 정보
You're driving away on a forest road, late at night, under a heavy storm. Your car breaks down. Luckily, there might be a gas station nearby.
But a misfortune never comes alone. The storm has brought something else, something otherworldly that oddly smells of spilled diesel oil. When it rains, it pours.
AUTO-CRISIS is a short horror game about cars, rain, being lost, and bad days.
 IMMERSIVE SHORT HORROR EXPERIENCE:
Realistic environments in a surreal setting.
You are soaked wet, and can barely see. The thunder strikes in the distance, revealing otherworldly creatures in the storm's vanishing light...
The rain has brought something else. You are not alone.

title: Mindwarp: AI Detectiv
description:
게임 정보
Key Gameplay Features:
You and your team are elite detectives who have arrived on an isolated island where something terrible has happened. In "Mindwarp: AI Detective," time is your main adversary. Can you unravel the intricate web of lies and clues before the clock strikes midnight?
Investigation Preparation:
Team Assembly: In the menu, gather your team of detectives (play solo or team up with friends in co-op, or perhaps you'll want to compete with friends for the title of best detective!).
Scenario Start: Choose one of many unique detective scenarios. Customize your game mode and set off for the island, receiving a brief introduction to the case.
Immersive Investigation:
Island World: Explore a picturesque yet mysterious island, filled with atmospheric locations and hidden corners.
Living NPCs: Interact with the local residents – each has their own unique backstory, daily routine, and a host of secrets. Simply approach them and press a button to start a dialogue, ask questions, uncover contradictions, and gain valuable clues.
Clue Hunting: Thoroughly search the map – from secret notes to suspicious objects, every piece of evidence brings you closer to solving the mystery. Collect them, analyze them, and piece them together.
Race Against Time:
Limited Time: You have only one in-game day to gather as much information as possible, interrogate all witnesses, and find key evidence. Time waits for no one!
Decision Making: Before dusk, you must deliver your verdict: who committed the crime and how? An incorrect decision will mean failure.

title: SHAPELAND
description:
게임 정보
SHAPELAND는 플레이하기 쉽고 이기기 어려운 싱글 플레이어 1인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.
무기는 하나뿐이고 파워업은 없습니다.
피나 고어, 재장전, 유지 관리, 공개된 지식, 거래/통화, 제작, 인벤토리, 긴 여정, 그라인드가 없습니다!
가장 빠른 시간과 가장 높은 점수를 위한 경쟁만 있습니다!
이 작은 오픈 월드 환경에서는 매초 무언가가 일어납니다. 표적을 향해 사격하고, 픽업을 쫓고, 포털과 벽을 여는 동안 적의 모양을 피하고 피합니다.

최대의 재미! 저중력 지형에서 걷고, 달리고, 질주하고, 점프할 수 있습니다. 특정 모양과 아이템을 활용하여 레벨을 '날아다니는' 법을 배우세요. 물 위를 이동하고 때로는 공중을 이동하는 보트도 있습니다. 이 아름답고 중독성 있는 리플레이 가능한 슈팅 게임에는 7개의 레벨과 보너스 레벨이 있습니다. 재미있습니다!

최대의 재미!

title: the travelers
description:
게임 정보
a surreal apocalyptic world awaits you outside the building where you wake up. without memory or knowledge of what happened to the world, you emerge into a broken city full of mystery, ringing a massive purple monolith that rises beyond the dark clouds high above, dead in the center of an empty world. the air hangs heavy with radiation, the rolling clouds above constantly raining ash onto a world untouched for a long, long time.
the travelers is a text-based adventure and mmo. the world is one massive grid to be explored by all players at once, where items can be discovered, bases can be built, and combat can be engaged. hidden within the world is a unique story, with dozens of old transcripts from a forgotten world to read through. hidden even within this, across the whole world, is a grand puzzle, guiding the community through clues that will reveal what happened to humanity. together, you can uncover the secrets of the wasteland.

title: Stash: A Card Looter
description:
게임 정보
Draft Unique Loot
Stash captures the thrill of opening a fresh pack of cards, chasing rare pulls, and uncovering powerful synergies. With an endless variety of unique cards, no two drafts are ever the same. Every decision is a razor-sharp balance between pushing your luck for that perfect chase card and the urgency of locking in a game-changing pick before the next battle begins.
Quick, Intuitive Card Selection
Make quick decisions with intuitive swipe-based card selection that feels just like opening a real pack of cards. Thanks to procedural generation, no two choices are ever the same. But don’t let the smoothness fool you—this is a game of deep strategy
Diverse Card Types
Choose from six distinct card types—heroes, weapons, relics, quests, consumables, and upgrades. Craft unique heroes, build strategic advantages, or grab a quick buff to turn the tide of battle.

title: psy-relic
description:
게임 정보
개요
보물을 찾기 위해 몰래 들어간 곳은 무서운 곳이었습니다.
만지면 눈이 멀게 되는 석고상, 팔이 휘감기는 꽃병.
안전한 생존을 선택하거나 위험을 감수하고 부를 선택하십시오
백만장자가 되는 것은 플레이어의 몫입니다!
gemmy 게임의 새로운 생존 공포
보물 사냥꾼이 되는 플레이어를 위한
최후의 선택이 다가온다!
이 게임에 대하여
최대 4명까지 온라인 멀티 협동 플레이가 가능하며, 싱글 플레이도 가능합니다.
직업 시스템이 있으며, 각 직업마다 심령 유물 탐색에 유리한 스킬이 있습니다.
PERK 시스템이 있으며, 플레이를 많이 할수록 심령 유물을 찾는 데 유리해집니다.
수집 시스템이 있으며, 일단 심령 유물을 수집하면 창고에서 자유롭게 다시 확인할 수 있습니다.
각각의 사이킥 유물에는 디버프 세트가 있으며, 들어올리면 다양한 효과를 가져온다.
작동 방법
W/A/S/D - 이동
E - 사이코 유물 들어올리기/내리기
F - 사이코 유물 로드(차량 앞에서만 유효)
B - 워키토키를 이용한 음성 통화
Shift - 대시
Ctrl - 웅크리기
마우스 휠 - 아이템 전환
콘텐츠 제작/유통 지침
개인, 법인 여부를 불문하고 자유롭게 영상을 게시하고 배포해 주시기 바랍니다.
동영상 및 스트리밍 제목에 게임 이름을 포함해 주세요.
예) 심리적 유물 사냥꾼

title: Gamba Simulator
description:
게임 정보
마피아가 부분적으로 통제하는 도시에 갇힌 감바(도박 중독자)가 되어보세요.
사멸한 화산을 채굴하세요,
이 기계로 도박을 하세요:
apendawn

title: Somniora: Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Somniora is a horror-puzzle game. Get ready to delve into the adventure of our character, who is trapped amidst strange dreams, while searching for answers to the questions lurking in their subconscious.
Amara
Like everyone else, you are someone trying to earn a living through your talent. While your debts and problems never seem to end, you also have to deal with your past. Psychological support aside, you cannot even sleep without medication. Why are you so afraid?
The big day
When that day comes, you won’t even know where you are because you’re on the other side, and if the ones controlling that place don’t want you to wake up, you won’t. Of course, defeating them might change things. A little blood may be spilled...

title: Bat to the Beat
description:
게임 정보
Swing your bat to the beat in this cricket-themed rhythm action game.
Think on your feet
Experience a unique twist on rhythm gameplay that challenges your sense of rhythm and spatial awareness. At each beat you have to make a split second decision. Attack and risk getting caught by the fielders. Or defend and let the pressure build up.
Enemy positions and patterns are randomized to make each play-through unique, forcing you to think on your feet.
Travel the world
As you make your way across the cricket-playing world you'll be challenged by the unique grooves of each country - ranging from one-drop reggae beats of Jamaica to syncopated Indian rhythms.

title: Lone Soul
description:
게임 정보
Lone Soul is a hack-and-slash action game featuring a combo-based fluid combat. By performing unique abilities, your combo meter gets upgraded, rewarding you with increased damage. 

A roguelite progression puts you on a multiple runs that takes you through a series of randomly generated locations, allowing you to craft a unique build with every playthrough. Killed enemies drop gear and health orbs, similar to top-down ARPGs.
Express Yourself in Combat
During your excursions into the mythical tower, you will acquire dozens of spells and attacks to enhance your combo deck. Whether you favor close-quarters combat, tactical positioning, or commanding arcane forces, the choice is yours.

title: KnockedDown
description:
게임 정보

Engage in fast-paced driving through bustling streets, around sharp turns and through traffic.



Fun racing through destructive enviroments, explosions and much more!



It ain't easy. Police is on your tail. Evade until the extraction plane arrives!



Extract before it's too late. The longer you wait the less cash you have left.

title: Budget Guardian: Health Realm
description:
게임 정보
Budget Guardian: Health Realm combines engaging gameplay with educational elements, making complex financial concepts both accessible and enjoyable.
Welcome to the whimsical world of Hindmarchville, where the villagers have elected a cat as their mayor, leading to some peculiar occurrences. In this casual simulation adventure, you play as Aayto, a dedicated health professional who has come to town to establish a care centre.

title: Chalice of Highland
description:
게임 정보
⚔︎ Guide a young bird on his quest to find the Chalice of Highland ⚔︎
In Chalice of Highland, embark on an epic adventure inspired by Gameboy aesthetics. Explore the world and dive into six challenging dungeons to recover the Chalice of Highland. As a brave bird, you’ll wield a sword to battle enemies and use your unique ability to fly, uncovering secrets along the way.
Key Features :
6 Unique Dungeons: Each dungeon presents its own mechanics and challenges, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
7 Epic Bosses: Face off against formidable bosses guarding each piece of the Chalice of Highland.
7 Dream Sequences: Uncover the hero's backstory through dream sequences that reveal the mysterious past of the Highlands.
Customizable Screen Colors: Choose from different screen color palettes to enhance your retro gaming experience.
Classic or Widescreen: Play in the original Gameboy format or switch to a 16:9 widescreen view for a modern twist.

title: Hollowge
description:
게임 정보
"Buried alive, one shall rise."
Descend into the depths of Hollowforge, a decaying mining complex overrun by monstrous horrors born of corporate greed. In this adrenaline-pumping first-person stealth/action game, you'll need more than just firepower to survive—you’ll need to outwit and outmaneuver the abominations lurking in every shadow.
Blending the fast-paced chaos of Doom with the stealth mastery of Thief, Hollowforge delivers a heart-pounding experience where every choice matters. Run, sneak, and shoot your way through a labyrinth of tunnels, making split-second decisions as you unravel the dark secrets of a megacorporation’s failed experiment.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced Stealth/Action: Stay sharp. Darkness is your ally, but when the monsters find you, your guns become the final word.
Immersive Underground World: Explore the massive, open-ended complex of Hollowforge—a place steeped in mystery, where every corner hides a secret or a nightmare waiting to strike.
Resource Management: Conserve your scarce ammo and health, or spend your hard-earned credits at vending machines for a fighting chance.
Weapons Arsenal: From pistols to crossbows, take control of a versatile range of weaponry as you adapt to the horrors below.
Dynamic 3D Graphics: Feel the tension build with every flicker of light in this atmospheric world. Every shadow could hide an enemy. Every step could be your last.
Get ready to survive. Will you bring the truth to light—or be swallowed by the darkness?
Are you brave enough to face the horrors of Hollowforge?

title: Enlightening
description:
게임 정보
Enlightening은 블록을 밀어 움직이는 논리 게임으로, 전기를 활용한 독특한 메커니즘을 제공합니다.
로봇 청소기 Flux를 도와 각 레벨의 출구를 작동시키는 에너지 회로를 만들어 탈출하세요.
임무는 간단해 보일 수 있지만, 퍼즐은 공간 인식, 추상적 사고, 그리고 분석적 사고 능력을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다.
준비되셨나요? 에너지를 충전하고 도전하세요!
125개 이상의 정교하게 설계된 레벨과 25개의 튜토리얼이 준비되어 있으며, 명확하고 보람 있는 게임을 위해 체계적으로 구성되어 있습니다.
각 퍼즐은 신선한 반전을 제공하며, 문제 해결 능력을 시험하고 계속해서 몰입하도록 만들죠!

title: Phantasms: Maledictus
description:
게임 정보
Phantasms is an episodic psychological horror game. Each chapter is hand crafted to deliver a unique and immersive horror experience.

More episodes are coming soon.
Phantasms: Maledictus
In this medieval-themed first episode, you play as a parent whose child has been abducted by a mysterious figure. You’ll face multiple possible outcomes, though only one leads to the correct ending.
Key Features
Stylized PSX graphics with a horror aesthetic.
VHS film shaders.
Interact with NPCs.
Multiple endings in this interactive story telling experience.

title: Повышенная Облачность - High Clouds
description:
게임 정보
The game is a 3D platformer for PC in a setting of flying islands. The islands are moving, swinging and rotating. Play a the main character  - a dog who wants to get to the highest island in order to fly to the moon by ship from there.
Jump from island to island
Plan on your coat
Cling to the rocks with a hook
Fly long distances by hang glider
Fight the pirates
On the way, the weather creates difficulties for him - wind, rain, thunderstorms.

title: Lucky Summoner
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to *Lucky Summoner*, a strategy card battle game that blends deck-building with RogueLite elements. Here, you'll play as a fledgling card summoner, skillfully utilizing the cards in your hand to defeat increasingly powerful enemies. Overcome the final BOSS's challenge to earn the title of Summoning Master.
Gameplay Introduction
The core gameplay revolves around strategic card battles. In each battle, you can summon powerful minions to fight for you using the cards in your hand or enhance their abilities with upgrade cards to pose a greater threat to the enemy. Within a limited number of turns, you must plan each move carefully and make optimal use of every energy point to defeat your opponent. If the turns run out and the enemy is still standing, the challenge will be declared a failure.

title: SPACEROCKS
description:
게임 정보
You are an obsolete model of space drone created for one purpose: mining resources. You were meant to be taken out of commission along with the others, but somehow, you've awakened just in time to avoid the culling. You know that there is an entire Universe out there for you to explore, but it won't be so simple: the other drones can sense that you've gone rogue, and will attempt to destroy you on sight. Your new mission: build enormous strength, wealth and infrastructure necessary to overcome the tremendous power of The Corporation, and escape to a remote area of space far from its control.
In order to escape far enough away from the reaches of The Corporation, you will ultimately need to build a Wormhole Machine. To accomplish this, you will need many supporting factories constructing the necessary parts and Generators to power them.

title: Who Is Ethan?
description:
게임 정보
"Who is Ethan?"은 1~4인 온라인 협동 심리 공포 게임입니다. 공포는 모든 그림자 속에 도사리고 있습니다.
당신은 버려진 병원에서 눈을 뜹니다. 혼란스럽고 혼자라고 느끼지만… 무언가가 지켜보고 있습니다.
팀원들과 협력하여 암호 같은 단서를 해독하고, 으스스한 복도를 탐험하며, 이 벽들 속에 숨겨진 왜곡된 진실을 밝혀내세요.
하지만 기억하세요… 어떤 질문은 절대 답하지 않는 것이 좋습니다.
🔪 악몽 속에서 살아남을 수 있을까요? 🔪
주요 특징:
👥 1~4인 협동 플레이: 친구들과 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 공포에 맞서세요.
🕵️ 깊이 있는 미스터리 & 조사: 불안한 퍼즐을 풀고 진실을 조각 맞추세요.
👻 적응형 AI & 예측 불가능한 위협: 매번 다른 경험이 펼쳐집니다.
🔊 몰입형 3D 사운드 디자인: 삐걱이는 소리, 속삭임, 발소리 하나하나가 위험일 수 있습니다.
🕯️ 제한된 자원 & 영구 죽음: 당신의 모든 선택이 마지막일 수 있습니다. 신중하게 결정하세요.
당신은 이 병원을 탈출할 수 있을까요… 아니면 그 전설의 일부가 될까요?

title: Blade of Jinshu
description:
게임 정보
Betrayed. Left to die. Now, you awaken in a fractured cybernetic reality, your mind and body fused with deadly and cutting-edge cybertronic abilities. The corruption that created you thinks you are gone, but they will soon learn how wrong they are.
Master a deadly arsenal of cyber-enhanced attacks, single blade, dual daggers, and devastating special abilities. Every strike is precise. Every move is lethal.

title: Bloodright
description:
게임 정보
On a fog-covered night, Adrian’s car breaks down on a desolate road. Searching for help, he finds a looming mansion and steps inside—only for the door to lock behind him. With no way out, he must navigate its dark corridors, piece together its buried secrets, and survive the horrors that now stalk him in the shadows.
Explore the mansion's decaying halls, uncover hidden pathways, and piece together the story.

title: Prism of You
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Prism, a unique emotional sandbox simulation where the player's goal is balance. Identify, engage, and express eccentric alien creatures that represent human emotions.
What’s hiding in the dark fog? Using sounds, movement patterns, and thoughts as hints, learn how to identify your emotions before you can start engaging with them. It gets easier as you go!
It’s important to engage with your emotions in a healthy way instead of bottling them up. Give your Emoes attention to maintain them, and build structures to help manage your Emoes more effectively. Your Emoes also have unique properties. Emoes of the same type can merge to create higher intensity emotions, and Emoes holding too much charge will split into more Emoes. Learn how to manage your population of Emoes and keep your Prism in a steady equilibrium.
Expressing your emotions can be relieving and cathartic. Express your Emoes to release charge from the system and help keep your Prism in balance.

title: Vesper's Hunt
description:
게임 정보
Vampires are lurking among the mortals, and it’s your job to uncover them before it's too late. Every turn, you’ll gather clues, track movements, and use deduction to separate the innocent from the undead.
Unmask the Hidden Vampires

title: Heir to the Queen
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
RPG Maker VX Ace로 제작된 미스터리 어드벤처 게임입니다.
시놉시스
평범한 여고생 야무는 우연한 계기로 고대 이집트의 여이 될 자격을 얻게 된다.
하지만 왕좌에 오르기 위해서는 수수께끼로 가득 찬 관문을 통과해야만 한다.
그러나 이곳에는 그녀를 시험하는 정체 모를 존재들이 기다리고 있다.
미지의 공간에서 펼쳐지는 퍼즐, 탐험, 생존의 여정...
과연 야무는 모든 시련을 극복하고 진정한 여왕이 될 수 있을까?
게임 특징
퍼즐 & 탐험: 알 수 없는 공간을 탐색하며 단서를 찾고 퍼즐을 풀어야 한다.
미스터리한 분위기: 신비롭고 긴장감 넘치는 스토리 전개.
생존 요소: 정체 모를 미지의 존재들을 피해 살아남아야 한다.
귀여운 픽셀 아트: 아기자기한 도트 그래픽과 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 디자인.

title: Gloamryn
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gloamryn!
A mystical strategy game set in a world of eternal twilight, where survival is as much about cunning as it is about strength.
In this land of fading light, resources are scarce, enemies lurk in the shadows, and magic pulses through the earth itself.
Build camps, gather supplies, and master the art of tactical combat as you lead your people through the unknown.
Will you seek refuge under the glowing leaves of the Healing Tree, strike dangerous bargains with witches, or carve your own path in the twilight?
The choices are yours – welcome to Gloamryn.
Tactical Combat - A Unique Card Game
Tactical combat in Gloamryn takes place through a unique, specifically designed card game. Your units, their equipment, and their abilities shape every battle, while each faction brings its own way of fighting. No two encounters play out the same.
Strategic Map

title: GraviTech
description:
게임 정보
From a Different Angle
In this 3D puzzle game, you will find yourself in a space laboratory dedicated to studying gravity. You will face numerous challenges that require you to see the world from a different angle—because here, gravity can be directed in any direction.
What You'll Find in This Game:
A variety of exciting levels
Over 10 unique interactive objects
A chance to test your sense of balance
Platforming sections
Level Editor
If the levels created by the developers aren't enough for you, you can create your own! The game features a flexible level editor to bring your ideas to life.

title: Slaves of Magic
