description:
게임 정보

The world was not prepared for the invasion. In a few months, every kingdom of the known world surrendered to the magic-using invaders masquerading as our old Gods. But humanity has not given up yet! Those who dare to oppose the new world order formed the shadow council in secret, and they tasked You to lead the resistance against these false Gods in this turn-based tactical strategy game.
Build up the resistance

You will need to build and manage bases throughout the continent. These will provide the resources necessary to hire and equip your troops and learn more about the magic the invaders are using. Every region has a unique culture that gives access to different equipment skills and resources. You will always have to weigh the importance of the regions in the strategic situation you find yourself in.
Outsmart the invaders on a strategic level

The invaders' grip on the continent is not absolute... yet. But they have multiple armies conducting missions every month, and it is your job to figure out the best ways to slow down their advance. The invaders have their own goals they try to archive with their armies, and they are constantly assessing how much danger the resistance poses to them and change those plans accordingly.

In combat, you will lead a 6-8 unit team which you can fully customize with equipment and skills. To reinforce the customization, there are no classes, only attributes like sword-wielding or barbarian, which all units can learn. This gives you the freedom to mix and match them to create your perfect team.

The resistance managed to get a working teleporter, which serves as their biggest asset. With proper intel and smart unit placement, your team can teleport to exactly where you need them to be, giving you a headstart on every mission. Position and teamwork are key to completing your objective.

The game is being built from the ground up to focus on replayability. There are multiple invading forces with different enemies and a reactive campaign AI necessitating a different approach. Nor you will be able to access or afford everything in one playthrough, giving ample space for experimenting with different approaches. Every invasion story will be yours to write. And humanity can only hope you are up to the task to save it from becoming Slaves of Magic!

title: RAFT Days
description:
게임 정보
You travel on a raft, rocked by the waves, from port to port.
You are a sailor, an adventurer, a traveler, a merchant.
You cross the sea from port to port.
When you find a good, you load it onto a raft.
You push and organize the goods like a "warehouseman.
If you find someone who wants it, you sell it to them.
Goods from foreign lands are rare and can fetch a high price.
Goods that may be useful for your trip will make your raft trip richer.
Let's make the raft bigger with the money we have accumulated.
And you can hire sailors to help you in a pleasant way.
RAFT Days will offer you a peaceful time with waves and winds in your busy days.

title: Lighting Lanterns
description:
게임 정보
🔔 Add to your Wishlist and Play the free Demo
🕯️ A gentle, cozy platformer about friendship and fading light.
In Lighting Lanterns, you’ll guide three unlikely friends through a gentle, handcrafted world — from golden bamboo groves to autumn tea villages.
Light magical lanterns to reveal hidden bridges, bouncing flowers, and drowsy creatures. Switch between characters to solve cozy puzzles and uncover a warm, storybook-style tale — told by a gentle narrator who walks every step beside you.
✨ What makes Lighting Lanterns special?
🕯️ Light to Reveal
Lanterns awaken platforms, creatures, and entire paths — like painting warmth into the world.
🐾 Cozy, Not Challenging
Just light puzzly moments, gentle exploration, and small acts of kindness.
🎭 Three Playable Friends
Switch between a hopeful tanuki, a cautious bird, and a playful spirit to navigate gentle puzzles together.
🍂 A Journey Full of Cozy Places
From lantern-lit islands to autumn-colored rooftops — explore at your own pace.
📖 Narrated Like a Storybook
Inspired by Thomas Was Alone, your journey is guided by a warm narrator who brings heart to every step.
🧡 Lighting Lanterns is a short, heartfelt escape —
perfect for players who love narrative gems, gentle platformers, and cozy moments of light.
☕ Best enjoyed with a blanket and a cup of tea.

title: Library Simulator
description:
게임 정보
📚 About This Game
In this library management simulation game, you start with nothing but an empty room and a few books. Your goal is to design and manage a fully functional library from the ground up, where every decision—from layout to membership plans—shapes how your space operates and grows.
Place furniture, arrange shelves, and customize the environment to reflect your own vision. Whether you're creating a quiet reading nook, a modern study area, or a sprawling multi-room facility, you're free to build the kind of library you want to run.
As your visitor base grows, you'll register new members, manage book types, and set up personalized subscription systems. Using an in-game computer interface, you'll handle purchases, pricing, and service upgrades to keep your library running efficiently.
The game offers a blend of creative freedom and thoughtful management, giving you the tools to create a unique library experience and the responsibility to keep it functioning smoothly.
🧠 What You’ll Be Doing:
📦 Build & Decorate:
Choose where every shelf, desk, decoration and even lights goes.

title: Project OBSCURE
description:
게임 정보
Project OBSCURE is a physics-based first-person puzzle game where you manipulate objects using the power of light.

Command objects using the power of "Light" and explore the forgotten chambers of an old facility. Harness the Law of Inertia—the first law of motion—and manipulate objects with the help of your flashlight. We aim to bring a fresh perspective to the puzzle genre, a mixture of both lively and realistic mechanics.

As you progress, uncover secrets and prepare yourself for mind-boggling puzzles. Prepare yourself for an atmospheric steampunk experience. May the light guide you...
📰 CUTTING EDGE TECHNOLOGIES FROM QUARK CORP!!!
S-8 GRAVITON is a groundbreaking invention from QUARK CORP. It enlarges when exposed to light and shrinks back to its original size when the lights turn off. SIZE SOMETIMES MATTERS!
While our beloved S-8 GRAVITON changes its size, its weight also changes accordingly. But keep in mind — EXCESS OF ANYTHING IS BAD.

title: Doomclock
description:
게임 정보
Doomclock is a fast-paced roguelite arena shooter with deckbuilding at its core. Dive into brutal, top-down action as you fend off relentless hordes, build a personalized deck, and wield an ever-growing arsenal to stop the Apocalypse in its tracks.
Build Your Deck
Choose from dozens of unique cards to craft your playstyle. Unlock powerful passives, new weapons, and active abilities through achievements and feats of strength. Discover hidden synergies and secret combos that can turn the tide of battle.
No Pauses!
Every moment counts—level-ups, upgrades, and shop interactions happen in real time. There are no pauses. Think fast, adapt on the fly, and survive the chaos. Each run lasts up to 20 intense minutes.
Slaughter Your Enemies
Slay enemies to earn experience and gold for mid-run upgrades and long-term progression. Face off against seven distinct enemy types and four unique bosses. Watch the blood fly—literally—and manage the gore or invest in handy helmet wipers to keep your vision clear.
Can you beat the clock, or will the Apocalypse win?
Features:
Auto-firing
Fast runs (up to 20 minutes, no pauses)
Multiple characters (each with their own skill tree)
Dozens of different cards (passives, weapons and active skills)
Multiple hidden synergies
Earn experience to level up during each run, and collect gold to spend at the shopkeeper or unlock meta progression
Screen gets soaked in gore—clean it or invest in helmet wipers
7 different enemies and 4 unique bosses

title: Meowventure
description:
게임 정보
This is a top-down roguelike deck-building game where you can combine a wide variety of cards to unleash unimaginable attack effects. With a high degree of freedom in deck construction, countless powerful combos await your creativity.
The game is set in a magical forest ruled by a dark lord. You will take on the role of a brave cat hero summoned from the city, fighting to rescue animal companions under the dark lord's control. Build powerful combos, defeat the dark forces, and save the enchanted forest!

title: Cell Servant
description:
게임 정보
First-person psychological horror game. Serve as a cell servant in a dark underground prison holding dangerous prisoners, and explore a mysterious facility with a unique mix of realism and subtle surrealism.

This is a 30-45 minutes horror experience with the story gradually revealed through gameplay.
This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with prison serving routine simulation and conversation mechanics.

title: The joyless joybound
description:
게임 정보
More than two hundred years after a great war, the world has entered an era of peace and development. Television, the internet, music, games, and various other forms of entertainment and technological inventions are rapidly changing people's lives and values. The pursuit of cultivation and immortality, once sought by everyone, has been replaced by a more relaxed, entertainment-first mindset. Consequently, once prominent cultivation sects have declined and gradually faded into the unprecedented tide of this new era. You, as the contemporary successor of the declining "Hehuan Sect," feel compelled to uphold the sect's last vestiges of glory after your master's passing. During your first summer break from university, you return to Xiahe Town, where you grew up, home to your sect and your companions. Making the right choices and responding to the feelings of the young women is the primary condition for inheriting the sect.
autokwd: The joyless joybound,合欢宗不允许谈恋爱

title: The Light Switch
description:
게임 정보
The shadow speaks to you. It wants to play a game. You'll have only a few seconds to find it.
Features:
Four different game modes, each using light and shadow in a unique way - think quickly, look intently, don't miss any details. You wouldn't want to make the shadow angry.
Three ways to play: Story Mode, Custom Mode, and Endless Mode each offer a different experience.
Over 100 random events involving light, sound, and the objects in the room mean that every playthrough is different - don't get disoriented when your world gets turned upside down, literally.
Three endings requiring mastery of the game modes tell the story. Why are you haunted by darkness itself?
Game Modes:
The shadow wants to play, but they will keep you on your toes. 
HIDE AND SEEK
The shadow will find somewhere in the room to hide. No peeking until it's done moving.

title: Sunberry Care Center
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Sunberry Care Center
Sunberry Care Center is a psychological, analog horror adventure horror game with multiple endings.
Upon launching the application, you take on the role of a newly hired staff member at Sunberry Care Center, a facility dedicated to the treatment of a rare disease known as Sunberry Syndrome.
Life at Sunberry Care Center is simple. Your job is to complete routine duties involving facility management and patient care.
At Sunberry Care Center, You should...
Keep the blinds open
Keep the lights on
Administer injections to patients
Ignore the patients if they talk to you
At the end of each day, you will earn a wage based on your performance. Save diligently. By the end of the contract you should have enough to start fresh—far away from this wretched facility.

title: Tiny Gunmon
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Gunmon is a cozy-yet-chaotic idle hunting and life-sim hybrid where you raise, evolve, and command adorable gun-wielding creatures known as Gunmons. Whether you're grinding through study sessions or enduring long workdays, your Gunmons are always by your side on your desktop screen—cute, fierce, and just a little bit hungry for battle.Welcome to their tiny playground, where life is as much about shooting preys as it is about fruit snacks and friendship.

Features

Idle Combat Meets Life Sim
Gunmons will stroll around, hunt, and harvest their AI preys even when you're away—but they need your help to thrive. Keep them fed, manage their behavior, and ensure they don’t get too cranky when hungry!

Hunger & Happiness System
Gunmons get hungry over time. Let them forage for fruits from AI preys to keep them active, healthy, and productive. A well-fed Gunmon is a happy (and profitable) Gunmon.

Evolution Through Battle
Watch your Gunmons grow! By hunting AI preys and gaining experience, Gunmons can evolve into stronger forms with new appearances. Merge two max-level Gunmons of the same kind to unlock their evolved version.

Gacha & Collecting
Unlock new Gunmons via a gacha system using in-game currency. Expand your roster, discover rare species, and build the ultimate Gunmon playground.

Customizable Playground
Decorate and upgrade your Gunmons’ playground with facilities and items. From clinics that slow hunger loss to fruit droppers and coin collectors, every addition changes how your tiny playground works.

Built for Desktop Companionship
Tiny Gunmon runs quietly in the background, making it a perfect companion while you work or study. Check in on your Gunmons, collect some coins, and get back to your tasks—with a smile.

title: Vocator
description:
게임 정보
Vocator combines the unpredictability of a roguelike, the strategic planning of a board game, and the tactical depth of an autobattler.
Core Features:
Choose from 8 unique Vocators, each with a powerful ability that shapes your strategy.
Play from a roster of 70 heroes, placing them on the board to boost your army.
Reroll your servants' dice to land them on tiles occupied by heroes.
Collect and equip 86 artifacts that enhance heroes, empower servants, or alter core game rules.
Discover powerful synergies between heroes, artifacts, servants, and abilities to maximize your score.
Master the roguelike gameplay loop, uncovering new strategies and combinations with each run to overcome increasing challenges.
Whether you're a roguelike enthusiast, a fan of tactical autobattlers, or someone who loves strategic board games, Vocator challenges you to think ahead, adapt fast, and master the mechanics.

title: Saratoga
description:
게임 정보
Saratoga is a solo or two-person turn-based strategy wargame that is Volume I in the Great Battles of the American Revolution wargame series created by designer Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games. The game focuses on the Battle of Saratoga on September 19, 1777 which proved to be the turning point of the American Revolution.
Players can battle human opponents online or play against the game's AI. There are three scenarios that offer opportunities to explore alternate histories, including a British counterattack on the next day.
Saratoga features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. Players alternate their turns with the first player being determined either by the scenario or randomly.  During their turn a player will conduct maneuver for their units and then engage in combat using units with capabilities based on the historical record.  Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, the ability of nearby leaders and the characteristics of the units in the combat.
Saratoga is Volume I of the enormously popular Great Battles of the American Revolution series designed by Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games.
Each side has an historically accurate order of battle that encourages the player to attempt to outdo the generals of history. Saratoga has scenarios that simulate "what-if" situations as well.  What if the British had counter-attacked the next day? What if Benedict Arnold had gotten his way and been free to attack?

title: Mad Carnival
description:
게임 정보
🎪 Mad Carnival
Welcome to the carnival of madness. Costumed mascots are attacking!?
A slightly creepy but comical amusement park sets the stage for this top-down shooting game, perfect for beginners!
Overview:
Rescue your kidnapped girlfriend from an amusement park taken over by a rogue AI!
Mad Carnival is a stage-based top-down shooter where you must conquer each ride one by one. Battle twisted mascot AIs across attractions like teacups, mazes, go-karts, and more!
Key Features:
🎯 Simple, beginner-friendly action shooting gameplay
🎡 Unique stage layouts and gimmicks for each attraction
🧸 Creepy yet comical mascots full of personality
🎫 Use money earned from battles to buy tickets and unlock new attractions
💥 Utilize multiple weapons to put an end to the AI rampage!
Story:
In a once peaceful amusement park, chaos erupts as the AI goes berserk.
Mascots turn hostile, and your loved one is taken away.
With madness closing in and smiles masking danger, you grab your ticket... and fight.
To bring her back.

title: cLocked In
description:
게임 정보
Description:
Step into the boots of a rookie officer in cLocked In, a fast-paced open-world police simulator set in a vibrant, low-poly, fantasy city where humans, orcs, elves, and goblins coexist—and crime never sleeps. You're the newest recruit on the force, starting small but dreaming big. From writing parking tickets in quiet suburbs to breaking up dangerous drug rings and surviving magical shootouts, your rise through the ranks begins now.
Explore Four Unique Districts:
Hannara – Human-dominated suburban streets with minor infractions and neighborhood disputes.
Morgatelis – Glittering skyscrapers housing wealthy elves and goblins—and the white-collar crimes they commit.
DelDedria – A gritty, dangerous zone home to orcs and humans, where gang violence and illegal deals run rampant.
Colezaria – An industrial wasteland policed with grit, where orc laborers and criminal rings clash in the factories.
Gameplay & Features:
🛡️ Tier-Based Crime Response
Tier 1 (Low-Risk): Chase down fleeing suspects such as graffiti artists, write parking tickets, and detain petty criminals using handcuffs.
Tier 2 (Medium-Risk): Use your trusty baton to break up street fights, control vandalism, and disarm and detain drug dealers.
Tier 3 (High-Risk): Gear up with a pistol and deploy a futuristic shield to face magical shootouts, bomb threats, and organized bank robberies.
🎖️ Level Up Your Officer
Earn XP and credits by resolving crimes correctly—non-lethal takedowns and appropriate force earn bigger rewards. Level up to take on more dangerous assignments, access higher crime tiers, and unlock perks and cosmetics.
🚓 Customize Your Loadout
Spend your hard-earned credits on:
Weapon camos for your pistol and baton
New police vehicles including high-speed cars and bikes
company: Luke Del Deo, Tyler Coletti, Keith Morgan,

title: Get In Timelessness
description:
게임 정보
Get In Timelessness — is a psychological horror game about hidden nightmares that can only be seen by accident. The story that unfolds here tells about a man and his fate to face the unthinkable, to go through horror, to sink to the very bottom of the impossible.

title: ARROW-ButtonHeart
description:
게임 정보
ARROW - Button Heart is a 2D pixel art game that combines platforming, puzzle-solving, and action-adventure elements, focusing on mechanism operation, arrow-shooting puzzles, and skill challenges. Players must use observation and reflexes to solve puzzles and overcome various obstacles in rooms filled with intricate devices.
Puzzle Mechanisms
Each room features unique mechanisms with various buttons scattered on the walls. Different colored buttons have different activation methods—some can be triggered by arrows, while others require environmental interaction. Correctly operating multiple buttons is necessary to open the door to the next room.
Precision Archery
Your bow and arrows are your main tools, used to shoot specific buttons or activate distant mechanisms. Your shooting skills directly affect your puzzle-solving efficiency and how you clear each room.
Continuous Challenges
The game includes time-limited mechanism challenges, multi-step button combinations requiring consecutive actions, and parkour elements that demand precise jumping skills—providing intense tests of reflexes and thinking.
Hostile Elements
Some rooms contain enemies that disrupt your operations. You need to stay agile and find a balance between puzzle-solving and combat.
Features:
2D pixel art platform style
Combination of platforming, archery, and mechanism puzzle gameplay
Diverse button types and unique mechanism designs
Time-limited challenges and multi-step operation mechanics
Single-player experience with a third-person perspective
Perfect for players who enjoy puzzles, skill challenges, and parkour
Every arrow shot tests your precision and intelligence. Solve the mechanisms, master the rhythm, and conquer every meticulously designed challenge room.

title: Whispers of Kelsden
description:
게임 정보
Step into the world of Andrew Bell, a private investigator with his deceased wife still on his mind in the fictional city of Kelsden where he's trying to keep it going.
In this subtly narrative driven game, you'll solve five standalone cases. Each case unfolds in a linear, and/or puzzle oriented format, with the outcomes relying on your decisions. Get lucky, get unlucky, manage your time, hack, find shortcuts, investigate findings, play mini games, assess the environment, follow your thoughts, and get to the result of your choice by using different methods and right tools in each case. While the path is guided, the outcome is still in your hands.
Features:
Five handcrafted detective cases, Each one offering its own standalone mystery.
Puzzle driven investigations in a linear style, Logic and curiosity are your best tools.
Time and choices matter, Your actions shape how things unfold.
Less UI, more immersion, No clutter, just you and the case.
A focused experience rather than sandbox. Not a sandbox, but a compact and thoughtful journey.

title: Hobby Horse: First Ride
description:
게임 정보
완전 무료로 취미 승마 모험을 시작하세요! 나만의 말을 만들고 첫 장애물 코스에서 실력을 시험해 보세요. 첫 트로피를 획득하고, 기술을 연마하며, 이 특별한 훈련의 분위기를 느껴보세요!
DIY로 시작하세요!
마구간이나 실제 말은 필요 없습니다. 상상력과 공간만 있으면 됩니다! First Ride에서는 나만의 첫 취미 말을 디자인하고 엄선된 코스에서 훈련을 시작할 수 있습니다. 직접 만든 말이 얼마나 큰 기쁨을 선사하는지 직접 경험해 보세요!

첫 번째 장애물, 첫 번째 성공!
말을 타고 체육관부터 숲길까지, 기본 장애물 코스를 탐험해 보세요. 실력을 시험하고, 새로운 기술을 익히고, 첫 번째 업적을 달성해 보세요. 지도를 열고 달리고 싶은 코스를 선택하세요!

라이딩 중에는 아무리 어려운 장애물도 극복하는 데 도움이 되는 다양한 부스터를 발견할 수 있습니다. 기본 파워를 시험해 보고 말과 함께 얼마나 멀리 갈 수 있는지 확인해 보세요!

첫 취미 말의 색상과 모양을 직접 선택하세요! 무료 버전에서는 트랙에서 돋보일 수 있도록 기본적인 맞춤 설정 옵션을 제공합니다.

Hobby Horse: First Ride는 취미 말 타기의 분위기를 느끼고 싶은 모든 사람에게 완벽한 시작입니다. 지금 바로 모험을 시작하고 직접 만든 말을 타고 장애물을 뛰어넘는 재미를 경험해 보세요!

title: The Hovaria
description:
게임 정보
Ready to defy gravity on a neon-lit hoverboard track suspended in space?
Play up to 4 players and race against your friends while you trying to  control a physics-based hoverboard. The Hovaria is challenging you to master speed, balance, and precision. Every turn is sharp, and every mistake might send you flying into the void.
You're not just racing—you're adapting.
Each track is built inside a massive cyberpunk-style space station, full of glowing lights, sudden drops, and deadly curves. With no rails to hold you and no second chances, every race becomes a test of instinct and control.
Key Features
Physics-driven hoverboard mechanics – Feel the weight, momentum, and impact of every movement.
1–4 player online races – Go head-to-head with friends or other players in tight, skill-based matches.
Stylish cyberpunk environments – Race through glowing tunnels and anti-grav drops in a visually striking space station.
No safety nets – One wrong move and you’re off the track. Stay sharp, ride hard.

title: Echo Protocol: Escape Room
description:
게임 정보
You wake up in an unknown but familiar facility. Can you find out how you got there and get out?

Echo Protocol is an escape room that will test your skills. Solve puzzles, decode secret codes and investigate the different rooms of this acilities. Help Hamilton find out what is going on.

Solve this mystery by exploring the rooms of this sci fi facilities. Will you manage to escape?
Features
Solve puzzles based on logic, observation and pattern identification.
Explore different rooms to find clues.
Discover how and why you are there.
Enjoy the mysterious and atmospheric environment we have created for you.

title: Rust Rides
description:
게임 정보
오래된 타브리아의 운전대를 잡고 우크라이나의 생존 도로에서 끝없는 모험을 시작하세요.
러스트 라이드에서는 줄거리 제한이 없는 현실적인 생존 시뮬레이터로, 플레이어의 결정에 따라 세계가 만들어집니다. 여러분은 자신의 자동차와 약간의 휘발유, 거래 능력 등 거의 아무것도 없이 시작합니다. 도로에는 무한한 가능성이 열려 있습니다. 고철, 견과류, 깃털 또는 자동차를 일반 NPC와 거래하여 성공으로 가는 길을 닦을 수 있습니다. 모든 킬로미터는 새로운 스토리를 위한 기회이며, 모든 주유소는 생존을 위한 기회입니다.
소박한 타브리아부터 희귀한 레트로 모델까지 우크라이나 자동차 산업의 자동차를 수집하고 업그레이드하세요. 저렴한 예비 부품을 구입하고 오래된 자동차의 힘과 스타일을 업그레이드하여 수익성 있는 비즈니스로 전환하세요. 업그레이드는 기술뿐만 아니라 캐릭터의 운전, 수리, 생존 기술도 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 판잣집에서 편안한 거처로 집을 확장하세요. 새벽마다 새로운 도전이 찾아오고 조용한 시골길부터 시끄러운 경매장까지 우크라이나의 무한한 세계가 열립니다.
게임 특징:
우크라이나 자동차 산업 모델을 포함한 자동차 수집 및 개조.
일반 NPC(철 금속, 깃털, 견과류, 자동차 등)로부터 상품을 구매 및 재판매하여 돈을 벌 수 있습니다.
고철, 자동차 대리점, 경매장, 확장 가능한 플레이어의 집 등 주요 장소가 있는 스토리 라인이 없는 오픈 월드입니다.
장비 및 캐릭터 업그레이드(다양한 생존, 제작, 운전 기술).
개발과 모험을 위한 무한한 잠재력을 지닌 진정한 샌드박스입니다.

title: Odyssey RPG
description:
게임 정보
ODYSSEY RPG
Step into the sandals of a wandering hero in Odyssey RPG, a classic-style JRPG that brings the epic of Homer to life like never before!
🌍 Explore a Mythical World
From the burning shores of Troy to the eerie songs of the Sirens, each destination is steeped in danger, mystery, and legend. Sail across the seas, battle ancient beasts, and test your resolve against the gods themselves.
🗺️ Your Journey Awaits
Defeat the Trojans
Survive the brutal ambushes of the Cicones
Escape the dreamlike fog of the Land of the Lotus Eaters
Outsmart the monstrous Cyclops on his cursed island
Brave the dark secrets of the Underworld
Endure the bewitching charms of Circe and Calypso
Face down the fury of Scylla and the whirlpool Charybdis
Return home through storm, betrayal, and divine wrath to reach Ithaca
⚔️ Turn-Based Combat – Classic JRPG battles with strategic depth. Customize your party with mythic gear, ancient magic, and heroic skills.
🏛️ Made with Passion in RPG Maker – Indie-crafted with love, pixel art, and countless drachma of dedication.
🛡️ Odyssey RPG is more than a game – it's a journey home. Will you find your way back, or be lost to myth forever?
⚓ Begin your voyage today. The gods are watching.

Recommended route and levels:
Troy - LVL 1
Cicones - LVL 5
Land of Lotus Eaters - LVL 10
Cyclops Island - LVL 15
Aeolus Island - LVL 20

title: My Money Grows On Trees
description:
게임 정보
Ever wondered what it'd be like if money grew on trees? 💸🌳
An incremental clicker farming game about growing your own farm full of money trees!
Click. Water. Grow. Harvest. Explore. Upgrade. Profit.
Over 40+ trees to grow, start small and expand to a sprawling money tree farm.
Click to harvest money from trees (because everybody knows that money does indeed grow on trees)
Expand your garden by building new crop plots and trees
Explore to find chests and gold bars to unlock new and bigger trees
Water your crops for faster growth or wait for time to grow
Upgrade your tools and equipment to farm and explore even faster
Build greenhouses and watering systems to speed up growth
Tree rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary, Mythical, Divine, Unbelievable

title: Tanks 3D
description:
게임 정보
Play against up to 1,000 other real players concurrently clashing as tanks as part of a giant army, on a massive, fully destructible battlefield.
Features:
Play as a highly maneuverable battle Tank in first or third person, with controls similar to a standard FPS.
Play on servers up to 1000 players concurrently on giant maps with destructible terrain,

title: The Undying Sea
description:
게임 정보
The Undying Sea is a first-person exploration title about dealing with death, exploring a city in decline, and reaching out a hand to those who need it.
A few years prior, an eccentric scientist claimed to discover the key to immortality. He invites a city full of artists, scientists, and engineers to join him on a remote man-made isle in the Atlantic to reap the benefits of eternal life.

title: Zaxtron EXPLUS
description:
게임 정보
Get ready for a high-octane, old-school styled shoot ’em up (SHMUP) that pushes your reflexes and strategy to the breaking point. Designed in the spirit of 1980s arcade classics, it’s not for the faint of heart.
Dive into five brutally challenging levels, arm yourself with 28 deadly weapons, and uncover a web of hidden secrets and bonus stages. Every run demands precision, pattern-reading and nerves of steel.
  Five Brutal Levels
Progress through uniquely themed stages, each ramping up the difficulty and crowding the screen with relentless enemy waves.
 28 Distinct Weapons
From rapid-fire blasters to devastating lasers—mix and upgrade your loadout to suit any situation.
 Hidden Secrets & Bonus Paths
Explore every nook and cranny to unlock secret areas, challenge rooms and alternate endings.
 Authentic 1980s Aesthetic
Pixel-perfect visuals, CRT filter and sprite-based explosions evoke the golden era of arcade shooters.

title: Junkyard Universe
description:
게임 정보
Junkyard Universe is a 2D Galaxy Cleaner - Cleaning Up the Universe Has Never Been More Fun.
Dissolve space trash into nothing and make space travelling saver for everyone!
Rebel agains the system by installing a repair upgrade to repair things instead of just dissolving them. Let the results of using the repair particles suprise you.
Use Upgrades and game mechanics skillfully to collect enough dissolve points for your very own junk eraser ship, before the dissolve year is over and your points are reset to 0.
Follow pilot Meredith on her search for her lost mother Elaina. Build a relationship with Junk Eraser Ship 3LS4, the ship that returned without Elaina. Decide which rebels you want to trust - and what you want to do with your junk eraser ship once it belongs to you.

title: Flowerdrops
description:
게임 정보
GROW
Sunrise. It’s time to grow a garden of your own.

As a newly formed cloud, venture out into a lost world filled with strange landscapes to fulfil your singular purpose: blooming flowers. Flowerdrops is a meditative puzzle game with a focus on satisfying physics-based gameplay and strong level variety where you use bouncy raindrops to water flowers. Use the power of your droplets to ricochet off of walls, navigate through obstructions, and ultimately grow as many flowers as you can - turn by turn, stage by stage, drop by drop. An ever expanding suite of environmental hazards and bizarre obstacles means you must plan each shot carefully and make every drop count. Nowhere is too remote, too dangerous, or too absurd for you to grow your flowering friends.
TEND
The world of Flowerdrops is vast and diverse. It is a place that’s often unkind to your droplets and flowers, yet underscored by a serene and self-reflective charm. It is melancholic, playful, and treacherous. Flowerdrops is a meditative experience with a deliberate and relaxing pace, even as it gets trickier. For every new discovery, and with each new complication, new sides of this world’s beauty are revealed. Your curiosity is rewarded. Your playfulness reciprocated.
With this goal in mind, Flowerdrops includes a host of features to help ensure that regardless of your personal skill level or past experience with games, you can find the balance that works best for you:
Explore Your Garden: There are many paths through the world of Flowerdrops, and the further you go, the more choices you will have at once. Not feeling a particular level or area? Come back to it later. There’s more than one way to grow this garden.
Time Is Yours: Even at its most challenging, Flowerdrops gives you all the time in the world to survey each level and plan accordingly. The game moves as quickly as you do.
Player-Driven Difficulty: Flowerdrops does not gate-keep progress behind barriers of difficulty. Avoid or skip levels you’re not interested in, retry as many times as you’d like, and don’t fret about growing every last flower you come across. If your goal is to relax, then relax without judgement. There’s no wrong way to play Flowerdrops.
Dialing it In: Seeking a greater challenge? There’s plenty to push your puzzle-solving skills further. Bloom every flower, complete every stage, or uncover unique challenges in the remote corners of the world. Now do it all again in even fewer turns this time. You decide when the challenge is right, and Flowerdrops will meet you at your level.

title: When eyes close
description:
게임 정보
"When Eyes Close" is a collection of standalone psychological stories. Choose a protagonist whose fate you wish to experience and dive into the nightmare of sleep paralysis, where an unseen force binds your body, and the demon at your bedside offers a deal.
Your goal is to awaken. But the path to it lies through a labyrinth of rooms, filled with fragmented memories that might belong to your hero... or to someone else.
Explore. Delve into the details. Every object, every note could be a key.
Remember. Piece together the story and appearance of your protagonist. Who are they? What did they do? Or what was done to them?
Guess. Find the one true bed among a sequence of random rooms that is yours. It is your only chance to break free.
Every story is a separate life, but not every ending is an awakening. And even if it is, was it worth waking up?

title: The Last Bell
description:
게임 정보
The Last Bell
Death is Not the End.
Trapped in a cursed, abandoned school where discipline takes a horrifying turn, four Students must outsmart a merciless Hunter in a heart-pounding game of survival. Choose your side and immerse yourself in this chilling asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience.
Students play in third-person for heightened situational awareness, while the Hunter adopts a first-person view, relentlessly tracking their prey.
Each game is a race against time, as the Students strive to unlock the escape door while the Hunter uses their arsenal of abilities to stop them. No two matches are ever the same in this procedurally generated environment of terror and strategy.
Key Features
• Outsmart or Be Caught – Students must work together—or act selfishly—to survive. Will you risk saving your teammates or focus solely on your own escape? The choice is yours, but the Hunter is always watching.
• A School of Horrors – Explore a procedurally generated map filled with eerie classrooms, haunting corridors, and discipline chairs that may seal your fate. Each playthrough feels fresh, unpredictable, and terrifying.
• The Hunter's Pursuit – Step into the shoes of a terrifying Hunter. Wield unique powers like tracking blood trails and exploiting sound cues. Discipline your victims with precision and unleash your finishing moves to assert dominance.
• Progress and Customize – Both Hunters and Students have deep progression systems. Unlock perks, upgrades, and cosmetic options to suit your playstyle and stand out in the nightmare.
• Atmosphere of Fear – Immerse yourself in a world of tension with dynamic lighting, haunting music, and unsettling sound effects that make each moment pulse with dread.
---
Warning: Photosensitivity/Epilepsy Seizures – A very small percentage of individuals may experience seizures or other discomfort when exposed to certain visual patterns or flashing lights. Please play responsibly and consult a physician if you have any concerns.
Do you have what it takes to escape, or will you be claimed by the curse? The bell tolls for you.

title: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
description:
게임 정보
스토리
주인공은 백화점 의류 매장에서 상품 교체를 돕는 임시 아르바이트를 하게 된다.
일하는 도중, 새로운 옷을 입어보라는 요청을 받는다.
그러나 탈의실에서 나오자, 매장은 기묘하고 불길한 광경으로 변해 있다…
무사히 탈출할 수 있을까?
핵심 게임 메커니즘
숨기: 적이 등장하는 지역에는 숨을 수 있는 장소가 있다. 숨어서 적을 피할 수 있다.
아이템: 게임을 진행하거나 클리어하는 데 필요한 아이템을 획득하고 사용할 수 있다.
선택지: 탐색 중에 발견한 아이템이나 이벤트에 따라 선택지가 제시될 수 있다.
정신력 게이지: 무서운 사건을 마주하면 정신력 게이지가 감소한다. 0이 되면 게임 오버가 된다.
게임 개요
스텔스 호러 게임: 초자연적 현상에 반응하여 "도망치고 숨는" 플레이 스타일
멀티 엔딩: 선택에 따라 엔딩이 달라진다
간단한 조작: 키보드와 마우스로 플레이 가능
스트리밍 및 게임 플레이 영상에 대해
게임 플레이 영상 사용은 다음과 같은 형태를 환영합니다: 소개 영상, 플레이 영상, 생방송 스트리밍
영상 설명란에 [게임 제목]과 Steam 스토어 페이지 링크를 포함해 주시면 개발자로서 큰 힘이 됩니다.
autokwd: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds,마네킹: 그들의 마음의 메아리

title: Air Hockey Roguelike
description:
게임 정보
It's a roguelike air hockey game where you must win matches to increase your stats, earn money by completing challenges, and purchase items in the store. You'll choose between two different types: passive and active, which you'll have to activate at the right time. Immerse yourself in the world of air hockey and defeat all the bosses without losing... or you'll have to start over.

title: BeatBucs
description:
게임 정보
Ahoy, Rhythm Buccaneer!
Set sail on a beat-blasting pirate quest where every boss fight is a full-blown musical number.
Each attack hits on the rhythm — learn the beat, dodge the pattern.
Master simple controls: move left and right, or up and down. That’s it.
From dancing crabs to penguin DJs — each choreographed to an original soundtrack.
Chart your course through pirate-infested worlds to rescue your kidnapped cat, one groovy showdown at a time.

title: Block Basher 3D
description:
게임 정보
Block Basher 3D는 현대적인 3D 환경에서 설정된 미니멀한 싱글플레이어 벽돌 깨기 게임입니다. 아르카노이드와 같은 클래식에서 영감을 받아, 간단한 공 튕기기 게임플레이를 세련되고 깔끔한 블록 기반 세계로 불필요한 장식 없이 가져왔습니다.
다양한 파워업을 사용하여 점점 어려워지는 블록 형태를 뚫고 나아가세요: 관통하는 공, 레이저 사격, 더 큰 패들 등. 세 가지 다른 카메라 각도 중에서 선택하세요—클래식한 탑다운, 각진 3인칭 시점, 또는 패들 완전히 뒤쪽 관점—매번 플레이할 때마다 신선한 경험을 제공합니다.
프로토타입 같은 게임 스토리도, 진행 시스템도, 리더보드도 없습니다—아직은. 이것은 부차적인 프로젝트였으며, 완전한 게임이 되도록 의도된 것이 아니었습니다. 하지만 물을 테스트하기 위해, 피드백을 수집하고 관심을 측정하기 위해 출시되었습니다. 충분한 사람들이 즐긴다면, 훨씬 더 큰 후속 게임이 계획되어 있습니다.
그럼 함정은 무엇일까요? 속편은 이 게임을 소유한 모든 사람에게 무료로 제공될 예정이며 다음을 포함할 것으로 예상됩니다:
완전한 3D 플레이필드, 블록이 평면에 제한되지 않음—일부는 떠다니고, 벽 주위를 감싸거나, 패들 위에 매달릴 것입니다.
캠페인, 무한, 협동, 멀티플레이어와 같은 새로운 게임 모드.
확장된 블록 타입, 물리 기반 상호작용, 리더보드 등.
아케이드 스타일 게임에서 이전에 볼 수 없었던 몰입형 스토리 경험.
주요 특징
클래식 게임플레이, 3D 세계 — 미니멀한 현대적 설정에서의 블록 깨기 변형.
전환 가능한 뷰 — 탑다운, 각진, 또는 패들 바로 뒤에서 플레이.
파워업 — 관통하는 공, 패들 확장기, 레이저 사격을 사용하여 우위를 점하기.
블록 다양성 — 표준 벽돌 (1-6 타격)과 근처 타일에 피해를 주는 폭발 블록.
그라인딩 없음 — 뛰어들어 부수기. 증가하는 난이도로 빠르고 집중된 게임플레이.
70개의 도전적인 레벨 — 점점 복잡해지는 블록 형태를 통해 기술을 테스트.
Steam 업적 — 게임 메카닉을 마스터하고 레벨을 클리어하면서 업적 잠금해제.
*속편/확장 버전의 공식 발표 이전에 이 게임을 구매한 모든 플레이어는 그러한 타이틀의 개발이 진행되는 한 추가 비용 없이 해당 미래 타이틀을 받게 됩니다. 이 제안은 충분한 커뮤니티 지원과 더 큰 프로젝트를 진행하려는 우리의 결정에 달려 있습니다.

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, unfolding through tense silence and detailed sound design that builds a growing sense of unease. Inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete: 200 minutes
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: Eden: Discovery
description:
게임 정보
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
Key Features:
• High-Stakes Extraction
Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.
• In-Game Currency & Tournaments
Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.
• Social Spaces
Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.
• Future Creative Mode
Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.
• Multiple Paths to Victory
Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.
EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.
• Marketplace & Player Economy
Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.
• PvPvE Gameplay
Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

title: Saratoga
description:
게임 정보
Saratoga is a solo or two-person turn-based strategy wargame that is Volume I in the Great Battles of the American Revolution wargame series created by designer Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games. The game focuses on the Battle of Saratoga on September 19, 1777 which proved to be the turning point of the American Revolution.
Players can battle human opponents online or play against the game's AI. There are three scenarios that offer opportunities to explore alternate histories, including a British counterattack on the next day.
Saratoga features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. Players alternate their turns with the first player being determined either by the scenario or randomly.  During their turn a player will conduct maneuver for their units and then engage in combat using units with capabilities based on the historical record.  Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, the ability of nearby leaders and the characteristics of the units in the combat.
Saratoga is Volume I of the enormously popular Great Battles of the American Revolution series designed by Mark Miklos and published by GMT Games.
Each side has an historically accurate order of battle that encourages the player to attempt to outdo the generals of history. Saratoga has scenarios that simulate "what-if" situations as well.  What if the British had counter-attacked the next day? What if Benedict Arnold had gotten his way and been free to attack?

title: Planet Hoarders
description:
게임 정보
You are a replicant engineered by the Corporation for a single purpose: gather valuable bio-species from abandoned facilities across various planets.

Alone or with up to three teammates, you'll land on planet surfaces to explore and locate facility entrances. Inside, navigate dark, procedurally generated networks of rooms and tunnels to collect small creatures you can carry—but beware of monsters that aim to end you. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are essential to evade or confront these threats.

With limited time on each planet, you must act swiftly to meet your KPIs.
Use in-game radio communication to share information and coordinate actions to access restricted areas.

Finally, uncover the unsettling truth behind your mission.

title: Strider Arena
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for drop in Strider Arena, a mobility mech arena shooter for you and some friends to duke it out. Last team standing wins, so kit out your strider and make sure the only team left is yours! Equip up to 4 unique weapons at a time for adaptability and solid performance in any situation, or go all in with 4 Lasers and melt yourself to slag seconds after vaporizing all your friends. Harass opponents from a distance with railguns, or rush them down with shotguns and grappling hooks. Play it safe with low risk weapons, or bet your life on one hugely damaging shot with the ion projector. Weapons in Strider Arena are designed to encourage a wide variety of playstyles, keeping gameplay fresh, and your enemies guessing. If 4 weapon slots wasn't enough customization, chassis mods may be the final piece you need to cement your build. Chassis mods are doled out between rounds and affect the core stats of your strider, often having both upsides and downsides. Choose the right chassis mod with the right weapons, and you'll truly be a force to be reckoned with in the arena.

title: The ULTIMATE Banana Game
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wanted to make your own idler game? Running a crowdfunding campaign and earning millions to make your dream come true? Would you like to know what hardships await a beginner developer? Then The ULTIMATE Banana Game is for you!
make your own game and gain new players
promote and advertise to climb in the ranks, aiming for #1
work with marketing specialists and influencers
run crowdfunding and develop a successful social media account
and much much more!

title: Slice & Dice: Pizza Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보

마리오 미트볼은 항상 최고의 피자 가게를 만들고 싶어했고, 이제 예산에 맞는 곳을 찾았고, 그의 꿈이 현실이 되었습니다. 하지만 부동산이 그렇게 싸게 팔린 데에는 이유가 있습니다...

title: WuttWorld
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Wutt World! A competitive multiplayer platform where simply being the fastest, isn't enough!
Collect bonuses, PLACE hazards, SURVIVE hazards, EARN hazards, place MORE hazards, outsmart your competition and impress the gods of this mysterious world and prove yourself.
Tons of hidden secrets to achieve and unlock. Stand out; be unique; showcase yourself and do it in style.

title: Malón
description:
게임 정보
In this minimalist strategy game you'll take command of an army fort, tasked with defending it at all costs. To succeed, you'll need to expand your base and train soldiers to stand by your side in defense of the flag.
Animals will be a highly valuable resource, enabling you to grow your economy and expand further.
You’ll also have the option to choose the opposing side, establishing your own indigenous settlement and becoming the leader of your people, guiding them in resistance against the huinca invasion.

title: Swingin'!
description:
게임 정보
Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement. Swingin-kun can't generate speed by himself, so be careful not to waste the speed you gain from falling! You can bounce off the floor, stick to walls, alternate between your two arms to attach yourself to the ceiling and move sideways– with some creativity, you can do all kinds of things! Furthermore, Swingin’! includes a level editor so that you can create and share your own custom stages!

title: Shadow Eagle
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Eagle is a secret organization for peace. It is said that it dates back to the Seljuk Empire and perhaps even before that. Recently, they have been fighting for justice all around the globe.
In a recent robbery that took place in one of London's museums, only the portrait of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror was stolen. Deniz sets out to Dublin to meet with the person who was examining and researching the painting before the robbery. While waiting in a pub for the meeting he learns that there will be an attack on the Limon Company data center.
Deniz and his connection Orla make a plan to stop this attack.
However this is just the beginning. What is the purpose of this attack? Why are they going to Türkiye, all of a sudden? Shadow Eagle faces an international criminal organization.

title: Wizard Hand
description:
게임 정보
Wizard Hand is a magical solitaire roguelike about accumulating the maximum number of magical points by mastering the art of combining enchanted cards, transformations, and a collection of magical items.
The goal of the game is to remove the entire pyramid of cards from the table, while scoring the maximum points. Play a matching card onto the pyramid card to start a combo! The more points you have, the more opportunities you have to expand your magical arsenal and be ready for future challenges!

title: Vorozhey
description:
게임 정보
In recent months, an eerie stillness has fallen over the city. Women are vanishing without a trace, only to be found later in the forest — heartless, marked with a burned noose on their bodies. The police are helpless, and the locals dare not speak of it aloud.
You are an artist, once inspired, now cursed. Your dreams have turned into vivid nightmares, visions of things that shouldn’t exist… or perhaps already have. Ancient forces whisper through your mind, growing stronger, closer — as if something is trying to break through, using you as its vessel.
Where does reality end and madness begin? Can you uncover the truth behind the victims before losing yourself? Or are you just a brush in the hand of darkness?
Vorozhey is shrouded in an atmosphere of ominous silence, where reality dissolves into ancient myths and personal nightmares. The creaking floorboards, whispers from the dark, and haunting visions make you question your own sanity.
Psychological horror
Slavic mythology
Uncover the mystery of the city

title: Prop Haunters
description:
게임 정보
Prop Haunters is a fun and fast-paced multiplayer party game where sneaky props and sharp hunters collide in a whimsical, action-packed showdown! Dive into a vibrant world filled with adorable environments, where you can play as a variety of quirky props trying to outwit a team of determined hunters.
As a prop, disguise yourself as everyday objects, blend into the surroundings, and evade detection with clever tactics and quick reflexes. But watch out—Runes give you the chance to fight back! Use special abilities like a flashbang to stun hunters, a speed boost to make a quick escape, or temporary invisibility to hide from sight. Runestones scattered across the map let you power up and take the hunt into your own hands!
As a hunter, your job is to track down those mischievous props before time runs out, using your wits and a keen eye to spot the hidden objects. But don’t get too comfortable—Runes also give hunters a boost based on their play style, such as increased speed for agile hunters or enhanced vision to spot props more easily.
With a focus on teamwork, strategy, and laughs, Prop Haunt brings hours of fun for friends and family alike. Whether you’re hiding or seeking, no two rounds are the same—every game is a new opportunity for chaos and hilarity. So, grab your friends, choose your side, and get ready for the ultimate game of hide and seek in the cutest way possible!
Key Features:
Cute, vibrant graphics that make every round a visual delight.
Multiplayer madness for up to 16 players.
A variety of props to play as, from chairs to teacups, each with its own quirky advantages.
Runes with unique powers, like flashbangs, speed boosts, and temporary invisibility, adding a new layer of strategy to each round.
Boosts for hunters tailored to their play style, helping them track down props with special abilities.
Dynamic environments full of unique hiding spots and surprises.
Fast-paced gameplay that's easy to pick up but hard to master.
Are you ready to haunt the props or hunt the haunters? The power is in your hands!

title: Slime Attack: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
🐾 유니크한 영웅 및 펫 잠금 해제 🐾
퀘스트를 완료하여 각기 다른 플레이 스타일을 가진 강력한 영웅과 함께 싸우는 충실한 펫을 잠금 해제하세요.
⚔ ◆ 6가지의 독특한 무기 타입을 마스터하고 그 이상 ◆ ⚔
중장비: 충격파로 적을 처치하세요.
활: 멀리서 적을 저격하거나 강력한 화살을 발사하세요.
쌍검: 빠른 칼날로 공격적인 전투를 펼치세요.
검과 방패: 공격과 방어의 균형을 맞추세요.
유틸리티 스태프: AoE 피해, 적 제어 및 버프.
소환 스태프: 전투를 돕는 크리처를 소환하세요.

title: Code Quest
description:
게임 정보
Fix the world. Learn to code. Uncover the truth.
In Code Quest, you step into the role of a mysterious character tasked with restoring order to a broken digital world. Journey through diverse locations – from enchanted forests and futuristic cities to a cosmic space station and the heart of a computer itself – solving increasingly complex programming puzzles along the way.
With a unique Scratch-like programming interface, you'll learn fundamental coding concepts such as:
Building sequences of instructions
Loops and logical conditions
Managing variables and data flow
Optimizing algorithms
Every level presents a new challenge that requires creativity and problem-solving skills. As you fix the world, you'll watch it transform before your eyes, uncovering hidden secrets and mastering the art of programming.

Key Features:
Learn through play: No coding experience required!
Scratch-like interface: Intuitive tools to build and test your code step by step.
Diverse worlds: Explore forests, cities, space stations, and the inner workings of a computer.
Engaging story: Discover the mysteries of the broken world and your role within it.
Progressive challenges: Puzzles that grow in complexity as you advance, introducing new programming concepts.

Code Quest is perfect for everyone – from beginners eager to learn the basics of coding to experienced players looking for a unique challenge. Can you repair the digital world and uncover the truth behind its fractured surface?
Add Code Quest to your wishlist today and begin your journey into the world of coding!

title: MEDIX
description:
게임 정보
How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

In MEDIX, you and the Medical Unit IX of the Imperial Army face a formidable challenge. In a story-driven campaign, you'll embark on a journey that will test your speed, wits, and endurance.

Rescue the wounded from the battlefield, gather supplies to care for them, and build infrastructure. Cleverly distribute your personnel between buildings, and when necessary, pack up your structures and use the recycled materials to build new ones or move the entire camp to a different location. In the heat of battle, you must constantly adapt to the dynamically changing situation.

The people you help, and their loved ones, will gladly support your efforts to upgrade your unit or expand your ranks out of gratitude.

War is both terrible and magnificent, and the characters in our story experience its horrors firsthand. Hand-drawn illustrations accompany an emotional narrative about the effort to save as many lives as possible, while also striving to retain one's humanity and hope.

title: Nevrosa: Rescape
description:
게임 정보
Nevrosa 2025 is a meticulously crafted VR puzzle/escape room game where players must solve numerous puzzles, battle mysterious creatures, and uncover a new Misty World hidden beyond the mirror in a grandfather's laboratory.

Adorable Miners: Meet a lovable cast of characters known as Rocklings, each with unique look and irresistible charm. Watch them come to life as they embark on their mining adventure!

You play against other players in either a relaxed Arena with no timers or an intense real-time Versus mode with up to 8 players. In both cases, you will need to come up with strategies and counter-strategies to win!

As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori.

Change Your Reality
Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself.
Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits.
Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles!

title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
description:
게임 정보
The game includes over 50 different types of growth skills that players can obtain, with over two hundred thousand words of game plot and character dialogues. In addition to over 50 sets of different types of equipment that players can obtain, scattered throughout the universe are several sets of ancient artifacts recording ancient secrets waiting for players to acquire and unlock. One hundred different effects of Fate Seals allow players to gain the blessings of destiny in intense battles...

The story takes place in a remote star domain we call Havendia, where the powers of elements such as gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, and thunder are the source of all energy. There are a total of eight major races here, and the peace that has been maintained for nearly a thousand years seems to have come to an end...
Exciting and Unique 3D Combat Visual Experience

We place great importance on depicting the combat process, drawing inspiration from various literary and artistic works to make "Peerless Destiny" stand out!
Featuring an innovative 3D spatial combat system, battles can extend from the ground to the sky, with unique camera effects presenting grand scenes of a fantastical world. Engage in battles as seen in novels and animations, where you can perform extraordinary feats like soaring through the air and unleashing incredible powers!
Fundamental Combat System

Blocking, dodging, parrying—inspired by the core elements of Souls-like games, we have made modifications to these mechanics. We offer various difficulty modes to cater to a broader range of players. Even against formidable bosses, players can engage in intense back-and-forth battles!
Satisfying Combo System

By interacting precisely with the keys, players can trigger combos and lengthen their duration. A well-executed combo can potentially turn the tide of a battle in an instant!
Environment Interaction Enhances Realism in Combat

Your skills not only serve as weapons to damage enemies but also have environmental impacts, capable of causing destruction in various settings—whether small villages or large cities, you have the power to wreak havoc. If you enjoy, hmm, demolition work, this could be a great choice!

Both NPCs and monsters intelligently respond to attacks by dodging, fleeing, blocking, counterattacking, and more. They offer real-time voice responses expressing disdain, fear, and other emotions towards you. In this world, each creature reacts differently based on its unique personality! Voice conversations between you and characters make the game livelier, ensuring you don't feel like a lonely warrior. Additionally, precise collision detection between creatures and the environment allows interactions such as kicking rocks on the ground or sending enemies flying through impact!

In addition to the normal "Story Mode", there are two modes to choose from: "Revisiting Old Dreams" and "Trial of Heaven"
"Revisiting Old Dreams" mode, you are randomly teleported to a previously defeated boss and immediately engage in battle. Hone your combat skills and earn additional rewards.
"Trial of Heaven" mode, also known as the "Heavenly Trial Grounds", you will face several replicated boss entities! This place is unstable. Anomalies can occur at any time! For example, encountering temporal disturbances that cause fluctuations in the flow of time, or facing imbalances in gravity, and even adverse environments that disrupt the minds of creatures.
Sustaining the "Heavenly Trial Grounds" requires a significant amount of energy, with the activity area continuously shrinking to reduce consumption. So, please eliminate your targets quickly; otherwise, you will have to face a siege by all bosses without any escape routes.
Of course, if you perform well in the trial, you can obtain not just more experience, equipment, and treasures but also Destiny Marks with random effects.

Customize your own exclusive skills and character growth path. Both skills and characters are capable of growth. The choice between specialization or a comprehensive development path is entirely up to you. The unique Thunder Tribulation system requires characters to undergo a Thunder Tribulation test with each growth, giving you a greater sense of ceremony, mission, and achievement!

We offer various ways to earn Lucky Points, which can be used to draw Destiny Marks. These marks provide different types of destiny-enhancing effects, such as invincibility aura or time dilation. This system combines elements of metaphysical concepts like the I Ching and Bagua!

Wielding the sacred artifact of heaven and earth, you guide the cycle of destiny! By unlocking celestial artifacts, you empower yourself with mysterious and endless strength, commanding unknown miracles within the cosmos!

The Celestial Stele leaderboard comprises four types of rankings. You can compete with players globally, showcase your achievements among friends, or contribute to regional competitions! The Celestial Stele was originally a heaven-defying divine object, stealing a glimpse of celestial secrets to create these leaderboards!

Embark on an incredible gaming journey with "Peerless Destiny"! Immerse yourself in a whole new gaming experience, merging captivating storytelling with interactive gameplay.

Discover a narrative fusion of novels, anime, and immersive gameplay. Experience the rebirth of a near-fallen protagonist, whose newfound strength uncovers deeper secrets of this world.

Engage in breathtaking 3D combat offering free-flight, earth-shattering battles. Destroy environments, from forests to entire villages, showcasing the true power of your character. Brace yourself for intense battles that surpass conventional limits.

Traverse a fantastical landscape filled with richly detailed environments. Witness the aftermath of destructive battles, leaving shattered vistas and scattered remnants. Indulge in the realism and engage in strategic gameplay.

Ascend to new heights through electrifying trials after accumulating sufficient experience points. Avoid fluxing time, gravitational imbalance, and cognitive disruptions. Triumph over challenges and unlock "Destiny" bonus effects.

Radiant with the light of wisdom, system sprites descend upon the dazzling starry skies of "Peerless Destiny". They are eager to establish a closer bond with you and explore the realms of fantasy together.
The game offers four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Devil.
Easy and Normal modes provide a satisfying grass-cutting experience where skills automatically target enemies, making gameplay relatively simple.
Hard and Devil modes are somewhat similar to souls-like games, requiring manual targeting of skills and utilizing actions like blocking, dodging, and parrying to avoid damage. Otherwise, death comes easily. The gameplay is slightly more complex.
Believe me, the Devil difficulty level will be the most challenging experience you'd rather not speak about! ^^~

title: Burden of Truth
description:
게임 정보
Burden of Truth is the next entry in the Burden of Proof saga, marking the return of this grand courtroom adventure! Experience the missing chapter from the original story which has been restored & fleshed out into a full game. Gather evidence by investigating the crime scene, find contradictions in the courtroom, and confront the truth with everything you have!



One year after his mentor's poisoning, renowned prosecutor Conrad Cross accepts a new case tangled in web of conspiracy. In order to determine the true culprit, Cross and his opponent, Kate Flocking, engage in a battle of wits and piece together the incident by analyzing the available evidence. However, this objective proves difficult to accomplish when it's revealed that a mysterious organization is interfering with the flow of information to the courtroom. Even so, the legal counsel is determined to persevere through these limitations and expel the lies by uncovering contradictions within the witness' statements. To deliver justice, someone must be found guilty.



But as the trial winds down, an unsettling situation unfolds when a mysterious figure informs Cross that his childhood friend, , has been arrested on suspicion of murder. At the same time, the dangerous rebellion group mounts an assault to retrieve the , a database of information that could plunge the world into if it falls into the wrong hands. Knowing that Sarah could never be responsible for the heinous crime she's accused of, Cross must turn his entire mindset around to become the that his friend deserves. As the only person capable of saving Fletcher and preventing the catastrophic consequences of the Zero Data's exposure, Cross must enter a that could very well determine the fate of the world.



continues RobProductions' iconic hybrid-genre experience with third person investigations and challenging logic puzzles that test your knowledge of each case. Explore the crime scene as you survey for traces of the culprit. Collect evidence and make surprising deductions via the new , which highlights more information about about the status of each clue. Hold people accountable by tracking the source of each item added to the court record, or utilize on-hand items to get out of dangerous situations.



Then, make your case in the courtroom by cross-examining witnesses and presenting evidence that favors your argument. As legal counsel, you get to and when to hold back, but be warned; the judge and his counselors grow weary with every faulty step, so be sure to back up your claims with . As you make choices that affect the course of the trial, new discoveries can be made that contradict previous testimony. With logic as your weapon, search for the within the witness' assertions and take the fight to them!



The outcome of the case is in your hands. As such, to deduce the truth and deliver justice for those that have been wrongly accused!

title: Wizard Cats Tank Battle
description:
게임 정보

Choose from seven classes and fight other Wizard Cats in Wizard Cats Tank Battle, a cross-platform multiplayer game!

Wizard Cats Tank Battle puts a fantasy RPG twist on the classic arena shooter genre, with mechanics inspired by MMORPGs, MOBAs, and ARPGs. The gameplay emphasizes teamwork and support while focusing on skill and precision.

As you play, you’ll earn Cat Coins, which you can use to customize your Wizard Cat’s fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and meows.
Classes
Choose from 7 Wizard Cat classes designed for damage, tank, and support roles. Every class has unique class abilities, including a buff, debuff, and ultimate, as well as unique stats.

Pyro-Prancer - Fire DPS
Hydro-Dancer - Water Support
Furricane - Air Glass Cannon
Purrth-Quake - Earth Tank
Pawadin - Light Support
Necropouncer - Death Tank
Voidstalker - Void Disruptor

Winning is about choosing classes that synergize well within your team, so you can effectively counter your opponents! Players are free, and encouraged, to swap classes mid-game.

Buffs are applied when projectiles hit allies. Debuffs are applied when projectiles hit enemies.

Customize your Wizard Cat with a variety of fur patterns, body types, hats, wands, tanks, and battle cries. Find your cat’s unique voice by choosing from a community-sourced collection of meows!

Your cat will meow loudly every time you defeat another player, taunting the defeated and announcing your kill to the rest of the arena.

Earn coins as you battle and unlock exciting tanks, hats, and wands!
Collect powerups around the map, including special spells such as Exploding MIssiles and Bouncing Bolt. Collect special buffs such as Zoomies (speed boost), Nipped Up (shoot faster), Storm of Claws (increased melee damage), Reflection Bubble (missiles reflect off the player) and more!
Have you ever been in a situation where you're playing a game with friends and there’s that one person who is either too experienced or too novice to really enjoy it?

The combat system in Wizard Cats Tank Battle was designed to ensure it is fun for everyone!

Novice players will benefit from the simplicity of playing a support roll: the same missiles that damage your enemies buff your allies! So, if you want a less experienced friend to have fun, tell them to stand behind you and shoot you in the back!

Experienced Wizard Cats players can use their knowledge to guide their allies into picking the best classes for the situation.

title: Quandary

Quandary is an intriguing 2D puzzle platformer where your character's internal struggle is brought to life. Your logic and empathy take form as two separate characters, moving in opposite directions, forcing you to strategically utilize both to navigate challenging puzzles.

Can you find harmony within this chaos and solve puzzles that seem impossible, ultimately deciding the fate of your suffering patient?

You control two bodies that move in opposite directions!
You control two bodies that move in opposite directions and represent your empathy and logic.



Solve puzzles to reach the light.






Duh, he is you, and you are him...

Play one of five distinct classes—Warrior, Guardian, Heretic, Elementalist, or Sorcerer— and battle through seven different zones, each shaped by a corrupted Templar’s domain.

Group based or Single player dungeon-based runs
Embark in dungeon runs on your own or either with your friends, up to 4 players
Progress in playing dungeons on various difficulties, clear them out faster for better loot
