Ability to choose different looks for your character to reflect your own identity.|

Simplified Abilities System
Tier based abilities system where you can pick 5 abilities at a time, one ability from each tier, different abilities allow improvement in different roles and gives you the ability to build hybrid roles!
One Utility Tier that assists you to play the game in your own style and ways.
Simplicity of Stats, Item Crafting, and Gearing

title: Dead Underworld
description:
게임 정보
Dead Underworld is a single-player, dungeon-diving, turn-based roguelike set in a fantastical realm of eternal conflict. Gather resources and strengthen your party to endure a harsh world brimming with dangers. Engage in swift, punishing battles where every decision counts. Should a party member fall, recruit a new fellow Seeker to continue your quest. Who among you will escape the Underworld?
Choose your path and explore a procedurally generated world.
Gather items and resources to aid your survival.

title: Cat at Home
description:
게임 정보
From the moment of waking up from a coma, the life of the cat Orange was completely rewritten. Upon entering this mysterious villa, Orange encounters the bizarre disappearance of the homeowner, "Boss." The animal companions living under the same roof, each with distinct personalities, can all speak and clearly possess wisdom beyond that of ordinary animals.
"Wait, how did I become so smart too?"

title: Inventorix
description:
게임 정보
(우주 요정이 제작한) INVENTORIX 장치를 사용하여 성간 아이템에서 최대한의 가치를 이끌어내고, 외계인을 고용하여 수익을 끌어올리세요. 미스터리한 빚을 갚거나, 운을 믿고 천문학적인 부를 창출해 보세요.
주요 특징(체험판, 더 많은 기능 추가 예정)
은하계 수익: 우주의 돈을 벌어보세요. 짤랑짤랑!
인벤토리 관리: 아이템과 외계인을 묶어서 강력한 콤보를 찾아보세요.
80가지 아이템: 신중하게 선택하세요.
75가지 외계인 특전: 빌드에 제일 큰 지원이 되는 특전은 무엇일까요?
10가지 이상 아이템 클래스: 한 클래스에 집중하거나 클래스를 혼합하여 우주처럼 어마어마한 시너지를 만들어 보세요.
로그라이크: 각 런은 변화무쌍하고 빠르게 전개되며 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
7가지 INVENTORIX 장치: 장치를 잠금 해제하고 장치마다 다른 고유한 전략을 살펴보세요.
7가지 난이도: 점점 어려워지는 도전을 정복하세요.
도감: 새로운 아이템과 외계인을 발견하여 도감을 완성하세요.

title: Hellspresso
description:
게임 정보
As a dedicated ghost chef trying to make a living in the afterlife, you decide to open your own restaurant in hell. Day after day and night after night, from one shift to the next, race against the clock to serve more and more hungry customers. Switch to your not-so-secret magic kitchen to prepare more exotic dishes. Start off small, expand your restaurant and your skills, and slowly gain your reputation as the best ghost cooking chief in hell!
Cook dishes and serve hungry customers!
.
.
.
Run, cut meat, fry potatoes, mix delicious smoothies, make coffee, serve customers before they storm out, clean tables, stack dirty plates, wash dishes… You will have a lot on your plate.Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your restaurant. Every second counts, because if you take too long, your customers will be tired of waiting and they will leave angry and hungry!
.
Encountering strange orders with venomous mushrooms or magic plants that you don’t have in your fridge? Time to enter your clandestine kitchen! Discover the mystical counterparts to your regular ingredients and kitchen tools. Watch as a regular steak transforms into rotten meat, and a mushroom becomes a venomous variant with red spots. Sprinkle glowing eyes on your donuts, chop garlic, brew magic potions, and create infusions with foxglove or deadly nightshade. Your cauldron and your alembic will help you to craft enchanting recipes and satisfy every customer. Master the art of juggling between both kitchens to ensure your dishes never burn!
.
.
Discover more than 50 ingredients to cook, each with its magical counterpart hidden in your secret atelier. From familiar carrots, mushrooms, and donuts to exotic items like garlic, blood, or deadly nightshade, a world of exciting ingredients awaits your culinary creativity! You can create more than 100 different recipes from all around the world and even beyond, to offer new dishes and drinks to your demanding customers.
.
Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast. Each day, you can choose which ingredients to put on your fridge and on your cupboard, as well as the counters that will be in your kitchen. With more than 10 different personalities, each customer wants something different, and it’s up to you to optimize your menu accordingly. Discover their favorite recipes to gain their trust and unlock their secrets.
.
Some ingredients and ustensiles have a magical equivalent in your secret kitchen, allowing you to put even more recipes to your menu!
.
When they are done eating, customers take a quick nap. Take advantage of their inattention to absorb a part of their soul! Souls can then be used to improve your restaurant!
.
.
Invest the souls you stole to build up your kitchen with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for unlocking new recipes and increasing your profit. Opt for more storage capacity with a fridge expansion to use more ingredients, or tools like a new blender or more stoves to increase your productivity. You can even invest in an automatic dishwasher! Buy more tables to host more and more hungry customers. Decorate your restaurant with fine taste to increase your customer’s patience… and tips! Take some classes and improve your serving skills to get better tips, or specialize in some recipes and increase your prices. Will you decide to master the art of donuts or to unlock the secrets of smoothies? It’s up to you!

title: Climbing Back to the Mothership
description:
게임 정보
Game Introduction:
Climbing Back to the Mothership might look like a typical 2D platformer.
But using "seems" to describe the genre feels a bit inaccurate. After thorough research, we found that the surveyor in the game can't actually jump because he's unconscious. He can't jump, and he can't move on his own. The core mechanic of the game revolves around using the grappling hook on the surveyor's arm to move around.
From feet to hands, from jumping to grappling, from nothing to something.
So, Climbing Back to the Mothership is a 2D platform drag-and-pull game.
Thank you for your interest in my game This page's content has been polished by GPT for localization.
The trailer features an older version of the content, but the core remains the same.
We will refine all related content before the game's release. Thank you for your understanding and look forward to it.
Game Features:
Play as a damaged grappling hook.
Climb from the depths all the way back to the mothership.
Friendly little robots help soothe your emotions when you fall back to the start.
Use your starting skills to increase your margin for error.
Hidden safety measures prevent severe falls, if you can find them.
Picturesque landscapes reminiscent of pixel art.
Fragmented storyline scattered across the map.
Many small robots accidentally dropped, each offering you surprises.
autokwd: Climbing Back to the Mothership,落叶归根 Climbing Back to the Mothership

title: Territorial Hissing
description:
게임 정보
Something smells funny around here...
Niko wakes up after a long night of partying to discovers that something is stinking up his neighborhood. As he investigates he stumbles upon a story of corruption that sends him down a path with more than he bargained for.
Explore the world and discover all the secrets. Fight your way through the mean critters as you learn all the truths. Snag some cool trinkets to enhance your abilities. And laugh along the way.

title: Small Kingdoms
description:
게임 정보
Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield
Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game with procedurally generated campaigns
Choose various options for the campaign including the number of kingdoms and cities, and a campaign map will be generated with a world consisting of several small islands, making each play through unique
Choose to play as one of several kingdoms that each has their own set of islands and cities. The kingdoms all have similar unit types, but each has their own unique flavour, with strengths and weaknesses for you to use strategically
Build up your cities by constructing buildings, gathering resources and training units for your garrison from the world map. Will your cities be economic powerhouses producing loads of resources? Or will they be military training camps designed to get a variety of new units into your armies?

title: Roll The Bones
description:
게임 정보
Let's roll them bones!
In this high-paced, action-packed roguelite you will need to carefully choose a loadout of spell dice to beat each dungeon floor.
Pave your way through 15 unique dungeon floors filled with bloodthirsty enemies!
What's the deal with dice?
Each die has 6 sides and possibly up to 6 different spells. Some are good, some are terrible and some will straight up annihilate the enemies (or even yourself).
Choosing dice that play well against specific dungeon floors is the key to success.

title: Death's Web
description:
게임 정보
"Death's Web" is a challenging "Rogue-lite" platformer where you explore an ever-changing 2D world filled with enemies ready to slay you. Fight, die, learn repeat.
Features:
Collector of Souls: You posess the ability to steal enemies souls after they die. you can secure the souls through soul spheres and use them after death to permanently increase your stats and upgrade spells.
Curses: Numerous curses are waiting to be discovered; they may lead to your demise, but they can be exchanged for blessings to aid your journey. Survive their devastating effects to claim your rewards. Curses can blind you, summon deadly spikes, unleash freezing hail, and much more—each one a unique challenge to overcome!
 Blessings: Some will heal you, others grant powerful new abilities, and some can completely absorb incoming damage. They enhance gameplay with unique effects, making each run more dynamic and engaging!

title: Seagull Kart Racing
description:
게임 정보
Dive beak on to victory!
Seagull Kart Racing is a frenetic and fun racing game in witch you're not bound like a mear mortal by gravity!
Use your wings and your wit to be the first seagull to cross the finish line!

You've just arrived in a new city and a crow from the future tells you that you're the only seagull capable of defeating the racing master, an alien entity that races across the universe destroying civilizations that aren't up to it .

Thus begins your training in time and space to become the fastest seagull of all time!

Main features:

• You can fly! Forget about gravity!
• Use 8 amazing power ups to win!
• Online multiplayer race mode (up to 8 players)
• Controller and keyboard support

Coming soon:
• Single player story mode
• Single player timed races
• Customize your seagull

title: Convicted
description:
게임 정보
Convicted is a survival horror multiplayer game set in a top-secret Soviet facility during the 1980s, full of unethical experiments, paranormal activities, and dangerous monsters! An accident happened to free some of the lab's anomalies, which will hunt you down! Play as them or try to escape!
Explore the secret Soviet laboratory, and be sure not to miss any items. They could potentially save your life! After all, you don't really know how to stop the strange, hostile anomalies. Will ordinary firearms be able to stop them? Well, there's only one way to find that out!

title: Summit Smash
description:
게임 정보
-PLAY SINGLE OR MULTIPLAYER MODE!
-Get to the top or stay on top before time runs out in a VERTICALLY TIGHTENING AREA!
-Leave behind those who try to bring you down with guns and traps
-Shoot or Push your opponents, remember this is a battle royale and only one person can win!
Start at one of four bottom towers and navigate obstacles to reach the top. Each floor has harder traps. Race to an area with two towers, facing more challenges. Use grappling hooks or special weapons to advance yourself or hinder opponents!

title: God Of This World
description:
게임 정보
God Of This World took a couple of classic RPG ideas and modernized them into a 3D top-down shooter. You'll have to explore a logical world while collecting health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back. Make your way to the boss of each level, and find secrets, as each level gets progressively harder.

title: Deus Proxy
description:
게임 정보
A New Kind of Auto Battler

Deus Proxy is a roguelike that brings together the most exciting aspects of new-school auto battlers and old-school tabletop gaming. Every game is a completely new adventure with 15 factions, human opponents, and hundreds of heroes, items, traits, and spells!
Asynchronous Multiplayer

In Deus Proxy you play through hand-crafted PvE and one-of-a-kind PvP encounters. Any army that wins a PvP encounter becomes an adversary in other player’s games. You see the enemy armies before picking your cards and designing your own army, which rewards drafting a diverse deck to counter the challenges you might face instead of playing the most "meta" cards.
Comprehensive In-Game Information

Tired of "wiki games" that require you to constantly alt-tab to see what a powerup does? Every spell, item, hero, unit, trait, buff, faction and game mechanic is explained in a searchable in-game compendium. When designing your army, an overlay tool is present to quickly view any stat of every unit on the field. Within seconds you can discover ways to counter your opponent.
Endless Theorycrafting

Every game of Deus Proxy is a possibility to try new strategies and find new synergies! There are no implicit faction bonuses, all bonuses come from items and spells related to that faction. Your plant-based army might focus on empowering ranged units to entangle far-away targets, giving army-wide regeneration bonuses to make your treants walking tanks, or just being immune to the acid rain your mage caused. Because you have 1-3 battles per turn, it is vital to keep your armies adaptable for each new challenge!

Heroes can equip any item that you obtain, and can cast any spell they have the slightest proficiency to cast. A huge variety of builds are possible, and the traits and stats a hero has are only a suggestion of what they're capable of when properly equipped.

title: Rinth
description:
게임 정보
Rinth is an old school dungeon rpg inspired by 90s dungeon crawlers.
Enter the dungeons, face different monsters and bosses.
Gameplay
chill mouse only gameplay
Collect weapons
buy and sell weapons to merchants
craft weapons on anvil (3 same rarity weapons will create a better one)
make decisions when to buy/sell and craft items
Dungeons
random generated dungeons
total 5 different dungeons, (10 levels each dungeon)
After beating all 50 levels you can do endless dungeons (has bosses too)
Playtime
Rinth is a short game, around 4-5 hours to complete everything
Style
Enjoy pixel graphics and listen great 16-bit music during the game
Can you save the world from evil?

title: Balkanija
description:
게임 정보
"Balkanija" is a unique blend of adventure, quests, and economic strategy that immerses you in an exciting world on the edge of Europe. The action takes place in the colorful capital of one of the Balkan countries, where life is bustling in a Romani neighborhood filled with vibrant characters and unexpected twists.

You will take control of the fates of the main characters — Hanko and his wife Zoe. Each new day will bring new opportunities, introduce you to interesting people, and present tasks that will make you think about the true values of life.

In this world, even the most mundane tasks can turn into thrilling adventures, but there will also be serious challenges. You will need to maintain a balance between the everyday lives of your heroes and the challenges posed by economic hardships and criminal threats.

Interact with other characters, manage resources and time, and make important decisions — every action you take will have consequences for the fate of Hanko and Zoe. Will you find a way to survive and find happiness in this complex yet captivating world?
Key Features:
Introduction of New Heroes: As the story progresses, you will encounter new characters who can join your team. Each hero has unique skills and can perform various tasks.
Quests: The gameplay is enriched with a quest system that helps you explore the diverse capabilities of your characters and unlock their potential.
Economy: The economy is an integral part of the game. Earn money through various means and use it to develop your business, support your family, and engage in gambling activities.

title: Circle Defense
description:
게임 정보
I know you have rich experience in defending the Earth!
CIRCLE is a tower defense game with a light card system, where you will play as a commander defending the Earth: by building/upgrading weapons on a rotating device called "CIRCLE" and using cards to deal with the continuously invading aliens.


Origin of the CIRCLE
One day, the moon was hit and destroyed by unknown creatures, and the debris turned into a circle around the Earth. Due to concerns about the unknown creatures, humans transformed the lunar circle into the CIRCLE device and deployed cosmic-level defense weapons on it.



Under the pressure of alien attacks, the human military technology tree continues to evolve, and its functions are summarized into command cards, waiting for the commander to issue orders.
The energy for the cards comes from the CIRCLE: the faster the Ring rotates, the higher the energy generation rate, but it seems to affect the aiming rhythm for deploying weapons.



- Level-based game: each successful defense against alien attacks will greatly enhance Earth's weapon defense technology, continuously unlocking new weapon types, upgrade items, and new technology cards.
- The combination of different weapon upgrade projects and different cards will create a multitude of possibilities.
- Each type of monster has its own behavior patterns and characteristics, so make sure to respond based on your understanding of them!
- Besides monsters, you also have to face the harsh cosmic environment, and some levels will force you to abandon common strategies to try more suitable solutions.
- You can press the space bar at any time to slow down time for more time to think about strategies and operations; or maybe you just want to see the fireworks in slow motion?

title: My Dear Neighbor
description:
게임 정보
The darkest matrix ever created
My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror puzzle game set in a distinct and captivating world. Players will find themselves immersed in a story rich with unique characters and a terrifying atmosphere. This game challenges players with moral decisions and reveals a brutally unforgiving world waiting to be discovered. As players navigate through this virtual realm, they will experience a hand-crafted universe filled with secrets and parallel dimensions to explore and unravel.
In My Dear Neighbor, Edition 404, players are plunged into a bleak and terrifying universe, where they must seek answers within a matrix-like reality. The challenge lies in discerning truth from illusion and facing one's deepest fears. Players must fight to escape a nightmarish world riddled with bugs and harrowing visions in this intense psychological horror experience.
A world unique in its kind

title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot.
Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards.

title: The Ogi: Cycles
description:
게임 정보
Enjoy the moments, take it at your own pace, delve into mysteries, listen to the sounds of the wind and spot birds and creatures on your way!
Intro
"Welcome, curious stranger, to the world of Mullar!

Come, sit by the fire - you came just in time for the gathering. I would prepare some tasty berry juice, but the berries are gone.. Because of the storms. And so, I’m afraid, is half of our tribe.

Everything was so peaceful and cozy.. And suddenly, it wasn’t anymore. Suddenly, it was all chaos. We don’t know why or how. We just know.. That we miss our friends. I bet they’re lonely out there.. Lonely and story-less. If the storms keep coming, I think we will run out of stories, too..

But tonight, the Elder will share a tale. A dark, important one. About when The Ogi arrived - and led us into chaos. That one, it scares me. A lot.

Luckily, legends aren’t true. .. They aren’t, are they?"

Key features
A unique and beautiful world, filled with mystery, history, interesting creatures and life!
Draw your way through puzzles, unique places and a rich emotional story!
Play on any device you want!

title: Mod Shooter
description:
게임 정보
Mod Shooter: the fast-paced arena FPS where the rules change every game! Mod Shooter is an arena FPS with modifiers, pickups, dynamic maps, various guns, and multiple game modes.
Inspired by the boomer shooters + arena shooters of the past, as well as LAN parties with custom lobbies, Mod Shooter changes the rules of the game every round.
Bringing The Arena Shooter Back To Its Roots
Across multiple dynamic maps and game modes, modifiers will fundamentally shape how you play each game of Mod Shooter. No two games will ever be the same.
Want more control? The host can also manually modify the game settings!
Features (With More Being Added!)
6 Game Modes
9 Modifiers
9 Pickups
4 Maps

title: Swing Boy
description:
게임 정보
Swing Boy는 스윙을 새로운 차원으로 끌어올린 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 그랩훅을 사용해 지하에서 탈출하여 지상으로 돌아가세요. 당신이 떠난 동안 무엇이 변했나요? 무엇이 남았나요?
지상으로 탈출하는 것은 쉽지 않습니다! 유독한 하수도를 가로지르고, 버려진 지하 연구소를 탐험하며, 위험한 적들을 피해야 합니다. Swing Boy는 현대적인 물리학과 레트로 픽셀 아트 스타일을 결합하여, 솔로와 협동 플레이 모두에게 잊을 수 없는 경험을 제공합니다.
스토리 모드 몰입감 있는 이야기
로컬 & 온라인 협동 모드
파티 모드: 감염, 타임 트라이얼 등
20개 이상의 Steam 업적
12개 이상의 잠금 해제 가능한 캐릭터
멋진 보스 전투

title: Roxy Raccoon 3: Troubles in Time
description:
게임 정보
Roxy Raccoon is back in this time travelling romp! Experience Roxy Raccoon like never before; when a wicked witch seeks to alter history and destroy the future, it is up to one raccoon cub to stop her! Play as Roxy as she battles through four unique eras in order to end the witch’s evil plan!

Roxy Raccoon: Troubles In Time is a cute, fun-filled 2.5D platformer for all ages and a throw back to collectathons of the past. Help your raccoon friends as they put an end to the witch’s wicked schemes and conquer her many challenges. Freely explore four uniquely themed periods in time as you prevent the witches dastardly schemes and save the future!

Compete in the witch’s trials and beat her at her own games, including popular sports, board games and more!

Explore 4 Unique eras and Experience an ever-expanding Hub-World as you unlock new areas!

Defeat the witch's minions as you traverse through the witch’s territory and save the future!

Unleash Roxy's magic with all new abilities and time manipulation!

Help your friends along your journey and make news ones along the way!

Adventure in style as you unlock colorful new cosmetics to customize Roxy’s appearance.

Rapid Ryan’s Arcade: Additional game modes packed full of minigames and unlockable content.

title: Y2K Directive
description:
게임 정보
The year is 1999.

As chaos looms on the horizon, reports flood in of gigantic monsters, zombie plagues, interdimensional portals, and various supernatural disasters unfolding worldwide. You, a military leader from a small island nation, are tasked with a simple yet daunting mission: Save as many civilians as possible before the clock strikes 2000.

Welcome to your Y2K Directive.

SURVIVE: Navigate through this apocalyptic year, rescuing civilians from endangered cities and deploying your troops to stem the tide of horrors.

ADAPT: Leverage the terrain, day and night cycles, and weather to your advantage. Train your troops, rebuild destroyed bases and power plants, and establish refugee camps for civilians. Keep panic and civil unrest at bay.

OVERCOME Every problem has a solution. Utilize your troops not just for combat but also to reduce panic, quell civil unrest, or suppress insurgencies. Manage your economy and infrastructure with precision to save your country from impending doom.

This strategic civil defense simulation, inspired by classic games like XCOM/UFO with roguelike elements, guarantees endless possibilities to test your skills. In each playthrough, a new scenario is generated. Zombies? Alien fauna? Kaijus? Maybe all of them (and more) at once? Choose your preferred settings, or let the random generator surprise you. Will you withstand the test, or let your country fall into chaos and anarchy?

title: DURT
description:
게임 정보
DURT is a block-based puzzle game where the deep underground mines have collapsed in on the unfortunate workers and there is only one mole brave enough to dare rescue them from this hazardous environment.



Journey into the 5 unique worlds filled with more than 100 expertly crafted puzzles that maximize each of the block's unique effects. Tunnel through dirt, dodge traps, and manipulate complex contraptions to solve the mine's puzzles and rescue the trapped miners! Once you have bested the story mode, go get your hands dirty creating and sharing your own puzzles using the in-game level editor or explore the community's puzzling creations via the Steam Workshop!










The game was originally made for the and won 1st place for the admin award. was made with Godot Engine.

title: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death
description:
게임 정보
우리 시대, Eithne 28년 겨울 61일, 우리를 인도하는 바람, 우리의 영원한 뿌리, Lucan 숲에 있는 언덕 위 도시의 여사제가 흙으로 돌아왔습니다.

우리 민족은 이제 대지와 바람과 나무의 여신인 버드나무의 여인 Imsha 와 연결될 새로운 지도자를 찾아야 합니다. 농작물이 자랄 수 있도록 땅을 축복하고, 우리 동족이 마실 수 있도록 물을 정화하는 것입니다.

누군가가 나서서 영혼들을 꿈으로 이끌어야 합니다. 누군가는 그녀의 신성한 성소에서 찬송을 불러야 우리가 축복받고 그녀의 진노에서 벗어날 수 있습니다. 자연은 친절한 만큼 잔인한 여주인이기 때문입니다. 그리고 나는 그녀의 불만에 대해 느끼는 두려움에 대해 감히 한마디도 말할 수 없습니다.

-Niamh, 약사이자 Amuniai 의 장로

게임의 특징:

🌻 자신의 백성을 지키겠다는 결심을 한 젊은 여성과 그러한 야망이 불러일으키는 고통에도 불구하고 그들의 의지가 펼쳐지기를 바라는 신과 남자를 중심으로 한 스토리 기반 RPG입니다. 설정은 고전 시대에서 영감을 받았습니다. 헤게모니, 의식, 무자비한 정치의 시대. 붉게 물들이는 것 외에는 아무것도 원하는 것 같지 않은 여신이 지배하는 세계...

🌻 다채로운 2D 배경과 3D 그래픽 효과로 보완된 아름다운 사운드트랙이 포함된 구식 영감을 받은 예술입니다. 이 모든 것이 당신을 깊은 마법의 숲, 덩굴로 뒤덮인 고대 유적, 어두운 비밀이 숨어 있는 조용한 마을의 세계로 안내합니다. 음악, 사운드, 예술 및 그에 수반되는 모든 것은 드라마의 맛과 함께 조용하고 편안한 게임 경험을 제공하기 위해 만들어졌습니다.

🌻 상호 작용 가능한 세계: 덩굴을 키워 접근하기 어려운 지역에 접근하고 물체를 띄워 퍼즐을 풀고 숨겨진 보물을 발견하세요. 정식 출시에서는 세상과 상호 작용할 수 있는 더 많은 방법이 계획되어 있습니다.

🌻무작위 전투는 없습니다. 지도를 돌아다니며 원하는 만큼 많은 적과 싸워보세요. 물론, 핵심 스토리 전투는 제외됩니다. 결국 우리 영웅의 죽음을 노리는 생물과 인간이 있고, 그러한 행동은 여신을 기쁘게 합니다...

🌻 과거의 위대한 RPG에서 영감을 받아 RPG에서 기대할 수 있는 모든 요소를 갖춘 시간이 지남에 따라 진행되는 전투 시스템입니다. 전투에는 다양한 아이템, 장비, 전략이 필요합니다.

🌻 사용자 정의 컨트롤 설정, 몬스터 및 전투 애니메이션/이동 끄기, UI 색상/메뉴 레이아웃 등과 같은 다양한 접근성 기능. 스토리에 집중하는 것을 선호하는 사람들이나 죽음 자체를 극복하기 위해 필사적으로 싸우고 싶은 사람들을 위한 난이도 설정이 있습니다. 키보드와 Xbox 컨트롤러 지원이 모두 포함되어 있어 원하는 방식으로 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이것은 완전한 목록이 아니며 전체 릴리스에는 더 많은 옵션이 있을 것입니다.


게임의 첫 번째 부분을 다루고, 정식 출시에서 기대할 수 있는 세계, 캐릭터, 핵심 게임플레이를 소개하는 무료 데모가 제공됩니다. 데모에는 이번 정식 릴리스에서 사용할 수 있는 모든 기능이 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

지금까지 우리의 이야기가 흥미를 끌었다면 데모를 한번 시도해 보시기 바랍니다.

🌻 전투원을 전문화하고 전투를 신선하게 유지하는 다양한 캐릭터 클래스. 데모에 포함되지 않은 몇 가지 예는 다음과 같습니다:
마녀 - 체력 포인트를 사용하여 공격 주문에 연료를 공급하고 치명적인 부작용과 함께 아군에게 강력한 혜택을 제공합니다.
안개 위버 - 다양한 원소의 마법을 엮어 연속 시전을 강화합니다. 공격력을 극대화하려면 체인을 계속 유지하세요.
검의 처녀 - 마법을 사용하여 무기에 원소 효과를 주입하고 자연스러운 신체 능력을 강화하여 칼날과 활로 적을 학살합니다.

🌻 마법을 사용하여 세상에 영향을 미치는 방법에는 관목을 태우고, 어두운 동굴을 밝히고, 먼 물체를 조작하고, 맹렬한 불꽃을 끄는 등 여러 가지 방법이 있습니다. 게임의 많은 퍼즐과 숨겨진 영역을 해결하고 접근하려면 마법을 창의적으로 사용해야 합니다.

🌻 부서진 섬의 운명을 결정하는 4막의 이야기. 이 땅은 Diadochi 이와 피에 젖은 Martellus 의 왕관에 의한 또 다른 정복이 될 것인가? 신들의 파괴적인 변덕이 균형을 이룰 수 있을까요?

🌻 전체 경험의 길이는 약 20~30시간으로 계획되어 있지만, 플레이 스타일이 얼마나 철저한지 및/또는 선택한 난이도 설정에 따라 확실히 달라집니다.
autokwd: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death

title: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Play the role of a forest ranger who finds herself stranded in a jungle that has undergone a mysterious anomaly while on an animal tagging mission. As night falls, a mystical energy turns the once-peaceful wildlife into dangerous threats. In this open-world survival game, you must manage your thirst, hunger, and health while uncovering the secrets of the jungle.
Your Mission
Survive the jungle, discover ancient ruins, and collect emeralds ("Manis") tied to the anomaly. Build a strong base, seek help from animals, and face powerful enemies to unlock the truth behind the jungle’s transformation.
Key Features

🌿 Survival, Build, Craft
You start wounded and stranded in a dangerous open-world jungle, now warped by a supernatural anomaly. Managing vital resources—hunger, thirst, and health—is key to surviving in this survival horror environment. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, and build a secure base to protect yourself from the many threats lurking in the darkness.
autokwd: Ruins of the Forgotten: A Wild Survival

title: Zurarararush!!!
description:
게임 정보
~story~
20xx
A pandemic Breaks Out Due to A Mutated Virus!
The Whole World Is Filled With Fear and Anxiety.
In the midst of this, a device that can directly attack the virus
"ZURA" is developed, and a ray of hope shines on the world!
Can you defeat the virus and save the world――?

~Game Overview~
"Zurarararush!!!" is a twin-stick shooter that is easy and intuitive to play.
The player becomes a doctor wearing a micro-suit,
and wears ZURA (a wig) as a weapon, and defeats the mutated virus inside the body.

ZURA has many types, and by wearing them, you can shoot various bullets.
ZURA can be stacked, so by taking multiple types, your firepower will increase significantly.
ZURA has a limited number of bullets (hair volume), so they will run out eventually.
The point of the strategy is to keep taking ZURA and maintain your firepower.

There Are Currently Two Modes Available.
Arcade Mode Has 100 Levels Plus Some Extras.
Score attack has two types: 3 minutes and infinite.

In arcade mode, there is a simple story where the doctor defeats the virus and becomes a hero, with themes of lovers and parents and children.
You can collect DNA and power up like an RPG, so anyone can aim for the ending.

In score attack, you compete with people around the world for the highest score.
By defeating enemies within a certain time, you can continue your combo and increase your score.
ZURA acquisition is essential for maintaining the combo.

The Play Time Is Expected to Be 10 to 20 Hours.

title: Surfers Code
description:
게임 정보
서핑은 라이프스타일입니다
여행하는 서퍼로서 열대 섬의 차가운 분위기에 빠져보세요.
첫 번째 섬에서는 독특한 캐릭터들과 교류하며 방향을 잡고, 서핑을 배우고, 과거 서퍼들의 역사를 발견하고, 보물을 탐색해 보세요. 편안하고 라이프스타일에 맞춰 첫 번째 서핑 장소를 연결한 후 보트를 타고 다른 섬으로 모험을 떠나보세요. 뱃사공은 "길을 따라 많은 휴식 시간이 있습니다"라고 암시하지만, 당신은 "빠른" 제트 스키에서 우승하면 더 멀리 모험을 하고 외부의 신비를 밝힐 수 있다는 것을 알고 있는 대회 섬에 가는 데 관심이 있습니다. 섬.

외곽섬
서핑만이 이 섬의 매력은 아닙니다. 처음에는 "이 섬들은 신비와 모험으로 가득 차 있다"는 것을 알게 됩니다. 다른 방문객과 대화하고, 여행자의 일기를 읽고, 제트스키를 타고 외곽 섬을 탐험하면서 섬의 비밀과 펼쳐지는 설화를 밝혀보세요. 모험이 발전해감에 따라 상황이 항상 보이는 것만큼 간단하지는 않다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다.


엄청나게 멋진 서핑
간단한 컨트롤과 무한한 가능성을 갖춘 물리 기반 서핑입니다. 버튼 하나로 테일 슬라이드, 컷백, 방송이 가능합니다. 하기는 쉽지만 잘하기는 어려운 시뮬레이션 디자인. 이 지역의 전문 서퍼들은 속도를 조절하고, 파도를 읽고, 속도를 높이고, 테일 슬라이드나 공중으로 달려가야 한다고 말합니다. 이것을 잘하는 법을 배우는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 파도는 당신이 그릴 수 있는 열린 캔버스입니다. 웨이브 점수는 귀하의 능력 진행 상황과 개선 방법을 보여줍니다. 모든 휴식 시간에 콘테스트가 가능합니다.


초보자 휴식에 적합한 시뮬레이션 보드로 시작하세요. 섬 곳곳에 흩어져 있는 더욱 전문화된 보드로 이동하세요. 큰 파도를 위한 빅 웨이브 건, 속도와 큰 공기를 위한 빠른 트윈 핀, 그리고 재미있는 보드 몇 개를 선택하여 화살통을 완성하세요.


섬 전체에서 서핑 브레이크를 찾아보세요. 초보자 휴식 시간부터 시작하세요. 약간의 기술과 연습이 필요한 빠르고 느린 구간으로 쉽게 이륙할 수 있는 정말 재미있는 쉬운 파도입니다. 근처에 있는 다른 리프, 포인트, 비치 브레이크를 이용해 보세요. 모두 고유한 특성을 가지고 있습니다. 군중에서 벗어나 다양한 신비롭고 알려지지 않은 휴식 시간을 발견하고 잠금 해제하세요.


당신은 한 명의 탐험가에게 묶여 있지 않습니다. 다양한 플레이어 중에서 선택하세요. 하지만 각 플레이어가 게임의 물리학에 영향을 미친다는 점을 알아두세요. 특히 서핑에서 플레이어를 바꾸고 게임의 느낌을 바꾸세요.

title: Egg Chef
description:
게임 정보
Egg Chef challenges you to cook and deliver eggs for points, but try not to drop any! Play by yourself for a high score or online with friends to determine the superior Egg Chef.

Catch eggs with your frying pan as they fall from above. Try to flip them as many times as you can to multiply your egg score, but be careful not to drop them as you will lose points.

Play against your friends in online multiplayer to see who's best. Catch Items as they drop from above to either enhance your cooking or hinder your opponents' cooking.
Key Features:
Move the frying pan to catch and flip eggs
Deliver cooked eggs to score points
Flip eggs to multiply their point value
Online multiplayer
Catch falling Items to use them to your advantage

title: Conquest of Kings
description:
게임 정보
Conquest of Kings blends deep turn-based strategy with fast-paced, 30-60 minute battles! Compete in 1v1 duels or intense 4 player free-for-alls, capturing the Sacred Sites to claim victory!
Recruit units, command powerful armies, and play devastating cards to turn the tide of battle!
Fast-Paced Strategy - Deep tactical decisions in a 30-60 minute game.
Online PVP - 1v1s, 2v2, 4-Player FFA.
Command Powerful Armies - Recruit from five unit types and seize control of key tiles.

title: A Blocc World
description:
게임 정보
A Blocc World. The best kind of world. A world of discovery, adventure and smashing fun.

Wander through peaceful fields, golden sands and towering trees, and dare to dream that you could be the hero this world needs. Stop dreaming. This world needs a hero.

You'll need to train. Smash your way through the ugly beasts trying to ruin your peaceful paradise. Learn from your battles. Unlock new powers to smash even harder. Steal items and equipment from your vanquished foes. Don't worry about the ethical concerns of looting the deceased, it's all for the Quest. Don't stop to clean up after yourself, that will only slow you down. Focus! The Quest!

You'll need help. Make friends on your travels. Help them with their troubles and they might just help you too. But don't get too friendly, they'll distract you from the Quest.

You'll be tested. Some of the ugly beasts pack quite a punch. But they stand in the way of you and the Quest. You know what that means.

You'll be Quested. The Quest is a quest that you need to quest. Quest.

title: Amnea28: Two Eternities
description:
게임 정보
∞ "Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 
∞ Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.
∞ 30-50 hours of gameplay
∞ 5 unique routes
∞ 36 different endings and 19 unlockable epilogues
∞ more than 100 CGs and 32 music tracks
∞ the character routes are NOT romantic (the protagonist can't romance anyone); however there are certain romantic subplots in the story
∞ the choices you make shape up the character's mental state, the changes can be observed via a special stress scale. Don't let stress destroy the poor thing's mind, or their not-so-great qualities will manifest. They say "Amnea" puts pressure on its guests, so don't let them lose their minds!

title: Cat Girl Survivor
description:
게임 정보
"Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“은 뱀서라이크 게임의 단순한 플레이 방식과 다양한 캐릭터, 장비 아이템, 스킬, 플레이모드가 조합된 슈팅 액션 게임입니다. 자신만의 캐릭터를 선택하고 다양한 장비와 스킬을 습득해 악마로부터 위협받는 고양이 소녀 세계를 구하세요!
주요 특징
다채로운 스킬과 캐스팅 시스템 효과적으로 악마들을 공격하기 위해 다채로운 스킬과 함께 "Cat Girl Survivor : Bullet Action“에서만 볼 수 있는 캐스팅 스킬 시스템을 활 용해 보세요. 캐스팅 스킬은 사용 전 파워를 모으기 위해 몸을 움직일 수 없는 치명적 약점이 존재하지만 그만큼 광범위하고 강력한 데미 지를 적에게 줄 수 있습니다. 캐스팅 스킬과 일반 스킬을 적절히 전략적으로 사용해 악마들을 효과적으로 공격해 보세요!
스킬을 전설 등급으로 레벨업 해 화려하고 시원한 타격감을 즐길 수 있습니다.
다양한 캐릭터 기본 캐릭터 뿐 아니라 각자 다른 스킬과 능력을 지니고 있는 캐릭터들이 있습니다. 아카네, 시로, 코로 등 당신에게 매력있고 플레이 스타 일에 맞는 캐릭터를 선택해 게임을 즐겨보세요!

title: AO: Containment Breach
description:
게임 정보
There's been a Containment Breach within the AO facility on Terra. You're being sent in to establish communications with the other teams inside and to Contain what AOs have broken containment.
AO: Containment Breach is a Procedurally Generated, Level Building, Semi-Auto-Battling, Rogue-lite, Horror hybrid. Fight and Contain AOs as you make your way through the Containment Breach of the Terra AO facility. During "Dives" scavenge for Materials to bring back to the hub to Craft unique Weapons, Upgrades, and Gear. Build Craft unique and interesting strategies to combat hostile entities. Answers to the breach lay deep within the facility...

CONTAIN: Assume all AO containments have been breached. Figure out the Containment Procedures by looking for clues and other means to Re-Contain them.

title: Casual Trucking

Casual Trucking is a laid-back delivery simulator without any time pressure.

It's a small game, a sort of experiment with 3d and chill gameplay. Something that you can play while listening to your favorite podcast.

- Choose a delivery mission, head to the location and pick up the truck and cargo
- Buy different trucks for specific delivery missions
- Purchase real estate and gain passive income

title: Turn Illness into a Weapon
description:
게임 정보
In a high school hidden within a centuries-old castle, terror strikes as a sinister force begins hunting the students. You must use your skills and wits to survive, evade the relentless villain, and find a way to escape.

title: Eclipse of Elysium
description:
게임 정보










In Eclipse of Elysium, you step into the shoes of 21-year-old Aria. At first glance, she appears to be a young, unassuming woman who wouldn't harm a fly. But appearances can be deceiving. In reality, Aria is a biological weapon, deployed on the most dangerous missions in Eldora. Will you guide Aria to become a guardian angel, protecting the innocent, or a ruthless assassin fulfilling the orders of the powerful and wealthy?



Aria's emotional landscape is turbulent at best. Impulsive, fierce, and often consumed by rage, she embodies the unpredictability of a storm. However, like the calm after a tempest, she can also exhibit kindness and a willingness to aid those around her. The emotional path Aria treads is yours to shape. Will you navigate her through the darkness with a compassionate heart, or will rage be her guide? The choice is yours.



Serving the "Python Network," one of the most critical intelligence services of the Republic, Aria operates in the shadows. She's the one called upon when danger looms, or when tasks demand a leap outside the boundaries of legality. Her hands are the ones that get dirty, fighting battles unseen and undertaking missions that others dare not whisper about.

At the helm of Aria's assignments is Liaison Officer Krall, a member of the Scalekrin—an ancient race of lizard people long oppressed. Krall has climbed the ranks through sheer determination and now stands as a pivotal figure within the Python Network. His loyalty to the organization is unwavering, and he will do whatever it takes to secure his standing, guiding Aria through the network's dark web of intrigue and espionage.



In this shadowed world, every decision, every alliance, and every battle shapes the destiny not only of Aria but also of Eldora itself. What will your choices reveal?





Charon, was once among the most influential figures in Endora. As the chief advisor to the Merchants' Guild, his knowledge, experience, and wisdom were highly valued, and his counsel was eagerly sought after.



However, those who knew him witnessed Charon's gradual descent into madness, a process that began when he started investigating the origins of the mysterious Conflux. This dangerous organism relentlessly spreads across the world, engulfing villages, cities, and even entire kingdoms in its path.

Charon's intent was to halt this threat, leading him to the ruins of ancient civilizations. Yet, as his investigations deepened, he became increasingly reticent and enveloped in secrets. Five years ago, Charon vanished from the public eye. Now, he has reemerged, leading a mysterious order that is working to accelerate the growth of the Conflux.



To be honest, I'm a newcomer in the video game industry. I've been gaming since I commandeered my sister's Super Nintendo at the age of 10. But the dream of developing my own video game only took hold three years ago when I tried out Unreal Engine for the first time and quickly realized the boundless possibilities it offers.



My dream is to create a game that merges the best of two worlds. I'd like to combine the charm and pathos of a JRPG like Xenoblade with the vast freedom of choice found in Western RPGs like Baldur's Gate. The adventure should be easily accessible. There are no complex mechanics preventing you from quickly getting into the game. I also want to avoid grinding that unnecessarily prolongs playtime.

I aim to create a cinematic work that takes players on an emotional journey, presenting them with tough emotional choices and introducing them to charming and complex characters.

title: Seagulls: Crappy Situation
description:
게임 정보
Seagulls: Crappy Situation
바다에 고립되어 분노한 갈매기들에게 둘러싸인 채, 슬링샷과 물 호스만으로 끝없이 밀려오는 파도를 견뎌야 합니다. 이 독특한 로그라이트 게임에서 멀티태스킹과 전략을 테스트하세요. 유머러스한 혼란과 기괴한 갈매기가 기다리고 있습니다!
🚣‍♂️ 갈매기 파도에서 살아남기
갈매기들의 파도에서 당신의 뗏목을 방어하세요. 슬링샷으로 갈매기를 쏴서 떨어뜨리세요, 하지만 조심하세요—이 새들은 끔찍한 엉망을 남깁니다. 실패할수록 더 많이 배웁니다!
👫 로컬 협력
친구를 초대하여 분할 화면에서 협력하여 갈매기들의 혼란을 함께 처리하세요! 팀원과 함께라면 더 카오스하고 훨씬 더 재미있습니다!

title: Mutants Ate My Carrots
description:
게임 정보
Once upon a time, there was a black rabbit with a wild temper who lived an outcast life outside the Deep Wood forest.
One day, all of his special carrot crops disappeared! He embarks on a wild adventure to find the thief, using his powers of observation as well as his martial arts skills on anyone who gets in his way, even if it means taking on an entire forest!
But things are more complicated than he thinks.
A wacky point-and-click adventure game set in a fairy tale forest with a dark secret.

title: Stop The Slimes
description:
게임 정보
Stop The Slimes is a tower defense card-based game where you need to protect their realm from a relentless invasion of the slimes.

What’s the gameplay like?

You will draw a hand of cards.
Using energy you can places your cards to build towers.
After each level you can pick from three new cards to help build your deck.



Levels can cap your deck to a max number of cards.
The deck builder screen will let you select the cards you want!

title: Phenomena Embattled
description:
게임 정보
From the far reaching void of space, to the very cores of planets. This is where Phenomena Embattled takes place. You are part of an alien confederation sent to earth to find the means of ending an intergalactic conflict. Humanity is caught between alien star-fleets. They must strive to keep their place in the universe. You must find the path to complete your mission.
The game is a physics based shoot 'em up. Interact with squadrons and entire fleets in a story driven world. This single player narrative focuses on action rich, rouge-like, trans-medium combat. Be it air, water, or vacuum. The medium you steer your unexplained vehicle through will determine your capabilities. And the ones of your enemies.
Features:
Physics based interactive environment
Action driven missions and story
Intelligent enemies
Formation flying
Ability leveling
Choose your unexplained phenomenon
60+ base units to fight with and against
Many unique undisclosed encounters
Underground bases

title: Screaming In The Basement
description:
게임 정보
“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, unfolding through tense silence and detailed sound design that builds a growing sense of unease. Inspired by P.T.
Average time to complete: 200 minutes
Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

title: Eden: Discovery
description:
게임 정보
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.
Key Features:
• High-Stakes Extraction
Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.
• In-Game Currency & Tournaments
Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.
• Social Spaces
Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.
• Future Creative Mode
Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.
• Multiple Paths to Victory
Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.
EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.
• Marketplace & Player Economy
Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.
• PvPvE Gameplay
Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

title: The Witch's Realm
description:
게임 정보
Escape and survive in this supernatural puzzle adventure game where light is your only defense!

Play as a female protagonist that is visiting her grandmother's house where you explore eerie locations, solve escape room-style puzzles, and uncover hidden objects while managing your sanity. Navigate between reality and a twisted ghost dimension while you fend off spirits with your flashlight and unravel the dark history of a cursed town. 
Explore The Witch's Realm
Investigate eerie locations, each hiding secrets and deadly threats:
A Haunted House – The last refuge of a good witch… and now a dangerous trap.
An Abandoned Town – Shrouded in mystery, filled with remnants of a lost past.
A Foggy Graveyard – Where restless spirits linger, guarding hidden truths.
A Twisted Swamp – A dark, shifting maze that distorts reality itself.
Classic Escape Room-Style Puzzles
Hidden objects
Number codes
Riddle solving
Mazes
Managing Your Sanity
The longer you stay in the darkness, the lower your sanity gets
Use Safe Zones to increase your sanity 
The lower your sanity, the more frequent and aggressive ghostly encounters become
Flashlight Mechanic 
Light is your defense against the darkness
Shining it on ghosts will temporarily make them flee or stun them
Ghost Dimension
An alternate dimension filled with supernatural power
Cleanse alters & ritual sites where ghosts use to cross over to the main world

title: Rename the History
description:
게임 정보
전후 역사상 가장 어려운 시기에 국가를 이끄세요. 이때 강대국이 될지 강대국이 될지 선택해야 합니다. 서쪽으로 갈지 동쪽으로 갈지? 결정은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 새로운 역사에서 국가를 잃지 않으려고 노력하고, 많은 갈등을 헤쳐 나가며 영향력을 높이세요.
당신의 목표는 21세기 초에 국가 지도자가 되는 것입니다. 국가를 개선해야 하며, 이는 여러 가지 방법으로 가능합니다. 강력한 국가 기관과 경제의 도움으로 강력한 우월성을 달성할 수 있습니다. 또는 강력한 군사 강대국이 되어 이웃을 정복하고 자신을 강대국이라고 선언할 수 있습니다. 두 가지 방법 모두 장단점이 있지만, 어떤 것을 선택할지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
군대
보병과 전차로 구성된 군대를 지휘하세요. 보병은 수비대를 만들고 정복한 국경을 보호하는 데 필요합니다. 전차는 전선을 돌파하는 데 필요합니다. 전선에서 승리하려면 여러 유형의 군대를 결합하세요!
경제와 건설
전장에서만 국가를 개발하는 것이 아닙니다. 돈을 빌리고, 사무실, 막사, 벙커를 건설할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 목표는 귀하의 국가에 최대의 번영을 이루는 것입니다. 다양한 경제 개발 방식을 결합하여 새로운 경제 기적을 위한 레시피를 만드십시오!
동맹과 외교
다른 국가와의 문제는 군사 행동의 형태로만 해결될 수 없습니다. 귀하는 그들과 동맹을 맺고, 군대의 통과를 요청하고, 인도적 지원을 보내는 등의 방법을 사용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 외교적 영향력 방법을 사용하여 국경에 편안한 환경을 조성하십시오.
국가 정책
국가 정책으로 국가 문제를 해결하십시오. 향후 60일 동안 국가 개발에 대한 초점을 선택하십시오. 이는 정치적 초점, 경제적 초점 또는 군사적 초점이 될 수 있습니다. 이 메커니즘은 귀하의 국가뿐만 아니라 전체 지역에도 강력한 영향을 미칩니다. 여기에서 강력한 외교 정책을 찾을 수 있습니다.
다양성의 강점
기억하세요. 선택할 수 있는 국가는 50개국 이상입니다. 그리고 각 메커니즘은 국가에 따라 더 중요하거나 덜 중요할 수 있습니다. 또한, 같은 국가에서 플레이하면 게임의 재미를 충분히 느낄 수 없습니다.

title: The Werewolf
description:
게임 정보
The Werewolf is an intense action-survival game where you become a cursed beast, doomed to transform under the full moon. When night falls, your hunger for blood takes over—eliminate enough victims to stave off the curse, or risk being consumed by it.
But the hunt won’t always be easy. As your reign of terror grows, the villagers may begin to fight back, forming a resistance with torches, traps, and weapons to defend themselves. If your killings draw too much attention, the kingdom may even send skilled knights to hunt you down, forcing you into brutal, high-stakes battles.
Amid the chaos, you may uncover the truth behind your curse. Who did this to you—and why? Will you seek revenge, hunting down the one responsible? Or will you succumb to the monster within, becoming the nightmare the world fears? The choice is yours, but the moon always rises again.

title: Guanabara Warriors
description:
게임 정보
Guanabara Warriors is a real-time strategy (RTS) game set during the founding of Rio de Janeiro, where the indigenous tribes of Brazil are drawn into conflict with European colonial powers. Experience the rich history of the 16th century as you lead your forces in epic battles for control of the land, resources, and the future of Guanabara Bay.
As tensions rise between rival indigenous tribes, the arrival of Portuguese and French soldiers escalates the struggle for dominance. In Guanabara Warriors, you’ll take command of distinct factions, managing resources, forging alliances, and deploying your troops in large-scale tactical warfare in Brazil.
Key Features:
Historical Setting: Explore the foundation of Rio de Janeiro, with a focus on the indigenous tribes and their clashes with French and Portuguese colonial forces.
Factions: Play with Brazilian indigenous units never before portrayed in game. You will assemble armies of fearless indigenous warriors, possessing unique skills and special weapons that add dynamic and tactical depth to the game.
Strategic Depth: Manage resources, build strongholds, and plan your attacks carefully to outsmart your enemies in real-time battles.
Dynamic Battlefields: Fight across diverse environments, from dense forests to coastal shores, on terrains that impact your strategy.
Cultural Immersion: Learn about the customs, rituals, and warfare tactics of Brazil’s native peoples through detailed storytelling and gameplay.
Command your forces, defend your people, and shape the destiny of Guanabara Bay in Guanabara Warriors. Will you unite the land or fall to the chaos of war?

title: Motorbike Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: Beach Outlet Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Beach Outlet Simulator는 1인칭 시점의 시뮬레이션 게임으로, 소규모 가게를 대형 소매업체로 성장시키는 것이 목표입니다.
매장 관리
스타일리시하고 실용적인 방식으로 매장을 설계하세요. 공간을 최대한 활용하여 제품을 효과적으로 진열하고, 고객에게 즐거운 쇼핑 경험을 제공하세요.
청소
고객은 매장의 청결을 중요하게 생각합니다. 창문을 깨끗이 하고 바닥에 쓰레기가 없도록 유지하세요!

title: Imperium: Titans of Commerce
description:
게임 정보
Titans of Commerce: A game where YOU! become the capitalist behind the shadows at the wake of WW1. Manipulate diplomacy, fund opposition's journals or even a coup! Triple your income via arms sales, profiting from global tension. Design, produce and sell the train, gun or ship of your will! Fund Governments and get hefty tax cuts. Improve your business day by day and open factories all around Europe. Thanks to the fund that were left to you with these tax cuts, improve your factories and even find talented people in their jobs and employ them!
Topple Governments and Fund Politics
Meddle with politics, fund the party you like and help them get to power, in exchange; you can get several benefits and hefty tax cuts. You can maintain relations with +40 different authentic parties throughout the Europe, benefit and thrive your business with your political connections.
Design Locomotives, Guns, Ships; Sell Them to Governments in Need 
You can design, produce and sell locomotives, ships and guns. You can utilize your political connections to bolster sense of threat between countries and incentivize governments to spend on your products!

title: My Furry Protogen 3 🐾
description:
게임 정보


My Furry Protogen 3 is the final chapter of the saga, continuing the story of protogen scientist Juno and our main hero. They have made their choice, and now they are ready to risk their lives to stop the antagonist, the mysterious protogen that almost killed Juno before. But will they find the required power for that?...

Meet new friends, find old ones, discover the truth about Juno, and stop this mysterious protogen in "My Furry Protogen 3"!
Features:
• About 2 hours of content.
• Cute female protogen!
• HD fully original artworks.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Some personal drama, as usual.

title: The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game
description:
게임 정보
The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game

《The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game》은 차세대 서바이벌 호러 게임의 정점에 빠르게 올라가고 있습니다. Unreal Engine의 힘으로 지원되며, 초현실적인 그래픽으로 꾸며진 이 게임은 위험이 도처에 도사리는 잊을 수 없는 서바이벌 체험을 제공합니다.

Lost in the Darkness: A Tale Unfolds

평온한 삶을 살아가던 안드레아는 전 여자친구로부터의 갑작스러운 전화로 인해 감정의 소용돌이에 휘말리게 됩니다. 예기치 않은 전화는 그녀의 평화로운 존재를 혼란에 빠뜨리고, 이례적인 어둠이 가득한 미지의 장소로 그녀를 끌고 갑니다. 섬뜩한 분위기가 그녀를 깊은 불안으로 채우며 본능에 의존하도록 강요합니다.

A Struggle Amidst the Shadows

에본베일의 어둡고 섬뜩한 경계에서 홀로 갇힌 안드레아는 그림자 사이에서 길을 찾기 위해 싸웁니다. 작은 희망의 빛을 붙잡으며 생존하기 위해 싸워야 합니다. 그녀의 모든 움직임을 위협하는 미지의 적과 맞서 싸워야 합니다. 모든 발걸음마다 주변에 숨겨진 위험에 주의하고, 빛을 향해 나아가기 위해 용기를 모아야 합니다.

현실 이상의 경험

《The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game》은 단순한 게임을 넘어 깊은 체험을 제공합니다. 긴장감 넘치는 순간, 감정의 동요, 그리고 어두운 비밀로 가득 찬 이야기로 플레이어를 매료시키고 잊을 수 없는 여정을 제공합니다.

어둠 속에서 생존 전쟁이 시작됩니다

안드레아의 어두운 세계에서의 생존 전쟁은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 그림자와 두려움의 중심에서 안드레아의 생존을 확보하기 위해 용기를 모으고 이 잊을 수 없는 모험에 뛰어들어 보세요.

title: Frogmageddon
description:
게임 정보
The Empire of Froge has fallen, but in your last stand, your comrades suddenly re-grow in numbers! This is Frogmageddon! A Bullet Heaven-style survival game where the more evil snakes you defeat, the larger your frog army grows (to the hundreds!).
Grow your army!
Every defeated snake poses an opportunity to amass more frogs. But watch out: each frog can only take one hit before being lost to the fires of war. Master your positioning to maximize the growth of your pond-dwelling platoon!
Weaponized Frogs!

title: Delivery Driver Service
description:
게임 정보
대형 허리케인이 플로리다 주를 휩쓸면서 구조물과 송전 시설을 포함한 대부분의 물류 지점이 파괴되었습니다.


스토리:
긴급 지역의 인프라 복구를 위한 회사가 최고의 전문가를 파견하여 발생한 작업을 해결하는 데 필요한 모든 것을 제공합니다.

[게임 플레이[/i]:
플레이어의 주요 임무는 허리케인으로 피해를 입은 지역의 상태를 복구하여 모든 것이 이전처럼 또는 더 잘 작동하도록 만드는 것입니다!


극복하기:
여행 중에는 다양한 유형의 지형과 자연 장애물을 만날 수 있습니다. 이를 극복하려면 교통수단의 적합성을 고려하는 것이 중요합니다. 일부 차량은 고유한 장단점으로 인해 다른 차량보다 특정 장애물에 더 적합합니다.

:
날씨 기능 외에도 게임 세계에는 봄부터 겨울 풍경까지 실시간으로 변화하는 계절이 등장합니다. 날씨와 마찬가지로 계절도 게임 월드의 지형에 어느 정도 영향을 미치기 때문에 자동차를 움직이기 어렵습니다.


:
게임 플레이를 통해 차량의 고유한 특성에 따라 차량을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다! 운전자의 레벨을 높여 차량과 운전 기술을 업그레이드할 수 있습니다. 운전 실력을 한 단계 업그레이드할 준비를 하세요!


:
운전자의 레벨이 올라갈수록 게임 캐릭터는 더 많은 기술과 운전에 대한 자신감을 얻게 됩니다. 그러니 계속 레벨을 올려 캐릭터의 능력을 향상시키세요! 또한 정비소가 없을 때 예기치 않은 고장에 대처할 수 있는 능력도 향상됩니다.


:
게임을 시작할 때, 여러분과 차량에 필요한 모든 편의 시설을 추가하기 위해 기술적으로나 시각적으로 업그레이드할 수 있는 기지를 이용할 수 있습니다. 침대를 개선하거나 냉장고를 추가할 수 있으며, 차량에는 차고를 떠나지 않고도 더 많은 차량을 수용하고 정비할 수 있는 두 번째 차고 또는 기술 수납공간을 만들 수 있습니다.
