title: Endless Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Endless Tactics is a Turn-Based Roguelite game where you play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining expedition. Defend your base from incessant hordes of alien creatures as you harvest valuable resources, and weather dangerous planetary hazards such as spore filled meteor showers and earthquakes, all while uncovering valuable drop pods and new mysterious Artifacts. Whenever things get too bleak, Extract to your orbiting spaceship to rearm, Upgrade, and unlock more dangerous and profitable worlds the more you further you get. Good luck, Commander. MechTek is counting on you to make a buck!
SECURE YOUR OPERATION
Defend your mining operation from the alien menace! Manage a variety of units from military vehicles to towering mechs to fight back the deadly alien hordes as you extract valuable resources! Sometimes, tough decisions and sacrifices will be necessary to keep it going just until the next Extraction Opportunity - then Extract, or remain there and face the fearsome Apex Enemies (Bosses unique to each Planet)!
EXPANSIVE UPGRADES
Outfit your orbiting spaceship with the latest gear in excavation and offensive technology (warning: some upgrades might increase profits at the cost of survivability).

title: Richard
description:
게임 정보
About this Game:
Welcome to Rose Academy for the Gifted where the best and brightest graduate standing on top of the world! Take on the role of George, a transfer student, in his final year at high school. Help George through the ups and downs of his high school social life as he works to make friends while campaigning against Richard, the most popular kid in school and his roommate. Learn about the other students, understand what they're really trying to say, and earn their trust as fast as possible in order to win the title of Prom king in this Shakespeare inspired social simulation game!
Are you confident you can earn the crown in time?
Features
Converse with students! - Talk to the popular kids in the school to earn their trust and help them trust each other!

title: Duo Heli Combat
description:
게임 정보
Duo Heli Combat는 전략 요소가 가미된 생동감 넘치는 복셀 기반 아케이드 게임으로, 헬리콥터를 조종하며 미션을 완수하고 기지를 점령하며, 혼자서 또는 친구와 분할 화면 모드로 전투를 펼치는 게임입니다!
미션을 완수하세요 - 포로를 구출하고, 호송대를 호위하며, 깃발을 점령하는 등 다양한 임무가 기다립니다!

title: Solitaire of Stygian Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Our world is being slowly consumed by an ancient evil old gods and only you have the knowledge of the dark forces. Some say the knowledge makes you a madman, yet you can see the cards are everywhere - each chaotic aglomeration a sign of chaos infiltrating our reality. The destiny of the world hinges solely upon your shoulders. Walk the streets of randomly generated city, tread the paths of randomly generated labyrinths, solve randomly generated card layouts to bring order to our world. Maybe you will succeed where the mute violist from H. P. Lovecraft's "The Music of Erich Zann" failed...
Solitaire of Stygian Shadows is a solitaire card game where each playthrough is unique. Card layouts are randomly generated, as well as the environment through which you move. The goal of the game is to discover, one by one, numbers of the cypher to open the gates to the den of the ancient evil.
Experienced solitaire players will find themselves comfortable with the rules of the game. The cards have numerical values from 0 to 9, instead of traditional playing card ranks with aces, kings and queens. Gameplay difficulty can be described as relaxed, despite the theme of the game.

title: Duckpool
description:
게임 정보
Duckpool is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements, where you play as a rubber duck. Blast bizarre enemies with lasers and bubbles, dodge traps, fight bosses, and collect loot. Unlock unique ducks to uncover a hidden mystery. The game revives the brutal difficulty of classic arcade games.
Features
Fight your way through nine maze-like maps (+1 secret or not)
Unlock over 150 collectible ducks
Unfold the story by collecting ducks
Face off against bizarre creatures
Collect different power ups
Collect soap loot and spend it on a slot machine or buy collectables directly

title: InfiniteEvolution
description:
게임 정보
· In the game, the player will play the role of the "Tester" who travels from reality to the "Land of Evolution".
In each game, players will have to pass six levels and defeat the final BOSS to win and become the "God of Evolution" candidate.
The game contains:
· Traditional overhead barrage shooting
More than 15 side quests are randomly generated, and each round has a different experience
Over 40 hot-swappable chips turn the skill mechanism on its head
· Match 20 bloodlines with you
Overhead corner barrage play:
Pedigree matching:

title: Phantasms: Maledictus
description:
게임 정보
Phantasms is an episodic psychological horror game. Each chapter is hand crafted to deliver a unique and immersive horror experience.

More episodes are coming soon.
Phantasms: Maledictus
In this medieval-themed first episode, you play as a parent whose child has been abducted by a mysterious figure. You’ll face multiple possible outcomes, though only one leads to the correct ending.
Key Features
Stylized PSX graphics with a horror aesthetic.
VHS film shaders.
Interact with NPCs.
Multiple endings in this interactive story telling experience.

title: Повышенная Облачность - High Clouds
description:
게임 정보
The game is a 3D platformer for PC in a setting of flying islands. The islands are moving, swinging and rotating. Play a the main character  - a dog who wants to get to the highest island in order to fly to the moon by ship from there.
Jump from island to island
Plan on your coat
Cling to the rocks with a hook
Fly long distances by hang glider
Fight the pirates
On the way, the weather creates difficulties for him - wind, rain, thunderstorms.

title: Lucky Summoner
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to *Lucky Summoner*, a strategy card battle game that blends deck-building with RogueLite elements. Here, you'll play as a fledgling card summoner, skillfully utilizing the cards in your hand to defeat increasingly powerful enemies. Overcome the final BOSS's challenge to earn the title of Summoning Master.
Gameplay Introduction
The core gameplay revolves around strategic card battles. In each battle, you can summon powerful minions to fight for you using the cards in your hand or enhance their abilities with upgrade cards to pose a greater threat to the enemy. Within a limited number of turns, you must plan each move carefully and make optimal use of every energy point to defeat your opponent. If the turns run out and the enemy is still standing, the challenge will be declared a failure.

title: Heir to the Queen
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
RPG Maker VX Ace로 제작된 미스터리 어드벤처 게임입니다.
시놉시스
평범한 여고생 야무는 우연한 계기로 고대 이집트의 여이 될 자격을 얻게 된다.
하지만 왕좌에 오르기 위해서는 수수께끼로 가득 찬 관문을 통과해야만 한다.
그러나 이곳에는 그녀를 시험하는 정체 모를 존재들이 기다리고 있다.
미지의 공간에서 펼쳐지는 퍼즐, 탐험, 생존의 여정...
과연 야무는 모든 시련을 극복하고 진정한 여왕이 될 수 있을까?
게임 특징
퍼즐 & 탐험: 알 수 없는 공간을 탐색하며 단서를 찾고 퍼즐을 풀어야 한다.
미스터리한 분위기: 신비롭고 긴장감 넘치는 스토리 전개.
생존 요소: 정체 모를 미지의 존재들을 피해 살아남아야 한다.
귀여운 픽셀 아트: 아기자기한 도트 그래픽과 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 디자인.

title: Gloamryn
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gloamryn!
A mystical strategy game set in a world of eternal twilight, where survival is as much about cunning as it is about strength.
In this land of fading light, resources are scarce, enemies lurk in the shadows, and magic pulses through the earth itself.
Build camps, gather supplies, and master the art of tactical combat as you lead your people through the unknown.
Will you seek refuge under the glowing leaves of the Healing Tree, strike dangerous bargains with witches, or carve your own path in the twilight?
The choices are yours – welcome to Gloamryn.
Tactical Combat - A Unique Card Game
Tactical combat in Gloamryn takes place through a unique, specifically designed card game. Your units, their equipment, and their abilities shape every battle, while each faction brings its own way of fighting. No two encounters play out the same.
Strategic Map

title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
description:
게임 정보
Yellowcake is an audio game. This means that the entire world and story are told in sound. To navigate in this game, you will need headphones or some other kind of audio device that allows you to localize sounds. Close your eyes and dive into a world like no other!
Yellowcake is a first-person experience. You play as Vident, a young man with a special gift. He can hear objects, animals and humans - but not just in the ordinary way. Vident can hear people even if they stand perfectly still and hold their breath. And he can hear the rocky walls of the uranium mines, in which he lives and works - and whose secrets he will soon discover. This talent helps him navigate through twisty caves and sneak past guards who try to stop him.
Yes, this game will be suitable for sightless and visually impaired players.

title: Backpack Guardian
description:
게임 정보
You are the last guardian and the last hope of your people, and the dark forces are spreading fast! Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run.
Engage in a fun, fast-paced combat where precision and quick reflexes are key. Master and unleash powerful magic to dominate the battlefield!
Strategically position and rotate items of varying sizes to maximize your limited inventory space. Each item has unique effects and can influence the stats of neighboring items. Choose wisely and carry what you need for success!

title: Collapsed Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Travel to planets
Travel the galaxy in search of planets rich in ores.
Explore and dig into the ground for valuable ores
Terraforms the planet and collects ores.
Sell ores
Remember that the company takes 30% of your earnings but that's the price you pay to return to Earth.
Buy new equipment
Jetpack, radar, sand vacuum, icebreaker, etc. Everything needed to optimize ore extraction.

title: Gimlé Trials
description:
게임 정보
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.
Key Features:
Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.
Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.
Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.
Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.
Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.
Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

title: Isoge
description:
게임 정보
Forge Your Dream City in Isoforge
Explore a vast island, design your perfect city, and defend it against relentless invasions! Isoforge combines strategic city-building with dynamic events, giving you endless possibilities to shape your world. Are you ready to build, defend, and thrive?
Build & Expand
Start with only a rocket and expand into a sprawling city. Choose from a wide variety of buildings, each offering unique effects that influence others positively or negatively. Unlock new structures, upgrades and events influencing your city in new ways.
Recruit & Defend
In Isoforge, threats are never far away. Recruit soldiers, unlock new units, and prepare for invasions. Strategize your defenses to protect your city while balancing resources and expansion.
Dynamic Events
Each in-game day brings new surprises! From invasions and upgrades to building unlocks and unexpected challenges, every moment keeps you on your toes. Can you adapt to the ever-changing world of Isoforge?
Unique Interactions
Buildings don’t exist in isolation. Every structure in Isoforge interacts with others, either enhancing their effectiveness or creating obstacles. Master this system to optimize your city and overcome challenges.
Gamemodes
Choose from different gamemodes, challenging you in new ways or giving you an even more relaxing experience.

title: Blood Curse Legions
description:
게임 정보
피의 저주 군단
게임에서 당신은 뱀파이어의 창시자로서 피의 저주 군단을 이끌고 세상을 휩쓸며 뱀파이어 국가를 세우고 지역을 지배하게 됩니다.
이 게임은 최대 4명의 플레이어를 지원하며, 협력 및 경쟁 모드를 제공합니다.
플레이어는 주로 전투에서 뱀파이어 기병 군단을 제어하며, 다양한 상황에 따라 포메이션을 변경하여 최대한의 피해를 입히고 지원 포메이션을 사용자 정의합니다.
영웅 유닛: 영웅은 랜덤 속성을 가지며, 매번 다른 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 일반적으로 4가지 유형이 있습니다:
탱크
약탈자
원거리
마법사
풍부한 스킬 선택을 통해 영웅의 성장 방향을 사용자 정의할 수 있습니다.
다양한 유형의 군대:
방패 보병
창 보병
원거리 부대
괴물 부대
비행 부대
자신만의 뱀파이어 성을 건설하세요: 여러 층의 성을 건설하고 전리품으로 장식할 수 있습니다. 성은 파괴될 수 없습니다.
적의 공격을 막기 위해 전방 요새를 건설하세요. 전방 요새는 파괴될 수 있습니다.
장비 및 제작 시스템: 무기 및 기타 중요한 아이템을 결합할 수 있습니다.

title: GraviTech
description:
게임 정보
From a Different Angle
In this 3D puzzle game, you will find yourself in a space laboratory dedicated to studying gravity. You will face numerous challenges that require you to see the world from a different angle—because here, gravity can be directed in any direction.
What You'll Find in This Game:
A variety of exciting levels
Over 10 unique interactive objects
A chance to test your sense of balance
Platforming sections
Level Editor
If the levels created by the developers aren't enough for you, you can create your own! The game features a flexible level editor to bring your ideas to life.

title: Why Do Boys Play Games?
description:
게임 정보
Why Do Boys Play Games? is a turn-based tactical strategy game that allows you to interact with your opponents when you aren't battling in an attempt to simulate the camaraderie and competition of an actual fantasy football league. You begin by creating a character, completing an optional tutorial, and drafting a custom team of players.
You then take those players into battle. Each player has distinct moves and passive abilities, many of which can synergize with each other.

title: Diffusion
description:
게임 정보
Use mining drills to gather ores and smelt them to gain building materials.



Defend your mining site from waves of disgusting hostile alien creatures.

title: TYRONE vs COPS 2
description:
게임 정보
Tyrone was minding his own business, when the cops rolled up with weapons drawn, claiming that they had a warrant for his arrest (again)... It's time to teach those pigs another lesson! This is a rogue-like third person shooter exploring the reality of police brutality in America.
Featuring all new mechanics and a new map, Tyrone is back and blacker than ever!
Features
Play as Tyrone
Hold your gun sideways
Shoot it at cops
Loot their weapons after you kill them
Over a dozen different types of enemy cops, including BOSS COPS
Awaken the latent power of your melanin using kills from your past lives
Over 40 different perks and abilities to improve Tyrone's cop-killing capabilities
Receive assistance from cute Federal Agents

title: Scenes from the Heart - Part 1
description:
게임 정보
In this heartwarming Visual Novel, you will aid two of your new classmates while also getting to know them better. Explore the world of improv theater, tease the group's Tsundere, learn about their backstory, and work together to create your own Visual Novel.
Scenes from the Heart is a classic Visual Novel about a mature but lonely boy (you) who struggles to connect with others due to his superiority complex. His life changes when he befriends Chisaki Namichi, who faces bullying for her unique eye color at elementary school. Together, they later discover Konaka Motomi, a new transferred classmate with her own quirks.
As they bond, Konaka introduces improvisation theater to Chisaki and you. Inspired, Chisaki initiates her long dream of a visual novel development project, involving the player and Konaka. Despite initial conflicts during the process, they succeed and win an award for their demo, as a menacing shadow is watching over them, hinting at challenges ahead...
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The story will be split into two parts:
Part 1 is more like a prologue to introduce the starting point and the main cast.
Part 2 (TBA) will be diving deeper into everyday life and branching the story at a certain point.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: WildAge
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a magical world where you play as two adorable dragons, each with their own unique abilities. One is agile and jumpy, able to leap over gaps and climb high platforms. The other is strong and clever, capable of pushing magical stones to open paths and solve puzzles.

Together, they travel through colorful worlds, collect shimmering magical crystals, and overcome fun yet challenging obstacles. Only by working as a team can the dragons reach the portal that leads them home — to the enchanted Dragon City.

This game encourages logical thinking, coordination, and teamwork, making it a perfect adventure for young players who love magic and exploration!

title: Echoes of Myth
description:
게임 정보
Echoes of Myth is a roguelite soulslike set in a broken, ever-changing fantasy world where gods have fallen silent. Choose your class and path, tactically battling enemies and bosses. Collect unique loot, unlock talents, and permanently enhance your character. Die, learn, and rise stronger.
Soulslike Combat
Engage in challenging combat against formidable enemies and bosses. Utilize a mix of melee attacks and spells, relying on well-timed dodges and parries to survive. Choose from different classes, each offering a unique weapon, spells, and talents that fit your playstyle.
Explore a Fragmented Fantasy World
Navigate through a broken, ever-changing realm where gods have fallen silent. Chart your own course through multiple routes filled with secrets and mysteries to uncover. Each path offers new challenges and discoveries in this dynamic world.

title: Cafe Maid - Classic Edition
description:
게임 정보
Summary - Idler Gameplay
In Cafe Maid serve your guests' needs in your own idle café. Your harem of cute anime maid girls earns you money even while you are shaving or watching your favorite movies, and when you come back, you can spend all that to make your cafe the biggest success around the globe. The game scales almost infinitely.

Grow your business through managing cute maid girls, deploying them in your cafe to serve your guests. As your business grows, more girls join. Flirt with them, get to know them deeper through engaging conversations, watch them open up, and change for the better (or worse) because of you.
Key Features
Chill Idle Gameplay
An enjoyable fusion of idle & clicker gameplay, allowing you to wind down a bit. Cafe Maid will not ask much of you, allowing you to focus on the girls and their stories while their business progresses on its own.
Upgrade Your Company
Once reaching a high collective level, sell your company to an investor for profits, and start over with a new girl added to the team. Spend the profit you earned on brand strategies, raising the girl's efficiency while working in the cafe. Through your previous successes your consequent businesses earn more coins, and attract more guests to be entertained.
Tasks and Achievements
An endless rotation of random tasks around the cafe will keep you busy, earning you extra rewards, such as fresh look for the girls and the cafe, gifts to give to the girls and more. In game achievements reward your mileage, allowing you to access great rewards through earned tickets.
Managing
Hire the cutest maids, selecting from a large variety, starting with your tsundere stepsister: a punk singer, an aspiring pie cook, a classic twintailed maid, a seductive fox girl and more. Set the girls up to meet the guests' needs, whether it's preparing and serving cakes and drinks, dancing and singing for them and more.
Flirting
Flirt with any and all of the maid girls of your cafe, earning their friendship and love beyond the role of being their boss. Give them gifts, take them on dates, flatter and tease them; each girl reacts differently, and their true nature reveals itself as you talk to them, but so will they reveal your true nature.

title: captain midnight
description:
게임 정보
Captain Midnight is a first-person horrific mystery game about what happens after the end of the world. 
It started small. A few sick people here, a few sick people there. Then there was thousands, millions. We called them "the drowned," on account of us not being all that creative back then. They ran for the ocean until the air left their lungs and the squirming masses burst from their eyes like confetti. Real mess, I tell ya. I saw it myself once or twice. Don't recommend it. 
Save The World
Just kidding. The worlds cooked, rotten. You missed the boat on saving it by a few decades- but there's still good to be done. 
A new disease is spreading amongst the survivors, a real doozy. I'll spare ya the details but let's just say somethings eating all of their memories, gobbling them right up. And then replacing them with fake ones. Ive seen em talk for an hour about kids they never raised, that never existed.
And then...well, it gets worse. Rather not write it down, to be honest, so I'll brief you on the way. Not good to dwell.   
Find Patient Zero
Someone started this, Captain. Someone dove too deep, deeper than deep, I reckon, and caught something other than dinner. 
To kill it, youre gonna have to find it. Find where it started. Find the source and snuff it out. 
It won't be easy, no sirree, you'll have to use all your grandfather's tools to track it. I know his body's still warm but the tide doesn't wait.

It never stops and neither do we, my young friend. 
Ill be waiting at the docks for you. Bring a change of clothes.
-- Twilight Kid

title: Western Death
description:
게임 정보
In Western Death, you navigate through rooms, slaying creatures, earning experience, and collecting new weapons. With each level-up, you can choose from various cards that grant unique perks and bonuses, enhancing your abilities and playstyle.
Story Introduction:
In Western Death, you play as Jack Wotson, a fearless bounty hunter on a mission to track down the notorious serial killer John Willams, a man with the power to wield magic. Your goal is to stop Willams before his dark sorcery brings ruin to the world.

title: 1234 connect puzzle
description:
게임 정보
-- How to play --
- Connect 3 or more numbers, such as 1, 2, 3, in descending order, then release your finger.
- The connected numbers will rearrange themselves in the order they are linked and merge into a single number greater than the last one connected (for instance, tracing 1, 2, 3 will result in a merged number of 4).
- You can connect circles whether they're touching or slightly apart.
- Additionally, you can connect the numbers in descending order, such as 4, 3, 2, 1.
- Remember to connect the numbers one at a time, following their order.
Examples of Valid and Invalid Moves:
Valid: [1, 2, 3, 4]
Valid: [2, 3, 4]
Valid: [3, 2, 1]
Invalid: [1, 2]
Invalid: [1, 2, 4, 5]
Invalid: [1,2,3,2]
When no more numbers can be connected, the game is over.
-- Feature --
- With no time limit, you can enjoy the game at your own pace.
- Experience gameplay free from flashy distractions.
- Immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of the BGM and the satisfying sound effects when tracing or generating numbers, designed to relax and enchant.
- Challenge players from around the globe in the score rankings.
- It's easy to dive into, but once you start, you'll find it hard to stop.

title: Subjectivation
description:
게임 정보
You can't afford to look away any longer
In Subjectivation, you have to take matters into your own hands.
You tried to avert your eyes and forget what has been done. The perfectly tuned, entropy-draining electromagnetic waves caught up with you anyway. 
Now, your only option is to return to the source of the signal. What you do with this oscillator is up to you, but you simply have to do something. During your journey you’ll rediscover what fate befell the snowy town  - and use that knowledge to shape the future with your own two hands.
You can't afford to look away any longer.
And when you finally turn back, you will
Collect keys, find useful items, and jot down notes to help you solve puzzles that will affect the story’s outcome 
Fight off the town’s inhabitants warped into unrecognizable creatures by the corrupting signal
Manage your body heat by finding the few rare sources of warmth in this wintery town
Explore the town’s exteriors and interiors with your trusty lighter and notebook in hand
Talk to those you've wronged and find out whether you can convince them to find forgiveness in their now-frozen hearts
Shape the town's future with the ways you solve the puzzles and approach the conversations you will be presented with

Twenty Six is an action packed bullet hell that you play through the multiverse- and experience how it was made in parallel dimensions!

title: SPACEROCKS
description:
게임 정보
You are an obsolete model of space drone created for one purpose: mining resources. You were meant to be taken out of commission along with the others, but somehow, you've awakened just in time to avoid the culling. You know that there is an entire Universe out there for you to explore, but it won't be so simple: the other drones can sense that you've gone rogue, and will attempt to destroy you on sight. Your new mission: build enormous strength, wealth and infrastructure necessary to overcome the tremendous power of The Corporation, and escape to a remote area of space far from its control.
In order to escape far enough away from the reaches of The Corporation, you will ultimately need to build a Wormhole Machine. To accomplish this, you will need many supporting factories constructing the necessary parts and Generators to power them.

title: Who Is Ethan?
description:
게임 정보

당신은 버려진 병원에서 눈을 뜹니다. 혼란스럽고 혼자라고 느끼지만… 무언가가 지켜보고 있습니다.
팀원들과 협력하여 암호 같은 단서를 해독하고, 으스스한 복도를 탐험하며, 이 벽들 속에 숨겨진 왜곡된 진실을 밝혀내세요.
하지만 기억하세요… 어떤 질문은 절대 답하지 않는 것이 좋습니다.
🔪 악몽 속에서 살아남을 수 있을까요? 🔪
주요 특징:
👥 1~4인 협동 플레이: 친구들과 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 공포에 맞서세요.
🕵️ 깊이 있는 미스터리 & 조사: 불안한 퍼즐을 풀고 진실을 조각 맞추세요.

당신은 이 병원을 탈출할 수 있을까요… 아니면 그 전설의 일부가 될까요?

The mountain’s belly is vast, dig wherever you please. If your intuition guides you well, you’ll discover countless enigmatic chambers, corridors, and halls filled with riches. Key Features
🌍 Build and Expand
Build a vast colony with modular bases, farms, mines, and research labs.

Balance oxygen, food, and energy systems to avoid collapse.

title: Prism of You
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the Prism, a unique emotional sandbox simulation where the player's goal is balance. Identify, engage, and express eccentric alien creatures that represent human emotions.
What’s hiding in the dark fog? Using sounds, movement patterns, and thoughts as hints, learn how to identify your emotions before you can start engaging with them. It gets easier as you go!
It’s important to engage with your emotions in a healthy way instead of bottling them up. Give your Emoes attention to maintain them, and build structures to help manage your Emoes more effectively. Your Emoes also have unique properties. Emoes of the same type can merge to create higher intensity emotions, and Emoes holding too much charge will split into more Emoes. Learn how to manage your population of Emoes and keep your Prism in a steady equilibrium.
Expressing your emotions can be relieving and cathartic. Express your Emoes to release charge from the system and help keep your Prism in balance.

title: Casual Cruise
description:

Casual Cruise is a driving game with a focus on drifiting! The handling of the cars is a mix of realistic and arcade feeling. Grind

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.

닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.

고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!

title: Bear Brigade: Ocean Attack!
description:
게임 정보
The Ursine Nations have always had a less than stellar relationship with the neighboring Aquatic Kingdom— likely on account of the bears’ favorite delicacy: fish. Despite this, the two societies have enjoyed relative peace, both respecting the treaty that ended their feud all those years ago. However, unrest is churning in the waves and the fish of the Aquatic Kingdom have suddenly decided to invade the bear’s territory! As the leader of the Grizzlies, one of the factions within the Ursine Nations, it is up to you to fend off these intruders.
Rally your troops...
Command the battlefield as a fierce Grizzly warrior and use your resources to deploy a variety of bear units.

title: Divine Move 神之手
description:
게임 정보
Divine Move
This game is inspired by a significant international Go competition in January 2025, which ended with dramatic and controversial results.
This is not a Go game. The game supports up to 8 players, with players taking turns using the same mouse to play.
Each player's block contains a certain number of gems. The next player will collect these gems. The longer a block stays on the board, the more gems it accumulates. When the last block is placed ,the player who collects more gems than the target amount wins.
Purchase special items: You can buy various cards and items in the shop to enhance the gem's extra rewards. Use your funds wisely.
20 variant shapes,
40 types of cards,
50 items,
Any item may change the course of the game.
Build your best profit combination: Each round requires you to filter your blocks and adjust your deck to maximize your profits.
Beware of robbers: Through various items or cards, other players may steal your gems. Of course, you can steal theirs too.
Level editor and Creative Workshop: You can design scenes yourself and share them in the Creative Workshop for other players to download.
Don't let high-value blocks fall: If a block falls, it will not yield any rewards. Plan your strategy carefully, and think about how to place high-value blocks. If necessary, sacrifice low-value blocks.

title: Strider Arena
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for drop in Strider Arena, a mobility mech arena shooter for you and some friends to duke it out. Last team standing wins, so kit out your strider and make sure the only team left is yours! Equip up to 4 unique weapons at a time for adaptability and solid performance in any situation, or go all in with 4 Lasers and melt yourself to slag seconds after vaporizing all your friends. Harass opponents from a distance with railguns, or rush them down with shotguns and grappling hooks. Play it safe with low risk weapons, or bet your life on one hugely damaging shot with the ion projector. Weapons in Strider Arena are designed to encourage a wide variety of playstyles, keeping gameplay fresh, and your enemies guessing. If 4 weapon slots wasn't enough customization, chassis mods may be the final piece you need to cement your build. Chassis mods are doled out between rounds and affect the core stats of your strider, often having both upsides and downsides. Choose the right chassis mod with the right weapons, and you'll truly be a force to be reckoned with in the arena.

title: MuteX+
description:
게임 정보
PUBLIC PLAYTEST IS OPEN NOW!! YEA!!
Content you see is still subject to HEAVY polish.
Heavily inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. 
____________________________________________________________
OVERVIEW
You play as Brigand, a researcher given an experimental weapon by her company's military division. She must cut through and search the nearby nests by force in hopes of finding something that will end her company's stagnating war, whether it be a simple resource or the secret workings of a completely different organization.
Within these nests are many different Anobrites, which are slimes with chitin parts. Each species has its own behavior and abilities, and they can mutate into completely different species by combining with others.
Brigand's moveset consists of a simple slash, punch, and dash. Each ability has its own properties and variants depending on when it is used, giving the tools needed to take on any situation. Additionally, specific tricks and combos (such as killing multiple Anobrites with one swing) reward the player with extra dash meter.

____________________________________________________________
GAMEPLAY
Brigand automatically moves and aims towards the player's cursor, rewarding mastery with smooth and precise gameplay (though there will be controller support for a conventional 1-stick experience). There are also very few ways to get i-frames; movement and positioning is key to avoid getting hit.
To beat a nest, the player simply kills enemies until the enemy count reaches 0. After defeating the boss that spawns at that point, the player beats the nest and can move on to the next one.

Bonus modes include an endless mode for each nest after clearing their normal mode and a boss rush after the last nest is completed.

title: Damashi Game
description:
게임 정보
Damashi Game에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
Damashi Game에서는 플레이어들이 퍼즐, 사회적 도전, 장애물 코스에서 서로 경쟁하며 궁극적인 상을 차지하기 위해 서로를 이기고 살아남으려고 노력합니다.
개요:
전략, 심리학, 빠른 사고가 가장 큰 무기가 되는 스릴 넘치는 멀티플레이어 사회적 속임수 경험인 "Damashi Game"의 세계에 발을 들여보세요. 모든 행동이 중요하고 모든 말이 마지막이 될 수 있는 게임에서 플레이어들은 일련의 치열한 도전에서 서로 맞서 싸우며, 기술뿐만 아니라 상대를 속이고 이길 수 있는 능력을 테스트합니다.
"Damaashi Game"에서 승리하는 유일한 방법은 살아남는 것입니다. 그리고 생존을 위해서는 속임수의 기술을 마스터해야 합니다. 고위험의 1대1 결투에서든 적들과 함께 위험한 장애물 코스를 통과할 때든, 당신의 결정 하나하나가 생사의 갈림길이 될 수 있습니다.

title: Blitloop
description:
게임 정보
Blitloop is a fast-paced, retro-styled space arcade shooter. You play as “Blit” on a mission to rescue orb pods and save the galaxy. Take down countless enemy ships and face massive bosses as you zip through a stylish world. And at the same time, rush to rescue the pods scattered across the level before they are captured by the enemy.

Blitloop blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade old-school SHMUPs with the tactical elements of modern hardcore bullet hell shoot 'em ups. Earn power-ups to enhance the ship’s weapons, keep the bombs and missiles fully stocked, and prepare for fluid arcade action, stylish graphics, and an '80s synthwave soundtrack.

Achieve a high score by keeping the score multiplier at its maximum and planning for additional combos.
Story

In the future, the Galactic Federation and the pirates of planet Zirkoid are at war. On planet EX4042, the Galactic Federation is mining a powerful orb that powers all crafts and weapons that are keeping the pirates at bay.

An infiltrator droid from Zirkoid intercepted the information of the whereabouts of EX4042 and sent a fleet of forces to steal pods containing the valuable minerals.

The Federation was taken by surprise and was immediately outnumbered. This can be the end of the prosperous Federation and lead to a new era of darkness where pirates of Zirkoid could destroy countless planetary systems.

But all hope is not lost…

Meet Blit, a space bounty hunter that was tracking down a Kessel smuggler in a nearby solar system. She picked up the distress calls from EX4042 and immediately changed course, making her way to the orb mining planet

With her genetically modified spaceship that can absorb orb minerals to enhance into a range of weaponry, Blit is the Federation’s last hope to stop a galactic destruction.
Game Features

title: Umbra Lumen
description:
게임 정보
You are dead...
So, yeah, sorry to tell you this, but you are, so... Anyway, I just thought you wanted to know. By the way, welcome to "Beyond Life." As for what this place is for… honestly, I have no idea.

Deckbuilding and Puzzle?
I know this sounds kind of weird, but hey, you're already here so you may as well try it. The idea is that your Tarot cards are powerful puzzle pieces that you can use to combat foes. You can build endless combinations with their own sets of mechanics and personalities. But there's a catch: you will need to adapt because the cards you find are pretty unpredictable. Which, now that I think about it, is kind of ironic given the whole "Tarot" thing.

About Beyond Life
To be honest, I think this whole place is a test, some kind of "purgatory." Reincarnation? Oh yeah, I've heard that too. But there are all sorts of wild theories floating around. Some say we’ll be reborn based on how we lived before, part of some endless cycle. Others are convinced this is Valhalla, where we wait for Ragnarok, the final battle. Some think we’re here to be judged, either sent to paradise or punishment. Then there are those who say the way you died determines your fate, and depending on it you need to climb the levels of the underworld. This would be a problem for me, I don't even remeber how I died!
How about you? Maybe you should explore a bit before jumping to any conclusions.

Coming soon!
The game is still in development, but is all steam ahead so it can be launched as soon as possible! I document everything on YouTube and take feedback and ideas on my Discord. So, don’t be shy—hop in and join the journey!

They searched not for wisdom, but for a doorway.
A method to gain entry into the sacred realm where no mortal was meant to tread.
They were approached by a stranger offering this forbidden knowledge.
A powerful god who guided them along a mysterious path.

title: IntelRoach
description:
게임 정보
In a world where information is the most valuable asset, your mission is to obtain data that could change the course of scientific progress and shape the future. By taking control of a miniature cockroach, you’ll infiltrate restricted areas, bypass security systems, and face unexpected challenges.
Key Features:
Unique Gameplay: Take control of a cockroach and experience what it’s like to be the smallest yet most crucial agent.
Stealth and Strategy: Your tiny size is both an advantage and a limitation. Use it wisely.
Engaging Storyline: Immerse yourself in a thrilling narrative where no choice is ever simple.
Puzzles and Secrets: Pay close attention to details and use your wits to overcome traps and uncover hidden truths.
Are you ready for a mission where your eyes, ears, and legs belong to a tiny spy?

title: Tailor Simulator
description:
게임 정보
From Workshop to Empire! Manage your workshop as a master craftsperson, design unique clothes, and fascinate your customers. Show your art by working with various materials from cotton to linen, nylon to polyester. Stay organized, meet your deadlines, and watch your small workshop grow into a tailoring business. From the smallest scissor to the largest shelf, transform every corner of your workshop into a reflection of your art. Prove yourself on this journey to become both a talented craftsperson and a successful entrepreneur!

title: MARKSMAN VR
description:
게임 정보
정밀함. 인내. 완벽함.
MARKSMAN VR은 당신의 정확도, 전략, 그리고 강철 같은 멘탈을 시험하는 몰입감 넘치는 가상현실 저격 게임입니다.
정밀한 사격을 즐기고 완벽한 한 발의 짜릿함을 원하는 플레이어를 위해 설계된 이 게임은, 긴장감 넘치는 미션 속에서 당신의 실력을 증명할 기회를 제공합니다.
🎯 임무 개요
은신 및 전략:
정밀한 계산과 신중한 계획이 핵심인 스텔스 미션에서 고가치 타깃을 제거하세요. 들키지 않고 조용히 적을 처치하는 것이 승리의 열쇠입니다.
속도 및 생존:
치열한 타임어택 미션에서 반사 신경을 시험하세요. 다수의 적을 빠르게 제압하고, 총알이 빗발치는 상황에서 살아남으세요.
🔑 주요 특징
🎯 초현실적인 VR 저격 시스템
소총의 무게, 방아쇠의 압력, 완벽한 명중의 쾌감을 느껴보세요. 손의 자연스러운 떨림과 움직임은 현실성과 도전 욕구를 더욱 자극합니다.
🔧 무기 업그레이드 시스템
게임 플레이를 통해 보상을 획득하고, 게임 내 상점에서 새로운 무기나 업그레이드를 해제하세요. 자신의 플레이 스타일에 맞게 장비를 구성하고 점점 더 어려운 임무에 도전할 수 있습니다.
🏆 다이내믹 점수 시스템
정확성과 속도를 보상하는 독특한 점수 시스템으로 최고 점수를 노려보세요:
적을 처치하면 기본 점수 획득
헤드샷 시 추가 보너스
빠른 임무 완료 시 보너스 점수 제공
🏙️ 몰입감 있는 환경
버려진 마을부터 외딴 전초기지까지, 각 레벨은 고유하고 분위기 있는 배경을 제공합니다. 환경은 무대이며, 중심은 항상 저격수의 시선에 있습니다.
🎯 훈련이 완벽을 만든다
기지에 위치한 인터랙티브 사격장에서 스킬을 연마하세요. 임무에 대비해 조준 실력을 향상시키고, 모든 도전에 대응할 자신감을 키우세요.
❓ 왜 MARKSMAN VR인가?

title: AI Clicker
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter! … or a future where it replaces you!
🔹 Collect Bits – Because AI runs on data, not on hopes and dreams.
🔹 Upgrade Your Algorithms – Go from "Potato Calculator" to "Overlord AI" in just a few clicks.
🔹 Automate Everything – Why click when the machine can do it for you? Efficiency is key!
🔹 Experiment with Upgrades – More power, fewer bugs, and some very mysterious bonuses…
🔹 Reach the Singularity – When AI gets too smart, who's really in control? 👀
Click wisely… your creation might have its own plans! 🧠💾
🚀 Download AI Clicker and become the creator… before your AI beats you to it! 🤯💾

title: Puzzle Tales: Arcane Voyager
description:
게임 정보
《Puzzle Tales》 - Where Elimination Meets Roguelike Adventure
Eliminate gems, unleash secret arts, and crush your foes in a grand adventure across the Ether World!
【Smooth Elimination・Strategy Upgrade】
Eliminate gems to charge your secret arts, unleash powerful spells and effects, and turn the tide of battle in an instant.
Expand your strategy from the battlefield to the chessboard, choose from a wide range of skills to pave your path to victory, and combine roguelike elements with multiple heroes for a fresh strategic experience in every battle!
【Build Diverse・Infinite Possibilities】
Take your strategy to the next level with the introduction of new "Arcane Artifacts." Skills, relics, and artifacts - this is the "trinity" of 《Puzzle Tales》!
Even in the face of powerful enemies, the chessboard and pieces are forced to join the "Great Game," making the battle environment ever-changing and the difference between victory and defeat a matter of mere moments!
- From the Solo Developer to Future Adventurers -
This is a game crafted for both "strategy enthusiasts" and "leisure explorers," organically combining the thrill of puzzle games with the strategy of roguelike games to bring you a fantasy adventure.
Join the official community (Discord/Steam Community/QQ group) now, your support and suggestions will shape the future of the game!

title: Dopdop Online
description:
게임 정보
A free-to-play collectible card game set in a sprawling cosmic universe. Inspired by a popular comedic sci-fi setting, it delivers fast-paced, dynamic battles—with absolutely no pay-to-win mechanics!
Key Features
Four Core Heroes
Each hero is tied to a specific race and boasts a unique glowing core color. Build your deck around your chosen hero to unlock powerful synergies and outmaneuver your opponent.
25-Card Decks
Your arsenal includes creatures and skill cards. Experiment with various combinations to find the strategy that suits you best.
Short, Exciting Matches
Each game lasts around 5 to 7 minutes, perfect for quick sessions or extended play. Jump in anytime!
Epic Cosmic Battles
Currently featuring a single arena—a showdown in the vastness of space, complete with twinkling stars in the background. We plan to expand with more arenas and visual effects soon.
Unique Class Effects
Certain class-based cards come with powerful, sometimes unexpected abilities that can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
Gameplay
Turn-Based 1v1 Battles
Challenge real players in tense, strategic duels. Your wits and card combos will be the key to victory.
Helpful Tutorial
New to CCGs? Our in-game tutorial will walk you through the basics, show you how different cards work, and get you battle-ready.
Deep Tactical Options
Every card has the potential to change your fate. Craft a winning strategy and seize the critical moment to outplay your rival.
Progression & Monetization

title: Dungeon Duelists
description:
게임 정보
Dungeon Duelists is an 8 player Battle-Royale/Roguelike in which players duel it out to be the last man standing. The game starts by generating a unique dungeon and letting the players choose starting locations based on a few hotspots on the map. Players gather gear by fighting enemies and opening chests while progressing through the dungeon while a large clock counts down. Players race against the clock to get as strong as possible because when that clock hits 0 all players are teleported to a 1-vs-1 arena and forced to fight to the death. When the stronger player wins the fight, the other player is eliminated and the winner will be teleported back to the dungeon and continue to gather gear while the countdown starts over again. This keeps happening until there is only one player left and that player is the victor.

title: Mob Boss Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Mob Boss Simulator puts you in the shoes of a legendary crime boss, ruling the streets and shaping the underworld to your advantage. Build your empire by forging alliances, eliminating threats, and staying one step ahead of your enemies. But remember—power is a delicate game of strategy, deception, and force.
Run illicit businesses like bootlegging, underground casinos, and racketeering. Rob banks, hijack shipments, and even target rival families’ casinos to cripple their income. The streets are yours to control, but staying on top means knowing when to strike and when to lay low.
Corruption is key—buy off politicians, police, and even newspapers to manipulate public opinion and keep the law on your side. But be careful, as even the most loyal cops have their limits. Too much chaos, and they might turn against you.
When diplomacy fails, violence speaks. Hire assassins to take out underbosses, crew members, or even rival dons. If necessary, wage all-out war, unleashing chaos in the streets as your men clash with enemy families. Just remember—every action has consequences, and only the smartest boss will survive.
Inspired by the real legends of organized crime, Al Capone, Lucky Luciano, John Gotti, Carlo Gambino, Meyer Lansky, and many more, we’ve crafted an experience rooted in history, strategy, and the brutal reality of the underworld.
Do you have what it takes to rule the underworld?

title: Coin Devotee
description:
게임 정보
Play a flip coin game with the devil.
You can keep all the coins you flipped in your pocket.
But nothing comes for free; you'll need to pay the debt in return.
Otherwise, some bad things could happen.
Can you fill your pocket full before you run out of luck?
Have bad luck? Worry not.
At the end of the round, the devil is kind enough to provide one item for free.
The item can be used to improve your game.
And if you have more to spare, you can buy them all!
Try to utilize them to build a strategy to maximize your profit.

title: Little Betty: Gold Rush
description:
게임 정보
Step into this captivating 2D pixel art retro platformer and enter a world where speed and precision determine your success. With a total of 60 levels spread across 4 diverse worlds, you'll experience fast-paced single-screen action: collect all the gold coins, master treacherous traps, and overcome dangerous obstacles.
Highlights:
60 Challenging Levels: Each world features 20 unique levels that will test your speedrunner spirit.
Retro Pixel Art: A lovingly crafted aesthetic that reinterprets classic platformer action.
Precise Platforming: React in a flash to traps and obstacles in single-screen level designs.
Steam Achievements: Earn achievements and prove your skills in exciting challenges.
Epic Final Boss: Confront the ultimate enemy in a battle that decides the fate of a family.
Embark on an adventure full of heart, action, and nostalgia—and let yourself be captivated by Little Betty: Gold Rush!

title: Rope Grabber
description:
게임 정보
Picture this: you are a remnant of a civilization on its way out, after years of prosperity. The advancement of old has been replaced with flesh-eating zombos, ready to pounce at a moments notice. Like any other day, however, your pet needs to use the bathroom and get exercise so they don't tear apart all 0f the furniture.
With the actual purchase in the future  you can likely expect (given met time and budget requirements instead of zero):
a twin stick arcade shooter with a unique mechanic and a tight arcade loop at a sawbuck price.
More pet selection
Varied gameplay and enemy ai
More variation to procedural generation
Multiplayer
Pet, player, and enemy animations that don't detract from the style
Working online high-score system WITHIN STEAM RATHER THAN RUNNING THE EXECUTABLE YOU DOWNLOAD WITHIN STEAM OUTSIDE OF STEAM TO GET IT TO WORK.

title: Malón
description:
게임 정보
In this minimalist strategy game you'll take command of an army fort, tasked with defending it at all costs. To succeed, you'll need to expand your base and train soldiers to stand by your side in defense of the flag.
Animals will be a highly valuable resource, enabling you to grow your economy and expand further.
You’ll also have the option to choose the opposing side, establishing your own indigenous settlement and becoming the leader of your people, guiding them in resistance against the huinca invasion.

title: Swingin'!
description:
게임 정보
Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement. Swingin-kun can't generate speed by himself, so be careful not to waste the speed you gain from falling! You can bounce off the floor, stick to walls, alternate between your two arms to attach yourself to the ceiling and move sideways– with some creativity, you can do all kinds of things! Furthermore, Swingin’! includes a level editor so that you can create and share your own custom stages!

title: Shadow Eagle
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Eagle is a secret organization for peace. It is said that it dates back to the Seljuk Empire and perhaps even before that. Recently, they have been fighting for justice all around the globe.
In a recent robbery that took place in one of London's museums, only the portrait of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror was stolen. Deniz sets out to Dublin to meet with the person who was examining and researching the painting before the robbery. While waiting in a pub for the meeting he learns that there will be an attack on the Limon Company data center.
Deniz and his connection Orla make a plan to stop this attack.
However this is just the beginning. What is the purpose of this attack? Why are they going to Türkiye, all of a sudden? Shadow Eagle faces an international criminal organization.

title: Wizard Hand
description:
게임 정보
Wizard Hand is a magical solitaire roguelike about accumulating the maximum number of magical points by mastering the art of combining enchanted cards, transformations, and a collection of magical items.
The goal of the game is to remove the entire pyramid of cards from the table, while scoring the maximum points. Play a matching card onto the pyramid card to start a combo! The more points you have, the more opportunities you have to expand your magical arsenal and be ready for future challenges!

title: Aker Fern 2
description:
게임 정보
Aker Fern 2 – 이제껏 경험하지 못한 비주얼 노벨!
미스터리, 운명, 과거가 현재에 미치는 영향에 대한 이야기를 계속 이어갑니다.
16세기, 미신과 미스터리로 가득한 세상에 Mikołaj Fern 이라는 한 남자가 살았습니다. 하지만 그는 평범한 여행자가 아니라 자신의 운명을 바꿀 수 있는 진실을 발견하고자 했던 사람이었습니다. 그는 공화국 땅을 횡단하며 초자연적인 현상을 추적하고 제거했는데, 이는 인간에 대한 관심 때문이 아니라 피할 수 없는 운명에서 벗어나고자 하는 열망에서 비롯된 것이었습니다. 그의 삶은 공개 처형으로 끝났지만 그가 시작한 이야기는 끝나지 않았습니다.

title: Friday at Ours
description:
게임 정보
Come Join the Party!
Loud music is blaring from your neighbour's flat. All the while you're dead-tired, a little introverted and most importantly: not invited. So what are you to do?
Once you've finally convinced yourself to stop by, you'll find that partying like a pro is not quite as easy as you would have imagined.
Unique Party-Based Gameplay:
Meet a bunch of kooky characters: If you'll manage get a read on them, you might be able to hit it off and become friends.
Solve puzzles: More and more of the party will become accessible to you, as you help out some of the partygoers.
Plan out your actions: In this turn-based time progression system, deciding when to do what is essential for getting the most out of your night.
Increase your Stats: Some partygoers may require you to refine certain social abilities. Strengthen them, to become a better conversationalist.
Collect phone numbers: Befriended characters will want to keep in touch with you. The'll also provide you with helpful tips if you don't know how to proceed.
Multiple playthroughs: You might be able to gather some hints concerning some of the guests deepest secrets. Being observant is the key to uncovering the games multiple endings.

title: The Charity Shop
description:
게임 정보
The Charity Shop is an atmospheric, surreal, first-person puzzle game where you use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived.
To this end, you have been delivered to The Charity Shop, the place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.
Clutch at permanence.
Kick your feet against the rising tide.
When your head is under, it will be over.

title: God in a Closet
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mysterious house of a witch in this short adventure game to find the answers behind a hunter's quest. A strange presence looms over you, you cannot turn back.
FEATURES
A unique hand-drawn artstyle inspired by Angel's Egg and old fairytales
Simple puzzles and easy gameplay
Explore the house, read documents and speak to the witch to resolve the dangers inside
An immersive and eerie experience to be finished in one sitting (under an hour)
GAMEPLAY
Pick up useful objects in your inventory, use them alone or combined to get through the levels.

title: Warrior's Dilemma 勇者难题
description:
게임 정보
마군의 전면적인 공격은 각 분야의 인물들의 도움으로 용감한 사람은 자신의 지혜로 위기를 해결함으로써 세계 평화를 회복해야 한다.
게임 특색:
1. 다음 단계에 무엇을 해야 할지 고민하는 데 중점을 둔다. 몬스터를 잡거나 컴퓨터 캐릭터와
2. 속성 포인트를 합리적으로 분배하고 자신의 강력함을 확보해야 한다.
3. 언제든지 조작을 번복하고 과거로 돌아갈 수 있다. 이미
4. 하나의 큰 지도 관문만 있고 어떤 장면도 존재하지 않는다.

title: Broth Bounty
description:
게임 정보
Broth Bounty is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by classic lightgun games, with a chaotic culinary twist! As a shotgun-wielding chef, you must restore order to kitchens across the country, where ingredients have gone rogue. Restaurants are counting on you to tame the madness and cook up the perfect soups for hungry customers. Aim carefully, make every shot count, and avoid hitting the wrong ingredients—your bullets are limited, and the pressure is on! Shooting the wrong ingredients can have dire consequences...
Features
🔥 Wacky, unpredictable ingredients – Shoot rampaging veggies, flying chickens, and more!
👹 Epic boss fights – Face off against monster-sized kitchen abominations.
🗺️ Randomized roguelite maps and levels – No two kitchens are ever the same.
🔫 Upgradeable arsenal & abilities – Enhance your skills and weaponry to survive the culinary chaos.

title: Don't Touch Us
description:
게임 정보
Don't Touch Us
A psychological horror RPG set in the decaying halls of an abandoned hospital, Don't Touch Us plunges players into a chilling mystery filled with puzzles, exploration, and haunting revelations. Experience a gripping story of loss, revenge, and the supernatural, brought to life with realistic graphics and immersive sound design in Unreal Engine 5.
Story
Anya was murdered. Brutally. Her ghost—shattered into two—now roams the ruins of Doctor's hospital, searching for the truth. As one half of Anya’s spirit, you awaken with no memories, drawn to an eerie voice calling your name, the other half of your lost soul. Together, you must uncover the hospital’s darkest secrets, reunite as one, and confront the entity that ended your life.
But the doctor still lingers… and he’s watching.
Gameplay
Linear, story-driven experience – No combat, just pure psychological horror.
Puzzle-solving & exploration – Uncover hidden clues and items to progress.
Environmental effects – Different areas distort vision, warp sound, and twist reality.
Diverse environments – Each level introduces a new tone and visual style, from dark, oppressive halls to unsettling, empty spaces.
Deep RPG elements – Level-based progression tied to uncovering Anya’s past.
Fully voiced characters – Immerse yourself in the chilling narrative.
Features
✔ Unreal Engine 5 visuals – Realistic graphics with ray tracing, and adjustable settings.
✔ Hauntingly immersive atmosphere – Every sound and shadow hides a story.
✔ A compelling mystery – Piece together Anya’s past and seek justice.
✔ Psychological horror meets shocking scares – A constant sense of dread, broken by heart-stopping moments.
Coming Q2 2025
Wishlist now and prepare to enter the nightmare.

title: Continuity
description:
게임 정보
In Continuity you are sent to a planet similar to earth that is plagued with evil and creatures that seek your blood. Your mission is to clear this world of plague and take over this planet to help fix overpopulation on earth.

Explore this vast world full of biomes and structures to get new gear and materials. Find new enemies in every area you go to. At the start of your adventure you land on this unknown planet "Athea 24Z7" sent to be the hero of earth and cleanse this world of evil. Upon loading into a world you must choose your class which will determine the skills you can unlock as well as the weapons and artifacts you can use. Fight off against bosses to unlock new stages of the story and find new enemies to fight.

You will soon realize the truths about your mission and the story of this unknown world. You aren't as alone as you thought you were, hero.

title: UNDER ROOMS
description:
게임 정보
In Under Rooms you take on the role of a 17-year-old teenager, you find yourself trapped in this mysterious and dangerous environment after an accident. Your mission is to survive, explore and discover your way back home. The gameplay focuses on looting, inventory management and crafting mechanics, allowing you to create and find essential resources for survival.
Navigate a claustrophobic, maze-like environment where every door might lead you closer… or deeper into confusion.
In Under Rooms, the map is not what it seems — observation is key, and sometimes retracing your steps is the only way forward.
Survival isn’t about brute force. It’s about managing scarce resources, avoiding danger when possible, and knowing when to run.
Scattered notes, whispers and hidden details hint at a fragmented story — one that slowly unfolds… if you dare to look in the right places.
Are you ready to descend into the unknown?
Find and create essential resources to stay alive
Search every corner for scraps left behind… or things no one dared to touch.
Combine what you find to craft key items — from makeshift tools to last-minute lifesavers.
Not everything is useful, not everything is spare… and what you don’t craft in time might cost you dearly.

title: Just Keep Looting
description:
게임 정보
Play as one of three classes, the Knight, the Mage, and the Barbarian in this 3D turn-based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Delve into a dungeon in search of loot and experience while fighting off hoards of skeletons and other enemies.
This game is meant to be played Windowed at an aspect ratio of 8:3 that is not designed to fill a traditional 16:9 monitor screen. The game is built with a small resource footprint so that it can be left running while other programs and games are active. During downtime in your other games, fight, level up, and loot!
Have a long queue for a match lobby in another game? Just Keep Looting!
Waiting for friends in your MMO to travel to your location or come back from AFK? Just Keep Looting!
Boss makes a dollar, you make a dime? That’s why you Just Keep Looting on company time!
Fight
Engage in turn-based combat where your decisions make the difference between victory and defeat.
Level Up
Watch that little bar grow as you defeat enemies and earn experience. Leveling up gives you stat points to allocate and increases your health and mana. Continue leveling forever with no level cap… sort of. Your character can continue to level as long as you continue earning experience. If you reach level 8,200 you will not be able to earn more experience. 
Find Loot
Inspired by many classic ARPG games, find randomly generated stats on items of different rarity. Find the best ones to maximize your gear and bonuses.
Characters
The Knight
Stalwart Fighter using Swords and Shields or Greatswords.
The Mage
Magickal Adept using Wands and magical Orbs or Staves.

title: exorSYS
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to exorSYS
After unknowingly upgrading to a cursed operating system, you must follow a breadcrumb of previous victims in order to uncover the truth before you inevitably become a victim yourself. Solve puzzles, dig for secrets, hack computers, and use special programs to help advance from level to level.
exorSYS Report Panel

title: Kiki's Nightmare
description:
게임 정보
In Kiki's Nightmare, players step into the shoes of a fearless hero tasked with rescuing princess Kiki trapped in her own twisted dreams. As the dream world comes to life around you, you'll traverse unhospitable landscapes, battle nightmarish creatures, and possibly solve intricate puzzles that test both your wits and bravery. Can you free her before the dream consumes her mind forever, or will the evil that haunts her dreams claim victory? Only the bravest can conquer the nightmare!

title: FiVe s'hIft masters
description:
게임 정보
slice, stab, and combo your way through four kingdoms and complete the four trials for each weapon! Then, return back to where it all began to learn the ultimate secret technique and help the prince overthrow the evil king!

title: The ULTIMATE Banana Game
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wanted to make your own idler game? Running a crowdfunding campaign and earning millions to make your dream come true? Would you like to know what hardships await a beginner developer? Then The ULTIMATE Banana Game is for you!
make your own game and gain new players
promote and advertise to climb in the ranks, aiming for #1
work with marketing specialists and influencers
run crowdfunding and develop a successful social media account
and much much more!

title: Slice & Dice: Pizza Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보

마리오 미트볼은 항상 최고의 피자 가게를 만들고 싶어했고, 이제 예산에 맞는 곳을 찾았고, 그의 꿈이 현실이 되었습니다. 하지만 부동산이 그렇게 싸게 팔린 데에는 이유가 있습니다...

title: captain midnight
description:
게임 정보
Captain Midnight is a first-person horrific mystery game about what happens after the end of the world. 
It started small. A few sick people here, a few sick people there. Then there was thousands, millions. We called them "the drowned," on account of us not being all that creative back then. They ran for the ocean until the air left their lungs and the squirming masses burst from their eyes like confetti. Real mess, I tell ya. I saw it myself once or twice. Don't recommend it. 
Save The World
Just kidding. The worlds cooked, rotten. You missed the boat on saving it by a few decades- but there's still good to be done. 
A new disease is spreading amongst the survivors, a real doozy. I'll spare ya the details but let's just say somethings eating all of their memories, gobbling them right up. And then replacing them with fake ones. Ive seen em talk for an hour about kids they never raised, that never existed.
And then...well, it gets worse. Rather not write it down, to be honest, so I'll brief you on the way. Not good to dwell.   
Find Patient Zero
Someone started this, Captain. Someone dove too deep, deeper than deep, I reckon, and caught something other than dinner. 
To kill it, youre gonna have to find it. Find where it started. Find the source and snuff it out. 
It won't be easy, no sirree, you'll have to use all your grandfather's tools to track it. I know his body's still warm but the tide doesn't wait.

It never stops and neither do we, my young friend. 
Ill be waiting at the docks for you. Bring a change of clothes.
-- Twilight Kid

title: Vorozhey
description:
게임 정보
In recent months, an eerie stillness has fallen over the city. Women are vanishing without a trace, only to be found later in the forest — heartless, marked with a burned noose on their bodies. The police are helpless, and the locals dare not speak of it aloud.
You are an artist, once inspired, now cursed. Your dreams have turned into vivid nightmares, visions of things that shouldn’t exist… or perhaps already have. Ancient forces whisper through your mind, growing stronger, closer — as if something is trying to break through, using you as its vessel.
Where does reality end and madness begin? Can you uncover the truth behind the victims before losing yourself? Or are you just a brush in the hand of darkness?
Vorozhey is shrouded in an atmosphere of ominous silence, where reality dissolves into ancient myths and personal nightmares. The creaking floorboards, whispers from the dark, and haunting visions make you question your own sanity.
Psychological horror
Slavic mythology
Uncover the mystery of the city

title: Prop Haunters
description:
게임 정보
Prop Haunters is a fun and fast-paced multiplayer party game where sneaky props and sharp hunters collide in a whimsical, action-packed showdown! Dive into a vibrant world filled with adorable environments, where you can play as a variety of quirky props trying to outwit a team of determined hunters.
As a prop, disguise yourself as everyday objects, blend into the surroundings, and evade detection with clever tactics and quick reflexes. But watch out—Runes give you the chance to fight back! Use special abilities like a flashbang to stun hunters, a speed boost to make a quick escape, or temporary invisibility to hide from sight. Runestones scattered across the map let you power up and take the hunt into your own hands!
As a hunter, your job is to track down those mischievous props before time runs out, using your wits and a keen eye to spot the hidden objects. But don’t get too comfortable—Runes also give hunters a boost based on their play style, such as increased speed for agile hunters or enhanced vision to spot props more easily.
With a focus on teamwork, strategy, and laughs, Prop Haunt brings hours of fun for friends and family alike. Whether you’re hiding or seeking, no two rounds are the same—every game is a new opportunity for chaos and hilarity. So, grab your friends, choose your side, and get ready for the ultimate game of hide and seek in the cutest way possible!
Key Features:
Cute, vibrant graphics that make every round a visual delight.
Multiplayer madness for up to 16 players.
A variety of props to play as, from chairs to teacups, each with its own quirky advantages.
Runes with unique powers, like flashbangs, speed boosts, and temporary invisibility, adding a new layer of strategy to each round.
Boosts for hunters tailored to their play style, helping them track down props with special abilities.
Dynamic environments full of unique hiding spots and surprises.
Fast-paced gameplay that's easy to pick up but hard to master.
Are you ready to haunt the props or hunt the haunters? The power is in your hands!

title: Slime Attack: Survivor
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징:
🐾 유니크한 영웅 및 펫 잠금 해제 🐾
퀘스트를 완료하여 각기 다른 플레이 스타일을 가진 강력한 영웅과 함께 싸우는 충실한 펫을 잠금 해제하세요.
⚔ ◆ 6가지의 독특한 무기 타입을 마스터하고 그 이상 ◆ ⚔

쌍검: 빠른 칼날로 공격적인 전투를 펼치세요.
검과 방패: 공격과 방어의 균형을 맞추세요.
유틸리티 스태프: AoE 피해, 적 제어 및 버프.
소환 스태프: 전투를 돕는 크리처를 소환하세요.

title: Code Quest
description:
게임 정보
Fix the world. Learn to code. Uncover the truth.
In Code Quest, you step into the role of a mysterious character tasked with restoring order to a broken digital world. Journey through diverse locations – from enchanted forests and futuristic cities to a cosmic space station and the heart of a computer itself – solving increasingly complex programming puzzles along the way.
With a unique Scratch-like programming interface, you'll learn fundamental coding concepts such as:
Building sequences of instructions
Loops and logical conditions
Managing variables and data flow
Optimizing algorithms
Every level presents a new challenge that requires creativity and problem-solving skills. As you fix the world, you'll watch it transform before your eyes, uncovering hidden secrets and mastering the art of programming.

Key Features:
Learn through play: No coding experience required!
Scratch-like interface: Intuitive tools to build and test your code step by step.
Diverse worlds: Explore forests, cities, space stations, and the inner workings of a computer.
Engaging story: Discover the mysteries of the broken world and your role within it.
Progressive challenges: Puzzles that grow in complexity as you advance, introducing new programming concepts.

Code Quest is perfect for everyone – from beginners eager to learn the basics of coding to experienced players looking for a unique challenge. Can you repair the digital world and uncover the truth behind its fractured surface?
Add Code Quest to your wishlist today and begin your journey into the world of coding!

title: Riftborn
description:
게임 정보
“Riftborn“ 은 인간, 언데드, 괴물 세 진영의 멀티플레이어 슬래셔 아레나로, 인간, 언데드, 괴물이 아레나에서 대결을 펼칩니다. 각기 다른 직업과 능력으로 각 경기는 전략과 액션으로 가득합니다. 저주받은 폐허에서 싸우고 고대 요새의 깊은 곳에서 우위를 점하세요. 각 경기장에는 교활함, 팀워크, 그리고 승리할 수 있는 능력이 필요합니다. 기사의 검을 휘두르든, 마법을 시전하든, 괴물처럼 적을 찢어 죽이든, 한 가지 확실한 것은 혼돈이 지배하고 재미가 멈추지 않는다는 것입니다!
다양한 무기
검, 도끼, 활, 석궁, 단검, 칼, 창, 원하는 마법 등 다양한 방법으로 상대를 죽일 수 있습니다!
게임 모드
Riftborn에는 다양한 플레이 스타일에 맞게 설계된 다양한 게임 모드가 있습니다. 플레이어는 혼란스러운 자유 대전(FFA) 모드에서 전투를 벌이고, 팀 데스매치(TDM)에서 동료와 협력하며, 최후의 팀 순위(LTS)에서 자신의 기량을 시험해볼 수 있습니다.

title: Baspetball
description:
게임 정보
😸 A portion of the profit from this game will be allocated to street cat rescue and support initiatives. 😻
The Ultimate Showdown:
Baspetball is a basketball-themed puzzle game with strategic elements, where the player controls a team of cats, each with their own unique abilities and movement styles. The goal is to plan their actions carefully to score baskets without letting the opposing team of dogs steal the ball.
Features:
🐾 50 handcrafted levels.
🎵 Original soundtrack.
🖼️ 5 different scenarios.
🐈 Cute cats.
🐕 Cute dogs.
🏀 Characters with basketball legend numbers.
🧩 Game experience designed for both think and relax.

title: MEDIX
description:
게임 정보
How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

In MEDIX, you and the Medical Unit IX of the Imperial Army face a formidable challenge. In a story-driven campaign, you'll embark on a journey that will test your speed, wits, and endurance.

Rescue the wounded from the battlefield, gather supplies to care for them, and build infrastructure. Cleverly distribute your personnel between buildings, and when necessary, pack up your structures and use the recycled materials to build new ones or move the entire camp to a different location. In the heat of battle, you must constantly adapt to the dynamically changing situation.

The people you help, and their loved ones, will gladly support your efforts to upgrade your unit or expand your ranks out of gratitude.

War is both terrible and magnificent, and the characters in our story experience its horrors firsthand. Hand-drawn illustrations accompany an emotional narrative about the effort to save as many lives as possible, while also striving to retain one's humanity and hope.

title: Encounter
description:
게임 정보
As fate would have it, you’ve stumbled upon this game. Might as well give it a try. Who knows what you might encounter… ayyy. Get it? Encounter is the name of the game. When I said, “who knows what you might encounter,” it was a play on words.
So, what’s this Tarot thing about? They represent scenarios where you might have to think on your feet, snack on some magical berries, or even get attacked by a [REDACTED]-eating succubus! Fun! But it's not just fate at play—you’ll need to manage your resources wisely, timing your limited actions perfectly as you navigate a labyrinth of twists and turns, and overcome a host of unpredictable events.
Your adventure kicks off with a single crate. What’s inside? Treasure? Trash? A mildly cursed sandwich? Crack it open and find out! From there, anything goes. You’ll encounter oddballs, outlaws, and outright disasters. Duel the friendly neighborhood postman, accidentally infuriate a small child, or face down ambush after ambush—who’s to say? Will you fight, finesse, or just wing it and pray to the RNG gods? Whatever you do, tread carefully—your journey lasts only as long as you do, and the next tavern might be farther than you expect.

title: Operation Zero
description:
게임 정보
Operation Zero is top-down run-n-gun arcade shooter with a sci-fi comedy edge. A mysterious and threatening artificial intelligence is spreading across New America, and only one hero has the brawn, firepower and ignorance to stop it: TASKILLER, the ultimate bio-engineered super-soldier!
You'll need the help of the GENERAL and some state-of-the-art firepower to blast your way through hordes of AI-deranged droids and drones to reach the nerve center of 8 secret bases, each more dangerous than the last.
Featuring:
Top-down run-n-gun action... fans of the late 80's and 90's arcade classics will feel right at home
Twin-Stick controls by default, but configurable to suit other styles
8 missions to take on, containing 5-7 levels each, spanning forests, secret bases and underground AI nerve centers
Arena Mode: a non-narrative "infinite" way to play - see how long you can survive against a never ending barrage of enemies
Randomly generated levels for extra replayability
Plentiful and stackable weapon powerups to form interesting and deadly combinations. Including but not limited to rapid, bounce, spread, split, explosive...
Personal drone powerups to augment your firepower

title: Sadko
description:
게임 정보
Fight or flee!
Not a moment's peace - evil is coming from everywhere and they have one target - to stop you. Wait, I think they're scared of… The letter “o”?! Go ahead, Sadko the singer!
Point your mouse in the direction of the enemy to perform your attack, apply skills for greater effectiveness, and don't let Sadko's health drop to zero so you don't lose progress.
Oh, is that a rock? I'll take it.
Help build a monument to the letter “O” that will banish evil from this land forever - find resources on the map for construction and save up currency to open new biomes.
Folk tales of ancient Rus
Visit five dangerous locations, on each of these the hero is waiting for new challenges, enemies and bosses inspired by Slavic folk tales - Baba Yaga The Bony-Legged, dangerous Koshchey the Immortal and Mavka, who watches from the depths. In short, be prepared for everything, entering uncharted lands...

title: Ox & Horse Work in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Core Gameplay
In "Ox & Horse Work in Hell" players team up with their friends to take on the roles of Ox-Head and Horse-Face, the guardians of the underworld. Your daily work involves battling evil spirits, punishing them, and collecting Sin Points they drop.
There are many ways to punish these evil spirits:
Beat them down directly with your fists.
Pick up items and smash them.
Tie up fallen ghosts on torture devices and vigorously torment them.
Utilize contraptions to create an assembly line of punishment.
Incidental Encounters at Work
Your work in Hell will also involve interacting with various colleagues and superiors, leading to numerous interesting story snippets.

title: Rustic Defense
description:
게임 정보
Rustic Defense is a hexagonal fantasy tower defense game with roguelike elements, generated enviroment with option explore your own way.
Turrets
Like in classic tower defense game, you build turrets that fight with incoming enemies.
You can research 15 types of turrets that belong to five categories (archery, natural, guns, throwing, splash). Every turret has physical damage, advanced turrets adds elemental damage bonus (fire, poison, ice) and special attack feature. Elemental damage rise overtime damage or slowing monsters. 
Enemies
Enemies incoming from four bioms. The Valley is nearest and enemies haven't any armor. Mountains, Desert and Swamp monsters has armor with resistances to specific elemental attack.
Map
Map and enviroment is randomly generated. After each wave you can choose way that you want to explore.
Progress
After every game you obtain experiences depends on reached wave. Those experiences you can convert to skills in skill tree, that give you advantage for rest of game.

title: Car Grind
description:
게임 정보
Car Grind is a kinetic game where you use combos of flips, grinds, and wheelies to power your car while you explore each arena. Your car is powered by combos, doing more tricks allows you to extend your reach from each recharge station.
Grind
Jump on rails and grind your car. Keep the balance right or slide off the edge and crash.
Jump & Flip
Turn your car in acrobatic flips! Don't forget to keep the car upright when you land!

title: Roadside Egg Stand
description:
게임 정보
로드사이드 에그 스탠드는 아늑하고 편안한 방치형 게임입니다. 귀여운 길가의 에그 스탠드를 직접 만들고 관리하며 신선한 달걀을 제공하고 작은 마을의 아름다운 도로에 기쁨을 전하세요.
조용한 시골길을 달리다 알록달록한 달걀과 수제 간식, 그리고 "신선한 달걀!"이라는 손글씨 표지가 있는 작은 나무 스탠드를 발견한다고 상상해보세요. 이 따뜻하고 포근한 느낌이 바로 이 게임의 핵심입니다.
행복한 닭 키우기:
닭 떼를 보살피고, 희귀 품종을 발견하며 점박이 달걀부터 황금 달걀까지 수집하세요!
스탠드 꾸미기:
꽃바구니, 랜턴, 꽃 장식과 손으로 그린 표지판을 추가해 스탠드를 더욱 매력적으로 꾸며보세요.
새로운 장소 탐험:
시골길, 숲길, 활기찬 마을 시장 등 아름다운 장소로 사업을 확장하세요.
신선한 달걀, 신선한 수익:
고객을 응대하고, 적절한 가격을 책정하며, 특별한 요청을 처리해 수익을 올리고 닭들이 잘 먹고 행복하도록 돌보세요!
이번 주의 직원:
최고의 닭들에게 재미있는 타이틀과 보상을 제공하며 가족처럼 축하하세요!
여유로운 분위기, 끝없는 재미:

title: Bear Brigade: Ocean Attack!
description:
게임 정보
The Ursine Nations have always had a less than stellar relationship with the neighboring Aquatic Kingdom— likely on account of the bears’ favorite delicacy: fish. Despite this, the two societies have enjoyed relative peace, both respecting the treaty that ended their feud all those years ago. However, unrest is churning in the waves and the fish of the Aquatic Kingdom have suddenly decided to invade the bear’s territory! As the leader of the Grizzlies, one of the factions within the Ursine Nations, it is up to you to fend off these intruders.
Rally your troops...
Command the battlefield as a fierce Grizzly warrior and use your resources to deploy a variety of bear units.
Buff Your Army: Place buildings and utilize tower buffs to defend your city. 
Spawn Allies: Spawn Grizzly bears, Panda bears, and Polar bears to utilize their unique abilities to destroy your enemies.
First Person: Fight alongside your troops in first-person mode
Build up your defenses...
Use natural resources to construct and upgrade defensive structures like catapults and crossbows.
Tower Building: Place and enhance towers with ranged attacks or elemental effects.
Environmental Strategy: Block river routes, build on high ground, or funnel enemies into choke points.
First-Person Engineering: Jump into the action to reinforce crumbling defenses in real time.
... and push back the tides of war!
