title: You Die Today
description:
게임 정보
YOU DIE TODAY
Step into a dungeon-crawling adventure that combines the strategic depth of deck-building with the thrill of rolling dice. Inspired by the magic of tabletop RPGs, this game brings you a unique rogue-like experience where every roll counts.
Key Features:
Deck-Building with a Twist: Collect powerful cards with unique abilities and build your ultimate deck.

title: SPACEROCKS
description:
게임 정보
You are an obsolete model of space drone created for one purpose: mining resources. You were meant to be taken out of commission along with the others, but somehow, you've awakened just in time to avoid the culling. You know that there is an entire Universe out there for you to explore, but it won't be so simple: the other drones can sense that you've gone rogue, and will attempt to destroy you on sight. Your new mission: build enormous strength, wealth and infrastructure necessary to overcome the tremendous power of The Corporation, and escape to a remote area of space far from its control.
In order to escape far enough away from the reaches of The Corporation, you will ultimately need to build a Wormhole Machine. To accomplish this, you will need many supporting factories constructing the necessary parts and Generators to power them.

title: One More Experiment
description:
게임 정보
One More Experiment is a first person puzzle-platformer based on elemental interactions.  You control The Absorber, capable of absorbing fire and water from the environment.          Use this power to navigate around obstacles, activate switches and alter the environment.
 Four chapters with mind-bending puzzles
Interact with fire, water, vines, pipes, balloons, ice and much more
Use switches to alter the environment around you
Navigate around obstacles such as force fields, spikes and moving platforms 
Explore an abandoned lab complex 
Four unique ambient soundtracks
Xbox Controller support
Single-Player mode

title: Iron Rain
description:
게임 정보
Iron Rain is a race to carnage! As an AI Tank Commander you battle the Nirvana AI and her robot hordes, in this Speedy Twin-Stick Roguelike. Grow overpowered with a vast range of upgrades against a varied and unique army of enemies!
Features
4 Playable Characters, each with different effects on gameplay and a Story Sequence
4 Stages with a 3-phase expanding map, adaptive soundtrack and a Unique Stage Boss
34 Unique Upgrades with 5-10 levels of power
26 Achievements, each contributing uniquely to meta-progression
10 Unique Mini-bosses
14 Unique non-Boss Enemies with unique behaviour
Multiple variations of enemies
22 Unique pickups
Setting
In the distant future, the rogue AI Nirvana, has completed her domination of the planet. In a desperate move, the now late Professor Cera launched her final initiative: Iron Rain.
Iron Rain, is a series of highly extremely advanced armoured assault vehicles: Shire, Quarter, Morgan and Thoroughbred. Piloted by her records of her old strike team. Captain Minnie, Captain Sadie, Captain Cera, herself, and a stranger.
Gameplay
Iron Rain is playable via Keyboard + Mouse, or via Controller as a twin stick.
In Iron Rain, after selecting a character and a stage, you will be faced with a racetrack and a growing horde of enemies. Completing laps of the track will expand it, and increase the enemy onslaught, spawning mini-bosses, and eventually the Stage Boss.
To help you defeat these bosses you will destroy enemies for a variety of upgrades!

title: Secret Seeker
description:
게임 정보
아무도 감히 손대지 않는 것을 수거하라. Secret Seekers의 요원이 되어 잊혀진 차원을 탐사하고 저주받은 유물을 회수하라. 모든 장소는 저마다의 비밀을 숨기고 있다 — 시간을 낭비하지 마라.

title: Rescue Quest
description:
게임 정보
Groups + Roguelike + Match-3
The hero went missing during a mission, and the demon race is about to strike again.
Your task is to find the hero as soon as possible and uncover the mastermind behind the scenes from any clues you can gather.
Scavenge loot during the rescue process
The full version will feature over 100 relics and 80 runestones, with different effects obtained through combinations.
Learn character extra skills at the camp
Each of the 5 available characters has 2 initial skills and 6 enhancement skills; choose suitable ones to further boost your power.

title: Friday Night
description:
게임 정보
I switched on my microphone and let the quiet settle in before asking the first question:
“How did you die?”
I’ve returned to the mansion after years, haunted by old memories. It’s been shut down since the incident. I turn on my camcorder and step inside to uncover the truth.
I’m determined to uncover every hidden detail, documenting the entire process for the world to witness in my camcorder.  No bookcase, painting, or door will go unchecked—every corner holds a secret waiting to be revealed.

title: Eternal Bonds
description:
게임 정보
Eternal Bonds는 두 캐릭터의 시점을 전환하며 우주선에서 퍼즐을 푸는 퍼즐 플랫폼 게임입니다. 당신과 예상 밖의 듀오는 우주선에서 탈출할 수 있을까요, 아니면 퍼즐을 영원히 풀며 갇혀 있을까요?
특징
작은 싱글 플레이어 게임 (플레이 시간은 당신의 지능에 달려 있습니다)
두 캐릭터의 시점을 전환하며 퍼즐을 해결하세요
각각 버려진 우주선의 다른 부분에 갇힌 우주비행사와 그의 로봇으로 플레이하세요
레버를 작동하고, 버튼을 누르고, 포털을 사용하여 출구로 향하세요
흥미진진한 이야기를 탐험하세요

title: em.Path
description:
게임 정보
em.Path is an immersive sim where you travel across a surreal and glitched world in your RV. You play as Em, a novice witch who has traded her memories for magical power.
Live by the road
Maintain and refuel your trusty RV, pick up lone travelers at gas stations and listen to their bizarre stories. Get lost in a maze of unliminal spaces and be dwarfed by impossibly tall buildings. Upgrade your camper and reach the Fragments of Creation hovering in outer space.
Hike to enigmatic temples lost in the woods and set up a camp, work as a hitgirl for the local fuel cartel, rent a truck and transport ICBMs coast to coast or just shoplift from any gas station you encounter, the Road is full of opportunities.
Bullet hell meet boomer shooter
Numbers don't lie, and the spell DISASTER for your enemies! Combine over 200 spells to create over 20,000 combinations. Want a bouncing fireball that summons a goblin with each bounce? You got it! Craving a freezing wind that melts the bones of your enemies? We at Esoteric Heavy Industries have a grimoire for that. Sacrifice VHS tapes and lost media to add new properties to your spells. Keep mixing them to create a transcendent spell that will break the entire game's logic, but beware: the Surviving Gods don't like hubris and amateur witches messing with the very laws of nature.
Class struggle
You starting class will slowly change by doing activities reserved for other classes, you can create hybrid classes and unlock combined abilities.
Witch
Has access to a flying broom and can fire spells with her gun.
CEO
Capitalism, ho! MP is now replaced by cash. Buy companies and mass produce grimoires, hire researchers, and advance the study of magic.
Wrestler
Pummel your enemy to cast spells! Deflect incoming projectiles with your chiseled abs.
Fishergirl
You have a random chance of fishing any item in the game, you can complete the entire game just by fishing.
Cultist
Literally the spy from Team fortress 2, but meaner.
Parkour
See that wall? You can climb it. As long as you're facing a wall, you can keep jumping and wall-running, adjusting your trajectory with the vector gun's recoil and potentially breaking the movement system with bunnyhopping.
Get entangled with the politics of the magical society: discuss the nature of the soul with , have a tea with your patron , get your proposal vetoed by , establish 4 hours workday applied to the entire world with the enchantress .
Exhange favours or threats to gain votes in the Mage Guild council.
The millenium bug has fried most of technology and a future apocaliptic event that will occur on December 21st, 2012, is retroactively rewring history, breaking the world beyong repair and merging baseline reality with fragments of the 92 outer dimensions.
Time is also broken and localized time loops have started to appear, the only way to advance your reference frame and escape a time loop is to move over 80 km/h, easily reachable with your RV.

title: Sit-Back Attack
description:
게임 정보
특징
음료수와 간식을 들고 편히 앉아 팀이 악의 무리를 처단하는 모습을 지켜보세요! 클래스 커스터마이징과 빌드 다양성에 중점을 둔 반유휴형 RPG입니다.
직면하게 될 과제를 해결하기 위해 수천 가지 빌드 옵션을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다!
모두 ZERO MTX로!!!!
60개 이상의 다양한 클래스, 500개 이상의 다양한 스킬, 무제한의 빌드 옵션을 갖추고 있어 4명의 영웅으로 구성된 팀이 300개가 넘는 몬스터, 보스, 울트라 보스를 물리칠 수 있습니다!
독특한 도전과 전략으로 재미있고 빠른 전투를 즐겨보세요.
속도 증가는 최대 20배까지 잠금 해제할 수 있습니다!
캐릭터 및 클래스 커스터마이징
팀을 더욱 강하게 만드는 방법을 결정하는 데 도움이 되는 전투, 통계 등의 모든 측면을 볼 수 있는 매우 심층적인 인터페이스입니다!
모든 클래스에는 고유한 캐릭터 아트와 고유한 기술, 강점 및 약점이 있습니다.
레벨업을 하면 원하는 방식으로 캐릭터를 구축하는 데 사용할 수 있는 능력치 포인트가 제공됩니다!
능력치와 플레이스타일을 크게 바꿀 수 있는 패시브 스킬!
애완동물 및 업적
4마리의 애완동물 중 1마리를 선택하여 팀을 강화하고 특수 공격을 사용할 시기를 제어할 수 있습니다. 기본 스텟도 파티를 강화시켜줍니다!
100개 이상의 성과. 달성할 때마다 애완동물의 레벨이 올라갑니다.
애완동물 레벨은 글로벌입니다. 새 게임을 시작하면 프레스티지 효과를 위해 해당 레벨이 상속됩니다!
펫 스킬은 수동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터의 패시브 스킬을 통해서도 향상될 수 있습니다!
레벨링 및 진행
레벨 상한은 500+입니다!
울트라 보스가 있는 도전적인 맵을 완료하여 모든 새로운 캐릭터 파워 등급(레벨 100, 200, 300 등...)을 잠금 해제해야 합니다!
우리가 찾을 수 있는 최고의 진행 균형을 제공하기 위해 엄격한 테스트를 거쳤습니다!

title: Business Simulator 2025
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 비즈니스 제국을 세우세요!
Business Simulator 2025는 처음부터 시작해 글로벌 거대 기업으로 성장하는 비즈니스 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 전략적 결정을 내리고 회사를 성장시키며, 재정적 도전을 극복하고 경쟁자를 앞지르세요! 비즈니스 세계에서 리더가 되는 데 필요한 모든 기술을 개발하게 될 것입니다. 마케팅, 생산 및 관리 프로세스를 마스터하고 기회를 포착하며 리스크를 효과적으로 관리하세요.

회사 설립:
회사를 설립하고 비즈니스 세계에 첫 발을 내딛으세요.


사업 선택: 전략으로 차이를 만들어라!
어떤 산업에 종사할지 결정하세요. 시장 분석과 경쟁 조건에 기반하여 사업 계획을 세우세요. 올바른 산업을 선택하는 것이 성공의 첫 걸음입니다!


:
제품을 분석하고 시장에 출시하며 수요를 충족하세요!

title: Spiritual Bond ~Breaking the curse
description:
게임 정보



The core gameplay of this game is a "text-based puzzle visual novel".
You'll need to search the cursed environment for hidden "Reifu" cards.
By combining these cards, you'll gradually uncover key events to break the curse.
Afterward, you'll be able to view memory fragments revealed by the "Yuan Shadow".
Through your choices, you can change their fate and guide them to "Higan"!
autokwd: Spiritual Bond ~Breaking the curse, Intertwining fates~,靈緣 ~化謎解咒，緣影交織~

title: Bumble Rumble
description:
게임 정보
평화로운 꿀벌의 세계가 갑자기 공격을 받고 있습니다. 꿀벌 친구들과 함께 전략적 기술을 사용하여 평화를 되찾기 위한 여정을 시작하세요.
범블럼블은 페글린과 타워디펜스가 융합된 게임으로, 다양한 꿀벌과 유물을 이용해 놀라운 조합을 만들어내지만 모든 명중 포인트를 잃지 않도록 주의하세요...

title: BeefArena
description:
게임 정보
Beefarena
Welcome to Beefarena, a wild roguelike ride through an alien invasion of mutant cattle!
Volunteer for Megga Corps
Enlist in Megga Corps today for your chance at glory! Confront the herd in over 150 arenas spanning 8 randomized biomes-- No two tours of duty are ever the same. Do you have what it takes to wrangle this invasion force and liberate earth?
Build Your Arsenal
Fill your weapon locker with the dozens of weapons you find in combat and enhance your firepower with items available in Megga Corp vending machines, conveniently located near the hottest invasion sites! Use weapons like the flamethrower, chainsaw, and electrifying cattle prod!
Round up Your Posse
Bring a friend and battle together with couch co-op! At any time a second player can pick up a controller and jump into the action with the press of a button. Recruit your most skilled allies to bring liberation to earths homesteads, or get someone to bait all those heat seeking rockets!

title: Axis Football 2026
description:
게임 정보
Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.
Axis Football 2026 is currently in development. Please see the development blog posts below for more information!
Full Franchise Mode Features:
Multiple league setup options (NFL-style, Tier style)
All-time record tracking
Player Contracts
Trades
Injuries
Practice Squads
Free Agency
Retiring Players
Weekly and Yearly Awards
Dynamic, tiered league structure with playoffs, promotions, and relegations
Unlimited seasons
Player progressions based on performance, age, potential, and playtime
End of season drafts
Season-long team stats
Individual league leader stats
Franchise stats
Depth chart control
Play, coach, spectate, or simulate matches
League and team schedule viewer
Spectate other matches
Customization:
Complete team creator / editor suite

title: Motocross Evolution 2025
description:
게임 정보

I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Motocross Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1980s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 15 motocross bikes from 40 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motocross bike with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

title: ELARIENNE
description:
게임 정보
ELARIENNE: Everything Comes Down to Luck
ELARIENNE is a pure luck-based defense game where every summon can change your fate.
A defense game where luck shapes your army—and strategy keeps you alive.
Every unit is summoned randomly—from the most basic tier all the way to the ultra-rare Mystic tier.
There are 8 tiers in total, and each unit belongs to one of three races: Humans, Elves, or Orcs.
Each race has its own distinct combat traits, making team-building both exciting and unpredictable.
Want to build your dream army? You’ll need some serious luck.
As darkness spreads across the land, only fortune can protect the world of ELARIENNE.
Test your luck in this ultimate defense challenge.
Runes: Luck or Strategy
What matters more—luck or strategy?
Defeat minibosses and bosses to choose from three random runes.
Bosses grant Support Runes
Epic Bosses grant powerful Attack Runes
Each rune gives you another chance to shape your strategy—or roll the dice again.
Survive 150 Waves
Enemies appear in waves and follow a fixed looping path.
If you don’t defeat them, they stay on the field and stack with future waves.
Let 100 enemies build up on the map, or fail to kill a boss before time runs out, and your run ends.
When too many monsters gather, the darkness consumes ELARIENNE and the world falls.
Hold the line before it’s too late.
Random Yet Tactical
No run is ever the same.
The units you summon shape how you choose runes and upgrades—turning randomness into strategy.

title: Break Shot Hero
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW
Everyone is balls! Flick your balls to victory in this billiards-like tactical RPG!
FEATURES
Angle your shots off of walls & obstacles to find your path to success! Predictive trajectories help you make tricky shots if you can imagine them.
Collect a cast of miniature characters! There are no micro-transactions, no FOMO - only the old fashioned grind. Every hero and monster can be recruited!

title: HyperCoven
description:
게임 정보
You, malevolent King, have learnt the ways of Sorcery
Gather wilful servants by enslaving varied tribes –
Collect trinkets to enhance your fighters in unique ways –
RTS-Roguelite Blend
HyperCoven plays like an RTS, but production of units is automatic.
Capture different Coven which supply troopers for you to send into battle.
Each trooper has up to 7 different attributes that can be enhanced with trinkets found in the world and buildings erected in base.
The Campaign spans 10 hand-crafted missions.
Conquest Mode is about venturing out to conquer the whole (randomized) world, as you would venture into a dungeon.
Invasion Mode is a take on the "wave defense" idea, the world is more sparse, but extra-dimensional invaders are warping in and drop valuable items.
Multiplayer: Frantic PvP, as well as co-op variants of Invasion and Conquest.

title: Brainrot Animals Fighting
description:
게임 정보
Tralalero Tralala vs Bombordiro Crocodilo, who to choose? It's a fighting game based on a famous meme: fight with your friends and win while playing as your favorite characters!
Check out 8 cool heroes at the start!
Choose your favorite, show off your skills and smash your friends in epic battles! Each hero has a unique animation.
Combine attacks, block in time and use your ultimate to turn the tide of battle. Each fight is unique due to individual character animations and a wide variety of blows.

title: Comic Book Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Manage your very own comic book store!
Step into the shoes of a comic book store owner and transform your humble store to a bookworm's haven!
Buy comic licenses, hire staff, and engage in various events such as book signings and collect rare version of comics and sell it at a premium! Use various tools to protect your store from troublemakers and keep your store clean! And explore the surrounding areas inspired by the Japanese backstreets!
Run and manage your own comic book store!

title: A Corgi's Cozy Hike
description:
게임 정보
Follow our Scalisco Developer Steam Page (click our developer name above) to get notified when we release more games that donate to help animals and other causes
Become a SUPERCORGI!
Don't let stubby legs stop you! Collect Corgi Butt Power to use ancient corgi superpowers to climb and soar and prove you're not too stubby to make it wherever you wish.
Be a Corgi Unleashed!
Choose your own path around the island and explore your way. Relax at cozy spots, grow your collections, or talk to locals. It's all your choice. You can even toggle the pixelized Nostalgia Mode on or off in the settings of the game!

title: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.
description:
게임 정보
Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you explore a character through thoughts and momentos you find in stages of their life. Its an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.
 Experience through the eyes of a character as they return to their childhood home, after moving out. What mementos will they find? What thoughts will they go through? Can they be happy? Maybe not. You decide which thoughts to keep or discard. Help them find a better Frame of Mind.
autokwd: Frame of Mind - A game of thoughts.

title: FATHER
description:
게임 정보
FATHER is a first-person psychological horror game about a family who isolated themselves from the sinful outside world in pursuit of salvation.


You play as Caleb — the father, who enforces strict rules, raises his children in discipline, and maintains the household according to God's commandments.
But beneath this perfect facade, tension is slowly growing. As silence and unease settle over the house, an inner struggle begins — and it cannot be stopped.
Explore the dark corners of the home, perform daily tasks, and try to hold onto your sanity as reality itself starts to twist and break.
Isolation and Routine
Live by strict rules. Care for the house, keep order, and oversee the behavior of your family.
Psychological Horror
Watch as familiar things become unsettling. Fear doesn't hide in monsters — it lingers in silence and glances.
Interactive Environment
Open doors, search rooms, find items and fragments of the story to piece together what truly happened.

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description:
게임 정보
Command advanced battle fleets!
Protect your fabricator megaship from waves of advancing enemies in tactical, card-based combat.
Deploy and move your space forces across multiple orbital lanes.
Use high-tech ability cards to support your vessels in battle.
Carefully consider your actions: Units operate on individual turn timers and every card you play brings them closer to carrying out their next attack run.
Enhance your tactics with dual-use status effects!
Ability cards in Hyperspace Deck Command give you an extra bit of tactical flexibility. Every effect works differently depending on if you play them against allies or enemies. Do you want to shield your ship, or contain and prevent attacks from a specific enemy? Do you use fuel to accelerate a friendly or to set an opponent on fire? Should your carriers deploy fighters to strafe targets, or send them to guard your own vessels?
Build highly customizable decks!
Combine dozens of possible fabricators, deck commanders, randomly generated flagships and auxiliary vessels into thousands of possible starting decks.

title: Break
description:
게임 정보
GAME CURRENTLY IN EARLY STAGES OF DEVELOPMENT / SCREENSHOTS AND GAME MECHANICS NOT FINAL
Welcome to Flumenborg, the city that never sleeps... mainly because people are afraid that you'll rob them blind while they do!
"Break, Enter, Repeat" thrusts you into the exciting world of burglaries, set against the frosty backdrop of the Cold War era. You are the architect of your own destiny, plotting burglaries from cosy homes to fortified government agencies, and from jewellery stores to museums, all while navigating the murky waters of espionage and intrigue.
🏠 Plan the perfect heist: Strategise your way from humble suburban homes to high-profile targets. Every decision matters as you climb the criminal ladder in a city brimming with wealth and risk.
🔦 Choose your own approach: Go in with a bang or be stealthy. Plan everything carefully in advance or improvise. The choice is yours!

title: Granvir
description:
게임 정보
Granvir is an action roguelite featuring mech building. Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more.
Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style.
Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir. Defeating enemy ace pilots unlocks their unique parts.

title: Chaos Front
description:
게임 정보
Chaos Front is the latest game of the Chaos Galaxy series, which has been deeply influenced by Super Robot War, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Advance War, and other similar games.
The program, art, and design are all completed by one developer alone.
Form your mercenary corps, move around the map of Centersea Sector, choose missions and join the war between the powers. Your choices will change the fate of people and the ending of the Centersea War.
Partners, enemies, friends ...... There are more than 100 important characters in the game, all with their own stories, identity talents and combat skills, such as commanders, staff officers, merchants, pirates, scientists ...... and even psychics, robots and aliens!
Battleships, submarines, mecha, artillery, fighters, titans ...... There are 100 available units in the game, all with different weapons and abilities.
Units can use a wide range of behaviors such as stealth, space mines, spreading fog, seizing, stealing, ramming, shelling, combating, shields, defensive force fields, and more. We can research the game system to create a powerful army with a variety of different play styles.
We can receive many missions with different story plots at the Mission Centers. It is also possible to participate in battles initiated by the big factions. When we become an ally of a faction, we can even make proposals to the faction to guide its strategic actions.

title: Candy Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
사탕 가게를 열어보세요!
제과 기업가 정신의 세계로 들어서면서 달콤한 모험을 시작해보세요. 나만의 사탕 가게를 열고 맛있는 사탕, 초콜릿, 달콤한 음식의 세계로 뛰어들어보세요.

나만의 페이스트리 만들기
주방에서 창의력을 발휘하고 입맛을 자극할 군침이 도는 페이스트리를 만들어보세요. 맛있는 초콜릿부터 거부할 수 없는 젤리까지 다양한 맛과 디자인을 실험하여 사탕 가게를 돋보이게 하는 시그니처 컬렉션을 만들어보세요.

제품 판매
당신의 달콤한 걸작을 세계에 선보이세요! 열성적인 고객을 위해 사탕 가게를 차리고 달콤한 향기가 분주한 군중을 끌어들이는 모습을 지켜보세요. 판매를 관리하고, 고객과 소통하고, 모든 맛있는 음식이 행복한 고객의 손에 전달되도록 하세요.

사탕 가게의 모든 측면을 관리하여 최고의 사탕 거물이 되십시오. 재고 및 가격 책정부터 마케팅 전략까지 현명한 비즈니스 결정을 내려 수익을 극대화하세요. 매장을 확장하고, 새로운 레시피를 잠금 해제하고, 고객이 더 많은 것을 위해 다시 방문하도록 하는 흥미로운 방법을 찾아보세요.

title: Dangerous Galaxy
Fear The Timeloop
description:
게임 정보
Fear The Timeloop는 시간 루프 스토리텔링과 공포 요소를 결합하여 서바이벌 호러 장르에 신선한 접근 방식을 제공합니다.
보안관 제임스 쿠퍼는 15분마다 죽음을 맞이해야 하는 버려진 병원에서 깨어납니다. 그가 의사소통할 수 있는 유일한 사람은 시간의 흐름이 정상적인 경찰 디스패처 로즈입니다. 그녀의 도움으로 그는 숙적이 설치한 함정을 탈출하려고 합니다.
세 층으로 이루어진 병원 단지를 탐험하고, 퍼즐을 풀고, 적과 싸우세요. 매 순간이 죽음에 가까워져 사이클이 재설정됩니다. 각 새로운 루프는 전략의 변화를 요구하며, 적응력과 창의력이 필요합니다.

title: Slaves of Magic
description:
게임 정보

The world was not prepared for the invasion. In a few months, every kingdom of the known world surrendered to the magic-using invaders masquerading as our old Gods. But humanity has not given up yet! Those who dare to oppose the new world order formed the shadow council in secret, and they tasked You to lead the resistance against these false Gods in this turn-based tactical strategy game.
Build up the resistance

You will need to build and manage bases throughout the continent. These will provide the resources necessary to hire and equip your troops and learn more about the magic the invaders are using. Every region has a unique culture that gives access to different equipment skills and resources. You will always have to weigh the importance of the regions in the strategic situation you find yourself in.
Outsmart the invaders on a strategic level

The invaders' grip on the continent is not absolute... yet. But they have multiple armies conducting missions every month, and it is your job to figure out the best ways to slow down their advance. The invaders have their own goals they try to archive with their armies, and they are constantly assessing how much danger the resistance poses to them and change those plans accordingly.

In combat, you will lead a 6-8 unit team which you can fully customize with equipment and skills. To reinforce the customization, there are no classes, only attributes like sword-wielding or barbarian, which all units can learn. This gives you the freedom to mix and match them to create your perfect team.

The resistance managed to get a working teleporter, which serves as their biggest asset. With proper intel and smart unit placement, your team can teleport to exactly where you need them to be, giving you a headstart on every mission. Position and teamwork are key to completing your objective.

The game is being built from the ground up to focus on replayability. There are multiple invading forces with different enemies and a reactive campaign AI necessitating a different approach. Nor you will be able to access or afford everything in one playthrough, giving ample space for experimenting with different approaches. Every invasion story will be yours to write. And humanity can only hope you are up to the task to save it from becoming Slaves of Magic!

title: Medic: Pacific War
description:
게임 정보
이들에겐 영웅이 필요합니다... 지금이야말로 영웅으로 거듭날 때입니다!

Medic: Pacific War에서 미국의 야전 의무병이 되어 태평양 전선에서 미 육군으로 복무하게 됩니다. 당신의 보직은 부상당한 동료들을 최선의 방법으로 돌보는 것입니다. 현재 가진 지식과 솜씨, 의료 장비만 가지고서 말이죠.

가끔은 힘든 선택을 내려야 합니다...

당신의 선택은 종종 전투 양상은 물론 전쟁 그 자체에 영향을 미칠 수도 있습니다!
또한, 도움을 받는 병사의 운명을 바꿀 뿐만 아니라 작전 전체에도 영향을 미칩니다. 사령부 및 상관들에게서 임무를 받는 것은 물론 동료들에게도 부탁을 받을 것입니다. 명심하세요, 모든 이의 목숨이 소중하지만 이들 모두를 구할 수는 없습니다. 신중하지만 빠른 결단을 내려야 합니다! 조심하세요, 전시 상황에서는 회의감에 빠질 시간도 없습니다!



전장은 시시각각으로 달라집니다. 이 변화에 빨리 적응하여 시간의 압박과 전방위적인 위협에 맞서 움직여야 합니다. 적을 피하되 부상을 입어서는 안 되며, 부상자를 돕되 나 자신과 부상당한 동료 모두 살아남을 확률을 높여야 합니다. 지옥 같은 전장을 뚫고 전우와 함께 살아남으세요.



도덕적 딜레마, 어려운 선택, 사방에서 터지는 폭탄, 이곳저곳을 날아다니는 탄환, 부상자들의 비명과 이들의 상처에서 솟구치는 선혈, 혼돈, 불타는 냄새, 절망과 평화를 향한 갈망까지... 이 모든 건 의 한 장면입니다.

title: Chef Simulator
description:
게임 정보


The Jury waiting for the dinner, and the clock is ticking. All players must be done their cooks before time run out. Here you have to work against your friends and cook well for the Jury requirements.

Chef Simulator lets you a multiplayer cooking experience with your friends up to 8 players. Be the master about 80 realistic cook recipes and experience realistic physics kitchen environment. Use the realistic kitchen tools. Play it your way - help your friends or even sabotage their plates! The game also gives you a sandbox cooking experience with wide ranged foods. You can play all the experiences with up to 8 friends in multiplayer mode or single player mode. If you want to have a relaxing chef experience, you can cook the most basic recipes, or if you want make some serious job there there are very complicated recipes waiting for you, but it doesn't matter either way the things going will be the crazy and most probably foods are start gonna fly.

One of the players can be Jury. You can share tasks with your friends. While a friend taking care of dishes or cooking meats, others can set the table for the dinner.

There is totally 8 game modes available. Both competitive and co operative modes for all type of gamers or you current mood.



- The multiplayer co-op mode allows you to play in a team of up to 8 people to make play as Chefs. There is no specific role requirement within the team, but you are completely free to choose task sharing if needed.

- You can totally customize your personal avatar, including male and female avatars, using an incredibly detailed customization system even face details.

- There are so many activities available in the kitchen. You can apply different strategies here, steal other player props and throw away them!

- Full detailed kitchen available. The method you choose to make your cook totally depend on your creativity.

- Meats and steaks are valuable. You have to cook and prepare them without wasting them. Environmental conditions are steady but be careful about the other players!

- Blowtorch and fire extinguisher can be used actively.

title: Soul Riders
description:
게임 정보
A game of speedy spectres
Soul Riders is a multiplayer party racing game inspired by the cult classic, Kirby Air Ride. In it players take control of one of many little ghosts as they play through the game's core mode, Midnight Mischief.
In Midnight Mischief, players are dropped into an open map for them to explore, collect stat boosts, sabotage other players and experience map-wide events called "Game Changers". Game Changers can be anything from a tornado wreaking havoc on the players, a fissure spewing out a ton of stat boosts or even a meteor crashing into the map!
Once time is up, players will use their upgraded vehicles to compete in a series of minigames. These miningames vary greatly! They could have you racing down a track, flying off a ramp to hit a dartboard with your vehicle, just a good ol' boss battle and many more!
Winner of the minigames takes all!
Players also have the option to play minigames outside of the core Midnight Mischief mode.
Along with achievements, unlockables, an in-game shop (no micro-transactions) and many other fun secrets, there's plenty to discover and experience in Soul Riders!
Create a vehicle that plays the way you want it to!
Each vehicle has a variety of stats that can be adjusted by collecting the corresponding stat boosts.
- Top Speed
- Acceleration
- Handling
- Gliding
- Boost
- Weight
- Offence
- Defence

With your friends help your state to clean up the radioactive sectors of the zone

title: Good Heavens!
description:
게임 정보



비디오 게임 캐릭터가 각자의 세계에서 삭제된 후 가는 영광스러운 사후 세계인 Xant-Rar에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 평화롭고 즐거운 세계지만, 경험치와 전리품을 얻기 위해 파밍하는 플레이어는 눈에 띄게(그리고 고맙게도) 부족합니다. 디지털 저승의 신 마이티 라르가 최근 몇 가지 실수를 저질렀는데, 모든 것을 다시 정상으로 되돌리기 위해 외부의 도움이 필요할지도 모릅니다.

플레이어들은 *한숨* 이 떠다니는 섬에서 싸우고, 제작하고, 농사를 짓기 위해 이 사후 세계 시뮬레이션으로 들어가는 것은 플레이어의 몫입니다. 이곳의 주민들을 만나 마이티 라르가 부숴버린... *한숨* 반복해야 한다는 걸 잊어버린 것을 고칠 수 있을 만큼 오래 살아남아야 합니다.

이 모든 것들은 "Good Heavens!"라고 외치고 싶게 만듭니다.




Good Heavens!는 뭣 모르는 신이 창조한 세계를 배경으로 한 고전적인 사후 세계 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 솔직히 말해서 Xant-Rar는 엉망진창이며 QA(품질 보증) 테스트가 정말 필요한 게임입니다.

이 목가적인 섬은 사후 세계를 '즐기는' 모든 NPC의 데스매치 맵이라고 볼 수 있습니다. 쾌락주의적인 다크 메탈 엘프, 히피 악마, 자본주의 늑대인간, 독실한 종교적 좀비 등이 서로의 목을 노리고 있습니다.

섬이 떠다니니 발걸음을 조심하세요. 주의를 기울이지 않으면, 부주의한 NPC가 "남겨둔" 계곡이나 뾰족한 막대기와 마주칠 수 있습니다.




마이티 라르의 버그 수정에는 기술이 필요합니다. 역동적인 직업 시스템을 활용해 능력을 조합하고 조합하여 어떤 플레이 스타일에도 딱 맞는 캐릭터를 만들어 보세요. 크래프터? 탐험가? 상인? 만능 재주꾼? 이곳이 천국이라면 옵션이 있어야 하겠죠!

수십 개의 퀘스트를 해결하여 정지되어 있는 지형에 평화를 가져오고 도시를 잔해에서 공중 부양하여 NPC에게 (다시) 어떻게 하는지를 보여주세요 ((미안하게도)).

뽐낼 권리를 위한 솔로 게임... 또는 다른 플레이어와 협력하여 XX인 멀티플레이어에서 라르의 창조물을 구출해 보세요!



하지만 사후 세계에는 우둔한 NPC만 있는 것이 아닙니다. 라르가 실수로 이 코드 줄 사이에 훨씬 더 나쁜 무언가를 위한 집을 만들었을 수도 있습니다...

네, 방귀 뀌는 가마솥, 말을 거는 칼, 투명 바지보다 더 끔찍합니다.

수수께끼가 풀릴 때까지 마이티 라르는 지금처럼 계속 하던 걸 하기만 하면 됩니다. 무엇을 망설이고 계십니까? 이 신성한 일은 저절로 이루어지지 않습니다!

title: VICE Undercover
description:
게임 정보
"CONNECTING US ALL WITH TECHNOLOGY ISN'T THE EXCLUSIVITY OF THE GOOD GUYS.
WE SHOULD HAVE SEEN IT COMING."
- GEN. THOMAS GRAY JR. 1985
VICE UNDERCOVER
In an alternate 1980s Miami, the early inception of the world wide web allowed criminal empires, for the first time in history, to operate globally, in real-time, and remain open 24/7. The internet connected the world, but the dark web made crime widespread and virtually undetectable. Creating the golden age of the cartels.

WELCOME TO MIAMI
VICE Undercover is steeped in the unique 1980s Miami atmosphere, from the neon aesthetic, synth soundtracks, and homages to classic crime cinema and TV, to - the cocaine trade. But in this alternate Miami, advanced technology existed much earlier than in reality.

Inspired by true events, the VICE Undercover saga spans across 22 Chapters and over 20 hours of gameplay. Every character and organisation you come across have their own and independent backstory to discover.

The gameplay primarily takes place in a classic operating system reminiscent of Windows 3.1. Players can explore an 80’s-era operating system with over 15 fully working apps, including databases, police apps, illegal cartel apps, and a music player resembling the classic Winamp.

Explore and install new apps that take you deeper into the cartel network. Access confidential information, order hits, monitor security cameras, discover hidden crime networks, and make tough decisions that will put your morals to the test.

Experience a retro-synthwave soundtrack using the Calypso Player, inspired by Winamp Classic. Browse a library of fully licensed retro-synthwave tunes from iconic artists of the genre and including original tracks produced by famed producer LAU.

title: Shopkeeper Simulator

나만의 스타일이 담긴 슈퍼마켓
판매 상품에 딱 맞는 매장을 직접 구성해 보세요. 진열대부터 캐비닛, 냉장고, 냉동고까지 다양한 선택이 가능합니다!


Shopkeeper Simulator는 단순한 게임 그 이상입니다. 여러분의 경영 능력과 전략적 감각을 시험할 도전에 임해보세요. 지금 바로 게임을 시작하고, 진정한 슈퍼마켓 경영인의 능력을 보여주세요!

title: Campus Life
description:
게임 정보
자신만의 길을 만드세요
대학 시절은 인생 최고의 순간이라고 말하기도 합니다. 이게임에서는 그게 사실입니다! 오래 전에 졸업한 분들도 다시 대학 시절의 환상을 즐길 수 있습니다. 최고의 특징과 기술을 선택하여 완벽한 학생을 만들어 보세요. 외향적인 파티 동물이나 열심히 공부하는 책벌레 중 어느 것이든 선택은 여러분에게 달렸습니다! 여러분의 캐릭터와 함께 청춘의 절정을 경험하고 대학 4년의 어려움을 극복하세요...



친구 및 경쟁자를 만나보세요!
대학 생활의 성공 비결은 네트워킹입니다. 혼자서는 어렵기 때문에 비슷한 목표와 포부를 가진 사람들을 만나기 위해 협회에 가입하세요. 미스터리한 입회식에 참여하고 연례 행사를 조직하는 데 도움을 주며 백년 전통에 기여하세요. 협회가 여러분에게 어울리지 않는다면, 다른 학생들과 함께 보통의 삶을 즐기세요. 친구를 만들기 위해 노력하는 동안, 더 흥미로운 것을 발견할 수도 있을 겁니다. 결국, 우리 캠퍼스에서 사랑하는 것은 금지되지 않습니다...




하루하루를 살아가면서도 학습을 잊지 마십시오. 안타깝게도 파티는 모든 문제의 해결책이 아닙니다. 친구들과 혹은 혼자 학습 자료를 복습할 시간을 찾아보세요. 강의에 참석하는 것이 실제로 다가오는 시험을 통과하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다. 믿기 어렵겠지만요?! 그러나 이 모든 혼돈 가운데서 열심히 일하고 활기찬 사회생활 사이의 균형을 유지해야 합니다. 다양한 캠퍼스 활동이 도움이 될 것입니다!




거의 깜빡했던 대학 생활의 성공적인 마지막 요소 - 평판! 성적, 인맥, 심지어 졸업도, 이름이 없다면 중요하지 않습니다. 다른 사람들이 당신을 알지 못한다면 최선을 다하더라도 의미가 없습니다. 결론은 간단합니다 - 평판을 유지하는 것이 중요합니다. 영향력 있는 학생들과 네트워킹하고 목표와 성취를 달성하며 좋은 성적을 쌓아 평판을 쌓아 가세요. 이렇게 간단해요! 가장 유명한 학생으로 졸업하려면 할 수 있는 모든 일을 하세요!

title: 琉奈と悪夢の館
description:
게임 정보
STORY
불운한 소녀 "이치야 루나"는, 어느 날 섬뜩한 풍경의 양옥에서 눈을 뜨게 된다.
그곳에서 본 것은 수수께끼의 소녀와 여러 이형들...
어째서 습격당하는가, 어째서 자신이 이곳에 있는가...
루나는 이형들에게서 도망치며 "악몽의 관"의 수수께끼를 풀고 탈출을 목표로 하게 된다.
과연, 소녀의 운명은 어떻게 될 것인가...
ABOUT
루나와 악몽의 관은 횡스크롤 고딕 호러 어드벤처 게임입니다.
주인공인 이치야 루나를 인도하여 양옥에서의 탈출을 목표로 합시다.
SYSTEM
아이템을 조사하거나, 수수께끼와 미니게임을 클리어하여 미래를 개척합시다.
아이템 중에는 위험한 것도 있으며, 조사하면 바로 사망하게 되는 것이 있습니다.
일부 이형은 루나를 쫓아오기 때문에, 보이지 않는 곳에 숨어서 피하도록 합시다.
수많은 배드엔드와 노멀엔드, 그리고 트루엔드를 준비하고 있습니다.

title: Elation For The Wonder Box 6000
description:
게임 정보
You're experiencing anhedonia so severe you've attained a level of spiritual rigor mortis. You want to be satisfied, but the only thing that would sate you is a game from your youth, released exclusively on a console that never sold, to a marketplace that ignored it. You played it, though, and it was foundational to You. You remember it, but nobody else does; not your fellow forum posters, not the man who lives in your walls, no one. You set out to the city to see if you can find a copy.


Freely explore a dense and open section of the local urban consumer metropolis. Experience all of it's psychic atmospheres, from the highest vantage points to the seedy under-bellies, and the convenience store.
Uncover secrets
Engage in direct, violent culture jamming
Meet various wastoids , sleazoids, and paranoids. Break bread and talk philosophy, politics, and most importantly, the underappreciated classic for the Wonderbox 6000, Elation
God (or GOD, or god, or G.O.D.) is real, and the citizens of the city aren't all in agreement as to what they're up to.
Thousands of frames of real, live clay animation
Solve some puzzles
Indulge in mindless pleasures
Satisfy all desires, physical, intellectual, carnal, spiritual; all of them.
Consult the man who reads fortunes in the wrinkled skins of past-ripe fruit for help. It's better than being stuck, after all.
Take some time to enjoy a nice show.
Make purchases

title: 9 Trials of Whiskers
description:
게임 정보
9 Trials of Whiskers는 매력적이지만 도전적인 3D 플랫폼 게임입니다!
달리고, 점프하고, 위험을 피하며 9 Trials에 도전하세요.
매우 쉬움 난이도로 편안하게 플레이하거나 어려움 난이도로 한계를 시험하세요. 모든 트라이얼을 마스터하고 자신의 고스트 러닝 기록과 경쟁하세요!

title: Potatogeddon
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for a potato revolution? Step into the role of an extraordinary hero – a potato who infiltrates the secret base of potato beetles and other creatures feeding on delicious and magnificent potatoes to stop their sinister plan to destroy the world's potato crops!
Potatogeddon is a dynamic first-person FPS game with roguelike elements that will immerse you in fast-paced action and humorous battles. Explore procedurally generated corridors of the enemy base, collect unique upgrades, and fight hordes of enraged beetles, mutants, and mechanical creatures standing in your way. Each attempt to beat the game is a completely new experience – with randomly generated levels, enemies, and items, no two runs are ever the same!
Game Features:
Fast, crazy FPS action – shoot, dodge, and fight against enemies in intense battles.
Procedurally generated levels – each playthrough offers new challenges, unique level layouts, and items.
Roguelike elements – face new combinations of upgrades, enemies, and challenges with every attempt, making each run a unique experience.
Co-op mode for up to 4 players – join forces with friends to avoid annihilation. Defeat enemies together and become potato heroes.
Humorous tone and stylized graphics – a comedic approach to a serious mission combined with a unique art style makes the game perfect for solo players and teams alike.
Take on the challenge in Potatogeddon and prove that the potato is king! 🥔

title: Isekai Captain
description:
게임 정보
"Isekai Captain" is a 2D fantasy cartoon-style light rogue-lite strategy game. You will play as a captain in another world, leading a team to battle against the demon army.
3 Gameplay Modes:
Campaign Mode (In Development):
A grand strategy mode with a world map.
Strengthen your towns, cut off enemy supply lines, assassinate elite demons, and seize strategic points.
Plan carefully and advance step by step to ultimately lead your army to the Demon King's lair!
Bridge Defense Mode:
A side-scrolling strategy/TD hybrid with 30 waves (expanding to 50 in future updates).
Command and upgrade 4 squads (20 units total). Victory requires mastering game mechanics and showcasing your tactical team composition and leadership skills.
Survivor Mode:
Survive for 15 minutes.
Start with 5 level 1 characters.
Train and command them to endure the onslaught.
Customizable Characters:
Players can customize their characters' race, appearance, starting class, and initial weapon.

title: Virtual Skate
description:
게임 정보
The closest to actual skateboarding you can get. Virtual Skate is the newest evolution of skateboarding games. Your hands control your feet giving you intuitive and next level board control. Skate with friends, customize your skater, grab a camera and film your tricks, or test your skills with challenging obstacle courses.

The evolution of skate game controls... First we had button presses, then single stick controls, next we had dual stick controls. Virtual Skate let's you control the board in all new dimensions. Each hand controls a foot directly, like hand boarding. Instead of having a 2D axis to control each foot, you now have full 3D control over your feet. Not only does this open up a whole new world of board control, it also let's you style your tricks in ways that aren't possible with canned animations.

title: Legacy of Ancestors
description:
게임 정보
야만에서 문명으로—당신의 선택이 가문의 운명, 그리고 사회의 흐름을 바꿉니다.
**《유전의 계보: 과거에서 미래로의 계승》**은
카드 선택, 생존 성장, 세대 계승을 결합한 텍스트 기반 전략 게임입니다.
플레이어는 자신만의 캐릭터를 만들어
원시, 고대, 현대로 이어지는 세 문명 시대를 경험하며
각 시대에서 세 번의 환생 인생을 거치게 됩니다.
그렇게 당신만의 독특한 가계사를 써 내려가게 되는 것이죠.
게임은 매년 운명을 좌우할 수 있는 **‘연간 이벤트 카드 시스템’**을 중심으로 진행됩니다.
해마다 몇 차례의 선택 기회가 주어지며,
우정, 연애, 결혼, 출산은 물론,
질병, 기근, 전쟁, 부조리와 착취 같은 사건들이 당신을 시험합니다.
선택의 결과는 능력치, 자원, 사회적 지위, 인간관계에 영향을 주며,
이 모든 것이 결국 한 인생의 형태를 완성해 나갑니다.
그리고 생이 끝나면, 캐릭터는 저승으로 향해
망각의 물을 마시고, 전생의 기억을 잊은 채 환생합니다.
생전에 자손을 남겼다면,
그중 한 명을 후계자로 선택하여
혈통, 명성, 자산을 계승시킬 수 있습니다.
그러나 후계자가 없다면,
모든 것을 잃은 무명의 존재로 다시 태어나
혹독한 세상을 처음부터 다시 마주하게 됩니다.
autokwd: Legacy of Ancestors,선조의 계보: 과거에서 미래로의 생명 계승

title: Sea Drillers
description:
게임 정보
리틀 리그맨을 관리하여 석유를 채굴하게 하세요.
해적의 공격을 막으며 최대한 많은 수익을 올리세요!
건설 및 업그레이드
자신만의 석유 시추기지를 건설하고, 다양한 건물들 중 선택하여 지하 자원에서 석유를 추출할 수 있도록 가장 효율적인 파이프라인을 구축하세요.
1인칭 시점으로 대원 제어
각기 다른 무기로 해적의 습격에 맞서 싸우기 위해 리그맨을 무장시키세요.
리그맨을 직접 조종하여 반격하거나, 그들이 알아서 처리하도록 맡길 수 있습니다.

title: Run Chicken Run
description:
게임 정보
"Run Chicken Run" 간단하고 재미있는 액션 게임입니다. 닭을 잡아 배달하는 첫 번째 손님(사냥꾼)이 승리합니다. 닭이 잡히지 않으면 시간이 지남에 따라 자라다가 결국 울타리를 넘어 탈출합니다. 닭이 잡히면 다른 사냥꾼들이 닭을 잡아 식당으로 배달하려는 플레이어를 노립니다. 서두르세요. 하지만 주변 사물에 다칠 수 있으니 조심하세요!
닭으로 플레이하는 게임 모드에서는 계속 비명을 지르고, 뛰어오르고, 잡히면 탈출하기 위해 몸부림쳐야 합니다. 네, 맞습니다. 이 기술은 실제로 마이크에 "바크 바크"(닭이 꽥꽥거리는 소리)라는 소리를 내어 사용할 수 있습니다. 조심하세요. 당신의 위치가 노출될 수도 있습니다.
처음에는 협동 모드로 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다(한 플레이어는 닭을 맡고, 다른 플레이어는 사냥꾼이 됩니다). 친구들과 함께 플레이하기 위해 개인방을 만들 수 있습니다. 활동적인 플레이어 그룹이 있으며, 원하시면 다른 방에서 게임에 참여할 수도 있습니다. 새로운 사람들을 만날 수 있는 환상적인 기회입니다!
사냥꾼을 위해

title: Tiny Vending Machines
description:
게임 정보
Tiny Vending Machine은 픽셀 아트 스타일의 방치형 게임으로, 다른 작업을 하는 동안 화면 하단에서 실행되도록 설계되었습니다. 목표는 자판기 제국을 구축하고 확장하여 항상 재고를 유지하고 수익을 극대화하는 것입니다.
어떻게 작동하나요?
음료, 사탕, 아이스크림, 과일, 패스트푸드, 샐러드, 수프 등 다양한 제품을 판매하는 자판기를 구매하고 관리하세요.

title: Co-Ape : Rise Of The Monke
description:
게임 정보
Co-Ape: Rise of the Monke – Two Minds, One Monkey!
In this unique co-op climbing game, full control is in your and your friend’s hands!
🔹 Control a single monkey as a duo!
🔹 Overcome challenging levels with unique mechanics and reach the top!

title: Whisker Wanderlust
description:
게임 정보
모든 관문은 동화의 환상으로 가득 찬 탐구 여행이다. 독특한 두꺼운 손으로 그린 화풍은 우리 게임의 하이라이트 중 하나이다. 우리의 상징적인 두꺼운 손으로 그린 예술 스타일은 모든 프레임을 벽지로 만들 가치가 있다. 이것은 게임의 진정한 시각적 표지이다.시각적 효과와 상부상조하여 각 관문마다 맞춤형 배경음악 곡목이 있어 몰입형 분위기를 만들어 완전히 몰입할 수 있습니다!
이 게임은 10개의 관문 장면과 1개의 숨겨진 관문, 30여 개의 상호작용이 가능한 NPC 캐릭터, 1200개의 찾아야 할 아이템, 90개의 관문 성취
게임 플레이 방법
1. 메인 라인 퀘스트: 장면도에서 스웨터를 수집하여 메인 라인 줄거리를 추진하고 게임의 최종 결말을 얻는다.
2. 의뢰 퀘스트: 서로 다른 장면 내의 NPC와 상호작용, 의뢰 퀘스트 잠금 해제 그들이 더 많은 물품을 수집할 수 있도록 돕는다
3. 숨겨진 관문: 메인 라인에서 통조림을 수집하여 엽서 모드를 열고, 엽서의 보물상자에서 고양이 목걸이를 수집하고, 숨겨진 관문을 잠금 해제하여 퀘스트를 완성합니다 (여기 숨겨진 줄거리도 있습니다.)
4, 화풍 & 달걀: 화려한 색상의 두꺼운 페인트 손으로 그린 화풍과 클래식 IP 달걀을 결합하여 탐색할 수 있습니다

title: The Mare Show
description:
게임 정보
The Mare Show is a Horror/Arcade game set in a macabre circus world, full of mystery, danger...and fun!
You are Tom Lorich, a bankrupt compulsive gambler who entered this bizarre world for no apparent reason, and now has to get out at any cost, while experiencing his greatest traumas in the form of strange creatures, created by an enigmatic entity called Mare, with unknown motivations.

DIFFERENT CREATURES
With different mechanics and visuals, you have to overcome them as best you can. From a pursuer Scarecrow to a macabre shadow, always watching you.

title: Sunken Engine
description:
게임 정보
러브크래프트 스타일의 트위스트가 가미된 조선소
Sunken Engine은 러브크래프트의 분위기를 지닌 선박 수리 시뮬레이터입니다. 아버지의 비극적인 죽음 후, 당신은 가족의 사업을 이어받아 운영해야 합니다. 이는 고객을 만족시키고 마을의 질서를 유지하는 일을 의미합니다. 그러나 새로운 배가 도착할 때마다 새로운 도전과 미스터리가 기다리고 있습니다.
러브크래프트식 공포
당신이 겪는 사건들은 정신 건강에 위협을 줄 수 있습니다. 이는 당신의 일을 어렵게 만들거나 어두운 존재들을 끌어들일 수 있습니다. 당신은 사업을 계속 운영하면서 정신을 유지할 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
침몰한 배의 보물
