title: Spinning My Wheel
description:
게임 정보
Escape a mad lab in a DIY rocket‑wheel!
Ham is a pissed off Hamster that has been subject to experiments from heartless Scientists! They are developing Brain Machine Interface Chips for the Military. But it has given Ham extra intelligence as well as being able to wirelessly interface with all kinds of electronics. He needs to escape this blasted laboratory! He augments his Hamster Wheel from his cage to escape!
The Scientists seem to always catch him and bring him back to the Lab, but that will not stop Ham! He enlists help from fellow test animals that have escaped the lab, but want to help Ham, and get revenge while they are at it! Well... they only want to help after some... persuasion from Ham.
Another piece of tech the scientists have made and are testing is the Jelloizer Gun! It turns solid masses of land into a jello like block made up of elements in the land. Ham can collect these, storing them in his Cheek pouches, and use these resources to build better wheels and attachments!
Please help him escape the dreaded Laboratory! 
The game will be broken into several different game modes
Laboratory
Escape!
Mining
Processing
Races
Workshop
Game Loop
Learn and unlock upgrades in the Laboratory. Then Go to the Workshop to build out your Rocket powered Wheel. Now try to Escape! If you get caught you can go Mining to get loot to make your wheel better. Or go back to the Lab to learn new attachments! Not happy with how much resources you get, Head back to the workshop and go to the Processing game mode to increase your refining processes.
Laboratory

title: Arcadian Days
description:
게임 정보
This is your story to tell.
Arcadian Days is a first-person exploration-adventure game that sets free your sense of child-like wonder and joy for the world. Explore highly detailed and vibrant environments packed with secrets, shape a dynamic narrative, develop your homestead and play with your loyal dog companion!
Stories That Unfold Naturally
No two playthroughs are alike: your interactions and observations influence the story and the world:
Emergent storytelling: Dive into narratives that unfold naturally, shaped by your actions and discoveries, making every playthrough uniquely personal.
Dynamic family relationships: Deepen your bonds with your family through simple, organic interactions. Shape their vocations and future by guiding them towards farming, animal husbandry, or pottery, among many others.
Environmental storytelling cues: Have you noticed subtle changes in the landscape? Certain environmental details hint at evolving stories, inviting exploration and keen observation.

title: 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Do you believe that tiny creatures dwell in the recesses of your mind? 
Inspired by MBTI, in 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors, you'll discover that your inner world is teeming with spirited beings—quirky, endearing, and ready for battle. Come get to know these charming spirits and bond with them as you stand together against the creeping shadows of doubt and fear.
Embark on an extraordinary journey where every personality unveils its hidden strengths. As you command your elemental sprites—each reflecting a distinct MBTI personality trait—watch them evolve through unique upgrade branches, transforming into formidable allies. Every encounter becomes a chance to learn more about who you truly are, as you craft dynamic builds that mirror your inner complexity.
So, what is your gaming MBTI? Step into the arena of your mind, forge powerful bonds, and let the adventure reveal the depths of your personality.

Key Features
Personalized Elemental Sprites: Use elemental sprites to embody your personality; each sprite not only reflects its unique individuality but also comes with exclusive skill upgrade branches, offering you a myriad of strategic options.
16 Unique MBTI Skills: Every MBTI personality boasts its one-of-a-kind skill, each of which can evolve further through upgrade branches to create your own distinctive battle style.
Fast-Paced Short Runs: Each run lasts around 15 minutes, featuring meticulously designed, short battles that deliver an exhilarating gameplay experience in a compact timeframe.
Hundreds of Traits and Items: Choose from hundreds of traits and items to enjoy fresh experiences and new combinations every run, ensuring each playthrough is full of surprises.
Innovative Theme Integration: Experience a unique fusion of personality testing and game mechanics, where exploring your inner world is paired with adventure-filled, strategic combat.

title: Gravebound
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
Enter the Shatterlands — a forgotten world where the ruins of Earth meet ancient magic.
Gravebound is a post-apocalyptic shooter extraction game that fuses fast-paced gunplay with light survival mechanics and dark fantasy elements. Explore shattered cities, scavenge powerful gear, and face off against other players and deadly creatures in a high-stakes fight for survival.
Choose your path — hunt for rare artifacts, engage in tense firefights, or strike deals with factions. But every run comes with a choice: push deeper for greater rewards or extract before the Shatterlands consume you.
Key Features
Shooter Extraction Gameplay
Load in solo or with a squad. Scavenge, fight, and extract — or risk it all for the best loot.
Post-Apocalyptic Fantasy World
Explore the Shatterlands — a unique setting where crumbling cities, corrupted forests, and magical ruins collide.
Fluid Gunplay Meets Fantasy Powers
Wield modern firearms alongside ancient relics and mystical abilities that can turn the tide of battle.
PvPvE Combat
Face off against other players and AI-controlled monsters and bosses — every encounter is a deadly choice.
Faction Reputation System
Loot gear and turn it in to factions for rewards, upgrades, and unique gear. Build alliances or make enemies.
Risk-Reward Extraction
Extract safely or dive deeper for the most powerful loot — but beware, death means losing everything you carry.

title: Bot Colony _redux
description:
게임 정보
CONVERSATION – THE MAIN GAMEPLAY MECHANIC
Exploring the game world your way, using your own words, may feel new to players used to clicking on choices in dialogue trees.  We achieve immersion with natural speech-to-text, character intelligence, and great-sounding, emotive text-to-speech.
A STORY-RICH GAME
You’re hired by Nakagawa Corp, a large Japanese robot manufacturer, to catch a spy who broke into their sanctuary in Agrihan Island in the Pacific. While each episode contributes to the story arc, it feels like a stand-alone game with its setting and characters. 
INTRUDER
Before giving you the mission, Nakagawa tests your abilities to command robots and to investigate.

title: Blade & Soul Heroes
description:
게임 정보
The Story
Journey with Yusol as she strives to rebuild her clan and enact justice against those who destroyed it. Follow her as she pursues the evil Yi Chun and unravels the mysteries of the Heaven's Fall Cult. Along the way, she’ll encounter an expansive cast of heroes, each with their own skills and story, who will join her resurgent clan and unite in the fight to defeat Yi Chun and Heaven’s Fall.
Dual Combat System
Seamlessly switch between turn-based strategy and real-time action.
In turn-based mode, all five team members take the battle field to unite for victory.
For real-time action, one designated lead hero fights the various enemies supported by four skill-linked allies
Character Collection
Build & grow your 5-hero team to begin your journey. With over 40 heroes to unlock, each with their unique skills & stories, a variety of legendary characters awaits you to join your clan.
Visual Style
Immerse yourself in this anime-inspired world with majestic vistas, eerie forests, ancient deserts, and mythical dungeons of the Earthen Realm. Each hero models a distinctive look and feel evocative of the elements.
Deep Tactical Combat
To defeat your foes, master your fighting abilities with a wide array of combinations and skills. With each battle, tailor your team strategically in order to achieve victory across different opponents and environments.

title: Typing With Ghosties
description:
게임 정보
👻 The Cute little virtual pet ghost that helps you learn to type!
🖥️ He lives on your desktop
🎮 Play minigames with Ghostie to keep him happy
⌨️ Get better at typing, that makes him happiest!
🍬 And... feed him... OR HE'LL DIE!
From 2 to 18 letter words!
Some words you'll know and bunch more you'll learn as you play.
Why play?
⌨️ Helps improve your typing
🏁 Compete against the steam community

title: Gun Center Simulator
description:
게임 정보
나만의 총기 센터를 열어보세요! 놀라움과 재미로 가득한 이 시뮬레이션 게임과 함께 다양한 무기의 비밀을 익히고, 짜릿한 수익을 올려보세요. 취미 수집가부터 사냥꾼, 전문 보안요원까지—다양한 고객층을 사로잡으며 총기의 세계에 깊이 몰입하고, 나만의 사업을 직접 키워나가보세요!



나만의 총기 상점을 운영해보세요!
권총부터 돌격소총까지, 모든 무기를 보기 좋게 진열해 고객의 시선을 사로잡아보세요. 철저한 재고 관리로 매장을 체계적으로 운영하고, 센터가 성장할수록 늘어나는 방문객을 맞이해 보세요. 일상적인 구매자부터 열정적인 수집가까지—다양한 고객으로 북적이는 활기찬 총기 전문점을 직접 만들어갈 수 있습니다!



사격장
‘건 센터 시뮬레이터’에서는 다양한 무기를 시험해볼 수 있도록 장비를 완비한 사격장을 제공합니다. 보유 중인 모든 총기를 자유롭게 테스트해보세요. 정밀하게 조율된 저격소총부터 기본적인 권총까지 — 이곳은 총기 애호가를 위한 최고의 놀이터가 될 것입니다.



디자인 & 개발
여러분의 매장은 단순한 비즈니스를 넘어, 나만의 스타일과 성공을 보여주는 공간입니다. 늘어나는 수익을 재투자해 센터를 확장하고 업그레이드해보세요. 정돈된 총기 진열대와 세련된 인테리어로 매장을 꾸미면 더 많은 고객의 시선을 사로잡을 수 있고, 그 관심은 자연스럽게 매출로 이어질 것입니다.



최고의 총기 사업가가 될 준비 되셨나요? 일반 고객을 위한 판매부터 열정적인 수집가의 취향을 저격하는 제품 구성, 사격장에서의 실력 테스트까지! ‘건 센터 시뮬레이터’는 치열한 총기 시장 속에서 성공으로 가는 완벽한 티켓이 되어줄 것입니다. 총기 센터의 주인이 되어, 나만의 제국을 건설하는 짜릿한 경험을 지금 바로 시작해보세요!

title: Nietzsche's Shadow
description:
게임 정보
A philosophical horror experience in the Alps: As Friedrich Nietzsche confronts his own shadow, he becomes lost between layers of reality.
Nietzsche's Shadow is a single-player experience with no combat mechanics, focusing instead on exploration, collection, and philosophical choice.
first-person philosophical horror exploration game where you wander through the Alps as Friedrich Nietzsche, confronting your own shadow and collecting pages of your final book.
Wander through the mist-shrouded Alps as Friedrich Nietzsche in this first-person exploration game, haunted by the wind-scattered pages of your final manuscript. Your shadow has taken form, speaking to you with sarcastic provocation, mercilessly exposing your contradictions and suppressed thoughts. What begins as a journey through flowered meadows transforms into a nightmare of twisted realities and philosophical terror.
As you collect the fragments of your work, traverse the breathtaking Alpine paths where Nietzsche himself once walked and developed his revolutionary ideas.
But this journey conceals deeper layers of reality. The truth of your existence may be more disturbing than any philosophical abyss you've contemplated. Are you ready to confront what lies beyond the veil of perception?

Who is this for?
If you enjoyed games like The Stanley Parable, The Beginner's Guide, What Remains of Edith Finch, or Layers of Fear - but wish they had more philosophical meat to chew on.

title: siMarket Cloth Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Fashion Empire in Miami Beach!
Welcome to siMarket Cloth Store Simulator, where your journey from a small boutique to the most luxurious clothing store in Miami Beach begins! Set against the stunning backdrop of palm trees, golden sands, and a vibrant plaza, you’ll manage every aspect of your business—from stocking shelves to satisfying fashion-hungry customers.
Design, Stock & Sell
Arrange over 100+ stylish clothing items—dresses, crop tops, jackets, hats, and more—on shelves, hangers, or eye-catching mannequins. Adjust prices to maximize profits or attract more shoppers. Need space? Expand your storage to keep surplus stock and let your restocking team work efficiently.
Hire & Expand
Recruit cashiers to handle checkouts and restockers to keep your store in perfect shape. As you level up (all the way to level 50!), unlock new clothing options, expand your store, and add fitting rooms—because every customer wants to try before they buy!
Customize Your Dream Store
Make your shop stand out with wall paints, decorative flowers, couches, and stylish signs. Use mannequins to attract more buyers and create the trendiest spot on the strip.
Dynamic Miami Beach Atmosphere
Enjoy the serene yet lively Miami plaza, where the environment changes dynamically, immersing you in a beachside retail paradise.
Bonus Challenge: "Long Shift" Minigame
Test your endurance in this fast-paced minigame—how long can you keep up with the rush?
Will you build the ultimate fashion destination? Start your retail empire today!

title: Paper Kite: Threads of Longing
description:
게임 정보
Wuhan Liyu Game Studio's debut work! A short pure-love GALGAME Chinese long-distance relationship story "Paper Kite"! This trial version currently only fully supports Simplified Chinese (optimizations for other languages will be added later). [Your language now supports game text translation; UI translation is in progress (click "Start Game" to run dialogue content). If you encounter translation issues, please leave feedback in the game review section—we'll resolve any language problems. Thank you!] The full game has approximately 120,000 to 200,000 words, with the trial version at around 15,000 words, covering only the initial chapters. The trial version tells the early story of Shen Luoying and Chen Yanqing, setting the stage for their separation due to distance. The full version will depict their post-separation story (expected release: late summer 2025).
Scheduled for release in August 2025!
autokwd: Paper Kite: Threads of Longing,纸鸢（PaperKite: Threads of Distant Love）

title: Upalu Mundi
description:
게임 정보
In a fantasy world shaken by the invention of the locomotive, you assume the role of Pyrael, a trolley cart network engineer at Mountain Mining Industries, Inc. As the company expands its operations across the world, you are in a unique position to shape the world around you.
Upalu Mundi draws inspiration from the challenges of efficiently connecting producers and consumers in open-ended transport games, but uses limited rail-switching logic on a neatly arranged 8x8 grid to offer self-contained puzzle levels with deterministic solutions. While initial solutions are generally easy to discover, unique strategies are essential to achieving optimal results.
Original Design - Lay tracks, build stations and control the flow of trains using switches. The R&D department is hard at work to invent more sophisticated train routing. In the meantime you'll have to make do with the 4 types of switches that the company used for trolley carts in the mines.
Orderly Simulation - Before commissioning a transport network, the design must be tested on a simulation device. Push the throttle and watch your creation materialize as the trains make their rounds on the model kit.
Open-Ended Puzzles - After getting the first working blueprint, see how it compares to the optimal line set by the mysterious workings of the Upalu Mundi, an iridescent gem that seems to contain humanity's knowledge.
Organic Storytelling - Read about the consequences of your actions in the world’s rich newspaper landscape, and skim through the company’s meeting minutes to catch what your coworkers are saying about your new look and any other important topics on the agenda.

title: Tankiro
description:
게임 정보
Tankiro is an action-packed parry combat game inspired by the Souls-like genre. Play as a lone tank defending Earth from an alien invasion, using only your tank barrel to attack and your armor to parry and block enemy strikes.
Battle various alien bosses on Earth's surface, then take the fight to their mothership in space. Defeat them and save the planet!
KEY FEATURES
Parry-Based Combat System
Various Bosses
Souls-Like Inspired Gameplay

title: Little Witch Survivors
description:
게임 정보
소서러는 8명의 수호사를 소환하여 마법소대를 구성하여 인해전술이 마물을 깔아뭉개는 쾌감을 체험하세요!근접 계열 밀착 수호, 원거리 계열 탄막 세안, 8중 공격 특효 중첩 순간 전장 점화!
각 수호사의 능력은 착용 위치에 따라 결정됩니다!이중 스킬은 착용 위치에 따라 전환합니다!자유롭게 공격 형식을 전환하여 지정 저격에서 범위 정리까지의 이중 전술 차원을 실현한다!

title: Hate You
description:
게임 정보
당신은 얼음으로 뒤덮인 황야와 끝없는 어둠에 둘러싸인 극지 관측소의 새 승무원입니다. 매 시간마다 기지에서 신비로운 타이머가 작동합니다. 제한된 시간 안에 코드를 해독해 터미널에 입력해야 합니다.
이 낯선 곳에서 당신은 전화기와 관측소 운영 매뉴얼을 사용할 수 있으며, 이들은 당신의 믿을 수 있는 동반자가 될 것입니다.

title: Super Movie Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Super Movie Tycoon에서 영화계 거물이 되세요! 각본부터 촬영까지, 드림팀을 꾸려 할리우드를 정복하세요!
창의적인 디자인으로 독보적인 영화 세계를 구축하세요! 각본 구상부터 세트 건설, 캐릭터 개발부터 특수 효과까지, 모든 디테일을 직접 창조할 수 있습니다. 여기서 당신은 감독, 작가, 프로듀서를 겸비해 무한한 상상력으로 자신만의 블록버스터를 제작합니다!
         
새로운 부지를 언락하고 각 전문 부서를 꼼꼼히 계획해 효율적인 영화 제작 라인을 구축하세요. 모든 토지를 최대한 활용하고 당신의 꿈의 영화 스튜디오가 무에서 유로 성장하는 과정을 목격하세요!

title: Dragon Detective: A Friend from the Shadows
description:
게임 정보
Solve the case and save the day as Sevyn Noxley, a private investigator living in a fantastical world of anthropomorphic animals. Help the citizens of the capital city of Rivulette in four twisting, turning cases of murder and intrigue.
Experience a story-rich visual novel detective adventure inspired by legal thrillers of the past. Inspect places of interest, question suspects, and point out contradictions by presenting evidence you've gathered during your investigation.
Use your six draconic senses on crime scenes and persons of interest to gather information.
A large cast of anthropomorphic characters and enticing locations presented in hand-drawn 2D artwork.
Features both "casual" and "detective" difficulty options. Enjoy either a cozy or a  more challenging experience and earn additional achievements.
autokwd: Dragon Detective: A Friend from the Shadows

title: FISH³
description:
게임 정보
Dive into a surreal speed-fishing odyssey that defies reality. In this unique blend of high-speed boating and unconventional fishing mechanics, you'll harness the power of fish to propel your vessel through dreamlike waters.
Cast your rod to catch a powerful fish that will pull your boat, becoming a fish-engine, control the direction by pulling the fishing rod into desired direction and hope that the fish won't outpower you!

title: Noon Stone
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Noon Stone
Noon Stone is an exploration and survival game inspired by solo tabletop role-playing games. Your mission: find a lost crystal named Noon Stone, in a hostile world. Every day counts, dangers grow, and enemies become stronger. Will you make the right choices to survive and triumph before it's too late?
Key Features
🎲 Dice-driven tactical battles
🗺️ Explore randomly generated maps and survive
🛡️ Build your character with gear, skills, and luck
⚡ Fast 5-15 minute runs
🔁 Endless replayability with evolving strategies
🧩 Simple to learn, challenging to master
📖 A black-and-white world with hand-drawn look
💯 Challenge yourself and beat your own score
How it plays
Roll your hero: Random class and stats
Explore: Choose your path across a hexagonal map
: Battle enemies with dice rolls

title: Cleaner Company
description:
게임 정보
You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! You now have a unique opportunity to begin your galactic adventure in one of the most demanding sectors of space. Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.
Recruit, your task is not just cleaning – it's a battle against chaos! You must transform every damaged place into something perfectly clean, as if it were brand new. What can you expect? Armed with a mop, you’ll fight stains in unusual colors – red, green, and blue liquids that look more like alien substances than regular blood. You’ll be tossing not only trash but also pieces of extraterrestrial beings that left their mark behind.

title: Country Hero
description:
게임 정보
A turn-based strategy game where, in a world constantly invaded by the Demon Lord, you use your wisdom to compete for fame with other players and become a legendary guild.
The Demon Lord has a chance to invade towns every day, turning them into monster nests. This will be a challenge in your journey.
At the start of each month, all buildings on the map will randomly change. Can you make the wisest decisions?

title: Project DINOZ
description:
게임 정보
In Project DINOZ, you step into the boots of a recon specialist sent to investigate a communications blackout at a remote research facility. What begins as a routine mission quickly turns into a nightmare as you and your team uncover the true horror lurking in the shadows: dinosaurs—real, intelligent, and hunting.
Explore a vast, mysterious island filled with abandoned labs, decaying outposts, and dense wilderness that hides secrets beneath the surface. Unlock new regions as you survive, from towering mountains to shadowed valleys and underground tunnels that echo with distant roars.
But survival won’t be easy. You’re alone. Cut off from the world. The predators here are relentless, and every encounter could be your last. Use stealth, strategy, and limited resources to avoid detection. Remember—you’re no hunter here. You're the hunted.
🦖 Key Features
Single-Player Story Mode
Immerse yourself in a narrative-driven survival horror experience where your only goal is to uncover the truth—and make it out alive.
Advanced Predator AI
Face off against highly intelligent and coordinated dinosaurs that stalk, flank, and adapt to your behavior. Every encounter is unpredictable and deadly.
Massive Island with Underground Facilities
Explore over 80 square kilometers of surface terrain and just as much hidden underground, from jungle ravines and research zones to multi-level labs deep beneath the earth.
Vehicles & Tools
Locate and operate dirt bikes, ATVs, and other utility vehicles—but use them wisely. Sound draws predators, and fuel is limited.
Tactical Gameplay & Stealth
Resources are scarce. Use light, noise, and terrain to your advantage. Avoid combat wherever possible—most predators can’t be taken down through force.
Replayability & Discovery
Uncover hidden lore, secret outposts, and branching narrative outcomes. Optional objectives and exploration unlock new paths and endings, rewarding curiosity and risk.

title: Up To Divine
description:
게임 정보
You - our best test driver. And this - the latest development, the legendary Niva, which we have brought to perfection. The car turned out to be such that God himself ordered it from us. Your task is to pass the final test and deliver it to the gates of heaven. Only then will it become truly divine.
The trial begins. Face challenging tracks, tricky ramps, deep gaps, and deadly obstacles. Driving the legendary Niva is no easy task. You won’t make it on the first try.
Patience and focus are your greatest allies. You’ll fall, fail, and start over — again and again — all for a higher purpose.
Can you deliver the machine to the gates of paradise and complete the final test?

title: Cat Home
description:
게임 정보
고양이를 좋아하시나요?
캣터리와 고양이 카페를 동시에 운영한다면 정말 행복할 것 같지 않나요?
캣터리 사장님 겸 카페 오너로서, 매일 털복숭이 행복이 가득합니다!
아침에는 캣터리에서 번식 고양이를 돌보고, 오후와 밤에는 고양이를 데리고 카페를 운영합니
나만의 캣터리와 카페를 꾸미고, 다양한 품종의 고양이를 마음껏 쓰다듬을 수 있습니다.
지금 참여해서 '냥'자본가의 인생을 시작하세요!

title: Four Divine Abidings
description:
게임 정보
Complete the Path to Liberation in this mindfulness-themed idle/incremental game inspired by Buddhist philosophy.
Cultivate the Four Divine Abidings: Loving-Kindness (Metta), Compassion (Karuna), Appreciative Joy (Mudita), and Equanimity (Upekkha) - and apply them in various encounters.
Enjoy a calm atmosphere supported by hand-painted art and relaxing music.
Freely choose between active and idle playstyles, with fair offline progress upgradeable to up to 52 hours.

title: Gun Shop Manager
description:
게임 정보

건샵 매니저 – 범죄, 장인정신, 그리고 맞춤형 화력!
『Gun Shop Manager』에서 마피아의 위험한 자금을 기반으로 설립된 음지의 무기 상점을 운영하게 됩니다. 한정된 재고와 막대한 빚에서 시작해 지하 무기 시장을 장악하는 자리까지 올라가세요.
어두운 시작에서 블랙마켓의 전설로
마피아와 갱단 고객들과 협력하여 도시 곳곳에 무기를 유통하세요. 의심스러운 주문을 받아 배달하고, 총기를 세척하고 개조하며, 경찰의 눈을 피해 고위험 거래를 성사시키세요.

title: Music Producer Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
《Music Producer Tycoon》 은 음악 프로듀싱의 진화를 따라가는 여정을 선사합니다.
작곡, 녹음, 발매를 통해 무명 프로듀서에서 세계적인 스타로 성장하세요.
전 세계 경기장을 울리는 히트곡을 만들고, 세대의 사운드를 정의하며, 음악 역사에 당신의 이름을 새기세요.
주요 특징

차고에서 글로벌 스타로
1960년대 먼지 쌓인 차고에서 시작해 수십 년간 음악 역사를 가로지르세요.
트렌드에 맞춰 사운드를 진화시키고, 1965년부터 현재까지 살아 숨쉬는 타임라인에서 전설적인 프로듀서로 성장하세요.

title: Cats Visiting Fairy Tales
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Cats Visiting Fairy Tales, a cozy clicker game where curious cats explore the enchanting realms of fantasy!
From magical schools and ancient spellbound towns to hidden elf villages, each of the five hand-drawn levels is bursting with charm, mystery, and—of course—cats.
Your mission?
Find 100 hidden cats in every level and uncover a unique special item hidden within each scene to complete your fairy tales collection.
With calming gameplay, delightful art, and a sprinkle of magic, Cats Visiting Fairy Tale is the perfect escape into a world where adventure and fluffiness meet.
tag: 캐주얼,숨은 그림 및 물체,고양이,포인트 앤드 클릭

title: 血姬：双生
description:
게임 정보
Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game where you play as a vampire lady, strategically switching between her vampiric and human forms. Engage in high-speed life-or-death combat using blood as your ultimate resource.
To find your long-lost sister, you must obey a mysterious broker and navigate a conflicted world. At the end of this bloody path lies your sister, a conspiracy, or... maybe hope?
“Pure Blood” Combat
Dual Forms: Blood is power! The bloodthirsty Scythe Form consumes HP for swift kills, while the tactical Cane Form allows HP recovery and stun.
Focus & Skills: Unleash stylish yet practical attack skills to overwhelm enemies with relentless combo chains.
Relentless Foes: Enemies track you across terrain and will relentlessly pursue you once combat begins.
Break & Execute: Shatter enemy defenses through skill combos, then deliver instant-execution finishers.
"Blood-Tears" Story
While searching for your sister, you receive a message from an enigmatic broker. To uncover her whereabouts, you must accept broker's missions.
In a modern world torn by human-demon race conflict, you – a vampire – confront brutal realities.
The broker, your sister, gangs... This isn't just about them.
This is also about you, and... yourself
Introduction to the protagonist's dual-form weapon
The following is an introduction to the weapons and some skills. There will be more in the official version!
Cane - Normal attack
In her human form, the vampire lady will gracefully strike her enemies with her cane weapon, dizzying them.

title: Raccoon Cocoon: A Cozy Puzzle Game
description:
게임 정보
할머니 너구리의 픽셀 집에 들어가서 매일의 혼잡을 정리하는 것을 도와주세요. 휴식하고, 정리하고, Raccoon Cocoon에서 작은 것들에서 기쁨을 느껴보세요.
🧹✨ 아늑한 퍼즐, 부드러운 분위기. 그게 바로 정신이에요!
이 따뜻한 작은 고치 안에서 당신을 기다리는 것은 무엇일까요?
책을 정리하고, 서랍을 정리하고, 아늑한 혼잡을 정리하세요
귀여운 선인장, 꽃, 버섯 컬렉션을 정리하세요
레트로 영감을 받은 미니 게임을 즐기세요
만족스러운 대칭, 패턴 맞추기, 시각적 논리
타이머도, 스트레스도 없이 — 오직 순수한 휴식만
🐾 상자를 비우거나 책 속에 꽃을 압착하는 등, 각 퍼즐은 할머니 너구리와 함께하는 조용한 순간입니다. 차를 끓여 놓고 천천히 시간을 즐겨보세요 — 할머니는 급하지 않아요. 🍵
autokwd: Raccoon Cocoon: A Cozy Puzzle Game,라쿤의 고치: 포근한 퍼즐 게임

title: Console Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Start and Manage Your Own Second-Hand Game Store!
In this immersive first-person simulation game, you'll strive to become the owner of the best second-hand game store around.
Begin with a small but exciting start:
Buy products, place them on shelves, and organize your shop.
Interact with customers, sell them games, and try to buy their items at the best prices. Haggle smartly to boost your profits and grow your business!
But it's not just about selling — customize your store’s interior to make it more stylish and appealing. The better your shop looks, the more customers you'll attract!
And don’t forget... it’s not all work! After a long day, hit the bar, unwind, and enjoy your social life.

title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue
description:
게임 정보
여러분이 들어가는 모든 던전은 각자의 도전 과제를 제시합니다. 기회를 놓치기 위해서는 장비 선택이 중요합니다. 생존 여부는 그에 달려 있기 때문에 현명하게 선택하세요.
무작위로 생성된 던전을 통해 흥미로운 모험을 시작하세요. 각각의 여행은 신선한 놀라움을 가져다 줍니다. 친구들과 뒤틀린 길과 신비한 방을 돌아다니면서 가장 가치 있는 숨겨진 보물을 찾고 다양한 도전을 극복하세요.

title: Screenside Station
description:
게임 정보
Screenside Station은 데스크톱 동반자 게임입니다
일하거나 영화를 보거나 다른 게임을 하는 동안, 작고 귀여운 기차역을 지켜보세요.
건설과 꾸미기
기차역 운영은 작은 마을을 소유하는 것과 비슷합니다. 어떤 방문객은 좋아할 만한 시설이 있어야 찾아옵니다. 수익으로 아이스크림 가판대, 축구공, 고무 오리 같은 다양한 아이템을 구매하고 배치해 보세요.
가장 중요한 방문자는 바로 당신이에요!
모든 아이템은 색상을 바꾸고 자유롭게 배치할 수 있어요. 당신만의 완벽한 미니 세상을 만들어 보세요.
완벽한 분위기
Screenside Station은 배경마다 고유한 곡이 있는 오리지널 사운드트랙과 부드럽고 방해되지 않는 효과음을 제공합니다. 화면 어디든 배치하고 잊어버리세요 — 잠깐의 휴식이 필요할 때 다시 찾게 될 거예요.

title: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
description:
게임 정보
책이 더 이상 재미없고, 옆 감방 죄수들의 농담도 웃기지 않은 날이 왔다. 이제 이 지루한 감옥을 탈출할 때다. 도구를 챙기고 땅을 파기 시작하자.
경비와 거래하여 식량을 얻거나, 죄수들에게 화장지를 주고 더 좋은 굴착 도구를 받을 수 있을지도 모른다.
경비의 검문에 주의하고, 카펫을 숨기고 화장실에 모래를 처리하며 발각되지 않도록 하자. 음식을 구하고, 더 좋은 신발과 큰 삽을 준비하자. 힘과 에너지를 키우기 위해 운동하고, 더 귀중한 아이템을 캐낼 수 있도록 더 좋은 배낭을 구매하자.
감옥 창고에서 도로시 여사에게서 뭔가를 살 수 있을지도 몰라? 가구, 야광봉, 더 멋진 카펫, 그리고 모래를 더 빨리 처리할 수 있는 좋은 변기를 구매해 봐.

title: BACKROOMS
description:
게임 정보

Survive the Endless.
Step into the eerie, ever-changing world of the Backrooms — a place beyond reality, filled with endless hallways, buzzing lights, and things best left unseen. Built on procedural generation, no two runs are ever the same. Every room, every sound, and every shadow could lead you closer to freedom... or deeper into the madness.
Key Features:
Procedural Levels – Explore infinite, randomly generated environments that evolve the deeper you go. Each playthrough offers new layouts, challenges, and threats.
Steam Workshop Support – Dive into custom-made levels and experiences crafted by the community. Create, share, and explore endless possibilities.
Atmospheric Horror – Minimal UI, immersive sound design, and psychological tension build a uniquely unsettling experience. It’s not about what you see… it’s about what you feel.
Dynamic Objectives – Solve puzzles, find clues, and make crucial decisions. Some paths lead to safety. Others… don’t.

title: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
description:
게임 정보
Step into the Misty Valley, a tranquil, cozy fishing adventure where your journey begins with the inherited of your grandfather’s old fisherman’s house. The valley, once full of life, now lays quiet and forgotten. Armed with a fishing rod, and an indomitable spirit, your task is clear: bring the valley back to life! Dive into serene waters, uncover hidden treasures, and restore the abandoned harbor and fish market to their former glory. As you discover rare and legendary fish, you’ll slowly unlock the rich history of the valley, forming bonds with its quirky inhabitants and witnessing its revival. Ready to cast your line and restore the valley’s lost charm?
Features
Explore a Cozy, Expansive World: Wander through the charming Misty Valley, from the foggy shores to the hidden corners of the map. Each area offers unique scenery, secrets, and opportunities to explore, all designed to evoke a sense of calm and nostalgia. The valley is alive with its own rhythm, watch as the world shifts with the changing of the day, bringing new experiences and moments to discover.
Fishing Adventures: Explore the tranquil waters of Misty Valley and catch a variety of fish, from everyday catches to legendary species. Use your fishing skills to restore the town’s economy and uncover hidden treasures.
Revive the Fish Market: Rebuild and restore the old fish market and its stalls. As you catch more fish, you’ll be able to sell them at the market, helping to revive the local economy and increase the town’s prosperity. Manage the market, increase your profits, and watch the town come back to life.
Simple Farming: Grow essential crops for bait and energy to support your fishing journey. Manage your small farm alongside your fishing expeditions.
Discover Mystical Artifacts: While fishing and exploring, you may uncover mysterious artifacts. These can be sold to the local archaeologist, who will display them in the town’s museum, adding a layer of intrigue and history to your adventure.
Relaxing Gameplay: With a focus on calm, cozy gameplay, Misty Valley invites you to take your time and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of fishing, farming, and town restoration. Perfect for fans of relaxing, simulation-style adventures.
Evolving Story: As you restore the valley, uncover the hidden history of Misty Valley and your grandfather’s legacy. Each step of the way reveals more about the people and mysteries that shaped this forgotten place.
autokwd: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale

title: Ravenhille: Awakened
description:
게임 정보
레이븐힐에 도착하면 진정한 도전이 당신을 기다립니다. 저주받은 숲을 탐험하고 지옥에서 온 고대의 괴수를 처치하세요. 너무 늦기 전에요.
그 짐승을 찾아 사냥하세요. 어둠 속에 숨어 당신의 모든 움직임을 감시합니다. 이 괴물은 태어난 게 아니라, 만들어진 후 숲 속에서 썩도록 내버려졌습니다. 단 한 발의 총알로도 막을 수 없습니다. 빗나가면 두 번째 기회는 오지 않을지도 모릅니다.

title: Idle Awakening: Mages Path
description:
게임 정보
Start your path as a simple human — and build your own story of becoming a true mage. Plan your daily routines, manage carefully crafted lists of actions, and steadily improve every aspect of your magical life.
Explore a rich and expanding world full of opportunities. Unlock new actions, resources, and systems at your own pace — and discover how much there is to unfold. Every hour brings something new: a potion to brew, an upgrade to earn, a choice that shapes your next step.
Design your workflow by combining manual tasks and automated sequences. Experiment with dozens of magical materials, learn powerful spells, and customize your home with furniture that provides meaningful bonuses.
Whether you play actively or prefer passive growth, your journey continues — even while you're away.
🔹 Core Features
Smart Progression
Start with just a handful of basic actions — and gradually unlock a vast network of upgrades, abilities, systems, and tools to manage them.
Action & List System
Plan, combine and automate your daily routines through a modular system of reusable action lists. Min-max or just let it flow.
Crafting & Alchemy
Craft dozens of materials, potions and unique accessories to improve your long-term growth.
Procedural Map Exploration
Explore an ever-changing map to discover rare herbs, treasure fragments and one-of-a-kind items with permanent effects.
Magic
Learn and upgrade your own arsenal of spells — from passive effects to direct magical actions.
No Prestige System
Your progress is permanent. No forced resets or repetitive loops — only forward momentum.
Flexible Skill Tree
Specialize your mage with a vast skill tree that adapts to your current needs — you can reassign skills during your journey to suit different strategies.
Customizable Home
Build and upgrade your private space with furniture that boosts your actions, automation, and progression efficiency.

title: Duskmarch
description:
게임 정보
Duskmarch에서 서사적인 모험을 떠나세요. 매혹적인 주사위 기반 RPG로, 여러분의 선택이 풍부한 판타지 세계를 만들어갑니다! 주사위를 굴려 속성을 결정하고 다양한 원형에서 선택하여 독특한 영웅을 만드세요. 스릴 넘치는 경험을 통해 레벨을 올리고, 동료를 모집하며, 그들의 인벤토리와 능력을 관리하여 궁극의 파티를 구성하세요. 모바일에 최적화된 전술적인 턴제 전투, 몰입형 스토리텔링, 전략적 탐험의 조화를 경험하세요.
전설을 창조하세요
먼저 주사위를 굴려 캐릭터의 스탯을 만들고, 플레이 스타일에 맞는 원형을 선택하세요 — 교활한 도적, 강력한 전사, 신비로운 마법사 등. 경험치를 얻고, 새로운 레벨을 해금하며, 더 큰 도전에 맞서기 위해 기술이나 주문을 강화하세요. 독특한 능력을 가진 동료를 모집하고, 장비를 맞춤 설정하여 캐릭터 중심의 RPG에서 전략을 보완하세요.
생동감 넘치는 세계를 탐험하세요
2D 세계 지도를 여행하며, 이동 포인트를 사용하여 흥미로운 장소에 도달하세요 — 각각은 매혹적인 이야기, 대화, 전투로 가는 관문입니다. 으스스한 숲에서 고대 유적까지, 모든 장소는 기술 검사를 통한 대화형 내러티브를 제공하여 갈등을 평화적으로 해결하거나 전투를 통해 해결할 수 있습니다. 장비 업그레이드를 위한 상점, 희귀한 전리품을 위한 퀘스트, 새로운 동맹을 만날 기회를 제공하는 허브 역할을 하는 성에 들어가세요. 이동 포인트를 보충하고 다음 모험을 준비하기 위해 휴식을 취하세요. 이 오픈 월드 탐험 RPG에서.
전술적인 전투를 마스터하세요
이니셔티브가 행동 순서를 결정하는 턴제 전투에 참여하세요. 역동적인 전장을 이동하고, 무기를 교체하며, 능력을 발휘하거나 주문을 시전하여 적을 이기세요. 모든 공격은 물리 기반 비주얼로 20면체 주사위를 굴리며, 영웅의 능력을 적의 방어와 비교합니다. 데미지 주사위가 전장을 굴러다니며, 타격할 때마다 흥미를 더합니다. 전투에서 승리하여 경험치, 동전, 전리품을 얻거나, 상황이 불리해지면 도망치세요. 이 주사위 전투 RPG에서 적을 정복하거나 그들이 흩어지는 것을 지켜보세요.
서사적인 이야기를 풀어가세요
독특한 사건, 캐릭터, 미스터리를 엮은 장소 기반의 이야기를 발견하세요. 속성 검사를 통한 대화 선택이 결과를 형성합니다 — 평화를 협상하거나, 비밀을 밝히거나, 전투에 뛰어드세요. 성은 이야기와 전투의 광대한 네트워크를 제공하며, 귀중한 보상이나 새로운 동료를 숨긴 상점과 관심 지점을 가진 이정표 역할을 합니다. 여러분의 결정이 이야기 중심의 RPG에서 개인적인 서사를 만들어갑니다.
Duskmarch를 플레이하는 이유
주사위 기반 메카닉 : 스탯, 공격, 데미지를 물리적으로 만족스럽게 결정합니다.
깊은 커스터마이징 : 원형, 기술, 장비로 영웅과 파티를 구성합니다.
전략적 탐험 : 글로벌 지도를 탐색하고 이야기 풍부한 장소에 뛰어드세요.
전술적인 전투 : 이니셔티브와 주사위로 턴제 전투를 계획하세요.
몰입형 이야기 : 선택과 기술 검사를 통해 내러티브를 형성합니다.
리플레이성 : 다양한 원형, 동료, 결과가 새로운 모험을 보장합니다.

title: MoonMiners
description:
게임 정보
MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator set in a dystopian future where you play as space miners working for a ruthless megacorporation, far from Earth. Completing your job might just be harder than staying alive - and that’s saying something.

As part of a mining crew, your mission is to complete a quota made up of various objectives. But danger lurks in every task: random threats, hostile environments, and even betrayal from within the team. Sometimes the greatest threat isn’t aliens - it’s your clumsy, chaotic crewmates.

title: Guardians of the Wild Sky
description:
게임 정보
Fall into the world of Wild Sky, a survival-crafting adventure where magical creatures called Guardians are your greatest allies. Sail through the skies on your trusty airship and explore a massive world; discover unique floating biomes teeming with life, hidden treasures, and dangerous beasts to conquer. 
Explore solo or play cooperatively with friends as you build everything from cozy cottages to elaborate homesteads, or even floating castles that can fly! 
Guardians: Your Magical Companions
At the heart of your journey are the Guardians - extraordinary creatures brimming with elemental magic and unique personalities. Your Guardians are more than companions; they’re your partners in shaping the skies.
Capture and bond with Guardians, each with unique abilities and traits that can aid you in combat, exploration, survival and crafting
Build strong relationships by feeding, grooming and caring for your Guardians. Watch them grow into loyal companions that can fight by your side or lend their work skills to your base or airship crew
Unlock a deep breeding system, combining traits and genetics to create powerful new Guardians tailored to your playstyle

title: Danger in Pompeii
description:
게임 정보
Relive the last day of Pompeii in this adventure puzzle game! Decipher Mercury’s message by helping the townspeople solve their mysterious problems and escape the eruption of Mount Vesuvius. Live a rich story and solve unique puzzles in the heart of the famous city of Pompeii.

title: Moros Protocol
description:
게임 정보
You wake up aboard The Orpheus, a derelict warship lost in deep space and crawling with horrors. No memory. No allies. Only the instinct to fight and a voice urging you forward. The ship shifts around you, the enemies never stop, and survival means battling through blood-soaked corridors to uncover what lies ahead.
Set in a haunting, low-poly world with crunchy pixel textures, Moros Protocol blends fast-paced combat of classic '90s and early 2000s FPS games, the unpredictability of genre-defining roguelites, and the challenge of Souls-like boss fights. Battle relentless enemies and towering nightmares in a brutal test of skill and willpower. With procedurally generated levels, evolving threats, and intense action, survival is never guaranteed.
The ship is a war zone. The enemy is endless. The odds are against you.
You may be outnumbered, but you are not outmatched.
🔺TACTICAL FPS COMBAT
Moros Protocol combines relentless action with adaptability and customization. Shape your loadout and let the augments and weapons you find dictate your fighting style. And yes, you can kick your enemies.

title: Otherskin
description:
게임 정보

A mission that’s expected to be your last:
Planet Vandermire, the ancestral home of the extinct “Magna” species, is suspected to be the source of the ever expanding Corruption; a universal threat to all life in the universe. Alex is “lucky” number 13 of volunteering Space Crusaders, ready to give their life in deadly solo-expeditions on the planet's surface. Mission “Exodus” empowers individuals with a unique high technology AI suit in order to gather as much information as possible, before falling to the Corruption. It is hoped that with each attempt, scientists can increase the time of survival on the surface and find a solution to contain the Corruption.

Collect alien morphs to expand your abilities:
While Alex explores the planet, every enemy encounter can change your experience! By absorbing alien "morphs", you gather new moves and powers that can literally turn the world upside down.

Improve your unique AI-powered suit:
Upgrade your suit powers and maximise weapon impact, life support and combat agility. The high tech suit includes an AI voice that will help Alex on her journey.

Ranged weapons and melee combat:
Use your most powerful ranged weapons and combine them with fast close combat moves. It's a breeze to switch between both.

Explore Vandermire:
This foreign planet is full of varied biomes. Scout every corner of this beautiful but dangerous alien world in order to collect more information about the origins of the Corruption.

title: Luminary
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist/Follow and then Join our Discord and the Army of Luminaries
You are a Luminary, a warrior of light. As your world falls into chaos the more dark magic is harnessed and exploited (warping the world and its inhabitants) "You" and your fellow Luminaries evolved to make use of the world's less prevalent resource, light magic. With that power, as you grow stronger throughout your adventures, you will gain the strength needed to rid your world of darkness, and bring back the light.
MAIN FEATURES of LUMINARY
Aside for the overall graphical fidelity, and ease of access to the Openworld ARPG genre for all, There are 5 main pillars of Luminary, that the gameplay and mechanics focus on:
EXPLORATION AND ADVENTURE
- A dense world to explore with a robust fun locomotion system that allows you to go anywhere. Running, Jumping, Gliding, Swimming, Climbing. Just moving around the world and exploring is truly fun.
BATTLES AND COMBAT
- A real time yet forgiving skill base combat system, where you can dynamically switch between fighting styles with the press of a button. Melee, Ranged, Magic, Blocking, Dodging, Parries. Play what style best suits you with a simple switch of your weapon

title: TEXNOPLAZM
description:
게임 정보
                  TEXNOPLAZM is a first person brawler/shooter hybrid centered on three intertwined movesets for punches, ranged weapons and firearms.
Defeat foes by wielding their own weapons, seamlessly switch combat styles during fights, and blend your combat skills and mobility for the most imaginative takedowns.
Year 200X, somewhere in Europe.
In a world where advanced magic works like technology, extraordinary feats are attainable for those who possess the right sorcerer code.
Nestled in the urban jungle, a street gang traffics synthetic companions known in the underground as “Dolls". One of them follows her routine—until the moment she does not.

Without any directive to guide her, she fights purely on instinct, a machine now unbound by purpose.

You are the Girl With No Name, you are a Technoplasm.

title: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode
description:
게임 정보
스토리
Cameraman: 파일럿 에피소드 은 시간을 구부리고 중력을 조작하여 퍼즐을 풀고 생존하는 심리 공포 게임입니다. 80년대 영국 TV와 M.C. 에셔에서 영감을 받아, 익숙한 장소를 훨씬 더 음산하게 뒤틀어 놓는 끊임없이 변화하는 방과 공간을 탐험하게 됩니다. VHS 녹화기 하나만을 갖춘 채, 캠코더 렌즈를 통해서만 볼 수 있는 수수께끼 같은 도전과 흉측한 이상 현상에 맞서야 합니다.
주요 특징
영국 아날로그 공포: 포털의 반대편에서 Cameraman은 익숙한 것을 경험합니다. 오래된 영국 TV 스튜디오, 구식 기술, 기묘하게 비어 있는 스튜디오와 먼지 쌓인 사무실 공간이 그것입니다.
중력 기반 퍼즐: 벽과 천장을 걸어 다니며 반대편의 수수께끼 같은 경로를 탐색하세요.
캠코더 시점: 80년대 스타일의 카메라 렌즈를 통해 우리 세계 너머의 신비를 보게 됩니다. 아티팩트, 버벅거리는 글리치, 고전적인 타이머가 포함되어 있습니다.
시간 되감기: 특정 객체를 되감아 환경의 도전을 극복하세요. 앞으로 나아가기 위해 필요할 수 있습니다.
실사 시
autokwd: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode,Cameraman: 파일럿 에피소드

title: Double Date - Yuri Visual Novel
description:
게임 정보
Alice is a disaster when it comes to asking women out. But when she adopts a dog from the shelter, she wasn't expecting to be knocked over by an absolutely cute lady who makes her want to try. When their dogs help them meet again, Alice starts to fall for Sophie. Will she be able to get her feelings across? Featuring the best wingdogs, Dani and Apple!
Apple "Awwww Alice is being flirty!"
Dani "Is that what you call it?"
Apple "Maybe we'll call it an attempt."
Features
Kinetic visual novel (no choices)
~25,000 word story
Get the point of view from the dogs helping their lovestruck owners!
Original sprite art, and 4 CGs (cutscenes)
Steam achievements

title: RANGER COMMANDO
description:
게임 정보
Always wanted to feel like an '80s action hero? Take down a global terrorist organization?
Now you can!
Explore Random Generated Missions
Assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up - complete a variety of dynamic objectives. No handholding, but easy to pick up! Every playthrough brings a fresh challenge with diverse terrains and layouts.
Bring Total Destruction
Unload an arsenal of high-powered weapons, raining bullets and explosions on everything in sight. Make it personal!
Complete Missions Your Way
Whether you prefer stealth or full-frontal chaos, tackle objectives in your own style. 
What to Expect?
Ranger Commando is a small game for quick, replayable fun - no complex progression or roguelike mechanics to worry about. A campaign consists of 10 missions played in various locations around the world.
Tactical gameplay, with light stealth mechanics.
Perfect for a quick, stress-relieving session after a long day.
Every mission is less than 8 minutes!

Solo dev project, please be gentle 🙏
About World Peace Industries
Once a trusted private military contractor and leading weapon manufacturer, World Peace Industries has now become a global threat. Hired to protect nations, it has gone rogue, amassing power and constructing fortified bases worldwide.
Believing they are the only force capable of maintaining global stability, they will go to any lengths to impose order - no matter the cost. Their actions grow more ruthless with each passing day.

title: Fantastic Haven
description:
게임 정보
균형을 위협하는 기술적 발전에 의해 마법이 점진적으로 사라져 가는 세계에서, 당신은 대륙의 보호자인 장로 역할을 맡습니다.
이곳의 주민들은 생물을 사냥하고 조금씩 마법을 버리는 것을 선호하지만, 당신의 사명은 판타지 생물들을 구조하여 균형을 되찾고, 외교와 교육을 통해 인간과 생물이 조화를 이루며 살아갈 수 있게 하는 것입니다.
새로운 보호소를 설립하세요

원하는 시작 지점을 선택하세요. 모든 장소가 서로 다르며, 각각의 난이도도 다릅니다.
기본 기반 시설을 건설하여 새로운 연구와 건물을 잠금 해제하고, 이를 통해 새로운 생물들을 받아들여 보호소를 번성하게 하세요.

주변 지역을 탐험하세요

마법사를 내보내 주변 지역을 탐험하고, 부상당한 생물이나 멸종 위협에 처한 생물 등 관심 지점을 찾아내세요. 이 생물들을 피난처로 데려오고, 적대적인 사람들과 협상하고, 미래를 바꾸는 결정을 내리고, 이용 가능한 5가지 에테르를 수집하세요. 에테르는 게임의 제작 자원이자 화폐 역할을 합니다.


생물들을 보호소로 데려올 땐, 우선 격리 구역에 배치한 후 다시 기존 생활권으로 옮기거나 새로운 생활권을 만들어야 합니다. 이때 각 생물에 필요한 요소를 생각하고, 다른 생물과 잘 지낼 수 있을지 여부도 고려해야 합니다. 당신의 목표는 그런 생물이 자연 서식지로 돌아갈 수 있을 때까지 잘 보살피고, 필요한 것을 제공해 주고, 이를 통해 점진적으로 마법을 복원하는 것입니다.


보호소를 최적화하기 위한 연구를 수행하는 것과 더불어, 시민들이 마법 생물들을 보살필 수 있도록 훈련시키다 보면 보호소의 명성을 높일 수 있습니다. 외교를 통해 현지 주민들과 강한 유대 관계를 맺고 생물과 인간, 자원과 마법 사이의 조화를 되찾으세요.


새로운 생물을 풀어줄 때마다 마법이 조금씩 복원되고 세계의 균형이 안정화됩니다. 한 지역에서 마법이 완전히 복원되면, 당신의 임무도 끝이 납니다.
하지만 당신의 도움이 필요한 구역은 그 외에도 많이 있습니다.

title: Biped 2
description:
게임 정보
Biped 2는 바이페달 로봇 Aku와 Sila가 등장하는 게임의 후속작입니다. Aku와 Sila는 서로를 지키며 함께 모험을 떠납니다. 퍼즐, 우정, 서포트, 재미로 가득한 협동 액션-어드벤처 게임입니다!
지구의 모든 비컨을 재활성화한 후, 바이페달 영웅들은 멀리 떨어진 행성에서 도움을 요청하는 신호를 수신했습니다. 함께 은하계를 건너, 곤궁에 처한 행성을 구하세요! 작지만 위대하게!
즐거운 컨트롤
클래식한 두 다리의 로봇들에게 새롭고 다양한 이동 방식이 추가되었습니다!
행글라이더로 우아하게 날아오르면서 패턴을 그리고, 갈고리로 난간과 파괴된 지형을 넘나드세요!
방방곡곡 슬라이딩도 가능합니다!
특별한 한 쌍 기믹
Aku와 Sila는 단순히 전진하도록 서로 돕는 걸 넘어, 협동하고 동작을 맞춥니다! 로봇 파트너와 하나가 되어, 각자 '다리'나 '팔' 역할을 맡을 수 있습니다. 수많은 파트너 퍼즐들이 기다립니다!

title: Burning Sword: Death Sun
description:
게임 정보
Chinese Martial Arts
In the game, you shall encounter martial techniques and inner energy arts inspired by the golden era of 90s wuxia tales. Prepare to be immersed in a thrilling, elegant, and fluid combat experience. You must memorize and master each technique, adapting your style to match both the situation and your foes.
Story
When ‘Zhang Yixian' loses someone important, he embarks on a vengeful journey against ‘Gao Tianqi’, master of the Death Sun poison. You’ll wield the power of a top sword master in intense Hack-and-Slash combat, striking with deadly precision and swiftness with no mercy.
Face the Challenge
In this world, the challenge stays the same for all — there is no difficulty setting. But do not worry, falling in battle brings no punishment. So keep training, learn your moves well, and use them wisely to defeat every enemy that stands in your way.
Skill Tree
You will be able to learn the martial arts that Zhang Yixian can use, including combo techniques and powerful skills that can be unleashed. Some of these arts require the use of Qi. Therefore, study and master them well before going out to test your skills in the martial world.

title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
description:
게임 정보
지금은 카니발 타임!!
모두가 신나게 파티 중… 그런데 오늘, 짜증나는 외계인들이 지구를 침공했다고?!
보스를 박살내라!
파티를 싫어하는 외계인들, 심술 가득한 보스들이 이끌고 있어!

title: Into The Grid
description:
게임 정보
로크라이크 덱 빌딩과 테이블탑 보드게임의 콜라보는 어떨지 궁금하지 않으신가요? Into The Grid의 액션감 넘치는 카드 배틀과 자원 관리를 통해 깊이 있는 전략적 맵 탐험을 경험해 보세요!

title: Mimic
description:
게임 정보

Mimic is an online multiplayer survival horror game where players (5 in matchmaking, up to 8 in private lobbies) must work together to get off a doomed spaceship, the Icarus. An alien creature, the Mimic, is disguising itself amongst the survivors and the Icarus has been set on a collision course with the nearby sun. The alien can be disguised as anyone, and stalking the corridors of the Icarus are killer maintenance droids; hunting down survivors to remove the alien threat, killing indiscriminately and relentlessly.

Throughout the match, players can vote and send commands to the android to hunt a specific player down, they can sabotage escape attempts, and sow chaos amongst those playing. Players must figure out who they can trust their lives with and work together, or are all doomed to share the same fate.
Player Roles
The Crew
The crew players must repair the escape shuttle and escape the ship before it is destroyed. However, they must unlock security access and evade the killer androids. They can only successfully escape if they escape without the Mimic amongst their party.

The Agent
One of the human players is a corporate agent, sent by the corporate owners of the Icarus to secretly gather evidence, complete their own secret objectives; and ensuring no witnesses leave the ship alive but them.


The Mimic is disguised as a human but may reveal their selves at any time to feed and lay their eggs. Their sole desire to escape the ship alive.

In public matchmaking the rules are set, but in a private lobby anything goes. Want you to be joined by up to 7 other friends? Want 3 Droids? 4 Mimics? Everlasting fire spreading damage? The rules are made by you so go crazy and have fun in a private lobby.


At terminals around the ship, you can cast your vote to send commands to the AI android roaming the halls to target a specific player. Don't trust someone? Send the android to do your dirty work.


Find Mementos, audio logs, testimonies and reports to discover the truth about the Icarus and its crew and discover the source of the Mimic creature.

A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game.

IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms.

You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued.

title: Daymare Town
description:
게임 정보
the World of Daymare
Daymare Town is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game. You find yourself in a heart of a strange city populated by peculiar Metamorph creatures. This town is full of nooks and crannies, puzzles, secrets and items to collect to help you along the way. Can you escape the nightmare of a day?

Story
You are not alone here. You will meet peculiar daymare inhabitants. Some of them will help you, some need your help. Almost everyone has a story. You can choose to learn those stories if you just listen or look carefully at the environmental story telling.

Puzzles
You will have to dive deep into the nooks and crannies of this town in order to solve all its mysteries and puzzles, of which are plenty. The better part of them will have you fighting the entropy of a town, bringing back signal to noise. There are also creatures here that need your help, look at them closely to learn who they are and what they need from you. You will have an inventory of items to use while solving puzzles.

Graphics
Entire game is hand-drawn. There's nothing auto-generated nor procedural. There's no AI used in any capacity. Each location was thoughtfully designed. Its stylized and sketchy character emphasizes the eerie atmosphere of an unshaped nightmare you found yourself in.

Piano music for this game was created by contemporary composer Alex Voytenko. His style of music perfectly emphasizes the atmosphere of unspoken madness permeating this town.

title: MycoRelic
description:
게임 정보
You are a sentient fungus, reanimating the scrapped robotic body of a long-dead machine.
Play Solo or Join Your Friends
Cooperate with your friends to solve puzzles, defeat bosses, and clear dungeons. Join your friend's world bringing your character and items with you. 
Build Your Combat Style in a Classless System
Dodge, block, parry, and engage the hostile tribes and creatures of the island. Master a variety of weapons, each with their own move sets and statistics. Equip yourself with armor that suits your playstyle and aesthetic.
Scavenge Parts to Enhance Your Robotic Body
Start with a decrepit, moldy frame. Replace it to overcome the dangers of the environment, support your combat style, or enhance elemental effects. Expand your stamina, boost the integrity of your frame, and increase the potency of your fungal magic.

title: Flow Of War
description:
게임 정보
Inspired by classic RTS games, Flow of War offers a unique Real-Time Strategy (RTS) experience with Auto-Micro mechanics for both Workers and Warriors. This allows you to concentrate on other aspects of a classic RTS without the need to micromanage individual units.


Design a well-constructed base not only for good defense but also to allow workers to operate efficiently and perform their tasks in infinitely unique maps.







Embrace the chaos and excitement of battles where multiple units are in action simultaneously.

Unlike other RTS while you have to micro every single unit, in Flow of War they will fight automatically and you can watch them like it’s Esports!





Besides inter-racial warfare, you'll also battle with neutral factions to secure key locations, gain rewards and special points for upgrading your army.




Play fully procedurally generated maps, each game offering a unique and never-before-seen map for both standard and custom game modes.

title: The Whims of the Gods 🏝️🏠🌋
description:
게임 정보
🏠 꿈꾸던 도시 🏠
나만의 도시를 건설하고 성장하는 것을 지켜보세요. 신흥 문명의 지도자가 되어보세요!
우리는, 고대의 기묘한 신들이, 너에게 목표를 주었다! 너는 활기찬 고대 대도시를 건설하고, 그곳 주민들의 필요를 충족시키며, 얻은 자원을 효율적으로 처리해야 한다. 쉬울 것 같으냐? 아마도 집이나 창고를 만들어 식량을 저장하는 것은 큰 도전이 아닐지 모르지만, 복잡한 생산 시스템을 구축하고, 식물을 재배하며, 동물을 기르는 일은 결코 쉬운 과제가 아니다. 그리고 우리는 네가 얼마나 참패하는지 지켜볼 것이다...
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 협동 도시 건설 게임 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
다른 플레이어와 함께 협동 게임을 플레이하세요. 힘을 합쳐 번성하는 메트로폴리스를 만드세요!

title: Dead Weight
description:
게임 정보


Dead Weight의 샌드박스 세계에서 신기한 스팀펑크 모험이 기다립니다. 항공선을 선택하고, 연료를 비축하고, 신뢰할 수 있는 아군을 모집하며 위험한 섬을 탐험하고 턴제 전투에서 고대 신들과 싸울 준비를 하세요. 새로운 스킬을 배우고, 힘을 기르고, 게임 후반 치명타를 피해보세요.
특징

고대 신들에 도전하고 크라이시스를 싸우기
세상은 극벽히 변하고 있고 그에 맞춰 변화해야 됩니다. 강력한 생물들이 영원한 잠에서 깨어났습니다. 그들과 싸우기로 결정하거나, 아니면 금지된 지식을 얻기 위해 그들을 따라갈 건가요? 적응하고 게임 후반 특별한 이벤트를 준비하세요.



턴제 전략 전투를 즐기기
전장에는 공간이 거의 없습니다. 승리하고 싶다면 미리 생각해보세요.

description: Adult Game

title: Animal Shelter 2
description:
게임 정보
우리 네발 달린 친구들을 도와주세요!
Animal Shelter Simulator 2에는 도움이 필요한 많은 동물들이 여러분의 손길을 기다립니다. 깨끗하고 안전한 환경은 물론 음식과 물, 그리고 무엇보다도 많은 애정이 필요합니다. 다행이도 이번에는 혼자가 아니랍니다!

새로운 직원과 함께 보호소를 발전시켜 보세요!
보호소 전체를 혼자서 관리하는 건 너무나도 힘든 일입니다! 그 중 일부 업무를 대신해줄 숙련된 직원의 도움을 받아보세요. 하지만 인력관리가 쉬운 일이 아니라는 점, 잊지마세요!

코옵 모드에서 친구와 함께 플레이해 보세요!
친구와 함께라면 재미는 두 배! 친구들을 초대해 보호소에서 함께 일하고 동물들에게 완벽한 집을 찾아주세요! 아름다운 풍경 속, 귀여운 동물들과 교류하고 감정에 이입하며 즐거운 시간을 보내보세요.

입양 과정에는 많은 인내가 필요합니다. 적절한 사람과 적절한 동물을 이어주는 것이 무엇보다 중요합니다! Animal Shelter Simulator 2에서는 입양 희망자가 보호소를 방문해 직접 눈으로 동물을 보고 입양 결정을 내립니다. 동물의 특징, 현재 상태, 그리고 보호소 시설과 상태 등 다양한 요인이 입양 결정에 영향을 끼친다는 것을 잊지마세요!

보호소는 숲과 산으로 둘러싸인 마치 그림처럼 아름다운 작은 마을에 위치해 있습니다. 보호소를 청결하게 유지하고 정기적으로 기능을 개선해 보세요! 낮과 밤 모두의 아름다운 경치를 즐겨보세요!

쓰다듬고, 함께 놀고, 옷을 입혀주세요! Animal Shelter가 돌아왔습니다. 활기 넘치는 주민들은 항상 여러분과 이야기를 나누고 싶어합니다. 동물을 위해 모든 필요한 도움을 주고 건강을 지켜주세요. 그 보답으로 여러분은 동물이 주는 무한한 사랑을 받을 겁니다.

title: Journey of Realm：Dawn Dew
description:
게임 정보
「Persisting in kindness, some people say it is absurd and dismiss it; But in the Realm where wedge energy and will intertwine, it brought us you and rally you.」
As a kind soul that comes to the realm, begins a journey of redemption in the realm of the raging tide of black beasts.
「When greed and violence destroy the nameless flower, we know why the Dawn Dew comes......」
In the process of continuous progress, discover the history of the realm and uncover the truth of the Black beast tide.
Explore box style maps with designs, collect various resources in the scene, and make yourself stronger.

title: Windstorm: The Legend of Khiimori
description:
게임 정보
Take on the role of a brave courier rider in Windstorm: The Legend of Khiimori! Bond with your horse and tame the open wilds of 13th century Mongolia. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.
Explore untamed land.
13th century Mongolia is the home of history’s best horse riders. The land is beautiful and vast, full of wonders and intriguing tales to uncover. Be prepared for harsh climates, steep cliffs, and amazing landscapes. Keep yourself safe from danger by strategically planning your delivery routes across the wide steppes, over snowy peaks or through the scorching desert.
Evolve your horses
Your horses will be essential in charting the expansive Mongolian landscape. Breed horses with specialized traits to overcome the many challenges along your path. Pair the best stock to breed increased capabilities across generations. Train your horses, build and maintain your bonds and unleash their full potential to become a true Yam courier rider. Enjoy unparalleled realism in lifelike equine behavior and animation, refined and approved by experts.

title: Kemono Teatime
description:
게임 정보
Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. Come now and live out your bestest and cutest life—down to the last drop. Though, you do know that once it's run out, that's it, right? It'd do you best to learn that all good things come to an end.
Meet all the Kemomimis that come through the cafe and help them wind down, spend a cute and adorable time sipping on some tea, and come to terms with their ultimate fates.
ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ Meow!

"Welcome!"
Come on in! Here, we strive to make the remainder of our customers' lives as enjoyable as possible, so we've curated a cute space for everyone to relax and find peace in. We also have a great range of tea blends and delicious desserts on offer, so please make yourself at home.

Now, to get things started, how about a nice cup of tea blended just for you?

Create your own unique teas with our stock of 9 black teas, 15 herbs, and 6 secret ingredients. Get to know the customers and make them something that they'll love while you immerse yourself in the wonderful sounds of the tea-making process.

De-stress with the cafe's ASMR, with all its sounds and effects recorded in binaural audio. The background music also changes with each customer, giving you unique experiences that come and go with each new soul you meet.

All the cafe staff and customers (except me) have animal ears! Please savor each encounter and goodbye while you can—I'm sure you'll have a very special and unforgettable time here with all the people you meet.


The cafe's trusty manager and elder of two sisters. She's the resident tea-blending expert.



Tarte's adorable little sister who is a patissiere and the face of the cafe.



A traveler who lodges at the cafe in exchange for some handy gifts.



Meet a host of these cute and colorful characters at the cafe!
You caught that, right? The shop's only running for a maximum of 21 days. What kind of people and stories will you get to know during this time? And is the cafe really shutting down after that? Why open up a limited-time cafe to begin with, anyway? The truth is up to you to uncover!

If you like what you see, please wishlist Kemono Teatime and we will deliver the latest updates to you. Until then, please sit back with a nice cup of tea and relax.

title: Aeterna Lucis
description:
게임 정보
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.
A new installment in the Aeterna Universe

The unforeseen consequences after the ending of Aeterna Noctis broke the balance between Light and Darkness. The Queen of Light awakes alone in a changing world at the edge of the void. It's up to her luminous majesty to find answers and stop the end of all things.

The Aeterna Universe continues to expand with the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. This time players will take on the role of the other monarch cursed by the will of the Supreme God Chaos., a protagonist featuring new abilities and bearing the responsibility of saving everything that has existed and will exist.
Game mechanics

Metroidvania first and foremost - You'll explore new areas interconnected in a large world map full of secrets, secondary quests, and evils to defeat. As the Queen of Light, you must uncover the mysteries of a land never seen before in the franchise and gather allies to stop the imminent collapse of space and time. The variety of settings is enormous, as is an artistic direction that gives each area a unique personality.

Fast-paced gameplay - Every Metroidvania focused on combat and exploration needs a fast-paced combat system and tons of passive and offensive skills... Guess what, both requirements are featured in Aeterna Lucis. The formula already implemented in its predecessor is now fully upgraded including much more polished combat controls, brand-new abilities, and exclusive weapons for the Queen of Light.

Level design and progress - The game features an intuitive level design for the players to enjoy precise movement controls and complete liberty to explore and discover alternative routes. This is a Metroidvania, remember? As you become more skilled and the Queen of Light gets new abilities, Aeterna Lucis allows players to exploit the full potential of their character in confrontations against final bosses that promise a visual, sound, and playable spectacle.

- Since Aeterna Noctis, the franchise's universe has always been characterized by a coherent art design that makes all gameplay areas, enemies, and NPCs feel part of the same world. Using our trademark stained glass art and hand drawing, all the settings and graphic elements stand out for their meticulous attention to detail. The music, another of the pillars of the game, will allow you to enjoy from the most epic moments to the most relaxing ones with a sound quality on par with the great titles of the genre.

- The Aeterna Universe uses dialogues, item descriptions, and environmental storytelling that don't interfere with the player's progress and the general flow of the game. Aeterna Lucis is no exception and introduces a lot of new details about the franchise's lore and the secrets behind the curse of the two monarchs.

title: City of Ashes
description:
게임 정보
A brutal post-apocalyptic fighting game set in the ruins of civilization. Fight to survive. Fight to rescue. Fight for redemption.

About This GameStep into the decaying streets of a ruined metropolis in City of Ashes, a visceral third-person isometric fighting game where every punch, kick, and improvised weapon strike carries weight. Set in a post-apocalyptic world where a devastating pandemic and the collapse of governments have plunged humanity into chaos, you play as a former MMA fighter searching for his kidnapped daughter in a city overrun by cannibalistic gangs.
Face brutal hand-to-hand combat as you fight through deranged enemies, gang leaders, and their twisted arenas to rescue the only family you have left.

Game Pillars
Melee Combat with Combos
Master a dynamic melee combat system designed for fluidity and impact. Chain powerful combos, block and counter attacks, and adapt to enemy fighting styles in adrenaline-fueled encounters.
Special Melee Abilities
Unleash devastating special attacks to turn the tide of combat. From crushing takedowns to cinematic finishing moves, your skills will evolve with your journey.
RPG Progression System
Level up your fighter with a straightforward RPG system. Unlock new moves, enhance your stats, and customize your combat style to suit your playstyle.
Loot and Improvised Weapons
Scavenge the urban wasteland for gear and loot to upgrade your abilities. Use improvised weapons—pipes, bats, crowbars, and more—to gain an edge in battle.
Photorealistic Environment
Explore a hauntingly beautiful post-apocalyptic world brought to life with photorealistic visuals. Every ruined street, crumbling skyscraper, and derelict arena immerses you in a gripping atmosphere of decay and danger.

A Story of Survival and Vengeance
In the aftermath of a global pandemic and government collapse, you’ve struggled to survive with your daughter. But when a cannibalistic gang ambushes you and kidnaps her, your world is shattered. Fueled by desperation and rage, you’ll stop at nothing to bring her back—even if it means taking on the city’s most feared gang in their blood-soaked arena.

title: GlitchSPANKR
description:
게임 정보
이 게임은 “직장에서 해도 괜찮은(Safe For Work)” 게임이며, 일반적으로 13세 이상 이용 권장입니다! 네, 엉덩이 때리기가 테마이긴 하지만 전부 장난이니까요. 음란하게 생각하지 마세요!
개요
당신은 90년대의 12살 꼬마 게이머입니다. 엄마가 금지했던 게임 Big Booty Slapper 6을 밤에 몰래 방에서 컴퓨터에 설치했죠. 그런데 실행하자마자 뭔가 이상합니다. 이름이 Spunk인 변신 바이러스가 게임을 장악했고, 내부 코드를 먹어치우고 있어요!
당신의 무기는 GlitchSPANKR 백신 소프트웨어와 금속 막대에 달린 말랑한 분홍색 손! 깨진 코드로 가득한 세계에 잠입해, 매번 달라지는 레벨을 탐험하며 이 바이러스를 사냥하세요.
하지만 Spunk는 단순한 악당이 아닙니다. 그는 외롭고 불안정하며… 어쩌면 이 세계의 미래를 그의 ‘존재하지 않는 손’에 쥐고 있을지도 몰라요. 파괴할 수도 있고, 친구가 될 수도 있고… 아니면... 사랑에 빠질 수도 있습니다?
당신의 선택이 이야기를 바꿉니다. 숨겨진 엔딩을 해금하고, SpankStick을 커스터마이즈하고, 디지털 본거지(HQ)를 장식하세요. 게임을 구할 수 있을까요? 아니면… 당신의 흐느적거리는 손에 모든 것이 달려 있습니다.

당신의 믿음직한 무기: 말랑한 분홍 손이 달린 휘어지는 금속 막대입니다. 역할은 단 하나: 전부 때리기. 문제 해결, 바이러스 처벌, 앞에 있는 거의 모든 걸 부숴버리세요! 손은 흔들리며, 휘두르면 휘파람 같은 소리를 냅니다. 그리고 깨집니다.
물리 기반의 때리기와 파괴 시스템! 거의 모든 것이 부서지거나 상호작용 가능해요. 손이 젖었나요? 에어 블로워를 찾으세요. 불탔나요? 그건… 당신 문제예요. 전등, 가구, 감정: 다 때려버리세요. 특히 말하는 그 변기는요.

title: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
description:
게임 정보
Kumitantei™: Old-School Slaughter is a murder-mystery tribute to retro anime and pop culture of 1980's Japan, underlined with a dark twist of horror and conspiracy!
Stylistically inspired by Rumiko Takahashi and classic Japanese adventure games, blended with a wide variety of interwoven gametypes from deck-building to platforming to puzzle solving, and all tightly wrapped in a plot influenced by the Danganronpa series, Kumitantei™ is a love letter to decades of ADVs that wears its many inspirations on its sleeve!
Enter into an engaging world of murder, mystery, and anemoic alternate history where solving complex cases is the key to unravelling the winding narrative!
Meet a colourful ensemble cast of sixteen uniquely gifted Absolute students as they find themselves caught in a deadly Apathy Experiment, where their very humanity is put to the test!

title: Wicked Seed
description:
게임 정보
Wicked Seed는 생존 호러 요소와 액션 턴제 전투 시스템을 결합한 게임입니다.
메인 중앙부의 어두운 숲을 여행하고, 잊혀진 지하 터널을 탐험하며, 대피한 도시를 수색하는 등 다양한 장소를 탐험하며 몬스터의 갑작스러운 출현에 대한 진실을 밝혀내세요.
실시간으로 이동하고, 막고, 받아치고, 회피하며 적의 공격을 방어하세요. 공격을 연계할 때 시간이 느려지며, 각 후속 행동이 이전보다 강력해집니다. 하지만 위험에서 벗어날 충분한 시간을 확보하는 것을 잊지 마세요.
잘 알려지지 않은 길을 탐험하며 독특한 아이템과 업그레이드를 발견하세요. 메모 속 힌트를 해독하여 퍼즐을 풀고 선택적 임무를 수행하세요.
tag: RPG,액션 RPG,턴제 전투,일시 정지 가능한 실시간

title: CleanFall
description:
게임 정보
역동적인 생태계– 포식자가 들끓는 환경에서 생물의 습성을 활용해 살아남아라.
전함 제작 시스템: 강력한 전함을 설계하고 커스터마이징하여 험난한 환경을 항해하세요.

title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands
description:
게임 정보
Eko and the Bewitched Lands is a randomly generated action RPG with Rogue-like elements. Explore and find the castle where the Dark Queen has imprisoned your friend and princess of the realm.
Gameplay is dinamic and fast paced. Dodge at the perfect time to be able to avoid enemy attacks or traps. Play very aggresive stopping enemies from hitting you or be a bit more strategic using your grenades or the environment.

title: Knight of Nevermore
description:
게임 정보
Knight of Nevermore is a 2D action roguelike where skill and strategy are key. Accurately timing your attacks, dodges, and parries makes the difference between crushing defeat or emerging from combat unscathed. Battle your way through procedurally-generated levels that change on every run, and power up by assembling potent combos and synergies. Achieving victory will be hard, but every run is a chance to expand your knowledge and try new strategies.
Fight Like a Mage Knight
Combat in Knight of Nevermore is tight and difficult, but entirely fair, and every enemy has a handcrafted move-set to challenge you in new ways. You'll need to learn enemy patterns, master timings, and leverage spells and items to tip the balance in your favor.
Build Strategically
With numerous unique items, weapons, spells, and consumables, every run offers new choices and combos. Become indomitable, pile up resources, sling spells, or land mighty melee attacks: you never know what opportunities the next run will bring.
Explore the Darkness

title: Necro Siege
description:
게임 정보
Necro Siege is a down and dirty First-Person Action Horror Shooter crafted by one developer with a love of everything horror and community-driven development. In this early stage of development players have the opportunity to help shape the future of the game.
Welcome to Necro Siege
A world where humanity is on the brink of extinction as otherworldly abominations rise from the shadows
Download the demo now and experience visceral gunplay and physics-based dismemberment. Then get involved and help make this the game you want it to be.
A Dark Dystopian Nightmare with no room for humanity.

title: HYPERxFANTASY
description:
게임 정보

잔혹한 디스토피아를 탐험하고, 길 잃은 영혼을 도륙하며, 특이점에 가까운 미래의 광기를 체험하세요. 이것은 실험적인 내러티브 RPG입니다!
희망의 이야기... 그리고 불가피한 특이점을 경험하세요.
공지: 이 HYPER FANTASY 프로그램은 불편하거나 충격적일 수 있는 강렬한 이미지와 주제를 포함하고 있습니다. 공복 상태에서는 플레이하지 마십시오.
-- 무슨 일이야?!
-- 알고 싶지 않아...?
-- 나는 Surcutt-P, 이 HYPER FANTASY PROGRAM의 창조자다.
-- 그리고 너는... 내 함정에 빠졌다!


어떻게 할 건가?
당신은 다음을 하게 됩니다:

title: Randomice
description:
게임 정보
Randomice is an item randomizer where you play as a mouse trying to escape a sprawling home. Designed like a Metroidvania adventure, you’ll plan and carve your path through the rooms using the tools you collect in unpredictable ways.
Find items to move forward
Each run is a compact Metroid-like experience. Find items that allow you to explore the house differently each time. From the magnetic grappling hook that lets you reach the bathroom faucet, to the rocket that can break the cabinet window, the house is full of items, each with its own use.
Adapt to your tools and escape as fast as possible
The same items appear in every run, but always in a different order. That means your route will change based on what you find first. Keep track of the places you can access based on your findings, master the platforming, and build the most efficient path to freedom!
Meet other mice
Along the way, you’ll run into wacky mice with funny dialogue. Help them, and earn new items as rewards!

title: Mystical Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.
Key features
Roguelike Gameplay: Every playthrough is a new adventure, with procedurally generated dungeons, encounters, and challenges.
Tactical Combat: Engage in intense turn-based battles where positioning, timing, and resource management are key to survival. Develop unique strategies to overcome formidable foes, from cunning goblins to ancient dragons.
Deep Character Progression: Customize your heroes with a wide variety of classes, abilities, and equipment. Experiment with different builds and synergies to find the perfect combination for your playstyle.
Unlockables and Secrets: Unlock new classes, items, and abilities with every single run. Uncover hidden paths and secret areas to unravel the mysteries of this world.

title: Ship of Heroes
description:
게임 정보
Show off your heroic side. Create your unique avatar. Select and custom-augment your powers as you rise through the ranks. Team up to defeat enemies in this friendly community, or try the hardest content solo, if you dare… Topple titans and accomplish incredible feats in large raids with dozens of heroes. Defend a nation in space aboard a vast spaceship in the 25th century. Harvest. Craft. Trade. Gain fame, wealth, and power. Uncover secrets and earn badges. Leave your mark on the galaxy in a grand, immersive and new story that really makes you feel like a hero.



Your look and costume are independent from your powers. Customize your character’s face, body, and costume. Choose from tens of thousands of possible looks and costume combinations. Mix and match. Recolor. The possibilities are endless! You can change them at any time, and you never have to give up a beloved look to gain powers or level up. Write your character’s story so other players can read it.





Select from five archetypes, and over 250 powers. Combine crafted augments and powers to create new and unique playstyles. Lock your enemies in stasis or cripple them with debuffs. Create multiple avatars, experiment with builds, think your way to victory. Fight, level up, and crush your enemies.





Harness the power of teamwork. Hang out in a welcoming chat where spammers are banned. Learn from veterans, then mentor new players. Make friends and form supergroups. Play at the level of your friends, whether higher or lower. Create teams of up to 10 with specialized roles. Design advanced attack chains and tactics to defeat specific enemies. Join dozens of other heroes to battle giant monsters and repel invasions of heavily armed aliens.



Rent or buy one or more individual spaces starting at level 1. No waiting lists. Rents are low and easily earned in game. Your space remains as you left it, whether you visit it or not.
Decorate and furnish your indoor space to be anything: cozy home, luxury apartment, secret lair, bunker, command center, roof top terrace, night club, gym, museum, store…Change the color and intensity of the lighting. Rotate, resize, and recolor props.





All options are included in the download and subscription. No premium skins or content. No cash shop, no loot boxes, no purchased add-on, no expensive gear, no microtransactions, no pay to win. Items are earned, crafted, or available for purchase with Dust, the in-game currency earned during gameplay.

title: U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition
description:
게임 정보
A digital version of the iconic U-BOOT The Board Game
Manage the crew of a powerful warship during World War II. Explore enemy territory, win battles using the strength of a steel giant and reliable tactics, and most importantly - overcome the blue abyss.
Lead the war effort
In the claustrophobic iron coffin that is the deck of a U-Boat, the most important thing is to keep your cool. Manage your crew: captain, officers, mechanics and navigators. Give orders, destroy enemy vessels and don't let your own ship sink. Use torpedo attacks and weapons of various calibres.
Develop a plan
Carry out the missions assigned to you. Complete side quests to gain additional experience. Develop strategies and make good use of the resources at your disposal. Take risks, but also be aware of the consequences. It is up to you to make the most of your crew's potential.
Look after your crew
It's not easy to stay mentally healthy while trapped underwater, knowing that every day could be your last. Look after your crew's morale, their wellbeing and safety. Prepare meals for them, treat their wounds, manage the watch system and don't forget that every seafarer needs rest too. Decide whether the success of the mission or the wellbeing of your seafarers is more important.
Think analytically
Conduct tactical operations in real time. Think carefully about every order you give and the cost you will incur for it. Deal with random events and difficulties you encounter on your way. Remember that nothing is impossible at sea, and you must act quickly and without hesitation if you want the mission to succeed.
autokwd: U-Boot: The Board Game - Digital Edition
company: G11 SA, OUT OF THE ORDINARY

title: Demonschool
description:
게임 정보
Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.


Tactics: Rewind any action during the planning phase and create combos to dispatch your foes.
Story: A light horror narrative told through huge avatars with side quests aplenty.
Schedule: Plan your school schedule to level your characters and build their skills.
Friendship: 15 characters with whom to build relationships.
