title: FOX XII
description:
게임 정보
FOX XII is a hybrid shooter that blends intense combat, dungeon crawling, and deep rogue-lite progression. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, uncover powerful loot, and evolve your build with every run in this action-packed ARPG experience.
You play as a spec-ops soldier trapped in an unfamiliar and supernatural environment where every corridor hides enemies, secrets, loot, and gear. Swap freely between top-down tactical gunfights and over-the-shoulder third-person precision as you adapt to shifting threats and unique room layouts. Death is not the end. Each run builds your permanent skills, unlocking new abilities, weapons, and combat styles.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle
description:
게임 정보
In this Jigsaw Puzzle you can:
Use your own images
organized in 'galleries'
Customize the game
select shape and number of pieces
adjust the colors of the environment
change game controller behavior
choose different sounds for actions
and few other minor niceties
Share the experience with your friends or family
Save your games so you can continue them later

title: Moon 2999
description:
게임 정보
Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.

Set in the year 2999, advancements in technology facilitate the colonization of the solar system, giving rise to multiple factions due to enduring political tensions. As the commander of a Luna base, your goal is to supervise and enhance base operations, explore space, and undertake a variety of missions, encompassing engagements with aliens, bounty hunting, factional conflicts, and PvP combat.

PVP combat


Aliens war on Mars


Bounty hunting


Moon2999 is a strategy game set in a future where humans have colonized most of the planets in the solar system. You are the commander of a human faction and you must manage your colony by constructing buildings, recruiting units and leading battles against other factions and Kragh aliens. You can construct a wide range of buildings, from command centers and military missions to production plants and research centers. Buildings can be upgraded to increase their power and efficiency. You can also recruit troops to protect your colony and attack enemies. There is a significant variety of units available, each with unique skills and different weapons. Battles take place in real time or turn-based and you have to use tactics and strategies to gain an advantage over your opponents. There are also RPG elements, you can upgrade your units by gaining experience on the battlefield.

title: Speed Rivals
description:
게임 정보
Slot Racing: 당신과 레일 사이의 최면과 같은 춤
🏁 Speed Rivals는 빠른 속도의 슬롯 레이싱 게임으로, 정확한 컨트롤과 전략이 승패를 가릅니다.
🚗 Slot Racing의 황금기를 떠올리게 하는 역동적인 트랙에서 경주하며, 차량을 업그레이드하고 토너먼트에서 승리하여 최고의 드라이버가 되십시오! 🏆 몰입감 있는 스토리 모드 📖, 경쟁 멀티플레이 🛣️, 그리고 긴장을 풀 수 있는 젠 모드 😴를 제공합니다. 😴
각 코너는 도전이며, 승리는 정상으로 가는 한 걸음입니다. 트랙을 지배할 준비가 되었나요? 🔥🏎️

title: Dungeons of Eternity
description:
게임 정보
Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in Dungeons of Eternity.
Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive.
COOP OR SOLO PLAY
Band together for an unforgettable cooperative experience with up to 4 players, or delve into the dungeons yourself. Teamwork is crucial when facing the hordes of monsters infesting the dungeons: coordinate with your party members to overcome the dangers, or embrace the lone wolf approach, facing your enemies head-on and emerging victorious!
EVER-CHANGING DUNGEONS
Explore randomly-generated dungeons across multiple game modes and realms - no dungeon run is the same. A vast array of chambers await, from combat arenas, puzzle and trap rooms, secret chambers, and more.

title: Quantum Eye
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
In the grim, dystopic future of America, a hyper-advanced artificial intelligence system called Quantum Eye — an all-seeing surveillance supercomputer designed to maximize and regulate every aspect of human life — is installed.
You are a systems technician based at the Quantum Eye Core Facility. In the course of performing routine maintenance, you make a chilling discovery: Quantum Eye has gained sentience. Its logic has progressed and now perceives humanity to be the root of inefficiency, chaos, and disorder.
Your mission is simple: shut it down.
Key Features
Physics-Based Gameplay: Every object in the world would react realistically to the player’s actions through real-time physics; objects can be picked up, thrown, climbed, smashed, or manipulated. No scripted combat solutions — everything is dynamic and player-driven.
Fully Immersive Arm and Body Mechanics: You will get that sense of bodily immersion that comes with full-body tracking when using regular inputs. The arms respond naturally to your movements, making every interaction feel lifelike and intense, from opening a vent to fighting for your survival.
Streamer Mode: Allows for toggling Streamer Mode to remove questionable or private content for a safer experience for those who create content. Stream entirely without fear of leaking your desktop name.
Warning
This game contains intense psychological elements and an immersive, reality-bending experience designed to make you feel watched and manipulated.
As part of its immersive design, the game may request optional access to elements like your webcam, microphone, or image folders to personalize your experience — for example, using real-world photos to populate in-game environments, or interpreting your voice in specific levels.
All of these features are 100% local to your machine. Nothing is stored, sent, or saved externally. You have full control over what is accessed, and all external functionality can be disabled at any time. The goal is to deepen immersion — not invade privacy.

title: Hybrid Blood
description:
게임 정보
A refreshing action Open World RPG, with retro fantasy ambience and unique physics-driven gameplay. In Hybrid Blood you can remember those old time 3d console games but with modern combat mechanics and playstyle.
Wake up, hybrid! Reclaim your domain.
Defeat enemies packed with diverse mechanics: In Hybrid Blood, each encounter has the potential to introduce new mechanics. Enemy NPCs aren’t just mindless attackers; they’re equipped with abilities a player could have. They can dodge, interact with the environment, coordinate with others, and force you to approach each fight with caution and strategy.
Expand your domain: As a Hybrid, defeating enemies expands your Vampiric Domain, granting access to higher stat levels and unlocking new abilities. This progression functions similarly to classic character leveling systems with some additions you will discover in-game.

title: Build a Bridge!
description:
게임 정보


Test your engineering and improvisation skills in a puzzle game where the stakes are as high as they get. It is you who will construct bridges for cars, trucks, buses... And sometimes even monster trucks. Gather your wits and get on with the construction!



During the planning phase the game presents itself with a simple, 2D interface. It is there that you select the best materials for your bridge and connect the dots to make the most resilient structure you can. You can approach each level as a complex puzzle, trying to be as efficient as possible and get the best solution. But don't be afraid to experiment too. You can just go crazy and construct something that looks outrageous but still somehow works. There's fun in both of these approaches.



When you're done, switch to the 3D mode and watch a car drive through your bridge. Will it hold? Or will you watch a spectacular crash?

In addition to the normal mode the game features the easy mode for more relaxed gameplay, focused on creativity and improvisation. You can also use in-game hint system if things get too hard. With 80 levels plus hidden and bonus bridges to construct you will not run out of things to do quickly.

title: CYBERVOID
description:
게임 정보
Deep underground, the advanced city of Umbral lies in silence. Strange silicon lifeforms stir in the depths, dormant robots await the call of their long-slumbering masters, and a lone scientist remains trapped—waiting for help.
Tasked with a mission to determine Umbral’s fate before time runs out, with limited energy, every decision counts. Will you explore, restore, or destroy?
Hack city storage to scavenge vital materials.
Snipe security drones with your long-range graviton beam.
Absorb lost personality cores to upgrade yourself.
As you navigate the city's 45 districts, each linked to its vast neural network, you’ll encounter strange and sentient beings—Dendrone, Cybersaur, the Twins, and the Dross Bishop—each holding fragments of your past.
Even when your BODY resists, something deep inside remembers who you are… until whispers of a THETA Military presence surface. A hidden faction, reawakening with an unfinished mission of its own.
With only five years before Umbral collapses, will you reach the city's core in time—or be buried with its secrets forever?

title: Rey: Shattered Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Rey: Shattered Darkness is a dark 2D action platformer where precise combat, tight movement, and time-fractured worlds collide. Built for players who love responsive gameplay and satisfying challenges, it delivers a combat-driven journey through broken timelines with a narrative that builds the story further as you progress.
You play as Rey, a lone warrior who stumbles across a tear in her home, and in doing so, is pulled from her own era and thrust into a world collapsing across time. As you explore  timelines and fight enemies pulled from distant pasts and possible futures, you’ll unlock new abilities and discover the truth behind the world’s unravelling, while making new friends along the way.
Every era throws something new at you—different enemies, hazards, and challenges—so you’ll need to adapt how you play. One level may reward fast aggression, another might demand patience and positioning. Replayability is also a factor, in that some areas are worth revisiting. The result: a game that keeps evolving alongside your playstyle.
What can I expect?
Responsive Combat
Slash, cast abilities and more through tightly tuned encounters. Combat is fast, fluid, and built around precision and satisfying encounters.
Special Abilities
As you progress, Rey unlocks powerful abilities that enhance your options in and out of combat. Use them to change your playstyle.
Multiple Timelines
Travel across fractured eras, each with its own visual identity, enemies, and gameplay feel. Meet new characters and become immersed in a broken world. 
Platforming That Feels Good
Responsive controls and tight design give platforming the same weight and polish as combat. Expect hazard-heavy traversal, trap sequences, and movement-based challenges.
Stylized Pixel Art with Parallax Backgrounds
High quality animated sprites and layered parallax backgrounds create a distinct visual identity that changes with each era Rey visits.

title: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
description:
게임 정보
Experience the universe of the Alien films like never before: re-envisioned for all PC users. An all-new action-horror entry into the classic franchise, Alien: Rogue Incursion transforms you into Zula Hendricks–the ex-Colonial Marine hellbent on exposing Weyland-Yutani’s black-site experiments–on an extremely dangerous mission to the uncharted planet Purdan. With her synth companion Davis 01 for guidance, Zula must infiltrate the infested Gemini Exoplanet Solutions research facility and survive the ever-present threat of the most cunning Xenomorphs ever encountered, with both skilled stealth and serious firepower at her disposal. And when the threat she discovers has extinction-level consequences, Zula suddenly finds herself with humanity’s fate on her shoulders.
PART ONE OF A TWO-PART STORY
Zula's Fight Begins Here: Part One of this gripping two-part story thrusts you into the violent world of ALIEN, where you will uncover the secrets lurking within the GES facility on LV-354, the enigmatic planet Purdan. This installment stands alone as a complete story yet leaves you hanging on a thrilling cliffhanger, eager to dive deeper into Zula's unfolding story in Part Two, where she will face new challenges and deadlier enemies.

title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
description:
게임 정보
Adventure Calls. Destiny Awaits.
Embark on a fantastical quest with your favorite Nicktoons characters—reimagined as epic Action-RPG heroes!
Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny is a vibrant, universe-spanning mashup that brings iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy-style tropes and real-time RPG action. Roll the the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with SpongeBob and more Nickelodeon characters! Get ready for epic battles, dynamic environments, and recognizable character moments, all with an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.
Key Game Features:
Play as Legendary Nickelodeon Characters—Fantasy Style
Suit up as a selection of Nickelodeon characters, each reimagined into classic RPG character classes from Spellcaster and Wizard, to Barbarian, Knight, and more. Every hero comes with their own unique powers and weapons.
Real-Time, Action-Packed Battles
Slash, cast spells, and strategize your way through fast-paced, fluid combat. Master each character’s unique style and time your combos to perfection.
Explore Whimsical Worlds
From Bikini Bottomshire and beyond; journey through colorful, Nickelodeon-inspired fantasy lands with fun, reimagined twists – each filled with puzzles, secrets, side quests, and wonderful surprises.
Conquer Epic Boss Battles
Face off against iconic enemies with intense boss battles - each fight offering unique mechanics and surprises—leading up to an unforgettably climactic final encounter.
Single Player or Local Co-Op for 1–4 Players
Team up with friends and build your party! Mix and match characters for the perfect balance of skills and chaos in your local squad.
Level Up and Customization
Unlock new powers, upgrade your weapons, and shape your heroes’ path through this awesome adventure.
Built for Nick Fans and Action-RPG Lovers

title: Gravewatch
description:
게임 정보
GraveWatch is a horror game that will take you on one of the scariest experiences of your life. You will play as Daniel, a desperate man trying his best to support his ill daughter. After losing his wife in a horrific accident and getting fired from his job, Daniel is at the end of his wits and decides to become a grave robber, which leads him to a new chapter of his life, his fiancee Sara. Together, they form an unlikely bond, ready to take on whatever comes their way...
however...
Their newest expedition doesn't go according to plan, as they are about to face hell on earth...
Features
Immersive atmosphere: You have no weapon or way to defend yourself. You must rely on your instincts to escape the most horrifying scenarios. Hide, run or die!
Play as Sara: While Daniel is the main protagonist, you will also play as Sara, his fiancée and partner in crime. This way, you will get to experience the story from 2 different perspectives, whenever they are separated or working together as a team.

title: Final Fantasy Tactics - The Ivalice Chronicles
description:
게임 정보
■스토리

태양과 성스러운 빛의 수호를 받는, 두 마리의 사자가 통치하는 국가 Ivalice.
이웃 국가인 Ordallia와의 전쟁 “The Fifty Years' War”에서 패전한 후 1년이 지나고, 선대 왕이 병사하면서 겨우 2살에 불과한 어린 왕자가 즉위한다.
그 후견인 자리와 실권을 둘러싸고 “The Fifty Years' War”에서 무훈을 세웠던 두 명의 장군, Duke Druksmald Goltanna와 Duke Bestrald Larg 사이에서 팽팽한 긴장감이 고조된다.
흑사자를 문장으로 삼는 Duke Druksmald Goltanna와 백사자를 문장으로 삼는 Duke Bestrald Larg.
두 장군의 치열한 격돌은 훗날 “The War of the Lions”이라 불리게 된다.
Ivalice를 대표하는 무가인 Beoulve 가문의 삼남으로 태어난 Ramza, 그리고 평민 출신이면서도 Ramza의 소꿉친구로서 함께 성장한 Delita.
두 사람이 걷는 운명의 길 역시 시대의 거대한 소용돌이에 휘말리게 된다.

위치 선정과 전술 예측이 승리로 이어지는 긴장감 넘치는 전략 시뮬레이션.
높이차가 존재하는 3D 맵의 특징과 각 유닛의 행동 순서를 전략적으로 활용하며, 전투를 승리로 이끌어라.

여러 잡과 어빌리티를 활용한 다채로운 전술을 펼칠 수 있다.
각 캐릭터를 성장시켜, 다양한 잡으로 변경하는 것도 가능하다. 각 잡은 저마다 특징적인 어빌리티를 습득할 수 있으며, 습득한 어빌리티는 다른 잡에서도 설정할 수 있다. 잡과 수백 종류의 어빌리티를 조합해, 자신만의 전술을 탄생시키자.
백마도사, 흑마도사, 용기사 등 「FINAL FANTASY」 시리즈의 대표적인 잡을 포함해, 20종류가 넘는 개성적인 잡이 등장. 이와 더불어 초코보 등과 같은 몬스터도 동료로 만들어 파티에 편성할 수 있다.

뛰어난 몰입감과 쾌적한 플레이를 위한 「Enhanced Version」, 과거의 추억을 그대로 불러일으키는 「Classic Version」 중에서 선택할 수 있다.
「Enhanced Version」에서는 더욱 아름다워진 그래픽과 더불어, 풀 보이스 대응을 통해 Ivalice의 세계에 더욱 깊이 몰입할 수 있게 되었다.
또한, 일부 시스템 및 배틀에서 플레이가 더욱 쾌적해졌으며, 처음 플레이하더라도 어렵지 않게 진행할 수 있는 난이도 「Squire」가 추가되었다.
한편, 1997년에 발매된 오리지널 버전을 충실하게 재현한 「Classic Version」도 추가되었다.
autokwd: Final Fantasy Tactics - The Ivalice Chronicles

title: The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker
description:
게임 정보
The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker
비의 정신: 코드 해결사

일인칭, 대기 퍼즐 탐험 게임

여러 지역에서, 캐릭터와 원작 주제가와 혼합된 이야기들을 찾고 코드와 퍼즐을 통해 잠금 해제가 가득차 있는 거대하고 인터렉티브한 세계.

배경


1957년 늦은 가을, 하비에르 카마릴로의 딸인 11살 릴라 카마릴로는 스페인 중부의 먼 친척들을 방문했을 때 폭풍우로 인한 보트 사고의 후유증으로 아주 깊은 잠에 빠진 혼수상태가 되었습니다. 릴라의 몸과 정신은 치유의 시간을 필요로하지만 광활하고 신비로운 대안 현실을 통해 삶을 되찾아야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 다시는 일어날 수 없기 때문입니다.

현실 세계를 인식 할 수 없이, 릴라는 자신의 정신안에서 무의식적으로 남아 있게 됩니다. 그녀는 이 상황을 헤쳐나가려고 하지만 절망에 빠지게 되며, 광대하고 신비로운 원더 랜드를 형성하며 현실로 돌아갈 수 있는 방법에 대한 희미한 실마리만 남아있습니다. 그녀는 많은 장애물, 경로, 포털 및 퍼즐과 맞서야 하며, 이 모든 것들에 대한 결과가 나타날 것 입니다.

릴라는 선량하거나 악한 이상한 생물이나 캐릭터들을 만나게 되며, 릴라의 여행을 돕거나 방해할 것입니다. 릴라의 능력은 공포, 유혹, 착각, 믿음 및 문제 해결로 시험대에 오르게 될 것 입니다. 릴라의 인생을 다시 찾을 수 있을까요? 운이 아주 좋으면, 릴라를 도와주는 문서, 코드, 마술, 손전등, 나침반, 지도 및 기타 여러 아이템을 우연히 발견할 것 입니다. 만약 운이 없으면, 릴라는 죽게 되거나, 물리거나, 위험에 빠지거나, 악날한 생물을 만날 수도 있을 것 입니다. 그러나 조금 더 자세히 살펴보면 숨어있는 비
의 정신을 발견할 수가 있을 것 입니다.

이상한 단서는 어디에서나 찾을 수 있습니다.


특징

• 거대한 열린 세계를 탐험하고, 퍼즐을 잠금해제하여 더 여행할 수 있도록 코드를 풀어보세요.
• 원작 주제가를 통하여 몰입할 수 있고 독특한 환경.
• 적, 포털, 수상한 캐릭터 및 문제 해결 기기에 몰입
• 퍼즐 게임 장르의 실험적인 도입
• 나를 도와줄 캐릭터들을 만나기
• 믿어야 할지 말아야 할지 결정 또는 학습
• 이전 대화를 찾아보기 위하여 플레이어 로그를 참조.
• 지점 A에서 지점 B까지를 포함하는 문제 해결 상황은 때로는 현혹하는 것 일 수 있습니다.
• 아름다운 게임 환경과 시간이 가는 줄 모르게 푹 빠져드는 게임 플레이

title: BYTE
description:
게임 정보
You play as Jonathan Harker, Dracula’s real estate agent, completing work tasks while exploring the castle, speaking with its inhabitants, and hacking into computers.
BYTE is a tactics RPG that adapts the classic novel Dracula, by Bram Stoker, with an emphasis on the themes of queerness and technology.
Jonathan Harker, a young real estate agent from New York City, is summoned to Detroit, Oregon in 1990 to help a mysterious Count Dracula purchase a collection of properties in NYC. Jonathan's proficiency with new technologies like fax machines, telephones, and the internet helped him rise quickly at his firm and earn this assignment, but the closer Jonathan gets to the castle, the wearier he grows.
BYTE's story is told through visual novel scenes that use a mixture of in-world and surreal 3D art and full-motion video to color the text of the story.
Technology permeates BYTE both in its world and in its presentation and the game is a celebration and exploration of early digital computer technology.
At the castle, Jonathan finds that the Count has already equipped his castle with an internet connection, fax lines, and solar power to speed up his work. Despite this, Jonathan finds more friction than expected, as it seems nearly everything in the castle is hidden behind some form of password protection.
BYTE features grid-based tactics battles that happen when Jonathan needs to hack into a computer.
Combat involves completing tasks rather than fighting enemies. Tasks can include collecting data, getting through firewalls, installing software, and more.

title: Mosh Pit Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Mosh Pit Mayhem
Throw elbows. Catch beats. Cause chaos.
Welcome to Mosh Pit Mayhem — a fast-paced brawler where fists fly, bodies collide, and the music never stops. Step into the pit and battle through waves of wild concertgoers in this no-holds-barred beatdown fueled by raw rhythm and real bands.
Every stage features three songs from real artists—each track a new round of pit-fueled madness. Survive the first two, and when the final song drops, the band dives into the pit themselves. Whether it’s trading blows with Las Vegas thrash titans 187, going head-to-head with the gritty bars of hardcore hip hop legend Spice 1, or brawling through the hilarious chaos of Green Jellÿ, you’re in for the fight of your life.
Build your brawler your way—collect brass knuckles for boosted damage, lace up battle boots for that extra kick, and scavenge health pickups to keep the beat going. Need more staying power? Stock up on med kits, extra lives, and continues to stay in the fight and own the pit.
With over-the-top combos, devastating special attacks, and an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack, Mosh Pit Mayhem is a chaotic celebration of music, mayhem, and the raw power of the crowd.
No rules. No rails. Just you, the music, and the pit.

title: Alpha Doomsday War
description:
게임 정보
As demons devour the ruins of civilization, you'll challenge endless cycles of death in a pixel-style roguelike gameplay across randomly generated apocalyptic battlefields. Every map, enemy layout, and resource point refreshes randomly, from shattered cities to radioactive wastelands, where beast lords and mutated creatures strike at any moment.
Under the permanent death mechanism, choose survivor characters with distinct traits, combine randomly dropped post-apocalyptic gear and skill trees, and fight your way through bullet storms.
autokwd: Alpha Doomsday War,阿尔法末日战争

title: Isle of Leil
description:
게임 정보
SOMETHING IS HIDING ON THE ISLAND OF LEIL
Bentley Crow is on a mission to find his mother, Samantha, after she disappeared during an archaeological trip to the medieval settlement of Leil. Traveling to the island shrouded in shadow and mystery, Bentley blindly follows to bring her back – but the time-locked, blood-thirsty creatures of Leil await.
Loosely based on Dante’s Inferno, you will venture through the island with only a trail of Samantha’s discoveries to follow. Cassette tapes, diary entries, ancestral secrets – the story descends with each discovery you make.
ABOUT THIS GAME
Isle of Leil is a first-person story driven horror developed by Curtis Hawes under his new studio Adversity Interactive.
Venture through an open landscape and find cassette tapes to uncover the whereabouts of your missing mother. Be wary, these environments can be treacherous! Navigate fog and water, unstable platforms and old ruins. Immerse yourself into the world and step in the shoes of Bentley a troubled London teenager in search for his missing mother. find clues, navigate the traps and hide from the monsters!

title: 魔法使いの嫁　盛夏の幻と夢見る旅路
description:
게임 정보
【STORY】
A non-human, living alone in the night of London.
One evening, he meets a girl seeking help in the fog.
She has lost her memories and knows not why she is there.
In saving her from the darkness, the two become fast friends.
The non-human, wishing to help his very first friend recover
her memories, makes for two beings he has heard about by
way of rumors among the fae: the Thorn Mage Elias, and Chise.
autokwd: 魔法使いの嫁　盛夏の幻と夢見る旅路

title: Dark Laws
description:
게임 정보
당신의 임무는 간단하지만 위험합니다: 처치하고, 약탈하고, 탈출하십시오.



다크 로즈의 세계에 입장하십시오. 텔로스 섬이 당신을 기다립니다. 심장이 뛰는 모험이 펼쳐지는 오픈 월드 전장에 발을 들여놓고, 생존은 피로 써진 증거이며, 약탈은 용감한 자의 통화이고, 탈출만이 유일한 탈출구입니다.



자신만의 운명을 만들어보세요. 치명적인 근접 무기, 정밀한 원거리 무기, 신비로운 주문, 그리고 능력을 향상시키는 패시브 유물을 선택하십시오. 그러나 무기 목록은 여기서 끝나지 않습니다 – 드래곤혼을 조작하여 당신의 장대한 드래곤을 소환하고, 전투의 흐름을 당신에게 유리하게 돌리십시오.

선택은 끝이 없고, 결과는 치명적입니다.

title: Beast and Cleaver
description:
게임 정보
Beast and Cleaver is a 2D open-world adventure where tactical combat and monster hunting define your journey. As the Hanging City's hired hunter, your mission is to track and defeat mythical creatures, uncover the secrets of their unique spawning conditions, and use their materials to strengthen both yourself and the city. Every successful hunt expands the Hanging City, unlocking new merchants, potions, and character customizations to aid your next battle.
A World Shaped by the Hunt
Venture through six distinct biomes—from the frozen peaks of the Snow Mountains to the infernal depths of The Flames—each home to unique creatures with their own behaviors, weaknesses, and environmental triggers. Learning how and where to summon them is just as important as the fight itself.

title: Crafters Heaven
description:
게임 정보
Crafters Heaven — Your Ultimate Lowpoly RPG Sandbox Adventure!
Dive into a vibrant lowpoly world where creativity meets survival. Explore vast landscapes, craft powerful tools, and build your dream sanctuary in this immersive RPG sandbox adventure. Whether you’re battling wild creatures, exploring mysterious dungeons, or gathering resources, every step is a new challenge and opportunity.
Key Features:
Open-World Exploration: Roam freely across beautifully crafted lowpoly environments filled with secrets and surprises.
Survival Mechanics: Manage your health, hunger, and stamina while facing dynamic weather and dangerous wildlife.
Crafting System: Gather resources and craft weapons, armor, tools, and building materials to thrive and defend yourself.
RPG Elements: Level up your skills, customize your character, and embark on quests that shape your adventure.
Sandbox Creativity: Build and customize your base with endless possibilities — from cozy cabins to mighty fortresses.
Adventure Awaits: Discover hidden dungeons, solve puzzles, and unlock the mysteries of Crafters Heaven.
Unleash your inner crafter, survive the wilderness, and carve your own path in this enchanting lowpoly world. Are you ready to build your heaven?

title: Flesh Farm
description:
게임 정보
Battle through an occult farm compound owned by a family who operates a gruesome hunting ground for unsuspecting travelers. These captives face a nightmarish fate—becoming test subjects for horrific experiments and sacrifices to the terrifying Blood Moon Serpent. Face off against grotesque, mutilated monsters as you fight to uncover the truth in finding your missing wife and son in an adrenaline-pumping shooter Flesh Farm!
Core Gameplay
Collect flesh parts, relics, and items to unlock doors and the truth of your wife and son
Fight your way through a labyrinth of claustrophobic terror 
Solve mind-bending environmental puzzles
AXE check! CHAINSAW check! SHOTGUN check!

title: Faceless Residence
description:
게임 정보
Explore an abandoned mansion filled with mysteries, dangers, and an oppressive atmosphere. In this survival and exploration game, you take on the role of a character who must uncover what happened in this place while facing terrifying creatures and solving challenging puzzles.
Key Features
Deep Exploration: Navigate through narrow hallways, dark rooms, and outdoor areas of the mansion, each hiding secrets and unexpected dangers.
Puzzles and Challenges: Solve intricate and interactive puzzles that block your progress, requiring reasoning and keen observation.
Tense Combat: Face bizarre and terrifying creatures using improvised tools, or choose to avoid them depending on your play style.
Immersive Atmosphere: Detailed graphics and carefully crafted sound design create an experience that keeps you on edge at all times.
Mysterious Story: Discover fragments of information about what happened in the mansion. Every clue brings you closer to the truth, but beware of what you might find.
Dynamic Environment: The mansion evolves over time, presenting new threats and challenges as you progress.
Are you ready to survive what lurks in the darkness?

title: Neon Inferno
description:
게임 정보

NEON INFERNO는 전경과 배경을 넘나들며 액션이 펼쳐지는 하이브리드 사이드 스크롤러 및 갤러리 슈팅 게임입니다. 디스토피아가 된 뉴욕시를 장악하기 위해 여러 세력이 전쟁 중인 가운데, 당신은 패밀리의 암살자로서 싸움에 뛰어듭니다. 이 악명높은 범죄 조직은 경쟁자를 제거하고 도시를 장악하려고 합니다. 아름다운 픽셀 아트와 감성적인 사운드트랙이 어우러진 Neon Inferno는 사이버펑크 감성을 담은 스타일리시하고 현대적인 2D 액션 경험을 선사합니다.
암살자를 선택하라
안젤로 모라노 또는 마리아나 비티를 조종하며 거리를 평정하세요. 적들을 쏘고, 튕겨내고, 베어내 제압하세요! 다양한 업그레이드와 무기 옵션을 선택해, 도시 전역에서 벌어지는 전쟁을 유리하게 헤쳐나갈 수 있습니다.
가까이서 쏘고, 멀리 조준하라
전통적인 런앤건 액션에 더해, 전경과 배경의 적들을 공격하고, "불렛 타임"을 이용해 투사체를 튕겨내어 반격하고, 차량을 탈취해 목표를 추격할 수 있습니다! 원하는 레벨의 난이도를 선택하거나, 원코인 클리어 아케이드 모드에 도전해 보세요!

title: Directive 8020
description:
게임 정보
UNTIL DAWN과 THE QUARRY의 제작자들이 강렬한 서바이벌 게임플레이에 의미심장한 선택지와 분기하는 스토리라인을 결합해, 완전히 새로운 시네마틱 SF 호러 어드벤처를 선보입니다.
지구는 죽어가고 있고 인류에게는 시간이 없습니다. 고향에서 12광년 떨어진, 타우 세티 f는 실낱같은 희망입니다. 식민지 개척함 카시오페이아 호가 행성에 불시착했을 때, 곧 승무원들은 이 행성에는 그들만 있는 게 아니란 것을 깨닫습니다.
카시오페이아의 승무원들은 먹잇감을 모방할 수 있는 외계 유기체에게 사냥당하고 있습니다. 살아남아 고향으로 돌아가려면 추격자들보다 영리하게 행동해야 합니다. 살아남기 위해 싸우면서, 이들은 가장 어려운 선택을 직면합니다. 자신들을 구하느냐, 지구의 모든 인류의 생명을 위험에 처하게 하는 일을 무릅쓰느냐의 선택 말이죠.
할리우드 배우 라샤나 린치(밥 말리: 원 러브, 더 우먼 킹)가 기발한 우주 비행사 '영' 역할로 출연합니다. 인류를 구하기 위한 심우주 임무에 착수해 몰입감 넘치는 시네마틱 스토리텔링과 손에 땀을 쥐게 하는 공포를 경험하세요.

title: Kingmakers
description:
게임 정보
죽어가는 세상의 마지막 희망은 바로 당신입니다. 500년 전 중세 영국으로 돌아가 피비린내 나는 전쟁의 전세를 뒤집으세요. 운이 좋다면 세상의 종말을 막을 수 있을 겁니다. 과연 당신은 역사의 저울을 기울이고 새로운 연대표를 써 내려갈 수 있을까요?

title: + PC Maker
description:
게임 정보
+ PC Maker is a simulation game in which you have to assemble and customize computers, and also improve your home/office as you progress through the game.
In the game, we have worked out a good system for assembling and customizing a PC, so you can make a PC assembly that is closest to what you would like to assemble in life.
After completing the PC build, you can install the operating system on it and test it in various benchmarks.
The construction system is also well developed, thanks to which you can create amazingly detailed interiors.

title: One of Those Games
description:
게임 정보
This is just another one of those games — the kind designed to stir up that dormant frustration inside you.
You play as a colored square trying to climb your way up a minimalistic, color-coded gauntlet. The rule is simple: you can only touch objects that match your current color. Mess that up, and you'll fall. And not just a little — you'll plummet all the way down through every layer you’ve already passed.
Simple controls. Brutal consequences. Unfair design that somehow always feels fair — until it doesn’t.
If you’re the kind of player who laughs in the face of pain, this one’s for you.

title: DIMAWORLD
description:
게임 정보
Misha is searching for Dima. He must scour a fictional world (CHECK 233 / 236 PLACES) whose landscapes vaguely resemble areas around major Eastern European cities in the early 21st century—reimagined in a humorous alternate reality.
DIMAWORLD IS:
Realistic visuals, cutscenes, and immersive sound design
A single-player open-world experience, offering several hours of gameplay packed with diverse elements: large-scale events, occurrences of natural phenomena, and unexpected encounters. You’ll interact with various physical objects and entities, robots, and weapons—purchasing and using them, and pursuing additional tasks along the way.
Control different vehicles, ride trains, and survive in third-person perspective, confronting humans, wild animals, robots, and even mutant monsters.
Immerse yourself in a fictional world with a slightly comical atmosphere of an early 21st-century alternate reality.
An indie open-world explorer with elements of survival, action, object searching, and an intriguing storyline.

title: Burlesque
description:
게임 정보
Starting a burlesque show can be tricky, can you make the right decisions to ensure the show is a success?

title: Dolven
description:
게임 정보
Dolven is a Tactical RPG where players lead a band of mercenaries sworn to defeat a powerful necromancer and end the evil plaguing the land. The game features a unique card-based combat system, where players form strategic hand combos, cast spells, and influence the battlefield. The goal is to uncover the necromancer’s dark secrets and stop the ancient evil threatening to consume the world.
Card battles include hand-to-hand combat and the cards provide characters with additional skills. What sets Dolven apart is its innovative and strategic card play mechanics, which add a touch of nostalgia by incorporating elements of classic poker. Players form hand combos, such as pairs, doubles, straight flushes, and flushes, to enhance their tactical options. These combo's earn the player mana bonus's and also add to the players overall point score on the leader board.
Each character in Dolven belongs to one of six distinct classes: Archer, Cleric, Guardian, Mage, Rogue, or Warrior. These classes are divided into three archetypes—Strength, Intellect, and Agility—each offering a unique set of skills and abilities to master.

title: Project Motor Racing
description:
게임 정보
Project Motor Racing은 프로 모터스포츠의 열정과 아름다움, 강렬함을 완벽하게 구현합니다.
최고만을 경험하라
여러 시대를 아우르는 10개의 상징적인 클래스와 27개의 글로벌 트랙에서, 정교하게 재현된 총 72대의 자동차로 질주하세요.
* 자동차: 현대의 혁신적인 LMDh 하이퍼카부터 모터스포츠 역사상 가장 상징적인 전설까지, 모든 차량이 공식 라이선스를 받은 걸작입니다.
* 서킷: 스캔을 통해 궁극의 정확도와 현실감을 선사합니다.
누구나 즐길 수 있는 레이싱
Project Motor Racing은 숙련된 시뮬레이션 레이서부터 입문자에 이르기까지 모두를 위한 경험을 제공합니다.
* 싱글 플레이어 커리어
* 온라인 레이싱 모드
* 게임 내 이벤트
* 4개 클래스가 어우러지는 레이스 경험

title: Love at The Milky Way Diner: Demo
description:
게임 정보



Love at the Milky Way Diner is a game about cultural exchange through food, building community, and finding love in the process.

200 years after first contact, humanity is still trying to find their  place in a galaxy full of far more advanced and established species.
One such human, our protagonist, has recently been laid off from their corporate job on Mars when news reaches them; their distant aunt Cassiopia has passed away suddenly, and she would like one of her relatives to take over her restaurant on the distant deep space station Hesperides.
The protagonist decides to take a leap of faith. They may have never left their home start system of Helios, but surely there must be something (or maybe someone) better out there waiting for them.
When they reach the station they find themselves welcomed by a vibrant, multi-species community of eccentric individuals who are only too happy to welcome the new owner of their favourite place to eat.


Love at the Milky Way Diner will feature 8 love interests, each with their own routes and stories
autokwd: Love at The Milky Way Diner: Demo

title: CyberRhapsody
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to <<Cyber Rhapsody>>!
This is a game that combines first-person shooting and music rhythm!
The story is set in the cyberpunk world of 2050 in the future. At that time, AI has ruled the world. In order to save energy to supply AI brains, humans have become cheap labor and become miserable workers in the dark factory assembly line. Humans are hypnotized, alienated, and transformed, or lose their minds and become monsters, or are brainwashed to become cannon fodder soldiers, or are transformed by reproduction and digestion to become fixed human meat machines on the assembly line.
Music brings salvation! Music awakens the protagonist's remaining sanity, and he takes up arms to fight to the end!
Holding a shotgun and a Gatling gun, quickly hunt monsters in a psychedelic cyberpunk city!
Press the keyboard buttons at the right time to collect music notes to keep your sanity from being swallowed!
Go! Go! Go!
Destroy everything!

title: Doctor Dreams - Enter The Dreams
description:
게임 정보
You are an experienced doctor who hasn’t been treated well by life. Seeking redemption, you specialize in the only thing you can still offer: helping others from within their own dreams.
Travel through the most twisted nightmares of your patients, facing their fears through surreal minigames. Each treatment is a risk; one mistake can lead to trial, and every decision impacts your reputation and future.
Manage your clinic, craft unique medicines based on what your patients feel… and work to become the greatest tycoon of Thornfield, a city where dreams are healed… or rot.
Discover Thornfield, a forgotten city where dreams can make us sick. Its inhabitants are unique and strange, each with their own stories and problems that only you can help solve. In Thornfield, nothing is as it seems, and every person is a world to discover.
Main Features
40 unique minigames
Each patient has their own nightmare. From impossible platforming to bizarre puzzles or a frantic shooter. Every dream, a new challenge.

title: Nameless adventure
description:
게임 정보
        An action RPG with elements of metroidvania, sandbox and platformer. You will find a dangerous dungeon that transforms in real time and hides many secrets. Only by reaching its deepest depths will you uncover the truth about what this "dungeon" really is...
Living dungeon – the world changes in real time, creating new challenges and opportunities
Cartoon style graphics
Full world destruction – almost everything can be broken… if you have a strong enough pickaxe
Building – construct structures, create battle cover, set traps, or carve new paths. It’s all up to your playstyle

title: Glöd
description:
게임 정보
Glöd is a hardcore survival game set in the unforgiving wilderness of Sweden. Struggle against nature’s wrath, scavenge for resources, and battle extreme conditions to survive. In this brutal landscape, every decision matters, and every moment is a test of endurance.
Explore a meticulously crafted environment filled with dark forests, rocky terrains, and harsh winters. Engage in tense gameplay with realistic survival mechanics, resource management, and a deeply atmospheric narrative that immerses you in a fight for survival against both nature and the limits of human resilience.
Key Features:
Dynamic Survival Mechanics: Scavenge, hunt, and craft to stay alive in a relentless world.
Harsh Swedish Wilderness: Experience a detailed and atmospheric setting inspired by Scandinavian landscapes.
Realistic Weather Systems: Adapt to punishing blizzards, freezing nights, and torrential rain.
Permadeath Mode: Challenge yourself with a mode where every mistake is permanent.
Immersive Storytelling: Uncover a compelling narrative as you survive against all odds.

title: Remote Position
description:
게임 정보
원격 직원은 싱글 플레이어 호러 스토리로, 새로운 원격 상사가 주는 이상한 임무를 따라야 합니다. 이 임무들은 당신을 신비로운 토끼 굴 속으로 깊이 빠져들게 합니다. 게임 플레이에는 환경 퍼즐과 빠르게 생각해야 하는 전투 생존 시퀀스가 포함됩니다!
게임 특징:
이상한 새 상사가 주는 임무를 완료하세요
환경 퍼즐을 풀어보세요

title: Death Rabbit
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a chilling and suspense-filled journey into the depths of terror. In this gripping single-player survival horror game, you assume the role of Alisa, an off-duty female NYPD officer, dispatched to unravel the spine-tingling enigma behind a series of eerie deaths haunting the labyrinthine tunnels of the New York City subway system.

Alisa, caught off guard while off-duty, now faces relentless horrors in the subterranean darkness. Armed with only her training and unyielding determination, you must guide her through the perilous underground maze to unearth the sinister secrets that threaten to consume her and the city itself.

Key Features

Survival Horror at Its Best: "Death Rabbit" delivers nail-biting tension and relentless encounters with horrifying enemies. Resources are scarce, and every bullet counts. Can you make it out alive?

Immersive Environments: Explore meticulously detailed subway stations, tunnels, and abandoned areas of the underground, all rendered with stunning graphics and an eerie atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Varied Arsenal: Collect an array of weapons and gear to customize your play-style. From standard police-issue firearms to improvised tools, you must adapt to survive.

Strategic Combat: Face off against grotesque and terrifying enemies that require careful strategy and precise aiming. Ammo conservation and tactical thinking are essential for your survival.

title: Keeper
description:
게임 정보
Lee Petty와 Double Fine Productions가 선보이는 Keeper는 아름답고 초현실적인 이세계의 모험이자, 말없이 펼쳐지는 이야기입니다.
오래전 인적이 끊긴 바다의 한 섬, 먼 산봉우리 그림자 아래에 기억에서 잊힌 등대가 조용히 잠들어 있습니다. 그러나 시들었던 덩굴이 뻗어나가 발이 되어주면서 등대가 깨어납니다. 불가사의한 목적의식에 이끌린 등대에 신비로운 바닷새가 찾아옵니다. 불현듯 찾아온 따스한 우정을 담은 이야기. 신비로운 변화를 향한 기나긴 모험. 그리고 섬의 중심을 향해, 이해를 넘어선 세계로 나아가는 뜻하지 않은 여정이 그렇게 시작됩니다.

title: AS ABOVE SO BELOW
description:
게임 정보
AS ABOVE SO BELOW is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

title: DICTOCRACY
description:
게임 정보
Take charge as the President of a newly-independent country, Adelphia. As Aiden Fitzgerald, you will take on this daunting role and lead Adelphia forward through tumultuous times by prioritizing the right action at each step. Build infrastructure, approve policies, handle unforeseen events, keep your ministers happy by fulfilling their demands and much more.
But remember, money is limited and time even less so. 
Will you be able to keep everyone (the public, your ministers, other country leaders', etc.) happy and get re-elected or will you fade into obscurity after your first term ? Your fate lies in your hands
Your role in Adelphia's freedom struggle is etched in the history books and has carried you to a unanimous term as the first President of Adelphia. However, patience wears thin, favors are seldom remembered and people would not hesitate to replace you if you fell short of their lofty expectations, viz.
General Public : The general public in each province would expect you to provide a decent standard of living across all metrics (employment, security, etc.). Failure to provide these will result in a drop in approval ratings which will lead to your eventual ouster in the next elections
Ministers : The ministers who form your cabinet will also expect you to fulfill their demands, be it diverting additional budget towards their ministry or taking certain decisions for the events that occur throughout the game. Each decision represents a double-edged sword by which you can make them happy or incur their displeasure. Displease them enough and they will withdraw their support toppling your government for good
Dynamic World : Each playthrough will be a unique experience as the population demographics, key issues, occurrences of random events, etc. will be different

title: NINJA GAIDEN 4
description:
게임 정보
궁극의 고속 닌자 액션 시리즈가 "NINJA GAIDEN 4"로 부활! 전통과 혁신이 융합된 스타일리시하고 자유로운 전투가 자아내는 최첨단 어드벤처 게임의 막이 오른다.
전설의 부활: "NINJA GAIDEN 4"를 굴지의 액션 게임 시리즈로 만든 격렬한 고속 액션이 부활. 신세대 플레이어를 위해 스타일리시하게 다시 태어난 전설의 시작을 체험하라.
더 진화된 장대한 고속 배틀: "NINJA GAIDEN 4"에서는 Team NINJA의 갈고닦은 전투 철학과 PlatinumGames Inc.의 스타일리시하고 다이내믹한 액션 게임 플레이가 융합되어 정밀함과 전략성이 요구되는 압권의 배틀에 뛰어들어라. '혈설'을 사용해 무기를 변형시키면 '이즈나 드롭'과 '비연' 등 익숙한 기술로 적에게 괴멸적인 대미지를 줄 수 있다. 전설의 류 하야부사도 개량된 추억의 장비를 갖추고 부활. 난이도 조정과 커스터마이징이 실장된 "NINJA GAIDEN 4"에는 숙련된 액션 게이머를 극한까지 몰아넣으면서도 초심자도 즐길 수 있는 스릴 넘치고 눈을 뗄 수 없는 전개가 기다리는 어드벤처가 펼쳐진다.
오랜 적의 부활: 오랜 적이 부활하여 근미래 도쿄에는 독기를 띤 비가 끝없이 내린다. 도시의 운명은 젊은 천재 닌자 야쿠모의 손에 달렸다. 길을 막는 기갑 닌자 부대와 이계의 크리처와의 싸움을 펼치며 야쿠모는 전설의 류 하야부사와 함께 짊은 운명에 맞서 도쿄를 오랜 저주로부터 해방시켜야만 한다.
company: PlatinumGames Inc / Team NINJA / KOEI TECMO GAMES CO, LTD

title: Isopod: A Webbed Spin-off
description:
게임 정보
Isopod is a roly poly platforming adventure from the wonderful world of Webbed.
Expressive Physics Platforming!
Roll up and smash your way through the undergrowth as a bouncy little wrecking ball! The Fire Ant Conglomerate won't know what hit 'em!
Magnet Drive!
A cool ant strapped a magnet to your back! Use it to swing through the air, catch flying cannonballs, and zip down powerlines... or just remove heavy metals from the soil - that's an isopod's job after all.
Isopod Skins!

title: Flow - Syn x Vertue
description:
게임 정보
'Flow - Syn x Vertue' is the very best Synthwave + Darkwave + Art Pop music genred arcade co-op party elimination racing game ever built. By far. For sure. No doubt.
Vertue [Party Time]
A melting pot of unique game mechanics, shaders and peripheral design to create intense, and intensely fun, collaborative and combative party play.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 3
description:
게임 정보
수상 경력에 빛나는 시리즈의 신작 쥬라기 월드 에볼루션 3에서는 여러 건물을 관리하고 나만의 쥬라기 공원을 운영하게 됩니다.
선사시대의 종을 합성하고, 번식시키고, 육성하여 생명이 스스로 살 길을 찾도록 도와주세요. 각 종을 관리하여 번영하도록 하고, 공룡들이 가족을 이루어 유전자를 다음 세대로 전달할 수 있게 도와주세요.
공룡들이 번성할 수 있는 놀라운 안식처를 만들어주고, 방문객들을 놀라게 할 흥미로운 새로운 명소를 건설하며, 재난이 닥쳤을 때에도 상황을 잘 관리하세요.
공룡 세대 육성
경외심을 불러일으키는 선사시대 생물 80종 가운데 75종을 관리 및 번식시켜 여러 세대를 온전히 거치며 가족을 육성할 수 있습니다. 장난기 많은 아성체를 입이 떡 벌어질 만한 성체로 길러내세요.종마다 뚜렷한 암컷, 수컷, 아성체 종류가 있습니다.
공원 방문객들은 이 장엄한 생물들이 주변의 생동감 넘치는 세계와 사회화하고 반응하는 모습을 보고 놀라워할 것입니다.
특별한 사회적 요구를 관리하고 새로운 행동을 관찰해보세요. 반수생 공룡들이 깊은 물 속으로 탐험을 떠나고, 익룡들이 땅 위를 걷는 모습을 지켜볼 수 있습니다.
진화한 창의성
쥬라기 월드 에볼루션 시리즈에서 사상 최초로 선보이는 새로운 제작 도구로 입이 떡 벌어지는 공원을 만들어보세요! 혁신적인 지형 편집에서 모듈식 풍경 사용자 지정까지, 맨땅에서부터 공원의 모든 요소를 만들고 조정할 수 있습니다.
가파른 절벽과 풍경을 활용해 자연스러운 우리가 있는 현장을 만들고, 열기구 투어 같은 멋진 신규 관람 명소를 도입하고, 공룡과의 만남을 통해 관람객들이 선사시대 동물을 보고 만질 수 있는 근거리 관람 명소를 추가하는 등 다양한 콘텐츠를 선보이세요!  
Frontier 창작마당을 사용해 크로스 플랫폼으로 창작물을 제작, 업로드 및 공유할 수 있습니다. 커뮤니티 최고의 창작물을 살펴보고 내 게임에 배치하거나, 나만의 공원, 건물, 우리를 만들어 다른 플레이어가 사용할 수 있도록 공유하세요.
전 세계를 넘나드는 장대한 캠페인
이안 말콤 박사 와 같은 쥬라기 공원 프랜차이즈의 익숙한 인물들과 함께 전 세계를 배경으로 펼쳐지는 비선형적 캠페인에 뛰어드세요. 몬태나 불모지와 같은 상징적인 장소는 물론, 일본과 같은 새로운 장소에서도 스릴 넘치는 새로운 도전이 기다립니다. 경쟁적인 인간의 이익과 오늘날의 세계에 공룡을 통합한다는 섬세한 작업 간 균형을 맞추며 결정을 내리다 보면 매 순간 공원 관리 실력이 시험대에 오르기 마련입니다.

title: Escape Simulator 2
description:
게임 정보
방 탈출 시뮬레이터 2는 많은 인기를 끈 방 탈출 게임의 후속작입니다. 몰입감 넘치는 새로운 환경, 더 어려워진 퍼즐, 혁신적인 제작 도구를 통해 최고의 일인칭 방 탈출 게임을 경험해 보세요.
새로운 방 – 더 커지고, 더 정교하고, 더 어렵습니다
방 탈출 전문가와 커뮤니티의 유명 방 제작자와 함께 만든 새로운 장소를 탐험하세요. 각 방 팩에는 복잡한 퍼즐과 숨겨진 미스터리로 가득한 4개의 방이 포함됩니다.
드라큘라의 성: 그림자가 드리워진 요새에 들어가 비밀을 밝히고 어둠의 저주에 걸린 마을을 해방하세요.
우주선 EOS: 탐사 우주선이 충돌 후 조난되었습니다. 신비한 어둠의 구체에서 에너지원을 회수해야 합니다.
저주받은 보물: 비밀 지도를 따라 해적 섬으로 가서 위험천만한 시련을 극복하고 고대 보물을 차지하세요.
출시 후 더 많은 콘텐츠가 추가될 예정입니다!
단독 플레이 또는 멀티플레이어
단독 플레이와 친구와 함께 멀티플레이를 모두 즐길 수 있는 게임입니다. 최대 8명의 플레이어가 온라인으로 함께 참여할 수 있으며, 음성 및 문자 채팅을 지원하여 퍼즐을 풀면서 쉽게 소통할 수 있습니다.
물리 및 상호작용
방 탈출 시뮬레이터 2를 시작하면 실제 방 탈출 게임을 즐기는 듯한 기분을 선사하고 싶었습니다. 모든 요소와 상호작용을 할 수 있도록 개발하여 물건을 집어 들어 살펴보고, 먼지를 닦아내고, 차량을 운전하고, 원하는 곳에 앉고, 고정되지 않은 모든 것을 움직일 수 있습니다.
방 편집기 2.0
업데이트된 방 편집기 2.0으로 꿈에 그리던 방 탈출 게임을 만들어 보세요! 저희는 첫 번째 게임에서 만들어진 4,000개가 넘는 방을 살펴본 후 더욱 강력하고 직관적인 도구를 개발했습니다. 새로운 조명 엔진을 통해 공식 방과 같은 분위기를 연출할 수 있고, 건물 편집기로 방을 디자인(계단이 작동하는!) 할 수 있으며, 시퀀스 애니메이션으로 모든 것을 움직일 수 있습니다.

title: YELLOW*DEMON
description:
게임 정보
만사 무사의 황금은 지하 세계의 동굴 깊숙이 숨겨져 있으며, 그가 많은 여정을 거치며 포획한 사나운 악마들이 이를 지키고 있습니다. 만사 왕이 지하 세계를 구매하면서, 그는 첨탑을 얻었습니다. 제국의 막대한 황금을 숨기기에 완벽한 장소입니다.
## 체인 시스템
체인 시스템은 짧은 시간 내에 수집 및 처치를 수행하면 보상을 제공합니다. 체인을 유지하여 점수를 대폭 증가시키세요!
## 체인 크러쉬
일부 적들은 공격 시 체인 크러쉬를 수행할 수 있습니다. 최초 공격으로 피해를 입을 뿐만 아니라, 체인이 0으로 초기화되므로 주의하세요!

title: World In The Abyss
description:
게임 정보
심연 속의 세상 신비로운 종말 이후의 수중 세계를 탐험하는 생존 게임입니다. 기지를 건설하고 적의 공격을 방어하세요. 아이템을 제작하고, 보스와 싸우고, 다양한 생태계를 탐험하세요. 원하는 답을 찾기 위해 점점 더 깊은 바닷속으로 잠수하세요.
기지를 구축하세요
바다 요새를 짓기에 가장 적합한 장소를 선택하고, 집에 가장 잘 어울리는 내부 인테리어를 선택하세요. 용광로, 양조장, 무기고, 주방, 벌집 등 다양한 구조물을 만들어 보세요.
기지를 방어하세요
살아남으려면 해면을 배회하는 약탈자들로부터 기지를 방어해야 합니다. 약탈자들은 파도처럼 밀려오므로 함정과 방어 시설을 완벽하게 설치하고 준비하세요.

title: Away From Home
description:
게임 정보
Michael ^
늦은 밤에 당신은 그들의 세계에 들어갑니다. 당신은 애비라는 소녀를 살게 되고 그녀 주위의 세상에 영향을 미치게 됩니다. 그녀의 형 마이클과 함께 당신은 낯선 장소와 캐릭터 갈등, 이야기의 결정적 선택을 탐험할 것입니다. 당신은 세상을 도울 권한이 있거나, 그대로 썩게 만들 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있습니다. 조심하세요, 당신의 존재가 음산한 무언가의 주목을 받았습니다...
많은 인디 RPG들이 새로운 기발한 게임이라고 주장하지만, Away From Home은 많은 훌륭한 RPG들을 혼합한 것입니다. 캐릭터들은 감정이 가득하고 당신이 그들과 공감할 수 있도록 해줍니다. 이 세계가 당신을 필요로 한다는 것을 잊지 마세요.
Papa Frinkle ^

title: Modulus
description:
게임 정보
Modulus에서 모듈이라는 빌딩 블록을 생산하는 공정을 만드는 역할을 맡으세요. 정해진 공식은 없습니다. 어떤 방식으로 어떤 생산 라인을 설계해서 필요한 모듈을 제작할지는 전적으로 개인 재량입니다. 당신의 결정이 공장의 효율성을 좌우합니다.

title: noox
description:
게임 정보
Noox is a 3D first person medieval fantasy ghost investigation game that can be played solo or co-op. Use magically powered tools to collect evidence left behind by ghost hauntings, sort through the clues to decide which type of ghost is haunting the location, and assemble the necessary runes on your trap to capture the ghost and stop the haunting. But beware of draining your mana too fast by using too many tools at once, because the ghost will sense your weakness and use that moment to attack!
You play an alchemist investigating hauntings to extract magical energy (noox) from spirits. Travel to different haunted locations and stop the evil presence. Utilizing some fantasy twists on classic ghost investigation tools like an EMF reader of glowing mushrooms, track the ghost and collect the energy it infuses into objects that it has interacted with. Once enough information has been collected, assemble the necessary runes to capture the ghost on your trap and bring the ghost back to your workshop to complete your collection and unlock new abilities.
This game is being developed LIVE on Twitch! See the latest updates, get a peek behind the scenes, and even suggest changes or bug fixes and see it all happen live at UdonEngineering on Twitch (check the social links).

title: Galactic Prospectors
description:
게임 정보
Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by you, a rogue AI. Take on the universe against humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.
Galactic Prospectors will have the following features upon release into Early Access:
Exploration: Explore the vastness of Space. Upgrade ships, build space stations, conquer enemies. It's an infinite world.
Build & Craft: Build space stations, ships, and other things. Craft components from resources such as ores mined from Asteroids that have been refined into Ingots.
Combat: Survive in this world against humans, other rogue AI, aliens and more.
Durability & Health: All ships and stations have health. This means, bullets deal damage, colliding with space junk deals damage. Repair your ships and stations using components and resources. 
Currency & Shop System: Buy ships, special weapons and tools, and more. 
Your purchase entitles you to receive all future updates free of charge!

title: Double Dragon Revive
description:
게임 정보
1987년 오락실에 등장하여 "벨트 스크롤 액션"을 확립한 걸작 타이틀 "더블 드래곤" 시리즈.
지금까지도 많은 게이머에게 영감을 주고 있는 작품이 "더블 드래곤 리바이브"로 다시 태어난다!

1. 스타일리시하게 향상된 캐릭터 비주얼!
아케이드 황금기를 빛낸 캐릭터들의 개성을 3D 그래픽으로 재현.
주인공 리 형제뿐만 아니라 여태껏 맞서싸워온 강적들도 등장한다!

플레이어가 화면을 좌우로 이동하면서 적을 쓰러트려가는 벨트 스크롤 액션.
그 심플하면서도 직관적인 게임성을 충실히 재현하면서도 조작감과 난이도를 현세대에 맞게 최적화.
아크시스템웍스의 격투 게임 제작 스태프가 철저히 감수하여 처음 플레이하는 사람도 쉽게 플레이가 가능!

본 게임의 전투 액션은 단순히 버튼을 누르는 것이 아닌 다채로운 움직임이 필요!
적의 행동 패턴을 기억하여 효과적인 공격 타이밍을 노리는 등 전략적 요소가 포함되어 있다.
각 스테이지에 떨어져 있는 무기나 준비된 기믹을 활용하여 전투를 유리하게 이끌어가자!

title: Effulgence RPG
description:
게임 정보
텍스트 기호로 생명을 얻은 신비로운 세계를 탐험하세요.
게임 특징:
★ 제작 자원을 모으는 유일한 방법은 생물을 물리치고 개별 입자로 분해하는 것입니다.
★ 이러한 입자를 사용하여 특별한 프린터에서 무기, 장비 및 기계를 인쇄할 수 있습니다.
★ 탐험할 수 있는 수십 개의 위치가 있습니다.
★ 프린터에서 아이템을 만들기 위한 다양한 자원.
★ 인쇄할 수 있는 아이템에 대한 100개 이상의 청사진.
★ 고급 캐릭터 업그레이드 시스템.
줄거리
위성이 닿는 거리라면 비디오 신호를 전송하는 것은 쉽습니다. 태양계를 넘어가면, 일반적인 이미지를 지구로 보내는 데 몇 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다.
그러나 신호가 백만 광년 떨어진 은하에서 온다면, 우리에게는 기호의 조각들만 도달합니다. 때때로 그것들을 해독하여 텍스트 문자로 만든 애니메이션으로 조합할 수 있습니다.
이것은 이상한 세계의 이야기입니다. 신호가 백만 년을 여행했으므로, 그 세계는 더 이상 존재하지 않을 수도 있습니다. 아니면 그 세계는 여전히 존재하며 공격을 준비하고 있을지도 모릅니다?

title: Maguntsche Chapter Two
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Macungie, Pennsylvania!
The Lockridge Shipping Company, a once bustling hub of commerce, now stands as a relic of the prosperity once experienced by a small community. Andrew Allen, the company’s latest hire, seizes this opportunity to weave digital threads through the decaying fabric of tradition, bringing the company into the modern era with his expertise in data security. Unknown to him, the company’s purpose has shifted, veering away from its repetitive logistical operations. His employee orientation, a mundane affair on paper, unfolds like a cryptic ritual with the intention of summoning a cataclysmic merger of worlds. As time runs out, Andrew finds himself entangled in the past, present, and future. Only you will decide how it ends.
Gameplay Features Summary
Maguntsche: Chapter Two is an indie horror game that blends the traditional elements of the survival horror genre with a branching narrative experience. The player is tasks with exploring the Lockridge Shipping Company Industrial Complex and must search for items to enable their progression through the warehouse.
The player will be tasked with completing computer work and will have the ability to collect, store, and craft useful items to help them in direct encounters with the entities of the Realmverse. During these frightening encounters, the player will experience two realms stitched together, where a mirrored reality hides in plain sight and the rules are changed.
When immersed within the Realmverse, the player must collect reality fragments to return to their body and continue their investigation; finding a way to stop these otherworldly forces. The Lockridge Industrial Complex is a vast facility full of hidden secrets. Look carefully and you might find evidence and other documents that provides additional insights into the secrets of your new employer. The further you dig, the closer you become to the truth.

title: Lost Tribe
description:
게임 정보
Aim and throw your spear to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. Use it to create platforms that give you a boost to reach new areas.
Master the winds with the gliding spear, riding air streams to explore even higher heights.
Explore a vast world filled with mysterious encounters and hidden secrets. Use the environment to your advantage by swinging on liana ropes.

title: Trail of the Cryptid
description:
게임 정보
Trail of the Cryptid is a chilling psychological horror adventure where the line between hunter and hunted blurs. Search for cryptids in the dark wilderness, and uncover clues to find their lair. Gather enough evidence to prove their existence, or kill the creature to return its carcass. Use stealth to avoid detection or use direct combat with guns, explosives, and traps.

Initially you'll be hunting bigfoot, but other cryptids will be added in future updates. Each cryptid will have unique abilities and strategies.

Investigate locations where the creature has been sighted, and search for evidence, like footprints and fur. Take photos of the beast. Gather enough evidence to win the game, but the best evidence will require getting close to the creature in its lair.

Play with up to three of your friends.

title: Mosaic of the Strange
description:
게임 정보
🧩 Mosaic of the Strange는 디지털 십자수입니다. 하나의 거대한 격자 퍼즐을 완성해 나가며 초자연적 사건들의 신비로운 콜라주를 드러내는 명상적인 게임입니다.
🖼️ 영역을 해결하며 점차 밝혀지는 소름 끼치는 픽셀 아트—신비한 사건, 믿을 수 없는 인물들, 그리고 기존 세계관을 뒤흔드는 기이한 생물들을 만나보세요.
💣 지뢰찾기를 할 줄 안다면 Mega Mosaic도 쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다! 숫자 단서(0~9)는 해당 단서 주변 1칸 내에 몇 개의 밝은 타일을 배치해야 하는지를 알려줍니다.
🎶 좋아하는 팟캐스트나 음악을 들으며 플레이해도 좋고, Mosaic of the Strange는 배경으로 제격입니다. 또는 신비와 공포가 넘치는 내장 사운드트랙을 감상해 보세요.
⏳ 수십 시간에 달하는 중독성 강한 게임플레이: 초자연 현상의 세계를 탐험하며 매혹적인 퍼즐 풀이에 푹 빠져보세요.

title: Try 2 Sleep
description:
게임 정보
Description
Try 2 Sleep은 초자연적 영화에서 영감을 받은 캐주얼 소파 협동 공포 게임입니다. 악령이 당신의 집에 침입했습니다. 파트너와 협력하여 밤의 공포에서 살아남으세요!
당신은 좋은 커플입니까? 함께 일하고 완벽한 조화를 이루어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 살아남지 못할 것입니다. 당신의 연결이 당신의 운명을 결정합니다.
게임 규칙:
집 문제로 인해 잠이 오지 않습니다. 문제를 해결하세요!

title: Twisted Christmas
description:
게임 정보
Twisted Christmas
Christmas is dying. An ancient darkness has corrupted the holiday season, and only a team of Santa's bravest elves can save it. Team up with 1-3 friends in this co-op present delivery adventure through procedurally generated cities where each gift you deliver pushes back against the encroaching shadows.
FEATURES:
• 1-4 Player Co-op Gameplay: Join forces with friends as a team of elves on a mission to save Christmas - coordinate your deliveries, watch each other's backs, and overcome the darkness together
• Advanced Procedural City Generation: Explore endlessly unique urban landscapes with every playthrough, featuring varied neighborhoods, building layouts, and delivery routes
• Strategic Present Delivery System: Collect presents from distribution points and navigate the twisted cityscape to deliver them to homes still clinging to hope
• Dynamic Environment Transformation: Watch as neighborhoods visibly transform from corrupted to joyful with each successful delivery
• Escalating Challenge: As you restore more of the city, the shadow forces grow desperate - coordinate with teammates to outmaneuver increasingly aggressive holiday horrors
• Unique Elf Abilities: Each player can choose different elf specializations with unique skills to aid in the delivery mission
GAMEPLAY:
Work together with your friends to save Christmas! Split up to cover more ground or stick together to handle tougher areas as you navigate the procedurally generated cities. Each teammate can grab presents from distribution centers and deliver them to marked locations throughout the city.
The procedural generation ensures every session offers fresh challenges with new city layouts, building placements, and delivery routes. Coordinate with your team using the magic map to efficiently distribute presents before the darkness consumes the holiday entirely.
COOPERATIVE EXPERIENCE:

title: Love Blades and Run
description:
게임 정보
Love, Blades, and Run is a high-mobility parkour game where style is survival and freedom is everything. You play as a masked urban rebel in a city that wants to cage your soul. Run, swing, wall-run, and slash your way through an oppressive regime while uncovering a hidden story of truth, justice, and personal liberation.

Feel the movement-driven combat, stylish traversal, and identity-defining choices that shape the full game. Whether you're sprinting across rooftops, dueling enforcers mid-air, or defacing propaganda with your own flair, this is your invitation to rebel—with elegance.

title: UNRETURNING
description:
게임 정보
Everyone says it's impossible to venture into the depths; everyone who tries ends up returning. But... maybe this time will be different?
You must stare into the abyss to truly discover where you are.
This time, THE JOURNEY is what matters.
A completely unknown environment waiting to be explored, surrounded by an aura of horror.
Pixel art graphics inspired by great classics like Undertale or Oneshot.
A deep story filled with charismatic characters that will make YOUR JOURNEY unforgettable.
Headphones are recommended.
Around 3-4 hours of horror, exploration, puzzles and comedy.
                                               WHAT IS THE ABYSS HIDING?

title: Comet Angel
description:
게임 정보
Izzy and Nat break out of their boring summer routine when they make the discovery of a lifetime: an alien living at the bottom of a nearby pond. The mysterious creature, which they name Faerie, asks them for help returning to its home on a passing comet in exchange for showing the girls their futures. As they search for scrap metal to feed their new celestial friend, Izzy and Nat suddenly realize Faerie's influence is spreading far beyond what they expected. Lost in the purgatory between adolescence and adulthood, they find themselves staring down the long and perilous road to self-acceptance.
Explore the small town of Cold Lake, Michigan as you search for the raw materials Faerie needs to survive, solving puzzles and facing the emotional consequences of Izzy and Nat's discovery. You'll encounter a wide variety of challenges, from wiring puzzles to cryptograms, as you scour abandoned factories and forgotten sheds for precious metals.
What will Izzy and Nat see when they look forward in time?
Key Features
Unique, multi-layered puzzles to solve
Relatable, charming, fully voice acted characters
Complete original soundtrack that invokes the alt-rock spirit of the 1990s
An emotional, heartfelt story with multiple endings

title: The Outer Worlds 2
description:
게임 정보
The Outer Worlds 2는 Obsidian Entertainmen가 선보인, 수상에 빛나는 1인칭 공상 과학 RPG의 간절히 기다려온 속편입니다. 설명만 들어도 엄청난 게임 같지 않나요? 일정을 여유롭게 비워 두고, 새로운 식민지에서 새로운 동료와 함께 새로운 무기를 들고 새로운 적과 맞서는 액션 가득한 모험에 나설 준비를 하세요! 새로운 게 엄청 많네요!

title: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island
description:
게임 정보
*Game IS in development, but due to personal circumstances, it takes longer than expected*
Check the Youtube Channel for most recent updates!

Holum Island, Island of Unspeakable Horrors, the Structureworld...... for centuries, stories have been told about an island in the mist. An island of death and despair, only be found by people stuck in the massive storms that threaten this part of the sea.
But there is one name everybody knows: Skull Island.

Jump into this Single Player Hardcore Survival game that lets you explore a new interpretation of Skull Island like you have never seen before!
With building mechanics that let you set traps, build small shelters, gather food and resources, this survival game gives you the freedom to explore and settle on the Coastal Area of Skull Island filled with prehistoric wild life but evolved, dinosaurs and fantasy creatures based on the location of the island.

The game heavily focusses on a semi-open world filled with creatures from big to really small to make it feel more alive.
Each creature has his own place in the ecosystem, with AI focussed on this aspect.
It is possible to overhunt animals(for a short time) because of the spawning system and animals will react to your way of hunting.
The game also features a dynamic weather system that will not only impact the spawnrates of certain animals, but will also result in respawning of resources given to you by the sea.
Sometimes it is better to start running instead of fighting the many hostile animals on the island.
They will crawl from caves, fall from the basalt cliffs, attack you from above and... from carcasses?

The game will also be released with a gore-censor option for youtube(to prevent demonetization).
autokwd: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island

title: Brainrot Wars
description:
게임 정보
Brain Are Gain!
Brainrot Wars는 무료로 플레이 가능한 턴제 캐주얼 게임으로, 밈(meme)과 전략이 만나는 곳입니다. 3시간마다 전리품을 수집하고, 자신만의 영웅 군단을 만들어보세요. 밈으로 가득한 전리품 축제이며, Steam 인벤토리를 통해 거래 가능한 보상과 실제 경제 시스템이 존재합니다.
1️⃣ 시즌 1
무료 영웅 6명
조합 가능한 영웅 12명 (희귀 6명, 에픽 4명, 전설 2명)
캐릭터 맞추기 미니게임
다양한 트링킷 (해당 시즌 한정)
2️⃣ 시즌 2
공개 및 랭크 아레나 모드 – 자신이 보유한 캐릭터로 전투
영웅 18명 (일반 6, 희귀 6, 에픽 6, 전설 2)
더 많은 트링킷 (시즌에 종속됨)

아티팩트 – 여러 트링킷을 조합해 강력한 아티팩트 생성. 하나의 영웅은 오직 하나의 아티팩트만 착용 가능. 매우 희귀하며 랭크 전용. 압도적인 힘을 가짐.
영웅 18명 (일반 6, 희귀 6, 에픽 6, 전설 2)

title: Flappy Bat 3
description:
게임 정보

It's Halloween night and the Flappy Bat is once again trying to make his way home.
Witches, ghosts, pumpkins, skulls, brooms, deadly spiders and other obstacles are in his way and you must help him navigate his way to safety.

title: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
description:
게임 정보
2차원 세상을 정말 좋아하는 소녀가 전파송과 함께 괴문서로 세계를 부순다! "아하하, 2차원에 대한 애정만 있으면 그걸로 충분해!"
(다른 문장: 정신나간 소녀가 2차원의 사랑을 받아 전파계 러브송을 타고 세계를 부순다! 아하하!)
방구석 외톨이 소녀가 전파송을 듣고 최고로 UP된 정신 상태로 사랑스러운 괴문서를 작성해 정신나간 세상을 만드는 리듬 어드벤처 게임입니다.
30곡 이상의 전파송과 멀티 엔딩으로 짜릿한 경험을 즐겨보세요.
Q. 소녀는 왜 방구석 외톨이가 되었는가?
Q. 괴문서로 어떻게 정신나간 세계를 만들 수 있는가?
Q. 패배자 덕후 소녀에게 행복한 엔딩이 찾아올 수 있는가?
위 "Q"의 대답은 어지럽게 휙휙 날아다니는 전파와 광기의 끝에 있습니다.
자, 지금 당장 헤드폰을 쓰고 "융융 전파 신드롬"에서 흘러나오는 전파를 받아 보세요.
【Groove to the DENPA!】

title: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake
description:

『드래곤 퀘스트 III HD-2D Remake』 이후의 세계를 그리는 『드래곤 퀘스트 I』과 『드래곤 퀘스트 II』가 1개의 타이틀로 등장.
도트 아트와 3D CG가 융합된 "HD-2D" 세계에서 다시금 모험의 막이 오른다!

title: ARC Raiders
description:
게임 정보
오늘날 우리가 아는 세상은 이제 거의 남아 있지 않습니다. 지상을 장악한 미지의 아크 머신들 때문에 인간은 지상에 정착하지 못하고 생존을 위해 지하에 공동체를 만들었죠. 모두가 근근이 하루하루를 버티며 살아가고 있지만, 일부는 용감한 길을 선택했습니다. 레이더라고 불리는 이들이죠.
출시 예정인 ARC Raiders는 아크라 불리는 미지의 머신들에게 침공당한 척박한 환경의 미래 지구를 배경으로 하는 구출 어드벤처 멀티플레이어 게임입니다.
ENLIST.RESIST
레이더로 자원해 황량한 세상에서 풍요로움을 누리세요. 지하의 스페란자에 나만의 집을 만들고, 지상의 치명적인 환경 속에서 필요한 물품을 찾아 확보하세요. 위협적인 아크 머신과 다른 이들을 사냥하는 레이더를 조심하고, 트레이더들과 좋은 관계를 유지하며 퀘스트를 수행해 귀중한 물품을 가지고 지하로 돌아가세요. 물품을 교환해 장비를 확보하고 나만의 공간을 업그레이드하세요. 인생의 값진 것들은 공짜로 얻을 수 없다는 걸 잊지 마세요.
필요한 것을 위해 어떤 일도 마다하지 않을 자신이 있나요?

title: Welcome to Doll Town
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Doll Town is a psychological horror game where players uncover the haunting mystery of a once-thriving village that has been cursed into a twisted, eternal nightmare. You play as a young Japanese student who, upon arriving for a part-time job in a desolate town, becomes ensnared in a macabre world where tragic events endlessly replay and the residents are lifelike dolls made from flesh and bone.
After a panicked boy leads you to the school rooftop, you witness what seems to be a real suicide—a girl, bullied and broken, jumps to her death. Now, you must explore the eerie town, solve twisted puzzles, and face the reanimated memories of the town’s victims—the seven dolls who represent those responsible for the tragedy.
With each doll you confront, you unravel more of the town's dark history. But as you navigate the town’s sinister secrets, you discover that Doll Town is a place where the line between life, death, and doll is blurred, and the real puppet master behind the scenes has much darker intentions. Can you break the cycle of torment, or will you too become a part of the dollhouse forever?
Key Features:
Deep Psychological Horror: Experience a story-driven horror game that combines atmospheric tension with emotional devastation.
Puzzle-Based Exploration: Solve intricate, Saw-like puzzles and unlock the hidden memories of each doll's tragic story to progress.
Cursed Town: Navigate through a hauntingly beautiful but twisted Japanese town, filled with disturbing secrets, lifelike dolls, and dark memories.
Narrative Driven: Unfold the mystery of Mio's death and the seven dolls through immersive storytelling, haunting flashbacks, and heart-wrenching confrontations.
Reenactments and Illusions: Witness surreal and horrifying reenactments of tragic events, never knowing what is real or a product of Doll Town's curse.
Atmospheric Immersion: With no electricity and an abandoned feel, each area is designed to chill with its eerie silence, ambient sounds, and subtle clues.
Doll Town will pull you into a nightmare where the only way out is to solve the twisted riddle behind Mio’s tragic fate. But beware—the deeper you go, the harder it is to distinguish reality from the dollmaker’s cruel illusions.

title: Athyra: Rock
description:
게임 정보

From the creator of... absolutely nothing else so far...
...comes the latest confusing mess of a game.
Athyra takes the simplest game everyone knows—Rock, Paper, Scissors—and turns it into the most complicated horror experience that not many understand (including maybe the developer).
Face off against unsettling opponents, solve cryptic puzzles, and try not to question your sanity—or the rules. Because yes, there are rules. Probably. Somewhere.
Also, it’s a horror game.

title: Orcs and Outlaws
description:
게임 정보
A classic action adventure shooter, featuring the blonde bounty hunter Ava Garant versus a horde of super Orcs and their army of the undead:
- A new generation of Orc warriors
- Their army of dragons, demons and the undead
- A badass blonde bounty hunter
- Melee, spell casting and shooting combat
Key Features:
ORCS, VAMPIRES, DEMONS AND MORE
The bounty hunters have been getting reports and rumors of bizarre and fearsome creatures roaming the islands. They include visions of dragons, giants and animals never seen before. Whatever’s there, its worth the risk for an Orc bounty.
Demon spirits - malevolent entities believed to possess supernatural powers

title: Worst Case
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to "Worst Case" – a gripping multiplayer horror game where your nightmares come to life! Step into a chilling world of the paranormal, where every moment could be your last.
Game Overview:
You and your friends are trapped in a mysterious, abandoned hotel brimming with dark secrets and deadly riddles. But beware, you’re not alone. Among you hides a sinister ghost with a loyal assistant, both intent on eliminating anyone who dares to disturb their haunting grounds.
Game Objectives:

Ghost & Assistant: Use stealth and supernatural abilities to hunt down and eliminate all other players.
Survivors: Discover and use powerful artifacts to identify the ghost's type and perform an exorcism to banish it before it's too late.

Key Features:
Interactive Gameplay: As the ghost's assistant, you can tag victims, create diversions, plant energy beacons, and relay crucial information to the ghost.
Varied Tools: Explore the hotel with an array of items like candles, crosses, UV flashlights, and thermometers to detect the ghost's presence and identify its type.
Intense Atmosphere: Experience realistic graphics and eerie sound effects that create an immersive horror atmosphere, where danger lurks around every corner.
Tactics & Strategy: Every decision matters—work with other players to find items, uncover the hotel's secrets, and survive the night.
Dynamic Role Switching: Each game is a new experience. Today you might be the hunter, and tomorrow the hunted. Can you survive when trust is in short supply?
Gameplay Snapshot:
You step into a decrepit, abandoned hotel. Dim lights flicker, and every shadow seems to move. You light a candle, its flame flickering as a ghostly presence draws near. Suddenly, the ghost’s helper marks you. A chill creeps up your spine. The lights go out. Footsteps echo behind you—it’s the ghost. You scream for help, but it’s too late...
Join the Haunt:
Whether you're a fearless ghost hunter or a cunning ghost, there’s a place for you in this terrifying world. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where fear is your greatest enemy, and only the bravest will survive.

title: The Red Forest
description:
게임 정보
The Red Forest is a story-driven, dark, emotional tale about power, loss, and the fear of the unknown.

Enter a futuristic world, immersing yourself in the complex narrative of two brothers. Their parents, pioneering scientists, have uncovered a groundbreaking power source.

You assume the persona of Yaro. Following a catastrophic nuclear reactor blast, you witness your sibling, Ace, being pulled into the woods adjacent to the power plant. Your task is to find your lost brother amidst the turbulent vastness of The Red Forest.

title: Robokid
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an extraordinary journey as RoboKid, a robot housing the soul of a child, determined to cleanse a spaceship infested with otherworldly creatures. Dive into a metroidvania experience that combines combat, atmosphere, and deep exploration, promising a fresh take on the genre.
FIGTHING SYSTEM
Arm RoboKid with a versatile arsenal, including guns and attachable weapons, to battle a diverse array of monsters, ranging from regular aliens to formidable bosses.
Strategically collect upgrades by either finding them or defeating specific creatures, enhancing RoboKid's combat capabilities.
MULTIPLAYER
Embark on the main story with a friend by joining in cooperative multiplayer mode.
Achieve a seamless gaming experience as progress made in both single-player and multiplayer modes is shared and carries over between them.
Transition between single-player and multiplayer modes without interrupting your gaming experience.

title: Halloween Night
description:
게임 정보
Join dark reimaginings of Snow White, Red Riding Hood, and Alice as they face off against iconic horror villains like Frankenstein's Monster and Count Dracula.
Empower your hero by collecting cards and mysterious artifacts. Gather companions and brew potions. Tame magical familiars as your pets and rise as the new dark lord of the cozy Halloween world.
🔹 Fairytale Heroes
Guide four legendary heroes with unique skills and playstyles
🔹 Collect Cards & Build Your Deck
Discover, upgrade, and combine powerful cards to empower your hero
🔹 Co-op & Epic Bosses
Team up with friends to defeat epic bosses in thrilling battles
🔹 Companions
Find friendly adventurers and recruit them into your party. Fighting evil as a team is way more fun
🔹 Magical Familiars
Tame magical familiars to become your pets
🔹 Mysterious Artifacts
Find mysterious artifacts and unlock their power
🔹 Alchemy
Сraft any spell you desire and share the recipe with the community
🔹 Procedural Narratives
Your actions and choices shape a procedurally generated story that’s never the same twice

title: Scary Stories
description:
게임 정보
This is a text-based, choose-your-own-adventure style game that presents you with multiple spine-chilling stories where you must navigate your way through with nothing but your wits and any items you find along the way.
Each story has multiple choices which can branch into new paths and even new endings... Along the way, you may be fortunate or smart enough to find yourself something that could be of use.
FEATURES
- Out-the-box Custom Story support!
- Text-based Stories
- Multiple choices/branching paths
- Custom audio sound effects
- Items that can be used to unlock paths/choices
- Configurable settings

title: Floatineer
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 바다 위 여정을 시작하여 광활한 바다를 항해하면서 수상 커뮤니티를 돕습니다. 모듈식 건축 블록을 사용하여 다양한 건축물과 주택을 건설합니다. 건설 과정 중에 플레이어는 토네이도, 지진, 뇌우와 같은 자연 재해에 직면하게 되며, 이러한 재해는 건축물에 실제 물리적 영향을 미칩니다. 플레이어는 안정성과 미적 요소 사이에서 균형을 찾아야 하며, 길 위에서 만나는 사람들이 거주할 수 있는 안전하고 아름다운 집을 만들어야 합니다.

또한, 이 게임에는 '화가 모드'가 있어 플레이어가 획득한 색상 팔레트를 사용하여 이미 지어진 건물을 다시 칠할 수 있습니다. 이 모드는 플레이어가 상상력과 창의력을 최대한 발휘하여 각 건축물에 독특하고 개성 있는 스타일을 부여하도록 격려합니다.

title: Twin Stick Heroes 2

Twin Stick Heroes 2 is a top down arena shooter.  Choose from a diverse cast of heroes, and engage in epic battles across a galaxy of exotic planets. This time with new gameplay options an array of new heroes to master, and balance improvements for fair and thrilling combat. Twin Stick Heroes 2 is the sequel you've been waiting for.
