title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134
description:
게임 정보
CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person Horror/Puzzle Adventure for PC and VR.
A wide variety of physics-based interactions lets you feel the weight of objects. The undistracted first-person perspective creates a vivid experience. Increase your feeling of presence even further by playing in VR – for those who dare only.
Picture a messy floor covered in interesting residues from former times! Or twenty buttons, levers and flip switches on a control cabinet! Doors, hatches, toilet flushes… – if it looks like you can interact with it, you can – in VR, as well as on PC.

title: Deck Vs Doom
description:
게임 정보
Build a deck from a vast selection of towers, traps, and spells, then strategically place your defenses as waves of enemies attack. Your deck is your arsenal, summon towers to hold the line, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to turn the tide of battle.
Between battles, uncover powerful artifacts that change how you play. Draft new cards, forge synergies, and grow stronger with each run.
With each run offering fresh choices, randomized upgrades, and evolving challenges, no two games are the same. Will you forge an unstoppable defense, or will The Doom claim your world next?

title: Soul Essence
description:
게임 정보
Explore a decrepit and cultist-infested estate, uncover your secret ties to the cult within, and collect awakened souls to conquer an ancient god looking to feast on your essence. Only one hour remains until the god is released at midnight!

World Features
Time is your enemy in Soul Essence. As midnight approaches, the cultists become more corrupt and erratic from the divine energy in the air that is rapidly spreading across the estate. The atmosphere will thicken making it harder to see, and the estate will become a hellish and terrifying environment. Each run offers a unique experience:

Random enemy encounters made interesting by the in-game clock. New challenges and foes will appear around the estate as the clock nears midnight.

Randomized weapons and item locations.

Unique and special world events randomly selected each run.

The clock feature adds an extra layer of uniqueness and unpredictability to the randomization in Soul Essence creating a unique, rich, and engaging environments that feels truly alive.

How you spend the hour is entirely up to you. Explore the deepest depths of the estate to collect as many useful items, awakened souls and ancient artifacts as you can before midnight or go directly into the god's territory to challenge it. Hold your ground or prevent the God's release all together.

title: Program Penguin
description:
게임 정보
Slash, shoot, and slide through Program Penguin, the minimalist adventure game bursting with birds, bad puns, and enough toilet humor to surely provoke a pity laugh or two. Explore the Antarctic Server and fend off impending doom in the form of the deadly computer virus. Discover items, unearth secrets, and battle baddies in this bold and bubbly bombastic bird-based bash!
** Notice To All Players: This game contains imagery that may harm players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar conditions. **
Features:
Acquire Items: 
Obtain a variety of items that are quirky, questionable and downright morally wrong.
Fight Enemies:
Shoot penguins, robots and anything else unfortunate enough to turn its back to you in this real-time action-adventure game.
Solve Puzzles:
Use abilities and items to solve a number of unusual puzzles in this 2-hour indie game made by a single person.
Battle Bosses:
Face 3 funky, mad and memorable bosses in the only video game that feels like a fart joke met a fever dream and rolled it all up into one penguin themed package.

title: What Happens After Midnight?
description:
게임 정보
What Happens After Midnight is an action-survival horror FPS where you play as Lucy, a paranormal investigator sent to check out the small town of Nightvale. Things are not as they seem. The people are strange here and an ominous feeling grows as the clock gets closer to midnight. Then ensues a journey through other worlds to save our own.
Explore mysterious worlds.
Collect resources and upgrades to get more powerful.

title: The HELL : City Builder of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
지옥 총관으로서 당신의 임무는 단순히 도시를 건설하는 것이 아니다. 죄악이 지배하는 이 영역에서 혼돈을 질서로 바꾸는 것이야말로 당신의 역할이다. 여기서는 모든 결정, 모든 영혼이 지대한 영향을 미친다.
이 도시 건설 게임에서 당신은 폐허 위에 망자의 도시를 세우고, 제한된 자원을 관리하며, 지옥에 유입되는 영혼들을 통제해야 한다. 칠죄종에서 비롯된 도전에 맞서고, 지옥의 수호자로 타락한 ‘추락한 짐승’과 대립하라. 각 임무는 깊이 있는 배경 이야기를 담고 있으며, 전략적 지혜를 시험한다. 그리고 모든 실패는 부흥을 향한 초석이 된다.
매번 반복되는 윤회 속에서 당신은 단련된다——과거의 실수가 미래의 힘이 되며, 시도할수록 불멸의 전설을 완성하는 길에 다가선다. 『대지옥』은 몰입감 있는 서사와 역동적인 플레이로 당신을 시험한다. 이 땅의 모든 건축물은 죄악, 고통, 그리고 구원의 이야기를 속삭이고 있다.
autokwd: The HELL : City Builder of the Dead

title: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls
description:
게임 정보
Crime strikes again, this time, at the luxurious inauguration to a charity gala! Miss Mishelle Shellington has had her pearl necklace stolen - and there's only one fish who's got the wits, the keen detective skills, and the glistening fish scales to put the culprit behind bars in this noir themed whodunnit...

Enter Detective Bass!

Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls is a witty, narrative-driven detective game, where the player must investigate, follow leads, and interrogate suspects to solve this crime. Take notes in your trusty detective pad, look for clues with your magnifying glass, and get to the bottom of this mystery using your sharp analytical skills and quick thinking fish brain!
autokwd: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls

title: Eyes of Rain
description:
게임 정보
Eyes of Rain is a dark fantasy game where your decisions shape the world's future. Choices can have immediate effects or accumulate over time, leading to endings that range from tragic to resolute.
(Primary player character)
A baker in a small, uneventful town, your world shifts when a mercenary in dark clothing shows up to buy a small treat. Who is she? What does she want from you?

title: Ghost Hunter Simulator
description:
게임 정보
*** Ghost Hunter Simulator is under active development. All screen shots and video are taken from pre-Alpha builds (in other words, we don't even have all the gameplay in place, let alone finalized) and may not reflect final gameplay. ***
Are Ghosts Real?
Have you ever wanted to explore spooky locations and hunt for ghosts?
In Ghost Hunter Simulator, the player takes on the role of an aspiring ghost hunter or skeptic with the goal of building their social media empire - as the ghost hunters who finally found proof or the skeptic who exposes all those charlatans.
Ghost Hunter Simulator is not a horror game, but rather Cozy Spooky. Think Haunted Mansion, not Haunting of Hill House. Using an extensive tag system, players can tailor the content of Ghost Hunter Simulator to their preferred flavor and intensity of spooky.
Players will spend much of their time exploring allegedly haunted locations and gathering evidence of the paranormal, as well as learning the lore and history of the location. Ghost Hunter Simulator uses a first-person view and focuses on using real world ghost hunting tools to collect evidence - either that full-body apparition photo that proves to the world, once and for all, that ghosts or real, or a video clip debunking the local ghost story by showing that the curtains only move because there's an air vent across the room that kicks on.
Believer or Skeptic, once you've gathered your evidence, the next step is to tell everyone. Via a puzzle like game, the player will sort and tag their evidence (e.g. "spooky", or "funny", or "EVP", or even "Prank") to post on various in game social sites - like BooTube or Deaddit. Follow the trends and your audience to earn fame and fortune - which coincidentally allows you to ghost hunt at more famous locations, with cooler equipment.
The locations visited in Ghost Hunter Simulator range from real world locations you COULD go visit in real life to fictional ones, including a few locations that no longer exist. Explore in safety, from the comfort of your own home, and find the evidence (or lack thereof) of ghosts!
Ghost Hunter Simulator is currently in development by Ryan and Kim Steiner, two former AAA developers, along with support from Matt Fossen and Ross Sigworth. Ghost Hunter Simulator will be updated at regular intervals - not only for bug fixing, balancing, expanding systems, and such, but also adding in new levels and places to explore.
Features:

title: Slingshot Pilot
description:
게임 정보
중력을 마스터하세요 (또는 충돌 시도) 슬링샷 파일럿! 위험한 기동을 해내고, 소행성을 피하고, 정신없는 임무를 완수하여 회사 순위를 올리고, 더욱 위험하고 위험한 임무를 맡으세요. 최고 점수 추격전에서 동료들과 경쟁하세요. 하지만 태양에 너무 가까이 날지는 마세요..
항해, 적응, 생존
날렵한 우주선을 조종하여 행성과 다른 천체에서 발생하는 중력이 변하는 레벨들을 헤쳐나가세요. 각 환경은 역동적이며 위험과 장애물로 가득합니다. 미리 계획하고 순간적인 대응이 생명줄이지만, 너무 안주하지 마세요. 충돌은 학습 과정의 일부입니다. 완벽한 중력 기동.
위험과 미스터리의 우주
소행성대, 용암 행성, 얼음 행성, 가스 행성을 탐색하세요. 좌초된 조종사를 구출하고, 생존자를 대피시키고, 당신을 사냥하는 듯한 불길한 외부인을 피하세요. 위험은 도처에 도사리고 있습니다. 이 혼돈 속에서 살아남을 수 있을까요?
업적 및 순위표
한 걸음 더 나아가 호기심을 충족시켜 주는 도움의 손길은 업적으로 보상받습니다. 순위표에서 친구 및 다른 플레이어와 경쟁하고, 지름길을 택하고 새총 실력을 갈고닦아 우주 먼지 속에 있는 라이벌들을 제압하세요.
키보드 또는 게임 컨트롤러
편안한 방법으로 플레이하세요. 이 게임은 키보드 + 마우스 및 일반 컨트롤러에 최적화되어 있으며 Steam Deck.
에서도 자연스럽게 작동합니다.

title: Terram Reduc Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Earth, ravaged by nuclear war, has become a battleground for an alien invasion. As humanity’s last hope, you’ll need to plow through enemy lines and reclaim our planet.
Survive mazes filled with deadly traps, face off against alien bosses, and eliminate anything that crawls or flies in your path to bring Earth back from the brink.
Use keyboard to move and mouse to aim and fire to navigate this intense 2.5D platformer inspired by the thrill of 90s shooters.
Developed by solo creator Horizont Games, this game combines fast-paced, modern gameplay with vibrant visuals.
Key Features:
Simple Controls: Run and jump with the keyboard, aim and shoot with the mouse—intuitive controls that keep you focused on the action.
Alien Annihilation: Battle deadly alien enemies and tactical drones that will put your reflexes and strategy to the test.

title: Metrocity
description:
게임 정보
metrocity is a city building simulation game that has interesting and unique gameplay. in this game you will be the mayor who manages and builds your city from 0 to become a megapolis city with a population of millions of people. You can arrange members of your government to help you in managing your city. There are some basic game facilities included such as:
1. Utility System
like cities in general which require water, electricity, sewage and garbage collector, in this game you can build and upgrade these facilities to the highest level. you can build a mega water dam or a nuclear fusion power plant with the help of research from scientists in your city.
2. Security System
A comfortable city is a safe city, so city security needs to be provided. In Metrocity you can build a police station and fire station, all of which can be upgraded to the maximum level following the development of your city. You can provide a mega police department for the availability of large numbers of police with more advanced equipment and vehicles, also a central fire station which can provide a more varied choice of vehicles.
3. Education System
build a university in your city and form a group of scientist researchers to open many new things in your city. improve the quality of education in your city to attract lots of investment and build large companies in your city. Workers with high quality and skills will be able to attract investors to invest in your city. The higher quality of education, the more technological and futuristic equipment or vehicles that you can create.
4.  Economy System
Adopting a real economic system, this game also uses a taxation system and commodity exports as the main keys to generating financial income for your city. You can adjust the tax rate to make more money but in return reduce the rate of population growth in your city. You can set residential, industrial or office zones to maximize your city's economy.
Apart from the facilities above, there are still many facilities embedded in this game. it will produce high quality graphics with stylized art technique. We also embedded DLSS and Raytracing features in this game to make the game more immersive.

title: Vortex: Hoverdrome
description:
게임 정보
Vortex: Hoverdrome is an arena shooter with up to 4 players at one time, all trying to capture the Proten, and get it to the extraction point to score a goal. You are driving a hoverbike that has afterburner, and you can pick up power ups like mines, and guided missiles to help you win the day. Protens will fall from the sky to be collected, and you must battle the other players in the arena avoiding lava and other obstacles in the quest to achieve the highest score in a 4 minute matches. An arena shooter like none other, we hope to see you in the Hoverdrome.

title: The Kharzov Effect
description:
게임 정보
The ultimate 80’s horror puzzle adventure! Unravel the mysteries, solve the puzzles, all while avoiding abominations!
Set in the cinematic world of 1985, you play as Chris, a boy searching for his recently abducted friend Billy. Solve puzzles and stealthily infiltrate the mysterious mansion of Professor Kharzov to uncover layers of dark secrets.
This single-player unforgettable experience has you exploring in first person, completing dangerous quests, and solving escape room level puzzles all while avoiding capture in a thrilling blend of strategy and horror.
We are enthusiasts of video games, escape rooms, and mysteries. Inspired by games like Hello Neighbor, The Hunt, The Room, Lethal Company, Control and many others, we realized that there was an untapped potential in solving puzzles while under the duress of fear.

title: Drops of Death
description:
게임 정보

Drops of Death is a murder mystery visual novel where the killer is randomly chosen at the start of the game.

Featuring four dateable characters, this romantic story has a deadly twist: you may unknowingly fall in love with the killer. Not all love is innocent, and it’s up to you to decide if you can look past their actions or bring them to justice.

Drops of Death is a killer romance not for the faint of heart.


Adrien is a college student trying to destress from classes by going to the school’s pool. What should’ve been a relaxing nightly swim quickly turns into a bloody nightmare when a hooded killer emerges. Adrien barely manages to escape the killer’s clutches. Traumatized and with the case ongoing, Adrien can’t help but feel the killer is watching them, waiting to finish what they started.

Choose your pronouns, with the option to choose between two different appearances for Adrien.




Edwin is Adrien’s best friend and a fellow marketing major, who is part of an active campus fraternity. He can be very protective of Adrien’s well-being and has walked them home to ensure their safety a number of times. However, Edwin has shown extreme bouts of jealousy when Adrien displays the slightest interest in others.

Would a best friend really go to such lengths to "protect" someone they hold so dear?


Fawn is an energetic and knowledgeable detective who runs her own true crime blog called Fawning for Crime. Though she can be annoying (especially to Detective Singh), she loves talking about a killer’s motive and unsolved cases. Some may say her passion for crime is a bit…unhinged.

Could this cute and bubbly true crime lover really be capable of murder?


Natasha is a quiet college student who was on the school’s swim team until she was advised to leave for unknown reasons. The experience she had with her teammates wasn’t pleasant and led to her being distant and at arm's length with others—except her older brother, Anton.

Can grudges with old teammates be strong enough to kill?


Nick Singh is a young homicide detective in charge of leading the murder investigation. Growing up he always wanted to be a detective, and eventually he started his career in his hometown, but was relocated to this smaller suburb. Up until now, he’s been forced to do paperwork and small, uninteresting cases.

Would a man who vowed to protect others really commit such a horrendous crime?

title: Roads of Ruin
description:
게임 정보
Join our discord from the sidebar to learn more about how to become a beta tester!
Welcome to Roads of Ruin, a thrilling top-down ARPG extraction experience that seamlessly melds the best elements of ARPGs and high-stakes extractions. Dive headfirst into the fray, battling both players and NPCs to claim the most coveted loot and gear. Whether you thrive in PvP combat or prefer the challenge of tackling unique dungeons and bosses, the choice is yours! Join forces with up to 3 friends, strategically balancing your party roles to outwit and outmaneuver your enemies.
What is Roads of Ruin? Rather than use more acronyms, let us describe practically what part of a game session might look like for you and some friends.
You start off in your camp, where you manage your resources, materials and spells to give you the best possible chance in preparation for your next mission. You and three other friends meet in town, collect a quest to retrieve some items from a nearby raided caravan and are ready to start your adventure. You queue into the quest map with dozens of other players- some friend, some foe.

title: Echoes in the Storm
description:
게임 정보
Investigate a series of brutal crimes in a remote Arctic town in this psychological horror experience steeped in oppressive atmosphere. Step into the shoes of Detective James Northland and confront the terrifying beast threatening to shatter your sanity in this unsettling tale of mystery.
Venture into a frozen, isolated setting where reason fades with the storm in Echoes in the Storm, an intense psychological horror game from DEAD BLUE SCREEN.
You’ll be drawn into a chilling investigation following a string of gruesome murders that have shattered the town’s fragile peace. As James digs deeper, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur, uncovering dark secrets and confronting the ghosts of his own mind.

Visit a variety of locations—including the police station, the morgue, and the town’s lighthouse—where you’ll gather crucial evidence to uncover the truth behind what happened. Interact with objects in the environment, listen to radio broadcasts, collect photographs, and read documents to piece together the origin of the horrific beast responsible for the murders.

But be warned: spending too much time outdoors can lead to death from the brutal cold.

title: MAGEYE
description:
게임 정보
In an increasingly oppressive world, a magpie feeds her only remaining child amidst a city of lackluster sightseers.
Take their vision and feed your son.
WELCOME TO MAGEYE
Following a tragedy and being forced to tend to the infected wounds of your only remaining kin, you explore a nameless dump of a city and reap the vision of uselessly sighted wanderers.
GAMEPLAY:
Play out action sequences and bleed through vengeance after they condemned and failed you.

title: Banshee Bash
description:
게임 정보
Banshee Bash is a fast-paced local multiplayer party royale! Team up or go solo in chaotic free-for-all battles. Collect spell books to expand your arsenal and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.
Features
8 Playable Characters – Choose your favorite fighter!
16 Unique Levels – Battle across diverse arenas.
Unlockable Cosmetics – Customize your character with stylish rewards.
Up to 8 Players – Bring the whole party! (Windows currently limits controller connections to 4, but bots can fill the rest).
Get ready to brawl in Banshee Bash – where the magic is wild, and the competition is fierce!

title: Aeschylus: Death
description:
게임 정보
Aeschylus actually just wanted to enjoy his weekend when the fate of an untimely demise befalls him. But even in the afterlife he finds no peace, because there is one last chance for everyone to fight their way back to life: the path.
The path is full of monsters, traps, aberrations, puzzles and powerful boss monsters and only those who follow it to the end will be allowed to return to this world.
Help Aeschylus become stronger by gaining experience, learning new skills and finding powerful weapons.
Follow the path

title: Ceaseless
description:
게임 정보
                   Highly configurable time based turns make the gameplay super engaging
                         Choose from a variety of modules to customize both the deck and hull layer.
Stop the Ceaseless from Spreading!
An unknown element has been unleashed upon space and its spread causes everything it consumes to cease!
It's your job to explore the universe while visiting structures and investigating signals to make your starship as powerful as you can make it.

title: Maid of Venia
description:
게임 정보
Maid of Venia is an action RPG adventure where you step into the armor of a red-haired warrior sworn to the Belt’s service, tasked with protecting the land of Venia from encroaching threats. But as you fulfill your sacred duties, you’ll uncover unsettling truths about your mission. Are you truly serving justice, or is there a hidden hand guiding your fate?
Choose Your Path
At the start of your journey, you must decide your combat style. Will you embrace the destructive power of fire as a Fire Mage, raining down flames upon your foes? Or will you take the path of the Summoner, calling forth spectral allies to fight by your side? Each choice alters your abilities, shaping the way you approach combat and the challenges ahead.
A World Steeped in Mystery and Magic
Venture through a beautifully crafted world teeming with both wonder and danger:
Thistledown, a hidden Elven town nestled in the towering silverwood trees, is home to ancient scholars, artisans, and rangers who protect their sacred lands from outsiders. It is a place of both wisdom and caution—where you may find powerful enchantments or wary allies unwilling to meddle in human conflicts.
Havenbay, a bustling coastal city, serves as a gateway to adventure. Here, you can catch a boat to perilous islands overrun by pirates and goblins, uncovering lost relics and forgotten ruins amidst the treacherous waves. But beware—some ships that sail from Havenbay never return.
Six grand kingdoms or towns to explore with unique quests and characters.
The Queen’s Deception & The Witch’s Influence
As you battle goblins, dragons, and the formidable Witch of the Wasteland, an even darker plot begins to unravel. The Queen herself may be behind a sinister scheme, conspiring with the Witch to manipulate your destiny. Through powerful magic, the Witch casts a spell that convinces you that your god is speaking directly to you—guiding your path, commanding your battles, and whispering of divine purpose. But is it truly your god’s voice? Or are you merely a pawn in the Queen’s war?
Dynamic Combat and Growth
Level up and customize your character, unlocking new skills, spells, and combat techniques.

title: The Path Home
description:
게임 정보
I need to head home......This must be the place I want to return to.
"The Path Home" is a mysterious puzzle game with a 2D pixel-art style, where you gradually transform a mysterious world.
Players can use panels to "flip" between black and white.
The girl is focused on going home, so she’s always looking for the "shortest route to the goal."
It’s up to you to reshape the puzzle world and guide her to the goal.
But if there are fake goals, she might get fooled.
Block the fake paths or steer her away from them.

title: Voodoo Dolls
description:
게임 정보
Voodoo Dolls is a first person action shooter, where you need to escape the Witch's Spooky Castle. Fight through endless corridors in 90s style mazes and dungeons. Inspired by Doom, Quake, Half-Life and Dusk.

Story

Once Upon A Time... Jack and Jill thought they lived 'Happily Ever After'. But they were being hunted by the Evil Witch. The Witch was old and ugly and she desperately wanted to be young and beautiful. An evil plan was set in motion to kidnap Jill for her beauty.

On Halloween Night, the Witch used an ancient spell to awaken the army of darkness. Voodoo Dolls rose from the dead through-out the land. They stole Jill and hid her in the tallest tower of the castle.

Challenges lay before Jack as he fights the cursed dolls. Jack needed to learn how to fight Voodoo Dolls, and quickly. Only Jack could save Jill by climbing the castle to the top. At sunrise, Jill will be sacrificed to the Witch. Jack has one night to climb the castle to save Jill....

Gameplay

Action packed and fast paced, Voodoo Dolls will bring a nostalgic gaming feel in a modern designed environment. Use the Pistol, Shotgun, Machine Gun, Elephant Gun, & Magical Powers to stop the evil Voodoo Dolls from taking Jill from her beloved Jack.

title: Trash Card Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Defeat your opponents at the card table and uncover their secrets!
TCA is a political, humorous card adventure game with charm. Discover the atmospheric (ballpoint pen) hand-drawn world and its inhabitants and collect lots of cards in the process!
Collect cards and build a deck!

Choose from many cards with different values and abilities to build your own deck!

What lies behind the façade of the cozy small town? A demonic rat, a cult in the sewers and the impending end of the world. In between, the everyday madness of the present.

Not every strategy leads to the goal. Combine different card types or specialize!

title: The House of Toys
description:
게임 정보
The House of Toys is a game developed by Old School Bros, a duo of video game and horror genre enthusiasts.
The game's mission is to free the soul of the cursed toy, day after day, game after game. But be careful—each game can be different. You will earn rewards that make your work more satisfying, allow you to improve your room, and help you discover secrets.
The House of Toys is divided into several phases in each game.
Phase 1:
Investigate – Explore the mansion, searching for clues to help you identify the toy.
Phase 2:
Puzzles and Action – While avoiding the cursed toy, you’ll need to solve puzzles that grant you the power to free its soul.
Phase 3:
Stealth – You’ll need to be cautious and stealthy to use your new power and release the toy’s soul.
Do you dare to discover the true origin of the curse?

title: Witch's Brew: Love and Lattes
description:
게임 정보
Serve up potions, cast spells, and go on coffee dates! As a barista at a magical university, will you craft useful charms or flip over some tarot cards for a love reading?
Witch’s Brew: Love and Lattes is an interactive novel by Cay Macres. It’s entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
After years of hiding your magical powers, you’ve been accepted into Peridot Pines University–as well as its secret society of magicians! At the cafe where Hecate society meetings are held, you find a job opening for a barista and are hired on the spot! Despite this, not everything is going your way. On your first day of classes, you learn the new chancellor might be onto the odd occurrences popping up in the sleepy town. You’ll have to decide whether to follow the rules or use magic out in the open.
You’ll also have the option to pursue a romance with one of your peers. There’s Mel: a sleepy alchemist who sips energy potions to stay awake while working at the cafe. You’ll also meet Rowan, who leaves a trail of daisies in their path and whose impulsive nature makes controlling their powers difficult. Or you can romance a mundane named Tomi who writes for the Peridot Periodical and has a feeling you have a story to tell.
You’ll need some powerful spells to keep the cafe running, the magical society a secret, as well as your studies and relationships afloat. If you get on the good side of a snarky stray cat, you might have a familiar to help with that.
Choose your pronouns and gender expression.
Choose your love interest’s gender.
Romance a barista who spikes their coffee with potions, a hot-headed elemental magician, or a mundane journalism student who asks a lot of questions.
Choose a type of magic to concentrate in: alchemy, divination, transmutation, or elemental magic.
Work as a barista and decide what kind of magic will help out the cafe.
Save a struggling cafe from being closed.
Keep your magical society’s secret…or use your magic out in the open.
Take in a stray cat and convince her to be your familiar or get help from the magical animals who reside in the library.
Will you keep your magical society a secret or use magic even when the cafe is open for business?

title: Cola Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Cola Tycoon begins in 1865, at the tipping point of history. The old world is dying. The slow-dripped wine, the aged whisky—dusty traditions of a fading elite. Now, the people crave for speed.
In this 19th-century tycoon game, you rise as an inventor with a vision. Build factories, hire specialists to generate production, marketing, and innovation, and craft your own Cola formulas through research and experimentation.
Invest, expand, and design targeted campaigns to capture new audiences and fuel your growing empire. The aristocrats had their time. You have ambition—and bubbles.
Create your own cola formula by combining ingredients. You spend Innovation Points to unlock and research new ingredients. Once unlocked, ingredients can be added to your formula. Each formula affects consumer response. You can iterate and improve formulas over time based on market performance.

title: Clash of Melodies
description:
게임 정보
Clash of Melodies is a Visual Novel Rhythm Game, set in a high fantasy world. It's telling the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together.
This game features two rhythm game modes: One DDR / FNF inspired "Arrow" Mode, and an original "Circle" Mode, in which you have to catch the incoming note with a circle in the middle. 
Beyond that, the story is told through classic visual novel style text cutscenes, as well as a few fully animated sequences. 
Once you have beaten a stage in the story, you can go for a highscore and a full combo in Freeplay. There you can also choose a hard mode that keeps a separate score.

title: Saw Counter
description:
게임 정보
The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!
He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?
Do you remember those horror movies where you yelled at the protagonist to scream, run, and call the police? Well… Now it's your turn to be the protagonist. Test your endurance, your mind, and your feelings.

title: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
description:
게임 정보
Join among the beverage Kings of old America!
Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, embark on an adventure to make a name for yourself. Build your own factory!  Make your own unique recipes! Weaken your opponents and maintain your place at the market!
Optimise your factory!
Optimize production by managing your workers, managers, raw material supply, and machines. Please your customers and preserve your relations.
 Think like a real boss!
A shrewd businessman who turns crises into advantage? A visionary boss who ignores details and dreams big? Live in the moment or invest in the future!
 Capture the networks, capture the market!
Big business doesn't work well with production alone! Disrupt your competitors' customer network, attract suppliers to your side and leave your competitors without raw materials!

title: Wake Up Kid
description:
게임 정보
A fast-paced, action-packed top-down shooter blending the chaos of Doom and Hotline Miami with a deep narrative twist.
Step into the chaos of Wake Up Kid, a brutal 2.5D top-down shooter where you control Bláinn, a mischievous demon banished from Hell. To survive, he strikes a deal with Timmy, a bullied kid, helping him fight back—inside the dreamworlds of his tormentors. Blast through surreal nightmares, unleash demonic powers, and uncover a sinister conspiracy hiding deep in the underworld.
🔹 Fast-Paced Combat – Chain together melee strikes, gunplay, and supernatural abilities in fluid, high-speed battles.
🔹 Dream-Hopping Missions – Infiltrate bullies' homes, invade their subconscious, and battle the demons controlling them.
🔹 Retro-Inspired Visuals – PS1/PS2 low-poly models with pixelated textures, giving the game a nostalgic, gritty feel.
🔹 Deep Narrative & Dark Humor – A story about bullying, redemption, and demons (both real and metaphorical).
🔹 Challenging Boss Battles – Face off against each bully’s nightmare form before confronting the ultimate evil.
We're launching a free demo along with our Steam page, so wishlist Wake Up Kid now and be among the first to experience the madness.

title: Deep In Hell
description:
게임 정보
Hell is an endless city of sins, where the population has become so accustomed to their pathetic existence that it has turned into a source of strange pleasure.
One fateful day, news comes of the death of God. God is dead, and what this news promises for the world is unknown. No respected investigator in hell wants to take on this dirty job, and it gets handed to the most degraded and aggressive detective. His office-elevator descends from level to level, passing through all nine levels of the city.
Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of uncertainty and drama, where every step could trigger a new truth or yet another betrayal. Will you uncover the mystery and restore justice, or will you become part of the endless cycle of sin and pain?

You will descend in an office-elevator to the very depths of the hellish city, filled with dangers and intrigues. Every decision matters. Encounter other characters — from power-hungry, mighty demons to voiceless and merciless monsters of the abyss — and untangle the complex web of lies and manipulations to uncover who is behind this horrific crime.
Key features of the game:
A gripping, brutal noir thriller with memorable characters, sharp dialogues, and a distinctive visual style.
Multiple unexpected endings that depend on player choices.
All characters are voiced by professional actors.
A card mini-game that allows you to gather new facts while interacting with suspects.

title: No Survivors
description:
게임 정보
There is so much conflict and division in the world—there’s only one hope for unity, and it starts with you, the first zombie. In No Survivors, you’re not just an ordinary undead; you’re an antihero on a mission to deliver the cure before humanity gets in its own way. With only 30 minutes on the clock, you must dash through a chaotic urban environment, balancing reckless mayhem with razor-sharp tactics.
As you carve your path toward a government facility developing the zombie cure, every decision counts. Unleash your inner tactician by:
• Upgrading on the Fly: Each fallen foe drops precious gems that fuel a dynamic, card-based leveling system. Choose from three upgrade cards at every level-up—with a dash of randomness that might force you to improvise your perfect build.
• Devour the brains of downed NPCs to earn meta-experience and convert them into loyal horde members. Later, invest your hard-won brains in a talent tree to unlock potent abilities and boost your stats.

title: The Headless Hunter
description:
게임 정보
The Headless Hunter is a tense and atmospheric horror game set across three forsaken towns, all surrounding a dense, cursed forest. A headless rider roams the woods, bound to an ancient curse and determined to stop anyone from breaking it.
Your only chance to end the nightmare is to find and collect cursed relics scattered throughout the towns and deliver them to the altar hidden deep within the forest. But nothing is ever that simple. The hunter can sense when someone dares to touch his relics, and the moment you do, the hunt begins.
The more relics you collect, the angrier he becomes. His search grows more intense, his presence more suffocating. What starts as a distant threat lurking in the forest soon turns into a relentless pursuit as he ventures into the towns, hunting you down. You’ll need to move between towns, solving puzzles and completing objectives to unlock access to each cursed relic, all while staying one step ahead of the hunter.
Every choice matters—sneak through the dense woods or risk faster but exposed roads. Move carefully, because the headless rider is always listening, always watching, and the more you push forward, the closer he gets.
Can you survive the hunt and lift the curse before becoming the hunter’s next victim?

title: ALCHEMIXUM
description:
게임 정보
Alchemixum is a cute lil' mixing game!
Mix elements starting from the four basic "air, earth, fire and water" and discover hundreds of combinations, and complete the Alchemixum. But not to worry, you won't be alone because you're part of a crew of space alchemists, them being:
Canva, a little hyperactive fairy who will help you with the game's customization, occasionally telling you jokes to lighten the mood...
Gaze, a studious critter who will help you progress further giving you hints towards element combinations.
And Figura, she will assist you with the game's settings and some more technical things, make sure to report any bugs you may encounter to her!
FEATURES:
Hundreds of elements to discover
Several quality of life features based on feedback from other games from the same genre
Bees
Scenery mode, resize, rotate and rearrange elements to create cute little scenes or goofy lookin' monstrosities using the stickers!
Unlock new options of wallpaper for the mixing area and music for the game by discovering new elements!
This game is still under development so a lot might and will change!

title: Shadows Of Memory ll
description:
게임 정보
Alice just escaped from the intruder chasing her, a man named Jack Thornton. She may scared him off, but there are other problems on the horizon. Not only does she have to move on after the passing of one of her closest allies, she still has to face the truth behind her painful memories. The answers lie inside her hometown, that has only changed for the worse...
Features:
A continuation of the first chapter of the series. (The demo.)
Hand-drawn artwork that was scanned and edited in Photoshop.
Animations that include fight scenes and scene transitions.
Music done by Nihilore, to add to a beautiful ambient atmosphere.
A visual novel with a few branching paths that can lead to a few optional bad ends.
A story about facing adversity and moving on from impossible struggles.
Characters:
Alice:  A woman who escaped from being a prisoner of a distant war. She only remembers her name, and her recent escape attempt. Her circumstances change after hiding in a cabin and receiving a letter from a friend that she thought was already dead. On this journey, she feels like somebody is trying to control her, like a puppeteer toying with her strings. Now, she returns to her hometown that has changed for the worse.

title: Goblin Lands
description:
게임 정보
고블린 랜드는 중독성 있는 실시간 전략 게임으로, 장대한 오케스트라 사운드트랙과 아름다운 2D 아트와 함께 섬을 정복하고 군대로 적을 물리치며 업그레이드를 통해 각 레벨에서 승리를 쟁취하고 바다의 지배자가 되는 게임입니다.

title: My Sleeping Girlfriend
description:
게임 정보
Will you protect her… or will you be the next one needing help?
What seemed like the beginning of a perfect life together soon turns into a terrifying reality that feels impossible to control.
"My Sleeping Girlfriend" is a psychological horror game where you take on the role of a young man who, after moving in with his girlfriend, uncovers a dark secret: her seemingly harmless sleepwalking hides something truly terrifying.
Your Mission:
Search for her in the darkness of a house that feels more hostile with each passing night.
Observe her carefully—every step, every movement could be a warning… or a trap.
Make quick decisions to prevent something terrible from happening. Her safety is in your hands… but so is your own.
Nothing is what it seems, and your actions each night could mean the difference between a bad dream… and a true nightmare.
What will you do when the real horror isn’t her… but yourself?
⚠ Content Warning: This game contains violent scenes, disturbing images, and unsettling moments, which may not be suitable for all players.

title: LabyrAInth
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징
미로 탐험: 무한히 생성되는 절차적 미로를 탐험하고 해결하는 고강도 1인칭 슈팅 액션 게임입니다.
온라인 순위: 이 게임은 온라인 순위를 지원하는 비동기 멀티플레이어 시스템을 제공하여 플레이어가 자신의 최고 기록을 다른 플레이어와 비교할 수 있습니다.
멀티미디어: PC 데스크톱과 선호하는 VR 헤드셋으로 게임을 체험하고 VR 내에서 미로 속의 짜릿함을 느껴보세요!
AI: AI와 대결하세요. 이것은 LabyrAInth 세계를 지배하는 외계인 인공지능입니다. 항상 새로운 미로를 생성하고 적, 함정 등으로 채웁니다.
게임 목표
LabyrAInth는 당신의 반응 속도, 기억력, 그리고 기술을 시험합니다.
당신의 목표는
1. 미로에서 가능한 한 빨리 탈출하는 것입니다.
2. 각 미로에서 적과 함정을 물리치며 탈출하세요.
3. 무기와 캐릭터의 통계를 향상시키세요.
4. 온라인 랭킹에서 다른 플레이어들과 경쟁하세요.
company: Pietro Dondi, Giorgio Morico, Marta Silla, , , , , , , ,

title: Ashborn
description:
게임 정보
Plunge into a ruined world, eaten away by time and haunted by echoes of a forgotten past.
Ashborn is a 3rd-person 3D roguelite inspired by the Souls games.
Master a demanding combat system, loot weapons and armour, and battle relentless enemies in a loop of death and redemption.
Precise, brutal combat: every blow counts, every mistake pays off.
Enemies and mini-bosses: battle cursed creatures with a variety of patterns.
Dark atmosphere: forgotten ruins, dying light...
Dynamic loot: find weapons and armour with every attempt.
Face the curse. Fall. Rise again. Start again.

title: Pokerii
description:
게임 정보
Play Cute. Think Smart. Score Big.
Welcome to Pokerii, a kawaii roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a tiny chess piece with big potential. Build your deck, place your cards, and rack up points by creating clever combos on a 3x3 board.
Collect pets, pick food, and power up your deck to survive an escalating series of waves filled with unique challenges and charming visuals.
About Pokerii
Inspired by chess and cozy roguelikes, Pokerii blends quick-thinking strategy with wholesome design. Your deck is small, your board is tight, and every decision matters. Whether you're stacking ranks to hit a combo or choosing a food that boosts your next wave, you'll find plenty of room for creative play.
Features
Chess-Inspired Deckbuilding
Use a 16-card deck of themed pieces—like pawns, knights, and queens—and place them on a 3x3 grid to plan your moves and activate scoring effects.
Combo-Based Gameplay
Score points by playing cards that match specific sum-based combos (like 15, 20, or 25). Learn the patterns and chase high-value turns with every wave.
Wave-Based Progression
Face increasingly tricky challenges in a series of short, punchy waves. Each one pushes your planning, positioning, and scoring to the next level.
Pets & Food
Between waves, visit a cozy café to adopt pets or choose food that grant permanent or temporary bonuses. Build a deck that fits your favorite playstyle.
Adorable Visuals
A soft, chibi artstyle with vibrant icons, clean UI, and cozy animations makes Pokerii a joy to look at and a breeze to play.
Small Deck. Big Brain. Cozy Vibes.
Whether you’re chasing high scores or just enjoying the cute combos, Pokerii offers a charming, strategic twist on chess and deckbuilding—made for short runs, smart plays, and sweet rewards.

title: Kindred [High Tide]
description:
게임 정보
The seas were calm. Your mission, simple. And then, everything changed.
Now, a restless dread grips you and your crew. Deep down, you feel it - something unwanted is on board.

title: Berghotel Heist
description:
게임 정보
Berghotel Heist is a co-op horror game rooted in Austrian folklore.
The game follows two thieves that break into a ski hotel to steal valuable items and slip away unnoticed. But what starts as a routine heist turns into a desperate struggle for survival.
The hotel holds a dark secret, it is haunted by restless spirits and a troubled past that refuses to stay buried. Soon it becomes clear that the thieves are not alone.
To escape, they must work together to evade the sinister forces hunting them,
and find a way out—before the hotel claims them forever.

title: Lichgate: Tower Survivor
description:
게임 정보
Lichgate: Tower Survivor is simple to play- just purchase weapons and upgrades to survive the onslaught of enemies.
Along the way you will have to make Faustian deals for more power, but if you are clever you can control how your enemies grow stronger to match your build.

title: Loop//Error
description:
게임 정보
This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.
Something is watching you. Something is waiting.
Alone in the dead of night, you find yourself sent on a simple errand—to check on a quiet gas station on the outskirts of town. But nothing here feels right.
The air is heavy with something unspoken, the radio crackles with words that don't belong, and the station itself... shifts.
Every step forward drags you deeper into a nightmare of fractured reality and unseen terrors. Strange voices whisper in your ear, shadows stretch and writhe, and the choices you make will carve your fate.
Will you listen? Will you obey? Or will you resist, knowing that every decision carries a price?

title: Backstabbing King
description:
게임 정보
Backstabbing King is a strategy game based around the rules of chess, where you must kill your own pieces at night to ensure that only the two kings remain on the board.
Backstabbing King is a much expanded and improved upon version of the top 200 ranked game I made for the 2023 GMTK Game Jam. It features 26 unique levels, 5 new mechanics, and a compelling story.

title: Dracs After Dusk
description:
게임 정보
"Dracs After Dusk" is an arcade, top-down shooter. Blast through bloodsuckers as the sharp shootin’ sheriff of a wild west town. Duke it out with the deadliest bosses, claim their powerful weapons from the Armory and tasty food consumables from the Pantry to fuel your leaderboard topping run. Welcome to an old school quarter muncher but luckily you have unlimited credits!
Survive waves of vampires

title: Pirate Den
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Pirate Den
In Pirate Den, pirates are the true heroes. Your name must echo louder than the crashing waves. Recruit brave souls, send them on daring missions, and win the hearts of your fans. Your goal: build your legend and become the King of Pirates.
A Crew to Feed, a Loyalty to Earn
A crew needs care. Feed them, pay them, and they'll keep sailing under your flag. Neglect them, and you'll soon find yourself alone, with only the sea for company.

title: Wasteland Bites
description:
게임 정보
"HEY, YOUR TRUCK STILL OPEN?"
You're on the clock till midnight.
Run a food truck in the post-apocalypse, serving bizarre meals to even stranger customers. Each night, you’ll balance cooking orders with staying alive—dodging horrors, managing your nerves, and trying not to completely lose your mind.
Mess up too many orders, serve the wrong freaks, or let something slip past you, and stress will pile up fast. Hit your limit, and it’s lights out.
"YOU GOT FOOD? I GOT MOUTH."
Hungry weirdos are lining up, and it’s your job to feed them. Toast, bowls, shish kebabs—raw or cooked, rotten or radioactive—you’ll serve them all, no matter how freaky their faces or their appetites.
It’s all part of the gig. Keep your truck moving, survive each stop, and maybe—just maybe—you’ll make it to that legendary non-irradiated beach on the horizon...

title: Interstellar Holy Spirit
description:
게임 정보
Several years have passed in a blink of an eye since the interstellar escape. I haven't been able to sleep lately, there's always a shadow swaying in front of me. Does it not look like a human? These shadows swayed back and forth, finally stopping on the wall, motionless, suddenly turning into puppets and zombies, rushing towards me! I woke up and saw a psychedelic interstellar space unfolding in front of me .....
“Interstellar Spirit "is a psychedelic style multiplayer horror cooperative game, including single player simple and difficult versions, as well as multiplayer cooperative versions.

title: Super Star Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Super Star Adventure is the 1-bit RPG that takes you on a wild ride through deep space gone wrong. Your ship hits a meteor field above Astralis, a rogue planet full of weird tech, weirder ruins, and even weirder creatures.
Your mission? Scavenge your busted ship's parts. Simple? NO—because everything on Astralis is either broken, cursed, alive, or some combo of the three. You'll explore the planet, barter with shady foes, and maybe punch a Shardkin or two.
Combat’s tactical but snappy. Dialogue’s weird. The whole thing plays like a forgotten Game Boy cart someone modded to have feelings.
It’s lonely out there, but not quiet.
Features:
Active Turn-Based Combat – Engaging fights where timing is important!
Three Damage Types – Balance Physical, Energy, and Mind attacks to exploit enemy weaknesses.
Exploration-Focused Gameplay – Search open zones, solve light puzzles, and recover missing ship parts.
Customizable Loadouts – Swap characters and gear to suit your style.
Dialogue-Rich Story – Strange characters, cryptic lore, and choices that shape how you’re remembered.
Chiptune-Inspired Soundtrack – A moody, cosmic score sets the tone for your adventure.
Original 1-bit Visual Style – Crisp pixel art in stark contrast with strange alien designs.

title: Beware the Depths
description:
게임 정보
BEWARE THE DEPTHS
A BRUTAL SAGA OF SURVIVAL AND CONQUEST IN THE FORGOTTEN REALM
Beware the Depths is an open-world exploration and survival game for 1-8 players set in a vast procedurally-generated world. Play as an adventurer in the world of Perdita- a realm that borders reality and what lies beyond. Here you must craft, build, and battle just to survive.
EXPLORE A WORLD SHROUDED IN MYSTERY
Venture into the vast lands of Perdita, where each journey offers new discoveries. From lush forests to deadly dungeons, every environment presents unique enemies to battle, resources to gather, and secrets to uncover. Sail treacherous seas in search of undiscovered lands and face the bloodthirsty monsters that call them home.

title: Wasteland Shop Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Wasteland Shop Simulator is a quirky and immersive post-apocalyptic shop management game where you’re not just surviving the end of the world — you’re thriving in it by running a thriving retail empire. Set in a dusty, dangerous world full of scavengers, thieves, and the occasional eccentric customer, it’s your job to build, manage, and defend the best store in the wasteland.
Start with an empty, rundown shack and turn it into a bustling business. Stock your shelves with whatever you can find — from salvaged tech and rusty tools to mysterious items uncovered in the wasteland. Customize your shop, hire staff, fend off thieves, and deal with unruly customers who seem to enjoy making a mess of your hard work. Expand your business by renting more locations and creating a name for yourself in a world where supply and demand have taken a wild new meaning.
Whether you're a meticulous organizer or a chaotic entrepreneur, Wasteland Shop Simulator offers a humorous and challenging take on life after the end times.
Key Features:
🛠️ Shop Setup – Buy shelves, tables, corner racks, and more to design the ultimate scavenger’s storefront.
🧱 Decorate Your Store – Customize your space to reflect your unique post-apocalyptic aesthetic.
🏬 Rent Multiple Shops – Expand your retail empire across the wasteland.
🎨 Customize Signage – Change your store name and sign color to stand out from the competition.
🧹 Customer Chaos – Watch customers randomly mess up your displays — cleaning up is part of the job.
👥 Hire Staff – Bring on workers to help with stocking, sales, and managing the madness.
🗺️ Explore the Wasteland – Venture out to scavenge unique, valuable, or just plain weird items.
🕵️‍♂️ Beware of Thieves – Not everyone is there to buy — keep an eye on your goods!
Build your fortune from the ashes and prove that even after the world ends… retail never dies.

title: Backstabbing King
description:
게임 정보

description:
게임 정보
Clash of Melodies is a Visual Novel Rhythm Game, set in a high fantasy world. It's telling the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together.
This game features two rhythm game modes: One DDR / FNF inspired "Arrow" Mode, and an original "Circle" Mode, in which you have to catch the incoming note with a circle in the middle. 
Beyond that, the story is told through classic visual novel style text cutscenes, as well as a few fully animated sequences. 
Once you have beaten a stage in the story, you can go for a highscore and a full combo in Freeplay. There you can also choose a hard mode that keeps a separate score.

title: Saw Counter
description:
게임 정보
The killer is here, and now he's coming for you!!
He will put you through trials, play with your emotions, your mind, and your body. Are you ready?
Do you remember those horror movies where you yelled at the protagonist to scream, run, and call the police? Well… Now it's your turn to be the protagonist. Test your endurance, your mind, and your feelings.

title: Fizz Flow: Factory Management
description:
게임 정보
Join among the beverage Kings of old America!
Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, embark on an adventure to make a name for yourself. Build your own factory!  Make your own unique recipes! Weaken your opponents and maintain your place at the market!
Optimise your factory!
Optimize production by managing your workers, managers, raw material supply, and machines. Please your customers and preserve your relations.
 Think like a real boss!
A shrewd businessman who turns crises into advantage? A visionary boss who ignores details and dreams big? Live in the moment or invest in the future!
 Capture the networks, capture the market!
Big business doesn't work well with production alone! Disrupt your competitors' customer network, attract suppliers to your side and leave your competitors without raw materials!

title: Pirate Den
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Pirate Den
In Pirate Den, pirates are the true heroes. Your name must echo louder than the crashing waves. Recruit brave souls, send them on daring missions, and win the hearts of your fans. Your goal: build your legend and become the King of Pirates.
A Crew to Feed, a Loyalty to Earn
A crew needs care. Feed them, pay them, and they'll keep sailing under your flag. Neglect them, and you'll soon find yourself alone, with only the sea for company.

title: Legacy of The Botanist
description:
게임 정보
Eat magical plants, explore a strange land, and uncover the Legacy of The Botanist. 
Note: This game is in mid-development - many of the visuals and all of the UI is unfinished
Legacy of The Botanist places you on an island inhabited by strange flora that give the player advanced powers of exploration. However, you aren't the first to discover this place. A long-gone figure known as The Botanist has left a strange infrastructure - and a dark mystery - in their wake.
What you can expect from The Botanist:
The plants are magical - Each of the five plants in the botanist provide the player with a new way to navigate the world - From enhanced jumps, to sticky feet, to gravity inversion. 
Exploration is key - Short cuts, game-altering artifacts, and environmental clues mean that those with wander lust will be rewarded.
Gardening is optional - As you run out of the plants you find, you can always grow more with seeds from each plant.
A mystery is afoot - The Botanist came before you, but what did they leave behind? Hidden graves, strange plaques, and more.
Screenshots (Work in Progress):

title: DungeonBox
description:
게임 정보
Jackbox-style party chaos collides with classic tabletop fantasy in DungeonBox, a phone-controlled RPG for 3-8 players. Type your boldest actions, vote for the funniest idea, and watch a quick-witted Dungeon Master weave the winning move into an ever-branching adventure packed with dramatic dice rolls, treasure, and mischief.
Key Features
Fast party pacing, lasting campaigns – Every round feels like a mini game show, while choices carry forward through full quests.
Phone-as-controller – Join instantly via QR or room code; no extra mobile app required.
Vote-driven storytelling & dice – Shape the narrative together, then test fate with digital d20s and cheeky items like Gold Dice or Potions of Confusion.
Streamer-friendly – Audience voting and Remote Play Together support.
“Jackbox” is a trademark of Jackbox Games, Inc., and “Dungeons & Dragons” is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast, LLC. DungeonBox is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by either company.

title: MIDNIGHT SNACK
description:
게임 정보
MIDNIGHT SNACK is a short, first-person psychological horror game with multiple endings about waking up in the middle of the night with an empty stomach. Live through multiple nights in the apartment building, talk to the other inhabitants, evade the lurking pale husk that stalks the halls and piece together your story.
Never Ending Nightmare
You wake up again, stomach as empty as before. Was it just a vivid dream caused by your poor nutritional practices? Oh well, time to go get a snack for real.

title: Plentiful
description:
게임 정보
Shape the world to channel water.
Nurture animals and plants.
Feed your tribe.
A relaxing god game, shaping the map by stacking stones.
Water flows over the landscape and needs to be caught in ponds and lakes.
Trees placed near water will flourish and produce food.
Fruit, Vegetables and Animals are eaten by your tribe of people.
Seasons
Day/night cycle
Water simulation
Stone stacking
Volcanoes, Lightning, Floods, Locusts, Earthquakes, Plagues, Fire

title: Pipkin
description:
게임 정보
A Cute and Spooky Creature Collecting Game with a Fall / Halloween Aesthetic
An In-Depth Battle System: with ~250 moves, 15 elemental types, and 4 classes.
Explore Unique and Colorful Areas: Explore moonlit forests, a witch academy, a fairytale town where people live in giant pumpkins, and more!
Create Your Own Character: Set your character's appearance, as well as their class and elemental type, giving every character a unique move-set and role in battles.
A Grind-Free RPG Experience: Experience and character progression are designed to minimize grinding and cut bloat content out of the game.
10+ Hours of Gameplay: (Demo playtime: ~1 hour)

title: Welcome To The Dark Place
description:
게임 정보


#1: Three red blots mark liars.
#2: Food means depravity and death.
#3: No one leaves the forest where trees align.
#4: Don't listen to the wolf.
#5: Holes in suspicious places may lead to the Undergoing.
#6: Tellers of time...
[The corner of the note is torn off.]

The Dark Place finds us all.

title: Leonardo's Island
description:
게임 정보

Leonardo's Island is an adventure/building game set in the age of pirates, featuring wooden constructions and sailboats.
You left the comfort of your parents' house in search of adventure, treasure, and freedom. But now, you find yourself alone on the island as pirates approach. It’s time to take action!





Create your new home, design your flag, hang a hammock, and relax!
Build structures to complete the campaign, dive for cannons, and protect the island!

You can build your own ships with 1, 2, or 5 sails — the design is entirely up to you!






Fortification is key in defending against pirates.




I have been developing this game for 8 years.
My dream is to incorporate all the ideas that I couldn't include in the early access version of the game.
Many thanks to William, the composer whom I was very fortunate to meet.

title: My Lil Afterlife
description:
게임 정보
Sorry Grim, the afterlife is under new management! Become the new ruler of the afterlife. Summon spooky friends to reside in your unearthly realm and decorate it however you like with items you can craft, buy and find.
Your friends in undeath
The afterlife would be a pretty lonely place without some friends to keep you company. Summon a colourful range of spirits to reside on your ghostly island. From an old wise skeleton, to a sassy sasquatch, there are plenty of creepy and cute characters who would like to call your realm home.
Customise your lil lich
Fashion isn't dead in the afterlife. Wear a range of clothes and accessories to truly customise your incorporeal form. It might not be sunny, but you can still wear sunglasses or how about a sword and crown to show the grim reapers evil ghouls who's the new boss? You'll just have to find the right residents who will sell you their collection of clothes first.

title: Chronoquartz
description:
게임 정보
In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?
Every Move Counts
In Chronoquartz, your number of moves is limited. You'll need to be clever to make the most of the 10 turns you're given.
Time Loops
You'll need to use the knowledge gained from previous loops to progress further in the game. This will allow you to open coded doors, take secret passages, know the location of objects, and discover the fastest paths to reach your destination.

title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
description:
게임 정보
"Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a 2.5D pixel roguelike action game. It tells the adventure story of Flandre Scarlet.
In this game, you can enjoy exhilarating combat and the thrill of countering enemies. It's a game where you only need to wield a single melee weapon to experience a variety of different skills.
You can trigger skills by defeating enemies or counter their abilities, which in turn generates new skills.
Whether it's the Spell Card skills triggered by defeating enemies or the countered enemy abilities, you can modify them using enhancement cards. This adds layers of depth to the gameplay, making the experience much richer.
autokwd: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers,东方祈妖录

title: Vampire's Best Friend
description:
게임 정보
Fly Through the Night
We've all had that dream where you're flying in the sky only to wake up to your boring terrestrial life, but dream no more! Fly around as a bat with unique movement that re-contextualizes precision platformer trappings and flips them upside-down!
Old-School Charm
Limitations were imposed on the palette, sprite size, and audio fidelity to really deliver on that old-school feeling. Retaining the difficulty of retro games, but with modern design sensibilities so you wont be throwing your rectangular controller.
Open World

it's tough out there, but you can take it at your own pace. If you're ever stuck on a challenge, you can easily take a different path and find another way forward.
