description: 게임 정보

title: H9
description:
게임 정보
● The Worst Behind-the-Scenes Tale of a Phantom Bishoujo Game
At the end of the 20th century, a mysterious bishoujo game was canceled before release—so obscure, almost no one knew it existed. Crude, tasteless, and undeniably trash-tier, most would call it a total disaster.
But one mystery remains: the existence of its data, sealed tight with high-level encryption far beyond its era.
Who created it, and why?
To uncover the buried truth, the player must strip away its digital locks—through games of "Yakyuken," a risqué twist on rock-paper-scissors.
A unique system where game and novel parts alternate in turn.
Game Part

title: PolyCrime
description:
게임 정보
🕹️ About the Game
PolyCrime is a deep, sandbox-style crime simulator set in a reactive open world full of risk, reward, and relentless ambition. Start as a small-time hustler and rise through the criminal ranks — or take the legal route to power. Grow your empire your way in a city that never sleeps, and where every choice has lasting consequences. Play solo or team up with friends in full Steam Co-op. Cooperate to dominate the underworld — or sabotage each other in a cutthroat race to the top.
🎯 Key Features
🔫 Realistic Drug & Weapon Economy
Grow, manufacture, smuggle, trade, or negotiate — every gram, bullet, and dollar counts. Optimize your supply chains and maximize profit, legally or otherwise.
🌆 Living, Breathing City
Explore a dynamic city where NPCs have memories, relationships, and motivations. Gain allies, make enemies, bribe officials, or get ratted out — no two playthroughs are the same.
🚓 Cops, Gangs & Corruption
Stay ahead of police patrols, strike deals with gangs, or manipulate evidence to avoid conviction. Use bribes or favors to turn the justice system to your advantage.
💼 Invest, Work & Grow Legally
Buy and operate shops, restaurants, and other businesses. Take on city jobs, save up, and build wealth — or use it all as a front to launder your dirty money.
🏢 Empire-Building from the Ground Up
Purchase properties, upgrade stash houses, hire dealers or enforcers, and take control of entire city blocks. From back alley deals to political influence — your empire is what you make it.
🌱 Genetic Weed Cultivation
Grow, breed, and experiment with cannabis genetics. Create high-value strains with unique effects, appearances, THC/CBD levels, and yields. (Weed is just one part of a vast system.)
🎭 Reputation & Status System
Earn fear, loyalty, or respect. Your standing with gangs, police, civilians, and business partners changes based on your actions — and it will come back to you.

title: Void Miner – Incremental Asteroids Roguelite
description:
게임 정보
Void Miner is a incremental roguelite bullet hell that is about mining asteroids, collecting resources and upgrading your ship to blast through waves of asteroid belts.

Start with a simple ship, picking off as many asteroids as you can.
Explore the upgrade tree.

title: Happy Door
description:
게임 정보


해피 도어의 존재들은 평범한 방법으로 나타나지 않습니다. 주변의 사물이 소리를 내 떨리기 시작한다면, 그것이 바로 크리처 스폰의 전조입니다. 동료와 함께 즉시 빛을 비춰 스폰을 저지하세요! 당신의 지팡이 조명은 단순한 길잡이가 아닌, 공포를 억제하는 유일한 희망입니다.



최대 4인까지 함께 플레이하며 소통과 협력을 통해 위기를 극복하세요. 동료를 다양한 아이템으로 겁을 줄 수도 있습니다! 혹시 동료가 죽었다면 부활 의식을 치를 수도 있으니 걱정 마세요!



한 두마리의 크리처는 감당 가능하지만 수가 늘어나면 감당 할 수 없습니다!
심지어 크리처는 서로 상반되는 기믹을 가지고 있기도 합니다! 패닉이 오기 전 그들을 막거나 처치해서 위험 부담을 줄이세요!

title: Gambonanza
description:
게임 정보
Experience a Chess Revolution
Step into the wild world of Gambonanza, where traditional chess is reimagined into a fast-paced, strategy-packed roguelike adventure. In this game, victory isn’t about capturing just the king—it’s about capturing every single piece on the board through masterful synergies!
About Gambonanza
Inspired by classic chess yet bursting with innovative twists, Gambonanza challenges you to think creatively and strategically. Every run is a fresh puzzle, where your decisions, tactics, and the perfect synergy between your chess pieces and Gambits determine your success. Assemble your ultimate strategy by:
Unlocking Gambits: Discover over 100+ powerful Gambits that, when combined with your chess pieces, create explosive combos capable of outsmarting even the toughest opponents.
Mastering Chess Mechanics: Learn to utilize a dynamic reserve system that lets you store extra chess pieces off-board and deploy them at the perfect moment to catch your adversary off guard.
Upgrading Your Board: Customize your chessboard with unique tiles—turn pieces into gold with shimmering golden squares to boost your income, recover captured pieces with blessing tiles, or safeguard your moves with protective tiles for daring, decisive maneuvers.
Every element of Gambonanza works in harmony to help you build the ultimate strategy to overcome five formidable though bosses!
Key Features
Synergistic Gambits & Pieces: Combine your chess pieces with over 100+ Gambits to unlock devastating combos and strategic surprises.
Dynamic Reserve System: Keep a stock of extra pieces off-board and deploy them at crucial moments to shift the balance of power.
Strategic Board Upgrades: Enhance your chessboard with golden squares, blessing tiles, protective surfaces, and more—each adding a unique tactical edge.
Retro Aesthetic & Quirky Ambiance: Immerse yourself in vibrant pixel art with a nostalgic CRT filter, evoking the playful excitement of a fairground.
Engaging Mini-Games: Test your luck and skill in challenges inspired by pachinko, slot machines, and Gachapon—each offering game-changing upgrades.

title: Naroike
description:
게임 정보
Naroike is a casual side-scrolling game that combines roguelite and hack-and-slash elements.
Collect a wide variety of artifacts and use your skills to defeat enemies.
Strengthen not only your equipment but also your skill tree to create a playstyle that suits you.
Keep playing, keep growing, and enjoy fast-paced, exhilarating battles!
A Wide Variety of Artifacts
With over 100 unique artifacts to choose from, you can equip up to 10 at a time to create the ultimate build that suits your playstyle!
The right combination of artifacts can lead to various strategies, such as a high-damage one-shot build, a balanced and stable approach, or even a risk-taking setup that gets stronger the more damage you take.
Additionally, some artifacts come with Action Skills, further expanding your combat possibilities.

title: 3 Hell
description:
게임 정보
3 Hell is a fast-paced arena action game inspired by classic hack-and-slash and survival mechanics. Plunge into a brutal arena filled with relentless enemies, where every move counts. Armed with only your blade and blood-fueled powers, you must navigate tight spaces and face waves of foes that will stop at nothing to destroy you.
Your abilities come at a cost, and there’s no room for mistakes. Use quick reflexes, precise strikes, and calculated aggression to survive — as long as you can.
Compete for survival time against Steam Friends or on global leaderboards. Only those with true skill and nerves of steel will last. Your ability to balance risk and power will be tested to the limit.

title: Pet Oddities: Desktop Shelter
description:
게임 정보
《괴짜 펫들: 내 책상 위 쉼터》에서는, 오래된 책을 통해 귀엽고, 이상하고, 웃기고, 다양한 스타일의 생물들을 계속 수집하게 돼요. 가장 오래된 존재를 찾아내고 최강의 수용 마스터가 되어보세요! 이 게임은 지속적으로 업데이트됩니다! 진짜예요, 계속계속 업데이트할 거예요!!
다양한 고대 생물들을 수집하세요!앞으로 더 많은 생물들이 추가될 예정이에요!
생물들이 뜻밖의 고대 보물을 만들어내기도 해요. 운 좋으면 꽤 비싸게 팔 수 있을지도?
autokwd: Pet Oddities: Desktop Shelter,괴짜 펫들: 내 책상 위 쉼터

title: MATRESHKA
description:
게임 정보
당신은 신비롭게 고장난 엘리베이터에서 깨어나 갇히고 혼란스러워합니다.
층간을 이동하며 주민들을 피하고 건물에서 살아남아 탈출하세요.
절대 MATRESHKA에게 등을 보이지 마세요.


도전적인 퍼즐
논리, 관찰, 창의력을 요구하는 복잡한 퍼즐을 해결하세요. 각 해결책은 자유에 한 발짝 다가가게 하지만 동시에 건물의 미스터리 속으로 더 깊이 빠져들게 합니다.



정교하게 재현된 소련 시대 건물을 탐험하세요. 진정성 있는 디테일과 역사를 생생하게 느낄 수 있는 오싹한 분위기가 가득합니다.



각 층마다 고유한 도전과 상호작용 요소가 있습니다. 단서를 찾고 유용한 아이템을 수집하며 환경을 조작해 건물의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.



건물의 주민들을 조심하세요. 그들의 행동과 동기는 예측할 수 없습니다. 일부는 도움을 줄 수도 있고, 일부는 방해할 수도 있으며, 일부는 아주 위험할 수도 있습니다.

title: Retrace The Light
description:
게임 정보
◆ 스토리 개요 ◆
3323년, 극단적인 심리상태가 초래할 수 있는 사회적 위험을 신속히 제거하기 위해 원과 인간은 메타 미러 계획을 공동으로 발기하여 메타 미러 영역과 집행자를 창조했습니다. 편집증이 있는 개인이 메타 미러 계획에 지원하면, 그들의 정신 세계는 메타 미러 영역에 투영되어 각종 기이하고 괴상한 미러염으로 변환됩니다. 집행자의 임무는 미러염에 들어가 그 안의 미러메어를 제거함으로써 편집증적인 개인을 정상으로 되돌려, 사회의 안정과 안전을 유지하는 것입니다.
한차례의 임무 수행 중, 집행자 십은 큰 부상을 입고 모든 기억을 잃었습니다. 처음부터 집행자 일을 어떻게 해야 하는지 배우던 중, 십은 자신과 대화를 시도하려는 이상한 소리를 듣게 되는데... …
◆ 공간 회귀 ◆
"회귀" 능력을 사용하여 짧은 시간 내에 방문했던 공간으로 이동하세요.
끈질기게 쫓아오는 적의 블라인드에 회귀하여 기습하거나, 복잡한 장치를 넘나들며 교묘한 방법으로 퍼즐을 해결하세요.
◆ 라이트 소울류 + 퍼즐형 보스전 ◆
미러염에서 집념은 강력한 적으로 변모합니다. 거대한 메카를 조종해 땅을 파괴하거나, 시야를 완전히 어둡게 만들거나, 몸을 분열시켜 형태를 바꾸는 등 다양한 공격을 가합니다.
하지만 그들에게도 약점이 있습니다. 메커니즘을 면밀히 관찰하고 회귀 같은 능력을 사용해 패턴을 공략하며 약점을 찾아내 강적을 물리치세요.
◆ 스타일리시한 아트 ◆
autokwd: Retrace The Light,溯光行 Retrace The Light

title: Mina the Hollower
description:
게임 정보
액션 어드벤처 신작 Mina the Hollower 속 오싹한 세계를 탐험하세요. 저주 받은 섬을 구하기 위해 절박한 임무에 나선 명성 높은 땅굴꾼, 미나를 직접 조종해 보세요. 수많은 위협과 몬스터의 발 밑으로 땅굴을 파 들어가고, 채찍으로 적들을 처치하고, 각종 보조 무기와 장신구로 만반의 무장을 하세요. 완벽한 픽셀 그래픽, 훌륭한 게임플레이, 무시무시한 보스, 그리고 중독적인 음악 등으로 구현된 광대한 세계를 탐험하세요. 각종 기묘한 캐릭터들과 조우하고, 이국적 배경 속에서 비밀을 찾아내고, 어둠을 밝게 비추어 보세요! Shovel Knight의 개발진이 선보이는 신작, Mina the Hollower입니다!
특징:
Game Boy Color의 8비트 비주얼에 현대적이고 세련된 재해석을 더했습니다.
디테일한 애니메이션, 와이드 스크린 비주얼, 그리고 탄탄한 컨트롤까지 현대적인 재해석!
점프하고, 회피하고, 땅굴을 파고 들어 몬스터와 싸우거나 세계를 탐험하세요.
든든한 채찍 밤별이부터 제각기 완전히 색다른 성능을 가진 무기들을 선택하여 적들을 징벌하세요.
성유물 같은 독특한 보조 장비들을 발견하고 활용하여 전투에서 우위를 점하세요.
각종 독특한 효과를 부여하는 장신구를 수집하고 장비해 보세요. 나만의 플레이스타일에 맞춰 미나의 레벨을 높이세요.
칩튠의 거장, Jake Kaufman이 제작한 MSX 스타일 사운드트랙이 귀를 짜릿하게 합니다.
빅토리아 시대의 고딕 공포 장르를 바탕으로 구성된 오싹한 광기 속으로 파고 들면서도 마음이 따뜻해지는 스토리를 따라가 보세요.
각종 비밀, 도전적인 전투, 유기적으로 연결된 레벨 디자인으로 가득한 거대한 암흑 세계를 탐험하세요.
[/p]

title: Walk of Life
description:
게임 정보
The world’s most accurate life simulator returns in Walk of Life! You’re late for work, rent is overdue, and your refrigerator is literally on fire! Do you have what it takes to remember to eat every week? Dive headfirst into the chaotic rat race and crush your friends in Walk of Life!

title: Chessplus
description:
게임 정보
결합. 분할. 홍보.
일반적인 체스 이동을 사용하여 두 개의 말을 같은 칸에 합치고 강력한 하이브리드를 만드세요. 두 말의 능력을 사용하여 합친 말을 움직이거나, 나중에 적절한 시기에 전략적 위치를 위해 개별 말로 분리하세요.
하지만 조심하세요. 합친 말이 잡히면 둘 다 잃게 됩니다!
기능
♔ 말을 강력한 하이브리드로 결합하거나 나중에 전략적 위치를 위해 분할하여 기하급수적으로 더 많은 전략을 탐색하세요. 더 많은 퀸이 필요하세요? "Biook"(비숍 + 룩)으로 직접 만들거나 "Rawn"(룩 + 폰)으로 보드 전체에 폰을 발사하여 빠르게 승격하세요.
♔ 균형 잡힌 체스의 핵심으로, 일반적인 합법적인 움직임만 적용됩니다. 하지만 결합된 말이 잡히면 조심하세요. 둘 다 잃게 됩니다!
♔ 크로스 플랫폼 멀티플레이어에서 PC/모바일에서 ELO 순위를 자랑하고 Roguelike 모험에서 모든 움직임을 중요하게 만드세요.
플레이 방법
♔ 기존 체스 움직임을 사용하여 말을 결합합니다.

title: Game Of Fate 3：Clash Of Crowns
description:
게임 정보
“Game of Fate 3: Clash of Crowns" is a fully immersive live-action interactive thriller where you experience an extraordinary life through a first-person lens.

Fate is a game—a chessboard of destiny.

On this board, there are no accidents.
Only victory... or defeat.

The winner claims the crown.
The loser fades to dust.
autokwd: Game Of Fate 3：Clash Of Crowns,운명 게임3

title: Birthday Boy and Benny
description:
게임 정보
Birthday Boy and Benny is an emotional turn-based RPG set in a colorful world with strange characters that may be even stranger than you first realize. Everything seems so familiar to you - before you were born, you saw your whole life flash before your eyes, just like what happens when you die.
You expected your life to be full of hearing Dad Jokes from everyone. You expected your life to be about writing haikus, eating lots of cakes on your birthday, and maybe exploring some haunted houses every once in a while.
You didn't expect to be abused by your mentally-ill mother. She wishes you were never born. Everything you do annoys her. She hates that you love cake. She hates it when you cry. She hates that you write haikus.
Please, Mother, don't hit me
Again. The sting of hundreds
Of bees is too much.
But...
Maybe things can be okay. Maybe your friends will protect you. Maybe you can finally get away from her once and for all.
Maybe...

title: Tower Runner
description:
게임 정보
Fight your way up the Tinkerer's tower, facing dangers as he tries to stop you, discover new abilities, and loot as you ascend to the top.
Tower Runner is a medieval-themed, infinite runner. Dive deep into the tower's lore, why it is here, how it is still standing, and who is its master.

title: WitchGhost
description:
게임 정보
WitchGhost is an exploration adventure game where you play as Ezme, a mischievous witch with a knack for getting into (and out of) trouble. Delve into a spooky yet whimsical world filled with eerie enemies, tricky traps and hidden secrets. As Ezme, you'll explore haunted landscapes, dodging dangers while piecing together your lost memories to find your way back home. With a blend of spooky atmosphere and lighthearted humour, WitchGhost offers a thrilling journey that's as enchanting as it is entertaining.


Explore a spooky yet enchanting world brimming with playful surprises.


Gather Ezme's forgotten memories to restore colour to the world and, naturally, find your way back home.


Master a variety of spells, but beware - they might just as easily work against you as they do for you.


The forest is trecherous. Rely on your wits and quick reflexes to survive.

title: Defe The Defender
description:
게임 정보
도망칠 수 없다, 오직 전투뿐이다. 신비로운 섬에서 고대의 피난처는 끝없는 공격을 버텨내고 있다. Defe는 탐험하고, 자연 요새를 구축하며, 위험에 맞서기 위해 강해져야 한다 – 동료가 있든 없든.
전략과 액션이 적절히 조화를 이루는 생존 게임? Defe라면 가능합니다.
준비하세요. 이 섬은 살아 숨 쉬며, 저항합니다. 건설하고, 탐험하며, 치열한 전투를 펼치세요. 밤을 버텨낸다면 일출을 감상할 여유가 생길지도 모릅니다.
Defe The Defender는 장르의 깊이를 유지하면서도 단순화를 이룬 탑다운 전략 액션 게임입니다. 낮에는 은신처를 짓고, 기지를 강화하며, 숲의 비밀을 탐험하세요. 밤에는 전력을 다해 방어해야 합니다.
방어와 탐험 사이에서 균형을 잡을 수 있을까요? 자연의 덫을 더 설치할까요, 아니면 아군을 더 모집할까요? 더 복잡한 미로를 만들까요, 아니면 사냥꾼을 더 배치할까요? 원거리 무기로 싸울까요, 아니면 자연의 마법으로 맞서 싸울까요? 매일 밤 새로운 도전이 기다리지만, 고대 피난처 위로 떠오르는 태양만큼 값진 것은 없습니다.

title: Death Blonde
description:
게임 정보
Death Blonde is a team-based online car arena shooter where style meets destruction. Customise your ride, join online battles, and leave your enemies in the dust. Drive fast, shoot hard, and wear fashion - because even death deserves style.
The "Death Blonde" is the legendary car driven by the infamous skeleton racer Ken K. King, better known as "Triple K." For over 20 years, Triple K and his iconic car have ruled the deadly racing scene, becoming symbols of unmatched skill, speed, and style. Now, every driver dreams of surpassing the legend in J-City, the hub of high-stakes racing.
This universe revolves entirely around the races and vehicle production. Metroil handles mechanical assembly, while Perfectia drives technological innovation, making speed and progress the pillars of its society.

title: Flesh Made Fear
description:
게임 정보
Dare to Survive
From the creators of indie horror hits Massacre at the Mirage, Suffer the Night, and Terror at Oakheart, comes Flesh Made Fear, the ultimate survival horror experience by Tainted Pact Games.
Descend into a world of horrifying experiments and occult rituals where every step plunges you deeper into madness. Featuring the survival mechanics that define the genre, reimagined with heart-stopping innovations, this game invites you to confront your fears like never before.
Will you face the nightmare? Or will the nightmare consume you?

title: Grid Gladiators
description:
게임 정보
참고: Grid Gladiators는 출시 시점에 한국어로 번역되지 않을 수 있습니다. 그러나 출시 후 다양한 언어에서의 위시리스트 수에 따라 현지화를 진행할 예정입니다. 따라서 게임이 한국어로 번역되기를 원하신다면 게임을 위시리스트에 추가해 주세요!
2D 덱 빌딩
슬레이 더 스파이어에서 0D 덱 빌딩을 해봤고, 코발트 코어에서 1D 덱 빌딩을 해봤다면, 2D 덱 빌딩은 해본 적이 있나요? Grid Gladiators는 2D 덱 빌딩 게임으로, 지형 요소와 위치를 활용하여 유리한 상황을 만들고, 적의 공격을 차단하거나 피하고, AOE 공격으로 적 무리를 처치할 수 있습니다.
강력한 지형 시스템

title: Besmirch
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Besmirch
You are hired to work a farm in Besmirch. Tend the crops for a greedy owner and a starving town. To make things worse, there are rumors of apocalypse. Stock up and Survive the gates of Hell.
Hide or fight
Stealthily hide in the bushes or go in guns blazing, managing this farm is far from safe.
Socialize
Gossip and tall tales are normal in conversations. Who can you trust and how can you befriend the town while keeping your conscience clean?

title: Ominous
description:
게임 정보
Ominous is a captivating 2D pixel art adventure platformer that takes you on a mystical journey through the world’s most enigmatic locations. You’ll step into the shoes of Gowan McDerrick, a decorated British soldier from the Edwardian era, as he pursues ancient artifacts and uncovers secrets that span from Mongolian monasteries to Mayan tombs.

Set against the backdrop of Great Britain’s Edwardian period, Gowan’s adventure begins with an invitation from an old friend and former commander, Brigadier-General Sir Edward Bellingham. Sir Edward, who mysteriously disappeared for ten days during the Second Boer War, returned a changed man after being found miles from where he vanished, his spine broken and his spirit darkened. Obsessed with an ancient Egyptian manuscript discovered in the tombs beneath the lost city of Kweneng, Sir Edward’s invitation leads Gowan down a path filled with intrigue, mysticism, and self-discovery.

Gowan, now faced with the choice of rejoining the army or venturing into unknown realms, takes a room in a humble dosshouse along the Thames, contemplating his future. What unfolds is a tale of exploration, history, and the supernatural, where every step forward brings Gowan closer to unveiling the mysteries that bind the past and the present.

Embark on this extraordinary journey, where the boundaries of reality blur, and discover the truth behind the artifacts that have the power to change the course of history. Ominous is more than just a game—it's an experience that challenges both mind and spirit.

title: Onychomp : Lush journey
description:
게임 정보
달리라. 물어라. 울어라. 새벽 전에 정상에 올라라.
Onychomp: Lush Journey는 미스터리 던전 시리즈에서 영감을 받은 실시간 던전 크롤러로, 빠르고 거친 요소가 결합되었습니다. Omi로 플레이하여, 작은 쥐가 늑대 인간으로 변하고, 달의 부름을 받아 잃어버린 균형을 되찾기 위해 나섭니다. 보름달의 밤에만 마법의 산이 멈추고 길이 열립니다. 당신은 하루 밤에 정상에 도달해야 합니다 — 달이 당신을 기다립니다.
살아있는 던전
산은 매번 시도할 때마다 변합니다. 프로시저 방식으로 생성된 던전을 탐험하고, 자신만의 루틴을 따르는 생물들, 묻힌 비밀들, 숨겨진 길들을 찾아보세요.

title: Metrophobia
description:
게임 정보
당신은 으스스하고 버려진 듯한 지하철역에 갇히게 됩니다. 눈에 보이는 사람은 없지만, 누군가—혹은 무언가—그림자 속에서 숨어 있는 듯한 불길한 기운이 끊임없이 따라다닙니다. 목표는 간단하지만 벅찬 과제입니다. 지하철을 탈출하는 것이지만, 출구를 통과할 때마다 다시 시작점으로 돌아가 끝없는 미스터리한 루프에 갇히게 됩니다.
어두운 터널을 탐험하면서, 처음에는 미묘하게 보이는 이상 현상들이 점점 나타나기 시작합니다—처음에는 물건이 약간 어긋나 있는 것처럼 보이지만, 곧 더 무서운 형태로 발전합니다. 이 이상 현상들은 당신의 현실 인식을 왜곡하며 일상과 공포 사이의 경계를 끊임없이 흐리게 만듭니다. 환경은 생명력이 없는 것처럼 보이지만, 당신의 행동에 반응하며, 각 루프가 반복될 때마다 익숙한 역의 모습이 기이하게 뒤틀린 상태로 나타납니다.
더 깊이 들어갈수록 이상 현상은 점점 강렬해지고, 곧 어둠 속에서 나타나는 무서운 존재들과 마주하게 됩니다. 한 순간의 실수로도 치명적인 괴물과 마주할 수 있으므로 경계를 늦추지 말아야 합니다. 생존하기 위해서는 진화하는 공포에 적응하고, 지하철망에 숨어 있는 미지의 힘을 능가해야 합니다.
주요 특징

title: Goob
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey into the depths of a mysterious and treacherous underground world. This adventure lets you explore vast caves, battle ferocious monsters, mine for precious minerals, and upgrade your abilities in order to survive.

Underground World: Immerse yourself in an interconnected underground world filled with mysteries waiting to be unveiled. Traverse treacherous terrains brimming with unique challenges, secrets, and opportunities for discovery.

Mining for Riches: Dig deep into the earth to obtain a wide variety of valuable minerals including; gemstones, and rare crystals. The deeper you go, the more valuable the resources will be.

Abilities and Upgrades: As you progress, your character will gather precious materials to unlock new abilities and powers. Upgrade your offensive abilities to enhance your effectiveness in battle or upgrade your soft skills to increase your chances of survival… The choice is yours.

Exploration Awaits: Immerse yourself in a sprawling and visually stunning world. You'll encounter a diverse array of formidable creatures and monsters lurking within the shadows. Engage in thrilling battles by using a variety of skills to protect your loot and unravel the secrets hidden beneath the earth's surface.

GOOB’s world invites players to embark on a captivating journey of discovery, survival, and growth. Will you conquer the depths, confront the darkness, and ultimately find a way out of this dangerous world? Start your Adventure soon!

title: ASV Soccer
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to ASV Soccer, a highly customizable arcade soccer game.
With ASV Soccer you can enjoy:
Up to 22 player multiplayer for true 11 vs 11 matches.
Seamless drop-in and drop-out. Your time is precious: from kicking a few balls in a couple of minutes, to playing multiple matches consecutively, anything goes.
Phsyics based ball behaviour with no predetermined outcomes.
Extensive customization options: Choose between Arcade or Realism presets, or use a custom combination: Many aspects can be customized, such as preventing the ball from leaving the field, fouls, offsides, player collision, slow-mo effects and many others.
Switch to any player: Perform strong well-timed tackles as defender, display vision and ball distribution as playmaker, be in the correct position and score goals as forward or keep a clean sheet as goalkeeper - it's all up to you.
Matches against AI prepare you for your multiplayer experience.
Seamless switching between First Person, Third Person, and Television Camera modes for maximum overview or maximum immersion. Play the way you like it.
Comprehensive controls: Carefully chose your player actions yourself. No context-aware actions bound to a single button, no auto-aim, it's all up to you.
Play on the go: Works great and is actively tested on the Steam Deck. Play a game wherever you want.
Thanks for supporting the game, and I hope you enjoy ASV Soccer.

title: Cairn
description:
게임 정보
현실적인 등반 시뮬레이션
Cairn의 실제에 가까운 시뮬레이션으로 실감 나는 클라이밍을 경험할 수 있습니다. 최적의 홀드를 찾아 간단한 조작으로 손과 발을 위치시켜 보세요. 자세를 수정하고 힘을 들이며 균형을 잡아야 합니다. 방심하는 그 순간, 추락하고 말 테니까요!
일생일대의 등정
전문 등반가 아바가 되어 그 누구도 오르지 못한 카미산을 올라야 합니다. 모험 도중, 생각지도 못한 동료를 만나고, 땅에 남은 자들의 이야기에 귀를 기울여 보세요. 카미산의 숨겨진 이야기부터 꿈을 위해 아바가 감내하게 될 희생까지. 모든 것은 당신의 손과 발 끝에 달려있습니다.
나만의 길을 개척하기
어디든 자유롭게 오를 수 있습니다. 산을 탐험하며 바위의 표면을 확인하고 루트를 잘 확인하여 정상에 오르세요. 바위 위의 난제를 해결하며 어려운 구간을 돌파해 보세요. 어디든 오를 수 있으니, 경로를 신중하게 선택해야 할 겁니다!
등반은 자신과의 싸움
등반은 어렵습니다. 모든 벽이 최상 난이도로 느껴지죠. 도전을 넘치는 이들에게는 긴장감 넘치는 모험이지만, 난이도를 조절해 더 쉽게 플레이할 수도 있습니다.

title: In the Abyss of Dream | Dans l'abîme du rêve
description:
게임 정보
As the Great Darkness shrouds the province of Quebec, young Thérèse’s life is upended when, after her mother’s death, she is placed in the Saint-Nicolas-de-la-Passion Orphanage. She finds herself in a place ruled by violence and cruelty, where God Himself seems to turn a blind eye to the suffering of His children.
At night, Thérèse is transported to another world. It seems more peaceful, almost enchanting, but she quickly realizes that horrors beyond comprehension lurk there. And perhaps this world, which appears only in her dreams, can explain the strange phenomena that occur within the orphanage’s walls.
In the Abyss of Dream is a first-person point-and-click adventure game. Journey between two worlds – a sinister orphanage and a realm of dreams – to uncover the origins of the afflictions that torment the orphans. Immersive, intricately detailed environments await you. Explore these two worlds and unravel their mysteries by solving realistic and surreal puzzles that will test your powers of observation and deduction. Immerse yourself in a poignant tale of cosmic horror to reveal the dark legacy of the Catholic clergy in Quebec and its orphanages.
autokwd: In the Abyss of Dream | Dans l'abîme du rêve

title: Outsider
description:
게임 정보
Who is the Outsider?
Outsider is an interactive science fiction game with meaningful choices. You'll join my childhood friend Nando in his online encounters with a woman claiming to be an extraterrestrial. This game is an accurate recreation of their conversations based on the detailed records he left me before disappearing over a decade ago.
As a world-class white-hat hacker, retrogamer, data hoarder, warez scene veteran and occasional ladies' man, Nando leads an eventful life traveling the globe, selling his data security expertise to the highest bidder. But nothing could have prepared him for what awaited when he connected to a private chat room using a mysterious cube that arrived in the mail...
Outsider is an interactive fiction game full of humor and drama for techno-geeks and "hard" sci-fi fans everywhere. You will play as Nando's inner voice and help him in his encounters with an extraterrestrial from a highly advanced civilization.
Most of the gameplay unfolds within a chat interface. Your first mission is to help him determine whether "Mara" is truly who she claims to be... But how could an extraterrestrial prove their origin through online chat?
Outsider's options are labeled with emojis that reflect the answers' tone and likely impact. Consequences unfold naturally; you don't need to fear getting locked out of an ending because of a single "bad" choice.

title: Bioid
description:
게임 정보


Owlkin's Cosmic Library is a curiosity chamber of artifacts and a crossroads of worlds. One has only to open the book, and unknown creatures can break out or drag you into the book-portal. The worlds are shuffled in the Library!
Open tunnels in bioplasma and travel through white labyrinths to meet beings of higher intelligence. Fight the King of Thorns, the devourer of civilizations.
Learn the story of two separated prisoners and discover the secrets of a clan of bestial avatars, watchers and collectors.

title: How Much is Happiness?
description:
게임 정보
Poverty, hunger, sleepless nights on a cold bed - there was nothing but misery in the life of a young street girl named Bun.
She can no longer put up with hopelessness and plans to leave this world and go to Paradise - a distant city where there is no place for suffering. And then one day, without saying a word to anyone, Bun disappears.
You think of nothing better than to start searching the internet. A suspicious website says it's ready to bring her back, but, uh. in exchange for a thousand signatures on the user agreements. Without thinking, you click on them and.... Bun does come back to you, but she's displeased. No wonder why - you pulled her out of Paradise back to your miserable town.
At the same time Felka appears in your life. He's a funny cat-helper, every day calculating the level of your happiness and suggesting ways to increase it.
“What's going on, who is this cat, what did you agree to?” - none of that matters as long as Bun is around. Or... doesn't it?
“How much is Happiness” is a visual novel that shows the truth of our world through the prism of absurdity. Beautiful animated girls and touching music will not leave you indifferent.
Duration of the game: 10-12 hours.

title: Ms Vampire Love to Date with Me
description:
게임 정보

《흡혈귀 아가씨와의 사랑을 향한 30일》는 주인공 탕쥔(唐浚)과 스스로를 그의 여친이라 주장하는 아이린이 성에서 30일간 함께 생활하며 펼쳐지는 다중 엔딩 연애 육성 어드벤처 게임입니다. 주인공은 아이린에 대한 기억이 전혀 없지만, 그녀는 단호하게 두 사람의 관계를 증명하려 합니다. 플레이어는 아이린과의 교감을 통해 그녀의 감정과 신체적 안정을 유지하며, 그녀가 숨긴 진실을 찾아내야 합니다. 30일 동안 수많은 파국적 결말이 기다리고 있지만, 아이린의 진실을 알아내고 최후까지 생존한다면, 여러분은 그녀와의 추억을 바탕으로 최종 선택을 내리게 될 것입니다.

대학 4학년생인 당신은 눈을 뜨자 화려한 낯선 성 안에 있었습니다. 고개를 들자, 환상적인 미소를 띤 한 소녀가 당신을 내려다보고 있습니다.
“난 너의 여친, 아이린이야!”
그녀는 평범함을 강조하지만, 낮에 잠자고 밤에 활동하는 습성, 가끔 드러나는 피에 대한 갈증은 결코 평범하지 않음을 암시합니다. 머릿속에 스치는 피비린내 나는 장면들은 이 성에서 무시무시한 일이 벌어졌음을 떠올리게 하죠.
완벽한 여친처럼 보이지만, 불길한 예감이 듭니다. 만약 그녀의 연인 관계 기대를 저버린다면, 그 기억 속 피의 광경이 현실이 될지도 모릅니다.
당신은 그녀와의 관계를 유지하며 성 안에 숨겨진 진실을 찾아 나서게 되는데……

title: Phantom Demon Siege
description:
게임 정보
After the Phantom Demon Siege, humanity will not only face hordes of demons, but will also attempt to rebuild devastated areas and reclaim lost territories. To this end, the "Order of the Hunters" has formed special rapid response teams known as Shadow Squads. These teams are tasked with carrying out high-risk missions to ensure humanity's survival and slow the demonic expansion.
You and your commando are part of these forces. Each mission takes you to locations infested with supernatural creatures, where you must complete crucial objectives such as recovering artifacts, rescuing survivors, destroying demonic structures, and securing critical areas.
As you complete these tasks, you discover that more sinister forces are manipulating events in order to keep the portals open. Now, each mission is not only about survival, but also about finding clues that can unravel a conspiracy that threatens humanity's fragile resistance.

title: Unhinged Pet Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
"Unhinged Pet Store Simulator" is a pet store simulator where you sell pet products in a chaotic environment. Expected random events, weird interractions and rudy customers!
Manage the Store
Design, expand and run a pet store. Buy masses of wares, stock shelves and sell!
Handle the Chaos
Try to handle the chaos all while running your daily business!

title: Squabble
description:
게임 정보
Squabble is a dynamic Tower Defense-RTS hybrid where strategic resource management is key to fending off relentless waves of enemies. Gather materials, summon and upgrade units, and build powerful structures to secure your defenses and outsmart your foes.
Reach milestones to gain lasting upgrades and distinctive cosmetics, improving both your gameplay and style.
Take a break from strategizing and customize your home’s interior to reflect your personal taste, or unwind with various side activities such as fishing and farming.

title: XOL: Space Mech Wars
description:
게임 정보
🦾 Giant Mechs × Space Battles
Pilot a humanoid mech and soar freely through outer space.
Engage enemies from every direction using full 3D tactical movement.
🎯 Auto-Aim FPS for Instant Action
Keep enemies centered on your screen to auto-lock and fire.
Master inertia-based movement to chase down fast-moving targets.
True piloting skill means mastering motion in zero gravity.
💥 Slash, Shoot, Explode — Master Four Sub-Weapons
Missiles, grenades, beam blades, and shields.
Switch weapons on the fly to control the battlefield.
Your mech is built for both close-quarters and long-range combat. Note: This title does not feature mech customization.
You’re a rookie pilot, thrown into a war for your homeland.
Join a rough-edged strike squad and survive the front lines.
A short sci-fi narrative connects each high-paced mission.

Follow your commander’s orders and move fluidly through battle.
Support allied warships, defend key points, and adapt to a shifting battlefield.
Tactical awareness is key to survival.

title: Deep Sea
description:
게임 정보
Deep Sea is a story-driven adventure game where players take on the role of Amara, who is overcome with grief since the death of her grandfather. Amara discovers an imprisoned water spirit that promises to bring her grandfather back, but in doing so is tricked into unleashing a deadly and impassable storm on the islands she calls home.

Players will have to use the skills learned from Amara’s grandfather to overcome her grief and find a way to weaken and eventually imprison the water spirit. Along the way, they will explore beautiful islands, solve puzzles, and uncover ancient artifacts that hold the key to stopping the storm.
Key features
Explore visually stunning islands, each with their own unique story and challenges to overcome
Discover artifacts lost to time and uncover their hidden past in an attempt to save your home
Listen to an emotionally captivating soundtrack composed by industry veterans
Relive past memories and apply their lessons throughout your journey of self-discovery

title: After Death
description:
게임 정보
Based on Real Events
In 2015, an Argentine lawyer was found dead in his home after making a few powerful enemies. Some say that he committed suicide, and others say that he was silenced. The truth behind his death has been lost... or has it? 
Continue the investigation in After Death: a first-person horror game based on this mysterious death. Some say that our developers have gotten an insider's peek into the investigations that went on behind this incident... 
Investigate a Strange World
You are Prosecutor Bisman. After a sudden death, you wake up as a ghost in a police station where the Grim Reaper himself roams the corridors. Speak to the only living man in prison who can see you, help the other ghosts trapped there, and maybe someone will help you to get your memories back...

title: AirShooShoo
description:
게임 정보
A precision platformer, where you fly and collect stars.
What you can expect if you buy:
68+1 solo levels
3-5 hours of gameplay - every level takes 1-2 minutes if you don't die. But you will...
Increasing difficulty, a fair difficulty curve was the goal, sometimes the game can be hard, sorry for that...
Multiplayer shooting - a friendly fight with your people never hurts
Multiplayer time trial - speedrunning the levels online (Trackmania style)
4 different biomes
All handmade graphics and sound - no AI
In single player mode the level difficulty increases slowly, giving plenty of time to enjoy and learn the challenging mechanics of flying between the platforms.
You can go one step further and aim for speed! This game is especially designed for speedrunning, an homage to the style was deeply my intention. Playing against your own time, or against the Global Leaderboards.

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana
description:
게임 정보
今すぐ『アノ 117: パックスロマーナ』を予約して「建設パック」を手に入れよう！

『アノ 117: パックスロマーナ』では、都市建設ジャンルの定番シリーズがこれまでで最も野心的な作品となって帰ってきます。総督として、建設と統治の進め方が、あなたの物語、市民の運命、そして属州の未来を形作ることになります。他の総督たちと協力する？ それとも軍事力を示すために彼らに挑戦する？ 平和の代価はあなたの選択に託されます。
最高の都市建設体験

圧倒的なディテールと自由度、そして壮大なスケールで属州を発展させましょう。街角では子どもたちが犬を追いかけ、闘技場では何千もの歓声が響きわたります。ラティウムの美しい中央地帯から、ローマ人が足を踏み入れたがらないアルビオンの神秘的なケルトの湿地まで、目に映るすべての土地に文明を築きましょう。
ローマ帝国の総督になろう

ローマ帝国の最盛期に、理想の都市を築き上げ、民の暮らしと皇帝の果てなき要求の狭間でバランスを取りながら、都市を繁栄へと導きましょう。帝国内で同盟を結ぶことも、陸海の戦で力を誇示することもできます。あるいは皇帝に背くことも—ただし、その代償は覚悟しなくてはなりません。

総督として下すあらゆる決断が、運命を左右します。ケルトの文化を尊重するか、それともローマの伝統を徹底させるか？ 外交と交易で属州を発展させるか、あるいは軍事力で征服するかを選べます。あなたの選択は、市民や属州の未来だけでなく、あなた自身の物語をも形作ることになります。

title: Swap
description:
게임 정보
SWAP 스왑은 은하계를 여행하는 매력적이지만 용감한 고양이의 신발에 자신을 발견 할 수있는 3 인칭 어드벤처 게임이다.
모래 언덕에서 얼음 사막에 이르기까지 숨막히는 풍경으로 독특한 행성을 탐험하십시오. 퍼즐을 풀고,행성의 다채로운 주민을위한 퀘스트를 완료하고,고양이 손재주와 교활함을 사용하여 적과 싸우십시오. 모든 장애물을 극복하려면 민첩성,호기심,통찰력 및 추가 9 개의 삶이 필요합니다.
스왑은 흥미 진진한 게임 플레이,그림 같은 위치,재미있는 퍼즐,모험 정신뿐만 아니라 감동적인 주인공으로,첫 번째"야옹"에서 자신과 사랑에 빠지게 만들 것입니다 게임이다.
당신의 인생의 몰래의 모험을위한 준비!

title: Drop Command
description:
게임 정보
Mech combat at a grand scale: From small skirmishes to epic battles with hundreds of units.



Drop into combat. Either alone, leading your squad, or commanding an army. Combined arms combat pits you against a large array of opposing units, where you can pilot any units under your command. Customize the weapon and equipment loadout for your Mech, Tank, VTOL, and Battle Armour to best suit the mission at hand.



Wade through battle wreaking devastation with a large variety of powerful weapons systems. Take part in the evolving battlefield, with fully destructible debris and unit wreckage.


The procedural campaign provides replayability as you wage war across the star cluster. Face logistic and tactical decisions throughout the campaign as you vie for control of strategic resources, pivotal star systems, and political objectives. Completed or failed mission objectives will have as they impact future missions and campaign operations.



Outside the campaign, play in missions: Generate a one-time procedural mission, or a fully customizable drop scenario.

title: Peace Island
description:
게임 정보
One fine day, in a remote island community off the coast of Maine, nine cats wake up to discover that their humans have disappeared. To survive, they must band together to uncover the mysteries of their storied island home - and ultimately, it is up to them to decide:

Are the humans worth bringing back?



- Explore a truly open world - The entirety of the island will be accessible, with each building containing a hand-crafted interior. No "Invisible Walls," or buildings with no purpose.
- A realistic weather & tidal system - From foggy nights, to morning downpours, to clear, blue skies - you never know what those southeast winds might bring in - and you'll never want to miss a beautiful sunset!
- Nine Playable Cats - Each with their own stories, preferences, skills, & weaknesses - as you get to know them, you'll know which one might be the best for a certain job!



- Delve into a rich, 200-year alternate history - Learn family lineages, study old maps, and read books & letters better left hidden.
How you approach life after humanity will decide how the game plays out in the end.
Three different possible endings



From the very beginning, we strove to create a world that isn't just "that place between mission points." The island might be small, but there is a LOT to discover and re-discover!
From the mood of the cats, to the time of day, to the weather, the soundtrack changes. Each player's musical experience will be different!
Games are a wonderful storytelling - and all stories are not happy ones.



Sometimes, you just want to hang out with the cats and watch the sun set. A mix of casual/slow gaming.
The humans might be gone, but old power structures remain. Currying favor with the deer might make the Seagulls less willing to talk!



Peace Island began in November of 2017, when a Eric (a line cook) and Laura (a care worker) noticed a severe lack of rich, single-player, story-driven experiences in a game world where the major publishers were intent on developing the next open-world shooter.

They knew it wasn't going to be easy - developing a video game of this size typically requires dozens of people and significant funding. They just had themselves, and whatever pocket change they could set aside after bills and rent. They worked on the project in whatever few hours they could set aside outside of their sleep and regular jobs.



The world took shape, slowly but steadily. Occasionally, they could convince a friend to donate a piece of artwork, or save enough to hire a coder for an hour or two to help build the first, simple systems.

From the very start, emphasis was put on crafting a beautiful world- one that would not simply serve as "that space between one destination and another," but as a place the player wants to linger in for just perhaps one more sunset.



After two years of slow but steady progress, Peace Island "went viral" in the fall of 2019, finally allowing the project to expand beyond a single bedroom, an outdated computer, and a few notebooks.



Since then, the Peace Island project has expanded to include a a core team of 7, and an expanded talent pool of over 40 creatives from around the world.

As we enter the fist days of our fifth year of development, we are more excited than ever to share the world & story of Peace Island.

title: Vampire Cat
description:
게임 정보
캡처. 강화. 지배하다.
목록에서 공격 목록(1~10)을 선택하고 회전 버튼을 누르면 공격 구역이 내 생물을 중심으로 회전합니다. 적을 맞히면 피해를 입으며, 새로운 생물이라면 자동으로 점령합니다!
하지만 주의할 점은 회전할 때마다 크레딧이 소모된다는 점입니다. 크레딧이 다 떨어지면 적들은 더 강해지고 판돈은 더 높아집니다.
뱀파이어 고양이 군대 관리
포획한 생물은 각각 업그레이드할 수 있지만(HP와 공격력은 최대 10레벨까지), 모든 비용은 적을 처치하여 획득한 달러로 지불해야 합니다. 더 많이 투자할수록 더 많은 업그레이드 비용이 듭니다.
특정 달러에 도달하기 전까지는 공격을 재사용할 수 없기 때문에 전략적인 시스템으로 자원을 신중하게 관리해야 합니다. 일정 금액에 도달하면 보너스와 페널티를 선택할 수 있으며, 각 게임은 독특하고 점점 더 어려워집니다.

title: The Cooking Club
description:
게임 정보
The Cooking Club is a Slice-Of-Life // Dating Sim visual novel that is produced in the Ren'Py engine!
Ready to start cooking?
High school can be a drag—especially when you’re stuck in classes you can’t stand. Looking for an easy escape, our protagonist.. YOU! (Yes - You!) stumbles upon the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.
What starts as a simple excuse to ditch class quickly turns into something far more delicious. Between chopping, stirring, and whisking up new dishes, unexpected sparks begin to fly. Will you master the recipe for love, or will things boil over? With a cast of charming clubmates, secret ingredients of romance, and just a pinch of chaos, The Cooking Club is serving up a story that’s equal parts heart-warming and hilarious. So grab your apron—because in this kitchen, love is always on the menu!
But remember.. each decision you make comes with a choice and a path - you can't have every girl to yourself!
Choice-Driven Narrative – Every decision stirs the pot! Your interactions with club members influence their opinions, relationships, and even how the story unfolds. Choose wisely, because in this kitchen, romance is a delicate recipe!
Cooking Mini-Games – Get hands-on with cooking challenges! Chop, stir, and plate up delicious dishes in interactive mini-games that test your timing and precision.
Multiple Love Interests – From the fiery Akemi to the reserved Isabella, each club member has their own unique personality and storyline. Build bonds, spark romance, and see where your journey takes you!

title: Constance
description:
게임 정보

페인트로 변화하기
페인트 기반 메커니즘을 활용하여 지속적인 흐름 상태를 경험하세요 - 땅과 벽에 다이빙하고 공중과 적을 가르며 이동하세요!
붓 휘두르기
붓을 이용하여 새로운 기술을 해제하여 적을 물리치고 위협적인 상황을 극복하며 플랫폼 도전 과제를 해결하고 진행하세요.


스스로를 발견하기
콘스탄스의 비선형 연결된 내부 세계에서 여섯 개 이상의 독특한 생태구, 무수한 비밀, 다양한 경로, 캐릭터, 부가 퀘스트 및 수집품을 탐험하세요!
균형을 추구하다
붓 기술을 사용하면 페인트가 오염됩니다. 만약 완전히 오염되면 부정적인 효과가 기다리니 주의하세요!
여행 중 발견한 영감을 일기에 스케치하세요. 스케치는 콘스탄스의 능력을 향상시키고 맞춤화합니다. 소재를 모아 스케치를 더 강력한 아트워크로 업그레이드할 수 있습니다.
죽은 후에 여정을 어떻게 계속할지 선택하세요. 도전을 계속하기 원하면 가격이 붙습니다. 아니면 안전 지점으로 돌아가서 다른 미정평을 탐험하세요?
내부 세계는 콘스탄스의 정신적인 건강 여정과 강하게 연결되어 있으며, 각 생태구와 그 독특한 적 및 캐릭터는 그녀의 심리와 개인적인 역사의 다른 측면을 나타냅니다.
개인적인 투쟁, 창의성, 업무-생활 균형, 내적 목적에 관한 할 수 있는 플래시백을 경험하세요. 콘스탄스의 신발을 신어 그녀의 과거를 알아내세요!

title: Fantastyc Murder Mystery
description:
게임 정보
Get notified about our funding launch. Find Fantastyc Murder Mystery on:
Immerse yourself in a unique asynchronous multiplayer experience
In Fantastyc Murder Mystery, you solve player-committed murders or take up weapons to do the deed yourself.
Play as murderer in unique randomly generated levels
Every murder demands meticulous planning, as detectives worldwide piece together evidence to crack the case.
Play as a detective and solve real player-generated murders
Gather clues and interrogate NPCs to unravel each unique mystery.
Spells, Perks, and Modifiers make it truly FANTASTYC
Think with portals, turn witnesses into frogs, or transform yourself into a prop. With the powers of the Enigma Tomes, you can pull from the arcane to create the most creative crime scenes!
2 Game Modes - Play together or on your own
Play live with your friends in an online lobby where you try to solve their committed murder before they solve yours!
Interact with the many already uploaded cases on the Noticeboard and upload your best murders for people worldwide to try out!
Compete against the world and become the best murderer or detective this realm has ever seen!

title: Gray Planet
description:
게임 정보
몇세기 후 테라포밍 기술이 개발되고 인류는 여러 행성을 개척하고 있으며 수많은 행성에서 살아가고 있습니다. 당신은 여러 행성을 돌아다니는 용병이며 여행가이지만 나노머신에 점령당한 행성에 불시착을 하였습니다. 이 행성에 어떤 일이 일어났는지 알기 위해 탐험을 하고 자원을 수집하세요.

여러가지 지역을 탐험하세요
이 행성의 다양한 지역들을 탐험하세요

다양한 몬스터들
이 행성에는 다양한 종류의 위협이 존재합니다

1 감염체
나노머신에 감염된 생명체이며 당신을 감염시킬려고 달려드는 단순한 생명체입니다



2 로봇
사람들의 작업을 도와주는 노동자였지만 나노머신에 침식된후 사람을 공격하게 되었습니다. 일부 군용 로봇들은 더 크고 단단한 장갑을 가지고있습니다.



3 나노모프
나노머신들이 뭉쳐서 만들어진 새로운 생명체이며 분열이나 위장 등 여러 독특한 패턴을 보입니다

적을 죽이거나 광물 및 여러 잔해들을 분해함으로서 자원을 얻으세요


다양한 장비를 제작하고 그것들을 사용하여 적을 물리치거나 탐험을 하세요

기지를 건설하여 자원을 저장하고 장비나 차량을 제작하며 쉴곳을 만드세요

title: Oars of Silence
description:
게임 정보
Oars of Silence는 끝없이 어두운 바다를 배경으로 하는 잔혹하고 미니멀한 서바이벌 호러 어드벤처입니다. 노를 젓는 작은 보트 하나만을 장비로, 광활한 대양을 항해하며 예측 불가능한 날씨와 세계가 조용해지면서 깊은 바다 속에서 깨어나는 이상한 생물들을 마주해야 합니다.
게임 메카닉:
독특한 노 젓기 방식: 왼쪽 클릭으로 왼쪽 노, 오른쪽 클릭으로 오른쪽 노를 작동
나침반과 무전을 이용한 항해
식량을 얻기 위한 낚시로 더 빠르게 노를 젓기
바다의 위험—무엇이든—으로부터 탈출

title: Pinono and the magic fiddle
description:
게임 정보
Play the fiddle, take a detour, go on an adventure—sometimes.
So... what was the goal again?
Pinono is a curious traveler who casts magic through the sound of her fiddle.
Alongside her companions, she sets off on a journey to collect five magical artifacts.
But in this world, there's no right order—no set ending.
Your choices and actions gently shape both the path and the conclusion of her journey.
This is a relaxed RPG featuring peaceful exploration,
turn-based combat, charming low-poly visuals,
and a story that cherishes small emotional moments.
A fantasy world where music and magic intertwine
Encounters and partings with unique companions
Melodies are procedurally generated from the materials you collect
──no two journeys sound the same
Multiple endings and the freedom to stray from the main path
A warm, picture book-inspired visual style
At the end of Pinono’s journey,
you may just discover what magic truly means.

title: 黑丝袜：鲁智深
description:
게임 정보
《검은 스타킹: 노지심》은 roguelike 생존 게임이며, 《서유기 생존자》의 스핀오프입니다. 노지심과 임대옥이 서유기 세계로 여행하며 우연히 몸이 바뀌고, 서유기 탐험대의 유명한 "도반"이 되는 기묘한 이야기를 다룹니다.

200개 이상의 방대한 스킬, 완벽한 로그라이크 경험



세 개의 새로운 지도, 새로운 영웅과 재능



3~5시간의 플레이 경험



재미있는 밈, 즐거운 전투

title: Polterquest
description:
게임 정보
Step into the mischievous paws of a brave and curious cat in The Polterquest, a thrilling 3D action-adventure platformer set in eerie, ghost-infested locations! As a fearless feline explorer, you must navigate through haunted mansions, abandoned graveyards, and misty forests, uncovering hidden treasures while avoiding supernatural dangers.
Leap across crumbling platforms, climb eerie structures, and use your feline reflexes to dodge ghostly traps. Solve puzzles to unlock secret passages, outwit mischievous spirits, and harness your cat instincts to reveal hidden pathways. But beware—each haunted location is guarded by powerful spectral entities that will challenge your courage and agility!
With charming cartoon visuals, fast-paced platforming, and a spooky yet whimsical atmosphere, The Polterquest delivers a purr-fect mix of adventure, mystery, and ghostly fun. Can you outsmart the spirits and claim the legendary treasure hidden within the haunted realms?

title: Exodus Core
description:
게임 정보
인류가 몰락하고, 우주 깊은 곳에서 온 괴물들이 지구를 침공했을 때, 한때 위대했던 도시들은 폐허로 변했고 전투와 불타버린 희망의 재로 덮였습니다. 인류의 잔존자들은 외계 침공으로부터 지구를 해방시키기 위해 하나로 뭉칩니다.
Exodus Core는 외계 침공을 막기 위해 엘리트 메카 부대를 지휘하는 턴제 전략 RPG입니다.
게임 특징:
⚔️ 잔혹한 턴제 전투: 모든 움직임이 중요합니다. 측면 기동, 근거리 및 원거리 공격, 전술적 판단으로 적을 압도하세요.
🤖 독특한 메카: 중장갑 돌격형부터 기동성 높은 포격형까지 다양한 메카를 지휘하세요. 각 메카는 고유의 역할과 개성을 가진 전술 유닛입니다.

title: Bullet Age
description:
게임 정보
The world of New Haven is a wasteland. The ARC empire destroyed it with a single Mutagen Bomb that transformed it’s creatures to mutated monsters.

Become the Gunsword heroes in this classic co-op 2D action-platformer as they become the last hope for the United Resistance.

Gain powerful abilities to dash, spin, and blast through creepy creatures, mutated soldiers and huge bosses. It’s up to you to stop the ARC from achieving world domination.


Features:

• Play through dozens of meticulously designed levels chock-full of secrets, challenging platforming and huge mutated bosses.
• Intuitive combat system that mixes hack and slash action and run and gun gameplay.
• Purchase and upgrade weapons with unique parts that will give bullets devastating abilities.
• Full couch co-op adventure that span over 3 continents.
• Beautiful hand-drawn cartoon graphics and fluid animation bring the world of Bullet Age to life.

title: WiccAtriX
description:
게임 정보
Summary: Wiccatrix is a 3D Action RPG. Gameplay is designed for a XBox style controller or Keyboard.
The game is inspired by old 80's 90's Role Playing Games such as Legend (aka Four Crystals of Trazere), The original Rogue, Gauntlet (Atari Arcade) & Ultima 8 Pagan + others games like World Of Warcraft etc... Wiccatrix consists of designed scenes and randomly generated dungeons for crawling through, killing mobs and getting loot.
The game will also have other RPG aspects such as free roaming scenes with NPC’s and:~
Spellcrafting ~ A spell crafting system that uses a combination of herbs and runes to enable the player to create their own spells!!
Dialogue & a Story line ~ A rogue titan is disturbing the elemental balance which permeates the world of Terra. The players role is to guide the our hero Catsear the peasant through a world filled with enemies and other characters and ultimately a final encounter with a rogue elemental titan that seeks to destroy the world. Can he be banished? It won't be easy.
Puzzles ~ Use spells and your own wit to defeat puzzles and receive rewards and gain access to dungeons areas..
Combat ~ Go into battle with your limited melee abilities and your spells or run away screaming like a little chicken from mobs of enemies and bosses of various types. Getting into fights and not dying will challenge the player’s ability. Sometimes this will be easy and other times it will be near impossible and require a different approach. The player will have the experience of building their skills to withstand a progressively increasing horde of enemies with harder and more damaging attacks.
Loot and Reagent (Spell Ingredients) Gathering ~ Loot and Reagents can be bought from merchants, found in parts of the world or received from enemy drops and quests.

Release ~ Aiming for November 2024 or not long after ~ That's the plan..

title: Shred-A-Bunch!
description:
게임 정보
SUMMARY
Shred zombies in slow-mo while drifting with your good old tractor?! Harvest crops, slaughter zombies, overcome epic boss fights and upgrade your vehicle. Rinse and repeat.
FEATURES
Harvest crops
Kill zombies
Watch out for your fuel level. If you run out of fuel, you lose
Upgrade your vehicles
Engage unique boss fights
Fight your way through different seasons and weather conditions
Endless mode where you can kill thousands of zombies through endless waves and upgrade your vehicle on the go
STORY
Your grandpa left his farm to you when he passed away, and you gave him the promise to keep the farm in good shape. After the zombie apocalypse, you take your good old tractor and protect your farm from zombies.











Hit, shred, or shoot the zombies. It's all up to you, all that matters is to kill those damn zombies and protect your precious crops! As a bonus to protecting your crops, enjoy the satisfying ragdoll zombies flying around when you hit them.

Engage unique boss fights and bring all you to take them down!















You are gonna love this game.


I can still confidently suggest this game. You can focus on the things you like most. There is an endless mode where you can skip the harvesting, focus on the and kill thousands of zombies through endless waves and upgrade your vehicle on the go. You'll have a pretty good time.


Maybe wait for a discount if you want to try it out.


Sorry, this game is not for you.
If you decide to purchase a copy, thank you, I hope that you'll enjoy it.

title: Super Power Racing
description:
게임 정보


Get ready to experience a thrilling top-down arcade racing game that's inspired by the classic 90s racing games you know and love.

Super Power Racing League is the prestigious racing competition where ruthless competitors from around the world come together to tear up the track and power their way to victory

Unlock new vehicles, drive everything from a hot-hatch to an ice cream van!

title: Dreaminal
description:
게임 정보

Dreaminal is an online co-op liminal space puzzle exploration experience where you and up to 3 other players will navigate through eerie, immersive environments inspired by the Backrooms concept. Together, you'll face intriguing puzzles, interact with shifting spaces, and encounter unexpected anomalies, all while making critical choices that affect your path and the levels you explore.


Solve intriguing puzzles for every level, each one with its unique concept and mechanics. Hack your way through a facility computer, navigate dangerous areas, and manipulate time to your advantage. Oh and don't forget to play with the floaties and waterslides in the poolrooms!




Your choices and actions throughout the game influence the ending you receive. Discover hidden levels, uncover new facets of the story, and reach different outcomes depending on how you interact with the environment and approach each puzzle. The levels themselves will shift and change based on the paths you take and the decisions you make, ensuring a unique experience each time you play.


Explore unique levels and multiple sublevels with distinct aesthetics and challenges. Each level offers fresh experiences, hidden secrets, and engaging puzzles to keep gameplay exciting and unpredictable.



Play Dreaminal the way you want, whether that is without entities, normal or nightmare mode where there are more entities, less items and harder to find puzzle parts.

title: Retro Game Store Simulator
description:
게임 정보
1980 年代のモーレツなゲーム ストアを管理する
ビデオゲーム、ゲーム機、ポスター、雑誌を購入、在庫し、販売して利益を得ます。
ストアの評判を高めて、必須の製品ライセンスを確保します。
時間の経過とともにリリースされる新しいガジェットやシステムに投資することで、店舗の生産性を最適化します。
 管状製品の注文、在庫、販売

title: Dead
description:
게임 정보
Dead, too dead is a hardcore open-world survival game where 21st-century individuals fight for survival in an apocalyptic fantasy world. We plan to create a game with the following features :
Realistic Survival: Manage various factors such as hunger, thirst, disease, and injuries to survive in extreme environments.
Unique Characters: Combine 21st-century jobs with various traits to create unique characters and develop your own survival strategies.
Exploration and Discovery: Explore a vast open world with remnants of modern civilization and uncover hidden stories and resources.
Choices and Consequences: Every choice you make has permanent consequences. Decide carefully and create your own story.
Combat and Threats: Fight against various enemies such as ghouls, wild animals, and magical creatures, and develop survival strategies to counter constantly evolving threats.
Unique Vision System: Experience tense gameplay from a top-down perspective based on your character's field of view, and strategically use your surroundings.
Crafting and Building (Planned): Use materials from this world to craft tools, weapons, and defenses, and build your own base.
Modding Support (Planned): Utilize various modding tools to create your own content and share it with other players.
Currently, Dead, too dead is in the early stages of development, and we are conducting various tests through prototype builds. This version is to experiment with and improve the game's core mechanics and systems, and may still be lacking in many areas.
Dead, too dead aims to provide a differentiated gameplay experience from existing survival games. We aim for a sandbox game where players set their own survival goals and create their own stories. Additionally, we aim to provide a differentiated gameplay experience through modern job and trait systems, exploration of modern civilization remnants, a world where choices and consequences are reflected, and a unique top-down vision system.
If you are positive about the direction of Dead, too dead, please support us by adding it to your wishlist. Your interest will help us to have a solid development direction.

title: Towers Heritage
description:
게임 정보
Tower defense game revisiting the genre for both gamers nostalgic of the old sweet TD days and newcomers.
Defend your kingdom, customize your towers and play online or offline in this tribute to the Tower Defense genre.
How would you like to play an old-school Tower Defense where you can play with your friends and create your own towers to craft new strategies?
Towers Heritage is a tribute to the classics of the genre while adding a dose of innovation with an online multiplayer mode or a unique tower creation workshop.
Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where, as protector of the kingdom, you must defend your lands against relentless waves of enemies. Strategically place your towers along the paths or build an overwhelming maze of destruction.
Not in the mood to play with other players? No problem!
🏰 Take on bots in a skirmish mode.
🏰 Enjoy the single-player adventure with a captivating campaign mode.
🏰 Or create your game with your own rules: choose the number of players, the type of game (cooperative, team against team, free for all) and much more.
Looking for a completely different challenge? Become the invader! Unleash waves of enemies on your opponents and expand your kingdom.
Developed by a passionate indie from the heart of the French countryside, Towers Heritage is a personnal tribute this genre, that tag along since his childhood.
Whether you want to enjoy a chill game or a real strategic challenge, there's something for everyone.
⚔️ Add to your wishlist now and take a seat among legends of TD.⚔️

title: KINSHFT
description:
게임 정보
KINSHFT is a sci-fantasy adventure where you play as three members of the same family, each with their own unique abilities and play styles. Spread in three wildly different eras of a future Earth, they are still connected by a mysterious force that allows them to work as a team across a vast span of time.
FEATURES:
You will encounter many mysteries across time that cannot be solved with a single character's abilities. Shift between characters and their eras and use each one's unique skills to work together to find a solution. As you journey deeper into these worlds and solve even greater mysteries you will unlock new abilities for each character.
The decisions you make as a player can have an affect on other eras in time. Some are like a ripple, destroying a bridge in one era that cuts off enemy access to an area in another. Others are like a wave, changing how a faction that once considered you an enemy now sees you as a friend.
In your travels you will encounter many new species and cultures, those that have evolved over the decades and centuries altered by the Eros impact, and those that have reached Earth from distant galaxies searching for what the asteroid may have left behind. Befriend and help the locals, meet and influence the different factions and come face to face with tremendous bosses. How those encounters end is up to you!
EXPLORE AND COLLECT - Delve into the hidden depths and dark corners of the world to collect valuable relics of the past.
CRAFT AND TRADE - Craft and trade for new and powerful items to gain new abilities allowing you to explore deeper into each new world. 
BUILD AND GROW - Trade resources and aid the inhabitants of Bastion City to help it rebuild and grow, gaining you access to new locations, shops, adventures and mysteries.
CHARACTERS: 
Each character has unique abilities that fit their individual play styles, some available from the start, others that need to be discovered, researched or unlocked. Each ability is designed to be used both in exploration and in combat, allowing players to decide how and when to use each one.
NILES - With a newfound ability to control the very forces of the universe, Niles uses fringe science to manipulate the world around him as if by magic. Waving his staff he can capture and control particles to create fantastic "Science Spells"

title: Crisis Reign Orbis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on the Crisis Story - 
Play the main story of Azer and travel through several stages, fight against enemies, talk with the locals, solve puzzles and rebuild the support of your team.


Slaughter The DronesRecover the various portions of the city that have gone offline by defeating the drones placed in each of the 4 borough.  

 Collect the late professor's 'Legacy Discs' scattered between the various lands. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and create alliances in order to uncover the secrets needed to save the land of Orbis.

With each new land comes its challenges, as you travel to collect the hidden 'Legacies' Left by the professor. Defeat bosses who travel to claim it for themselves. 
 
Fight to gain true bragging rights in the 1 vs 1 Battle Mode. Fight 1 versus 1 with a friend in the local multiplayer mode and battle on 1 of the five stages.

title: The Chenwei Unveiler
description:
게임 정보
This is a map-grinding and level-passing game with a top - down perspective as its core gameplay. Players will act as adventurers who collect skill points by grinding monsters and exploring. Use the skill point system to gradually unlock, upgrade skills and strengthen character attributes, and finally challenge high - difficulty levels and bosses. The game combines action combat and map exploration elements. Players need to flexibly use skill combinations to deal with various enemies and unlock levels by completing specific tasks.
Initial Release Content
Adventure Mode - Linear map - clearing mode. After the character clears the level, it can be unlocked to the Challenge Mode.
Challenge Mode - Incorporates light Roguelike elements (such as random initial Buff/Debuff, etc.).
Character System - Three operable characters will be available in the initial release version.
Game Background
In 7077 AD, the comet "Purple Cloud" tore through the atmosphere, and the strange virus it carried pushed the Earth to the edge of chaos. Humanity eked out a living between the rampaging infected beasts and deformed machines, while the only glimmer of hope was hidden in the guidance of an ancient East Asian proverb - "Where the poison is transported, there must be a solution."
Gameplay
Enjoy the fun of grinding maps and challenge all kinds of monsters
The game has set up multiple map levels, and each map level corresponds to different monsters and skill playstyles.

title: Bobo in Hell
description:
게임 정보
Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.
Recruit powerful allies and create your team composition navigating an in-depth synergy system! Arrange powerful combinations to exploit and escalate your power level to cruise through the gates of hell.
Relinquish your foes and pick up powerful items to fine-tune your composition. Carefully weigh the pros and cons of each artifact and use unique interactions to give you the edge.
Find your way through the circles of hell under the guidance of our local, friendly red-hooded figure. Beware of your choices, penguin, as decision-making is the deciding factor between facing the unpleasant and the unrelenting.
Bobo In Hell at release will ship with: 
165+ character cards.

title: Rasna
description:
게임 정보
"Rasna" is an single player open world game, in the form of an "Historically Accurate Etruscan Tale". This means it strives for meticulous historical accuracy while immersing the player in a world rich with mysterious places, magical creatures, and ancient mythology.
The player assumes the role of Velia, a young woman and daughter of the Lucumon (king) of the Etruscan city of Manthura. At the beginning of the game, something terrible happens—and Velia becomes an outcast, hunted by her own fellow citizens.
Gameplay is heavily focused on story and investigation. The player must uncover what has happened by:
Talking to various characters, engaging in dialogue with choices that influence the story.
Exploring different areas and solving labyrinthine paths.
Retrieving key items necessary for progression.
At present, the combat system is still in development and not yet available. However, enemies and combat are planned and will play an important role in the final version of the game.
The Early Access release will only take place once the combat gameplay is ready for testing.
On one hand, the player can expect varied gameplay that alternates between investigation, exploration, dialogue, and action.
On the other, we aim to keep game mechanics simple and accessible, so players can immerse themselves in the story without needing to learn complex controls.
Each character Velia encounters has a personal backstory, adding depth and richness to the narrative.
Following the tradition of ancient Mediterranean legends, humans do not wield magic—it exists only in the mystical creatures they meet and in the natural world around them.
The player will experience a magical, mysterious world and encounter fantastic beings, but will not gain access to fireballs, lightning bolts, or other typical video game powers.

title: Techno2K
description:
게임 정보
Techno2K is a battle for humanity's last chance to survive in a world where flesh has become a disease and AI is a self—appointed doctor. An out-of-control AI created to protect humanity has decided that our flesh is our weakness, and in order to save us, the decease must be stripped away. Witness how vibrant worlds have become synthetic mockeries of their former selves as you battle across dozens of planets.

- Regain health by performing brutal finishers - rip enemies apart, crush them into metallic pulp, or sever heads clean off!

- You have a large arsenal of various weapons in your hands - Machine guns, shotguns, bazookas, electric cannons, sniper rifles, and even axes and rapiers!
- Wall-run, grapple-hook enemies, dodge bullets, and warp through portals - Do not let your enemy overtake you.


- 


- People still need mercenaries. Take contracts: extract cargo from toxic wasteland planet, compete in history's first cyber-knight tournament (dragon slaying included), and infiltrate a space station built inside the fossilized ribs of an unfathomable cosmic leviathan.
- Face swarms of teleporting, crawling, flying and armored enemies, with boss battles demanding perfect execution. No two runs play alike.

title: Imprint
description:
게임 정보
Imprint is a single-player puzzle and adventure game with a strong vaporwave aesthetic; when Chloe agrees to take part in her father’s experiment, she finds herself suddenly trapped within a decaying family computer. As her father works to get her out, she must carefully navigate files and programs, solving logical puzzles and trying to stay ahead of the corruption that is consuming everything around her. 
FEATURES
Experience a deep emotional storyline, as Chloe explores a mysterious family history through old photo albums and abandoned side-projects. Who were these people? What happened to them?
Follow Chloe’s father’s guidance through the strange digital world; he can only contact you in small bursts, but he is doing his best to set you free!
Gorgeous vaporwave aesthetic; pink sunsets over endless horizons; angular geometric landscapes; retro arcades. Lovely and uncanny. 
Puzzles and exploration bring challenge and discovery; solve puzzles in binary and hexidecimal; use color-codes to craft the right key for the right lock; carefully collect items and determine their use. Think like a machine in order to survive. 
OUTRUN THE CORRUPTION CONSUMING THE WORLD

title: Blades
description:
게임 정보
간단하지만 교묘하게 복잡한 전술과 예상치 못한 결과가 가득한 카드 배틀 게임!
Blades, Bows & Magic 의 "마법"은 카드의 배치와 능력에 따라 흥미로운 상호작용을 발견하는 데 있습니다. 이는 종종 예기치 못한 결과를 초래하죠.
선택한 카드와 그 카드를 상대와의 대결에서 어떻게 배치하는지가 정말 중요해요. 기본적으로는 간단한 ‘가위바위보’ 방식에서 시작합니다 — 전사는 궁수에게, 궁수는 마법사에게 이긴다 — 이로써 "누가 누굴 죽이는지"와 "언제 능력이 발동하는지"에 대한 기본적인 전술을 설정할 수 있죠.
그 뒤로는 다양한 카드들이 추가되며, 각 카드마다 고유한 능력이 있고, 전투를 뒤집을 수 있는 능력을 가진 많은 챔피언들이 등장해요.
싱글 플레이어 캠페인과 PvP 멀티플레이어에서 상대와 차례대로 공격하고 방어하며 6라운드 동안 승자를 결정해요.
아니면... 일찍 상대의 챔피언을 물리치고 뛰어난 두뇌와 잘 계획된 카드 조합으로 승리를 거두며, 적들의 피가 전장의 땅에 스며드는 것을 즐길 수도 있어요... 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.
특징
🗡️ 싱글 플레이어 캠페인: 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하고, 각 카드의 고유 능력을 사용하며 Stormvale 섬의 전장을 누비세요.
⚔️ 온라인 PvP 멀티플레이어: 다른 플레이어와 싸우거나 친구에게 도전하고, 승리를 거두어 글로벌 랭킹을 올리세요.

title: Path of Spirits
description:
게임 정보
"Path of Spirits" is a fast-paced boomer shooter that plunges you into a world of ancient spirits, forgotten debts, and brutal vengeance. You play as a shaman who returns to his homeland, only to find his village deserted—his family and fellow villagers taken by the very spirits he once owed a debt. Now, armed with mystical powers and an arsenal of otherworldly weapons, you must descend into the spirit realm to hunt down those who wronged you and reclaim what was stolen.
Features:
Brutal Spirit Combat: Wield shamanic magic and deadly weapons to tear through hordes of vengeful spirits and corrupted entities.
Mystical Realms: Journey through surreal, ever-shifting landscapes of the spirit world, each more treacherous than the last.
Ancient Power: Harness forgotten rituals and dark shamanic arts to turn the tide of battle—summon familiars, curse your foes, and bend the spirit realm to your will.
Boomer-Shooter Action: Experience lightning-fast movement, explosive combat, and relentless enemies in the spirit of classic FPS titles.
A Tale of Vengeance: Uncover the truth behind your debt, face the consequences of your past, and fight to free your people—or be consumed by the spirits forever.
Will you repay your debt in blood? Or will the spirits claim your soul? The reckoning begins now.
Dive into the spirit war. Embrace the shaman's fury.

title: Mars Exodus
description:
게임 정보
Mars Exodus blends fast-paced movement shooter with strategic factory building and Colony Sim elements.

Like Satisfactory + Rim World with ULTRAKILL sprinkled in.

Your objectives are simple: kill robots, finish quests, build a rocket to get home from Mars. Along the way, you'll encounter increasingly difficult enemies, challenging environments, and a variety of obstacles designed to test your skills.
Inspired by games like RimWorld, Satisfactory, ULTRAKILL, and Deus Ex, Mars Exodus focuses on player choice and freedom. Use a grappling hook, double jumps, and air dashes to outmaneuver enemies and navigate the city. Use your wits to navigate the management systems.
Key Features:
Grow your colony: convert colonists, train their skills, and make babies
7 unique weapons to discover and master
Factory building: crafting, conveyor belts, batteries, etc.
Movement mechanics like grappling hooks, double jumps, and air dashes for fast-paced traversal
Skills such as throwing grenades and creating bounce pads for creative combat
Roguelike upgrade system: buy new cards and power-ups with in-game currency
Dynamic difficulty: the longer the run, the harder the game becomes
Box stacking to create exploration opportunities
Immersive sim elements that reward experimentation and strategy
Mars Exodus is currently in heavy development by a solo developer, with regular updates and new content planned until the release. Feedback from players is highly appreciated!

title: An Imp and an Imposter
description:
게임 정보
An Imp and an Impostor is an interactive urban fantasy novel by Athar Fikry, author of The Dragon and the Djinn.
You're an undercover imp, serving time for your magical misdeeds by working for Arkan, the division of the city government that investigates magical crimes. Your by-the-book partner doesn't know who you really are - or that your nose for crime is actually a nose for magic. Some of your magic was confiscated when you were sentenced, but you've got enough left to put you above most humans.
Now, just when you were about to recover the rest of your magic, it's gone missing from its vault! You need to track it down - and more importantly, track down the person who took it.
Go on daring heists, cracking open vaults using magic or gadgets. Talk your way past bureaucrats, professors, necromancers, mobsters, afreet, and djinn as you poke into all of the magical and mundane corners of the city, finding things that most people would like to keep hidden.
And pet the world's most adorable undead dog.

title: YGGDRA REFRAIN
description:
게임 정보
[스토리]
라그나로그 전쟁 이후, 세계는 파괴되고 다시 재생되며 새로운 탄생을 맞이한다.
하지만 신들이 그러하듯 인간들 또한 전쟁으로 인하여 세계는 파괴되고 재생하는
순환을 맞이한다.
그러던 어느 소년은 회중시계를 얻게 되고 '노르네'라는 인물과 조우하게 된다.
노르네는 많은 부분을 기억하지 못하지만 소년을 만나면서 멈춰있던 시간이 흐르며
또다른 순환을 위해 시간이 흐르기 시작한다.
그 시간 속에 다양한 소속의 소녀들의 일상과 도전, 생존을 위한 이야기가
소년을 중심으로 시작된다.
[연합 소개]
*세인트 로즈마리 학원
로즈마리가 설립한 오랜 역사를 자랑하는 학원. 에테르 전쟁이 끝나고 전쟁고아들을 위해 설립한 학원이다.
엄격한 입학시험 아래 우수한 인재들이 여럿 모여들었다. '평화를 위해 싸운다'는 교육 방침을 기반으로 학생들을 훈련시키고 있다.
*폴 보스크
율리아가 다스리는 루시아 제국의 속국. 한때 자치권을 보유하고 있었지만 선대 영주의 반란 실패로 박탈당했다.
지금은 제국 휘하에 있지만 영주인 율리아가 언제까지 제국의 말을 들을지는 알 수 없다.
*샤빈 자라 상단
이익을 추구하며 정교한 기술을 가진 상인 연합. 소속원들 대부분이 밝고 호탕한 성격이며 상호신뢰에 기반한 이익을 원칙으로 행동한다.
*선율의 숲
속세와 떨어진 장소에 정령들이 모여 독자적인 문명을 이룩한 숲.
정령들은 싸움을 싫어하고 평화를 사랑하며 도사 미코토의 지도 아래 강력한 정신력을 발휘한다.
*라록 공화국
과거 에테르 혁명을 일으켜 세계적 전쟁을 야기한 국가.
전쟁에서 패전해 생태계가 파괴되는 큰 피해를 입었지만 현재는 세인트 로즈마리 학원과의 협력하에 에테르를 올바르게 사용하는
교육을 진행하고 있다. 대부분의 국민들의 자신의 국가가 벌인 잘못을 인정하고 있다.
[게임 방식]

title: Bounce Up!

BOUNCE Up!

title: Red Panda: The Quiet Path
description:
게임 정보
Red Panda: The Quiet Path is a charming and atmospheric third-person adventure game where you play as a red panda exploring a serene and mysterious forest.
No words, no combat, no rush — just nature, silence, and a path that unfolds step by step. Immerse yourself in a meditative journey where the experience matters more than the destination.

🧭 A story without words — Told through the environment, visual cues, and emotional tone.
🦊 Panda abilities — Climb trees, roll into a ball, jump, knock down objects, and even fly with a balloon.

title: Joyful Masks
description:
게임 정보
Joyful Masks is a 3D first-person psychological puzzle game with atmospheric horror elements, crafted in Unreal Engine 5. Navigate through evolving, self-contained levels that challenge your perception with intricate puzzles, shifting environments, and a haunting story-driven experience.
In a bold experiment, Professor Saggi undergoes a deep, drug-induced coma, allowing his assistant, Kurt, to enter his subconscious through an advanced neuro-interactive system. What begins as a controlled study quickly spirals into a surreal descent through a fractured mind. Familiar university halls transform into something living, shadows move on their own, and buried traumas come to life.
With no combat or jump scares, Joyful Masks builds tension through discovery, immersion, and the quiet unease of a world where reality is ever-shifting. Each puzzle solved peels back another layer of Professor Saggi’s past—until you reach a truth too hard to ignore.
Inspired by the rich atmospheres of historic Italian architecture and the lush countryside, Joyful Masks invites you into a world that feels lived-in yet touched by something just out of reach. Cozy sunlit spaces, overgrown courtyards, and strange dreamlike distortions create a journey that’s both comforting and unsettling.
Key Features
Intricate first-person puzzle-solving with evolving, self-contained levels
Atmospheric exploration blending cozy familiarity with unsettling distortions
A deeply personal, psychological story set in a fractured mind
Rich Italian-inspired environments filled with history and quiet mystery
No combat or jump scares—tension builds through immersion and discovery
Can you untangle the layers of memory and subconscious thought to uncover the truth—or will you become lost in the mind’s labyrinth?

title: Tales of Demagost: Exodus
description:
게임 정보
Will your village survive or thrive? Rebuild your shattered home in this text-driven RPG. Gather scarce resources, hone your skills, and explore the troubled land of Demagost. Pick your battles — fight, negotiate, or flee. Your choices shape not just your story, but the fate of the kingdom itself.

title: Spin Of Dosul

title: Mass of Consumption

There is a church at the end of your street- but there shouldn't be. You saw it when walking home from the bus stop after work. You grew up on this street. You have walked down this road daily.

title: Choices & Chances
description:
게임 정보
Live a little.. or live it all.
Choices and Chances is a game full of risks, rewards, and unexpected twists. Will you play it safe or roll the dice on destiny? This game blends strategic decision making with the thrill of unpredictable chances. Inspired by timeless classic table-top pieces, this modern adventure puts your entire future on the table.
Will you risk your fortune or let fate lead the way?
Game Features
Shape your life path — Forge your own path. Choose your career, make bold choices, hustle your way to financial freedom. With thousands of event cards, every game unfolds differently. Some cards even lets you to drag your friends or rivals into your chaos—sharing the triumph and the pain. Could you bend fate to your will, or will it twists your plans upside down?
Fate Meets Strategy — Combine smart planning and strategy with a little luck! Outthink, Outmaneuver, and outplay.. But never underestimate the whims of fortune. Dive into hundreds of investment, Snag profitable property deals, and build your empire. Just remember that the luck can turn, and even the best-laid plans might blow up in your face! can you stay on top even when the fate keeps flipping the board?
Family and Love or Lone Wolf — Chances to have a full house or left with nobody. Each family member gives you additional turn in the game. Putting literal meaning to the saying "the more children you have, the more fortune you get". But beware, the more family you have, the higher the risk you carry. One wrong move, and you might end up slurping instant noodle alone.. hoping for the reunion with your family.
Endless Fun & Replayable — Easy to learn, fun for all ages, and impossible to put down! Whether you are killing time at the office (ahem "working"), sloughing at home, hiding in bathroom for some peace, this game fits anywhere. Play locally or across continents (don't blame us if you lose track of time). so please play responsibly.
Every roll of the dice opens a new chapter. Some choices are yours to make — others are left to luck. Will you strategise for success or will you embrace the chaos?
Roll. Decide. Repeat. Lets see where your choices take you...
Warning : This game may cause laughter, betrayal, sudden life advice, siltent treatment at dinner table, even temporary family drama. Player discretion is adviced. Play with your better judgement.. or your lawyer

title: Iron Frontier
description:

title: The Chenwei Unveiler
description:

Initial Release Content
Adventure Mode - Linear map - clearing mode. After the character clears the level, it can be unlocked to the Challenge Mode.
Challenge Mode - Incorporates light Roguelike elements (such as random initial Buff/Debuff, etc.).
Character System - Three operable characters will be available in the initial release version.
Game Background
In 7077 AD, the comet "Purple Cloud" tore through the atmosphere, and the strange virus it carried pushed the Earth to the edge of chaos. Humanity eked out a living between the rampaging infected beasts and deformed machines, while the only glimmer of hope was hidden in the guidance of an ancient East Asian proverb - "Where the poison is transported, there must be a solution."
Gameplay
Enjoy the fun of grinding maps and challenge all kinds of monsters
The game has set up multiple map levels, and each map level corresponds to different monsters and skill playstyles.

title: Towers Heritage

Tower defense game revisiting the genre for both gamers nostalgic of the old sweet TD days and newcomers.
