title: KINSHFT
description:
게임 정보
KINSHFT is a sci-fantasy adventure where you play as three members of the same family, each with their own unique abilities and play styles. Spread in three wildly different eras of a future Earth, they are still connected by a mysterious force that allows them to work as a team across a vast span of time.
FEATURES:
You will encounter many mysteries across time that cannot be solved with a single character's abilities. Shift between characters and their eras and use each one's unique skills to work together to find a solution. As you journey deeper into these worlds and solve even greater mysteries you will unlock new abilities for each character.
The decisions you make as a player can have an affect on other eras in time. Some are like a ripple, destroying a bridge in one era that cuts off enemy access to an area in another. Others are like a wave, changing how a faction that once considered you an enemy now sees you as a friend.
In your travels you will encounter many new species and cultures, those that have evolved over the decades and centuries altered by the Eros impact, and those that have reached Earth from distant galaxies searching for what the asteroid may have left behind. Befriend and help the locals, meet and influence the different factions and come face to face with tremendous bosses. How those encounters end is up to you!
EXPLORE AND COLLECT - Delve into the hidden depths and dark corners of the world to collect valuable relics of the past.
CRAFT AND TRADE - Craft and trade for new and powerful items to gain new abilities allowing you to explore deeper into each new world. 
BUILD AND GROW - Trade resources and aid the inhabitants of Bastion City to help it rebuild and grow, gaining you access to new locations, shops, adventures and mysteries.
CHARACTERS: 
Each character has unique abilities that fit their individual play styles, some available from the start, others that need to be discovered, researched or unlocked. Each ability is designed to be used both in exploration and in combat, allowing players to decide how and when to use each one.
NILES - With a newfound ability to control the very forces of the universe, Niles uses fringe science to manipulate the world around him as if by magic. Waving his staff he can capture and control particles to create fantastic "Science Spells"

title: Crisis Reign Orbis
description:
게임 정보
Embark on the Crisis Story - 
Play the main story of Azer and travel through several stages, fight against enemies, talk with the locals, solve puzzles and rebuild the support of your team.

 Collect the late professor's 'Legacy Discs' scattered between the various lands. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and create alliances in order to uncover the secrets needed to save the land of Orbis.

title: Techno2K

-

- Face swarms of teleporting, crawling, flying and armored enemies, with boss battles demanding perfect execution. No two runs play alike.

title: Witchbound
description:
게임 정보
Witchbound
Haunt the mansion, chase intruders and embrace the haunting, and defend your home from exorcism.
About the Game
Witchbound turns the classic horror genre on its head, placing YOU in the spectral shoes of the ghost. Guard your lair from unwelcome intruders who dare to disrupt your eternal peace. This isn’t just a fight for survival—it’s a fight to preserve your haunted sanctuary.
In this reverse horror experience, players take on the role of a powerful, vengeful spirit bound to an ancient, abandoned mansion. Your mission? Terrify and eliminate intruders who seek to banish you from your domain. As you patrol the eerie halls of your home, AI-controlled NPC players will collaborate to complete tasks that unravel the exorcism ritual.
Key Features
The Ghost’s Perspective: You’re no helpless victim. Harness your supernatural abilities to stalk, terrify, and dispatch those who dare enter your domain.
Dynamic Cat-and-Mouse Gameplay: Outsmart the intruders as they work together to cleanse the mansion. Strike fear into their hearts, isolate them, and remove them one by one.
Evolving Challenges: As the exorcism progresses, NPC intruders grow more determined and resourceful. Adapt your strategies to keep your home under your control.
Atmospheric Haunting: Explore your cursed mansion, rich with secrets, chilling visuals, and immersive soundscapes that heighten the suspense.
Game Modes: Unlock Veilbound, a challenging mode where the line between the physical world and the supernatural thins, amplifying both your powers and the intruders’ resolve.
Gameplay Overview
For the Intruders: Complete ritualistic tasks scattered throughout the mansion while evading the ghost. Work together—or fall one by one.
For the Ghost: Use stealth, fear, and precision to hunt the intruders. Discover weaknesses in their plans and strike before they finish the exorcism.
Can you preserve the peace of your eternal afterlife, or will you be cast out into the void?
Witchbound awaits. Are you ready to haunt?

title: Dimension L
description:
게임 정보
Dimension L is an online turn-based strategy RPG where players enter an alternative temporal dimension. In this universe, known as Dimension L, dinosaurs never went extinct and have evolved, developing elemental powers. These creatures, called L, have created an advanced civilization, forming small villages organized with their own laws and traditions. However, peace is threatened when invaders from other dimensions attack their land.
To defend their home, the village leader, KinLoRai, organizes the Duty Cup, a tournament to gather the most powerful warriors. Each player takes on the role of an L fighter who competes in the tournament and manages their squad to lead it to victory, facing powerful rivals and aspiring to become the ultimate defender of their world.
Key Features:
Turn-based strategic battles: Engage in tactical grid combat where positioning and planning are crucial for victory.
Online multiplayer: Compete against other players in the tournament to prove who is the strongest L warrior.
Evolution and elemental powers: Enhance your L fighters to unlock unique abilities based on elemental mastery. Form a squad that maximizes the special skills of each recruit.
Alternate universe: Dimension L is a mysterious world filled with evolved creatures, reimagining the story of dinosaurs.
Grand-scale tournaments: Compete in the Duty Cup and rise through the ranks to become the defender of Dimension L.
Immerse yourself in a world of parallel dimensions, evolutionary mysteries, and epic tournaments. Do you have what it takes to save Dimension L and protect it from invaders?

title: Blades
description:
게임 정보
간단하지만 교묘하게 복잡한 전술과 예상치 못한 결과가 가득한 카드 배틀 게임!
Blades, Bows & Magic 의 "마법"은 카드의 배치와 능력에 따라 흥미로운 상호작용을 발견하는 데 있습니다. 이는 종종 예기치 못한 결과를 초래하죠.
선택한 카드와 그 카드를 상대와의 대결에서 어떻게 배치하는지가 정말 중요해요. 기본적으로는 간단한 ‘가위바위보’ 방식에서 시작합니다 — 전사는 궁수에게, 궁수는 마법사에게 이긴다 — 이로써 "누가 누굴 죽이는지"와 "언제 능력이 발동하는지"에 대한 기본적인 전술을 설정할 수 있죠.
그 뒤로는 다양한 카드들이 추가되며, 각 카드마다 고유한 능력이 있고, 전투를 뒤집을 수 있는 능력을 가진 많은 챔피언들이 등장해요.
싱글 플레이어 캠페인과 PvP 멀티플레이어에서 상대와 차례대로 공격하고 방어하며 6라운드 동안 승자를 결정해요.
아니면... 일찍 상대의 챔피언을 물리치고 뛰어난 두뇌와 잘 계획된 카드 조합으로 승리를 거두며, 적들의 피가 전장의 땅에 스며드는 것을 즐길 수도 있어요... 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.
특징
🗡️ 싱글 플레이어 캠페인: 새로운 카드를 잠금 해제하고, 각 카드의 고유 능력을 사용하며 Stormvale 섬의 전장을 누비세요.
⚔️ 온라인 PvP 멀티플레이어: 다른 플레이어와 싸우거나 친구에게 도전하고, 승리를 거두어 글로벌 랭킹을 올리세요.

title: Corner Shop: NightShift
description:
게임 정보


당신의 일은 단순히 물건을 채우는 게 아닙니다. 스스로를 지키는 것이죠. 근무 시간 동안 재고를 관리하고, 물건을 받고, 손님을 응대하며 가게를 유지해야 합니다. 하지만 피로, 스트레스, 그리고 편집증은 수익만큼이나 중요한 요소입니다. 피곤할수록 현실이 왜곡됩니다 — 반응 속도는 느려지고, 그림자가 움직이며, CCTV는 당신의 기억과 다른 장면을 보여줍니다.
야간 근무는 단순한 일이 아닙니다. 생존입니다.
스토리 중심의 상점 시뮬레이터에 심리 공포 요소를 더한 게임.

진열대를 채우고, 바닥을 닦고, 그 빌어먹을 조명을 고쳐라. 배송을 받고, 상품을 스캔하고, 손님을 응대하라. 끝났어? 좋아, 이제 매장을 업그레이드하자: 새로운 알람, 작동하는 CCTV, 더 튼튼한 자물쇠. 시간을 관리해라. 돈도. 정신 상태도. 아무도 도와주지 않아. 약값도 스스로 내야 해. 직장을… 아니면 정신을 잃지 마라.

title: Tomboy Adventure 2
description:
게임 정보
A sequel to the critically acclaimed "Tomboy Adventure!" is finally here!
Living in the middle of nowhere can have its benefits. Just you, the sea and ice cream from the vending machine up-hill. No one to bother you. Well, aside from this one girl that keeps showing up whether you want it or not...
Summer is getting close!

Tomboy Adventure 2 is an interaction driven dating sim where through your choices you unsuccessfully try to romance your companion. Exploring the island unlocks new dialogue options, outfits and interactions, creating new opportunities for getting your feelings across. Perseverance is key!
Features

title: Delirium: Echoes of the Domino
description:
게임 정보
Delirium: Echoes of the Domino는 모든 타일이 혼돈을 불러일으킬 수 있는 최면에 걸린 뒤틀린 도미노 로그라이크 게임입니다. 플레이할 때마다 바뀌는 게임에서 조각을 결합하고, 초자연적인 힘을 활성화하고, 디지털 신들과 맞서세요.
전략적인 플레이를 구축하고, 규칙을 깨는 와일드 카드를 발견하고, 보드의 규칙을 바꾸는 조건에서 살아남으세요. 보이는 것과는 전혀 다른 복고풍 미래 세계에 들어서면서 베팅하고, 위험을 감수하고, 불가능한 콤보를 찾아보세요.
보드를 마스터하고, 함정을 피하고, 규칙을 마음대로 바꾸는 독특한 보스를 만나보세요. 각 게임을 통해 악순환을 깨거나 영원히 갇혀버리는 상황에 한 걸음 더 다가갈 수 있습니다.

title: Sokoku
description:
게임 정보
Sokoku is a block-pushing game with a twist: you not only push blocks, you are one. Specifically, you are a die that rolls over itself, changing its top face with every move.
You'll need to plan your path carefully so that all numbers end where they have to, including the one on top of yourself, while you interact with all kinds of cubes and mechanics.
Dozens of puzzles will test your logic, patience, and spatial thinking. Can you roll your way to the solution?

title: Winter Heat
description:
게임 정보
Winter Heat is a no-choices kinetic novel game about love in the internet age.
Javiera Vera is a freelancer living in the sweltering summer of Santiago, in Chile.
Fukkoshi Shio is an office worker living in the snowy rural town of Miyazu, Kyoto, in Japan.
The two are long-time internet friends, living across the world, across time zones, but with a bond as strong as the fiber optic cables connecting them. How will that bond transform, though, during one special December?
Follow Javi and Shio through their online chats and video calls as they grow even closer together.
Features:
A fluffy, fun romance story across continents.
Totally linear storyline with some unlockable chapters.
2-3 hours of gameplay.
Bonus game included: Oomfie RPG!

title: City Car Driving 2.0
description:
게임 정보
City Car Driving 2.0 is a realistic car simulator that will help novice drivers master basic car driving skills in conditions as close to reality as possible.

Artificial intelligence monitors compliance with traffic rules, player behavior on the road, which helps to consolidate practical skills and theoretical knowledge of traffic rules.

Cars physical model realism and dynamic weather conditions provide a deep immersion in the World, challenging even experienced drivers.


KEY FEATURES
• Elaborated game controls that include both manual and automatic gearbox, and end-to-end driver preparation
• Player’s car customization
• Choice of common vehicle types
• Car simulator physics and ambient sounds as realistic as possible
• Dynamically changing times of the day and weather conditions
• Diverse environment for exploration: city, forest, etc.
• Numerous game modes

title: Clockwork Ambrosia
description:
게임 정보
Knowledge is a gift, but ego is a curse - don't become the lesson.

Thrilling and empowering, Clockwork Ambrosia is a vibrant fusion of metroidvania and 2D shooter gameplay with a weapon-building twist.



Clockwork Ambrosia's combat mechanics thrill to life as players piece together unique weapons with game-changing modifications and synergies.



Rig up endless combinations of powers: screen-filling shot splitters, devastating missile strikes and armor-piercing sniper rounds.



Exploration and discovery drive the world of Clockwork Ambrosia. Brilliant pixel art takes players above the clouds to the steampunk wonders of a cloud city, through the lush and gorgeous mushroom forest, and down below to the moody underbelly of the sunken kingdoms - and much more.



Players do not work alone. They will entreat a cast of characters, from rogue - but benevolent - AI companions to bumbling mushroom folk, to overcome the dangers of the island.



Walk the forbidden biomes of Aspida as Iris, an itinerant airship engineer trying to escape the island after a near-miss airship crash. The plucky engineer soon finds herself caught up in a mystery spawning eons when the island's populace disappears, seemingly replaced by malevolent robots and cyborgs. The true architect of these plans, however, will draw Iris towards a truth she may not want to face...

title: DSS 2: War Industry
description:
게임 정보
무한한 군대, 끝없는 도시, 비교할 수 없는 자원 시뮬레이션을 갖춘 혁신적인 실시간 대전략 게임입니다. 전쟁 게임을 재정의하고 규모와 깊이의 한계를 넓히도록 설계되었습니다.
특징
도시 건설: 전쟁 노력을 지원하기 위해 도시를 건설하고 발전시키세요.
방어: 요새화 및 경비소로 방어를 강화하세요.
자원 관리: 원활한 재료 공급을 보장하기 위해 생산 체인과 배송 시스템을 설정하세요.
자동화: 정복에 바쁜 동안 중세 산업을 계속 운영하도록 설정하세요.
군대 제어: 지도 전반에 걸쳐 군대를 지휘하면서 잘 공급하고 먹이세요.
다양한 군사 유닛: 각각의 장단점을 가진 다양한 유닛 유형을 배치하세요.
외교 시스템: 다른 이들을 설득하여 당신의 원인에 동참하게 하세요.
놀라운 규모: 수십만 명의 군인과 노동자가 실시간으로 시뮬레이션됩니다.

title: House Of Decay
description:
게임 정보
악마의 세계에 어서 오세요! 어떻게 여기까지 왔는진 모르겠지만, 정말 멍청한 짓이었어. 동생이 악마에게 잡혀간 건 유감이지만… 정말로 그를 찾을 수 있을 거라고 생각해? 그럴 가치가 있긴 한 거야? 어쨌든 내 알 바 아냐. 네가 할 일은 이 멋진 세계를 탐험하는 것뿐… 운이 좋다면 살아남거나 누군가를 만날지도 몰라.
게임 특징:


- 3D 액션 플랫폼 메트로배니아!
- 캐릭터 외형이 업그레이드마다 진화!
- 8개 이상의 탐험 지역 (체험판 포함: 1개 지역 + 보너스 스테이지)



- 반응형 컨트롤
- 감각적인 레트로 비주얼
- 다양한 지역별 몬스터



- 숨겨진 비밀 대방출
- 다양한 유형의 업그레이드
- 펫 수집 시스템



- 상점에서 구매하는 캐릭터 & 펫 커스터마이징 아이템 (스킨, 모자)
- 완벽한 최적화
- 게임패드 & Steam Deck 완전 지원

title: Fantasy World Manager
description:
게임 정보
Build a massive-scale MMO-themed Fantasy World where you design all Creatures, Objects, Quests , Events and Dungeons and watch the Inhabitants of your World embark on Adventures!
Build a massive Fantasy World on a 2500x2000 Canvas!
World:
Build on a 5.000.000 Tiles big Canvas
Choose between an empty and randomly generated World
7 biomes ( final game will have 14)
Create Points of Interest to make the World feel alive!

title: Hillshade Farm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome back to your roots.
🌾 A Farm You Build, A Life You Shape
You’ve inherited a quiet piece of land and a rundown farm. It’s not much at first, but it’s yours.
There’s a lot to fix, a lot to build, and even more to figure out.
Work at your own pace, set your own goals, and make something real. One day, one choice, one goal at a time.
This is where it starts.
🌱 A World Where Everything You Do Matters
Farming here isn’t about repetitive clicks, it's about meaningful choices. Choose exactly where, when and how to plant your seeds, nurture your crops through sunny days and heavy rains, and watch your farm transform season by season. With over 30 different plant species to learn and grow, your land is yours to shape freely.

title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
description:
게임 정보
주요 특징
일부 NPC를 위한 고급 AI:
일부 NPC는 세계와 상호작용하고, 적은 긴 전투 중에 당신의 전투 스타일과 마법을 기억합니다. 만약 평범한 마을 주민이나 여행자가 죽으면, 그들과의 연결은 영원히 사라집니다.
혁신적인 마법 시스템:
몰입감을 높이는 새로운 인터랙티브 주문 방식.
매력적인 스토리라인:
독특한 캐릭터와 흥미진진한 사건이 가득한 스토리를 따라가세요.
선택의 영향:
당신의 결정이 스토리의 전개와 세계의 변화에 큰 영향을 미쳐, 매번 새로운 경험을 제공합니다.
다양한 주문:
다양한 주문을 발견하고 습득하여 나만의 마법적 정체성을 만들어보세요.
캐릭터 강화:
게임 스타일에 맞춰 캐릭터를 강화하세요.
최적화된 자원:
최상의 성능을 위한 세심하게 최적화된 자원으로 고품질 그래픽을 즐기세요.
도시에서는 통치자 외에도 가장 강력한 마법사들이 존경받습니다. 일부는 주머니를 금으로 채우려 하고 있는 반면, 시골의 가난한 사람들은 약탈하고 여성들을 번식하기 위해 납치하는 고블린과 싸우고 있습니다. 그 사이 성 주변에서는 갑자기 오크와 다른 악한 존재들이 나타나기 시작했습니다. 이 혼란 속에서 당신은 가족을 구해야 합니다. 하지만 사람들은 서로 전쟁을 시작했고, 누군가는 금지된 흑마법을 익혀서 무언가 끔찍한 것을 소환했습니다...
가장 위대한 마법사가 되어, 여러 가지 조합 가능한 마법을 익히고, 성을 방어하거나 포위하며, 가족의 행복을 최우선으로 하는 캐릭터의 매혹적인 이야기를 따라가세요.
autokwd: World of Magic: Rise of Magic

title: Omega Redux
description:
게임 정보
"Just one hour. Just one task: E.R.E. — Explore, Retrieve, Escape. Doesn’t sound too hard… unless you’re trying to find a relic hunter. Nobody wants to go there for your stupid stuff! But I will."
OMEGA REDUX is an episodic adventure with exploration elements, where you play as a relic hunter and his robotic companion. Dive into doomed worlds exactly 60 minutes before their total annihilation—and race against time to escape with a priceless artifact and complete your mission.
IN EACH EPISODE, YOU WILL:
Track down a bizarre artifact requested by passionate collectors of oddities.
Discover and enjoy unique vehicles—from a horse and sports car to a helicopter and hot air balloon—each tailored to the episode’s setting.
Explore an open world filled with secrets and the final stories of people doomed by an impending apocalypse.
Escape just before disaster strikes to survive, complete your mission, and deliver the artifact to the client.
GAME FEATURES
Apocalyptic Setting
A sci-fi journey through colossal disasters that blur the line between awe and terror—an experience you can live through, both literally and figuratively, only in a video game.
Cinematic Finales
Witness realistic and epic apocalyptic events: a falling mega-Earth, an approaching insatiable black hole, terrifying nuclear blasts, or a mile-high tsunami.
Open-World Exploration
Diverse open-world maps with multiple paths and no two episodes alike. Played in both first- and third-person, you’ll travel from peaceful mountain towns to perilous jungles on the far side of the universe.
Robot Companion Interaction
Switch perspectives to play as the robot for artifact scanning and environmental analysis, or interact with it as the relic hunter. Work together to solve puzzles that require both characters.
Variety of Vehicles and Mounts

title: The Legend of Pamperlotte
description:
게임 정보
The Legend of Pamperlotte is a tactical RPG with a unique twist: the "Tactical Combo" system! Depending on your character and class, you can have up to three actions per turn that can be anything! You can run to an enemy, hit him and run away! Or hit an enemy, run and take a potion... The more you use an action per turn, the more efficient it becomes. Another unique feature is the "Turn Again" system. If you defeat an enemy, your combo counter refills and you can act all over again and break havoc in the enemy camp! But beware, the enemy has all those same quirks as you do!
Pick your best teams among over 10 classes with 50 different unique skills and techniques. Improve your stats in the skill tree and get to know your teammates with character episodes.
In a world divided among humans, demons and animals, the war is on the verge of breaking out. Follow Hiro and his friends to prevent the catastrophe and bring peace in the Island of Pamperlotte!

title: Terminal Defense
description:
게임 정보
Gameplay
Never ending waves of letters will keep coming. It is your mission to stop them from corrupting your terminal. How high of a score can you get?
Maps

Maps will be procedurally generated.
Towers

Unique towers to aid you in defeating the evil letters.

title: Uagi-Saba 2
description:
게임 정보
Uagi-Saba 2 is a complex creature care/breeding sim inspired by some of my favorite artificial life sims from when I was a child.

Watch your creatures hatch from eggs and raise them to adults. Creatures can see, hear, smell and think for themselves and are all born with their own unique genes/personalities. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. They can learn from experiences, form relationships with other creatures and breed. Breed strong family lines through selective breeding and find rare mutations after multiple generations. Laugh and interact with your creature and cry when they reach the end...



Features/Mechanics
Explore
A variety of biomes to explore. Snowy drifts. crystal caves, forgotten mines, magma vents and alien ruins.

title: Automaton Heart
description:
게임 정보
Automaton Heart is an adventure game set in an esoteric world. Uncover the history of the place you find yourself trapped in during an expedition to find your creator, learn about your origins, and stabilize the planet's chaotic ecosystem.
Wander through ancient ruins, natural environments, and colossal structures built by the 'constructs', a group of synthetic beings that live forever.

title: Final Remedy
description:
게임 정보
Overview

Final Remedy is an atmospheric, story-rich walking simulator with some puzzle elements and crafting mechanics. Solve the mystery, survive, avoid the enemies, or defeat them and escape!

Story

"It's cold! I'm cold! I am very cold! Is that snow?
Where am I? Who am I? How did I get here?"

You wake up in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how you got there or who you are.

Your first priority is to figure out where you are and why you're there. As you begin to unravel the mystery of your surroundings, you'll realize that your only hope of escape is to find a way out of this strange world. But it won't be easy – you'll need to use all your wits and resources to survive and find your way home.

title: Crystal Ball Critters
description:
게임 정보
Roll, jump, ride, glide and fly in this platformer racing game. All from inside a crystal ball!
Unlike most vehicles, a ball does not have a front end; rather, its front end is where its speeding towards!
No need to steer a car back and forth. You can turn around and build up speed in any direction you wish. Racing through platforming sections; even vertically.
Drive masterfully using simple and intuitive controls to keep your speed high with up to 5 strangers or friends.
Crystal Ball Critters features beautiful environments and worlds to race across. Full of original gimmicks and secrets to keep things fresh and stay ahead of the race. All matter of colorful critters competing for recognition from the most evil (actually nicest) villain that the universe has ever had.
All you need is a jumping and rolling to access all of the game's movement. But controlling that movement to its full potential and maintaining your speed flawlessly is an art of its own.
Across the worlds of Crystal Ball Critters, you will encounter Mana Orbs.
Picking one up will give you a burst of speed; giving you an opportunity to turn instantly and change your trajectory, allowing skilled players to make sharp turns without slowing down, and rewarding skill in ways that don't require any strange input or training!
All of it comes naturally by playing.
Perfect for players looking to jump straight into a game without waiting, and also those that want to hone their skill for faster and faster times in the solo modes!
✦ What This Game Is Not

title: Harbor
description:
게임 정보
Harbor에서 당신의 유일한 목표는 생존입니다. 포스트 아포칼립스 무정부 상태의 숨막히는 분위기 속에서 제한된 자원에 접근하고 가진 모든 것을 보호해야 합니다.
당신은 단지 배고픔과 목마름만 직면하지 않을 것입니다! 동맹을 맺고, 쉼터를 건설하며, 다른 사람들과 거래할 수 있습니다. 이 오픈 월드에서는 모든 것이 당신의 죽음을 기다리고 있습니다. 민주주의도, 규칙도 없습니다. 단 하나의 안전 지대: HARBOR.
주변의 물건을 변형하여 생존에 도움을 받고 환경을 탐색하십시오.
수집한 자원을 통해 도구, 무기, 의류 및 기타 필수 아이템을 제작할 수 있습니다.
게임에서 가장 중요한 것은 깨끗한 피와 연료입니다.
Harbor 구역으로 가서 임무를 수행하고 자원을 거래하며 제한된 시간 동안 안전 지대 내에서 캐릭터의 안전을 확보하십시오.
귀중한 자원을 제공할 수 있는 전투 트럭과 열차가 있지만, 이를 잡으려면 차량이 필요하다는 것을 잊지 마십시오.

title: Graviton 引力子
description:
게임 정보
A 2D platform puzzle game based on gravity control, rigorous yet full of surprises, reveals the laws governing the operation of the world under the existence of non-existent physical laws, and enables you to understand everything that happens in the place you are in during the journey.
Currently included mechanisms:
1. Anti-gravity: Completely freely control the direction of gravity (up or down), which also affects the behavior of all objects in space. Utilize this point and combine with your physical intuition to cross obstacles.
2. Anti-matter: Anti-matter is subject to gravity opposite to that of positive matter. Under the premise of gravity manipulation, there are more variations, and physical phenomena that do not exist in reality emerge (only experienced in the demo version).
3. Magnetic field: Can pull metal objects to move. The combination of magnetic force and gravity makes the levels more diverse.
4. Gravity field: You will automatically switch gravity within the field, but you cannot freely switch gravity; the limitation of basic abilities will force you to plan your action scheme before entering the field.
5. The Mirror: Cooperate with the mirror-like form of yourself. He will imitate your behavior, but due to terrain limitations, there will be different degrees of asynchrony. Utilize this to cross obstacles that cannot be crossed by yourself alone.
... More mechanisms are under development and this description will be gradually improved as it is updated.

title: Floorball Practice
description:
게임 정보
Floorball Practice
Step into the immersive world of Floorball Practice, the ultimate training ground for Floorball enthusiasts! Built on the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5, this game pushes the boundaries of realism with ray tracing, lumen lighting, and detailed characters. Designed to fine-tune your Floorball skills, this Early Access title offers an open-world experience like no other—laying the foundation for the next phase in Floorball gaming.
Key Features
Explore an Open World
Travel through a sprawling open world featuring multiple Floorball halls connected by a train system. Venture into lush forests to jog or run, boosting your stamina while taking in stunning visuals across a dynamic weather system with a fully functioning day and night cycle.
Master Your Skills
Practice like a pro with objectives and skill-based activities designed to refine your Floorball techniques.
Practice shooting with customizable sticks, balls, rinks, goals, and Floorball fields—designed with gear you can unlock and arrange to your liking.
Unlock advanced animations and shooting finishes to perfect your style.
Customize Your Experience
Choose between male or female characters, with options for left- or right-handed playstyles.
Build your identity with a wide range of clothing, sticks, and training gear available through an in-game currency system.
Use the in-game phone system to order gear, set GPS destinations, manage playlists, and more.
Practice Alone or with a Friend
Switch seamlessly between first-person and third-person perspectives to fully immerse yourself in the action. Play solo, or share the Floorball journey with a friend or sibling in mode.

title: Paralives
description:
게임 정보
Paralives is an upcoming doll house life simulation indie game for PC and Mac. Build your dream house, create some characters and manage their lives the way you want inside their homes and all around an open world town!
Dreaming of building your perfect house but need the right tools?
No problem! Paralives comes with innovative tools to create grid-less constructions, curved walls, resizable objects, split level floors, custom shaped stairs, full color/texture customization and much, much more!
What about creating a unique Parafolk?
Paralives comes with an advanced character creator including a height slider, resizable facial and body features, full color customization and complex personalities. From head to toe, you can really decide it all!

title: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld
description:
게임 정보
In that era of epidemic, I, who lived alone, could not escape and collapsed alone in the apartment. In a trance, I suddenly found myself in a black and white world, where there were people who gathered here for different reasons, a mysterious girl, and a group of mysteries and demons beyond cognition.
"Work together or kill each other"
The girl gives us hope to return to the human world, but also brings us harsh and frightening conditions. Should we follow our instincts and continue to maintain the kindness of the human world, or do everything for the illusory hope? In this ambiguous "City God's Residence", what is right? What is evil? Everything here has turned into chaos.
"Resurrection" is a suspenseful text adventure game. Players search for the truth of human heart hidden in the puzzles in an alternative Chinese-style fantasy dream woven by Chinese mysticism, religion, and folklore.The gameplay functions of the game are mainly divided into several parts: level options, plot reasoning, level decryption, and map exploration.
autokwd: 死者还阳Escape from the Underworld

title: Mega Mouse
description:
게임 정보
Mega Mouse is a 3rd Person Action/Adventure game, set in a haunting dreamscape dimension occupied by the Shadow Cats.
Jack was an ordinary mouse, haunted by his nightmares - until one night, Jack became aware he was dreaming and transformed into MEGA MOUSE.
Experience the wonders of the Shadow Realm - a world between worlds - and it's many unique challenges. 
Use your Laser Rifle & Rocket Launcher to fight the Shadow Cats.
Explore a large variety of traps, puzzles and abstract challenges.
Run, fly and cruise through the Shadow Realm, as Mega Mouse takes on variety of forms.
Linear, arcade like gameplay with intuitive control and non-stop action.
GOAL: To break free from the control of the Shadow Cats and escape the Shadow Realm.


In a world between worlds, there are entities known as "Shadow Cats".
Take control of Mega Mouse in this 3rd person action shooter, as you seek to escape their labyrinths - learning along the journey that reality is not exactly what it appears to be.

title: Spellbind Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Follow me in twitter for news:



Description;

‣  Strategy and planning are the keys when playing Spellbind Tactics, each character has certain set of movements that when used properly can lead to a powerful game plan, every character is designed to support each other in order to achieve effective synergies and movements. Your capacity when executing your game plan and your ability to react to your oponent's will be decisive in order to win.

About the game:

‣ Multiplayer tactics based.
‣ One vs One onlie matchups.
‣ Based on skills and decisions.


‣  Each character has a unique set of abilities, choose wisely how to combine them!



‣  Plan your attack and your defense, adapt to the moves of your opponent!



‣  Combine different characters and abilities to unlock powerful effects!

title: Spell Slide
description:
게임 정보
Push letters to form words in Spell Slide—a unique word game with two distinct modes. In Creative mode, discover as many words as you can to boost your score and unlock new levels. In Puzzle mode, each world introduces new mechanics: from bespoke single-solution challenges, to puzzles where spelling specific words opens doors, to strategy levels with companion robots, and even cryptic clue-based conundrums. Whether you're into freeform wordplay or structured problem-solving, Spell Slide lets you play your way.

title: Ash and Flame
description:
게임 정보
When the world is engulfed in flame and hope turns to ash, every moment shapes destiny. Step into the epic fantasy "Ash and Flame" — a cinematic adventure where your choices change everything.
You are Raynar Talvord, a war veteran longing to forget a bloodstained past. But ancient evil has awakened, threatening to destroy everything you hold dear. Unite humans, elves, and dwarves — or doom the world to eternal darkness under the Flame of Ash and its ominous leader, the Black Rider.
Key Features:
• 25 Prologue Outcomes – Your early choices instantly affect the lives of 11 characters and the entire story.
• – Face harsh moral dilemmas that test your beliefs and convictions.
• – Explore stunning locations, from burning villages to ancient fortresses.
• – Discover the pain of assassin Kaira, the hope of young Brenn, and the unshakable will of Lord Edric.
• – Powered by Unreal Engine 5.4, with filmic presentation and a powerful mix of orchestral and rapcore music.
• – Feel the intensity of large-scale fights where every move reshapes the world.

title: Jamir
description:
게임 정보
BASE WARS MODE

3개 팀이 기지전에 참가하여 주발전기에 가장 큰 피해를 준 1개 팀이 주 기지를 장악하고, 선두팀이 다른 2개 팀 앞에서 일정 시간 버틸 수 있으면 기지전이 종료되고 챔피언 팀이 됩니다. 보석으로 수여됩니다. FPP 및 TPP의 두 가지 보기 유형을 기반으로 15, 30, 45, 60 또는 75명의 플레이어 기본 전쟁 경기에 참여할 수 있습니다. 충분한 수의 매치 플레이어가 입장하면 기지 전쟁이 자동으로 시작됩니다.
DEATHMATCH FREE FOR ALL
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
TEAM DEATHMATCH
목표는 라운드당 10분 동안 다른 팀 플레이어를 최대한 많이 죽이는 것입니다. 업그레이드되고 더 강한 플레이어를 죽이면 더 많은 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.
SURVIVAL
플레이어가 가능한 한 생물의 파도에서 살아남아야 하는 협동 게임 모드입니다. 3가지 유형의 생물이 있으며 각 유형을 죽이면 파도의 강도에 따라 다른 양의 보석을 얻을 수 있습니다.

title: The Silent Catalyst
description:
게임 정보
What do your dreams tell you?

The Silent Catalyst is a first-person psychological horror experience where every room is a puzzle and every puzzle is a piece of you.
Play into the fragmented psyche of a mind on the edge. Each level unfolds a different psychological state, a phobia, or a scar from the past. Solve surreal, unnerving puzzles to progress, unlocking rooms that whisper memories, twist reality, and pull you deeper into something you're not sure you want to understand.
There are no second chances. Once a room is completed, it's gone just like a dream you can't return to. Tools exist, but they're fleeting. Use what the environment gives you before it slips away. Narration, scattered clues, and distorted environments guide your descent.
This horror doesn't scream, it lingers.

title: Saturday Super Day
description:
게임 정보
Saturday Super Day is a point and click exploratory choose your own adventure game that was prototyped in PowerPoint.
You play as Bobbi who wakes on a mid 90s Saturday morning with a mission: To reach the computer lab at Scuttlebutt High School and back up an important project before the school servers get wiped for the summer.

Embark on a lovingly handcrafted journey through Olympia WA. That's been packed to the brim with explorable content and characters.

Features:
A vast, mid 90s accurate world to enjoy at your own pace.
Over 30 different environments to explore.
Unique hand-drawn art style based on 90s animation.
Intuitive drag and drop controls.

title: Run Away
description:
게임 정보
제발 저희 매혹적인 공포 게임에 몰두하고, 무서운 비밀을 탐색하고 가창적인 생존 전투에 참여하세요. 당신은 잊혀진 건물을 탐험하게 되며, 각각의 한 걸음이 마지막일 수 있고, 모든 구석마다 무서운 생물이 숨어 있을 수도 있습니다. 예측할 수 없는 상황에 직면하여 어려운 수수께끼를 풀고 생존을 위해 괴물과 싸우세요. 고품질의 그래픽과 현실적인 사운드 효과로 공포와 긴장감의 분위기 속에 몰입하게 될 것입니다. 하지만 주의하세요: 당신이 내리는 각각의 결정은 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 진정한 도전에 대비하고, 오직 가장 똑똑하고 용감한 사람들만이 생존할 수 있는 준비를 하세요. 당신의 가치, 지혜, 교활함을 보여주며 이 어둠의 세계의 비밀을 밝혀내고 성공적으로 탈출하세요.

title: Three Kingdoms Cities
description:
게임 정보
Game Background
In this war-torn land, you are not a legendary general from the history books, but an "Outsider" who descends from the unknown. With no predetermined destiny or allegiance, you step into the chaos wielding a rusted blade. Will you become a hero to the refugees, a warlord under a feudal lord, or a king carving your own path? This Three Kingdoms era is reshaped by your choices.
Reimagined in intricate pixel art, the world recreates the landscapes and cities of the late Eastern Han Dynasty: the imperial grandeur of Luoyang, the bustling streets of Jingzhou, the vast frontiers beyond the Great Wall... Every city is freely explorable, hiding side quests and serendipitous encounters.
Rewrite History: Assassinate Liu Bei before the Oath of the Peach Garden? Help Lü Bu defy his fate at the White Gate Tower? Your actions trigger chain events, spawning Alternate History Paths unseen in historical records.
Diverse Roles: Master martial arts as a lone warrior or command armies as a brilliant strategist. With a rich combat system and a sprawling open world, boredom is impossible.
Historical Context
Political Turmoil:
The late Eastern Han Dynasty collapsed under corruption and famine, sparking the Yellow Turban Rebellion. Though quelled, the dynasty crumbled, leaving warlords to carve out their own domains.
Warlord Wars:
Amidst the chaos, factions like Cao Cao, Liu Bei, and Sun Quan rose to power, culminating in the Three Kingdoms (Wei, Shu, Wu) rivalry.
Core Gameplay
🔹 Open-World Sandbox:
Freely explore a vast map, conquer cities, rise as a warlord, or unite the realm under your rule.
🔹 Dynamic Real-Time Combat:
Choose to roam as a lone swordsman or lead armies into epic battles with tactical command.
🔹 Legendary Generals System:
Recruit over 40 iconic Three Kingdoms generals, each with unique skills. Fight against or ally with legends like Guan Yu and Zhao Yun.
Character Progression

title: The Doomed Knight
description:
게임 정보
You are the Doomed Knight. Torn between madness and sanity. You walked the realm of death for thousands of years forgot your own past and identity. But something is wrong in the realm of death. A boy in the world is not allowed to die! The cities of the dead are empty! Souls are being tortured and corrupted. And the black death is preparing something unspeakable! Together with your oldest advisor, the necromicon, the book of the dead, you are out to discover what it is. And maybe even your own past will be uncovered...

This metrodvania inspired game lets you discover an fascinating world full of monsters, secrets and mysteries.

The game offers you:

- 12 giant metroidvania areas
- multiple endings depending on your decisions and gameprogress
- 12 Endbosses and over 60 monsters and creatures
- huge arsenal of items, abilities and equippment
- over 60 souls/characters you can collect
- approximately 20 hours of gameplay
- unique and detailed artstyle

title: Metal Hunter
description:
게임 정보
This is an experimental imitation work that has only been expanded to a certain extent based on the original original system. As it is an abandoned project that was first born in 2012, please do not have too high expectations for this work.
Out of respect for the copyright of the original work, this work will not be used for commercial purposes.
company: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司

title: Split Signal
description:
게임 정보
A new puzzle game from LYNE creator Thomas Bowker with visual design by Peter Bentley.

Traverse a vast landscape filled with hundreds of tetromino inspired puzzles and fix something that has broken.

title: Ball King Jam
description:
게임 정보
볼 킹 잼은 어리석은 물리학 기반의 농구 게임입니다. 컴퓨터 상대와 대결하거나 다양한 환경과 코트에서 친구들을 이기는 재미를 즐기세요.

로컬 협동 플레이!
솔로로 플레이해보거나 친구들과 팀을 짜보세요. 최대 네 명까지 다양한 모드에서 함께 플레이할 수 있습니다. 기술과 우정을 시험하세요!
캐릭터 맞춤 설정!
캐릭터를 선호에 맞게 조정하고 맞춤 설정하세요! 도전과제를 완료하여 희귀한 의상을 언락하세요.

스탯을 강화할 수 있는 다양한 영구적이고 장비 가능한 아이템을 언락하세요.

title: Taro the Sneaky Ninja
description:
게임 정보


Taro the Sneaky Ninja is the stealth game Nintendo would make. It's a 2D stealth platformer mix of Mario and Mark of the Ninja, combining classic platforming with tactical stealth action and a wide range of difficulty modes for a game both casual and hardcore can enjoy!


Become one with the shadows and be the adorable ninja you've always wanted to be! Stay out of sight by using your environment to hide from enemy Samurai. Use your items to defeat your enemies sneakily or distract them to create an opening to slip by. Use your ninja acrobatics like your double jump, walljump, ledge vault, and many more to move quickly through the shadows. Outsmart your enemies like a true ninja!




For a hundred years, a small Ninja village has lived peacefully in the forest of Udon Groves, protected from the warring Samurai army by the magic of their spirit guardians. One day, the spirits' magic mysteriously begins to fade and the Samurai invade the Ninja's home! Join Taro and his fellow ninja on their dangerous journey to restore power to the spirits before the Samurai can wipe out the Ninja once and for all!




Whether you want to take out every last enemy or sneak past without hurting a fly, you have the options to do it your way. Choose from 4 playable characters with their own unique abilities suited for different playstyles, a dozen different items ranging from fast-flying shuriken and arrows to non-lethal smokebombs and sleeping darts, plus several different magical abilities to get you past your enemies in one piece!


6 different chapters with their own themes and environmental mechanics to use to your advantage! Swing from vines and climb ivy in the dense forests of Udon Groves, hide in the wheat and rice fields in the farmlands of Bento Plains, brave the treacherous blizzards of Shiro Peaks and much more!




Sneaky Ninja accommodates all players, from absolute beginners all the way to veterans of the stealth genre. Different difficulty modes transform the game from a casual action platformer to a hardcore tactical stealth game -- no one is left out and everyone can play at their own skill level!

title: Shadow Codex
description:
게임 정보
Shadow Codex invites you into a mystical world where magic meets mystery. In this cooperative puzzle-horror game, you and your friends take on the roles of a daring explorer and wise researchers, each with your own crucial part to play. Set in an enchanted forest filled with secrets, you’ll need to communicate effectively and strategize together to uncover ancient truths and combat malevolent witches.
As the explorer, navigate through atmospheric, richly detailed environments—from a enervating graveyard to a frozen lake—each haunted by a distinct elemental witch with unique powers and vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the scholar assists by deciphering a mystical book filled with lore, puzzles, and spells essential for progress and survival.
Asymmetric Co-Op: Engage in a unique cooperative format where one player explores in-game locations while the other consults interactive documents to provide guidance and solve puzzles.
Mystical Environments: Explore three beautifully rendered, eerie locations each themed around natural elements of fire, ice, and blood, with challenges and aesthetics to match.
Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of dynamic puzzles that require real-time communication and collaboration, ranging from brewing ancient potions to decoding celestial alignments.
Rich Narrative: Unravel a gripping story woven through interactions and discoveries in the game, revealing the histories and secrets of the witches you face.
Replayability: With multiple solutions to problems and various strategies to defeat the witches, each playthrough offers new challenges and outcomes.
Atmospheric Visuals and Sound: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world complemented by a haunting soundtrack that enhances the mysterious and foreboding atmosphere of the forest.
Accessibility Modes and Customization: Don't want the enemies listening to you? Turn it off. Just want a chill puzzle experience with your friends? Shadow Codex has that. Want jump scares and butt-clenching terror? That's there for you too.
In Shadow Codex, your teamwork will be tested as you delve deeper into the forest’s shadows. Can you and your partner banish the darkness together, or will you be consumed by the secrets that lurk within? Step into the forest, and discover what lies beyond the veil.

title: HEX Defense
description:
게임 정보
Conquer back your homeworld, taken over by strange crystal-like lifeforms that suddenly appeared 22 years ago after a calamity. You were forced to retreat and spent years researching possible options to counteract them. And you’ve finally found it! Build complex defenses from basic blocks, find the origin of the calamity and wipe out all hostile creatures in this original tower-based RTS.

Features
Pattern-based building process: every tower is constructed from patterns of simple blocks. Build your defenses piece by piece the way you like it, upgrade, combine, optimize space and resources to survive against the overwhelming forces.
Three enemy life forms: cuboids, spheroids and polygonoids, each operating differently and requiring a unique strategy to overcome.
Freedom of strategy and flexible defense perimeter: Go for quick low-tier tower rush or bunk with well-defended artillery posts, then collect your blocks and rebuild the defenses on the spot — just mind the free space and resources left.
Indirect control over your forces. Get up to a strategic level and don't waste your time with routine tasks: plan your defenses and issue orders while your units do all the work.
Over 40 levels with varied gameplay and different objectives, taking place in seven distinct biomes.

The Hex World needs your protection!

title: Zero Symptom
description:
게임 정보
Zero Symptom is a first-person horror game with shooter and survival elements that tells the story of a doctor who arrives at the center of an epidemic caused by an experimental vaccine against COVID.
The game takes place around the 90s in post-Soviet Russia, in one of the many remote towns in the forgotten corners of the country.
The vaccine worked as expected for most people, but turned the rest into previously unseen creatures.
The previous doctor has stopped communicating, and you will have to learn about his actions before you, as well as clean up the consequences or worsen them with your choice.
Will you be able to stop the spread of the epidemic and help everyone in need, will you be able to save seemingly hopeless patients, or will you turn the city into a hotbed of infection?
The choice is yours.

title: Detective Butler and the King of Hearts
description:
게임 정보
Detective Butler and the King of Hearts is a linear murder mystery visual novel, with emphasis on a fast-paced, character-driven narrative. The story is divided into 15+ chapters, each with its own mystery, while at the same time asking you to piece together a deeper mystery that spans across all chapters. No prior knowledge of the Detective Butler storyline is required to enjoy the game.



Estimated 20-30 hours of content across 15+ chapters
A unique hand-drawn art-style with animated sprites and backgrounds
Fully voiced dialogue and narration (both optional, English language only)
One big murder mystery, plus at least one small mystery per chapter
Case Notes and Lecture Notes to help solve each mystery
A large cast of characters with secrets to uncover
Thought-provoking themes on truth, happiness, life, and death
Original soundtrack




Three years after the events of , Gilligan Golder is now CEO of his late father's life insurance company, where Butler also now works as a fraud investigator. At the same time, Gilligan has been attending classes at the prestigious Diamond University. The company's investors have great expectations for Gilligan upon his graduation.

One day, Gilligan and Butler learn about a Detection Club at the university. At the same time, a serial killer has been targeting the female students, each victim's heart ripped out from a gaping wound. As none of the hearts have been found -- apparently stolen -- the killer has been nicknamed "The King of Hearts."

Tensions have grown on campus as the female students fear becoming the next victim, and the male students fear being falsely accused as the killer. In the midst of all this, Gilligan falls in love with one of the girls, but lacks the confidence to pursue her.

Eventually, a new victim is discovered: one of the members of the Detection Club.

And the prime suspect?



Gilligan refuses to believe it. With Butler as the brains and Gilligan doing the legwork, they work together to pursue the truth and catch the true killer.

The other members of the Detection Club all have secrets they want to remain hidden. Will Gilligan come to regret the truth he ends up discovering?

What are the consequences of telling comforting lies over the harsh truth?

And what are the consequences of believing them?



The primary gameplay is within your own mind as you try and solve the mysteries yourself. The game will provide you with Case Notes and Lecture Notes to help you keep track of the characters, clues, and other important information.

You will encounter choices to personalize your experience and test your skills of deduction, but they won't significantly influence the outcome of the story. Instead, you'll be taken on an emotional rollercoaster, with many exciting twists and turns as the mysteries slowly unravel themselves.

In addition to the overarching mystery of the King of Hearts Serial Murders, each chapter has at least one dedicated mystery for you to solve. Please enjoy solving all of them!
autokwd: Detective Butler and the King of Hearts

title: Warpflux
description:
게임 정보
In Warpflux you assume the role of the only living officer aboard an autonomous colony ship. The destination? A new birthplace for humanity. Take command and decide the best course of action during the thousand-year long voyage full of perils.

Features
Defend against enemies during an intense, time-limited resource gathering phase
Carefully plan and manage a limited number of actions before entering cryo sleep
Collect research and use it to unlock new upgrades
Encounter crisis events and make tough decisions
Explore procedurally generated solar systems

title: Hive Quest
description:
게임 정보
Hive Quest is an immersive real time strategy game set in a mythical woodland filled with ancient magic, strange creatures & intriguing puzzles. As the Hive Mind you will guide your insect tribe on a hazardous adventure to find safety after a terrible cataclysm. Explore mysterious locations with the help of your pet Shrublet, find allies, uncover the story behind the Old Orchard and fight against other tribes. Do you have what it takes to re-establish your Hive’s fortunes and seek out the mythical ‘Sunny Uplands’?

– Guide your embattled tribe on a quest to find fortune, glory and a new home.
– Interact with a wide variety of crazy puzzles and strange goings on as you try to make sense of it all.
– Explore the mysteries of the Deep Woods and uncover new allies and enemies.
– Battle against other hives to maintain control of your territory.
– Manage resources and build your Hive into a powerful kingdom, filled with hard working drones.
– Take mind control of your drones and send them into unknown territory on dangerous missions.
– Launch attacks on enemy Hives & dangerous creatures that stand in your way.
– Obtain woodland elementals as pets and upgrade them to fight and do your bidding.

Thanks for looking!

title: Wardens Rising
description:
게임 정보
Wardens Rising is a one-of-a-kind, action-packed game of heroism, strategy, and epic battles blending high-octane PvE coop ARPG shooter action and MOBA-like base defense strategy for an experience like no other!
Embark on an exhilarating campaign against a relentless interdimensional threat. Your mission is to protect vital energy cores from massive invasions and defeat mighty bosses to save humanity and attain everlasting glory.
Plan your strategy and build defenses before each battle. Over time you will unlock new defensive technology like towers, traps, portals, walls, and more to use in your next battle.

title: Esothe
description:
게임 정보
Esothe is a third person single player indie game. The game tells about the journey of a lonely wanderer through a forgotten land located on a plateau, separated from the rest of the world by a high wall. The plateau initially seems to be an abandoned, although an idyllic land, however, with time it reveals its dark past, which the explorer slowly discovers...
Features:
Exploration - An open world with dozens of locations to explore, full of secrets and connected underground ruins,
Platforming - traversing dungeons and ruins requires dexterity - a lot of jumping and crawling,
Story - The plateau has a dark past. Statues of winged beings, that can be found at every step, skeletons of giants in dungeons, traces of siege. All this will fold into a complex story over time,
Puzzles - The plateau is full of magical mechanisms that are the remains of the technology of the ancient civilization that once lived here, some of the mechanisms are inactive and you need to find a way to activate them to know their destiny.

Esothe takes place in the same universe as Venineth game.

title: Star Shift Legacy
description:
게임 정보
** Star Shift Legacy is a work in progress. The demo is outdated and contains bugs.

—Over 100 playable characters and hours of gameplay
—Branching story arcs
—Base and empire building
—Strategic turn-based combat (standard)
—Tactical battle system (fleet and army)

title: Among Ripples: Shallow Waters
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to Among Ripples: Shallow Waters, an eco tycoon sim focused on
maintaining balance in lakes and rivers. The water bodies are filled with different
creatures that needs your help. In the game you focus on saving nature from
different hazards and problems. Our game is inspired by ecology and the people
who spend time and effort to solve the problems we face today.



Key Features


Create your own ecosystem
Balance predators and prey, plants and other organisms. Watch how they
interact with the world you create for them.

Nurture and tend to wildlife
Understand their needs and comforts, giving them a place to call home.

Shape their world
Raise and lower land with the terraforming tool, as well as expand bodies
of water.

Immerse yourself
A single-player campaign where you lead a team of experienced scientists,
get to know your crew and dive further into dialogue between missions at
the base camp. You can even see the world from the point of view of fish and
other creatures.

title: Zodiac Legion
description:
게임 정보
Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG featuring lethal combat, squad management and kingdom building. Lead your heroes through daring raids and mysterious ruins, defend your land in a time of conquest and betrayal, and master the secrets of volatile ancient magic to restore a realm beset by a forgotten menace. Stand fast and take the fight to your foes, battling creatures from the depths of legend, and adversaries from the very precipice of damnation.
Features
Lead your knights in turn-based tactical battles in a merciless war against the Aegidian League.
Explore ancient ruins and places of power, thwart the plans of enemy lieutenants, forge alliances, and restore the Zodiac Order.
Engage in authentic combat based on medieval martial arts and troop formations, where armour is more than just a modifier.
Smash your way through procedurally generated and fully destructible dungeons.
Randomly generated maps and a dynamic campaign ensure that no two playthroughs are the same.

Expand and strengthen your stronghold, research new spells and craft powerful artifacts.
Reshape the terrain to your advantage.

title: Parkour Bot
description:
게임 정보
Zdravím všechny hráče, kteří sem zavítali během „CZ & SK Games Week 2024“. Vyzkoušet si zde můžete demo hry. Demo má zatím hotovou hlavní mechaniku, tj. fyziku hlavní postavy. Na grafice, zvucích, úrovních atd. budu pracovat. Plná hra by měla mít i achievementy a žebříčky. Budu rád za každý wishlist a hlavně odezvu v komunitním centru. Super bude, když zasídlíte video nebo screenshot z vašeho hraní. Pokud narazíte na chybu napište zde do diskuze.
Děkuju.
Parkour bot - 5 best game features
1) Unique playable character = Unique game experience
2) Physics based levels = Lots of unexpected events & more fun
3) Diverse enemies = New challenges
4) Less talking = More playing
5) A lot of achievements = Speedrunners are welcome
Fast paced rhythm based physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character and dynamic levels. No story, just your skill. So what are you waiting for?

title: Neon Sword
description:
게임 정보
Neon Sword is an open world 3rd person top down action RPG, the none linear story has multiple choices that effect the world around you leading you down many paths; the person you become is shaped by your decisions made within the game.
Time and Setting
Neon Sword takes place in the fictional Quaid City in the year 2083. The setting takes inspiration from late 70s to early 90s Sci-Fi, Cyberpunk and Synthwave - Neon Lights, Big hair and dodgy moustache...

title: Divinoids
description:
게임 정보
Pilot one of several unique Divinoids, alien mecha that change back and forth between God and Mythical Beast forms. Destroy human armies, demolish their cities and conquer their planets. Up to four players co-op.

Travel through procedurally generated galactic sectors; land on planets to explore and conquer.
Highly destroyable everything; climb and destroy buildings, cities and giant bosses piece by piece.
Each Divinoid is entirely unique; no shared moves or even climb mechanics.
Shapeshift between unique God and Mythical Beast forms to handle any situation.
Equip weapons and passive modules for deep customization and replayability.
Eject from your Divinoid when it's destroyed, and keep fighting on foot.
Grab a submarine and throw it at a helicopter!

title: Selenwald
description:
게임 정보
Prepare to face the unimaginable magnificence of the university of Selenwald!
Enter the halls of Selenwald to learn forbidden knowledge never meant to leave the cursed edifice. Meet madmen and face horrors that cannot be described by mere words. Discover the truth that terrifies scientists and priests alike.



Challenging Combat - Fight for survival having ultimate control over your character's actions. Engage in melee combat or take enemies down from afar using firearms and powerful magic. Aim carefully since every attack can miss if executed blindly. Dodge enemy attacks and adapt to enemies' behaviour. Use stealth and assassinate or sneak past enemies to avoid risky encounters altogether.
Resource Management - Most of your combat and survival capabilities are dictated by what resources you find. Resources are limited and so is the character's inventory. Make choices on what to bring with you every time you descend to a lower level. Every bullet, potion and spell makes a difference.
Character Development - Every class has a different pool of starting traits, predispositions, items and types of inventory slots available. Make choices when being presented with new random traits to gain power and build interesting combinations. Modify your inventory with acquired accessories to further customize your character.
Permanent Death - If your character dies, they die for good. Choose a new, random adventurer and embark on a new adventure. Even if you don't manage to go far, your actions will have consequences that carry over to subsequent playthroughs. Dying is a natural part of the game.
Random Dungeons - Every playthrough brings completely different areas to explore. No shuffled predefined rooms - truly original locations every time.
Unique Setting - Travel to Europe of the late 1700s and enter the gateway to where the afterlife takes place. Discover how scientists eternally isolated from the world of the living crossed boundaries dictated by known science. See how the discovery of selenium's arcane properties enabled humanity to tap into powerful forces reminiscent of magic. Gain answers to mysteries never before found on the pages of written history.

title: Evolution adventure
description:
게임 정보
Breeder Simulator: A Game Where Monsters Go on Adventures Themselves
In this game, the player takes control of a base dedicated to raising and crossbreeding monsters. Roads stretch out in all directions from the base, filled with adventures, treasures, and other monsters.
Ran out of monsters? No problem! Skip a day, and new ones will be born in your basement.
Upgrade your base, explore the map, and create the rarest and most valuable monsters.
Planned for release:
A global map packed with quests.
Over 30 base monsters for evolution.
More than 400 types of evolved monsters.
Over 20 hours of gameplay to complete the main story, with endless possibilities for discovering new evolution combinations.
Embark on this evolution adventure and become the ultimate monster breeder!

title: The Cabbage Effect
description:
게임 정보
The Cabbage Effect is a cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements and procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.
The game shows that planet Earth was invaded by complex and strange creatures and, during the attack, the planet was protected by a small team with their vehicles and gadgets.


Unlockable characters
A variety of absurd weapons.
The player can pick up objects and throw them at opponents or to interact with the environment.
Experimental narrative that explores aesthetic elements of non-verbal storytelling and communication noise.

title: Treasure Islands
description:
게임 정보
Treasure Islands is a budget price first-person adventure by Mark J. Lovegrove, for Screen 7.
A Tale From Triassic Zoo...
Nick and Pippa have inherited Uncle's assets and among them, an old abandoned museum! To see it re-opened they will need a new selection of exhibits, artefacts & curiosities!
The search will stretch to far away islands, each with their own character, quirks and treasures to be found! But beware - they are not the only opportunists out there...
Mysterious caves, curious locals and strange events - with YOUR help the treasure hunting team will keep their wits about them as they search for that all important centre-piece!
But what are the shady scientists up to? Is Uncle still out there? Will Triassic Zoo keep turning in your absence? And what other mysteries await? Find out in Treasure Islands - Soon !!
Pieces Of Fate...
» Explore 7+ islands in a light-hearted single-player adventure story
» Quirky characters & creatures to meet with full English voice acting + subtitles
» 120+ minutes of engaging licensed music + an additional 60 minute underscore
» Filled with atmospheric sound, in-game achievements & many other secrets!
Treasure Islands contains infrequent cartoon violence and is suitable for most ages.
You may also be interested in Mr. Maze, already available on Steam!

title: Quarantine Cutz
description:
게임 정보
It's day 87 of the quarantine, and you've run out of options. You're going to have to cut the family's hair yourself. There's just one problem: You have no idea what you're doing!

Choose to play as either Pappa Smith or Momma Smith, each with their own special secret haircut skill. Each family member will ask for a haircut of their celebrity idol, who of course you've never heard of. Using a magazine as a guide, you'll be graded on how closely you can match their dream haircut: "Soul Crushing", "Terrible", or most impressive of all, "Barely Passable".

Each level challenges you to give a different family member an increasingly tricky haircut, culminating in the most difficult surprise challenge of all.

Key Features:
Master ludicrously uncontrollable jittery clippers that veer out of control at the slightest mistake.
Learn how to prevent ruining haircuts from increasingly unruly family members who resist and fight you at every turn.
A story that reveals the fates of the family members and their new hairstyles when the quarantine finally ends.

Can you overcome your jittery nerves and pop culture obliviousness to give your children a haircut that won't crush their hopes and dreams? Probably not, but it's worth a shot.

title: Tentoria
description:
게임 정보
Lyss, the Deadeye



Experience the story of Lyss, the Deadeye. A badass femme fatale hitman with countless successful missions behind her, and no failures. That is, until the story begins...
Lyss, the Beast



Cursed by the God himself, she will wreak havoc in the world to quell her burning desire for revenge! She will sunk so deep and completely lose her humanity that she will be known as .



Experience the story of someone that went to hell and back to cleanse themselves. Killing demons might be easy for someone as strong as her; but when it comes to fighting with her inner demons, she will struggle a lot. Some will even talk about her as .



After series of events, her rage will subside; and she will try to live peacefully in isolation. But people, demons, even the dead will never stop bothering .



In the end, she will find her place among the society. But this is not a "they lived happily ever after" ending, on the contrary, people will try to take down .



But no fool can do harm to !

Hey there, I'm a solo developer working very hard on this game. I always loved the character action genre since my childhood. Making such a game was in my mind for more than 15 years; but I never had the courage to jump into such a monumental task. After working in the industry for years; I had earned all the necessary experience over time, and one day I felt that I should just do it! Even though I would have loved to work with a team, I want to make the first game in the franchise all by myself to test myself. If people likes this game and supports me financially, I would love to expand the franchise with a sequel and a team of professionals!

You can add the game to your wishlist if you want to support me, and by doing so, you can get notified about the early access discounted sale! I don't plan on making huge discounts to the game in it's first years, and early access sale will be the cheapest you can get it to show my appreciation for the early supporters!

For those that want to see more, I'm documenting the evolution of characters in the game on my ArtStation account. Checking them might give you some ideas about the game. Here is the link for it:

Feel free to join the community over Reddit:

In future, there will be a dedicated Discord server for the game, also I will monitor Steam forums for bug reports.

Now that you know how to reach me, feel free to ask anything!

title: Omni Axes
description:
게임 정보
Omni Axes is an authentic 3D shooting game. You play in a 3D cube space and take down the enemies coming at you from all directions to aim for a high score.

You move along the three axes using your keyboard and change the camera angle and target location with your mouse. Fly anywhere you want in the 3D space as you evade, aim and shoot. This game takes the essence of shooting games and refines each element.

The difficulty goes up as you play, so you can feel yourself progressing as you advance through the game.

Main Features:
- Completely different game modes for you to enjoy
- Flashy and exhilarating hit effects
- Original chiptune soundtrack
- Many model designs, from traditional to cute!

title: Keepsake County
description:
게임 정보


We’ve added a huge update to Keepsake County’s demo, showcasing a brand new, never-before-seen heist (plus two classics), as well as 3 new enemies! Just for Steam Stealth Fest!

Burgle the Architect, the man responsible for Keepsake County’s strange, maze-like homes who lives on the edge of a huge swampy lake across from a guest house. Why’s he so paranoid? And why does he keep looking up at the sky?
Dodge the Pizza Guy, tiptoe past Hounds, and evade the Detective on your tail!
Play a shiny new tutorial that carefully guides new players to greatness.
Mantling, for scampering through the rooms and up the pipes of hoarders!
Twitch Integration, where viewers can prank streamers, or help them pull off amazing heists.
More story than ever, plus loads of new goofy and midwestern voice acting!
Loads of bugfixes and improvements.



Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge.

You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.

title: Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem
description:
게임 정보


Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem is a bullet hell shooting adventure where you swap between a trio of heroes on the fly!

Take control of Gale, Fia, and Casey, three flying fighters with their own unique abilities! Through strategic character swaps, and the power of Synergy Boost, you can overwhelm your foes with tactics and style!


In a land where fantasy and technology intertwine, cities across the world are under attack. The only thing connecting these incidents is the Steel Butterfly, a sword wielding butterfly woman who brings destruction in her wake.

The Typhoon Unit, a small but capable band of airborne heroes, have been called in to put a stop to the threat. Can the Typhoon Unit halt the Steel Butterfly's conquest, and discover her secrets?

title: Vega Motions: Project Unleashed
description:
게임 정보
Vega Motions: Project Unleashed is a skills-based fighting video game for the PC. You play in 3rd person split screen mode against a friend or in full screen mode against the AI. The fight is set in a futuristic arena that is destructible.

title: Get Bento!
description:
게임 정보
Get Bento! is a bento box-building puzzle game.

Design sushi and add them to your bento box for today's lunch. Sort and arrange your tasty treats neatly, ensuring they all fit into your lunch box.

Get Bento! follows a young girl during her holiday break as she packs delicious snacks into her bento box to take to her summer job.
FEATURES

Lunch Box
80 cutesy hand drawn sushi and other bento box tasties for you to collect and arrange in your lunch box.
Levels
The games has 100 levels designd to stimulate your puzzling needs.
Arcade Modes
If you can't get enough of organising sushi into your bento box you'll love the extra modes crafted to keep the fun going indefinitely.
Steam Deck
The game is the perfect relaxation game built for the steam deck and controller but works beautifully with a mouse too.

title: Church of Shadows
description:
게임 정보
In a forgotten church, sealed away for centuries, a dark presence waits to be freed. You are the only one who can stop it—an unlikely hero chosen by a preacher on his last legs. Your task is deceptively simple: burn the books and break the curse. But the task is anything but easy.
Features:
Survive a Maze of Fear: Explore a dark, abandoned church where every shadow holds danger. The environment twists and shifts as the witch manipulates reality, keeping you on edge.
Face Five Unique Demons: Each demon is bound to a cursed book and has its own behavior and hunting style. From the crawling horror of Dal’Gan to the towering brute Verinnath, you’ll need strategy and courage to evade them.
Confront the Witch: Once the demons are defeated, Emelyn herself will appear. She can block doorways, twist hallways, and manipulate your surroundings, making her the ultimate challenge.
Dynamic Fire Mechanics: To burn the cursed books, you must light a cauldron. Choose wisely: using a regular flame may result in failure, but combining lanterns around the church creates a blue, everlasting fire that guarantees success.
Sanity Management: Demons and the witch can break your mind. Protect yourself using crosses to temporarily banish threats, but be careful—resources are limited, and the church itself drains your sanity.
High Replayability: Randomized book and demon spawn locations, along with shifting hallways, ensure that no two playthroughs are the same.
Terrifying Atmosphere: With dynamic lighting, sound design, and jump scares, the church becomes a living nightmare that pulls you deeper into its horrors.
Story to Unravel: Learn the tragic tale of Emelyn Hawke, a healer betrayed by her village and transformed into something monstrous after making a dark pact. Clues scattered around the church reveal the truth behind her vengeance.
Will you break the curse and escape? Or will the witch claim yet another soul?

title: Maenovan
description:
게임 정보
About This Game
Thirty years ago, the idyllic Maenovan Valley was ravaged by a mysterious sickness, forcing a mass evacuation. The once-thriving community was left abandoned, its secrets buried beneath an unsettling silence.
The year is 2007. You are lured to the valley by the abundance of prey and the promise of a successful hunt. As you explore the decaying remnants of the past, you'll uncover a haunting narrative that reveals the darkness that still lingers in the valley's shadows.
Gameplay:
Atmospheric Exploration: Immerse yourself in the eerie atmosphere of the abandoned valley and its surrounding areas. Explore decaying buildings, forgotten landmarks, and the unsettling remnants of a once-vibrant community.
Unraveling the Mystery: Piece together the fragmented narrative through environmental storytelling, cryptic clues, and chilling encounters. Discover the truth behind the valley's evacuation and the lingering darkness that haunts its present.
Suspenseful Encounters: Brace yourself for spine-chilling moments as you navigate the valley's eerie silence and confront the unsettling remnants of its past
Run, Hide, or Fight: Use whit and cooperation to overcome a variety of threats in riveting adrenaline-filled sequences. 
Features:
Multiplayer Adventure: Play solo, or work with up to six friends to accomplish your mission while the forces of nature work against you.
Immersive Sound Design: Chilling ambient sounds will immerse you in the valley's eerie atmosphere, heightening the suspense and tension.
Difficult and Repeatable Gameplay: Work together with friends to reach all of the possible game endings at varying difficulties. Can you be the best?
Compelling Narrative: A rich and atmospheric narrative will unfold as you explore, revealing the valley's dark secrets and the tragic fate of its former inhabitants.
Indie Spirit: Developed with a passion for storytelling and a commitment to creating a unique and unforgettable horror experience.

title: Horizon Heat
description:
게임 정보
Horizon Heat is an ideal choice for those who love racing and the atmosphere of the 80s and 90s. The player will have to drive straight and avoid other cars on his way. The game design impresses with its bright neon colors and some futuristic elements. The game has several levels, each with its own unique design. The game also has a leaderboard that allows players to compare their results with other players and friends.

The game's soundtrack created specifically for the game, is simply fascinating with its shades of retrowave and vintage sound. You will have to unlock some tracks, but it will not be difficult.

The game has detailed car reflections, you can see the sun and other cars on the road in the reflection. Sometimes you can find strange cars in the game, you will definitely recognize them. Earn money while traveling and buy new cars. You can collect them all.

However, the main thing in the game is the gameplay. It is relaxing and suitable for any player, regardless of experience level. This game will be a great option for those who love the retro vibe and atmosphere of the 80s and 90s, as well as for those who just want to spend time playing a relaxing and beautiful game.

title: The Realm of Order: Arisen
description:
게임 정보
Enter the kingdom of Mythuras: a proud and mighty human kingdom, and face the greatest threat that the land has yet to see. The dead themselves have arisen.
EXPLORE AND EXPERIENCE THE KINGDOM
Every area of Mythuras is open for exploration. Speak with citizens, inspect items and explore hidden areas to learn the story of the kingdom that you fight for.
There are no right path to saving Mythuras - you must pick the one you deem the safest, fastest or most empowering.
CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF COMBAT
Whether you are a vicious warrior wielding a sword and plate armour, a swift archer who excels in ranged combat or even a great sorcerer with great intellect, you can always get stronger. Buy new weapons and protection from the merchants scattered across the land, or search for them yourself in the darkest corners of the forests.
WORK TOWARD YOUR GOAL
With so many paths to take and so many ways to improve, play through the undead crisis over again, and find the best possible way to save Mythuras. Whether it makes you stronger, faster or perhaps most knowledgable.
MADE TO FEEL LIKE A CLASSIC GAME
The Realm of Order: Arisen is specifically designed to look, sound and feel like a game from years ago. With many old technologies researched and simulated, experience nostalgia without replaying a game from the past.

title: Miyu's Cursed Store
description:
게임 정보
Intro
In a new alternate universe set in the early 20th century, follow Miyu, a young student, as she tries to live everyday life with her teddy bear and guide, 'Cotton'.


When Miyu's parents' reckless lifestyle causes financial harm and attracts dangerous attention, she and her loyal companion embark on a journey into the infernal realms to begin a new business venture.
Characteristics

Write Your Story: Make impactful choices to your journey as shopkeeper.

Profitable Dungeon Crawler: Explore fast-paced dungeon challenges to gain access to new useful resources for your shop.

Potion Crafting: Discover a new and exciting way to make potions.

Master the Art of Pricing: Strategically price your products to attract new customers and maximize profits.

title: Immune Simulator Type Z
description:
게임 정보
Immune Simulator is a strategy-adventure game.

The story describes a world in which humans are fighting against zombies and losing. The female protagonist accidentally finds an old computer with software that records the process of human-zombie conflicts, much like historical documents.

The protagonist attempts to operate the computer and view these historical records but discovers that the historical data can be changed. After leaving the machine, the balance of power between humans and zombies in the real world also changes. Just as she thinks she can use this machine to turn the tide against the zombies, her companions begin to change one by one.

Is this machine a salvation from God or a trap from the devil? What secrets are hidden in this machine? It's up to the player to discover.

title: dev_hell
description:
게임 정보
We are searching for a software developer who is able to start work in our metro office location as soon as possible. This is an exclusive opportunity meant only for big thinkers who truly want to make an impact on the world. The ideal candidate for this position must be committed to unconditional motivation and positivity every day.
Employees at our company recognize that blending work and life is nothing to shy away from. Our current contract with [REDACTED] involves three upcoming projects with tight timelines. The right person for this role will be willing to do whatever it takes.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Able to launch software in a high pressure environment.
5+ years experience in software development.
(Recruiter’s note) Client doesn’t really care about experience.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Complete features before the end of each sprint.
Ensure quality through code reviews and paired programming.
Work with QA to identify and resolve bugs proactively.
Maintain positive relationships with your coworkers.
Play your cards right to balance multiple priorities. (Over 400 cards!)
WHAT WE OFFER:
Career development opportunities. (Lots of unlocks!)
Kudos loyalty rewards to spend at the company store.
Freedom to follow your own path (within reason).
Unlimited coffee.

title: Rules of Alchemy
description:
게임 정보

Rules of Alchemy is a spell combo roguelike with thousands of items, deep rpg systems, fast-paced strategic combat, and a procedurally generated world full of secrets. Mix your spells with each other, the environment, and your weapon, as you master thousands of combinations to decimate your foes!
MASTER THE ELEMENTS
Unlock over 100 spells on the Runegate and discover even more hidden spells as you play the game. In Rules of Alchemy spells are cast by combining other spells in real time. This unique system will have you experimenting with tons of different loadouts. Learn to counter enemy spells and turn them into your own. You can even use the environment or items as part of your combo.
Find your perfect playstyle among the 9 classes and their weapon types. From sword and shield, to dual lances, each weapon class provides a unique combat system that evolves the further you progress in the game. Experience the unique combo system and master every weapon’s perks and techniques. Discover legendary weapons and use them to augment your spells, reach hidden areas, and defeat secret bosses.
Craft, transmute, trade, equip and level up thousands of procedural items. Combined with a deep rpg stat system, a massive spell tree, and 7 procedural biomes, Rules of Alchemy will have every run feeling fresh and exciting.
