Meet a wide range of NPCs and access different rare items, epic quests, boss fights and climatic endings, all based on the dialog, items, and stats you choose.
A dark force has corrupted the land and the torn have begun to invade. It is said only the Philosopher's Stone can repair this broken world and drive out the dark forces. Discover the mysteries of an ancient people and seek out answers to your immortality. Unlock the power of the runegate and find the traitorous alchemist within your ranks.









***Many features listed are not available in the demo

title: Cradle-18
description:
게임 정보
I wake disoriented. Where am I? Looking out a window, I see the light reflected off the planet below. Clearly, I’m in orbit, but over a planet I don’t recognize. How did I get here? Why can’t I remember anything? Where is everyone?

Cradle-18 is a 3D walking simulator aboard an orbital space station. Explore from one compartment to the next to unravel the mystery of this deserted craft. What was the mission? And what has become of the crew? Am I truly alone?

Search for clues and collect information to piece together the answers. But space is a harsh environment, and the systems on this craft are showing signs of stress. Survival is not guaranteed.

Notes of horror. It feels uncomfortable on the uninhabited station in space.

Space ambient music. Enjoy space views to the beautiful space music. While you can.

title: Heistfest
description:
게임 정보
Become the notorious getaway driver, dodging through destructible cityscapes inspired by real-world locations, rendered in a unique retro hand-drawn style. Your goal? Escape the relentless pursuit of cops, SWAT teams, helicopters, tanks, missiles, and even paratroopers!
You are now the public enemy
Will you be able to survive the rampage?



Features:
-Escape epic cop chases and become the most wanted heist driver



-Unlock legendary vehicles
-Find and craft weapons and power-ups to enhance your car and firepower
-Rob banks and survive against police units, SWAT , helicopters, military tanks, airstrikes jeeps, , missiles , paratroopers and more.



-From the streets of Italy to the pyramids of Egypt, embark on daring heists worldwide.
-Evade law enforcement through sprawling, free-roaming maps ripe for action-packed drifting and racing.

Can you outrun the law and cement your status as the ultimate heist driver? The world of high-stakes crime awaits—will you make it out alive?

title: Desert Pirates
description:
게임 정보



GAME DESIGN documents will soon be released to the community. If you're curious or interested, you'll get to know EXACTLY what we're building!
Features:
Cars convoy
Primary weapon variety
Secondary weapon (missiles)
Dynamic Zoom
RAM damage
Speed boost
Command Orders
Upgrade cars and weapons
Collect Cars
Find skins
Expand your convoy
World
2 fighting tribes w/ several cars and features each
1 trading tribe w/ several shops
Environment destruction
4 resources to obtain + credit coin + tech
Strategic levels
Eternal Ride
Experience:


The game involves driving and battling through zones to gather enough resources to sustain your journey as far as possible, all while having a BLAST of fun. Creating a game that can be played "" forever might seem like a foolish idea, but somehow, it's working! (If not us, then who?)

This game is the result of collaboration among three industry colleagues, each with a background in different studios across various eras, some of which we share. We're devoting our spare time to this endeavor. Though it's a gradual process, it's unfolding beautifully.

Our goal is to create a genuinely enjoyable and scalable game that players can engage with over the long term. By continuously adding new content along the journey, we're crafting an experience that players can wholeheartedly immerse themselves in.

title: Diamond Sun
description:
게임 정보
An Evocative Hand-Crafted World
The world of Diamond Sun is brought to life in vivid, moody detail, its caverns alive with bizarre and terrifying creatures, each animatedin a unique 3D style. Every new area you’ll discover is beautifully unique and strange, teeming with new creatures and characters. Take in the sights and uncover new wonders hidden off of the beaten path. If you like classic gameplay, cute but creepy characters, epic adventure and beautiful, gothic worlds, then Diamond Sun awaits!

Brave the Depths of a Forsaken World
Beneath the surface of a flooded planet lies a ruined kingdom shrouded in mystery. Many venture into its depths, chasing after treasure, glory, or long-buried secrets. Diamond Sun is a classically inspired rogue-like adventure set in a sprawling, interconnected world. Traverse winding tunnels, explore lost cities, and navigate perilous landscapes; face off against fearsome foes, encounter eccentric allies, and unravel the enigmatic truths hidden at the heart of this forgotten realm.

title: Residuum
description:
게임 정보
In Residuum, players take on the role of a team of miners on Mars, tasked with defending their base from unexpected invaders. With a combination of tower defense and shooter gameplay, players will build structures and mine resources to upgrade their weapons and crew. Each game session lasts 20-30 minutes and players can earn rewards that they can use to upgrade their base in between games.

With a futuristic setting and a variety of enemy types, players will need to use strategy and quick thinking to survive. The addition of unique crew members with special abilities adds another layer of depth to the game, allowing players to choose their team and tailor their strategy to each game session.

Residuum is a thrilling and fast-paced experience, perfect for players looking for a challenging and rewarding tower defense game. So grab a friend and get ready to defend your base on the Red Planet!

title: Kosmos Connections
description:
게임 정보
"In this story, the choices you make only matter as much as you want them to.

Your perception of these events will determine your outlook on what transpires.

'There is no such thing as a subjective truth…

only interpretations of an incomplete picture.'”

✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧*:・ﾟ✧ *:・ﾟ✧

“Kazuhira Hatanaka is the man behind the Soul Uplink, a machine that uploads people’s souls to a digital world called the Datascape. However, when his assistant Nona runs the first test, it all goes wrong. She finds something in the Datascape that shouldn’t be there; something that gave her a sense of loss…” …At least, that’s the story of Uplink Alethia, the visual novel that Tau, your childhood friend, has created.


Welcome (back) to Kosmos, Adelfos! After being away for a long time, you return with your sister Runia for the final week of your winter vacation. With no hesitation, Tau asks you and Jennavieve, the mysterious café owner, to bug-test her game. Kosmos Connections contains two visuals novels in one – the short story of Uplink Alethia, and the fuller narrative that is Kosmos Connections. You must choose to spend your time wisely in order to build up your connections or even rekindle some. At the same time, you are helping out Tau by giving feedback on her game, experiencing a new chapter each day to analyze and discuss. Will you find out the truth of Kosmos, or forever be complacent where you stand?

title: Mort's Dream Jump
description:
게임 정보
Mort's Dream Jump is a fun, fast-paced platformer that challenges you to beat a series of handcrafted levels using a variety of tools. Double jumps, light dashes, jet packs, and the omnimover are all at your disposal as you navigate obstacles and make your way through each stage. Unlock new stages by collecting challenge stars and make your way through Mort's bizarre dream.

This early demo is a proof of concept and example for the kinds of single-screen stages you can expect in the full title. Rather than develop in private, I'll be posting new builds directly to Steam, where you can try new stages and help shape the development of the game.

All art assets, music, and stages are in a very work-in-progress state, and do not reflect the final version of the game.

title: Road Warriors
description:
게임 정보
Become a warrior of the road!

Road warriors is a casual rogue-lite game where you can create a build to fight against tons of enemies, becoming stronger and stronger throughout the run!

Features

Builds
Unique items to compose your build

Weapons
Multiple weapons to be unlocked

Original soundtrack
Originally composed music to keep you on the road.

title: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
description:
게임 정보
당신이 조심하지 않고 엉뚱한 곳에서 현실을 벗어나면 당신은 뒷방에 있게 될 것입니다. 그곳은 눅눅한 오래된 카펫의 냄새, 모노노랑의 광기, 형광등의 끝없는 배경 소음뿐입니다. 최대 윙윙거리는 소리와 함께 무작위로 분할된 약 6억 평방 마일의 빈 방에 갇히게 됩니다.
지옥에서 당신의 말을 확실히 들었기 때문에 근처에서 방황하는 소리가 들리면 신이 당신을 구하십시오.

1인칭 심리 및 생존 공포 경험. 당신은 백룸에서 길을 잃었고 이 위험한 우주에서 살아남을 방법을 찾아야 합니다.
다양한 레벨을 탐색하고 단서, 물건 또는 메시지를 찾아 백룸의 비밀을 알아내십시오.
이곳에 살고 있는 독립체와 탈출하거나 싸우거나 대화를 시도하세요.
다른 탐험가의 발자취를 따라 그들을 만나고, 그들의 은신처에서 피난처를 찾고, 인벤토리를 채워서 생존 가능성을 높이십시오.
당신은 현실 세계로의 복귀에 성공할 것인가, 아니면 뒷방의 깊숙한 곳에서 길을 잃을 것인가?

주요 기능:
백룸 탐색
위험에서 살아남기
그들의 비밀을 밝혀라
개체와 다른 탐험가를 만나다

⚠️ 이것은 게임이 아닙니다! 백룸이 존재하며 위험은 현실입니다. 이 프로그램을 실행하는 것은 생존 가능성을 높일 수 있는 유일한 기회입니다. 놓치지 마세요, 지금 위시리스트!

title: To and Fro
description:
게임 정보
To And Fro is a vibrant VR action-adventure 3D platformer where you can explore a vast, colorful world filled with treasures and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Step into the shoes of our hero, Joe, and utilize his unique abilities to navigate diverse landscapes and challenges. This cozy and casual game features easy-to-pick-up gameplay, making it perfect fun for players of all ages.

Immerse yourself in a relaxing and atmospheric quest, featuring impressionistic, low poly graphics reminiscent of the N64-style. Discover the unparalleled depth and immersion that only VR can offer, allowing you to effortlessly gauge distance and hop between platforms with pinpoint accuracy. VR perspective brings the world to life in a way that flat-screen 3D platformers simply cannot match.

Take control from a captivating third-person perspective, where you directly influence the character you observe. Seamlessly adjust your position and angle of view, offering a fluid and intuitive way to guide your player through the adventure, all while enjoying a dynamic and immersive gameplay experience.

Dive into a world of adventure with To And Fro!

title: Manaclysm
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer Magic Brawler
Manaclysm is a PvP brawler where up to 60 mages wage war across realms fractured by magic.
Defeat Opponents, Earn Sparks
Obliterate other mages to earn Sparks. Spend them between rounds to enhance your spell arsenal, or max out your Mana and lay waste to the whole arena!
Counter-spell Combos
Each match features a unique set of spells - combine them in creative ways to counter your adversaries and emerge victorious.
Unleash spell storms, obliterate your opponents, and emerge victorious!

title: Lone Planet
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Lone Planet: start a journey on your lonely planet to discover the birth and fate of the universe. While in search of the meaning of life, live this light adventure playing with unusual physics, in a puzzle platform manner.

The game offers (but is not limited to):
Moments of contemplation
(Bad) humor
Deep lore
Easy platform sections
Slightly harder platform sections
Science references

Everything presented to you through: colorful vector art.

title: Radical Striker
description:
게임 정보
We are creating a 2D fighting action game by adding stage action elements to the 2D fighting game.
Production is an indie team with one person.
In the game, we are developing 2D fighting battles in one-to-many and multi-to-many so that you can play them on low-spec PCs.

Multiple heroes can be selected, and other fighting styles will be added as the characters level and stats rise.
You can continuously attack like a 2D fighting game.
Since it is basically assumed to be one-to-many, you can avoid it by warping when you are attacked as a evasion in case of being attacked by pinching.



----- World view / Story -----
Not yet published.

title: Timeless Heart VR
description:
게임 정보
"Timeless Heart VR is a narrative-focused VR roguelite action game. In it, you'll encounter the fates of various realms sealed within the cage of time and space, while discovering the essence and meaning of this space. As the second entry in the Timeless Stories series, this game further simplifies and enriches the unique sword technique system of the series. It introduces a distinctive VR gameplay mode that merges first-person and third-person perspectives for cooperative play. You will control both yourself and your companion Lycanea, exploring and advancing through four stylistically distinct realms. Choose your weapons and your companion's armor wisely, and together break through the blockades set by fate!"
Game system introduction:

Sword Skill System:
Players will get "Chain Claw Prosthetic Arm" to assist in melee / range attack action.
At the same time in the game players will randomly obtain a variety of special style weapons to further strengthen their own ability.


Chain Claw System:
Players can use the chain claw to rapidly evade attacks from enemies and grab special objects in the scene to throw/use to break the enemy's weaknesses.


Lycaena, the heroine of this game, will accompany the player in battle, and she will also gain new skills and armor as the game progresses.


This game introduces four major elemental attributes: wind, ice, flame, and thunder. Each of them will correspond to different special effects, and different elements will react with each other to produce additional cumulative effects. Building your own and your teammates' elemental attributes properly can help you defeat your enemies more efficiently.

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:
게임 정보
About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
description:
게임 정보
Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

HOLLOW POINT
Cloned flesh is no substitute; you’ve saved no one real. Hollow Point continues the story of the first System Purge, adding six new surreal sectors to explore. Survive a litany of new obstacles and monstrous threats as you delve into the System’s very foundations…and beyond.

BEARTRAP MODE
After you've finished Hollow Point, tackle the game’s hardest challenge in Beartrap Mode. Play through an alternate story which remixes and redesigns every level from the original game, adding new obstacles, new secrets, and 4 brutally difficult boss encounters.

SPEEDRUN MODE
Put your skills to the test in 2 new speedrun categories. Jumps, deaths, and uncovered secrets are now tracked during each run.

title: HyperCore : Rhythm Bullet Hell
description:
게임 정보
HyperCore 소개
HyperCore는 기존의 탄막 게임을 음악 리듬 게임과 조합한 "리듬 탄막 게임" 입니다.
음악에 맞춰 코어에서 날아오는 셀 수 없이 많은 장애물을 피하며 살아남으세요.

특징
점수 공격: 위험을 감수하면 더 많은 포인트를 얻을 수 있습니다! 아슬아슬 위험한 상황을 넘기며 점수 승수를 높이세요.
시간 공격: 맞고, 죽고, 다시 반복하세요. 이 자비 없는 게임 모드에서는 최대한 오래 살아 남는 것이 관건입니다.
맞춤 노래: 여러분의 노래로 플레이하세요!
2명의 로컬 플레이어 대전: 친구와 경쟁하세요.

title: Backrooms of Reality
description:
게임 정보
Backrooms Of Reality is an atmospheric game with horror elements based on creepypasta /meme Backrooms.
You play the role of a new office worker of some mysterious large company. The strange events of the first day of work take us to the backrooms, the endless corridors on the verge of our reality.


Key Features:

Gameplay: Singleplayer. Mainly a "walking / running simulator". with puzzle and horror elements and a bit of story in the background.

Playing time: approx. 1-2 hours depending on the player.

Enemies: You can meet 2-3 enemies in the game. Some events are scriptable, others are random, so you never know what's lurking around the corner.

Immersive: Atmospheric, photorealistic graphics enhance your horror experience.

Controls: Mouse and keyboard

Saving: The game does not have a save system, but you unlock new chapters (levels) during the gameplay. Once unlocked, you'll be able to access these chapters from the main menu.

Multiple Endings: There are 3 endings (and endless endings if you get lost in backrooms)

In addition, certain third-party and first-party assets are the properties of their creators and not released under CC-BY SA.

title: Sidekick
description:
게임 정보
Robots have drawn humanity into war, and it's your job as Blaser Man and Turtle Belly Bot to infiltrate and wipe out the heart of these tin puppets!

Experience 10 varied levels based on classic games in Sidekick! But not only that, in Sidekick different genres are linked thematically. It doesn't matter whether it's run and gun, top-down shooter, or jet ski action, here you can find everything that made you happy and frustrated on the NES!

And of course, there is also a multiplayer mode, and it's 100% couch co-op! You and your friends! In real life, together! Shoot, I tell you, shoot!

title: Princess of Seas
description:
게임 정보
Princess of Seas is a sea sailing. Start the blue-colored adventure now.
Basic Features
Randomly Generated World: The world is procedurally generated. So the adventure in a completely new world every time.
Open-World: No limitation. Explore the world freely.
Trading: Selling goods all around the world and making money
Upgrading Ship: 197 ships in the world. Unlock them, buy them, and enhanced them. You can never be too powerful.
Hire Sailors: More than 300 sailors all over the world. Pick your desired sailor and build the team.
Sea Battle: Trace the pirate, defeat them (and make some money).

This game is still under development. More features are coming soon.

title: Unmurk
description:
게임 정보
숨겨진 복셀 개체를 발견하는 미니멀리스트 퍼즐 게임. 퍼즐의 가장자리만 볼 수 있으며 개체를 회전하여 퍼즐 조각을 제자리에 조정합니다. 레벨이 끝나면 숨겨진 복셀 개체를 드러냅니다.

객체 회전



퍼즐 맞추기

title: Galactic Diner
description:
게임 정보
A jam-packed, cooking-themed RPG about winning a galaxy-wide cooking tournament…
for aliens!
You’re whisked away to compete in Galactic Diner, the universe’s most popular TV show. Serve customers, explore an alien world, meet new friends, and cook everything from pancakes to dumplings as you fight your way to the top!
...But will it REALLY be that easy?
🌶️ Cook your way to the top!
It’s just a normal reality TV cooking show… or is it? Work with unlikely new friends to defeat NovaCorp and save the galaxy!
🍳 Delicious minigame madness
Master over 50 unique cooking-themed minigames. Cook in levels themed for everything from beaches to hot pots as you fight for your life against the galaxy's best chefs!

title: CyberNet
description:
게임 정보
저희는 전략 장르와 카드 게임을 결합하여 최고의 덱 빌더를 선보입니다. 독특한 덱을 구성하고, 영토를 차지하기 위해 싸우고, 카드를 조합하여 효율성을 높이고, 승리로 가는 길을 찾아야 합니다!
모든 것의 기본은 카드 덱입니다.
카드를 현명하게 선택하세요! 전투 중에 덱을 구성할 다양한 카드를 만나게 됩니다. 전략을 선택하고 카드 능력을 조합하여 상대에게 최대 피해를 입히세요.
진영
게임에는 기업, 갱단, 노마드, 네트러너의 네 가지 진영이 있습니다. 각 진영에는 고유한 특징과 능력이 있습니다. 한 진영의 카드는 서로를 강화하지만 다른 진영의 카드는 약점을 보완합니다.
지도자
매 게임마다 자신이 플레이할 진영의 지도자를 선택합니다. 모든 리더는 자신만의 능력과 재능을 가지고 있습니다. 각각의 리더에게 적합한 전략이 하나씩 있습니다. 자신이 누구인지, 어떻게 플레이하고 승리할지 선택하세요.
사이버 정신병
사이버 사이코시스는 파괴적인 힘을 더해주지만 대가가 따릅니다. 그런 대가를 치를 준비가 되셨나요? 상대는 승리를 위해 무엇을 할 의향이 있나요?
무엇보다 중요한 것은 전략입니다
훌륭한 전략가라면 강력한 카드뿐만 아니라 깔끔한 덱을 갖추는 것도 중요하다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 최고 중의 최고를 모으고 약한 카드를 제거하세요. 이 도시는 약자를 용납하지 않습니다.

title: Lokko
description:
게임 정보

LOKKO 는 즐거움과 창의성이 만나는 독창적인 3D 플랫폼 게임입니다. PS5®, PC, iOS에서 실시간으로 원활하게 도전적인 레벨을 만들고 공유하세요. 자신만의 아바타를 만들고, 적과 보스를 디자인하세요. DualSense™의 강력한 기능을 세 가지 플랫폼에서 모두 활용하세요. 플레이어들은 창작물을 교환하고 서로 경쟁할 수 있습니다. 가장 재미있고 독창적인 레벨을 만들어 보세요.
LOKKO 는 India Hero Project 2기 멤버입니다.


레벨 에디터
플랫폼 게임과 레이싱 게임을 위한 내장형 레벨 에디터를 통해 플레이어는 직접 레벨을 제작하고 배포할 수 있습니다. 타이머, 가속기, 스위치를 연결하고 NPC와 보스를 배치하여 친구들과 함께 즐길 수 있는 재미있는 레벨을 만드세요. 게임 컨트롤러 및 키보드/마우스를 지원하는 직관적인 조작 방식을 제공합니다.

title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
description:
게임 정보
Earth in 2240 had survived war, ecological threats, alien invasions and more, but after all countries exhausted their nuclear stockpiles during the last war, the world was sent back into the Dark Ages. The United States was broken into kingdoms and the lands outside of their reach were populated with mutated orcs, evil mages and entire rogue armies.



Pedro and Sofia, siblings who were questing through the open lands, are called into service to a kingdom in need, where a strange new cult has been converting the local populace and building their own radiated army. Soon, they uncover a mystery across America that must be stopped before Earth is led to its final, nuclear annihilation.

Features:
Over 60 unique skills and more than 500 different types of weapons and equipment to find or build
Fully immersive 3D environments, including a massive, open-world with dungeons, towns and mysterious locations
A unique crafting system to build and upgrade a variety of weapons, armor and more
Real-time, action-RPG combat and a story-rich quest that takes place across America
Three different characters with original stories to play as and build with unique job classes
Hours and hours of quests and surprising adventures, plus fully playable on Steam Deck

title: Changa
description:
게임 정보
Warning:Changa game play and videos contain moving patterns and changing colors which may trigger seizures in people affected by photosensitive epilepsy.


Set and Setting


A wandering consciousness that decides to forge her own path. Equipped with her extreme mobility, a melee attack, and a ranged dagger, Jade embarks on a psychedelic 3D bullet hell arcade odyssey as she tries to sever the web of suffering and escape the cycle of deaths and rebirths. Bounce, dodge, fly, and fight the illusions of material and immaterial reality in this new kind of bullet hell.


Features
















Changa is hitting Early Access with one complete difficulty of 10 maps, with a second difficulty coming soon after release. A single playthrough will test your resolve and your creativity in movement, reactions, and planning on the fly. Expect somewhere in the 2-8 hour range for a first playthrough on the base difficulty.

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder
Decorate and expand your very own hideout
WARNING ALL ACTS OF MURDER, THEIVERY, WAR CRIME, AND DEVIOUS BEHAVIORS ARE PURELY ENTERTAINMENT!

title: Casa De Diamantes
description:
게임 정보
Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower,
on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous
casino, the Casa De Diamantes.
Casa De Diamantes is a 2D movement shooter with aggressive enemy
encounters and tight level design. Fight your way through multiple enemy
types, collect chips then spend and gamble them away at the casino.
Play blackjack, customize your appearance or decorate your hotel room
at the Casa De Diamantes.
FEATURES
Momentum Based Movement

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: RECURSOR
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the RECURSOR robot and traverse through a randomly generated labyrinth of trials. Enhance your build by installing a wide variety of upgrades. How far can you go?

RECURSOR's mechanics that take inspiration from the platform fighter genre for both movement and combat. This combined with randomized levels and upgrades of the rogue-lite genre multiplies the depth and replayability.



RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

RECURSOR's artstyle takes the classic pixel art charm and makes use of modern graphics technology to give it a fresh look. Most evidently is the lighting system that casts soft shadows and uses normal maps to create the illusion of 3d.

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

title: RSOD
description:
게임 정보
AS REAL AS IT GETS ON A 686



RSOD is as cyberpunk as legally permissible. Everything glows or has a flat videogamey texture. Objects have sharp black outlines, like an anime. All the maps are honest geometry with 1:1 physics on almost every triangle.



Shoot some zombies, or catgirls, rednecks, or cyborgs. Hitscan, projectiles, ranged and melee. Engage in content. Experience graphics.

Development is ongoing and the release date may be pushed back until the base game has sufficient content.

title: Hypnotix
description:
게임 정보
What is Hypnotix?
Hypnotix is a guided meditation mindfulness app which will take you on a different journey every time you click 'Start'.

This app is not for the faint of heart, as you will need to completely let go and prepare to be taken to unknown places within your mind . . .

Featuring:

* Algorithms that put together a different meditation journey each time, by chaining different sound files into varying combinations.
* Hundreds of meditation sound files.
* Mystery lockboxes and other awards to unlock, as a reward for time spent in meditation.
What is the aim of this app?
The focus is on you 100%. My aim is to help you unwind, relax, and take you on many exotic, unpredictable, mysterious and fun journeys.
How is this app different to most other meditation apps?
The guided meditations are put together using algorithms which build a different relaxing experience every time, using hundreds of different sound files. The guided meditations are almost hypnotic. Hypnotix is a sister app to 'Boot Camp Fitness' but focusing on mindfulness and relaxation rather than physical health and exercise.

This is not your standard, hit the spacebar and time your mediations app.
Can I control the journey in any way?
No, you will have no control whatsoever, which gives Hypnotix its appeal. There are some player settings where you can turn on or off suggestions for healthy eating, regular exercise, stress management, confidence building etc, but beyond that you will have no control. However, despite being unorthodox and unpredictable Hypnotix only takes you to positive places.
The development road map
The aim is to add more and more mystery journey meditation sound files to expand the game further and further. With many journeys shaped and influenced by players.
When using Hypnotix, please find a safe space where you can close your eyes, either by lying down or sitting comfortably. Do not use this app when driving, using heavy machinery or any other activity that requires waking attention.

title: Thawed Waters
description:
게임 정보
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

title: One More Encounter
description:
게임 정보
One More Encounter: The Game That Never Was
On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.
More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.
Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.
Over 6 different characters (there are 8 characters)
More than 20 minutes of gameplay (if you're a slow reader)
Two or more endings (but you can only get one)
Dynamic narrative text (because one letter appears after another)
Disclaimer
Due to problems with the game executable itself, it may have to be restarted several times to complete the game fully. We have tried our best not to do this, but something has prevented us from doing so. We have not been able to find the reason. We hope that, with your help, we can solve this mystery together.
Content Warning
The game has graphic depictions of violence, self-mutilation, and blood. Please, be very careful.
Created by Diego Freire
Art and UI by Fran Segura
SFX and Music by Javier Calderón

title: Echo Wars - Road Rage
description:
게임 정보


The Echo brothers, two retired cybernetic clone troopers, enjoy their well-deserved retirement and the company of Meghan, their adorable enginurse, with whom they reminisce about their crazy past adventures. But little do the old cyborgs suspect that their days of action are not over yet…

Meghan seems to be suspiciously interested in these core memories. We soon find out that the enginurse is forcing the Echo brothers to remember their past exploits to unlock one by one the pieces of a great puzzle that takes shape as the game progresses.



Echo Wars is a driving shooter that can be played in cooperative multiplayer, where players take on the role of the Echo brothers, two retired cyber soldiers, and relive their adventures aboard a futuristic combat buggy.

Echo Wars is designed to make the most of Virtual Reality displays, but it can also be enjoyed on regular screens, ultra-panoramic screens, and Steam Deck.

The Echo brothers reminisce about their past missions as elite imperial officers at each level. Their tendency to exaggerate and brag about their feats allows the player to choose how specific phrases of the interactive script end, with surprising and hilarious results.

The narrative leads to action-packed first-person levels. Thanks to the three difficulty levels available, we will be driving with one hand while shooting with the other in breathtaking gameplay suitable for all players.

title: Rail Fights
description:
게임 정보
Rail Fights is a multiplayer shooter for 1-8 players that adds a competitive edge to the simplicity of old-school arcade games. Players ride their tanks on a closed oval rail, bump other tanks around, capture different launchers, shoot and total opponents on the other side of the arena.
Solo or Team
Fight solo against 7 other solo players, team up with a friend as a duo to face off against 3 other teams of two or join forces with three other players to form a team of four and compete against another team.
Multiplayer
Enjoy Rail Fights locally with friends on your device, playing against each other or AI. We're keeping an eye on player interest and may add online features, like casual and ranked matches, in the future based on demand.
Single Player
Not in the party mood? You can always enjoy single-player mode against AI opponents and aim to top the leaderboards.

title: Super Spy Academy
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure filled with espionage and intrigue in Super Spy Academy, a captivating narrative-driven game set in a prestigious private university overtaken by sinister forces. As Leo, a determined freshman, players must navigate through a series of challenging puzzles and obstacles to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of his brother and the infiltration of the academy by the villainous "Super Villain Academy."

With the help of QBear, an AI companion, players will explore a rich 3D world teeming with secrets and surprises, interacting with unique characters along the way. From navigating through six diverse areas with their own distinct themes to solving over 15 puzzles scattered throughout the academy, every step taken brings players closer to unraveling the gripping mystery at the heart of Super Spy Academy.

Featuring fully voice-acted dialogue, captivating visual novel-style storytelling elements, and engaging mini-games to test your spy skills, Super Spy Academy offers an immersive gameplay experience unlike any other. Whether playing with a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad, players will find themselves immersed in a world where every clue leads closer to the truth. Dive into a world of suspense and embark on an unforgettable journey to save the academy from its perilous fate.

Key Features:

Lots of characters to interact with
Explore 6 diverse areas, each with its own theme and challenges
Solve over 15 puzzles to progress through the story
Fully voice-acted cast brings the characters to life
Experience visual novel-style storytelling elements
Navigate a rich 3D world filled with secrets
Engage in mini-games to test your spy skills
Compatible with mouse and keyboard, as well as gamepad controls

title: Sanity City
description:
게임 정보
>> Virtual Reality Avatar Multiplayer Raids
Put on your VR headset and customize your body.
Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world.
Team up with your friends and go on a raid.
Acquire money, equipment and fame.

>> Leave your mark in Sanity City
Explore the urban canyons of your hood in Sanity City.
Browse stores of all kinds along the streets.
Do business with smugglers and gunrunners.
Find the next client who will send you on a lucrative mission.
Assemble a team and make sure everyone comes back alive.
Money is great, but you need street fame to stay in the game...

>> Cybernetics
Guns and crime rule the streets in the outer districts of Sanity City.
You've become a raider striving for fame and money.
A mercenary for crime syndicates, shady corporations and anyone else who'll pay you.
State-of-the-art gear is expensive and the only way to survive in this high-tech, cut-throat environment.
You will require all the firepower you can muster, but occasionally sneak and hack your way into buildings.

>> Rumors
Someone - something? - is shaking the established order of the criminal underground.
Prominent teams of raiders are taken out one by one.
Survivors are rare, and they tell incredible stories of a single fighter, lightning fast and seemingly invincible.
You don't believe in fairy tales of losers. Nothing exists that can not be killed.
But what if there is something to the rumors about the H.E.R.O.S. project after all?
That secret gear could give you godlike powers and make you king of the underworld in no time...

>> The late 2030s
Sanity City is the Utopian experiment amidst a world of chaos, a shimmering sign of hope for mankind.
During the "turbulent twenties", a decade of global disorder, this ever growing giga-metropolis was designated as a neutral, supranational zone by the remaining nations of the world.
Governed by a highly advanced AI, this is a place where all people are equal. A place for all people to prosper. And a safe harbor for every sane person fleeing from madness, war and disaster. It is a place where all your past sins are forgiven…
So they say.

title: Bomberrage
description:
게임 정보

💣 Bomberrage – 폭발적인 멀티플레이 배틀!

개요: 혼돈 속으로 뛰어들어라! Bomberrage는 빠른 속도와 액션이 가득한 멀티플레이 게임으로, 전략과 반사 신경이 생존을 결정한다! 스마트한 AI와 맞서 싸우거나 친구들과 함께 매 순간이 중요한 폭발적인 전투를 펼쳐라!
주요 특징:

🔥 강렬한 멀티플레이 배틀 – AI 또는 실제 플레이어와 박진감 넘치는 폭탄 전투!
🧠 도전적인 AI 상대 – 적응하고 잔혹한 적을 뛰어넘어라!
🗺 끊임없이 변화하는 아레나 – 절차적으로 생성된 맵으로 항상 신선한 전투!
🎮 배우기 쉬우나 마스터하기 어려움 – 캐주얼 플레이어도 즐길 수 있으며, 경쟁적인 플레이어에게는 도전적인 경험!
🎬 에픽 시네마틱 & 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 – 폭발이 이보다 더 멋져 보인 적은 없다!

title: Crawling Silence
description:
게임 정보
Crawling Silence is a survival horror game featuring an online co-op and singleplayer escape mode.. When playing, the players must find clues and solve puzzles to uncover the secrets hidden within the building. During your exploration, you must find one of multiple ways out of the building, utilizing items randomly hidden around the map. But beware, mistakes may alert creatures hiding behind every corner....
The setting
Crawling Silence is set in an old, long forgotten building shrouded in mystery, the secrets of which you must uncover.
But beware, various dangerous creatures may lurk in the dark...
The monsters you encounter while uncovering the secrets within the building have full access to vents, rooms and secret areas, so be cautious...

Many elements of the game are puzzle based
There are various hidden doors and passages which you can discover, and maybe find helpful clues or items!
or they will turn against you, and force you to react quickly!

title: Volleyhalla
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of Volleyhalla, a hectic, frantic "battle-tennis" game. Defend the flock, destroy evil.

Engage in ritualized barbarian shepherd combat, which coincidentally happens to look a little bit like ping pong.
As the last Battle Shepherd, it's up to you to guard your herd from marauding beasts and harvest wool to trade for essential resources.
With each victory, you'll restore your land and uncover ancient secrets hidden beneath the soil.
Along the way, unlock unique characters who bring their own skills and stories to your journey.
Find and purchase new Weapons and Shields to complement your playstyle and vanquish your foes.
Wield unique Magics to give you an edge over your ruthless opponents and turn the tide.
Your destiny is to rebuild, protect, and save Volley Valley—will you rise to the challenge?

title: Spikeball
description:
게임 정보
Spikeball is a sports video game that adapts the classic game of Spikeball to the digital environment. Designed to offer a fast and competitive gaming experience, it allows you to face players from all over the world or enjoy games with friends.
In Spikeball, accuracy, strategy and speed are key. The the game is designed to deliver exciting games in every session.
Fast and Accurate Gameplay: Dynamic games that capture the essence of Spikeball.
Multiplayer Modes: Compete online with a friend or join a match online.
Player Customization: Configure your avatar with different clothing and accessory options.
Background Music: The main menu has a DJ that adds a sound environment according to the rhythm of the game.

title: Miuma
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember your aunt from fifteen years ago, your aunt fussing in the kitchen during the early morning to prepare the pastries for the first customers? The nostalgia of baked delectables, the scent of aged wood, and the compassionate atmosphere of family all caused your heart to twinge. Suddenly, your old house was tragically abandoned, and the glory of the former bakery was only but a distant memory that was lost in the past. After so many years, could you revive the family business and return home, accepting the challenge?

In this absorbing adventure, you can provide your fellow neighbors with luscious, lip-smacking cakes, pies, and rolls; you can engage in different handicrafts, participate in the town's fests and fairs, delight in the hymns of nature, contemplate about your town's historical streets, intriguingly interact with those around you, and explore the lore together with Kevin!

This video-game creation has both a colorful gameplay with endless possibilities and a captivating plot. A story of a timeless town is told through its vivid residents, including the protagonist Kevin and his ancestors. Free will acts as a guardian: decisions and freedom are bestowed upon you with the bittersweet responsibility of further consequences. You are allowed to decide for yourself—from a certain day's tasks to the revelation of unseen opportunities.

Sometimes, one can face barriers with which they cannot cope. Sometimes, one makes inevitable, daunting mistakes and makes the wrong decisions. Sometimes, the world does not turn out to be as open and tender as one had wondered in their childhood of purity. Instead, one can be met with the unmerciful, shattering apathy of reality. Even so, you have the spirit to keep your welcoming heart warm to let love spread and to live life to the fullest.

This game is not just a simple bakery simulator: it's a story about a young man whose fate was to resume family traditions of baking and about a man who can reject these traditions—but ... does he want to? Your life is devised by your habits, the choices that function as the fragments to your very being.

title: THE KNIGHT OF NEPHIART
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW

THE KNIGHT OF NEPHIART is a classic RPG for VR in which you lead a party as a knight to fight against the Demon King.
A player can experience the adventure in a fantasy world while looking around 360 degrees in VR.



The battle system uses a turn-based command input.
With an old-school system feel let you play right away, without any learning.


Relive your imagination in your youth, 'Diving into the imaginary world' with VR !

The royal family of the kingdom of NEPHIART has brought peace to the kingdom through the power of light passed down from generation to generation.
The family undergoes the holy land trials in order to awaken the special power.
A knight of the kingdom accepts an order to escort the princess to the holy land and sets off with her.

They travel around the holy land and the princess undergoes trials.
Their conventional journey to awaken the special power takes a sudden turn when something strange happens at the royal palace.

title: Blinding Oversight
description:
게임 정보
Blinding Oversight is a slow-burning, narrative-driven horror experience that emphasizes atmosphere, isolation, and unraveling mystery.
FEATURES
Explore a decaying log house and the woods surrounding it, both designed to unnerve and disorient
Piece together a haunting backstory of the family that resided in the house by interacting with scattered letters, sketches, and environmental storytelling
Endure disturbing visions and unsettling imagery that blur the line between reality and hallucination
A world that gets darker and creepier as events progress in the game
Navigate the space with limited tools, relying on observation, exploration, and instinct to find your way out
A short, deliberately-paced experience focused on build-up through anxiety, linear storytelling, and immersive sound design
THE GAMEPLAY
Waking up in a room she doesn’t recognize, Emma finds herself lying on a dusty, blood-stained bed with bandages wrapped around her head. Looking around, she notices moldy wooden walls dimly lit by the evening glow. With her last memory being a solo road trip, she begins to suspect she may have been kidnapped – or worse.
With no map, no weapons, and no clear answers, you must guide Emma through a decrepit log house and whatever lies beyond. Clues are scarce and nothing is explained outright. You’ll find letters, drawings, and fragments of stories that suggest something deeply wrong happened here… and may still be happening.
Visions will strike – unprompted and often inexplicable. Some might hold meaning. Others may be fragments of Emma’s deteriorating mind. As the world shifts subtly around you, you’ll begin to question: what’s real, and what is meant to be real?
Your only goal is to get out. But doing so will mean pushing forward into the unknown—and uncovering a truth you may not want to face.
THE STORY
Emma is alone. At least, that’s what it seems like at first. After regaining consciousness in a strange wooden house, she’s plagued by disjointed memories, inexplicable visions, and a deep sense of being watched.

title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato
description:
게임 정보
When Miho steps into the pantry to get a potato for his grandmothers' soup, he's suddenly pulled into a distant fantastical land where he must retrace the steps of a mysterious great traveler before him.
He must venture through a world of wonderous rainforests, teetering towns, and talking beasts, outsmarting thieves and meeting quirky characters along the way.
But each time he returns to the kitchen with an ingredient, things have changed in unexpected ways…
Sopa is a tale about family, adventure, and the things we pass along to future generations, comforting like the first sip of hot soup on a cold day and vital as an ancient memory.
autokwd: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato

title: A Ruthless World
description:
게임 정보
As an employee of Juice™, you wake up to a beautiful new day. While the urge to get to work is strong, there’s still time to tidy up at home and choose your outfit for the day. Once everything feels just right, you head off to your beloved Juice™ battery factory.
In this puzzle adventure, featuring 80s-styled graphics and modern physics, things are not always as straightforward as they seem. What starts as a simple journey to get to work turns into an adventure filled with obstacles, strange creatures, and inexplicable events.
Easy, customisable, controls using keyboard, gamepad, or touch input
Learn new abilities and combine them as game progresses
Bite-sized levels* with unique problems to solve
Character customization
Should run on a potato, see requirements for specifics
*Includes a subscription to Juice™ Reconstruction Service.

title: DEVIL'S LIMINAL
description:
게임 정보
A yuri horror visual novel inspired by Azores folklore.
Margo Silva has done everything she can to leave behind the trailer park in Arizona where she grew up. Now all she has to do is focus on her summer job until she can leave for college. Her illusion of a quiet summer is shattered when a hungry ghost enters her dreams.
Two mysterious girls show up in town, claiming they can help her.
Margo must contend with a demon's claim on her soul, and how to stop ghosts from this life and the past that want to take her future.

title: Rogue Tank
description:
게임 정보

Rogue Tank is a chaotic 3D tank shooter with rogue-lite elements. Enter the arena with your trusty tank. It’s time to wreak havoc!
COMBINE DEADLY UPGRADES
Upgrade your tank as you defeat your enemies. Pick upgrades that fit your style of combat. However, choose carefully, as combining the right set of upgrades will turn your tank into an absolute force of destruction.

Bombard enemies with your turret, crash them into deadly arena traps, zap them with lightning, or burn them to a crisp. Destroy your enemies with a diverse set of tools as you dodge incoming attacks.

Unlock new weapons, upgrades, and arenas as you battle. Permanently upgrade your tank to become even stronger!

title: Zoolovelogy
description:
게임 정보
Pair up all animals with one of their own type to beat each puzzle level
Explore how different animal types, objects, and tiles interact with one another and
Utilize their unique traits to find the optimal solution and earn all 3 stars!
Make and share your own puzzles using Zoolovelogy's handy in-game editor

Features:
Easy to grasp but deep gameplay with many different interactions
Hundreds of levels (100+ on release)
Lots of different animal types, each with their own unique attributes (with more to come!)
Various tiles and objects that differentiate the gameplay
Puzzle editor so that players can create their own custom levels & share them with others

title: Folk Emerging
description:
게임 정보
Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky autobattler combat. Discover fire, domestication, politics—and survive to tell the tale.
Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.

title: Portal Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Portal Guardians는 당신을 지루하게 만들지 않을 것입니다!
혼자 또는 친구와 싸우십시오. 다양한 무기와 함정을 사용하여 적의 파도를 막으세요! 포털이 전 세계에 열렸습니다. 곧 닫힙니다!

무기고에 있는 무기의 모든 힘을 사용하고 다양한 장소(벽, 바닥 및 천장)에 다양한 함정을 설치하여 스토리 시나리오를 진행하세요. 무기고를 개선하고 개선 수준마다 무기의 강도가 증가하고 함정의 힘이 증가합니다. 포털이 닫히는 동안 포털을 보호하여 세계 질서를 회복하고 괴물이 거기에 가지 못하게 하십시오!
주요 기능

스토리 캠페인 - 적의 무리와 싸우고 이러한 공격의 원인이 되는 신비한 힘을 발견하십시오.
협동 플레이 - 두 명의 용감한 영웅을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다..
치명적인 무기 - 마법, 활, 검 등 고유한 특성을 가진 9가지 유형의 무기
죽음의 함정 - 벽, 바닥, 천장에 설치할 수 있는 다양한 함정입니다. 이 함정은 적 무리를 제거하는 데 도움이 되므로 업그레이드하는 것을 잊지 마세요!
Dangerous Enemies - 고유한 특징과 특징을 지닌 30가지 이상의 상대 유형! 무기와 함정을 현명하게 선택하세요!
개선 사항 - 캠페인을 진행하면서 무기와 함정을 업그레이드하세요.
광범위한 재생성 - 난이도 선택은 몇 번이고 다시 돌아오고 싶은 욕구를 일깨울 것입니다!

title: The Golden Light Guardian
description:
게임 정보
Sure, here's the translation to Korean:
광활한 오픈 월드 맵을 탐험하세요!!!
다양한 생물 군계를 발견하고, 독특한 자원, 숨겨진 비밀, 위험한 적들을 찾아보세요. 모든 코너에는 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다!

생존하세요!
재료를 모으고, 음식을 사냥하며, 건강과 스태미나를 관리하여 적대적인 환경에서 살아남으세요.

섬을 탐험하고 생존을 위해 사냥하세요. 당신의 기술을 사용하여 몬스터를 추적하고 처치하며, 자원을 모으고 도구를 제작하고 음식을 요리하여 생존하세요.

섬을 돌아다니는 몬스터들을 조심하세요.

끊임없이 몰려오는 해골 공격자들을 견디기 위해 방어를 전략적으로 구축하고 강화하세요.

title: Body Count
description:
게임 정보
Body Count lets you step into the worn shoes of a dedicated cop whose world is shattered by a personal tragedy. As the line between right and wrong blurs, you'll grapple with the moral cost of justice in the face of unspeakable loss. Dive into a gripping experience where personal consequences are no longer calculated and a once venerable cop decends into the path of vengeance.


Body Count is a bullet hell shooter that challenges you to explore the gritty side of morality as you navigate a city teetering on the edge of chaos.

title: Alien Boom Boom
description:
게임 정보



The aliens are invading your small town, they seem to be everywhere, but a mysterious transmission is guiding you to fight back!




It's time to take the fight to them! Put a stop to their plans by travelling through their network of interconnected ships, bringing you to new destinations such as moon bases, space stations, the white house, exotic runes, your small town and more!




Your ability to utilize your weapons effectively, control recoil, and place those much needed headshots is great and all, but you're still going to have to master the movement! Dash, jump and time your attacks effectively to ensure you tip the scales in Earth's favor.




The mysterious voice in your head needs your help! There is more here than meets the eye, and some how you are central to stopping this invasion.
The truth is UP there!

Alien Boom Boom is a shooter that embraces exaggerated action over realism.

Master your movement and powerful weapons such as explosive shotguns, powerful plasma rifles, railguns that rip through enemies and more. Visit many locations, while battling the alien threat including: moon bases, space stations, the white house and exotic locales.





Follow the journey of a small-town hero as they are thrust into a world-saving mission
Discover the truth behind the alien invasion and uncover a sinister plot.

title: Christmas Smash
description:
게임 정보
전작 "Christmas Blaster"에서 산타클로스는 이미 크리스마스를 위협하는 사악한 존재 크람푸스와 맞서 싸워 그를 물리쳤습니다. 그의 용기와 결단력이 승리하여 평화와 기쁨을 되찾았습니다.
이제 "Christmas Smash"에서 크람푸스가 돌아와 엘프들 사이에서 큰 반란을 일으키고, 산타클로스를 그의 사명을 포기하도록 강요하기 위해 산타 부인을 납치합니다. 용기와 뛰어난 능력으로 잘 알려진 산타클로스는 다시 한 번 다가오는 위험에 맞서기 위해 소환되며, 이번에는 크람푸스와 그의 반역 엘프 군대로부터 사랑하는 사람을 구해야 합니다.
여정 동안 산타클로스는 부패한 엘프, 기계, 얼음 병사와 같은 강력한 적들과 위험한 도전에 직면합니다. 그는 동료들의 도움을 받아 눈 덮인 환경을 헤치고 나아가며, 최종적으로 적 크람푸스의 소굴에 도달하여 그와의 최후의 대결에 임합니다.
폭발적이고 액션 가득한 모험을 준비하세요!

title: Betroyal
description:
게임 정보
Betroyal is a fast-paced roguelite turn-based tactical game, that took best from roguelike tactics genre. Pass through regions full of encounters, hire and upgrade units, get epic perks, abilities and items fro your commander and kill all bosses. And again, but with crazy build that you always wanted to try.

Build up your camp to draft more powerful and rare units, and unlock new perks for the protagonist.

The sheer variety of tactical and strategic options makes Betroyal a true treat for any ardent fans of the roguelite genre.
Core Features:

Hundreds of builds for your commander from classic to the most insane
A new look at a turn-based combat system
Three regions with procedural generations of encounters
50+ units, including Meat Wagon and Swine Lord, to hire and upgrade with more than 200 individual abilities
Camp building to unlock devastating possibilities
Narrative image of father-daughter relationships without tons of texts
Classic tactics and roguelite features, including numerous commander builds, procedural map generation, and high replay value

title: CrossPlanet
description:
게임 정보
CrossPlanet – The Ultimate Multiplayer Shooter Experience
CrossPlanet is a thrilling third-person shooter that delivers fast-paced, skill-based combat across dynamic battlefields. Whether you're facing off against other players in intense PVP firefights or teaming up to battle monstrous alien creatures in PVE missions, CrossPlanet offers action-packed gameplay with a focus on strategy, movement, and precision gunplay.
A Shooter Focused on Gameplay First
No unnecessary fluff—CrossPlanet is built for fluid movement, satisfying gunplay, and competitive action. Players can sprint, take cover, aim down sights, and unleash devastating firepower across a variety of maps and modes. With a robust selection of 11 weapons, each with distinct handling and playstyles, every encounter feels fresh and tactical.
Battle Across Diverse Worlds
From futuristic military bases to hostile alien landscapes, CrossPlanet’s maps are designed for strategic combat and environmental storytelling. Engage in team-based skirmishes, solo challenges, and cooperative missions as you adapt to ever-changing battle scenarios.
Key Features:
✅ Multiplayer Warfare – Face off in competitive PVP battles or squad up for cooperative PVE missions.
✅ Diverse Arsenal – Wield 15 unique weapons, each designed for specific playstyles.
✅ Tactical Movement – Sprint, evade, double jump, jetpack and use map layouts to outmaneuver your enemies.
✅ PVE Battles – Fight against swarms of alien creatures and massive bosses in thrilling co-op missions, or risk going in solo.
✅ Skill-Based Combat – No pay-to-win mechanics—victory comes from strategy and reflexes.
CrossPlanet features 10 PVP Multiplayer maps, 15 Modes, 10 Unique Armors to wear and show off, earned through playing the game! Plus, a range of PVE missions against waves of enemies and huge bosses, either alone or with friends! 
CrossPlanet is designed for players who love pure shooter gameplay without distractions. Whether you're a competitive player looking for your next challenge or a PVE fan ready to take on alien horrors, prepare to drop into the action.
Are you ready to dominate the battlefield?

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder
Decorate and expand your very own hideout
WARNING ALL ACTS OF MURDER, THEIVERY, WAR CRIME, AND DEVIOUS BEHAVIORS ARE PURELY ENTERTAINMENT!

title: Casa De Diamantes
description:
게임 정보
Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower,
on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous
casino, the Casa De Diamantes.
Casa De Diamantes is a 2D movement shooter with aggressive enemy
encounters and tight level design. Fight your way through multiple enemy
types, collect chips then spend and gamble them away at the casino.
Play blackjack, customize your appearance or decorate your hotel room
at the Casa De Diamantes.
FEATURES
Momentum Based Movement

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: RECURSOR
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the RECURSOR robot and traverse through a randomly generated labyrinth of trials. Enhance your build by installing a wide variety of upgrades. How far can you go?

RECURSOR's mechanics that take inspiration from the platform fighter genre for both movement and combat. This combined with randomized levels and upgrades of the rogue-lite genre multiplies the depth and replayability.



RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

RECURSOR's artstyle takes the classic pixel art charm and makes use of modern graphics technology to give it a fresh look. Most evidently is the lighting system that casts soft shadows and uses normal maps to create the illusion of 3d.

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

title: RSOD
description:
게임 정보
AS REAL AS IT GETS ON A 686



RSOD is as cyberpunk as legally permissible. Everything glows or has a flat videogamey texture. Objects have sharp black outlines, like an anime. All the maps are honest geometry with 1:1 physics on almost every triangle.



Shoot some zombies, or catgirls, rednecks, or cyborgs. Hitscan, projectiles, ranged and melee. Engage in content. Experience graphics.

Development is ongoing and the release date may be pushed back until the base game has sufficient content.

title: Hypnotix
description:
게임 정보
What is Hypnotix?
Hypnotix is a guided meditation mindfulness app which will take you on a different journey every time you click 'Start'.

This app is not for the faint of heart, as you will need to completely let go and prepare to be taken to unknown places within your mind . . .

Featuring:

* Algorithms that put together a different meditation journey each time, by chaining different sound files into varying combinations.
* Hundreds of meditation sound files.
* Mystery lockboxes and other awards to unlock, as a reward for time spent in meditation.
What is the aim of this app?
The focus is on you 100%. My aim is to help you unwind, relax, and take you on many exotic, unpredictable, mysterious and fun journeys.
How is this app different to most other meditation apps?
The guided meditations are put together using algorithms which build a different relaxing experience every time, using hundreds of different sound files. The guided meditations are almost hypnotic. Hypnotix is a sister app to 'Boot Camp Fitness' but focusing on mindfulness and relaxation rather than physical health and exercise.

This is not your standard, hit the spacebar and time your mediations app.
Can I control the journey in any way?
No, you will have no control whatsoever, which gives Hypnotix its appeal. There are some player settings where you can turn on or off suggestions for healthy eating, regular exercise, stress management, confidence building etc, but beyond that you will have no control. However, despite being unorthodox and unpredictable Hypnotix only takes you to positive places.
The development road map
The aim is to add more and more mystery journey meditation sound files to expand the game further and further. With many journeys shaped and influenced by players.
When using Hypnotix, please find a safe space where you can close your eyes, either by lying down or sitting comfortably. Do not use this app when driving, using heavy machinery or any other activity that requires waking attention.

title: Thawed Waters
description:
게임 정보
Thawed Waters is a mature emotional story experienced through hardcore boat-poling gameplay when every wrong move leads to losses and each stamina point counts!

Thawed Waters is not another farming sim, nor rogue-like, but pure classic isometric action with a problematic topic that needs to be raised in video games.

It's time to look into the ugliest corner of human life - animal testing.

"Pandemic of the second decade was nothing compared to what global warming melted in the Arctic later, freeing bacteria buried by nature millions of years ago. One of the thawed viruses ruthlessly attacked not only people but also animals of all kinds. Multiple attempts to develop a vaccine before the world plunged into chaos were unsuccessful, and a few remnants scattered across the globe lost all hope of surviving."
Stepan, head of Pukhovka village, 2047



NAVIGATE THE BOAT

Survive the planetary flood in the rusty boat with the pole in your hands! Choose directions wisely and apply force carefully to minimise rocking and tilting and avoid capsizing. Go around obstacles with the surgeon’s precision to keep the boat in one piece. Mistakes cost precious live cargo and materials, and the old man's stamina is a finite resource. Every decision is critical.

RESCUE AND SIT RABBITS

Finding the perfect time to pick rabbits is one side of the problem. How about sitting jumpy animals around the boat to achieve balance? The boat's behaviour depends on it, and therefore your life! Don’t miss a safe zone to release your fellow travellers or drown together and be forgotten.

FIGHT FATIGUE

Mental and physical fatigue are your eternal silent companions, that you have to deal with to survive. Collect and identify Siberian herbs and berries, mix them and brew a cosy cup of tea in safe zones to ease physical fatigue. Or not too cosy and get some unexpected side effects. Live through events of your past as mini-games to reduce or increase mental fatigue when dreaming next to the bonfire.

UPGRADE AND MODIFY

Your only ally, a mysterious prosthetic arm, holds the key to survival. Upgrade it with unique mods, and unleash its potential to travel further, push stronger, and save more lives. The boat barely stays afloat, but natural wit and a bit of luck will get you some cool artefacts increasing the boat’s stability or strength when it is needed the most.

LIVE THROUGH APOCALYPTICAL EVENTS

Fight the forces of nature to save it and give humanity another chance. Find a new meaning in life and watch how the broken old man transforms physically and mentally. Discover all the endings of this unusual story of personal salvation through rescuing the tiniest creatures. Explore the dark and submerged corners of the dying Siberian hinterland with a touch of cyberpunk.

title: One More Encounter
description:
게임 정보
One More Encounter: The Game That Never Was
On November 17, 1992, a small group of three developers released a video game like no other. Only available for the NEC PC-9801 computer, this was the most ambitious game the industry had ever conceived. Unfortunately, it was a sales failure and was lost in the abyss of time.
More than 30 years later, One More Encounter (a.k.a OME) has been partially revived. One More Encounter was a dungeon crawler where the important thing was not the motif, but the journey itself and the characters we encountered along the way. Unfortunately, only 0.35% of the total game could be saved. That is, of the more than two thousand possible encounters in the game, this version only contains seven.
Be that as it may, this is a look at a world that could have been, an industry that never really took hold, and a type of videogame that, so many years later, we are still struggling to make.
Over 6 different characters (there are 8 characters)
More than 20 minutes of gameplay (if you're a slow reader)
Two or more endings (but you can only get one)
Dynamic narrative text (because one letter appears after another)
Disclaimer
Due to problems with the game executable itself, it may have to be restarted several times to complete the game fully. We have tried our best not to do this, but something has prevented us from doing so. We have not been able to find the reason. We hope that, with your help, we can solve this mystery together.
Content Warning
The game has graphic depictions of violence, self-mutilation, and blood. Please, be very careful.
Created by Diego Freire
Art and UI by Fran Segura
SFX and Music by Javier Calderón

title: Sanity City
description:
게임 정보
>> Virtual Reality Avatar Multiplayer Raids
Put on your VR headset and customize your body.
Start your new life in a futuristic cyber world.
Team up with your friends and go on a raid.
Acquire money, equipment and fame.

>> Leave your mark in Sanity City
Explore the urban canyons of your hood in Sanity City.
Browse stores of all kinds along the streets.
Do business with smugglers and gunrunners.
Find the next client who will send you on a lucrative mission.
Assemble a team and make sure everyone comes back alive.
Money is great, but you need street fame to stay in the game...

>> Cybernetics
Guns and crime rule the streets in the outer districts of Sanity City.
You've become a raider striving for fame and money.
A mercenary for crime syndicates, shady corporations and anyone else who'll pay you.
State-of-the-art gear is expensive and the only way to survive in this high-tech, cut-throat environment.
You will require all the firepower you can muster, but occasionally sneak and hack your way into buildings.

>> Rumors
Someone - something? - is shaking the established order of the criminal underground.
Prominent teams of raiders are taken out one by one.
Survivors are rare, and they tell incredible stories of a single fighter, lightning fast and seemingly invincible.
You don't believe in fairy tales of losers. Nothing exists that can not be killed.
But what if there is something to the rumors about the H.E.R.O.S. project after all?
That secret gear could give you godlike powers and make you king of the underworld in no time...

>> The late 2030s
Sanity City is the Utopian experiment amidst a world of chaos, a shimmering sign of hope for mankind.
During the "turbulent twenties", a decade of global disorder, this ever growing giga-metropolis was designated as a neutral, supranational zone by the remaining nations of the world.
Governed by a highly advanced AI, this is a place where all people are equal. A place for all people to prosper. And a safe harbor for every sane person fleeing from madness, war and disaster. It is a place where all your past sins are forgiven…
So they say.

title: Rusty Seas
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Seas is a retro-style game reminiscent of the 16-bit console era with a splash of 90's computer gaming, drawing inspiration and design philosophy from some of the great classics of that time, as well as plucking a few bits from more modern games to bridge the gap.

Play as Mirig, a diner waitress whose afternoon off is interrupted by a mysterious (and very profitable) offer to collect high-tech junk washing up on the beaches of Northshore. But her venture is fraught with a colorful cast of competitors who also want to lay claim to the salvages. To overcome, Mirig will need to throw her weight around, dunk her adversaries, buy outfits and items, and make friends and allies along the way.

In addition to action-based gameplay, Rusty Seas also features a splash of visual novel style content, through which the player can learn that the lore of Northshore runs a little deeper than its cozy sands.

title: Skip Lake 2
description:
게임 정보
Skip Lake 2 is a minimalist and relaxing puzzle, set in a lake of crystal clear waters and musical rocks.



The sequel of Skip Lake, this game is now going a litlle deeper in the story, and bringing new mechanichs with unique puzzles!

The game captures the international game of skipping stones into the water, transforming it into a puzzle of logic and direction, with harmony of music and sound effects, carefully composed to relax.
Hit the pots trough stunning landscapes
Key Features

Touch the rotating pillars until they are at the right angle for the stone to hit until it reaches the pot on the other side of the lake !!

title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon is a spiritual successor to the classic Ogre Battle series, combining real-time, squad-based tactics gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Move units across the map in real time to capture towns and castles; when enemy units come in contact, a turn-based battle ensues, with the defeated side forced to give up ground.



Organize soldiers with unique appearance, stats and classes into units. Choose from dozens of classes, and customize your unit's formation to maximize each soldier's effectiveness, taking advantage of position-specific abilities, damage types and resistances, and support abilities which can be used to help nearby units when they enter combat.



Explore dozens of unique regions depicted in lush, hand-painted graphics. Destroy your opponents and capture their territories to win. Choose where to stand your ground - fighting from the right terrain can give you the advantage you need, and traversing difficult terrain can build up fatigue that will reduce your units' effectiveness.




When your unit comes in contact with the enemy, a turn-based battle ensues. Battles play out ; characters act in initiative order, and their actions are determined by their class, formation, and enemy positioning. Archers will rain down destruction on enemies from the rear, but if they lose their cover, they're defenseless. Swordsmen will attack from the front row and must hit the enemy's front row first; from the rear, they'll do nothing. Bleddyn the bard will bravely wield his rapier from the front, or play a song to buff the entire squad from the back.

The side that deals the most morale damage - by hitting hard, taking down units, or weakening the enemy commander - is the winner, with the other side losing ground on the map.


Years ago, the scattered kingdoms of the Britons were nearly united by one of history's greatest princes, Llewelyn the Great, in fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Llewelyn was the greatest ruler the land had seen since King Arthur. But when he reached the apex of his power, he died, leaving behind a messy succession crisis. And in the chaos, England invaded, leading to a loss of nearly all Llewelyn had won.

Llewelyn II was named after his famous grandfather. He too is destined for greatness and will someday be known to history. But his path to greatness is uncertain: his father and brothers are imprisoned in London, England occupies half of the territory of Gwynedd, raiders harry the coast, and the ruling prince, Llewelyn's uncle, is viewed by many as a usurper. Will he be known as the prophesied Son of Destiny who ruled over a united Kingdom of the Britons, or as the prince who lost everything when England invaded?
autokwd: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

title: Space gold rush TD
description:
게임 정보
Space Gold Rush is a unique hybrid of tower-defense and real-time-strategy. Set in the not distant future where space travel has become viable to everyone. In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

title: Tapes of Fear: Smile
description:
게임 정보


Tapes of Fear: Smile는 당신에게 극한의 공포를 안겨주기 위해 만들어졌습니다. 이 1인칭 심리 공포 게임은 플레이할 때마다 독특하고 무서운 경험을 보장합니다.



Tapes of Fear의 중심에는 Infinity Green Game Studio가 개발한 혁신적인 Infinity Fear System™이 있습니다. 공포를 유발하는 방법에 대한 학술 연구를 기반으로 개발된 이 고급 시스템은 실시간으로 사용자의 결정과 반응을 모니터링하고, 게임 이벤트를 동적으로 조정하여 공포를 극대화합니다. 이 시스템은 공포 경험이 지나치거나 부족하지 않도록 보장하여 완벽한 공포의 흐름을 유지합니다. 각 결정과 반응은 사건의 진행을 변화시켜 매번 새로운 무서운 경험을 제공합니다.

title: Miuma
description:
게임 정보
Do you remember your aunt from fifteen years ago, your aunt fussing in the kitchen during the early morning to prepare the pastries for the first customers?
