The nostalgia of baked delectables, the scent of aged wood, and the compassionate atmosphere of family all caused your heart to twinge. Suddenly, your old house was tragically abandoned, and the glory of the former bakery was only but a distant memory that was lost in the past. After so many years, could you revive the family business and return home, accepting the challenge?

In this absorbing adventure, you can provide your fellow neighbors with luscious, lip-smacking cakes, pies, and rolls; you can engage in different handicrafts, participate in the town's fests and fairs, delight in the hymns of nature, contemplate about your town's historical streets, intriguingly interact with those around you, and explore the lore together with Kevin!

This video-game creation has both a colorful gameplay with endless possibilities and a captivating plot. A story of a timeless town is told through its vivid residents, including the protagonist Kevin and his ancestors. Free will acts as a guardian: decisions and freedom are bestowed upon you with the bittersweet responsibility of further consequences. You are allowed to decide for yourself—from a certain day's tasks to the revelation of unseen opportunities.

Sometimes, one can face barriers with which they cannot cope. Sometimes, one makes inevitable, daunting mistakes and makes the wrong decisions. Sometimes, the world does not turn out to be as open and tender as one had wondered in their childhood of purity. Instead, one can be met with the unmerciful, shattering apathy of reality. Even so, you have the spirit to keep your welcoming heart warm to let love spread and to live life to the fullest.

This game is not just a simple bakery simulator: it's a story about a young man whose fate was to resume family traditions of baking and about a man who can reject these traditions—but ... does he want to? Your life is devised by your habits, the choices that function as the fragments to your very being.

title: THE KNIGHT OF NEPHIART
description:
게임 정보
OVERVIEW

THE KNIGHT OF NEPHIART is a classic RPG for VR in which you lead a party as a knight to fight against the Demon King.
A player can experience the adventure in a fantasy world while looking around 360 degrees in VR.



The battle system uses a turn-based command input.
With an old-school system feel let you play right away, without any learning.


Relive your imagination in your youth, 'Diving into the imaginary world' with VR !

The royal family of the kingdom of NEPHIART has brought peace to the kingdom through the power of light passed down from generation to generation.
The family undergoes the holy land trials in order to awaken the special power.
A knight of the kingdom accepts an order to escort the princess to the holy land and sets off with her.

They travel around the holy land and the princess undergoes trials.
Their conventional journey to awaken the special power takes a sudden turn when something strange happens at the royal palace.

title: Blinding Oversight
description:
게임 정보
Blinding Oversight is a slow-burning, narrative-driven horror experience that emphasizes atmosphere, isolation, and unraveling mystery.
FEATURES
Explore a decaying log house and the woods surrounding it, both designed to unnerve and disorient
Piece together a haunting backstory of the family that resided in the house by interacting with scattered letters, sketches, and environmental storytelling
Endure disturbing visions and unsettling imagery that blur the line between reality and hallucination
A world that gets darker and creepier as events progress in the game
Navigate the space with limited tools, relying on observation, exploration, and instinct to find your way out
A short, deliberately-paced experience focused on build-up through anxiety, linear storytelling, and immersive sound design
THE GAMEPLAY
Waking up in a room she doesn’t recognize, Emma finds herself lying on a dusty, blood-stained bed with bandages wrapped around her head. Looking around, she notices moldy wooden walls dimly lit by the evening glow. With her last memory being a solo road trip, she begins to suspect she may have been kidnapped – or worse.
With no map, no weapons, and no clear answers, you must guide Emma through a decrepit log house and whatever lies beyond. Clues are scarce and nothing is explained outright. You’ll find letters, drawings, and fragments of stories that suggest something deeply wrong happened here… and may still be happening.
Visions will strike – unprompted and often inexplicable. Some might hold meaning. Others may be fragments of Emma’s deteriorating mind. As the world shifts subtly around you, you’ll begin to question: what’s real, and what is meant to be real?
Your only goal is to get out. But doing so will mean pushing forward into the unknown—and uncovering a truth you may not want to face.
THE STORY
Emma is alone. At least, that’s what it seems like at first. After regaining consciousness in a strange wooden house, she’s plagued by disjointed memories, inexplicable visions, and a deep sense of being watched.

title: Echo Wars - Road Rage
description:
게임 정보


The Echo brothers, two retired cybernetic clone troopers, enjoy their well-deserved retirement and the company of Meghan, their adorable enginurse, with whom they reminisce about their crazy past adventures. But little do the old cyborgs suspect that their days of action are not over yet…

Meghan seems to be suspiciously interested in these core memories. We soon find out that the enginurse is forcing the Echo brothers to remember their past exploits to unlock one by one the pieces of a great puzzle that takes shape as the game progresses.



Echo Wars is a driving shooter that can be played in cooperative multiplayer, where players take on the role of the Echo brothers, two retired cyber soldiers, and relive their adventures aboard a futuristic combat buggy.

Echo Wars is designed to make the most of Virtual Reality displays, but it can also be enjoyed on regular screens, ultra-panoramic screens, and Steam Deck.

The Echo brothers reminisce about their past missions as elite imperial officers at each level. Their tendency to exaggerate and brag about their feats allows the player to choose how specific phrases of the interactive script end, with surprising and hilarious results.

The narrative leads to action-packed first-person levels. Thanks to the three difficulty levels available, we will be driving with one hand while shooting with the other in breathtaking gameplay suitable for all players.

title: Rail Fights
description:
게임 정보
Rail Fights is a multiplayer shooter for 1-8 players that adds a competitive edge to the simplicity of old-school arcade games. Players ride their tanks on a closed oval rail, bump other tanks around, capture different launchers, shoot and total opponents on the other side of the arena.
Solo or Team
Fight solo against 7 other solo players, team up with a friend as a duo to face off against 3 other teams of two or join forces with three other players to form a team of four and compete against another team.
Multiplayer
Enjoy Rail Fights locally with friends on your device, playing against each other or AI. We're keeping an eye on player interest and may add online features, like casual and ranked matches, in the future based on demand.
Single Player
Not in the party mood? You can always enjoy single-player mode against AI opponents and aim to top the leaderboards.

title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato
description:
게임 정보
When Miho steps into the pantry to get a potato for his grandmothers' soup, he's suddenly pulled into a distant fantastical land where he must retrace the steps of a mysterious great traveler before him.
He must venture through a world of wonderous rainforests, teetering towns, and talking beasts, outsmarting thieves and meeting quirky characters along the way.
But each time he returns to the kitchen with an ingredient, things have changed in unexpected ways…
Sopa is a tale about family, adventure, and the things we pass along to future generations, comforting like the first sip of hot soup on a cold day and vital as an ancient memory.
autokwd: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato

title: A Ruthless World
description:
게임 정보
As an employee of Juice™, you wake up to a beautiful new day. While the urge to get to work is strong, there’s still time to tidy up at home and choose your outfit for the day. Once everything feels just right, you head off to your beloved Juice™ battery factory.
In this puzzle adventure, featuring 80s-styled graphics and modern physics, things are not always as straightforward as they seem. What starts as a simple journey to get to work turns into an adventure filled with obstacles, strange creatures, and inexplicable events.
Easy, customisable, controls using keyboard, gamepad, or touch input
Learn new abilities and combine them as game progresses
Bite-sized levels* with unique problems to solve
Character customization
Should run on a potato, see requirements for specifics
*Includes a subscription to Juice™ Reconstruction Service.

title: Super Spy Academy
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a thrilling adventure filled with espionage and intrigue in Super Spy Academy, a captivating narrative-driven game set in a prestigious private university overtaken by sinister forces. As Leo, a determined freshman, players must navigate through a series of challenging puzzles and obstacles to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of his brother and the infiltration of the academy by the villainous "Super Villain Academy."

With the help of QBear, an AI companion, players will explore a rich 3D world teeming with secrets and surprises, interacting with unique characters along the way. From navigating through six diverse areas with their own distinct themes to solving over 15 puzzles scattered throughout the academy, every step taken brings players closer to unraveling the gripping mystery at the heart of Super Spy Academy.

Featuring fully voice-acted dialogue, captivating visual novel-style storytelling elements, and engaging mini-games to test your spy skills, Super Spy Academy offers an immersive gameplay experience unlike any other. Whether playing with a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad, players will find themselves immersed in a world where every clue leads closer to the truth. Dive into a world of suspense and embark on an unforgettable journey to save the academy from its perilous fate.

Key Features:

Lots of characters to interact with
Explore 6 diverse areas, each with its own theme and challenges
Solve over 15 puzzles to progress through the story
Fully voice-acted cast brings the characters to life
Experience visual novel-style storytelling elements
Navigate a rich 3D world filled with secrets
Engage in mini-games to test your spy skills
Compatible with mouse and keyboard, as well as gamepad controls

title: Saveseeker
description:
게임 정보
Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide.

Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!
Game Features:

Embark on a classic quest: Travel to the six lands the Hero once visited, overwriting his Save Stops along the way
Join forces with boss allies: Five ex-bosses will join you on your adventure, each with their own motivations to face the Hero again
Discover a bright pixel art world: From the autumnal Badwoods to the swampy kingdom of Mirell, each land brings unique challenges to face and puzzles to solve
Uncover hidden secrets: Compete in optional minigames to unlock special equipment and hidden lore
Enjoy 30+ original tracks: A warm and catchy original soundtrack composed by Dale North accompanies your journey

title: Hank's Voyage
description:
게임 정보


Join Hank on an adventure to rescue his friend and uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt!
Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget, hide from your enemies, solve puzzles and prove that you're a world-class spy every step of the way!



In the year of 1948, a group of talented jazz musicians formed the Jazz Association of Secret Spies, also known as JASS.
Their main directive: maintain world peace at all costs.

As one of their agents goes missing in Egypt they send Hank, their most recent hire, to investigate what they believe to be a routine mission.

Join Hank in his journey to Giza as he unravels secret conspiracies and sheds light on ancient mysteries while making the most out of his high-tech hat gadget.
Help him to sneak past his enemies, use his hat gadget to solve different puzzles, and gain powers that will help him make his way through 5 distinct locations.




Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget: Attack, Activate, Distract and use it as a platform to solve different puzzles.



Collect to unlock .



past and outwit your enemies: Fighting is not always an option. Sometimes you have to blend in the environment and go unnoticed.



Fight your way through featuring : Encounter unique enemies and gameplay challenges.



in several different and



an offbeat story with colorful characters and a .



the levels to discover all their : The levels are loaded with hidden treasures and great rewards, waiting to be found.

title: Forgot
description:
게임 정보
Forgot is a short anomaly hunting horror game. You play as a boy who is imprisoned at home with his grandparents. But is this really your home and are you sure those are your grandparents?
You want to leave, but no exit leads to the outside. The rooms are looping endlessly and time seems to be standing still. It is midnight and "grandmother" won't let you leave before the morning. She keeps feeding you cake and sends you back to your room.
Sometimes your surroundings change and sometimes they stay the same... Look out for anomalies and make a decision:
Are there anomalies at home?
The cake is poisoned, do NOT eat it and leave immediately!
Does everything look normal?
The cake is safe and delicious, make sure to eat it on your way out!
Only if you make 12 correct decisions in a row, the morning will come and the path to freedom will open.
Playtime: 15 - 60 minutes
tag: 선택의 중요성,숨은 그림 및 물체,심리적 공포,퍼즐

title: Rhythm Towers
description:
게임 정보
음악은 Planet Rhapsody의 고동입니다. 그루비한 곡들이 지속적으로 블루그래스 꽃밭을 통해 울리고, 유령 같은 황무지를 가로질러 메아리치며, 험준한 산맥 위로 울려 퍼집니다. 이러한 음악적인 곡들은 신비로운 AlgoRhythm을 보호하고 유지시키는데, 이것 없이는 Planet Rhapsody는 조용한 심연으로 붕괴될 것입니다.
이제 AlgoRhythm은 초자연적인 힘에 의해 분노에 휩쓸린 생명체들의 위협에 노출되어 있고, 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.
그래, 당신은 큰 성공을 이루지 못한 외계인 팝 그룹일지라도, 이런, 아이야, 당신에게는 용기가 있어. 그리고 비트를 유지할 수 있어. 음악이 당신의 세계니까 - 그래서 당신이 그것을 구해야 해.
음악으로 구축됨
다른 순서와 위치에 타워를 설치하여 독특한 교향곡을 만듭니다. 당신이 건설하는 각 Rhythm Tower는 사운드트랙에 새로운 음악 레이어를 동적으로 추가하여, 각 레벨의 음악적 풍경을 극적으로 변경합니다. 새로운 환경을 탐험하면서, 편안한 Lo-Fi 힙합부터 강렬하고 박진감 넘치는 드럼 앤 베이스까지 다양한 템포와 독특한 스타일의 새로운 음악 장르에 맞춰 춤추세요.

title: LIMYN
description:
게임 정보


In the colorful soundscapes of LIMYN, you rotate with the rhythm, guiding a delicate thread through a geometric maze. Each rotation, a tick in time; each transition, a note in an ever-evolving melody. Obstacles dance, enemies lurk, but you are in command.

LIMYN evokes the simple gameplay of turn-based puzzlers like Hitman GO, but with skill-based obstacles that will challenge your musical timing.

Find the flow.

title: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding
description:
게임 정보



Bike Baron 2 is a wild motorbike racer built for time attack. It blends physics-based gameplay, pixel-perfect controls, and mad level design into a game that lives from all the faceplants, uncountable retries, and relentless breaking of records.

The path to the new record is simple. You hit a section, and try to improve it.

Land too far.
Crash.
A little out of balance.

Forty attempts later, you're consistently two tenths faster. Do the same for the last loop in the level, then string it all together for a time that—by some small miracle—ends up just under 37 seconds. That's #4 overall. And there's still that early section to work on!

This game is perfect for those who just know they can squeeze one tiny fraction more out of their run.

Dozens of extraordinary tracks. Varying in difficulty, style, and pacing, each 30-120 seconds in length, some of them quite outrageous.
Ghost runs. Not only to know how fast you're going in comparison, but also to get a look at how others are making their records.
Leaderboards. See where you stand in a competition between friends or—if you're that good—among the world elite at the very top of the standings.

Grab your helmet and let's start breaking records!
autokwd: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding

title: Mirror Land
description:
게임 정보
**WHAT IS THIS**
*Mirror Land* is an original game that focuses on optical illusion puzzles. It is inspired by some Magic Mirror Concepts such as **FengYueBaoJian** in *Dream of the Red Chamber* and **The Mirror of Erised** in *Harry Potter*. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.
According to THE MIRROR CONCEPT, a series of gameplay and stories are created. Meanwhile, this game uses poetry-writing methods as a source of reference, which makes the game more interesting and creates a poetic atmosphere in it.

**For closer eye movement and deeper puzzle layout, the puzzles of this game are specially developed for vertical screens. If the player’s display can be rotated to vertical, as long as the windows desktop is set to vertical. Then open the game, the game will be full screen. Or, if the display cannot be rotated or you don't want to bother, players can just use the normal horizontal screen mode. The game experience will not be different, and the areas on the left and right sides of the screen will be filled with black. **

**HOW TO PLAY**
You can learn how to play from the demo video or read the tips below.
0.The MIRROR and The Feet of the character have an interactive relationship.
1.When you can see The Feet of the character in the MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button, thus the character is tied to the MIRROR surface and turns into 2D form.
2.When the MIRROR is moved, the terrain reflected in the MIRROR is changed.
3.When the 2D form character’s feet meet an empty foothold reflected by MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button again, thus the character is released to the corresponding terrain.

**MECHANISM**


**Pedal Trigger** can make the terrain or other things change.


**THRUST DEVICE** When the character moves to the front of the THRUST DEVICE, this device will do a powerful thrust and push the character out for a certain distance. During this process, the
character is not affected by gravity.





**CLUSTER LIGHT**
When the source of The CLUSTER LIGHT is turned on, there will be a beam of The CLUSTER LIGHT. It can be reflected by a MIRROR. You can make the LIGHT travel to different positions by adjusting the angle of light emission as well as the angle and position of the mirror.
1.The CLUSTER LIGHT can pass through transparent terrain.
2.When the CLUSTER LIGHT reaches a FLAT place whether it is transparent or not, a TELEPORT POINT of LIGHT can be etched at the irradiation point.
3.LUMEN STONE CAT can travel in CLUSTER LIGHT-TELEPORT POINT System


**NPCs**



**LUMEN STONE CAT** is a passenger of the CLUSTER LIGHT. It is a mysterious animal imprisoned in the LUMEN STONE. When it is not exposed to the CLUSTER LIGHT, it looks like a dull square stone that is almost as tall as the character. In this case, It can be dragged and moved on a flat place, helping characters reach different terrain. But when THE CAT is moved to a teleport point of the CLUSTER LIGHT, which connects with another teleport point by CLUSTER LIGHT, THE CAT will transform into a cat that can swim in the LIGHT. After it reaches the teleport point as far as it can, THE CAT will transform into stone-form again.



**The SILENCE** is such a STABLE being that no character can push it away. When it blocks a character's way, the character can only walk away and wait for it to go to the next position, or catch it and put it in the MIRROR.



**The STRENGTH** In most cases, the STRENGTH will push away every movable object that gets into its reach. How far it pushes an object depends on the size of STRENGTH. During the pushing process, the STRENGTH and the object are not affected by gravity.
What The STRENGTH can push away: the character, the cubes, and smaller STRENGTHs
What The STRENGTH can not push away: THE SILENCE, THE LIGHT FLOWING STONE CAT, and solid terrains.
When the STRENGTH pushes the objects beyond its ability, it will be pushed away by the reaction force.
The STRENGTH can also be caught and put in the MIRROR.

**CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR MECHANISM**

1.When the character is caught and put on the CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR, he will become a chess piece that can move to the adjacent chessboard grid.
2.Each chessboard grid has a corresponding relationship with a certain foothold out of the MIRROR. When the MIRROR releases the character, the character will be placed in the corresponding position.


**THE STORY OF MIRROR LAND**

There is a continent in the darkness where the sun, the moon, and stars do not exist. The LIGHT is stored in a big mountain like gel. The mountain is called LUMEN.
Living creatures near the LUMEN gradually evolve into humans. They learn the methods of mining and using the LIGHT. They pipe the LIGHT to high places, illuminating most places. Technology and civilization are developing. Kingdom has formed.
Not far from the west of the LUMEN is the MIRROR PLAIN where the supply of MIRRORS is inexhaustible. Once the last piece of MIRROR PLAIN was exploited, an earth movement will come. A new MIRROR PLAIN will raise.
These MIRRORS can catch living creatures and put them into the surface of MIRRORS. This is discovered by accident.
One of the believable legends is about a hunter. Once upon a time, he was chasing the LUMEN BEAST. This BEAST escaped to a mirror. The hunter prayed subconsciously that someone could help him catch it. Unexpectedly, THE MIRROR responded to his prayer and caught the BEAST.
Later, people found a way to make MAGIC MIRRORS between witchcraft and technology.

THE STORY OF XIU(the character)

XIU’s ancestors are INKMEN,XIU is a inkman as well. INKMEN is one of the results of human genetic modification.
After humans learned to make MAGIC MIRRORS, some clever bad guys commit crimes with MAGIC MIRRORS they make, and leave no trace of themselves. The ruler of the kingdom decides to keep all the clever guys under supervision. Every movement of them has to leave a trace behind. So the clever ones become INKMEN. Ink always seep out through their skin, and their shoes cannot be waterproof. So the footprints they leave are all ink-like.
XIU’s mother was a TRAFFIC MIRROR ENGINEER. In a TRAFFIC MIRROR test 7 years ago, when the MIRROR released her, she disappeared. This strange thing made people panic, but no reason was found.
Now XIU is fifteen years old, inherited mother's relics.XIU found 7 SPECIAL STONES among them. One day, a mysterious voice came into XIU's ears, saying,” Take THESE STONES to the FURNACES I designate. Then forge them into a HAMMER according to the drawings I give you. Use the HAMMER to smash the one-thousand-year-old MIRROR hanging in the capital. And you can find your mother…”
"As long as there is a chance of finding my mother, I will try it…."

title: Brobot
description:
게임 정보


Brobot is a single player platform game. Each stage will be released episodically. Its main character; Brobot, is a small robot. He must traverse a myriad of worlds and ultimately reach the mythical Dynamo Core to restore order to his home world.

Brobot allows the player to manipulate the direction of gravity to traverse various worlds and overcome obstacles, creating interesting and unique challenges that encourage fast-paced play while the player uncovers the truth of their purpose in the multiverse.

title: Armageddon Sky's Invasion
description:
게임 정보
Help the Alarician Empire protect its world from the invaders of Sephtisian Empire in this SHMUP. The action doesn't let up as you destroy countless waves of the enemy invaders over fifteen levels of non-stop action.

title: Rework
description:
게임 정보
Explore an open world forest and build fantastic contraptions. Build your home, protect it from enemies using your ingenuity. Adventure alone, cooperate with up to 6 friends online or 4 in local split-screen multiplayer.

title: Island of Winds
description:
게임 정보




Island of Winds is an adventure game set in a stunning environment inspired by 17th century Iceland, drawing upon its nature, folklore, and history.
Upon the abduction of her mentor and an attack on her homestead, Brynhildur the Balance Keeper must go on a journey of discovery.



The core gameplay involves spellcasting, intriguing puzzles, fantastical lore, and a special focus on approaching encounters with empathy. Island of Winds features a semi-open world environment that explores themes of self-doubt, violence, regret and empathy, as well as the conservation of nature.

title: Gobby Island
description:
게임 정보
Crazy beat'em up with retro aesthetics and good music. As a cute green gobby, punch out all bad things from invader knights, and do so with style!
Coming some time in 2022.
Main features:
master complex combat system
use available moveset to do crowd-control
save fellow tribesemen, to call them later for AOE and range attacks
each block, that makes level is destructible - use terraforming magic to get advantage in battle
test your skill against 5 challenging bosses
explore colorful locations of mysterious island
experience fun story, full of puns, jokes, and memorable characters
create custom levels and share them with the world using build-in level editor

title: Uncounted Isles
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ From Greenhorn to legend in the Uncounted Isles! 🛡️
Step into the boots of a novice adventurer in the charming Uncounted Isles. You're not here to save the world... at least not yet. Your journey begins with humble tasks that seasoned legendes ignore, but don't be fooled these 'small' quests are the building blocks of your legend.

Progress from chasing mischievous rats to outsmarting crafty bandits and facing spine-chilling undead. Each quest, no matter how small, shapes your story and hones your skills. The beauty lies in the details: every village saved, every item recovered and every mystery solved brings you one step closer to uncovering a plot all other adventurers have overlooked.

Tailor your adventure to your style. Trade with quirky local villagers, discover unique loot and craft the perfect loadout for your evolving tactics. Will you become the go-to problem solver with a mastery of magic or the reliable sword-arm that villagers trust?

Thanks to the Adventurers' Guild's mystical death crystal, your journey never truly ends. Each setback is a chance to learn, adapt and come back stronger. Your safehouse awaits, ready for you to plan your next move. But beware: always store some fallback equipment to recover what's lost.

Uncounted Isles is a passion project, lovingly crafted by a solo developer using a custom-built game engine. This voxel-based, first-person fantasy roguelite RPG celebrates the small victories that lead to bigger adventures. Your support can help shape this indie game's future. Wishlist now on Steam or follow the adventure on Social Media to join our growing community of up-and-coming legendes!

Craft Your Legend, One Quest at a Time:
Flexible Roleplaying: Shape your character's destiny with our custom-built progression system
Living, Breathing World: Explore handcrafted islands enriched with procedural elements for variety
Immersive Perspective: Experience intense, up-close action with our first-person combat system
Roguelite Elements: Face consequences for failures, but retain progress and learn from each attempt
Economy: Engage in a rich item ecosystem through strategic looting and trading

title: Void Inside
description:
게임 정보
Void Inside is a first-person psychological horror game


In a world devastated by radiation, the surface of the Earth has turned into a lifeless wasteland.
People long ago sought refuge in underground shelters, but even there, death caught up with them through disease. The protagonist is the last survivor in his shelter

He is completely alone, surrounded by silence and the bodies of those he once knew. After many days of despair, he decides that staying any longer is meaningless. He leaves the shelter and boards a monorail, not knowing where it leads or what awaits him ahead


An atmosphere of claustrophobia and hopelessness
Horror conveyed through sounds and the sense of presence
The monorail as a symbol of the final refuge

title: NeuroSquad - Slay the Horde
description:
게임 정보

NeuroSquad is a Bullet Heaven / Action Roguelite game, where you can design your own guns by building them up modularly. Summon a group of holographic soldiers who fight alongside you as you control the whole squad!
In this game no upgrade is tied to a specific weapon, you can freely choose which gun gets which modifications.


Choose from a wide variety of pickups and upgrades! Customize your own attacks and discover powerful synergies! Set up your auto-attacking soldiers using neuro-implants. Summon them, make them stronger, turn them into killing machines!









Humanity is in the process of stepping out of the biological era. Brain enhancement, neural chips, and other body augmentations are part of this new reality. But a change this drastic was never going to happen without conflict and catastrophes.

Now it's your turn to face their hordes. The latest weapon types, such as the laser shotgun and biosense mines, as well as augmentations like the cyber aura will help you become stronger and wipe out the AI bots.

With each death you become more powerful. Each night is a new opportunity to save the future.

title: Demon Source
description:
게임 정보
Jump to the pit, die - repeat!
Demon Source is a roguelike adventure about one of the last Source Hunters.
Explore the vast procedurally generated dungeons. They are generated with pre-made prefabs with 3 variations of enemy spawn. So you will always have the pleasure of being scared entering each location.

Find skills and items and be killed by various enemies. Then hunt them in your run of revenge. Try new builds and strategies every new run and be bamboozled by unexpected enemy hiding by the corner. Collect the Source energy from dead enemies to unlock new weapons and abilities. 30+ unique weapons, 20+ skills, 40+ armors and rings are waiting for you.

Seek for story and lore? I have some!
Deep down the Ulm rock dwarves found the relic of great power. Demonic power. Very soon hordes of demons and possessed undeads were marching through the Lavert Kingdom.
Heroes of the past had stopped them, but they couldn’t destroy the Source. Inside the Ulm mountain this power was able to reshape dungeons to an endless labyrinth full of creatures of the dark. It also was able to revive demons countless times so they can’t be really killed.
Some heroes drink demon blood in order to receive same power. Those who did not died, went deeply to the old dwarf kingdom in order to find and destroy Demon Source.

You don’t remember how have you got to that dungeon. But it is clear that you are immortal such as those demons. Every time you die, the dungeon reshapes and all demons revive. Source doesn’t want to be found and doesn’t want you to go back. People of the past were optimistic about that - saying that now they have countless attempts. But now they are all mad and became corrupted guardians of the Source. So I wish you don't get crazy.

Try this game made with all passion just by single person. And let me to tell you the story of redemption which you will probably experience on yourself in the future. Try the Demon Source

title: Last Words
description:
게임 정보
Last Words is a game of social deception based on the Prisoner’s Dilemma philosophical theory. Are two individuals more likely to work together, or betray the other to make things better for themselves? Stuck in the past (or is it the future?) after your time machine inevitably breaks, you must work together with your fellow imprisoned time traveler to get out. You’ll both profit if you make it out together. But…
What if you betrayed them and seized the loot all for yourself along with a new ride home stranding them? After all, your goal is to amass a collection, not help rival explorers make a greater name for themselves. On the other hand, what if they are preparing to do the exact same thing to you? Can you afford to risk your own survival and a potential partnership?
Work together with the other stuck in time prisoner to escape this predicament.
Unlock perks, consumables, and tricks to synergize on both of your escape plans.
Trust in your sudden ally, prepare for his sudden, but inevitable betrayal, or plot their downfall first before they can even consider it.
[/list]
Customize your time traveler with the aforementioned perks, consumables, and other tricks unlocked in your travel.
Put the spoils of time travel collecting to use by changing your explorer’s appearance and personal hideout.
Flaunt your achievements and shiny accolades, but don’t get too cocky or they might be tempted to try and steal it for themselves.

title: Agent Simulator
description:
게임 정보



Agent Simulation is an action, simulation, and strategy game in which each player shows their targeting skills and agility against enemies in a virtual environment. At the end of each mission, you will collect medals and earn various certificates with these medals. At the end of the game, these certificates will prove your strength as an agent and help you to receive your agent license.
In each level of the ‘Agent Simulation’, you will be evaluated according to your targeting skills. Before the limited time provided ends, you must kill all your enemies. Every successful head shot will get you more points! Of course, if you say ‘I am not that good’ and use up your time, you need to start over. Sorry for that! Sometimes you will be asked to complete the missions in such a limited time, you have to be fast and agile! It is a great environment to test yourself, is it not? You can skip the levels that you could not complete and still advance in the game. But it does not sound that great, right? We are talking about being an agent in here.
There will be three options offered in each level and those options will constantly change! For example, double bullets, double damage, slowing time down, blocking bullets or extra life, etc. You can strategize using any of these options! If you would like, you can repeat any level to test and improve your skills.
When you complete all levels of a lesson, you will receive an overall score including all points and medals you earned in that lesson. If your overall score is not high enough to move on to the next lesson, we regret to inform you that you have to work harder and spend more time by repeating all low scored levels. Do not forget that it is not easy to train an agent!
Earning enough certificates will allow you to receive your agent license at the end. According to your license score, you can see where you are in the world ranking or within your friends.
Fight to be the best!

title: Slumhack
description:
게임 정보
Slumhack is a puzzle-platformer game featuring indirect character control.
Play as Neriko, a girl living in a near-future slum with a virtual friend, and hack your way through the streets of Cynorm.
Make smart use of a variety of Action Buttons and guide Neriko to the goal!

title: Age Of Blocks
description:
게임 정보
In Age of Blocks, gathering resources and mining blocks are at the heart of your kingdom’s survival and expansion. Send your workers to chop down towering trees for wood, harvest bushes and catch fish to keep your army fed, and mine precious gold to fund your growing empire. Every resource plays a vital role, fueling construction, recruitment, and technological advances. As you collect blocks from the voxel-based world, you'll unlock the power to shape the land itself—place blocks to build walls, raise towers, and design your perfect stronghold. Whether you're fortifying defenses or expanding your city, mastering resource collection and block placement is key to defending Azuria!
Building your civilization is a journey of strategy and creativity. With 13 unique types of buildings at your disposal—from humble houses and bustling farms to powerful barracks and advanced research centers—you'll shape a thriving kingdom tailored to your playstyle. As your city grows, unlock a wide range of technologies that boost your economy, strengthen your armies, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Advance through different ages of civilization to gain access to more powerful structures, elite units, and game-changing upgrades. Every decision you make brings you one step closer to turning your fledgling settlement into the most formidable empire in all of Azuria!
Leading your army into battle is where your strategy truly comes to life. Train and command a diverse roster of units such as fearless Footmen, swift Lancers, and devastating Warhounds on the front lines. Rain arrows from afar with Longbowmen and Crossbowmen, or unleash heavy siege power with Catapults, Rams, and the deadly Scorpio. Dominate the seas with powerful Galleons and Scorpio Ships, transport your troops across the map with Transport Ships. Monks can provide crucial support on the battlefield, turning the tide with healing. As you research new technologies, your units become stronger, faster, and deadlier, giving you the edge you need to crush your enemy.

title: High Elo Girls
description:
게임 정보

High Elo Girls is an esports visual novel about ambition, competition, and pursuing your dreams to become stronger. Experience the career of a newly minted professional player; from her initial trials, all the way to finally competing in a major tournament. Along the way you’ll confront themes of new adulthood, trust, rivalry and the challenges we face when we embrace the climb.
Featuring
A newcomer-friendly tour of the MOBA esports scene
5 Team Roles to Play (Top Lane, Jungle, Mid Lane, DPS, and Support)
5 Teammates to Befriend, Romance, or Antagonize
Choice-based MOBA Simulations featuring narrative-changing decisions
Embrace your dreams

You play as Rafaela, a college dropout with more regrets than qualifications. The only arena you have any shred of confidence left is also your only escape: the popular MOBA, .

But when you’re invited to join Momentum Gaming (MMG), you finally have the chance to prove to the world, what you’re really made of. But, the job demands not just your skill in , but in negotiating relationships with your ambitious new teammates too. Can you rise to the challenge, or will this end up being just another squandered opportunity?

Engage in choice-based matches that impact Rafaela’s life in and out of her career. Are you a reliable follower closing the deal on your team’s plans; a showstopper making the daring plays that hit social media; or a wildcard who leaves nothing off the table?

Each of your five MMG teammates bring their own perspectives and goals with them. Building friendships, rivalries, and more, will be key to cementing your place in the team.

For someone truly willing to stop at nothing to reach their goals, there may be other paths to discover, provided you’re able to stomach them.

Wishlist us today and look forward to future development updates!
✨ The Split Fate Team

title: Ribby: The Game
description:
게임 정보
DEMO v1 AVAILABLE NOW!
Demo v2 coming... soon?
It's Ribby: The Game! An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about acceptance, friends, and frogs! Ribbit.
Follow the story of Ribecca "Ribby" Brown, an altruistic frog girl on a journey to get back home - hoping to make some friends along the way and discover things she doesn't yet know about herself.
Looking inward is always a daunting task, especially when you're afraid of what you'll find.
what r they talkin bout...
Warning: This game may make you feel like:
Smiling
Having fun
Telling ALL of your friends about it
Kissing someone right on the mouth

title: Keys of Fury
description:
게임 정보
                                                                                                       No Controller
                                                                       No Mouse
                                                                 Pure Keyboard
Keys of Fury is a retro style Beat `em up typing game.
Destroy loads of enemies as you type your way to victory.
Earn coins for each perfect word typed and use them to purchase abilities, outfits, accessories, and music tracks!
                           Arcade:  A Potpourri of a variety of levels including Bad Dad Jokes, Racing Dinosaurs, and battling through waves of increasingly difficultly worded enemies.  Choose upgrades between each wave to prepare for the next one.
Story:  Help clear corruption from the inner city and engage in your own witty banter with the locals.  Fight a variety of enemies: robots, ninjas, vegetables throwing street venders, etc.
Modding:  Want to add your own word phrases, levels, and art?  Keys of Fury was designed to be easily moddable!

title: NULLPTR
description:
게임 정보
NULLPTR is a real-time tactical hacking puzzle, nominated as a finalist for Innovation and Best Brazilian Game at Gamescom LATAM 2024, where every action you take reshapes the challenge ahead. Infiltrate megacorp servers, reroute connections, collect valuable data, and outmaneuver adaptive defenses—all while racing against the clock and the relentless threat of reactive sentinels.
KEY FEATURES
Tactical grid-based hacking:
Connect to servers, unveil layouts, and plot your path before time runs out and detection sets in.
Reversible trails & stack mechanics:
Every move leaves a trace, increasing your exposure but also opening up new opportunities. Manage your collected data with limited memory, turning the environment to your advantage.
Intelligent sentinels:
Face advanced defenses that patrol, adapt, and react directly to your actions, transforming every stage into a dynamic puzzle.
Reactive environments:
Firewalls, coded doors, and data nodes can change in real time, demanding constant creativity and strategic adaptation.
Constant pressure:
Manage the timer on every run and escape before you’re caught. Every second counts in the fight against megacorporation defenses.

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Octopus City Blues
description:
게임 정보
Enter Octopus City, the last bastion of humanity in a frozen world.

Meet the cowardly Kaf Kafkaryan, a tentacle trimmer living on a giant octopus.



Explore bizarre worlds and unravel dark conspiracies as the line between dream and reality begins to blur.

Talk to eccentric people with their own motives and schedules. Learn their secrets and spread scandalous rumors.



Handle tense situations while keeping your anxiety in check. Make difficult decisions with long-lasting consequences.

Ghost in a Bottle presents Octopus City Blues: the world's first Octopus City Simulation. Please support us by adding it to your wishlist!

title: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse는 섬뜩한 생물과 페이스가 빠른 근접 전투, 강력한 능력과 함께하는 도전적인 핵 앤 슬래시 로그라이트 게임입니다. 초자연적 현상을 조사하고 인류의 생존을 위해 싸우는 비밀 조직의 일원이 되세요.
진실을 밝히세요!
손으로 그린 코믹 패널이 게임플레이에 자연스럽게 뒤섞이며 수수께끼와 음모가 가득한 어두운 이야기 속으로 플레이어를 끌어들입니다. 게임을 시작하고 죽을 때마다 늑대 섬의 위험과 그 안에 도사린 비밀이 조금씩 드러납니다.
강렬하고 빠른 페이스의 전투에서 실력을 시험하세요!
쉬지 않고 공격을 계속하다 보면 결국 때이른 죽음을 맞을 뿐입니다. 나만의 스타일에 맞춰 고유한 능력과 유물, 강화를 조합해서 강력한 시너지를 발휘하세요. 까다로운 보스들과 맞서 싸우며 우월한 실력을 증명하세요. 적에게 지옥을 맛보여주세요!
autokwd: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse

title: Tristan Cole's Pro Driver
description:
게임 정보
In Tristan Cole's Pro Driver you're a stunt driver for hire and willing to take on any paying job that gets you closer to buying your next upgrade. Whether it's taxiing passengers around town, completing objectives, or winning races, you need to drive with both speed & style to to impress your customers.



Weave through traffic, hit & destroy props, and jump across rooftops as you navigate your way through the stylized maps of TCPD. Customize your choice of heavily modified caged street cars featuring custom suspension built for high speed stunts. Score big combos by performing dozens of tricks including wheelies, drifts, spins, flips/rolls, grinds, and plenty of insane aerial stunts.



Challenge other drivers in a variety of multiplayer modes to show off your style & prove that you're the best stunt driver on the street.

title: Poison Noir: Desire
description:
게임 정보
Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters is an animated visual novel with a captivating fantasy theme. Immerse yourself in a rich, multilayered narrative where desire, time, and danger intertwine in a world of gangsters, secrets, and uncertain fates.
In the 90s, for the shy Jake—a gamer and noir novel enthusiast—and his brave friend Lucy, their small hometown holds no future. Seeking new opportunities in the city, Jake begins a romance with Nina, a wealthy and fascinating girl, but one who is also unsettling and full of secrets.
Their relationship becomes complicated when Jake suffers from a strange illness—poison, madness, or something even darker? With each episode, he is thrust between two different eras, stripped of his memories, unable to distinguish reality, and feeling as if a faceless destiny is pulling the strings of his fate.
Trapped between the seemingly harmless modern world and the violent, ruthless gangster underworld of Prohibition, Jake must confront not only a powerful and merciless enemy but also a painful journey of self-transformation. Surrounded by danger and horror, he becomes entangled in brutal mafia wars as well as sinister mysteries beyond his comprehension.
To protect those he loves, he will fight against his hallucinations and fears, struggle with the terrifying suspicion that nothing is as it seems, and be tormented by the collapse of the sacred values he once held dear. But his greatest challenge in this web of time and fate will be to find, among countless paths, the one that leads him back to sanity, love, and the Light. But… how can he be sure he's making the right choice?

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description:
게임 정보


APOPIA: SUGAR COATED TALE is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

As Mai, you will:

Explore the beautiful fantasy world. Get to know funny characters who are a cat, a mole, a lot of bunnies, and more. Each with unique personality and background story.
Solve creative puzzles along your way home.
Beat enemies... um, lower your fists... You'll beat them by outsmarting them in minigames.
Defeat dark bosses in rhythm games.
Discover the truth about your family and identity.











Catch a glimpse into a world before the events of Apopia Prologue. Learn why Moly was banished from her castle in this animated short. Watch and enhance your demo experience!

title: Eternity Guards
description:
게임 정보
The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

This is a world of magic and tactics.

Style - handpaint.

Battle Royale PVP fighting game with strategy elements.

On a small one map, from 2 to 6 players fight at the same time, who are divided into equal teams. Fast matches have a maximum duration of 10 minutes, so the maps are not big, but well designed for energetic battles with fun running around the map in the heat of magical effects.

Each map has all 4 times of year, all are available on the same map to increase variability.

At the end of each match, there will be a unique anti-cheat system based on feedback and ratings of players for the subsequent successful formation of the effective teams.

Before the battle, players appear in a room where they have 30 seconds to equip and buy clothes, weapons, bottles and recharge abilities.

There is an interaction with the environment in the form of teleports and places of interest (landslides, lava, waterfalls, lightning, tornado) that block the way and can inflict damage on the opponent.

The tactic is to activate the character selection circle (menu wheel) via a hotkey for the interaction: for enemies - magic, weapon strikes or debuffs; for allied characters - useful buffs, damage resistance, acceleration, healing etc.

There is a teleport on the map with an 5 sec activation delay, the next character can only be passed with the same delay. There is always some kind of artifact there, which you can use in this or in the next game only once.

There will be several characters in the game, including:
Viking - tank, human shield;



After the end of the fight, in addition to experience, which unlocks many different abilities, and in addition to game currency to unlock new weapons and elements of armor, there is also the opportunity to upgrade a room with weapons (fireplace, sparring partner, sofa, bar etc).

title: Generation Ship
description:
게임 정보
당신은 세대선박의 책임을 지는 인공지능(AI)입니다. 살아남기 위한 인류의 마지막 희망입니다. 실시간 시뮬레이션에서 효율적인 원자재 순환을 구축하고, 먼 새로운 고향으로의 여정에서 우주의 역경을 극복하도록 크루를 도우세요!

지구는 천연 자원이 고갈되어 파수잡아져 푸른 하늘이 회색 연무로 대체되는 가운데, 국가들은 점점 감소하는 자원을 차지하려 경쟁하고 긴장이 고조됩니다. 당신은 인류의 마지막 희망인 세대선박을 건설하라는 임무를 맡은 인공지능입니다.

처음에는 지구가 미션을 시작하기 위한 충분한 자원을 제공할 것입니다. 그러나 시간은 당신을 위해 흘러가지 않습니다. 긴장이 증가하고 전쟁이 지구를 휩쓸면 지구의 공급 라인은 줄어들고, 자급자족해야 하는 어려운 과제를 남겨줍니다. 당신의 식민지선박은 지구의 공급에 의존하는 단계에서 자체 자원을 생산하고 재활용해야 합니다. 이 어려운 전환을 넘어서, 전략을 조절하고 인류의 미래를 보장하기 위한 능력을 구축하세요.
당신의 식민지선박을 건설하세요
한 부분 한 부분, 인류의 마지막 희망을 새로운 고향으로 운반할 선박을 건설하세요. 그러나 기억하세요, 모든 선택이 중요합니다. 당신은 선박의 능력을 최적화하고 인류의 생존을 보장하기 위해 노력하는 동안 모든 선택이 중요합니다.

어려운 결정
지구의 상황은 시간이 흐를수록 악화되며, 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다. 부족한 공급은 신중한 고려를 요구하며, 간단한 해결책은 없습니다. 결과의 중요성에 대비하세요. 당신이 취한 모든 조치는 인류의 운명을 결정할 것입니다.
넓은 우주에서는 모든 인치가 중요합니다. 효율적인 조직과 자동화는 선박의 잠재력을 극대화하는 데 중요합니다. 가치 있는 자원을 보존하면서 인구의 요구를 수용하기 위해 전략적으로 세대선박을 디자인하고 배치하세요.

세대선박에서의 생활을 현실적인 시뮬레이션으로 탐색하면서 완전히 몰입할 준비를 하세요. 환경 제어, 인간 모델, 중력의 힘을 관리하는 도전에 직면하게 됩니다. 현실을 반영하는 세계와 상호 작용하며, 여러분의 기술을 시험하고 한계에 도전하게 됩니다.

title: It's Better Alone
description:
게임 정보


It's Better Alone is a puzzle platformer where you must switch control between two characters in order to solve a variety of platforming puzzles.

A weathered man, haunted by the past.

A burdened robot, living to atone.

Work together, so that they can return home. Journey through a world in ruin, and uncover the events that led to the end of the world.

Solve a variety of puzzles.
Switch control between two characters.
Journey through a world reclaimed by nature.
Uncover the events that led to the end of the world.
Strengthen the bonds between man and machine.

title: Buoy
description:
게임 정보
Fight the undead or learn all the ways to sneak and hide among them. Dig through the ruins of the Old World and complete missions from different factions and survivors to earn valuable resources. Risk life and limb to protect those in need, or brutally kill anyone who gets in your way. Destroy both the dead and the living with an arsenal of melee, ranged, and makeshift weapons. Crawl along the ruined streets in search of supplies and secrets.

title: Wintertwined
description:
게임 정보
When an endless snowstorm traps a parent and child in a remote cabin, they discover its horrific history.
Wintertwined will be a narrative focussed, puzzle horror game.
You take control of Winter, a shy but snarky young adult, who’s trying to get back “home” safely.
With the aid of Giles, Winter's parental guardian, the two of them must work together to survive the snowy apocalypse.
Wintertwined is currently in development and planned for a commercial release in 2025
Features
• A slow burn mystery with multiple endings
• Original soundtrack by Harumi Makoto
• Puzzles with 3 difficulty levels
• Original spritework

title: Rabbit's Tale
description:
게임 정보
Rabbit was born and raised in Carrot’s Village, a small, sunny town surrounded by forest, where habitants lived in harmony. Small town, great rabbits!
A threat grew each day, as a dark entity lurked closer and closer to Carrot’s Village. The Steam Order discovered the power of steam machines, propelling them to power and conquest.
They threatened and took by force all the land they could, expanding their dominion thanks to their terrifying steam machines and cold-hearted minions.
One afternoon, they arrived at Carrot’s Village. A warning they gave, but a short one.
By dawn everything was sacked, burning and destroyed. Families were torn apart by kidnappers with no soul.
Now, our Hero finds himself alone with a mission on his hands.

title: Aboard the Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Aboard the adventure is a humorous adventure game (with capital ADVENTURE!) in which you will be part of the team of the daring Captain Quinn, with the goal of defeating the sinister Professor Weaver in a race to get various ancient and mysterious artifacts that can change the fate of the world.



Intrigue, grave robbers, fisticuffs, NINJAS! Get ready for a roller coaster of thrills and action.
Use poison darts, machetes and whatever else you have on hand to fight your way through your mission to save the world.



You didn't think we were going to leave all the weight on Captain Quinn's shoulders, did you?
Throughout the game you can also control Miguel, the captain's best friend and second in command - out of a crew of two - aboard the SS Adventure. And also Doc: a brilliant academic whose high IQ is only surpassed by her adventurous spirit!

.

With full voice acting and fun dialogue, you'll have a hard time forgetting the many diverse characters that populate the Aboard of Adventure universe. Besides, it won't be all about throwing punches: you'll also have to overcome your personal conflicts, help others and even solve some heart problems!

Travel the world solving puzzles at your own pace and enjoy the pixelated experience that we have lovingly prepared for you.

Come on, go on an adventure! And most of all,

title: MIRAI #167
description:
게임 정보
Join MIRAI #167 and Jonas, two characters separated by time but united in soul—switch between them to use each character’s unique abilities to overcome and defeat enemies.

title: Christine
description:
게임 정보
Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. She loves to sing and dreams of being a soprano at the Opera, but she never thought it would be possible.

When she sees that there will be a selection for the lead singer of a majestic opera based on the book Phantom of the Opera by Gaston Leroux, a light goes on.

Our Christine's life has several coincidences with the Christine in that story: an orphan living and working hard at the Paris Opera. She loves music, a passion inherited from her late father, but she didn't have the opportunity to explore that talent and passion.

How will she reconcile her daily tasks with her evolution? Who can she count on: her friends, an Angel of Music, or herself?
Is it worth facing her fears to pursue her goal?

In this interactive story with a unique musical score, follow the defining year in Christine's quest to pursue her dreams.
FOLLOW CHRISTINE'S DEVELOPMENT!


Add “Christine” to your wishlist and follow the game to keep up with the development.


The game will feature art from Katia Numakura (@katia.numakura) and music from Tatyana Jacques (@taty_jacques).
tag: 쌍방향 소설,퍼즐,비주얼 노벨,숨은 그림 및 물체

title: RunMan Turbo
description:
게임 정보



The world's fastest returns in RunMan Turbo, a high speed 2D platformer continuing the energetic flair of beloved predecessor RunMan: Race Around the World. Combining the essence of old school classics with tight, modern mechanics, RunMan’s return brings wild enthusiasm and unhinged energy matched with a vibrant aesthetic and groovy soundtrack.




A new challenger wielding a mysterious power has scrambled RunMan's world! Each time you run through a level, it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts and reaction in order to get the fastest time.

Bounce, slide and run fast as heck through high speed levels across five unique zones. Beat record times to earn medals and unlock secret characters, levels, and more.




Cool stuff can you do in this game:





Other stuff you will be jazzed about:







RunMan Turbo is soundtracked by a bunch of awesome artists and bands from Philadelphia. With an eclectic mix of rock, folk, funk, and more, I promise you have never heard a game that sounds like this!

Confirmed artists:
Catbite
SNACKTIME

More music to come soon...


Created by Tom Sennett in 2003 and debuting in the Game Maker Community, the RunMan series has spanned more than half a dozen titles, including 2009's beloved RunMan: Race Around the World - a collaboration with Maddy Thorson (, ). RunMan is also featured as a playable character in indie classic . After a few false starts on mobile, RunMan returns to PC for the triumphant sequel RunMan Turbo.


Yo! I'm Tom Sennett, I'm from Philadelphia, and for two decades I've created video games which have brought joy to millions of people around the world. I'm an IndieCade award winner, and have been featured in Kotaku, VICE, Rock Paper Shotgun and more. When it comes to making games, I do everything including design, art, and programming - I even sometimes create my own sound effects and music. My work focuses on taking classic gameplay constructs and tearing them down to be rebuilt in a lean and modern way. I'm pumped to share it with you!

title: Spice Sacrifice
description:
게임 정보
Spice Sacrifice is a JRPG style game with randomized action-platformer battles.



Travel through an underworld full of caves of guts and bones, or goo and piercings or other fantastical stuff. But watch out for the spice that permeates the air, it will transport your character's minds to a dimension full of dangerous beasts that they must fight. Not to mention all the other dangers that keep getting people killed in gruesomely bizarre ways.

Two of the main characters are Oregano - the anxious wreck who must rescue his boyfriend, and Yonko Donko - the punk donkey with amnesia. The story will feature themes of sexuality, mental health, queer comradery, and finding a sense of place in a hostile world.



Outside of battle, Spice Sacrifice plays like a JRPG with in-depth story segments, towns, dungeons, managing equipment and items, leveling up and collecting things, and minigames.

Travel the overworld to find and hang out with various NPC's and grow friendships with them and advance the story. The gameplay has lots of intertwining systems to keep everything deep and addicting.



When you enter a battle, the game becomes an action-platformer with completely randomized levels. A random-gen system makes each screen unique, with random wall layouts, enemy placements, powerups, etc. Avoid the enemy's spells and use a variety of high-impact attacks to survive.
The game has an ensemble cast of playable characters and NPCs, such as:






A few accessibility options we'll include:

title: Knight of the Lions
description:
게임 정보


A story-driven, single-player platformer
Simple mechanics used to create a challenging gameplay
The insight into the diary of a person who has suffered a loss
Pen-drawn graphics meant to look like doodles in a notebook
Inspired by the story of Don Quixote

title: TOCOViX
description:
게임 정보
TOCOViX is a turn-based strategy game where 2-4 players take turn to place Crosses on the game board. The goal of the game is to combine Crosses to create "Shapes", which award points and "Stops". The purpose of Stops is to hinder opponents by preventing them from completing Shapes. A player is unable to move when all of the boxes on the board surrounding their Crosses are already occupied. The match is over when all players are unable to move or when the last standing player has more points than the others.
Levels
Choose between 10 levels with 3 different starts each. As you progress with the game levels get more complex.
Tutorials
From the Main Menu you can access tutorials with a detailed description of every game mechanic. Each explanation is made of both text and animations and can be interrupted at any moment.
TOCOViX comes with hard challenges which range from winning all levels against the CPU to conquering a certain number of boxes in a single match. Complete a challenge to obtain a Trophy and obtain all Trophies to unlock a special Cross!
Thanks to dedicated servers you can challenge other players from around the world! Every time you complete a match online you are awarded or deducted points from your online score. Challenge other players to rise through the ranks and enter the Diamond League!

title: Interconnected Stories
description:
게임 정보

In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...




- Place the cards on the board to help our friendly characters in their mission
- Unlock dozens of action cards, all of them customized for the different characters
- Enjoy a wide variety of chapters, which can be solved in different ways
- Take advantage of free mode to create your own stories without the restrictions of the main mode




A great variety of characters will appear in the story, some with more relevance than others, but all with an distinctive essence:
- Carapán: a young 216-year-old dragon who, contrary to the traditions of his family, wants to dedicate himself to what is his true passion in life: the bakery.
- The Knight of the Iguana: a small town boy who has launched himself in search of adventure along with his secret weapon, which makes him immortal... at least as far as he has proven.
- Lúa: from a noble family, this astrologer has become a royal advisor fighting against imposed stereotypes, although she has an important private matter that keeps her busy...
- And more to discover! A princess, a ghost minstrel, an evil monster...

title: DEATHGRIP
description:
게임 정보
DEATHGRIP invites the player to the jump in the pilot's seat of some of the fastest and most lethal hovercrafts ever seen and dominate the tracks they compete on. Navigate natural environments through split paths, twists, turns, jumps, shortcuts, and narrow corridors in an intense race to the finish.

DEATHGRIP introduces a depth to its racing controls that challenges the player to explore the skill ceiling. From afterburner allowed at any time to pitching, rolling, drifting, repairing, managing heat, and firing weapons, one should take pride in their ability to master a racer.

It is an experience meant to be visceral, brutal, exciting, and intense, centered on offering players instant enjoyment without gimmicks and an extended sense of achievement for those competitive and dedicated enough to get the most out of the game.


The base release will include (at a minimum) the following features:

8 Unique Racers
All racers share the same functionality, but each has it's own strengths and weaknesses to suit different playstyles.

10 Distinct Tracks
Race across 10 environments on 10 tracks over terrain filled with obstacles, jumps, drops, shortcuts, multiple paths, and other challenges.

Combat Racing
Race against AI with offensive and defensive armaments. Outfit your racer with cannons, shotguns, missiles, countermeasures, and more. Witness the carnage as the track turns into a battlefield.

Time Trials and leaderboards
Best times across the game are saved as ghosts. Compete against your own times, challenge the ghosts of your friends or compete those of the top ranking players on the leaderboards.


Earn credits from winning and spend them on visual and performance upgrades to suit your playstyle. Choose from multiple parts to spec out your racer for speed,


Prove yourself by winning trophies and claiming tops ranks.

title: Evil Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Uncover the mystery of the town of Marwood
At the end of the Wild West era, Marcus, a teenager from a noble family, decides to find out why his city suffers from evil dreams. To find the reason, he goes to his neighbors' nightmares, where he may find out the truth or get stuck forever.
Evil Dreams - 2D adventure with elements of psychological horror and a variable plot. You have to travel between the real world and the world of the dreamers, find out the hidden secrets of the citizens, try don't lose mind and much more. And fully hand-drawn 2D graphics in the author's style, combined with an immersive soundtrack and a historically correct setting will help you with this.


Game Features:

title: Spirit Vendor
description:
게임 정보


Design your home and your shop exactly to your liking. Place furniture, decorate walls and ceilings,
or simply change the wallpaper and flooring.
Create a unique atmosphere that delights both you and your customers.





In Aeonica, there are many interesting potential partners.
Go on dates, deepen your relationships, and experience a romantic story that can lead to marriage and beyond.





Whether it's fresh produce, handcrafted creations, or rare fish – decide what to sell and how your shop looks.
Take care of your spirit customers and make sure they keep coming back.





Plant crops, raise animals, build pathways, and decorate your farm.
Create your own little paradise and supply your shop with fresh products.

title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Supporting small indie artists, Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game brings players to a cute & whimsical fantasy world where rivalling factions of animal characters fight to uncover fantastical riches!

Gameplay
AT:TCG is played as a 2-player game with both players racing to uncover all of their 8 'Treasure' cards before the opponent does. They can bring in animal characters to help their cause & do battle! Play happens with a pre-built deck of 50 cards and 8 player-chosen Treasure cards. Players are matched up with another player on Steam online, or if no players are available they will play against a CPU. An internet connection is required.

Collections
Show off cards you pull from booster packs or earn through challenges to your friends! AT:TCG uses the Steam Inventory service to manage the cards you own, meaning your collection is in safe hands!

Events
Participate in regular events & prove your might and mettle to earn prizes! Ranked Challenge is the first regular event to reach Arcane Treasures: TCG - seeing players fight to earn the most Ranked Points over an event period - but more will be on the way!

Player Feedback
The development process is heavily rooted in player feedback, with great respect held in the views of the player. By participating in the Discord, you can have your say! But don't just take our word for it, feel free to ask members of the community who have given in feedback!

Supporting Indie Artists
Arcane Treasures and those involved with its development have always been rooted in the indie world, and always will be. Except for placeholder artworks during early development stages (which are steadily being replaced) all artwork is sourced from small, independent artists, and as the game grows it is committed to finding further ways to support independent artists.

If you're an artist and you'd like to get involved, please get in touch through the email attached to the Steam store page.

title: Trailthread
description:
게임 정보

In the Augment Battle System, each fighter can act twice per turn. Use your first move to cast spells or attacks, and use your second move to modify those commands with game-changing Augments!

Augments apply diverse modifiers to your arsenal: Imbue attacks with lightning damage, cast your heals as team-wide spells, and guarantee your buffs trigger before anyone else moves. With millions of Primary-Augment combos available in-game, the sky’s the limit!


Trailthread's story follows a blacksmith, baker, and bandit on their journey to scale Anvite Mountain and slay the bitter Obsidian Drake. Rekindle enchanted forges, meet strange friends, and tumble across the timeline with the mysterious Timestitcher. Can you reach the summit?


Trailthread is a focused 10-hour experience. It features a streamlined world map and quick combat expansion. Enjoy plenty of strategic customization, expressive characters, vibrant music, and more… all in one tight-knit package!

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:
게임 정보
About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
description:
게임 정보
Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

HOLLOW POINT
Cloned flesh is no substitute; you’ve saved no one real. Hollow Point continues the story of the first System Purge, adding six new surreal sectors to explore. Survive a litany of new obstacles and monstrous threats as you delve into the System’s very foundations…and beyond.

BEARTRAP MODE
After you've finished Hollow Point, tackle the game’s hardest challenge in Beartrap Mode. Play through an alternate story which remixes and redesigns every level from the original game, adding new obstacles, new secrets, and 4 brutally difficult boss encounters.

SPEEDRUN MODE
Put your skills to the test in 2 new speedrun categories. Jumps, deaths, and uncovered secrets are now tracked during each run.

title: Delilah
description:
게임 정보
Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.



Two characters with unique loadouts
Varied encounters, from tight horror experiences to slaughter maps
Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story
Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites
MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's
Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry



A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields.

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.
Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

title: Super Skeleton Butler
description:
게임 정보
In Super Skeleton Butler, you play as a skeleton defending your dungeon home from adventurers trying to steal your treasure. Build traps, cast spells and slay hundreds of enemies while protecting your precious treasure from dirty, thieving humans.

title: Divine Doubt
description:
게임 정보
“I can give you that which you desire most. Your humanity.” This was all that was promised to Callum Röttwell in the mysterious email he received out of the blue one day. It was enough though for him to uproot his life and travel to the city of Starhaven to start anew. As an angel from a small town, he has to adapt quickly and learn how to interact with those he's never encountered before- demons. Especially since he must share a bedroom with one in a cramped apartment. Throughout this journey, Callum will meet many characters, explore the city of Starhaven, and dive deeper into what that strange email entails for him. But he must be wary, for his goddess is watching closely.


Features:

-Dialogue and exploration based RPG gameplay
-Engaging and original story
-Pixel artstyle
-Original soundtrack
-Many characters to meet and talk to
-Two different endings to get
-Many puzzles and minigames to do

Baked with love by Team Meatpie

title: A Piano Tale
description:
게임 정보
피아노고 스튜디오(Pianogo Studio)의 프랑스 팀은 빠르게 움직이는 이 세상에서 음악과 그림을 사랑하는 분들을 위해 느리고 고요하고 사색적이며 몰입적인 게임을 제안합니다.

피아노 테일(Piano Tale)은 음악적 지략의 요소와 더불어 이야기가 있는 게임입니다. 게임은 가상의 음악가 알렉산드라 아로노비치의 이야기를 따라 그녀의 삶의 여러 단계를 거칩니다. 노년에 들어서 그녀는 알츠하이머 병을 앓고 있는 할머니가 됩니다. 알렉산드라는 소련 스탈린주의 시대의 작곡가였던 아버지 보리스 아로노비치가 체제 전복적인 비밀스런 협주곡을 작곡했다는 사실을 알게 됩니다. 당시 예술가들은 원하는 것을 원하는 대로 만들 수 없던 시대였죠. 그의 협주곡은 딸 알렉산드라를 위한 곡이었고, 이 협주곡을 찾는 일은 대부분의 나레이션에서 중요한 동기가 됩니다. Point&Click 단계와 키보드를 통한 음악적 지략의 게임에서 플레이어의 성공에 따라 세 가지의 결말이 있을 수 있습니다. 알렉산드라가 자신의 병에도 불구하고 기억을 되찾을 수 있었는지, 그리고 아버지로 인해 힘들고 엄격했던 자신의 어린 시절에도 아버지를 용서하게 되는지 볼 수 있습니다.

title: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love
description:
게임 정보
DokiToki is a first-person puzzle game about manipulating time to solve escape-the-room style puzzles. Players need to freeze, unfreeze, and manipulate objects in time to reach each level's exit and progress through school.
Stopping time......with the power of love!
Play as Ai, a girl who's so hopelessly in love, it feels like everything around her is stopped in time. Traverse Ai's school, hopping from hallway to hallway and clearing each classroom in search of the boy Ai wants to confess to.
Toy with time
Use a collection of various tools each affecting time in different way. Some let you manipulate frozen objects, others will send items flying when unfrozen. Put each time-manipulating tool to use to solve each puzzle!
autokwd: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

title: HyperCore : Rhythm Bullet Hell
description:
게임 정보
HyperCore 소개
HyperCore는 기존의 탄막 게임을 음악 리듬 게임과 조합한 "리듬 탄막 게임" 입니다.
음악에 맞춰 코어에서 날아오는 셀 수 없이 많은 장애물을 피하며 살아남으세요.

특징
점수 공격: 위험을 감수하면 더 많은 포인트를 얻을 수 있습니다! 아슬아슬 위험한 상황을 넘기며 점수 승수를 높이세요.
시간 공격: 맞고, 죽고, 다시 반복하세요. 이 자비 없는 게임 모드에서는 최대한 오래 살아 남는 것이 관건입니다.
맞춤 노래: 여러분의 노래로 플레이하세요!
2명의 로컬 플레이어 대전: 친구와 경쟁하세요.

title: RoadOut
description:
게임 정보



RoadOut is a story-driven adventure that combines top down action-RPG elements with rubber-burning driving mechanics. Explore a vast post-apocalyptic world in your car, then battle your way through puzzle-filled dungeons on foot. With inspirations from The Legend of Zelda, GTA and Rock'n Roll Racing, RoadOut has a rich story full of surprises, missions and rip-roaring races.


After a great cataclysm, what's left is a post-post-apocalyptic world dominated by an A.I. with rebel groups that take refuge in a desert area known as The Dead Zone.

Claire survives in this world by executing black market contracts for local leaders involving delivery, sabotage and murder. The Dead Zone, now not so dead, is occupied by three rival factions: The Wasteheads, The SaibaKuran, and Order of the New Code.
