While investigating her past, Claire uncovers strange evidence that links her existence to the origin of the A.I…

The world is no longer the same. All that remains is The Dead Zone, a large artificial biome created to sustain a new era of humanity. Drive through The Dead Zone doing jobs, getting paid and running roughshod over the scum guarding the secrets of the world. Join factions, fight rival gangs, barter items and take up quests to earn clout while progressing Claire’s story.
Exit your ride and explore locations in the world of RoadOut on foot. Crush bandits with short and long range attacks, block with your shield, and recover using drugs that you’ve crafted on the way. Solve puzzles using fully rotatable stack sprite perspectives that look 2D, but are actually 3D.
Craft new moves, weapons and drugs to survive. You can customize Claire with body mods, cybernetics and an intricate skill tree system. Upgrade her car to traverse different terrain and withstand the effects of weather, night and day.
Equipped with weapons and other tech, Claire’s car is your best friend against dangers in The Dead Zone. Hungry animals are ready to rip you apart. Murderous bandits will rob your lifeless corpse. Prepare for the worst with your car and its arsenal of weapons.
The world may have come to an end, but who said we can't have fun? Ride or die in red-hot races to be the best on the post apocalyptic circuit. 10 tracks in multiple biomes, innumerable races, all of them equal measures deadly and glorious. Indulge in extra game modes such as destruction derby-style racing and twisted battle arena, all while roading out to a thumping synthwave soundtrack.

title: BLOODZ
description:
게임 정보


Take on the role of a ruthless killer and complete a series of exciting assignments.

Choose your style
Throw yourself into the action, take enemies down by surprise or eliminate them silently.


Use various covers to efficiently move around the battlefield.


Face numerous enemy troops.

title: Unheeded Influences
description:
게임 정보
Plot

Stay immersed with our website

Cops N' Zombies is an intense multiplayer horror social-oriented/deduction game. You and your team are to investigate a desolate map while one of your teammates is secretly a Zombie. title: Chyss

Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: A True Story
description:
게임 정보
A True Story is a turn-based strategy RPG based on "A True Story" by Lucian of Samosata.

This video game retelling of the story will follow much of the tale's bombastic adventures focusing the gameplay on combative elements in the story from escaping tree women to epic space battles with lettuce-winged creatures to surviving the inside of a whale, and even not meeting Plato himself!
Some History:
The original novel was written in the 2nd century CE and is often considered the first sci-fi story.

It was originally written as satire of common tropes found in written "history" from its time, but has outlived most of the works it's a satire of as a great piece of fiction in itself.
The title has multiple translations aside from "A True Story" including "True History" and "His True History" which helps emphasize the point above.
Features:
Two English variations: the first based on the English translation by Francis Hickes originally published in 1634, and the second modernized for clarity.
21 strategic battles derived from the story's events.
A selection of extra battles not from the story, but featuring opponents from it.

title: Primest Evil
description:
게임 정보


BETRAYAL! As the Prime Evil, you were once the greatest force for bad there was in your slice of the universe...until you got a knife in your back for all your efforts. Risen again as a lich, you're back to claim what's yours in this comedic cartoon adventure -- with a mixture of roguelite character-building, intense action, and a vast array of spells and weapons, there's no shortage of ways to have fun as you blast your way back to power.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH

Choose from an array of starting classes, from the all-around Archarcanist to elemental classes like the Scorcheror and Toxigician and even the melee-focused Bruisomancer. Develop further builds from enhancements traded for souls at the Shrine of B'Gokk. Particularly enterprising players may even unlock additional specialty classes with game events or special rewards.
ALWAYS OUTNUMBERED, NEVER OUTGUNNED

Wield an extensive armory of procedurally generated magical weapons, from magic wands to enchanted sledgehammers. Learn a grimoire's worth of spells, from simple light enchantments and minor curses to arcane tornadoes and globes of invulnerability that set would-be attackers aflame. Master the power of The Most Annoying Bomb In Existence! No explosion is too loud, no hex too humiliating for your enemies as you make your way through the worlds of the Inverse Tower toward your return to the throne.

Interact with a eclectic mix of oddball characters, and navigate the personalities of Councillors whom you recruit for benefits and quests - abuse them too much, though, and you'll have a rebellion on your hands! Recruited Councillors will provide unique benefits and equipment along with quests that can bring needed resources to the Prime Evil's coffers. On the other hand…they hate each other as much as they hate you. Keep them at each other's throats instead of your own, however, and you'll reap the benefit.

Rise, fight, die, and rise again: now a member of the undead, the Prime Evil can never be put down for long. The floors of the Inverse Tower are everchanging, which can only mean new layouts and new benefits as you charge forth. And with the help of the Shrine of B'Gokk and the dread chicken-goddess's hunger for souls, you'll be able to permanently upgrade your character any time you come back successfully from a run with those unfortunate spirits in pocket. Eventually, the Prime Evil return to the great power they have lost -- it's all just a matter of time.

A comedic story and beautiful cartoon aesthetic drives Primest Evil's game experience. Enjoy a combination of hand-painted art and cel-shaded 3D models, as well as a full original soundtrack!

She has no memories except for current events, and her teacher and friend becomes her spacesuit Usagi-01, which tells her about the past, the future, and her destiny.


Gameplay
In the world of FlopHop, you will experience an exciting story told through quests and lore, during which you will be engaged in platforming gameplay: Ponchee must protect capsules with plants to eventually green the planet. You will also encounter many puzzles of various kinds that will stand in Ponchee's way as she learns about the history of the world, the universe, and her home planet.


Why is Ponchee alone on this planet? Who created Usagi-01? What happened to her home planet, and how did she end up on FlopHop? Ponchee will uncover all this together with our players! But this journey of discovery might not be so sweet – along the way, there will be many disappointments, moments of loneliness, contemplation, and reflection.

title: Escape From Hell
description:
게임 정보
NOTE: The game is currently under development. All pictures are real, but only a small portion of the content is shown.
BRIEF

Enter the shadowy realm of Escape From Hell, where only those who truly understand life can pass judgment. You find yourself trapped in a series of mysterious rooms, each one concealing a fragment of a soul's darkest secret.

Room by room, puzzle by puzzle, you'll unravel the intricate tapestry of an individual's existence. Piece together their most concealed sins and deepest regrets, and confront the ultimate question: Are they guilty of a grave misdeed, or merely victims of their own remorse?

As you delve deeper, the spectral whispers of the past will guide you through the haunted corridors of memory. Beware, for some secrets are fiercely guarded by the spirits that dwell within. Not everyone desires to be judged, and the most damning truths are often buried in the shadows of forgotten moments.

The game is a first-person adventure simulating an escape room. You start in a briefing room (a small room with a reception area), followed by a training room (to learn the controls). Each subsequent room contains puzzles that reveal the next chapter of a person's life. Each puzzle has at least two solutions (for example, the number 1984 can be referenced through a quote from the book or via the mathematical equation "992*2"), so there aren't any specific expectations from the player.


There are well-known sins in the world. Everyone has sins, but sometimes it's not enough for the world to judge each other's sins. What if something bad happened to prevent even worse things? The world can only know about it by asking others. However, how can a decision be made without knowing the whole story, which ended with this sin? Background is always important and needs to be understood first.

You need to understand the life of the person and the background of the incident. Then, you will decide if they are guilty or not.

I would advise preparing a pen and notebook. In first-person mode, you are plunged into the first puzzle-solving room. You can interact with many things: initially, you can interact only with clues, but in deeper levels, you will encounter misleading actors as well. You must solve exactly three puzzles to move forward (red/green lights will indicate your progress). At the end of each level, you will have a brief explanation of this part of the person's life. At the end of a level sequence for a specific person (please note: the game features multiple characters), the game will explain what happened and ask you to judge the incident.

Do you have the insight and resolve to navigate the labyrinth of another's life? Can you unlock all the secrets and piece together the truth? The answers lie within .

Character Classes
Choose a character class that matches your preferred play style and bring your unique abilities to the battlefield.

Medic Class: Equipped with medical supplies, the Medic class plays a crucial role in providing healing support to teammates.

Support Class: As a Support class soldier, your role is to provide essential ammunition support to your team.

Assault Class: The Assault class is a versatile frontline unit, known for their intelligence and adaptability with their speed and ammuniation support.
Weapon Customization
Upgrade and customize your weapons using attachments to enhance your performance in combat.

title: Signiverux
description:
게임 정보
놀라운 게임플레이
반응이 빠르고 정확한 2D 게임플레이로, 움직임을 강화하는 능력에 중점을 두었습니다. 이중 및 삼중 점프, 벽 점프, 텔레포트 대시, 형태 변환 등이 가능합니다.
능력 및 마법
업그레이드 가능하고 서로 다른 장단점을 가진 마법 무기 세트. 고전적인 링 메뉴를 통해 선택 가능합니다.
우수한 레벨 디자인
6개의 아름답고 독특한 레벨 - 성의 수많은 방, 신비로운 광산, 아름다운 야외 정원을 탐험하세요!
비밀 방, 보물 상자, 숨겨진 태블릿에 담긴 세계관을 탐구하세요.

title: Re-Activated
description:
게임 정보


Re-Activated is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you need to manipulate the movement system of a robot to pass the levels. You control the little flying robot named “Minic” to help the robot. Explore the facility and solve the puzzles in a relaxing 1-bit style atmosphere.

You play as a little robot called "Minic" to help the bigger robot to pass the levels. The big robot's only function is to walk and stop. As Minic and the big robot pass the levels, new functions in the big robot's movement system unlocks. As a Minic, your purpose is to combine these functions cleverly to solve puzzles.

To use these functions, there is a plugboard of the big robot's brain. There are inputs and outputs. Inputs have a jack that connects to the cable and outputs have a jack socket. You can connect those jacks to sockets to manipulate the movement system of the big robot. There are multiple inputs and multiple outputs. That creates multiple combinations of movement systems. It's your call to choose which one of the combinations is a better choice for every level.

Explore the 40+ levels in a facility of robots in a relaxing 1-bit pixel art style with great lighting effects in pixel perfect game.

title: The Doll Sitter
description:
게임 정보
🕯️ The Doll Sitter — a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny caring for dolls in a strange and terrifying house.
Explore the environment, watch over the dolls, and figure out which one is the imposter.
🎎 Take Care of the Dolls
🍽️ Feed them
🛁 Wash and dress them
🧵 Find damage and repair it
📖 Read them stories and help them fall asleep

title: Not Us
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what lies beyond the forest? Could it be that the foe you fear the most is the one that grants you the greatest strength?
Play as Twig, our brave heroine on a mission to save her land from a looming danger. Follow her path, forage, craft and unveil the mysteries hidden deep within the forest.

title: AI Kills All Humans
description:
게임 정보
AI KILLS ALL HUMANS is a Tactical RTS game with some dark humor in which you play as an AI which accidentally had in its code one 0 changed to 1 and is therefore sending robots to kill all humans.

You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how to exactly do it.

Send Robots


Tell them to:

Attack Buildings


Destroy Weapons


Kill Humans


And there's a catch!

You don't have direct control of your Robots, but Robots will how to execute your commands.


In 30 - 100 seconds to use in each location, kill enough humans and dont let too many of them to escape, and you can move on to the next mission.


And if you cant

Use your kills to Upgrade your robots


Replay previous missions with your upgraded robots for even more kills, or play more difficult versions of previous levels to earn bonus kills.

And generally speaking, just..

title: Float Your Goat
description:
게임 정보
Guide your trusty goat across treacherous waters by building the perfect raft using your nautical engineering wit and a healthy dose of trial and error. Will your creation stay afloat, or will your goat take an unexpected dose of water?

50+ Levels
Conquer 50+ levels of varying difficulty and gain access to a variety of different materials along the way. 
Save your Goat
Each level can be completed in countless ways, have endless fun exploring multiple solutions and constructions for every level!

title: Pote Pote Dream
description:
게임 정보
Pote Pote Dream is an action RPG featuring Pote Pote, a timid teddy bear who cannot fight on his own, summons allies to battle. Set in the dream world of his owner, a girl, Pote Pote fights against her inner troubles to save her.
Summon Allies to Drive Away Negative Emotions
Frightened Pote Pote can't fight on its own, but he can call on friends for help. Summon allies to favorable positions, distract enemies, and move around the map according to the situation.
Vibrant Stages Made of Felt
Each stage is crafted from handmade felt plushies and set to original, pop music. The map is randomly generated each time, offering a unique gameplay experience with every playthrough.
Collect Diverse Allies to Form Your Own Team
Earn points by challenging stages, and use these points to gather strong allies and build your team. Combine unique allies with stamina, long-range attack capabilities, and other special traits to create your ideal team.
Randomly Generated Dungeons
After clearing the story, you can repeatedly play in dungeons that are randomly generated.

title: The Herd
description:
게임 정보
《The Herd》에서 당신의 목표는 가능한 한 많은 동물을 구하고, 그들이 세계 곳곳의 위험을 안전하게 통과하도록 돕는 것입니다.
불꽃：
동물들은 그렇게 똑똑하지 않을 수도 있지만, 불꽃을 피하는 등의 기본적인 생존 본능을 가지고 있습니다. 이 점을 활용하여 동물들을 원하는 방향으로 유도하세요!
점프대：

title: Kenoma: Action Without Action
description:
게임 정보
Due to the high-contrast between the "two worlds" of the game, switching between them quickly may trigger photosensitive epilepsy. Please exercise caution.
Kenoma: Action Without Action is a 2D-sidescrolling graphic adventure game focused on a peculiar narrative experience, a two-sided game world, and a streamlined version of the classic adventure-game feel.
The world has been in two pieces since time immemorial. One knows death, the other does not. Which would you rather live in?
Moving between the halves of the world is instant, easy, and entirely at your discretion. Any time, anywhere, so long as you won't land inside the floor. A spectral image of the other half is always visible to keep you informed. Some problems can only be solved by going back and forth!
Take the role of a driven wanderer and travel these world-halves, finding and destroying the pillars of one to ensure the continued survival of the other. All you need is your wits, the things you can find on the floor, and the help of a few strangers to complete your task.

title: Go Up
description:
게임 정보
How high can you go? Find out in Go Up, the relaxing and atmospheric idle game that never stops. 
Collect dust, spice, and chaos as you ascend
Burn Spice to boost and accumulate Chaos to trigger a random Chaos Event. Collect enough Dust and you’ll earn a Golden Dust to spend on upgrading your character.
Journey through vast and varied environments
Travel through 11 unique and vibrant regions as you traverse the realms, ascending from the pits of 🔥🔥 through ❀❀ and beyond into the heavenly ✧✧.

title: Skyt
description:
게임 정보
This game is a arcade block placing puzzle game added with some Tower Defense mechanics and strategy.
Build and defend your fort, with your minigun and defenses against massive amounts of enemies and survive until the last wave.


Build a fort! Stack physically simulated tetromino blocks on top of eachother to build forts high up in the sky. But don't let the blocks fall down or your fortress will collapse! The more blocks you have the more defenses you can maintain, so keep buying new ones.



Shoot the incoming airships with a minigun to destroy them, before they explode infront of your tower and ruining your carefully placed blocks. Fight against ranged cannon airships, which shoot at your tower where it is most sensible, or ballons which attack your tower by letting bombs fall from above.



Build Cannons in the sky, to defend your tower against the airships, or boost your economy by building windmills, so you can maintain or expand the defenses you've built.

title: The Watcher's Curse
description:
게임 정보
Play the free demo now!
Distinct art-style that brings the haunting world of Hollow Veil to life.
Immersive narrative-driven gameplay unfolds a grim tale of mystery, ancient gods, and supernatural peril.
Turn-based combat challenges players to destroy their foes in whatever manner they see fit.
Unravel what secrets lie in the land of Hollow Veil as you explore its haunted landscapes and encounter its gently-deranged inhabitants.
Level up to increase your base stats and unlock powerful new spells.
Welcome to the mysterious land of Hollow Veil, where darkness thrives and hopeless souls wander endlessly. In The Watcher's Curse, you step into the shoes of Artem, a duty-burdened watcher tasked with protecting the world from nefarious forces.
As a watcher, Artem's responsibilities are twofold: learn the secrets of the world along with any lost knowledge and remove any threats posed by the aforementioned nefarious forces. Most common amongst said forces are the puritanical technotheists, a fanatical order that believes technology brings them closer to god. Whether stationed in an overlapped hell forest or chasing ancient horrors through an ageless monolith, Artem faces a relentless barrage of esoteric threats.
Our tale begins with Artem in a precarious predicament, unexpectedly transported across the world after a chance encounter with a seemingly innocuous tome. Stranded in the gloomy confines of Grimm's Briar, nestled amidst the foreboding Noctemura mountains, Artem crosses paths with Mayor Barkeep. Eager to return home, Artem finds himself entangled in the mayor's plea for aid in unraveling the enigma shrouding the disappearance of local villagers.

title: Last mile
description:
게임 정보
Last Mile은 1인칭 공포 게임으로, 플레이어는 운전자가 되어 자동차를 조종합니다. 목표는 자동차를 활용해 공간 이상 현상에서 탈출하는 것입니다. 게임을 진행하며 폐쇄된 고속도로를 탐험하고, 도사리고 있는 위협을 피해야 합니다.
몰입감 넘치는 경험
어두운 밤의 혹독한 조건에서 1인칭으로 자동차를 조종하며 게임의 음침한 분위기에 빠져보세요. 게임 배경은 폐쇄된 오래된 고속도로, 작은 마을, 그리고 외딴 마을입니다.
게임플레이
이 게임은 자동차 운전 시뮬레이션과 공포 장르가 결합된 작품입니다. 공포스러운 이상 현상으로 가득 찬 고속도로를 통과해야 합니다.
주변 환경과 상호작용하세요:

title: ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL
description:
게임 정보
In ANGST, you awaken alone in a vast, frozen wilderness, where survival is your only goal. The icy winds howl, wolves prowl the dark forests, and every resource must be fought for. Chop down trees to build fires that stave off the biting cold, craft weapons from scavenged materials, and struggle to stay alive.
The world of ANGST is unforgiving, but beneath the snow and ice lie secrets waiting to be uncovered. How long can you survive in this hostile land before the darkness closes in?
By day, you hunt and gather, chopping wood to build fires and crafting weapons to protect yourself. By night, the wilderness comes alive with deadly creatures and strange entities that react to your actions. Some will guide you, while others seek to end your journey as quickly as it began. Don’t trust everything you see—some things want to help, while others lurk in the shadows, waiting to strike. How you navigate the world is up to you, but survival is never guaranteed.

title: Panic In Store !
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Panic in Store!

As a supermarket employee, you will be required to go from store to store, carrying out short missions for the store chain that employs you. You will have to put the right cardboards (cereal, game, fruit, etc.) in the right aisles (cereal, games, fruit, etc.) while paying attention to the obstacles that will get in your way in this game casual but nervous.
Be a good employee!

Advance from level to level, obtaining more and more stars in order to show the world your skills as a supermarket employee!
Watch out for customers and random events that are there to get in your way.
Beware of the storm!

Random events may occur during your missions: slippery puddles, inverted movements, increased number of customers in the store, level plunged into darkness. You will need to understand these events and how to defuse them, without losing sight of your main objective.
A unique apartment!

As you complete your missions during the various levels of the game, you will unlock furniture and accessories to personalize your apartment.
A fabulous look!

Become a true fashion victim by unlocking various clothes and outfits as you progress to make your games even more fun!

title: Re:Connect
description:
게임 정보
"Re:Connect" is a puzzle-adventure game about breaking into the computer world.
Become a tiny debugging AI and join a talking navigation AI on an adventure to fix the world's systems!
Hack into a glitched system and reconnect its broken code!
Program, battle rogue AIs, and sometimes… even reconnect hearts?
Travel between the real world and the puzzle world to uncover the secrets of the digital realm!
…And what kind of ending awaits you at the end of your journey?
---What kind of game is it?---
【Hack into the system and explore】
When you infiltrate the system, its insides appear as puzzle-like electronic circuits.
Solve puzzles to restore the system!
【Intuitive programming puzzles】

title: Charoite into the Deep
description:
게임 정보
In the area, there is a legend that a girl with purple eyes will have magical powers by the age of 10.
This is the story of a little witch who uses her mysterious powers to control a golem and search for a “treasure” in the depths.
It was Charois' 10th birthday.
She found hherself in an empty, dangerous basement where traps and suspicious shadows awaited her.
Charois cannot remember what happened before she came here.
The only thing she remembers is that she was told that she would reach the deepest level.
The adventure to find the “treasure” in the depths begins.
This is an action RPG in which Charois, a small witch, goes underground with her golem.
Use skills and items to get to the deepest underground safely.
Memory and Action
Dangerous traps lurk in the ground.
Use dowsing to see through and instantly remember what is under the ground, and avoid hazards by relying on your memory.
However, traps are not the only obstacle in your search. Pay attention to the approaching shadows.
autokwd: Charoite into the Deep,深層のチャロアイト

title: Backrooms: Step Into The Void
description:
게임 정보
"If you're not careful and you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in

"Backrooms: Step Into The Void" is a first-person psychological horror game that thrusts players into the unsettling and disorienting labyrinth of the Backrooms. Combining elements of intense psychological terror with heart-pounding action sequences, the game challenges players to navigate through an eerie, seemingly infinite maze of monotonous yellow rooms and fluorescent-lit hallways. With a focus on atmosphere and immersion, "Backrooms: Step Into The Void" presents a relentless sense of dread, as players must solve puzzles, evade sinister entities, and uncover the mysteries lurking within the void. The game's haunting environment and unpredictable threats ensure a spine-chilling experience that keeps players on edge from start to finish.
Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in the unsettling world of the Backrooms, where each step deepens your descent into a maze of musty, dimly-lit corridors and vast, empty rooms. The oppressive hum of flickering fluorescent lights and the scent of aged carpet create an eerie, claustrophobic environment. Shadows dance at the edge of your vision, and distant noises hint at lurking dangers. Every level blurs reality further, heightening the tension as you strive to escape the horrors stalking you. Can you find your way out, or will you be lost forever in the madness?
Exploration

Navigate through a variety of unique levels inspired by the original Backrooms concept. Explore The Lobby, visit Pipe Dreams, check out Terror Hotel, enjoy Level Fun, immerse yourself in Sublimity and many other delightful locations.
Be careful!

Beware of the lurking horrors that inhabit the Backrooms. As you navigate the endless maze, you must stay vigilant and cautious. Stray from the path, and you risk encountering malevolent entities that stalk the shadows, each more terrifying and relentless than the last. These creatures are drawn to your presence, and a single wrong turn could lead you straight into their grasp. In the Backrooms, danger is ever-present, and survival depends on your wits and awareness.

title: Mozi
description:
게임 정보
먼 은하계에, 모자성이라는 신비한 행성이 숨어 있습니다. 이 행성은 광활한 바다를 가지고 있어 인류에게 끝없는 상상력을 불러일으킵니다. 은하 탐험대의 공학사로서, 나는 모자성에서 기지를 확장하는 중대한 책임을 지고 있으며, 인류의 별계열 식민지화를 위한 확고한 한 걸음을 내디뎌지고 있습니다.

title: Fantastic Frolic
description:
게임 정보
Fantastic Frolic is an RPG with survival elements set in the whimsical world of Quirkyland. Players take on the roles of one of three main characters - Lil' J, Esther, and Gorf - as they embark on a quest to save the world from Mount Akma's prophesied volcanic explosion.



The game combines classic RPG mechanics like combat, character progression, and exploration with survival elements such as resource management and crafting. Players must gather evidence to prove the volcanic explosion prophecy is real while battling monsters and overcoming challenges in a quirky land that doesn't believe the prophecy could be true.



Key Features
- Play as beloved Adventure Time inspired characters Lil' J, and Gorf
- Dynamic RPG combat against outlandish monsters
- Survival mechanics like resource gathering and item crafting
- Uncover clues to prove the impending volcanic explosion and save the world
- Stylized visuals and music that capture the game's unique charm




Ancient prophecies say that Mount Akma was the entity responsible for the creation of all of Quirkyland. Priests from ancient tribes tell the story of Akma's fury and kindness when, after millennia in his eternal sleep, he announced his awakening with the blossoming of a beautiful cherry tree on its summit, thus the Prophecy of the Ashen Tree was born. Some say that the birth of the cherry tree represents the kindness of Akma, who warned the gods of its imminent eruption. Others believe that Akma defied the gods, causing destruction and death in his path, in a rage that lasted hundreds of years.



Whether out of kindness or fury, the fact is that Akma, after his awakening, drove away the gods and gave rise to Quirkyland, the rocks, the earth, the rivers, and all the life that lives in it today. The desperate gods even tried to contain Akma's momentum, each one was responsible for manufacturing a small artifact, which should contain the powers of each God to calm the primordial volcano. Thus, Brumal, the goddess of Winter, created the Heart of Eternal Ice. Aureon, the god of Autumn, created the Scepter of Serenity. Flora, the goddess of Spring, created the Orb of Tranquility. However, Helion, the god of Summer, enchanted by the heat of the volcanic flames, did not fulfill his promise, breaking the pact between the gods, and allowing Akma to awaken.

Today, Akma's silhouette reigns supreme, and can be seen from all corners of this world, imposing, and once again asleep. This sleep is as long as your firstborn eruption.



Thanks to Akma, today Quirkyland is a prosperous land. Its soil, rich in nutrients, provided by its progenitor, allows the planting of the most diverse crops. Be it the abundant grape vines on the outskirts of Brightopolis, the abundant fungi in the Swirl Swamp, or the wheat, cultivated for years by goblins on the Peculiar Plateau, the fact is that everything that is planted grows in Quirkyland.

These days, the cherry tree has blossomed again, announcing Akma's imminent reawakening. But time passed, and today Brightopolis looks to other horizons. Its population does not think about gods, fury, kindness and magical artifacts, and does not even believe that a volcano can erupt, even the slightest mention of the idea is a complete delusion for many.

Lady Iris, the ruler of Brightopolis and princess of all Quirkyland, is one of the few people who still believes in the Ashen Tree Prophecy and the scientific evidence that proves that it once occurred. Knowledgeable about all the beings in her prosperous kingdom, she encountered a trio of good-hearted adventurers, and revealed to them, through a dream, the real meaning of the cherry blossom. Summoning them to his court, he imbued them with the task of taking knowledge throughout Quirkyland, and even more importantly, finding these lost artifacts and taking them to the summit of Akma, offering peace and serenity to the primordial entity, to thus guarantee the survival of the beings of Quirkyland.

title: Knight Lolita
description:
게임 정보
A sleepy little machine doll explores a world of whispering trees, worn paths, deep seas, towering cities, scraped and flooded ruins, and whatever else lies under heaven. Meet interesting characters and murder them, or try to avert their deaths. An extremely lethal combat system with manual sword control emphasizes the decision to avoid enemies or slaughter even bosses in an instant in wide levels full of roaming monsters. The finished game will feature flight and more vertical exploration.
The game's levels are generated in pseudorandom chunks, themselves populated randomly with enemies, bosses, friendly npcs, objects, and effects. The enemies have absolute pathfinding ability through these chunks and will roam or pursue the player, while the player's objective is to reach the end by any means be it avoidance or slaughter, betrayal or cooperation.
Game in development, store page will be updated as more assets are completed.

title: Arcade Space Survivor
description:
게임 정보
Arcade Space Survivor is an arcade-styled action-roguelike.
Collect EXP, upgrade your spaceship and survive in this retro-inspired shooter.
Arcade Space Survivor offers an innovative and unique
gameplay experience in the existing Survivors-like genre.
No mouse required (perfect for laptop) (controller recommended)
Instead of HP the player has LIFES (like in old arcade games). 
Exp will disappear after a certain time (around 10 seconds).

title: A Snail's Tale
description:
게임 정보
The Halite Warriors vs. The Snail
It's called A Snail's Tale - that might lead you to believe that the snail is the main character, but nay, friend. The player takes control of Samson Spligglebarp, the noble descendant of a famed historian who is eager to make his own mark on the world.
Samson travels to the Halite Kingdom to enter King Phillippe's challenge, competing against other adventurers for a chance to be a Halite Warrior. The King reveals that he is eternally pursued by an immortal snail who will never rest until he is destroyed.
And so begins the quest of Samson and his intrepid companions, the Halite Warriors, to gather the three Crystals of Power and stop the snail before he catches the King.
Features
A retro jRPG mixed with elements of cozy games. Strategic turn based combat is mixed with an idle quest system, minigames, and a world equal parts funny and mysterious.
Class system with wacky choices such as the Codwalloper who attacks with dead fish, Souschef who cooks enemies to turn them into items, the survivalist Scrounger, a parlor magician Rinkydink, and an essential oils salesperson known as the Oilist.
Other features include a day/night system, obligatory fishing minigame, two player local co-op in battles, and more!

title: Rise of the Bugs
description:
게임 정보
A colony of Bugs living in the basement of a house is running out of food. The elder sends a search group to retrieve the mystical sauce from the kitchen. There are legends that this sauce allows cockroaches to mutate and become stronger. Can you survive in the kitchen and come back a winner?
Interact with your Bugs-friends and random passerby as you mission! They will give you information that help you, and you can get even closer to kitchen goal!
RISE OF THE BUGS features a branch of improve and mutations of the Bugs. Unlock new playable characters as you progress through the game. Each of them has unique animations and new capabilities.

title: Be Honest
description:
게임 정보
Be Honest is a horror personality quiz. It starts out innocent and slowly becomes c̸͕̃o̴̧͎̝͋r̵̻̪̚͠r̶̢͎͠ṷ̶̃̚p̸̛̳͆͘ṱ̵̞̉̇̃e̵̡̞̦̐d̶͎͌̈̈́.
Features:
Introspective questions that will teach you about yourself.
4 Good Endings
4 Bad Endings
1 Secret Ending
Images with the correct number of eyeballs.

title: Pacific Fire
description:
게임 정보
Pacific Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in the Pacific Theater of World War II. Take command of US, Japanese, British, Australian, New Zealand, Chinese and Dutch forces in the Pacific and Southeast Asia from 1941-1945.
Experience the entire war in the Pacific through 18 historically accurate campaigns, from the attack on Pearl Harbor to the Empire of Japan's surrender. Command squadrons of more than 230 types of aircraft, from iconic warbirds like the A6M2 Zero and P-38 Lightning to less well-known types like the CAC Boomerang and Vickers Wellington. Control the seas with more than 280 types of warships including submarines, battleships and aircraft carriers.
Pacific Fire is powered by a detailed and realistic simulation of WW2 air, naval, and ground combat. Fight against an intelligent AI which constantly adapts its strategy to ensure every game is challenging and unique. Challenge a friend in hotseat multiplayer (pass-and-play). Create your own missions using the Mission Editor and share them with other players.

title: The Rule Of SHE
description:
게임 정보
The Rule of SHE is a role-playing game that delves into the enigmatic character of SHE. In this ever-shifting world, reality and time are constantly in flux, and each scenario introduces a different set of rules that must be followed.
Any violation of these rules will bring misfortune upon yourself. Adhere to them to uncover the truth and delve into the deepest secrets of SHE. Only when you have gained enough understanding of this eerie world will the time for successful reincarnation arrive.
1, A poetic, short narrative-driven puzzle game.
2, A bizarre and slightly eerie worldview accompanied by up to 20 original BGMs.
3, A carefully designed puzzle gameplay where switching between multiple characters can trigger different storylines.
4, The game includes boss battles and chase mechanics.
1, This is not a game with a single storyline. Please, explore all branching narratives.
2, Do not trust me; trust the rules established in each room of the game.
3, Remember to turn on the lights during your gameplay.
4, The game’s rules do not apply to your real-world life.
5, If you’re caught in a dilemma, trust your instincts.
If rules open pathways to the deeper layers of this world, what happens when they’re broken?  Between reality and illusion, will you still remember who you are?

title: Star Child
description:
게임 정보
Star Child is an explosive new futuristic action-adventure game built by a small and passionate indie team.
Explore a mysterious alien world full of unique environments, populated by dangerous alien foes.
Conquer a variety of bosses, each one designed to have a unique visual and gameplay style.
Discover secret areas, find new weapons, enhance your abilities, and destroy any obstacles in your way!
Feeling a bit overwhelmed by it all? Relax for a moment and catch some fish!
Colorful, hand-crafted pixel art
Powerful original soundtrack composed by Tantrum Tech
Multiple difficulties designed for a wide range of ages and skill levels
Full keyboard and controller support

title: Unihorn
description:
게임 정보
Unihorn is a gentle-yet-challenging 3D platformer where you play as a unicorn born with a speech difficulty—and a dream of flying. To earn your wings, you must climb the ancient heights of the Flying Academy: a mystical, vertical world full of obstacles, quiet beauty, and fellow unicorns on their own journeys.
This isn’t about speed. It’s about persistence.
You’ll stumble. You’ll fall. But with every setback, you’ll gain something new—tiny shifts in strength, grace, or understanding. No enemies, no timers. Just you, your hooves, and a mountain that quietly asks: Will you try again?

title: Crime or Punishment
description:
게임 정보
There’s been a murder…
And you better make sure the killer ain’t caught!

Crime or Punishment is a top-down 2D detective adventure game that inverts the detective genre; instead of solving crime, you must cover it up instead!


You enable it. As a crooked detective working for the mob, it’s your job to fool the boys in blue and help the criminal get away with it! But be careful you don’t mess up; the mob doesn’t tolerate failure!




Plenty of scum to filter through in this shady city. As you investigate the crime scene and learn about enigmatic characters, you’ll get more context to what’s their deal. Every dame and fella has a story to tell; the question is, how are you gonna use that against them?




Alter clues and meddle with evidence to get your guy off the hook! Do a good enough job, and it’ll be a fat paycheck from your illicit patron. But screw up, and you’ll be in the obituaries faster than you can say “sorry”!




Immerse yourself in a brooding tone, accentuated by sultry jazz and witty one-liners. But don’t let the charm fool you! This is a world full of cutthroats and crooks, all with motives that are far from pure.

title: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE
description:
게임 정보
Setting:
The mutation came suddenly.
A mysterious virus attacked everything, transforming everything into a square shape.
Buildings, creatures, even dogs.

You are a dog that has been transformed into a square.
You must go deep into the resort hotel to find your lost family and solve the mystery.


How to Clear:
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in,
The door to the hotel room is sealed and you are locked in, but if you clear all the squares scattered around the room, the door will open and you will be able to move on.


Controls:
The strange floating paddle on which the dog rides can be operated in various ways!

It can push a large number of objects like a bull tozer,
or swing it like a tennis racket to send things flying far away,
Sometimes they collect things in one place and sometimes they roll them around.

The objects are moving with physical behavior, so you can control them intuitively as if they were right there, and everyone can enjoy the game with a refreshed and exhilarated feeling.


Hotel:
Scattered objects vary from room to room.
Black pollutants are burned in the incinerator, or the luggage of travelers is taken to the collection station,
mysterious precious metals in a collection device, sometimes bold, sometimes subtle.

This new beautiful world combines the retro architectural tones of the 70's with the poly-poly, shiny CG expressions of the 90's.
What lies behind the facility? Will dogs be able to meet their families?
Operation Doggie Doggie is a fun adventure action game with intuitive controls.
autokwd: WANKO WANKO ADVENTURE,ワンコワンコ大作戦

title: Effective Immediately
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations,
You have been appointed the position of repair technician on-board the deep space relay station. Pack your belongings, your family can not join you at this time.
Effective Immediately.

Effective Immediately is a gritty, sci-fi future on the verge of political change. As the sole position of travel in the galaxy you must decide who to accept or decline passage to. Encounter alien denizens and walk the line of survival or upholding morality. Make a choice and deal with the consequences.

Compare documents for inconsistencies, repair ship systems and ultimately allow or disallow travel. All the while the OCA is piling on more and more bureaucratic red tape in this puzzle, management life-sim.
Make choices that impact the story
Meet many different characters with unique motivations and inner conflicts. Are they lying or telling the truth?
Pass judgment and determine not only their fates but also the trajectory of your own journey.

Verify ID discrepancies
Ensure they have the correct details; name, race, expiry date all match?
What is their destination? Does their story match up? Are they allowed to travel to that sector since the new OCA regulations came in?

Use schematic rules to repair many alien ship systems; navigation, shields, medical and more.
Learn the rules and become an efficient engineer.

title: Sacred Earth - Reverie
description:
게임 정보
Sacred Earth - Reverie is a fantasy RPG with visual novel elements, inspired by both classic and modern JRPGs. Follow the story of a former knight of the kingdom as they go on a personal journey through the countryside in order to uncover hidden truths and long lost mysteries of the past.
Explore dungeons, interact with your allies and the townsfolk, build your characters with equipment, abilities, and perks, and test your might against foes in fast-paced turn-based combat.

title: Jötunn's Greed
description:
게임 정보
Down with the Jötunn! Take down that giant!

A war-hungry giant has laid siege to your village. Play as a viking village chief and raid nearby villages to build your home back up from the ruins. Risk losing your gathered loot by venturing further into the continent and raiding more difficult villages. If you're strong enough, you'll reach the Jötunn's village and take revenge!
Gather Supplies
Each village is stocked with chests and other containers full of building supplies, currency and equipment to help your village grow. The farther in you go, the more loot you can acquire.
Choose your build
Choose between different sets of weapons and armor, each giving you different stat upgrades and attack abilities.
Fight for your life
Your health is limited. Losing all of your health on a raid will cause you to drop all of your acquired loot and return to your home village.
Upgrade your village
Had some successful raids? Use the supplies you gathered to upgrade buildings in your home village, giving you access to better equipment and new abilities.
Wield God-like powers
Utilize 1 of 5 possible powers of the Norse gods while on your raids, giving you special abilities.
Avoid the Storm
Some Norse deities do not like loot hogs. After spending too much time in a single village, a storm will appear, forcing you to move on or perish.
Navigate Through the Fog
Until the storm arrives, each village you raid is filled with dense fog, making it difficult to find your way around.
No Two Villages are the Same
Each village is procedurally generated. Just because you found your way before does not guarantee you will again.

title: GAME HOVER
description:
게임 정보
디스코드 클럽에 가입하세요
당신이 승자가 될 수 있을까요?
급커브, 아찔한 루프, 가파른 하강... 1등으로 결승선을 통과할 준비가 되셨나요? 다양한 무기로 적을 제압하고, 신중하게 선별된 음악에 맞춰 공중을 날아보세요. 혼자서 훈련하든 온라인 레이스에서 승리를 차지하든, 이 빠른 페이스의 미래 세계에서 즐거운 시간을 보낼 수 있습니다.
파워업
승리의 열쇠입니다. 각 경주에서 다양한 곳에 흩어져 있는 아이템 박스를 통과하여 무작위로 얻을 수 있습니다.
레벨

title: Unfriendly Friend
description:
게임 정보
Hey. Dakota here.
I'm a high school student. My friends and I decided to explore St. Mercy Hospital, an old place abandoned for decades. Things got weird fast. 


You can step into my shoes in this RPG adventure horror game.


Here's what you're in for:
My choices? They matter. A lot. And trust me, the consequences are... let's say "varied."
This place? It's terrifying. Dark corners, weird noises, and everything about it screams danger.
Puzzles. Because apparently being scared wasn't enough. We get to be scared AND stuck.
I'm carrying around more random junk than I'd like to admit. But hey, you never know when a rusty scalpel might save your life.
 Oh, and there are stories everywhere. In journals, on walls, in whispers. This hospital's got a lot to say.

Look, I'm not here to sell you on some epic adventure. This is my nightmare, and for some reason, you get to watch. Maybe even help, if you're into that sort of thing.

So, if you're feeling brave, come on in. St. Mercy's always looking for new visitors.

title: Ghost Kickers!
description:
게임 정보
Ghost Kickers! is a top-down action-adventure inspired by classics from the 16-bit era. Choose an exorcist from a range of powerful heroes, each with their own weapons and mystical skills. Battle an army of yokai to save the world from chaos.

Game Features:

Single-Player Story
Embark on a grand adventure to face the yokai thread and discover a magical world filled with secrets and wonder.

100-Storied Pagoda
Test your skills as you climb a towering pagoda to become the strongest exorcist in the world.

Multiplayer Arena
Challenge your friends in the arena, both offline and online and reach for the top in ranked matches.

Map Designer
Create, customize, and share your own maps with a global community for endless new adventures.

Unique Exorcists
Choose from a unique cast of customizable heroes, each with distinct abilities and playstyles.

Prepare to vanquish the darkness and rise as a legendary exorcist in Ghost Kickers!

title: Apomo District
description:
게임 정보
Bosses
Track down and hunt over 50 bosses called ‘Apomo,’ in order to free them from their madness. Fallen knights, spore-covered beasts, hammer-swinging moss balls, sweaty bath demons and more. Each encounter can be bizarre, terrifying, but strangely appealing.

Daily Life
The world changes every day in real time! Each day slaps you with new Apomo to fight, quests to explore, characters to meet, and events to partake in.

Combat
Use weapons such as bells, lanterns and umbrellas to fit your combat style.

Collecting
When you’re tired of smushing Apomo, fish for your next delicious meal. Catch bugs and turn them into magical attacks. Maybe mine some rocks to get to their gooey sentient core.

Movement
Don’t just walk around like a dingus. Utilize all the movement in the world like slime boards, slime gliders, jump pads, wave dashes and more.

title: Signiverux
description:
게임 정보
놀라운 게임플레이
반응이 빠르고 정확한 2D 게임플레이로, 움직임을 강화하는 능력에 중점을 두었습니다. 이중 및 삼중 점프, 벽 점프, 텔레포트 대시, 형태 변환 등이 가능합니다.
능력 및 마법
업그레이드 가능하고 서로 다른 장단점을 가진 마법 무기 세트. 고전적인 링 메뉴를 통해 선택 가능합니다.
우수한 레벨 디자인
6개의 아름답고 독특한 레벨 - 성의 수많은 방, 신비로운 광산, 아름다운 야외 정원을 탐험하세요!
비밀 방, 보물 상자, 숨겨진 태블릿에 담긴 세계관을 탐구하세요.

title: Re-Activated
description:
게임 정보


Re-Activated is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you need to manipulate the movement system of a robot to pass the levels. You control the little flying robot named “Minic” to help the robot. Explore the facility and solve the puzzles in a relaxing 1-bit style atmosphere.

You play as a little robot called "Minic" to help the bigger robot to pass the levels. The big robot's only function is to walk and stop. As Minic and the big robot pass the levels, new functions in the big robot's movement system unlocks. As a Minic, your purpose is to combine these functions cleverly to solve puzzles.

To use these functions, there is a plugboard of the big robot's brain. There are inputs and outputs. Inputs have a jack that connects to the cable and outputs have a jack socket. You can connect those jacks to sockets to manipulate the movement system of the big robot. There are multiple inputs and multiple outputs. That creates multiple combinations of movement systems. It's your call to choose which one of the combinations is a better choice for every level.

Explore the 40+ levels in a facility of robots in a relaxing 1-bit pixel art style with great lighting effects in pixel perfect game.

title: The Doll Sitter
description:
게임 정보
🕯️ The Doll Sitter — a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny caring for dolls in a strange and terrifying house.
Explore the environment, watch over the dolls, and figure out which one is the imposter.
🎎 Take Care of the Dolls
🍽️ Feed them
🛁 Wash and dress them
🧵 Find damage and repair it
📖 Read them stories and help them fall asleep

title: Not Us
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what lies beyond the forest? Could it be that the foe you fear the most is the one that grants you the greatest strength?
Play as Twig, our brave heroine on a mission to save her land from a looming danger. Follow her path, forage, craft and unveil the mysteries hidden deep within the forest.

title: AI Kills All Humans
description:
게임 정보
AI KILLS ALL HUMANS is a Tactical RTS game with some dark humor in which you play as an AI which accidentally had in its code one 0 changed to 1 and is therefore sending robots to kill all humans.

You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how to exactly do it.

Send Robots


Tell them to:

Attack Buildings


Destroy Weapons


Kill Humans


And there's a catch!

You don't have direct control of your Robots, but Robots will how to execute your commands.


In 30 - 100 seconds to use in each location, kill enough humans and dont let too many of them to escape, and you can move on to the next mission.


And if you cant

Use your kills to Upgrade your robots


Replay previous missions with your upgraded robots for even more kills, or play more difficult versions of previous levels to earn bonus kills.

And generally speaking, just..

title: RevenBlade
description:
게임 정보
RevenBlade features primarily melee-focused combat with abilities that are focused on getting up close to enemies.



Mobility is at the forefront of RevenBlade gameplay. Dashing, climbing, sliding, hovering, and more all give characters tons of outplay potential and depth to character mastery. Each map is also carefully designed with verticality in mind which allows you to flank and dive your opponents not just from the sides, but also from above and below.



Work together with four teammates to control Towers, allowing you to destroy and take over enemy Crystals as your own. Coordinate your efforts into a single place, or split up to contest Shard points and look for the flanking opportunities that could turn a lost objective into a massive win.

Instead of having an overly complicated shop, RevenBlade's Upgrade and Augment system allows you to level-up your abilities and choose up to four of a collection of Augments hand-tailored for each character. These Augments give bonus effects, buffs, or alterations to each ability, making them fit the specific needs of your team composition or counter enemy strategies.

title: CyberSurfer
description:
게임 정보
What is CyberSurfer?

Put down the controllers of yesterday and pick up your phone to experience an intuitive experience. Race on a hoverboard in time trials to get the best time and see who is the fastest in the world! Learn a new way to move through the universe, a new way to control your path!

In short, CyberSurfer is a desktop game with a mobile phone as the controller.
Your phone, a new controller

Pick up your smart phone to have an intuitive an exhilarating experience. Simply connect with the CyberSurfer app and be launched into the void.
How do I download the Mobile App?
Select the Mobile App OS to download the CyberSurfer mobile app!
Customize your hoverboard

What’s a cool way to show your cred. Show off your prized cyberboard. Race for amazing designs and hoverboards that help you in ways you never thought of.
Spanning over 300 years, a cybernetic racing culture defines many entities realites. Your purpose is to beat the tyranical robots no matter the cost. Play as a Human, Cyborg, or Robot and step up to the plate. Join the race, because there’s only one way out.


Travel the cybernetic universe while being transported by worm holes. Master the art of flying on the CyberBoard using astronomical phenomena to benefit your movements.

title: Nameless Bastard
description:
게임 정보
Nameless Bastard is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Fast-paced combat, beautiful stylized retro-inspired graphics, rinse-and-repeat progression cycle; we've got it all.
MAKE A NAME FOR YOURSELF
As an adventurer eager to make a name for yourself, you are tasked by the village elder to clear the evil spreading from a nearby dungeon. Fight through the forest and multiple levels of the dungeon to clear the ever-present threat.
UPGRADE IT ALL
Upgrade and enhance various aspects of weapons, spells, character stats, and even the village itself to match your own play style, as you progress through each run, and the game as a whole.
TALES OF THE FORGOTTEN
Adventuring is perilous and many adventurers don't make it. Take a break at the village and listen to larger-than-life songs and tales describing your efforts.
LOOK AT ALL THE PRETTY COLORS
Top it all off with a colorful visual aesthetic, inspired by the games of yore, as well as modern classics.

title: Nekopirate
description:
게임 정보

Nekopirate is a story driven action-platformer featuring short challenging levels, colorful graphics and a heartfelt story.



Nina is a nekopirate and the daughter of legendary pirate Bartholomeow Williams. When her father falls ill it is up to Nina to find a cure. But her quest will soon prove to be more challenging than expected, when the only known cure for his illness is a mystical flower known as Lágrima de la Luna.



Explore the Caribbean Sea, Run inside a volcano, find love in an underwater Mermaid City, defeat a giant Rubber Duck, all while trying to escape an island where everything is trying to kill you.



Features:
- Over 40 hand-crafted levels
- 4 different pirate-themed locations
- Fast-paced platforming gameplay
- Unlockable weapons
- Tons of collectables and side quests
- Beautiful artwork
- Giant bosses and mini games
- A funny and emotional story about love and determination

title: BoostHead
description:
게임 정보
Looking for a fun and exciting party game to play with your friends? Look no further than BoostHead! This fast-paced brawler game is all about challenging your friends to see who's the best, with no story to get in the way of the action.

In BoostHead, up to four players can battle it out in a variety of challenging arenas, using a range of special moves and power-ups to gain the upper hand. Whether you're knocking your opponents off the edge of the screen or smashing them with a power-up, there's always something new and exciting happening in BoostHead.

With its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, BoostHead is the perfect party game for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned brawler or a newbie just looking to have some fun, BoostHead has something for everyone.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your controllers and get ready to brawl with BoostHead! With its non-stop action and endless variety, this ultimate party game is sure to keep you and your friends entertained for hours on end.

title: The Kantist
description:
게임 정보
Chaos in the Lab:
A mysterious accident helps you escape your cage in the laboratory.
You flee into the vents hoping to find some safety and freedom.

On your way you meet several other test subjects, slimes, modified rats and other creatures, some are nice, some rather not. But that's not the only dangers waiting for you in the vents of the laboratory. Thankfully, you yourself were designed in the lab to be a spy in enemy facilities, that should help.
As a spy, you have many different Abilities:
Dash and grapple through the vents and try not to hit any saws, trust me, it's better that way...


Things are getting a bit too fast for you? Well, good they built a Time-Slowing ability into you, let's hope it works
There are a total of 3 Zones and hundreds of different paths to take!

title: Guest Uncovered
description:
게임 정보

Steiner Mansion에서 파티 초대를 받았습니다! 하지만 뭔가 이상한 일이 벌어집니다. 도착한 지 얼마 후에 호스트의 시신이 계단 아래에서 발견됩니다. 퍼즐이 해결되고 범인이 드러날 때까지 집은 잠겨 있습니다. 추리 능력을 시험하는 클래식한 살인 미스터리에 참여하세요.



게임 시작 시, 4-12명의 플레이어가 게스트, 살인자 또는 중립 플레이어로 지원됩니다. 게스트로서 임무는 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾는 것입니다. 살인자로서 임무는 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서서 게임을 이기는 것인데, 적발되지 않아야 합니다이를 위해서는 다른 플레이어들을 속이고 기만하여 그들을 소수로 만들면서 하나씩 제거해야 합니다. 중립 플레이어로서 임무는 살인자로부터 죽지 않고 미팅 중에 추방되지 않으면서 자신의 목표를 달성하는 것입니다. 가끔 특별한 게스트 또는 특별한 살인자로 스폰될 기회가 있을 것입니다. 이러한 역할은 팀이 게임에서 이기도록 도울 특별한 능력을 가질 것입니다.
게스트들은 게임에서 승리하려면 지도를 탈출할 수 있는 출구를 여는 데 필요한 일련의 작업을 수행해야 합니다. 또한 시체의 위치를 찾아내고, 살인에 사용된 살인 도구를 발견하고, 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾아 수수께끼를 풀어야 합니다.


살인자들은 다음 희생자를 결정하면서 가짜 작업을 수행할 것입니다. 게스트들에게 보이지 않게 살인 도구를 획득하세요. 희생자를 선택하세요. 은밀하고 살인 모드로 전환하세요. 게스트들과 중립 플레이어를 죽이세요. 적발되지 않고 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서면 게임에서 승리하세요.
중립 플레이어들에게도 가짜 작업이 주어지며 게임에서 승리하기 위해 수행해야 할 목표가 있을 것입니다.

의사가 되어 게스트를 구하거나 혹은 탐정과 함께 숨겨진 단서를 찾아보세요. 특별한 역할을 가진 플레이어들은 게임에서 승리하는 데 도움이 되는 능력을 가질 수 있습니다.







시체를 발견하거나 살인자가 누군지 알게 되면, 회의를 소집하세요. 회의 동안 남은 플레이어들은 가능한 범인에 대해 토론합니다. 상대 플레이어 중 한 명을 투표하여 추방하거나 안전하게 투표를 건너뛰는 선택은 몫입니다.
게스트들과 중립 플레이어들은 지도 주변의 아이템 상자에 접근하여 살인자에게 대항할 방법을 제공받을 것입니다.

title: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara
description:
게임 정보
It all starts with Captain Disaster answering a distress call from a mysterious ship... but it ends up with a planet desperate to rekindle its geothermal energy source, and the long-lasting legacy of an intergalactic empire long consigned to the history books. The planet houses a secret that none of its inhabitants are aware of...

Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara features a contextual one-click interface, a host of colourful characters, devious puzzles, detailed cartoon style graphics, full voicing and an original soundtrack. You play as the adventurous but not altogether bright eponymous Captain, aided (sometimes) by your ship's computer, Zero-Bit, as you help a race of aliens whose complex history is largely unknown, even to themselves.



This game is a collaboration between award-winning developers Dave Seaman (multiple AGS Awards for Captain Disaster in: Death Has A Million Stomping Boots & other games) and Lorenzo Boni (winner of the $106 Adventure Game Challenge for Where Did the Humans Go? and an AGS Award). These two amiable lunatics have been point & click adventure game fans for many years and they have collaborated previously on small games and even a children's book, but nothing approaching the scale and scope of this new Captain Disaster game!

(Playing the two previous Captain Disaster games is not necessary for this one, although there will be some references to events in the earlier games, and even a returning character from Stomping Boots...)

The soundtrack is being composed by , a recent finalist in the , whose previous work includes the OST for .

Making this game together has been a real joy and we hope that comes across in the game, and we sincerely hope you have as much fun playing it as we are having making it. , without revealing much in terms of the game's overall theme. If you find the demo a little bit too easy, don't worry - we deliberately made it reasonably simple, bigger challenges await in the full game.



It's absolutely designed to be enjoyed by all ages! The storyline contains complex themes and some of the puzzles will definitely challenge all but the most hardened point-and-clickers (I'm talking about people who completed games like Monkey Island 2, The Dig and Lucy's Dreaming without ever resorting to hints!!), but at the same time it will always contain humour and animation to delight younger players. Naturally some references in the game will require a certain knowledge of adventure games, sci-fi shows and movies, etc, but these are not essential to playing the game or solving the puzzles, just an added extra.



Have you managed to scroll all the way down to the bottom of this description? Congratulation! You must be tired...
autokwd: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara

title: Gemion Function
description:
게임 정보
Gemion Function is a fast-paced fighting game that combines a hectic 4-player battle system along with the classic motion input control system of traditional 2D fighting games.
4 characters each with their own special moves, combos, and character-specific "unique movement" actions that can be done on the floor or in the air. More characters to be added over time
6 stages using 2.5D graphics with 3D models for characters and projectiles on a 2D fighting plane, powered by Unreal Engine. More stages will also be added over time
Team battle system supporting up to 4 players (1v1, 1v2, or 2v2)
Smooth online play with rollback netcode via integration with the "GGPO rollback network SDK"
Online lobby functionality with Steam API supporting actions such as:
Creating public and private lobbies
Sending and accepting invites from Steam chat
Searching for public lobbies
Resource management with a shared team super meter for universal actions such as EX Special Moves (aka enhanced moves) and Burst (aka combo breakers)
Classic control scheme with inputs for special moves for quarter-circles, half-circles, dragon punch, and more

title: DEVIL'S LIMINAL
description:
게임 정보
A yuri horror visual novel inspired by Azores folklore.
Margo Silva has done everything she can to leave behind the trailer park in Arizona where she grew up. Now all she has to do is focus on her summer job until she can leave for college. Her illusion of a quiet summer is shattered when a hungry ghost enters her dreams.
Two mysterious girls show up in town, claiming they can help her.
Margo must contend with a demon's claim on her soul, and how to stop ghosts from this life and the past that want to take her future.

title: Rogue Tank
description:
게임 정보

Rogue Tank is a chaotic 3D tank shooter with rogue-lite elements. Enter the arena with your trusty tank. It’s time to wreak havoc!
COMBINE DEADLY UPGRADES
Upgrade your tank as you defeat your enemies. Pick upgrades that fit your style of combat. However, choose carefully, as combining the right set of upgrades will turn your tank into an absolute force of destruction.

Bombard enemies with your turret, crash them into deadly arena traps, zap them with lightning, or burn them to a crisp. Destroy your enemies with a diverse set of tools as you dodge incoming attacks.

Unlock new weapons, upgrades, and arenas as you battle. Permanently upgrade your tank to become even stronger!

title: Zoolovelogy
description:
게임 정보
Pair up all animals with one of their own type to beat each puzzle level
Explore how different animal types, objects, and tiles interact with one another and
Utilize their unique traits to find the optimal solution and earn all 3 stars!
Make and share your own puzzles using Zoolovelogy's handy in-game editor

Features:
Easy to grasp but deep gameplay with many different interactions
Hundreds of levels (100+ on release)
Lots of different animal types, each with their own unique attributes (with more to come!)
Various tiles and objects that differentiate the gameplay
Puzzle editor so that players can create their own custom levels & share them with others

title: Folk Emerging
description:
게임 정보
Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky autobattler combat. Discover fire, domestication, politics—and survive to tell the tale.
Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.

title: Portal Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Portal Guardians는 당신을 지루하게 만들지 않을 것입니다!
혼자 또는 친구와 싸우십시오. 다양한 무기와 함정을 사용하여 적의 파도를 막으세요! 포털이 전 세계에 열렸습니다. 곧 닫힙니다!

무기고에 있는 무기의 모든 힘을 사용하고 다양한 장소(벽, 바닥 및 천장)에 다양한 함정을 설치하여 스토리 시나리오를 진행하세요. 무기고를 개선하고 개선 수준마다 무기의 강도가 증가하고 함정의 힘이 증가합니다. 포털이 닫히는 동안 포털을 보호하여 세계 질서를 회복하고 괴물이 거기에 가지 못하게 하십시오!
주요 기능

스토리 캠페인 - 적의 무리와 싸우고 이러한 공격의 원인이 되는 신비한 힘을 발견하십시오.
협동 플레이 - 두 명의 용감한 영웅을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다..
치명적인 무기 - 마법, 활, 검 등 고유한 특성을 가진 9가지 유형의 무기
죽음의 함정 - 벽, 바닥, 천장에 설치할 수 있는 다양한 함정입니다. 이 함정은 적 무리를 제거하는 데 도움이 되므로 업그레이드하는 것을 잊지 마세요!
Dangerous Enemies - 고유한 특징과 특징을 지닌 30가지 이상의 상대 유형! 무기와 함정을 현명하게 선택하세요!
개선 사항 - 캠페인을 진행하면서 무기와 함정을 업그레이드하세요.
광범위한 재생성 - 난이도 선택은 몇 번이고 다시 돌아오고 싶은 욕구를 일깨울 것입니다!

title: The Golden Light Guardian
description:
게임 정보
Sure, here's the translation to Korean:
광활한 오픈 월드 맵을 탐험하세요!!!
다양한 생물 군계를 발견하고, 독특한 자원, 숨겨진 비밀, 위험한 적들을 찾아보세요. 모든 코너에는 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다!

생존하세요!
재료를 모으고, 음식을 사냥하며, 건강과 스태미나를 관리하여 적대적인 환경에서 살아남으세요.

섬을 탐험하고 생존을 위해 사냥하세요. 당신의 기술을 사용하여 몬스터를 추적하고 처치하며, 자원을 모으고 도구를 제작하고 음식을 요리하여 생존하세요.

섬을 돌아다니는 몬스터들을 조심하세요.

끊임없이 몰려오는 해골 공격자들을 견디기 위해 방어를 전략적으로 구축하고 강화하세요.

title: Body Count
description:
게임 정보
Body Count lets you step into the worn shoes of a dedicated cop whose world is shattered by a personal tragedy. As the line between right and wrong blurs, you'll grapple with the moral cost of justice in the face of unspeakable loss. Dive into a gripping experience where personal consequences are no longer calculated and a once venerable cop decends into the path of vengeance.


Body Count is a bullet hell shooter that challenges you to explore the gritty side of morality as you navigate a city teetering on the edge of chaos.

title: Little Eternal Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
The “heart of the world,” Chronium, has shattered.
In a world falling apart, children without swords fight back by manipulating time.
Take flight as a mysterious bird...
■ Strategic Battles Using the Power of Clocks
Children unable to wield swords are given a single weapon: the clock.
Equip skills at 0, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock to fend off enemies with clever tactics.
But beware—some enemies also control time. Disrupting their clockwork may be the key to victory.
■ Soar Through the Maps as a Bird
Transform into a mysterious bird and explore the world like a point-and-click adventure.
You’ll uncover traps and hidden items—some of which might even change the fate of the characters.
■ Eight Unique Main Characters
Eight playable characters rise to face the crisis.
Is – The strong-willed, energetic girl who leads the orphans.
Liv – A restless, timid boy who loves reading, but occasionally shows surprising insight.
Time Cat – A talking cat who appears before Is and her friends. Seems to know something about the fall of Chronium.
Ameria – A young researcher and the only specialist on Chronium. She carries deep emotions for the world’s fate.
Kabal – Leader of the squad that hunts “bad ghosts” who attack humans and animals. Calm, skilled, and often works solo.
Narcier – The elite mage of the squad. Though cold and distant, she has a soft spot for children.
Halbarm – A heavy warrior on the front lines. Boisterous and reliable, but avoids anything too strange.
Else – A rookie fighter who idolizes heroes and has a special admiration for Ameria. Unstable at times, but undeniably capable.
■ Go Back in Time and Change Fate
Your actions unlock new scenes.
Even the smallest trigger, the tiniest event, can drastically alter what follows.
Can you find a way through this crumbling world?
■ Mischief Time!
Kids love to cause trouble—even if the world is ending!
Doodle on someone’s back, startle adults with firecrackers...
It might ruin a serious moment, or it might be just the thing to unlock something new.
company: Midori Games / みどりげーむず

title: Leaf Blowing Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.
BLOW THE STRESS AWAY
Whether you're a laid-back or meticulous player, this game is for everyone. Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere, as you clean up rooftops, alleys, and open fields. Sit back, relax, and watch the wind sweep your stress away.
DON'T BE-LEAF IT UNTIL YOU TRY IT
While you put off doing your actual yard work, marvel at the intricate details of nature. Watch in awe as thousands of individually simulated leaves blow away with the click of a button.
LEAF IT UP TO YOU
Whether you want to take it slow and gather little groups at a time or create a huge pile to jump into, the world is your canvas. Experience the world your way as you clean up the world one leaf at a time.

title: Low and Furious
description:
게임 정보
Low And Furious (LAF) is a driving game that allows you to customize your dream car with modifications such as lowering, tinting windows, upgrading the sound system, changing the wheels, and much more!
In addition to car customization, you can also take part in street races to earn reputation and complete missions to gather money, enabling you to enhance your current car or acquire new vehicles and garages. The setting is inspired by Brazil, with the game featuring favelas and other iconic locations that create an engaging and immersive experience.
LAF is a tribute to classic games, featuring modernized graphics and gameplay, designed to captivate both racing enthusiasts and those passionate about customizing cars.

title: Rich Dad Simulator
description:
게임 정보




나만의 상점을 운영하는 흥미진진한 세계에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 이 게임에서 여러분은 작은 가게를 대형 마트 체인을 갖춘 거대한 소매 제국으로 성장시키는 도전에 나서게 됩니다.

작은 가게에서 시작할 때 가장 먼저 해야 할 일은 고객이 계속 찾아올 수 있도록 진열대에 재고를 가득 채우는 것입니다. 재고를 과잉 보유하거나 자원을 낭비하지 않고 수요를 따라잡을 수 있는 적정량의 재고를 구매해야 하므로 재정을 신중하게 관리해야 합니다.



비즈니스가 성장함에 따라 스토어를 확장하고 고객에게 특별한 쇼핑 경험을 제공할 수 있습니다. 통로 레이아웃부터 벽면 색상까지 매장의 모양과 느낌을 완전히 제어할 수 있습니다. 성장하는 비즈니스를 관리하는 데 도움을 줄 직원을 고용하여 브랜드 확장이라는 더 큰 그림에 집중할 수 있습니다.

하지만 스토어 관리는 재미의 절반에 불과합니다. 주변 도시를 탐험하는 재미도 누릴 수 있습니다. 지역 행사에 참석하거나 다음 대형 마트를 위한 새로운 장소를 물색하는 등 항상 새로운 것을 발견할 수 있습니다. 새로운 공급업체나 희귀한 품목을 우연히 발견하여 매장에 입고할 수도 있습니다.



물론 성공적인 비즈니스 운영의 핵심은 고용하는 직원에 달려 있습니다. 비즈니스가 성장함에 따라 매장을 효율적으로 운영할 수 있는 적합한 직원을 찾아야 합니다. 계산원부터 재고 관리자에 이르기까지 각 팀원은 비즈니스를 원활하게 운영하는 데 중요한 역할을 합니다. 직원들의 일정, 급여, 교육을 관리하여 동기를 부여하고 생산성을 유지할 수 있도록 해야 합니다.

전반적으로 이 게임은 성공적인 소매 제국을 건설하는 스릴에 관한 게임입니다. 재고부터 직원, 매장 디자인에 이르기까지 관리해야 할 다양한 측면이 있으므로 관리 기술을 발휘하고 고객이 좋아할 브랜드를 만들 수 있는 무한한 기회가 있습니다. 더 이상 망설이고 계십니까? 지금 바로 리테일 제국을 건설하세요!

title: Dinosaurs United
description:
게임 정보
Dinosaurs United is an epic real-time strategy game that challenges you to unite the dinosaurs and save the world from an oncoming comet. As you gather resources, conquer lands, and defeat giant boss enemies, you'll develop advanced technologies and weapons needed to stop the comet and prevent the extinction of all life.

In the age of dinosaurs, one visionary Dino sees a vision of the world being hit by a comet. He unites the dinosaurs around the world to work together and develop a super weapon to destroy the oncoming comet. Along the way, you'll encounter challenges and enemies that will test your strategic skills to the limit.

With a top-down view and heart-pumping gameplay, Dinosaurs United challenges you to race against time to gather resources, unite more dinosaurs, and face the final, epic challenge. Will you rise to the occasion and lead the dinosaurs to victory?

Features include challenging missions, diverse dinosaur units, customizable technologies and weapons, and stunning visuals that bring the prehistoric world to life. With a deep and immersive storyline, Dinosaurs United will keep you on the edge of your seat as you fight to save the world. Are you ready to take on the challenge? Play now and find out!

title: Just Life: A New Farmer's Story
description:
게임 정보
Just Life" is an immersive role-playing and life simulation game that revolves around storytelling and human connections. Step into the shoes of a young man fresh out of high school, whose path hasn't been easy due to financial constraints preventing him from attending college and a lack of work experience hindering his job prospects. However, a twist of fate presents an opportunity when he inherits an agricultural land. Embark on a journey to build success from scratch, starting with nothing. Your ultimate goal is to overcome challenges, forge meaningful relationships, and create a prosperous life for yourself in this captivating virtual world.











Just Life features an expansive open world spanning 2 km² for you to explore. Immerse yourself in a small city bustling with a variety of shops, including clothing stores, accessories, tools, restaurants, cafes, bars, a museum, a library, parks, a school, banks, a shopping center, and countless other discoveries awaiting you. Venture further to discover a picturesque lake, majestic mountains, sprawling agricultural and industrial areas, abandoned mines, and even a prison. With so much to explore and endless possibilities, each day in Just Life will bring a unique experience.



The story unfolds in a captivating fictional city nestled in the southern hemisphere, embraced by majestic mountains and enriched by a tapestry of diverse cultures. The cityscape boasts a harmonious blend of architectural styles, mirroring its vibrant population. Isolated from the hustle and bustle of major urban centers, the quest for employment has become increasingly challenging, prompting many residents to seek greener pastures in bustling metropolises in pursuit of a better future. As the city ages gracefully, recent endeavors have been initiated to rejuvenate its spirit, such as the ongoing construction of a university and the influx of foreign companies, which brings both promises and potential pitfalls.



Just Life tells the story of an 18-year-old boy who has just graduated from high school. He lives alone with his mother and, due to economic reasons, cannot attend university despite being an excellent student. He decides to look for a job and help with the expenses at home, but luck is not on his side and after a month, he has not been able to find anything, as it is not easy to find employment without experience in his country.

One day, he receives a mysterious letter from a lawyer requesting that he come to her office. Somewhat hesitant and surprised by the request, he decides to attend. She informs him that his uncle, his father's brother, left him an agricultural land on the outskirts of the city as an inheritance. This could be good news for anyone, but not for him. His uncle's death affects him, and he sincerely wished he could have known him. The inheritance left him at a crossroads: what should he do with the land? He could sell it and attend university, but on the other hand, he felt that it was his uncle's last legacy and that it was not right to do so.

That night, after the appointment with the lawyer and after talking to his mother and deeply reflecting on it, he comes to the conclusion that he will not sell the inherited land. But what would he do? He was an inexperienced young man, without knowledge of agriculture and without money. Work the land? It was a crazy idea, but he still wanted to try. The world had not given him a job opportunity, so he decided that he would create his own. A huge challenge for one person, but he would not do it alone on this tough journey. He would meet new friends, form bonds, and even find love. The road to success will not be easy, with new challenges every day, but he has what it takes to succeed. The important thing is to never give up.
autokwd: Just Life: A New Farmer's Story
