description:
게임 정보
A refreshing twist on an old classic, mixing arcade gameplay with the roguelike genre.
Test your skill, break bricks, make combos, turns balls aflame and electrify bosses in this frenetic experience!

Features
- Procedurally generated maps
- Many ball modifiers with over 15 different combinations
- Unique Bosses
- A wide range of Upgrades with many synergies

title: Legend of Hidden Flows
description:
게임 정보
《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.

In this game, there is a completely open world, and every restart is a brand new map. Since you were born, you have to start simulating a new life.

You will grow from an unknown person. On the way to growth, you will encounter many strange people, and you can socialize with them or fight decisively.

You can collect the world's spiritual herbs and refine miraculous elixirs and divine medicines; You can also collect legendary minerals, cast epic equipment, and become a legend.

There are many forces in this world, and various conflicts often arise between them. You can join them to serve the faction, or you can be arrogant without any sect.

You can experience a different life in this world.

title: April '86
description:
게임 정보
구성:
Sergei는 어린 시절을 Pripyat시에서 보냈습니다. 그는 한때 아버지와 여동생 Varya와 함께 그곳에서 살았습니다. 1986년, 체르노빌 원자력 발전소 사고 직전, 도시에서 아이들이 사라지기 시작했습니다. 어느 날 Varya도 사라졌습니다. 자원봉사자들로 구성된 경찰과 수색팀도 흔적을 찾지 못했다.
1986년 4월 26일 - 체르노빌 원자력 발전소에서 사고가 발생했으며 실종 아동 문제에 아무도 관여하지 않았습니다. 세르게이의 아버지는 원자력 발전소 직원이었으며 방사선병으로 사망했습니다. 세르게이는 도시에서 대피하여 벨로루시에 있는 조부모와 함께 살았습니다. 10년 후, 세르게이는 죽은 도시를 배경으로 한 여동생의 사진이 담긴 이상한 봉투를 받습니다. 어떻게 이럴 수있어? 그녀는 정말 살아 있나요? 이러한 질문에 답하기 위해 우리의 영웅은 버려진 도시 프리피야트로 돌아가 1986년에 실종된 아이들에게 일어났던 끔찍한 사건을 하나씩 재구성해야 합니다.

title: SCHROTT
description:
게임 정보
🦝SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game!🦝
SCHROTT is all about absurd vehicles, insane stunts, and endless opportunities to customize and upgrade your ride. And let's not forget speed - SCHROTT is all about fast-paced, heart-pumping action.
⚙️Features🔩
Fast-paced and arcade-like driving controls that are easy to pick up and play
Roguelite gameplay with a focus on driving absurd vehicles
Customize and upgrade your vehicle to make it even more absurd and powerful
Get loot... a lot of loot

title: Panchin is Frustrated
description:
게임 정보
This is an Idle game, meant for playing in the background while doing other things. For the optimal experience, put the game on a second monitor while you work or browse. Made for PIGSquad Idle Jam 2023, this new version adds many new dreams and activities for Panchin.

You are the all-seeing observer of a pair of roommates, Panchin and Julem. Panchin is an artist struggling with creative block, and thus spends most of their time pacing around the room, or staying distracted.

Click to collect Panchin's Tears of Frustration. The amount of Tears collected during the day affects Panchin's dreams at night.

Connect with Twitch to suggest things for Panchin to do during the day.

Featuring:
15+ Explorable Dreams
Full original synth soundtrack
A cast of quirky, clay-like characters
A hostile goblin

title: JumpCat
description:
게임 정보
Trapped in limbo. Toyed with for eternity. Escape, or lose your last chance at life.
In JumpCat, you find yourself imprisoned in a haunting limbo ruled by Sadie—a sinister girl with a twisted love for games. She’s trapped you in her dark playground, alongside the eerie residents she’s crafted to entertain her forever. Your only hope? Climb, jump, and outsmart her to reclaim your life. Fail, and you’ll remain her plaything for eternity.
Explore Sadie’s unsettling world, where every shadow holds a secret and every leap brings you closer—or pulls you deeper into despair. Meet her peculiar creations, unravel the truth behind their tragic existence, and search for hidden collectibles that might just hold the key to your freedom.

Key Features
Escape Sadie’s Eternal Trap: Outsmart a sinister child determined to keep you in her nightmarish limbo forever.
Unravel Dark Secrets: Meet haunting residents, uncover their origins, and piece together the story of Sadie’s twisted world.
Climb for Your Life: Navigate challenging vertical levels filled with traps, puzzles, and eerie surprises.
Discover and Collect: Search for hidden artifacts that reveal more about the world—and strengthen your chances of escape.
Solo or (lan) Multiplayer Escape: Face the terror alone, or team up with friends in a frantic race to freedom.
Reclaim your life before it’s too late! Play JumpCat—and jump for your salvation.

title: Arcane Tower Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Arcane Tower Survivors is a horde survival game where you face relentless waves of enemies in intense 20-minute sessions, with over 100 unique skills to help you fend off the onslaught.

Make different builds that are unique each game.

Rebuild abandoned wizard tower to get more abilities, characters and weapons.

title: The Truth
description:
게임 정보
"The Truth" is a psychological horror game where you play as a police officer who is investigating a suspected criminal. You need to solve different puzzles to solve the case. Find out what happened to the family and the suspected criminal. As you delve deeper into the investigation, you begin to realize that things are not as they seem. The truth is elusive, and the more you uncover, the more terrifying the situation becomes. As you uncover the dark secrets of the family and the suspected criminal, you will be forced to confront your own fears and anxieties.
Singleplayer
The Truth features a singleplayer horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5
Story
Discover secrets and find the truth about the case you are investigating.
Find out what happened and don't die.
Puzzles
The Truth features several puzzles and challenges to solve.
Highly detailed environments
The games features more than one simple house. It features several houses, a huge forest and more.
Checkpoint and save system
You don't need to start over when you close the game. There are many checkpoints that automatically save the game. There are also many save-devices that you can find during your journey.

title: Cutie Crowd Control
description:
게임 정보

HERD ANYTHING - you are a hero dog that can herd anything
HILARIOUS WAYS TO DIE - worlds full of dangerous and ridiculous traps
SAVE THE CUTIES - a bunch of cute and too-dumb-to-survive animals
UNLOCK NEW CHARACTERS to play as (Red Panda anyone?)
STREAMER MODE available for all levels - have fun with your audience!
MULTIPLAYER MODES to challenge or co-op with your frens!




Sheep (duh!)
Tractors

title: Jewel of Clementia
description:
게임 정보
One day you meet a woman who is collecting artifacts. On the artifacts there are many unfamiliar characters written. She says that to decipher the characters, she needs mana. According to her research, the characters are written in a foreign language called Japanese and if you decipher the characters on the artifacts, they will lead you to the Jewel of Clementia. Since you know how to collect mana, you get interested and decide to collect artifacts and decipher the characters. Now your journey will begin.
Jewel of Clementia is a puzzle solving visual novel game where players actually learn the Japanese language. Players collect artifacts and manas and decipher the characters on the artifacts. The characters are written in Japanese, and in the process of deciphering, players will naturally learn the Japanese language. Jewel of Clementia is not a language learning course, but immersive gaming experiences. Instead of someone teaching you Japanese, you will discover how the language works on your own. The game aims to offer a new innovative way of learning a language. The game focuses on puzzle solving so the game is enjoyable even if you are not interested in learning Japanese.
Jewel of Clementia is a visual novel game, but the story progress is non linear. For example, you can practice what you learned whenever you want and each time you successfully complete a practice, you will gain manas. There are many interesting quests in the game and as you take on the quests, you will learn about the world, the Jewel of Clementia, and of course the Japanese language. This game is an ambitious project which incorporates an interesting story and gameplay into language learning. Whether you are interested in learning Japaese or not, the game will surely offer you excellent gaming experiences.

title: Emblems: Sunless Vow
description:
게임 정보
Help three unlikely friends destroy the void—before they destroy each other!
New allies Weapon, Spirit, and Magic have some big tasks ahead of them. Recover their stolen memories, defeat an ancient demon or two, and escape from the dreaded void between worlds... Assuming they can stop arguing first, that is.

title: Interconnected Stories
description:
게임 정보

In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...




- Place the cards on the board to help our friendly characters in their mission
- Unlock dozens of action cards, all of them customized for the different characters
- Enjoy a wide variety of chapters, which can be solved in different ways
- Take advantage of free mode to create your own stories without the restrictions of the main mode




A great variety of characters will appear in the story, some with more relevance than others, but all with an distinctive essence:
- Carapán: a young 216-year-old dragon who, contrary to the traditions of his family, wants to dedicate himself to what is his true passion in life: the bakery.
- The Knight of the Iguana: a small town boy who has launched himself in search of adventure along with his secret weapon, which makes him immortal... at least as far as he has proven.
- Lúa: from a noble family, this astrologer has become a royal advisor fighting against imposed stereotypes, although she has an important private matter that keeps her busy...
- And more to discover! A princess, a ghost minstrel, an evil monster...

title: DEATHGRIP
description:
게임 정보
DEATHGRIP invites the player to the jump in the pilot's seat of some of the fastest and most lethal hovercrafts ever seen and dominate the tracks they compete on. Navigate natural environments through split paths, twists, turns, jumps, shortcuts, and narrow corridors in an intense race to the finish.

DEATHGRIP introduces a depth to its racing controls that challenges the player to explore the skill ceiling. From afterburner allowed at any time to pitching, rolling, drifting, repairing, managing heat, and firing weapons, one should take pride in their ability to master a racer.

It is an experience meant to be visceral, brutal, exciting, and intense, centered on offering players instant enjoyment without gimmicks and an extended sense of achievement for those competitive and dedicated enough to get the most out of the game.


The base release will include (at a minimum) the following features:

8 Unique Racers
All racers share the same functionality, but each has it's own strengths and weaknesses to suit different playstyles.

10 Distinct Tracks
Race across 10 environments on 10 tracks over terrain filled with obstacles, jumps, drops, shortcuts, multiple paths, and other challenges.

Combat Racing
Race against AI with offensive and defensive armaments. Outfit your racer with cannons, shotguns, missiles, countermeasures, and more. Witness the carnage as the track turns into a battlefield.

Time Trials and leaderboards
Best times across the game are saved as ghosts. Compete against your own times, challenge the ghosts of your friends or compete those of the top ranking players on the leaderboards.


Earn credits from winning and spend them on visual and performance upgrades to suit your playstyle. Choose from multiple parts to spec out your racer for speed,


Prove yourself by winning trophies and claiming tops ranks.

title: Armageddon Sky's Invasion
description:
게임 정보
Help the Alarician Empire protect its world from the invaders of Sephtisian Empire in this SHMUP. The action doesn't let up as you destroy countless waves of the enemy invaders over fifteen levels of non-stop action.

title: Rework
description:
게임 정보
Explore an open world forest and build fantastic contraptions. Build your home, protect it from enemies using your ingenuity. Adventure alone, cooperate with up to 6 friends online or 4 in local split-screen multiplayer.

title: Lokko
description:
게임 정보

LOKKO 는 즐거움과 창의성이 만나는 독창적인 3D 플랫폼 게임입니다. PS5®, PC, iOS에서 실시간으로 원활하게 도전적인 레벨을 만들고 공유하세요. 자신만의 아바타를 만들고, 적과 보스를 디자인하세요. DualSense™의 강력한 기능을 세 가지 플랫폼에서 모두 활용하세요. 플레이어들은 창작물을 교환하고 서로 경쟁할 수 있습니다. 가장 재미있고 독창적인 레벨을 만들어 보세요.
LOKKO 는 India Hero Project 2기 멤버입니다.


레벨 에디터
플랫폼 게임과 레이싱 게임을 위한 내장형 레벨 에디터를 통해 플레이어는 직접 레벨을 제작하고 배포할 수 있습니다. 타이머, 가속기, 스위치를 연결하고 NPC와 보스를 배치하여 친구들과 함께 즐길 수 있는 재미있는 레벨을 만드세요. 게임 컨트롤러 및 키보드/마우스를 지원하는 직관적인 조작 방식을 제공합니다.

title: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
description:
게임 정보
Earth in 2240 had survived war, ecological threats, alien invasions and more, but after all countries exhausted their nuclear stockpiles during the last war, the world was sent back into the Dark Ages. The United States was broken into kingdoms and the lands outside of their reach were populated with mutated orcs, evil mages and entire rogue armies.



Pedro and Sofia, siblings who were questing through the open lands, are called into service to a kingdom in need, where a strange new cult has been converting the local populace and building their own radiated army. Soon, they uncover a mystery across America that must be stopped before Earth is led to its final, nuclear annihilation.

Features:
Over 60 unique skills and more than 500 different types of weapons and equipment to find or build
Fully immersive 3D environments, including a massive, open-world with dungeons, towns and mysterious locations
A unique crafting system to build and upgrade a variety of weapons, armor and more
Real-time, action-RPG combat and a story-rich quest that takes place across America
Three different characters with original stories to play as and build with unique job classes
Hours and hours of quests and surprising adventures, plus fully playable on Steam Deck

title: Changa
description:
게임 정보
Warning:Changa game play and videos contain moving patterns and changing colors which may trigger seizures in people affected by photosensitive epilepsy.


Set and Setting


A wandering consciousness that decides to forge her own path. Equipped with her extreme mobility, a melee attack, and a ranged dagger, Jade embarks on a psychedelic 3D bullet hell arcade odyssey as she tries to sever the web of suffering and escape the cycle of deaths and rebirths. Bounce, dodge, fly, and fight the illusions of material and immaterial reality in this new kind of bullet hell.


Features
















Changa is hitting Early Access with one complete difficulty of 10 maps, with a second difficulty coming soon after release. A single playthrough will test your resolve and your creativity in movement, reactions, and planning on the fly. Expect somewhere in the 2-8 hour range for a first playthrough on the base difficulty.

title: DoBad Inc
description:
게임 정보
In this open world, stealth game you play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live, but acquiring this won't be easy, sneak through warehouses, murder Dogooders, steal from civilians, shoplift and more, all just for the sake of your psychotic individuality.
Features:
Traverse the city and interact with civilians
Take jobs from your bosses and commit them out in the world
Use your DoBad Promotional Credits to climb higher on this hellish corporate ladder
Decorate and expand your very own hideout
WARNING ALL ACTS OF MURDER, THEIVERY, WAR CRIME, AND DEVIOUS BEHAVIORS ARE PURELY ENTERTAINMENT!

title: Casa De Diamantes
description:
게임 정보
Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower,
on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous
casino, the Casa De Diamantes.
Casa De Diamantes is a 2D movement shooter with aggressive enemy
encounters and tight level design. Fight your way through multiple enemy
types, collect chips then spend and gamble them away at the casino.
Play blackjack, customize your appearance or decorate your hotel room
at the Casa De Diamantes.
FEATURES
Momentum Based Movement

title: Halberd Black
description:
게임 정보
Halberd Black is an action-adventure JRPG set thousands of years into the future of our galaxy, where you play as a Stark, a genetically engineered human being caught in a struggle to survive and protect those he holds most dear from those who'd wish him harm. Explore the rich story of the Halberd Black universe and explore the beautiful landscapes, and dense city streets and enjoy combat reminiscent of the JRPGs of old ( With a Modern Twist ). Fight a wide variety of enemies using a dynamic turn-based combat system. Explore new environments as you seek strength to fight back against the powerful megacorporation that is after you and your friends. Only through grit and determination will you be able to fight against the threats that are coming your way. The only question is, do you have what it takes?

title: RECURSOR
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the RECURSOR robot and traverse through a randomly generated labyrinth of trials. Enhance your build by installing a wide variety of upgrades. How far can you go?

RECURSOR's mechanics that take inspiration from the platform fighter genre for both movement and combat. This combined with randomized levels and upgrades of the rogue-lite genre multiplies the depth and replayability.



RECURSOR has an extensive moveset allowing you complete freedom of movement! For the speedrunners and labbers, RECURSOR comes with a debug mode to move frame by frame, view your current state, see hitboxes and more!

RECURSOR's artstyle takes the classic pixel art charm and makes use of modern graphics technology to give it a fresh look. Most evidently is the lighting system that casts soft shadows and uses normal maps to create the illusion of 3d.

Inspired by the scifi films and anime of the 80s and 90s, RECURSOR frames the game within a computer terminal / CCTV station that grants the user the ability to monitor and control the RECURSOR robot.

title: RSOD
description:
게임 정보
AS REAL AS IT GETS ON A 686



RSOD is as cyberpunk as legally permissible. Everything glows or has a flat videogamey texture. Objects have sharp black outlines, like an anime. All the maps are honest geometry with 1:1 physics on almost every triangle.



Shoot some zombies, or catgirls, rednecks, or cyborgs. Hitscan, projectiles, ranged and melee. Engage in content. Experience graphics.

Development is ongoing and the release date may be pushed back until the base game has sufficient content.

title: Rusty Seas
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Seas is a retro-style game reminiscent of the 16-bit console era with a splash of 90's computer gaming, drawing inspiration and design philosophy from some of the great classics of that time, as well as plucking a few bits from more modern games to bridge the gap.

Play as Mirig, a diner waitress whose afternoon off is interrupted by a mysterious (and very profitable) offer to collect high-tech junk washing up on the beaches of Northshore. But her venture is fraught with a colorful cast of competitors who also want to lay claim to the salvages. To overcome, Mirig will need to throw her weight around, dunk her adversaries, buy outfits and items, and make friends and allies along the way.

In addition to action-based gameplay, Rusty Seas also features a splash of visual novel style content, through which the player can learn that the lore of Northshore runs a little deeper than its cozy sands.

title: Skip Lake 2
description:
게임 정보
Skip Lake 2 is a minimalist and relaxing puzzle, set in a lake of crystal clear waters and musical rocks.



The sequel of Skip Lake, this game is now going a litlle deeper in the story, and bringing new mechanichs with unique puzzles!

The game captures the international game of skipping stones into the water, transforming it into a puzzle of logic and direction, with harmony of music and sound effects, carefully composed to relax.
Hit the pots trough stunning landscapes
Key Features

Touch the rotating pillars until they are at the right angle for the stone to hit until it reaches the pot on the other side of the lake !!

title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon is a spiritual successor to the classic Ogre Battle series, combining real-time, squad-based tactics gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Move units across the map in real time to capture towns and castles; when enemy units come in contact, a turn-based battle ensues, with the defeated side forced to give up ground.



Organize soldiers with unique appearance, stats and classes into units. Choose from dozens of classes, and customize your unit's formation to maximize each soldier's effectiveness, taking advantage of position-specific abilities, damage types and resistances, and support abilities which can be used to help nearby units when they enter combat.



Explore dozens of unique regions depicted in lush, hand-painted graphics. Destroy your opponents and capture their territories to win. Choose where to stand your ground - fighting from the right terrain can give you the advantage you need, and traversing difficult terrain can build up fatigue that will reduce your units' effectiveness.




When your unit comes in contact with the enemy, a turn-based battle ensues. Battles play out ; characters act in initiative order, and their actions are determined by their class, formation, and enemy positioning. Archers will rain down destruction on enemies from the rear, but if they lose their cover, they're defenseless. Swordsmen will attack from the front row and must hit the enemy's front row first; from the rear, they'll do nothing. Bleddyn the bard will bravely wield his rapier from the front, or play a song to buff the entire squad from the back.

The side that deals the most morale damage - by hitting hard, taking down units, or weakening the enemy commander - is the winner, with the other side losing ground on the map.


Years ago, the scattered kingdoms of the Britons were nearly united by one of history's greatest princes, Llewelyn the Great, in fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Llewelyn was the greatest ruler the land had seen since King Arthur. But when he reached the apex of his power, he died, leaving behind a messy succession crisis. And in the chaos, England invaded, leading to a loss of nearly all Llewelyn had won.

Llewelyn II was named after his famous grandfather. He too is destined for greatness and will someday be known to history. But his path to greatness is uncertain: his father and brothers are imprisoned in London, England occupies half of the territory of Gwynedd, raiders harry the coast, and the ruling prince, Llewelyn's uncle, is viewed by many as a usurper. Will he be known as the prophesied Son of Destiny who ruled over a united Kingdom of the Britons, or as the prince who lost everything when England invaded?
autokwd: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon

title: Space gold rush TD
description:
게임 정보
Space Gold Rush is a unique hybrid of tower-defense and real-time-strategy. Set in the not distant future where space travel has become viable to everyone. In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

title: Eternal Mist
description:
게임 정보
"I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones" - Albert Einstein.



Several generations have passed since the end of the Great War, and even deep old men cannot remember who first used forbidden spells. But once begun, there was no stopping them, and the land was swallowed by the Mist.

On the wreckage of the old world, a new world gradually emerged - divided into isolated islands and states. And only a few brave men dare to travel through the deadly expanse of mist. You are at the beginning of this journey, and where and how it will end depends only on you!



Eternal Mist is a game that involves real-time tactics where you will be in charge of commanding different types of squads including paladins, hunters, and mages. Each squad possesses unique skills that can be improved as you progress in the game.

Elements such as bonfires, cauldrons, and other objects on the battlefield have an impact on the abilities of your warriors. Placing your units near these objects can provide a significant tactical advantage.

The Mist is a source from which hordes of creatures emerge. These formidable beings represent a relentless force that poses a significant threat to all who cross their path. Their agility and speed allow them to swiftly traverse the terrain, making them a daunting challenge to overcome. Only a skilled commander can give confident and well-thought-out orders to inspire their soldiers and guide them towards victory.

title: The Celestial Seeker
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic intergalactic adventure in this space faring Metroidvania! Irata, a skilled bounty hunter and unlikely hero, is tasked with saving the solar system from a menacing federation of hostile species. With your blaster and a thirst for adventure, explore three diverse planets filled with bounties, upgrades, civilizations, hidden secrets, and dangers.
Eons ago, the Eternium core, an advanced chipset with the power to link all intelligent systems, was created in a last-ditch attempt to ward off the first coup of power organized by the Federation. Moments before defeat, the planetary alliance activated the Divine Architect, a sentient artificial intelligence that was designed to control the Eternium core.
The war was won but, in its wake, left a thirst for power. It was no longer just the federation that wanted control. Insiders within the planetary alliance from all corners of the solar system tried their hands at gaining control.
It was then, that the leaders of the 3 planets agreed to give the Eternium core its last instructions, to separate in 6 and have its pieces be spread equally across the planets.
Peace was restored. The legend of the Eternium Core faded to myth. And the Divine Architect laid dormant. Until now.

title: NecroTactics
description:
게임 정보
Build and battle against an army of the undead as you attempt to kill Death itself. Grow your undead army overtime and develop your graveyard with traps and towers to survive as long as possible.
💀 Create Your Own Synergies!
📜 Features
Develop a Huge Army of 100 Total Units!
Place Structures to Bolster Your Army
Cast Fireballs, Lightning Strikes and Poison Bombs
Fight a Giant Boss and Their Army
Earn Achievements
🤝 Community Focused Development

title: Trials of Cascadia
description:
게임 정보


As the son of a farmer, Isaac had always dreamt of one day becoming a Paladin like the Chosen Hero, Zvarus. A man whose bravery was legendary and who stood down in the face of no foe. After a year of training with Orman's father Orlan, a retired Paladin general, Isaac sets off with his sword and holy book alongside his friend to vanquish the forces of Darkness that beset the world.

But not all is as it seems on the surface. Those who presume to speak in the name of justice may abuse their power, while those who commit heinous acts may do so out of perceived necessity. Sometimes, even certain facets of history are conveniently omitted. But the truth is out there waiting to be found, as the friends soon find out. Will they do the right thing, or play it safe? Only time will tell.





-A story-focused RPG. Explore Cascadia in an unfolding narrative to discover the world's true story, that spans multiple continents, and possibly multiple dimensions

-Custom artwork to bring the game alive with a vivid watercolor aesthetic

-Custom sound and meditative, emotional music reminiscent of 90's JRPGs

-A plethora of items and equipment to discover

-Special Artifacts that can empower your entire party

-Optional side quests strewn throughout the world map that may increase your reputation

-Playable with controller, keyboard or mouse





-A charming cast of unique characters, each with their own stories, roles, abilities and skill augments. Mix and match for your favorite group

-Build TP with normal attacks, and then spend them on flashy spells and specials. Gain Pwr with damage or healing to boost your morale

-Delay enemy actions and cancel spells altogether with instant cast skills

-Use elemental debuffs from offensive magic spells to stack weaknesses on your enemy

-Unleash devastating 5 TP ultimate attacks

-Over 50 different enemies for you to encounter, including rare enemies (and even some friendly encounters)











A new recruit to the Paladin order, Isaac is eager to prove himself to his superiors and make his parents proud. What he lacks in experience, he makes up for in talent.
Isaac is able to heal the party and cure various debuffs, but he can also dish out massive damage using his Light-based abilities such as Lumina Blade. He has a higher critical chance than others.




Isaac's best friend from a young age. Although somewhat boisterous and headstrong, Orman has the heart of a hero. He doesn't always like to follow the rules.
Orman is able to protect the party by drawing the enemy's attention and blocking physical attacks with his shield. He excels at interrupting spells and has several defensive utilities up his sleeve.




A mysterious and proud elven girl with pink hair, she is able to wield the power of the elements. Although her motives are unclear, she seems to have peaceful intentions.
Aiya can't take as much abuse as the Paladins, but she has the highest damage potential. When using her magic spells, she can also gain enchantments for her dagger, which can be stacked for exponential damage amounts.




An eccentric man who claims to be an oracle, and hundreds of years old. He claims to guide the party towards their destiny, but his past remains obscured.
Mondrus is a hybrid between a healer and a caster. He can cast nature spells which make the enemy more vulnerable or restore the party and apply shields. While his spells are cheaper to cast, they take a short time to recharge.

title: GOMAN -stuck in the avici hell
description:
게임 정보
GOMAN은 이름 없는 지옥을 배경으로 한 횡스크롤 액션 게임입니다.

어떤 이유로 지옥에 던져진 주인공 가몬이 지옥에서 탈출해 역으로 탈출을 시도합니다.

그는 지옥의 여러 층을 지배하며 탈출을 막으려는 '누시와 그 하인들'과 맞서 싸워야 합니다.

강한 개성을 가진 누시들이 만든 세계에서 탈출을 시도하는 사람은 죽임을 당하고 입구로 되돌아가 끝없는 형벌을 받습니다.

가몬이 가진 유일한 무기는 그가 죽기 전에 얻은 특성인 '무한한 저항 = 깨지지 않는 마음'입니다.

가몬은 수만 번 죽임을 당하고 돌아와도 포기하지 않고 걸음을 멈추지 않으며 누시에게 계속 도전합니다.

적의 강한 일격에 반격하여 격퇴하고, 때로는 죽었다가 돌아오기도 하지만 죽었을 때의 기억을 이용해 적의 공격을 읽고 반격합니다.

title: Unheeded Influences
description:
게임 정보
Plot
You awake in the dark as an elemental soul. You have no memories or strength. Chaos, an indistinct guide, teaches you about intuition and what are energies and how to shape them at will.
You learn about the 12 Natures and the 3 realms where spirits, divines, and living coexist. You start your journey accompanied by an odd and useless Egyptian fennec.
You incarnate, travel through worlds, and influence human life. Soon enough you discover the mark of the biggest realms' threat ever. And it seems you were its first victim, interrupting your old plans...
Stay immersed with our website
As an Elemental soul, you live among our mythologies that coexist
You are a soul and you are imbued with 12 different Natures, such as fire, water, time...
You evolve in the spiritual realms and travel to mystical places.
As a spirit, you'll love taking on the appearance of the living and inspiring dreamwalkers.

title: Cops N' Zombies
description:
게임 정보
Cops N' Zombies is an intense multiplayer horror social-oriented/deduction game. You and your team are to investigate a desolate map while one of your teammates is secretly a Zombie. The zombie player can transform at will and must use this to their advantage to kill all the police. The police can also find weapons and kill who they think are the zombie. How will you figure out who's who and who to trust?
Game Features
Play with your friends or meet new people in different servers!
Explore the map and find different guns to kill your teammates or the zombie!
Zombie can strategize and can act like a player to betray people or transform into a stronger melee zombie!
Earn Money each round and buy different equipment, like this taser!
Proximity Voice chat to scream at your friends.
Game is still under development. Be sure to follow our Social Media for latest updates!
Join the discord for more updates!

title: Chyss
description:
게임 정보
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description:
게임 정보
Train the best, most powerful Lamias!
WORLD
In an impoverished demon world ravaged by the war between man and beast, the Lamia tribe are on the verge of extinction.

Ivy, reincarnated into the demon world as the Lamia tribe's savior, along with princess Hedera aim for the revival of their tribe. Play as Ivy as you multiply and raise Lamias and battle the Harpy tribe to reclaim the Lamia Palace.
DUNGEONS
Battles take place in demon world dungeons with familiar 2D maps. Explore the dungeons again and again and defeat the bosses waiting in their depths.
Classic command-style turn-based battles. The key to good battle strategy is to form your party to take advantage of each Lamia's characteristics, choosing from Lamias skilled at physical attacks to those specializing in magic attacks. Lead your Lamias to victory.
Not only will you find Lamias, but you'll also see Harpies, Fairies, and other familiar monsters complete with up-tempo*** conversations and stories in an enjoyable pixel art demon world.

The Lamia training system is scheduled to be released in Summer 2024, when Japan is scorching hot.

Don't miss the latest Lamia's Bambina ("LamiBam") information!

title: BITGUN Survivors
description:
게임 정보

Immerse yourself in the expansive world of BITGUN Survivors, now featuring an open-world experience filled with exploration, random events, and vampire-survivors inspired gameplay. Navigate through the aftermath of a zombie outbreak, as you adapt to your surroundings and make crucial decisions to ensure your survival. Witness the collapse of civilization, as friends turn against each other and people do whatever it takes to stay alive.



Features:
- Open-world exploration in a dynamic and ever-changing environment
- A vast array of random events and encounters, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same
- Vampire survivor-inspired mechanics, adding a unique twist to the zombie apocalypse genre
- Upgrades and meta progression to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival
- Challenging and addictive gameplay that will test your skills and adaptability
- Quick and fun game which you will need to repeat many times until you will be able survive till the end

Explore the unfolding of a zombie apocalypse and watch the civilization fall. Friends turn against each other, and people will do whatever it takes to survive. You are alone in the middle of a zombie horde and your goal is to survive.



Gameplay:
- Top down game with vampire-survivors-like gameplay
- Huge hordes of zombies
- 1 large map
- Shop for permanent upgrades

This is not an easy game. Enemies in BITGUN: Survivors are relentless and unforgiving. If you make a mistake, you will die. There are no second chances. You must be prepared for a challenge, and you must be willing to learn from your mistakes.

title: Twelfth Life
The Human Story
description:
게임 정보
Explore miniature worlds depicting different cultures throughout human history:



Find characters, objects and stories about our ancestors and learn about their lives:









The Human Story is a relaxing, colorful hidden object game in which you explore historically accurate miniature worlds. The game is capturing a big picture view of how human societies and cultures evolved over time from the very first humans in the Old Stone Age until the present day.

I am a solo dev with a big curiosity for history and creating this game is my way of making sense of the world we are living in today.

title: DROSS
description:
게임 정보
You wake up, crashed onto a barren planet. Around you there is nothing but hostile wasteland, battered by wicked wind and storm. There is a lone outpost barely visible nearby. Crawling slowly, with oxygen low, you finally reach the open entrance. Within the doorway a ramp seems to lead down into an underground facility. You decide you must enter this facility and hope to find a way to escape this wretched place but you aren't alone...The Dross are here with you.
Sneak around your enemies to minimize contact with stealth and subterfuge utilizing traps or door access or fight head on and aggressively utilizing heavy weapons and explosives to purge the infestation at its root. The Dross respond to your tactics and react accordingly.

title: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the young cargo runner, Wolfstar and his companion Bun-E in this sci-fi action adventure platformer. As part of the crew of The Zero Sun, a starship run by the distinguished Captain Olive, travel to various worlds in the Inu System.


Talk to a colorful cast of NPCs to discover the mystery behind the disappearance of the heirs to the Pug Empire.


Explore sprawling sci-fi environments, fighting enemies and unlocking upgrades that will help you defeat the boss of each dungeon.
autokwd: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System

title: Timepunk
description:
게임 정보
Timepunk is a retrofuturistic bullet-hell roguelike where you play as a rogue time traveler, fighting through hundreds of historical enemies. Use weapons from different eras, unlock time-manipulating skills, and create unique builds to survive. Every run is a new path through different historical periods—shoot, loot, and defy physics until you reach the end of time!
Blast your way through various timelines to seek revenge against the mysterious Society of Time! The journey won’t be easy as each timeline brings different challenges like robots, wholly mammoths, and unpredictable outcomes like Nazi Zombies riding Mecha-Dinosaurs. Will you find your revenge against the society of time in this pixelated bullet hell designed for the most skillful of players.
Master of space and time
As a time traveler defy physics with unique different powers, bring weapons from each time period and build your unique build based on the mutations that occur from jumping through time.
Explore different timelines

title: Sanguinite
description:
게임 정보
Sanguinite is a lunar-lander-meets-twin-stick-shooter action game with elements of resource management and exploration. Visit the surface of alien planets using remotely operated drones, searching for resources and artifacts to bring back to your ship. Encounter hostile forces with your initially under-equipped hardware. Research advanced alien technology and integrate it into your own while you investigate the nature and origin of the aliens you encounter.

Faced with global annihilation, humanity was able to unite long enough to execute the Exodus projects. Colony ships filled with passengers in stasis undertook centuries long journeys to escape. Specially designed Envoy vessels were sent far ahead of the colonists to scout and secure potential new homes, each operated by a single pilot. This is your task. Equipped with a fleet of standard issue Beryl drones and a universal fabricator to maintain them, you will conduct exploratory surface missions to acquire resources and investigate your target system. In the unlikely event of a hostile encounter, you will need to improvise. Your Envoy is primarily a scientific and industrial vessel, after all.

title: Reclaim The Sea
description:
게임 정보
Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy and adventure game, set in a naval pirate fantasy world. Your goal is to lead your pirate crew through dangerous seas, keep your ship in one piece and save the World. Face tough decisions, manage resources, spend gold in equipment, upgrades and new crew. You will encounter different ships from many factions each time and face tough decisions. Will you be a good pirate or reckless buccaneer? Will you defend this civilian ship attacked by thugs? Or will you take advantage of its weakened position? If you engage in a fight, you will have many options: taking down the enemy crew, burning or sinking their ship, staying at long range and playing defensively or engaging at close range… Each run is unique thanks to randomly generated ships and maps.
Command your crew
Order your crew to move in the ship to accomplish all the required tasks : charge weapon, pilot the ship, board the enemy ship, repair the ship and many more!
Set weapon targets
Choose your ship weapons and set their targets. Will you reduce enemy fire power or manoeuvrability? Will you try to kill the enemy crew, destroy their ship or overwhelm it under fire?

title: Star Head
description:
게임 정보
Overview
Master the art of split limbs in this chaotic action-adventure where your head and body become instruments of mayhem. Harness magnetic powers to amplify your control while creating devastating attacks or clever diversions. Whether you're a precision head-shot specialist or a tactical mastermind, every challenge is an opportunity to express your style.
This Isn't Your Normal Platformer
Two points of control. Infinite possibilities. Star Head turns platforming into a symphony of coordinated chaos. Launch your head to clear paths while your body handles platforming challenges. Execute perfect teleports to reunite your split form at crucial moments. Chain magnetic powers between your two points to amplify your effectiveness. Create your own solutions - from aggressive dual-point attacks to cunning tactical separations.
A Journey Beyond Logic
Guide QT, a head-launching android with a rebellious streak, through a world where reality bends in unexpected ways. From abandoned military bases to mysterious cities, you'll face corrupted machines, mutated creatures, and bizarre adversaries who'll push your abilities to their limits. Each environment challenges you to master your unique powers as you search for answers about QT's creator. The Star Head rocket holds secrets - if you can overcome the chaos that stands in your way.

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Christine
description:
게임 정보
Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. She loves to sing and dreams of being a soprano at the Opera, but she never thought it would be possible.

When she sees that there will be a selection for the lead singer of a majestic opera based on the book Phantom of the Opera by Gaston Leroux, a light goes on.

Our Christine's life has several coincidences with the Christine in that story: an orphan living and working hard at the Paris Opera. She loves music, a passion inherited from her late father, but she didn't have the opportunity to explore that talent and passion.

How will she reconcile her daily tasks with her evolution? Who can she count on: her friends, an Angel of Music, or herself?
Is it worth facing her fears to pursue her goal?

In this interactive story with a unique musical score, follow the defining year in Christine's quest to pursue her dreams.
FOLLOW CHRISTINE'S DEVELOPMENT!


Add “Christine” to your wishlist and follow the game to keep up with the development.


The game will feature art from Katia Numakura (@katia.numakura) and music from Tatyana Jacques (@taty_jacques).
tag: 쌍방향 소설,퍼즐,비주얼 노벨,숨은 그림 및 물체

title: Tristan Cole's Pro Driver
description:
게임 정보
In Tristan Cole's Pro Driver you're a stunt driver for hire and willing to take on any paying job that gets you closer to buying your next upgrade. Whether it's taxiing passengers around town, completing objectives, or winning races, you need to drive with both speed & style to to impress your customers.



Weave through traffic, hit & destroy props, and jump across rooftops as you navigate your way through the stylized maps of TCPD. Customize your choice of heavily modified caged street cars featuring custom suspension built for high speed stunts. Score big combos by performing dozens of tricks including wheelies, drifts, spins, flips/rolls, grinds, and plenty of insane aerial stunts.



Challenge other drivers in a variety of multiplayer modes to show off your style & prove that you're the best stunt driver on the street.

title: Poison Noir: Desire
description:
게임 정보
Poison Noir: Desire, Time & Gangsters is an animated visual novel with a captivating fantasy theme. Immerse yourself in a rich, multilayered narrative where desire, time, and danger intertwine in a world of gangsters, secrets, and uncertain fates.
In the 90s, for the shy Jake—a gamer and noir novel enthusiast—and his brave friend Lucy, their small hometown holds no future. Seeking new opportunities in the city, Jake begins a romance with Nina, a wealthy and fascinating girl, but one who is also unsettling and full of secrets.
Their relationship becomes complicated when Jake suffers from a strange illness—poison, madness, or something even darker? With each episode, he is thrust between two different eras, stripped of his memories, unable to distinguish reality, and feeling as if a faceless destiny is pulling the strings of his fate.
Trapped between the seemingly harmless modern world and the violent, ruthless gangster underworld of Prohibition, Jake must confront not only a powerful and merciless enemy but also a painful journey of self-transformation. Surrounded by danger and horror, he becomes entangled in brutal mafia wars as well as sinister mysteries beyond his comprehension.
To protect those he loves, he will fight against his hallucinations and fears, struggle with the terrifying suspicion that nothing is as it seems, and be tormented by the collapse of the sacred values he once held dear. But his greatest challenge in this web of time and fate will be to find, among countless paths, the one that leads him back to sanity, love, and the Light. But… how can he be sure he's making the right choice?

title: Last Words
description:
게임 정보
Last Words is a game of social deception based on the Prisoner’s Dilemma philosophical theory. Are two individuals more likely to work together, or betray the other to make things better for themselves? Stuck in the past (or is it the future?) after your time machine inevitably breaks, you must work together with your fellow imprisoned time traveler to get out. You’ll both profit if you make it out together. But…
What if you betrayed them and seized the loot all for yourself along with a new ride home stranding them? After all, your goal is to amass a collection, not help rival explorers make a greater name for themselves. On the other hand, what if they are preparing to do the exact same thing to you? Can you afford to risk your own survival and a potential partnership?
Work together with the other stuck in time prisoner to escape this predicament.
Unlock perks, consumables, and tricks to synergize on both of your escape plans.
Trust in your sudden ally, prepare for his sudden, but inevitable betrayal, or plot their downfall first before they can even consider it.
[/list]
Customize your time traveler with the aforementioned perks, consumables, and other tricks unlocked in your travel.
Put the spoils of time travel collecting to use by changing your explorer’s appearance and personal hideout.
Flaunt your achievements and shiny accolades, but don’t get too cocky or they might be tempted to try and steal it for themselves.

title: RunMan Turbo
description:
게임 정보



The world's fastest returns in RunMan Turbo, a high speed 2D platformer continuing the energetic flair of beloved predecessor RunMan: Race Around the World. Combining the essence of old school classics with tight, modern mechanics, RunMan’s return brings wild enthusiasm and unhinged energy matched with a vibrant aesthetic and groovy soundtrack.




A new challenger wielding a mysterious power has scrambled RunMan's world! Each time you run through a level, it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts and reaction in order to get the fastest time.

Bounce, slide and run fast as heck through high speed levels across five unique zones. Beat record times to earn medals and unlock secret characters, levels, and more.




Cool stuff can you do in this game:





Other stuff you will be jazzed about:







RunMan Turbo is soundtracked by a bunch of awesome artists and bands from Philadelphia. With an eclectic mix of rock, folk, funk, and more, I promise you have never heard a game that sounds like this!

Confirmed artists:
Catbite
SNACKTIME

More music to come soon...


Created by Tom Sennett in 2003 and debuting in the Game Maker Community, the RunMan series has spanned more than half a dozen titles, including 2009's beloved RunMan: Race Around the World - a collaboration with Maddy Thorson (, ). RunMan is also featured as a playable character in indie classic . After a few false starts on mobile, RunMan returns to PC for the triumphant sequel RunMan Turbo.


Yo! I'm Tom Sennett, I'm from Philadelphia, and for two decades I've created video games which have brought joy to millions of people around the world. I'm an IndieCade award winner, and have been featured in Kotaku, VICE, Rock Paper Shotgun and more. When it comes to making games, I do everything including design, art, and programming - I even sometimes create my own sound effects and music. My work focuses on taking classic gameplay constructs and tearing them down to be rebuilt in a lean and modern way. I'm pumped to share it with you!

title: Agent Simulator
description:
게임 정보



Agent Simulation is an action, simulation, and strategy game in which each player shows their targeting skills and agility against enemies in a virtual environment. At the end of each mission, you will collect medals and earn various certificates with these medals. At the end of the game, these certificates will prove your strength as an agent and help you to receive your agent license.
In each level of the ‘Agent Simulation’, you will be evaluated according to your targeting skills. Before the limited time provided ends, you must kill all your enemies. Every successful head shot will get you more points! Of course, if you say ‘I am not that good’ and use up your time, you need to start over. Sorry for that! Sometimes you will be asked to complete the missions in such a limited time, you have to be fast and agile! It is a great environment to test yourself, is it not? You can skip the levels that you could not complete and still advance in the game. But it does not sound that great, right? We are talking about being an agent in here.
There will be three options offered in each level and those options will constantly change! For example, double bullets, double damage, slowing time down, blocking bullets or extra life, etc. You can strategize using any of these options! If you would like, you can repeat any level to test and improve your skills.
When you complete all levels of a lesson, you will receive an overall score including all points and medals you earned in that lesson. If your overall score is not high enough to move on to the next lesson, we regret to inform you that you have to work harder and spend more time by repeating all low scored levels. Do not forget that it is not easy to train an agent!
Earning enough certificates will allow you to receive your agent license at the end. According to your license score, you can see where you are in the world ranking or within your friends.
Fight to be the best!

title: Slumhack
description:
게임 정보
Slumhack is a puzzle-platformer game featuring indirect character control.
Play as Neriko, a girl living in a near-future slum with a virtual friend, and hack your way through the streets of Cynorm.
Make smart use of a variety of Action Buttons and guide Neriko to the goal!

title: Spice Sacrifice
description:
게임 정보
Spice Sacrifice is a JRPG style game with randomized action-platformer battles.



Travel through an underworld full of caves of guts and bones, or goo and piercings or other fantastical stuff. But watch out for the spice that permeates the air, it will transport your character's minds to a dimension full of dangerous beasts that they must fight. Not to mention all the other dangers that keep getting people killed in gruesomely bizarre ways.

Two of the main characters are Oregano - the anxious wreck who must rescue his boyfriend, and Yonko Donko - the punk donkey with amnesia. The story will feature themes of sexuality, mental health, queer comradery, and finding a sense of place in a hostile world.



Outside of battle, Spice Sacrifice plays like a JRPG with in-depth story segments, towns, dungeons, managing equipment and items, leveling up and collecting things, and minigames.

Travel the overworld to find and hang out with various NPC's and grow friendships with them and advance the story. The gameplay has lots of intertwining systems to keep everything deep and addicting.



When you enter a battle, the game becomes an action-platformer with completely randomized levels. A random-gen system makes each screen unique, with random wall layouts, enemy placements, powerups, etc. Avoid the enemy's spells and use a variety of high-impact attacks to survive.
The game has an ensemble cast of playable characters and NPCs, such as:






A few accessibility options we'll include:

title: It's Better Alone
description:
게임 정보


It's Better Alone is a puzzle platformer where you must switch control between two characters in order to solve a variety of platforming puzzles.

A weathered man, haunted by the past.

A burdened robot, living to atone.

Work together, so that they can return home. Journey through a world in ruin, and uncover the events that led to the end of the world.

Solve a variety of puzzles.
Switch control between two characters.
Journey through a world reclaimed by nature.
Uncover the events that led to the end of the world.
Strengthen the bonds between man and machine.

title: Buoy
description:
게임 정보
Fight the undead or learn all the ways to sneak and hide among them. Dig through the ruins of the Old World and complete missions from different factions and survivors to earn valuable resources. Risk life and limb to protect those in need, or brutally kill anyone who gets in your way. Destroy both the dead and the living with an arsenal of melee, ranged, and makeshift weapons. Crawl along the ruined streets in search of supplies and secrets.

title: Age Of Blocks
description:
게임 정보
In Age of Blocks, gathering resources and mining blocks are at the heart of your kingdom’s survival and expansion. Send your workers to chop down towering trees for wood, harvest bushes and catch fish to keep your army fed, and mine precious gold to fund your growing empire. Every resource plays a vital role, fueling construction, recruitment, and technological advances. As you collect blocks from the voxel-based world, you'll unlock the power to shape the land itself—place blocks to build walls, raise towers, and design your perfect stronghold. Whether you're fortifying defenses or expanding your city, mastering resource collection and block placement is key to defending Azuria!
Building your civilization is a journey of strategy and creativity. With 13 unique types of buildings at your disposal—from humble houses and bustling farms to powerful barracks and advanced research centers—you'll shape a thriving kingdom tailored to your playstyle. As your city grows, unlock a wide range of technologies that boost your economy, strengthen your armies, and unlock new tactical possibilities. Advance through different ages of civilization to gain access to more powerful structures, elite units, and game-changing upgrades. Every decision you make brings you one step closer to turning your fledgling settlement into the most formidable empire in all of Azuria!
Leading your army into battle is where your strategy truly comes to life. Train and command a diverse roster of units such as fearless Footmen, swift Lancers, and devastating Warhounds on the front lines. Rain arrows from afar with Longbowmen and Crossbowmen, or unleash heavy siege power with Catapults, Rams, and the deadly Scorpio. Dominate the seas with powerful Galleons and Scorpio Ships, transport your troops across the map with Transport Ships. Monks can provide crucial support on the battlefield, turning the tide with healing. As you research new technologies, your units become stronger, faster, and deadlier, giving you the edge you need to crush your enemy.

title: High Elo Girls
description:
게임 정보

High Elo Girls is an esports visual novel about ambition, competition, and pursuing your dreams to become stronger. Experience the career of a newly minted professional player; from her initial trials, all the way to finally competing in a major tournament. Along the way you’ll confront themes of new adulthood, trust, rivalry and the challenges we face when we embrace the climb.
Featuring
A newcomer-friendly tour of the MOBA esports scene
5 Team Roles to Play (Top Lane, Jungle, Mid Lane, DPS, and Support)
5 Teammates to Befriend, Romance, or Antagonize
Choice-based MOBA Simulations featuring narrative-changing decisions
Embrace your dreams

You play as Rafaela, a college dropout with more regrets than qualifications. The only arena you have any shred of confidence left is also your only escape: the popular MOBA, .

But when you’re invited to join Momentum Gaming (MMG), you finally have the chance to prove to the world, what you’re really made of. But, the job demands not just your skill in , but in negotiating relationships with your ambitious new teammates too. Can you rise to the challenge, or will this end up being just another squandered opportunity?

Engage in choice-based matches that impact Rafaela’s life in and out of her career. Are you a reliable follower closing the deal on your team’s plans; a showstopper making the daring plays that hit social media; or a wildcard who leaves nothing off the table?

Each of your five MMG teammates bring their own perspectives and goals with them. Building friendships, rivalries, and more, will be key to cementing your place in the team.

For someone truly willing to stop at nothing to reach their goals, there may be other paths to discover, provided you’re able to stomach them.

Wishlist us today and look forward to future development updates!
✨ The Split Fate Team

Follow the story of Ribecca "Ribby" Brown, an altruistic frog girl on a journey to get back home - hoping to make some friends along the way and discover things she doesn't yet know about herself.

what r they talkin bout...

                                                                                                       No Controller

Keys of Fury is a retro style Beat `em up typing game.
Destroy loads of enemies as you type your way to victory.
Earn coins for each perfect word typed and use them to purchase abilities, outfits, accessories, and music tracks!
                           Arcade:  A Potpourri of a variety of levels including Bad Dad Jokes, Racing Dinosaurs, and battling through waves of increasingly difficultly worded enemies.  Choose upgrades between each wave to prepare for the next one.
Story:  Help clear corruption from the inner city and engage in your own witty banter with the locals.  Fight a variety of enemies: robots, ninjas, vegetables throwing street venders, etc.

title: NULLPTR
description:
게임 정보
NULLPTR is a real-time tactical hacking puzzle, nominated as a finalist for Innovation and Best Brazilian Game at Gamescom LATAM 2024, where every action you take reshapes the challenge ahead. Infiltrate megacorp servers, reroute connections, collect valuable data, and outmaneuver adaptive defenses—all while racing against the clock and the relentless threat of reactive sentinels.
KEY FEATURES
Tactical grid-based hacking:
Connect to servers, unveil layouts, and plot your path before time runs out and detection sets in.
Reversible trails & stack mechanics:
Every move leaves a trace, increasing your exposure but also opening up new opportunities. Manage your collected data with limited memory, turning the environment to your advantage.
Intelligent sentinels:
Face advanced defenses that patrol, adapt, and react directly to your actions, transforming every stage into a dynamic puzzle.
Reactive environments:
Firewalls, coded doors, and data nodes can change in real time, demanding constant creativity and strategic adaptation.
Constant pressure:
Manage the timer on every run and escape before you’re caught. Every second counts in the fight against megacorporation defenses.

title: Octopus City Blues
description:

Enter Octopus City, the last bastion of humanity in a frozen world.

Meet the cowardly Kaf Kafkaryan, a tentacle trimmer living on a giant octopus.



Explore bizarre worlds and unravel dark conspiracies as the line between dream and reality begins to blur.

Talk to eccentric people with their own motives and schedules. Learn their secrets and spread scandalous rumors.



Handle tense situations while keeping your anxiety in check. Make difficult decisions with long-lasting consequences.

Ghost in a Bottle presents Octopus City Blues: the world's first Octopus City Simulation. Please support us by adding it to your wishlist!

title: Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse

Lethal Honor - Order of the Apocalypse는 섬뜩한 생물과 페이스가 빠른 근접 전투, 강력한 능력과 함께하는 도전적인 핵 앤 슬래시 로그라이트 게임입니다. 초자연적 현상을 조사하고 인류의 생존을 위해 싸우는 비밀 조직의 일원이 되세요.
진실을 밝히세요!
손으로 그린 코믹 패널이 게임플레이에 자연스럽게 뒤섞이며 수수께끼와 음모가 가득한 어두운 이야기 속으로 플레이어를 끌어들입니다. 게임을 시작하고 죽을 때마다 늑대 섬의 위험과 그 안에 도사린 비밀이 조금씩 드러납니다.
강렬하고 빠른 페이스의 전투에서 실력을 시험하세요!
쉬지 않고 공격을 계속하다 보면 결국 때이른 죽음을 맞을 뿐입니다. 나만의 스타일에 맞춰 고유한 능력과 유물, 강화를 조합해서 강력한 시너지를 발휘하세요. 까다로운 보스들과 맞서 싸우며 우월한 실력을 증명하세요. 적에게 지옥을 맛보여주세요!

Features
Five wildly different areas to explore, each filled with an assortment of upgrades to find and enemies to fight. Traverse the Starchaser’s wreck in this tight 2D platformer.
Gorgeous hand drawn 32 bit pixel art, with colorful yet atmospheric environments to traverse. No two areas look alike, and enemies are filled with personality.
An energetic soundtrack that pulls from a charcuterie board of 90s electronic music. Head bang to the boss theme while fighting a giant squid, relax and chill out to the melodic tones of the Kelp Forest in the ambience of a glowing jellyfish.
Uncover the mystery of the Starchaser’s sinking… Where are all the bodies?
Lots of crabs.

title: Marble Puzzles
description:
게임 정보
Sandbox Marble Track Creator
Create the marble track of your dreams with dozens of parts and in different environments. Build your marble track with slopes, pipes and curves or go a little more crazy and use triggers, elevators and boosters. If that's not enough then there are also teleporters, gravity fields and marble eaters.

Mind bending Puzzles
Solve nifty puzzles created by our own team or by the community. Use the parts correctly to guide each marble to their goal. An ever increasing level of difficulty makes sure you get in easily and are challenged for a long time.

Defend yourself against the marbles in tower defense mode. Make sure the marbles don't hit the detonation trigger and instead reach the goal.
Choose the right parts to build your deck and use your deck to solve increasingly difficult puzzles in rogue like mode.

title: Back To The Collis
description:
게임 정보
Back To The Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn Point & Click adventure puzzle game, that will take you on a journey into the atmospheric world and amaze you with lots of logical and engaging puzzles.





In Back to the Collis you will play as Benjamin, who has formerly left the town of Collis, built on a hill, and now lives in the forest in his comfort, nearby the town.
But after a while, Benjamin must return to the Collis to tackle a seemingly simple problem of water shortage, which has already affected him as well.
With Benjamin, you will have a chance to explore the town, introduce its varied and memorable populace, their social problems, solve lots of exciting puzzles and who knows, maybe at the end of your shared journey you will even understand why he left this town long ago.




Back to the Collis is classic point & click adventure game, where you will solve lots of engaging environmental quests and logical puzzles.
This game is designed to be more than just a game, it is an adventure that will make you think about the way of life of its society, their coexistence issues, which has lots of in common with our real ones.

title: CASSETTE BOY
description:
게임 정보
Is the moon still there when I'm not looking at it?
If it isn't...will the people I love disappear if I stop looking at them?



"Do you really believe the moon isn't there when you're not looking at it?" This famous quote attributed to Einstein poses a profound question about quantum mechanics. This game is a puzzle adventure inspired by quantum mechanics, set in a world where things cease to exist when you're not looking at them. Manipulate existence and solve the mysteries of this intriguing world!

About Cassette Boy:
Cassette Boy looks like a 2D game, but its world is actually 3D.
In order to solve its puzzles, you will have to turn and twist the map around, changing the perspective.
Things that you can't see from your perspective, for example because they're hidden behind a wall, stop existing—this is called the "Schrödinger system."
Hide obstacles out of sight and out of mind or reveal secret passages to advance through the game.
Of course, solving puzzles won't be enough. You'll have to pick up weapons and face monsters and bosses as well.
Enemies, puzzles, and more await you in this mysterious world!



The state of matter is only defined once you observe it.
In Cassette Boy's world, what you can't observe doesn't exist. In other words, the only thing that matters is what you can see on the screen.
Yes, even the people you just talked to. They don't exist unless you're observing them.
Flip the world around and bring things in and out of existence.

title: Explory Story
description:
게임 정보

Our highly detailed worlds involve beautiful hand-drawn pixel scenery and thoughtful stories. The text on the floor can be interacted with, leading to a huge variety of effects and experiences. Reading and engaging with the text are crucial for progressing through the puzzles. Additionally, many secret interactions and hidden locations are spread out throughout the game.


Progressing through each level will involve cleverly interacting with objects and text. In some cases, you will be tasked with restoring context to a sentence; in other cases, you will be crafting entirely new and highly variable phrases.


Explory Story contains a boss at the end of each Act. That means 4+ entirely unique boss fights with unique mechanics and challenges. These can be undertaken alone or together with a friend. Additionally, each boss has variants that you can access by engaging with the story.

title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Supporting small indie artists, Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game brings players to a cute & whimsical fantasy world where rivalling factions of animal characters fight to uncover fantastical riches!

Gameplay
AT:TCG is played as a 2-player game with both players racing to uncover all of their 8 'Treasure' cards before the opponent does. They can bring in animal characters to help their cause & do battle! Play happens with a pre-built deck of 50 cards and 8 player-chosen Treasure cards. Players are matched up with another player on Steam online, or if no players are available they will play against a CPU. An internet connection is required.

Collections
Show off cards you pull from booster packs or earn through challenges to your friends! AT:TCG uses the Steam Inventory service to manage the cards you own, meaning your collection is in safe hands!

Events
Participate in regular events & prove your might and mettle to earn prizes! Ranked Challenge is the first regular event to reach Arcane Treasures: TCG - seeing players fight to earn the most Ranked Points over an event period - but more will be on the way!

Player Feedback
The development process is heavily rooted in player feedback, with great respect held in the views of the player. By participating in the Discord, you can have your say! But don't just take our word for it, feel free to ask members of the community who have given in feedback!

Supporting Indie Artists
Arcane Treasures and those involved with its development have always been rooted in the indie world, and always will be. Except for placeholder artworks during early development stages (which are steadily being replaced) all artwork is sourced from small, independent artists, and as the game grows it is committed to finding further ways to support independent artists.

If you're an artist and you'd like to get involved, please get in touch through the email attached to the Steam store page.

title: Astortion
description:
게임 정보
Astortion is a minimalistic, atmospheric puzzle-platformer that revolves around gravity.
Explore the ruins of the most pivotal research facility on earth, unlock new abilities that mess with spacetime itself, and get to the bottom of what is going on.
Features
Gravity-Based Puzzles: Attract or repel objects, stick to walls or change the gravity of an entire room in order to progress further.
Immersive World: Delve into the depths of an abandoned research facility, full of mysterious, interconnected chambers. Piece together the story of this place and find out what is your role to play.
Unlockable Abilities: So-called drivers provide you with new ways to interact with the environment - allowing you to solve more complex puzzles or shine a new light on places you have previously visited.
Unusual Platforming Gameplay: Use your control over gravity to swiftly traverse the world of the game while staying out of harm's way.

title: Tall Poppy 2
description:
게임 정보
About the game

In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!










Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...




















, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
