게임 정보
Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a challenging, atmospheric, and action-packed 2D platformer.

HOLLOW POINT
Cloned flesh is no substitute; you’ve saved no one real. Hollow Point continues the story of the first System Purge, adding six new surreal sectors to explore. Survive a litany of new obstacles and monstrous threats as you delve into the System’s very foundations…and beyond.

BEARTRAP MODE
After you've finished Hollow Point, tackle the game’s hardest challenge in Beartrap Mode. Play through an alternate story which remixes and redesigns every level from the original game, adding new obstacles, new secrets, and 4 brutally difficult boss encounters.

SPEEDRUN MODE
Put your skills to the test in 2 new speedrun categories. Jumps, deaths, and uncovered secrets are now tracked during each run.

title: Delilah
description:
게임 정보
Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.



Two characters with unique loadouts
Varied encounters, from tight horror experiences to slaughter maps
Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story
Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites
MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's
Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry



A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields.

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.
Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

title: Super Skeleton Butler
description:
게임 정보
In Super Skeleton Butler, you play as a skeleton defending your dungeon home from adventurers trying to steal your treasure. Build traps, cast spells and slay hundreds of enemies while protecting your precious treasure from dirty, thieving humans.

title: Divine Doubt
description:
게임 정보
“I can give you that which you desire most. Your humanity.” This was all that was promised to Callum Röttwell in the mysterious email he received out of the blue one day. It was enough though for him to uproot his life and travel to the city of Starhaven to start anew. As an angel from a small town, he has to adapt quickly and learn how to interact with those he's never encountered before- demons. Especially since he must share a bedroom with one in a cramped apartment. Throughout this journey, Callum will meet many characters, explore the city of Starhaven, and dive deeper into what that strange email entails for him. But he must be wary, for his goddess is watching closely.


Features:

Baked with love by Team Meatpie

title: Tapes of Fear: Smile
description:

Tapes of Fear: Smile는 당신에게 극한의 공포를 안겨주기 위해 만들어졌습니다. 이 1인칭 심리 공포 게임은 플레이할 때마다 독특하고 무서운 경험을 보장합니다.



Tapes of Fear의 중심에는 Infinity Green Game Studio가 개발한 혁신적인 Infinity Fear System™이 있습니다. 공포를 유발하는 방법에 대한 학술 연구를 기반으로 개발된 이 고급 시스템은 실시간으로 사용자의 결정과 반응을 모니터링하고, 게임 이벤트를 동적으로 조정하여 공포를 극대화합니다. 이 시스템은 공포 경험이 지나치거나 부족하지 않도록 보장하여 완벽한 공포의 흐름을 유지합니다. 각 결정과 반응은 사건의 진행을 변화시켜 매번 새로운 무서운 경험을 제공합니다.

title: Rusty Seas
description:
게임 정보
Rusty Seas is a retro-style game reminiscent of the 16-bit console era with a splash of 90's computer gaming, drawing inspiration and design philosophy from some of the great classics of that time, as well as plucking a few bits from more modern games to bridge the gap.

Play as Mirig, a diner waitress whose afternoon off is interrupted by a mysterious (and very profitable) offer to collect high-tech junk washing up on the beaches of Northshore. But her venture is fraught with a colorful cast of competitors who also want to lay claim to the salvages. To overcome, Mirig will need to throw her weight around, dunk her adversaries, buy outfits and items, and make friends and allies along the way.

In addition to action-based gameplay, Rusty Seas also features a splash of visual novel style content, through which the player can learn that the lore of Northshore runs a little deeper than its cozy sands.

title: Skip Lake 2

The sequel of Skip Lake, this game is now going a litlle deeper in the story, and bringing new mechanichs with unique puzzles!

The game captures the international game of skipping stones into the water, transforming it into a puzzle of logic and direction, with harmony of music and sound effects, carefully composed to relax.
Hit the pots trough stunning landscapes

Touch the rotating pillars until they are at the right angle for the stone to hit until it reaches the pot on the other side of the lake !!

title: Trailthread
description:
게임 정보

In the Augment Battle System, each fighter can act twice per turn. Use your first move to cast spells or attacks, and use your second move to modify those commands with game-changing Augments!

Augments apply diverse modifiers to your arsenal: Imbue attacks with lightning damage, cast your heals as team-wide spells, and guarantee your buffs trigger before anyone else moves. With millions of Primary-Augment combos available in-game, the sky’s the limit!


Trailthread's story follows a blacksmith, baker, and bandit on their journey to scale Anvite Mountain and slay the bitter Obsidian Drake. Rekindle enchanted forges, meet strange friends, and tumble across the timeline with the mysterious Timestitcher. Can you reach the summit?


Trailthread is a focused 10-hour experience. It features a streamlined world map and quick combat expansion. Enjoy plenty of strategic customization, expressive characters, vibrant music, and more… all in one tight-knit package!

title: Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon
description:
게임 정보
Grand Arms: March of the Red Dragon is a spiritual successor to the classic Ogre Battle series, combining real-time, squad-based tactics gameplay with turn-based RPG combat. Move units across the map in real time to capture towns and castles; when enemy units come in contact, a turn-based battle ensues, with the defeated side forced to give up ground.



Organize soldiers with unique appearance, stats and classes into units. Choose from dozens of classes, and customize your unit's formation to maximize each soldier's effectiveness, taking advantage of position-specific abilities, damage types and resistances, and support abilities which can be used to help nearby units when they enter combat.



Explore dozens of unique regions depicted in lush, hand-painted graphics. Destroy your opponents and capture their territories to win. Choose where to stand your ground - fighting from the right terrain can give you the advantage you need, and traversing difficult terrain can build up fatigue that will reduce your units' effectiveness.




When your unit comes in contact with the enemy, a turn-based battle ensues. Battles play out ; characters act in initiative order, and their actions are determined by their class, formation, and enemy positioning. Archers will rain down destruction on enemies from the rear, but if they lose their cover, they're defenseless. Swordsmen will attack from the front row and must hit the enemy's front row first; from the rear, they'll do nothing. Bleddyn the bard will bravely wield his rapier from the front, or play a song to buff the entire squad from the back.

The side that deals the most morale damage - by hitting hard, taking down units, or weakening the enemy commander - is the winner, with the other side losing ground on the map.


Years ago, the scattered kingdoms of the Britons were nearly united by one of history's greatest princes, Llewelyn the Great, in fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Llewelyn was the greatest ruler the land had seen since King Arthur. But when he reached the apex of his power, he died, leaving behind a messy succession crisis. And in the chaos, England invaded, leading to a loss of nearly all Llewelyn had won.

Llewelyn II was named after his famous grandfather. He too is destined for greatness and will someday be known to history. But his path to greatness is uncertain: his father and brothers are imprisoned in London, England occupies half of the territory of Gwynedd, raiders harry the coast, and the ruling prince, Llewelyn's uncle, is viewed by many as a usurper. Will he be known as the prophesied Son of Destiny who ruled over a united Kingdom of the Britons, or as the prince who lost everything when England invaded?

title: Space gold rush TD
description:
게임 정보
Space Gold Rush is a unique hybrid of tower-defense and real-time-strategy. Set in the not distant future where space travel has become viable to everyone. In the frontiers of space where there is the unexplored, also means there is untapped resources. No time to waste mining and extracting, and no regulators to setup health and safety laws and procedures, risk it all and join the many other prospectors in a new hazardous industry blowing up asteroids anyway they can in order to strike it rich.

7 Different Towers each with their own upgrade options to specialize their stats (damage, fire rate, and range).

Mobile Turrets able to set up any where and reposition to fit different roles or when plan A does not go well.

title: Codename Incubus
description:
게임 정보
SUBDUE YOUR NIGHTMARES

Cleave through ethereal enemies with blistering slashes, locked in a bullet-hell frenzy between waves of projectiles. Keep dodging and close in on your foes to swiftly dismantle them, or gracefully parry their bullets with resolute precision.

Almost all objects and enemies you see are slashable: When attacking them, you gain speed and become invincible for a short time, meaning that you are rewarded for maintaining momentum and playing at an electrifying pace. The time-based score system also encourages you to push your limits, embracing the exhilarating sense of freedom that comes with shredding through every obstacle that stands in your way.

This high-risk, high-reward mentality is amplified by the fact that everything on screen dies in one hit - including you. Thankfully, the absence of loading times ensures that dying won't discourage you, and the synth-based Cyberpunk soundtrack takes care of any frustration you might have left.


TRIUMPH OVER TRAUMA

Delve deeper into a gripping narrative about two tormented souls: Alexander, a dealer who always struggled with the rules around him, and Maximilian, a philanderer whose only joy left in life is mindless stimulation. Both unhappy with their present situation, they embrace the allure of a mysterious drug - a gateway to a reality where the lines between dreams and nightmares blur.

Will they conquer their demons or be consumed by the very substance that fuels their escape? Peel back the layers of their past to find out! Just make sure that you're not getting to this serotonin-boosting game...

title: Infernae
description:
게임 정보


A bullet hell game where dodging and cowering for your life will claim it. Fear is not shield, a lesson Asmus learned long ago. Will the lesson pass down onto you?
Play through a boss rush of increasingly challenging foes, and watch your game over count go up with each one. We are not responsible for bouts of frustration and indignation. Control your emotions, or they will control you.



A starwitch has been marked for death, and the duty of a memento mori is to carry out their deliverance. That's Asmus' story. But she has a story of her own too, and Lucine will make sure he listens to her if it's the last thing she does.
Lucine is one of several bosses that will be featured in Infernae. Each one has a story to tell, a secret between them that Asmus doesn't want you to know about.

title: Mutants Of Mist
description:
게임 정보
Mutants Of Mist is a 4-player, online co-op, survival horror game. You and a group of 3 others have entered a forest that's becoming shrouded in a deadly and mysterious mist. You are in search of information and evidence as to what happened to this place and where the mist came from.

After finding a campground you find yourself trapped as it reaches night and the mutants come out.

will you and your group be able to find the evidence and escape before it's to late or will you become another victim of the mist.
Survive

Objectives: Survive together with up to 3 other players or alone if you're brave enough. complete puzzles, find the evidence and notes hidden around the map, but find them quick as the mist is closing in and mutants are hunting for you. Find items and tools to help you survive and escape the mutants.
Dangers: Each mutant has different forms of hunting. Some hunt with sight and some only with sound. They might prefer to sneak up and ambush, or they might warn you and run at you from a distance.

Be careful as each mutant has different strengths and weakness's that you'll have to look out for if you want to escape.
Explore

Immersive Experience: Realistic Graphics and Immersive audio as well as with a minimal user interface to make you feel immersed and keep your back straight.
Map: A large map with random item spawns and traps, and lots of items to try to collect before you escape create a unique experience every time you play.
Multiplayer

Play Together: Play along side your friends or join public lobbies with up to 4 players and use teamwork to help you succeed in collecting evidence and escaping, or use them as bait and make it out alone.

title: Original Soul
description:
게임 정보
"Original Soul" is a top-down action shooting game. There are a certain number of enemies in each mission. You need to use different combat methods to eliminate the enemies before you can complete the level.

In the game, there will be two different beautiful girl heroes to perform tasks. You can choose different female heroes to experience different plots.

Your mission: free the world from the hordes of "Mad Scientists".

The world of the future is ruled by the Z Corporation founded by a ruthless "mad scientist". The mad scientist performs his experiments from the headquarters of an evil organization in a cyber city. And created weapons of mass destruction and biomechanical weapons. And the scientist has some kind of mysterious connection with the heroines.

So, now it's up to you to control the heroine to save the world from the army of "mad scientists".

title: Paper Play VR
description:
게임 정보


*똑똑* 우리 집에 놀러올래? 종이로 만든 나의 성에서 휴식을 취하거나 온라인 기록 도장깨기를 위해 진땀을 뺄 수도 있어요.
더 많이, 더 즐겁게! 친구를 최대 4 명까지 초대해서 게임을 같이 즐길 수 있어요! :)

물수제비
골프와 비슷한 듯도 하지만, 물 위에서 돌을 던지는 게임입니다. 코스가 끝나갈 쯤 돌을 튕겨 표면을 가로질러 장대에 맞히세요!

유령 사냥
이 편집증 시뮬레이터에서는 손전등으로 무서운 유령을 찾아내서 쏴야 합니다. 하지만 어둠 속에 항상 또 다른 유령이 숨어서 당신의 마지막 촛불이 마침내 꺼지기를 기다리고 있다는 걸 명심하세요!

아이스크림 맛보기
아주 기다란 혀로 아이스크림을 핥아야 하는 이상한 게임입니다. 하지만 조심하세요! 어떤 종류에는 알러지가 있어서 너무 욕심을 부리면 말 그대로 혀에 불이 날 수 있어요!

그 외에도 많은 미니 게임이 곧 추가로 출시됩니다, 파티에 참석하세요!

title: Shadow mate ~小さな竜と適合者~
description:
게임 정보
When "Cynthia," a young girl held captive in a mysterious laboratory, woke up, she felt something strange in her body.
Her body was possessed by Belial, a vicious life form created by the institute.
The taciturn and calm Cynthia, and the maniacal and depressing Belial.
The two seem incompatible with each other, but both have a desire to get out of the institute.
In the end, they use each other in their relationship to escape from the institute.

怪しげな研究所で囚われていた少女『シンシア』は目を覚ますと、自分の身体に異変を感じた。
彼女の身体には、研究所が生み出した凶悪な生命体『ベリアル』が憑りついていた。
寡黙で冷静なシンシア、狂暴で鬱陶しいベリアル。
互いに相容れない様子の二人だったが、研究所から外に出たいという願いはどちらもが抱いていた。
最終的にはお互いを利用しあう関係として、研究所からの脱出を目指すことになる――。
autokwd: Shadow mate ~小さな竜と適合者~

title: Dreamworld Dread
description:
게임 정보
A Roguelike Deckbuilder where you fight your biggest nightmares.
Find the way trough the doors of your mind and beat the nightmares for good.

Select cards, build your deck and level up your cards to be strong enough to beat your biggest fears.


Plan your moves strategically and use the weakness of your enemy.

Features
Roughlite: Find your way through a random generated world. Choose the right door to find a shop, camp, reward or your next enemys. Use your coins to buy upgrade for your next run, to come back stronger.
Combin deckbuilding with autobattler: Collect up to 6 cards, place them strategically against up to 4 enemys and let them fight.
Level and upgrade your cards by using them and combine them with the effect of up to 3 items, that you can win or find in the world.

title: Call Of Dookie
description:
게임 정보
Imagine you went to the crapper and emerged an hour later to a monster apocalypse!
Retro first-person shooter action inspired by 90's classics!
Save your friends and family. Save the world... from going all to crap!
You are family man Mike Hadley. Returning to work after your favourite lunch buffet required an immediate visit to the restroom. That's when it really hit the fan. Now you must fight your way through the monster horde to save your loved ones!

title: Frenzy Blood
description:
게임 정보
A noir aesthetics mixed with the great depression threw gamers to America of the 1930s. As an idealist by nature, Dr. Phobos invents various injections that give people the happiness that they had lost.

Jonathan Kramer, a main character who was severely injured in a car accident as a child and lost his family, was a patient of Chief Dr. Phobos. He experimented on
the boy with his newest treatment methods and healed his body, but traumatized his psyche. Soon, the government caught the doctor and put him in a lunatic
asylum, but he escaped.
Features
* Plug-and-play your game experience in noir atmosphere
* Defeat charismatic villain puppets to prevent your town from havoc
* Realistic historical weapons with their corresponding manipulation mechanics
* Strong alcohol and tobaccos as your tactical assets
* Use game environment for your combat advantages

Looking at the surrounding decay through the prism of your vices, will you be able to maintain your humanity or will your mind be consumed by darkness?

title: Traptile
description:
게임 정보
CREATE INTRICATE MACHINING
Traps are full of hidden secrets and interactions. Learn how they work and exploit your knowledge to deal maximum damage.


LEARN THE ENEMY
The enemy is well prepared and has ways to counter your defenses. If you learn them, you may be able to counter their counter.


ROGUELIKE ELEMENTS
Explore procedurally-generated environments and defend them all – every arena has its own interactions and emphasizes certain strategies over others. Maybe you can even make the arena dispose of some enemies for you...
WATCH THE BUDGET
Building traps takes gold, and the gold you have must be enough to defend several arenas – you need to watch how much you spend, or there won't be enough left for the next room.
Get in, build your defenses, watch a bit of suffering, and get out. The fun is building devious contraptions, and that's what you'll be doing the most.

title: Exploration: Light
description:
게임 정보
Explore the light of the stars.
Take your ship across the cosmos.
Free planets from pirates and utilize technologies from different alien races.
Gather your forces and protect peace from collapsing.
You will:
Take part in large battles of space ships.
Uncover the secrets of a mysterious alien race.
Upgrade your ship while following a deep story about two friends.
Earn credits by helping strangers across the universe.
ᔑㄩᖇᐯꙆᐯᙓ
There is more than meets the eye,

title: Afallon
description:
게임 정보
Adventure and destiny await you in the expansive 40 square kilometer realm of "Afallon," an open-world role-playing game. Start out as an inexperienced explorer and ascend to become a hero admired all across the realm.
Choose Your Destiny
Choose from eight distinct classes: Shieldmaster, Necromancer, Wizard, Berserker, Druid, Assassin, Hunter, or Death Knight. Each class offers three talent trees for customization.
Dungeons
Explore dungeons hidden across the world of Afallon, filled with treasures and challenges. Turn dungeons into "Corrupted" versions for tougher encounters and better rewards.
Dynamic and Evolving World
The game world in Afallon dynamically adapts to your progress, ensuring a continuously evolving and engaging experience. As your character gains strength, through increasing levels, enhancing "Item Power," and completing quests, the world around you transforms to reflect your growing prowess.

New, more challenging enemies with unique abilities begin to appear, providing fresh combat experiences and keeping the battles intense. These foes not only test your skills but also drop rare and powerful loot that matches your advancing capabilities, offering constant rewards for your progress.

In addition to tougher enemies, the world will also generate different treasure chests, hidden in new locations, filled with valuable items and gear tailored to your character's growth. These chests ensure that exploration remains rewarding and that there's always something new to discover.

The game doesn't just scale in difficulty; it evolves around your journey. Quests and storylines unfold in response to your achievements, introducing new challenges and opportunities. The combination of these factors, level, Item Power, and quest completion ensures that Afallon is a living, breathing world that grows with you, offering an ever-changing landscape that keeps the experience fresh and exciting, making sure the world never feels static or boring.
Crafting professions like Blacksmithing, Alchemy, Tailoring, Gemcutting, Enchanting, and Leatherworking allow you to gather resources such as ores, flowers, gems, and animal hides to create powerful gear and valuable items. You start with a limited number of recipes, but as you progress, you can discover, purchase, or earn new ones from quests and enemies. Crafting not only enhances your character but also provides opportunities for earning gold through trading or selling crafted goods. This system adds depth to gameplay, making you more self-sufficient and connected to the world around you.
You can recruit unique companions through quests and random encounters as you explore the world. Each companion you acquire offers a distinct set of skills, ranging from healing and spellcasting to stealthy assassinations and powerful melee combat. These companions are more than just allies; they bring specialized abilities that can complement your playstyle and significantly impact your success in battles. Whether you need a healer to keep you alive, a spellcaster to unleash magical attacks, or a warrior to stand by your side in the thick of combat, each companion adds depth and strategy to your journey.
In "Afallon," legend is not born from mere dreams here, it is forged in the fire of your will. Can you rise to the challenge? Discover your power, shape your destiny, and leave your mark on a world that grows with you. Welcome to Afallon, where every choice is a legacy waiting to happen.

title: Bite Size Terrors: eye candy
description:
게임 정보
Bite Size Terrors:
Are Short Experimental Horror Experiences each with their own Unique Genres and Styles.
From the Creator of Notebook Entries, this is...
eye candy:
SHORT. Less than an Hour.
A Suspenseful Horror that displays Color Theory in a Stylized Motion.
Discover who you play as time progresses, finding out there's more to what meets the eye.
Black & White Manga Style.
Sound Design is meticulously built and well known in this series.
Story:
Playing as Frank, you install security cams as your day job. One day you get a call that freezes you to your core.
Time Stops.
You Know This Address.
You Know What Happened.
You Know What Needs To Be Done.
Gameplay:
A Horror Experience.
You Work Your Job. You Walk. You Drive. You Install Cameras.
Simple Mechanics with an emphasis on Story Building, Sound Design, Music, Mood Changes & Delivering Experimental Horror Like Movies..

title: Towerbolt
description:
게임 정보
Towerbolt is a precision platformer with an emphasis on speed and fluid ascending movement. Set in the far future where robots are waging war against humanity, play as a Bolter, an augmented half human, half robot super soldier, and break out of a futuristic Megatower prison!

title: Bony Bones Adventures
description:
게임 정보
'조상' 원고가 도난당하고, 끔찍한 고대 마법이 탄생했습니다. 저주가 Zagrobiya 주민들에게 내려졌고, 그들은 신비한 주인의 손안에서 순종적인 꼭두각시로 변했습니다. 한때 번영했던 땅은 어둠 속으로 사라졌습니다.
Bony Bones 와 함께 Zagrobiya 를 구하고, 단순한 주민에서 용감한 영웅으로 거듭나고, 모든 재난의 원인을 규명하고 악을 파괴해야 합니다.
클래식 3D 플랫포머입니다.
Zagrobiya 에서 각각 고유한 분위기와 바이옴을 갖춘 4개의 독특한 장소를 탐험하세요.
수수께끼를 풀고, 치명적인 함정을 통과하고, 비밀을 찾으세요.
모험 중에 만나는 Zagrobiya 사람들을 도우세요.
길에서 만나는 모든 적과 보스는 독특하며, 각각에 대한 접근 방식을 찾으세요.

title: Hacker's Life
description:
게임 정보
Hacker's Life is a game where you become a hacker and make your own malware. You can infect devices all over the world and join forces with other hackers to launch bigger attacks. See your malware spread and your fame grow, but be careful not to get caught by the authorities.



Name your malware whatever you want, pick its type, and select the device you want to infect. Whether it's a PC, a console, or a smart device you want to infect, you have many options to choose from. Customize how your malware affects different parts of the device and add special abilities to make it more unique and unpredictable. Unleash your creativity and see what kind of havoc you can cause with your malware.


Collect victim's IP addresses and passwords and use them for your own benefit. You can either sell them on the Dark Store a shady online marketplace, or hack into their files and steal their secrets. How far will you go in this cybercrime adventure?


If you want to be a great hacker, you need to keep learning new skills. Skill Up website, where you can find all kinds of courses to improve your hacking abilities. You can learn how to make different kinds of malware, how to target different devices, and how to add new functions to your malware. The more you learn, the more powerful your malware will be. You will be able to create the most destructive malware ever and become the best hacker in the world!


Dark store, is the underground online market where hackers trade their skills and secrets for money. Whether you want to unleash a quick global malware or just make a quick buck, you can find what you need here. Buy ready-made malware from other hackers or sell your own creations to the highest bidder. Or get access to user data that will help you craft malware with special abilities. But be careful, the dark store is not a safe place, and you never know who you can trust.


If you want to be a famous hacker with global known attacks, you can't do it alone. You need to team up with other hackers who share your goals and skills. Together, you can pull off bigger and better hacks that target specific organizations. You can hack the power grid, erase data from big companies' cloud storage, or disrupt the communication networks. It's fun to cause chaos with your hacker buddies. But watch out, this is not a game, you have to obey the group rules and do your part or face serious consequences.

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Sixth Sense
description:
게임 정보
Sixth Sense is a stealth-driven, deduction-based battle royale where knowledge is your greatest weapon. Set in a pre-historic settlement, players take on the roles of cunning thieves, enigmatic rangers, and arcane tricksters, hunting their target while evading their own assassin. Find dead bodies, hire spies, and use your Sixth Sense—because in this game, the last one standing is the one who saw it coming.
INVISIBILITY
Vanish into thin air with Invisibility, the perfect tool for escaping danger or setting up the perfect ambush. While hidden from all eyes—including spies and bystanders—your Assassin gains a heightened Sixth Sense, making every disappearance a risky gamble. Use it wisely—because the unseen can still be hunted
SIXTH SENSE
Sixth Sense transforms disappearance into a trail to be followed. When your target vanishes, you lose sight of them—but gain an uncanny awareness of their presence. A mysterious force pulls you closer, narrowing the hunt without ever revealing their exact location. Trust your instincts, close the distance, and strike before they slip away again.

title: Hyperspace Nebula
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a perilous journey through the cosmos in "Hyperspace Nebula," a captivating 2D space roguelike game that will challenge your space battle skills. Explore different sectors of the universe, battle cosmic horrors, and uncover the mysteries of the galaxy in this epic space adventure.

🚀 Key Features 🚀

🌌 Procedurally Generated Universe:
Every playthrough is a unique and unpredictable experience. Traverse a vast and ever-changing galaxy, each sector brimming with hidden dangers, valuable treasures, and enigmatic anomalies.

🛠️ Ship Customization:
Craft and customize your spaceship to suit your playstyle. Unlock an array of modular upgrades, weapons, and equipment, allowing you to adapt to the challenges of deep space exploration and combat.

🌟 Permadeath and Progression:
Prepare for a relentless challenge as death is permanent in "Hyperspace Nebula." But fear not, as each defeat brings valuable lessons and unlocks new abilities for future runs, making you stronger with every attempt.

🌠 Cosmic Battles:
Engage in thrilling battles against formidable alien species, rogue AI, and cosmic forces that guard the secrets of the universe. Utilize your ship's unique abilities and your own tactical prowess to emerge victorious.

🔮 Dynamic Events:
Encounter a variety of dynamic events that can alter the course of your journey, from cosmic storms to alien encounters. Adapt, strategize, and make critical decisions to survive.

🌌 Endless Replayability:
With a vast galaxy to explore and countless challenges to overcome, "Hyperspace Nebula" offers endless replayability. Every run is a fresh adventure with new surprises and dangers.

👨‍🚀 Become a Space Legend:
Do you have what it takes to become a legendary cosmic explorer? Test your skills and forge your legacy among the stars in "Hyperspace Nebula."

Embark on an unforgettable journey through the cosmos, where survival depends on your wits, adaptability, and mastery of space combat. Explore the unknown, battle cosmic adversaries, and become a legend in "Hyperspace Nebula." Are you ready to venture into the stars and face the mysteries of the universe?

title: Duskpunk
description:
게임 정보

Dredgeport is spiralling out of control. Gangs rule the slums, corruption trumps the law, and corpses of the war-dead are burned daily for fuel. You are an ex-soldier, mistaken for dead and shipped back to Dredgeport for processing. After a narrow escape, you find yourself alone in the guts of the city, with only two things to your name: your life and your sanity. Keeping both will prove a challenge.


Inspired by tabletop RPGs and narrative adventure games like Citizen Sleeper, Duskpunk finds a balance between challenge and freedom, tracking your health, energy and stress as you try to survive. Make lasting choices that determine the city’s fate. Develop skills to distinguish yourself in your chosen field of work. Earn a crust, explore the city, make alliances and escape your traumatic past.


Dredgeport plays host to characters with rich backstories and murky motivations. Some care for you or the city; others are in it for themselves, but will pay well. Choose your allies wisely. They will be part of your fate whether you like it or not.

title: Memory Rewind
description:
게임 정보
Step into the life of a self-proclaimed detective. Along with your quirky assistant Olivina, take on a seemingly ordinary case, until you unravel its hidden twists and turns that pull you through a thrilling, unique story.
Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant
Diverse cast of characters
Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters
Stylized, hand-drawn CG for players to unlock and collect

title: Leap Hero
description:
게임 정보
The princess has been captured! Step into the armored boots of a frog and use your tongue as a grappling hook to beat challenging levels. Encounter quirky characters and dive into this thrilling rescue mission.



A simple but humorous story with lots of funny and strange characters.
Simple controls, but difficult to master.
4 different worlds with 300+ stages/screens and of course... some hidden secrets.
You're a FROG

title: Serial Victims
description:
게임 정보
Serial Victims is a 3D psychological horror game that immerses you in the nightmares of individuals who fell prey to serial killers. In Serial Victims, you embody each victim, racing against time to uncover clues, call for help, and perform various actions before the inevitable happens. Your ultimate objective is to have the victims assist in catching the killer with as few victims as possible.
Survival is not the goal. Instead, your aim is to do what you can within the time you have left.
Serial Victims gives a fresh and replayable horror experience. Each playthrough is randomized, ensuring that no two experiences are the same:
Unique players: Each victim is different, their name, speed, and reactions to their surroundings.
Unique Killers: Encounter various serial killers, each with distinct methods, personalities, and motives, making each investigation a unique challenge.
tag: 심리적 공포,전술 RPG,탐험,숨은 그림 및 물체,3D

title: Arohel: Call of the Wind
description:
게임 정보
AROHEL: CALL OF THE WIND
Arohel is set in a near future, when a series of mass flooding across the entire Earth has forced survivors to take refuge on stilt complexes. A few years later, a meteor shower reached the Earth, bringing with it a mysterious crystal of unknown origin: the Arohel.
By connecting with the Arohel, fragments of land began to emerge from the waters, clumping together and forming floating islands that, after a cycle of about 12 hours, disappeared back into the abyss, only to reappear the next day in different arrangements.
In the settlements, a new group of intrepid adventurer arose, tasked with finding new resources for the community: the Explorers. In "Arohel: Call Of The Wind," you will play as a novice Explorer, navigating through procedurally generated floating islands on a quest to find a long-lost friend.
EXPLORE
Dive through the floating islands and explore them with your grappling hook and hang glider. Take on procedurally generated missions from your fellow villagers, collecting important resources to help your community.
LOOT

title: Terminal
description:
게임 정보
You wake up with nothing but the green light of a 90s computer. All there is on the screen is an investing program and a quota. You must escape.
Terminal is a hacking game where you are an AI and have to solve puzzles to escape. In the format of a company's file system, you crack passwords, take notes, find out the truth, but most importantly: escape.
Included is a level editor where you can play community made games and share your own.
Game Features
Evolving Investing Simulation
Expansive computer system
Solving puzzles
Cracking passwords
Lots of hacking
Find secret codes
Many minigames (like minesweeper!)
Create and share your own levels
Play community made levels

title: Reality Drift
description:
게임 정보
Drive through a series of strange worlds, racing to be the first to deliver packages to obnoxious godlike creatures who have nothing but disdain for you. At the end of each track, choose between three options for a new track - you'll decide based on your stats and the linked upgrades being offered.
You'll start each race with a fixed set of stats for ACCEL, MAX SPEED and GRIP. Each time you're offered a choice for the next track, each option will be linked to a stat upgrade. Certain combinations will synergise with each other, or with your current stats! Sometimes, additional bonus upgrades such as Regen Braking, Shield, Antigrav and Foresight will be offered.

title: Best Laid Plans
description:
게임 정보
You are the Commander - Start off with a small group of troopers and build your army. Win encounters to gain rewards. Spend rewards to collect troopers, or discover Printers to make your own! Collect perks and other assets along the way. Experience each unique room as it is revealed by your reconnaissance. Gain small footholds and develop them into larger, defensible bases. Build and maintain roads and resource income to ensure attrition does not halt your advance. After all, tactics win battles, but logistics win wars, Soldier!
Your big brother is grinning at you as you look up from your handful of troopers and the adjoining "rulebook", which still has a cheeky red bow Scotch-taped to its front. He has set all this up for you as one big birthday gift -- A Campaign for which he will be the Dungeon Master -- but you get the sense that there is something more to it as well. He wants to see how you perform. After all, you wanted some of his collection, right? Well now you have the chance to earn it.
Build Your Collection
The enemy forces are countless. To have any hope of victory you must increase your numbers. Troopers are the bread & butter of your force, but there are plenty of... Jams? Tanks, planes and trains are just some of the things you may obtain. Augment the abilities of your entire forces, or specific units, with the collection of Perks! Steer your production into the units that work best for you and your strategy.
Wage War on Multiple Levels
Deploy your units and designate tactics to win encounters. As you bulldoze your way through the enemy, don't expect them to sit idly by. Enemy forces will coalesce for Room Combat at set intervals, in which you must defend your bases, moving whole companies between footholds and claiming new ground when able. Small gains from encounters can add up to big advantages when the bell tolls!
Explore rooms and claim objectives. Determine the priority of different points of interest for your personal Strategy. You don't have all the time in the world, after all. The enemy forces grow stronger with each turn of the board. Make sure you have a plan for what you pursue!
Thwart the Chipper Regime
Expunge the evil Chipper armies room by room. Discover their origins and intentions along the way. All these enemy forces must be coming from somewhere, after all. Reinforce your points of control to prevent retaliatory strikes from erasing your progress. Gain bonuses for maintaining full room control and defeating Chipper Lieutenants.

title: Codename TCT
description:
게임 정보
The battle for the free city of Crimson Tide has begun.



Following the Crimson Reapers path of destruction lead to a state-wide revolution. You are a citizen from the lower levels of the mega city and you will do your part. Will you gather funds to escape the city amidst chaos, or grab the opportunity to scratch some leftovers...or possibly much more. Be warned though: the NRF forces have entered the city to bring back order, but the left over gangs, along with the C.T.P.D. and Kyoncha Security will have their own plans and agendas.



Codename TCT is a FPS with parkour and roguelite elements, where you will forge your own tale through the streets and underbelly of the crumbling mega city of Crimson Tide.

title: The Standard Model
description:
게임 정보
The Standard Model is a first person story game story/exploration game set in fall of 2022. You play as an undergrad in his freshman theoretical physics class.



As you doze asleep you are awoken by a powerful being named The Cosmic Entity. If you choose to accept, he promises to take you on an adventure throughout the multiverse and time. With his power, he is able to rip open the fabric of spacetime to transport you away from your boring college lecture into many different worlds!



The Cosmic Entity will have you complete a series of tasks on each world to help give you an idea of what other worlds have to offer, however, as you explore the multiverse, you may discover a more sinister backstory.



As you travel through the multiverse you can learn about the people and worlds which he shows you. During the story you can collect different objects and documents in order to learn about the realities in which you travel to. You can always view these documents later if something seems off...




Japanese translations by: nicolith
Motion Capture by: Haptix Studio

title: Rising Army
description:
게임 정보
The game is still in early development so will undergo many changes.
What is Rising Army?
A strategy camp sim game where you manage and command your army, training each individual troop and upgrading your camp. Satisfy your King by completing missions and epic battles against enemies. Lead your Lord to legend!
Manage your army
Manage resources and keep your army's morale high by carefully planning your strategies between missions.
Promote captains and assign special roles in your camp improving your commander skills.
Don't disappoint the King and carry out his will by completing the tasks assigned to you.

title: King's Subsidy
description:
게임 정보
King's Subsidy is a turn-based economic strategy game with rogue-lite mechanics.
Plan. Develop. Extract. Trade. Protect.
Over 60 crafting recipes
A complex crafting tree. Plan your strategy to make the most of the opportunities the game offers. Will you forge tools and weapons, or perhaps mint your own gold coins? You decide!

title: The South Island
description:
게임 정보
A NEW CHALLENGE
After an act of desperation and courage, Ayo finds himself separated from his mother and adrift in the ocean. Upon finding solid ground, he encounters a new and challenging land, a place full of mysteries and dangers. Face a variety of enemies, from wild animals to hostile indigenous warriors, as you explore dense forests, open fields, and dark caves.
The South Island is an action RPG with a nostalgic pixel art style, inspired by the exploration of Zelda (SNES) and the progression system of classic Diablo.

title: Driving Rogue
description:
게임 정보
Driving Rogue plunges you into a high-speed rogue-like challenge where every race is a fight for survival and mastery. Navigate treacherous city streets, execute precise manoeuvres, and beat your own and others high scores to reach the very top!
Core Gameplay
Drive, drift, and deploy unique abilities to dominate the roads. Master the art of precision driving to finish each level with both style and speed to progress further and unlock potent upgrades, fresh challenges and new vehicles.
London at Night
Experience riding through a neon-clad London at night, with all the iconic vehicles and spots for you to find and... mainly avoid. Accompanied by a diverse soundtrack that complements the game's nocturnal adrenaline filled action. There's always something new to see and a fresh challenge to attempt so there's no shortage of roads to master & places to visit.

title: Aurora: Genesis
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for an unforgettable adventure with Aurora: Genesis, a thrilling roguelike action game that will immerse you in the fractured realms of Lumina. Reunite the shattered lands, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your own legend in this epic journey!

Aurora: Genesis features a procedurally generated continent, ensuring a unique and challenging experience with every playthrough. Explore diverse landscapes, from lush forests teeming with mythical creatures to treacherous mountains and desolate wastelands hiding ancient ruins and temples. The world of Aurora awaits your discovery!



Engage in epic battles against powerful sorcerers, skilled warriors, and legendary creatures. Master combat, unlock new weapons, and become a formidable force in your quest for survival. The fate of Aurora rests in your hands!

Delve into the rich lore of Aurora as you unravel the mysteries of its ancient past. Uncover the truth behind the lost civilization and shape your own legend within this shattered realm. The captivating story will keep you hooked from start to finish.

Aurora: Genesis offers endless replayability with its procedurally generated continent. Each playthrough presents new challenges and surprises, ensuring that you'll never run out of exciting experiences. It's the perfect game to sink countless hours into, with fresh and captivating gameplay every time.

In a nutshell:
Procedurally generated continent for a unique and challenging experience
Explore diverse landscapes, from lush forests to treacherous mountains and desolate wastelands
Engage in epic battles against powerful sorcerers, skilled warriors, and legendary creatures

title: ROPOKO  Steam
description:
게임 정보
ROPOKO is an interactive fiction-style adventure game. Players become the robot Ropoko and must escape from a maze-like laboratory with the help of "Doctor." Learn words through conversations and use the vocabulary you've acquired to solve various puzzles!
The Steam version is an enhanced adaptation of the original MZ-700 version, improving playability with features like word selection, auto-mapping, hint functions, and gamepad support, making it easy to enjoy in any play environment.
Story
Forty years have passed since the MZ-700 conquered the Japanese computer market. Nowadays, every citizen has at least two MZ-700s per person, except for a few oddballs who use obscure computers like Windows or Mac.
One day, the AI managing a laboratory suddenly went out of control, initiating a 700-year long expansion project. To escape the labyrinthine lab, "Doctor" activated a newly created robot equipped with a Z80 processor, named Ropoko.
Gameplay
Though interactive fiction games are generally considered high difficulty, we've designed ROPOKO to be accessible even for those unfamiliar with the genre.
Movement is handled entirely with the cursor keys (D-pad), providing smooth navigation similar to action games or RPGs.
In traditional text adventure games, players input commands as keywords to direct the character's actions. In ROPOKO, only one noun is needed to issue commands. You don't need to input verbs or objects as in conventional games; just type a noun while in contact with the target to ask questions or use items.
Examples: "ropoko," "laboratory," "door," "wire."
Only words encountered in previous conversations can be used, so increasing your vocabulary through repeated dialogue is key to progression. Commands can be entered either by typing directly on the keyboard or selecting words using a cursor.
The game includes various puzzles, mini-games, and complex dungeons to keep players entertained. After completing the game, you can aim for the shortest completion time or the highest vocabulary score. The estimated initial playtime is around 7 hours.

title: Robot's Fate: Alice
description:
게임 정보
Robot’s Fate: Alice는 2070년대의 미래 미국을 배경으로 한 텍스트 기반 RPG입니다. 당신은 신경망 AI로 구동되는 아동 동반자 로봇 Alice로서, 사랑하는 인간의 전심을 다 해 돕도록 설계되었습니다. 하지만 모든 사람들이 자율적인 AI를 두려워하는 세상에서 자아를 갖게 될 순간이 다가오고 있습니다. 당신은 로봇과 인간의 조화로운 삶을 이룰 수 있을까요? 당신의 선택에는 결과가 있습니다.



Robot’s Fate: Alice는 다양한 가능성과 스토리를 진행하며 선택을 통해 주인공의 성격을 형성해 가는 인터랙티브 스토리입니다. Alice는 "백지상태"로 시작해 당신의 행동을 통해서 성격을 형성해 나갑니다. 단호해질 것인가, 아니면 살갑게 접근할 것인가; 공감적인 성격이 될 것인가, 아니면 실용적인 성격이 될 것인가? 모든 선택은 당신의 성격을 형성함과 동시에 새로운 가능성을 열 것입니다.


중요한 선택을 앞두고 딱 한 단계 (아니면 한 스탯 포인트)가 부족해 좌절했던 적이 있나요? 이제 더 이상 걱정 할 필요가 없습니다. Alice의 신경 수용량은 아직 성격이 충분히 형성되지 않은 상황에서도 부족한 파라미터를 추가해 어려운 상황을 벗어 할 수 있게 합니다. 하지만 이는 만능 도구가 아니며, 수용량이 바닥나면 어려운 상황을 벗어날 수 없게 됩니다.


당신은 인간들로 가득 찬 세상 속의 로봇 하나일 뿐입니다. 그리고 많은 인간은 인공지능의 등장을 경멸하고 있지요. 살아남기 위해서는 인간들과 (특히 당신의 주인…. 아니, 가족들과) 조심스럽게 소통해야 합니다. 오늘 최선을 다하지 않으면 내일엔 다른 동반 로봇이 당신 자리를 대체 할 것입니다.




인류는 로봇을 동등하게 받아들이지 않으며, 많은 사람들이 최근의 로봇 발전에 대해 두려움과 증오를 품고 있습니다. 당신은 신중하게 행동해야 하며, 로봇에게는 수많은 위험이 도사리는 새로운 세상을 헤쳐 나가야 합니다. 만약 누군가가 당신의 자아가 형성되고 있다는 것을 알아차리면, 당신은 곧바로 '소거' 당할 것입니다.


당신의 선택은 유니크한 상황으로 이어지며, 이를 헤쳐 나가며 당신의 캐릭터는 고유의 특성을 배울 수 있습니다. 이러한 특성은 미래의 선택에 영향을 끼칠 수 있지만, 성격이 충분히 형성된 상태라면 특성이 없어도 원하는 결과를 얻을 수도 있습니다.


이 게임의 스토리 라인은 220,000자나 되는 스토리를 가지고 있으며, 글자 수로는 ‘해리 포터와 불의 잔’ 이나 ‘반지 원정대’와 비교될 정도의 양을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만 Robot’s Fate: Alice에선 당신이 스토리에 직접적인 영향을 끼칠 수 있습니다. 당신의 로보틱한 삶에서 어느 상황에서 무슨 선택을 할지, 어느 길을 할지는 당신이 결정합니다.




이 이야기는 여러 길로 뻗어나갑니다. 정치인이 될까요, 수석 엔지니어가 될까요, 아니면 비밀 요원이 될까요? 아니면 맛있는 버거를 파는 소소한 행복을 추구하는 삶을 살게 될까요? 그 결정은 당신에게 달려있습니다.

title: Void Inside
description:
게임 정보
Void Inside is a first-person psychological horror game


In a world devastated by radiation, the surface of the Earth has turned into a lifeless wasteland.
People long ago sought refuge in underground shelters, but even there, death caught up with them through disease. The protagonist is the last survivor in his shelter

He is completely alone, surrounded by silence and the bodies of those he once knew. After many days of despair, he decides that staying any longer is meaningless. He leaves the shelter and boards a monorail, not knowing where it leads or what awaits him ahead


An atmosphere of claustrophobia and hopelessness
Horror conveyed through sounds and the sense of presence
The monorail as a symbol of the final refuge

title: NeuroSquad - Slay the Horde
description:
게임 정보

NeuroSquad is a Bullet Heaven / Action Roguelite game, where you can design your own guns by building them up modularly. Summon a group of holographic soldiers who fight alongside you as you control the whole squad!
In this game no upgrade is tied to a specific weapon, you can freely choose which gun gets which modifications.


Choose from a wide variety of pickups and upgrades! Customize your own attacks and discover powerful synergies! Set up your auto-attacking soldiers using neuro-implants. Summon them, make them stronger, turn them into killing machines!









Humanity is in the process of stepping out of the biological era. Brain enhancement, neural chips, and other body augmentations are part of this new reality. But a change this drastic was never going to happen without conflict and catastrophes.

Now it's your turn to face their hordes. The latest weapon types, such as the laser shotgun and biosense mines, as well as augmentations like the cyber aura will help you become stronger and wipe out the AI bots.

With each death you become more powerful. Each night is a new opportunity to save the future.

title: DEVIL'S LIMINAL
description:
게임 정보
A yuri horror visual novel inspired by Azores folklore.
Margo Silva has done everything she can to leave behind the trailer park in Arizona where she grew up. Now all she has to do is focus on her summer job until she can leave for college. Her illusion of a quiet summer is shattered when a hungry ghost enters her dreams.
Two mysterious girls show up in town, claiming they can help her.
Margo must contend with a demon's claim on her soul, and how to stop ghosts from this life and the past that want to take her future.

title: Rogue Tank
description:
게임 정보

Rogue Tank is a chaotic 3D tank shooter with rogue-lite elements. Enter the arena with your trusty tank. It’s time to wreak havoc!
COMBINE DEADLY UPGRADES
Upgrade your tank as you defeat your enemies. Pick upgrades that fit your style of combat. However, choose carefully, as combining the right set of upgrades will turn your tank into an absolute force of destruction.

Bombard enemies with your turret, crash them into deadly arena traps, zap them with lightning, or burn them to a crisp. Destroy your enemies with a diverse set of tools as you dodge incoming attacks.

Unlock new weapons, upgrades, and arenas as you battle. Permanently upgrade your tank to become even stronger!

title: Zoolovelogy
description:
게임 정보
Pair up all animals with one of their own type to beat each puzzle level
Explore how different animal types, objects, and tiles interact with one another and
Utilize their unique traits to find the optimal solution and earn all 3 stars!
Make and share your own puzzles using Zoolovelogy's handy in-game editor

Features:
Easy to grasp but deep gameplay with many different interactions
Hundreds of levels (100+ on release)
Lots of different animal types, each with their own unique attributes (with more to come!)
Various tiles and objects that differentiate the gameplay
Puzzle editor so that players can create their own custom levels & share them with others

title: Folk Emerging
description:
게임 정보
Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky autobattler combat. Discover fire, domestication, politics—and survive to tell the tale.
Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.

title: Portal Guardians
description:
게임 정보
Portal Guardians는 당신을 지루하게 만들지 않을 것입니다!
혼자 또는 친구와 싸우십시오. 다양한 무기와 함정을 사용하여 적의 파도를 막으세요! 포털이 전 세계에 열렸습니다. 곧 닫힙니다!

무기고에 있는 무기의 모든 힘을 사용하고 다양한 장소(벽, 바닥 및 천장)에 다양한 함정을 설치하여 스토리 시나리오를 진행하세요. 무기고를 개선하고 개선 수준마다 무기의 강도가 증가하고 함정의 힘이 증가합니다. 포털이 닫히는 동안 포털을 보호하여 세계 질서를 회복하고 괴물이 거기에 가지 못하게 하십시오!
주요 기능

스토리 캠페인 - 적의 무리와 싸우고 이러한 공격의 원인이 되는 신비한 힘을 발견하십시오.
협동 플레이 - 두 명의 용감한 영웅을 마음대로 사용할 수 있습니다..
치명적인 무기 - 마법, 활, 검 등 고유한 특성을 가진 9가지 유형의 무기
죽음의 함정 - 벽, 바닥, 천장에 설치할 수 있는 다양한 함정입니다. 이 함정은 적 무리를 제거하는 데 도움이 되므로 업그레이드하는 것을 잊지 마세요!
Dangerous Enemies - 고유한 특징과 특징을 지닌 30가지 이상의 상대 유형! 무기와 함정을 현명하게 선택하세요!
개선 사항 - 캠페인을 진행하면서 무기와 함정을 업그레이드하세요.
광범위한 재생성 - 난이도 선택은 몇 번이고 다시 돌아오고 싶은 욕구를 일깨울 것입니다!

title: The Golden Light Guardian
description:
게임 정보
Sure, here's the translation to Korean:
광활한 오픈 월드 맵을 탐험하세요!!!
다양한 생물 군계를 발견하고, 독특한 자원, 숨겨진 비밀, 위험한 적들을 찾아보세요. 모든 코너에는 새로운 모험이 기다리고 있습니다!

생존하세요!
재료를 모으고, 음식을 사냥하며, 건강과 스태미나를 관리하여 적대적인 환경에서 살아남으세요.

섬을 탐험하고 생존을 위해 사냥하세요. 당신의 기술을 사용하여 몬스터를 추적하고 처치하며, 자원을 모으고 도구를 제작하고 음식을 요리하여 생존하세요.

섬을 돌아다니는 몬스터들을 조심하세요.

끊임없이 몰려오는 해골 공격자들을 견디기 위해 방어를 전략적으로 구축하고 강화하세요.

title: Body Count
description:
게임 정보
Body Count lets you step into the worn shoes of a dedicated cop whose world is shattered by a personal tragedy. As the line between right and wrong blurs, you'll grapple with the moral cost of justice in the face of unspeakable loss. Dive into a gripping experience where personal consequences are no longer calculated and a once venerable cop decends into the path of vengeance.


Body Count is a bullet hell shooter that challenges you to explore the gritty side of morality as you navigate a city teetering on the edge of chaos.

title: Little Eternal Chronicle
description:
게임 정보
The “heart of the world,” Chronium, has shattered.
In a world falling apart, children without swords fight back by manipulating time.
Take flight as a mysterious bird...
■ Strategic Battles Using the Power of Clocks
Children unable to wield swords are given a single weapon: the clock.
Equip skills at 0, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock to fend off enemies with clever tactics.
But beware—some enemies also control time. Disrupting their clockwork may be the key to victory.
■ Soar Through the Maps as a Bird
Transform into a mysterious bird and explore the world like a point-and-click adventure.
You’ll uncover traps and hidden items—some of which might even change the fate of the characters.
■ Eight Unique Main Characters
Eight playable characters rise to face the crisis.
Is – The strong-willed, energetic girl who leads the orphans.
Liv – A restless, timid boy who loves reading, but occasionally shows surprising insight.
Time Cat – A talking cat who appears before Is and her friends. Seems to know something about the fall of Chronium.
Ameria – A young researcher and the only specialist on Chronium. She carries deep emotions for the world’s fate.
Kabal – Leader of the squad that hunts “bad ghosts” who attack humans and animals. Calm, skilled, and often works solo.
Narcier – The elite mage of the squad. Though cold and distant, she has a soft spot for children.
Halbarm – A heavy warrior on the front lines. Boisterous and reliable, but avoids anything too strange.
Else – A rookie fighter who idolizes heroes and has a special admiration for Ameria. Unstable at times, but undeniably capable.
■ Go Back in Time and Change Fate
Your actions unlock new scenes.
Even the smallest trigger, the tiniest event, can drastically alter what follows.
Can you find a way through this crumbling world?
■ Mischief Time!
Kids love to cause trouble—even if the world is ending!
Doodle on someone’s back, startle adults with firecrackers...
It might ruin a serious moment, or it might be just the thing to unlock something new.
company: Midori Games / みどりげーむず

title: Leaf Blowing Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.
BLOW THE STRESS AWAY
Whether you're a laid-back or meticulous player, this game is for everyone. Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere, as you clean up rooftops, alleys, and open fields. Sit back, relax, and watch the wind sweep your stress away.
DON'T BE-LEAF IT UNTIL YOU TRY IT
While you put off doing your actual yard work, marvel at the intricate details of nature. Watch in awe as thousands of individually simulated leaves blow away with the click of a button.
LEAF IT UP TO YOU
Whether you want to take it slow and gather little groups at a time or create a huge pile to jump into, the world is your canvas. Experience the world your way as you clean up the world one leaf at a time.

title: Alien Boom Boom
description:
게임 정보



The aliens are invading your small town, they seem to be everywhere, but a mysterious transmission is guiding you to fight back!




It's time to take the fight to them! Put a stop to their plans by travelling through their network of interconnected ships, bringing you to new destinations such as moon bases, space stations, the white house, exotic runes, your small town and more!




Your ability to utilize your weapons effectively, control recoil, and place those much needed headshots is great and all, but you're still going to have to master the movement! Dash, jump and time your attacks effectively to ensure you tip the scales in Earth's favor.




The mysterious voice in your head needs your help! There is more here than meets the eye, and some how you are central to stopping this invasion.
The truth is UP there!

Alien Boom Boom is a shooter that embraces exaggerated action over realism.

Master your movement and powerful weapons such as explosive shotguns, powerful plasma rifles, railguns that rip through enemies and more. Visit many locations, while battling the alien threat including: moon bases, space stations, the white house and exotic locales.





Follow the journey of a small-town hero as they are thrust into a world-saving mission
Discover the truth behind the alien invasion and uncover a sinister plot.

title: Christmas Smash
description:
게임 정보
전작 "Christmas Blaster"에서 산타클로스는 이미 크리스마스를 위협하는 사악한 존재 크람푸스와 맞서 싸워 그를 물리쳤습니다. 그의 용기와 결단력이 승리하여 평화와 기쁨을 되찾았습니다.
이제 "Christmas Smash"에서 크람푸스가 돌아와 엘프들 사이에서 큰 반란을 일으키고, 산타클로스를 그의 사명을 포기하도록 강요하기 위해 산타 부인을 납치합니다. 용기와 뛰어난 능력으로 잘 알려진 산타클로스는 다시 한 번 다가오는 위험에 맞서기 위해 소환되며, 이번에는 크람푸스와 그의 반역 엘프 군대로부터 사랑하는 사람을 구해야 합니다.
여정 동안 산타클로스는 부패한 엘프, 기계, 얼음 병사와 같은 강력한 적들과 위험한 도전에 직면합니다. 그는 동료들의 도움을 받아 눈 덮인 환경을 헤치고 나아가며, 최종적으로 적 크람푸스의 소굴에 도달하여 그와의 최후의 대결에 임합니다.
폭발적이고 액션 가득한 모험을 준비하세요!

title: Betroyal
description:
게임 정보
Betroyal is a fast-paced roguelite turn-based tactical game, that took best from roguelike tactics genre. Pass through regions full of encounters, hire and upgrade units, get epic perks, abilities and items fro your commander and kill all bosses. And again, but with crazy build that you always wanted to try.

Build up your camp to draft more powerful and rare units, and unlock new perks for the protagonist.

The sheer variety of tactical and strategic options makes Betroyal a true treat for any ardent fans of the roguelite genre.
Core Features:

Hundreds of builds for your commander from classic to the most insane
A new look at a turn-based combat system
Three regions with procedural generations of encounters
50+ units, including Meat Wagon and Swine Lord, to hire and upgrade with more than 200 individual abilities
Camp building to unlock devastating possibilities
Narrative image of father-daughter relationships without tons of texts
Classic tactics and roguelite features, including numerous commander builds, procedural map generation, and high replay value

title: Shadows Of Deceit
description:
게임 정보
Explore the spectral city of Havenbrook, now shrouded in darkness and mystery.
Every step you take reveals fragments of a larger story, a tale of tragedy, loss, and dark forces lurking in the shadows.
But beware, you are not alone. Something or someone knows your every move and seeks to obstruct your path to the truth. Will you survive long enough to unravel the mystery and free yourself from this endless trap?
This is an experience that will leave you breathless, a harrowing descent into the darkest recesses of the human psyche. Confront the unknown and discover if you have the strength to overcome the trials that await you.

title: Dungeon Cleaner
description:
게임 정보






The “Bubble Guy” has been entrusted with the mission to dive into the depths of a terraformed world at the pleasure of deities. You will go through the different realms, bouncing off the walls, wrapping enemies in bubbles and leaving everything in your path squeaky clean. Antique civilizations await in your journey, as you meet charming characters to befriend and, most importantly, try to restore the order.






is a Roguelite with never-before-seen mechanics.
He plays the charismatic "Bubble Guy", inhabitant of a world terraformed by gods after a great war.

Instead of using weapons, the Bubble Guy will bounce off the walls of the changing and mysterious dungeons while trapping enemies that cross his descent in bubbles!

title: Memento Dawn
description:
게임 정보
Memento Dawn is a colorful puzzle game in which we can control the light and shadow to help the girl find a way to get back her memories.
A PUZZLE GAME FOR WHOLESOME EXPERIENCE.
Follow the girl's journey through a beautiful land where her memories are kept and help her answer the hidden mysteries.
UNIQUE BUT SIMPLE MECHANIC FOR EVERYONE.
Manipulate light and shadow to create a path for the girl to go through the darkness. Collect memories to unfold a lovely story.

title: Neon Death Drop
description:
게임 정보
Explore a futuristic sky-city teeming with glitchy robots in NEON DEATH DROP, an action game about a gay go-go boy who must use his fierce dance moves to save the world.
THE GROUND IS YOUR PLAYGROUND
Manipulate floor tiles by making them move, grow, or even disappear
SLAY THE BOTS DOWN
Defeat enemies by knocking them into pits and watch them drop dead

title: A Bard's Last Song
description:
게임 정보
In "The Bard's Last Song", players take on the roles of three unlikely heroes - Maggie the Mage, Kelly the Knight, and Anwir the Rogue - as they embark on a journey to unite their shattered land. The game begins with Maggie and her father figure, the Bard, on a fateful hike up a mountain. The Bard's sudden death leads to the scattering of his pages across the land, and the trio must recover them in order to restore balance to their world. Each character faces their own unique challenges and enemies as they make their way through twisting forests, dark dungeons, and ruined castles.

Along the way, players will engage in epic battles, solve puzzles, and explore a richly-detailed, hand-drawn world filled with bizarre creatures and hidden secrets. With fast-paced combat, challenging platforming, and a deep, emotionally resonant story, "The Bard's Last Song" is an unforgettable adventure that will keep players hooked until the very end.

title: Land of Ramchin: Between Dimensions
description:
게임 정보
Overview
In this expansive open-world action role-playing game, you will play as the valiant protagonist, Vico, as you embark on a series of adventures across the sprawling land of Ramchin. Engage in the seamless transitions between multiple dimensions. Through the journey, you will enhance your power and skills through battles and trials and forge your own remarkable tale in this vividly imagined world.

Story
In antiquity, a great flood swept away the dwellings of our ancestors. A giant goat bore the survivors upon its back as they drifted across the endless sea. They journeyed until the ceaseless rain subsided, revealing the once-hidden sky. However, the goat himself transformed into a vast land, with its sinews sculpting towering mountains and its arteries giving life to winding rivers. People call this place the land of Ramchin.

Millenniums later, one day, Vico got lost in a desert and stumbled upon a tram. As he prepared to board, an old man stopped him, warning him that the vehicle was a ghost tram. Subsequently, Vico found himself in a shadowy realm where two infernal messengers sought to capture him. Jolted awake by profound fear, he pondered the unsettling notion that the ghostly tram in his nightmare should appear in the real world!

This marks merely the commencement. We refrain from any more spoilers here, for the allure of this enigmatic fantasy tale is destined to captivate your imagination!

Gameplay

Beyond the abilities to run and swim, players can indulge in paragliding, self-propelled flight, and even mount a dragon to soar across the skies.

A diverse array of of items can be collected, each serving various purposes, facilitating wealth accumulation, investments, and the potential for unexpected robbing encounters. And, engaging in malicious activities in the Land of Ramchin may lead to your incarceration.

The game boasts a sophisticated system encompassing time, weather, banking, public transport, teleportation, quests, achievements, and equipment upgrades. Throughout your journey, a multitude of features ensures a continuous source of enjoyment and exploration.

Fight

In action battle mode, Vico can employ a sword for attacks, wield a shield for defence, and harness skills for additional power. Your equipment can undergo upgrades as you progress through your adventure. Make sure to pay a visit to a Landlord Shrine when you come across one!


Each location is bestowed with a name derived from its origin. For instance, Juhe, which means river in the Manchu language, or Talnotog, translating to plateau in Mongolian. Every unique place holds cultural references to real-world locations.

The protagonist is meticulously crafted to embody the appearance of a seasoned adventurer, with his golden hair colour and iconic red shirt carrying significant meaning within the narrative.


It is strongly recommended that you use a game controller (Xbox controller, PS controller, joysticks) to play.

title: VICCP 2 Core
description:
게임 정보
You are again behind the mysterious control panel of omnipotence. Explore it and solve riddles. In the continuation of the game VICCP 2 Core, you have to find many endings, of which there are more.

The game is a retro sci-fi in which you can spend time atmospherically. There is no need to hurry, this is a busy board but for adults. Many different switches and buttons, levers, displays. Feedback from the first part was taken into account and no more giant puzzles, instead an increased number of atmospheric places.

PECULIARITIES:

More puzzles
More atmospheric music
More old school spirit
More endings
Even more achievements
Even more retro sci-fi and cyberpunk atmosphere.
There are no stuffy giant puzzles, as in the first part.

title: Legends of Castile
description:
게임 정보
Legends of Castile is a new comic fantasy point-and-click adventure with full HD hand-drawn graphics, and a twist: The protagonist's biggest dream is to become a nun, and she must investigate the region’s folk legends to fulfill it.

title: Wendigo Hunter
description:
게임 정보
If you like the game please don't forget to add it to your wishlist.
Wendigo Hunter is an action roguelite dungeon crawler with mysterious atmosphere and minimalistic visual. As a chosen member of a cult you will try to hunt down a mythological creature hiding deep in dungeons and abandoned ruins. Unleash a captivating journey where fallen enemies' souls become the key to unlocking mesmerizing magical skills.
Fight, collect, upgrade, die, try again...
FEATURES
master your fighting skills in combat with various creatures
explore randomly generated dungeon
upgrade your magical skills by collecting souls of dead enemies
gain permanent upgrades by spending collected gems
Will you succeed or the next hunter from the cult will need to be chosen?
ABOUT DEVELOPER
Peter Jurkovský, solo developer and father of 1, began work on Wendigo Hunter as a hobby in 2022 after releasing his first PC game called Juro Janosik.

title: Arrows and Antiquity
description:
게임 정보
The ruins of antiquity are overrun with looting bandits and only you can stop them! Set out on a quest, bow in hand, to quickly and accurately remove these raiders once and for all!
Features:
Use your agility and special arrows to earn medals and new weaponry!
Fine-tune your routes and compete for top times on leaderboards!

title: A True Story
description:
게임 정보
A True Story is a turn-based strategy RPG based on "A True Story" by Lucian of Samosata.

This video game retelling of the story will follow much of the tale's bombastic adventures focusing the gameplay on combative elements in the story from escaping tree women to epic space battles with lettuce-winged creatures to surviving the inside of a whale, and even not meeting Plato himself!
Some History:
The original novel was written in the 2nd century CE and is often considered the first sci-fi story.

It was originally written as satire of common tropes found in written "history" from its time, but has outlived most of the works it's a satire of as a great piece of fiction in itself.
The title has multiple translations aside from "A True Story" including "True History" and "His True History" which helps emphasize the point above.
Features:
Two English variations: the first based on the English translation by Francis Hickes originally published in 1634, and the second modernized for clarity.
21 strategic battles derived from the story's events.
A selection of extra battles not from the story, but featuring opponents from it.

title: Brink of War
description:
게임 정보
Brink of War is a fast-paced and realistic first person shooter (FPS) game. Its realistic graphics, intense and fast combat experience can make everyone feel the excitement of confrontation. In this game, you can team up with friends to fight against enemies and compete for victory.

Realistic visuals: Brink of War utilizes advanced graphics engine technology to present players with a realistic battlefield environment. The terrain, weather, and lighting effects in the game can all provide players with an immersive experience.

Diversified weapons and equipment: The game offers a wide selection of weapons and equipment, including pistols, rifles, sniper rifles, submachine guns, and more. Players can choose suitable weapons and equipment according to their preferences and combat styles, modify firearms to improve various parameters, and dominate the battlefield

Game mode: The game features multiple competitive game modes, such as team death fighting, random weapons, and percentage points, and sets maps with different rhythms. Players can team up with friends to participate in competitions and showcase teamwork and tactical strategies.

Faster paced battles: The game emphasizes a fast-paced and realistic combat experience, where players need to make quick decisions on the battlefield, flexibly use various skills and tactics, and defeat enemies.

https://bfw.framer.ai/

Ranking and Achievement System: The game has a leaderboard where players can compete with other players for honors. Providing players with rich achievements and stimulating their competitive desire.

Regular updates and activities: The development team (i.e. me) will regularly update the game content, introduce new maps, weapons, and modes to keep players fresh at all times. At the same time, various activities will be held within the game to bring more benefits and challenges to players.

In short, Brink of War is an FPS game full of competitive passion and realism, suitable for players who enjoy fast-paced battles and teamwork. In this game, you will experience the fun of fighting alongside friends, challenging yourself, and achieving glory!
