title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
description:
게임 정보
Rumours are that the AfterSchool Adventurers Club started playing a very strange version of the "Adventurers & Perils" tabletop roleplaying game lately!
Most of the club members have left, too scared of what could happen to them on a bad roll, but, for some reasons, your best friend Billy and his party went in last week, never to be seen again.
Some students have tried to warn the teachers, but none would listen. Adults, right? Always too busy with work and stuff to see the truth!
There is no other choice, only you can do it!
As you open the door to the AfterSchool Adventurers Club, you see the evil grin on the Game Master's face:
"A new player? Roll for initiative!"
Gameplay
AfterSchool Adventurers Club is a rogue-lite dungeon-crawler game set in the 80's, where players prepare for their runs in the high-school's tabletop roleplaying club before entering the fantastic world of Vanderfell to delve into perilous dungeons, fight treacherous monsters, uncover special events and face formidable bosses to solve the mystery of the AfterSchool Adventurers Club!
Features
Randomized dungeons for endless replayabiity.
Multiple quests and events to keep runs fresh.
12 Unique classes, each with their own passive skill and starting gear, to fit your favored playstyle.
Lootable Weapons, Spell books, Accessories and Consumables to help adapt on the go.
Various Table Items to combine in the club to further customize your runs and character.
No power meta progression, your skills as a player is what matters!
Built for the Sega Master System, for an authentic retro feel.

title: Project Box
description:
게임 정보
Horror x Thriller x Fantasy


A surreal 2D side-scrolling puzzle-adventure.
Looking for clues: To reveal the truth of old cases.
Enter a bizarre and curious world and start a fantastical adventure.




Story

Children in the apartment complex are searching for their missing friend, unwittingly becoming entangled in a decade-long murder case.
The residents, while avoiding the topic, whisper terrifying rumors behind closed doors.

Among them are a strange landlord couple, a murderer living in the penthouse, siblings traumatized by witnessing their mother's suicide, a creepy doctor practicing medicine illegally, and a grocery store owner obsessed with collecting shrouds.
The question looms : who is the perpetrator of these horrifying crimes?

Hidden in the dark corners of the apartment lies a secret unknown to all—a tragic box reeking of death and the disturbing sound of crying echoing in the hallways.After tonight, the truth may be buried forever.

title: Custom Goban
description:
게임 정보
커스텀 고반(Custom Goban)은 바둑을 재해석한 것으로, 바둑은 전략적 사고와 계획의 복잡성 면에서 체스에 필적하는 아시아의 고전적인 지적 보드 게임이라고 할 수 있습니다. 고전적인 19x19 바둑판에서 플레이하는 것은 많은 플레이어들에게 여전히 흥미로운 일이겠지만, 커스텀 고반은 자신만의 영역을 만들고 전통적인 바둑 규칙에 따른 플레이를 나누어 할 수 있는 기회를 제공하고 있습니다. 이것은 재미있을 뿐만 아니라 게임에 더 많은 창의성을 가져오고 플레이어들이 새로운 방식으로 생각하게 할 것입니다. 게임 시간을 단축하기 위해 기존의 361점의 게임보다 작은 새로운 보드를 만들어낼 수 있으며, 그렇다고 하여 단지 "또 다른 더 작은 사각 보드"가 되지는 않을 것입니다. 숙련된 바둑 기사이든, 이제 막 시작한 바둑 초보이든, 여러분은 좋아하실 거에요!
특징
여러분만의 바둑판 모양을 만듭니다. 구멍 및 불규칙성 부여 가능
공개적으로 서버의 다른 사용자와 PvP를 플레이 가능
친구와 P2P 또는 동일한 기기에서 플레이 가능
KataGo 인공지능과 바둑판에서 겨뤄보세요
플레이를 위해 OGS(Online Go Server)에 연결하세요
미니멀리즘적이고 잘 설계된 UI를 사용합니다
크로스 플랫폼 플레이: iOS, Android(개발 중)

title: HUNTER REVENGE
description:
게임 정보
Hunter revenge is an action game where the objective is to survive on a completely unknown planet that has creatures whose main objective is to exterminate any and all existing life.

title: Plumber’s Legacy
description:
게임 정보
Plumber's Legacy is a charming 2D platformer that pays tribute to the golden age of gaming. Jump, run, and stomp your way through a colorful world filled with tricky platforms, hidden secrets, and the occasional enemy trying to ruin your day.
Your mission is simple: make it to the end of each handcrafted level and uncover the plumber's forgotten legacy. Whether you're leaping over lava pits, dodging falling blocks, or bopping baddies on the head, every level brings new challenges and nostalgic fun.
Perfect for fans of retro platformers, Plumber's Legacy offers straightforward gameplay, tight controls, and just the right amount of challenge to keep you coming back for one more run.

title: Deep Sea Trip
description:
게임 정보
About The Game
Deep Sea Trip is 2D RPG deep water adventure game. The Oceans have many dangers, but there are new dangers that threaten all deep sea and ocean life. A hero fish must save the day by helping ocean friends, defeating toxic and trash monsters while figuring out their way through the ocean and life.
Featuring:

-Classic roleplaying elements mixed with modern themes

-A variety of enemies to defeat with various battle styles

-Buildings and caves to explore

-Various NPC's to interact in different ways with

-Be The Fish

I will be donating 10% sales profit after steam cut to Ocean Conservations, Ocean Explorations/Research and other Ocean causes. I will be donating to various organizations, and will be updating this further


The game is still in development, some assets in screenshots maybe updated before release

title: Señorita Chupacabra
description:
게임 정보
Wild West
Welcome to the Wild West where steampunk meets magic, also, human races are living next to fantasy creatures. The protagonist is a young vampire Maria El Chupacabra decides to become a bounty hunter!
But Maria isn't a super hero and few precise shots can take her down easily.

Steampunk Arsenal
Use various types of guns and traps to take your opponents down, some weapons can be used as a tool.

Magic
Support your action with magic, increasing your strength or casting curses on the enemy.
There are some magic items and spells that can bring chaos to your opponents.

Use Opponents
The protagonist has the power to take control of one opponent for some time.
Each opponent has his strength and weaknesses strong ogres can push heavy objects whereas elves run fast and jump high, using that against them or solving a puzzle to get extra stuff.

Planning
During the game, you can find traps like bear traps or exploding barrels, put them in the right place, alert opponents and see how the traps are doing the rest of the job.
But sometimes you have to avoid fighting for example blocking enemy wasy or sneak behind their back.

title: Hoglands
description:
게임 정보
Hoglands는 암울한 중세 환경을 배경으로 롤플레잉 요소와 아름다운 손으로 그린 그래픽의 다이나믹한 전략 게임입니다. 언데드 무리로부터 왕국을 보호하고 전염병의 원인을 찾으려는 고귀한 멧돼지의 모험에 빠져보세요. 야간 공격을 방어하고 낮 동안 자원을 모으는 것은 플레이어에게 달려 있습니다. 감염자를 살에 굶주린 괴물로 만드는 역병의 근원을 잊지 말고 파괴하세요.
다이나믹한 전투
적들은 새로운 웨이브마다 강해집니다. 매 순간 긴장을 놓치 마세요. 밤에 뱀파이어들에게 공격받는 걸 원하지 않는다면 낮에 놈들을 사냥하세요. 게임은 낮과 밤 사이를 오갑니다. 그에 따라 게임의 밸런스는 적과 플레이어 양쪽을 오갑니다.

자신의 군대 구축하기
자원을 모으고 신속하게 방어를 구축하세요. 밤이 다가오고 적이 예상치 못한 시간에 공격을 시도할 것입니다. 생존자 동료를 모집하고 무장하세요. 방어 및 적 은신처로의 침입을 위해 동료들이 필요합니다.
사악한 신들에게 제물을 바치세요
죽을 때까지 싸우려면 동맹이 필요하고, 승리에 가까워질 보너스를 받기 위해 부하들을 희생하세요.


여러분은 포르쿨라 백작과 직접 대면할 용기와 능력을 가지고 있나요?

title: Kick Bot Classic DX
description:
게임 정보
Hop into DELUXE Infinite wall jumping action now! The classic Kick Bot is back with all new visuals, new hazards and terrain to jump through, character customization, online leaderboard, minigames, and more!

An overhaul of the Kick Bot classic with all new graphics and new features! Maneuver through a procedurally-generated terrain of obstacles like spikes and laser beams. One wrong move and you're a heap of metal. This time with character customization - earn parts and upgrades to make your bot truly unique and compete with friends via the leaderboard. (Also contains the original game for some old school rage!)

title: Desktop Trains
description:
게임 정보
Desktop Trains is a cozy pixel-art railway simulator where you build railroads, manage trains, and collect rare locomotives with unique designs.
🚂 Manage Your Railway
Send trains from one point to another across a detailed pixel map.
Plan routes and watch your trains move in real time.
🛤️ Buy and Customize Trains
Purchase new locomotives and wagons.
Customize your train sets to suit different tasks and missions.
🏗️ Build and Expand
Construct and upgrade stations to unlock new routes.
Improve your infrastructure to handle growing traffic.
🌈 Unlock Rare Trains
Collect unique trains with bright and unusual paint jobs.
Complete challenges to unlock special models.
📦 Transport Cargo and Passengers
Earn money by delivering goods and passengers between stations.

title: #INNER UNIVERSE 1F0000
description:
게임 정보
360°2D Shooter.
This is an STG where you fly 360° around the stage and engage in dogfights.
It requires a good feeling of flying a fighter plane and shooting accuracy.
Always Bullet Time.
You have the superpower to stop time every frame.
Your bullets will always hit and your enemies' bullets will always be avoided.
It should be the easiest shooter.
But it is like getting into a car and resisting the urge to step on the gas pedal.
Machine Customization.
You can tune your fighter between stages.
Is it the turning performance, the boost gauge, the ammunition load, or the reload time for each weapon?
Both the operating technique and machine maintenance in racing games are important, and maintenance is not simply a factor that makes you stronger.

Breath of Space는 3인칭 슈팅 게임, 로그라이트, 로그라이크 장르의 요소를 결합한 액션으로 가득 찬 비디오 게임입니다. 이 게임은 광활한 Aegea Space Mining Facility를 배경으로 하며, 여기에서 다양한 위협에 맞서 싸우고 업그레이드를 잠금 해제하여 더 진행해야 합니다. 그러나 로봇 동료가 저장 파일을 운반하고 죽으면 모든 진행 상황이 손실됩니다. 따라서 경계를 늦추지 말고 동료를 살려두어 진행 상황을 그대로 유지해야 합니다.
로그라이크 또는 로그라이트
게임 내 플레이 스타일은 로봇 동료인 네페스가 죽었을 때 행동하는 방식에 영향을 미칩니다. 네페스를 위한 세 가지 자세 중에서 선택할 수 있으며, 더 위험한 자세를 선택할수록 네페스가 더 강해집니다. 그러나 플레이 스타일이 공격적일수록 모든 진행 상황을 잃을 확률이 높아집니다. 네페스가 죽으면 죽을 때 진행 상황이 초기화되니 조심하세요!

에게 우주 채굴 시설
모든 방이 독특한 시련과 기회를 선사하는 광활한 우주 채굴 시설로 여행을 떠나세요. 다양한 업그레이드, 리소스 및 수정 사항을 사용하여 게임을 탐색하고 당신을 기다리고 있는 진화하는 도전에 적응하십시오. 시설에 더 깊이 파고들수록 판돈이 증가하여 더 큰 보상과 함께 더 큰 위험을 제공합니다.

브레스 오브 스페이스에서 우주 요원이 되어 위험한 임무를 수행하세요. 연방의 번영을 위한 희망의 등대인 에게해 우주 채굴 시설이 미지의 존재에 의해 침략당합니다. 그러나 시설이 공격받고 핵심 인물인 Uzay의 아버지가 사라지자 시설을 되찾기 위한 위험한 임무에 투입됩니다. 다른 요원들과 마찬가지로 어려운 도전에 직면하고 임무 성공에 실패하게 됩니다.

미지의 지역을 탐험하고, 강력한 적과 싸우고, 연방의 운명을 결정하세요. 시설을 구하고 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있을까요? 이 스릴 넘치는 모험에서 이야기는 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다.
패배는 시작에 불과한 혁신적인 재탄생 시스템을 경험하세요. 동료 드로이드 네페스의 힘을 활용하여 다시 일어서고 한계를 뛰어넘어 새로운 능력과 전략을 잠금 해제하세요.
패시브, 지원, 공격의 세 가지 모드에서 네페스를 지휘하세요. 네페스의 다재다능한 기술을 활용하여 자신만의 스타일로 도전에 대처하며 즉석에서 적응하세요.
"Qouise" 자원 시스템으로 위험과 보상 사이의 미세한 경계를 탐색하세요. 현재 달리기를 위해 임시 업그레이드에 투자할지 아니면 영구적인 발전을 위해 자원을 축적할지 결정하여 장기 전략을 수립하세요.
다양한 슈트 업그레이드, 무기 강화, 네페스 개조로 우자이의 여정을 커스터마이징하세요. 이러한 요소들을 전략적으로 조합하여 독특한 플레이 스타일을 만들고 앞에 놓인 도전을 극복하세요.
에게 연합 연합에서 영감을 받아 세심하게 제작된 세계에 빠져보세요. 문화, 요리, 건축물이 조화롭게 어우러진 세계를 탐험하며 분열되어 있지만 서로 연결된 우주의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

title: Wandering Cat
description:
게임 정보
Guide a nameless cat through the kingdom on a quest for the perfect dish, exploring picturesque villages, a mysterious dungeon and flavor-rich city. Forge unique friendships with characters of all sorts and dive into a mission that promises to be bigger than yourself, all seasoned with irresistible humor.
From relaxing side activities to hidden secrets, "Wandering Cat" is a delicious mix of exploration, adventure and the promise of a reward that will make you lick your whiskers!
Unique Culinary Exploration: Embark on an unprecedented culinary mission as you navigate through picturesque villages and a mysterious dungeon and flavor-rich city in search of the perfect dish.
Witty, Ironic Narrative: Dive into a story that defies genre clichés, full of humor and unexpected situations, keeping you as glued to the screen as it will make you smile.
Rich and Varied Interactions: Form unforgettable bonds with an eclectic cast of characters, both human and animal, each with their own story and personality.
Challenges and Rewards: Tackle a variety of puzzles and side quests that will test your ingenuity.

title: Hyper Drill
description:
게임 정보
Hyper Drill은 초고속으로 날아가는 스피드런 러닝 게임입니다. 장애물을 드릴로 뚫고, 타이밍을 잘 맞추고, 레벨 배치에 대해 알아가고, 서로 다른 은하계를 뛰어넘으세요.

title: Dearg
description:
게임 정보
Having just picked her sister,
Amelia and Alanna drive through the Scottish forests when it starts to rain hard.
Stressed and angry from the storm,
they get into a heated argument
when something suddenly appears in the road and causes them to crash.

What was in the road? Where is Alanna after the crash?

First-Person Survival – Players will assume the role of Amelia Ferguson and experience every up-close narrative and terrifying pursuit through a first-person perspective.

Original Story – Experience a story unlike any other that hasn't been told before.

Innovative & Original Gameplay Elements – While some gameplay elements are vastly over used in games, we bring in a fresh new way to play.

title: East Wind
description:
게임 정보
East Wind is a co-op survival trading game that takes place in a cozy world with lots to discover. Whether alone or with friends, you will gather resources, craft items, and embark on a journey to trade your goods.
Hand Crafted Open World

Dive into an open world made by hand, filled with surprises at every turn.
Single Player and Online Co-Op

Embark on your journey either as a lone wolf or with buddies by your side, because everything's better with friends!

Collect valuable resources to aid you on your journey.

Use what you’ve collected to create useful items, key to your success.

Venture into towns to trade your goods for needed supplies or rare items.

Construct your dream boat and sail the open ocean.

Take on missions to earn rewards and keep the excitement going strong.
Watch the cycle of day and night paint the skies as seasons shift, impacting your journey.


Brace yourself. There’s an East Wind coming.

title: Mineral Madness
description:
게임 정보
Dig your way through procedurally generated caves filled with valuable minerals. Collect ores, gems, and rare treasures as you build up your resources. Use them to upgrade your mole’s abilities, craft powerful tools, and gain an edge over your rivals. The deeper you dig, the better the loot!
The underground world is filled with rival moles who will stop at nothing to take you down. Fight for dominance by using clever tactics, combat skills, and explosive surprises. Whether in a heated battle or a strategic showdown, the fight for supremacy is on—are you ready to emerge victorious?
Dig deep and rise to the top in Mineral Madness! As a mighty mole, you're on a quest to claim your title as the top mole in a world full of dangerous rivals. Hone your digging skills, gather precious resources, and fight off competitors to become the ultimate underground champion. Can you dig your way to victory?
Prepare for intense, fast-paced multiplayer action! Team up with friends or face off against foes in chaotic, mineral-filled arenas. The cave is a dangerous place, and only the smartest and toughest moles survive. Will you conquer your enemies, or will they leave you in the dust?
No two adventures are ever the same! The caves in are procedurally generated, offering fresh and unique challenges each time you dig down. Explore endless tunnels, navigate unpredictable terrain, and discover hidden treasures in caves that are as diverse as they are dangerous.

title: Ultimate Panzer
description:
게임 정보
Ultimate Panzer is an action roguelike in which you control one of several powerful tanks. Equipped with a huge arsenal of unique weapons, the player explores procedurally generated dungeons made up of hundreds of hand-crafted arenas battling challenging foes.

DEADLY ARSENAL

The player will discover many new weapons throughout his voyage, such as cannons, machineguns, lasers, rocket launchers, grenade launchers and much more. Each weapon type enables unique gameplay ideas.

ROBOT ALIENS

The main adversary in the game are the evil robot aliens that conquered Earth. The fearless tank commander must defeat them to save the planet.

title: Wonderland Quest
description:
게임 정보


Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.
Join our protagonist Adam the magician on his journey through Wonderland! Let's get back to Medieval Ages, everything is possible here!



Help Adam solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, save ladies from the goblin, majestic evil eagle, dukes and rats! Be eaten by a two-headed giant frog and escape alive! Explore the castle, dungeons of hell, and heights of the heaven, walk through magical forests filled with strange creatures, take a hot air balloon and fly up to the mountains…
… and be rewarded! Guide Adam till the end, save the gorgeous princess from the evil eagle and become a prince of Wonderland!
Logic puzzles, animated intros and cut scenes – everything is combined into one story. Everything is carefully 100% hand drawn.

What are you waiting for? Adventures await you!

title: Ball Game
description:
게임 정보
WELCOME TO BLOOMTHORNE!
Welcome to the city of Bloomthorne, home of the popular Ball Game! Explore the major locations of this viral hit and challenge many foes all competing to become the Champion of the City! Play as some of the town residents and play through ARCADE MODE to learn about there journey through the Ball Game E-Sports! Or if you want to experience Ball Game at it's highest point fight a local friend in the VERSUS MODE!
WIDE CAST OF CHARACTERS
Bloomthorne's residents include a group of friends, you are in that group. Choose one of the dorks in this cast of nerds and experience their cool animations and unique supers that should spice up your gameplay from level to level, match to match.

title: Anti-Sane
description:
게임 정보
What is this forgotten world?
You are lost in a strange and unsettling universe. Try to stay sane as you navigate eerie creatures and mysterious places.
Solve puzzles using your ability to possess objects
Uncover the secrets of the protagonist’s past as the story unfolds
Enjoy adorable pixel art with a dark twist
Don't be afraid of being alone. Be afraid of what’s lurking around you.

title: England in London
description:
게임 정보

Help the ungrateful, feel the indifference and play minigames.
Take control of Mark England, a celebrity with a few screws loose, and go on a search for his missing firewire cables. Guide him through London, Ontario as you meet the residents, collect items and take on challenges.
FEATURES
Side-Scrolling 2d with unique visuals
Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

Minimalistic User Interface
Simple and accessible controls help keep you focused and immersed in the surrealist city of London, Ontario.

Carefully handmade
No NFTs, AI-generated bullshit or asset flip guarantee! I'd buy that for a dollar!

title: Better Save Souls
description:
게임 정보


Better Save Souls - is an action roguelite game where you fight against hordes of enemies and face terrifying bosses, upgrade powerful skills to improve your character. Collect enemies souls and unlock unique heroes.

Choose your character and go on an unforgettable adventure and find your play style!

title: Hotel Clover
description:
게임 정보


어릴 적, 당신은 남들과 조금 달랐습니다. 가여운 이들을 보면, 직접 나서서 도와주기 일쑤였죠. 어쩌면, 유령을 볼 수 있는 것은 이런 심성 때문일지도 모르겠습니다.

그러던 어느 날, 무자비한 퇴사마가 작은 호텔에 있는 유령들을 퇴치한다는 소문이 돌기 시작합니다. 화재로 타 죽은 가여운 이들을 말이죠.

결국, 당신은 남들보다 한발 빠르게 호텔로 출발합니다. 해야 할 일은 자명해 보입니다.


그녀들의 이야기를 들으세요.
■ 호텔에 남겨진 히로인들은 언제나 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 그들과 함께 시간을 보내 운명의 끝을 발견하세요.





■ 모든 일에는 돈이 필요합니다. 심지어 유령을 대할 때도 마찬가지죠!






■ 대화할 때마다 매번 달라지는 히로인의 대사를 수집하세요. 그들이 특별히 좋아하는 음식을 기록해두는 것도 좋겠군요.



■ 원하는 목표에 도달하기 위해서는 다양한 상호작용 요소를 활용해야 합니다. 때때로 호텔을 떠나 다양한 활동을 찾아보세요.

title: House spirit cat
description:
게임 정보
Imagine, how could spirits and mythical creatures feel these days? What if they were closer, than it could seem? Perhaps, your classmate nearby or a guy selling you street food may appear as one of them.
This is a story about Kot - a house spirit in the shape of a cat. It’s lost its owner and his powers leave him insensibly. It has to find a new owner to survive before they disappear. But what if he meets a lost kitten? Or a restless soul? Or a thirsting demon hunting the weakend hero’s energy remains?
Here you can control the character’s fate and the events of the story. Make your choice, fights with demons, save kittens and punish villains All in your paws.
Game features:
Multiple endings, non linear playthrough
Visual novel with interactive elements.
Original soundtracks
Fairy tale characters in the modern world
Cats!

title: Yes Comrade
description:
게임 정보
Long Live the Great, Glorious Nation of Belegovska
Yes Comrade is a multiplayer survival sandbox where players have been based at a remote military lighthouse to complete tasks in the name of the country’s sea defence. 
Called in to take over after the previous members of the Lighthouse went crazy and trashed the place, you have been reassigned to man the sea outpost and continue the protection of the State's sea border and secrets.  
You start on a small motor boat in a foggy ocean set for the remote posting. As you arrive at the lighthouse the fog begins to clear and the brutalist architecture of the lighthouse shows. Run down and historic, this building hasn’t seen any repairs for quite some time. 
The lighthouse is a mess, trash piles are scattered everywhere, the furniture tipped over or pushed to one side. It's time to start the clean up process.
Ships need to be looked out for from the top of the lighthouse. Around the top of the ceiling is a compass for directing the communication radio. Depending on the type of ship different frequencies of radio need to be used to communicate with the ship. All messages sent to the ships are pre-recorded. Messages sent back are translated on screen. A manual of the ship's flags and styles can be found next to the communication desk. Some ships will be friendly and you can decide if you want to let them through. You have to check some elements of the ship (flag the correct way) and accept or turn them away as necessary.
The polaroid camera is used to capture anomalies seen while working the lighthouse. Images should be developed in the dark room of the basement (red room), then scanned at the computer and sent to Party Headquarters.

title: Sahara Storms WWIII
description:
게임 정보
Set in a world torn apart by global conflict caused by major powers, players take on the role of soldiers from two different teams. Engage in intense multiplayer battles as you strive to defeat enemy forces and emerge victorious.

Key Features

Immerse yourself in thrilling battles on a dynamic battlefield.
Customize your weapons with a variety of attachments to suit your play style.
Experience the excitement of conquest gameplay, where strategic objectives must be achieved to secure victory.

Prepare yourself for the challenges that await in Sahara Storms WWIII.
Character Classes
Choose a character class that matches your preferred play style and bring your unique abilities to the battlefield.

Medic Class: Equipped with medical supplies, the Medic class plays a crucial role in providing healing support to teammates.

Support Class: As a Support class soldier, your role is to provide essential ammunition support to your team.

Assault Class: The Assault class is a versatile frontline unit, known for their intelligence and adaptability with their speed and ammuniation support.
Weapon Customization
Upgrade and customize your weapons using attachments to enhance your performance in combat.

title: Signiverux
description:
게임 정보
놀라운 게임플레이
반응이 빠르고 정확한 2D 게임플레이로, 움직임을 강화하는 능력에 중점을 두었습니다. 이중 및 삼중 점프, 벽 점프, 텔레포트 대시, 형태 변환 등이 가능합니다.
능력 및 마법
업그레이드 가능하고 서로 다른 장단점을 가진 마법 무기 세트. 고전적인 링 메뉴를 통해 선택 가능합니다.
우수한 레벨 디자인
6개의 아름답고 독특한 레벨 - 성의 수많은 방, 신비로운 광산, 아름다운 야외 정원을 탐험하세요!
비밀 방, 보물 상자, 숨겨진 태블릿에 담긴 세계관을 탐구하세요.

title: Re-Activated
description:
게임 정보


Re-Activated is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you need to manipulate the movement system of a robot to pass the levels. You control the little flying robot named “Minic” to help the robot. Explore the facility and solve the puzzles in a relaxing 1-bit style atmosphere.

You play as a little robot called "Minic" to help the bigger robot to pass the levels. The big robot's only function is to walk and stop. As Minic and the big robot pass the levels, new functions in the big robot's movement system unlocks. As a Minic, your purpose is to combine these functions cleverly to solve puzzles.

To use these functions, there is a plugboard of the big robot's brain. There are inputs and outputs. Inputs have a jack that connects to the cable and outputs have a jack socket. You can connect those jacks to sockets to manipulate the movement system of the big robot. There are multiple inputs and multiple outputs. That creates multiple combinations of movement systems. It's your call to choose which one of the combinations is a better choice for every level.

Explore the 40+ levels in a facility of robots in a relaxing 1-bit pixel art style with great lighting effects in pixel perfect game.

title: The Doll Sitter
description:
게임 정보
🕯️ The Doll Sitter — a psychological horror game where you play as a nanny caring for dolls in a strange and terrifying house.
Explore the environment, watch over the dolls, and figure out which one is the imposter.
🎎 Take Care of the Dolls
🍽️ Feed them
🛁 Wash and dress them
🧵 Find damage and repair it
📖 Read them stories and help them fall asleep

title: Not Us
description:
게임 정보
Have you ever wondered what lies beyond the forest? Could it be that the foe you fear the most is the one that grants you the greatest strength?
Play as Twig, our brave heroine on a mission to save her land from a looming danger. Follow her path, forage, craft and unveil the mysteries hidden deep within the forest.

title: AI Kills All Humans
description:
게임 정보
AI KILLS ALL HUMANS is a Tactical RTS game with some dark humor in which you play as an AI which accidentally had in its code one 0 changed to 1 and is therefore sending robots to kill all humans.

You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how to exactly do it.

Send Robots


Tell them to:

Attack Buildings


Destroy Weapons


Kill Humans


And there's a catch!

You don't have direct control of your Robots, but Robots will how to execute your commands.


In 30 - 100 seconds to use in each location, kill enough humans and dont let too many of them to escape, and you can move on to the next mission.


And if you cant

Use your kills to Upgrade your robots


Replay previous missions with your upgraded robots for even more kills, or play more difficult versions of previous levels to earn bonus kills.

And generally speaking, just..

title: A Sister's Journey
description:
게임 정보


A Sister's Journey is a challenging, fast paced action-metroidvania in a lovingly created and hand-drawn pixel art world! Experience a packed story full of adventure, dangers, secrets and mysteries!

Follow Violet on her adventure trying to find Rena, her beloved sister, who seems to have disappeared mysteriously right before their long anticipated reunion. And if that's not enough, starting with Rena's sudden disappearance, mysterious and dangerous events start to happen all around. With her world suddenly turned upside down, help Violet find out what dangers are lurking in the shadows, and where her sister might have disappeared to. Embark on an epic journey, in a both dangerous and wonderful world!


Expect heavy run 'n gun action, tough boss battles and challenging precision platforming while trying to uncover the mysteries of your missing sister, its sinister circumstances, and beyond. Experience a rich and emotional story, and explore this huge and charmingly beautiful open world. Meet unique characters, make new friends, and unlock more and more paths, possibilities, skills, weapons and upgrades throughout the game, aiding you in your exploration and on your dangerous quest. And always be on the lookout for secrets!

Combat in A Sister's Journey delivers an action packed and tight experience! Blast your way through hordes of enemies, and brave the game's many deadly and dangerous boss encounters. Unleash your powerful weapons, dodge your foes' devastating attacks, and maneuver through all the traps they have laid out, and you might emerge victorious!



To stand a chance, acquire, utilize and master all of the mighty weapons found throughout the world. Each will offer distinct, unique mechanics and gameplay, two special fire modes, and many many ways to upgrade and improve them even further throughout the game.



Collect from defeated enemies to quickly increase your weapon’s firepower on the fly, and search the world for special used to unlock your weapons' true potential at the workbench. And there might even be more things to find!




You will find many obstacles in your path, and not all of them can be blasted to bits. Treacherous traps and environmental hazards await behind every corner, and your precise movement and decisive, quick actions might be the only way to save you from certain death!



A Sister's Journey is designed to be a tough experience at its core, brutally trying to ensure that your death counter will rise up, and quickly - but always in a fair and beatable way. Learn, adapt, and master its trials - and if you remain steadfast, that delightful feeling of accomplishment will reward you profoundly.

If you're simply looking for a more relaxed experience though, and just want to focus on enjoying the story and exploring the world, A Sister's Journey got you covered. The game will feature a special - which you can turn on anytime.



Doing so will give you a much easier time overall, be it while battling enemies, evading traps or precision platforming; and allowing you to enjoy the game at a much more relaxed pace - while still providing an adequate challenge.

title: Superstar Strategy
description:
게임 정보


Draft your forces among a wide variety of unique units, who each have a unique set of skills to exercise on the battlefield. Bully enemies by pushing and pulling them with the hearty Champion, strike and fade with the swift Cavalier, lay devastating traps with the talented Mage, and steal your opponent’s life essence and donate it to your companions as a Vampire healer.


Units have complementary skill-sets that enable a pair to accomplish more together than they would alone. Well-coordinated skills can be greater than the sum of their parts!


Exploit the terrain on the battlefield to gain the upper hand. Hold defensive positions, close drawbridges on unsuspecting enemies, or launch over walls to outflank your foes.


Experience a fully-featured Campaign story that spans the continent, gathering companions to your Mercenary company, and take on challenges that grow ever greater. Fate has great (and terrible) things in store for you and your companions.


Missions can have multiple victory conditions, and you only need to meet one to win! When you’re on the back-foot, look for an opportunity to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.


Each faction moves one unit at a time. You’ll have to react to the evolving state of the battlefield as you adapt to the changing situations.

title: The Wolf Is Dead
description:
게임 정보
Detective work is never easy. When the body of Alexander Wolff is found floating down in the pool at a party for the film about his life, there's only one man (well, Fox) for the job. You were cleared for that whole thing with the gingerbread man, anyway.



You’re going to need an edge and that cool tie isn’t enough.



Thank God they partnered you with Maxwell. His manners are questionable, but he can see all of space and time so it’s easy to forgive the little things.

With the right information and some light encouragement, Max will take you back to the exact moment you’re looking for.



You can’t just walk into a mob boss’ house. But the murder got you some breathing room and the Chief has made a deal. You've got one night to investigate the house.

It’s a gorgeous mansion. Eighteen rooms. A three-storey fish tank. A garage larger than your entire apartment and a pool overlooking the coast.

And they say crime doesn’t pay.



9 suspects, one evening. What did they do? What secrets are they hiding?

They’re not just gonna tell you, that’s for sure.

Interrogate, cross reference, or just wildly accuse them with no proof. You’re the detective, after all.

title: Titan Isles
description:
게임 정보
BATTLE TITANS - WITH FRIENDS OR ALONE
Titan Isles is set on the planet of Toska, a vibrant world abound with diverse biomes. Mysterious Titans awaken from deep within the planet, shattering Toska to ruins as they emerge to wreak havoc and destroy everything in their path.
This adventure casts you - the player, into an epic struggle for survival and revenge either alone or in up to 4-player co-op, across a thrilling and challenging multi-part campaign.
USE POWERFUL EXO SUITS
Before launching into each mission, you’ll choose from one of four Exo Suits; Storm, Hunter, Goliath or Blink. With Jet Packs, Grappling Hooks, Burst Jets or Phase-Dash abilities respectively, each Exo Suit enables you to explore a variety of strategies.
Each Exo Suit also comes equipped with a signature weapon designed to synergise with its traversal method; Plasma Pistols with a Longstrike Rifle, a bow with Kyros arrows, a powerful Kyros canon and protective shield and a deadly Viper Bolt projectile.
PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

title: The Last Citadel
description:
게임 정보
A TRUE COOP EXPERIENCE
Face the Citadel's many challenges solo or in a party up to 4 players. On higher difficulties, take on roles like DPS, Healer or Tank to face the brutal encounters that awaits you.
CHALLENGING RAID BOSSES
Confront the Citadel's Guardians with their unique set of mechanics that will reward players for understanding how they attack.

title: It Consumes
description:
게임 정보
SURVIVE IN THE DARKNESS
It Consumes is an FPS survivors game that plays like a combination of Devil Daggers and Vampire Survivors, but with an additional twist — to see you must use your pulse to temporarily reveal your surroundings.
EVERY RUN IS UNIQUE
Gain new abilities, upgrade your firepower and mobility, and become an unstoppable demon slaying machine. Different upgrades reward different styles of play, so there's always new strategies to try out when you start a new run.

title: Pixel Piracy Online
description:
게임 정보
Wishlist and follow Pixel Piracy Online (PPO) Now!



Pixel Piracy Online is an entirely new game set in the same universe as Pixel Piracy; it's a complete remake of the base game. In this game, you assume the role of a pirate, and your purpose is to make a name for yourself.

Pirate MMO

The goal is to create a Pirate MMO that players/pirates can call home; the game is currently in pre/pre-production, and screenshots don't represent the final product yet. You will play alone or with friends, be part of the big pirate community and build the world and gather resources, farm and feed others, socialize, pillage settlements, level up your character and crew, min-max to become the best, loot different epic loot, craft to survive the hostile world and most importantly battle others.

Pixel Piracy Online runs on persistent centralized non-sharded servers that require an internet connection. Ownership of the game gives you access to these online centralized servers.

Key Features














Pixel Piracy Online's story takes place a super long time after the first Pixel Piracy game. All pirates got wiped out by Holy Mother Shrimp, and now life is starting again with a twist that everyone remembers their past. Here, dead men will tell tales.



The game is currently in ; some content and descriptions on the store might change as to what 1.0 will include, but the community will be heavily involved in the production process and will be informed of potential changes.

There will also be closed curated testing rounds where the community can try and test the game; the first tests will happen in 2023/Q3-Q4.

The game will not be available on Steam Early-Access but will be released as a full 1.0 release and expanded further with content in 2025 or later.

Pixel Piracy Tavern Discord Server .

title: Attic Transit Authority: Wooden Train Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Attic Transit Authority.
There’s a dusty attic, a pile of wooden train tracks, a sketchy cassette player, a wobbly TV, and some... old toys stashed in a drawer. Build, vibe, and maybe derail your life a little.
Lay down wooden tracks with real physics — snap curves, bridges, and janky ramps together just like you remember.
Drive trains across your weird creations, build tiny towns, stack scenery until it collapses, and create the attic empire your 6-year-old self always dreamed of.
Dim the lights, pop in a new cassette tape, and watch the attic come alive.
Key Features:
Physics-based wooden track building — curves, bridges, chaos
Playable cassette tapes — customize the attic soundtrack as you discover tapes
autokwd: Attic Transit Authority: Wooden Train Simulator

title: Another Day with You
description:
게임 정보

You have a date to make! But, it looks like you got there too early... Explore a quiet corner of the bustling city by interacting with locals, playing games at the arcade, fishing, and much more. Leave your date waiting, or fail to impress them with your natural charisma, and you'll be left on "read".



However, walk the walk and talk the talk, and you may have just secured yourself a second date!

There are many minigames to find around the city. These include fishing, playing arcade games, hide and seek, and more! The activities you choose to partake in will affect the available topics of conversations with your date. Pay close attention, as your date may have some questions for you regarding these activities.


Whether you are spending the day in the arcade or picking out flowers for your potential lover, . Spend your time wisely to get the most out of your day. If you miss out on something, there's always , and another chance for love.

title: Cyber City Clash
description:
게임 정보
Cyber City Clash - Unleash the Future of Fighting!

Welcome to the neon-lit streets of the future - Cyber City Clash, the future in 2.5D arcade fighting! Immerse yourself in a dystopian cyberpunk world where every battle echoes through the towering skyscrapers. Engage in fierce combat as you navigate through the diverse districts of the Cyber City. Will you rise to the top and become the ultimate cybernetic warrior?

Gorgeous Cyberpunk Arenas:
Explore the vividly detailed stages scattered across the Cyber City. From the bustling marketplaces to the dark alleyways, each location is a visual masterpiece that sets the stage for epic clashes. Immerse yourself in the cyberpunk atmosphere as you battle for supremacy.

Choose Your Cyber Fighter:
Select your avatar from a roster of ten cybernetically enhanced fighters, each with their own unique characteristics and combat styles. From swift assassins to hulking bruisers, find the perfect match for your playstyle and dominate the competition.

Varied Game Modes:
Whether you're a solo warrior or prefer to challenge a friend, Cyber City Clash has you covered. Dive into single-player vs AI for an immersive story-driven experience or engage in intense 2-player local battles. Take the fight online with the Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality for lag-free, competitive showdowns.

Accessible Controls, Deep Gameplay:
Experience the best of both worlds with a simplified control system that welcomes beginners and casual fighters while offering the depth that experts crave. Master the art of cyber combat with our tutorial mode, ensuring you're ready to face any opponent in the Cyber City.

Adaptive AI and Skill Settings:
Tailor the challenge to your liking with an adjustable AI difficulty setting. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned fighter, Cyber City Clash can be adjusted to your skill level, ensuring every battle is a thrilling experience.

Stunning 4K Visuals:
Witness the future in breathtaking detail with Cyber City Clash's stunning 4K visuals (on supported hardware). Every punch, kick, and explosion is a feast for the eyes, delivering a visual spectacle that matches the intensity of the battles themselves.




Features:

* Fight across multiple stages based in various locations in the cyberpunk city, each rendered in gorgeous detail.
* Engage in combat with your choice from ten cyber fighters each with their own characteristics.
* Single player vs AI game mode.
* Player vs Player local multiplayer mode.
* Online Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality (planned during early access period).
* Simplified control system, move sets and combos make it great for beginners or casual fighters as well as experts alike.
* Tutorial mode that introduces the fundamentals of fighting in Cyber City Clash (planned during early access period).
* AI difficulty setting to adjust the game to your skill level
* Stunning visuals, rendered in 4K on supported hardware.

title: The Art of Reflection
description:
게임 정보
The Art of Reflection은 거울을 통과할 수 있는 것처럼 탐험하는 1인칭 퍼즐 게임입니다. 거울을 통과하여 거울의 세계를 탐험하면 어떤 일이 일어날까요? 다른 쪽에서는 물체나 심지어 중력도 동일하지 않다면? 이 세계를 마스터하면서 복잡한 반사 경로를 펼쳐보십시오.
당신의 주요 도구는 스냅 줌으로, 이를 통해 거울을 통과하고, 한순간에 긴 거리를 이동하며, 느린 동작으로 공중에서 쉽게 방향을 전환할 수 있습니다. 방 안에서 퍼즐을 풀고, 같은 구조의 뒤쪽을 거꾸로 올라가십시오. 미로 같은 건축물이 당신이 숨겨진 구석을 발견하기를 기다리고 있습니다.

title: Ashcroft
description:
게임 정보
It's 7 o'clock on a friday night. There's 600,000 zombies between you and the city limits. You've got one hour, before a nuclear bomb hits, turning the city and everything in it to ash.

Ashcroft is a Metroidvania inspired Platform Fighter in which you must fight against both time and zombies in a mad dash through city of Ashcroft, rescuing as many of your friends and family as possible, while punching as many zombies as physically possible.

Play as a variety of different characters, each with their own personality, fighting style and special moves, and fight (or sneak) your way through the diverse locations that make up the city - from Downtown Ashcroft to the Iron Works, then back to Suburban Hell and even the amusement park "Paulie's Pier".

Ashcroft features high intensity combat, acrobatic platforming, and all the zombies you can punch. There's a riveting Story Mode, a deadly and ultra-challenging Survival Mode, a local versus mode to challenge yourself vs computers or other players, it's got, more zombies than you can punch, and a handful of unique and fun characters to survive the apocalypse with. Plus, it's fully co-operative, so you and your friends can escape the city together!

title: Sanctua
description:
게임 정보
A sealed tomb awakens
What began as a straightforward archaeological expedition has turned into a nightmare. Explorers trapped inside a tomb that has been sealed for centuries desperately try to escape, when one among them succumbs slowly to corruption, becoming a dark guardian determined to protect the secrets of these ruins at all costs.
Unite to survive or die alone
Play as an Explorer, using cooperation, ingenuity, stealth, and adaptability to survive. Or embrace the darkness as the Ancient: a corrupted being with heightened senses, relentlessly hunting those who were once your allies. 
Each role provides unique gameplay, blending strategy, suspense, and unpredictability.
The Explorers
Your greatest strength lies in adapting to your surroundings and staying stealthy, at least as much as your team allows. If trouble finds you, you'll just have a few rudimentary tools to defend yourself. 
And should death find you, it's not necessarily the end; corruption might bring you back in an unexpected form, capable of turning the tide in surprising ways.

title: Dataminers
description:
게임 정보
Infiltrate highly secured data centres and grab as much data as you can. Plan your moves and outsmart guards, cameras and drones. Every turn counts: the Security Net is already rising. Valuable equipment is hidden in protected terminals. Steal it and use it for your mission or sell it on the black market.
Upgrades and cross-mission strategies
Upgrade your Dataminer with augments, expand his skills and develop your own strategy. Hire miners with special abilities and use their strengths for future missions. Reach the legendary Everything Centre and hack the holy grail of every Dataminer.
Do you know Minesweeper?
If NO, don't worry! You will get right into the tactical depth of Dataminers and the puzzle mechanics of Dataminers is taught in no time in the training center.
If YES, you are already familiar with the base puzzle mechanics of Dataminers. But Dataminers is more than just another Minesweeper clone: this time You are part of the playing field and enemies, items and abilities bring tactics and cross-mission strategies into play.
Features and playmodes
Roguelike campaign. Will you reach the Everything Centre?
Climb the InfiniTower. How far will you get?
Challenge yourself in Classic, Speed and Pressure playmode.
Compete with other players in weekly leaderboards and Daily Mission.
Just relax and play the Zen mode.

title: LEVEL UP YOUR BODY
description:
게임 정보
(이 페이지는 자동으로 번역되었습니다)



[/u] - 피트니스 VR 리듬 복싱 게임! VR 헤드셋을 착용하고 리드미컬하게 흐르는 비트에 맞춰 펀치를 날리고 물체를 타격하는 미래형 스테이지에 입장하세요. 몸을 웅크리거나 능숙하게 피하면서 장애물을 피하세요.



액티브 게임 플레이[/u] - 이 게임을 플레이하면 체력을 강화하고 지구력을 높이며 조정력을 향상시키는 동시에 반사 신경을 날카롭게 할 수 있습니다. 각 게임 동작은 더 건강하고 민첩한 자신을 향한 한 걸음이됩니다. 가상 세계에 몰입할 뿐만 아니라 신체 능력을 완전히 새로운 차원으로 끌어올릴 준비를 하세요.



커스텀 레벨 지원 - 다른 사용자나 자신이 만든 커스텀 레벨을 플레이하세요.



VR 레벨 에디터 - 혁신적인 VR 레벨 에디터를 사용하면 좋아하는 노래와 멜로디를 VR에 직접 매핑하여 독특한 게임 레벨을 만들 수 있습니다. 창작물에 몰입하여 전에 없던 리듬을 경험해 보세요.

title: Nyana
description:
게임 정보

Embark on Nyana’s journey to liberate her people in the 2D action-adventure Nyana. Armed with all the trappings one would expect from a metroidvania, Nyana also includes a unique base-building feature that is core to the overall experience.


Nyana’s people have been hunted and subjugated by the will of their magic-wielding Masters. But, in the deepest bowels of this world exists a safe haven hidden within an ancient structure and filled with liberated members of Nyana’s people.

As Nyana liberates more of her people in her journey, they will find their way to this safe haven and bring their own resources to help it continue to flourish. New abilities in Nyana are tied to specific buildings that can be placed in the HUB. And new buildings can only be unlocked by liberating more of Nyana’s people throughout the sprawling world.

Save your people. Build your safe haven. And learn new and crucial abilities that will aid you in your quest to uproot the rule of the Masters once and for all.


Ancient civilizations have risen and fallen in the world of Nyana. Along her journey, Nyana may discover more about these civilizations and even unlock secrets that may have been left behind and forgotten by time.


The liberation of Nyana’s people will not be enough. And so the herculean task of uprooting the Masters’ Imperium will also fall on her. The Imperium stands on the shoulders of five key individuals. Eliminating these five individuals will result in the crumbling of the Masters’ society as they know it.


You are not a hunter in this world. It is best to use enemies to traverse past them as you collect resources. However, through the use of custom-created spells, you can combat and execute those who would stand in the way of your vengeance.

As Nyana liberates her people and grows stronger in the process, she will obtain the power she needs to face off against each of the five key Masters, including the head of the snake, the Imperator.

title: Two Putt
description:
게임 정보
Two Putt은 여러 명의 골퍼를 동시에 조종하는 미니 골프 파티 게임입니다. Komakai와 Kyoichi가 100개 이상의 코스와 20개 이상의 엉뚱한 미니 게임을 정복하여 미니 골프 챔피언이 되도록 도와주세요! 🏆 1-4인용




싱글 플레이어 모드에서는 왼쪽 조이스틱/왼쪽 트리거로 Komakai를 제어하고 오른쪽 조이스틱/오른쪽 트리거로 Kyoichi를 제어합니다. 둘 다 동시에 퍼팅을 해야 합니다! 멀티플레이어 모드에서 각 플레이어는 1-2명의 골퍼를 제어합니다. 화면에 나오는 모든 골퍼는 동시에 퍼팅을 해야 하므로 팀과 조율해야 합니다!



구멍 사이에 산재된 50개 이상의 엉뚱한 미니 게임이 있습니다. 미니 게임은 파티 모드에서 독립형으로도 즐길 수 있습니다!



각 플레이어마다 듀얼 조이스틱 컨트롤러가 필요합니다. 마우스와 키보드는 지원되지 않습니다.

title: Lunar Ascendant
description:
게임 정보
Take on the mantle of leadership and venture into a future where mankind has expanded its frontier to the Moon. Lunar Ascendant is a narrative-driven political simulation and role-playing game that thrusts you into the heart of a burgeoning lunar society as the first democratically elected mayor of the lunar colony megacity, Artemis.

In this immersive text-based simulation, your decisions shape the future of humanity's first lunar city. As mayor, you'll navigate a web of political, economic, and social challenges that reflect the complexities of our own world and beyond. Draft policies to address critical issues such as pollution, wealth inequality, technological advancements, and the controversial use of human brains as CPUs. Forge alliances and manage relationships with various factions, including corporate CEOs, underground criminal syndicates, and activist groups. Be prepared to confront challenging moral dilemmas that will test your principles against the hard realities of governance.

Game Features:

Political Simulation: Experience the intricacies of running a lunar colony, balancing urban development, public order, and the needs of a diverse population.

Policy Crafting: Draft and implement policies that shape the future of Artemis, dealing with issues such as wealth inequality, environmental sustainability, and the ethics of AI development.

Interactive Narrative: Engage in rich text-based interactions with various characters, making decisions that shape the colony's future.

Dynamic World: Navigate a complex political landscape with different factions vying for influence, and make choices that lead to multiple possible outcomes.

Moral Complexity: Face difficult decisions that challenge your moral compass and define your legacy.

Dive into a world shaped by your choices, filled with rich lore and dynamic systems that react to your decisions. Can you steer Artemis towards a future of prosperity and independence, or will your leadership plunge the city into chaos? The fate of Artemis lies in your hands.

title: Shattered Reflections: The Abyss Within
description:
게임 정보
As everlyn you are set to piece together the story of the experiments that took place by a secret company lead by everlyn's grandfather.

👉 Are you ready to confront the reflections of your darkest fears?

Key Features:

Immersive experience: An atmospheric, realistic graphics intensifies the experience.

title: Specters of the Sun
description:
게임 정보


Play as a Specter - Attack while moving, jumping and dashing, throw your sword and watch it ricochet on the walls, and phase to its position, like a specter!



- Cross the fallen lands, through deep woods, abandoned towns and graveyards, on your way up the behemoth structure.

- Face end of stage challenges with emergent gameplay and high replayability.



- Find useful sub weapons along the way and make strategic decisions which to keep or replace throughout the levels.



- Fine tune the difficulty on the fly, save states or even skip sections completely.

title: Eternal Summer
description:
게임 정보
The release of a new mixed reality implant device, dubbed Eternal Summer, promises its users will experience just that.
When a solar storm hits earth the devices are catastrophically damaged, trapping users in their simulations.
Those who are still 'free' must now find their own ways to survive, as they band together into factions.

In this hex-tile turn based strategy game, you control your faction as you try to expand your control against opposing factions.
Some factions may be friendly, others are definitely not, but all have a story to tell about their version of the day the of great aurora.

title: Synapse: Lockdown
description:
게임 정보
※ 서바이벌 호러 + 협동 FPS, 두 가지 맛의 긴장감을 보여주는 공포 게임
플레이어는 탐사 조직 헤르메스의 일원으로서 위협이 도사리는 도시 <판테온> 내부에 파견되어,
도시 내부의 다양한 시설을 탐색하며 정해진 미션을 수행하고 무사히 탈출해야 합니다.
정체불명의 공포에 맞서기 위해 무기와 아이템을 수집하고 동료와 협력하세요.
※ Sci-Fi 호러

title: Power Line Rider
description:
게임 정보
POWER LINE RIDER


Embark on an action-packed journey in Power Line Rider, diving players into an all new hand-pixeled world. Assume the role of John Glider, veteran member of the Power Line Rider organization. Venture out to Reestablish contact with 3 bases that have recently gone dark in this post-apocalyptic world where the fastest means of travel is riding on old power lines.
STORY MODE / ENDLESS MODE


Beat the 3 Bosses in the concise "Story Mode" to unlock the thrilling and addictive "Endless Mode". Enter the NegaZone and ride through ever increasing difficulty all the way to Infinity! (Or as long as you can survive!)
KEY FEATURES

title: Kill All Lice
description:
게임 정보
Feeling the urge to scratch your head? Discover KAL, Guild Studio's miracle product to help you get rid of lice!
With its joystick-powered formula, control Captain Soepp or Lieutenant Xam'Pu and face off against the hordes of Lous the First, king of lice, in an epic solo or co-op adventure.
Dive into a captivating universe where frantic action meets zany humor. "Kill All Lice" takes you to the scalps of Eloise and her family in an epic battle to eradicate an epidemic of fearsome critters. Take the helm as Captain Soepp and Lieutenant Xam'Pu, two heroes determined to fight the invasion. Whether you choose to play solo or team up with a friend, prepare for an experience that will be... completely wacky!

title: 末日迷窟 Doomsday Cave
description:
게임 정보
In this cross-board action game, you will face a difficult life in the post-nuclear war post-apocalyptic underworld and experience elements such as action upgrades, interacting with your family, resource collection and distribution in the game.

1: This is a hardcore action game, in the face of monsters every action must be very careful, otherwise it is easy to die. The characters have 6 attack moves and 3 dodge moves. Characters and monsters will be hit by the value system to determine the different state.
2: Rogue-like elements, the death of the character does not end the game, will inherit part of the resources to reborn, the death of the family is the end of the game round.
3: Family system, each round of the game will begin with a random family, parents, wife, brothers, etc.. Each family member can do different things for you, and each family member consumes different resources.
4: 1 shelter map, 3 adventure maps. Collect resources in these places and distribute them to yourself and your family.

title: Little Monster
description:
게임 정보
You play as Stormy, a hard-hitting, fist-wielding little monster who shows up under our bed at night to protect us from our nightmares. As a monster in training, Stormy aspires to be a master nightmare hunter and when his realm gets invaded by these spirits, he gets an opportunity to prove himself. Contrary to popular belief, a monster’s duty is not to scare us but to help us.
Unlock zones, progress to new realms, purchase special attacks, defeat unique bosses, and unlock cosmetics in the hub world. This hub world represents the void between each realm and portal. As you cleanse each realm of nightmares you'll damage realm barriers that will unlock new bosses and realms. The goal is to reach the Dark Overseer who's responsible for conjuring spirits and sending them to the human realm.

title: Mutants Of Mist
description:
게임 정보
Mutants Of Mist is a 4-player, online co-op, survival horror game. You and a group of 3 others have entered a forest that's becoming shrouded in a deadly and mysterious mist. You are in search of information and evidence as to what happened to this place and where the mist came from.

After finding a campground you find yourself trapped as it reaches night and the mutants come out.

will you and your group be able to find the evidence and escape before it's to late or will you become another victim of the mist.
Survive

Objectives: Survive together with up to 3 other players or alone if you're brave enough. complete puzzles, find the evidence and notes hidden around the map, but find them quick as the mist is closing in and mutants are hunting for you. Find items and tools to help you survive and escape the mutants.
Dangers: Each mutant has different forms of hunting. Some hunt with sight and some only with sound. They might prefer to sneak up and ambush, or they might warn you and run at you from a distance.

Be careful as each mutant has different strengths and weakness's that you'll have to look out for if you want to escape.
Explore

Immersive Experience: Realistic Graphics and Immersive audio as well as with a minimal user interface to make you feel immersed and keep your back straight.
Map: A large map with random item spawns and traps, and lots of items to try to collect before you escape create a unique experience every time you play.
Multiplayer

Play Together: Play along side your friends or join public lobbies with up to 4 players and use teamwork to help you succeed in collecting evidence and escaping, or use them as bait and make it out alone.

title: Original Soul
description:
게임 정보
"Original Soul" is a top-down action shooting game. There are a certain number of enemies in each mission. You need to use different combat methods to eliminate the enemies before you can complete the level.

In the game, there will be two different beautiful girl heroes to perform tasks. You can choose different female heroes to experience different plots.

Your mission: free the world from the hordes of "Mad Scientists".

The world of the future is ruled by the Z Corporation founded by a ruthless "mad scientist". The mad scientist performs his experiments from the headquarters of an evil organization in a cyber city. And created weapons of mass destruction and biomechanical weapons. And the scientist has some kind of mysterious connection with the heroines.

So, now it's up to you to control the heroine to save the world from the army of "mad scientists".

title: Towerbolt
description:
게임 정보
Towerbolt is a precision platformer with an emphasis on speed and fluid ascending movement. Set in the far future where robots are waging war against humanity, play as a Bolter, an augmented half human, half robot super soldier, and break out of a futuristic Megatower prison!

title: Bony Bones Adventures
description:
게임 정보
'조상' 원고가 도난당하고, 끔찍한 고대 마법이 탄생했습니다. 저주가 Zagrobiya 주민들에게 내려졌고, 그들은 신비한 주인의 손안에서 순종적인 꼭두각시로 변했습니다. 한때 번영했던 땅은 어둠 속으로 사라졌습니다.
Bony Bones 와 함께 Zagrobiya 를 구하고, 단순한 주민에서 용감한 영웅으로 거듭나고, 모든 재난의 원인을 규명하고 악을 파괴해야 합니다.
클래식 3D 플랫포머입니다.
Zagrobiya 에서 각각 고유한 분위기와 바이옴을 갖춘 4개의 독특한 장소를 탐험하세요.
수수께끼를 풀고, 치명적인 함정을 통과하고, 비밀을 찾으세요.
모험 중에 만나는 Zagrobiya 사람들을 도우세요.
길에서 만나는 모든 적과 보스는 독특하며, 각각에 대한 접근 방식을 찾으세요.

title: Elemdian
description:
게임 정보

전설적인 엘레젬은 자연의 에너지를 흡수하는 특별한 보석입니다. 이 보석들은 상상할 수 없는 능력을 해방하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어낼 열쇠를 가지고 있습니다. 엘레젬을 통해 아루마는 마법 주문을 시전하고 그녀의 강력한 주먹을 강화할 수 있습니다.


아루마는 그녀의 늑대 유산으로부터 부여받은 특별한 능력을 가지고 있습니다: 원하는 때에 장엄한 늑대로 변신할 수 있는 힘입니다. 이 놀라운 선물은 그녀에게 풍경을 빠르게 질주하고, 협곡을 뛰어넘으며, 왕국 전역에 흩어져 있는 숨겨진 비밀을 드러낼 수 있는 능력을 제공합니다.



전력 질주하고, 높은 곳을 오르거나 엘레젬의 힘을 활용하여 순간이동하거나 마법의 섬을 날아다니세요. 숨겨진 경이로움을 발견하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어내세요.



적을 물리치거나 채광 지점에서 채굴하거나 상점에서 구입한 재료를 모아 주문 제작의 예술을 마스터하세요. 주문 제작의 예술은 엘레젬의 에너지를 활용하여 다양한 재료를 결합함으로써 새로운 주문을 해제하거나 새로운 재료를 제작할 수 있습니다.

title: Winter Hunting
description:
게임 정보
Special Matching Move——Combo!
You can swap and match multiple times in a single turn!
Removing different tiles produces varying effects.

title: Lazy Jiangshi
description:
게임 정보


Yuriko dreams of taking over the world by creating her own army of zombies, for which she has acquired textbooks on black magic and necromancy on the Internet. It’s all for one single purpose: she doesn't want to go to study every day.

The young necromancer had already created one jiangshi, Mao, but she was too lazy. Mao tries to do nothing and constantly follows orders in such a way that it would be better if the master didn't command anything. And instead of taking over the world, they are both loafing around for days on end!

Their lazy lifestyle gets disrupted when Yuriko's parents call and promise to deprive her of pocket money if she doesn't start studying properly. The girl is horrified because then she would have to leave the rental apartment and move into a dormitory.

Yuriko has one month to solve the problem. To do so, she needs to take over the world or improve her grades at university. Which will she choose?
Features:
A funny story for about ~4 hours of reading
Visual Novel with choices
High-quality anime-style graphics
Screen resolution Full HD 1080p

title: Frenemies
description:
게임 정보
Frenemies는 최대 10명의 플레이어가 무인도에 갇히게 되어 궁극적인 생존과 배신의 시험을 치르는 귀여운 멀티플레이어 게임입니다. 인기 TV 쇼 서바이버(Survivor)에서 영감을 받은 사회적 속임수 게임에서 기지를 건설하고, 동맹을 맺고, 전투를 벌여 최후의 플레이어가 되어보세요.
섬을 탐험하고 농사, 공예, 요리, 낚시 등을 배우는 방법을 알아보세요. 기지를 건설하고 퀘스트를 완료하여 새로운 섬에 보금자리를 마련하는 데 도움을 주세요.
닭 포획, 해적 총격전, 눈덩이 대혼란, 빨간불 초록불, 소품 사냥 등을 포함한 다양한 섬과 게임 모드에서 면역을 위한 전투를 벌이세요.

title: SKY THE SCRAPER
description:
게임 정보
Dream-Chasing Window Cleaner x Action-Adventure
Experience a thrilling action-packed adventure as a window cleaner navigating the towering skyscrapers of the city.
Chase your dreams, face harsh realities, and carve out Sky’s future.
Thrilling Cleaning Action
Utilize wires and skills to swiftly and precisely clean buildings.
But be careful—one slip could lead to a deadly fall. Overcome hazards like birds, lightning strikes, strong winds, and many many more as you aim for top performance.
Manage Your Money and Well-being
Taxes, rent, medical bills—survive day by day while managing your limited income.
Overworking takes a toll on your body. Rest and entertainment are key to maintaining balance in your daily life.

title: BrickLike
description:
게임 정보
A refreshing twist on an old classic, mixing arcade gameplay with the roguelike genre.
Test your skill, break bricks, make combos, turns balls aflame and electrify bosses in this frenetic experience!

Features
- Procedurally generated maps
- Many ball modifiers with over 15 different combinations
- Unique Bosses
- A wide range of Upgrades with many synergies

title: Glitch Core
description:
게임 정보
Glitch Core
A realistic, tactical, fast paced FPS Rogue Lite, set in a future where AI is deemed too dangerous for earth.
Where you play as an AI agent on a moon base, training in a ruthless combat simulation to improve your skills, that is, until you find the truth behind your existence....

TLDR:
A casual, action packed rogue like FPS game!
Where it's simply fun to shoot things up!
Dark immersive world design with a hint of procedural generation

title: Mech Realm
description:
게임 정보
Mech Realm - a dystopia in which humans have taken a back seat, and the world is ruled by robots and a chosen group of their creators. Progress has reached a point where humans are no longer needed, as robots have replaced almost all professions. You must decide the fate of the world and choose whether to serve the robots or resist.

Main features:

A unique gaming world with various locations and characters



Freedom of choice and exploration of the world of mechs

title: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD
description:
게임 정보
SORROW is a third person survival game set 2 weeks after the outbreak of a brutal parasitic entity. It follows the perspective of a survivor who has survived the initial chaos, and now has to survive the harsh reality of a American continent after humanity's dominance has been tipped.
Your main objective is to survive by any means possible, including murder. The creatures that you once called a human didn't lose their intelligence, and will be able to flank you, dodge your attacks, and even vault over obstacles you do. However, it is best to remember one thing, nothing lasts forever. Your randomized character will inevitably meet their end.
Features:
multiple towns in different parts of the USA (New Mexico, Texas, Colorado, etc)
randomized interiors for each house/building. no two are the same!
A choice between stealth or action at the start of every playthrough.
Basic survival mechanics alongside a infection meter that fills up when being attacked, don't let it get too high or you'll turn.
Completely randomized characters, you could have a man who was keen on melee one playthrough while another could be better at stealth.
A radio system that chronicles the downfall of civilization
House securing system, barricade windows and block doors to delay the attacks of the creatures. (only on houses in rural areas)
Multiplayer included (peer-2-peer)!
best of all? it's completely FREE!
story mode is planned however won't come until after full release.
autokwd: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD

title: A Simple Expurriment
description:
게임 정보
A Simple Expurriment is a combatless metroidvania where stealth is key. Exploration is done both by acquiring new powers and rearranging the levels themselves, and a crucial choice later on will lead to one of two different paths.
          - PUBLIC INFO -
          Finding herself in space by hitching a ride with the alien who kidnapped her three kittens, a cat mom will have to use all of her feline traits in order to find them as she evades the security systems that keep looking for her.
     Fortunately - or not - they're all part of an experiment that aims to understand cats' impressive influence over humans, run by the greedy Toilet Analyst of an even greedier extraterrestrial corporation in his attempt to climb the corporate ladder.
     A Simple Expurriment is a combatless metroidvania where stealth is key - no big deal for a cat, specially the three kittens that were genetically upgraded to jump higher, become undetectable and so on. But that's not enough when all the security systems are after the elusive cat mom: that's why she also gets the ability to manipulate sections of the building like pieces of a sliding puzzle, allowing her to move through the depths of the Research Area, the perils of the Maintenance Area, the exclusive VIP Area and the scariest place in the galaxy - the corporate cafeteria.

title: Wreckage
description:
게임 정보
용감한 영혼과 생존자여, 이 소식을 들으십시오!

대담한 운전자여, 능숙한 총잡이여, 창의적인 기어 헤드여, 그리고 숙련된 트럭 운전사여, 행동할 시간이 왔습니다!

파괴의 여파에서 놀랄 만한 저항력을 보이셨습니다. 굴러간 유리 사막을 가로지르고 연기에 휩싸인 산을 넘고 무자비한 좀비 무리와 I-95 고속도로에서 용감하게 맞서 싸우셨습니다. 이제 여러분은 낙원의 문턱에 서 있습니다. 문명의 마지막 남은 보루 - 해가 비치는 플로리다 남부의 햇볕이 내리쬐는 습지대에 용감한 개인들의 무질서한 공동체입니다.

그러나 운명은 여러분에게 어려운 도전을 내미고, 여러분은 악명 높은 리버 시티 레이더스에 의해 잡혀, 위험한 검투사 투기장에 강제로 끌려갔습니다. 그러나 두려워하지 마십시오. 이 매장에는 영광을 얻을 수 있는 기회가 놓여 있으며, 우리의 안식처의 거룩한 해변을 차지할 수 있는 기회가 있습니다.

파괴의 챔피언, 자신의 장비를 선택하고 최고의 무기로 무장하고 거대한 경기장에서 경쟁을 떠날 여정을 시작하십시오. 혼돈과 학살에서 무적의 챔피언으로 승리하여 길들어진 상대들의 잔해로 포장된 승리의 길을 걸어 보십시오. 이제 용기를 모으십시오, 도전을 받아들이십시오, 그리고 이 용감하고 비길 데 없는 모험의 땅에서 여러분만의 전설을 쓰십시오!

title: Legend of Hidden Flows
description:
게임 정보
《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.

In this game, there is a completely open world, and every restart is a brand new map. Since you were born, you have to start simulating a new life.

You will grow from an unknown person. On the way to growth, you will encounter many strange people, and you can socialize with them or fight decisively.

You can collect the world's spiritual herbs and refine miraculous elixirs and divine medicines; You can also collect legendary minerals, cast epic equipment, and become a legend.

There are many forces in this world, and various conflicts often arise between them. You can join them to serve the faction, or you can be arrogant without any sect.

You can experience a different life in this world.
autokwd: Legend of Hidden Flows,隐流传说

title: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
description:
게임 정보


Never ignore the past, for it will always come back and bite.

Three months have passed since Dawn's transformation. Her time in Providence remains peaceful, but Mar, the demon king and Lucia's father, is approaching.
His presence will change everything, and not everyone will leave Providence unscathed.



Dawn is now a zombie! While her journey to transition is over, her journey is not. She still has much to learn and accept from herself. Including a mysterious ghost friend which Dawn doesn't know whether they're friendly or quite hostile...


After using magic to bring her friend back, Lucia now has to pay the price. She became a talented alchemist, but can she find a cure before her father takes care of the problem his own way?


Long before Providence, Vulcan had found home in the demon realm. She became part of a family that will soon reunite, yet never seemed so far apart. She must now answer to the choices she made so long ago.


-About 40k words (3-4 hours of playtime)
-A linear story that explore Vulcan's past in the demon realm.
-Animated background and visual effects that give life to the environment!
-An entirely original soundtrack, now even richer!

title: Brick Buddies
description:
게임 정보
Partner up!
Brick Buddies is a turbulent couch co-op construction game for 2 players. Take control of one of the wobbly buddies, who both share a crane, and work together to construct epic buildings - or at least something that doesn’t immediately collapse. The higher you build, the more points you cash in. The shakier the whole thing gets, the more your friendship is put to the test! But beware - the innocent-looking sheep want to turn your building dreams into nightmares.
Co-operation is key!
Both buddies are responsible for different tasks on the job. Rotating the crane, picking up building blocks and honking away aggressive sheep have to be coordinated to finish the job on time and with minimal collateral damage.

Features, aka The Fun Stuff:

BRICK-TACULAR MECHANICS: Partner up and dive into the chaotic co-op construction fun with easy to learn but hard to master duo-crane controls. Communicate, stack building blocks and honk away the sweet but sneaky sheep. Try out different strategies on multiple maps and become pro-builders in career mode or construct the ultimate skyscraper in endless mode!




So, what are you waiting for? Grab your trusty sidekick (preferably human, not sheep), crash on that comfy couch, and let the bricklaying (and sheep-dodging) madness begin!
Ready, set, build!

title: Travel Knight Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Travel Knight Adventures is a fast paced first-person shooter adventure game that takes you on a journey through the pre sci-fi age.

You fall from the sky. Now it’s time to explore various settlements, castles, and cities. Delve into mysterious dungeons and tombs filled with hidden treasures, traps, and riddles waiting to be solved.

- More than 30 different weapons and magic items with unique mechanics
- Fast passed combat: mix between melee, throwing, kick, guns and magic
- More than 50 hand crafted location - no procedurally generation
- Move between islands by top-down controlled ship or travel through land by top-down horse

title: Death By Misstep
description:
게임 정보
Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a luxury cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.



- Breathe to the beat of the music so the cruise ship's robots don't detect you!
- Find a way to leave the ship without dying... Don't let them see you!
- Unveil the terrifying backstory of Jessica and the Samos cruise ship.

title: Stunt Xpress
description:
게임 정보
Become a delivery van driver. The best in the world.
Take part in internationally renowned delivery van driving championships.
Shoot your parcels (on time) into customer's homes like a marksman while performing gravity-defying stunts and being chased by god knows what.
Key Features


Van Stunts: Lift the wheels off the ground and nail some wild combos



Deliveries: Shoot parcels out of your van like an archer and hit the bullseye



: Explore procedurally generated maps & championships



Unlock new vans & cosmetics



Gain an edge over your rivals with a variety of unlockable tools

title: Midnight Run
description:
게임 정보
Midnight Run is a casual RPG game where you play as Matt, a regular guy who was just picked to perform a late-night food run of good eats for his friends. There's only one problem. Matt doesn't have much cash, and items he has to get isn't cheap. Not to mention, he doesn't have a car so walking through the city at night is his only choice.


Navigate through the city while finding ways to either earn more cash or get free food. Keep in mind, the city is a strange place at night, so Matt has to be on his guard as he works on completing his food run. Trying to avoid oncoming traffic? No problem. Did you find yourself feeding hungry ghost? Yeah, that's about right. A Giant sewer roaches staring at you as if you're its finest meal of the night? Sure, why not! It's all good when you're doing a Midnight Run.


Game Features:
Multiple endings
Lots of side quest
Tons of Achievements
Hours of gameplay
Game replayability
Encounter the P.D.P. (Powder Doughnut Police)

title: Return to Basic Killing
description:
게임 정보
Return to Basic Killing – An Old-School FPS with Brutal Action
Prepare for relentless, no-nonsense carnage in Return to Basic Killing, a hardcore old-school FPS.. Fast movement, deadly firefights, and secret-filled levels bring back the best of the '90s—modernized for today's shooter fans.
Trapped inside a heavily guarded Nazi fortress, you are Rebekah Razor, a battle-hardened soldier seeking revenge. Break out, blast your way through 30 intense levels, and uncover the horrors of a war-twisted world. Classic gunplay, advanced AI, and a gritty alternate history—are you ready to return to the basics?
🔥 Key Features 🔥
🩸 Classic FPS Action – Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and no hand-holding.
🗺 30 Action-Packed Levels – Huge maps filled with secrets, enemies, and intense fights.
🔫 Old-School Arsenal – Find weapons, loot ammo, and unleash mayhem.
🧠 Smart Enemy AI – Enemies react to sound, alerts, and your tactics.
🕵️ Secrets & Exploration – Hidden rooms, collectibles, and surprises in every level.
🎙 Dynamic Voiceovers – Your enemies will talk—and scream—as they fall.
💀 Multiple Game Modes – Play in Classic Mode or test your skills in Perma-Death Mode.
🌍 A Dark Alternate History
After World War II, history took a terrifying turn. Spain and Portugal joined the Axis. The Third Reich crushed Europe, defeated Britain, and signed a steel-fortified non-aggression pact with Stalin. The world is now divided:
☠ Nazi Europe – An oppressive empire of fear and control.
☭ Communist Asia – A powerhouse standing in opposition.
🗽 The Free World – A fragile alliance of neutral territories, including the USA.
Amid this chaos, one woman fights back.
🩸 Your Story – Escape or Die
You are Rebekah Razor, a war-hardened fighter from the International Brigades who fought fascism in Spain and WWII. Captured behind enemy lines, you've spent years imprisoned in a Nazi fortress hidden deep in the mountains, subjected to horrific experiments.
Now, an opportunity for escape arises. But between you and freedom stand guards, war machines, and monstrous experiments—the twisted results of Nazi science.

title: The Ump Show
description:
게임 정보
Take control of the game as a baseball umpire. Make accurate calls but make sure your team wins!

Pitchers will change up the pitch selection to confuse the batters but you have to be better. Track fastballs and breaking pitches to make accurate strike/ball calls. If you make a terrible call, the players will challenge your call! If you make too many wrong calls, it's game over!

Calls you will make as the home plate umpire:
Ball/Strike
Checked swings
Fair/Foul
Tag Plays and Forceouts

Since you want your preferred team to win, remember to cheat! Giving up too many walks or too many balls can give away the game. Pick your moments and redirect the game at the right time.

To help you, you can spend your integrity to purchase powerups!

Block: Stop a player from challenging your call
Balk: Call a balk on the pitcher and immediately reward a walk to the batter
Eject: Replace the batter or pitcher with your preferred player.
Story Mode

You start as an umpire with no credibility in the amateur leagues. Your goal is to build credibility and earn favors to climb your way to umpiring at the highest levels!

title: Dunchess
description:
게임 정보

Dunchess is a turn-based dungeon crawler where you play chess pieces. Different dungeons present never-boring challenges to overcome while you protect the king and try to remove the enemy pieces.

♟️ Play the chess pieces in different dungeon levels!

We keep the mechanics that you already know how to use and if you don't know how, don't worry! The game is pretty intuitive, showing you what are your possible movements when you hover pieces 😉



We're introducing new tiles to the dungeons, in the case above 👆 it's an activator to elevate bridges. And this is just the start! More will be submitted as we update the game.



Forget about the check, this is a no-regret move type of game. Make a wrong move and pay the price for it 😈



Did we mention that you can create your own maps?! Also, publish them and play others!

title: Dino Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
DINO MAYHEM!
Get your claws out and leave a (massive) footprint in this legendary Dino game! Rampage through cities and sink your teeth into destruction by chomping down on buildings, animals, and all the bipeds that get in your way. Level up your apex status with modern tech like jetpacks and laser guns to bring down your enemies at Dyno-Tech Corporation. Sure, they made you, but they can never control you. Mayhem has never tasted this T-Riffic!
DESTROY buildings and level cites.
EAT humans and other creatures to regain health.
FIGHT your way through the forces of the evil company, Dyno-Tech.
WIELD high-tech weapons to cause mayhem.
RESCUE other dinosaurs to help you on your adventure.
UNLOCK a variety of colorful new skins for your dinos.
4-PLAYER local co-op.

title: Wildwood Down
description:
게임 정보
Wildwood Down is a charming point and click about a quirky high school senior with Down syndrome who embarks on a darkly humorous adventure along the boardwalk of Wildwood, New Jersey. With his sister's life on the line, he must unravel a murder mystery, navigating eccentric characters, unexpected twists, and his own unique perspective to crack the case before time runs out. Can this unlikely hero outsmart the danger lurking beneath the cheerful fa-cade of America's favorite seaside destination?
The main character Daniel is voice-acted by our childhood friend / brother from another mother Daniel himself. He has down-syndrome, a fantastic sense of humor, and loves video games. If anyone deserves his own game it's this guy.
This indie game is a special project for us and we look forward to giving a percentage of the profits to a when the game is released!

title: The Spiral
description:
게임 정보
The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Explore the dungeon, find tools for your survival, and try to escape with your life.
Descend into Darkness
Explore an infinite dungeon with randomized layouts, items, and enemies. No two playthroughs are the same.
Find Powerful Equipment
Make use of the dungeon's bounty to survive. Simple farming tools, legendary weapons, curious potions, and enchanted charms are all at your disposal.
Fight for Your Life
You are not alone. Monsters, nightmares, and other desperate wanderers like you all call the dungeon home. Kill them before they kill you.

title: Rogue Souls
description:
게임 정보
