When the Lich is released, it unleashes its dark magic upon the world, reviving old spirits, ancient creatures, and new monsters. But in its arrogance, it also brings back ancient Souls; Souls with their will intact, serving no one but their purpose.
Gameplay:
Rogue Souls combines the exploration and looting of a 'Roguelike' with the difficulty of a 'Souls' game, where your skill is everything. Whether defeating all enemies without taking a single hit or facing the weakest enemy repeatedly. Bring various Souls to life with unique abilities and weapons, making each playthrough feel completely different. Wield powerful items to strengthen your character and fulfill your main objective: not to die.
Features:
- 4 different types of Souls.

- 16 usable weapons.

- Randomly generated rooms.

- +20 unique items

title: Cosmorons
description:
게임 정보
COSMORONS
Greetings, cosmic conquerors! We present to you COSMORONS, an old-school futuristic shooter about comedic robot drudges conquering the cosmos with outlandish weapons & hijinks galore.  To achieve ultimate glory, grapple, shoot, and drill your way to galactic domination. New areas bring big rewards, but drastically increase in difficulty.
SINGLE PLAYER / ONLINE CO-OP GAMEPLAY
Take on the universe as a conquest of one or play co-op with your fellow Drudges! Cosmorons offers both single player and co-op gameplay. As a single player, combat alien factions, complete thrilling challenges and collect planetary cores on your own. In co-op play, it's you and a team of fellow Drudges versus the universe! Online co-op means you and your friends can play from the comforts of your own home.

title: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure
description:
게임 정보


Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure is a captivating 3D puzzle/adventure game where your goal is to guide Lum, a brave light spirit, through a world filled with challenging puzzles and stunning environments. Rotate the levels, think creatively, and solve intricate puzzles to reach the magical purple crystal that hold the key to Lum's journey.
Key Features:

Innovative Puzzle Mechanics: Rotate and manipulate the environment in unique ways to solve puzzles. Each level presents new challenges that require both logic and strategy to overcome.

Four Distinct Chapters: Embark on a journey through 4 beautifully crafted chapters, each with 10 levels, more chapters will be available as we go on. Every chapter introduces its own unique visual style and puzzle elements, ensuring that no two levels are the same.

Visually Stunning Environments: Explore a world where every chapter has a distinct look and feel, from mystical nature to ancient ruins, each rendered in a vibrant and enchanting art style.

Immersive Audio Experience: Enjoy a captivating soundtrack and sound effects that enhance the gameplay and draw you deeper into Lum's world. The music sets the mood perfectly, whether you're deep in thought or celebrating a hard-earned victory.

Challenging and Rewarding Gameplay: Test your puzzle-solving skills with a variety of intricate puzzles. The satisfaction of figuring out each level is matched only by the excitement of discovering what lies ahead.

Can you help Lum collect all the crystals and unlock the mysteries of this enchanted world? Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure offers hours of engaging gameplay for puzzle enthusiasts and adventure lovers alike. Start your journey today!

title: Operation Terra
description:
게임 정보
Operation Terra는 절차적으로 생성된 레벨과 맵이 있는 공상과학 1인칭 슈팅/롤플레잉 게임입니다.
당신을 막으려는 끈질긴 기계들과 싸우는 동안 새로운 지구인 테라에 인류가 정착할 길을 닦으세요.
싸움

무엇이든 불가능하게 만드는 것이 유일한 목표인 드론, 드로이드, 로봇, 탱크, 포탑과 싸우세요. 보너스와 파워업을 수집하세요.
탐험

거의 무한한 절차적으로 생성된 맵과 레벨 레이아웃을 탐험하세요.
모든 플레이가 똑같지는 않습니다.
업그레이드

미션에서 약탈한 크레딧으로 무기와 장비를 업그레이드하세요. 기지에서 영구 업그레이드를 구매하세요. 기지의 새로운 부분에 접근할 수 있는 허가를 받으세요.

최종 게임은 30개의 고유한 적, 6개의 서로 다른 환경, 전체적으로 30개의 고유한 타일 세트를 특징으로 하며, 각각은 2~4개의 서로 다른 텍스처 세트와 절차적으로 매치되어 다양성과 재생성을 더했습니다.

title: Brickhaven
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Brickhaven
Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and muster up any juicy prospects along the way to help build your criminal empire.
The Empire
-Recruit your members right off the street
-Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits
-Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city
-Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything is able to be automated through delegation
Rule the Streets

title: Souls Survivors
description:
게임 정보
마지막 세계가 무너진다. 마지막 영웅이 일어난다.
Souls Survivors에서 당신의 모든 발걸음은 죽어가는 우주 속 생존을 위한 전투입니다.
혼돈이 모든 생명을 삼키는 역동적인 액션 로그라이크 세계로 뛰어드세요. 광기의 적들을 베어내고, 고대의 공포와 싸우며, 사라지는 세계의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.
치명적인 빌드를 만들고 파괴적인 능력을 익혀 문명이 붕괴한 땅에서 생존을 위한 힘을 찾아나가세요.
게임 특징:
끝없는 전투:
타락한 기사, 악마, 사이버 괴물 등 수천의 적과 싸우며 매번 새로운 도전에 맞서세요.
긴장감 넘치는 보스전:
고대의 지배자들과 대면하고 그들의 힘을 흡수하여 적을 무기로 삼으세요.
다양한 지역과 고유한 메커니즘:
버려진 유적, 저주받은 숲, 하늘의 도시, 숨겨진 미궁 등 각각 독특한 환경 효과, 함정, 비밀을 지닌 장소에서 시련에 도전하세요.
무한한 빌드 가능성:
수백 개의 능력을 조합하고 영웅 고유 특성과 시너지를 통해 다양한 전투 스타일을 창조하세요.
다차원의 영웅들:
붕괴된 세계에서 등장한 영웅들과 그들의 대체 버전을 해금하세요. 각기 다른 전투 스타일과 성장 루트를 가집니다.
몰락한 문명의 세계:
전설의 유물을 수집하고 잊혀진 이야기를 밝혀내 우주 붕괴의 진실에 접근하세요.
생존자 도전:
특별한 난이도와 도전을 통해 당신의 실력을 증명하세요.
Souls Survivors는 매번의 도전이 세계를 구할 기회이자, 함께 몰락할 수도 있는 여정입니다.
모든 것이 무너져가는 세계에서, 당신의 선택과 용기가 운명을 결정할 것입니다.
우리에 대해
우리는 몇 명의 소규모 개발자로 구성된 팀으로, 우리가 정말 만들고 싶은 게임을 위해 일하고 있습니다.
게임에 관심을 가져주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다.
위시리스트에 추가해 주시면 저희에게 큰 도움이 됩니다!

title: Byte Breach
description:
게임 정보
                                                          AI 메가코프를 공략하라!
디스토피아 미래, AI 대기업이 모든 데이터를 통제합니다. 당신은 "브리처"(Breacher): 핵심 정보 탈취를 위해 고위험 계약을 수행하는 숙련된 요원입니다. 이익, 신념, 혹은 생존을 위해 팀을 이루세요 (1~4인 플레이, 솔로 가능). 회피만이 살길인 이 긴장감 넘치는 SF 호러 코옵에 참여하십시오.
디지털 월드를 해킹하라
"디지털 비전"(Digital Vision)을 활성화하십시오: 현실과 얽힌 숨겨진 디지털 네트워크를 드러내는 통합 AR 오버레이입니다. 이 레이어를 활용하여 데이터 스트림을 추적하고, AI 시그니처를 탐지하며, 보안을 우회하십시오. 데이터 탈취는 예술입니다. 당신의 가젯으로 스킬 기반 마이크로 챌린지를 수행하고, 불안정한 데이터 사이펀을 관리하십시오. 두 현실을 모두 마스터하여 우위를 점하십시오.
(1~4인) 코옵: 시너지가 핵심
진정한 팀워크는 가장 강력한 자산입니다. 복잡한 데이터 상호작용 중 팀원을 지원하고, 제한된 아이템을 공유하며, 차원 초월 전략을 조율하여 함께 브리치를 돌파하십시오.
무한한 헤이스트
절차적으로 생성되는 시설과 역동적인 AI 위협 증가는 어떤 데이터 헤이스트도 결코 똑같지 않음을 보장합니다.
브리처를 진화시키십시오
"바이트 웹"(Byte Web)에 뛰어드십시오: 임무에서 획득한 "지식 노드"(KN)를 사용하여 방대한 "특전 (Perk)" 네트워크를 잠금 해제하십시오. 자유롭게 조합하여 자신만의 로드아웃을 만들고, 능력을 업그레이드하며, 전략을 맞춤 설정하십시오. 어려운 다단계 임무를 완료하여 사이버 랭크를 올리고, 상위 티어 능력과 게임의 판도를 바꾸는 특전 전문화를 잠금 해제하십시오. 자신만의 스타일을 구축하십시오!
격상되는 보안에 맞서라
여러분은 정지된 목표물을 공격하는 것이 아닙니다. 기업 AI가 여러분 팀의 "디지털 발자국"(Digital Footprint)을 추적합니다. 악명이 높아질수록 보안 프로토콜도 강화됩니다: 더 발전된 AI 유닛, 정교한 디지털 ICE (침입 방지 대책 전자 장비), 그리고 여러분의 분대에 도전하기 위해 맞춤 제작된 시설 방어 체계에 대비하십시오. 모든 플레이가 진화합니다.
위험과 보상
초기 목표를 달성했습니까? 전리품을 가지고 탈출하여 다음 브리치를 준비하거나, 증폭된 위협에 맞서 더 큰 보상을 위해 더 깊이 파고드십시오. 선택은 당신의 몫입니다!

title: Quiz Racer
description:
게임 정보
퀴즈 경주는 빠르게 진행되는 무중력 레이싱 퀴즈 게임으로, 절차적으로 생성된 환경으로 학습에 중독될 수 있습니다!
장애물 피하기
절차적으로 생성된 끝없이 펼쳐진 트랙에서 다양한 장애물을 통과하며 속도를 내야 합니다. 두 번의 달리기는 결코 같을 수 없습니다!
질문에 답하기
도중에 질문이 나타나고 우주선을 빠르게 충돌시켜 정답을 맞혀야 합니다!
재미있는 학습
빠르게 진행되는 게임 플레이 루프는 재미있고 중독성 있게 설계되었으며, 마주치는 문제를 기억할 수 있도록 도와줍니다.
친구들과 경쟁
최고 점수를 업로드하고 친구들과 비교해 보세요. 은하계에서 가장 빠른 퀴즈 파일럿이 누구인지 알아보세요!
향후 기능
계획된 기능은 다음과 같습니다:
지리, 언어, 수학, 의학 등 다양한 카테고리의 질문
우주선의 능력치에 영향을 미치는 차원 간 우주선의 사용자 정의 가능한 부품
플레이하면서 새로운 부품, 장애물 유형 및 문제 팩을 잠금 해제하는 진행 시스템
학습을 추적하는 통계
스페인어, 독일어, 이탈리아어, 프랑스어, 중국어 및 러시아어를 포함한 8 개 이상의 언어 현지화

title: Covert Crew
description:
게임 정보
- 클래식 2D 턴제 전술
전투 파괴 가능한 구조물, 보조 목표, 독특한 보스 전투를 통해 그리드 기반 전투를 벌이세요.
 - 20개 이상의 플레이 가능한 유닛
각기 고유한 힘, 외모, 개성, 공격력을 가진 다양한 캐릭터에서 모집하세요.
 - 팀원과의 시너지
좋아하는 승무원과 함께 일하며 시너지를 높여 새로운 유대감 장면, 장비, 전투 중 보너스를 잠금 해제하세요.
 - 당신의 힘이 무기입니다
 파워 모듈레이터를 장착하여 공격을 수정하고, 파워와 속도를 높이거나, 상태 효과를 부여할 확률을 추가하세요. 게임을 진행하면서 새로운 모듈레이터를 잠금 해제하고 제작하세요.

title: Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
They are billions. You are alone.
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman.

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.
Steal the weapon and obliterate them.
Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way.
A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.
The Brotherhood is a retro-shooter with classic Wolfenstein 3D style. You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience.
Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.
There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs.

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that.
Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces.
You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.
No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.
Destroy Them All!

title: Unbox Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Unbox Tactics는 전략과 깜짝 요소가 결합된 로그라이크 턴제 전술 게임입니다. 시작 영웅을 선택하고 육각형 전장에서 전투를 펼치며, 미스터리 박스를 열어 개성 넘치는 전사들로 최강의 팀을 구성하세요.
게임은 한 명의 영웅으로 시작됩니다. 적을 처치하고 골드를 획득해 상점에서 미스터리 박스를 열고 새로운 동료를 영입할 수 있습니다. 하지만 팀은 최대 세 명까지 구성할 수 있으므로, 새 영웅을 얻을 때마다 누군가를 포기해야 합니다.
각 스테이지에 들어가기 전, 무작위로 제시되는 타일 팩 중 하나를 선택하게 됩니다 — 예: 숲, 사막, 사이버 시티 등 테마별 생태계가 있으며, 각각 고유한 적, 함정, 보상이 존재합니다. 선택한 팩에 따라 전장의 난이도와 전략이 달라집니다.
결정적인 판단을 내리고, 캐릭터의 능력을 최대한 활용하며, 아이템을 조합해 강력한 시너지를 만들어 보세요. 실패하더라도 영구적인 업그레이드를 통해 매번 점점 더 강해집니다.
예측 불가능한 전투를 열어보세요. 팀을 구성하고, 전략으로 승리하세요!

title: Room 404
description:
게임 정보
존경하는 주민 여러분:
최근에 많은 주민분들께서 요즘 한밤중에 4층에서 이상한 소리가 자주 난다고 말씀하셨습니다.
조사를 하였고 당분간 4층에 엘레베이터를 멈추지 않게 설정하였습니다. 불편을 드리게 된 점 양해 부탁드립니다.
실수로 4층에 가시게 되었다면, 나가지 못해도 절대로 당황하지 마시고 4층 복도를 유!심!히! 살펴보시기를 바랍니다.
이상이 없다면 왔던 길로 되돌아가시면 되고, 이상이 있다면 그대로 직진하십시오.
새로 모신 수호신께서 이미 계단에 도착하셔서 귀신을 물러내고 평화를 지키고 계십니다.
전문적인 도사님도 이번달에 오실예정이오니 모두들 안심하시기를 바랍니다.
모두 무사하기를 바랍니다.
게임 특징:
초현실적인 렌더링
가상엔진 5와 대량으로 스캔된 컨텐츠 라이브러리를 사용하는 이 게임은 몰입도가 높고 초현실적인 중국 레트로 호러 환경을 제공합니다.
단편적인 스토리 텔링
이상한 상황들 사이의 연관성을 발견하고 4층 주민들의 이야기를 둘러싼 미스터리를 알아냅니다.
단순한 "틀린 그림 찾기"가 아님

title: Cabral's Quest
description:
게임 정보
Cabral’s Quest is a pixel art puzzle game set in a hidden world underneath the wetlands, ancient homeland of the capybaras.

Make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed to help Cabral reclaim their land. Use different runes to change the elements of the world around you to solve each puzzle.
GOALS



RESCUE BABY CAPYBARAS
Baby capybaras are hidden across the world, lost after the occupation of their lands.
They're optional collectibles to prove your ability.

OBTAIN EACH FRAGMENT OF THE SACRED DEED
And help Cabral recover the land of his community.
Cross portals, doors or bridges and try to avoid the wildlife around to make your way to each fragment of the sacred deed.

CONCEPT

LOGICAL AND LATERAL THINKING
Set in a calm atmosphere, encouraging deep thinking in both logical and lateral ways.


Based on the combination and switching of game elements’ colors, allowing for an accessible but rich gameplay.


Crafted with specific wildlife and natural elements that expand the original mechanics creating new experiences and puzzles.




Use the to modify the elements of the world, changing their color and disabling them to solve the puzzles.


Each element and enemy has different behaviour, and color is always at the core of each mechanic.

Use portals, doors, bridges and other elements to move around the levels.

Avoid the corrupted wildlife that will make your way to the harder.

title: Rusted Awakening
description:
게임 정보
Deep below, in a darkened, rusting world. Humanity has been forgotten. Progress without progress. Those who should have preserved life destroyed it, and what remains is a broken reflection of the human form. Rusted pipes. Twisted wires. Menacing liquids bubble through the bodies of those who remain. They’ve forgotten the meaning of things.
Now you’ve awakened, and the life in you draws them near. You must make your way through this industrial nightmare.
This is your Rusted Awakening.
Weapons hit hard. Movement keeps you alive. Every shot matters. Every encounter is brutal.
Distilled from the liquids of the dead, a powerful injection system lets you augment your abilities on the fly... but at what cost?

title: Inhabitants
description:
게임 정보
Watch the development of this game live on twitch!
Inhabitants is a single-player horror game that has you delve into the mysterious disappearance of your friend.
They left without a trace. Their apartment was left unlocked and seemingly empty. Maybe there is something that can point you in the right direction?
Uncover the mysteries behind their disappearance. 
Your only clue is their computer. But what lies within may not be best if found.

title: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzle Challenge
description:
게임 정보
This game is an ultra-high difficulty jigsaw puzzle where players embark on a challenging journey. Players must fit pieces into the correct positions to complete images generated randomly using colored tiles.

However, this game deviates significantly from traditional jigsaw puzzles. Placing a piece triggers several unexpected events. For example, with each piece placed, the colors gradually fade, increasing the difficulty for players to discern the image. Additionally, the workspace gradually shrinks, forcing players to work within tighter confines.

Moreover, placing a piece in the wrong position triggers an explosion, resetting the game from the beginning. Players must carefully select pieces and place them accurately.

Furthermore, players may encounter falling debris when placing pieces, obscuring their view and adding to the challenge.

This game serves as a test of players' concentration and strategic thinking, offering an extremely challenging puzzle experience. Can players accurately fit all the pieces and complete the puzzle?

title: Archery Pro VR
description:
게임 정보
Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR!

There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

Be warned, archery is extremely addictive and challenging.

You can compete online with friends or other players and climb the tournament ranks and unlock amazing rewards.

Players can also experience a realistic and challenging single player campaign by tackling specific trick shots and situations. Friends can compare scores and progress with each other on the leaderboard.

title: Red Snow
description:
게임 정보


RED SNOW is the most violent snowboarding game on planet earth.

Hit the slopes with an arsenal of weapons.

Combo your way through an arctic battlefield as you flip, spin, and grind for your life.

Upgrade your weapon loadout and build your dream snowboarder-warrior.

Paint the slopes red with their blood. Welcome to RED SNOW.

title: Temples Vs Buildings
description:
게임 정보


Fight against a vast array of flying buildings: 18 different enemies in early acess.

Get stronger with relics: 11 relics that changes the gameplay in early acess.

title: XenoTechArena
description:
게임 정보
Xenotech Arena is a Roguelite arena shooter set in Neo-Japan inspired arena.
A variety of characters such as Geisha Girl, Ninja Head, and Sumo Rider are playable.
Choose and collect over 70 different power-up items to enhance your player!
If you can get class change items, you can evolve and further enhance your players.
Take on screen-filling monsters with your enhanced character and enjoy the exhilarating experience of tackling and blasting them!
Collect items in dungeon mode and see how long you can survive in arena mode!

title: Sleeping Forest
description:
게임 정보
Hey there, fearless adventurers! Welcome to the wild bunch that is "Sleeping Forest"!

👉 Assemble Your Dream Team:
Imagine this: you're the hotshot leader of the "Sleeping Forest" mercenary group, and your team is as dynamic as a wizard at a disco. But guess what? It's not just these four legends; no sir, you're gonna be recruiting mercenaries along the way! Build your dream squad, and watch it grow like a happy garden of destruction.

🤔 No Room for the Faint of Heart:
Get ready to make decisions that'll make your granny blush! In the heat of battle, one wrong move, and BAM! Perma-death's knocking on your door. Every choice matters, but hey, that's what makes victory taste so sweet. Will you rise to the challenge or crumble like a cookie under pressure?

🌎 Fantasy World Extravaganza:
We're not in Kansas anymore—say hello to a medieval-fantasy mashup that's weirder than ... well its weird, trust me! Explore magical lands, encounter quirky creatures, and unlock the secrets of this world inspired by the coolest parts of our own history.

💘 Love in the Air (and Maybe Some Arrows):
Who said mercenaries can't catch feelings? Amidst the chaos, expect a dash of romance to spice up the battlefield. Forge bonds, make choices, and maybe, just maybe, find love in the weirdest places. Love and war, they say – let’s see if you can conquer both!

🕵️‍♀️ Puzzles and Investigations, Oh My!:
It's not all hack and slash – put that brain to work! Solve puzzles, unravel mysteries, and outsmart your enemies. It's like being a detective in armor, and trust us, nothing says "victory" like outwitting your foes.

👬 Party Time with Pals:
Grab your buds because "Sleeping Forest" supports local couch co-op multiplayer! Team up, laugh together, and probably argue over battle strategies. It's a party, and everyone's invited to this medieval-fantasy fiesta!

🏆 Buddy, Are You Up for the Challenge?:
So, ready to dive into "Sleeping Forest" and create your own legend? It's not just a game; it's a rollicking adventure filled with laughs, tears, and a sprinkle of magic. Gather your wits, recruit your squad, and let's turn this fantasy world upside down!

Adventure awaits, my friend. Let's make history together!

title: Exorkízein
description:
게임 정보
Exorkízein is an entity-hunting multiplayer co-op game. Immerse yourself in real-life haunted location replicas as well as folklore entities, each with its unique behavior and aspects. Join Theo's paranormal crew on a mission to investigate and capture entities around the world.


Using real life ghost investigation equipment and fiction capturing weapons we want to bring a full experience of the hunt, not only investigate but also capture entities.


Allow up to 32 people per lobby so you can get to know people before getting into missions to prevent trolls, also we are working to improve overall experience compared to other multiplayer games of the genre related to network and server prediction.


Starting with 24 entities half ghosts and half demons we based their features into real life folklore characters from different places of the world.


With 13 haunted location replicas, we aim to bring worldwide culture so everyone can feel identified with the game, and not only people from a certain geographical area.

title: TransmuTowers
description:
게임 정보
How To Get Involved Pre-Release
Wishlist, follow, and join our Discord for opportunities to play in early playtests and help craft the game. We would love to get a small core group of players who love the tower defense and bullet heaven genres so we can make a great game that fits your tastes!
Explore the Campaign
Welcome to the world of Valber! In TransmuTowers, you will explore Valber through a variety of maps, each with their own resources, challenges, and monsters to defeat.

title: Cookie
description:
게임 정보
Cookie is an engaging idle game where players step into the role of a skilled baker, producing both ingredients and delicious cookies. These items can either be sold on a dynamic online marketplace to other players or used directly to bake even more tempting cookies. With each transaction, market prices fluctuate, creating a constant rise and fall in value.

When you sell your last batch of flour right before the prices crash...
Players have the power to influence the economy by strategically buying or selling to maximize their profits. Through clever trading and efficient management, they can dominate the market and expand their cookie empire. The cycle of production, sales, and market influence creates an immersive, interactive world where every decision can shift the balance of the marketplace.

title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
description:
게임 정보
Fight back against the powerful wizard who has captured your village under his spell.

Battle your way into his ever-shifting towers and tangle with his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.

The castle is always similar but never the same, can you find the way and complete your siege of the shifting fortress?


Optimize your hero for close-quarters combat, long-range assaults, or magical dominance. Do you shoot a Bow, or prefer the balance of a Sword and Shield? How about the raw damage of a Great Sword or the brute force of a Warhammer? Mix and match weapons and abilities to create a combat style tailored to you. Experiment with different builds, each offering distinct advantages and tactical options. Choose your style, master your weapons and select abilities that will allow you to dominate your foes.


Master elemental magic to inflict status effects such as freeze, burn, and poison on your enemies. Ice spells slow and eventually freeze them. Once frozen, focus on other threats as they slowly thaw, or shatter them with a physical attack for bonus damage. Use the raw power of Fire to damage and eventually set your enemies ablaze for high damage over time. Poison spells will weaken your adversaries and slowly drain the life out of them. Each element offers unique strategic advantages and effects that you can use to your benefit.


Reveal Synergy Abilities as you raise specific skills to a threshold, which then unlocks a new, combined ability. For instance, enhance your swordplay by reaching proficiency in both Ice Magic and Enhancement Magic, allowing you to imbue your blade with a chilling freeze effect. Alternatively, level up Fire Magic and Block to gain a burning aura ability that damages nearby adversaries. These synergy abilities reward raising skills thoughtfully to unlock powerful new capabilities.


As you ascend the formidable tower, your mission involves rescuing villagers trapped within its walls. Each villager you free adds a valuable ally to your cause.
Unlock a trainer who can enhance your stats, a blacksmith who upgrades your equipment, or an alchemist to upgrade your potions. These freed villagers' skills become essential to your journey, making you a formidable force against tougher adversaries awaiting on higher floors.
Navigate the tower's mysteries, utilize your expanding network of skilled villagers, and break the chains of oppression. Every rescue sharpens your edge in battle and binds the fate of the tower with your own.


There are combat skills like Sword, Greatsword, and Bow. And, magical ones like Transformation and Summoning.
The choice is yours to develop a character that fits your strategy and preferences.
Master the art of melee with the Warhammer or Spear. Alternatively wield the destructive force of Fire Magic, the freezing power of Ice Magic, or keep you and your friends healthy with Life Magic.
Our skill system is not just limited to combat, it also includes practical abilities like Scouting, which enhances your ability to detect enemies and treasures, and Focus, which intensifies your precision. Each skill can be raised when you level up, unlocking new abilities along the way. Perfect your dodge, to gracefully evade enemy attacks, or research Wind Magic to control the flow of battle. Every skill you choose can dramatically influence your journey and combat effectiveness.
Forge your path to greatness, refine your abilities, and become a legend in a land where skill mastery is the gateway to unrivaled power.


Search every corner of each room to find chests and upgrade your equipment. Find magical items that enhance your stats, skills or grant unique abilities. Equip yourself for glory, and let your gear tell the story of your journey as you rise to become the ultimate hero.

Stand alone against the dark.. just you.. and seven of your friends! Join forces in our online co-op game, supporting up to 8 players. Or navigate the tower alone, mastering the game at your own pace to overcome the toughest dungeons and defeat the most difficult bosses. The amount of loot and the difficulty of monsters are multiplied as more players join. Whether you're a lone wolf or a team player, you can have the experience that you desire. Prepare to forge your path, conquer enemies, and achieve greatness, however you choose to play.

Dive into adventures, tackle challenges, and enjoy seamless gameplay with friends worldwide. Experience teamwork, strategy, and unforgettable moments as you struggle to ascend the tower. The adventure begins now!

*Note: Racing the tower key has no real purpose other than sheer entertainment value, so don't sprain an ankle.

Oh, you mean that fountain of life? That thing is super cool. It not only saves your progress, but it revives your character too. And, it projects itself into the dungeon to create fountain resting and save stations for you. It's like it has a mind of its own. Buy the game and take a sip and see for yourself!

However, when its life-giving properties were discovered that's where all the trouble began. You see... in this story, some people want to live forever but are going about it the wrong way. Take our main villain for example. His dark magic has aged and corrupted his body, so when he heard about the fountain he immediately invaded the village.

The wizard sought to consume the magical village fountain and take its life-giving properties, but the fountain has a magic of its own. With its powerful life magic the fountain has repelled the wizard.

Stunned and angry the wizard has hidden in the castle and begun experiments to break the fountains' protection. His experiments have produced monstrous creatures that roam throughout the halls. He then hid his location by casting a powerful spell of "Shifting". This makes the dungeons change each time they are entered. He has hidden the path to find him and commanded his minions guard his halls.

Fight your way into his ever-shifting towers and battle his minions. Drag treasures from the halls to build your strength. And finally, take the fight to the wizard himself to set your village free.
autokwd: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress

title: Trasmoz Legends
description:
게임 정보
⚔️ Trasmoz Legends: 궁극의 레트로 아케이드 도전
ZX Spectrum과 Amstrad CPC에서 찬사를 받은 홈브류 게임 시리즈의 최종 장에 참여하세요. 이번에는 황금기의 아케이드 게임처럼 완벽한 버전을 경험할 수 있습니다.
👾 진정한 8비트 픽셀 아트와 칩튠 사운드
16가지 엄선된 색상 팔레트와 저해상도 스프라이트로 1984년 아케이드 스타일을 완벽 재현. 전설적인 Yamaha YM2203 칩으로 FM 합성과 PSG를 결합한 독특한 사운드트랙을 제공합니다.
FM 베이스 라인, 복고풍 신시사이저, 명료한 멜로디로 가득 찬 사운드가 몰입형 아케이드 경험을 선사합니다.
🛡️ 모든 플레이어를 위한 다양한 모드
Family Mode — 무한 크레딧과 쉬운 난이도로 어린이도 쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다.
Classic Mode — 고전 아케이드의 진정한 도전. 난이도 상승, 제한된 크레딧, 한 생명 한 생명이 중요합니다.
Speedrun Mode — 시간을 경쟁하며 순위를 올리세요.

title: Chicken with Robot Legs
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Chicken with Robot Legs!
You are a chicken that wakes up in an unknown place. Not knowing who you are or why are you there you know one thing, you gotta get out of there!
Explore a 2D pixel world with a lot of secrets and collectibles, the chicken doesn't stop moving forward, you'll need to use your abilities and environment to traverse and find a way out.

Features
- the first game that combines the Runner and the Metroidvania genres a "Runner-Vania" game.
- explore alternate paths to uncover secrets and collectibles.
- upgrade the chicken with abilities that help you reach for new places.
- never stop running, use the scenery and abilities in neat ways to get your way around.
- collect various kinds of items to get rewards or open secret paths.

title: Elevator Down
description:
게임 정보
Judge the Fate of the Dead in this satirical, bureaucratic, decision-making game. Talk to Souls, check their documents, reference Holy Texts and decide if they're going Up or Down. Follow the Rules or trust your own moral compass and see where your choices take you - hopefully not the Elevator Down.
Read different documents, from Life Summaries to Holy Texts, and decide each Soul's Fate. Test your ability to follow complex guidelines, as you decide who goes Up and who Down!
Balance strict Rules from various Religions, while also adhering to your own sense of Justice. Each Soul has you face ethical dilemmas, making every decision hinge on your morality!

title: Rising Sands
description:
게임 정보
Set in a post-apocalyptic world, as ex-military soldier Daku, discover the secrets of the sand and reveal how the world has gotten to this state. Uncover the many groups formed after the war, from the government corporation EcoSurge to the eco-terrorist group Rising Sands, and many more.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Rising Sands features grounded third person shooter gameplay mixed with fantasy. Heavily inspired by classic RPG titles alongside modern Shooters, the ever changing environments constantly being tampered by The Gemini's rising sand make for a unique experience for every player. The captivating story along with these elements lead to gripping boss fights that push Daku to his limits.



Rising Sands features complex characters in a world where no one truly knows who is right. See all sides of the story and discover what really happened after the war.

title: Aisla
description:
게임 정보
Play as Aisla, a woman who wakes up with no memories in a complex on Mars.
Your objective is to explore the environments and discover who the character is and what situation she is in.

Key Features:

- Narrative Driven Adventure
- Cinematic Cutscenes
- Mind Map: Keep track of your discoveries
- Collectables Objects
- Licensed Indie Soundtrack & Original Soundtrack
- Hand-painted mixed with semi realistic visuals

title: Into The Craft
description:
게임 정보
Into the Craft is an Open World survival game, where you will create your own place.

Whenever you do an activity, you level up a profession. Develop your character, to unlock more crafting recipes and become better at everyday work!

You can engage in a variety of activities such as:

- Gathering

- Farming

- Tame and raise animals

- Cooking

- Build a small village

- Exploration

- Craft at workstations

- Trade with villagers

- Fight and loot the enemy Camps

and much more!

Gain experience points in categories like Mining, Lumber, Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy, Building, Fighting and Jewelcraft. Level them up by doing tasks in the game world, to unlock new recipes, be able to gather better resources, or fight more dangeorus foes!

title: Paranatural
description:
게임 정보

온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 팀을 이루거나 혼자서 계약을 완료하며, 다양한 초자연 사냥 장비를 사용하여 유령을 식별하세요.
식별된 유령의 유형에 따라 독특한 퇴마 의식을 수행하세요.
주의: 퇴마에 실패하면 파괴적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.
현재 16가지의 독특한 퇴마 의식이 있으며, 출시 후 더욱 많은 의식이 추가될 예정입니다.


Paranatural은 이전에 본 적 없는 독창적이고 동적인 유령 시스템을 사용합니다.
50가지 이상의 동적 반응 기반 유령 이벤트로 이루어진 전에 없던 무서운 경험이 언제나 가까이에 있습니다.
유령은 당신의 모든 움직임을 학습하고 적응하여, 자신의 능력과 환경을 활용합니다.
동적 유령 시스템은 모든 기본 게임 위치뿐만 아니라 커뮤니티가 만든 사용자 지정 위치에서도 자동으로 작동합니다!


유령 사냥의 여정 동안 유령 사냥에 특화된 애플리케이션이 장착된 특별한 전화기가 제공됩니다.
이 애플리케이션들은 영구적으로 전화기에 남아 있으며, 레벨 업할수록 게임 내 상점에서 구매할 수 있습니다.


Unreal Engine의 MetaHumans를 사용하여 완전한 기능을 갖춘 캐릭터 커스터마이저로 외모와 의상을 커스터마이즈할 수 있습니다.

title: Decktamer
description:
게임 정보
Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?
In Decktamer, you'll encounter creatures that have adapted to their strange environment: the abyss. Rumor has it that anyone brave enough to reach the bottom of the giant crater will find great fortune. But watch out, as you dive deeper, the creatures only get more and more bizarre and dangerous...
In this game, cards are not simply handed out to you, you have to tame your enemies to add them to your deck!
But be careful, when one of your creature dies, the card is gone forever!

title: Dreamers Disease
description:
게임 정보


Dreamers Disease is a fast-paced atmospheric boomer shooter where you go deeper into your dreams to kill the illness dubbed "Dreamers Disease". Thanks to new technology you are able to Shoot Yourself in the head, and the bullets fly back at higher speeds! But you will have to be really careful with your health while doing this.



The game is inspired by FPS games such as Dusk and ULTRAKILL. Dreamers Disease is Fast and Chaotic, you will get overwhelmed by the variety of enemies and you will die, but if you focus and prioritize enemies you just might make it out alive.



Explore impossible spaces and nonsensical architecture that your dreams create, you never know where the Dreamers Disease will be.



Dreamers Disease has a big focus on worldbuilding and story. You will have to look for clues as to what is happening and to figure out that most of what you think, isn't what it seems.

title: Galactic Love Utopia
description:
게임 정보
You are a fanfiction writer who gets kidnapped by aliens. But instead of being probed or experimented upon you are taken to a space station run by a mysterious rich backer who selects a single member of each known intelligent alien species to write more for them to read. You are the only human on a writer's retreat space station filled with different alien species.
In Galactic Love Utopia you will meet and get to know a bunch of intergalactic babes as you try to get used to living in this luxurious yet strange environment.
Gameplay
Galactic Love Utopia is a story focused visual novel with some dating simulator elements. Make choices and decide which part of the space station you want to explore by selecting a room to visit on the interactive map. Focus on improving your relationship with one or some of the main heroines, or visit a place where none of them tend to hang out for a scene with one of the side heroines.
Main heroines
, a shy woman from an alien species whose skin color changes depending on their emotions.

title: The Real Face of a VTuber
description:
게임 정보

—Mr. C, CEO of world-famous VTuber Kuripa's agency, has been brutally murdered. Possible suspects have been whittled down to one of the agency's six employees, three of which claim to be Kuripa's "real face," saying they were streaming as Kuripa during Mr. C's murder—the perfect alibi! As Prosecutor Justin Truth, it is your job to uncover the lies and find Mr. C's killer!




As prosecutor, it's up to you to question all possible suspects, uncover conflicts in their statements, and determine the outcome of the case. After collecting enough evidence, players can make their final decision on who to prosecute.




With proper questioning, guide friendly witnesses to provide testimony favorable to the prosecution. Present evidence to reveal weaknesses, undermine the credibility of hostile witnesses, and win victory in the courtroom!
autokwd: The Real Face of a VTuber,誰是中之人

title: Redemption
description:
게임 정보
Redemption은 2000년대의 액션 슈터 및 서바이벌 게임을 기반으로 한 일인칭 액션 호러 게임으로, Redemption은 더 느린 페이스의 슈터와 서바이벌 호러 요소를 혼합하려고 노력합니다.
탐험

죽음을 불러올 위험한 생물로 가득한 다층 시설을 탐험하면서 정확히 당신이 어디에 있고 왜 그곳에 있는지 알아보려고 노력하십시오.
생존

제한된 탄약과 자원이 탐험을 장려합니다

title: Plant Budz 98
description:
게임 정보
Plant Budz are pets raised on your new retro desktop. Budz react and evolve based on how you interact with it. Each final evolution transforms into a unique game, which can unlock new rewards and ways to play games. Transport back to the golden era of desktops to find new-age twists on nostalgic classics!

title: Nameless Bastard
description:
게임 정보
Nameless Bastard is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Fast-paced combat, beautiful stylized retro-inspired graphics, rinse-and-repeat progression cycle; we've got it all.
MAKE A NAME FOR YOURSELF
As an adventurer eager to make a name for yourself, you are tasked by the village elder to clear the evil spreading from a nearby dungeon. Fight through the forest and multiple levels of the dungeon to clear the ever-present threat.
UPGRADE IT ALL
Upgrade and enhance various aspects of weapons, spells, character stats, and even the village itself to match your own play style, as you progress through each run, and the game as a whole.
TALES OF THE FORGOTTEN
Adventuring is perilous and many adventurers don't make it. Take a break at the village and listen to larger-than-life songs and tales describing your efforts.
LOOK AT ALL THE PRETTY COLORS
Top it all off with a colorful visual aesthetic, inspired by the games of yore, as well as modern classics.

title: Nekopirate
description:
게임 정보

Nekopirate is a story driven action-platformer featuring short challenging levels, colorful graphics and a heartfelt story.



Nina is a nekopirate and the daughter of legendary pirate Bartholomeow Williams. When her father falls ill it is up to Nina to find a cure. But her quest will soon prove to be more challenging than expected, when the only known cure for his illness is a mystical flower known as Lágrima de la Luna.



Explore the Caribbean Sea, Run inside a volcano, find love in an underwater Mermaid City, defeat a giant Rubber Duck, all while trying to escape an island where everything is trying to kill you.



Features:
- Over 40 hand-crafted levels
- 4 different pirate-themed locations
- Fast-paced platforming gameplay
- Unlockable weapons
- Tons of collectables and side quests
- Beautiful artwork
- Giant bosses and mini games
- A funny and emotional story about love and determination

title: BoostHead
description:
게임 정보
Looking for a fun and exciting party game to play with your friends? Look no further than BoostHead! This fast-paced brawler game is all about challenging your friends to see who's the best, with no story to get in the way of the action.

In BoostHead, up to four players can battle it out in a variety of challenging arenas, using a range of special moves and power-ups to gain the upper hand. Whether you're knocking your opponents off the edge of the screen or smashing them with a power-up, there's always something new and exciting happening in BoostHead.

With its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, BoostHead is the perfect party game for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned brawler or a newbie just looking to have some fun, BoostHead has something for everyone.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your controllers and get ready to brawl with BoostHead! With its non-stop action and endless variety, this ultimate party game is sure to keep you and your friends entertained for hours on end.

title: The Kantist
description:
게임 정보
Chaos in the Lab:
A mysterious accident helps you escape your cage in the laboratory.
You flee into the vents hoping to find some safety and freedom.

On your way you meet several other test subjects, slimes, modified rats and other creatures, some are nice, some rather not. But that's not the only dangers waiting for you in the vents of the laboratory. Thankfully, you yourself were designed in the lab to be a spy in enemy facilities, that should help.
As a spy, you have many different Abilities:
Dash and grapple through the vents and try not to hit any saws, trust me, it's better that way...


Things are getting a bit too fast for you? Well, good they built a Time-Slowing ability into you, let's hope it works
There are a total of 3 Zones and hundreds of different paths to take!

title: Guest Uncovered
description:
게임 정보

Steiner Mansion에서 파티 초대를 받았습니다! 하지만 뭔가 이상한 일이 벌어집니다. 도착한 지 얼마 후에 호스트의 시신이 계단 아래에서 발견됩니다. 퍼즐이 해결되고 범인이 드러날 때까지 집은 잠겨 있습니다. 추리 능력을 시험하는 클래식한 살인 미스터리에 참여하세요.



게임 시작 시, 4-12명의 플레이어가 게스트, 살인자 또는 중립 플레이어로 지원됩니다. 게스트로서 임무는 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾는 것입니다. 살인자로서 임무는 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서서 게임을 이기는 것인데, 적발되지 않아야 합니다이를 위해서는 다른 플레이어들을 속이고 기만하여 그들을 소수로 만들면서 하나씩 제거해야 합니다. 중립 플레이어로서 임무는 살인자로부터 죽지 않고 미팅 중에 추방되지 않으면서 자신의 목표를 달성하는 것입니다. 가끔 특별한 게스트 또는 특별한 살인자로 스폰될 기회가 있을 것입니다. 이러한 역할은 팀이 게임에서 이기도록 도울 특별한 능력을 가질 것입니다.
게스트들은 게임에서 승리하려면 지도를 탈출할 수 있는 출구를 여는 데 필요한 일련의 작업을 수행해야 합니다. 또한 시체의 위치를 찾아내고, 살인에 사용된 살인 도구를 발견하고, 살인자가 누구인지에 대한 단서를 찾아 수수께끼를 풀어야 합니다.


살인자들은 다음 희생자를 결정하면서 가짜 작업을 수행할 것입니다. 게스트들에게 보이지 않게 살인 도구를 획득하세요. 희생자를 선택하세요. 은밀하고 살인 모드로 전환하세요. 게스트들과 중립 플레이어를 죽이세요. 적발되지 않고 모든 게스트들을 숫자로 앞서면 게임에서 승리하세요.
중립 플레이어들에게도 가짜 작업이 주어지며 게임에서 승리하기 위해 수행해야 할 목표가 있을 것입니다.

의사가 되어 게스트를 구하거나 혹은 탐정과 함께 숨겨진 단서를 찾아보세요. 특별한 역할을 가진 플레이어들은 게임에서 승리하는 데 도움이 되는 능력을 가질 수 있습니다.







시체를 발견하거나 살인자가 누군지 알게 되면, 회의를 소집하세요. 회의 동안 남은 플레이어들은 가능한 범인에 대해 토론합니다. 상대 플레이어 중 한 명을 투표하여 추방하거나 안전하게 투표를 건너뛰는 선택은 몫입니다.
게스트들과 중립 플레이어들은 지도 주변의 아이템 상자에 접근하여 살인자에게 대항할 방법을 제공받을 것입니다.

title: Eight Dragons 2
description:
게임 정보
Eight Dragons 2 is an action-packed arcade beat-'em-up for up to 8 players. Build your crew and take on the gangs that rule the city in this side-scrolling brawler, fighting waves of unforgiving enemies in a vibrant 2D world!
Ultimate 8 Player Co-op
Join forces in local or online multiplayer for chaotic cooperative gameplay, coordinating epic takedowns in increasingly huge battles. Mix and match up to eight players in any combination of local or online players across all platforms.
Retro Arcade Action

title: NANOVOID
description:
게임 정보
In NANOVOID it's not just about the shooting - it's about outsmarting your enemies. Customize and command your modular ship where each piece adds a unique function and can be the difference between victory and defeat. But beware, your enemies aren't just a health bar. Their ships also use the same modular system, meaning you'll need to strategically target their ship's components to disable them effectively.



Engage in intense battles where the laws of physics reign supreme. Every movement, every shot fired, every explosion generates forces that can be used to your advantage - or lead to your downfall if mismanaged.

Features:

Modular Ships: Build your own spaceship from various modules, each with its own function and characteristics.
Realistic Physics: All actions have consequences, and the realistic physics engine brings a new level of depth to space combat.
Tactical Combat: Outmaneuver your enemies, target their weak points, and use the environment to your advantage.
Epic Encounters: Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses.

In this 2D tactical space shooter, you'll engage in fast-paced battles against deadly enemies and bosses, using strategy and planning to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Utilize your skills and reflexes to take down powerful bosses, and immerse yourself in a beautifully designed universe with stunning visuals and special effects.

Fly and fight using intuitive WSAD controls and mouse aim. The open space offers strategic possibilities, allowing you to retreat and recover your shields before re-engaging.

title: JETPACK BIRDIE
description:
게임 정보
JETPACK BIRDIE is a fast-pased third-person shooter that takes the fun and freedom of jetpack flights to a whole new level. Use its power to ignore the ground. Find and use wind zones to gain more speed, or risk using accelerated flight, which can overheat your jetpack and cause it to explode.
You are Birdie, a young man on the run from the most powerful gang in the city above the clouds. Evade enemies in a thrilling chase and carve your way to a free future. Cooperate with rebel group called Red Poppy Society and discover the dark secrets of global politics.
Your journey will fuse the short sections of NEON WHITE, classic shooter fun of the original MAX PAYNE, multi-functional weapon of CONTROL and movement that you have never seen before. Master your skills and unlock secrets in highly replayable environments to become an unstoppable force.
Features
Highly enjoyable movement with a lot of depth.
Short levels with high replayability, reminiscent of speedrun shooters.
Includes arcade mode with special challenges, leaderboard and ranking system.
Concentrated action story set in an alternate world after the collapse of the Great War.
An old school shooter with no covers or unnecessary pauses.

title: The First Mine
description:
게임 정보
The First Mine is a turn based building, strategy and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine with your population by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different tasks and random events.
Play as a single player or in multiplayer mode with up to 4 friends
Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources
Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold
Don't let tasks and game events distract you
Play alone in single player mode or play together with up to 4 friends in a competitive multi player mode. There are different game sizes and difficulty levels to choose from, as well as several characters with unique traits for varied gameplay.
Each round you have to cleverly place and group a new random resource tile and upgrade your existing tiles as needed. Placing a new tile end the current round, mine gold in your mine and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.

title: Umbratica Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Umbratica Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines the precise tactical combat of “Into the Breach” and the strategic deck crafting of “Slay the Spire”. Lead a squad of vampire slayers as you banish the fiendish creatures that have taken over the cursed land of Umbratica.


Precise no-RNG tactical turn-based combat: Deploy your squad of vampire slayers in a series of fast-paced grid-based combats. Purge this land from the ghouls, fiends, and other deadly monstrosities that inhabit the night!


Strategic roguelike deckbuilding: Your squad abilities are determined by your deck! So as you make your way through the cursed land of Umbratica you’ll gather new cards. You’ll use these as your squad's attacks, actions, and abilities in combat!


As you play each run you’ll have several options over the way your squad fights. First, you’ll select the heroes that’ll go on your journey, each has their own set of available cards! As your journey progresses you’ll find different cards and you’ll upgrade them to further customize your playstyle, you’ll find powerful ancient relics that affect the functioning of the whole squad, and also mysterious items that can boost (and nerf) individual hero's stats and also add special status during combat. Strategically combine all of these elements to express your playstyle fully!

Each time you dare to adventure into the gothic land of Umbratica the layout will be different. Different combat stages and rewards, different text-based events, different cards, relics, and items. No two runs are the same!

title: Appearances
description:
게임 정보

게임은 아직 개발 중이며 따라서 변경될 수 있습니다. 저희 Discord 서버를 팔로우하고 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하십시오!
악몽의 밤
Appearances는 1인용의 1인칭 공포 및 퍼즐 게임으로, 당신은 가족 별장에서 자신을 돌보는 베이비 시터와 함께 어린 수지 역할을 합니다. 밤중에 이상하고 날카로운 소리가 들리는데, 이는 당신을 깨우기 위해 특별히 디자인된 것 같습니다. 첫 번째 본능은 시터를 찾는 것인데, 생생한 상상력을 가진 아이에게 밤은 무서울 수 있습니다. 할머니가 당신을 위해 만든 음악 상자가 최고의 위안입니다. 그러나 곧 옆에 초자연적인 무언가가 숨어 있음을 발견할 것이며, 이 음악 상자는 단순히 음악을 연주하는 것 이상의 목적을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 가족의 과거를 밝히고 이 악몽 같은 유령을 끝내야 합니다.
평행 세계
현대적인 가족 별장으로 진화하고 이 복도와 방들의 미로를 탐험하십시오. 그러나 신비한 축복을 따라가면 당신이 괴롭히는 존재가 거주하는 평행 세계에 접근할 수 있습니다. 분위기 변화와 새로운 길이 당신에게 열릴 것입니다. 이 기회를 잡아 탈출하고 추가적인 비밀을 발견하세요.
할머니의 음악 상자, 그 음악은 당신을 악몽에서 끌어내는 유일한 방법입니다. 이 음악 상자를 사용하여 이 불온한 밤에 당신을 따라 다니는 존재를 찾고, 걸리지 마십시오.
퍼즐을 풀어 가족의 비밀을 밝혀내고 진실을 드러내십시오. 그러나 항상 기억하십시오. 당신은 이해할 수 없는 존재에게 계속해서 쫓기고 있는 어린이일 뿐입니다.
이 게임은 영화와 비디오 게임의 공포 작품 및 탈출 게임에서 영감을 받았습니다!

title: Dreamians: Card Battle
description:
게임 정보
드리미안즈: 카드 게임은 전투 중에 진화하고 전투의 흐름을 예기치 못한 방식으로 변경할 수있는 크리쳐를 갖춘 Roguelike Deckbuilder입니다. 게임에는 반 드래곤 반 개 인 Dragnis, 파란 늑대 Wolfae 및 악몽 박쥐 Kalek과 같은 세 가지 주요 드리미안즈가 포함되어 있습니다. 각각은 게임에서 제시된 도전에 대처하기 위한 고유 한 능력과 솔루션을 갖추고 있습니다.
드리미안즈: 카드 게임에서 플레이어는 우리가 잠을 잘 때 또는이 세계에 연결되기위한 특수 기계에 넣을 때만 액세스 할 수있는 드리미안즈의 세계로 이동합니다. 이것은 잠재우기를 유도하고 강력한 영혼 프로젝션을 강제로 수행함으로써만 액세스 할 수 있습니다.
드리미안즈의 세계는 모든 가능한 꿈을 빼앗으려는 무시무시한 Oníricos 여행자들에 의해 침략 받고 있습니다. 플레이어와 그의 드리미안즈는 숲, 산, 부서진 도시, 불길 한 길 및 심지어 왜곡 된 차원을 통과하는 5 개의 지도에서 치열한 전투를 승리해야합니다.
숫자 -
+100 - 게임에 사용되는 카드입니다. 이들은 공격, 방어 및 특수 카드입니다.
+40 - 드리미안즈의 속성을 수정하는 드림 쥬얼.

title: Codename Incubus
description:
게임 정보
SUBDUE YOUR NIGHTMARES

Cleave through ethereal enemies with blistering slashes, locked in a bullet-hell frenzy between waves of projectiles. Keep dodging and close in on your foes to swiftly dismantle them, or gracefully parry their bullets with resolute precision.

Almost all objects and enemies you see are slashable: When attacking them, you gain speed and become invincible for a short time, meaning that you are rewarded for maintaining momentum and playing at an electrifying pace. The time-based score system also encourages you to push your limits, embracing the exhilarating sense of freedom that comes with shredding through every obstacle that stands in your way.

This high-risk, high-reward mentality is amplified by the fact that everything on screen dies in one hit - including you. Thankfully, the absence of loading times ensures that dying won't discourage you, and the synth-based Cyberpunk soundtrack takes care of any frustration you might have left.


TRIUMPH OVER TRAUMA

Delve deeper into a gripping narrative about two tormented souls: Alexander, a dealer who always struggled with the rules around him, and Maximilian, a philanderer whose only joy left in life is mindless stimulation. Both unhappy with their present situation, they embrace the allure of a mysterious drug - a gateway to a reality where the lines between dreams and nightmares blur.

Will they conquer their demons or be consumed by the very substance that fuels their escape? Peel back the layers of their past to find out! Just make sure that you're not getting to this serotonin-boosting game...

title: Into the Depths of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Into the Depths of Despair (ItDod)

I woke up in a room, but I was never asleep. The air is heavy, carrying a scent I can’t recognize. I see with eyes that are not my own, feel a body that doesn’t feel like mine.

The walls seem to breathe, the shadows shift when I’m not looking. There’s no sound except my own breathing—I am alone. Or am I?

Something is keeping me here. I don’t remember how I got to this place, but I know there must be a reason. Is there a way out? Or am I sinking deeper into despair?

title: My Little Kitty
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the game of 'My Little Kitty' This pet development game allows you to play the role of the owner of a kitten, take care of it, train it, and play games with it. In this fun filled game, you need to do various

Get coins offline, and other methods to establish and raise your pet cat.

My Little Kitty not only has cute and charming character images and delicate and smooth animations, but also rich gameplay and fun. You can interact and play with your kittens, feed them, dress up, and even ride cows, run parkour, and more. Each outfit has unique effects, such as feeding rewards, mobility, etc. You can gradually give your kitten unique traits and abilities, and earn more coins and rewards.

title: Morgan: Metal Detective
description:
게임 정보
Morgan: Metal Detective is a first-person, cozy metal-detecting adventure game. It combines exploration, creativity, and a cozy atmosphere into a heartwarming adventure.



Everyone on the island is searching for something, Morgan must search the island with her metal detector to find these lost treasures. Each of these quests asks you to engage and really think about the potential location of the lost item. On returning, each of these characters rewards Morgan with a unique cassette tape which you can listen to whilst you’re exploring. This music and the detailed audio soundscape throughout Glasden helps to place you in this magical environment. Lose yourself in the quests and lovely audio.


Use you metal detector to search for hidden treasures (and maybe some rubbish) hidden just below the surface

As you explore the island using your trusty metal detector, you will find many types of items hidden underground. You can take these items to Cenna’s shop, exchange them for credits and purchase new sticker packs and film for your instant camera. You can then decorate the journal with these stickers and the photos you’ve taken. Express yourself in the in-game journal.

The game features a brilliant original score and fantastic voice acting, featuring BAFTA nominated Charlotte McBurney as the titular Morgan, who voices Amicia in the A Plague Tale series of games.

title: Hype Me For Your Life!
description:
게임 정보
Show off your rhythm in a musical battle where the music decides your fate! Face the God of Time and capture souls to the beat of the music to survive.
🎵 UNIQUE RHYTHM MECHANICS
Each soul is a note falling on one of the 7 strings of your board. To capture them, you must press buttons with both hands as if you were playing real musical chords.
Left Hand: Selects the range of strings where you can capture souls.
Right Hand: Chooses the exact string within the selected range and plays at the right moment.
Double Challenge: Simultaneous notes and strategic combinations will put your skills to the test.
⚔️ USE MUSIC TO ATTACK
You can’t attack your enemy directly… but you can make them drop their guard!
Capture notes in succession to build up your Hype Combo, and once you reach the max level, unleash a devastating attack.
Master the rhythm to break defenses and overcome obstacles.
Prepare for epic boss fights with unique patterns and surprising mechanics.

title: Freerunners
description:
게임 정보
Freerunners is a game about giving the feeling of freerunning (Parkour). Finding a flow and an underlying rhythm of movement as you traverse through your environment in the quickest time possible.

Start off a total noob and become a skilled pro, learning new moves along the way. Vault, climb, jump, duck, swing, flip, slide, do what it takes to travel as fast as possible whilst using your environment to outwit the enemy henchmen who have kidnapped your freerunning teacher and are hunting you down.

Be Fast, Be Fluid, Be Direct!
Key Features:
50 Fast-paced Levels - Think quick and solve problems on the move in fast-paced action-packed levels.

Fail, Retry, Refine - You're going to fail a bunch as you find your flow but refine your timing and technique and watch as you improve and flow more seamlessly through your environment.

Use Your Environment - Outwit evil henchmen using the environment and your freerunning skills.

title: Attic Transit Authority: Wooden Train Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Attic Transit Authority.
There’s a dusty attic, a pile of wooden train tracks, a sketchy cassette player, a wobbly TV, and some... old toys stashed in a drawer. Build, vibe, and maybe derail your life a little.
Lay down wooden tracks with real physics — snap curves, bridges, and janky ramps together just like you remember.
Drive trains across your weird creations, build tiny towns, stack scenery until it collapses, and create the attic empire your 6-year-old self always dreamed of.
Dim the lights, pop in a new cassette tape, and watch the attic come alive.
Key Features:
Physics-based wooden track building — curves, bridges, chaos
Playable cassette tapes — customize the attic soundtrack as you discover tapes
autokwd: Attic Transit Authority: Wooden Train Simulator

title: Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale
description:
게임 정보


APOPIA: SUGAR COATED TALE is a comedic adventure with dark mysteries. Help young girl Mai to find her way home. Progress by solving puzzles and outsmarting enemies in minigames. Make friends and foes with talking animals. Unravel the mystery of Mai’s identity from her dark and blurry memories.

As Mai, you will:

Explore the beautiful fantasy world. Get to know funny characters who are a cat, a mole, a lot of bunnies, and more. Each with unique personality and background story.
Solve creative puzzles along your way home.
Beat enemies... um, lower your fists... You'll beat them by outsmarting them in minigames.
Defeat dark bosses in rhythm games.
Discover the truth about your family and identity.











Catch a glimpse into a world before the events of Apopia Prologue. Learn why Moly was banished from her castle in this animated short. Watch and enhance your demo experience!

title: Eternity Guards
description:
게임 정보
The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

This is a world of magic and tactics.

Style - handpaint.

Battle Royale PVP fighting game with strategy elements.

On a small one map, from 2 to 6 players fight at the same time, who are divided into equal teams. Fast matches have a maximum duration of 10 minutes, so the maps are not big, but well designed for energetic battles with fun running around the map in the heat of magical effects.

Each map has all 4 times of year, all are available on the same map to increase variability.

At the end of each match, there will be a unique anti-cheat system based on feedback and ratings of players for the subsequent successful formation of the effective teams.

Before the battle, players appear in a room where they have 30 seconds to equip and buy clothes, weapons, bottles and recharge abilities.

There is an interaction with the environment in the form of teleports and places of interest (landslides, lava, waterfalls, lightning, tornado) that block the way and can inflict damage on the opponent.

The tactic is to activate the character selection circle (menu wheel) via a hotkey for the interaction: for enemies - magic, weapon strikes or debuffs; for allied characters - useful buffs, damage resistance, acceleration, healing etc.

There is a teleport on the map with an 5 sec activation delay, the next character can only be passed with the same delay. There is always some kind of artifact there, which you can use in this or in the next game only once.

There will be several characters in the game, including:
Viking - tank, human shield;



After the end of the fight, in addition to experience, which unlocks many different abilities, and in addition to game currency to unlock new weapons and elements of armor, there is also the opportunity to upgrade a room with weapons (fireplace, sparring partner, sofa, bar etc).

title: Generation Ship
description:
게임 정보
당신은 세대선박의 책임을 지는 인공지능(AI)입니다. 살아남기 위한 인류의 마지막 희망입니다. 실시간 시뮬레이션에서 효율적인 원자재 순환을 구축하고, 먼 새로운 고향으로의 여정에서 우주의 역경을 극복하도록 크루를 도우세요!

지구는 천연 자원이 고갈되어 파수잡아져 푸른 하늘이 회색 연무로 대체되는 가운데, 국가들은 점점 감소하는 자원을 차지하려 경쟁하고 긴장이 고조됩니다. 당신은 인류의 마지막 희망인 세대선박을 건설하라는 임무를 맡은 인공지능입니다.

처음에는 지구가 미션을 시작하기 위한 충분한 자원을 제공할 것입니다. 그러나 시간은 당신을 위해 흘러가지 않습니다. 긴장이 증가하고 전쟁이 지구를 휩쓸면 지구의 공급 라인은 줄어들고, 자급자족해야 하는 어려운 과제를 남겨줍니다. 당신의 식민지선박은 지구의 공급에 의존하는 단계에서 자체 자원을 생산하고 재활용해야 합니다. 이 어려운 전환을 넘어서, 전략을 조절하고 인류의 미래를 보장하기 위한 능력을 구축하세요.
당신의 식민지선박을 건설하세요
한 부분 한 부분, 인류의 마지막 희망을 새로운 고향으로 운반할 선박을 건설하세요. 그러나 기억하세요, 모든 선택이 중요합니다. 당신은 선박의 능력을 최적화하고 인류의 생존을 보장하기 위해 노력하는 동안 모든 선택이 중요합니다.

어려운 결정
지구의 상황은 시간이 흐를수록 악화되며, 어려운 결정을 내려야 합니다. 부족한 공급은 신중한 고려를 요구하며, 간단한 해결책은 없습니다. 결과의 중요성에 대비하세요. 당신이 취한 모든 조치는 인류의 운명을 결정할 것입니다.
넓은 우주에서는 모든 인치가 중요합니다. 효율적인 조직과 자동화는 선박의 잠재력을 극대화하는 데 중요합니다. 가치 있는 자원을 보존하면서 인구의 요구를 수용하기 위해 전략적으로 세대선박을 디자인하고 배치하세요.

세대선박에서의 생활을 현실적인 시뮬레이션으로 탐색하면서 완전히 몰입할 준비를 하세요. 환경 제어, 인간 모델, 중력의 힘을 관리하는 도전에 직면하게 됩니다. 현실을 반영하는 세계와 상호 작용하며, 여러분의 기술을 시험하고 한계에 도전하게 됩니다.

title: MegaBattle
description:
게임 정보




Get ready for Megabattle, a roguelike card game that combines strategic deckbuilding elements with the thrill of epic robot battles. Build a custom deck and embark on a procedurally generated journey, facing increasingly challenging trials.



In Megabattle, each victory brings valuable rewards in the form of parts and upgrade cards. Utilize these resources to enhance your deck, making your robot more powerful and resilient. During battles, strategically play cards to improve your parts, attack opponents, and defend against enemy assaults.



Explore various robot classes, each with their own unique characteristics and obtainable parts. Discover new attack cards and exclusive power-ups to strengthen your arsenal and adapt to different battle strategies.



With an immersive sci-fi/futuristic atmosphere, Megabattle transports you to a universe filled with robots, advanced technology, and thrilling action.

Prepare for battle and claim victory in Megabattle!

title: Solaro
description:
게임 정보
Guide a tiny traveller on an epic journey across alien worlds. Solaro takes you into the heart of a mysterious galaxy, where natural forces like gravity, wind, and solar energy guide your movements. Master the art of space exploration from an alien point of view, as you unravel the mysteries of your forgotten past.
An ancient legend tells of a race of beings who could travel the stars as easily as fish swimming across the ocean... Solaro tells the story of one traveller, lost and adrift in a world that pulsates with a life of its own. Whether you're exploring a natural wonder like a gas giant or planetary geyser, or unlocking the eerie secrets of a technological ruin, Solaro's environments are constantly evolving, moved by ancient and powerful forces.

title: Saveseeker
description:
게임 정보
Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide.

Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!
Game Features:

Embark on a classic quest: Travel to the six lands the Hero once visited, overwriting his Save Stops along the way
Join forces with boss allies: Five ex-bosses will join you on your adventure, each with their own motivations to face the Hero again
Discover a bright pixel art world: From the autumnal Badwoods to the swampy kingdom of Mirell, each land brings unique challenges to face and puzzles to solve
Uncover hidden secrets: Compete in optional minigames to unlock special equipment and hidden lore
Enjoy 30+ original tracks: A warm and catchy original soundtrack composed by Dale North accompanies your journey

title: Hank's Voyage
description:
게임 정보


Join Hank on an adventure to rescue his friend and uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt!
Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget, hide from your enemies, solve puzzles and prove that you're a world-class spy every step of the way!



In the year of 1948, a group of talented jazz musicians formed the Jazz Association of Secret Spies, also known as JASS.
Their main directive: maintain world peace at all costs.

As one of their agents goes missing in Egypt they send Hank, their most recent hire, to investigate what they believe to be a routine mission.

Join Hank in his journey to Giza as he unravels secret conspiracies and sheds light on ancient mysteries while making the most out of his high-tech hat gadget.
Help him to sneak past his enemies, use his hat gadget to solve different puzzles, and gain powers that will help him make his way through 5 distinct locations.




Use your hat as a multi-purpose gadget: Attack, Activate, Distract and use it as a platform to solve different puzzles.



Collect to unlock .



past and outwit your enemies: Fighting is not always an option. Sometimes you have to blend in the environment and go unnoticed.



Fight your way through featuring : Encounter unique enemies and gameplay challenges.



in several different and



an offbeat story with colorful characters and a .



the levels to discover all their : The levels are loaded with hidden treasures and great rewards, waiting to be found.

title: Forgot
description:
게임 정보
Forgot is a short anomaly hunting horror game. You play as a boy who is imprisoned at home with his grandparents. But is this really your home and are you sure those are your grandparents?
You want to leave, but no exit leads to the outside. The rooms are looping endlessly and time seems to be standing still. It is midnight and "grandmother" won't let you leave before the morning. She keeps feeding you cake and sends you back to your room.
Sometimes your surroundings change and sometimes they stay the same... Look out for anomalies and make a decision:
Are there anomalies at home?
The cake is poisoned, do NOT eat it and leave immediately!
Does everything look normal?
The cake is safe and delicious, make sure to eat it on your way out!
Only if you make 12 correct decisions in a row, the morning will come and the path to freedom will open.
Playtime: 15 - 60 minutes
tag: 선택의 중요성,숨은 그림 및 물체,심리적 공포,퍼즐

title: Rhythm Towers
description:
게임 정보
음악은 Planet Rhapsody의 고동입니다. 그루비한 곡들이 지속적으로 블루그래스 꽃밭을 통해 울리고, 유령 같은 황무지를 가로질러 메아리치며, 험준한 산맥 위로 울려 퍼집니다. 이러한 음악적인 곡들은 신비로운 AlgoRhythm을 보호하고 유지시키는데, 이것 없이는 Planet Rhapsody는 조용한 심연으로 붕괴될 것입니다.
이제 AlgoRhythm은 초자연적인 힘에 의해 분노에 휩쓸린 생명체들의 위협에 노출되어 있고, 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.
그래, 당신은 큰 성공을 이루지 못한 외계인 팝 그룹일지라도, 이런, 아이야, 당신에게는 용기가 있어. 그리고 비트를 유지할 수 있어. 음악이 당신의 세계니까 - 그래서 당신이 그것을 구해야 해.
음악으로 구축됨
다른 순서와 위치에 타워를 설치하여 독특한 교향곡을 만듭니다. 당신이 건설하는 각 Rhythm Tower는 사운드트랙에 새로운 음악 레이어를 동적으로 추가하여, 각 레벨의 음악적 풍경을 극적으로 변경합니다. 새로운 환경을 탐험하면서, 편안한 Lo-Fi 힙합부터 강렬하고 박진감 넘치는 드럼 앤 베이스까지 다양한 템포와 독특한 스타일의 새로운 음악 장르에 맞춰 춤추세요.

title: LIMYN
description:
게임 정보


In the colorful soundscapes of LIMYN, you rotate with the rhythm, guiding a delicate thread through a geometric maze. Each rotation, a tick in time; each transition, a note in an ever-evolving melody. Obstacles dance, enemies lurk, but you are in command.

LIMYN evokes the simple gameplay of turn-based puzzlers like Hitman GO, but with skill-based obstacles that will challenge your musical timing.

Find the flow.

title: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding
description:
게임 정보



Bike Baron 2 is a wild motorbike racer built for time attack. It blends physics-based gameplay, pixel-perfect controls, and mad level design into a game that lives from all the faceplants, uncountable retries, and relentless breaking of records.

The path to the new record is simple. You hit a section, and try to improve it.

Land too far.
Crash.
A little out of balance.

Forty attempts later, you're consistently two tenths faster. Do the same for the last loop in the level, then string it all together for a time that—by some small miracle—ends up just under 37 seconds. That's #4 overall. And there's still that early section to work on!

This game is perfect for those who just know they can squeeze one tiny fraction more out of their run.

Dozens of extraordinary tracks. Varying in difficulty, style, and pacing, each 30-120 seconds in length, some of them quite outrageous.
Ghost runs. Not only to know how fast you're going in comparison, but also to get a look at how others are making their records.
Leaderboards. See where you stand in a competition between friends or—if you're that good—among the world elite at the very top of the standings.

Grab your helmet and let's start breaking records!
autokwd: Bike Baron 2: The Art of Riding

title: Mirror Land
description:
게임 정보
**WHAT IS THIS**
*Mirror Land* is an original game that focuses on optical illusion puzzles. It is inspired by some Magic Mirror Concepts such as **FengYueBaoJian** in *Dream of the Red Chamber* and **The Mirror of Erised** in *Harry Potter*. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.
According to THE MIRROR CONCEPT, a series of gameplay and stories are created. Meanwhile, this game uses poetry-writing methods as a source of reference, which makes the game more interesting and creates a poetic atmosphere in it.

**For closer eye movement and deeper puzzle layout, the puzzles of this game are specially developed for vertical screens. If the player’s display can be rotated to vertical, as long as the windows desktop is set to vertical. Then open the game, the game will be full screen. Or, if the display cannot be rotated or you don't want to bother, players can just use the normal horizontal screen mode. The game experience will not be different, and the areas on the left and right sides of the screen will be filled with black. **

**HOW TO PLAY**
You can learn how to play from the demo video or read the tips below.
0.The MIRROR and The Feet of the character have an interactive relationship.
1.When you can see The Feet of the character in the MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button, thus the character is tied to the MIRROR surface and turns into 2D form.
2.When the MIRROR is moved, the terrain reflected in the MIRROR is changed.
3.When the 2D form character’s feet meet an empty foothold reflected by MIRROR, press the MIRROR Button again, thus the character is released to the corresponding terrain.

**MECHANISM**


**Pedal Trigger** can make the terrain or other things change.


**THRUST DEVICE** When the character moves to the front of the THRUST DEVICE, this device will do a powerful thrust and push the character out for a certain distance. During this process, the
character is not affected by gravity.





**CLUSTER LIGHT**
When the source of The CLUSTER LIGHT is turned on, there will be a beam of The CLUSTER LIGHT. It can be reflected by a MIRROR. You can make the LIGHT travel to different positions by adjusting the angle of light emission as well as the angle and position of the mirror.
1.The CLUSTER LIGHT can pass through transparent terrain.
2.When the CLUSTER LIGHT reaches a FLAT place whether it is transparent or not, a TELEPORT POINT of LIGHT can be etched at the irradiation point.
3.LUMEN STONE CAT can travel in CLUSTER LIGHT-TELEPORT POINT System


**NPCs**



**LUMEN STONE CAT** is a passenger of the CLUSTER LIGHT. It is a mysterious animal imprisoned in the LUMEN STONE. When it is not exposed to the CLUSTER LIGHT, it looks like a dull square stone that is almost as tall as the character. In this case, It can be dragged and moved on a flat place, helping characters reach different terrain. But when THE CAT is moved to a teleport point of the CLUSTER LIGHT, which connects with another teleport point by CLUSTER LIGHT, THE CAT will transform into a cat that can swim in the LIGHT. After it reaches the teleport point as far as it can, THE CAT will transform into stone-form again.



**The SILENCE** is such a STABLE being that no character can push it away. When it blocks a character's way, the character can only walk away and wait for it to go to the next position, or catch it and put it in the MIRROR.



**The STRENGTH** In most cases, the STRENGTH will push away every movable object that gets into its reach. How far it pushes an object depends on the size of STRENGTH. During the pushing process, the STRENGTH and the object are not affected by gravity.
What The STRENGTH can push away: the character, the cubes, and smaller STRENGTHs
What The STRENGTH can not push away: THE SILENCE, THE LIGHT FLOWING STONE CAT, and solid terrains.
When the STRENGTH pushes the objects beyond its ability, it will be pushed away by the reaction force.
The STRENGTH can also be caught and put in the MIRROR.

**CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR MECHANISM**

1.When the character is caught and put on the CHESSBOARD OF THE MIRROR, he will become a chess piece that can move to the adjacent chessboard grid.
2.Each chessboard grid has a corresponding relationship with a certain foothold out of the MIRROR. When the MIRROR releases the character, the character will be placed in the corresponding position.


**THE STORY OF MIRROR LAND**

There is a continent in the darkness where the sun, the moon, and stars do not exist. The LIGHT is stored in a big mountain like gel. The mountain is called LUMEN.
Living creatures near the LUMEN gradually evolve into humans. They learn the methods of mining and using the LIGHT. They pipe the LIGHT to high places, illuminating most places. Technology and civilization are developing. Kingdom has formed.
Not far from the west of the LUMEN is the MIRROR PLAIN where the supply of MIRRORS is inexhaustible. Once the last piece of MIRROR PLAIN was exploited, an earth movement will come. A new MIRROR PLAIN will raise.
These MIRRORS can catch living creatures and put them into the surface of MIRRORS. This is discovered by accident.
One of the believable legends is about a hunter. Once upon a time, he was chasing the LUMEN BEAST. This BEAST escaped to a mirror. The hunter prayed subconsciously that someone could help him catch it. Unexpectedly, THE MIRROR responded to his prayer and caught the BEAST.
Later, people found a way to make MAGIC MIRRORS between witchcraft and technology.

THE STORY OF XIU(the character)

XIU’s ancestors are INKMEN,XIU is a inkman as well. INKMEN is one of the results of human genetic modification.
After humans learned to make MAGIC MIRRORS, some clever bad guys commit crimes with MAGIC MIRRORS they make, and leave no trace of themselves. The ruler of the kingdom decides to keep all the clever guys under supervision. Every movement of them has to leave a trace behind. So the clever ones become INKMEN. Ink always seep out through their skin, and their shoes cannot be waterproof. So the footprints they leave are all ink-like.
XIU’s mother was a TRAFFIC MIRROR ENGINEER. In a TRAFFIC MIRROR test 7 years ago, when the MIRROR released her, she disappeared. This strange thing made people panic, but no reason was found.
Now XIU is fifteen years old, inherited mother's relics.XIU found 7 SPECIAL STONES among them. One day, a mysterious voice came into XIU's ears, saying,” Take THESE STONES to the FURNACES I designate. Then forge them into a HAMMER according to the drawings I give you. Use the HAMMER to smash the one-thousand-year-old MIRROR hanging in the capital. And you can find your mother…”
"As long as there is a chance of finding my mother, I will try it…."

title: Brobot
description:
게임 정보


Brobot is a single player platform game. Each stage will be released episodically. Its main character; Brobot, is a small robot. He must traverse a myriad of worlds and ultimately reach the mythical Dynamo Core to restore order to his home world.

Brobot allows the player to manipulate the direction of gravity to traverse various worlds and overcome obstacles, creating interesting and unique challenges that encourage fast-paced play while the player uncovers the truth of their purpose in the multiverse.

title: Explory Story
description:
게임 정보

Our highly detailed worlds involve beautiful hand-drawn pixel scenery and thoughtful stories. The text on the floor can be interacted with, leading to a huge variety of effects and experiences. Reading and engaging with the text are crucial for progressing through the puzzles. Additionally, many secret interactions and hidden locations are spread out throughout the game.


Progressing through each level will involve cleverly interacting with objects and text. In some cases, you will be tasked with restoring context to a sentence; in other cases, you will be crafting entirely new and highly variable phrases.


Explory Story contains a boss at the end of each Act. That means 4+ entirely unique boss fights with unique mechanics and challenges. These can be undertaken alone or together with a friend. Additionally, each boss has variants that you can access by engaging with the story.

title: Spirit of Midnight
description:
게임 정보
Spirit of Midnight is a charming adventure game. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries.

Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended.

Play an introduction to the game before release in *** Spirit of Midnight: Prologue *** today!

title: Knight of the Lions
description:
게임 정보


A story-driven, single-player platformer
Simple mechanics used to create a challenging gameplay
The insight into the diary of a person who has suffered a loss
Pen-drawn graphics meant to look like doodles in a notebook
Inspired by the story of Don Quixote

title: TOCOViX
description:
게임 정보
TOCOViX is a turn-based strategy game where 2-4 players take turn to place Crosses on the game board. The goal of the game is to combine Crosses to create "Shapes", which award points and "Stops". The purpose of Stops is to hinder opponents by preventing them from completing Shapes. A player is unable to move when all of the boxes on the board surrounding their Crosses are already occupied. The match is over when all players are unable to move or when the last standing player has more points than the others.
Levels
Choose between 10 levels with 3 different starts each. As you progress with the game levels get more complex.
Tutorials
From the Main Menu you can access tutorials with a detailed description of every game mechanic. Each explanation is made of both text and animations and can be interrupted at any moment.
TOCOViX comes with hard challenges which range from winning all levels against the CPU to conquering a certain number of boxes in a single match. Complete a challenge to obtain a Trophy and obtain all Trophies to unlock a special Cross!
Thanks to dedicated servers you can challenge other players from around the world! Every time you complete a match online you are awarded or deducted points from your online score. Challenge other players to rise through the ranks and enter the Diamond League!

title: Interconnected Stories
description:
게임 정보

In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...
