- Place the cards on the board to help our friendly characters in their mission
- Unlock dozens of action cards, all of them customized for the different characters
- Enjoy a wide variety of chapters, which can be solved in different ways
- Take advantage of free mode to create your own stories without the restrictions of the main mode




A great variety of characters will appear in the story, some with more relevance than others, but all with an distinctive essence:
- Carapán: a young 216-year-old dragon who, contrary to the traditions of his family, wants to dedicate himself to what is his true passion in life: the bakery.
- The Knight of the Iguana: a small town boy who has launched himself in search of adventure along with his secret weapon, which makes him immortal... at least as far as he has proven.
- Lúa: from a noble family, this astrologer has become a royal advisor fighting against imposed stereotypes, although she has an important private matter that keeps her busy...
- And more to discover! A princess, a ghost minstrel, an evil monster...

title: DEATHGRIP
description:
게임 정보
DEATHGRIP invites the player to the jump in the pilot's seat of some of the fastest and most lethal hovercrafts ever seen and dominate the tracks they compete on. Navigate natural environments through split paths, twists, turns, jumps, shortcuts, and narrow corridors in an intense race to the finish.

DEATHGRIP introduces a depth to its racing controls that challenges the player to explore the skill ceiling. From afterburner allowed at any time to pitching, rolling, drifting, repairing, managing heat, and firing weapons, one should take pride in their ability to master a racer.

It is an experience meant to be visceral, brutal, exciting, and intense, centered on offering players instant enjoyment without gimmicks and an extended sense of achievement for those competitive and dedicated enough to get the most out of the game.


The base release will include (at a minimum) the following features:

8 Unique Racers
All racers share the same functionality, but each has it's own strengths and weaknesses to suit different playstyles.

10 Distinct Tracks
Race across 10 environments on 10 tracks over terrain filled with obstacles, jumps, drops, shortcuts, multiple paths, and other challenges.

Combat Racing
Race against AI with offensive and defensive armaments. Outfit your racer with cannons, shotguns, missiles, countermeasures, and more. Witness the carnage as the track turns into a battlefield.

Time Trials and leaderboards
Best times across the game are saved as ghosts. Compete against your own times, challenge the ghosts of your friends or compete those of the top ranking players on the leaderboards.


Earn credits from winning and spend them on visual and performance upgrades to suit your playstyle. Choose from multiple parts to spec out your racer for speed,


Prove yourself by winning trophies and claiming tops ranks.

title: Demon Source
description:
게임 정보
Jump to the pit, die - repeat!
Demon Source is a roguelike adventure about one of the last Source Hunters.
Explore the vast procedurally generated dungeons. They are generated with pre-made prefabs with 3 variations of enemy spawn. So you will always have the pleasure of being scared entering each location.

Find skills and items and be killed by various enemies. Then hunt them in your run of revenge. Try new builds and strategies every new run and be bamboozled by unexpected enemy hiding by the corner. Collect the Source energy from dead enemies to unlock new weapons and abilities. 30+ unique weapons, 20+ skills, 40+ armors and rings are waiting for you.

Seek for story and lore? I have some!
Deep down the Ulm rock dwarves found the relic of great power. Demonic power. Very soon hordes of demons and possessed undeads were marching through the Lavert Kingdom.
Heroes of the past had stopped them, but they couldn’t destroy the Source. Inside the Ulm mountain this power was able to reshape dungeons to an endless labyrinth full of creatures of the dark. It also was able to revive demons countless times so they can’t be really killed.
Some heroes drink demon blood in order to receive same power. Those who did not died, went deeply to the old dwarf kingdom in order to find and destroy Demon Source.

You don’t remember how have you got to that dungeon. But it is clear that you are immortal such as those demons. Every time you die, the dungeon reshapes and all demons revive. Source doesn’t want to be found and doesn’t want you to go back. People of the past were optimistic about that - saying that now they have countless attempts. But now they are all mad and became corrupted guardians of the Source. So I wish you don't get crazy.

Try this game made with all passion just by single person. And let me to tell you the story of redemption which you will probably experience on yourself in the future. Try the Demon Source

title: Spirit Vendor
description:
게임 정보


Design your home and your shop exactly to your liking. Place furniture, decorate walls and ceilings,
or simply change the wallpaper and flooring.
Create a unique atmosphere that delights both you and your customers.





In Aeonica, there are many interesting potential partners.
Go on dates, deepen your relationships, and experience a romantic story that can lead to marriage and beyond.





Whether it's fresh produce, handcrafted creations, or rare fish – decide what to sell and how your shop looks.
Take care of your spirit customers and make sure they keep coming back.





Plant crops, raise animals, build pathways, and decorate your farm.
Create your own little paradise and supply your shop with fresh products.

title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Supporting small indie artists, Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game brings players to a cute & whimsical fantasy world where rivalling factions of animal characters fight to uncover fantastical riches!

Gameplay
AT:TCG is played as a 2-player game with both players racing to uncover all of their 8 'Treasure' cards before the opponent does. They can bring in animal characters to help their cause & do battle! Play happens with a pre-built deck of 50 cards and 8 player-chosen Treasure cards. Players are matched up with another player on Steam online, or if no players are available they will play against a CPU. An internet connection is required.

Collections
Show off cards you pull from booster packs or earn through challenges to your friends! AT:TCG uses the Steam Inventory service to manage the cards you own, meaning your collection is in safe hands!

Events
Participate in regular events & prove your might and mettle to earn prizes! Ranked Challenge is the first regular event to reach Arcane Treasures: TCG - seeing players fight to earn the most Ranked Points over an event period - but more will be on the way!

Player Feedback
The development process is heavily rooted in player feedback, with great respect held in the views of the player. By participating in the Discord, you can have your say! But don't just take our word for it, feel free to ask members of the community who have given in feedback!

Supporting Indie Artists
Arcane Treasures and those involved with its development have always been rooted in the indie world, and always will be. Except for placeholder artworks during early development stages (which are steadily being replaced) all artwork is sourced from small, independent artists, and as the game grows it is committed to finding further ways to support independent artists.

If you're an artist and you'd like to get involved, please get in touch through the email attached to the Steam store page.

title: Hypnotix
description:
게임 정보
What is Hypnotix?
Hypnotix is a guided meditation mindfulness app which will take you on a different journey every time you click 'Start'.

This app is not for the faint of heart, as you will need to completely let go and prepare to be taken to unknown places within your mind . . .

Featuring:

* Algorithms that put together a different meditation journey each time, by chaining different sound files into varying combinations.
* Hundreds of meditation sound files.
* Mystery lockboxes and other awards to unlock, as a reward for time spent in meditation.
What is the aim of this app?
The focus is on you 100%. My aim is to help you unwind, relax, and take you on many exotic, unpredictable, mysterious and fun journeys.
How is this app different to most other meditation apps?
The guided meditations are put together using algorithms which build a different relaxing experience every time, using hundreds of different sound files. The guided meditations are almost hypnotic. Hypnotix is a sister app to 'Boot Camp Fitness' but focusing on mindfulness and relaxation rather than physical health and exercise.

This is not your standard, hit the spacebar and time your mediations app.
Can I control the journey in any way?
No, you will have no control whatsoever, which gives Hypnotix its appeal. There are some player settings where you can turn on or off suggestions for healthy eating, regular exercise, stress management, confidence building etc, but beyond that you will have no control. However, despite being unorthodox and unpredictable Hypnotix only takes you to positive places.
The development road map
The aim is to add more and more mystery journey meditation sound files to expand the game further and further. With many journeys shaped and influenced by players.
When using Hypnotix, please find a safe space where you can close your eyes, either by lying down or sitting comfortably. Do not use this app when driving, using heavy machinery or any other activity that requires waking attention.

title: Evil Dreams
description:
게임 정보
Uncover the mystery of the town of Marwood
At the end of the Wild West era, Marcus, a teenager from a noble family, decides to find out why his city suffers from evil dreams. To find the reason, he goes to his neighbors' nightmares, where he may find out the truth or get stuck forever.
Evil Dreams - 2D adventure with elements of psychological horror and a variable plot. You have to travel between the real world and the world of the dreamers, find out the hidden secrets of the citizens, try don't lose mind and much more. And fully hand-drawn 2D graphics in the author's style, combined with an immersive soundtrack and a historically correct setting will help you with this.


Game Features:

title: Purgatory Heroes
description:
게임 정보
죽음 이후, 당신의 영혼은 영원히 떠도는 연옥에 들어섰습니다. 자유로 가는 문을 지키는 대악마를 처치하는 것만이 유일한 탈출구입니다. 불안한 영혼들, 끔찍한 몬스터, 그리고 악마의 무리를 헤치고 싸우세요. 쓰러뜨린 적의 영혼을 모아 당신의 외형을 변화시킬 수 있습니다. 당신이 물리친 모든 캐릭터로 플레이하세요.
주요 특징
영혼 포식자
적의 영혼을 파괴하고 흡수하여 그들로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 쓰러뜨린 캐릭터로 플레이할 수 있게 해주는 독특한 시스템입니다. 다양한 클래스와 능력을 가진 수많은 캐릭터가 등장하며, 각각 고유한 강점과 약점, 그리고 독자적인 성장 경로를 가지고 있습니다.
성장 경로
캐릭터의 레벨을 올리세요. 레벨이 오를 때마다 특정 속성이 증가하거나 감소할 수 있습니다. 아티팩트와 별의 돌로 캐릭터를 강화하세요.
클래스
게임에는 다양한 클래스가 존재합니다. 각 클래스는 자신만의 고유한 이점이 있으며, 이를 발전시킬 수 있습니다.
별 지도
별의 돌을 모아 점성가의 도움으로 특정 클래스의 속성을 향상시켜보세요.

title: Check x Mate
description:
게임 정보
A chess puzzle dating sim set in a world torn asunder by a century-long war—which the Schwarz Kingdom is set to lose until you and your twin are transported from our world and right in the middle of it, each holding a true game changer: magical crowns that give you the power to control the battlefield as a chess board.

In one battle, you turn the tide of the war as you solve for the Schwarz army and defeat the invading marble Weiss soldiers—who, in return, kidnap your twin sibling.

Take the crown and command the Schwarz army, bonding with their officers and royalty, to rescue your sibling and bring an end to the war!

Features:
A Magical Chess world, where the pieces are people that you interact with
Befriend a Schwarz Knight, Bishop, Rook and the Queen and team up with them in battle
A fantastical adventure where your decisions really matter
Beginner difficulty for beginners and those new to chess, or if you just want to focus on the story
Beginner difficulty focuses on teaching and testing basic chess tactics such as forks, castling, pins, checkmate, and much more
Expert difficulty designed for those who want more of a challenge (estimated puzzle ratings 800-1200)
Hundreds of hand crafted chess puzzles to find and solve throughout the story
Additional Chess gauntlet for a series of selected puzzles to complete

title: Termina
description:
게임 정보
Termina is an intense, adrenaline-fueled, survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Dive into the heart-pounding action of endless waves of the undead, scavenging for power-ups, unlocking powerful weapons, and battling through hordes of relentless zombies until your last breath.

Gameplay
Termina is a wave-based shooter reminiscent of classic zombie survival games. Players must fend off successive waves of zombies, utilizing a variety of weapons, power-ups, and perks to survive!


Key Features:
Multiple weapons
Multiple maps to play
A bunch of achievements
perks n power-ups

title: Trailer Park Life
description:
게임 정보

Trailer Park Life is a city-building, simulation and management game about building and growing a trailer park with a thriving community.

Your trailer park will be a place for people to come and camp, come to party and come to live. With camping areas with tents, RV trailers on lots to double-wide retirement villas you will have all types of people staying at your trailer park. Your park needs resources like power and water, businesses to keep your citizens entertained and have places to eat and staff to keep it all up and running. Your citizens and your park will challenge you with wants and needs, not to mention a variety of natural disasters including tornados, fires and more!

The success of your trailer park will depend on your attention to your citizens and management of the employees and park resources.



Layout your park as a quiet place to relax or turn it into a freakish party zone, not intended for early risers. Trailer Park Life is all about choices. With many buildings to plop down that cater to services, food & dining and entertainment. Building locations really matter. Be sure they are close enough to access yet not so close to annoy the neighbors.




Park services will be needed in keeping the park up and running. Each of the services require people to run them and funds to pay them so your management will be vital to the success of your park.

You will need staff to help you keep things in order. Life will be easier by hiring and upgrading your cleaning staff, maintenance staff, security guards and more. All these employees don't come free, so you will need manage the park expenses and income so you can turn a profit.


The success of your thriving park will depend on how you treat your citizens. Listening to their wants and needs they will become a happier community and be willing to pay their lot fees. But if you ignore them they will turn on you and take revenge on your hard work and getting them to pay their fees will be difficult.
It will be a fine balance between giving them everything they want and what your park budget can afford.

title: Bomberrage
description:
게임 정보

💣 Bomberrage – 폭발적인 멀티플레이 배틀!

개요: 혼돈 속으로 뛰어들어라! Bomberrage는 빠른 속도와 액션이 가득한 멀티플레이 게임으로, 전략과 반사 신경이 생존을 결정한다! 스마트한 AI와 맞서 싸우거나 친구들과 함께 매 순간이 중요한 폭발적인 전투를 펼쳐라!
주요 특징:

🔥 강렬한 멀티플레이 배틀 – AI 또는 실제 플레이어와 박진감 넘치는 폭탄 전투!
🧠 도전적인 AI 상대 – 적응하고 잔혹한 적을 뛰어넘어라!
🗺 끊임없이 변화하는 아레나 – 절차적으로 생성된 맵으로 항상 신선한 전투!
🎮 배우기 쉬우나 마스터하기 어려움 – 캐주얼 플레이어도 즐길 수 있으며, 경쟁적인 플레이어에게는 도전적인 경험!
🎬 에픽 시네마틱 & 개성 넘치는 캐릭터 – 폭발이 이보다 더 멋져 보인 적은 없다!

title: Crawling Silence
description:
게임 정보
Crawling Silence is a survival horror game featuring an online co-op and singleplayer escape mode.. When playing, the players must find clues and solve puzzles to uncover the secrets hidden within the building. During your exploration, you must find one of multiple ways out of the building, utilizing items randomly hidden around the map. But beware, mistakes may alert creatures hiding behind every corner....
The setting
Crawling Silence is set in an old, long forgotten building shrouded in mystery, the secrets of which you must uncover.
But beware, various dangerous creatures may lurk in the dark...
The monsters you encounter while uncovering the secrets within the building have full access to vents, rooms and secret areas, so be cautious...

Many elements of the game are puzzle based
There are various hidden doors and passages which you can discover, and maybe find helpful clues or items!
or they will turn against you, and force you to react quickly!

title: Volleyhalla
description:
게임 정보
Enter the world of Volleyhalla, a hectic, frantic "battle-tennis" game. Defend the flock, destroy evil.

Engage in ritualized barbarian shepherd combat, which coincidentally happens to look a little bit like ping pong.
As the last Battle Shepherd, it's up to you to guard your herd from marauding beasts and harvest wool to trade for essential resources.
With each victory, you'll restore your land and uncover ancient secrets hidden beneath the soil.
Along the way, unlock unique characters who bring their own skills and stories to your journey.
Find and purchase new Weapons and Shields to complement your playstyle and vanquish your foes.
Wield unique Magics to give you an edge over your ruthless opponents and turn the tide.
Your destiny is to rebuild, protect, and save Volley Valley—will you rise to the challenge?

title: Grim Potions
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a magical journey with "Grim Potions," a game that blends alchemy and dice-rolling. As a skilled alchemist, use special dice to brew potent elixirs. But the adventure doesn't stop there - manage your apothecary shop, serving heroes with unique needs.

Gameplay:
Roll dice to match symbols and create various potions. Unlock new dice and recipes as you progress.

Shop Management:
Serve heroes, each with distinct tastes. Build a reputation for your shop's quality.

Features:
Enchanting world with stunning visuals.
Explore alchemical adventures in a unique dice game.

title: Frontier Ferris For Adventurers
description:
게임 정보
Overview
This is the frontier of Ferris, an unexplored frontier by mankind.
As an adventurer, you risk your life to explore this uncharted land.
Hunt dangerous wild animals, escort traders, cut down trees by yourself, and break rocks that block human invasion.
Main features
Skill tree: Gain skills to suit your style of play.
Store: Buy weapons, armor, and other tools for your adventures. Sell loot from your adventures.
World Map: Some outlying areas can be very dangerous. Check the map carefully. In the beginning, start from areas near your base and hone your skills little by little.
Information Gathering: There is a lot of information you can get in town that can help you avoid unnecessary dangers and advance your adventure. You can also earn money efficiently by accepting requests.

title: Dark Age Gladiator
description:
게임 정보
Dark Age Gladiator is a dark fantasy world where you live as a gladiator fighting in the arena for wealth and fame.
The opponents are not limited to humans, but also include a variety of demons.
In addition to fighting in the arena, players can also receive requests to exterminate demons and search for various treasures in ancient ruins to gain wealth that cannot be obtained in the arena, as well as to explore unknown worlds.

As you continue to win as a gladiator, you may find yourself fighting not only against your own city, but also against gladiators from other cities. And in the end, you will make a name for yourself as the strongest gladiator in the empire.
Main Features
.
Extensive growth system
.In addition to improving a character's basic abilities through training, player gladiators can acquire various weapon proficiencies, various types of attack skills, etc., allowing them to develop a variety of unique strengths.
Various equipment to make the character stronger
.Gladiators can wear various types of weapons and armor, which not only change their appearance but also give them strength according to their weapons.
Some armors are finely crafted and some are magic-enhanced, and by wearing powerful equipment, gladiators are able to face even the strongest enemies.
Competing against a variety of gladiators
.Each of the gladiators you will face off against has a unique fighting style and ability, and you will be required to fight according to your opponent.
Find your opponents' openings and face off against powerful foes.

title: AMNYAM
description:
게임 정보
“마우스 조준 기술로 정상에 도전하세요!”
“AMNYAM”은 당신이 “마우스 조준 기술”을 사용하여 올라가고 정상에 도전하는 플랫폼 게임입니다.
주변에 떠 있는 “목표”를 정확히 조준하고 클릭하여 고양이 소녀가 높이 점프하게 하세요.
하지만 아무것도 하지 않으면 캐릭터는 원래 높이로 떨어집니다.
따라서 공중에서 다음 목표를 클릭해야 합니다.

title: Gaula Survival
description:
게임 정보
Gaula 생존은 다음을 수행해야 하는 생존 게임입니다.
[목록]

자원 수집
사냥
적과 싸우다
도구, 무기 등을 찾아보세요
생존에 도움이 되는 각종 아이템을 수집하세요
쉼터를 건설하세요.
마지막으로 루프를 다시 시작합니다.

Gaula Survival에서는 죽음이 결코 멀지 않습니다.

title: Arcade Forever
description:
게임 정보
Arcade Forever is a 3D vertical space shooter. This is an action game in which many enemies, obstacles and different weapons guarantee great fun. If you like fast space action, this is the game for you.
Info/Features:
Vertical space shooter.
3D graphics.
Sci-fi environment.
25 levels.
Upgrades.
No additional purchases required.

title: Knight Case Files
description:
게임 정보
In the Phoenix Kingdom, there is a man known as the Corpse Killer.
A duke attempted to usurp the country using an imposter of his daughter. A necromancer who once warred with the Phoenix Clan lurks in the shadows.
Wilhelm, a new Knight of the Royal Guard, becomes entwined with investigations into the forces working to oppose king and country. He is assigned to the personal guard of Master Alchemist Topherf, a descendant of the Serpent Clan.
Together, they must understand the history of the Phoenix Kingdom, two immortal races, and the body of a young duchess kept suspended at the moment of her death.
Wherever the pair go, a deep fate awaits them...
Knight Case Files is a dark fantasy visual novel featuring a gender-bending alchemist named Topherf, a necromancer, and a twisted scheme. As Wilhelm, the player interacts with the other characters and uncovers the truth through their choices.

title: Realms of Riddles: Wizards'Keep
description:
게임 정보
마법의 중세 세계에서 1인칭 시점의 매혹적인 방탈출 게임에 빠져보세요. 인터랙티브한 환경과 상호작용하고, 비밀을 발견하며, 도전적인 수수께끼를 풀어 신비로 가득한 이야기를 풀어보세요. 당신의 지혜를 시험해보세요!
도전적인 퍼즐
다양한 인터랙티브 퍼즐로 당신의 마음을 도전하세요. 각 도전이 당신의 지혜와 능력을 시험할 수 있는 독특한 기회를 제공하는 매혹적인 세계에 빠져보세요.

흥미진진한 이야기
비할 데 없는 긴장감과 감동으로 가득한 세계에 빠져드는 몰입형 내러티브 경험. 매혹적인 이야기 속으로 흥미진진한 여행을 떠날 준비를 하세요.

title: League of Speedrunners
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the League of Speedrunners! It's a third-person 3D platformer that takes you to a magical world. The familiar civilization, with its modern technologies, sank to the bottom of the water depths, but on the ruins of the past, a new civilization has emerged, breathing in itself the spirit of great change and competition.

An exciting competition awaits you to claim the title of the best speedrunner, with many challenges scattered across the open world, each with its own leaderboard.

Immerse yourself in a colorful, open world and explore it freely.


Complete challenge as quickly as possible. In this game, time is of the essence.


Play as different heroes, each with their own unique superpowers, such as hook, super jump, blink, and more.

title: Treasures of the Haunted Forest
description:
게임 정보
Finding a job in the big city is hardly possible for a young witch, and the rumors say the haunted forest hides countless unique alchemical ingredients. Maybe that would be your chance?

Explore the haunted forest in search of alchemical ingredients. Discover new potions and sell them to customers. Enhance your equipment to enter even deeper into the woods. Improve and decorate your house.

title: Escape from the Abandoned Outpost
description:
게임 정보
Congratulations! You've graduated from the Space Academy and are ready for your first mission—an internship at a remote outpost on the edge of the galaxy. The outpost is fully automated and everything seems routine... until it isn’t. Suddenly, you're stranded on a hostile planet, and the outpost is in ruins.

In Escape from the Abandoned Outpost, your mission is to search the desolate outpost and the dangerous planetary jungle for resources. Repair the outpost, upgrade your equipment, and fend off the hostile flora and fauna as you fight to survive and return to civilization.

Repair the outpost to secure your survival
Explore the dangerous planetary jungle
Upgrade your gear to overcome the planet’s challenges

Are you ready to face the unknown and make it out alive?
tag: 캐주얼,비주얼 노벨,숨은 그림 및 물체,만화 같은

title: Follow The Rules
description:
게임 정보
In Follow the Rules you step into the role of a night shift guard entrusted with the protection of different sites, each with its own mysteries and hauntings. The game delivers a truly immersive and suspenseful horror experience where the core focus is on adherence to a straightforward but critical set of rules.

Diverse Locations: Each night brings a new place to safeguard, from the hushed library filled with ancient books to the grand theater and the museum housing captivating relics.

Realistic Night Shift: Experience the eerie, quiet, and haunting ambiance of the night shift with graphics and sounds that plunge you into the role of a night guard.

The Vital Rules: Your lifeline rests on following a precise set of rules. Violate them, and you'll face the sinister and enigmatic entities lurking in the darkness.

Supernatural Challenge: Encounters with the paranormal, unexplained events, and unsettling encounters will keep you on edge.

Survival at Stake: Follow the Rules challenges you to remain obedient to the rules and endure through each night shift.

title: Suspended Animation 💽
description:
게임 정보
Suspended Animation is a sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

Piece together the events of the past to find out what's going on, exploring every nook and cranny for clues. Download yourself to nearby droids to get in where you shouldn't be. Increase your security access by being trustworthy, or by hacking your way there.

Solve puzzles to traverse the treacherous environment of your failing ship, and talk to NPCs to gain their trust - if you even want it.

title: Gassy Getaway
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Gassy Getaway - the hilarious casual game that will put your laughter and time management skills to the test!
Navigate Through Office Chaos

In this frantic office adventure, you take on the role of an employee in a highly urgent situation - a pressing need that just can't be stopped! But beware: Your character unfortunately has limited control over their gases and must navigate through the office without hitting too many colleagues with their unwanted emissions.
Complete Tasks Before the Countdown

Your mission? Complete all the important tasks assigned to you in the office before you just can't hold it anymore and urgently need to visit the restroom! Whether it's quickly printing out an important document or locking the computer - withstand the time pressure and avoid embarrassing encounters on the way to relief.
Key Features:

Unique Gameplay: Navigate through the office and complete important tasks while trying to keep your flatulence under control.
Exciting Challenges: From simple to tricky tasks waiting to be completed before you just can't hold it anymore.
Hilarious Animations: Dive into a world full of funny animations and characters that will tickle your funny bone.
Office Environment: Explore various office areas with different obstacles and hiding spots as you make your way to the restroom.
Rewards and Leaderboards: Unlock achievements and compete for the top spot on leaderboards as you showcase your skills in flatulence management.
Customization Options: Customize your character with different outfits and accessories, getting ready for the wild adventure in the office!

With these features, Gassy Getaway is sure to provide an unforgettable experience for all players looking for a humorous and entertaining pastime!

title: Dear
description:
게임 정보
An Otter tasked with saving the land by guiding animals to a healing tree, and Aaron, a man struggling to love himself after an abusive relationship. Two parallel narratives exploring loneliness, hope and the mutual healing found in an unexpected connection.
"Dear, Lake" is a parallel narrative-driven game where you mainly play as an Otter and Aaron. Set in the vast lands of the healing tree, explore snowy terrain, and lush grassy plains, as you set out on a journey to find other animals and lead them towards peace. Along the way, you'll meet other animals like a bear, mole, and more unlocking the ability to play as them, utilizing their abilities to traverse the healing lands.
Features:
~Third-person narrative. Switch between the likes of a story centering around Animals trying to save their home and a man searching for his home.
~Play as different animas. "Dear, Lake" offers many playable animals, such as an Otter, Beetle, Mole, Bear, and more.
~Interconnected world. Traverse the lands of the healing tree, with interconnected areas leading to snowy mountains and grassy plains.
~Side Stories. As the Otter you can help the lives of many animals through side stories helping them through hardships.
Playtime: 2-3 hours.

title: Brawlygon
description:
게임 정보
Jump into the world of Brawlygon!
Master mechanical mix-ups as the robot, armor aggressive attacks as the knight, practice patience and precision as the cowboy, or mystify the mid-range as the mage, there's a wide variety of fighters to choose from, as fighters from around the world, through time, and across dimensions, have come together, to beat the polygons out each other! With a planned base roster of 12+ characters (possibly more), and additional characters after launch.

Brawlygon sets out to fill the gap between high and low difficulty fighting games, being approachable, yet complex. implementing the simple control scheme of platform fighters, and a good variety of attacks for you to play around with, all while you dodge, dash, run and roll around the stage with a wide array of defensive and mobility options! There're also a few twists thrown into the genre, like making defense the most effective way to build meter, while introducing "Piercing" attacks, which deal more damage on BLOCK than on hit! Every character also utilizes the "stamina" and "energy" meter differently, so you'll have to learn how manage each individual fighter's resources effectively!

Features (Currently):
8 Playable Characters
Local Multiplayer
Single player arcade mode, and challenges
Control Remapping

title: Marked - The Quest  Tripura
description:
게임 정보
An epic team up of Indian gods...
An encounter of planetary proportions....
Three levitating cities destroyed by a smile...
An archeological marvel in South India and
One of the oldest games known to mankind - this game reveals the secret that millions of Indians have carried for generations with a mark on their foreheads - a clue to reach the lost cities of Tripura.

Marked - The Quest for Tripura tells the story of the origins of Chess by putting the player through mind bending turn based puzzles as they explore the ruins of Hampi in their quest to find Tripura. In this third person puzzle exploration game you play as Dee, short for Drauni, and must find a way to escape your past and make it to the lost cities of Tripura before the agents catch you.

** Please note that the art is work in progress, this is not how the final game will look**

All the puzzles are built on 1 rule, the Knight's movement


The grid shapes create different puzzles

title: Hangry Bear
description:
게임 정보
Hey heyyy! Step right up and indulge in the whimsical world of Hangry Bear! Stroll down streets bustling with delectable chaos, execute gravity-defying flips, and give your inner bear a chance to shine in a tumultuous pursuit of gastronomic glory. In Hangry Bear, time is a fishy currency, and only the most ravenous of bears will reign supreme.

Features:

🐾 Four Levels of Mayhem: Immerse yourself in the bedlam of four delightfully distinct levels, each more 'bear-tastic' than the last. It's a hangry escapade like no other!

🎯 The Pursuit of Fishiness: Follow the conspicuous red arrow as you chase your next tasty objective – a mouthwatering fish! Can you appease your bearish appetite and become the ultimate culinary critter?

🕹️ Controller Elegance: Play as you please with complete controller support. Get set to bare it all with your preferred controls!

🎤 Bear-illiant Tutorial: Master the art of bear acrobatics and tactical dropkicks at your own pace with our dulcet-toned tutorial. You'll be bear-ing it all like a pro in no time.

🏆 Competitive Bear-ism: Amass points by enduring the longest, amassing the most fish, delivering acrobatic front flips, and administering face-pummeling dropkicks. The leaderboard beckons – can you stake your claim?

🎮 Classic Arcade Frolic: Hangry Bear offers brisk, pick-up-and-play sessions that'll keep you returning for more. Perfect for when you require a breather from epic gaming extravaganzas.

Are you primed to flip, dash, and dropkick your way to bear brilliance? Hangry Bear is your passport to a side-splitting adventure filled with bearish antics and satirical sustenance. Get ready to embrace your inner bear and let the hangry hilarity unfurl!

title: Rewind And Reclaim
description:
게임 정보
A homage to the 90’s horror movies and Series B slashers, REWIND AND RECLAIM is a bloodcurling turn based tactical in which your wits and survivability skills are the only things standing between you and a gruesome death.
Play through the different VHS, outsmart terrible foes, and piece together the story that links them all together!
Play as a survivor of an 90's horror movie and use your ingenuity and your combativeness to to defy the odds and survive fearsome encounters.
Use your environment, from a crowbar to a gas can, and confront creatures much stronger than you in turn-based fights. Explore small scaled but fully-packed tactical maps that’ll get your blood pumping and your brain racking.

title: Tora's Garden
description:
게임 정보
CREATE YOUR SANCTUARY
Venture into the wilds to find furniture and collectables, catch fish, and collect bugs to bring back to your fully customisable sanctuary.
5 UNIQUE AREAS
Traverse and glide through 5 unique areas, uncovering secrets and meeting a cast of eclectic characters.
THE STORY OF A DYING WORLD
A prequel to the events of Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe, stave off the death of the planet by creating a sanctuary and healing the environment around you.
FEATURES
Create your unique sanctuary amidst a dying world.
Go fishing and catch bugs to bring back your growing safe haven.
Attract unique fauna to your sanctuary as it grows.
Follow the story of a dying world and your role in its last stand.
Glide through the skies in Tora's Garden's vertical environments.
Help the locals that deal with the challenges a dying world brings.
Find hidden furniture, plants, props and more to decorate your sanctuary.

title: Kelp Keeper
description:
게임 정보
Become a Sea Otter
Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.
Score-Attacking Arcade Fun
Kelp Keeper is a score-based arcade game with multiple levels that can be unlocked after achieving high enough scores on previous levels. Earn more points by eating multiple enemies at the same time!

title: ABYA:Paint Ball
description:
게임 정보
In the aftermath of the world's destruction, a unique mechanical city was established underground by some survivors. However, limited resources forced the population to split again, leading to constant conflicts between the "Explorers" and the "Utopians." Ultimately, war broke out once again, but no human emerged victorious. Today, only ruins and robots faithfully executing their programs remain in the underground world.
Decades later, a robot named ABYA unexpectedly awakens from its hibernation pod. An awakened intelligent brain informs it that there may still be human civilization on the surface, but the central elevator leading to the surface has stopped functioning. Guided by the intelligent brain, ABYA picks up its weapon and begins to explore the deserted and silent underground...
Coherent and Compact 2D Platforming Experience
The desolate underground city has fallen into disrepair, and the lack of electricity has made most areas difficult to traverse. To successfully explore or reach your destination, you need to think strategically, utilize your existing equipment, and navigate with agility.
Multiple Practical or Fun Special Ammunition
As a member of the intelligent mechanical firefighting team, your special water gun is your greatest secret weapon. With various ammunition mechanisms, you will no longer fear any challenges, whether it's poison gas, high platforms, or crevices!

title: Candy Bandits
description:
게임 정보
Candy Bandits is a thrilling 3D top-down multiplayer party game where Guardians and Bandits face off in chaotic team battles! Equip a mix of passive and active abilities, collect powerful one-time actions from action boxes and strategize with your teammates to outsmart the competition.
Your goal? Collect 30 candies to secure victory or stop the enemy team by catching them—teamwork, quick thinking, and clever tactics are your keys to triumph!"

Will you be a Guardian, defending the precious candies scattered across different landscapes, or will you embrace the life of a Bandit set on stealing these delicious treasures?
Actions: Grab one of many action boxes scattered around the maps and use the unique effects to your and your teams advantage!
Actions vary from simple dashes to more complex team-based actions like laying bombs and blinding your enemies!

title: Infected Frontier
description:
게임 정보

Infected Frontier는 다각형 좀비 생존 루터 슈터로, 기지 건설과 제작이 포함되어 있습니다.
스토리 및 임무 - 흥미진진한 이야기에 몰입하고 독특한 보상을 획득하고 전개를 진행하기 위해 임무를 완수하십시오.
당신의 목표는 생존뿐이며, 나머지는 선택 사항입니다.



당신의 방식대로 플레이하세요: 싱글 플레이어, 온라인 서버 기반 멀티플레이어, 또는 친구들과 온라인 협동 플레이.
캐릭터 생성: 나만의 캐릭터를 만드세요.
기지 건설.
제작: 다양한 상황에 맞는 수백 가지 아이템을 제작하세요.
수집: 세상을 탐험하거나 적을 처치하여 아이템을 찾으세요.
자원 채집: 나무, 돌, 금속 등 원재료를 수집하세요.
총기 커스터마이징: 여러 가지 부착물을 찾아 제작하여 당신의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 총기를 만드세요.
생존 메커니즘: 배고픔과 갈증을 관리하여 생존하세요.
낚시: 간단한 낚시 시스템으로 음식을 구하세요.
수집: 수백 가지의 고유한 아이템을 수집하세요.
날짜, 시간, 기후 시스템.
인벤토리 관리.

title: Plinio Needs a Hand
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a charming and whimsical world, where physics bends to its own rules, and a quirky family of slimes embarks on a journey through five extraordinary levels. In a realm where the surreal becomes routine, meet the slime adventurer family: a robust green father, a delicate pink mother, and a lighter-than-air daughter in soft shades of pink. They've conquered every nook of this peculiar universe, from the foundations to unexplored heights.

Yet, a fateful day turns their journey into an exciting saga. Returning home, a malevolent creature cuts the bridge connecting levels, causing the father slime to plummet to the lowest tier. Desperate to reunite with his beloved family, he stands at the edge of an impassable precipice.

This is where players step in, summoned to guide our slime hero through intriguing challenges using the magic of our hands. Manipulate boxes, unravel puzzles, and forge a path through each level as the captivating narrative unfolds.

Game Features:
🌈 Surreal World: Explore vibrant levels filled with surprises, where each layer unveils new challenges and wonders.
🤯 Innovative Puzzles: Master the art of manipulating boxes controlled by your hand to create passages through intriguing obstacles.
👾 Malevolent Creatures: Encounter and interact with unfriendly creatures whose mission is to hinder our hero.
👪 Family Bonds: Immerse yourself in the exciting story of a slime family, gathering them and overcoming challenges to restore harmony.
💡 Fun and Challenging Physics: Test your skills with a unique game mechanic that challenges the laws of physics in unexpected and stimulating ways.

Get ready for a unique and unforgettable adventure, where your dexterity and imagination are the keys to reuniting this adorable family. Embark now on a journey of puzzles and discoveries in a world where even the simplest slimes can become extraordinary heroes.

title: Castillon
description:
게임 정보
Castillon is a bite-sized strategy game that blends RTS and TD gameplay
As a renown wizard you lay claim to a new land to build your castle. But beware, for demon invaders roam the wilds. Grow your castle during the day then fight off waves of enemies at night!
Inspired by the base-building and resource management of classic RTS titles like WarCraft 3, the defensive experimentation of GemCraft, and simplified tactics of games like Thronefall and Bad North – Castillon aims to offer a familiar yet unique experience that borrows from some of our favorite titles.
Build and Upgrade
Gather up resources and spend them to expand your base as you see fit. There are no limits on building placements. Plan carefully to protect your castle and survive increasingly challenging nightly attacks. Each morning, you’ll be able to draft a new means of enhancing your hero or base.
Harness Mystical Elements
Utilize the 4 schools of magic: Holy, Arcane, Necrotic and Engineering to defeat your foes. Experiment with different magical combinations to maximize your defenses with unique and powerful elemental Towers.
Defend your Kingdom
During the day you can help your villagers collect resources, focus on building, or venture out in search of loot and additional magic gems. Build homes, farms, towers, barracks, walls and more to fortify your base. Striking a balance between economy and defense is key!

title: Stream or Die!
description:
게임 정보
CONQUER THE CREATORS
You're Cage, an underdog streamer, teetering on the brink of obscurity. Seize a mysterious invitation to stream WISH, an unexplored MMO, and buckle up for the ride of your life.



Tactical auto-battler RPG plus Streamer simulator all in one!
You've never experienced a story like this
Recruit adventurers with the LFG Party System
Unlock powerful combat abilities by creating Formations
Watch in horror as your in-game choices bleed into the real world!
25+ endings
Fully voiced





Inspired by the Persona series and with an innovative RPG auto-battle system, every choice you make shapes your path. Will you be a family-friendly entertainer or a controversial edgelord? Each decision impacts your journey and your audience. Balance is key; keep your energy high, stress low, and sanity in check to dazzle your audience stream after stream.




As Cage, dive into and lead massive raids through a rich, expansive world brimming with quests, mystical artifacts, and treacherous dungeons. Watch your subscriber count soar as you become a streaming legend.




Uncover the enigmatic lore of the Monumentals, gargantuan beings consuming cities, and the Whisperers, mysterious figures holding the balance. Your streaming journey intertwines with these mysteries, leading to unexpected revelations.




Who Influences the Influencers? As you skyrocket to fame and fortune, a lingering question haunts every stream – who really controls the world of , and what's their game?

title: Sternly Worded Adventures
description:
게임 정보
Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.
FEATURES
Master over 8 different classes
Over 15 different enemies
Unlock over 180 items
Spell words with over 25 different letters

WHAT'S IN THE DEMO?
In the demo you are limited to the starting Adventurer class.
You can play any adventure node up to and including Level 3. Visiting a Level 4 node triggers an event that ends the demo.
You have access to every item the adventurer could normally access except for one, which is restricted because it can trigger the afore mentioned event early.
You have full access both of the Wordle and Minesweeper inspired minigames, without limit.

You can directly continue your save file from the demo in the full version.

title: Disco Samurai
description:
게임 정보
개요
디스코 사무라이는 펜실베이니아의 사이버펑크 도시 디스코를 배경으로 한 독특한 리듬 전투 게임입니다. 공격, 방어, 대시 및 기타 능력을 음악의 비트에 맞춰 부드럽게 결합하여 당신의 기술을 시험해보세요. 법과 규칙이 없는 세상에서, 검을 마스터한 자만이 영광과 번영을 누릴 자격이 있습니다. 상상 이상의 음모에 휘말린 반항적인 학생 폭스가 되어, 볼륨을 높이고 신스웨이브와 록의 전율적인 사운드스케이프의 리듬을 잡고, 미니멀리스트 디오라마 아레나를 통해 싸워 나가세요!
상세 정보
전투
디스코 사무라이에서는 당신과 적의 행동이 음악의 비트에 맞춰 동기화됩니다. 사무라이로서 적을 존중해야 합니다 – 적의 공격 지표에 주의를 기울이고, 패리, 블록, 회피를 번갈아 사용하여 적을 지치게 해야 합니다. 주저하지 말고 주도권을 잡아 공격하거나, 적을 환경적 위험 요소로 차서 추가 피해를 입히는 등의 특수 능력을 사용하세요. 비트를 놓치면 당신은 죽은 목숨입니다 – 하지만 레벨은 짧으니 다시 시도하는 데 몇 초밖에 걸리지 않습니다.

보스 전투
복잡한 공격 패턴을 가진 매우 위험한 보스들과 맞서 싸우세요. 각 보스는 자신만의 독특한 노래에 맞춰 공격 패턴이 동기화되어 있어, 각 싸움에 개인적인 터치를 더합니다.

맞춤 음악
레벨을 완료한 후, 게임에 로드한 맞춤 음악으로 다시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
스토리
세상은 디스코 사무라이에 미쳐 있습니다 – 사이버펑크 메타버스인 디스코를 배경으로 한 게임입니다. 모든 사람이 이 게임을 하고 있습니다 – 당신의 이웃, 당신의 상사, 아마도 당신이 가장 싫어하는 정치인까지도요. 사람들은 가상 부동산, 자동차, 디자이너 옷을 구매할 뿐만 아니라 심지어 보험까지 가입하고 있습니다! 미친 소리 같나요? 저에게 말해보세요 – 게임이 출시된 이후로 세계 범죄율이 77% 이상 감소했습니다! 사소한 범죄로 감옥에 썩느니, 디스코에서 악명 높은 현상금 사냥꾼이 되어 아무런 결과 없이 활동하는 게 낫지 않겠어요?

이 이야기는 건축과 미술 분야에서 이름을 날리고 싶은 반항적인 학생 폭스를 따라갑니다. 가상 반달리즘과 픽셀 피를 흘리는 것이 강의를 듣는 것보다 그녀의 스타일에 더 맞기 때문에, 디스코 세계는 ""브루탈리즘""의 새로운 정의를 배우게 될 것입니다.

title: Wiblu
description:
게임 정보
Wiblu
"Unraveling the Mystery of Fire Tea"

Embark on an enchanting journey with "Wiblu," a captivating story adventure game inspired by German mythology. Winner of the Best Indie Game Prototype at the German Videogame Awards, "Wiblu" invites you to explore a world filled with mystical creatures, breathtaking landscapes, and a quest for a legendary cure – the elusive fire tea.

Key Features:
🔮 Immersive Storytelling: Join Wiblu, a young Hommlinger girl, on a quest through the fantastical world of "Waag" to find the cure for her ailing grandmother. Encounter magical places, forge new companionships, face old dangers, and unveil the mysteries of Wiblu's own past. The narrative promises an adventure straight out of a storybook – with a pinch of love and the creativity of our five dedicated developers.

🎶 Melodic Masterpiece: Immerse yourself in a unique musical experience as you traverse the realms of "Wiblu." The game's self-composed and handcrafted music draws inspiration from the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, featuring harps, flutes, guitars, synthesizer sounds, choirs, and orchestras. Let the bard's lament serve as a musical thread, intertwining themes that encapsulate the rich lore of "Wiblu."

🎨 Hand-Drawn Elegance: Witness the breathtaking artistry of "Wiblu," where every detail is meticulously hand-drawn. The unique and elaborate art style creates a visual feast for your eyes, turning the game into a living, breathing masterpiece.

🎮 Engaging Gameplay Mechanics:
Dialogues/Minigames: Immerse yourself in the story through interactive dialogues and entertaining minigames that sharpen your skills and enhance crucial content.

Key Items/Items: Solve puzzles and overcome challenges using a variety of items, each with its own significance. Key items can be reused, while ordinary items play a pivotal role in unraveling mysteries.

Stories: Explore hidden stories scattered throughout the levels, encouraging thorough exploration. Deepen your understanding of the game's lore and support worldbuilding by collecting these captivating snippets.

🔍 Discover Waag: Experience a seamless and user-friendly gaming environment with simple controls, detailed hand-drawn levels, and hidden items waiting to be uncovered. Engage with lovingly designed puzzles that gradually increase in complexity, keeping you captivated from start to finish.

"Wiblu" is more than just a game; it's an immersive adventure crafted with passion, creativity, and the desire to offer a truly memorable experience. Dive into the world of "Wiblu" and let the magic unfold.

title: Forest of Soul
description:
게임 정보



"영혼의 숲"은 독특한 롤플레잉 게임입니다.
자신의 영적 세계에 들어가면 어떤 멋진 광경을 보게 될지 생각해 본 적이 있습니까?
플롯 중심의 게임 흐름, 여유롭고 즐거운 게임 경험, 아름다움과 마법이 공존하는 몽환적인 장면, 잊지 못할 여정을 시작해 보세요!
>>>클릭하여 위시리스트에 추가하고 팔로우하시면 체험판 데모 소식을 최대한 빨리 받아보실 수 있습니다!







다른 세계에서 온 탐험가이며 꿈속에서 기적을 보게 될 수 있다고 말했습니다. 소녀는 작은 유령을 따라가며 스릴과 즐거움이 가득한 여행을 시작했습니다. 그녀는 꿈속에서 다양한 판타지 장면을 접했고, 흥미로운 친구들을 많이 사귀었습니다. 그러나 꿈이 끝나갈 무렵 그녀는 놀라운 비밀을 발견했고, 그것은 모두 자신의 과거와 관련이 있다는 사실이 밝혀지는데…

title: Masada
description:
게임 정보
Civilization is trapped in Masada, a vast and exotic nebula far from any star system. Thousands of years have passed since humanity became prisoners of this strange world, and in that time, it has blossomed into drastically different cultures—ranging from humble nomads to black hole-worshiping theocracies and powerful empires competing for total domination. The struggle for survival is always present in this brutal space.
Gameplay
Masada is a single-player RTS/RPG set in a 5,000 x 5,000 x 50 km open world sandbox.
Explore many unique regions ranging from vast asteroid fields filled with pirates to dense nebula where any dangers could be lurking in the fog, to even epic ice capped terrain. The nebula is a strange and wild place.
Immerse yourself in a simulated world. You are not the center of the universe in Masada. Ships and their pilots will carry on with their business whether you are there or not. Encounter miners hauling ore back from an excavation, ambush traders as they bring goods across the nebula, scavenge wreckage from a battle you stumble upon, and much more.
Build and customize your fleets, from nimble interceptors to powerful battlecruisers and even motherships. You will need to use a wide range of tactics to truly thrive in the nebula. Arm your ship's weapons with autocannons, artillery, railguns, missiles, beams, pulse cannons, torpedoes... and more. Setup support ships with repairing shield beams to protect your frontline. Develop robust carriers that can quickly dock and repair your smaller craft in battle. The combination of outfitting all your ships with a wide range of weapons and modules leads to infinite variations of tactics for you to explore.
Craft and discover greater and more powerful modules and weapons through industry, trade, combat and exploration.
Learn to build and fly all the ships in the nebula through blueprints. Some will be harder to acquire than others...
Train and recruit a powerful faction of pilots to pursue roles from scouts to frigate captains and set your best to command your most powerful warships. Your pilots can achieve mastery in any area to dominate the nebula.
Freedom to pursue any path. Whether you want to lead a powerful faction, command a small elite squad of pirates, build an industrial powerhouse or even become a nomadic trader, Masada is a game centered around unrestricted player freedom.

title: Dead Meat
description:
게임 정보
Unleash your inner detective in Dead Meat - a murder mystery interrogation game where you can ask the suspects literally anything, using voice or keyboard!
Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers.
Want to discuss their alibi? Probe them on the meaning of life? Confess your love? Or just troll them mercilessly? Your words hold power, and anything goes. Persuade them, manipulate them, threaten them, or even charm them into spilling their secrets.
The Interrogation room is your sandbox, and your imagination is the only limit. What will you ask to get to the truth?

title: Extraktion 1943
description:
게임 정보
Local + Online Co-Op

Take on the nazis with up to 4 players in PVE co-op.

Loot and Survive

Manage many resources to stay alive behind enemy lines: Food, Water, Health, Energy, Body Temperature, and Mental Strength.
Sabotage

Hit the enemy where it hurts! Sabotage the enemy's lifelines; vehicles, factories, food production, anything you can!
Assassinate

The less Nazis the better, take down high ranking officers but make sure you have a clear exit route. Use sniper rifles, explosives, or even your bare hands.

Get out of the mission zone alive. If you die during your run, you'll lose all your loot! Choose to extract with your loot or push on for greater challenges and rewards.
