title: BeetleBall
description:
게임 정보
I know what you're thinking-"Maybe if I was a beetle, my life wouldn't suck". Newsflash pal, you're right. How could a beetle playing soccer with dung balls be sad? Anyway, that's why we've invested our life savings into bringing you BeetleBall, the greatest multiplayer dung beetle soccer game on Steam.
Fun Movement Mechanics
You have full control over where and how you move in the dung field. Climb up a wall, glide down at full speed, and steal an enemy's ball to roll it straight into their net!
Unique Classes
Find a play style that suits you with a diverse roster of beetle classes based on real species. Each beetle has unique abilities that can shift the balance of each round.
More than one Ball
Compete for freshly dropped dung balls and merge them together to form a golden ball, or steal the enemy's ball right out of their hands.
Game Changing Map Design
BeetleBall is not limited by the verticality of standard soccer (football) fields. Each map offers a unique experience that keeps each game feeling fresh and exciting.

title: Invade
description:
게임 정보
INVADE는 최대 4명의 플레이어가 즐길 수 있는 혼돈의 멀티플레이어 파티 게임입니다. 선택한 캐릭터로 다양하고 예측할 수 없는 레벨들을 돌파하고, 상대의 보물 상자를 빼앗아 자신의 기지로 안전하게 가져오세요. 그러는 내내 상대방이 당신에게 사용하는 마구잡이식의(그리고 폭발하는 일이 비일비재한) 파워업을 피해야만 합니다.

로컬 멀티 플레이어 모드 & 온라인 멀티플레이어
INVADE는 친구와 플레이할 수 있는 게임입니다. 최대 4인의 플레이어가 온라인 또는 같은 기기에서 2개 팀으로 나뉘어 플레이할 수 있습니다.

캐릭터
저마다 특색 있는 무기를 갖춘 다양하고 흥미로운 캐릭터들 중에서 신중하게 선택하세요!

레벨
해변, 기차역, 건설 현장 등 다채로운 레벨 중에서 매치 장소를 고르세요!

파워업
상대의 머리 위로 폭탄을 떨어뜨릴 수도 있고, 상대를 용암으로 둘러싸거나 우주로 날려버릴 수도 있습니다! 어떤 게임이든 여러 가지 파워업이 등장하면 더욱 정신없어지기 마련이죠!

title: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
description:
게임 정보
Your journey takes you from your birthplace of Sorrelfield to the mysterious Za of the desert and through the fast-paced lives of The Uprooted, to name a few.

Discover all 10 factions and choose your place among them. Llamas always look for greener pastures - it's time to find yours!

Battle through the singleplayer campaign or craft items and trade them with your friends after PvPing.

Master the turn-based combat system and find new ways of playing your character, all while doing it in a game that combines the best parts of your favorite old-school RPGs mixed together into its own unique style.

Key Features
2D 16 Bit Style Graphics
Turn-Based Combat
Complex Crafting System & Professions
Endless Itemization Options
Talent Trees & Specializations
Unique Puzzles & Fight Mechanics
Buy Once - Enjoy Forever: No Monetization or DLCs
Planned Mobile & Console Support

The entire world is meant to have a purpose and often be revisited for various quests, grinds, or simply for fun. No gimmicks, no LlamaPass, no PayToWin mechanics; just pure reward for putting in the work and becoming better at the game.

title: Vignettes: The Dream City
description:
게임 정보
In recent nights, your dreams have been haunted by a city of unknown origin. It stands as an enigma to you, with parts of its design and structure seemingly mocking the familiarities of human architecture. Feeling drawn to something, you begin exploring the city.



Vignettes: The Dream City is a dungeon crawler set in the surreal city you've been dreaming about, ceaselessly, for months. Throughout your exploration of the dream you could meet other dreamers, find rare loot, discover unknowable truths, and damage your psyche forever. All within the dream world, of course.

title: Combo Haven
description:
게임 정보
Combo Haven is a game that aims to distill the most exciting aspect of platform fighting games: doing cool combos! Without having to worry about putting in countless hours of effort or outplaying opponents with years of practice, in Combo Haven anyone can experience the satisfying thrill of landing a nasty combo.
If you are someone who likes to be challenged, rest assured. Underneath the relatively forgiving and easy to learn controls and physics of Combo Haven, lies a significant level of mechanical depth, for those who aim to beat the developer high scores and reach the top of the leaderboards.
Combo Haven is currently in development. I hope to release a polished free demo to Steam by mid 2025, and the full version by the end of 2025. The demo will include 4-5 levels, with one playable character.
The full version will include 20+ unique levels, and 3 different playable characters, as well as global leaderboards, replay saving features, and an original soundtrack.

title: Cut the Cards
description:
게임 정보
In this roguelike deckbuilder, you cut the cards... literally! With scissors! You can recombine the cut-outs to form new cards, and you can play your custom cards in combat or in text-based dialogue events. The game has a custom language processing engine that will determine the special effects of each new card you make.
(Note: This game does not use generative AI.)

Features:
Hundreds of cards. You can mix-and-match effects from different cards using a unique card-cutting mechanic. There are endless possibilities of what you can make!

title: Precarious Platmer
description:
게임 정보
Precarious Platformer is a lighthearted platformer inspired by Miyamoto's Donkey Kong.
In Donkey Kong, players initially avoid barrels by jumping onto platforms. Upon acquiring a power-up (the hammer), players can smash barrels by swinging the hammer but lose the ability to jump. This power-up acquisition transforms the gameplay from a platformer into an action game, though progressing without the item remains possible.
In this game, the core movement shifts from jumping to dashing in four directions. Directional devices replace power-ups to achieve similar gameplay effects.
There is a map builder where you can build your own map and share it with others.
Game Content
Seamless map with interconnected levels
Equippable Devices with various abilities
Physically driven mechanisms
Map Builder
8 component types: Static, Facility, Character, Device, Item, Block, Collective, Decoration
Five editable layer (some Facilities support cross-layer interaction)
Custom background & music per level
Selectable Characters with unique abilities

A: Planned update if sales targets achieved.

title: Pitchks and Daggers
description:
게임 정보
How far will you go to keep your crown?
Pitchforks and Daggers is a branching court politics drama where every choice matters.
 As King Henry of Elander, you must navigate treacherous lords, scheming family members, and angry peasants- all while trying to secure your kingdom’s future.
This is a game of difficult decisions. Every action has consequences, shaping the fate of your rule and the land you govern. Consult your court, weigh your options, and decide carefully.
 Features:
A deeply branching narrative with multiple endings.
A web of political intrigue, betrayal, and war.
High-stakes choices that impact the story.
Replayability-see the different paths your rule could take.
 The Story:
King Henry has no heir- his beloved wife, Mary, cannot bear children. Meanwhile, his uncle, King Harold of Ervin, challenges his claim to the throne.
The kingdom teeters on the brink of war.
Your choices will shape the fate of Elander. Will you secure your legacy- or lose everything?

title: MEMORYLEAK
description:
게임 정보
Do You Have What It Takes Kid?
Get ready to dive into MEMORYLEAK, an extraordinary FPS adventure like no other! Explore diverse dimensions in 2D, 3D, and VR, all set in a gripping, narrative-rich world of 2000s Texas. MEMORYLEAK isn’t just a game – it's a groundbreaking journey through time and reality, designed to captivate and thrill.
Why MEMORYLEAK is a Must-Play:
Embrace the future of gaming with MEMORYLEAK, where cutting-edge technology meets compelling storytelling. Developed with Unreal Engine 5, this game is a stunning visual feast with a heart-pounding storyline.
Varied Gameplay Dimensions: Jump between intense FPS battles, explore immersive VR worlds, and enjoy captivating 2D gameplay. MEMORYLEAK offers a gameplay experience for every style.
Engrossing Storyline: Set against the backdrop of Lampasas, Texas, MEMORYLEAK's narrative is inspired by real events, woven into an engaging and thought-provoking story.
Stunning Visuals: Experience the beauty of Unreal Engine 5, with breathtaking graphics, detailed environments, and a world that feels alive.
Interactive World: Every corner of MEMORYLEAK is crafted for maximum immersion and interactivity, making you feel truly part of the game.
Explore, Engage, Enjoy: With each dimension offering its unique challenges and delights, MEMORYLEAK promises endless hours of fun and exploration.
Key Highlights:
A unique blend of 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay.
A story that's as engaging as the gameplay itself.
Gorgeous graphics that push the limits of realism.
A living, breathing game world waiting for you to explore.
Sound and music that pull you deeper into the experience.
Ready for an adventure that will redefine how you think about gaming? MEMORYLEAK is waiting for you. Join us on this unforgettable journey, and let's push the boundaries of gaming together!

title: Runehaven
description:
게임 정보
Runehaven is an atmospheric first-person dungeon crawler with roguelike elements taking place in a destructible voxel world. Combine runes to craft your own unique spells or to enchant weapons, alter the environment, explore procedurally generated dungeons, battle vile creatures, solve puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and dodge deadly traps!
Craft your own spells by combining different runes using a magic system inspired by Ultima and Arx Fatalis! Each rune affects the spell in an unique and emergent way!

title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
description:
게임 정보
In Teo Dove Am Skater 2 you will build you abilities as a professional skateboarder. Gathering experience points by completing missions and performing flip tricks, grabs and grinds. Score big with long insane linked lines. Use experience points to up your skills and learn new tricks while exploring open levels.

Key Features
Controls inspired by the great Tony Hawk Pro Skater series
Competitive High score system and local game of HORSE
Open levels to explore

title: The Quest of the Tiny Hero
description:
게임 정보
Embark on an epic journey in "The Quest of The Tiny Hero," a captivating 2D top-down RPG that invites players into a world teeming with vibrant life and boundless adventure. Designed to charm with its pixel-art visuals and enchant players with its RPG mechanics, this title is a love letter to the classic role-playing games that have enchanted us for decades.

Key Features
Quest System: Immerse yourself in quests granted by other villagers and travellers you meet on your adventure. From defeating formidable foes to finding mystical artefacts, each quest is a brushstroke in the grand painting of your hero's saga.

Craft Your Destiny: Harness the resources of the land to forge new gear, mix potions, and prepare for the trials ahead. Crafting is key to your growth as the village champion.

A World Alive with Possibility: Explore diverse zones, from lush grasslands to dry. Discover dungeons, settlements, and secrets that dot the landscape, all waiting for the touch of an explorer.

Progressive Challenge: As you become stronger, so do your adversaries. New challenges will emerge, requiring courage and strength, leading to the ultimate confrontation with a powerful enemy.

Charming Aesthetics and Sound: Enjoy the nostalgic allure of pixel art coupled with a soundtrack that evokes the spectrum of emotions in your journey—from the serenity of your village to the adrenaline of combat.

For Whom is This Quest?

"The Quest of The Tiny Hero" is an accessible entry into the RPG genre that offers a fulfilling adventure for both newcomers and seasoned players.
Can you rise from the diminutive stature of an aspiring hero to become the titan your village needs? Your quest awaits.
autokwd: The Quest of the Tiny Hero

title: LIMINOUS
description:
게임 정보
LIMINOUS is a first-person survival horror game. An immersive experience meant to flip the book on the genre, with just as many reasons to find danger as there are to avoid it. You'll find yourself in the shoes of resident explorer, Sydney, tasked with exploring unknown gaps in our reality in search of anything worth finding.
WORLDS BEYOND
Venture into the unknown, documenting discoveries and solving the mysteries of worlds we can't quite explain. Using the new dimensional portal, you'll find yourself in worlds small and large, familiar and not. Solve puzzles, log your findings, and steer clear of danger while venturing into this untold story. Make no mistake, this is a largely linear story, and remember, you're an intruder in these domains. Not every new face is a friendly one.
TOOLS OF THE TRADE
While you'll be traveling alone, you aren't without help. The boys in the lab are just a long-distance interdimensional transmitter away, always coming up with new tools to help you on your not-so-optional quest. Your discoveries, and anything you can bring back to the lab, will help fund these new tools to aid you on your journey. Best be cautious, however, as the story will continue to be told, whether you're prepared for it or not.
This is a story and project crafted by a solo developer. A labor of love that I hope you enjoy playing as much as I enjoyed making it.

title: Summoner of Greats
description:
게임 정보
Is it a prayer or a curse...
And what is a human being? A hymn to humanity that questions the beauty of human beings.
---
For 3,000 years, the Moon Rabbit [Lewis] has looked down on the earth and painted portraits of great historical figures.
However, he passed away after "an event".
And he left behind a series of portraits.

Why did he, a being so close to God, die?
This is a story of "prayer and curse" of a lonely rabbit who paints his thoughts on a canvas.
The disastrous yet beautiful historical figures [Effector Series] by Takahiro Tanaka, one of Japan's leading animation directors.
You can build your own deck by combining more than 200 great figures.
Everything in the interface exists as material that ties into the narrative and unfolds seamlessly without compromising the worldview.
.
There are also events that unfold as if the interface were a theater.
Yose! Sing! Dance! Strip!!!

In addition to over 100 story quests, there will be daily quests and regular event quests. All of them are boss battles!

The game makes full use of the unique skills of each effector, training, deck building, and tactics utilizing terrain and other factors.
The variety of aspects generated by placement and weather changes is appealing and allows you to build your own unique style of play.
Just use the mouse to make selections and place them on the board; the game design is suitable for both beginners and advanced players of RTS.
As you complete quests, you will obtain "memoirs and vinyl videos," fragmentary evidence of the story.
autokwd: Summoner of Greats,黒ニ狂: Summoner of Greats

title: Pakinpaks
description:
게임 정보
Pakinpaks is a cozy puzzle game where you must become the best in the art of packing bags! Travel all around the world by arranging luggages, bags and boxes while fulfilling specific requests along the way.
BonBon is your very relaxed boss cat companion who runs a bag-packing company, sit back and relax alongside him while figuring out how to fit everything inside that tiny backpack.
Game Modes
Cozy Travel Mode - Travel around the world alongside BonBon! Fulfill client requests at an Oasis, a Beach or even at Neo-Tokyo by packing their bags in specific ways.
Zen Infinite Mode - Unwind and pack at your own pace. Face an endless stream of procedurally generated bags, each requiring you to fit increasingly complex shapes. No time limits, no move caps — just pure, peaceful packing.
Rush Mode - Race against the clock! Pack as many bags as you can before time runs out. Each successfully packed bag adds a bit more time — how long can you keep going?
Brainy Mode - Every move counts! You have a limited number of moves, so plan carefully before placing each piece. Strategy is the key to success.

title: STEAM TRIGGER
description:
게임 정보
스팀 트리거로 스팀펑크 오디세이에 뛰어들어보세요.
산업 진보의 덜그럭거리는 톱니바퀴가 빅토리아 시대의 우아함과 어우러지는 광대한 대도시 베리디움에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 연례 클록워크 갈라, 기계적 경이의 눈부신 전시회인 그랜드 스팀펑크 이벤트에 몰입하세요. 전 세계 참석자들을 끌어들이는 이 화려한 행사의 중심에서는 대담한 모험가이자 탁월한 발명가인 에바가 뜨거운 정신을 불태우며 서 있습니다.
클록워크 갈라가 펼쳐지는 동안, 에바는 그녀의 걸작, 스팀 트리거를 공개합니다: 신비한 에너지원 에테리움으로 구동되는 거대한 기계 슈트입니다. 참석자들은 베리디움의 에테리움 매장지를 장악하여 도시를 혼란에 빠뜨리려는 음모를 꾸미는 수수께끼 같은 말라카이 경과 그의 반란 발명가 그룹에 의해 곧 클록워크 반란이 일어날 줄 모릅니다.
에바는 그녀가 마주하는 각 보스와 장애물을 통해 말라카이 경의 음모를 하나하나 파헤칩니다. 지략, 전략, 기계적 능력의 서사적 전투에서, 에바는 베리디움을 찢을 위협을 가진 기계 괴물과 맞서며 스팀 트리거를 겨눕니다.
인간의 창의성이 기계 괴물을 이기는 승리를 경험하세요. 스팀 트리거에서는 결단력 있는 여성 주인공, 클록워크가 가득한 세계의 경이로움, 인간 혁신의 꺾이지 않는 정신을 기념하는 스릴 넘치는 스팀펑크 이야기를 선보입니다. 베리디움의 운명을 다시 쓸 준비가 되셨나요?
주요 특징들:
다이내믹한 게임플레이: 게임의 다양한 풍경을 가로지르고 세로로 스크롤하면서 새로운 경험을 하십시오. 이러한 혼합은 여정에 흥미와 예측 불가능성의 추가적인 층을 더합니다.

title: Chop Shop
description:
게임 정보
이 액션 상점 운영 게임에서 놀라울 정도로 빠른 속도로 사냥하고, 고기를 발라내고, 요리하면서 흐름을 타보세요. 귀여운 몬스터를 사냥하고, 거대한 고깃덩이를 썰고, 신선육을 파워 슬라이스로 잘라 고객에게 더욱 빠르게 대령하세요. 상점이 살아남으려면 빠르게, 예리하게 대처해야 합니다.
정육 - 거대한 내장과 살코기를 발라내어 팔아 수익을 올리세요.
요리 - 각 고객에게 딱 맞는 요리를 만들거나 대중을 위한 매력적인 식품으로 가공하여 파세요.
- 적을 싹둑 썰어 맛있는 고기 부위로 만들어 보세요.

title: Disc Dimension
description:
게임 정보
Play disc golf in an immersive virtual reality world! Whether you've never played disc golf, you play every day, or you're somewhere in between, you'll find an experience for you in the Disc Dimension. Customize the game to match your system, gameplay style, VR comfort, and skill level. Learn how to control disc flight in a powerful, high-fidelity simulation with dynamic wind! Build your bag by collecting numerous unique discs with amazing designs, after discovering secrets and earning rewards.

Visit our Training Hill, where you learn the basics of disc golf, hone your disc golf shots, and complete challenges! Use Throw Assist to effortlessly launch distance shots from your chair, or turn it all the way down for a true-to-life simulated experience.

Put your real-world disc golf skills to the test in a Natural Round, where it's just you vs. nature! Face challenges and lines familiar on traditional courses. Throw your favorite shot shapes, and master your form. Track arm speed, spin force, disc angle, and more! Hit your gaps, develop your hyzer flips, hone your touch upshots, and use any other throws in your arsenal! Increase your putting percentage and go for distance on your drive. Develop your disc golf game, and take what you've learned to a course near you!

In an Adventure Round, face mind-bending hazards that change each round, altering your course strategy! How low can you score, and how stylish can you be? Confront distance-traversing portals, speed-altering fields, gravity-warping orbs, and more! Each hole presents a unique puzzle, blending traditional obstacles like trees and sand with magical forces that test your skill and strategy.

Technical Features include detailed textures and lighting, spatialized soundscapes using Steam Audio, and SteamVR velocity prediction for precise throws. The game supports 1k, 2k, and 4k textures with a dynamic resolution option, so you can scale the settings to match the performance your system can handle. We support OpenXR, so you can play via SteamVR with your favorite devices that support this interface including Oculus devices, Valve Index, HTC Vive, and many others.

Whether you're a seasoned disc golfer seeking a new challenge or a newcomer enticed by the magic of VR sports, prepare for an immersive journey beyond the fairway!

title: Ooga
description:
게임 정보
Ooga like meat. Pterosaur also like meat. Pterosaur steal Ooga's meat! Ooga MAD!!! Must get meat back! Spear help Ooga get meat! Spear defy all known laws of physics! Use to advantage! Soar like Pterosaur with spear!

Features:
Climb and fly through levels using Spears
Master the intuitive and tight momentum system
A massive world with unique area mechanics and enemies
Dozens of unlockable OogaBoy levels with unique visuals, locked behind tough movement challenges for the highest skilled Oogas.
Compete against your friends' scores on the Leaderboards (Not in Demo)
A cute and loveable protagonist filled with combustible gasses

Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

title: Six Orders
description:
게임 정보
Try to save the earth

ClimaSave's Terraforming Environmental Restoration and Revival Androids (TERRAs) went rogue. What once was humanities last hope to life again on planet earth turned out to be the possible end for terrestrial live.
Not all hope is lost

As a Simulation Specialist it is your task to find a way to stop the TERRAs and save the earth from its impending death. Jump into new procedurally generated simulations to find the one way to save the earth.
Control and build your squad of robots

Fight with up to 7 different robots against the TERRAs and try to stop them from destroying the earth even further. Customize your robots with different lasers and metal alloys to improve on their tactical strengths.
Manage your resources

For every simulation you try, there is only a limited amount of resources you can use to repair or extend your squad. During each mission you can to stockpile more metal and survive the tactical battles until the TERRAs are defeated.

Every simulation will be different. So can be your squad that you start with. Show ClimaSave that you are capable of saving the earth to . Each has its own strengths and weaknesses providing a different experience with every playthrough.

title: To The Hall Of The Mountain King
description:
게임 정보
GAME IS STILL IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT!




Setting: A parallel medieval fantasy universe where women can choose their spouses freely. Olivia, having chosen Vlad over the King, faces the King's wrath as he kidnaps their cat, Dimitrije.
Main Characters:
- Olivia: The brave protagonist who chose Vlad as her partner over the King.
- Vlad: Olivia’s partner, a skilled swordsman dedicated to rescuing Dimitrije.
- Mate: Olivia and Vlad’s roommate, providing support on their quest.
Plot Summary: Olivia, Vlad, and their roommate Mate embark on a not-so-secret mission to rescue Dimitrije from the King and seek revenge. The townsfolk are aware of their mission and support them by giving quests. Failure to complete these quests decreases a public secret meter, leading to attacks from the King's soldiers.




Core Objectives:
Players control Olivia, Vlad, and Mate to rescue Dimitrije and overthrow the King of the Seasons.

Key Features:
Hack and Slash Combat: Players face various enemies using combat skills to survive.
Platforming Challenges: Includes obstacles like jumping and crawling.
Adventure Story: A deep, emotional narrative with Kafkaesque twists and satirical humor.
Diverse Enemies: From guards to monsters, each with unique challenges and tactics.
Revenge and Rescue: Players encounter moral dilemmas while solving problems.

Game Mechanics:
Completing quests for townsfolk prevents the depletion of the public secret meter.
Choices impact gameplay; for example, choosing to help a pig or a farmer results in different outcomes and challenges.
Players earn "Threat" points based on their actions, affecting their rank and unlocking stronger attacks, better defense, more health, or faster movement.

Multiplayer Mode:
Online multiplayer includes free-for-all and team battle modes with specialized maps.




Overall Environment:
- The game is set on a large medieval fantasy island with villages, cities, forests, mountains, coastlines, rocky and swampy areas, and underground caves.
- Divided into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter, each with three main levels and a boss battle, totaling 17 single-player levels and 21 levels including multiplayer maps.
Single-Player Mode:
- Spring: Introduction and basic missions, escalating to challenging battles.
- Summer: Increasing difficulty with new characters and quests.
- Autumn: Complex levels with enchanted environments and mystical characters.
- Winter: Final challenges leading to the ultimate battle with the King.
Example Levels:
- Spring Level 1: Basic tutorial to learn controls and mechanics.
- Summer Level 2: Helping magical beings and solving elemental puzzles.
- Autumn Level 3: Navigating a magical forest and defeating enchanted guardians.
- Winter Level 4: Final confrontation with the King, involving strategic combat and rescue missions.
autokwd: To The Hall Of The Mountain King

title: Hoku Shrine
description:
게임 정보
A beautiful open world is waiting for you! Learn different fighting styles and magic skills, practice archery. Explore the world, mine resources, create weapons and brew potions, combine combat sets. Fight for justice and restore the Hoku Shrine!

Currently implemented in the game:

Character progression
Melee Combat (Two-handed Axe, Two-handed Sword, Sword and Shield, Halberd)
Ranged Combat with Bow and Arrow
Magic Spells
Enhancement with magic and potions
Resource Gathering: wood, herbs, crystals and minerals.
Armor and weapon crafting, potion brewing
Locations full of mobs, dungeons with guards and bosses.

title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
description:
게임 정보
❝Revenge and Correcting Old Sins Come Together in One Entity❞
Revenge Crystal is an epic top-down action RPG. Awaken as a knight with no memory in a ruined land overrun by mysterious invaders. Battle fierce foes, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate interconnected challenges to reclaim hope.
KEY FEATURES:
Discover a rich, diverse world, bursting with secrets and dangers in every unique environment.
Engage in epic battles with fierce enemies and powerful bosses, testing your combat skills to the max.
Wield magical spells with the option to enhance them with elemental powers for devastating effects.
Craft your own journey, making choices that determine your path and the challenges you face.
Customize your character to suit your playstyle, evolving skills and abilities to conquer your foes.

title: Te-Amic
description:
게임 정보
Multiplayer: Team up with friends to survive and upgrade your abilities in a world filled with various equipment.
Farming: Grow a wide variety of plants and raise animals to build and expand your farm.
Survival: Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to survive against harsh environments and challenging enemies.
Te-Amic: A special system where you can make new friends to assist you on your journey.

title: Marble Champions
description:
게임 정보
"Marble Champions"은 당신의 기술과 반사 신경을 극한으로 시험할 스릴 넘치는 구슬 레이싱 게임입니다. 복잡한 트랙을 통과하고 장애물을 극복하며 라이벌에게 승리하기 위해 당신의 기술에 의지하세요. 게임을 진행함에 따라 독특한 구슬의 보물창고를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 각 구슬은 독특한 외관과 통계를 가지고 있어 라이벌을 제압하고 모든 트랙을 스타일리시하게 정복하는 당신의 비밀 무기가 될 것입니다. 매일 시도하는 시간 트라이얼과 토너먼트에 참여하여 다른 플레이어들에게 자신의 실력을 증명하세요.


루키에서 마블 챔피언까지 순위를 올라가세요. 각 부문은 새로운 도전과 치열한 경쟁을 제공하여 정밀 레이싱과 플랫폼링의 기술을 마스터하도록 격려합니다.


각자 독특한 외관과 통계를 가진 다양한 종류의 구슬로 가득 찬 가방을 채우세요. 날렵한 고속 레이서부터 강인한 장애물 정복 거대한 구슬까지, 당신의 레이싱 스타일과 전략에 맞는 구슬을 선택하세요.


토너먼트와 매일 진행되는 타임 트라이얼 챌린지에서 속도와 민첩성을 증명하세요. 특별히 디자인된 트랙에서 전 세계 플레이어들과 매일 최고 시간을 기록하고 글로벌 리더보드에서 자리를 차지할 수 있을까요?

title: Neon Net
description:
게임 정보
The gameplay follows the rules of the "Minesweeper" game, but does not stop the game when a player opens a "mine", it only imposes a time penalty. Since the goal is to complete a task within a certain time (usually finding "keys"), and not just to open all the cells, it makes the game more dynamic, forcing the player to take risks, and challenges the players' quick decision-making skills.

RPG elements create progression and allow you to customize the game to your style - the player can improve both the effectiveness of certain skills and reduce the penalties for using them.

One of the mechanics is also the search for "targets" and the correct use of their finances - to find higher-ranking criminal AIs, the player needs to improve their systems at the right time and choose the most "profitable" targets.

The game also has a storyline, during which the player will choose certain answers that will affect the outcome of the story.

title: THRASHER
description:
게임 정보
From the artist & composer behind the cult hit THUMPER comes THRASHER, a mind-melting arcade odyssey and audiovisual experience. Guide a magnificent space eel, elegantly swooping and thrashing it through mesmerizing alien worlds. Race to evolve the space eel from a tiny worm into a mega beast, taking on wild bosses through 9 psychedelic realms. Dive into the game's deep combo system to perfect your runs and compete on the leaderboards, or simply vibe out inside the breathtaking but unsettling landscapes.  Experience the award-winning game on PCVR and 2D screens (including Steam Deck) soon!
TRANSCEND SPACETIME
Immerse yourself in a dazzling odyssey where music, visuals, and gameplay mesh into one transcendent experience. Journey from the depths of primordial gloom to the heights of celestial bliss, culminating in a heart pounding reckoning with a cosmic baby god.
YOU V THE UNIVERSE
Swoop, dash and thrash at breakneck speed, busting through obstacles and stacking up combos, leading to nine jaw dropping encounters with mysterious leviathans that will challenge your skills, and your sanity.
SOUND AND FURY
Lose yourself in the enthralling soundtrack created by designer Brian Gibson, bassist for the band Lightning Bolt. THRASHER is a spatial audio and haptics showcase, creating a stunning sensory experience.
CHILL OR CHALLENGE
Vibe out and enjoy the wild journey, or push yourself to the limit by chaining together massive combos to worm your way up the rankings.

title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
description:
게임 정보
Game introduction
This is an RPG strategy adventure game that incorporates tabletop game elements and uses card construction as the main gameplay.
Main plot
A game called Greed Island is holding a trial session. 100 players from all over the world participated in this event and played on the latest virtual reality equipment. Not long after the trial started, the players They found that they could not leave the game, and there was a huge ancient tree where they were. Through talking to the NPC, they learned that most of the people who came here came here to reach the top of the soul tree, because it can realize your dreams. Any wish. Faced with the situation of being unable to return to reality, the players started their adventure with complicated emotions.
Gameplay
You will play Lin Yue, a player who is late for the trial meeting, and adventure in the fantasy world of swords and magic. You will get to know many players from the same world as you, as well as NPCs in the game, who may become you. A powerful partner on the way forward, or an enemy that can hinder or even destroy you.
During the adventure, you will be able to collect a variety of cards, equipment and props, and make full use of them to challenge various powerful enemies and learn the truth about this world.
Character introduction
Lin Yue. An editor from an ordinary magazine company attended a game trial session due to work reasons, but was late.
Zhou Mo. He used to be the best among players, but for some reason he gave up his adventure in the Soul Tree and lived in the Novice Village.

title: Overthrone
description:
게임 정보
HEXAFLIP is a gripping strategy game that blends the classic sensibilities of tabletop strategy with the vibrant energy of a digital board game. Whether your prefer to outsmart other players in PvP skirmishes, or you like to obsess over optimal strategies in the campaign mode, this is a game for you!
Key Mechanics
Charge and Capacity. Each hexagon has a capacity (think of it as it's health), and charge. The charge represents the damage potential of a hexagon, or the number of nearby enemy hexagons it can zap.
Recharging. Using up charge makes the hexagons potentially less effective in future turns. But every time you use up all the charge on a hexagon, it triggers a recharge of all your hexagons. Plan your attacks wisely and create a satisfying recharge loop.
Special Abilities. Multiple special abilities are available (and more will be added). These abilities can spice up the dynamics in the game and take your plays to the next level! Special abilities require unstable charge to operate.
Unstable Charge. Unstable charge will gather on enemy hexagons. You need to zap the hexagons containing it to pick it up. At the end of each turn, the unstable charges migrate on the board challenging you to adapt on the spot.
Game Modes
Campaign: Single-player mode where you try to clear the map in as few turns as possible.
PVP: Play against other players on symmetrical maps. Choose your special abilities wisely and rank up on the ladder.
Daily Challenge: A single-player mode where a new unique map is released every day and all players compete to solve it as quick and as efficient as possible.
Abilities
ZAP
This is the normal attack. Activate a hexagon you control to zap nearby enemy and neutral hexagons.



This is a single-use ability. It upgrades any hexagon on the map to 6 capacity and 6 charge.



This is a single-use ability. It demotes any hexagon on the map to 1 capacity and 1 charge.



Permanently flip the owner of any hexagon on the map. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Place a retaliation rod on any hexagon. When that hexagon is attacked it will attack back. Up to 6 retaliation rods may be placed on a single hexagon. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Performs a more powerful, frenzied, attack from any hexagon you own. For each charge two attacks will be performed. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.



Infiltrate an enemy hexagon and perform an attack from it as if it were yours. This is a special ability and requires unstable charge to be used.

title: Long Trip
description:
게임 정보
게임의 이야기는 장거리 종교 전쟁 중에서 시작됩니다. 플레이어는 초보 기사로서 고대의 신이 탐구를 위해 자신을 부르게 되었습니다.
여행가로서 각 지역을 탐색하고, 오래된 민족의 추적을 찾아내고, 듯한 문제를 해결하려고 합니다. 길을 나아갈수록 위험한 생물들과 만날 것입니다. 그리고 미션을 완성할 때까지 주민들과 팀업합니다. 당신은 자신의 모험 파티에 다양한 동료를 영입할 수 있으며, 그들은 전투에서 유용한 도움을 제공하고 장애물을 무너트리는데 도움이 됩니다.
그러나 승리를 위해 강력한 상인들과 전투에 직면하라. 당신의 여정을 도와주기 위해 능력을 강화하기 위해 소중한 재료를 모아 음식, 요약 및 무기를 제조하십시오. 최고급 무기를 제작하고 강력한 반대자와 힘든 전투에 참여할 수 있습니다.
Long Trip은 매우 인상적인 아트스타일과 광범위한 몰입형 세계를 포함하여 독특한 게임 경험을 제공합니다. 그것은 도전적이지만 공평한 게임 플레이를 통해 플레이어를 마법의 세계를 탐색하고 점령하도록 초청합니다. 이 환상적인 여행을 시작하겠다고 준비했다면?

title: RX10-40
description:
게임 정보
『RX10-40』(RX ten forty)은 3인칭 슈팅 게임입니다.

『RX10-40』의 특징
간단하고 선형적이며 정통적인 TPS입니다.
총으로 쏘고, 방패로 방어하고, 곤봉 스턴건으로 근거리 공격을 하고, 슈퍼 어택으로 마무리합니다.
사격 시 위아래를 조준하는 동작을 금지함으로써 점프와 웅크리고 있는 동작을 장려하여 더욱 역동적인 플레이가 가능합니다.
레벨업 같은 건 없으므로, 오로지 플레이어의 실력에 달렸습니다.











친구 및 가족과 함께 강렬한 로컬 대전 모드를 즐기세요. 좌우 화면이 분할된 단일 화면에서 진행되는 전투는 향수 어린 광란을 만들어냅니다.



적들이 끝없이 나타나는 서바이벌. 최고 기록을 달성하면 라이벌에게 스크린샷을 보여주세요.






게임 스트리밍과 영상 배포와 관련하여서는 수익 창출 여부와 관계없이 자유롭게 하셔도 됩니다.

title: Catting Over It
description:

Fluffy Jumping Adventure - Catting Over It: You must fight for your love, never giving up! A dangerous monster has kidnapped the love of your life! This challenging journey to the top will require great skill in calculating trajectories, self-control, and the ability to plan your actions. Just remember, falling is not scary, at the bottom awaits a soft blanket and your beloved basket.



Main features:
Prepare for complex trajectory calculations.

title: God For A Day
description:
게임 정보
당신의 결정이 이 2D 내러티브 기반 시뮬레이션 게임에서 도시의 운명을 형성합니다. 당신은 신의 아들로서 신성한 역할을 수행합니다.



당신의 신성한 미션: 호프우드 시의 주민들을 결정하고, 축복하고, 혹은 저주하세요.



인생을 바꿀 선택을 하기 전에 그들의 아이템과 비밀을 통해 이야기를 밝혀내세요.



당신의 선택은 심판의 날에 대한 당신의 계시에도 영향을 미칠 것입니다.



‘Papers, Please’, ‘Death and Taxes’, 또는 ‘Do Not Feed the Monkeys’와 같은 내러티브 기반 인디 게임을 즐겼다면, ‘God for a Day’에서 시각과 스토리텔링의 독특한 조화를 사랑할 것입니다. 이 게임은 당신이 신성한 선택을 통해 호프우드 시의 운명을 형성하도록 초대합니다. 시도해보고 다른 어떤 것과도 비교할 수 없는 스토리텔링 어드벤처에 나서세요!




















독립 개발자가 만든 ‘God for a Day’는 현재 활발히 개발 중입니다. 데모 버전을 경험한 사람들로부터의 피드백은 이 독특한 게임 어드벤처를 다듬고 풍부하게 만드는 데 중요한 역할을 합니다. 이 솔로 개발 여정에 참여하여 ‘God for a Day’를 정말 특별하게 만드는 데 기여하세요!

Discord에서 당신의 생각과 피드백을 항상 환영합니다. 우리 커뮤니티에 참여하고 ‘God for a Day’의 독특한 내러티브 경험을 형성하는 데 함께하세요.

title: Renxia
description:
게임 정보
Ren Xia is an instant action role-playing game in which you play the role of a young warrior of unknown origin who travels around the ancient land of China, seeking martial arts masters to fight with each other, and gradually unravel the mystery of his own origin.

This is a very difficult game, you need to make the right moves at the right time to defuse the enemy's various offensives, and constantly counterattack. Dance on the edge of a knife.

At the same time, you will accumulate energy with the action. Rational use of these energies to strengthen their own actions, change the situation of the war. In the case of enough energy, it can play a continuous offensive and defeat a strong enemy.
Game background

It all started with the fall of Loulan.

A small pearl country in a desolate desert, destroyed in a single night.

Countless masters were killed, and the pattern of martial arts was rewritten.

Twenty years later, the chaos has just subsided,

And the children born in those turbulent years have grown into men.

Now, he will go to find the seven lost Swords and uncover the truth of the story.
Game Features

Martial arts story experience with Chinese characteristics!

Exciting and difficult action battles!

A variety of weapons attack and defense collision!

title: Antidote city hall
description:
게임 정보
토마스라는 이름의 형사와 혼돈과 절망의 세계에 빠져. 이 도시는 그의 집이지만 지금은 지뢰밭처럼 보입니다. 마약,부패,살인-이 모든 것이 일반화되었습니다.

토마스는 도시의 수호자였지만,고위급 사건으로 경찰에서 해고당했습니다. 이제 그는 자신의 탐정 기관을 설립하고 자신의 전 영광을 회복하기 위해 노력하고있다. 그러나 시간이 지나고 여전히 고객이 없습니다. 잊혀지고 우울한 토마스는 술 한 병에서 위안을 찾습니다.

하지만 토마스는 좋은 이름을 되찾을 기회가 있습니다. 그는 마약 카르텔과 정치인과 관련된 신비한 살인 연쇄를 해결해야 할 것입니다. 그는 도시가 오랫동안 기다리고있는 영웅이 될 수있을 것인가?

게임의 특징:

-예기치 않은 왜곡이있는 흥미 진진한 이야기.
-많은 이웃과 위치가있는 거대한 도시.
-관심과 논리적 사고가 필요한 복잡한 조사 시스템.
-자신의 비밀과 동기를 가지고 각각의 다른 캐릭터와 상호 작용할 수있는 능력.
-전체 통로를 통해 당신을 동반 할 도시에서 지배적 인 두려움과 절망의 분위기.

title: Music Sim Empire
description:
게임 정보
What would the world be without music?

In the year 2150, music is a relic of the past. People have forgotten it. Now it's your task to rediscover it - all the fascinating epochs from the 20th-century jazz to hip-hop. You decide which genre is particularly important to you - which of the individualized musicians you want to hire. Each musician and each genre brings its own exciting characteristics and is worth exploring and experiencing. Take care of your musicians and their needs, let them produce albums, mixtapes, singles, or even a summer hit. Grow into a thriving music empire that dominates the market and the charts. Focus on a single genre or let all genres flourish by creating a precisely planned facility where all processes are strictly timed. Upgrade your musicians, studios, cafeterias, distributions, etc., to suit your needs and watch as simple rooms turn into high-tech laboratories and futuristic studio technology noticeably increases efficiency. Unlock legendary musicians who actually existed. It's worth stopping by regularly even for a short visit. There is always something to upgrade, and special events can occur at any time. These could be XP boosts for a day, discounts, or situations you have to deal with. Do you sell one of your beloved musician because an agent offers you a considerable sum? Do you want to send your most popular musician on a tour? And how do you deal with it when your rappers argue again? Become part of a fascinating world where music gets a second chance and rewrite its history!

title: Typing Tales
description:
게임 정보
Typing Tales는 순수한 타이핑 게임입니다. 마우스를 한 번도 만지지 않고 플레이할 수 있습니다. 여러분의 기술을 시험하거나 새로운 언어를 연습하고 즐겨보세요!
🤯 키보드만으로 싸우고, 탐색하고, 능력을 사용하세요 🤯
😱 플레이를 통해 더 많은 콘텐츠를 잠금 해제하세요 😱

title: Capyverse Odyssey
description:
게임 정보
Experience a fast-paced Roguelike as an enlightened capybara, where every decision shapes your journey. Discover new worlds, gain allies, and master unique abilities to save the capybara universe from looming threats. Face evolving challenges for a fresh, exhilarating playthrough as you explore, strategize, and unlock secrets in the multiverse.
You’ll step into the paws of Capy, the sharp-witted leader of a futuristic capybara civilization.
Unleash powerful allies to aid you on your journey, each with unique abilities to help you conquer the challenges of the multiverse.
Play as Moody, the baby hippo, unlocking new abilities and attacks to conquer the multiverse!

title: My Space Bar
description:
게임 정보
Build Your Space Station Bar
My Space Bar is a restaurant and attractions simulator where you build and manage a space station bar!



Expand your station. Build a dining area with tables, lights, and décor. Build a kitchen and hire staff. Make your space bar even more special by adding dance clubs, arcades, and more. The happier your customers are, the more space bucks they will spend!
Build Your Station

Customize your space station using different kinds of floors and walls. Will you go with a space age look, or perhaps something more cozy? It’s up to you! How you build your station matters. Tables near windows and good lighting are more appealing than those near a noisy generator. The better ambiance you provide the more money you will make!

Build solar panels and generators to provide power for all of the cool things in your station. Dance clubs and arcades require quite a bit of power. You’ll need to decide the best places to put the generators to avoid disturbing your patrons.

Customers will want a comfortable and well-lit place to eat. Make sure your tables are near light sources, fans to circulate fresh air, décor to beautify the area, and more.

Hire and level up staff to run the kitchen, serve the food, play music, and maintain your equipment. Each staff member has different strengths and weaknesses. A good waiter can increase the chance that a party will order dessert and a good mechanic will ensure that all of your arcade machines are in working order. And of course, doing that well means more money!

Start with a simple menu and then expand into more choices including dessert and specialty drinks. The more options you have, the more satisfied your customers will be.

Unlock and build a dance club and an arcade! The more atmosphere you add to the dance club and the more arcade machines you provide the more your customers will spend time there and of course, spend money too. Additional specialty areas will be added during development as well!

title: Vivere Memento
description:
게임 정보


1919, Ukraine. It's the last moments of independence, and fear of the future and despair in the air are mixed with the will to live. A self-proclaimed detective comes to the club, asking about the girl from the photo whom no one remembers. A singer who dreams of writing her own songs finds strange poems of unknown authorship. Together, they try to unravel a tangle of riddles and mysterious disappearances but stumble upon something that the human mind is unable to fathom.



- Join the investigation of the two main characters, which will last 7 in-game days
- Explore the streets of the Ukrainian city of 1919 and see the life of people behind the military front line
- Enjoy the atmosphere of noir, black-and-white silent movies, original songs, and chthonic horrors
- Live through a relationship that blossomed in the face of despair

Description, including general details and list of localizations, can be added to and changed during the development of the game.

title: Unbox Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Unbox Tactics는 전략과 깜짝 요소가 결합된 로그라이크 턴제 전술 게임입니다. 시작 영웅을 선택하고 육각형 전장에서 전투를 펼치며, 미스터리 박스를 열어 개성 넘치는 전사들로 최강의 팀을 구성하세요.
게임은 한 명의 영웅으로 시작됩니다. 적을 처치하고 골드를 획득해 상점에서 미스터리 박스를 열고 새로운 동료를 영입할 수 있습니다. 하지만 팀은 최대 세 명까지 구성할 수 있으므로, 새 영웅을 얻을 때마다 누군가를 포기해야 합니다.
각 스테이지에 들어가기 전, 무작위로 제시되는 타일 팩 중 하나를 선택하게 됩니다 — 예: 숲, 사막, 사이버 시티 등 테마별 생태계가 있으며, 각각 고유한 적, 함정, 보상이 존재합니다. 선택한 팩에 따라 전장의 난이도와 전략이 달라집니다.
결정적인 판단을 내리고, 캐릭터의 능력을 최대한 활용하며, 아이템을 조합해 강력한 시너지를 만들어 보세요. 실패하더라도 영구적인 업그레이드를 통해 매번 점점 더 강해집니다.
예측 불가능한 전투를 열어보세요. 팀을 구성하고, 전략으로 승리하세요!

title: Room 404
description:
게임 정보
존경하는 주민 여러분:
최근에 많은 주민분들께서 요즘 한밤중에 4층에서 이상한 소리가 자주 난다고 말씀하셨습니다.
조사를 하였고 당분간 4층에 엘레베이터를 멈추지 않게 설정하였습니다. 불편을 드리게 된 점 양해 부탁드립니다.
실수로 4층에 가시게 되었다면, 나가지 못해도 절대로 당황하지 마시고 4층 복도를 유!심!히! 살펴보시기를 바랍니다.
이상이 없다면 왔던 길로 되돌아가시면 되고, 이상이 있다면 그대로 직진하십시오.
새로 모신 수호신께서 이미 계단에 도착하셔서 귀신을 물러내고 평화를 지키고 계십니다.
전문적인 도사님도 이번달에 오실예정이오니 모두들 안심하시기를 바랍니다.
모두 무사하기를 바랍니다.
게임 특징:
초현실적인 렌더링
가상엔진 5와 대량으로 스캔된 컨텐츠 라이브러리를 사용하는 이 게임은 몰입도가 높고 초현실적인 중국 레트로 호러 환경을 제공합니다.
단편적인 스토리 텔링
이상한 상황들 사이의 연관성을 발견하고 4층 주민들의 이야기를 둘러싼 미스터리를 알아냅니다.
단순한 "틀린 그림 찾기"가 아님

title: Valourglade
description:
게임 정보
After a devastating raid by monsters, a once-thriving village lies in ruins. It's up to you to rebuild the village from the ground up. Explore the world to gather resources, face formidable bosses, and gather blueprints to craft new tools and construct buildings. As you help villagers with quests and restore their home, you'll earn their trust—and uncover the mysteries of the land.
Rebuild the Village: Gather materials from caves and forests to craft tools and rebuild homes, shops, and key structures.
Fight Epic Bosses: Battle fierce monsters guarding powerful loot like blueprints and upgrades that will transform your village.
Help the Villagers: Take on side quests to earn rewards and strengthen your bond with the townsfolk, unlocking new features and abilities.
Craft and Upgrade: Build everything from basic tools to advanced structures, expanding your village’s potential with each new blueprint you discover.
Can you bring peace and prosperity back to the village and defend it from the dangers that lurk beyond?

title: Daimyo Reign
description:
게임 정보
Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!
Build
-Building improvements allow you to increase your wealth, recruit new units, defend your territory, and reduce unrest.

title: Abrasion
description:
게임 정보
You've been captured and enslaved by mysterious figures and tasked with retrieving a valuable resource from the depths of an ancient facility, but it may not be as abandoned as it looks... Will you accept your fate, or find a way to escape enslavement?
Abrasion is a first-person horror game set inside a brutal, skyless, megastructure. It's a difficult game that won't hold your hand, and takes around 90 minutes to complete. The world is filled with useful items, environmental storytelling, and many secrets, so exploration is heavily encouraged.
Features
A dynamic, stalking AI monster.
An interconnected world full of hidden passages and secret areas.
Diverse items and tools to help you progress.
Deep worldbuilding enhanced by intricately designed visuals and audio.
An unsettling story told through the game's environments.

title: Idles of Madness
description:
게임 정보
Idles of Madness is a Lovecraftian incremental/clicker that allows you to play how you want to! Want a more active playstyle? Choose upgrades that mean there’s never a dull moment! Want to sit back and relax? Choose automation upgrades that do the work for you! The choice of how to build your monstrous army is yours - but, one thing’s for sure: Cthulhu is watching…
FEATURES:

Dozens of eldritch monsters to choose from, each with their own abilities and uses.
Eldritch Laboratory & Research Tree systems, allowing you to upgrade specific monsters and unlock game-changing upgrades respectively.
Choose your playstyle - whether that’s active clicking, or passive automation.
Summon hordes of cultists, monsters and victims to sacrifice to Cthulhu!
Transmute your central horror into 10+ different forms - and, ultimately, the Great Dreamer themself...
BUILD AN ARMY OF LOVECRAFTIAN MONSTERS!



Build up your defences between waves, depending on which types of enemies are coming, and which paths they’ll take. Place and upgrade your turrets, and use special modules to make them even more powerful! Be careful: enemies may be equipped with unique upgrades designed to do extra damage if they manage to get through your defence.



Upgrade specific monsters in the Eldritch Laboratory, or unlock game-changing upgrades in the Research Tree, allowing you to choose your own playstyle - whether you want to be constantly busy, or take a more automated, AFK approach.



Each milestone you hit (and there are 10 of them!) your horror will transmute into a new form! Filled with Lovecraftian references (Aptenodytes Albus anyone?), madness awaits for those brave - or foolish - enough to discover them all…

title: Hot Seat
description:
게임 정보
- ARE YOU READY FOR HOT SEAT? -

Welcome to Vulkan Computing Security Systems.

Here at Vulkan, we strive to build better condor systems, to allow the world a smoother trip through the virtual realm.
Its only the dark right?

title: Dice
description:
게임 정보

Welcome to a card-based roguelike where you, yes you, must save your village. What an honor, right? Roll the dice, play your cards, and laugh in the face of danger. Or at least try not to cry.


As soon as Koshchei opened his eyes, darkness began to spread throughout the forest. Trees whispered evil tales, rivers began to churn ominously, and cute little animals turned into evil monsters. Choose one of the five losers... I mean, heroes, living in your village, and venture into the forest where every bush hides danger, and every tree has an old story to tell. Get ready to battle the chicken-legged hut, get roasted by the firebird, and encounter other charming characters from Slavic folklore.


In this game, the dice decide your fate. A bad roll? Well, someone got up on the wrong side of the bed! But not all is lost, for your cards can change the course of battle. Play them wisely, and don’t forget a pinch of luck—you'll definitely need it. Dice, Destiny and Death is an adventure where every action can lead to either an epic victory or a colossal failure. The village is counting on you, hero. So go forth, save the world, and try not to become the next meal for some mythical beast! Good luck! We're all watching and laughing... I mean, believing in you.

title: Hero of the Hive
description:
게임 정보
Take flight in this casual adventure game as a bee on a mission to save your crumbling hive. With the Queen mysteriously missing, it's up to you to gather resources like pollen and nectar to rebuild your home, explore the vast Aurora Basin, and embark on quests across the land to help the animals of nature as you become the hero your hive needs!



With the Queen missing, the hive is struggling to survive. There are few bees left to forage for the hive. Fly out into the vibrant world to collect all the staples a bee needs: pollen, nectar, and propolis. You may even find a few rare flowers along the way!



Help get the bees back on their wings! The hive is in desperate need of repair and you know just what they need. Reopen shops to customize your bee with vibrant colors or fun hats, rebuild rooms to attract more bees back to the basin, and even fix up a dance floor to show off your moves!



Bees hold ecosystems together! Animals across the entire basin rely on your assistance. From helping a lost fawn find its way home to resolving disputes between wildlife, you can help restore the balance of nature and make new friends along the way!



Explore the vast and diverse Aurora Basin! From the snowy mountain peaks to the scorching heat of the desert, there are unique areas to visit with secrets to be found.

title: Bug Alliance
description:
게임 정보
Bug Alliance is a pixel style top-down action RPG, where you play as bug warriors, each with unique abilities and weapons. Choose your Bug, select a game mode and dive into battles against worm tyranny. Fight, upgrade, farm resources, evolve and become a legend. Alliance is calling you!
-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------
THE STORY
After the Earth faces the catastrophic meteor strike, everything changes once and for all. With the extinction of humanity, it leaves its place to a new mutated life. This "New World" is mainly ruled by two forms of living, Bugs, and Worms. Worms try to devour the nature to feed their greedy King - Glutton.
Bugs, on the other hand, under the command of their Queens, pledged to protect the nature and the whole living from hoggish worms at any cost. After losing the great battle, bugs and their queens are captured, tortured, and enslaved. Many years later, bugs create a secret alliance, called “Requiem Society”, with the mission to unite all of the brave and mighty Bug warriors across the continent and fight back for the Volucris and the Queens!
-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------*******-------------

title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
description:
게임 정보
About This Game

"Fatal Dopamine" is a strategy-filled and challenging roguelike card game that also tests your luck. In this game, you will play as an anonymous gambler who arrives at a peculiar casino. Using a variety of unique cards, you'll employ strategy and luck in a blackjack-based game to achieve victory and become a "big shot" on the leaderboard. The gambling here isn't just about playing blackjack; it integrates multiple complex rules and strategies. Each game is a psychological battle where you need to gauge your opponent's thoughts and predict their next move. Simultaneously, you must manage your chips and cards to ensure you can surprise your opponents at critical moments. Through continuous gambling, you can gather clues to uncover the well-hidden truths of this place. Is there a conspiracy behind the games? Deception among gamblers? Evil dealings by merchants? What is the truth behind the dopamine? More stories await your discovery.

Story Background

In this world, there exists a place where only those driven by extreme desires can enter. Here, they come with their lucky cards, wagering their blood as the stakes to raise the ante for their enemies. Those who come here are all in pursuit of becoming the prominent figures on the leaderboard, which promises them the long-coveted "dopamine" they've heard so much about.

However, behind the facade of playful revelry, a darker undercurrent flows. This secretive place attracts a variety of individuals: powerful counts, scholars in search of truth, and swordsmen who will stop at nothing to gain power. Each gathers here for their own reasons, creating an atmosphere thick with tension and excitement. In the brightly lit hall, every table is adorned with exquisite gambling tools. The gamblers' eyes are like those of hungry wolves, fixated on every card and chip on the table.


-Lucky Cards: Customize your own cards that will soon meet you in the game, providing crucial assistance at critical moments.
-Deck Building: Defeat merchant bosses to unlock powerful effect cards and build your unique deck to form a distinct combat style.
-Free Choice of Challenge Order: Challenge the big names on the leaderboard in any order you prefer, which will influence the sequence of merchant card -unlocks and your deck building strategy.



-Randomly Generated Levels: Each adventure is a new experience. Randomly generated enemies, events, and rewards ensure every game is full of surprises.
-Random Events: Encounter random events that will give you extra number and effect cards. Keep an eye out for them when they appear.
-Strategic Combat: Plan every move carefully, using card combinations and tactical strategies to defeat powerful enemies and bosses.
-Permadeath: Death is final. Every failure means starting over, but you can learn and grow stronger from each experience.
-Story Unlocks: Continuously collecting cards will unlock new character stories, giving you a deeper understanding of the diverse characters in the casino.


Diverse Card Collection: Over 100 unique cards providing countless combinations and strategies.
Deep Strategy: Every decision is crucial. Choose the best cards and strategies for the current situation to progress further.
Unique Visual Style: Beautiful hand-drawn art brings you into a fantastical world that is both beautiful and dangerous.
Engaging Music: Completely original soundtrack that creates a tense and exciting adventure atmosphere.

title: Eversiege
description:
게임 정보
Eversiege is a game where you have to find balance between your production and building defense to survive waves of enemies. Each siege defended provides experience that can be later spend on unlocking new buildings, leaders and upgrades.
PRODUCTION
Establish good economy by placing production buildings that'll give you various resources needed for further constructions.
DEFENSE
Build defenses to protect your city from enemies!

title: Battle Beat Arena
description:
게임 정보
Step into the epic and chaotic realm of Jarenara in: Battle Beat Arena, a turn-based strategy RPG with a rhythm twist! Test your humor, strategic thinking, and sense of rhythm. In a world where every decision and beat can mean the difference between victory and defeat—or just a good laugh.

title: Roodies Factory - Chapter 1
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Roodies Factory!

This is the first game in the "Roodies Factory" saga.

Roodies Factory is a first-person horror mascot exploration game. In the game you are the ex-founder of "Roodies Factory" who returns to the factory years after it was abandoned in search of his missing brother...

Explore the abandoned factory, solve puzzles and find out what really happened 3 years ago when the factory was abandoned.

Roodie

Roodie is a tall animatronic clown who can think for himself. He is the main animatronic of Roodies Factory, he is also the most loved animatronic by children.

Characteristics

-Photorealistic Enviroment
-Horror Atmosphere
-Receive calls from NPCs
-Solve puzzles
-Explore the abandoned factory

title: CUBEN
description:
게임 정보
―Features―

Unique Puzzle Experience: Dive into an addictive and refreshing cube puzzle game!
Inventory Management: Strategically place items and build your unique setup!
Roguelite Elements: Experience new strategies and encounters with each run!



The game features a 4×4×4 grid of mini-cubes. Swipe in any of the six directions, and all mini-cubes move accordingly. When three or more same-colored cubes align in the direction of movement, they merge and burst, triggering an attack! Combine multiple bursts at once for even greater damage.



Sometimes, small companions called 'Sii' are born from the mini-cubes. These loyal allies automatically attack enemies but have short lifespans. Use items to extend their lifespans and maximize their effectiveness.


Strategically place items and 'Sii' to advance with your unique strategies.



On your journey, you may encounter the mysterious 'Pathway' Here, you will meet various characters. What is their connection to the 'CUBEN'...?

Get ready for an engaging puzzle adventure that combines strategy, excitement, and a bit of mystery!

title: Phoebe Eridani
description:

Welcome to Mini Worlds, a cozy, relaxing sandbox for you to create whatever you want.
Generate beautiful and unique landscapes to play on.
Build charming, tiny cities for your townsfolk.
Decorate for more detail to add that homey feel.

Choose the world of your dreams
Start creating beautiful cities
Kick back and relax

title: Creature Park
description:
게임 정보
크리쳐 파크에 오신걸 환영합니다!
지루한 일상 생활에 지친 여러분, 현실과 동 떨어진 크리쳐들이 넘쳐나는 크리쳐 파크에 어서오십시오! 크리쳐 파크와 함께 일하게 된 여러분들은 동물원의 밝은 곳이 아닌, 어두운 곳에서 일하게 되실 겁니다. 하지만 걱정마세요! 여러분들을 위한 적절한 메뉴얼과 돈만 있으면 큰 도움을 주는 첨단 기술들이 있으니까요! 그래도 문제가 생긴다면... 다음 사람이 올 테니 저희는 괜찮습니다!
크리쳐를 잡아오세요!

여러분은 위험 지역에 파견을 나가, 크리쳐를 직접 잡아와야 합니다. 크리쳐들은 각기 다른 특징을 가지고 있습니다. 이들을 잘 관찰하여 빈틈을 노리세요!
동물원을 관리하세요!

여러분이 잡아온 크리쳐들은 동물원에서 살게 됩니다. 크리쳐들이 동물원에서 날뛰는 모습을 보기 싫다면, 그들이 원하는 것을 들어주세요. 여러분들의 작은 선택이 동물원 운영에서 어떤 결과를 가져올지는... 직접 확인하세요!
다양한 위협

위험 지역에는 다양한 종류의 크리쳐들이 존재합니다. 여러분은 포식자가 아닌 피식자라는 것을 잊지 마십시오.
협력 플레이

당사는 여러분이 팀을 꾸려 함께 행동하기를 장려합니다! 혼자서는 힘들 수도 있지만, 여럿이라면 가능한 일도 많으니까요!

title: Tickety Boom
description:
게임 정보


In Tickety Boom, you play as Max, a veteran bomb disposal expert whose world is turned upside down by a ghost from his past. And they’re raining terror on his city. Working with his colleague and best friend, Vic, Max must solve puzzles to defuse bombs before time runs out and the city is turned into piles of rubble.



Tickety Boom features a top-down 2D pixel art adventure interlaced with time-limited puzzles. Control Max in a cat-and-mouse game as you discover clues behind each puzzle and the reasons why Max is caught in this deadly game.



Explore the crime scenes to uncover power-ups that help Max stay focussed on the job, or pick up distractions that make him lose concentration.



The key to defusing each explosive is hidden behind a puzzle. Solve it before time runs out!



But why is the mastermind behind these bombs targeting Max? What does it all mean? Play Tickety Boom to find out.

title: Access: EnTree
description:
게임 정보
Access: EnTree is the first-ever game to promote awareness of accessibility and disabilities. The player collaborates with their community to create an accommodating village and recruit new characters into their community. Players learn about accessibility issues through a relaxing social sim environment.

Embark on quests as you explore the world of Axis and make the land of EnTree more accessible!

Farm resources and utilize them for builds, crafts, recipes and more!

Craft and furnish the town to your hearts content!

title: Maximus Mouse's Manic Mayhem
description:
게임 정보
Maximus Mouse is back!
Experience manic arcade action set across loads of game modes. Classic arcade gameplay with many twists and surprises awaits you!
Story
Those pesky cats have stolen Max's retirement fund! Pursue them around the world to get it back, but watch out for surprises along the way!
Party!
Grab three of your friends for some couch mayhem! Stay alive, grab those coins and capture those cheeses! Use power ups to your advantage, but beware - anything can happen: laser attacks, high winds, and lemon hitmen are just a few of the events you'll face.

Oh, and do keep an eye out for that walrus!
Trials
Pit your wits against the cats across 50+ trials. Quick, bite-sized challenges to test any mouse!
Arcade
Try your hand at the arcade modes and beat those scores!

title: The Banker Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
The Banker Tycoon은 꿈의 은행을 구축하고 관리하는 매력적인 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 먼저 서비스의 전략적 가격을 설정하고, 최고의 직원을 채용하여 최상의 운영을 보장하십시오. 은행을 맞춤 설정하고 확장하여 비전에 맞게 기능과 역량을 향상시키세요. 은행이 성장함에 따라 명성이 높아지고, 더 부유한 고객을 끌어들여 금융 세계의 리더로 자리매김할 것입니다. 도전에 대응하고, 혁신하며, 은행 산업의 정상에 올라 궁극의 은행 거물이 되십시오!
은행의 세부 사항을 만들고 맞춤화하며, 서비스를 확장하고 장식하십시오.
더 많은 카운터/책상 추가
좌석 구역 확장
장식과 분위기 향상
직원의 요구사항 충족
더 나은 고객 서비스를 위해 시설 업그레이드

title: Esper Agent
description:
게임 정보
Esper Agent is a game about esper secret agents, where a group of girls from an agency receive a mission to infiltrate the cities of a large corporation and stop their evil plans.
Players can choose one of several unique agent girls to take part in the mission. During the game, you'll need to dodge waves of enemy bullets while attacking and using special abilities to defeat enemies and reach the goal.
Shooting Mechanics
Players can choose a weapon for combat. As you progress, you'll collect various parts to modify your weapon, increasing its damage or enhancing its effects. Each weapon has different bullet capacity limits and reload times, so you’ll need to manage reload windows carefully to maximize your damage output.
Mastering Your Abilities
To advance and thwart the corporation's conspiracy, players must grow stronger step by step by leveraging their agent’s abilities and weapons. This includes using genetic chips to enhance your powers, weapon parts to improve your arsenal, and skill rings to adapt to different situations.
Infiltration Missions
The route you choose for each infiltration will affect the journey ahead. By selecting the most relevant paths and exploring for rewards, you’ll increase your chances of successfully reaching the final destination.

title: Skateballers
description:
게임 정보
스케이트볼러는 선수들을 포스트 아포칼립스적 극단적인 롤러 축구에 몰입시킵니다. 이 게임은 싱글 플레이어 모드에서 스토리 캠페인을 완료 할 수있는 동반자와의 관계를 발전시킬 수있는 스포츠 시뮬레이터입니다.
빠른 공격을하고 승리 골을.

포스트 종말의 세계에서,경쟁자와 하나의 전투 싸움,모든 수단은 승리를 위해 좋다

경기장에서 함정을 피하십시오

새로운 장비를 획득하고,필요한 매개 변수와 경기장의 조건에 따라 장비를 적용하고 결합하십시오.

팀에 새로운 선수를 수집,자신의 능력에 따라 경기에 갈 누구와 파트너를 선택합니다

역사를 통해 이동합니다. 토너먼트의 진정한 목적이 무엇인지 알아보십시오.


토너먼트에서 우승 당신의 삶,이웃을 저장하고 도시가 정상적인 생활에 무정부 상태로 급락 반환 할 경우 결정하기 위해 도시의 주위에 여행. 게임의 결말은 대회 기간 동안 당신의 선택에 따라 달라집니다:당신은 당신이 재생 누구와 함께 경기에 갈 사람.

title: Department of Gravity Management
description:
게임 정보
Control gravity, control the station. In this 3D Puzzle Platformer, you get to change gravity to solve physics-based puzzles. Meet your quotas, gain new abilities, and free the station from the oversight of the Newton Corporation.
Change Gravity: Activate gravity panels, cylinders, and spheres to change the gravity around you in different ways.  Use these to move Newtonium to reactors throughout the level.  Once you meet your quota, you can move on to the next level.
Walk on Walls: You can use the gravity panels to push and pull yourself in different directions.  Walk on the walls and ceilings.  Fly through the air.  Navigate the levels in creative ways.  Just be careful not to fly into the Newtonium reactors.
Fun with Physics: Send objects into orbit with fully simulated physical forces.  Anything not nailed down is affected by gravity changes, so have fun experimenting with how the different gravity panels affect objects in the game.  And of course, since you control the gravity, you can pick up and throw anything, no matter how big.
New Abilities: Gain new gravity-based abilities as you progress, creating new ways to navigate the world and solve puzzles.  You can create your own gravity panels, use the gravity hook to pull yourself through the air, and even slow time to consider your next move.  You'll need these abilities to navigate the levels and free the station from the oversight of the Newton Corportation.

title: Midnight Swamp
Pirate Survivors
description:
게임 정보
Pirate Survivors is a Roguelite Bullet heaven that focuses on movement and infinite upgrades.
Navigate treacherous seas swarming with relentless monsters, arm yourself with powerful items and defeat enough Sea Legends to rid of the monsters for good!
But beware - each time you grow stronger, so do your enemies! Make your choices wisely or risk being overwhelmed by the evolving monstrosities that lurk in the depths.
Unlock Powerful Upgrades & New Ships:
With each run, plunder treasure to permanently enhance your ship. Complete daring challenges to unlock new items and ships for future runs. Max out your permanent upgrades and discover every possible combination to push your survivability to the limit!
Conquer the Sea Legends:
You decide when to face the deadly Sea Legends, but delay too long and you will not be able to hold off the hoard of monsters, Only those brave enough to take on all three Legends will unlock the final, ultimate challenge. Defeat them, and gain access to even more perilous depths where only the strongest can survive.
Credits:
Trailer music by Otto Halmén.

Play your formulas to reach objectives
