Build your deck

title: GHOST TRAVELER: Adventures in Edo
description:
게임 정보
◆ A Supernatural Tale of a Boy Transported to Edo-Period Japan
The protagonist (the player) is a 17-year-old boy named Kotaro who lives in modern-day Japan. One day, he is caught in a supernatural phenomenon in Shibuya and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a setting reminiscent of a Japanese historical drama. Eventually, Kotaro learns from a "god" that he has been transported back in time to the Edo period as a soul, and that he is now in Yoshiwara, the pleasure quarter in Edo, the capital of 19th-century Japan.
◆ A Grotesque Mystery Adventure Set in Yoshiwara
Without knowing why he has arrived in this era or how to return to the modern world, Kotaro begins to wander around Yoshiwara in search of clues to unravel the "mystery." Soon, he encounters the murder of an oiran (courtesan) and takes on the role of a "detective" to solve the case. However, he is drawn into a series of grotesque murders.
◆ A Time-Loop Narrative That Brings You Closer to the Truth
The mystery of the "oiran murder," a central part of the story, cannot be solved in a single playthrough. The scenario is interwoven with multiple settings and foreshadowing, functioning alongside a time-loop system where the protagonist, as a ghost, can go back in time and possess others to replay events. This culminates in a dramatic twist at the end.
◆ Historical Mode Explaining Edo-Period Yoshiwara
The game is set in late Edo-period Yoshiwara and includes a mode that explains the lifestyles, customs, and terminology of the era. This feature allows players to learn about Yoshiwara, even aspects that many Japanese people are unfamiliar with. Additionally, the game supports English and Simplified Chinese, enabling players from different language regions to explore and learn about Japan’s Edo period.

title: Paper Wars
description:
게임 정보
Paper Wars는 강력한 종이 비행기를 조종하는 싱글플레이어 비행 액션 게임입니다. 육지와 바다의 위협과 함께 빨간 종이비행기 군대와 맞서 싸우세요. 비행기를 잠금 해제하고 업그레이드하여 하늘을 지배하세요!
강력하게 무장한 종이 비행기
이 종이 비행기는 일반적인 종이 비행기가 아닙니다! 총, 미사일 등 다양한 무기를 장착하고 있습니다. 다양한 무기와 장비로 비행기를 커스터마이징하여 자신의 스타일에 맞게 전투에 임하세요. 업그레이드된 종이 비행기로 하늘, 땅, 바다의 적들을 상대하세요.

title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
description:
게임 정보
《의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하》에서는 유례없는 아이템 조합의 자유도를 경험할 수 있습니다! 데모 버전에서는 50종 이상의 독특한 기능을 가진 의체를 제공하며, 각각의 의체는 새로운 전투 전략과 즐거움을 선사합니다.
총알이 분열 후 폭발하도록 만들고 싶으신가요? 아니면 유도 탄환에 관통 효과를 더하고 싶으신가요? 이러한 자유로운 조합은 모든 전투를 색다르고 짜릿하게 만들어줍니다. 끊임없이 실험하고 조합하여 자신에게 딱 맞는 전투 방식을 찾아내고, 매번 도전에 1+1>2 이상의 즐거움을 느껴보세요!
autokwd: Exo Helljumper: Descent X,의체 궤도강하 타격대: 첫 번째 강하

title: Welcome Home
description:
게임 정보
Enter the shadows of one of the darkest, most enigmatic buildings you’ll ever explore. Inside these cursed walls, nothing is as it seems. Each step uncovers fragments of a story drenched in deceit, desperation, and survival. You will meet liars, killers, and victims of this harrowing environment—along with a few who may hold the keys to your salvation.
As a nameless protagonist, your journey is driven by the chilling need to uncover the secrets buried deep within "the house." Search for hidden paths, solve cryptic mysteries, and confront the horrors that await. But beware: Not all doors should be opened, and not all who dwell here wish you well.
Exploration Meets Terror: Delve into a grim, atmospheric world designed to unsettle you with haunting visuals and an eerie soundtrack.
Meaningful Choices: Your decisions matter. Engage with NPCs through branching dialogue, altering your path and the unfolding narrative.
Survival Over Shooting: Ammo is scarce, and danger is everywhere. Choose your battles wisely—sometimes, running is the only option.
Unlock the Unknown: Seek out vital items and NPCs to progress, piecing together the disturbing truth of your environment.
A Distinctive Retro Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in the original Game Boy resolution (160x144), brought to life with stunning, handcrafted pixel art that adds a nostalgic yet deeply unsettling charm to every scene.

title: Oakley the Leafbug
description:
게임 정보
Summary : 
Oakley the Leafbug is a fast-paced 2.5D platformer built in Godot.
Features :
2 Playable Characters (Oakley the Leafbug & Snowblitz the Arctic Fox)
Drift on Oakley's leaf to surf waves and kickflip your way into gaining more speed!
Snowblitz can swap between two control sets, roll mode and trick mode to chain combos.
2 Zone Types (Race & Score Attack)
Race : Get to the finish line as fast as possible to complete the zone.
Score Attack : Score enough points to pass all score gates to complete the zone.

title: THE HELMINTHS
description:
게임 정보
당신은 음식입니다.
목성의 한 위성 깊은 곳의 원주민인 헬민스(기생생물)로서, 당신과 당신의 형제자매, 후손들은 인간에게 많은 단백질을 제공합니다. 그리고 맞습니다, 당신은 맛있습니다. 하지만 탐욕스러운 인간의 위장에서 끝나길 원하시나요?
게임 플레이
The Helminths는 은하계에서 가장 맛있는 통조림 식품을 생산하는 거대한 광산 복합체를 배경으로 한 선형 플랫폼 게임입니다. 불행히도, 당신이 주재료입니다. 헬민스가 채굴되고, 가공되고, 통조림되는 이 산업 복합체의 비밀을 밝혀내세요. 정밀한 플랫폼 액션과 환경 퍼즐 해결을 마스터하여 치명적인 인간 시설을 통과해 탈출을 이루세요。

사냥꾼이 되어라, 사냥감이 아닌

title: Moonsigil Atlas
description:
게임 정보
에너지 시스템도, 액션 포인트도 없는 덱빌딩을 경험하세요 – 물리적 공간을 사용하여 카드를 플레이하세요. 공간과 카드가 맞물리기만 하면, 플레이할 카드의 숫자에 대해서는 제한이 없습니다!
플레이 가능한 세 개의 캐릭터와 수백 장의 카드를 선택할 수 있는 다양한 전략과 플레이 스타일을 가진 수많은 덱이 있습니다.

title: Eldritch Escape
description:
게임 정보
In this roguelike bullet-heaven, Earth has been consumed by an ancient eldritch god. Form a customizable squad of survivors and explore decaying, metroidvania-inspired worlds trapped within the god’s belly. Battle endless waves of nightmarish creatures, extract resources, rescue survivors, uncover forbidden knowledge, and search for a way out.
Portals powered by ancient eldritch forces link worlds and realities, forming a tangled web. With a limited oxygen supply, your squad has just 20 minutes to navigate the portal network, jumping from world to world in search of the one escape route. Can you escape the void in time?

title: Sizebound
description:
게임 정보
Sizebound
Sizebound is a first person puzzle game where you will use physics and perspective slightly differently.
In this game you will have to solve puzzles with objects that will vary in size and weight, by going through portals, by changings your perspective of the object, to solve different kinds of puzzle rooms.
You will be guided through your adventure by Clappy an AI agent part of a laboratory called "The Nexus" where all the tests will take place.
Key Features
In-game Level editor
Single player campaign
(Level count: not known at the moment)
 Coop campaign
In game modding tools
(Custom props/play models, and possibly more)
More about the game
This game is inspired by Portal and Superliminal and was at started for the GMTK 2024 with the theme "Built to scale".

title: The Victor Initiative
description:
게임 정보
Overview
The Victor Initiative is a first-person survival horror game in which you explore the halls of an abandoned government facility in order to discover its secrets while evading the strange entities lurking within. The game is divided into separate floors, which all present unique challenges. These floors make up larger 'chapters', which present widely different threats for you to outsmart. The demo includes the first chapter of the game.
Gameplay
In The Victor Initiative, you have no health bar, nothing telling you what to do and one main goal: surviving. From a first person perspective, make your way through the winding halls of The Initiative in a bid to survive to the next room. Each room will present a new threat, or a new puzzle that you need to solve in order to keep pushing through. With no tools, no knowledge, and just your environment & the occasional patchy audio log for clues, will you be able to survive?
The Mission
It's your job to explore an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago. What horrors will you discover within?

title: Snakes with Fists!
description:
게임 정보
The RPG with a Beat 'em Up Battle System
Snakes with Fists! combines the open-world exploration elements of an RPG—interesting NPCs, side quests, secrets, and a strong narrative—with the fun of fighting in the beat 'em up style! Open areas are explored in a top down 2d RPG world, Beat 'em UP stages are entered and cleared to unlock new areas and to complete quests. 
Also, you can fight anyone!
Yes, you can... but should you?
Instead of 'random encounters' you will enter into a Beat 'em Up style fight scene with anyone you punch in the RPG world.

title: The Hundredth Hike
description:
게임 정보
The Hundredth Hike
The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.
Rich Story
The Hundredth Hike is a story rich in lore, that is set in the middle of a devastating apocalypse. Napazarim has taken over the minds of 90% of the population causing hallucinations in the infected people in which became an international pandemic. You are one of the lucky few who survived and after losing your family, over the years you went on hikes all over the world to escape real life. This is YOUR Hundredth Hike how will it be different?
Losing your Mind
Along your Hundredth Hike you question your reality on this enormous hike along a mountain that has been restricted for over a decade. Sneaking into a quarantined country, you delve deep into your own mind and lose touch of reality. Will you bring yourself back from the fold?
Mechanics
Run, Hide and solve deep puzzles to escape your faith. With inventory management for your light sources and many interactive objects you will always feel on edge. With barely any HUD and following the protagonists story you will always be immersed in The Hundredth Hike. There are many mechanics of the game I don't want to give away as more and more mechanics are introduced over the course of the game.
Graphics
With the power of UE5, I have been able as a solo developer to get realistic and eye watering graphics with each chapter giving a different feel. From the amazing weather effects to the fully manually placed assets across all of the chapters, you will get an experience which is hard to forget.

title: Woke Quest
description:
게임 정보
Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.
Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality. Suddenly, a surge of energy engulfs them, transporting them from their computer screens into a realm unlike anything they’ve ever imagined.
Emerging from a cosmic rift, they find themselves in a vibrant world brimming with magic, mythical creatures, and breathtaking landscapes straight out of an RPG. It quickly becomes clear that they are far from home.
Unbeknownst to them, their arrival marks the beginning of an epic saga that will shape the destiny of this enchanted realm and challenge their very understanding of reality.

title: Bluebie VS The Army of Cyborgs
description:
게임 정보
Bluebie VS the Army of Cyborgs is a Cartoony 3D platformer that will take you to the fictive world of planet Rebaga. The planet look pretty much like earth and the culture there is pretty similar to ours. One day, Cybex, a self made Cyborg, decided to invade the planet and turn its inhabitants into his servants.
Of course, Bluebie, a farmer, is not willing to see his planet enslaved by the army of Cybex and decided to fight back and free the prisoners Cybex took.
In his quest, Bluebie will travel through mines,  mountains, desert and different other places where the cyborgs settled and launched their operation. He will fight the generals of Dr Cybex to free as much prisoners as he can while developing and purchasing new skills thanks to his colorful closet plenty of different outfits.
Fight Enemies
A stick, a spear, a boomerang, a slingshot, a crossbow and a pigeon launcher. Which weapon to use to fight your enemies. Every weapon will have its own range and damage level. One is sometimes enough, two or more could be a necessity.
autokwd: Bluebie VS The Army of Cyborgs

title: GRAVIT
description:
게임 정보
Control gravity in this first-person, 3D physics-based, puzzle-platformer to reach the end of each trial. The early trials are simpler with limited gravity control with later trials providing more challenge and freedom. You'll be sure to have your navigation and problem-solving skills put to the test. You can also take on a number of bonus levels such as races and survival.
GRAVIT includes a number of other gameplay features such as:
Freezing Objects

title: Echos
description:
게임 정보
Immerse yourself in an expansive and captivating world where exploration, survival, and strategy intertwine to create a unique gaming experience.
In this open-world survival adventure, you will embark on a journey through vast and diverse landscapes, each teeming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. From dense forests to barren deserts, icy tundras to mysterious caves, the environments are not only visually stunning but also brimming with hidden challenges.
Key Features:
Exploration and Discovery: Traverse various biomes, each with its own set of challenges and resources. Uncover hidden areas, ancient ruins, and mysterious artifacts that may change the course of your journey.
Crafting and Resource Management: Gather resources from the environment to craft essential tools, weapons, and survival gear. Whether you're building a shelter, crafting advanced weaponry, or preparing potions, careful resource management is crucial to your survival.
Dynamic Combat: Face off against a range of creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses. Engage in real-time, fast-paced combat where both skill and strategy are needed to survive.
Survival Mechanics: Keep an eye on your character's health, hunger, and stamina levels. Adapt to the environment by learning to craft necessary survival items such as clothing, fire starters, and food, while managing limited resources.
Story and Quests: Experience an engaging narrative filled with side quests and objectives. The world is rich with lore, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your environment and your place within it.

title: Deserter
description:
게임 정보
In a world of total control and endless wars, you are John Holden, an AWOL soldier trapped in a grim, war-torn town. Use every available trick to survive and escape this damned city: break into houses, steal food and medicine, hone your thieving skills, and influence the fate of its citizens.
You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

title: Spire
description:
게임 정보
In a far-future seascape cursed by the ancients, will you make mankind's last home a haven or a fortress?
Surge, Spire, and Sea is a 333,333-word interactive post-apocalyptic science fantasy novel by Nebula nominated game writer Stewart C Baker. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Back rebels or royals, or pursue your own rise to power. Speak for the spirits or fight for your own kind, or try to reconcile both by uncovering ancient injustices. Heal the creatures afflicted by a magical rot or defeat them in the name of defending the ones you love. Shape humanity's destiny with magic, alchemy, or high-tech masonry. 
But be warned: the gods, the spirits, and your king are watching your every move.
Master the art of spirit magic, the high-tech craft of masonry, or meld science and the supernatural with alchemical potions.
Play as male, female, or non-binary; cis- or trans-gender; gay, straight, bi, asexual, or poly.
Cast your lot with the king and his Spireguard or the anarchist rebels of the Surge.
Explore the Spires and Shallows, two distinct regions of Gigantea, humanity's last tower-home.
Seek out platonic, romantic, sexual, and polyromantic relationships with a diverse and memorable cast of NPCs.
Sail the rot-cursed Worldsea in search of life—or fortify your home with a powerful military fleet.
Experience a festival and night market with delicious food and entertaining mini-games, as well as gifts for your loved ones.
Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic setting where people of all body shapes, sizes, disabilities, skin tones, and identities are treated equally.
Strive to become the new ruler of your home or turn away from it all for a chance to explore the world.
Communicate in speech and sign language.
* Navigate a world propped up by centuries of truth, lies, and mythology.
* Climb ruined towers or seek refuge in a subterranean space of your own making.

title: Incrate
description:
게임 정보
Incrate is a mind-warping 2D/3D puzzle game contained within a crate! You've been mysteriously trapped in a bizarre box-shaped prison. Rotating the prison will twist your notions of perspective. Bend reality to your whim and manipulate your world and the things in it to solve the puzzles and escape!
You find yourself suddenly uplifted from your life and discover you're an inmate in a crate with no recollection of how or why you got there. The crate is an otherworldly prison contained within a boxed world. The local inhabitants that greet and guide you seem to be a despondent guard and mysterious ghost...

title: Yaku Slap
description:
게임 정보
🎴 Yaku Slap – Walk the Flower Path and Slap Down Monsters! 🌸
Ready to duel monsters, master ancient card combos, and get just a little addicted to slapping down the perfect hand? Yaku Slap blends the strategic flair of Hanafuda Koi Koi with rogue-like chaos where every match could be your last—or your ultimate victory.
Collect powerful spells, master rare Yaku combinations, and score big as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a true Yaku Master. Win, lose, and unlock classes, and passive abilities with every run!

🎴 Features:
🌿 Strategic Card Combat: Master the classic Koi Koi mechanics with a supernatural twist.
🌸 Rogue-like Progression: Every run earns you perks and passives to power up.
🃏 Monster Showdowns: Duel dangerous creatures that are as challenging as they are zany—slap hard or get slapped!

title: Absolution of the Dead
description:
게임 정보
NARRATIVE.
The Soviets knew they would lose the war. In a desperate attempt at victory, they unleashed a hell upon the battlefront that would consume Europe...
You wake up in a zombie infested hotel, the only way out is to descend into pure chaos. As you go from floor to floor slaughtering the undead, you'll go deeper into the trenches of your mind to uncover the truth of the outbreak.

title: Beacon of Hope
description:
게임 정보
CHILLS TO THE BONE!
A few months ago, a catastrophic explosion at the Beacon plunged the world into an endless winter. People continue to perish, and the only hope of restoring order lies in repairing the Beacon.
As Victor, an engineer on a mission to save humanity, you’ll journey through a frozen city, scavenging materials for the Beacon and encountering survivors – some bloodthirsty, some benign.
FEATURES:
Level-based Structure!
15 immersive levels split between two distinct locations: outdoor levels focused on parkour and indoor areas centered on fight.
Numerous Cutscenes and Dialogues!
Immerse yourself in Victor’s dramatic journey through powerful scenes and dialogues that reveal a rich story and universe filled with vibrant characters.
Jump and Maneuver!
Platformer controls at their best! Each area is packed with obstacles and deadly foes, keeping you on your toes.
Boss Battles!
Every boss victory, requiring refined combat skills, unlocks new abilities, making each step of your adventure even more thrilling.
ARE YOU READY?
Can you bring hope back to a world on the brink of collapse?

title: Unfoldink
description:
게임 정보
Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature.
UNFOLDINK OFFERS
-> Unique mind boggling puzzles
 -> Total of 10 diffrent cards and...
...over 350 animated combinations
-> Surprising and funny character interactions

title: Breathless Hope
description:
게임 정보
Breathless Hope is a first-person horror and action game set in a peripheral area forgotten by the government and completely isolated after a deadly outbreak.
Survive and help your neighbors
Within the blockade, you’ll have to survive on your own. Most of your neighbors are either infected or locked inside their homes.
Every decision matters
Make tough choices that will shape the storyline. Would you help a neighbor who wronged you in the past? Your choices matter and could mean the difference between life and death.
Don't lose your breath
Run for your life, avoid getting caught, and show no mercy – because the monsters you face certainly won't. When tired, stop and rest – or take an energy drink – otherwise, you’ll become easy prey.
Explore
Explore dark alleys in search of supplies to help others and yourself. But be cautious when turning a corner, as something may be lurking.
Remember: In this game, haste is the enemy of survival.

title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
description:
게임 정보
TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack.
Cutting-Edge XR
Battle as many friends as you can fit in your space, customise your environment, choose your loadout, and experience VR like never before. Play in either our Immersive Mode (full VR), Mixed Reality (hybrid) or the Real Life mode that lets you feel like you’re truly battling IRL.
Your Space, Your Battlefield
TritonXR is as simple to set up as it is fun to play. Our intuitive mixed-reality map editor lets you quickly create combat arenas in your physical space. Add walls, props, weapons and more!
Team Up, Take Down
No friends? No problem. Our brand new Survival Mode lets you battle flying foes that can navigate around your space, and creepy crawlies that can climb any piece of furniture in your room. See how long you can survive in singleplayer or multiplayer mode!
The world's most advanced XR game is here - turn any playspace into the ultimate multiplayer combat arena in TritonXR!

title: The Exit Project: Backstreets
description: 게임 정보

title: Tentacle Tango
description:
게임 정보
Tentacle Tango is a quirky and treacherous co-op platformer where you and a partner must work together, holding tentacles. Don’t let the cute visuals fool you—this game is as challenging as it is charming. Every jump, swing, and tentacle bend requires precise coordination as you navigate traps, obstacles, and enemies. Whether playing solo or in local co-op, teamwork is your only path to victory, because after all, it takes two to tango!
Unique Co-op Gameplay
Bound together, you and your partner must synchronize your movements to overcome every challenge. Use momentum, timing, and teamwork to swing across gaps, avoid traps, and defeat enemies. In Tentacle Tango, even the smallest misstep can send you both tumbling, adding to the game's deceptively tough nature.
Diverse Worlds to Explore
Each world brings new, progressively challenging obstacles—from crumbling platforms to intricate puzzles that require perfect coordination. The difficulty ramps up with every level, demanding quick reflexes and flawless teamwork.
Solo or Local Co-op
Play solo, controlling both characters, or team up with a friend in local co-op mode. Whether you're flying solo or partnering up, success hinges on perfect synchronization and timing.

title: Teddy the Tractor
description:
게임 정보
You arrived to help your uncle with crops in the fields. But of a sudden, you've been attacked by a tractor monster. To rescue the village, you must collect crops and defeat Teddy the tractor!
One of the most important parts of Teddy the Tractor is the tractor. You will ride your tractor, upgrade it, unlock new weapons, and fight Teddy.
During the gameplay, you move through the story by committing quests and collecting crops day by day. Time moves forward constantly, and some quests can be missed or failed.

title: A Snoot's Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Join Snoot in an Epic, Adorable Journey Like No Other!
Prepare for the fluffiest, fastest-paced, and most Snoot-tastic adventure ever! In “A Snoot’s Adventure,” you’ll step into the floppy shoes of Snoot, the lovable creature from Snootville, as you embark on a magical quest to save the Seven Realms. With vibrant 3D platforming, high-speed paintball combat, and heartwarming acts of kindness, this game blends snoot-strategy with non-stop action!
                       A mysterious rift has opened between Snoot’s peaceful realm and our universe. Now, Snoot must race through intergalactic realms, collecting Spirit Leaves from the legendary Tree of Life to restore harmony. Along the way, earn Gratitude Hearts for helping the quirky citizens of these realms, from shy snails to the snootily mischievous JoJo Magnifico.
                        Key Features

title: Far From The Darkness
description:
게임 정보
Far From The Darkness is a multiplayer strategy and betrayal game for 4 to 12 players.
You are part of a squad of soldiers among whom werewolves are hiding. During the night, the soldiers must complete missions while surviving the werewolves, who can transform once and kill a victim during the night.
If the missions are not completed within the time limit, the squad will have to survive a blood night. During this phase, the werewolves can transform again and continue the massacre.
If the missions are completed within the time limit, the day breaks, and the squad votes to eliminate the most suspicious person.
Of course, the werewolves are not invincible, and the squad is not defenseless. All players (soldiers and wolves) have roles that grant them unique abilities. New roles will be added regularly.
Additional Information:
Gameplay: Unlike the board game, you must move around in a 3D environment. Some roles grant the ability to shoot various projectiles; poor aim can seriously hinder your team.
Communication: The game features a proximity chat system to communicate with other players.
Atmosphere: During the night phases, players move through dark areas, lit only by their flashlights. In this terrifying darkness, danger can come out of nowhere! A word of advice, try to find batteries to stay far from the darkness.
Progression: Every action during a match earns you experience. Each level unlocks in-game cosmetics. Your stats are also saved.

title: Project Chameleon
description:
게임 정보
Project Chameleon은 적에게 들키지 않기 위해 물체로 변신해야 하는 잠입 게임입니다. 전 세계를 무대로 임무를 수행하는 엘리트 스파이 Siren이 되어 플레이하세요. 환경을 조작하고 함정을 설치하며 각 미션에서 강력한 장치를 사용하세요.







강력한 슈트를 사용하여 다양한 물체로 변신하십시오. 슈트는 사용 후 충전이 필요하므로 변신할 물체를 신중하게 선택하세요!





일부 물체는 환경을 조작하는 데 사용할 수 있는 고유한 기능을 가지고 있습니다. 복잡한 해킹 시스템을 사용하고, 소리를 내는 물체로 경비를 유인하는 등 추가적인 능력을 사용하여 더 복잡한 도전에 도전하십시오!





각 시나리오에서 고급 장치와 다양한 아이템을 찾아 Siren의 임무를 돕는 데 사용하십시오!

title: Forest Time
description:
게임 정보
Forest Time combines puzzle elements with tactical gameplay. Play as dwellers and guests of the fantasy forest, helping them meet their goals in this peaceful, family-friendly turn-based puzzle.
You can plan your actions carefully to complete everything on time, or experiment and explore the levels to your heart’s content. The game is set in a peaceful environment and doesn’t punish you for learning through trial and error.
Variety of Characters
There are many characters in the game, and each one is unique in its own way. Explore their abilities and quirks in various settings and master each one of them.
Many levels to solve
With more than 40 puzzles, there are many tasks to solve: from collecting fruits and berries and chatting with friends to trick-or-treating or playing with spirits during seasonal festive events.

title: Dragons Invade Scotland
description:
게임 정보
Match-3 meets Tower Defense! Your matches become towers. Defend each real castle in Scotland! Learn about real Scottish castles/stories/legends while playing. The game takes place on full map of Scotland made of 5 million tiles, where each tile is 19.5 square meters of the real world.

From the creator of Tower Swap. This game isn't released yet, so here's some reviews of Tower Swap:

"It's a perfect blend between the match-3, merge, and tower defense genre, so if you like any of those genres and you want to venture forth with a twist this is a perfect game with a great gameplay loop and great mechanics. It's super addicting... I enjoyed my time with Tower Swap so much that I lost track of time and got a super long gameplay recording." - MintCity Review

"This is a hidden gem and belongs in the best-of list of indie match 3 mobile games alongside Triple Town, 10000000, and Puzzle Craft." - Loren Hernandez

"Never have I ever played a game for such a long time continuously as this game. It's so simple and sooo good. 10/10 would recommend everyone ever. My grandma would love this game and my grandchildren would someday still love this game. ok I'm done. But seriously, play it."

"One of the most well-designed games I've ever played! Game is easy for beginners to play but it takes quite a bit of skill to attain higher levels, as success requires using both match-3 and tower defense strategies."

100s of castles are planned with real folklore from each:

Did you know that there was a castle ruled by a Viking princess, and it was on an island, and she put up a chain reaching to the mainland to stop ships?

Did you know that there was a castle that was said to have been built by a wizard using an army of goblins?

Did you know that there's a fairy flag that still exists today in Dunvegan castle, and it is said that it can only be used 3 times, and it has already been used twice in medieval times to summon fairies to their defense?

All of these and hundreds more are planned to be added to the game.



Note that the game is priced low because it contains IAPs. If you don't want to pay you can play for free on the web but with banner ads, coming soon. You are essentially paying to remove the banner ads, and to be able to load up the game without internet, and to make sure your progress doesn't get cleared from your browser's storage. The Steam version doesn't have any banner ads. There will also be mobile versions with the same structure.

title: Tears Apart
description:
게임 정보
Tears Apart는 순수한 고속 액션입니다. 대천사 Raggon이 되어 어둠을 뚫고 은하계에 빛을 가져오는 임무를 수행하세요. 당신은 우주를 가득 메운 그림자 속을 돌진하며 적을 베고 정복할 것입니다.
승리를 향한 돌진
모든 공격은 적과 장애물을 가르는 번개처럼 빠른 돌진입니다. 이 게임은 속도와 정확성에 달려 있습니다. 한 번의 실수로 어둠이 당신을 삼킬 수 있습니다.
별자리 창조
숨겨진 별을 발견하고, 당신이 정화하는 은하계마다 더 강해지는 별자리를 해제하세요. 각 별자리는 새로운 힘과 무한한 플레이 방법을 제공합니다.
에픽 보스 전투
당신의 기술을 그 어느 때보다도 시험할 거대한 심연의 보스들과 대결하세요. 이 전투들은 강렬하고 빠르며, 무자비하게 진행됩니다—바로 당신이 원하는 방식대로.
은하계에 질서를 가져오세요
혼돈의 심장부로 뛰어들어, 모든 돌진으로 어둠을 부수고 별을 다시 밝혀 우주의 질서를 회복하세요. 각 승리는 단순한 승리가 아닌 새로운 별의 탄생, 광대한 우주에서 희망의 등대이며, 영원한 영혼의 안식처입니다.
출시 시 특징:
돌진 기반 전투: 모든 공격이 적을 가르는 고속 액션을 경험하세요.
역동적인 우주: 숨겨진 별과 도전, 적들로 가득한 독특한 은하계를 탐험하고 정복하세요.
별자리 시너지: 무한한 전략적 가능성을 제공하는 강력한 별자리를 해제하고 결합하세요.
에픽 보스 전투: 거대한 보스들과 강렬하고 빠른 속도의 전투에서 맞서 싸우세요.
스타더스트 업그레이드: 스타더스트를 모아 다음 은하계를 위한 영구적인 업그레이드에 투자하세요.
몰입감 있는 분위기: 시작부터 끝까지 우주의 모든 구석에 도달하려는 캐릭터로 플레이하세요. 그녀의 우주 규모의 여정에 뛰어들어 다른 원초적 존재들과 만나보세요.

어둠을 찢고 은하계를 균형 잡을 준비를 하세요. 지금 위시리스트에 추가하고, 우주를 차지할 준비를 하세요!

title: Chosen War
description:
게임 정보
"Chosen War" is a strategic roguelike game where you build a troop list for battles. You will take on the role of the Divine Chosen One, assembling and leading your army to explore various islands. Through careful troop deployment, you engage in battles against enemies. By using the skills of the Divine Chosen One and simple operations on the army, you strive to defeat the foes. After passing different islands, you'll receive various rewards. It could be an upgrade to your troops, the liberation and incorporation of imprisoned slaves into your army, or the rich treasures hidden under the Italian divine secrets. Ultimately, you'll battle against the evil High Priest to achieve the final victory.

title: BlastBall: All-Stars
description:
게임 정보
Dive into the ultimate sports showdown with BlastBall: All-Stars! Pick your favorite all-star from our roster of adorable creatures and jump into the fun.
With intuitive controls adapted to each sport, jumping into new games is a breeze! Aim with the left stick and add spin with the right stick to score highlight reel goals.

title: Ninas Escape
description:
게임 정보
A special kind of Jump-and-Run game in honor to the classics from the 80s home computer era. Our hero, little Nina, has been trapped into a large cave with multiple levels - you can help her to escape from there. In every level, there is a teleporter that moves Nina to the next level. Those teleporters work from batteries - so you have to collect all batteries in a level to activate the end level teleporter to escape from that level.
There are numerous hazards in every level: poisonous spiders dangling from the ceilings, pools filled with deadly liquids (water, slime, lava), flying balls that send out electrical shock bolts, evil people chasing Nina, even bats are lurking around. Movement is done by walking, jumping and jumping, also climbing walls and ladders. There are lift platforms (moving horizontal and vertical), in-level teleporters that need coins to operate, and electrical forcefields that block passageways.
You can play either alone, or party up with friends or family and play locally with up to 4 players in a game (coop mode). There is no "points counting", so no rivalry is needed. But all players have to complete a level to count it "done". So it is "play together", and not "who wins the game".

title: The Backwars
description:
게임 정보
The Backwars is a survival horror game that keeps you on edge at all times. Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, your only goal is to survive. Scavenge for food and water, build what you need to stay alive, and hide from the unspeakable horrors hunting you. Each level is packed with threats that force you to think fast and act faster.
Step into an unforgiving world where everything feels disturbingly real. The heavy atmosphere, eerie sounds, and gritty visuals pull you into a nightmare that won’t let go. Every item, object, or system in the game connects in ways that can surprise or terrify you. Nothing feels safe, and nowhere is truly secure.
The entities stalking you aren’t the only danger—other players can be just as deadly. Trust can get you killed, and alliances rarely last long. Whether you’re hiding in the dark, crafting tools, or fighting for your life, every moment is a gamble.
The Backwars offers different ways to play:

title: WitchCraft: Spellbound Decks
description:
게임 정보
이 게임에 대하여

Witchcraft: Spellbound Decks는 고대 마법의 예술에 몰입하여 카드를 구성하는 로그라이크 덱빌딩 게임입니다. 마법이 실재하는 신비로운 세계를 배경으로, 플레이어는 젊은 마녀가 되어 강력한 주문과 의식의 힘을 활용하여 점점 더 어려워지는 적들을 물리칩니다.

Witchcraft에서 실험은 필수적입니다. 다양한 카드 조합을 통해 강력한 전략을 창조하세요. 당신은 순수한 힘을 추구하나요, 아니면 교묘한 속임수를 신뢰하나요? 일시적인 이익을 위해 카드를 희생할 것인가, 아니면 장기적으로 무적의 덱을 구성할 것인가요? 선택은 당신의 몫이며, 각 시도는 다를 것이고, 당신의 전술을 적응하고 발전시키도록 도전할 것입니다.
특징

턴제 전투: 각 움직임이 중요한 전략적 전투에 참여하세요. 신중하게 행동을 계획하고, 강력한 주문과 교묘한 전술을 사용하여 적을 압도하세요.

탐험 지도: 가지가 많은 경로와 숨겨진 비밀이 가득한 동적인 지도를 탐험하세요. 다양한 도전과 보상을 만나면서 신중하게 경로를 선택하세요.

카드 제작: 고대 의식을 통해 새로운 카드를 제작하여 덱을 맞춤화하세요. 요소를 결합하여 자신만의 플레이 스타일에 맞는 강력한 주문과 능력을 만드세요.

상점: 신비로운 상점을 방문하여 특정 카드를 구매하세요. 자원을 현명하게 사용하여 덱을 강화하고 생존 확률을 높이세요.

랜덤 이벤트: 여정의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 다양한 랜덤 이벤트를 경험하세요. 유용한 동료이거나 위험한 적일 수 있는 이 만남들은 당신을 긴장하게 할 것입니다.

보스 전투: 독특한 능력과 전략을 가진 강력한 보스와 맞서 싸우세요. 가장 숙련된 마녀들만이 그들을 물리치고 여정을 계속할 수 있을 것입니다.

title: Polygun
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of Polygun, an endlessly customizable hero shooter where you battle against an ever increasing hoard of bloodthirsty shapes! With an array of upgrades to choose from, you'll quickly build from humble beginings into a hexa-bustin killing machine. The possibilities are endless! How long can you survive?
Choose your hero!  
Choose from among a variety of eye-catching heroes with unique weapons and ability focuses!  
Gain experience and unlock new upgrades!

title: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX
description:
게임 정보
불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.




당신은 2천년 전 엄청 유명한 대학살의 주인공인 전설의 피닉스이다. 당신은 전투의 상처를 치료하기 위해 2천년간 잠적했고, 지상의 마물들은 당신을 처치하기 위해 찾아왔다.



명예로운 환상수인 당신은 그들의 도전을 받아들여야 하지만, 아직 상처 치료가 덜 되어 전성기 시절의 힘을 딱 11초만 낼 수 있다.

차례로 몰려오는 적들을 모두 무찌르고 2천년 전 '불사조는 진짜 유명한 피닉스임.'의 전설을 재현해 주도록 하자.












게임이 시작되면 오른쪽 UI에 당신이 입력 가능한 키보드 키가 표시됩니다. 그 키를 눌러 마물을 공격하세요.

COMBO에 주의하십시오. 올바른 키 입력에 성공하면 1 COMBO가 쌓이고, 공격력이 상승합니다. (COMBO당 +1)
COMBO는 잘못된 키를 입력하면 0으로 초기화됩니다.



당신은 단 11초만 싸울 수 있습니다. 11초 안에 모든 적(LEVEL 10)을 처치하지 못하면 패배합니다.
autokwd: YOU ARE SUPER MEGA LEGEND PHOENIX

title: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion
description:
게임 정보
Story:
Enter The Void
On the search for his missing wife and daughter, paranormal investigator, Jonathan Hunter, finds himself trapped in a strange new world. Faced with the ruins of a dying kingdom and searching for answers, Hunter must enlist the help of an amnesiac spirit named Angel and the kingdom’s last remaining denizen: A lonely shopkeeper named Craven. Armed with his wits, a weapon, and newfound mystical powers, Hunter must dive into a plot of revenge, redemption, and insanity on his search for the truth. Together, he and his allies’ will face demons inner and outer to find Hunter’s family and save the kingdom from destruction. No matter the cost…
autokwd: Levels of Fear: Voidwalker Act I- An Undying Devotion

title: Grinville
description:
게임 정보
An abandoned park, a forgotten tragedy, and something that should never have been awakened. Years ago, a charming parade turned into a massacre when the animatronics, created to entertain, brutally attacked the audience. Now, you return to this cursed place to uncover the truth. But beware... they are still here, waiting.

title: Curation
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the world of museum management! Build, customise, and expand your dream museum into a place of science and history, wonder and mystery in this award-winning casual building/management sim!
As the architect, designer, and curator, it’s your job to transform an empty plot of land into a cultural landmark. Create an unforgettable experience for your NPC visitors by selecting, buying, and placing artefacts throughout your new museum. If they have a great time, they might even donate a little cash before heading out!
Build, expand, customise
Design your museum from the ground up! Drag out walls and create uniquely shaped rooms to give your museum a one-of-a-kind layout. A range of customisation options means you can expand and modify your building, tailoring each room for the ultimate visitor experience.
Collect & Display Unique Artefacts

title: Bearstone Campsite
description:
게임 정보
Bearstone Campsite is a first-person horror game that follows the journey of our character who goes missing during a camping trip.
Maria, Paul, and Nathan should have never gone without you. It’s absurd they thought they could manage without the only sensible person in the group. But could they, really? Your friends are out there, desperate, waiting for you to come back.
Now, witness their story. You left them to this fate.
You’ve always been cautious... or maybe just a coward. But this time, what are you going to do?

title: Jelly Farm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Jelly Farm, where farm fun gets a sweet twist! Embark on a colorful and addictive adventure as you run a unique farm where everything is made of food. Plant vibrant crops and harvest resources to create unique treats that will make your farm shine.
(explore and cultivate)
Jelly Farm is the perfect place to relax, have fun and discover your inner jelly farmer! Get ready to build your own dream farm and reap the rewards of a lifetime of fun.

title: Emberhold
description:
게임 정보
Explore and defend a fantasy kingdom in the skies!
Emberhold is a bastion of hope for the people of Astria, one that has long been in slumber. With your help, the fires of the guilds and trade will awaken anew to battle the tides of evil lurking at it's borders! Work together with allies to reclaim lost territory and quell the warring factions. Rebuild your bastion to defend against the nightmares that lie beyond the fog and below the mists.
Experiment with varying playstyles
Outfit your party the way you want! Your characters can fight with a sword and shield, wield magic, or use a gun; your party composition is yours to decide how best to take on the challenges that await.
Collect, repair, craft, and expand
Gather resources and find unique items on your adventures to restore the Emberhold to it's former glory! Craft equipment at the forge to outfit your party before you set out so that you're ready to face even the strongest foes.
Face off against challenging enemies
Use strategy and skill to take down enemies in a variety of encounters. Even the simplest of foes can pose a threat in large numbers. Take your party and challenge powerful bosses in uniquely phased fights.

title: EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse
description:
게임 정보
Embark on Everdark, an action-packed shooter that blends classics like Unreal or Doom with influences from survival horror games such as Resident Evil. Filled with references to 1980s horror movies, you'll be transported to a city swarming with vampires, where you'll face these creatures in diverse and bloody ways.
Survive in a devastated city
Upon returning from a visit to your cousin in Milwaukee, you're forced to take a detour that leads you to Everdark. Then, you suffer a terrible car accident that leaves you stranded with no way to call for help or continue your journey.
The only way out is on foot. However, the streets have descended into chaos… The city is infested with vampires that have wiped out most of its inhabitants! Can you help the survivors, uncover the cause of this catastrophe, and escape alive?

title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver
description:
게임 정보
Play as Captain Corgi in this space adventure! Hop on your cosmic sailboat and explore the Milky Way, land on floating worlds, and lend a helping hand to the eccentric inhabitants of this storybook universe.



This is a short, narrative adventure with some light puzzling. Captain Corgi and his brother Lem are on a quest to become Planetary Problem Solvers! Or at least that's Corgi's quest. Lem would probably rather hang back and read, but their mom told him he needs to look after his little brother. But who knows, maybe he'll learn something new along the way as well.
Features:
Chill exploration without combat
Quirky animal characters to chat with
A 'bark' button
Space sailing!

title: Oaths Against the Darkness
description:
게임 정보
They came from the seas. Long ships, affixed with hideous totems which hurt the eyes to look at. They brought destruction, hedonism, and pain to our sacred Land. At times, ominous whispers spoken from a thousand lips herald their coming. Other times, wails of the forsaken can be heard for miles. They threaten our Kingdom, our God, and our very way of life. They must be defeated.
In this medieval turn-based RPG set in a fantasy world based on 9th century England, lead your warband of honorable warriors to victory against the Nightmare Vikings.
Fight in tactical battles against Thralls, Warriors, Berserkers, and foes darker still.
Swear oaths of honor, which must be upheld in order to succeed in battle.
Upgrade and progress your troops with equipment, stat boosts, and perks.
Oaths Against the Darkness is designed to be a simple tactics game that doesn't take a ton of brain power to pick up and play, but can still offer deep tactical gameplay. 
If you'd like to interact with me and give feedback, there's a link to a discord I'll be using throughout the next few months!

title: Train to Hong Kong
description:
게임 정보
트레인 투 홍콩은 포스트 아포칼립스 비주얼 노벨로, 고등학생 준의 여정을 따라가는 게임입니다. 친구들과 함께 좀비를 처치하고, 동물들로부터 도망치고, 감염된 아시아 도시를 탐험하며 홍콩에 도착하세요!

title: Night Plane
description:
게임 정보
Night Plane is a thrilling airborne hospitality simulator that costs way less than a plane ticket! Board passengers, assist with their trivial struggles, and resolve emergency situations all by yourself in this hyper-realistic representation of a commercial flight in 1999 New Zealand. Enjoy the world-class airport, babies crying at 30,000 feet, and very reliable aircraft systems. Also, please don't let the psychopomp fly the aircraft.
Board passengers, keep them comfortable, and strive to provide a survivable flight for all paying customers.
Decide who boards the plane! Customer satisfaction is what it's all about, but some passengers just aren't worth the hassle. If someone looks like a troublemaker, feel free to reject them at boarding and luxuriate in their absence during the flight.
Countless (99+) interactable objects, both in the airport and on the plane!
Hyper-realist representation of 1999 New Zealand.
Unravel the occult mysteries of the airplane bathroom...
And pet the cat!

title: 神明高中生 - Cosmic High Schooler
description:
게임 정보
The principles of the universe are its bones, time flows silently through its veins, and the cosmic web forms its nerves…
"All things will fade—that may be the rule for many worlds, but not for mine."
"Even you must sometimes hope for a twist in the world, don't you?"
 You are an ordinary girl from a rural area, with a humble background.
For the sixteen years since your birth, the seasons have cycled, the sun has risen and set, and the universe has moved faithfully to the rhythm you know so well.
Immersed in the bittersweet routine of daily life, you believe that this is all there is to existence.
However, upon entering high school, the arrival of two mysterious boys disrupts your once ordinary life.
It seems a supernatural force is shaking the familiar world you thought you understood.
As reality and dreams start to intertwine, you begin to question your preconceptions about the world.
Is this story one of miracles, mysteries, or distortions?
All the answers rest in your choices…
autokwd: 神明高中生 - Cosmic High Schooler

title: Space Diner Simulator
description:
게임 정보
Space Diner Simulator is a cozy diner management game where you will slowly grow your diner from a humble little place to a place with many workers.
Cook, clean, serve and unlock new recipes as you improve your diner with all kinds of different equipment.
Quality service is of the utmost importance in the hospitality service. Customers will complain if the food isn't on time or if it's not hot enough. So speed is greatly appreciated.
Cooking is a skill and as any skill over time it gets better. The more dishes you prepare, the better quality and price they will have. But don't be afraid to try all the different dishes.

title: Necromancy  Homies
description:
게임 정보
The story is set in Zhitebsk, a city of contrast, where the commonplace, down-to-earth Central Russian town meets the mystical and the metaphysical, and where the ridiculous meets the horrendous.
An unnamed mob in the 1990s is mourning over their boss’ death. They are in great sorrow, not sure what should they do now without him. However, a necromancer for the establishment and an old acquaintance of theirs, Mr.Besolyubov, doesn’t seem to accept that. He offers to do his job and bring the boss back from the dead, but the mob would have to help.
… That’s where the utter nightmare and the incredulous parade of surreal idiocy begin in the funerary train.
▷ Loads of humor of all sorts
▷ That one absurdist 90s dark comedic movie atmosphere
▷ Shocking plot twists
▷ Vivid, expressive grunge visuals
▷ Nostalgic point-n-click gameplay elements
▷ Your choices affect the story
▷ A trap music score

title: Suqare: Hired Gun
description:
게임 정보
In this 2D, Top-Down Shooter, you take control of a mercenary named Suqare as he tries to make a name for himself. You will take jobs from different corporations to build rapport with them and make money. Decisions made during missions determine what jobs you have access to, your reward, how each corporation fares compared to the others, and even the over-arching story. Use strategy and skill to outwit, outsmart and outshoot your enemies. 
You'll have a plethora of melee weapons, guns, gadgets, and upgrades that you can steal from dead enemies or buy from the shop. Change your play-style from guns-blazing to Hitman-like stealth by the way you choose to spend your hard-earned cash. Most weapons have uses that aren't initially apparent, so try them in many ways! You will be finding useful secrets and new weapons nearly every mission so search the area thoroughly.

title: Planetary Delivery Boys
description:
게임 정보
Overview
In the dystopian future, you are tasked with delivering across the galactic empire. Complete deliveries by ensuring safe travel aboard the train, making the business thrive! From your CCTV you can monitor and react to all incidents within the train. All of your tools utilise the power, which you must manage or risk leaving the entire train open for the taking. Package thieves aim to ruin your career prospects. Avoid their ambushes and keep them away from the customers packages!
Realistic Managers!
The future is bright, but not for you. People need their damn packages on time, and you’ve got a tight schedule. Board the train, and keep it going until you reach the destination. Stop those pesky parcel thieves and sacrifice your life if you must, you’re all replaceable anyway.
Train Simulation

title: 星象迷案 The Zodiac Mystery
description:
게임 정보
A case that has been cold for over 20 years is suddenly reopened after an astrology enthusiast returns from abroad and discovers a mysterious diary. Forgotten faces, past events, and lost loves resurface one by one... Amid stacks of intricate, perplexing files, travel through time and space, revisiting the past to uncover the concealed secrets of the case. How do the good and evil of human nature intertwine and clash within this mystery? Does the devil truly exist? Were the zodiac sacrifices a mere guise, or a carefully laid trap? Experience a puzzle full of unpredictable twists and endless challenges.
Unravel the mystery and separate truth from falsehood on this journey of discovery. Does the final answer lie in a purgatory of eternal damnation, or a fiery rebirth and redemption? With multiple endings that exceed all expectations, the story's conclusion is yours to uncover in this unique adventure, available on Steam!
✥ Gameplay: Mind-bending puzzles in an immersive world!
✥ Art Style: Delicate & vivid, with diverse & rich scenes
✥ Story: Full of twists & turns, offering a unique narrative journey
✥ Characters: Complex relationships & focus on human nature
✥ Mechanics: Cleverly designed gameplay to test observation
✥ Puzzles: Innovative multiple endings & fresh puzzle-solving experience
autokwd: 星象迷案 The Zodiac Mystery

title: Beneath the Frost
description:
게임 정보
You are the sole survivor of a devastating spaceship crash, stranded on a frozen, desolate planet. Now, you must scavenge whatever scraps remain in a desperate attempt to call for help.
Remote-Controlled Exploration
Trapped within the hollow shell of your ship, deploy a scrap recovery bot to venture into the outside world. Search for what scarce resources this planet offers and uncover the mystery behind your crash.
An Unfolding Landscape

title: Finares
description:
게임 정보
Who are you?
You are Ares, a shepherd dog without a permanent home. Just as you were about to settle down, you return from a short trip to find yourself alone. All the humans have disappeared. When no one fills your food bowl anymore, you realize the situation is serious. Then, a strange female dog appears in your territory, and your adventure to find the humans begins. Find your way through the chaos of the world and lead your pack forward.
What can you expect on this journey?
Travel through multiple open worlds
Listen to local frequencies for signals from humans
Find diary entries, notes, laptops, smartphones, and anything that gives you clues about the last thoughts of humans
Meet other dogs along the way and exchange information with them
Use your nose to track scents and reach new places
Help pick locks and restore the power
Play tag and hide-and-seek
Take care of your pack
Always have your trailer with you
Search for supplies and shelters for the night
Solve puzzles to get information
Friendship
Painted graphics
How is the game's development going?
You can find the game on youtube, where I regularly upload videos about the game:
You can also play the free demo (please note that the game is in active development)

title: Find Us Cats
description:
게임 정보
Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline friends! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in Level 1 of our free demo, the Planetarium.
Level 1: The Planetarium
* Explore the universe and the building too if you have time!
* There are 25+ cats hidden within level 1
* Rare undocumented cats may be lurking throughout the demo, but only for those brave enough to scour the environment carefully
We plan to expand the game further based on the feedback gathered from the demo, so please share your opinion on the forums.

title: The Lizard Problem
description:
게임 정보
Have you had enough of building impenetrable defenses and then having to wait at 2x speed until the waves provides a challenge big enough? Then look no further.



The Lizard Problem is a dynamic tower defense with a focus on making every wave a new challenge that has to be reacted to. Mother nature herself will rip your defenses apart with earthquakes that shatter your formations and the level in the beginning of each wave, providing new paths for the lizards to then take and try and steal your eggs. You will have to adapt to the ever changing landscape by moving your towers and replacing those who got destroyed in battle.

You may be just a magpie bird, but you are not defenseless. Apart from bribing the animals of the world to help you (building towers), you can yourself engage in the battle. Smack them with your wings, just like your mom said. Speaking of your mom, she will guide you through the life of a soon to be parent, giving you tips on how to deal with The Lizard Problem.

The natural breaks between waves give you a good time to think about what to do next, but if you already got a plan, the game makes sure you can execute it as fast as possible. There are intuitive hot keys for every interaction, letting you place and move turrets in a fraction of a second, even mid round. The flight mechanic makes sure you can reach all ends of the map quickly, which is especially useful for quickly killing of a stray lizard that escaped with the close range melee combat.

Many more features are to be announced as development continues!

title: Wish Of Hers
description:
게임 정보
개요
Wish of Hers는 주인공의 꿈속 세계에서 벌어지며, 현실이 한 걸음 한 걸음마다 휘어지고 변화합니다. 이러한 초현실적인 풍경을 탐험하면서 누군가가 당신의 꿈을 조작하고, 더 깊은 목적을 향해 인도하고 있음을 알게 됩니다. 전투를 통해 진실에 한 발짝 더 다가가고, 꿈속에 숨어 있는 궁극의 적에 맞서기 위해 힘과 능력을 모읍니다.
능력
파워 카드를 구매하여 독특하고 강력한 능력을 획득하세요. 이 능력들은 전투 전략을 강화하도록 설계되었으며, 파괴적인 공격부터 방어적인 동작까지 다양합니다. 능력들은 창의적인 방식으로 결합하여 꿈속에서 변화하는 도전에 적응할 수 있습니다.

업그레이드
현실 조형기를 사용하여 능력을 업그레이드하고 더욱 강력하게 진화시키세요. 업그레이드할 때마다 능력은 새로운 효과와 강화된 힘을 얻게 되며, 꿈의 신비를 깊이 탐구하기 위한 우위를 제공합니다.

title: Skyrift: The Shattered Sky
description:
게임 정보
In a world once whole, cataclysmic events shattered the land into countless floating islands, each with its unique ecosystem and challenges. Embark on an epic quest in Skyrift: The Shattered Sky, where you, alongside a team of intrepid adventurers, strive to restore harmony to a fractured realm.

Join the legendary hero Aeron in this strategic 3D roguelike adventure, set against a backdrop of verdant forests, arid deserts, and ethereal space realms. Your journey begins from a central village on a large floating island, the hub for all restoration efforts. Gather resources, upgrade structures, and plan your expeditions to reunite the fragmented islands and lost continents.

Key Features:

Dynamic World Exploration: Traverse diverse floating islands, each with its distinct environment, from lush forests teeming with life to harsh deserts and cosmic anomalies.

Ancient Temples: Discover and modify dormant celestial observatories that hold the key to restoring balance. Use collected modules to transform these temples into powerful spawners, influencing enemy dynamics and resource generation.

Strategic Gameplay: Balance resource gathering, combat, and temple modifications. Navigate a dynamic day-night cycle that affects enemy behavior, resource availability, and the overall urgency of your missions.

Rich Narrative: Uncover the secrets of the shattered world, the true purpose of the Core of Unity, and the history behind the cataclysm. Face off against the enigmatic figure wielding remnants of the Core's power in a final epic showdown.

Epic Showdown: Confront the last boss, whose quest for dominion led to the world's fragmentation. Learn from his mistakes, restore the temples, and reforge the Core of Unity to bring the world back together.

Experience a captivating tale of restoration and unity in Skyrift: The Shattered Sky. Forge your path, reunite the realms, and restore harmony to a world forever changed.

title: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada
description:
게임 정보
Greetings, brave adventurer! Welcome to Croak Crusader: Champion of Canada, a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer where precision, skill, and grit are your ultimate allies. When the Roachilla Empire (grotesque alien bio-experiments created by the sinister Professor Creature) threatens the Great White North, it’s up to the indomitable Captain Croak to swing into action and save the day. Armed with a versatile grapple and fueled by unrelenting determination, you’ll dash, leap, and battle through a gauntlet of explosive, white-knuckle challenges.
Explore a vibrant world of forgotten bomb factories, sprawling circuses, and shadowy jungle ruins, each teeming with traps and enemies that demand lightning-fast reflexes and razor-sharp precision. The gameplay is difficult but deeply rewarding, blending tight platforming mechanics with fluid momentum and thrilling combat. Every step forward is a test of your skill, every enemy encounter an opportunity for satisfying chaos.
With its stunning black-and-white visuals inspired by the golden age of cinema and the chaotic energy of Hollywood Z-movies, Croak Crusader isn’t just a game: it’s an unforgettable journey. Will you conquer the impossible and save the Land of the Maple Leaf, or will the Roachilla Empire prevail? The fate of Canada is in your hands.
autokwd: Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada

title: Mush Dash
description:
게임 정보
"Mush Dash"는 최대 7명이 레이스를 펼치는 멀티플레이 파티 게임입니다.

여러가지 패턴의 장애물과 함정들을 피해 목표지점까지 완주해야합니다.

Mush Dash만의 특별한 함정을 경험해보세요! (쉽지 않은 난이도)





Mush Dash는 한 테마당 5개의 웨이브로 구성되어있고 플레이 시작 시 랜덤으로 3개의 웨이브가 정해집니다.



3개의 웨이브가 모두 끝난 후 랭킹을 집계하여 최종 우승자가 정해집니다.





웨이브를 1등으로 완주하는 것도 중요하지만 여러 도전과제를 통해 버섯 코인을 많이 모을수록 최종 우승에 한 발짝 가까워지게 됩니다.

title: SAVE AMANI
description:
게임 정보
SAVE AMANI is a adventure game about war. Players will help a child named Amani escape from various dangers during the war by solving puzzles. Players can feel the cruelty of war and the devastation and damage to people's lives and souls, thereby arousing people's appreciation for peace and attention to children in war.





Game Features

The city ravaged by war is in ruins and a mess. The once glorious buildings have now turned into ruins, the streets are covered in gravel and scorched earth, the smoke of gunpowder permeates, and the sky is gloomy. The ruthlessness of war deprives cities of vitality and energy, leaving behind endless sadness and painful memories. People are displaced, their homes are shattered, and the shadow of war covers every inch of the land, which is heartbreaking. ‌




The enemy is lurking in all directions, soldiers armed with live ammunition may appear at any time, drones hover continuously in the air, mechanical dogs patrol along the necessary routes, and in addition, one must always be vigilant of collapsed walls, landmines hidden in the soil, and shells that may fall from the air. Every step is full of unknowns and dangers.




Be sure to hide and stay as far away as possible from enemy drones. Once scanned and locked by them, Oman will face the danger of being shot.




He can control his small drone, explore the situation ahead, and effectively lure away enemies, with a wide range of uses.




War rages on, innocent children, and little boy Aman witnesses his home shattered and his loved ones scattered. The warm embrace of the past has become a cold memory, a tender heart that endures endless sorrow.
To commemorate the deceased teacher, light a candle and offer the sincerest wishes and thoughts.




Multiple spaces support switching from a third person perspective to a first person perspective for exploration.




Help Aman find that QR code, just put on VR glasses and scan it, and he can immerse himself in the illusory scene that was not destroyed before the war. The former campus, classrooms, streets, libraries, amusement parks, and central square are all vividly remembered. Every time he puts on his VR glasses, Oman's face blooms with a smile, as he can once again see his former family, classmates, teachers, and those familiar environments.




However, when he took off his glasses and reality came into view again, Oman's heart was filled with endless sadness. ‌




Once upon a time, the little boy Aman was like a ray of sunshine in winter, with a warm and bright smile, and a pure light shining in his eyes. He loves sunshine, warmth, clouds, nature, and small animals. However, now his eyes no longer flicker and he can only hide himself in the darkness. It seems that things that are within everyone's reach have become an unattainable luxury for Oman.




Separated by a wall, the two worlds are completely separated, with no hope of crossing over. However, the boy Aman still needs to gather courage and move forward resolutely in the midst of danger.
autokwd: SAVE AMANI,拯救阿曼 SAVE AMANI

title: Spook-A-Boo
description:
게임 정보
환영합니다, 후보생 여러분!
다른 유령 사냥꾼들과 팀을 이루어 은하계를 가로지르는 장난꾸러기 유령들에 맞서 싸울 시간이 왔습니다. 이 문제의 유령들이 더 큰 혼란을 일으키기 전에, 기이한 세계와 혼란스러운 차원을 여행하며 그들을 찾아 나서세요.
스푹-어- Spook-A-Boo 는 1~4명이 함께 즐길 수 있는 소파 협동 게임으로, 온라인과 오프라인 모두에서 플레이할 수 있습니다. 친구들과 가족과 협력하여 유령들을 속이고, 도망치기 전에 붙잡으세요. 28개의 독특한 레벨에서 시간과 경쟁하며 임무를 완수하고, 유령들의 숨겨진 진실을 밝혀내세요.
숙련된 게이머이든, 가족과 함께 즐길 재미있는 활동을 찾고 있든, 스푹-어-부 Spook-A-Boo 는 웃음과 협동, 그리고 유쾌한 유령 소동으로 가득한 시간을 약속합니다.
최첨단 기술 사용하다
너희 자신을 최신 유령 사냥 장비로 장비하여 그 성가신 유령들을 잡아라.

title: Baba Yaga
description:
게임 정보
In this turn-based strategy roguelike, you’ll face hordes of loyalist forces who are after your head! Play as Baba Yaga, the enigmatic witch from Slavic folklore, and uncover her reimagined origin story within a dark medieval fantasy setting.
Each turn, your enemies draw nearer… Plan your moves carefully, and eliminate each wave to progress through the game.
Choose from a wide variety of spells to expand your dark magic arsenal. Will you cripple your foe? Bolster yourself? Rain down destruction? No two spells are the same!
Draw power from three separate mana pools of Hatred, Sorrow, and Spite - use your resources efficiently.
Seek synergies, exploit weaknesses, and unleash raw diabolical power!
Each run is unique and procedurally generated. It takes up to 30 minutes to complete a run, so you can experiment freely and learn faster.
Learn from your mistakes, master the game mechanics, and explore new choices every time.
Each potential encounter has different enemy types and rewards: spells, mana upgrades, or powerful perks. Choose your path wisely!
You will be offered a changing set of spells and perks in every run. Test new builds, and remake the witch you wish to be.
Ascend through higher difficulty modes that provide novel challenges, even for seasoned players!

title: The Final Fragment
description:
게임 정보
“Believe in yourself!”, “Follow your heart!”, “Trust your gut!”. The modern world always preaches about self-discovery, self-realization and self- anything, really. But nobody explains how to find that fickle and unreachable 'self' everyone seems to treat like the ultimate answer to the greatest puzzle called life. Is it a journey you need, as they say, to take on yourself?

These musings torment Nina, a melancholic student at the Olha Kobylianska Arts Academy.

Answers run away from her, hiding behind all sorts of mundane troubles: how to hide a crush on that one perfect girl she shares a dorm room with, deal with an eccentric ex-friend and choose a major for her next year at college? And, most importantly, what does her submission for the upcoming academy’s art exhibition desperately lack?

But a mysterious incident at the exhibiton tears apart Nina’s safe and uneventful life, forcing her to confront everything she's been running away from…

Length: ~20k words, approximately 2 hours of reading



Experience a cozy coming-of-age tale filled with emotion and mystery
Dive into the painterly atmosphere of the arts academy drawn by Valentyna Olefirenko
Listen to your inner voice and choose what feels right
Find the last missing piece of Nina’s scattered sense of self

title: Bar Night VR
description:
게임 정보
Bar Night VR puts you in the shoes of a virtual bartender, where the hustle never stops! Manage your underground bar, serving customers, restocking drinks, filling machines, and keeping the night alive. As you progress through each shift, you’ll face new challenges and master the art of being a bartender.
Start by serving simple drinks, then work your way up to crafting complex cocktails—all while ensuring your bar stays in control and the vibes stay fun!
Serve up drinks and learn new bartending skills
Keep the peace and prevent bar brawls
Cater to all kinds of customers, from everyday patrons to the more... mysterious types
And most importantly, keep yourself sober!
Get ready to mix, serve, restock, and repeat—because in Bar Night VR, the party never ends!

title: The Genetic Dilemma
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 두 인물의 시선을 통해 이 세계를 경험하게 됩니다. 대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 시대, 그러나 그 속에서 살아가는 사람들의 일상은 결코 단순하지 않습니다.
남자의 이야기
반복되는 일상에 지친 그는 가벼운 용돈벌이를 위해 설문 조사에 참여하기로 합니다. 지루한 하루를 보내던 중, 우연히 오래된 친구와 재회하게 됩니다. 친구의 집에 초대받아 방문한 그곳에서, 그는 친구의 여자친구와 마주하게 되는데… 단순한 만남이 예상치 못한 방향으로 흘러가며, 그의 삶은 돌이킬 수 없는 변화를 맞이합니다.
여자의 이야기
자율주행 자동차의 자동 브레이크 시스템을 연구하는 그녀는 최첨단 기술의 중심에서 일하고 있습니다. 그러나 어느 날, 뜻하지 않은 사고로 인해 생사의 기로에 서게 됩니다. 그리고 그녀에게 제안된 것은 기존의 장기 이식과는 차원이 다른 ‘혁신적인 수술’— 오직 뇌만을 새로운 몸으로 옮기는 이식 수술이었습니다.
눈을 떴을 때, 그녀는 완전히 새로운 세상 속에 있었습니다. 하지만 그녀를 기다리는 운명은 과연 축복일까요, 아니면 새로운 딜레마의 시작일까요?
대중교통이 무료로 제공되는 세계. 하지만 이 편리함의 대가는 결코 가볍지 않습니다— 단순히 이동하는 것조차 끝없는 광고를 견뎌야 하는 시대입니다.

title: Xalos: Collectible Card Game
description:
게임 정보
Players take command of aliens, robots and humans using their unique playstyles to destroy the opponent's energy core. Discover synergy between the cards to craft your combos. Players will face off against the enemy AI in singleplayer or other players in multiplayer mode.
Mechanics
There are 3 main races.
Aliens: Balanced offense and defense, excelling in neither. Effects allow for a board control based approach.
Robots: Typically boast higher defense. Effects have a focus on destruction and sustainability.
Humans: Higher attack power but low defense. Their effects boost each other, call for reinforcements and can equip weapons to become even stronger.

title: The Concrete District
description:
게임 정보
WHERE THE STORY UNFOLDS:
After the end of the world, hardly anything was left - except the "Concrete District", a surreal place of endless concrete facades, without doors, without windows - like a city that was never built for people.
EVERY STATUE FOLLOWS THEIR OWN RULES. LEARN THEM - OR DIE:
The district is haunted by eerie humanoid statues, each with its own bizarre and terrifying behavior. Some of these statues move only when you’re not looking, others are always in motion, and some remain still until you make eye contact. You never know which ones will come to life and threaten you.
IT WILL GET WORSE AND WORSE:
The tension builds as you explore, never sure if it’s safe to look away. The atmosphere is oppressive, and the challenge is more psychological than physical. Will you survive the twisting corridors of the Concrete District, or will the statues claim you as their next victim?

title: Next Player
description:
게임 정보
Next Player is a first-person psychological horror game where a nostalgic gaming experience turns into a chilling nightmare. Late at night, alone in your room, you play an innocent-looking platformer. But this ordinary night is about to become a terrifying ordeal...
As you progress through each level on your television, reality in your room starts to fracture. One wrong step can turn off the lights or make shadows move. Initially confined to pixels, the tension slowly merges with reality, blurring the line between virtual and real.
Finally, your door creaks open. Something has entered—and it's now inside your room. This time, the game is playing you.
Features:
Reality vs. Virtuality: A mind-bending horror experience built around the 'game-within-a-game' concept.
Claustrophobic Atmosphere: A single-room setting where reality gradually tightens and deteriorates.
Short but Intense: A 30-minute psychological thriller guaranteed to send chills down your spine.
Retro Aesthetic: Nostalgic nightmare filled with VHS glitches, CRT screens, and distorted visuals.

title: Black Paradox Reloaded
description:
게임 정보
Black Paradox Reloaded takes the fast-paced, roguelite shoot 'em up to new heights. The pixel art has been completely overhauled, making every detail pop with vibrant color and clarity. The gameplay has been meticulously rebalanced, and the new synthwave tracks are electrifying, setting the perfect mood as you blast through waves of enemies. One of the standout additions is the hardcore boss rush mode – a true test for any seasoned player.
As the legendary bounty hunter Black Paradox, players will take on the Hellraisers, the galaxy's most notorious criminal syndicate, along with their seven formidable lieutenants.

Key Features
Upgraded Visuals: Stunning new pixel art enhances every aspect of the game.
Rebalanced Gameplay: Fine-tuned for a smoother, more challenging experience.
New Synthwave Tracks: Thrilling music that perfectly complements the intense action.
Hardcore Boss Rush Mode: An extra challenge for those seeking to push their skills.
Extensive Arsenal: 20 unique weapons, 37 powerups, 13 deadly drones, and 8 powerful combos, including the iconic "Black Paradox" move.
Diverse Enemies and Bosses: 62 different enemies with unique attack patterns and 14 deadly bosses, plus a secret one.
Stat Upgrades: Enhance your stats and unlock new powers to become even more formidable.
Local Co-op Mode: Team up with a friend for double the action and fun.

title: Hyperslice
description:
게임 정보
Hyperslice is a fast paced action arena roguelike where dashing is your main weapon. You slice through enemies to kill them and push them to turn them into projectiles.
Upgrade your ship and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.
Slice through enemies & push them
Use various abilities
Unleash your powerful ship's ultimate

title: Contained
description:
게임 정보
Contained is a monster pet simulator where you are sealed inside a sci-fi facility alongside some moody monsters.
Your role is to take care of these monsters and use their powers to keep the base running.
As your pet monsters evolves, they will uncover new skills, moods and resources.
But beware, monsters have a mind of their own and can be dangerous!

Monster Pet Simulator
Take care of your monsters and watch them grow.
Keep a monster happy, feed it, play with it, and make sure it doesn't get lost for too long.

Base Management
Use your monsters to run and upgrade the facility.
Generate resources, power machines, and keep the lights on.
Can you keep the base running and uncover the secrets of the facility?

Uncover the story
As you progress through the game, you will uncover the story of the facility and the monsters within.
How did you end up here? What is the purpose of the facility?

Complex simulation
The facility stands in a delicate balance. Your input is required to manage and optimize all these interlocking systems.

title: Echo of Prypiat
description:
게임 정보
"프리피야티의 메아리" - 체르노빌 배제 구역의 분위기에 플레이어를 몰입시키는 매혹적인 워킹 시뮬레이터로, 이 잊혀진 땅에 버려진 사람들의 모든 공포와 두려움을 전달합니다. 이 게임은 플레이어가 이 신비로운 장소의 분위기를 느낄 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

체르노빌의 금지 구역을 탐험하며 위험과 수수께끼에 맞서세요. 당신의 인내와 결단력을 시험하는 시련을 겪으세요. 구역의 어두운 구석에 숨어있는 미지의 존재와 마주할 준비를 하세요.

음향 효과와 시각적 효과를 통해 체르노빌의 몰입감 있는 분위기를 제공합니다. 첨단 그래픽을 사용하여 배제 구역을 현실감 있게 재현합니다.

title: Venusville
description:
게임 정보
Venusville은 금성 구름 속에 도시를 건설하려는 우주 정착민들을 이끄는 도시 건설 게임입니다.
게임에서 당신은 기지 건축가이자 관리자 역할을 맡아 식민지 주민들에게 떠다니는 도시를 확장하고 생존에 필요한 구조물을 건설하는 방법을 지시합니다. 온도와 압력을 관리하여 생존하는 동시에 산소, 식량 및 물을 지속적으로 공급해야 합니다.
정착민들은 혹독한 환경에서 에너지를 수집하고, 물을 추출하고, 구름을 채굴하고, 식량을 재배하고, 로봇을 제작하며 완전히 자급자족할 수 있는 기지를 건설해야 합니다. 언제든 완전히 실패할 수 있는 위험이 도사리고 있습니다.
부력과 균형
당신은 금성 하늘에서 도시의 안정성을 관리하는 중요한 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
도시의 다양한 구조물은 각기 다른 무게와 부력 수준을 가지고 있어, 세심한 관리가 필요합니다. 불균형이 발생하면 도시가 뒤집히거나 구조적으로 붕괴되는 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다. 배터리 및 엔진과 같은 무거운 요소는 균형을 유지하기 위해 전략적으로 배치해야 합니다.
부력 유지는 단순히 균형의 문제가 아니라 생존 전략이기도 합니다. 금성 대기의 깊은 곳에 존재하는 위험한 온도와 압력으로부터 도시를 보호하기 때문입니다. 이러한 섬세한 균형 유지는 도시를 확장하고 식민지 주민들의 안전을 보장하는 핵심입니다.

title: Rubedo: The Occult Dawn
description:
게임 정보
당신은 50년 이상 전에 모든 마법을 제거한 무자비한 마녀 사냥의 유일한 생존자입니다. 감옥에서 평생을 보낸 후, 왕실의 협정이 당신을 풀어주고 다가오는 침략에 대비해 왕국의 최후의 수단으로 한때 봉인된 혼돈을 해방시키는 임무를 맡깁니다. 신비한 잠재력을 다시 연결하면서 중요한 선택에 직면하게 됩니다. 고대 영혼, 몬스터, 저주를 통해 혼돈을 일으킬 것인가, 아니면 왕국에 더 부드러운 접근이 필요할 것인가?

문자 시전 기술을 마스터하세요
혁신적인 턴제 전투는 9개의 연금술 기호를 30개의 강력한 상징으로 결합하여 사람이나 더 끔찍한 무언가를 신속하게 무찌를 수 있게 합니다. 모든 기호를 잠금 해제하고 그들의 창의적인 조합을 통해 새로운 전략을 개발하세요.
마법은 결코 완전히 사라지지 않습니다. 올바른 의식은 자비롭거나 혼란스러운 힘을 확실히 되돌려줄 것입니다. 잠자는 기념비를 살아있는 마법의 장소로 바꾸세요.
[/img] [h2]그리고 더 많은...[/h2] [list] [*][b]풍부한 오픈 월드[/b] - [i]규모보다 내용. 루베도의 세계에서는 모든 공간이 목적을 가지고 있습니다.[/i] [*][b]가입 가능한 파벌[/b] - [i]3개의 파벌 중 하나에 가입하여 파벌 특유의 갑옷, 퀘스트 및 스토리 라인을 잠금 해제하세요.[/i] [*][b]선택이 중요한 이야기[/b] - [i]당신은 복수 임무에 있는가, 아니면 왕국을 새로운 마법의 황금 시대로 이끌 것인가?[/i] [*][b]선택 기반 캐릭터 진행[/b] - [i]당신의 속성은 사용자 인터페이스 클릭을 통해 성장하지 않습니다. 대신, 대화 및 퀘스트 선택이 당신의 본성: 혼돈, 자비 또는 진실을 결정합니다.[/i] [*][b]연금술[/b] - [i]연금술은 단순히 물약을 만드는 것이 아닙니다. 그것은 세계와 자신을 변형시키는 것입�
커스터마이즈 가능한 지하 필사실에서 마법의 질서를 재건하고, 과거의 신비로운 영광을 되찾으십시오. 새로운 추종자들을 찾아 전환시키고, 다시 한번 당신의 전당에 찬송이 울려 퍼지게 하십시오.

title: Ultimate Jello Party
description:
게임 정보



Ultimate Jello Party is a multiplayer party game that combines elements of card, board and minigame battles. Challenge up to 3 friends and mess up the game with your strategies! Earn coins, plan your moves, collect and accumulate jellies to become the big winner.

With unmatched creative powers and an incorrigible addiction to video games, Mr. Gelatin prepares to raise the level of his projects. With the vast G-4MER knowledge in his hands, he emerges as Master of the Games and summons important figures from across the Universe to compete in his most intriguing creations. To the winner, a wish come true!

Your cards are more than just tools: they allow you to navigate the board, grant upgrades and sabotage your opponents. At each turn start, players receive a lootbox containing basic resources for their moves and, in the course of the match, they can direct their routes to find the mysterious Shopkeeper and buy cards of varying prices and rarities. Surprise is a constant factor andyou never know what crazy turns a match can take!

At the end of each round, players engage in an exciting mini-game where they control charismatic new characters in special challenges. The rules vary, but the goal is the same: stay in first place and conquer great powers! But remember: with great powers come great responsibilities... (like getting in the way of your friends)

title: A Byte War
description:
게임 정보

Byte War는 실시간 전략 게임으로 다른 차원에서 온 기계의 위협에 맞서 블록 기반 기계 종족을 이끌게 됩니다.블록으로 기지를 건설하고 패턴을 형성하여 건물을 지어 자원 수확, 유닛 스폰, 영향력 확장 등 필요한 사항을 커버하세요.적을 정복하고, 영향력을 확장하여 지도를 지배하거나 자신의 땅에서 버티며 적이 방어를 뚫고 들어오지 못하게 하는 것까지, 다양한 엔딩이 있는 임무에서 자신만의 길을 찾아보세요.



Byte War에서는 기본적인 건물 블록인 블록을 지을 능력이 있습니다.타일 기반 격자에 여러 패턴으로 지어서 특정한 모양과 기능을 갖춘 건물을 만드세요.특정 모양의 블록을 사용하여 퍼즐 조각처럼 배치하여 상상한 대로 자신만의 기지를 만드세요.

각 건물은 꼭대기의 조종 장치로 제어됩니다.예:
- 본부는 주요 건물로 특정 활성화 스킬 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 자원 수확기는 스폰 및 자동 수확 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다.
- 유닛 스포너는 유닛을 특정 목적지로 보내는 조종 장치를 가지고 있습니다

이 필수 건물을 지으려면 블록을 특정 패턴으로 배열해야 합니다.각각 전략 옵션을 강화하는 고유한 기능을 선보이는 어려운 임무에 걸쳐 진행해 나아가며 새로운 패턴과 건물 기능을 잠금 해제하세요.



영향력을 확장하는 것은 주변 지역을 장악하는 데 있어 중요한 메커니즘 중 하나입니다.여러분의 영향력은 영구적인 영향력 스팟을 생성하는 본부부터 시작되며, 도달 범위를 전략적으로 계속 확장하려면 영향력 확산기를 배치하여 주변 지역에 대한 지배력을 강화하세요.

여러분의 영향력 아래에 있는 지역은 다음과 같은 큰 이점을 제공합니다.
- 기지가 제대로 작동되도록 유지합니다
- 피해를 당한 유닛을 치유합니다.
- 무기화하여 적 건물을 비활성화하고 적 유닛에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다
- 새로운 자원 매장물을 생성합니다
- 지도의 기존 매장물을 변환합니다

하지만 조심하세요. 적이 자신의 영향력을 사용하여 반격할 수 있으니까요.



모든 임무에서 자신만의 길을 선택하여 고유한 여정과 결과를 만들어 내세요.

본 게임은 다양한 임무 유형을 제공하며 각각 구별되는 도전 과제와 전략 목표를 선사합니다.압도적인 적 부대에게서 달아나거나, 생존하기 위해 무자비한 침략을 물리치거나, 우격다짐으로 적 영토를 정복하거나, 자신의 영향력을 확장하여 지형을 지배하는 자신을 보게 될 것입니다.
각 임무 유형은 여러 후속 임무로 갈라져 나가며 특정 엔딩으로 종결되는 다양한 길로 이끕니다.

title: Glintland
description:
게임 정보
A shadow drifts over Glintland, stealing pigs and disrupting its harmony across the land. After years apart, your sister Clara reaches out for help, setting you on a path to join her Nightstone Academy, forge magical items, and create production networks.
In short play sessions, Glintland offers a tile-placing game with a simplified reduced world you can relax and immerse yourself in. Any free minute can be used to leave reality behind to take on a new fantasy challenge. Fulfill the needs of the people and use your gained experience to unlock new exciting tiles and ways to play.
Deck of Tiles
Each game begins with a randomly shuffled tile deck. Then draw tiles into your hand. Look at your open jobs and find a good spot to start with your first tile in the world. After you have placed your first tile, each further tile has to be placed on a valid connecting spot. Once your hand is empty, draw again up to your hand limit and continue tiling until your job is fulfilled and you are happy with your settlement or challenge yourself in Trials and Favours and keep playing until you are out of tiles.

title: Death Remains
description:
게임 정보
WHAT IS DEATH REMAINS?
Death Remains is a relentless open-world survival game where the dead never rest—and neither do you. Face off against overwhelming zombie hordes and ever-shifting factions in a world where permadeath forces you to choose wisely at every turn.
HOW YOU PLAY!
Whether you dive into online multiplayer on player-run servers hosting up to 100 players or team up in local co-op for up to four, the challenge is real. Roam vast landscapes where day gives way to night, winter encroaches, and nature slowly reclaims deserted cities. Experience dynamic events such as reactivating power plants and transforming trains into mobile bases for transport and supplies.
Your survival hinges on every choice—from scavenging for scarce resources and crafting weapons to constructing fortified shelters by felling trees and sawing wood. Navigate treacherous terrain in physics-driven vehicles while honing your skills in carpentry, cooking, farming, fishing, and more—all while battling hunger, thirst, illness, and other hardships.
