title: Atomcraft
description:
게임 정보
모든 픽셀이 물리적으로 시뮬레이션되는 세계에서 건설하고, 전투하고, 탐험하세요! 우주의 모든 원소를 수집하고, 나만의 무기를 제작하며, 프로시저 방식으로 생성된 행성들로 이루어진 태양계에서 외계 보스들과 맞서 싸우세요 — 무엇이든 가능합니다!
당신은 우주의 모든 원소를 손에 넣는 궁극의 도전에 도전할 준비가 되었나요?
---
Trailer Song: Atlantis · Audionautix ℗ Creative Commons Attribution 4.0

title: POLY IMPULSE
description:
게임 정보
POLY IMPULSE 는 미니멀하고 빠르게 진행되는 무브먼트 FPS로, 레벨을 통과하기 위해 다채로운 다면체를 쏴야 합니다. 정확도 또한 매우 중요하므로 이 게임으로 조준력을 시험해 보세요!
특징:
• 네온 그린 아이코사헤드론을 쏘며 충동을 느끼고 속도를 높여보세요.
• 레벨을 스피드 런하고 자신 및 전 세계 순위표와 경쟁하여 자신이 최고임을 증명하세요.

title: Vignettes: The Dream City
description:
게임 정보
In recent nights, your dreams have been haunted by a city of unknown origin. It stands as an enigma to you, with parts of its design and structure seemingly mocking the familiarities of human architecture. Feeling drawn to something, you begin exploring the city.



Vignettes: The Dream City is a dungeon crawler set in the surreal city you've been dreaming about, ceaselessly, for months. Throughout your exploration of the dream you could meet other dreamers, find rare loot, discover unknowable truths, and damage your psyche forever. All within the dream world, of course.

title: Combo Haven
description:
게임 정보
Combo Haven is a game that aims to distill the most exciting aspect of platform fighting games: doing cool combos! Without having to worry about putting in countless hours of effort or outplaying opponents with years of practice, in Combo Haven anyone can experience the satisfying thrill of landing a nasty combo.
If you are someone who likes to be challenged, rest assured. Underneath the relatively forgiving and easy to learn controls and physics of Combo Haven, lies a significant level of mechanical depth, for those who aim to beat the developer high scores and reach the top of the leaderboards.
Combo Haven is currently in development. I hope to release a polished free demo to Steam by mid 2025, and the full version by the end of 2025. The demo will include 4-5 levels, with one playable character.
The full version will include 20+ unique levels, and 3 different playable characters, as well as global leaderboards, replay saving features, and an original soundtrack.

title: Gods of the Arena Dungeon
description:
게임 정보
Hectic PvPvE with unique non-instanced dungeon bosses and bot support
Extensive class tree system culminating in 16+ different endgame classes
Boasts team modes with unique class interaction
Items and specializations allow for build customization
Numerous game modes and maps

title: Brotherhood
description:
게임 정보
They are billions. You are alone.
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman.

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.
Steal the weapon and obliterate them.
Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way.
A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.
The Brotherhood is a retro-shooter with classic Wolfenstein 3D style. You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience.
Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.
There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs.

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that.
Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces.
You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.
No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.
Destroy Them All!

title: Midnight Run
description:
게임 정보
Midnight Run is a casual RPG game where you play as Matt, a regular guy who was just picked to perform a late-night food run of good eats for his friends. There's only one problem. Matt doesn't have much cash, and items he has to get isn't cheap. Not to mention, he doesn't have a car so walking through the city at night is his only choice.


Navigate through the city while finding ways to either earn more cash or get free food. Keep in mind, the city is a strange place at night, so Matt has to be on his guard as he works on completing his food run. Trying to avoid oncoming traffic? No problem. Did you find yourself feeding hungry ghost? Yeah, that's about right. A Giant sewer roaches staring at you as if you're its finest meal of the night? Sure, why not! It's all good when you're doing a Midnight Run.


Game Features:
Multiple endings
Lots of side quest
Tons of Achievements
Hours of gameplay
Game replayability
Encounter the P.D.P. (Powder Doughnut Police)

title: Return to Basic Killing
description:
게임 정보
Return to Basic Killing – An Old-School FPS with Brutal Action
Prepare for relentless, no-nonsense carnage in Return to Basic Killing, a hardcore old-school FPS.. Fast movement, deadly firefights, and secret-filled levels bring back the best of the '90s—modernized for today's shooter fans.
Trapped inside a heavily guarded Nazi fortress, you are Rebekah Razor, a battle-hardened soldier seeking revenge. Break out, blast your way through 30 intense levels, and uncover the horrors of a war-twisted world. Classic gunplay, advanced AI, and a gritty alternate history—are you ready to return to the basics?
🔥 Key Features 🔥
🩸 Classic FPS Action – Fast movement, brutal gunplay, and no hand-holding.
🗺 30 Action-Packed Levels – Huge maps filled with secrets, enemies, and intense fights.
🔫 Old-School Arsenal – Find weapons, loot ammo, and unleash mayhem.
🧠 Smart Enemy AI – Enemies react to sound, alerts, and your tactics.
🕵️ Secrets & Exploration – Hidden rooms, collectibles, and surprises in every level.
🎙 Dynamic Voiceovers – Your enemies will talk—and scream—as they fall.
💀 Multiple Game Modes – Play in Classic Mode or test your skills in Perma-Death Mode.
🌍 A Dark Alternate History
After World War II, history took a terrifying turn. Spain and Portugal joined the Axis. The Third Reich crushed Europe, defeated Britain, and signed a steel-fortified non-aggression pact with Stalin. The world is now divided:
☠ Nazi Europe – An oppressive empire of fear and control.
☭ Communist Asia – A powerhouse standing in opposition.
🗽 The Free World – A fragile alliance of neutral territories, including the USA.
Amid this chaos, one woman fights back.
🩸 Your Story – Escape or Die
You are Rebekah Razor, a war-hardened fighter from the International Brigades who fought fascism in Spain and WWII. Captured behind enemy lines, you've spent years imprisoned in a Nazi fortress hidden deep in the mountains, subjected to horrific experiments.
Now, an opportunity for escape arises. But between you and freedom stand guards, war machines, and monstrous experiments—the twisted results of Nazi science.

title: Into the Depths of Despair
description:
게임 정보
Into the Depths of Despair (ItDod)

I woke up in a room, but I was never asleep. The air is heavy, carrying a scent I can’t recognize. I see with eyes that are not my own, feel a body that doesn’t feel like mine.

The walls seem to breathe, the shadows shift when I’m not looking. There’s no sound except my own breathing—I am alone. Or am I?

Something is keeping me here. I don’t remember how I got to this place, but I know there must be a reason. Is there a way out? Or am I sinking deeper into despair?

title: My Little Kitty
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the game of 'My Little Kitty' This pet development game allows you to play the role of the owner of a kitten, take care of it, train it, and play games with it. In this fun filled game, you need to do various

Get coins offline, and other methods to establish and raise your pet cat.

My Little Kitty not only has cute and charming character images and delicate and smooth animations, but also rich gameplay and fun. You can interact and play with your kittens, feed them, dress up, and even ride cows, run parkour, and more. Each outfit has unique effects, such as feeding rewards, mobility, etc. You can gradually give your kitten unique traits and abilities, and earn more coins and rewards.

title: Elemdian
description:
게임 정보

전설적인 엘레젬은 자연의 에너지를 흡수하는 특별한 보석입니다. 이 보석들은 상상할 수 없는 능력을 해방하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어낼 열쇠를 가지고 있습니다. 엘레젬을 통해 아루마는 마법 주문을 시전하고 그녀의 강력한 주먹을 강화할 수 있습니다.


아루마는 그녀의 늑대 유산으로부터 부여받은 특별한 능력을 가지고 있습니다: 원하는 때에 장엄한 늑대로 변신할 수 있는 힘입니다. 이 놀라운 선물은 그녀에게 풍경을 빠르게 질주하고, 협곡을 뛰어넘으며, 왕국 전역에 흩어져 있는 숨겨진 비밀을 드러낼 수 있는 능력을 제공합니다.



전력 질주하고, 높은 곳을 오르거나 엘레젬의 힘을 활용하여 순간이동하거나 마법의 섬을 날아다니세요. 숨겨진 경이로움을 발견하고 모록의 비밀을 풀어내세요.



적을 물리치거나 채광 지점에서 채굴하거나 상점에서 구입한 재료를 모아 주문 제작의 예술을 마스터하세요. 주문 제작의 예술은 엘레젬의 에너지를 활용하여 다양한 재료를 결합함으로써 새로운 주문을 해제하거나 새로운 재료를 제작할 수 있습니다.

title: Hacker's Life
description:
게임 정보
Hacker's Life is a game where you become a hacker and make your own malware. You can infect devices all over the world and join forces with other hackers to launch bigger attacks. See your malware spread and your fame grow, but be careful not to get caught by the authorities.



Name your malware whatever you want, pick its type, and select the device you want to infect. Whether it's a PC, a console, or a smart device you want to infect, you have many options to choose from. Customize how your malware affects different parts of the device and add special abilities to make it more unique and unpredictable. Unleash your creativity and see what kind of havoc you can cause with your malware.


Collect victim's IP addresses and passwords and use them for your own benefit. You can either sell them on the Dark Store a shady online marketplace, or hack into their files and steal their secrets. How far will you go in this cybercrime adventure?


If you want to be a great hacker, you need to keep learning new skills. Skill Up website, where you can find all kinds of courses to improve your hacking abilities. You can learn how to make different kinds of malware, how to target different devices, and how to add new functions to your malware. The more you learn, the more powerful your malware will be. You will be able to create the most destructive malware ever and become the best hacker in the world!


Dark store, is the underground online market where hackers trade their skills and secrets for money. Whether you want to unleash a quick global malware or just make a quick buck, you can find what you need here. Buy ready-made malware from other hackers or sell your own creations to the highest bidder. Or get access to user data that will help you craft malware with special abilities. But be careful, the dark store is not a safe place, and you never know who you can trust.


If you want to be a famous hacker with global known attacks, you can't do it alone. You need to team up with other hackers who share your goals and skills. Together, you can pull off bigger and better hacks that target specific organizations. You can hack the power grid, erase data from big companies' cloud storage, or disrupt the communication networks. It's fun to cause chaos with your hacker buddies. But watch out, this is not a game, you have to obey the group rules and do your part or face serious consequences.

title: Convenient: Fiend
description:
게임 정보
Dig up graves to steal from the dead while you escape graveyard security and run from the legendary Oldlake Wendigo.
Gameplay:

Dig up graves!
Low poly PS1 style
Survive terrifying monsters
Discover hidden secrets
The continuation of Convenient


Survive

Quickly before security catches you. You're at the Oldlake Cemetery to loot graves and make some money. Find the gravestones with the names written in your notebook and dig them up while staying out of sight. If you are spotted, make quick decisions while being chased to survive. Find hiding spots and stay out of sight until the coast is clear. Security guards aren't the only thing you'll be running from so keep your eyes peeled.




Find VHS tapes around the graveyard to uncover the mystery hiding in the cemetery. Instead of watching VHS tapes, you live them. Solve puzzles and experience the story yourself. You may be a grave robber, but there's more going on here than just a few missing bodies. Discover the birth of the Oldlake Wendigo and how to stop it.



The origins of , the short horror game made by LunaApps.

title: Sixth Sense
description:
게임 정보
Sixth Sense is a stealth-driven, deduction-based battle royale where knowledge is your greatest weapon. Set in a pre-historic settlement, players take on the roles of cunning thieves, enigmatic rangers, and arcane tricksters, hunting their target while evading their own assassin. Find dead bodies, hire spies, and use your Sixth Sense—because in this game, the last one standing is the one who saw it coming.
INVISIBILITY
Vanish into thin air with Invisibility, the perfect tool for escaping danger or setting up the perfect ambush. While hidden from all eyes—including spies and bystanders—your Assassin gains a heightened Sixth Sense, making every disappearance a risky gamble. Use it wisely—because the unseen can still be hunted
SIXTH SENSE
Sixth Sense transforms disappearance into a trail to be followed. When your target vanishes, you lose sight of them—but gain an uncanny awareness of their presence. A mysterious force pulls you closer, narrowing the hunt without ever revealing their exact location. Trust your instincts, close the distance, and strike before they slip away again.

title: Hyperspace Nebula
description:
게임 정보
Embark on a perilous journey through the cosmos in "Hyperspace Nebula," a captivating 2D space roguelike game that will challenge your space battle skills. Explore different sectors of the universe, battle cosmic horrors, and uncover the mysteries of the galaxy in this epic space adventure.

🚀 Key Features 🚀

🌌 Procedurally Generated Universe:
Every playthrough is a unique and unpredictable experience. Traverse a vast and ever-changing galaxy, each sector brimming with hidden dangers, valuable treasures, and enigmatic anomalies.

🛠️ Ship Customization:
Craft and customize your spaceship to suit your playstyle. Unlock an array of modular upgrades, weapons, and equipment, allowing you to adapt to the challenges of deep space exploration and combat.

🌟 Permadeath and Progression:
Prepare for a relentless challenge as death is permanent in "Hyperspace Nebula." But fear not, as each defeat brings valuable lessons and unlocks new abilities for future runs, making you stronger with every attempt.

🌠 Cosmic Battles:
Engage in thrilling battles against formidable alien species, rogue AI, and cosmic forces that guard the secrets of the universe. Utilize your ship's unique abilities and your own tactical prowess to emerge victorious.

🔮 Dynamic Events:
Encounter a variety of dynamic events that can alter the course of your journey, from cosmic storms to alien encounters. Adapt, strategize, and make critical decisions to survive.

🌌 Endless Replayability:
With a vast galaxy to explore and countless challenges to overcome, "Hyperspace Nebula" offers endless replayability. Every run is a fresh adventure with new surprises and dangers.

👨‍🚀 Become a Space Legend:
Do you have what it takes to become a legendary cosmic explorer? Test your skills and forge your legacy among the stars in "Hyperspace Nebula."

Embark on an unforgettable journey through the cosmos, where survival depends on your wits, adaptability, and mastery of space combat. Explore the unknown, battle cosmic adversaries, and become a legend in "Hyperspace Nebula." Are you ready to venture into the stars and face the mysteries of the universe?

title: Duskpunk
description:
게임 정보

Dredgeport is spiralling out of control. Gangs rule the slums, corruption trumps the law, and corpses of the war-dead are burned daily for fuel. You are an ex-soldier, mistaken for dead and shipped back to Dredgeport for processing. After a narrow escape, you find yourself alone in the guts of the city, with only two things to your name: your life and your sanity. Keeping both will prove a challenge.


Inspired by tabletop RPGs and narrative adventure games like Citizen Sleeper, Duskpunk finds a balance between challenge and freedom, tracking your health, energy and stress as you try to survive. Make lasting choices that determine the city’s fate. Develop skills to distinguish yourself in your chosen field of work. Earn a crust, explore the city, make alliances and escape your traumatic past.


Dredgeport plays host to characters with rich backstories and murky motivations. Some care for you or the city; others are in it for themselves, but will pay well. Choose your allies wisely. They will be part of your fate whether you like it or not.

title: Memory Rewind
description:
게임 정보
Step into the life of a self-proclaimed detective. Along with your quirky assistant Olivina, take on a seemingly ordinary case, until you unravel its hidden twists and turns that pull you through a thrilling, unique story.
Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant
Diverse cast of characters
Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters
Stylized, hand-drawn CG for players to unlock and collect

title: Leap Hero
description:
게임 정보
The princess has been captured! Step into the armored boots of a frog and use your tongue as a grappling hook to beat challenging levels. Encounter quirky characters and dive into this thrilling rescue mission.



A simple but humorous story with lots of funny and strange characters.
Simple controls, but difficult to master.
4 different worlds with 300+ stages/screens and of course... some hidden secrets.
You're a FROG

title: Morgan: Metal Detective
description:
게임 정보
Morgan: Metal Detective is a first-person, cozy metal-detecting adventure game. It combines exploration, creativity, and a cozy atmosphere into a heartwarming adventure.



Everyone on the island is searching for something, Morgan must search the island with her metal detector to find these lost treasures. Each of these quests asks you to engage and really think about the potential location of the lost item. On returning, each of these characters rewards Morgan with a unique cassette tape which you can listen to whilst you’re exploring. This music and the detailed audio soundscape throughout Glasden helps to place you in this magical environment. Lose yourself in the quests and lovely audio.


Use you metal detector to search for hidden treasures (and maybe some rubbish) hidden just below the surface

As you explore the island using your trusty metal detector, you will find many types of items hidden underground. You can take these items to Cenna’s shop, exchange them for credits and purchase new sticker packs and film for your instant camera. You can then decorate the journal with these stickers and the photos you’ve taken. Express yourself in the in-game journal.

The game features a brilliant original score and fantastic voice acting, featuring BAFTA nominated Charlotte McBurney as the titular Morgan, who voices Amicia in the A Plague Tale series of games.

title: Hype Me For Your Life!
description:
게임 정보
Show off your rhythm in a musical battle where the music decides your fate! Face the God of Time and capture souls to the beat of the music to survive.
🎵 UNIQUE RHYTHM MECHANICS
Each soul is a note falling on one of the 7 strings of your board. To capture them, you must press buttons with both hands as if you were playing real musical chords.
Left Hand: Selects the range of strings where you can capture souls.
Right Hand: Chooses the exact string within the selected range and plays at the right moment.
Double Challenge: Simultaneous notes and strategic combinations will put your skills to the test.
⚔️ USE MUSIC TO ATTACK
You can’t attack your enemy directly… but you can make them drop their guard!
Capture notes in succession to build up your Hype Combo, and once you reach the max level, unleash a devastating attack.
Master the rhythm to break defenses and overcome obstacles.
Prepare for epic boss fights with unique patterns and surprising mechanics.

title: Tangled Crisis
description:
게임 정보
Search, dodge, find and collect in this minimalist score based maze game with limited vision, before the timer runs out!
Mechanics 
BOOST: Gain a temporarily boost of speed and invulnerability to pass through hazards.
VISION: Enlarge your vision and reveal hidden paths.
BUILD SCORE: Collect coins and try to beat your previous run.
FIND KEYS: Search for keys to reach the exit.

title: NANOVOID
description:
게임 정보
In NANOVOID it's not just about the shooting - it's about outsmarting your enemies. Customize and command your modular ship where each piece adds a unique function and can be the difference between victory and defeat. But beware, your enemies aren't just a health bar. Their ships also use the same modular system, meaning you'll need to strategically target their ship's components to disable them effectively.



Engage in intense battles where the laws of physics reign supreme. Every movement, every shot fired, every explosion generates forces that can be used to your advantage - or lead to your downfall if mismanaged.

Features:

Modular Ships: Build your own spaceship from various modules, each with its own function and characteristics.
Realistic Physics: All actions have consequences, and the realistic physics engine brings a new level of depth to space combat.
Tactical Combat: Outmaneuver your enemies, target their weak points, and use the environment to your advantage.
Epic Encounters: Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses.

In this 2D tactical space shooter, you'll engage in fast-paced battles against deadly enemies and bosses, using strategy and planning to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Utilize your skills and reflexes to take down powerful bosses, and immerse yourself in a beautifully designed universe with stunning visuals and special effects.

Fly and fight using intuitive WSAD controls and mouse aim. The open space offers strategic possibilities, allowing you to retreat and recover your shields before re-engaging.

title: JETPACK BIRDIE
description:
게임 정보
JETPACK BIRDIE is a fast-pased third-person shooter that takes the fun and freedom of jetpack flights to a whole new level. Use its power to ignore the ground. Find and use wind zones to gain more speed, or risk using accelerated flight, which can overheat your jetpack and cause it to explode.
You are Birdie, a young man on the run from the most powerful gang in the city above the clouds. Evade enemies in a thrilling chase and carve your way to a free future. Cooperate with rebel group called Red Poppy Society and discover the dark secrets of global politics.
Your journey will fuse the short sections of NEON WHITE, classic shooter fun of the original MAX PAYNE, multi-functional weapon of CONTROL and movement that you have never seen before. Master your skills and unlock secrets in highly replayable environments to become an unstoppable force.
Features
Highly enjoyable movement with a lot of depth.
Short levels with high replayability, reminiscent of speedrun shooters.
Includes arcade mode with special challenges, leaderboard and ranking system.
Concentrated action story set in an alternate world after the collapse of the Great War.
An old school shooter with no covers or unnecessary pauses.

title: The First Mine
description:
게임 정보
The First Mine is a turn based building, strategy and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine with your population by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different tasks and random events.
Play as a single player or in multiplayer mode with up to 4 friends
Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources
Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold
Don't let tasks and game events distract you
Play alone in single player mode or play together with up to 4 friends in a competitive multi player mode. There are different game sizes and difficulty levels to choose from, as well as several characters with unique traits for varied gameplay.
Each round you have to cleverly place and group a new random resource tile and upgrade your existing tiles as needed. Placing a new tile end the current round, mine gold in your mine and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.

title: Umbratica Tactics
description:
게임 정보
Umbratica Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines the precise tactical combat of “Into the Breach” and the strategic deck crafting of “Slay the Spire”. Lead a squad of vampire slayers as you banish the fiendish creatures that have taken over the cursed land of Umbratica.


Precise no-RNG tactical turn-based combat: Deploy your squad of vampire slayers in a series of fast-paced grid-based combats. Purge this land from the ghouls, fiends, and other deadly monstrosities that inhabit the night!


Strategic roguelike deckbuilding: Your squad abilities are determined by your deck! So as you make your way through the cursed land of Umbratica you’ll gather new cards. You’ll use these as your squad's attacks, actions, and abilities in combat!


As you play each run you’ll have several options over the way your squad fights. First, you’ll select the heroes that’ll go on your journey, each has their own set of available cards! As your journey progresses you’ll find different cards and you’ll upgrade them to further customize your playstyle, you’ll find powerful ancient relics that affect the functioning of the whole squad, and also mysterious items that can boost (and nerf) individual hero's stats and also add special status during combat. Strategically combine all of these elements to express your playstyle fully!

Each time you dare to adventure into the gothic land of Umbratica the layout will be different. Different combat stages and rewards, different text-based events, different cards, relics, and items. No two runs are the same!

title: Appearances
description:
게임 정보

게임은 아직 개발 중이며 따라서 변경될 수 있습니다. 저희 Discord 서버를 팔로우하고 게임을 위시리스트에 추가하십시오!
악몽의 밤
Appearances는 1인용의 1인칭 공포 및 퍼즐 게임으로, 당신은 가족 별장에서 자신을 돌보는 베이비 시터와 함께 어린 수지 역할을 합니다. 밤중에 이상하고 날카로운 소리가 들리는데, 이는 당신을 깨우기 위해 특별히 디자인된 것 같습니다. 첫 번째 본능은 시터를 찾는 것인데, 생생한 상상력을 가진 아이에게 밤은 무서울 수 있습니다. 할머니가 당신을 위해 만든 음악 상자가 최고의 위안입니다. 그러나 곧 옆에 초자연적인 무언가가 숨어 있음을 발견할 것이며, 이 음악 상자는 단순히 음악을 연주하는 것 이상의 목적을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 가족의 과거를 밝히고 이 악몽 같은 유령을 끝내야 합니다.
평행 세계
현대적인 가족 별장으로 진화하고 이 복도와 방들의 미로를 탐험하십시오. 그러나 신비한 축복을 따라가면 당신이 괴롭히는 존재가 거주하는 평행 세계에 접근할 수 있습니다. 분위기 변화와 새로운 길이 당신에게 열릴 것입니다. 이 기회를 잡아 탈출하고 추가적인 비밀을 발견하세요.
할머니의 음악 상자, 그 음악은 당신을 악몽에서 끌어내는 유일한 방법입니다. 이 음악 상자를 사용하여 이 불온한 밤에 당신을 따라 다니는 존재를 찾고, 걸리지 마십시오.
퍼즐을 풀어 가족의 비밀을 밝혀내고 진실을 드러내십시오. 그러나 항상 기억하십시오. 당신은 이해할 수 없는 존재에게 계속해서 쫓기고 있는 어린이일 뿐입니다.
이 게임은 영화와 비디오 게임의 공포 작품 및 탈출 게임에서 영감을 받았습니다!

title: Dreamians: Card Battle
description:
게임 정보
드리미안즈: 카드 게임은 전투 중에 진화하고 전투의 흐름을 예기치 못한 방식으로 변경할 수있는 크리쳐를 갖춘 Roguelike Deckbuilder입니다. 게임에는 반 드래곤 반 개 인 Dragnis, 파란 늑대 Wolfae 및 악몽 박쥐 Kalek과 같은 세 가지 주요 드리미안즈가 포함되어 있습니다. 각각은 게임에서 제시된 도전에 대처하기 위한 고유 한 능력과 솔루션을 갖추고 있습니다.
드리미안즈: 카드 게임에서 플레이어는 우리가 잠을 잘 때 또는이 세계에 연결되기위한 특수 기계에 넣을 때만 액세스 할 수있는 드리미안즈의 세계로 이동합니다. 이것은 잠재우기를 유도하고 강력한 영혼 프로젝션을 강제로 수행함으로써만 액세스 할 수 있습니다.
드리미안즈의 세계는 모든 가능한 꿈을 빼앗으려는 무시무시한 Oníricos 여행자들에 의해 침략 받고 있습니다. 플레이어와 그의 드리미안즈는 숲, 산, 부서진 도시, 불길 한 길 및 심지어 왜곡 된 차원을 통과하는 5 개의 지도에서 치열한 전투를 승리해야합니다.
숫자 -
+100 - 게임에 사용되는 카드입니다. 이들은 공격, 방어 및 특수 카드입니다.
+40 - 드리미안즈의 속성을 수정하는 드림 쥬얼.

title: Another Day with You
description:
게임 정보

You have a date to make! But, it looks like you got there too early... Explore a quiet corner of the bustling city by interacting with locals, playing games at the arcade, fishing, and much more. Leave your date waiting, or fail to impress them with your natural charisma, and you'll be left on "read".



However, walk the walk and talk the talk, and you may have just secured yourself a second date!

There are many minigames to find around the city. These include fishing, playing arcade games, hide and seek, and more! The activities you choose to partake in will affect the available topics of conversations with your date. Pay close attention, as your date may have some questions for you regarding these activities.


Whether you are spending the day in the arcade or picking out flowers for your potential lover, . Spend your time wisely to get the most out of your day. If you miss out on something, there's always , and another chance for love.

title: Cyber City Clash
description:
게임 정보
Cyber City Clash - Unleash the Future of Fighting!

Welcome to the neon-lit streets of the future - Cyber City Clash, the future in 2.5D arcade fighting! Immerse yourself in a dystopian cyberpunk world where every battle echoes through the towering skyscrapers. Engage in fierce combat as you navigate through the diverse districts of the Cyber City. Will you rise to the top and become the ultimate cybernetic warrior?

Gorgeous Cyberpunk Arenas:
Explore the vividly detailed stages scattered across the Cyber City. From the bustling marketplaces to the dark alleyways, each location is a visual masterpiece that sets the stage for epic clashes. Immerse yourself in the cyberpunk atmosphere as you battle for supremacy.

Choose Your Cyber Fighter:
Select your avatar from a roster of ten cybernetically enhanced fighters, each with their own unique characteristics and combat styles. From swift assassins to hulking bruisers, find the perfect match for your playstyle and dominate the competition.

Varied Game Modes:
Whether you're a solo warrior or prefer to challenge a friend, Cyber City Clash has you covered. Dive into single-player vs AI for an immersive story-driven experience or engage in intense 2-player local battles. Take the fight online with the Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality for lag-free, competitive showdowns.

Accessible Controls, Deep Gameplay:
Experience the best of both worlds with a simplified control system that welcomes beginners and casual fighters while offering the depth that experts crave. Master the art of cyber combat with our tutorial mode, ensuring you're ready to face any opponent in the Cyber City.

Adaptive AI and Skill Settings:
Tailor the challenge to your liking with an adjustable AI difficulty setting. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned fighter, Cyber City Clash can be adjusted to your skill level, ensuring every battle is a thrilling experience.

Stunning 4K Visuals:
Witness the future in breathtaking detail with Cyber City Clash's stunning 4K visuals (on supported hardware). Every punch, kick, and explosion is a feast for the eyes, delivering a visual spectacle that matches the intensity of the battles themselves.




Features:

* Fight across multiple stages based in various locations in the cyberpunk city, each rendered in gorgeous detail.
* Engage in combat with your choice from ten cyber fighters each with their own characteristics.
* Single player vs AI game mode.
* Player vs Player local multiplayer mode.
* Online Player vs Player mode, featuring rollback netcode functionality (planned during early access period).
* Simplified control system, move sets and combos make it great for beginners or casual fighters as well as experts alike.
* Tutorial mode that introduces the fundamentals of fighting in Cyber City Clash (planned during early access period).
* AI difficulty setting to adjust the game to your skill level
* Stunning visuals, rendered in 4K on supported hardware.

title: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
description:
게임 정보


Never ignore the past, for it will always come back and bite.

Three months have passed since Dawn's transformation. Her time in Providence remains peaceful, but Mar, the demon king and Lucia's father, is approaching.
His presence will change everything, and not everyone will leave Providence unscathed.



Dawn is now a zombie! While her journey to transition is over, her journey is not. She still has much to learn and accept from herself. Including a mysterious ghost friend which Dawn doesn't know whether they're friendly or quite hostile...


After using magic to bring her friend back, Lucia now has to pay the price. She became a talented alchemist, but can she find a cure before her father takes care of the problem his own way?


Long before Providence, Vulcan had found home in the demon realm. She became part of a family that will soon reunite, yet never seemed so far apart. She must now answer to the choices she made so long ago.


-About 40k words (3-4 hours of playtime)
-A linear story that explore Vulcan's past in the demon realm.
-Animated background and visual effects that give life to the environment!
-An entirely original soundtrack, now even richer!

title: Brick Buddies
description:
게임 정보
Partner up!
Brick Buddies is a turbulent couch co-op construction game for 2 players. Take control of one of the wobbly buddies, who both share a crane, and work together to construct epic buildings - or at least something that doesn’t immediately collapse. The higher you build, the more points you cash in. The shakier the whole thing gets, the more your friendship is put to the test! But beware - the innocent-looking sheep want to turn your building dreams into nightmares.
Co-operation is key!
Both buddies are responsible for different tasks on the job. Rotating the crane, picking up building blocks and honking away aggressive sheep have to be coordinated to finish the job on time and with minimal collateral damage.

Features, aka The Fun Stuff:

BRICK-TACULAR MECHANICS: Partner up and dive into the chaotic co-op construction fun with easy to learn but hard to master duo-crane controls. Communicate, stack building blocks and honk away the sweet but sneaky sheep. Try out different strategies on multiple maps and become pro-builders in career mode or construct the ultimate skyscraper in endless mode!




So, what are you waiting for? Grab your trusty sidekick (preferably human, not sheep), crash on that comfy couch, and let the bricklaying (and sheep-dodging) madness begin!
Ready, set, build!

title: Travel Knight Adventure
description:
게임 정보
Travel Knight Adventures is a fast paced first-person shooter adventure game that takes you on a journey through the pre sci-fi age.

You fall from the sky. Now it’s time to explore various settlements, castles, and cities. Delve into mysterious dungeons and tombs filled with hidden treasures, traps, and riddles waiting to be solved.

- More than 30 different weapons and magic items with unique mechanics
- Fast passed combat: mix between melee, throwing, kick, guns and magic
- More than 50 hand crafted location - no procedurally generation
- Move between islands by top-down controlled ship or travel through land by top-down horse

title: Death By Misstep
description:
게임 정보
Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a luxury cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.



- Breathe to the beat of the music so the cruise ship's robots don't detect you!
- Find a way to leave the ship without dying... Don't let them see you!
- Unveil the terrifying backstory of Jessica and the Samos cruise ship.

title: Stunt Xpress
description:
게임 정보
Become a delivery van driver. The best in the world.
Take part in internationally renowned delivery van driving championships.
Shoot your parcels (on time) into customer's homes like a marksman while performing gravity-defying stunts and being chased by god knows what.
Key Features


Van Stunts: Lift the wheels off the ground and nail some wild combos



Deliveries: Shoot parcels out of your van like an archer and hit the bullseye



: Explore procedurally generated maps & championships



Unlock new vans & cosmetics



Gain an edge over your rivals with a variety of unlockable tools

title: Slum Dweller
description:
게임 정보
슬럼 드웰러는 물리적으로 시뮬레이션된 몰입형 격투 게임으로, 플레이어가 평범한 슬럼가 주민이 되어 열악한 범죄 환경에서 살아남기 위해 노력하거나 현대 슬럼가에서 진행되는 지하 토너먼트에서 싸우는 스트리트 파이터가 되는 독특한 경험을 선사합니다. 혁신적인 전투 시스템을 통해 플레이어는 마우스나 조이스틱을 사용하여 캐릭터를 쉽게 제어할 수 있으며, 강력한 상대와 대결할 때마다 전투의 강렬함과 스릴을 느낄 수 있습니다.
물리 기반 전투: 모든 움직임이 중요한 비할 데 없는 전투 경험을 준비하세요. 모든 애니메이션과 기동은 사실감을 바탕으로 세심하게 설계되었습니다. 각 캐릭터는 무게, 힘, 지구력, 민첩성 등 고유한 속성을 가지고 있으며, 이는 이동, 피해 입히기, 타격 능력에 영향을 미칩니다.
로컬 멀티플레이: 옛날처럼 친구들과 화면을 공유하며 도전하세요!

title: Pandash
description:
게임 정보



Collect All Perks
The game lets you unlock and collect unique active and passive perks to use against your foes. Each perk brings new powers for even more combinations. Uncover new abilities and enhance your run with awesome possibilities.




Create different builds depending on your playstyle! Want to place traps over traps with more traps? Want to throw all of your projectiles at once - with huge explosions? Or just ram everything down in a melee build? That might be for you!




Explore the pixelart world and see where the run will bring you! Use the level and for your advatage and search the detours to get new rewards.




Pandash is a strategic roguelite that takes the player Ryu on a journey to a world where he receives support from a mysterious ghostly realm. In this Roguelite platformer, the player must traverse various areas to gradually free his world from the unknown threat.
During the game, the player can discover and use various perks to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles.

Each use of the perks disrupts the balance of the worlds. The current world and the ghostly realm must remain in harmony. If this harmony is disturbed, Ryu's strength falters and he will feel the direct effects. But perhaps there are also ways to take advantage of this imbalance...
The threatened world that Ryu travels through is full of secrets and dangers. The environment changes every time the player begins his journey. Each journey also means new challenges that he must face.

title: LoveSoTea
description:
게임 정보
Love your tea, love your life.

Gameplay:
Become more and more proficient in the art of tea by making a daily brew each day.
Advancing the story unlocks a variety of tea leaves to choose from, with a particular focus on black tea.
Schedule events in your calendar that can boost luck and wellbeing and live a happy, peaceful life.

In the kitchen:
Practise making tea in the kitchen and play with different heat levels, tea leaves, and brewing times.
Then run taste tests until you discover the perfect brew.

Story:
Meet Yoru, who has been told he only has a few months left to live, and Chihiro, a high school student who keeps insisting on treating him to some delicious tea, for reasons unknown.
The two slowly pass his remaining time together, not at a café but at home, sharing some peace and quiet - and a few laughs - at a tea time just for two.

Features:
Many café games have a lot of tasks, such as running the business and serving countless tables. In this game, you only serve one person.
Plus, you should be able to recreate all the teas in the game at home with your own setup.

- Featuring Japanese and Chinese teas
- No need to be a master of tea party etiquette
- Easy controls: just click, drag, and drop!
- No prior knowledge of tea-making required
- Appropriate for all ages (in theory)

NOTE: If you do care about tea-making etiquette, please forgive the blasphemous idea of throwing tea leaves straight in the kettle.

title: Maze Chase
description:
게임 정보
Step into the maze with friends or players worldwide and see who is the ultimate seeker or the most elusive hider. Learn the maze and find the best hiding spots.
Currently, there is only one game mode where a survivor joins the hunters when caught.
Both hiders and seekers can dash.

title: A Call From Under the House
description:
게임 정보

There is a house on the shores of a Massachusetts town where rumors of unworldly events run amuck. Strange green lights can be seen flickering in closed stores, tentacles have been spotted from the pier, and some swear that their radios will play nothing but swing. What does the house have to do with all that? That's your job to find out as head of the paranormal taskforce. The police chief is tired of you using the new task force as an excuse to get out of doing real work, so he's sending you out, and you better not come back until you have something worthy of the force's reputation.

In this point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles and find runes to open the mysterious basement door.
Investigate the House to Find Evidence
Solve Puzzles and Find Runes
Unlock the Basement Door and Find the Secret of the House
autokwd: A Call From Under the House

title: Lurkers
description:
게임 정보
Dive into Lurkers, a multiplayer 2D game where creativity meets destruction! Battle zombies, build epic bases, and explore an infinite, fully destructible world. With millions of players, every session is a new adventure.

Fight in fast-paced PvP modes like Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Bedwars, or survive the zombie apocalypse in PvE.
Explore endless, randomly generated worlds filled with diverse biomes—forests, deserts, snowy mountains, scary caves, and more.
Destroy everything in sight with fully destructible environments—build, mine, chop, and watch buildings collapse!
Craft & Upgrade your gear from basic tools to mythical weapons by mining deep for rare ores.
Dominate massive battles with hundreds of players and NPCs, forming factions, and waging epic wars.
Customize your character with unique skins and emojis, and climb the leaderboards to become the top player.
Automate your world with advanced mechanics—drive vehicles, program systems, and manipulate physics.
Mod & Script your own adventures, run custom servers, and create the game world you’ve always dreamed of.

title: Neural Synapse
description:
게임 정보
A distinctive journey awaits you, where you'll delve into the narrative of our protagonist navigating the shadowy alleys of a futuristic metropolis.
Immerse yourself in a realm of technological advancements and criminal mysteries, where the repercussions of your every choice unfold.
Employ your logical reasoning and analytical skills to endure in this tumultuous world.

Key Features:
• Third Person 3D Adventure
• Non-linear Storytelling
• Exciting missions
• Mini Games
• Clean tone story
• Multiple endings

title: A Long Survive
description:
게임 정보
“It was our fault. Our home, Earth, was attacked and devastated. But we prevailed. We managed to drive out the Lerp and acquire their technology. Our mission now is to find resources and seek a new home for humanity. We know they will attack again. But we will be prepared. We will do what we do best: Survive."
A LONG SURVIVE
A Long Survive is a cooperative shooter game focused on survival against waves of varied enemies. It is an intense action game with resource management, real-time strategy and building elements. One of its keys features is its immersive VR experience, which is compatible with all kinds of VR devices, as well as its crossplay connectivity with PC Players.
All the Project is building in Unreal Engine 5.
JOINS THE SPACE CORP
In A Long Survive, you will take on the role of a soldier from Space Corp. You will have to go with your team to one of the extraction bases on the new planets taken by humans.
But obviously, it won't be easy.
These extraction bases are besieged by the Lerp army. You will have to survive their waves as long as you can while protecting the nexus.
Will you be able to complete the mission? Or Will you have to escape?


GAME HIGHLIGHTS

SURVIVE - PROTECT THE NEXUS.
You have to survive different waves filled with many enemies with different mechanics that Will attack you relentlessly. And what's more important; you must protect the Nexus. If the Nexus falls, the game is over.
MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES – FORTIFY YOUR POSITION.
You will have a wide variety of weapons to survive. But not only that. Thanks to the "Forge Gun" and the resources you acquire during the game, you can fortify your position. You will have the possibility to build walls, turrets, and many other constructions that will help you protect the nexus.
Be smart. Use your resources and those of your team strategically.

title: Cold Salvage
description:
게임 정보
Cold Salvage is a co-operative survival game.

Take on the role of a blue-collar salvage engineer. Take contracts, working in the cold depths of space - in a job full of danger and riches. Claim your own tug from the junkyards, and earn credits to upgrade and repair it's systems. Then work with your team to return abandoned vessels to service... but watch for what lurks in the dark.

Stemming the tide of war depends on you. Return the warships to the docks, or destroy them where they drift. The horrors on board cannot be allowed to reach Earth.

title: Montaro 2
description:
게임 정보

Montaro 2 is a stealth game where you are a clever doggo, navigating through various locations such as shopping streets, residential areas, schools, stations, and public swimming pools to complete sneaky missions and steal interesting items.
Sneak into different scenes, use the environment and props to hide from store clerks, and accomplish mission objectives.
Featuring:
Cute Shiba Inu
Busy humans
Underwear
Woof!

title: Mad King Redemption
description:
게임 정보
왕국은 미친 왕에게 함락되었고, 왕은 금지된 마법을 사용해 여왕을 소생시키려 했어요. 하지만 삶과 죽음의 힘이 너무 커서 감당할 수 없었고, 그 결과 왕은 이성을 잃었습니다. 신중하게 버튼을 눌러 적 무리를 처치하세요! 싸움꾼의 역할에 충실하면서 도적의 전략적인 요소가 더해져 왕국의 운명이 여러분의 어깨 위에 놓여 있습니다. 전투 기술, 유물 및 영웅을 잠금 해제하려면 매번 실행 후 영웅의 형제단을 업그레이드하세요.
BEAT'EM'UP 게임플레이
사랑받는 고전 게임에서 영감을 얻어, 저희는 구식 컨트롤과 레트로 감성을 혁신적인 3D 메커니즘과 결합한 비뎀업 경험을 만들었습니다. 4명의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터는 각각 고유한 전투 스타일, 게임플레이에 영향을 주는 커스터마이징 가능한 능력치, 자세한 배경 스토리를 가지고 있습니다. 모든 영웅은 죄를 지었습니다. 그들도 구원이 필요합니다.
로그 엘리트 진행
매번 실행할 때마다 새로운 영웅, 공격 기술, 유물을 잠금 해제하고, 금지된 회랑 깊은 곳으로 모험을 떠나 광기의 왕을 찾아 그의 광기에서 벗어날 수 있도록 하세요. 모든 달리기는 무작위 요소로 구성되어 있습니다. 모든 영웅이 죽거나 미친 왕이 쓰러질 때까지 미친 왕에게 가해진 모든 피해는 같은 런에서 지속되며, 단결된 영웅 형제단만이 미친 왕을 물리칠 수 있습니다. 새로 실행할 때마다 모든 영웅이 다시 태어나지만 미친 왕도 완전한 생명력을 회복합니다.
tag: 앞서 해보기,2D 격투,픽셀 그래픽,핵 앤 슬래시,2D

title: Grimwalker
description:
게임 정보
슈팅 게임 "Grimwalker"에서 지옥의 군대와 대치하십시오. 다양한 무기로 짜릿한 전투를 벌이고 악마의 형상을 사용하여 더욱 강력해지십시오. 생존을 위해 자원을 관리하면서 비밀로 가득한 세계를 탐험하십시오.



클래식한 소총과 권총부터 근접 무기까지 다양한 무기의 아르설을 사용하세요. 적들과의 전투에서 승리하기 위해서는 적마의 생물들과의 싸움에서 적절한 장비 선택이 핵심입니다.



이것은 단순한 슈팅 게임뿐만 아니라, 탐험할 수 있는 수수께끼와 미스터리로 가득한 세계입니다. 장비를 관리하고 생존 기회를 제공하는 자원을 찾으세요.



자신의 악마의 형태로 변신하여 적들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 모두는 한계를 가지고 있습니다... 악마로서, 당신은 그 한계를 무시할 수 있습니다.



잊혀진 마을을 점령한 악마들의 군대에 맞서 싸우고, 악마들의 미스터리를 풀어내기 위해 일어나세요.

title: 17.waves TD
description:
게임 정보
온라인 코옵 타워 디펜스
외행성 W4-V35의 17개 콜로니가 공격받고 있습니다! 17.waves에서 전부 살아남을 수 있을까요?
최대 4명의 친구들과 온라인에서 모여 몰려오는 외계인 무리들로부터 기지를 지키십시오.
협력을 통해 코인과 자원을 모으고 타워를 만들어 유지해야 합니다.
콜로니 수호
[b]외계인의 습격[/b] -- 외계인 벌레들이 기지를 습격합니다! 놈들의 습격 경로를 학습하고 방어 계획을 세우십시오.
[b]타워 제작[/b] -- 다양한 유형의 타워 중에 원하는 타워를 선택해 가장 효율적인 방식으로 배치하십시오.
협력이 중요합니다
내 역할 찾기 -- 7가지 특징적인 업그레이드 중 하나를 이용해 각 팀원을 특화시키십시오. 플릿 풋, 로드 로드, 오버클록과 같이 서로 다른 특징이 있습니다!
[b]자원 채굴[/b] -- 타워는 에너지를 소모하므로 계속 충전해줘야 합니다. 자원을 모아 타워에 주입해 계속 가동하도록 해야 합니다.

title: Calamity
description:
게임 정보
You are our very best in these chaotic times. Your job is to help out the locals during these devastating disasters. Can you survive the calamities?
Chaotic Events: Experience meteors smashing into buildings, physics driven tornadoes ripping through towns and tossing you and the locals around, and exploding everything near by, survive the blistering cold inflicted by blizzards, and find cover while dust storms are hitting and huge tumbleweeds hit the town.

Destruction: Experience buildings getting ripped apart by tornadoes or meteors smashing into buildings flying debris.


Player Choices: Play with your friends or find others to help out the locals while trying to survive natural disasters. Adapt and alter your surroundings to gain advantages and create new paths to safety.

title: Panic Lane
description:
게임 정보
Are you ready for the most intense driving game you’ve ever played? In Panic Lane, your goal is simple: survive. You'll be on the edge of your seat as you dodge randomly spawned obstacles and fight relentlessly just to stay alive. Will you make it? There’s only one way to find out.

title: Into Samomor
description:
게임 정보
Origin
After a plane plunged into the heart of Samomor town, 19 children started disappearing mysteriously. To break the cycle of sorrow, two brave students, you and Jack, embarked on a quest to uncover the root cause.
Anyone can be eliminated. The story changes as each person disappears
Don't murder anyone, or the game will change almost completely.

title: Not Only Nine
description:
게임 정보
Till All Complete
You have fallen. Your soul is a cat, journeying to the center of The Afterlife in order to save your human. However, the Reapers will try to stop you from reaching The Tower. An ancient being (helps?) defeat Death itself in this narrative RPG with turn-based boss battles.

Game Features:
NO quest markers - interact with residents of The Afterlife to progress.
Actually, there are no menus at all - game systems are directly integrated into the world.
Heartfelt story with deep characters that respond to actions you've taken.
I am sorry for what I do to these characters.
The best part of RPG's is exploring RPG towns so I put a lot of that.

title: Hivefall
description:
게임 정보
Synthesis: Welcome to Hivefall, a post-apocalyptic world devastated by The Hive, a horde of carnivorous mutants that hunt in synchronicity. As one of the last survivors, your mission is simple: stay alive. Drive your caravan, fight for resources and decide whether you will rebuild what is left of humanity or perish in the attempt.
Every decision counts in this fight for survival and hope for a better future.
Main mechanics:
Dynamic Survival: Explore a hostile world by collecting resources, hunting prey and facing mutants. Constant movement is your best ally,
as stopping too long could attract the deadly attention of The Hive.
Your Caravan, Your Strength: Your vehicle is not just a means of transportation; It is your home, your refuge and your best weapon. Customize it and improve its capabilities to resist enemy attacks and travel long distances.
Wave Battles: Stay in one place too long and prepare to face endless hordes of enemies. With your caravan as a mobile combat base, use strategic tactics and resources to survive these brutal confrontations.
Reconstruction and Renaissance: Shows that humanity still has a chance.
If you survive long enough, you can help the villagers build self-sufficient settlements, marking the beginning of the recovery of the lost world.

title: Cozy Dungeons
description:
게임 정보
코지 던전은 던전을 탐험하며 적을 물리치고 개조하여 수익을 얻는 어드벤처/인테리어 디자인 게임입니다! 사업에 새로운 변화를 더하기로 한 몬스터 퇴치 길드의 리더가 되어 보세요. 던전을 민박집으로 바꿀 수 있는데 던전 정복에만 집중할 필요는 없잖아요?
위험천만한 던전 탐험
교묘한 퍼즐과 사악한 적, 치명적인 함정으로 가득한 던전을 통과하세요. 탐험과 전투에 도움이 되는 다양한 도구를 사용하고 기지를 발휘하면 생존에 필요한 우위를 점할 수 있습니다.

내면의 장인정신을 발휘하세요
여러분이 방문하는 모든 던전은 고객의 소유이며, 고객들은 새로운 모습을 보고 싶어 합니다! 새 가구를 만들고 쓰레기를 치우며, 벽과 바닥을 바꾸고 고장 난 가구를 판매하는 등 다양한 작업을 할 수 있습니다! 모든 준비가 끝나면 이제 돈이 굴러들어 오길 기다리면 됩니다!

길드 커스터마이징
열심히 번 골드를 사용하여 길드를 꾸미고 확장하며 캐릭터를 향상시키고, 새로운 설계도를 사고, 새로운 친구를 만나는 등 원하는 방식대로 길드를 꾸미고 확장할 수 있습니다!

title: Operation Excision
description:
게임 정보


THE STORY:

Decades after the Great War on Earth, a new world was built on Mars. It was mostly a time of peace, although a cold war was brewing between the Republic of Mars in the Northern Hemisphere, and the Mars Commonwealth in the Southern Hemisphere. Settlers, known as the Mons Gens, had built several colonies around the equator of Mars, forming their own nation-states which had no allegiance to The Republic nor The Commonwealth. Within the past few decades, the largest Mons Gens colony known as Arsia Mons, was abandoned. The Colony’s massive domed cities, built by Atlas Dynamics, would lie uninhabited in the crater for years.



When the Mars Commonwealth spaceport at Pickering was nearly completely destroyed by an old, obsolete Atlas Dynamics construction drone carrying an explosive device, many assumed the Republic of Mars were responsible. But then, long range telemetry picked up dozens of signatures, similar to those of the Atlas Dynamics construction drone, deep below the supposedly abandoned colony at Arsia Mons.

As a Mars Commonwealth Special Forces soldier, your task is to insert into the abandoned Arsia Mons colony, and investigate deep below the surface to find the origin of the signatures and their relation to the bombing of Pickering Spaceport. Bring back any intel you find.

title: THREAT ACTOR
description:
게임 정보
Threat Actor is a cybercrime-themed RTS game featuring a series of campaign maps with increasingly complex mechanics and objectives.
THE DARK HUB
As a fresh member of an infamous cybercrime organization called The Dark Hub, your life depends on whether you can prove your worth to the faction's leaders by successfully completing your assignments.
As you slowly climb the leadership ladder, it is only a matter of time before some of the senior staff members start to see you as a threat.
THE DARK WEB
Your criminal enterprise resides on the Dark Web, a 3D topdown map filled with various resources, factions and hostile malware entities.
Occupied by all kinds of people - from simple scammers to hackers, creeps and dangerous members of the occult, you will encounter a variety of quests and other interactions designed around given campaign map's theme.
THE CRIME ECONOMY
Participate in the dark web economy by building out your marketplace. Create workers to gather resources and manage your organization's income, population and amenity level. Produce units to defend your base or attack hostile organizations. Hire moderators to work at the marketplace's facilities and leverage your faction's economy to accomplish the map's objective.

title: Creature Containment
description:
게임 정보
In the 500 years since the world experienced a catastrophic apocalypse, magic has begun to seep into the world. Although devastated by the event, humanity has begun harnessing this power, and is currently experiencing a golden age of human expansion.
As a newly graduated United City States Militia Commander, you have been tasked with heading to a new posting along the western frontier. A fast-spreading goblin infestation has taken over an old-world underground mega-facility, and you've been tasked to clear it out.
ARKCORP, working in conjunction with the UCS Militia, has provided the operation with a cutting edge M-TEK computer, capable of administering an entire base from one machine. With this tech, the user can:
Read Emails
Construct Shops
Purchase and Sell Equipment

title: Space Base Defense
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to the unforgiving frontiers of deep space!
In Space base Defense, you're the commander of a stranded lander under constant siege by alien creatures. Your mission is simple: gather, build, and survive.
A lighthearted and tactical tower defense game where you gather resources, create and upgrade different types of units to fend off endless waves of enemies. Collect, create, and position strategically to survive each attack in colorful alien environments full of surprises.
Harvest glowing blue gems from the planet's crust to construct an army of mining bots, defensive- and combat units. Fend off endless waves of alien enemies who drop green gems upon defeat — your key to unlocking new planets and tougher challenges.
Every planet offers new layouts, fresh enemies, and the chance to perfect your strategy. Will your base become a shining beacon of survival or fall beneath the alien swarm?
Features:
Strategic Base Defense — Protect your lander at all costs against incoming alien waves.
Mine and Build — Collect blue gems to expand your defense and create new units.
Plan Your Growth — Balance resource gathering with firepower to outlast the enemy.
Unlock New Worlds — Defeat alien invaders, collect green gems, and unlock new planets to explore and conquer.
Simple to Learn, Hard to Master — Easy to pick up, but challenging to survive!

title: Kenopsia
description:
게임 정보
케놉시아(Kenopsia)는 조용한 깨달음의 경험이며, 과거가 머물고 보이지 않는 존재가 지켜보는 텅 빈 공간을 여행하는 것입니다. 끝없이 이어지는 빈 복도는 희미한 빛에 잠겨 있고, 잊혀진 성소는 감각 너머의 존재로 은은히 울립니다. 고요함 속 어딘가에서, 무언가가 듣고 있습니다.
당신은 홀로 걷고 있지만, 버려진 것은 아닙니다. 침묵 속에는 질문이 가득합니다. 그것은 당신의 것일까요, 아니면 누군가의 것일까요? 벽은 말해지지 않은 단어들의 메아리로 숨 쉬며, 아직 발견되지 않은 답들이 기다리고 있습니다. 한 걸음 한 걸음 내디딜수록, 당신은 말 없는 대화 속으로 더 깊이 빠져듭니다. 이해는 듣는 것이 아니라, 느끼는 것입니다.
이곳에는 ‘무언가’가 있습니다. 그리고 그것은 항상 여기 있었습니다.
당신은 들을 것인가요? 말을 걸 것인가요? 그리고 만약 그렇다면… 그것은 대답할까요?

title: Complex 629
description:
게임 정보
Where are you?
You arrive at your home complex 629 but you lack all your memories but why? The other residents you meet along your journey deeper into the complex speak of the devil constructing the halls you wander. Be aware however for a violent spectre stalks the halls and he is The Grandfather
Make your way through the structure
Dig your way through the halls by moving the snow manually or with the aid of consumables. To Find what lies at the end of the Complex you must collect money to purchase materials so you may complete the construction of your magnum opus. The key to regaining the memories that have been stolen away from you.

title: Rainbow Unicorn Dash
description:
게임 정보
Rainbow Unicorn Dash is a fast and fun 2D game with art designed by my 5-year-old 🎨 Play as a unicorn, collect shoes to dash through enemies, and chain together massive combos. After dashing, your shoes fly off and bounce around the stage—dash through them again to extend your combo and climb the leaderboards. Unlock powerful abilities, aim for the highest scores, and enjoy quick, exciting gameplay sessions!
🌈 - Play as a unicorn
🎨 - Cute Art
✨ - Chain together massive combos
📈 - Climb the leaderboards
🔥 - Unlock fun abilities
⏰ - Quick gameplay sessions

title: Melodic Mage
description:
게임 정보
Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage, a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging—all in sync with the beat.
Key Features
🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music.
🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages.
⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss.
🎶 Hard mode – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat.
Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!

title: BABELOMANIA
description:
게임 정보
[And the Lord said, "Look, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is only the beginning of what they will do; nothing that they propose to do will now be impossible for them."]
GENESIS, 11:6
20XX, 14th of May. Central France.
You are cordially invited to attend the wedding of Francesco Colombo and Delphine Badeaux. The ceremony will take place on the grounds of the historical Château de Bois-le-Dumont, a bizarre estate with a dark hidden past.
Please be warned that when the lights go out, you shall find no succour. When the darkness overwhelms your neighbour, you shall find no salvation. When the cruel ambition reveals itself, you shall find no solace. Arm yourself with your wits, determination, and an open mind...
Or lose your humanity, before you lose your life.
BABELOMANIA is a technogothic horror adventure, with a visual novel style narrative, point&click puzzles and light survival elements.

title: Beyond the Grove
description:
게임 정보
비욘드 더 그로브는 하이브리드 실시간 전술 및 턴 기반 전략형 룰렛 게임으로, 젊은 숲지기인 플레이어는 미스터리한 오염에 맞서기 위해 모험에 나서야만 합니다. 지속적으로 소환되는 버섯 전사 및 제작계 원소 골렘과 함께 세력을 집결하여 다양한 목표를 가진 수십 개의 맵에서 전투를 수행하고 숲 너머에 있는 세계의 운명을 발견해 보세요.
전략과 실행을 반복하면서 부대를 통솔하세요. 시간을 들여 작전을 세우고 골렘을 제작한 다음, 전투가 흘러가는 양상을 지켜본 후 다음 기회가 왔을 때 조정하세요. 계속 반복하세요. 부대의 이동을 조정하고, 조합을 변경하고, 적을 앞지르세요.

title: Take You Home
description:
게임 정보
Move, jump, and progress. Stuck? Try flipping the world. This is all you can do in this peculiar, monochromatic space.
Take You Home is an indie minimalist 2D platformer game where you navigate by swapping the black and white and inverting gravity to find your way forward. Your goal is to chase a mysterious black cat that occasionally appears, to see what unfolds.
Key Features
Swap black and white and invert gravity to find your way forward.
80 (or more) meticulously crafted and distinct levels, woven into a simple yet touching narrative.
Only three controls, making it easy to pick up and play.
Collect items for unexpected surprises?

title: Shoot  the Moon
description:
게임 정보
SHOOT FOR THE MOON은 우스꽝스러운 로그라이트 업그레이드와 사랑스러운 성우진의 부적응 친구들이 등장하는 아케이드 액션 플랫폼 게임입니다!
드루이드가 통제하는 위험한 숲을 통과하면서 비행 생물에게 마법의 창을 던지세요!
이상한 가족의 도움으로 창, 주문, 괴물 친구를 업그레이드하여 점점 더 높이 성장할 수 있으며, 숲에서 하늘 도시, 용의 뱃속을 거쳐 그 너머까지 탐험할 수 있습니다!
창 길이와 속도를 업그레이드하여 멈출 수 없는 작살과 투척 기계가 되세요!
숲의 어두운 면에 숨겨진 끔찍한 비밀을 밝혀내세요!
순간이동 및 마인드 컨트롤과 같은 예상치 못한 기술을 잠금 해제하기 위해 새로운 친구를 데려오세요!
새, 박쥐, 짐승을 삼켜서 달리는 동안 콤보에 불을 붙이고 힘을 키워보세요!
숲을 노예로 삼는 사악한 드루이드에게 복수하세요.
유쾌한 목소리 연기와 중독성 넘치는 게임, 이제 창을 들고 달을 향해 쏠 시간입니다!
놓치면 무기를 업그레이드하고 다시 가세요!

title: The Way of Knight
description:
게임 정보
What is it?
The Way of Knight is a chess-like puzzle game about the journey of Esroh the knight. You pilot the heroes through various enemies, boards, hazard. Think your way through different challenges such as defeating all enemies, obtaining special items, and getting to the exit safely.
Features
75 Levels
New Enemies
Enviromental hazards
Hand drawn artstyle

title: Nylos
description:
게임 정보
Nylos is a puzzle platformer that takes players through diverse environments–from lush caves to floating islands and high-tech labs.

The game introduces a variety of unique powers that you can combine in creative ways to solve puzzles and explore every corner of the world.

title: Mochi Conquest
description:
게임 정보
✨ WISHLIST NOW & JOIN THE ADVENTURE!
⛩️ MOCHI NEED YOU! WILL YOU SAVE… OR DESTROY THEM ALL?
 The Dread Fog spreads, twisting the land and corrupting the once-sacred Kami. Cursed Shikigami enslave the Mochi, turning them into relentless foes.
 You are their last hope. Lead the Mochi warriors, free the Kami, and reclaim a world drowning in corruption.
 When the time comes, will you save the lost… or erase them forever?
⚔️ MASTER TIMING-BASED COMBAT

title: Macho Harvest ~ Muscular Harvest Puzzle ~
description:
게임 정보
마초 × 농업의 슈퍼 혼돈 퍼즐 게임!
밭에 단백질을 뿌려서 탄생하는 다양한 종류의 마초들을 정중하게 애정을 담아 육성해 출하시키자!
■스토리
마쵸 농원의 원장은 근육을 너무 사랑했던 겨우 '마초를 키우는 농원'을 열어 버린다.
"마초의 씨앗"이라는 수수께끼의 씨앗을 흙에 묻혀 단백질을 물 대신에 준다.
며칠 후, 작은 아령의 싹이 나오고, 밭 일면에 근육의 향기가 풍긴다.
이웃의 사람은 말한다. 「어쩐지, 단백질의 바람이 불어 오지 않는가?」
성장한 마초들은 매일 스쿼트와 벤치 프레스에 힘쓰고,
점차 큰 가슴 근육이 열리고 복근이 갈라진다 ...
■출하시키기에는 단 3스텝만!
①밭에 단백질을 꽂는다
3 종류의 단백질을 밭에 뿌려 마초가 탄생!
색의 곱셈으로 다양한 색의 마초도···?
② 마초를 키우다
탄생한 마초에게 더욱 단백질을 주어 가는 것으로 레벨이 올라간다!
잘 기르고 출하에 대비하자!
③ 정리해 발송한다
많은 마쵸를 한 번에 발송하는 것으로 고득점 겟이다!
단백질의 형상에 맞추어 잘 마초를 키워 가자!

title: After Juice: Animal Disco Mafia
description:
게임 정보
In this wild and colorful graphic adventure, you play as Tofu, a cheeky little college hamster with zero shame and a whole lot of attitude. Dive into an out-of-control college night in the city of Furrol, where the party never sleeps, secrets hide behind every sip of juice, and every animal has their own drama to spill. A story packed with partying and mystery, tons of humor and terrible jokes, but above all… Drug—wait, I mean, SUGAR!
Load up on gummies🍬, juice boxes🧃, and chocolate bars🍫 to experience the true Furrol Experience.
What starts as a night of partying with your campus’s most chaotic ferret, Churro, quickly spirals into a surreal mystery when something weird happens after the first round of juice.
Your mission: figure out what went down and survive the weirdest night of your life.
Get ready for a ride through neon lights, chaotic beats, unforgettable characters, and sooo many sweets. 🍭
🗺️ Dive into the wild side of Furrol
Embrace the chaos, the madness, and the humor of a city that blends the best (and worst) of college life. From graffiti-covered buildings to streets where rules are just a suggestion, Furrol is a love letter to reckless youth and an unhealthy obsession with candy.
Explore a living, detailed city filled with unique areas:
Theme bars, underwater nightclubs, secret alleys, and not-so-legal candy shops.
Every venue has its own vibe, music, and wild local fauna.
Unlock new zones as you progress through the story (or do the right “favors”).

title: Fugue Shot
description:
게임 정보
Each run in Fugue Shot presents a series of unique dreamscapes, filled with increasingly difficult puzzles and randomized encounters to test your abilities to their limit. Plan your shots carefully to clear the playfield and overcome the ever-shifting landscape of this liminal and surreal world.
Build Your Own Solutions
Set up your playfield and test different ideas to destroy bumpers with unique and challenging properties. Interact with a satisfying physics engine and endure the effects of your strange dreams to master the unexpected.
Power Up Your Run
Obtain any of dozens of unique items to impact your run and warp your playstyle. Discover powerful synergies to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly shifting experience.

title: Clap Clash
description:
게임 정보
About the Game
This is a unique blend of rhythm, deck-building, and roguelike mechanics. Embark on an adventure, unlock and collect various skills, and build your own skill pool to adapt to the ever-changing challenges.
The gameplay is inspired by a classroom clapping game that was popular in parts of East Asia about twenty years ago. Unlike traditional card-based roguelikes, you won’t have the luxury of time to carefully plan your next move. Instead, you must adapt to a fast-paced and ever-shifting combat rhythm, making split-second decisions before each beat.

title: Survivesmith
description:
게임 정보
Survivesmith is a reverse bullet-hell game with a simple crafting twist. Shoot hails of bullets, missiles, nails, lasers and whatever is at your disposal at your enemies and make tactical choices to overcome all obstacles. You are here to find the 'Life Essence', and you're not leaving without it!
Item Crafting
Every biome has a unique resource (or more) for you to collect. Collect them and craft handy consumable items from your Survival Kit to make surviving a little bit easier. But be warned—you’ll need plenty of resources if you hope to face the final boss!
Biome Hazards
Every biome has some kind of hazard to throw at you. Make sure you are ready for these random weather changes, unless... you find a way to turn the tides in your favor.
Preset Loadouts
In Survivesmith, you don't have to submit to the randomness of the upgrades you get. While there are many random elements to experience in the game, your loadout isn't one of them. Make sure you know what you're doing, and equip well before a round!

title: Shadows of Tuonela
description:
게임 정보
Journey to the Finnish purgatory – Tuonela – and fight the countless other versions of yourself to prove worthy of ascending back onto the Earth.

Explore the open world, gather resources, craft better equipment to prepare for battle.

But choose your fights wisely as the three hit combat can take even a seasoned Shadow by surprise.

Tuonela remembers only the triumphant.

title: DigSite
description:
게임 정보
Step into the golden age of archaeological discovery as an ambitious archaeologist eager to uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt. DigSite invites players to dig, explore, clean, document, and donate long-forgotten relics hidden beneath the vast desert sands.
Buy a dig site license, choose the right spot and dig for valuable artifacts. Physical labor will quickly drain your energy so drink water to refill it or find shaded spots where you can rest in the heat of the day.
When you contribute a rare artifact to the museum, the rewards are significant. You’ll earn substantial recognition and monetary compensation. This funding can be used to expand your excavation operations.
After cleaning and restoring the finds, it’s time to document your discoveries. Use a vintage camera to take photos of artifacts before sending them off to a museum. This way you will not only preserve the artifacts for future generations but will also help you build a reputation as one of the greatest archaeologists of your time.
As darkness falls, the temperature drops sharply, and the once scorching sands now feel cold and treacherous. With limited visibility, you’ll need to use a lantern to find your way back to your tent and rest for the night. The day-night cycle is critical to your journey, as certain actions and explorations can only be carried out during daylight. The desert at night is treacherous - creatures like snakes and scorpions lurk, waiting to strike.

title: Blood Aliens 3
description:
게임 정보
Features
Fast-Paced Combat: Take down swarms of aliens with quick reflexes and calculated precision. Chain kills into streaks to earn extra points.
Story: Engaging 3D cutscenes and professional voice acting that bring your journey to life.
Multiple endings: Are you able to get a great score? You'll be rewarded with an alternative ending to the story and cinematic!
Diverse Enemies: Face a variety of alien species, each with unique movement patterns, projectile attacks, and behaviors to keep every encounter fresh.
Boss Battles: Test your mettle against powerful alien bosses that demand every ounce of strategy and dodging ability.
Difficulty adjustments: Three difficulty modes that adapt to each player.
Fun achievements: Unlock them by exploiting enemy mechanics.

title: Fuggedaboutit Farm
description:
게임 정보
                                         Think you know farming sims? Fuggedaboutit.  Your brother is in debt to a Southern crime family and now he's gone missing.  You happen to be a competent farmer yourself and unfortunately are now their insurance policy.  Gather materials from around the farm, grow a variety of crops and raise and sell pigs to make as much money as you can to pay off your brother's debt.  You have 30 days to complete the task; will you ship enough to please the boss or end up sleeping with the parsnips?
 Fuggedaboutit Farm is a small-scale farming sim with a big mischievous twist.  Manage your time and resources to ship as much as possible in 30 days.  Replenish stamina by consuming items to make the most of each day.  Buy seeds from the local shop of crops of varying legality and fill your field.  Craft items to help you around the farm to be more productive and more profitable.  Explore the nearby cave to mine for metals, using them to craft more items.  Purchase and raise pigs by feeding them things found or grown on the farm and then sell them when they reach a higher star rating. Help the family dispose of their big black bags by any means necessary; you may need to get creative.  Do you have what it takes to pay off your brothers' debt and leave this frantic farm?  Fuggedaboutit.
Features
 Farming
Visit Smokey's Shop to purchase seeds for up to 7 different types of crops.  Follow the straight and narrow path and grow parsnips or grapes and hops or take a more immoral approach and focus on crops of an illegal nature.  Whatever makes you the most profit!

title: Metal Coffin
description:
게임 정보
In a world that's seen destruction time and time again, a war of a race that's seen extinction before take place once again. You are part of the rebellion pushing your way through enemy lines hoping to one day reach and occupy the enemy capital. With limited time, supplies and alliances you set forth on you journey to Dormak.
Gather allies
Each city visited provides another opportunity to find new captains who are interested in joining your cause. Ask around, somebody might now their locations.
Plan Your Moves: Master the Art of Strategy
Success in this turbulent world demands more than just quick reflexes; it requires a strategist's mind. Our game empowers you to take control of the battlefield through careful planning and tactical acumen. Here's how you can leverage your planning skills:

title: DashBall
description:
게임 정보
DashBall – The Ultimate Speed Showdown
Get ready for ultra-fast duels in DashBall, a competitive game where reflexes and strategy make all the difference! Face off against your opponents in intense matches where every move counts, and use spells to gain the upper hand.
Fast-Paced Gameplay: Rapid and dynamic exchanges that test your reflexes.
Spells & Power-ups: Catch temporary spells on the map to turn the tide.
Varied Game Modes: Competitive 1v1, fast-paced matches with special rules, and unique challenges.
Ranking & Competition: Climb the leaderboard, face the best players, and become the master of the arena.
Dynamic Maps: Environments that evolve during the match to spice up the action.
Neon Arcade Style: A retro-futuristic design reminiscent of 80s arcade machines, modernized for a new generation.
Are you ready to become the master of DashBall?
Add DashBall to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release!

Note: Once the core game mechanics are developed, I will focus on improving the graphics. The current icons, banners, and visuals are a representation of the intended final look of the game.

title: Momochan's brain is so crazy!
description:
게임 정보
Guide the Silly Cat "Momo-chan" to the Goal!
Momo-chan is a silly cat who can't do anything. She can't attack enemies or perform special actions—all she can do is move! But that's exactly what makes this game fun!
Simple Rules!
If Momo-chan collides with an enemy, hits an obstacle, or falls off the course, it's game over, and you'll have to restart from the beginning.
Throughout the stages, you'll find cat cans that affect your score.
🟢 Green Can → +1 point
🔵 Blue Can → +5 points
🔴 Red Can → +10 points
The timer starts counting up when the game begins. Your final score is determined by:
Elapsed Time - Total Cat Cans Collected
If your final score is 0 or higher, you clear the stage!
If it's negative, it's game over, and you'll have to try again!
Simple Yet Deep!
A 20-stage action game that starts off easy but gets progressively harder!
By the end, you'll be facing super challenging stages that will put your skills to the test!
Can you guide Momo-chan to victory?
