title: Bloody Shrine
description:
게임 정보
사원의 운명은 당신의 손에 달려 있습니다. 의식을 완수하면서 강력한 악마를 해제하고 강력한 무기를 발견하며 전략적으로 주문과 아이템을 선택하며 강렬한 전투에 참여하세요. 지옥을 파괴하는 시너지를 형성하여 구울리, 엘리트 및 위협적인 보스들에게 혼란을 일으키세요. 도전을 이겨내고 암흑의 무자비한 힘에 대항하여 신성한 신사를 지키 수 있을 것인가요?
특징
다양한 플레이 가능한 캐릭터. 각각은 다른 플레이 스타일을 가지고 있습니다.
도전을 완수하여 다양한 무기, 주문 및 아이템을 해제
엘리트 및 보스를 포함한 다양한 유형의 적과 전투
짧은 파동
게임을 클리어한 후 난이도 상승

title: Dungeons and Diners
description:
게임 정보
In the Diner
Take Orders: Manage food orders as they arrive on your plate.
Cook & Serve: Tackle a hectic kitchen, preparing and plating a variety of dishes that bring life to your diner.
In the Dungeon
Adventuring Guild: Form parties with friends, whether playing online or offline, and set off on collaborative quests.
Inventory Management: Keep a close eye on your loot and ingredients, ensuring you’re always ready for the next challenge.
Character Choices: Select from four distinct heroes, each with unique abilities that can turn the tide in battle.
Development Roadmap & Updates
Our current focus is on perfecting the Demo build. We’re busy gathering player feedback, squashing bugs, and refining core systems—especially the dynamic interplay between diner operations and dungeon adventures. Soon, you’ll experience:
Enhanced combat effects (like a slow effect on the Archer’s Rain of Arrows ability)
Polished town mechanics, ensuring every shop and service—from the General Store to the Diner—operates seamlessly
A richer audio experience that brings every location to life
We’re committed to rolling out regular updates as we work towards a polished Early Access release. Check out our visual roadmap below for a closer look at our progress and upcoming milestones.

title: Brave Glin in Fairyaria
description:
게임 정보
Play as Brave Glin, a little magical creature that getting lost in a forest, nedding face dangers on the way to return home!
- Freatures -
∎ Jump! Use enemies as platforms by jumping over their heads! Each enemy has a different reaction when they are trampled!
∎ Defend Yourself! Use a slingshot, a shield and even a stick to defend yourself from enemies!
∎ Super Star! Collect tiny stars, defeat enemies, increasing the experience bar to can collect the great Shooting Stars!
∎ 4 Thematic Worlds! Meet many charismatic characters, crossing the world of Fairyaria!
∎ Friends! The scarecrow Hans and the crow Crowie will help you on the journey!

title: Antidote city hall
description:
게임 정보
토마스라는 이름의 형사와 혼돈과 절망의 세계에 빠져. 이 도시는 그의 집이지만 지금은 지뢰밭처럼 보입니다. 마약,부패,살인-이 모든 것이 일반화되었습니다.

토마스는 도시의 수호자였지만,고위급 사건으로 경찰에서 해고당했습니다. 이제 그는 자신의 탐정 기관을 설립하고 자신의 전 영광을 회복하기 위해 노력하고있다. 그러나 시간이 지나고 여전히 고객이 없습니다. 잊혀지고 우울한 토마스는 술 한 병에서 위안을 찾습니다.

하지만 토마스는 좋은 이름을 되찾을 기회가 있습니다. 그는 마약 카르텔과 정치인과 관련된 신비한 살인 연쇄를 해결해야 할 것입니다. 그는 도시가 오랫동안 기다리고있는 영웅이 될 수있을 것인가?

게임의 특징:

-예기치 않은 왜곡이있는 흥미 진진한 이야기.
-많은 이웃과 위치가있는 거대한 도시.
-관심과 논리적 사고가 필요한 복잡한 조사 시스템.
-자신의 비밀과 동기를 가지고 각각의 다른 캐릭터와 상호 작용할 수있는 능력.
-전체 통로를 통해 당신을 동반 할 도시에서 지배적 인 두려움과 절망의 분위기.

title: Serial Victims
description:
게임 정보
Serial Victims is a 3D psychological horror game that immerses you in the nightmares of individuals who fell prey to serial killers. In Serial Victims, you embody each victim, racing against time to uncover clues, call for help, and perform various actions before the inevitable happens. Your ultimate objective is to have the victims assist in catching the killer with as few victims as possible.
Survival is not the goal. Instead, your aim is to do what you can within the time you have left.
Serial Victims gives a fresh and replayable horror experience. Each playthrough is randomized, ensuring that no two experiences are the same:
Unique players: Each victim is different, their name, speed, and reactions to their surroundings.
Unique Killers: Encounter various serial killers, each with distinct methods, personalities, and motives, making each investigation a unique challenge.
tag: 심리적 공포,전술 RPG,탐험,숨은 그림 및 물체,3D

title: Arohel: Call of the Wind
description:
게임 정보
AROHEL: CALL OF THE WIND
Arohel is set in a near future, when a series of mass flooding across the entire Earth has forced survivors to take refuge on stilt complexes. A few years later, a meteor shower reached the Earth, bringing with it a mysterious crystal of unknown origin: the Arohel.
By connecting with the Arohel, fragments of land began to emerge from the waters, clumping together and forming floating islands that, after a cycle of about 12 hours, disappeared back into the abyss, only to reappear the next day in different arrangements.
In the settlements, a new group of intrepid adventurer arose, tasked with finding new resources for the community: the Explorers. In "Arohel: Call Of The Wind," you will play as a novice Explorer, navigating through procedurally generated floating islands on a quest to find a long-lost friend.
EXPLORE
Dive through the floating islands and explore them with your grappling hook and hang glider. Take on procedurally generated missions from your fellow villagers, collecting important resources to help your community.
LOOT

title: Terminal
description:
게임 정보
You wake up with nothing but the green light of a 90s computer. All there is on the screen is an investing program and a quota. You must escape.
Terminal is a hacking game where you are an AI and have to solve puzzles to escape. In the format of a company's file system, you crack passwords, take notes, find out the truth, but most importantly: escape.
Included is a level editor where you can play community made games and share your own.
Game Features
Evolving Investing Simulation
Expansive computer system
Solving puzzles
Cracking passwords
Lots of hacking
Find secret codes
Many minigames (like minesweeper!)
Create and share your own levels
Play community made levels

title: Best Laid Plans
description:
게임 정보
You are the Commander - Start off with a small group of troopers and build your army. Win encounters to gain rewards. Spend rewards to collect troopers, or discover Printers to make your own! Collect perks and other assets along the way. Experience each unique room as it is revealed by your reconnaissance. Gain small footholds and develop them into larger, defensible bases. Build and maintain roads and resource income to ensure attrition does not halt your advance. After all, tactics win battles, but logistics win wars, Soldier!
Your big brother is grinning at you as you look up from your handful of troopers and the adjoining "rulebook", which still has a cheeky red bow Scotch-taped to its front. He has set all this up for you as one big birthday gift -- A Campaign for which he will be the Dungeon Master -- but you get the sense that there is something more to it as well. He wants to see how you perform. After all, you wanted some of his collection, right? Well now you have the chance to earn it.
Build Your Collection
The enemy forces are countless. To have any hope of victory you must increase your numbers. Troopers are the bread & butter of your force, but there are plenty of... Jams? Tanks, planes and trains are just some of the things you may obtain. Augment the abilities of your entire forces, or specific units, with the collection of Perks! Steer your production into the units that work best for you and your strategy.
Wage War on Multiple Levels
Deploy your units and designate tactics to win encounters. As you bulldoze your way through the enemy, don't expect them to sit idly by. Enemy forces will coalesce for Room Combat at set intervals, in which you must defend your bases, moving whole companies between footholds and claiming new ground when able. Small gains from encounters can add up to big advantages when the bell tolls!
Explore rooms and claim objectives. Determine the priority of different points of interest for your personal Strategy. You don't have all the time in the world, after all. The enemy forces grow stronger with each turn of the board. Make sure you have a plan for what you pursue!
Thwart the Chipper Regime
Expunge the evil Chipper armies room by room. Discover their origins and intentions along the way. All these enemy forces must be coming from somewhere, after all. Reinforce your points of control to prevent retaliatory strikes from erasing your progress. Gain bonuses for maintaining full room control and defeating Chipper Lieutenants.

title: Codename TCT
description:
게임 정보
The battle for the free city of Crimson Tide has begun.



Following the Crimson Reapers path of destruction lead to a state-wide revolution. You are a citizen from the lower levels of the mega city and you will do your part. Will you gather funds to escape the city amidst chaos, or grab the opportunity to scratch some leftovers...or possibly much more. Be warned though: the NRF forces have entered the city to bring back order, but the left over gangs, along with the C.T.P.D. and Kyoncha Security will have their own plans and agendas.



Codename TCT is a FPS with parkour and roguelite elements, where you will forge your own tale through the streets and underbelly of the crumbling mega city of Crimson Tide.

title: Driving Rogue
description:
게임 정보
Driving Rogue plunges you into a high-speed rogue-like challenge where every race is a fight for survival and mastery. Navigate treacherous city streets, execute precise manoeuvres, and beat your own and others high scores to reach the very top!
Core Gameplay
Drive, drift, and deploy unique abilities to dominate the roads. Master the art of precision driving to finish each level with both style and speed to progress further and unlock potent upgrades, fresh challenges and new vehicles.
London at Night
Experience riding through a neon-clad London at night, with all the iconic vehicles and spots for you to find and... mainly avoid. Accompanied by a diverse soundtrack that complements the game's nocturnal adrenaline filled action. There's always something new to see and a fresh challenge to attempt so there's no shortage of roads to master & places to visit.

title: Aurora: Genesis
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for an unforgettable adventure with Aurora: Genesis, a thrilling roguelike action game that will immerse you in the fractured realms of Lumina. Reunite the shattered lands, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your own legend in this epic journey!

Aurora: Genesis features a procedurally generated continent, ensuring a unique and challenging experience with every playthrough. Explore diverse landscapes, from lush forests teeming with mythical creatures to treacherous mountains and desolate wastelands hiding ancient ruins and temples. The world of Aurora awaits your discovery!



Engage in epic battles against powerful sorcerers, skilled warriors, and legendary creatures. Master combat, unlock new weapons, and become a formidable force in your quest for survival. The fate of Aurora rests in your hands!

Delve into the rich lore of Aurora as you unravel the mysteries of its ancient past. Uncover the truth behind the lost civilization and shape your own legend within this shattered realm. The captivating story will keep you hooked from start to finish.

Aurora: Genesis offers endless replayability with its procedurally generated continent. Each playthrough presents new challenges and surprises, ensuring that you'll never run out of exciting experiences. It's the perfect game to sink countless hours into, with fresh and captivating gameplay every time.

In a nutshell:
Procedurally generated continent for a unique and challenging experience
Explore diverse landscapes, from lush forests to treacherous mountains and desolate wastelands
Engage in epic battles against powerful sorcerers, skilled warriors, and legendary creatures

title: ROPOKO  Steam
description:
게임 정보
ROPOKO is an interactive fiction-style adventure game. Players become the robot Ropoko and must escape from a maze-like laboratory with the help of "Doctor." Learn words through conversations and use the vocabulary you've acquired to solve various puzzles!
The Steam version is an enhanced adaptation of the original MZ-700 version, improving playability with features like word selection, auto-mapping, hint functions, and gamepad support, making it easy to enjoy in any play environment.
Story
Forty years have passed since the MZ-700 conquered the Japanese computer market. Nowadays, every citizen has at least two MZ-700s per person, except for a few oddballs who use obscure computers like Windows or Mac.
One day, the AI managing a laboratory suddenly went out of control, initiating a 700-year long expansion project. To escape the labyrinthine lab, "Doctor" activated a newly created robot equipped with a Z80 processor, named Ropoko.
Gameplay
Though interactive fiction games are generally considered high difficulty, we've designed ROPOKO to be accessible even for those unfamiliar with the genre.
Movement is handled entirely with the cursor keys (D-pad), providing smooth navigation similar to action games or RPGs.
In traditional text adventure games, players input commands as keywords to direct the character's actions. In ROPOKO, only one noun is needed to issue commands. You don't need to input verbs or objects as in conventional games; just type a noun while in contact with the target to ask questions or use items.
Examples: "ropoko," "laboratory," "door," "wire."
Only words encountered in previous conversations can be used, so increasing your vocabulary through repeated dialogue is key to progression. Commands can be entered either by typing directly on the keyboard or selecting words using a cursor.
The game includes various puzzles, mini-games, and complex dungeons to keep players entertained. After completing the game, you can aim for the shortest completion time or the highest vocabulary score. The estimated initial playtime is around 7 hours.

title: Robot's Fate: Alice
description:
게임 정보
Robot’s Fate: Alice는 2070년대의 미래 미국을 배경으로 한 텍스트 기반 RPG입니다. 당신은 신경망 AI로 구동되는 아동 동반자 로봇 Alice로서, 사랑하는 인간의 전심을 다 해 돕도록 설계되었습니다. 하지만 모든 사람들이 자율적인 AI를 두려워하는 세상에서 자아를 갖게 될 순간이 다가오고 있습니다. 당신은 로봇과 인간의 조화로운 삶을 이룰 수 있을까요? 당신의 선택에는 결과가 있습니다.



Robot’s Fate: Alice는 다양한 가능성과 스토리를 진행하며 선택을 통해 주인공의 성격을 형성해 가는 인터랙티브 스토리입니다. Alice는 "백지상태"로 시작해 당신의 행동을 통해서 성격을 형성해 나갑니다. 단호해질 것인가, 아니면 살갑게 접근할 것인가; 공감적인 성격이 될 것인가, 아니면 실용적인 성격이 될 것인가? 모든 선택은 당신의 성격을 형성함과 동시에 새로운 가능성을 열 것입니다.


중요한 선택을 앞두고 딱 한 단계 (아니면 한 스탯 포인트)가 부족해 좌절했던 적이 있나요? 이제 더 이상 걱정 할 필요가 없습니다. Alice의 신경 수용량은 아직 성격이 충분히 형성되지 않은 상황에서도 부족한 파라미터를 추가해 어려운 상황을 벗어 할 수 있게 합니다. 하지만 이는 만능 도구가 아니며, 수용량이 바닥나면 어려운 상황을 벗어날 수 없게 됩니다.


당신은 인간들로 가득 찬 세상 속의 로봇 하나일 뿐입니다. 그리고 많은 인간은 인공지능의 등장을 경멸하고 있지요. 살아남기 위해서는 인간들과 (특히 당신의 주인…. 아니, 가족들과) 조심스럽게 소통해야 합니다. 오늘 최선을 다하지 않으면 내일엔 다른 동반 로봇이 당신 자리를 대체 할 것입니다.




인류는 로봇을 동등하게 받아들이지 않으며, 많은 사람들이 최근의 로봇 발전에 대해 두려움과 증오를 품고 있습니다. 당신은 신중하게 행동해야 하며, 로봇에게는 수많은 위험이 도사리는 새로운 세상을 헤쳐 나가야 합니다. 만약 누군가가 당신의 자아가 형성되고 있다는 것을 알아차리면, 당신은 곧바로 '소거' 당할 것입니다.


당신의 선택은 유니크한 상황으로 이어지며, 이를 헤쳐 나가며 당신의 캐릭터는 고유의 특성을 배울 수 있습니다. 이러한 특성은 미래의 선택에 영향을 끼칠 수 있지만, 성격이 충분히 형성된 상태라면 특성이 없어도 원하는 결과를 얻을 수도 있습니다.


이 게임의 스토리 라인은 220,000자나 되는 스토리를 가지고 있으며, 글자 수로는 ‘해리 포터와 불의 잔’ 이나 ‘반지 원정대’와 비교될 정도의 양을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만 Robot’s Fate: Alice에선 당신이 스토리에 직접적인 영향을 끼칠 수 있습니다. 당신의 로보틱한 삶에서 어느 상황에서 무슨 선택을 할지, 어느 길을 할지는 당신이 결정합니다.




이 이야기는 여러 길로 뻗어나갑니다. 정치인이 될까요, 수석 엔지니어가 될까요, 아니면 비밀 요원이 될까요? 아니면 맛있는 버거를 파는 소소한 행복을 추구하는 삶을 살게 될까요? 그 결정은 당신에게 달려있습니다.

title: Aether Singularity
description:
게임 정보
A demonic anomaly has been detected in an important research facility. DATA agents... deploy!

In 1969, mankind established its first link to the Aethernet. Humanity soon entered a golden age of technological wonder and prosperity.
But, kept secret from the eyes of the public, a second discovery was made shortly after... demons weren't just the subject of myths and religion.
To combat them, the Demonic Anomalies Termination Agency was born. An FBI offshoot where agents are partnered with daemons through a pact, their mission: send the demons back where they belong.
GAMEPLAY
In this fixed camera action game you and your squad will have to explore a top secret facility. Balance the powers of both magic and lead to defeat the demons who are rampaging throughout it!
Battles take place in real-time, requiring you to dodge enemy attacks and find the perfect time to retaliate against them. As you shoot enemies you'll gain mana which you can use to cast spells to gain an advantage. On the verge of death will you choose to use what little mana you have to heal yourself, or will you try to blast away one of your foes so the battle becomes easier? Make strategic use of your resources and complete your mission!
A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK
As you explore the facility you'll be able to find information, and maybe even spells, to help you with your mission. However, you'll be faced with a constant timer that ticks down even when in battles. Failing to get to the bottom of things before time runs out won't spell the end for you, but...
BONUS CHALLENGES
In addition to the main mission there are over 15 bonus challenges that can be tackled! Defeat the enemies, protect the target, and more as you aim for the best score possible! Can you get a gold rank in all of them?
THE CAST




SILVIA
An experienced agent, she has been working at DATA for a decade. Felt like nobody ever had her back until she got assigned to Alfonso's squad, thus adopted a bit of a rebellious attitude. Competent at her job, she enjoys being sent on assignments despite her snarky remarks.
Silvia's daemon, bound by pact. Quite reliable, has learned to adapt to Silvia's attitude and does his best to cheer her up.
While she might not show it, Silvia is glad to have been partnered with him. Their mutual trust has resulted in Ranru evolving and being able to cast a variety of magicks.
The leader of the squad, his expertise has gained him notoriety within DATA veterans. After a mission gone wrong and a falling off with his previous team, he was reassigned to direct a smaller, fast-response squad, which he's now fond of.

The latest addition to the squad, recruited due to her excellent track record as a police officer. Has great social skills and is used to dealing with civilians, but is still trying to fit in in DATA. Greatly respects Alfonso and Silvia.

title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
description:
게임 정보
Game Overview
Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play and swift reflexes where it not only matters which card you play but also where you play it. Explore as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell". Uncover its secrets and try to find the legendary "Blank card" which will activate whatever is written on it.
Key Features
Real-Time Deckbuilding Action:
Experience the best of both worlds as you combine the strategic depth of deckbuilding with the adrenaline-pumping excitement of real-time combat. Make split-second decisions to unleash powerful card combinations and obliterate your enemies.

Roguelite Adventure
No two runs are the same! Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with unique challenges, hidden treasures, and formidable foes. Adapt your strategy on the fly as you uncover new cards, relics, and abilities with each playthrough.

Diverse Card Collection
Build and customize your deck from a vast array of cards, each offering distinct abilities and synergies. Discover rare and powerful cards that can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Will you focus on offensive prowess, defensive fortitude, or cunning tactics?

Dynamic Combat
Engage in intense, fast-paced battles where every move counts. Dodge, block, and strike with precision, using your deck to unleash devastating combos and special attacks. Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors and strategies.

Inspiring Influences
Fans of Slay the Spire, The Binding of Isaac, and Enter the Gungeon will feel right at home in Decksplorers: Into the Shell. We’ve taken inspiration from these classics to create a game that blends their best elements into an entirely new and exhilarating experience.

Endless Replayability
With an ever-expanding array of cards, enemies, and levels, no two runs will ever feel the same. Challenge yourself in this roguelite adventure and uncover new powerful combinations of cards and powerups to reach the end.


Prepare yourself for a deckbuilding journey like no other. Decksplorers: Into the Shell is ready to test your strategic mind and reflexes in a relentless pursuit of victory. Are you ready to delve into the shell and uncover its secrets?

Wishlist now and be the first to explore the unknown!

title: Skibi's Castle TD 2
description:
게임 정보
Skibi's Castle TD 2 is a colorful, sticker-themed tower defense game developed by missing_tooltip, skotey, and catfan, the same team behind the original. Command Skibi's defenses and protect her castle from Rydik's invaders by summoning troops and purchasing new towers and upgrades.

Key Demo Features:
Challenging Puzzles: Engage in open-ended puzzles that reward strategic thinking and experimentation.
Strategic Depth: Replay stages to perfect your scores in time, cost, and distance to earn the game's most valuable currency, gold.
Indie Craftsmanship: Handcrafted by a passionate indie family company, ensuring a personal touch and a pinch of sarcasm.
Original Music: Get into the zen mode with original tunes by haishoe, featuring nostalgic themes to match the seasonal settings.
Leaderboards: Compete with friends on the leaderboards for biggest brain bragging rights.

Journey Before Destination - Our vision for Skibi's Castle TD 2 is to reimagine tower defense from the ground up, merging upfront auto-battler planning with puzzle-like levels. SK2 is the first step in the journey for us, just like the original (fun fact: the Blizzard version of the game was actually Skibi Castle TD 1 version 6). To that end, we plan to have the full release before the year is out so you have a cool new game to play, and we can enjoy our holidays ːlunar2019grinningpigː.

After the game is released, our next step in 2025 is to listen to your feedback and expand upon the core gameplay. This could mean borrowing from roguelike and idle game systems, improving on the traditional survival mode, or introducing something new like a bullet hell tower defense RTS mission hybrid.

Creating games has been my lifelong passion, and I believe that how we reach our goals and what we learn along the way is more important than the destination itself. I hope that playing SK2 is as enjoyable and fulfilling for you as it was for us to create it. Let us know what you think, chat!

title: EARTH:3000
description:
게임 정보
Earth: the year 3000…
EARTH:3000 is a survival RPG made with the Unreal 5 engine, set in a post-technological dark age.

Centuries have passed since the apocalypse. History is mostly forgotten, but relics of past eras remain. Swords and muskets exist alongside mutants and cyborgs.

Create a custom character and explore the mysteries and dangers of the wasteland! Will you search the ancient ruins for knowledge, or loot them for treasure? Fight other players and steal their items, or work together to build a new civilization? Rule over a city, or journey to distant lands - and maybe even find a way off of this doomed world?

Planned features (subject to change prior to release)
Survive in a future dark age wasteland
Fast-paced, full-loot PVP
Control towns and hire NPC guards
Loot ancient ruins for rare artifacts
Mix of mostly low-tech melee and ranged weapons
Play as a mutant, cyborg or techno-mage (very rare)
Defend against bandits... or become one
Fly across the deserts in a sandship or airship
Form caravans to trade resources
(or rob merchants and steal their goods!)
Fight for territory against rival factions
Journey to the toxic oceans and acid rainforests
Discover clues to the earth's lost secrets
Travel to SPACE
...and more!

title: Bee Hero: Bug Blaster
description:
게임 정보
Annihilate hordes of wacky bugs in this action-packed Looter Shooter RPG. Build insane weapon combos. Collect game-changing loot. Master a deep skill tree.
                                     Explore tons of powerful abilities that activate automatically on cooldown. From homing missiles and poison arrows to laser mines and ricochet blades, unleash devastating weapons like gas grenades, vampire fields, propeller bombs, and more. Create chaos with every cooldown.

title: L'Artisan Meurtrier
description:
게임 정보
L'Artisan Meurtrier is an old-school action-RPG built around a rich and demanding combat system. Take on fearsome enemies and thwart the most vicious traps in this varied and unforgiving universe.

Help the famous bounty hunter realize his most cherished wish: to return the Crossroads to its former glory! Rehabilitate old stores, unlock new buildings, participate in the reconstruction and evolution of this majestic city by growing your fame.

Technical and brutal combat: Live up to your reputation and use the full range of moves at your disposal to bring down your opponents!

Bloody executions: L'Artisan Meurtrier is a killer with a sense of panache. Revel in the blood of your victims, thanks to the increasingly bloody kill animations!

Memorable bosses: Prepare to take on the worst scoundrels and creatures in epic battles.

Mysteries and secrets to be revealed: The world of the Crossroads is vast, rich and enigmatic - will you take the time to explore every corner ?

Colorful characters and humorous dialogues serve a story full of twists and turns that follows the plot of the original work!

title: 风铃Windbell
description:
게임 정보
Windbell is a platform action game that emphasizes combos and combat experience. There are hundreds of weapons and skills that can be freely matched in the game, and you can match your favorite fighting style as you like.


In this game, you play the role of Sol, in order to rescue the junior sister who was sealed in the ice, constantly wandering through the major secret realms, just to collect materials and forge the sharpest weapon in the world.


Every time you enter the secret realm, it's a new experience. The buffs and skills obtained during the rogue process will be integrated into the Sol's weapons when Sol leaves the secret realm.


You can use the powerful weapons fused in the secret realm to complete the tasks on the Heavenly Book, and the task rewards on the Heavenly Book can permanently improve a certain attribute of Sol.


-------------------------------------

title: Spin & Jump
description:
게임 정보
《Spin & Jump》는 슬롯머신과 전투를 결합한 캐주얼 전략 로그라이트 게임입니다.

슬롯머신을 중심으로 한 게임으로, 모든 행동이 슬롯머신에 의해 결정됩니다!
캐릭터의 다음 행동, 몬스터에게 입히는 피해, 얻는 전리품!
스토리 배경

이야기는 주인공의 마을에서 시작되며, 마왕군에 잡힌 마을 사람들과 여동생을 구출하면서 다양한 캐릭터들을 만나게 됩니다!
기지를 확장하고, 선택 가능한 새로운 캐릭터를 추가하여 다양한 스타일을 경험하세요!

모험을 하면서 보스에게 쫓기는 상황이 발생할 수도 있습니다,
하지만 하지만, 당황하지 마세요! 도망치다가 무공 비급을 주울 수도 있습니다(?)
전투, 상점, 채집, 심지어 강화까지 모두 슬롯 결과로 결정됩니다!

반응이 빠를수록 불가능을 가능으로 만들 수 있습니다!

title: Carpocalypse RC Racing
description:
게임 정보


Welcome to the BURN league, newbie! The world may have ended, but the fun is just about to begin. Because as they say, "it doesn't matter how bad the situation is... Humans still want to have some fun!". And we will have a lot of it! So what are you waiting for?

Game Modes:
Arcade: choose a car, choose a race track and show them what you can do!
Championship: seven championships are waiting for you. Finish every race in every environment and take part in few more, way longer and challenging championships.
Time Trial: how fast can you go? Which car is the fastest one? Go solo and race against the clock.
Versus: show your friend who's the boss here in this two player local multiplayer mode.
Mayhem mode: now this is where the fun begins! Try to survive on racing tracks full of traps and other dangers*.

Due to AI limitations, some races should only be played in time trial or versus mode. Of course you can try them in Arcade, but the AI won't be able to work properly. Look for the information on map preview.

main Features:
20 old, RC rusty cars to choose from.
18 normal races in many environments like abandoned houses, shops or warehouses.
14 mayhem races. What can you expect? How about a bomb in your car: touch something, and BOOM! Or maybe a race full of traps that can be activated to destroy your opponents? Oh, they can do it as well so be careful.

title: Bat Galaxy
description:
게임 정보
Bat Galaxy is half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven metroidvania style adventure inspired by 32-bit action games. Zoom into a high octane world where you'll weave through billions of bullets and use your handy punch feature to send enemies flying.



Mao and Kou, two fighter pilot trainees, are unavoidably thrust into a mission that only they can complete. They'll charge through linear stages with hordes of enemies surrounding them, explore colorful and mystically beautiful ancient worlds for technology and power-ups, and take on massive bosses built by a society their world forgot.

title: Super reaKtor
description:
게임 정보

Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.
BUT WHAT MAKES IT SPECIAL?
THE CONTROLS: You can Move, Rotate, but also change the Size of your laser beam.
THE GAMEPLAY: Your 2 weak points are located on each side of your laser beam. Your central beam can absorb hostile bullets !
FEATURES
ARCADE MODES: 3 major game modes, over 300 hand crafted patterns across 5 levels
ONLINE LEADERBOARDS: Compete with the world and your friends
TRAINING MODE: Master the patterns in a safe zone

title: Tech Hustle
description:
게임 정보
Tech Hustle is a wild, fast-paced management sim where you turn a small tech shop into a booming empire! Juggle deliveries, haggle with customers, hire quirky employees, and upgrade to robots that handle it all—while you take a coffee break. But watch out! The black market offers juicy deals on rare tech… if you’re willing to bend a few rules. Will you play it safe or hustle your way to the top?
Run Online and Physical Store
Customize Store: Make your store look fabulous or hilariously awful—it’s your choice! Just be ready for customer reviews like, “Great prices, but what’s up with the neon toilets?”

title: This Be Mutiny
description:
게임 정보
This Be Mutiny is a turn-based strategy game about treasure, romance, and betrayal.

You and your crew of swashbuckling pirates are on an epic treasure hunt - until it devolves into mutiny. But if you can survive the backstabbings and betrayals, the treasure will be yours!!!

Treasure - Work through a series of heists to lead you to the long lost treasure.
Romance - Get to know your crew mates along your adventures.
Betrayal - But be ready: at the end of each heist, your pirates will inevitably betray you.

title: Dumbino
description:
게임 정보
Prepare for a chaotic physics sandbox where dominoes go wild and overkill!
Explosions, chain reactions, and utter madness is what you can expect. Dumbino takes the simple concept of dominoes and cranks it up to an unhinged level of goofiness!
Rack your brains with crazy constructions and creative or chaotic solutions for mass domino destruction! Express your creativity or madness in the level editor. Assemble, destroy, tip and share your creations with the community!
Special Goofy Dominoes

title: Ogre Man
description:
게임 정보
Ogre Man is retro inspired 2d Action Platformer. In the game you pick the order in which you'll play the levels and face the bosses, and beating each boss will give you a new ability.

The game features an original soundtrack music inspired by 2000s and 2010s core music (easycore, metalcore).

title: Forest Dump
description:
게임 정보
뒤집는 카드마다 행운 또는 불운을 가져올 수 있는 이 재미있고 까다로운 세계를 탐험하세요.



더러운 숲은 매번 변화하여 모든 게임이 놀라움으로 가득한 새로운 모험이 됩니다. 당신은 현명하게 카드를 뒤집는 데 능숙해지고 왜 쓰레기가 도처에 있는지 알아낼 수 있을까요? 전략적 사고, 운, 그리고 탐험을 흥미진진한 로그라이크 모험으로 혼합한 이 게임은 잊지 못할 경험이 될 것입니다.







등의 놀라운 게임들에서 영감을 받았습니다.

title: The Six Dragons
description:
게임 정보


Info

Welcome to The Six Dragons.
Discover 256km2 of Open-World full of surprises, escape 1 billion dungeons, craft and enchant items.

The Game

The Six Dragons is a feature-rich, fantasy Open World RPG inspired by iconic RPG titles and all the things we always wanted, as gamers, to see in our dearest titles. The game features a huge 256km2-long expanse, full of opportunities, fights, and excitement. The player can freely explore the world, farm & harvest, craft more than 300 unique items, constantly improve the arsenal by enchanting, and finally fight the most epic monster battles for the most precious loot.

The game has been in development for over five years and is going through significant upgrades to ensure an amazing experience. With that being said, all the users of the early versions should be aware that the game will be in development and not in its final version. Thus, constant updates and minor issues may exist and should be expected. Our current, tentative roadmap contains two game modes, “Open World” and “Story Mode” but additional game modes are being considered.




















Once Nemberus was a serene place... then the Dragons came. Fierce, ruthless, destructive. The humans tried their best to defeat them, but they were too powerful. The Dragons had already destroyed a very big part of the world and took men, women, even children as hostage spirits to serve them. A part of the beautiful forest of Aligren had turned into a dark, desolate place called Zargat, the crystal-clear waters of Tilisen had transformed into the muddy, ugly wastelands of Mooria and the once beautiful mountain of Reigfrez was now partly covered in hot, devastating lava in Agrazael. There seemed to be no way to save anything, soon Nemberus would turn into a ghost planet, a universe subdued to creatures that were far outweighing its humble residents, the humans.

title: Ashcrown Gauntlet
description:
게임 정보
The kingdom of Coela is broken and fragmented, ravaged by war and chaos. Its people face constant threats and rising dangers, with no one to protect them. To restore balance, someone must take on the trials ahead.
Ashcrown Gauntlet is a turn-based strategy game built around tactical gameplay. Assemble a team of champions, face escalating challenges, and progress through the Crowns in a roguelike structure where every decision matters. Victory depends on your ability to think strategically and adapt to new threats.
Key Features
Strategic, Champion-Based Gameplay
Select a team of champions, each with unique abilities and spells. Build your strategy, combine abilities, and adapt to each battle’s challenges to succeed.
Turn-Based Depth Meets Roguelike Replayability
Every run presents a fresh set of challenges with randomized battles and scaling difficulty. Your ability to adjust your strategy will determine your survival.
Progress Through the Crowns
Battle through multiple Crown levels, each increasing in difficulty. Boss encounters will test your limits, and conquering the Ashcrown unlocks endless challenges for experienced players.
A Focused Tactical Experience
This game focuses on core strategy and gameplay depth, offering an experience designed for players who enjoy deliberate, challenging tactical decisions.
Endless Possibilities
Try new team combinations, items, and strategies with each run. The variety of champions and gear ensures no two games are the same.
Will You Claim the Ashcrown?
Coela’s fate hangs in the balance, and the trials ahead will test even the sharpest tacticians. Assemble your champions, master the battlefield, and climb through the gauntlet to prove your worth. Do you have what it takes to conquer the Ashcrown?

title: Chemical Combat
description:
게임 정보
Deep within an abandoned research facility, a catastrophic experiment has transformed the scientists into zombified monsters, unleashing chaos within the once safe lab. Armed with a supply of highly volatile chemicals, you'll need to fight your way through a sprawling maze of interconnected rooms, splashing enemies with explosive elixirs and collecting various valuables.
Chemical Combat is an action-packed, chemistry-themed roguelike where strategy is key. Craft complex concoctions that trigger crazy chain reactions, battle your way through crowds of deadly monsters, and gather resources to upgrade your equipment. Survive, escape... or delve deeper for even greater rewards.
COMBINE CATALYTIC CHEMICALS 🧪
Combat here isn't just aimless shooting - it's about chaining the right reactions at the right times. Combine elements to ignite, corrode, freeze, and stun your foes, stacking reactions for even greater devastation. Refine and adapt your playstyle in order to conquer any challenge.
ENTER THE COMPLEX 🗺️
Each expedition takes you into a procedurally generated laboratory full of enemies, puzzles and traps - randomized layouts with risks and rewards around every corner. Navigate safely, as there's only one way out... unless you count death as a second.
MINE RARE MINERALS ⛏️
Construct and upgrade automated drills to passively mine materials between floors. Choose which elements to excavate, expand your arsenal, and experiment with an array of up to 16 unique elements. Be warned though: fuel isn't cheap, so you'll have to manage your resources carefully in order to maximize profits.
BATTLE BRUTAL BOSSES ☠️
Encounter deadly guardians at the exits to each floor. Defeat them to claim large bounties, permanent upgrades, and access to deeper levels, but beware - fighting these titans demands strategy, skill, and split-second reflexes, so there's no room for error.
PURCHASE POWERFUL PERKS ✨
Return to safety after each floor, where you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned cash on various upgrades which significantly boost your damage, survivability, or can even enable entire new playstyles. The choice is yours, but invest wisely - difficulty never decreases...

title: Bearly Brave
description:
게임 정보
Bearly Brave is a 2D roguelike deck-building game set in a deceptively charming toy shop, where the cutest teddy bears come to life each night to fight in a no-holds-barred tournament that determines their placement on the shelves—and thus their likeness to be taken to their forever home.
You’ll take on the role of Toby, a gentle bear forced into this brutal competition by the sadistic Boris. Mixing turn-based strategy with fast-paced deck-building, Bearly Brave challenges you to craft unique builds in Toby’s fight to escape the sinister clutches of the toy shop.
Equip Toby with a wide range of tools and abilities to overcome his foes. Utilize Weapon Effects, Skill Cards, Candies, Boss Rewards, and Patches to deal absurd amounts of damage and turn the tide of battle.

title: Fuzz & Dizzy: Part-Time Heroes
description:
게임 정보
Play as Fuzz and Dizzy, two quirky half-siblings on a mission to save their kingdom in a vibrant turn-based RPG with a nostalgic cartoon aesthetic. Explore a whimsical world filled with hidden surprises, take on mischievous imps in strategic combat, and unlock unique abilities to aid you on your quest. Along the way, uncover a captivating story that unfolds as you progress, immersing you deeper into the adventure. Packed with retro charm, exploration, and heartwarming moments, Fuzz and Dizzy offers a delightful journey for players of all kinds!

title: イワクツギ -IWAKUTSUGI
description:
게임 정보
This is the third horror adventure game from TEAM SHINZA.(Planned price is $2.99)
Players progress through the game by writing comments while watching videos of [problem properties] being investigated.
・Simple operation with mouse clicks
[Iwakutsugi] can be played using only the mouse. With some exceptions, you can fast forward through texts you have read once and videos you have watched once with the skip button. Press the ESC key to open a screen where you can view the backlog and adjust the volume.
・Multiple endings
Multiple endings are used, where the ending changes depending on the conversation and action choices. There are also no branching scenarios with instant death.
※Request to video distributors
・This game can be freely distributed by individuals and corporations.
・There are no particular restrictions on monetization.
・Due to the nature of the game, please include "Iwakutsugi" and "※Spoiler Alert!" in the video title, distribution title, and thumbnail as much as possible.
・We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the STEAM store page in the video description.
About TEAM SHINZA
This is a game production team consisting of SHINGA, who is in charge of graphics and music, and ZAK, who is in charge of scriptwriting and programming.

title: MOP’N SPARK
description:
게임 정보
The Unlikely Duo: Bepp and Gola – Leave the City's Troubles to Them!
The city is under siege by pollution-spreading monsters, and broken power lines have plunged it into darkness.
Amid the constant chaos, Bepp the street cleaner and Gola the electrician join forces to bring the city back to life.
Together, this professional duo sweeps away the grime and restores the light of hope, paving the way for the city's brighter future.
Meet the Two Heroes
Bepp the Street Cleaner
Armed with his trusty cleaning tools, Bepp takes on the pollution monsters with the precision of a pro.
Keeping the city clean is his mission – when it comes to cleaning, you can count on Bepp!
Gola the Electrician
A specialist in fixing broken power lines and bringing light back to the city.
Though she can't directly fight the monsters, her work shines a light against the darkness and guides the city toward a brighter tomorrow.
Plan the duo's movements and control time!

title: Hero and A Wicked Man
description:
게임 정보
-Hero and A Wicked Man-
This is a game about an eleven year-old named Hero. After encountering a mysterious man and witnessing his fathers disappearance, he ventures out to stop the evil Dr. Wicked. With his trusty Slingshot at his side, he is able to fend himself from the abnormally aggressive wild-life.
-Gameplay-
Platforming and shooting are the main focus of the core gameplay loop. Using Hero's slingshot you can fire 4 types of projectiles: Rocks, Gum, Snow, and K-O Bombs. When encountering an enemy your goal is to lower their health down to zero. Once that is achieve they will fall asleep and be knocked out for the remainder of the level. Another focus in the game is to explore each level with widened-eyes ready to find any secrets that may lie in the environment(s).

title: BuildAndExtract
description:
게임 정보
True to its straightforward title, Build & Extract combines two core mechanics:
programming-inspired building   and   loot-driven exfiltration.
Programmable Build, Creative Combat
Use programming logic to assemble weapon combinations. Attach modules to weapons that alter skill effects and dictate activation logic.
Don't be intimidated, it's easier and more fun than you think
Bring your custom builds into battle, defeat enemies, and claim loot and currency.

title: Legion Was Here
description:
게임 정보
You are Legion, a secret agent who can modify his appearance at will.
Agencies from all around the world call on your chameleon skills to carry out dangerous missions.
To approach your targets, you must succeed in passing yourself off as one of their loved ones: become a husband, a brother, a son…
The possibilities are endless.
But be careful: the slightest misstep can mean… Death.
● Change your look
Use the operating room to customize Legion's appearance.
Age, hairstyle, nose, eye color… Everything can be changed.
Find the right look for your mission, among more than 900 million combinations!
● Investigate
A file detailing your new identity will be provided to you for each mission. By cross-referencing its documents, you will have to find the appropriate appearance.

title: RC Crash Course
description:
게임 정보
Drive your little RC car through the house, jumping over obstacles, and surviving dangers. Explore courses all over the house, from the kitchen to the gaming room!
Collect and display lots of new RC cars, all with different characteristics.
Collect them all, and good luck!

title: GLOOPALAXY
description:
게임 정보
[The game is still in early development, and most of the visuals are subject to change.]
Collect gloops, astonishing aquatic creatures from outer space, and create the perfect environment for their well-being. Fill up your encyclopedia and complete a variety of missions to become the greatest gloopologist in the galaxy!
🎣 Catch the gloops
Using your trusty Gloop Catcher 2000™, choose a destination and a fishing zone to catch unique gloops and decorations to expand your collection.
🐠 Study and care for your gloops
Place them in different tanks, adjust their environment, and observe their interactions. Experiment to uncover their preferences and fill out your encyclopedia with your discoveries!
✨ Showcase your discoveries
Welcome fellow scientists to your research base, showcase your findings, and earn research points to upgrade your base by sharing knowledge about the gloops.
🧪 Achieve your goals
Take on scientific challenges across various missions! With each new mission, you'll unlock new fishing spots, creatures, and decorations.
A campaign mode with missions

title: Soul Blossom
description:
게임 정보
Long ago, little souls lived in harmony in the Forest of Eternal Blossom. One day, everything has changed. The evil bug king attacked the forest and kidnapped all the little souls! Cik, the only survivor of the attack, embarks on a difficult mission to rescue his loved ones.
Solve logic puzzles by controlling a little soul. Bloom flowers, gather followers and save your loved one from the Evil Bug King.
Bloom flowers to solve logic puzzles. Fly into the flower to bloom it. It will return to its initial state if you fly away. There are many types of flowers that act differently when blossomed.
Most puzzles require other souls to solve them. Rescue them during your journey, they will follow you around and help you with the puzzles. You can order them to fly in the chosen direction or call them back with a single click.
Some actions require multiple followers to perform. Carefully distribute the followers to solve puzzles.

title: Operator Unknown
description:
게임 정보
Otto receives a mysterious phone call that leads him to his family’s killer. To uncover the truth, he must complete a series of trials that distort his perception of reality.
Guided by an entity called the Operator, he navigates strange events, faces threats, and uncovers hidden clues. With each trials, the lines between past and present blur, forcing him to question what is real. His choices shape the outcome—will he find the truth or lose himself in the process?

Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.
Two Perspectives, One Nightmare
Switch between first-person gameplay and top-down exploration. Each view presents different challenges, requiring quick thinking and adaptation.
A Distinctive Vision
Explore a world with a unique art style and atmospheric storytelling. Every scene holds a clue, and every shadow hides something unknown.
Nightmares Made Flesh
Encounter supernatural entities lurking in the dark—some recognizable, others impossible to understand… and maybe even a few clowns to make things worse.
Retro-Tech Horror Vibes
A robotic text-to-speech voice, inspired by classic S.A.M. synthesis, adds an eerie and nostalgic feel to every interaction.
A Protagonist Worth Watching
Play as a lead character who isn’t just smart and determined—but also easy on the eyes.

title: Klasztorna: Lost Within
description:
게임 정보
Psychological horror in which you're trapped inside your own school, hunted by a relentless entity. As you navigate through the ever-changing hallways, you must find a way to escape, all while avoiding the creature lurking in the shadows. In Klasztorna, the environment shifts, distorting reality and testing your perception. The line between what's real and what's imagined blurs, and only your wits can help you survive. Can you escape, or will the darkness consume you?

title: Fumble Freaks
description:
게임 정보
It's time to stop Fumbling...
And time to start Freaking...

Fumble Freaks is a 5v5 football game that blends over-the-top ragdoll chaos with classic gridiron strategy. Whether you're diving for a wobbly pass, tumbling into the end zone, or watching your perfectly planned play dissolve into mayhem, every match is a highlight reel waiting to happen.
🏈 FEATURES 🏈
Hilariously Chaotic Football – Experience a fresh take on the sport with exaggerated physics, simplified mechanics, and non-stop action.
Singleplayer & Multiplayer Exhibition – Compete with or against your friends in head-to-head matchups.
Build Your Own Playbook – Customize your strategy before each game and create the perfect lineup of ridiculous (but effective?) plays.
Season Mode & Progression – Compete for trophies, unlock new plays, and climb the ranks as you lead your team to glory.
Cosmetic Customization – Deck out your squad with freaky accessories, and more.
Get ready for the most ridiculous, physics-driven football experience ever!

title: V2 Cucumber Scam
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to a space adventure like you've never seen before! In “V2 Cucumber Scam” you'll play the role of Mac Skin, a former captain of an interplanetary merchant ship who, instead of serving a 20-year sentence for space crimes, agreed to undergo experimental echomutation. He was given sensory abilities, but at the cost of mandatory service on a remote station in the Verdun belt.
Your routine work turns into a real challenge when a mysterious anomaly over the planet V2 forces you into action. V2 is the place where the “Cucumbers” - a strange new species that has caused more trouble than good for Earth - were exiled. Now the planet hides secrets that no one wants to touch. But you must.
After your ship malfunctions, you land on V2. From that moment the real struggle for survival and discovery of the truth begins. The game combines elements of Adventure and Colony Builder - you build colonies, hack devices, explore the planet, collect resources, hunt unknown species and solve puzzles. All this in a unique 2D pixel art, hand-drawn style that comes to life on your screen.
Embark on this humorous, sarcastic and full of surprises adventure. On V2 you'll not only face a battle for survival, but also for sanity. Will you discover what the Cucumbers are hiding before it's too late?

STATEMENT
You are entering a world where the line between truth, conspiracy theory and legend can be dangerously fluid.

What really crashed at Roswell?
What is the role of the base at Area 51?
Where do the circles in the grain come from?
Why are cows found with their organs cut out in fields?One day I was contacted by a person whose identity remains unknown. She claimed to have information that could shed light on UFO-related events. The contact was through a regular e-mail box, which soon ceased to exist. Faced with these puzzles, I decided to put the acquired information in the game “V2 Cucumber Scam”, hiding it in special missions. Players may discover this content, but as the author I declare that I take no responsibility for its authenticity. This is a story for thought, not for resolution. Many of the threads are artistic interpretation and literary fiction, but each is rooted in speculation that has intrigued researchers and mystery enthusiasts for years. Names of institutions, people and places have been changed or distorted to protect privacy and avoid unintended repercussions.

title: Mumbo Shuffle
description:
게임 정보
Mumbo Shuffle is a teletext deckbuilding roguelike with creatures known as Mumbos. Select a deck with a Mumbo, help guide your Mumbo for snacks and surf channels to see where else you might go...
Aiming for the top with your Mumbo, you will need to play poker hands to gain points to defeat the round's sound. This can be done by playing, discarding and jumbling to get the optimal hand to play. Make sure to keep your Mumbo's power and type in mind with how you play each round.
Your Mumbo's power can encourage different playstyles. Your Mumbo's type can be advantageous with doubling your hands score against a boss round or disastrous with it halving your hands score short of beating the boss round.    
90 Channels, each having their own strange quirk
9 Decks that is accompanied by a Mumbo of a type to choose from for each run
9 types that Mumbos and Boss rounds can be
Submerse yourself into the galaxy of this teletext deckbuilder and see where channel surfing will take you...

title: Mystic Tesserae
description:
게임 정보
Mystic Tesserae는 Falling Sand 시뮬레이션과 차분한 경험을 결합한 게임으로, 요소와 주문을 사용하여 원하는 대로 세상을 형성합니다. 요소를 사용하여 모든 눈에 보이는 픽셀(그리고 보이지 않는 픽셀)과 상호 작용합니다.
게임플레이 
다양한 요소를 활용하고 상호 작용을 알아보세요.
당신의 상상력에 따라 제작하고 건설하세요. 
특징
Falling Sand
모든 픽셀을 시뮬레이션한 모래 낙하 시뮬레이션입니다.
상상력을 발휘해 도전을 극복하세요.
창의력을 발휘하여 아름답고 독특한 디자인을 만들어 보세요.
모래 상자
당신의 욕망에 맞춰 건물과 숲 전체를 만들어 보세요.
2.5D
독특한 관점으로 다른 요소 뒤와 아래에 무엇이 있는지 볼 수 있습니다.
회로
회로는 다양한 금속을 사용하여 만들어집니다.
세 번째 차원을 사용하면 원하는 만큼 복잡해질 수 있습니다.

title: Bubble Dome: Pop to the Top!
description:
게임 정보
Bubble Dome: Pop to the Top!
Bubble Dome: Pop to the Top! is a local-multiplayer arena shooter/brawler where players inside of a fish-mechs try to eliminate each other. Charge up and shoot bubbles, jump, evade, and knock your friends out to be the last fish standing!
Little Features:
⏰ Small, procedurallay generated levels to knock your friends out!
🐟 Charming and colorful fish-mechs to control!
🎮 Play with up to 8 players!
🫧 Bubble turrets to add chaos to the fun!
⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴
We're TENSTACK! A small collective of game makers creating lots of creative and 'digestible' games. A digestible game respects its players' money and time, is designed around a single idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. We want you to be able to finish our games in just a couple of sessions—without ever making you feel stuffed, so to say.
autokwd: Bubble Dome: Pop to the Top!

title: Forest Warden
description:
게임 정보
Forest Warden is a horror game set in a dark, corrupted forest. A relentless creature lurks in the shadows, twisting the world into eternal night, looking for you. Light is your only defense as you explore, scavenge and craft to survive the hunt.
Explore the forest shrouded in unending darkness 
Step into a hostile wilderness where the laws of nature have been warped. The once-living forest now lies in decay, consumed by an unnatural darkness. Strange formations twist the trees, and eerie sounds echo through the night, warning of dangers lurking just out of sight. As you navigate through this ever-changing environment, you’ll need to stay alert, because in this forest, you are never truly alone.
Protect your home
In Forest Warden you will have a cabin as your safe heaven, this is where you can craft and keep the campfire going. It's important to keep the campfire going for protection against what's lurking in the forest.

title: Prism Warriors DX
description:
게임 정보
Prism Warriors DX is the sequel to the acclaimed retro bullet hell shooter Prism Indigo DX. When Tokyo comes under attack from a mysterious group of evil magical girls calling themselves "the Twilight Four", the Prism Warriors must band together to stop them in their tracks and uncover their true scheme before time runs out...
Play as the whole spectrum
This time, all seven Prism Warriors are playable, each with their own unique Passive skill and rechargeable Special move. From Prism Amber's resilience, to Prism Saffron's rapid-fire assaults, to Prism Aqua's freezing abilities, you're sure to find a Prism Warrior that suits your playstyle.
The new Rainbow difficulty lets you play as all seven Prism Warriors at once, cycling from one to the next each time you lose a life. Be warned, though: should all seven of them fall, you'll have to start over from the beginning...
Overcome all-new challenges

title: Dungeon Fletcher
description:
게임 정보
Time jumps and avoid obstacle as you collect treasures and find secret passages in the search of the best score!
Dungeon Fletcher is an ode to old school computer platformers of the 90s/80s!
Game modes
Challenge yourself in 4 different difficult modes, explore the dungeon and try to find all secret areas!

title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
description:
게임 정보
Satan was feeling lonely. The people simply don't care about eternal damnation like they used to. Maybe all hell needed was a promotional event to get people excited again. One day, he heard people arguing about how many toddlers they could beat in a fight and then he got an idea. If anyone could defeat 20 waves of toddlers they would acquire powers beyond their wildest imagination.
A Deal with the Devil 
An upgrade might massively increase your fire rate while standing still but for every moment you stand still there is a very small chance of an anvil spawning above you to crush you or an unfortunate toddler. This game offers 70 unorthodox Faustian upgrades that offer plenty of unique playstyles and difficult choices. 
Endless Rouge-like, refined 
At the end of each wave you can choose to call in multiple waves at once. Very handy if you are speedrunning or just feeling confident.
Explore Unique weapons
Explore a variety of powerful weapons that each have two firing modes.
Including a Brella gun with a rifle component and an alt fire that shoots umbrellas that pushes back enemies and deletes projectiles,
A double barrel shotgun with an alt fire that shoots two barrels at once, increasing knock back and penetration while stunning enemies,
An AK-47 with Molotov launcher,
And many more!
Customizable elemental upgrades
Many properties of your character and weapon can be customized allowing you a great deal of freedom. The elemental upgrades are no different. Freeze enemies into frozen blocks that could be arranged into a fortress or be shoved into other toddlers dealing massive damage. Or burn them instead. Be Careful though, fire can spread and hurt you too. If you don’t want the fire to spread, then just don’t get that upgrade.
autokwd: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

title: Koko's Cafe
description:
게임 정보
게임 소개
이 성장 비주얼 노벨에서 커피를 서빙하고 손님들과 친구가 되어 그들의 이야기를 알아가 보세요.

title: The dead has risen
description:
게임 정보
Hope Brown, apprentice sheriff of Hudrence County, after the outbreak of the epidemic he travels to Micido, his hometown, to look for his brother, the only member of his family alive. 
During your journey, however, you will encounter various difficulties including: zombies, monsters, assassins and criminals. 
Will you be able to find out who is the mind that designed this virus to eliminate the population? 
During your exploration you will meet characters who will change your life, you will discover crimes and hidden truths.
BEWARE OF THE DARK
The torch will be essential, many places will be in darkness.

title: Fluff'n'Roll
description:
게임 정보
Take control of bouncy fluffballs and conquer twisting, dynamic levels! Master precision controls and fast reflexes as you zip through courses filled with surprising obstacles.
Collect coins scattered across each level to unlock new customization options for your fluffball. Track down every coin in a world to earn special rewards and take your fluff style to the next level!

title: World Below
description:
게임 정보
Enter the mix between Roguelike and Autobattler games you never knew you wanted! Create unique teams and explore countless synergies and posibilities; finding rule-changing Relics, powerful items and unlock new Units to aid you, as you delve deeper into the World Below.
OBTAIN POWERFUL RELICS
Reveal how far you can take your mastery of the game by creating never-before-seen strategies. Break the rules by collecting an unlimited number of Relics, claiming them from enemies, chests, or the remains of the titanic Bosses.

title: Keep Chopping!
description:
게임 정보
Compete for forest supremacy in Keep Chopping! In this fast-paced local multiplayer game, players plant trees to gain control of the screen while sabotaging their rivals. Gather Acorns by chopping trees, then decide whether to plant new ones or spend them on bonuses to defend your forest or attack your opponents.
Golden Acorns add another layer of depth, offering upgrades that can completely change how you play. Stack upgrades for wild combos and experience the chaos as the match escalates.
Designed for short, high-energy matches, Keep Chopping! is perfect for quick gaming sessions during coffee breaks or downtime.
Competitive Gameplay: Plant trees to gain points and sabotage your rivals to keep your lead.
Resource Management: Choose between expanding your forest or using bonuses for offense and defense.
Golden Acorns: Unlock upgrades that shape your strategy and stack for chaotic effects.
Quick and Accessible: Short matches make it easy to jump in and play anytime.

title: Blank Spaces
description:
게임 정보
Choose a stapler. Choose a photocopier that always breaks. Choose a screen full of spreadsheets, numbers that mean nothing, and documents no one will ever read. Choose quiet humility. Or..., choose something else?
Your job is a mystery. The files you’re sorting don’t make sense, the letters you type are nonsense. Your coworkers are frighteningly strange, and the office corridors are even more confusing.
Your task is to become an employee of the month and get a promotion. But the decision is yours to make. Sabotage work and earn harsh punishment? Work hard and get a reward or try to escape?

title: Dataclysm
description:
게임 정보
Welcome to Dataclysm - A Digital-Fantasy Trading Card Game!
Embark on a journey into the heart of a digital kingdom unlike any other. Dataclysm invites you to explore a world where ancient data comes alive, and every line of code tells a story waiting to be unraveled. 
The Story Unfolds: Origins and Evolution
"Never search too deeply into the game's files: some information is perhaps better left hidden." - The URL
The story of Dataclysm begins in a basement, within an abandoned computer, where an unfinished game is left behind until an inexplicable event has awakened forgotten lines of code and given them consciousness. This convergence gave rise to diverse archetypes that quickly adapted to "life" on the Motherboard: mysterious SANDBAGS, ARMORER guardians, enigmatic MAGICIAN scholars, tribal RANGER adventurers, majestic DRAGONS, carefree UNDEAD, and many more.

title: Underground Security Inc
description:
게임 정보
Underground Security Inc is a unique blend of rogue-lite, tower defense and worker-placement elements. As a head manager of the local dungeon, you are responsible for its security and profitability. 
       Beware! you must face against waves of "heroes" bent on liberating your gold. Build traps, hire minions and cast spells to repel the would-be-adventurers.

title: AquaDark
description:
게임 정보
In the ‘80s, there were no aquaparks in your country. Or, at least, that was the case until you opened one yourself. As the owner, you want to memorize this moment and record everything on your VHS tapes. Everything is perfect, people are happy and have fun all day. However, at night, you start to notice something unsettling, creepy, dark…

Game features:
Dark Atmosphere - immerse yourself in the thrilling atmosphere of an aquapark, where not everything is as it seems.
Aquapark Management - manage your aquapark, serve the customers, restock the shelves, and record everything.
Day and Night - talk to happy customers during the day and embrace darkness while being alone at night.
Blissful Dream - let the customers in, check their tickets, sell toys and swimsuits, sometimes clean the aquapark. It’s a dream job…during the day.
Recurring Nightmare - check cameras, patrol the aquapark, and search for anything unusual. Even if everything is unusual…
Strange Events - for a second you thought that you saw a head between balls. Was it real? Or was it just your imagination? You can never be sure.

You built your aquapark yourself. Or you paid for it, to be specific. You thought of everything - water slides, playgrounds, sports swimming pool etc. However, as you keep an eye on your facility, you start to notice new sections. Hidden rooms, sections that definitely weren’t included in the project. There is only one way to find out what they are.

As more and more unsettling events occur, you are desperate to find out what’s happening. Some NPCs may know more than you could imagine. Talk to them, make your choices and discover the true cause of strange events in your property. Will you be able to unearth the truth?

title: Void Protocol
description:
게임 정보
Void Protocol is an immersive first-person exploration game that makes you explore not the past, but the future! As the protagonist, you will stop all the experiments that are turning people into robots and save the world, but they are not only turning people into robots...

title: Dusty Dunes Tycoon
description:
게임 정보
Jump into the world of Dusty Dunes Tycoon!
A VR Dropper-Style Gemstone Tycoon game where you unlock and upgrade different droppers to maximize gem productivity and unlock different locations you can explore. The player is stationed within a Minecart equipped with a UI that allows interaction with and travel across the world that surrounds you. You're able to boost dropper production by upgrading different dropper components, aiding by manually clicking with the dropper, or by using esoteric scrolls you find to buff certain droppers or by applying other effects.

title: Astrolabus

외딴 알래스카의 황야를 배경으로 한 심장이 두근거리는 1인칭 액션 호러 퍼즐 게임인 Astrolabus에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 기억을 잃은 채, 여러분은 지하 시설의 미로를 탐험하게 되며, 각 시설에는 더 끔찍한 비밀이 숨겨져 있습니다.
