title: Monday Syndrome
description:
게임 정보
Monday Syndrome is a singleplayer action roguelike where you play as an intern that's trapped in a hellish office. Descend into a satirical corporate hell, battling demonic coworkers with absurd office supply weapons in an endless, procedurally generated tower. Can you survive the eternal 9-to-5?
Unleash fast-paced, chaotic combat amidst destructible office environments.
tag: 핵 앤 슬래시,리플레이 가치,액션 로그라이크,빠른 진행

title: Tinymon RPG
description:
게임 정보
Wake up in an unfamiliar world full of monsters to catch and battle. 
Tinymon RPG is a new take on the classic monster-taming genre, featuring simple but charming graphics, familiar but fresh battles, and a new world to explore to collect both the Tinymon inhabitants and language learning cards that have been lost.
Where have you awoken? Travel through the land of Tinymon, battling your way to the top on a journey full of questions you hope to answer. Learn a new language through the flashcard system, the professor's cards have been lost and scattered around the island. Even though you are a new (and confused) resident, it's up to you to find them. Find out where and how you arrived to this new world through a story with unexpected twists.
*Language learning aspects are toggleable and therefore completely optional
Tinymon RPG features in-world, turn based battles. Run into a challenger, and battle right in the environment you found them in. Simple, but refreshing. Customize what parts of the HUD are in English and Japanese, whether you want to play in full English and ignore all language learning features, or mix it up and have a little of both. It's up to you to choose the experience that fits you best.
Language learning? Tinymon RPG features both English and Japanese simultaneously. All dialogue and text within the game can be customized to your liking. Tinymon RPG is a dual language game if you want it to be, showing every bit of text in the game in 2 languages at once. With the collectible flashcard system, you will learn new words and phrases on your journey through this Isekai inspired world.

title: Power Chips
description:
게임 정보
Get your mech suit ready and blast through the bots on your way to uncover why a new wave of destruction is sweeping the city! Power Chips is a love letter to classic 2D 16-bit platforming and shooter games that’s fun for the whole family. 

One of the many features in Power Chips is the crisp movement, specifically dashing, which gives players a burst of forward momentum. This not only speeds up movement but also opens up new platforming possibilities and combat strategies, allowing for quicker evasion and better control when lining up attacks. Additionally, wall jumping lets the player cling to and scale vertical surfaces, adding depth to platforming and enabling players to scale walls to avoid attacks.

You can attack the main bosses in any order. After each boss is vanquished a new a weapon will be gained, some bosses are weaker to another bosses weapon so plan your route wisely!

title: Cardalaxy
description:
게임 정보
Cardalaxy is a card upgrading game with 4X inspiration and
5+ different victories.
Upgrade Planets
Upgrade your planets with buildings to increase their value. Advance through multiple tiers of buildings, each with better effects and bonuses.
Research, Explore, Develop
Collect points and use them in each of the different systems to advance your empire.

title: Mitch
description:
게임 정보
In this story-driven art game, you’ll follow Mitch, who’s just moved to a strange new planet. Join her as she settles in — starting a new job, exploring the city, and meeting all kinds of interesting folk.
Key Features
Explore the city! Jump on the subway and discover each unique neighborhood.
Meet new friends! Develop relationships with a variety of unusual characters. 
Work for a spider chef! Grind away at your new job - serving sandwiches to flies.
Settle in for a heartwarming and introspective story. Watch Mitch as she grows and adapts to her new life. Face challenges, solve problems, and learn lessons as events unfold.
Enjoy open-world freedom grounded by a linear journey. Join Mitch for a week in her life. Each day is full of potential!
100% indie. This is a two-dev project with hand-drawn artwork and an original soundtrack.

title: JusticeCat 裁决之猫
description:
게임 정보
本游戏以动物拟人的形式展开，玩家扮演法官进入一场场不同政体之下的庭审，游戏中玩家的每个决定、量刑轻重都将在全局世界产生蝴蝶效应。
与其他法律游戏不同，本游戏的法庭与审判构建于三个完全不同的世界政局之下——玩家通过开局的选择，将得到不同规范之下进行审判的体验，并开启截然不同的故事主线及多个支线结局。每次判决，都有可能使周围的世界发生天翻地覆的变化，要求玩家必须谨慎处理每一个交互选项。
本游戏的玩法核心在于审判，要求玩家兼顾“政府满意度”、“民众满意度”及“心之庭”，政府满意度高低决定玩家法官身份的持续，民众满意度指向社会是否稳定，而 “心之庭”数值将影响关键案情的推进，玩家需要在审判时小心平衡三个指标，以达到游玩目的。

title: Sorted
description:
게임 정보
Sorted is an online co-op game for one to four players. You are a robotic chibi employee traveling across space in a high-tech cargo spaceship. Your mission is simple, to craft and send products within the various sorting stations across the known galaxy. Avoid destruction as you race against the clock, to appease customers both far and near. Work together with your friends to become the most effective sorting company or fall prey to the rival company Skull Express led by Doctor Diabolical. Keep your ship running smoothly and achieve greatness!
Machines
Utilize machines to help get the job done. Interact with the stamper, combination, and sorting machines to get those products out of the station and into the hands of your customers.
Customization
Customize your robot to sort with style! Make yourself unique by changing accessories ranging from heads, hats, eyewear, and backpacks.
Strategy
Find your playstyle as you take on the challenges of each station with its unique layout and environmental hazards that will test your very metal. Will you succeed or succumb to your rival sorting company?

title: Queen's Revenge
description:
게임 정보
Betrayal and darkness have torn the queen from her home. Trapped in a sinister parallel world, she must fight for survival, defeat her enemies, and push back the darkness—hoping to one day reclaim her rightful throne.

title: Kickoff Land!
description:
게임 정보
Kick Off Land – Where Myth Meets Strategy!
Step into a world where legends come alive, and claim your place as the new king! Embrace your destiny to build and defend a flourishing city against relentless threats.
🌟 The Journey Begins: The New King – Manne
Start your adventure with the first chapter, "The New King: Manne," and unlock new chapters inspired by myths and legends from around the world!
🎯 Your Mission: Conquer, Defend, and Unlock
Seize the land, build a powerful city, and protect it from endless waves of enemies. Unlock powerful cards to strengthen your defenses and gain strategic advantages. Combine city-building skills with tower defense strategy to overcome every threat.

title: Blades of Crossed Hearts
description:
게임 정보
What is Blades of Crossed Hearts?
Blades of Crossed Hearts is an angsty anime character action fighting game taking inspiration from Marvel vs Capcom and the Devil May Cry series.

title: The Otherworld Laboratory
description:
게임 정보
플레이어는 실종된 지인을 찾아 연구실을 방문합니다.
그곳에서 그는 다른 세계의 연구실에 갇힌 자신을 발견합니다.
연구실은 네 가지 지시를 내립니다.
- 이상이 있으면 왼쪽 복도로 가세요.
- 이상이 없으면 오른쪽 복도로 가세요.
- F호실에 있는 출구로 나가세요.
- 온 길을 되돌아가지 마세요.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
※ 이 작품에는 소름 돋는 표현과 충격적인 장면이 포함되어 있습니다. 이러한 콘텐츠에 익숙하지 않은 분은 주의해 주시기 바랍니다.
[다른 차원의 공포]
설정은 장난꾸러기 사악한 신이 만든 특별한 "연구실"입니다. 현실과 분리된 뒤틀린 세계입니다. 플레이어는 신비한 규칙을 따르고 출구를 찾아 다른 차원의 금지된 연구실을 돌아다닙니다.
※ 시나리오는 Exit 8과 크툴루 신화에서 영감을 받았습니다.
[실시간 영상/스트리밍에 관하여]
동영상 공유 사이트에 영상을 스트리밍하고 게시하는 것은 허용됩니다.
게시자 또는 제3자가 입은 모든 손해에 대해 당사는 책임을 지지 않습니다.
다른 사람을 비방하거나 종교적 또는 정치적 목적을 가지고 있거나 반사회적이거나 공공 질서와 도덕을 위반하는 비디오의 스트리밍 또는 게시는 금지됩니다.

title: Hell Drill
description:
게임 정보
솔로 또는 최대 4인 온라인 협동 플레이
함께 협력하여 깊은 지하 동굴 시스템을 탐험하세요
지하의 공포에서 살아남으세요
소리와 움직임을 감지하는 무시무시한 생물체들을 피해 다니세요
시행착오를 통해 생존 전략을 배워나가세요

title: Anime Scary Teacher 3D
description:
게임 정보
A day at school has never been this thrilling! Izumi Sensei, your ruthless teacher with a dark side, has been terrorizing the students for far too long. It’s time to teach her a lesson she’ll never forget—by pranking her at every turn!
Will you outsmart Izumi Sensei, or will her sharp instincts catch you in the act? Your mission: cause as much chaos as possible, and maybe even make her regret all those cruel punishments. After all, revenge is sweet!
Features:
Dive into a hilarious 3D anime world full of tricky pranks and surprises!
Outsmart and prank the terrifying Izumi Sensei, but beware—she's always watching!
Explore different parts of the school and unlock hidden areas for the perfect prank.
Customize your character with fun anime-style accessories.
Laugh, plot, and prank your way through this wild adventure as you teach Izumi Sensei that payback can be fun!

title: Hardcore Circus
description:
게임 정보
Hardcore Circus는 『슈퍼 미트 보이』, 『점프 킹』, 『겟 오버 잇』에서 영감을 받은 고난도 정밀 플랫폼 게임입니다. 플레이어는 숙련된 곡예사 Dik가 되어 악마의 손에서 형제를 구출하는 모험을 떠납니다。
게임 특징：
관성 기반 움직임
신체 절단 시스템 - Dik은 다리를 잃어도 구르거나 점프할 수 있지만, 두 손을 모두 잃으면 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다
무기가 없지만, 환경을 이용해 보스를 물리치고 적을 피할 수 있습니다
다양한 물리적 특징을 가진 여러 바이옴 탐험 (예: 바다, 우주)
회전 기어, 포탈, 톱날, 대포, 레버, 스파이크, 트램폴린, 공기 및 물 흐름, 떨어지는 천장, 가고일, 상어 등 독특한 장애물에 도전하세요。
중독성 있는 게임플레이 - 포기하지 말고 계속 도전하여 완벽을 이루세요!

title: Hero's Odyssey: Summoned into Ancient Greece with a Quest I Didn't Ask For!
description:
게임 정보
On one faithfull day filled with grief and despair the tragedy happens and you’re striken by a thunderbolt. But it’s not all bad, somehow you’re awaken on the beach in Dalmatheia - a world of ancient greek mythos, full of gods, monsters, but also kindness and companions willing to sacrifice themselves for the success of your mission. What mission you might ask, the one Zeus himself tasks you to!
Explore the land inspired by ancient Greece, Build a team, become the hero of your own story. And once you embark on the quest you might learn the truth behind your sudden appearance, behind your grief and behind gods’ war. It’s time to shape your destiny.
Take on a role of a university literature student - unremarkable, unprepared, and undeniably human. But when you're hurled into a war of gods, your hidden powers, gifts from Zeus himself begin to awaken. You’ll grow from a confused outsider into a leader, mastering thunderous abilities and swordsmanship while facing choices that challenge your morals, loyalty, and identity. Every path you take carves a different legend, and not all roads lead to glory.
autokwd: Hero's Odyssey: Summoned into Ancient Greece with a Quest I Didn't Ask For!

title: Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity
description:
게임 정보
Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity — is a dark fantasy game with a telling title. This is a hardcore Action RPG in which everyone can make their own interesting and unique build. An endless leveling tree, 50+ different skills, 2000+ skill combinations and an almost complete absence of restrictions will help you cope with this task. Become the new deity of this world, if, of course, you succeed.
One day, a woman died in a terrible magical ceremony in order to give birth to a being with potential similar to a deity. This strengthened her fetus and filled it with all kinds of magic of this world. The being that the woman gave birth to — is You. You will have to surpass the old deity, who was killed by the Devourer of Worlds. And make the most important choice: to continue the endless war, to subjugate the magic of another dimension and become a Devourer of Worlds himself, or to become a new deity protecting this world.
autokwd: Endless Leveling In Mycelium Dungeons: from zero to infinity

title: The Vast White
description:
게임 정보
Explore The Vast White at your own pace
Embark on a solitary snowboarding journey down a vast, untamed mountain where every run is unique. The Vast White blends exploration, storytelling, and the thrill of the descent into a seamless open-world adventure. With only your board and your instincts, carve through pristine alpine wilderness, uncover hidden trails, and unravel the secrets buried beneath the snow.
🏔️ An Open Mountain to Conquer
Ride at your own pace through sprawling peaks, frozen forests, and secluded valleys—every path you choose reveals new wonders and challenges.
❄️ Uncover the Mountain’s Mysteries
Explore every corner of the mountain to find hidden routes, and stunning landscapes that reveal the mountain's past.

title: How West Clement Was Kinda Won
description:
게임 정보
A drifter finds themselves in the town of West Clement, and it's knee deep in a dire situation. The town is going to be taken over by a big ol' company! And this drifter just so happened to arrive right on time to help out these citizens in need!
Play through 4 chapters of that shows the best of Clement County!
Relatively short, this slightly comedic game surely make you silently laugh in your head.
Turn-based combat with up to 3 other NPC companions that you love so very much!
Basic and easy to pick up, fight forces of bad and evil with your new friends! Use stats you crafted in the beginning of the game to take down anything in your path with ease.
Also those companions I was talking about? There's more than 20 of 'em you could unlock!
Unlock more than 20 companions naturally through playing the game, or by exploring the world between main-line missions. There also might be a handful of more harder to find companions lurking in the area.
Multiple areas in one of the dumbest parts of the world!
Explore the main place, West Clement or travel north to the mysterious town of Clement, or head into the plains and mountains of Amberlight County. Or maybe you like going underground? You can enter the dangerous sewers where your strength is tested in sprawling bridges and tunnels.
In these areas, you can meet all sorts of people whether it be: humans, civilized non-feral zombies, mutants, aliens, robots, and more + a few non-civilized feral zombies that will try to eat you. These people aren't the smartest but most of them will give you a warm welcome.
Build your strength by frickin' fighting! Survive by eating pizza and drinking soda!
Each battle gives you the strength to fight the next one even better but each fight will not be the same! You can fight a group of feral zombies multiple times but each time they will fight with a different strategy, or none at all! This is why you need proper medicine: Pizza. To keep you in the fight!
Amazing special attacks like Vomit, Super Kick, Skull Crack and MP3 Player!
Gain your own special moves by progressing through the game or get the help of your companions who all have their own unique attacks!
Made with love!
autokwd: How West Clement Was Kinda Won

title: HELI 100
description:
게임 정보
Get into your gunship and defend the planet from flying alien armies in this action-packed shoot 'em up game!
FEATURES:
Intense twin-stick shoot 'em up action!
Gamepad is preferred but also keyboard + mouse is supported
Battle in the air against aliens from outer space
Unleash total destruction with dozens of powerups!
Unlock powerful gunships and mechs
Special endless attack modes for the true hardcore shmup fans!

title: Project Horizon
description:
게임 정보
Players will be members of an up to 4 person crew. There are no assigned roles, so you'll have to communicate among the chaos and decide who will be:
Manning the Guns
Flying the Ship
Operating the Radar and Auto-Turrets
Preventing the Reactor from Melting Down
However, EVERYONE will be repairing the ship constantly as it takes damage throughout combat. 
When your ship takes a missile to the aft compartment, there is no health bar slider that gets a bit lower. Instead, the aft compartment starts leaking air, perhaps the oxygen generator was stored there?
It is up to you and your crew to decide what needs fixing first. Can your crew afford to take someone off of the guns to seal up the holes? Or perhaps you have plenty of oxygen stored up and sealing off the compartment is smarter for now.
Wish list and Join our Discord for Frequent Updates!

title: Spellslime
description:
게임 정보
Spellslime is a fast-paced rougelite adventure with chill and relaxing vibes. Leap, blast and spellcast your way through the Slimelord's horde. Gain powerful synergistic upgrades, summon the elements to defend you, and explore a world full of colorful, exotic locations.
Spellslime puts you in control of a weak but determined young slime starting a one-slime rebellion against the tyrannical Slimelord. Left with a magical inheritance shrouded in mystery and danger, you must fight to survive and find out the truth of your world.

title: Baoli
description:
게임 정보
Key Features
Exploration and Puzzle Solving: The player, as Arjun, will explore these environments, searching for clues and solving puzzles to progress the narrative. This includes finding keys, using dates as passwords, decoding Morse code, and potentially deciphering number lock hints.
Unreliable Narrator and Hallucinations: A central element of the psychological horror is the unreliable nature of Arjun's perception due to his drug use and the potential for hallucinations, particularly the presence and actions of his friend. This blurring of reality and illusion will be a key source of tension and confusion for the player.
Environmental Storytelling: The state of the environments, such as the messy hostel room and the dusty house, along with items like the smiling photograph of Arjun and his brother, contribute to the narrative and provide insights into Arjun's mental state and his relationship with his brother.
Supernatural Elements: The appearance of a scary ghost resembling Arjun's friend introduces a potential supernatural threat, further blurring the lines between reality and hallucination. The "fear meter" and heartbeat sound during encounters with the ghost will add to the horror experience.
 Email as a Narrative Device: The changing content of the mysterious email serves as a crucial plot point, suggesting an external force at play and escalating Arjun's fear and paranoia. The email also provides potential clues, such as the alphanumeric patient ID.

title: WOOL
description:
게임 정보
WOOL is an old school inspired 2d platformer that puts you into the hooves of Ewe, a fluffy sheep whose peaceful life on the edge of an island inhabited entirely by cutesie animals is disturbed by the pesky environmental pollution. Using a needle and your wool as a grappling hook, swing through a variety of urban landscapes, including a junkyard, a factory and the rooftops of a metropolitan city, in order to hold the polluters to account.
Explore over 20 colorful hand-crafted levels, each with distinct visual vibe, gameplay mechanics and unique soundtrack to boot.
Collect colourful beads and buttons hidden throughout the levels and exchange them with the ol' cat Patches for fun rewards.
Think Ewe got what it takes? Master each level and go for gold buttons by racing against the clock.

title: Zorezdra
description:
게임 정보
Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania set aboard a giant starport. A woman with unusual powers searches for the truth about her origins, and a way to finally free herself from her difficult past.
THE STORY OF ZOREZDRA
In a lonely galaxy, in a universe unlike our own, people speak of a great prophecy. As the age draws to a close, the galaxy will undergo a phenomenal transformation, granting incredible power to those within it. The time of fulfilment is approaching, and everyone looks forward to it with anticipation.
Almost everyone.
On an isolated space station, hidden away at the galaxy's edge, a mysterious woman lives in solitude. She's never known how she got there or why – none of what she can piece together seems to make any sense. All she knows for sure is that some in the galaxy hold a grievance against her, and only by staying out of their way has she maintained a delicate peace.
It cannot last. When the station is attacked without warning by an army of robotic reptiles, she is forced to flee everything she has ever known. What consequences will there be for revealing her existence to the galaxy she has learnt to fear – and what will be the future of Zorezdra...?
FEATURES
Retro-style action: Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a huge starport.
New powers: Enhance your character with an array of superhuman abilities.
Engaging story: Discover the complex truth about your character's backstory, and the galaxy she inhabits.

title: Frontline Command
description:
게임 정보
Join the fight and lead the offensive!
Frontline Command is an intense auto-battler roguelite that challenges you to build and manage your squad in tactical combat. Set in a war-torn world, you control a team of elite troopers, each with unique weapons and skills that can be enhanced through strategic synergies. The game offers diverse gameplay with over 25 unique units and  countless upgrades that allow you to craft the perfect army and adapt to ever-changing battle conditions. As you progress, you'll face increasingly difficult enemies, testing your tactical prowess and decision-making.
Key Features:
Unique Generals and Units: Choose from five different generals, each with distinct playstyles, and use more than different 25 units to fit your strategy.
Roguelite Replayability: Every battle is different, with procedural generation of enemy forces and strategic relics to keep each run fresh and exciting.
Strategic Depth: Perfect your tactics with a variety of unit combinations, leveraging synergies and powerful relics to defeat increasingly challenging enemies.
This game is perfect for fans of auto-battlers and roguelites looking for an engaging challenge with endless replayability. Build your strategy, test your limits, and see if you can lead your troops to victory!

title: Returnless
description:
게임 정보
First-person exploration action game, philosophical trip, and artistic experience. It incorporates elements of horror and roguelike. Returning is not allowed.
It walks you through your greatest fear and search to find meaning. It incorporates elements of horror and roguelike.
The adventure takes place in a post-apocalyptic city occupied by mysterious creatures. The game mainly consists of exploring and feeling this bleak world's deep and strong ambience, but platforming and shooting areas will also enrich the experience.
The game is constructed with procedural generation, so every run is new and fresh. Not knowing in advance keeps you paying attention.
Something unstoppable is always behind you, pressing you to continue forward and not giving you time to rest.
Most parts of the journey will require only the will to survive and move forward.

title: Princess of Frozen Flowers
description:
게임 정보
Play as Snow, a legendary warrior princess armed with her mother’s weapon, 'Icebreaker', and a time-reverting device, 'the Antikythera', in this strategic dungeon RPG. The fate of the world of Ouranos hangs in the balance—its destruction is imminent in just 3 days. But there’s hope: you can save Ouranos by collecting Angelic Power Sources from 3 unique dungeons.
Each day, you must select one dungeon to tackle. Each passing day the dungeons gain new mechanics and within the dungeons, everything costs time.
You’ll need to master your fighting class, leverage the Antikythera’s powerful rewind mechanic, and carefully manage your resources to uncover the most efficient strategies and conquer each dungeon in time.

title: Forge Together
description:
게임 정보
Forge Together is a blacksmith simulation where you craft and sell weapons for different villagers in the marketplace. 
Craft your masterpiece:
Smelt ore and shape them into the blade of your choosing. Add hilts to complete your weapon and ready them for sale.
Sell your creation:
Negotiate with villagers to maximize profit. Charge a reasonable price, or you’ll risk losing a valuable customer!

title: Snapshot Spirit Live!
description:
게임 정보
In Snapshot Spirit Live! you play as a jetpack-flying photographer named Katie as she hunts ghosts in this educational photography game with minimalist 1-bit-inspired graphics and a Game Boy-inspired soundtrack.
Play as Katie as she flies around a haunted forest to find and photograph a wide variety of cute ghosts and build her photo portfolio. Katie streams her photography and jetpack-flying adventures to viewers, and she comments on what happens each day!

title: Tessera
description:
게임 정보
Tessera is a serene jigsaw puzzle game where the puzzles are made by you.
Take a stroll through various levels and choose a view that suits your puzzling predilection, then transform what you see into a jigsaw puzzle.
Watch hot air balloons, birds and clouds move across the sky and use them as reference to connect pieces together. Sea waves, rustling leaves and shadows cast are more than decoration and can be used to help you piece together the puzzle.

Features:
Unique blend of walking simulator and jigsaw gameplay
Dynamic soundtrack that changes as you get closer to solving a puzzle
Reveal hidden paths by piecing them together, unlocking new areas to explore
Explore 5 fantastical worlds with unique visuals

title: Recurrence
description:
게임 정보
Recurrence is a classic survival horror game set in a cyberpunk world caught in a time loop, where time, humanity and technology converge in a spiral of mystery and terror.
Discover the truth behind the loop.
In a future corrupted by a strange signal, you will step into the shoes of Vera, a researcher who awakens in the body of a replicant. Explore a strange world that has succumbed to the influence of a cosmic horror. Solve puzzles, confront mechanical horrors and unravel the origins of the signal that started it all.
The loop changes everything.
Each repetition offers new opportunities to explore, learn and survive. As time marches on and the world crumbles, you'll discover clues that only exist at specific times and events that unfold in unexpected ways.
A classic horror adventure.
Recurrence pays homage to survival horror greats like Silent Hill and Resident Evil, combining classic mechanics with a modern take. With fixed cameras, brain-teasing puzzles and retro-style graphics that capture the essence of the classics, you'll experience a nostalgic and revamped horror experience.
Prepare to face your deepest fears on a journey where time is not your ally and every cycle could be your last. Can you break the loop?

title: Vicious Cycle
description:
게임 정보
Vicious Cycle is a first person Horror game where you venture into a dark forest by bike and on foot. Brave hazardous trails on your bike until the path is blocked. Then, explore abandoned sites on foot while solving puzzles and encountering supernatural creatures. Can you survive the cursed forest?
Survive haunted trails
With only your Bicycle light as a guide, ride through forest trails filled with roadblocks and Creatures out to get you. Be wary of your surroundings as they can come from anywhere!
Investigate the eerie Forest
Venture into long abandoned areas of the forest where mysteries and danger await. Uncover the stories of the people that were once there.

title: Crimson Skyline
description:
게임 정보
Crimson Skyline 은 2D로 펼쳐지는 높은 난이도의 아케이드 스타일 비행 슈팅 게임입니다.
진행 방식
Crimson Skyline에서 플레이어는 항공모함과 기타 전함들로 이루어진 적들의 물결에 맞서 싸우게 됩니다.
항공모함은 모든 공중 적기를 실어나르는 게임의 핵심 요소입니다. 이들을 신속하고 전략적으로 격침하는 것이 승리의 관건이 될 것입니다.
각 스테이지는 10개의 웨이브와 최종 보스로 구성되어 있습니다.
플레이 가능한 전투기
RAFALE (라팔)
고속 연사 가능한 더블 머신건을 장착하여 지속적이고 치명적인 피해를 높은 정확도로 가합니다.
특수 능력 "코브라 샷건"은 순간적인 반전 기동 후 산탄총 형태의 탄막을 퍼부어 전방의 적을 모조리 쓸어버립니다.

title: FIREBALL
description:
게임 정보
Assume the role of Autonomous Strategic Mobile Projectile No. 100 (hereinafter referred to as "No. 100") and strive to conquer the Facility.
How to Navigate the Floors:
Touch the black objects to charge energy.
In this state, press the button to build power and release to launch toward the pointer.
(You can launch up to two times with a single charge.)
Progress to the next area by leaping between black objects.
Once you reach the goal area, launch No. 100 into the goal to clear the floor.
NOTE:Some floors may differ from these rules. Adapt as needed.
Utilize various gimmicks and physical laws to conquer each floor.
Clear all 15 floors within the time limit to conquer the Facility.
Story

title: Ragnar’s Quest: Return of the Hero
description:
게임 정보
Ragnar Lothbrok, once a legendary Viking hero, has been summoned back to life by Odin the All-Father. In his previous life, Ragnar fought valiantly, yet his soul was tainted by misdeeds, and his spirit was forced to wander in the cold mists of Hel’s domain, deprived of Valhalla's glory.
But Odin saw something of value in Ragnar’s unyielding spirit.
And now, the All-Father has granted him a second chance - not only to redeem himself but to serve the gods in a quest that spans realms few have ever seen.
Our hero embarks on a mysterious journey to recover powerful artifacts scattered by ancient forces. Ragnar's quest leads him through enchanted lands, filled with magic, illusions, and strange creatures, his path lit only by glimpses of fate and the weight of his own redemption.

title: Peagrove Noir
description:
게임 정보
An Open-World to Explore
Discover a quiet island town racked by corruption, conspiracy, and collusion. Alone or with up to 3 of your friends, explore speakeasies, tea houses, dockyards, and more across Peagrove's 8 unique districts.
Meet the Locals
Immerse yourself in a world of colourful characters, risky rogues, and vainglorious villains. Townsfolk will remember you and your actions, so find friends, make enemies, and integrate into the local culture as Peagrove's newest detective.

title: Quirky Forest
description:
게임 정보
Quirky Forest is a fast-paced single player puzzle platformer. Help two inseparable friends to explore this wacky forest. Place the correct item at the right place, plan ahead, think carefully, this game is easy to play, but hard to master. Be prepared to be challenged!
A big inspiration for the design of this game is Nintendo. I believe if you truly enjoyed titles as Toad Treasure Tracker, Super Mario 3D World, this game is totally for you, thank you so much for checking it out.
The full game will contain:
35 Levels
4 Worlds
A cozy story about two inseparable friends 
6 Different mind-boggling mechanics

title: Unbound Drift
description:
게임 정보
Unbound Drift is a high acceleration physics game built around the desire for speed and the grace of elastic motion. Once you've mastered the simplistic controls you'll be soaring through space at nerve inducing speeds!
Physics Driven Mastery
Behind the simple swings and artful arcs lies tons of physics fun. Every obstacle is an opportunity to bounce, every corner an opportunity to wrap yourself around. At high speeds, even your tether is loaded with elasticity, allowing you to slingshot yourself to the stars!
